title: 车站的人性化设计
body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![zAK067NBNARXg5Xn_IMG_20260529_215337.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/snowli/images/zAK067NBNARXg5Xn_IMG_20260529_215337/zAK067NBNARXg5Xn_IMG_20260529_215337.webp)
![G3hs0VFTIr6sopxQ_IMG_20260530_141227.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/snowli/images/G3hs0VFTIr6sopxQ_IMG_20260530_141227/G3hs0VFTIr6sopxQ_IMG_20260530_141227.webp)
![LoKWI6XO9lvDdGqt_IMG_20260530_140907.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/snowli/images/LoKWI6XO9lvDdGqt_IMG_20260530_140907/LoKWI6XO9lvDdGqt_IMG_20260530_140907.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

那天去了东站没赶上动车，突然发现旁边有便民充电的地方，而且是那种插座，可以直接用充电器充电，还可以坐在那里边充电边吃东西，因为是有桌子和凳子的。但是我要先赶车过到火车站那边去。所以充了一会我就走了。

去到火车站那边，时间还有好久，一个半小时这样，我就看到旁边座位也有可以充电的地方，只是这个要把充电头拿下，只连数据线。这个就会充得慢好多。因为我的是快充，没有了充电头，就充不了多少电了。

时间太早了，我就发现旁边有一个柜子，里面有泡面和饮料还有矿泉水。还是太全面了一点。我就买了一桶泡面，八块钱，里面还有两饼面。然后我一看，这个面还不错呢。分量也足。旁边就是饮水机和洗手间。真的很便民和人性化了。吃完泡面我就感觉口渴了，还没发车，我又去买了一瓶矿泉水。3块钱。感觉也不算很贵。

还有就是我印象中，不同起点不可以改签。这次我赶不上车，帅哥说可以改签，我也是蛮震惊。最后从动车改成火车还给退了20块钱。不然发车了就退不了票了，然后又要重新花钱买票。那得多亏呀。

还有就是火车上面的卧铺，居然狭小的空间里面也知道搞个挂钩，也是非常人性化了，不然我不知道我的眼镜放哪里了。然后那个放脚的前面也是有地方可以放行李什么的，也是蛮好了。

以上就是我发现车站的一些人性化设计。欢迎大家继续补充。

title: [ESP/ENG] A punto de colapso / On the Verge of Collapse ☹️
body:
>


Hola. Hace unos días leí un escrito de una compañera cubana que me hizo reflexionar profundamente sobre la situación en su país y, por extensión, sobre la mía. 

Al pasar cinco horas sin luz, es normal sentir mucho más que una simple molestia: la angustia y la desesperación comienzan a invadirme, y me siento perdida, sin saber cómo calmar ese anhelo de vivir mejor.

Quiero aclarar que, no busco hablar de política ni religión; más bien, comparto mi experiencia personal y cómo afecta a mi calidad de vida. Espero que, este mensaje encuentre empatía en quienes lo lean, ya que, entiendo y respeto las normas de cada comunidad que restringen esos temas, pero aquí, en redes como hiveblog, siento que puedo expresar mis sentimientos sin ser juzgada.

Hive Blog se ha convertido en un diario donde puedo escribir \

. Es el espacio ideal para desahogarme sin cargar a nadie con mis problemas o temer ser malinterpretada por tener opiniones políticas diferentes. La realidad social y la baja calidad de vida están tan arraigadas en nuestro día a día que eso genera en mí una gran incomodidad e incertidumbre constante.

Quizás mañana despierte con mejor ánimo y una visión más positiva, pero hoy sentía la necesidad de soltar estas emociones, y pensé que compartirlas aquí sería una forma de aliviar un poco esta carga.

Les deseo una feliz noche, intentaré dormir. 
_________



Hello. A few days ago, I read a post by a Cuban friend that made me reflect deeply on the situation in her country and, by extension, on my own.

After spending five hours without electricity, it's normal to feel much more than a simple annoyance: anguish and despair begin to overwhelm me, and I feel lost, not knowing how to soothe this longing for a better life.

I want to clarify that I'm not trying to talk about politics or religion; rather, I'm sharing my personal experience and how it affects my quality of life. I hope this message resonates with those who read it, as I understand and respect the rules of each community that restrict these topics, but here, on platforms like Hive Blog, I feel I can express my feelings without being judged.

Hive Blog has become a journal where I can write \

It's the ideal space to vent without burdening anyone with my problems or fearing being misunderstood for having different political opinions. Social realities and the low quality of life are so deeply ingrained in our daily lives that they generate a great deal of discomfort and constant uncertainty within me. Perhaps tomorrow I'll wake up in a better mood and with a more positive outlook, but today I felt the need to release these emotions, and I thought that sharing them here would be a way to alleviate this burden a little. title: Rice with roasted noodles and mixed vegetables (Eng-Esp)
body: <center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23wX1BBbasJfLZ3BMgTV5Jr6ryJZ1JkkhpYZAM6W5fGjFGaxVnMh5RmCec1ZLnTZpbbrH.png)</center>\n\n* Good evening friends, I hope you had a wonderful Saturday! This time, I'll explain how to prepare a delicious \

This recipe is very versatile; you can use it to accompany countless dishes: grilled chicken, baked fish, ground beef, smoked pork chops... I hope you enjoy the process of making this tasty and colorful recipe. Let's get started!

>* Buenas noches amigos, espero que hayan pasado un sábado genial! En esta ocasión, les explicaré como preparar un apetitoso \

. 
Esta receta es muy versátil, pueden utilizar para acompañar infinidad de platillos: pollo a la plancha, pescado al horno, carne molida, chuletas ahumadas... Espero disfruten el proceso de esta sabrosa y colorida receta, empecemos! 

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23w2urwJ3kSbs1sk3tLDdRjZp5kxMwD4zMnjjF62UeHtnnuy6TwaVy5mV5fUgNXfgFmtS.png)</center>

* INGREDIENTS: zucchini, carrot, bell pepper (red or green), onion, garlic cloves, noodles, black pepper, mild olive oil, butter, black pepper, oregano powder, rice and salt to taste.

>* INGREDIENTES: calabacín, zanahoria, pimiento (rojo o verde), cebolla, dientes de ajo, fideos, pimienta negra, aceite de oliva suave, mantequilla, pimienta negra, orégano en polvo, arroz y sal al gusto.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23tmU83NyCSPWSmsjkktN5NFzFMhbQPbkBAP2gYDuPg1cJctXRtran4caNvGq26dMmfp5.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/48b2jL8sv8Gkjtmq9RVyXAg3iyycjkj39buYZBC79QhBKeGqbpagUNzHhK7bKkXLaW.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23xL9JhopddoUsCRqaTEtKgqxQmLwE6onAaheTUDsZkBMZYFC926PZPWmrmmDsrr1hAkF.png)</center>

<center>PREPARATION/PREPARACIÓN</center>

* FIRST STEP: Toast the noodles in a non-stick pan over medium-high heat until golden brown. I suggest not adding oil; stir occasionally until cooked through.
Set aside for the final step.

>* PRIMER PASO: Asamos los fideos en un sartén antiadherente, cocinamos a fuego \

hasta que se doren. Les sugiero no colocar aceite, mezclamos de forma ocasional hasta que estén listos. 
Reservamos para utilizar en el paso final.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23wCGNWeb2SjxrCszFXcuTNAzpkDGq8DKeeQ3koqZoQn8H1AmEmTSmvY1NwTzBtcmHDpo.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23vsV3FEeSFCqQcHU1bPYZHxPSj9AcXspPXUPAVkDSzVnwSvHt4YcjC3S6NyEDotEW2CD.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23yncwzfeApbRvMAv8XBJPidTUw2NYbHgWFHCPQjT2a7anCsy5mDP4hbpSuNjXn3jwCwC.png)</center>

* Add 1 tablespoon of mild olive oil to the pot along with 1 teaspoon of butter... Sauté the onion, along with the pepper and the garlic cloves (finely chopped), sauté until they are slightly translucent (season with salt and pepper).

>* Incorporamos 1 cucharada de aceite de oliva suave al caldero, junto con 1 cucharadita de mantequilla... Sofreímos la cebolla, junto con el pimiento y los dientes de ajo (finamente cortados), sofreímos hasta que se cristalicen un poco (salpimentamos).

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23wMcgThw7cFHYwuxJNXwz1MjmHrMXeBDKhuMMaKL1LMPUyKnEGJePV4wswuV4tCgUZcq.png)</center>

* Next, add the zucchini and carrot (both diced into small cubes)... I suggest leaving the skin on the zucchini; this way it will retain its wonderful texture. Sauté, stirring occasionally, until the zucchini skin is golden brown.

>* A continuación, añadimos el calabacín y la zanahoria (ambos ingredientes cortados en cubos pequeños)... Les sugiero dejar la piel al calabacín, de esta forma conservará su maravillosa textura.
Salteamos mezclando de forma ocasional, hasta que la piel del calabacín se dore.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23wgSHMu7iCWiS78Vs9Vm8vK48kZwKr9GrvZox5msASF9UKs2WnoRyrQNXBNMi5xq3Fho.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23ywuigZAy8WSimnVDwGAxbDxzM2SU5g33Thh1yt8YwEdaXuZX41rkrnFg3gEcesaN4o5.png)</center>

* Add the rice and sauté for 2 minutes. Then add the reserved noodles.
For 1 cup of rice, add 3 cups of water. At this stage, season with black pepper, dried oregano, and salt to taste. Cook over high heat for the first 5 minutes, then reduce the heat, cover, and cook until tender.
The cooking process will take approximately 20-25 minutes.

>* Integramos el arroz, sofreímos durante 2 minutos... Colocamos los fideos que teníamos reservados.
Para 1 taza de arroz añadí 3 tazas de agua, en este paso condimentamos con: pimienta negra, orégano en polvo y sal al gusto. Cocinamos a fuego \

los primeros 5 minutos, luego bajamos el fuego, tapamos y cocinamos hasta comprobar que está listo.
El proceso de cocción tardará aproximadamente 20-25 minutos. 

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/EonnSXz6nQ8Mn7Z6k3ARdk1bTgLvV9sGSKHZNg7jGKPFPzGh5jujqAP7N3Sbu8CALnG.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/Eos3JeHKXvjeCQdBwQrL2qvce12cqro2FiLQfvoAHbaVpVHYTM6qSnccRPR2wFadMgW.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23zS7PaFd5SZTEsYDs9XdLyjvE92tXfnDBJVAGUDQY69VzsAnug1gRwgiXgCLqjSJpfoN.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/Eptby4UZWynwnYf2H1BCAHKVqj4uXGSqVNEDkSgEZxd1PGCg574BaidXUUwv2BwDuH2.png)</center>

an excellent option to share with your family and friends.
I hope you enjoyed the step-by-step instructions; I'm sure you'll love it! Thank you so much for visiting my blog. See you in the next post... Sweet dreams!

title: Una celebración de tradiciones [Esp-Eng]
body:
Una celebración de tradiciones [Esp-Eng]

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcpdQqhWbz1tfnytCikCb4an85uCGXgBCo6XKxf5KMDVA/1780196391553.jpg)

Hay eventos que te remueven las esencias, que te seducen, que te asombran... Esos que te hacen preguntarte cuánto conoces realmente de tu raíz criolla, de tus contemporáneos, de tu propio ADN. Eventos que nacen para dejar una huella, para marcar la diferencia, para darle una cachetada a la rutina y hacen suyas las palabras de Nicolás Guillén, el Poeta Nacional de Cuba, cuando dijo: \

. 
Una de esas citas culturales es, sin dudas, la Fiesta de Raíces y Tradiciones, el evento más importante que organiza cada año la filial de la Fundación Nicolás Guillén (FNG) en la provincia de Las Tunas, Cuba. Esta vez, por lo difícil que está el panorama socioeconómico de Cuba, no vinieron delegaciones extranjeras. Sin embargo, numerosos escritores, narradores orales, catedráticos, investigadores y otros artífices, provenientes de varias provincias cubanas, sí están en Balcón de Oriente entre los días 29 y 31 de mayo. 
Entre los participantes figura Ury Rodríguez, presidente del Comité Provincial de la Unión de Escritores y Artistas de Cuba (Uneac) en Guantánamo y actor con múltiples resultados; Pedro Péglez, escritor y periodista, Premio Cucalambé (de décima escrita) y líder del grupo nacional Ala Décima; y Yoandra Francisca Santana Perdomo, quien comanda la FNG en Camagüey y se desempeña como escritora, además.
Esta cita da vital importancia a su espacio teórico por antonomasia: el Coloquio de Presencia de Guillén, que ahora arribó a su 15 edición. En ese contexto, tanto en la sede tunera de la FNG como en la Universidad de Las Tunas, se comparten ponencias valiosas que se acercan, por ejemplo, a las desigualdades sociales, al racismo, al legado de Guillén, a la décima como estrofa nacional de Cuba, a la cultura de pueblos como Costa Rica y muchos otros asuntos.
Esta vez el festejo se dedica a Edilberto E. Agüero Rodríguez (Zabala) y sus Estampas Tuneras, popular comparsa que ha marcado la historia de nuestro terruño. Además, el programa honra el aniversario 95 de la publicación del poemario Sóngoro Cosongo, de Guillén, y el centenario del natalicio de Fidel Castro Ruz.
Interesantes han sido las investigaciones compartidas, con énfasis en el legado de Zabala, quien Darlenis Urquiola, directora provincial de Cultura, y otros estudiosos, han desmesurado inteligentemente, acercándose a historias y anécdotas no tan conocidas. 
Para los hijos de este tiempo saber que otrora alguna vez la comparsa usara una avioneta como parte de sus presentaciones y otras sorpresas, resulta cuánto menos interesante.
Que el primer hijo cumpla años casi el mismo día que el padre y lleve su mismo nombre y apellido también resulta curioso, así como que el progenitor (carpintero además de aficionado a la música) por cierta tartamudez inscribiera a uno de sus párvulos Vrigilio, en vez de Virgilio, son cosas memorables para el cubano promedio. 
En Las Tunas quizás pocas personas sepan quién es Edilberto Agüero Rodríguez, pero si decimos Zabala, ya es otra cosa... Hoy el Zabalero Mayor no está,ñ entre los vivos, pero sus hijos (desde la calle Adolfo Villamar No. 130, \

) mantienen viva la tradición a través del proyecto Zabaleando.\nEste evento, además de variadas y sustanciosas presentaciones artísticas (conciertos, recitales poéticos, exposiciones...), propicia que se ahonde en la idiosincrasia del cubano, el latinoamericano y el caribeño. Además, favorece la profundización en torno a la obra de Guillén. Pero va más allá. En palabras de Yoandra Santana, a veces lo vemos como marmóleo y nos privamos del hombre común, ese al que le gustaba el ron, las mulatas, la ironía, el humor... Ella me contó, por ejemplo, cómo Guillén caminaba las calles camagüeyanas (su comarca) y la gente le hacía fila detrás. \
, se pregunta ella. Y ella misma se responde: \

Es uno de los grandes autores de Cuba y del universo. Si buscamos el cubano más traducido ahora mismo en el mundo, es él. Está entre los más leídos del orbe. Si algo nos define a quienes dirigimos las filiales con su nombre es que somos enamorados y defensores de su obra\
she asks. And she herself replies: \
\nThe author of poems such as Postales de agua (Ediciones Orto) and Brevedad de ser (Ediciones Ácana), also expressed: \

That’s why being here is intoxicating. In book presentations, in the readings of poems full of stories, in the declamations that give us chicken skin, in the pictures with which we lose ourselves to another dimension, our Cubanicity is galloping. I agree with Yoandra, if Guillén were here she would be happy.

>
Hoy les traigo una receta fácil y saludable: pollo a la parrilla con especias. Además de aportar su color dorado, la cúrcuma junto con el ajo y el orégano aportan un toque aromático y delicioso tan buena para la salud como para el paladar. Te prometo que te encantará. Espero que disfrutes de este paso a paso. >Today I’m sharing an easy and healthy recipe with you: spiced grilled chicken. In addition to giving it a golden color, turmeric, along with garlic and oregano, adds a delicious, aromatic touch that’s as good for your health as it is for your taste buds. I promise you’ll love it. I hope you enjoy this step-by-step guide.
![New Year's celebration.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/23wCV7zAWZ8jHYtW7PvRiG7yG5wURG35R8XJpkk9JG76Y8CmMhLKHcm2qSE9JGYRbE14c.jpg)

> ![700 gr de pechuga de pollo, 01 limón, 01 cucharada de ajo en polvo, 03 cucharada de paprika ahumada, 02 cucharadas de aceite de oliva, 01 cucharada de maicena, 01 cucharadita de miel, 34 taza de a.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/243By7Q4o13YYCJBcoqzaBPSPNEf8J5vAJfZTda2nYoVdSj9ijV4kZFyJPm5ks9Mk58ny.png)

>
Lo primero que hay que hacer es lavar bien los trozos de pollo con agua y vinagre, y luego escurrirlos para que las especias y el aceite penetren mejor. A continuación, marina el pollo con las especias: primero añade la sal, la pimienta, el ajo en polvo, la cúrcuma, el orégano y el aceite; frota bien la mezcla para que todo quede bien cubierto y, después, déjalo reposar durante media hora, bien tapado, en la nevera. >The first thing to do is to wash the chicken pieces thoroughly with water and vinegar, then drain them so the spices and oil can penetrate better. Next, marinate the chicken with the spices: first add the salt, pepper, garlic powder, turmeric, oregano, and oil; rub the mixture in well so everything is thoroughly coated, then let it sit for half an hour, tightly covered, in the refrigerator.

A continuación, precalienta la parrilla, úntala con aceite y coloca el pollo sobre ella; cocínalo durante siete minutos por cada lado o hasta que esté dorado. >Next, preheat the grill, grease it, and place the chicken on it; cook for seven minutes on each side or until golden brown.

El resultado: un delicioso plato de pollo, perfecto para una comida saludable como la de hoy, que he acompañado con papas al vapor, plátanos cocidos y remolacha. ¡Que aproveche! >The result: a delicious chicken dish, perfect for a healthy lunch like today's, which I served with steamed potatoes and cooked plantains and beets. Enjoy your meal!

title: Challenge #04900-M151: Big Truffle in Little River
body:
![annie-spratt-RTwXZuKcOtA-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/internutter/23t7Di43DgWykmkTSqSijEXXN5XNtR1BUR9NL93kDNBtTmUjYJs5PNWReCwdHS1jaGoME.jpg)

> Two villages, once best friends, were viciously warring. A seer came to town prophesizing doom as both villages were to \

. The battles stopped. They lived in peace to fortify against the doom. The seer lied, and did not lie, the war stopped, they didn't die. -- Anon Guest

Swindon and Wallowdale had been battling over a pig. The exact circumstances differed depending on who you asked, but the broad strokes were thus: It was the _other_ side who stole it and it was their bound duty to get their revenge against those filthy pig thieves on the other side of the stream.

So far, there had been minor injuries, but things were bound to escalate. Clearly, someone had to do something.

These facts were completely lost on Maggart, who lived in the woods alone and had eaten a few too many of the interesting mushrooms growing in a nearby cave. That, in combination with a lot of equally interesting flora, resulted in her stumbling onto the bridge where both villagers posted up to have there semi-weekly battle.

She was quite the sight. Unkempt, clad in random rags and patches of leather or furs. Looking _exactly_ like she had stepped out of a cautionary woodcut about the dangers of Faekindred wanderers. She was babbling loose collations of syllables that sounded like they _could_ be an unfamiliar language. People kept out of her way and simply let her reach the middle of the bridge.

There, on its crest, she stopped. Maggart turned herself widdershins once. Twice. Thrice. All in breathless silence. She stood stock still. Rigid. While the townsfolk on either side watched in fascination.

Words rose out of her throat.

\

The stories say she disappeared in a puff of smoke. Or otherwise vanished without a trace. Mostly because of the fact that throwing up over the balustrade and then passing out doesn't make as much of a satisfying ending.

All that said, there was only one thing to do when a seeming madwoman emerges from the woods and spouts poetry out of nowhere.

_Listen_ to the warning.

Pitchforks returned to the fields and toolsheds. Clubs and staves returned to their everyday use. The contested pig, now fattened and mature, was slaughtered and became part of a feast central to the debate over what the prophecy _meant_.

Clearly, the main concurrence held, was that some outside threat would occurr to them both because they were too busy arguing about a pig that never really belonged to anyone anyway. Over very nice sausages, and more ale than should have been healthy, they conferred over plans to fortify themselves against whatever foe may be coming now that their ploughshares were ploughshares once more.

Some were sensible, like putting together a palisade before planning a wall. Some were... less so, like building a castle specifically for their shared pigs so that the villagers need not fret about thievery.

All while Maggart slumbered under the care of two villages' Healers.

She returned to consciousness in two days. Clean, dressed in servicable clothes, and a lot hung over. Maggart stumbled, squinting, into the sunlight to behold the whirlwind of activity that was two towns building a wooden pallisade around their shared border.

One of the villagers from Swindon paused when they saw her. \
\n\nMaggart boggled at them, at the frenzy of preparations, and mumbled, \

Which, after collecting her things and returning the dress, she did.

To this day, Swindon-Wallowdale is the most _impressive_ walled city in all of Alfarell. It boasts that it has never been conquered by _any_ malevolent force.

They just neglect to mention that any malevolent forces haven't been bothered.

On the other hand, they do serve a lovely pork pie.

title: Oatmeal Cookies with Peaches in Syrup (Eng/Esp)
body:
> Today I wanted to satisfy an afternoon craving for a snack with the family, so I decided to make some delicious oatmeal cookies. I also thought about adding fruit to make the experience even more enjoyable, so I prepared peaches in syrup to use as a garnish, ensuring that every bite had a fresh, sweet, and unforgettable touch.
![1000445530.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23ynUuvMESkWLYaq237YUm6dNwrG5EZbBTbqFUAj7rZrQXxb3REgmHAoJYxGXmGGmHPkm.jpg)
## Ingredients: - 80 grams of oat flour - 80 grams of wheat flour - 1 cup of sugar - 50 grams of butter - 1 egg - 8 peaches - 1/2 cup of water
![1000445427.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23xATTt7YkJWdV9unh9JeeoSpstp9Z96bfKcRyLdFCQD4KscGat73ECd8EeEJi3PN24j9.jpg)
## Preparation: I washed the peaches, peeled them, cut them into pieces, and placed them in a pot with half a cup of water and half a cup of sugar. I let the magic of cooking do its work; in fifteen minutes, they were tender and the sugar had turned into syrup—absolutely delicious. Meanwhile, in a bowl, I added butter and half a cup of sugar, stirring until perfectly creamy. Then I added the egg and continued mixing. I gradually added the oat flour and wheat flour, balancing the flavors as I went.
![1000445436.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23ywuckecw6dxUY3ghpt1wB37taQi2TK7UUMcBmfHBFiM1t1Kj4o5aicytoyJyaQFK7ze.jpg)
![1000445438.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23xehUuGJhi9gwYJR1xRgi1vg2ggJcFii538CFmxXimhYqsh39vmAZQ5ULx3ghHAMD9a8.jpg)
Once the dough had the right consistency, it was time to shape the cookies. I greased a baking sheet with butter and dusted it with a little all-purpose flour, then placed the cookies on it; I opted for convenience and shaped them into circles. I baked them at 250 degrees for 20 minutes. The cookies turned out crispy and had a very pleasant oatmeal flavor.
![1000445437.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23y8mjL83Su8BCBGHvggFewDGcLGnuk6Y3TDpmyauSSJHKgiX3NR3HHMX7b1MLhbgvGyY.jpg)
![1000445529.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23yd6F2J6AG7ZqAoK4fZ9FLkjigimc1cqtbQcRssCQQDoUyF1CZyM5kEgzY3BMe4GfP5y.jpg)
Once they were done, I let them cool for a while and topped them with peaches in syrup—a delicious combination that left me satisfied and delighted my guests’ palates. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> Hoy quería satisfacer un antojo en horas de la tarde para merendar con la familia, me incliné por unas deliciosas galletas de avena. También tenía la idea de agregar fruta para hacer la experiencia más agradable, así que preparé duraznos en almíbar para decorar y que cada bocado tuviera un toque fresco, dulce e inolvidable.
![1000445530.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23ynUuvMESkWLYaq237YUm6dNwrG5EZbBTbqFUAj7rZrQXxb3REgmHAoJYxGXmGGmHPkm.jpg)
## Ingredientes: - 80 gramos de harina de avena - 80 gramos de harina de trigo - 1 taza de azúcar - 50 gramos de mantequilla - 1 huevo - 8 duraznos - 1/2 taza de agua
![1000445427.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23xATTt7YkJWdV9unh9JeeoSpstp9Z96bfKcRyLdFCQD4KscGat73ECd8EeEJi3PN24j9.jpg)
## Preparación: Lavé los duraznos, los pelé, corté en pedazos y los coloqué en un olla junto a media taza de agua y media taza de azúcar. Dejé que la magia de la cocina hiciera su trabajo, en quince minutos estaban blandos y la azúcar convertida en almíbar, toda una delicia. Por otra parte, en un envase vertí mantequilla y media taza de azúcar, removí hasta lograr la cremosidad perfecta. Luego añadí el huevo y continúe mezclando. De forma progresiva agregué la harina de avena y la de trigo, así logré equilibrar los sabores.
![1000445436.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23ywuckecw6dxUY3ghpt1wB37taQi2TK7UUMcBmfHBFiM1t1Kj4o5aicytoyJyaQFK7ze.jpg)
![1000445438.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23xehUuGJhi9gwYJR1xRgi1vg2ggJcFii538CFmxXimhYqsh39vmAZQ5ULx3ghHAMD9a8.jpg)
Cuando la masa tuvo una buena consistencia, era el momento de formar las galletas. Entonces unté mantequilla y un poco de harina de trigo a una bandeja y allí fui colocando las galletas, opté por la practicidad e hice círculos. Llevé al horno a una temperatura de 250 grados por 20 minutos. Las galletas quedaron crujientes y con un sabor muy agradable a avena.
![1000445437.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23y8mjL83Su8BCBGHvggFewDGcLGnuk6Y3TDpmyauSSJHKgiX3NR3HHMX7b1MLhbgvGyY.jpg)
![1000445529.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23yd6F2J6AG7ZqAoK4fZ9FLkjigimc1cqtbQcRssCQQDoUyF1CZyM5kEgzY3BMe4GfP5y.jpg)
Cuando estuvieron listas dejé reposar un rato y les coloqué durazno en almíbar arriba, una combinación muy sabrosa que me dejó satisfecha y cautivó el paladar de mis comensales.   *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

title: Working with a sore back and little sleep.  My Actifit Report Card: May 30 2026
body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/f36068e0-667f-4172-8729-1444b4a33681.jpg) Well I'm back home which is good. I get up walk my familiar route with the dog and my wife which is good. The weather is nice and overall it's good to be home. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/d3e25ed2-738c-4532-9eab-c167f4b89b1d.jpg) But I'm so glad tomorrow is a day off. My body is jet lagged. Not as bad as coming back from the Philippines/Indonesia but bad enough that yesterday's post came out garbled. Sorry to anyone who read it. I absolutely wasnt at my best. To make things worse? I went to bed early hoping to get a great night's sleep... Except my son had friends over and I woke up at 230am... And couldn't get back to sleep. Sure it was almost 6 hours sleep but 230 is a terrible time to wake up. Today I had to work and I was dragging my heels all day. Still have blisters on my feet. Worse I had a sore back. I wish I know why. Are my pants too tight? Is it too much walking? Was it a bad bed in Edinburgh? No idea but trying to focus when... I've been away for a month. I'm sore. I'm sleepy. Well it just makes things tough. On a positive note. With very little up do at 3am I worked on getting one more park of the gld website ready. Hooray But I'll talk about that more in a different post. Was I active today? Well. Walked the dog and walked around work. Good enough for over 5k steps But it will be so much nicer when I can actually move well and go to the gym. Maybe tomorrow but it will be decided by my back and my foot. Still. I made it through my day at work, got my 5k steps and now I can crash for the day. Hooray.

title: Delicioso filetes de pollo con verduras en el air frayer// (Esp/Eng)
body:
---
_Feliz y bendecido día_ >_Happy and blessed day_

![El texto del párrafo (4).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23u6Dr8WRYgMScKg3SV4Tfji7eLnANA4FHwutCMgw6Kw2er1MVKZK5zH8LVs2KiQWQ3kf.jpg)

>


Hola, amigos, qué bueno contar con esta comunidad en esta plataforma, ya que gracias a ella puedo compartir mis recetas. Les traigo esta vez una receta muy sencilla y nutritiva; se trata de una ensalada alemana. Esta receta la hago con frecuencia en casa porque es la favorita de mi familia; cada vez que la hago, la disfrutan. Además, es sencilla de hacer y lleva pocos ingredientes que son fáciles de conseguir. Podemos servirlo acompañado de pollo asado. Espero que les guste. Aquí les dejo el procedimiento paso a paso.

> Hello, friends! It’s great to have this community on this platform, because it allows me to share my recipes with you. This time, I’m bringing you a very simple and nutritious recipe: a German salad. I make this recipe often at home because it’s my family’s favorite; they enjoy it every time I make it. Plus, it’s easy to make and requires just a few ingredients that are easy to find. We can serve it with roasted chicken. I hope you like it. Here are the step-by-step instructions.

---
![El texto del párrafo (32).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/EouEzXFRam7Qu5Er4T5yaxbebYHDJJvGYKKJedtHFWxqE5sXNxmydEWFdjp6DLSkUTF.jpg)

<div class = \
> - 5 papas - 1 cebolla morada - 2 huevos - Perejil - Mayonesa - Mostaza - 1 cucharadita de miel - Sal

> - 5 potatoes - 1 red onion - 2 eggs - Parsley - Mayonnaise - Mustard - 1 teaspoon of honey - Salt

![1000482288.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23yJNy6kJLZGSHbqvb2rd2JTNvEQLvryQJ2BKHGiSJ9KPwYw8KXpZE7tRH5P2KaNGwpbf.jpg)

![El texto del párrafo (31).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/EowNPiUud55yj2BkuDpKGUA8asqcUnP2g4hytTz9iUtwoeMREbopLjBeaQpT27KBKrK.jpg)
- Lo primero que hacemos es retirar la piel a las papas, la lavamos muy bien y la cortamos en cubos medianos. > - First, peel the potatoes, wash them thoroughly, and cut them into medium-sized cubes.
|![1000482292.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23yJSoGDrGeNbkEg2RdrHE3E5Mri64ZJg85b7CaprjHTY9K6Pq7JppuFexPYYXANLeL2g.jpg)|![1000482296.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23wgWMwbyuutiEPvapmjJRwqQUBRmwLeE5YYHH1YhnHuA3mfMmALrypBUcDFrVboGxwbX.jpg)| |-|-|
- Ahora colocamos una olla con agua en la cocina a fuego alto y colocamos las papas y dejamos cocinar hasta que este blanda. > - Now place a pot of water on the stove over high heat, add the potatoes, and let them cook until tender.
![1000482299.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23wMcLkBAYn5H7EjHHKLo54xHhbftQdxEKMR8SAeLaAxs3XLLpxd41UxFnTgytARVxuSc.jpg)
- En otra olla colocamos los huevos a cocinar durante 10 minutos. > - In another pot, boil the eggs for 10 minutes.
![1000482301.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23vsLbW7ZmvhRkuNEismrg4R53V8QtuW5dJuu7CS2BpuHoczHAYRLxKmgjDG9gB3RjdJm.jpg)
- Mientras se cocinan las papas y los huevos, cortamos la cebolla en juliana y la añadimos en un bol con agua; le agregamos sal y vinagre. > - While the potatoes and eggs are cooking, slice the onion into thin strips and place them in a bowl of water; add salt and vinegar.
|![1000482310.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23xVRCccqsffCeMhLLLQYUCDpEK5NDong1Kd4U4VZWu8wnKQ7R4Z5HNkDZT3rBerW3dzz.jpg)|![1000482311.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23u6BKaaow1maAuLPVb94vpngSCxwRPax1y7xnyUudyAyLELeieT3tah2iZgMfTc9Lwz8.jpg)|![1000482313.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23uR56xQAGeWXJjhL7vD85ocEXADjnF6oaLFfZ5QAR6BpT2XTsoeWaHLS8wWPHmEuAjxC.jpg)| |-|-|-|
- Una vez listas las papas, las añadimos a un bol; luego escurrimos la cebolla y la incorporamos junto con la papa. > - Once the potatoes are ready, add them to a bowl; then drain the onion and add it to the bowl along with the potatoes.
|![1000482316.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23wCJA8a1Mg7eh35GRzp5HM4PkR5iS6qC71gdSnp61mAmh9sEY5RqFtRS9BQRy8yLMEwL.jpg)|![1000482317.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23uFVrRLgbwmr27zJsM7kxoAa74hdFzUggypSZKFidSixVjPEWPMEQYbJRkUn3XpnKuVA.jpg)|![1000482319.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23xei2hALUKFLg8ms1PZYuPquTTHeRMgtsyERNQwG8qAQpn99pULouFznDcifaVymtkYR.jpg)| |-|-|-|
- Ahora cortamos el celery en pedacitos y los huevos cortados en rodajas. >- Now cut the celery into small pieces and slice the eggs.
|![1000482320.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/241tWyg1qWcAcZHjYeVs8PMwGyaj36Lk3PNtgJsHaQYtEi7M3B6PSGTC3irdEXCNwcT17.jpg)|![1000482321.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23xKzWDCCRvDFER4AYAJzqJBaWbAfV6GCtZ27ejaSiAVncgMh84FaLyw9WW4fBa9V1GnP.jpg)| |-|-|
- Luego preparamos el aderezo con mayonesa, mostaza, miel y mezclamos. >- Next, we make the dressing with mayonnaise, mustard, and honey, and mix it together.
|![1000482322.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23xpFCi3hf9p8Nn7NPrmri9dne7xcxMH2Lsh8MA3NmzLfhuRCbNNijbFJEyMrpogb3rRG.jpg)|![1000482323.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23zbaMEnL1qeAhFoUSkaQwXLUmKKQcVVh3s9qHbgdsyRdwuSwzpmynz6haNdQZTsjgUcp.jpg)| |-|-| |![1000482325.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23xVPDWAYxGubsPxer3z18ENRsi2aPMNZMzfGny8t2bX9ZVE7d6PYByBgkHrkZrrr9SeY.jpg)|![1000482326.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23yTomjKUz1jGr4ejSwTRob2BetAE3qhiGUNdFTXGkib2GAnap53tdeLohKuCqrm9H7tB.jpg)|
- Ahora se la añadimos a la ensalada y sal al gusto. Revolvemos bien para que se integren los sabores. > - Now add it to the salad and season with salt to taste. Toss well to combine the flavors.
![1000482327.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23uQy26mBFn3ZcZGfVkyLrGcMFLvheueDoP75p1yDQtKZXodjF8xHpWSQk6ZLCebvoB7X.jpg) ![1000482328.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23tmMkq1RaNWxZL91tmEcAREasCFBE818sgMLu6tdG9j45cKjKX8dDwrZkVy8H7h625HH.jpg)
- Listo está nutritiva y deliciosa ensalada alemana. >- There you have it: a nutritious and delicious German salad.
![1000482330.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23w2wjPEwSqxCLJsPE1BzTP3veybrB6oCcABH4Z1NcTX7rQ3x7QUGNkNBRxuGENutnh1W.jpg) ![1000482332.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23w2waFujSA6upr9TKf5iuj6poiuRCVisR1xFrwzRNUisEA2xNoHxDMkRWtAjUDS7Fnwe.jpg) ![1000482335.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23wC7vkXaTXz2yojvpmVLAcRCEi1cVpqfyEpPCvBeCf1uDgVEu1hU5nQa5xrK5JgYoaJe.jpg) ![1000482336.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23wMWc5vD8dwv5mPtDLK357j9Z8ZDEsFd4c8XQVeDugLHWvsfxstFoUHed5nrJfH5VRsF.jpg) ![1000482338.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23wMYNFzaYC6TCeAtdqTmqoriRXcmu3dw6ekBEGQSLFFGCzvsbDzRTBE9bTmDzVAQ6iKs.jpg) ![1000482337.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23wWvxL9W2BdmL9VR4tHGD2V9TuefrRFDKZJ6GTUVGQJHYr4spvvajWLjXRHzHjxtAoZ2.jpg) ![1000482341.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23tmQNYHJexiXz9f132TQRb9kfwvKcFLYaAkyKbYozyREZscApt1wRa7mC365Ri9EKTta.jpg)

title: We are growing in Hive with everything we have been learning ESP-ENG
body:
>

En el mundo de hive intento crecer estaba aprendiendo algunas cosas estos meses, desde aprender a cuidar mi cuenta y respaldar mis llaves hasta poder hacer una delegación que fueron cosas que desconocía pero mirando un poco en estos meses qué hacen los demás he podido conocer algunas cosas sobre estas herramientas que usan para interactuar.

In the world of Hive I try to grow I’ve been learning some things these past months from learning how to take care of my account and back up my keys to being able to make a delegation things I didn’t know before but by watching what others do I’ve been able to understand some of these tools they use to interact.

>

Es por tal motivo que ahora mis hive los pongo en delegación a cuentas que usan tu hive en stake para votar contenido de calidad como no tengo el tiempo ni el poder para estar votando, este sistema de la delegación es útil para quienes no entienden cómo funciona o el tiempo no lo tienen disponible.

Por tal razón mis pocos hive están en varias cuentas delegadas para poder distribuir a todos los que me han ayudado en este tiempo.

For that reason now I put my hive in delegation to accounts that use your staked hive to vote quality content since I don’t have the time or the power to be voting this delegation system is useful for people who don’t understand how it works or don’t have the time available.

title: Zucchini, plantain, and oat arepas served with smoked chorizo (Eng/Esp)
body:
> When it comes to breakfast, arepas top the list of options. Today, I combined three ingredients to create a new flavor: zucchini, plantain, and rolled oats. This arepa is very nutritious and delicious. Plus, the butter makes it even more tempting, and this time, I decided to serve it with smoked chorizo.
![1000118096.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xefJULwmSxqbgRKN8BnaKFQFmVgirBfXzCdgTnLabiNCx1zETLH7TxCrYNv3DDUmdvN.png)
## Ingredients: - 100 grams white corn flour - 100 grams yellow corn flour - 50 grams rolled oats - 1 zucchini - 1 plantain - 1 tablespoon sugar - Salt to taste - 2 cups water - 2 smoked chorizo sausages - Butter - Oil
![1000118082.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23yJT96QTjvQny5hs3xarNbsxZ7N7grNf1oieAkNCyLp4eip5NQivxQSsgU1dTAQduuzi.jpg)
## Preparation: I poured water into a deep bowl, then added the zucchini to rinse it, peeled it, and sliced it. Next, I peeled the banana and cut it into pieces. I put the zucchini and banana pieces in a blender along with two cups of water and a tablespoon of sugar. As I blended, the liquid thickened.
![1000118085.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23u67LBsLVzuykDgtrwaEChoptKrGK7LrRas9dtvyYoboza8XvBXCWP7uLaDq9K61s9kR.jpg)
![1000118089.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xyZHKgkhtkGxuiyxEvGiJJuk3g2BES7y39KYgpqZJjLf1eKpvPgBW3SjBZDhxdCnvfm.jpg)
I poured this mixture into a bowl, added a pinch of salt, and gradually added the cornmeal (100 grams of each color). I try to stick to this ratio because it guarantees a very smooth batter. Once the dough was ready, I prepared the budare by oiling the surface, then arranged three large arepas and one small one on it. I cooked them for 20 minutes—10 minutes on each side—to create a crispy crust.
![1000118093.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wMm3PMPio2NinnszHBbRAcJRWPTqP3dzt1NM2wJWcdHQKdJSJCa5CfH4fZzrCAKU66j.jpg)
Next, I washed the chorizos, sliced them, and cooked them in a skillet with a drizzle of oil. I let them brown on both sides and removed them from the heat. The final step was to open my arepas, spread butter on them, and top them with the slices of smoked chorizo. I enjoyed a breakfast full of flavor. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> Cuando se trata de desayunos, las arepas lideran la lista de las opciones, hoy uní tres ingredientes para crear un nuevo sabor: calabacín, plátano y avena. Esta arepa es muy nutritiva y deliciosa. Además la mantequilla la hace más provocativa y, en esta ocasión, decidí acompañar con chorizos ahumados.
![1000118096.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xefJULwmSxqbgRKN8BnaKFQFmVgirBfXzCdgTnLabiNCx1zETLH7TxCrYNv3DDUmdvN.png)
## Ingredientes: - 100 gramos de harina de maíz blanca - 100 gramos de harina de maíz amarilla - 50 gramos de avena en hojuelas - 1 calabacín - 1 plátano - 1 cucharada de azúcar - Sal al gusto - 2 tazas de agua - 2 chorizos ahumados - Mantequilla - Aceite
![1000118082.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23yJT96QTjvQny5hs3xarNbsxZ7N7grNf1oieAkNCyLp4eip5NQivxQSsgU1dTAQduuzi.jpg)
## Preparación: En un envase hondo vertí agua, luego incorporé el calabacín para limpiarlo, retiré las conchas y corté en rodajas. Posteriormente quité la cáscara del plátano y dividí en pedazos. Llevé los trozos de calabacín y plátano a la licuadora junto a dos tazas de agua y una cucharada de azúcar. Al batir el líquido se espesó.
![1000118085.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23u67LBsLVzuykDgtrwaEChoptKrGK7LrRas9dtvyYoboza8XvBXCWP7uLaDq9K61s9kR.jpg)
![1000118089.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xyZHKgkhtkGxuiyxEvGiJJuk3g2BES7y39KYgpqZJjLf1eKpvPgBW3SjBZDhxdCnvfm.jpg)
Vertí esta mezcla en un envase, allí adicioné un punto de sal y de forma paulatina fui añadiendo la harina de maíz (100 gramos de cada color). Trato de seguir esta proporción pues hay garantía de una masa muy suave. Cuando la masa estuvo lista preparé el budare aceitando la superficie, allí dispuse tres arepas grandes y una pequeña. Cociné 20 minutos, diez por cada lado, así se realiza una capa crujiente.
![1000118093.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wMm3PMPio2NinnszHBbRAcJRWPTqP3dzt1NM2wJWcdHQKdJSJCa5CfH4fZzrCAKU66j.jpg)
Seguidamente lavé los chorizos y los corté en rebanadas y en un sartén con un toque de aceite los cociné, dejé que se doraran por ambas partes y retiré del fuego. El último paso fue abrir mis arepas, untarle mantequilla y servir las rebanadas de chorizo ahumado. Disfruté de un desayuno lleno de mucho sabor.   *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

This is an insect and it can fly in the sky for a short time. It is a beautiful insect of the natural environment. The beauty of its body will be seen by any person again and again. This insect has several beautiful names and one of them is Handmaiden moth. When I saw this insect in the afternoon, I liked it very much and took some pictures with my own mobile to share with friends. This insect is quite familiar to me and is one of my favorite insects. Some pictures of this insect are presented in stages.





I saw this beautiful insect yesterday, with its wings spread out under the leaves of a banana tree next to a house, and it was sitting very beautifully and I enjoyed the beauty of this insect. It is actually a type of moth and it sits in a particular place for a long time. I see this type of insect occasionally and I saw a combination of different colors in this insect. It was very beautiful to see its wings spread out and I saw the natural beauty. I sat under the leaves of a banana tree and presented my mobile face up to take a picture of this insect. Anyway, I shared the pictures with my Hive community friends today.

title: [ESP/ENG] Healthy and delicious dish with pompano fish, fresh lettuce salad and pumpkin puree.
body:
> Un saludo cordial para toda mi gente amante de la comida y del buen sabor, aprovechando este fin de semana es ideal para preparar un pescado frito en casa pues me gusta porque tengo mayor tiempo disponible y puedo cocinar el pescado de forma tranquila y sin apuros, además haciéndole una deliciosa combinación con puré de auyama y una ensalada fresca de lechuga, el pescado que voy a presentarles hoy es conocido como pámpano, creo que es la segunda vez que lo compro en casa, esté pescado de carne blanca de buen sabor, así que los invito a ver mi receta. >A warm greeting to all my food lovers and those who appreciate good flavor! This weekend is the perfect time to prepare fried fish at home. I enjoy it because I have more time and can cook the fish calmly and without rushing, pairing it with a delicious pumpkin puree and a fresh lettuce salad. The fish I'm going to present today is known as pompano. I think this is only the second time I've bought it for my family. This white-fleshed fish has a great flavor, so I invite you to check out my recipe.
![GridArt_20260530_224746211.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/AKFARjPYSehy2asMTrTEcw3TDy2cCq9QDckov8tQ864KYKR3HK8vyTBeLKQxP3X.jpg)
Ingredientes: 1 kilo de pescado pámpano, 1 kilo de auyama, lechuga, 2 tomates, 1 cebolla, aceite, sal, orégano, mantequilla. >Ingredients: 1 kilo of pompano fish, 1 kilo of pumpkin, lettuce, 2 tomatoes, 1 onion, oil, salt, oregano, butter.
![GridArt_20260530_224335221.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/23tveDXc7hrkxqbawxPrp849DWT167mkjcCGrzNvivdJZBqoNnbBTHu3gMDEkjqUVnzVv.jpg)
Preparar pescado frito es bastante sencillo, debemos de limpiar sus entrañas, hacerle una abertura a cada lado, lavarlo muy bien y sazonarlo con un poco de sal y orégano, luego colocaron un sartén con suficiente aceite a calentar, allí vamos a freír nuestro pescado por ambas partes hasta que quede bien cocido. >Preparing fried fish is quite simple. We must clean its entrails, make an opening on each side, wash it very well and season it with a little salt and oregano. Then, we place a pan with enough oil to heat up, and there we will fry our fish on both sides until it is well cooked.
![GridArt_20260530_224258430.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/AK2DRD5C4epMzRhy8isi5LC2sbzExeY8Yvbrdw7aBXqXboGhkFuvERvU9sFrRRY.jpg)
Para preparar el puré de auyama debemos retirar totalmente su concha cortarla en trozos medianos y llevarla a una olla con agua a cocinar, agregándole un toquecito de sal, cuando la auyama esté blanda la retiramos dejamos en un colador para extraer toda el agua, luego lo colocamos en un recipiente y agregamos mantequilla para triturarla con ayuda de un tenedor hasta tener una consistencia cremosa. >To prepare the pumpkin puree, we must completely remove its peel, cut it into medium-sized pieces, and put it in a pot with water to cook, adding a touch of salt. When the pumpkin is soft, we remove it, leave it in a colander to extract all the water, and then place it in a container and add butter to mash it with the help of a fork until it has a creamy consistency.
![GridArt_20260530_224427546.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/23uQy6NDBC8CdoXTJxcxxox19rGiU7SAP5arZ4d71eftfCSs6iLVEwq3zMLdyAnvjJJpq.jpg)
Para la ensalada colocamos un recipiente con agua y un chorrito de vinagre, lavamos las hojas de la lechuga, el tomate y la cebolla, luego procedemos a cortar la cebolla y el tomate en cuadritos muy pequeños, por otra parte la lechuga en trozos más grandes colocamos en un recipiente y sazonamos con un poco de sal y aceite. >For the salad, we put a container with water and a splash of vinegar, we wash the lettuce leaves, the tomato and the onion, then we proceed to cut the onion and tomato into very small squares, on the other hand the lettuce into larger pieces, we place it in a container and season with a little salt and oil.
![GridArt_20260530_224508595.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/AJmt1UfmWksWQek1Jp5Din2ZCFN2SYB1yAwfnE3qjm4syCX4DaWnLJLCxpi82Nu.jpg)
De esta manera realicé mis preparaciones, colocando estas tres en un mismo plato para presentarles el resultado final de una comida bastante saludable y rica. >This is how I made my preparations, placing these three on the same plate to present you with the final result of a very healthy and delicious meal.
![GridArt_20260530_224547842.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/AJkT7MmXt4jBHPPTBhCT1psmNFeJFAncXxc3Jz1GNKhn4Apo4GvnGqAh4Kzc4N4.jpg)

title: Beef liver with onions and sweet peppers.[Esp-Eng]
body:
>    
<hr>
Feliz y bendecido fin de semana, un gusto compartir una vez más con ustedes, hoy les quiero compartir la receta de hígado con ajíes dulces y cebolla ideal para un almuerzo con el contorno de nuestra preferencia, este hígado es fácil de preparar y además queda deliciosi aquí les dejo el paso a paso de esta sencilla receta.

>Have a happy and blessed weekend! It’s a pleasure to share with you once again. Today I’d like to share a recipe for liver with bell peppers and onions—perfect for lunch, served with your favorite side dish. This liver dish is easy to prepare and turns out delicious. Here’s a step-by-step guide to this simple recipe.



<hr>


![GridArt_20260526_140235128.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/indelvalle65/Eokf4zpmhjLmiVoHAL5y2Yx7tpmg9y94gxZH47xA6W5SvskKMA7Mu6ZSKxhS1kBuMdU.jpg)


<hr>

# <center> *INGREDIENTES/INGREDIENTS* </center>

<div class = \

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/indelvalle65/EoeEseSxBJZ5gyPQbfT83ZqphW8bx39JJ2XKGMkHvpTSQZPiVFWsSVGczousSeor7WK.jpg - 500 gramos de hígado de res - 1 cebolla - 4 ajíes dulces - 1/2 cucharadita de ajo en polvo - Orégano - Salsa inglesa - Aceite de oliva - Sal y pimienta al gusto >- 500 grams of beef liver >- 1 onion >- 4 sweet peppers >- 1/2 teaspoon of garlic powder >- Oregano >- Worcestershire sauce >- Olive oil >- Salt and pepper to taste
#
*PREPARACIÓN/PREPARATION*
Lo primero que haremos es limpiar el hígado, lo ponemos en un bol y le añadimos vinagre lo dejamos unos minutos y luego lo lavamos y escurrimos lo sazonamos con sal, pimienta, ajo en polvo, orégano y salsa inglesa, y lo dejamos marinar por unos minutos. >First, we’ll clean the liver, place it in a bowl, and add vinegar. Let it sit for a few minutes, then rinse and drain it. Season it with salt, pepper, garlic powder, oregano, and Worcestershire sauce, and let it marinate for a few minutes.
![GridArt_20260526_140521589.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/indelvalle65/Eoc7zujgQNidrMhMQWm1zn8AQubtNFkmNVKtz5XCn43rPh1cNeHLtbh2HXespgVAgMS.jpg)
En una sartén colocamos un chorrito de aceite de oliva cuando esté caliente ponemos el hígado y vamos friéndolo por ambos lados hasta que se dore y retiramos de la sartén. >Heat a splash of olive oil in a skillet. Once hot, add the liver and fry it on both sides until golden brown, then remove it from the skillet.
![GridArt_20260526_140709697.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/indelvalle65/Eo8TnC3Ft4D3j3Af4uPGhCFYG9B2Rah3etzEFfECWrzsEUxG1dA3KesVk7vcQuWxrFn.jpg)
Le añadimos otro chorrito de aceite y ponemos la cebolla picadas en tiras a sofreír al marchitar le agregamos los ajíes picados en tiras y seguimos salteamos volvemos a introducir el hígado removemos y le agregamos un poquito de agua rectificamos de sal y pimienta y dejamos por unos minutos. >Add another splash of oil and sauté the onions, cut into strips, until they soften. Then add the chili peppers, also cut into strips, and continue sautéing. Return the liver to the pan, stir, and add a little water. Season with salt and pepper to taste, and let it cook for a few minutes.
![GridArt_20260526_141000484.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/indelvalle65/EoK6ryFQZyqe3k73Nvf9Fkuopq9Dpzb1BHSpA5YoA6HQQHZeRnU4W1USrCrDS3jFo89.jpg)
Una vez listo el hígado servimos caliente acompañado con el contorno de nuestra preferencia yo combiné con arroz blanco y tajadas para disfrutar de un almuerzo balanceado. >Once the liver is ready, serve it hot with a side dish of your choice. I paired it with white rice and plantain slices for a balanced lunch.
![GridArt_20260526_140331675.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/indelvalle65/EogQC75KqE2yH5XxJemT8eJyV9bXv1BPSLgtgnLhTKUSZqjvEKXzbeReXVEMmcxK25x.jpg)
Espero que esta sencilla receta que les comparto el día de hoy sea de su completo agrado hasta la próxima y muchas bendiciones. >I hope you enjoy this simple recipe I’m sharing with you today. Until next time, and many blessings.

title: 十二週，一顆球，一個完美結局 Twelve Weeks, One Shot, A Perfect Ending
body:
https://www.youtube.com/shorts/3oatMFSL6xY

最近完成了十二堂高爾夫球課，這段學習旅程比我想像中更有戲劇性。前八堂課都在練習場（driving range）進行，每次上完課我都會錄一段影片，從影片中可以明顯看到自己的進步，揮桿越來越穩，擊球也越來越紮實。這些影片也意外地在 YouTube 上吸引了一些觀眾，讓我更有動力持續練習。

然而，當課程進入最後四堂，移到真正的高爾夫球場時，一切卻像被重置了一樣。原本在練習場建立的信心似乎消失了，面對真實球道的地形、距離感與心理壓力，我感覺自己像是在學一個完全不同的運動。前三堂在球場上的表現幾乎沒有進步，也因此沒有再錄製新的影片。

但故事在最後一堂課出現了轉折。一個標準的四桿洞，理論上需要四桿完成：開球上球道、第二桿打上果嶺、接著兩推進洞。然而就在那一天，我在第三桿時完成了一個幾乎不可能的表現——我只用了一推，就把球送進洞裡，成功打出一記小鳥球（Birdie），只用了三桿。

在我推桿之前，教練拿起手機開始錄影。他其實並不認為我會推進，因為我平常連短推都不太穩定，更何況是這樣的距離。他甚至半開玩笑地說，如果我打進了，就要把影片送去新聞台播放。
結果，我真的推進了。

那一刻，全場歡呼。那不只是我個人的突破，也是我們這群人當中唯一的一次小鳥球。這個瞬間，不只是技術的展現，更像是一個努力累積之後自然出現的結果。

十二週的課程，每週只有一小時，花費不高，卻帶來了超出預期的收穫。不僅學會了一項新的運動，也認識了一群新朋友，最後還用一個漂亮的結局為整段旅程畫下句點。最近的生活，簡單卻非常充實。

I recently completed a 12-lesson golf course, and the journey turned out to be far more dramatic than I expected. The first eight lessons were held at the driving range. After each session, I recorded a video, and over time I could clearly see my progress—my swing became more consistent, and my ball striking improved noticeably. These videos even gained some unexpected attention on YouTube, which motivated me to keep going.

However, everything changed when the last four lessons moved onto a real golf course. Suddenly, all the confidence I had built at the range seemed to disappear. Playing on an actual course—with real fairways, distances, and pressure—felt like learning a completely different sport. During the first three on-course lessons, I barely improved, and because of that, I didn’t bother recording any new videos.

Then came the final lesson, where something unexpected happened. It was a standard par-4 hole. Typically, that means one shot to reach the fairway, a second shot to the green, and two putts to finish. But on that day, I did something I didn’t think I was capable of—I sank the ball with a single putt on my third stroke, scoring a birdie and finishing the hole in just three shots.

Right before my putt, my coach started recording with his phone. He didn’t expect me to make it—after all, I usually struggle even with short putts, let alone one from that distance. He even joked that if I actually made it, he would submit the video to a news station.

And then, I made it.

Everyone on the course cheered. It wasn’t just my personal highlight—it was the only birdie anyone in our group achieved. That moment felt like a perfect combination of effort, timing, and a bit of luck coming together in a way that made everything worthwhile.

Twelve weeks, just one hour per week, at a relatively low cost—but the experience turned out to be incredibly rewarding. I picked up a new skill, met new friends, and ended the whole journey with a memorable finish. Life lately has been simple, but deeply fulfilling.

Vivir es un regalo que nos da la vida y así mismo nos lo puede quitar de repente. Es por eso que llegar a la tercera edad es un logro para cualquier ser humano y después disfrutarla aún con la complejidad que ese periodo representa.


La Edad de la experiencia, como le digo yo esta llena de colores. Lo veo así, y así se los quiero presentar. Digamos que es mi visión particular y reflexiva. Comienza con un tono sereno, casi blanco, pues llegar a la tercera edad no es una derrota. Es una victoria silenciosa que no todos celebran. Porque envejecer es, ante todo, un privilegio negado a muchos. Cada arruga cuenta una supervivencia, cada cana un amanecer más, son batallas ganadas. Pero para entender esta etapa hay que mirarla con los colores que merece.

Miremos los colores que yo le veo a cada evento, por así decirlo. Esta por ejemplo, el azul profundo de los cambios. El cuerpo cambia, ya no responde con la misma prisa, las rodillas avisan antes de llover, la memoria a veces juega a las escondidas. Cambia el rol en la familia pues pasas de protector a protegido, de activo a observador. También lo hace el tiempo, ahora se mide en pausas, no en carreras. El azul es el color de lo hondo, de lo que se mueve despacio, como la marea. Y aunque algunos cambios duelen, también enseñan una verdad incómoda y hermosa, nunca se deja de ser, solo se cambia de manera.

Hay un desliz hacia el gris plateado de la soledad. Esa soledad real con la mesa con una silla de menos, el teléfono que no suena y las tardes que se alargan sin prisa. El gris plateado no es oscuro; es el color del estaño, de la luna, de lo que aún brilla en el silencio. Porque aprender a estar solo en esta edad es también aprender a escucharse. Y el que se escucha, sobrevive. La soledad, bien habitada, se vuelve compañía.

Pero hay giros en los colores y entonces aparece el dorado de la experiencia. Ese color no se compra, solo lo da el tiempo. La persona mayor lleva consigo un archivo imposible, ha visto guerras en televisión y guerras en casa, ha amado mal y bien, perdido trabajos y encontrado oficios, criado, llorado, cocinado para otros y guardado secretos. El dorado es la luz de quien ya no necesita demostrar nada;  la certeza de que pocas cosas son nuevas bajo el sol. Y esa sabiduría, aunque duerma en el sofá, vale más que cualquier título universitario. Llegar a viejo es tener un mapa de casi todos los caminos.

Hay un color doloroso, el violeta oscuro de la pérdida. A esta edad se pierde tanto que a veces parece que el equipaje se vacía. Se pierden amigos, hermanos, pareja. Se pierde la agudeza de los sentidos, la autonomía, la casa de siempre. El violeta es un susurro grave. Es el color de la ausencia hecha materia. Pero atención, perder no es fracasar. Es la otra cara de haber tenido. Quien nada ha perdido, poco ha amado. La pérdida en la vejez tiene una extraña nobleza y es el precio de una vida larga.

Y así se llega al blanco roto de el duelo. Un color que parece vacío pero está lleno de todo lo que se fue. El duelo en la tercera, casi es un oficio. Porque hay duelos que se llevan en el café de cada mañana, en la silla vacía, en la radio encendida sin nadie que escuche. El blanco se vueleve memoria pacificada. Es aprender a convivir con las despedidas sin que estas te entierren en vida. Los mayores son expertos en duelo, y merecen respeto por eso, no compasión, siguen queriendo a los que ya no están, y eso es un acto de valentía cotidiana.

Y al final, cuando se han atravesado todos los colores, aparece el naranja cálido de una verdad incómoda para una sociedad que idolatra la juventud, llegar a viejo es un golpe de suerte. No todo el mundo lo consigue. Muchos se quedan en el camino por enfermedad, violencia, accidente o mala fortuna. Por eso, cada persona mayor debería ser tratada como lo que es, un testimonio vivo de resistencia. No como un problema a resolver.

Envejecer duele a ratos, sí. Pero no envejecer duele para siempre.

Así que cuando veas a alguien en la tercera edad, no mires solo sus pérdidas. Mira la paleta completa. Mira los cambios que superó, la soledad que aprendió a habitar, la experiencia que nadie le robará, las pérdidas que transformó en memoria y los duelos que convirtió en paz.

Mira el arcoíris entero de una vida que sigue siendo vida.

La tercera edad no es el final del color,
es el momento en que los colores, por fin, tienen sentido.

---
---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPioZKWPc3STML2a1iV8y8o3y7Ayv6wXZdNk6AeXJaENj/1758503903035.jpg)

---
---

# *ENGLISH*

---
---

Greetings to all and have a good rest.

Living is a gift that life gives us, and just as easily, it can suddenly take it away. That is why reaching old age is an achievement for any human being, and then enjoying it, even with the complexity that this period represents.

The Age of Experience, as I call it, is full of colors. I see it that way, and that's how I want to present it. Let's say it's my particular, reflective vision. It begins with a serene tone, almost white, because reaching old age is not a defeat. It is a silent victory that not everyone celebrates. Because growing old is, above all, a privilege denied to many. Every wrinkle tells a story of survival, every gray hair one more dawn — they are battles won. But to understand this stage, you have to look at it with the colors it deserves.

Let's look at the colors I see in each event, so to speak. For example, there is the deep blue of change. The body changes, it no longer responds as quickly, knees ache before it rains, memory sometimes plays hide-and-seek. Your role in the family changes, as you go from protector to protected, from active to observer. Time also changes; it is now measured in pauses, not in races. Blue is the color of the deep, of things that move slowly, like the tide. And although some changes hurt, they also teach an uncomfortable and beautiful truth: you never stop being, you only change your way of being.

There is a slide toward the silver-gray of loneliness. That real loneliness of a table missing a chair, a phone that doesn't ring, and afternoons that stretch on without hurry. Silver-gray is not dark; it is the color of tin, of the moon, of what still shines in silence. Because learning to be alone at this age is also learning to listen to yourself. And those who listen to themselves survive. Loneliness, when well inhabited, becomes companionship.

But there are twists in the colors, and then the gold of experience appears. That color cannot be bought; only time gives it. An older person carries an impossible archive within them: they have seen wars on TV and wars at home, loved badly and well, lost jobs and found vocations, raised children, cried, cooked for others, and kept secrets. Gold is the light of someone who no longer needs to prove anything; the certainty that few things are new under the sun. And that wisdom, even if it sleeps on the sofa, is worth more than any university degree. Reaching old age is having a map of almost every path.

There is a painful color: the dark violet of loss. At this age, you lose so much that sometimes it seems your luggage is emptying. You lose friends, siblings, a partner. You lose sharpness of your senses, autonomy, the home you've always known. Violet is a grave whisper. It is the color of absence made material. But pay attention: losing is not failing. It is the other side of having had. Those who have lost nothing have loved little. Loss in old age has a strange nobility; it is the price of a long life.

And so you arrive at the off-white of grief. A color that seems empty but is full of everything that is gone. Grief in old age is almost an occupation. Because there are griefs that you carry with you in your morning coffee, in the empty chair, on the radio left on with no one listening. White becomes pacified memory. It is learning to live with goodbyes without them burying you alive. The elderly are experts in grief, and they deserve respect for that, not pity; they continue to love those who are no longer here, and that is an act of daily courage.

And at the end, when you have gone through all the colors, the warm orange of an uncomfortable truth appears for a society that idolizes youth: reaching old age is a stroke of luck. Not everyone makes it. Many are left behind by disease, violence, accident, or misfortune. That is why every elderly person should be treated as what they are: a living testament of resistance. Not as a problem to be solved.

Growing old hurts at times, yes. But not growing old hurts forever.

So when you see someone in their old age, don't just look at their losses. Look at the full palette. Look at the changes they overcame, the loneliness they learned to inhabit, the experience no one will steal from them, the losses they transformed into memory, and the griefs they turned into peace.

Look at the entire rainbow of a life that is still a life.

Old age is not the end of color,
it is the moment when colors finally make sense.

---
---


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPioZKWPc3STML2a1iV8y8o3y7Ayv6wXZdNk6AeXJaENj/1758503903035.jpg)

---

# *PORTUGUÉS*

---
---

Uma saudação a todos e um bom descanso.

Viver é um presente que a vida nos dá e que, da mesma forma, pode nos tirar de repente. É por isso que chegar à terceira idade é uma conquista para qualquer ser humano, e depois aproveitá-la, mesmo com a complexidade que esse período representa.

A Idade da Experiência, como eu a chamo, é cheia de cores. Eu a vejo assim, e é assim que quero apresentá-la. Digamos que é minha visão particular e reflexiva. Começa com um tom sereno, quase branco, pois chegar à terceira idade não é uma derrota. É uma vitória silenciosa que nem todos celebram. Porque envelhecer é, acima de tudo, um privilégio negado a muitos. Cada ruga conta uma sobrevivência, cada cabelo branco mais um amanhecer, são batalhas vencidas. Mas para entender essa fase, é preciso olhar para ela com as cores que ela merece.

Vejamos as cores que eu vejo em cada evento, por assim dizer. Há, por exemplo, o azul profundo das mudanças. O corpo muda, já não responde com a mesma rapidez, os joelhos avisam antes de chover, a memória às vezes brinca de esconde-esconde. O papel na família muda, pois você passa de protetor a protegido, de ativo a observador. O tempo também muda, agora é medido em pausas, não em corridas. O azul é a cor do profundo, do que se move devagar, como a maré. E embora algumas mudanças doam, também ensinam uma verdade incômoda e bonita: nunca se deixa de ser, apenas se muda de maneira.

Há um deslize para o cinza prateado da solidão. Aquela solidão real da mesa com uma cadeira a menos, do telefone que não toca e das tardes que se alongam sem pressa. O cinza prateado não é escuro; é a cor do estanho, da lua, do que ainda brilha no silêncio. Porque aprender a ficar sozinho nesta idade é também aprender a ouvir a si mesmo. E quem se ouve, sobrevive. A solidão, bem habitada, torna-se companhia.

Mas há reviravoltas nas cores e então aparece o dourado da experiência. Essa cor não se compra, só o tempo a dá. A pessoa idosa carrega consigo um arquivo impossível: viu guerras na televisão e guerras em casa, amou mal e bem, perdeu empregos e encontrou ofícios, criou filhos, chorou, cozinhou para os outros e guardou segredos. O dourado é a luz de quem já não precisa provar nada; a certeza de que poucas coisas são novas sob o sol. E essa sabedoria, mesmo que durma no sofá, vale mais do que qualquer diploma universitário. Chegar à velhice é ter um mapa de quase todos os caminhos.

Há uma cor dolorosa, o violeta escuro da perda. Nessa idade, perde-se tanto que às vezes parece que a bagagem está se esvaziando. Perdem-se amigos, irmãos, companheiros. Perde-se a nitidez dos sentidos, a autonomia, a casa de sempre. O violeta é um sussurro grave. É a cor da ausência feita matéria. Mas atenção: perder não é fracassar. É o outro lado de ter tido. Quem nada perdeu, pouco amou. A perda na velhice tem uma estranha nobreza; é o preço de uma vida longa.

E assim se chega ao branco quebrado do luto. Uma cor que parece vazia mas está cheia de tudo o que se foi. O luto na terceira idade é quase um ofício. Porque há lutos que se carregam no café de cada manhã, na cadeira vazia, no rádio ligado sem ninguém que escute. O branco torna-se memória pacificada. É aprender a conviver com as despedidas sem que elas te enterrem em vida. Os idosos são especialistas em luto, e merecem respeito por isso, não compaixão; eles continuam amando os que já não estão, e isso é um ato de coragem cotidiana.

E no final, quando se atravessaram todas as cores, aparece o laranja quente de uma verdade incômoda para uma sociedade que idolatra a juventude: chegar à velhice é um golpe de sorte. Nem todos conseguem. Muitos ficam pelo caminho por doença, violência, acidente ou má sorte. É por isso que cada idoso deveria ser tratado como o que é: um testemunho vivo de resistência. Não como um problema a ser resolvido.

Envelhecer dói às vezes, sim. Mas não envelhecer dói para sempre.

Então, quando você vir alguém na terceira idade, não olhe apenas para as suas perdas. Olhe para a paleta completa. Olhe para as mudanças que superou, a solidão que aprendeu a habitar, a experiência que ninguém lhe roubará, as perdas que transformou em memória e os lutos que converteu em paz.

Olhe para o arco-íris inteiro de uma vida que continua sendo vida.

A terceira idade não é o fim da cor,
é o momento em que as cores, finalmente, fazem sentido.

title: A Day with Blackouts📉💡 [Eng+Spa] Un día con apagones.
body: >(Versión en español más abajo). * * * * * * Today I experienced one of those blackouts that leave you feeling completely drained. 😮‍💨 =========================================================================================== Today was one of those days when the power decided to disappear for several hours, as if it had its own schedule and I wasn't on it. And of course, when that happens, your entire routine is turned upside down in a matter of minutes. You try to stay calm, but the truth is, patience also goes into overdrive 😅. Because it's not just being without a fan, a computer, or internet; it's feeling that strange mix of helplessness, anger, and exhaustion that many of us know all too well.

/> [Image source.](https://orinocotribune.com/ten-micro-chronicles-of-resistance-in-the-middle-of-the-blackout/) The Race Against Time --------------------- On days like this, you end up doing everything as if you were in a sprint. Cook quickly, clean quickly, check the computer quickly, solve whatever you can while there's electricity, and cross your fingers that the power doesn't go out at the worst possible moment⚡. And yes, it even sounds funny when I tell it like this, but deep down, it's not funny at all. Constantly worrying about whether the power will go out again affects your mood, disrupts your rhythm, and forces you to be on guard all the time. What One Remembers ------------------ The worst part of these outages is that they don't come alone. They also bring back unwanted memories, like the collective trauma of those massive blackouts that paralyzed the country and made us understand, once again, how fragile everything can be. In Venezuela, power outages no longer surprise us as much, but that doesn't mean they hurt any less. On the contrary, sometimes they're more annoying precisely because they've become part of the routine, as if resignation were a mandatory habit. Amidst the Bad News ------------------- Today, luckily, things didn't escalate. There were several hours without power, yes, but at least the electricity returned the same day. And in this context, although it sounds sad to say, that already counts as a small relief. Because here you learn to celebrate the little things: that the food doesn't spoil, that the computer holds up, that the pending work can be salvaged, that the day doesn't completely sink. And even so, every blackout leaves its mark.

/> [Image source.](https://orinocotribune.com/argentinas-blackout-is-a-hit-to-its-fragile-economy/) Moving Forward -------------- Not having your own generator isn't a stylish choice or a funny anecdote. It's simply the reality of not being able to afford a solution to a problem that should be solved in another way. And that weighs heavily on you. So, we have to keep going, as always, hoping that tomorrow will be a little better than today. With the stubborn hope that life will become less of an uphill battle, even if just for a little while. 😊\_💛💙❤️ * * * * * *

> (English version above). ------------------------ * * * * * * Hoy me tocó vivir un apagón de esos que te dejan con el alma arrugada. 😮‍💨 ============================================================================ Hoy fue uno de esos días en los que la luz decidió jugar a desaparecer por varias horas, como si tuviera agenda propia y yo no figurara en ella. Y claro, cuando eso pasa, la rutina completa se pone patas arriba en cuestión de minutos. Uno intenta mantener la calma, pero la verdad es que la paciencia también se va poniendo en modo ahorro 😅. Porque no es solo quedarse sin ventilador, sin computadora o sin internet; es sentir esa mezcla rara de impotencia, rabia y cansancio que ya muchos conocemos demasiado bien.

/> [Fuente de la imagen.](https://orinocotribune.com/ten-micro-chronicles-of-resistance-in-the-middle-of-the-blackout/) La carrera contra el reloj -------------------------- En días así, uno termina haciendo todo como si estuviera en una competencia de velocidad. Cocinar rápido, limpiar rápido, revisar la computadora rápido, resolver lo que se pueda mientras haya electricidad, y cruzar los dedos para que la luz no se vaya justo en el peor momento ⚡. Y sí, suena hasta gracioso cuando lo cuento así, pero en el fondo no tiene nada de divertido. Vivir pendiente de si el servicio se va a caer otra vez te cambia el ánimo, te rompe el ritmo y te obliga a estar en guardia todo el tiempo. Lo que uno recuerda ------------------- Lo peor de estas fallas es que no llegan solas. También traen de regreso recuerdos que uno no pidió, como el trauma colectivo de aquellos grandes apagones que paralizaron al país y nos hicieron entender, otra vez, lo frágil que puede ser todo. En Venezuela, los cortes de luz ya no sorprenden tanto, pero eso no significa que duelan menos. Al contrario, a veces molestan más precisamente porque se volvieron parte de la rutina, como si la resignación tuviera que ser una costumbre obligatoria. Dentro de lo malo ----------------- Hoy, por suerte, la cosa no pasó a mayores. Fueron varias horas sin servicio, sí, pero al menos la electricidad regresó el mismo día. Y en este contexto, aunque suene triste decirlo, eso ya cuenta como un pequeño alivio. Porque aquí uno aprende a celebrar lo mínimo: que la comida no se dañe, que la computadora aguante, que el trabajo pendiente pueda salvarse, que el día no termine de hundirse del todo. Y aun así, cada apagón deja su marca.

/> [Fuente de la imagen.](https://orinocotribune.com/argentinas-blackout-is-a-hit-to-its-fragile-economy/) Seguir adelante --------------- No tener una planta eléctrica propia no es una elección elegante ni una anécdota simpática. Es simplemente la realidad de no poder costear una salida a un problema que debería resolverse de otra manera. Y eso también pesa. Así que toca seguir, como siempre, esperando que mañana venga un poco mejor que hoy. Con la esperanza terquísima de que la vida se ponga menos cuesta arriba, aunque sea por un ratito. 😊\_💛💙❤️ * * * * * * #tribe #hope #social #fear #apagon * * *

title: Renovando mi cédula con 10 años de vencimiento /Renewing my ID with 10 years expiration
body:
https://images.hive.blog/DQmd3KQ6ggHFwJbgGeyqec94pDhRBiMrnwUqjpD1JfKKSdm/IMG-20260527-WA0009.jpg

Con un hermoso cielo matutino salí de casa apurada para renovar mi cédula de identidad Pero han pasado muchas cosas recientemente. Me fue adjudicado un terreno para construir mi vivienda ¡Propia al fin! en él. >With a beautiful morning sky I left the house in a hurry to renew my identity card >But a lot has happened recently. I was awarded land to build my home, my own at last! in it.
![IMG-20260522-WA0089.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWY6KyZRJuM4eQxtEj1wvjpdEWy7ajwXsw5gEeTykpsVK/IMG-20260522-WA0089.jpg)

Pero es con la condición de que fabrique de inmediato. Buscando opciones de materiales de construcción ecoómicos laúnica opción a nuestro alcance actualmente es la de adquirir láminas de zinc, construir un cuarto 3x3 y un baño. Mudarnos allí y luego darnos a la tarea de convertir ese ranchito en una casa. >But it is on the condition that it manufactures immediately. Looking for options for economical construction materials, the only option currently available to us is to acquire zinc sheets, build a 3x3 room and a bathroom. Move there and then take on the task of turning that little ranch into a house.
![IMG-20260522-WA0091.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYAsZDY2LsKJN1Le4apRSRqLcFpdrD4RdLhngvpoibLFG/IMG-20260522-WA0091.jpg)

En la foto pueden ver a mis vecinos Cris y Will midiendo el terreno. Para fabricar el cuartito y el baño (techo y paredes) necesitaremos 30 láminas de zinc. Cada lámina cuesta 10$, estamos hablando entonces de 300$ sólo en láminas y hay qué agregar la tubería para aguas negras, la poceta y la tubería para aguas blancas. Y los cables para la luz ... son muchos detalles. Bueno, una amiga que está en USA me envió 100$ para comprar 10 láminas de zinc. Me los mandó por Paypal. Resulta que no encuentro la clave y a la hora de irla a recuperarla me enviaron no solo un código al correo sino que tienen qué enviarme otro por teléfono y el que tenía cuando abrí PayPal se dañó, tengo otro y no lo cambié. >In the photo you can see my neighbors Cris and Will measuring the land. To make the room and the bathroom (roof and walls) we will need 30 zinc sheets. Each sheet costs $10, so we are talking about $300 just in sheets and we must add the black water pipe, the well and the white water pipe. And the cables for the light... there are many details. >Well, a friend who is in the USA sent me $100 to buy 10 sheets of zinc. She sent them to me via Paypal. >It turns out that I can't find the password and when I went to recover it they not only sent me a code by email but they also had to send me another one by phone and the one I had when I opened PayPal was damaged, I have another one and I didn't change it.
![InShot_20260530_181311311.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPgigoAvqQAycmkwqh767YyBjYaTZG57F1dx74aARt4QA/InShot_20260530_181311311.jpg)

[Fuente/Source](https://es.vecteezy.com/arte-vectorial/20336424-paypal-logo-vector-paypal-logo-gratis-vector )
Aún hay otra forma de demostrar mi identidad en PayPal: escaneo de mi rostro y de mi cédula de identidad vigente. Tengo la cédula de identidad vencida ¡Desde hace diez años!, así que me toca hoy irla a renovar para poder comprar al. menos algunas laminas >There is still another way to prove my identity on PayPal: scan of my face and my current ID card. >My identity card has expired for ten years! So I have to renew it today to be able to buy from. minus some sheets
![IMG-20260527-WA0022.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmb6eLTjMKVYiiKEiSKmznZgWLoKamFT9WY6V7fCdBFWha/IMG-20260527-WA0022.jpg)

Voy en camino desde Villa de Cura hasta Cagua para hacer la renovación. Ambas son localidades ubicadas en el estado Aragua en Venezuela. >I am on my way from Villa de Cura to Cagua to do the renovation. Both are towns located in the Aragua state in Venezuela.
![IMG-20260527-WA0024.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQmu9kdgRoQ5KUU4vwDbfDEjrRyaLrh2MDJNkNRYGCmKF/IMG-20260527-WA0024.jpg)

Ese es el restaurant 'El Rey de las Carnes\
Haga su colita y pase. No hay problema porque usted es de la tercera edad\
Make your queue and pass. There is no problem because you are elderly.\
Una cosa es trabajar para comer pero eso de trabajar para no comer no va conmigo\
It's one thing to work to eat, but working to not eat doesn't suit me.\
