body.title: Government Palace, a building inspired by Greek architecture (Eng/Esp)
body.body:
> On a recent stroll through Plaza Bolivar in the city of Cumana, my gaze fell upon the old Government Palace. Although I have written on my blog about the sculpture atop its façade—the goddesses Paria and Araya seated in their robes—today I looked more closely and noticed other details that had previously gone unnoticed.
![1000118115.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23wC7vjSBwRXZMQ4V6eTFtknyf7szLjrfV2fHrmehMAUx6KwcEwRyeJhF7BWcNodvSeVb.jpg)
Below the pedestal of the goddesses, the structure features stepped cornices. Next, a frieze with floral motifs and a lion’s head in the center can be seen. This façade replicates Greek-style architecture; its Ionic columns display proportion, harmony, and symmetry that combine to create an aesthetic appeal. On the sides near the ceiling, I noticed various gargoyles—mythical zoomorphic heads. These ornaments, in addition to serving a decorative purpose, act as drainage channels for rainwater. I’ve passed by here many times, and only now have I noticed these gargoyles—elements that fell out of use decades ago, once art shifted toward avant-garde and modern styles.
![1000118109.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23tvcEGHzHfafhoMLjvv2q2uCRzAWuNAvVYEiiVMo8yxfsQvqMRh57s53sc5Sb4jD8BhN.jpg)
Even though the government palace has not been restored since it was vandalized in 1998, these symbols that have stood the test of time are still visible; the deities Paria and Araya honor feminine beauty and, at the same time, the geographical beauty of the two great peninsulas of Sucre State. It is a shame that this structure remains abandoned across from the Sucre State Government headquarters and Plaza Bolivar.
![1000118102.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23tmL9ig7tMgj1k1L8x5oF1bkbNNwhUS54itHUtJLKgLswwVGo6L81kRSSUEDGa6N6drL.jpg)
Since this place burned down, the only work that has been done is painting the facade and covering the large windows—which used to be beautiful stained-glass windows—with banners so that passersby cannot see inside; however, a side view from the Ateneo de Cumaná still reveals the ruins of what was once a building of great architectural value and imposing presence. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> En un nuevo recorrido por la Plaza Bolívar de la ciudad de Cumaná fijé la mirada en el antiguo Palacio de Gobierno, si bien he escrito en mi blog sobre la escultura que se encuentra en lo alto de su fachada; las diosas Paria y Araya sentadas con sus túnicas, hoy agudicé la mirada y me di cuenta de otros elementos que antes pasaron desapercibidos.
![1000118115.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23wC7vjSBwRXZMQ4V6eTFtknyf7szLjrfV2fHrmehMAUx6KwcEwRyeJhF7BWcNodvSeVb.jpg)
Debajo del pedestal de las diosas, la estructura presenta cornisas escalonadas. Luego se distingue un friso con motivos florales y la cabeza de un león en el centro. Esta fachada replica las construcciones de estilo griego, sus columnas al estilo jónico presentan proporción, armonía y simetría que se conjugan para lograr un atractivo estético. En los laterales próximos al techo pude observar diferentes gárgolas, cabezas zoomorfas míticas. Estos ornamentos, además de tener un fin decorativo, actúan como canal de drenaje para el agua de lluvia. Pasé muchas veces por acá y hasta ahora es cuando caigo en cuenta de la presencia de estas gárgolas, elementos que desde hace décadas dejaron de utilizarse, una vez que el arte se inclinó hacia propuestas vanguardistas y modernas.
![1000118109.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23tvcEGHzHfafhoMLjvv2q2uCRzAWuNAvVYEiiVMo8yxfsQvqMRh57s53sc5Sb4jD8BhN.jpg)
Aún cuando el palacio de gobierno no ha sido recuperado, desde que lo vandalizaron en 1998, todavía se perciben esos símbolos que han permanecido en el tiempo, las deidades Paria y Araya hacen honor a la belleza femenina y, al mismo tiempo, a la belleza geográfica de dos grandes penínsulas del estado Sucre. Es una lástima que esta estructura permanezca abandonada frente a la sede de la Gobernación del estado Sucre y de la plaza Bolívar.
![1000118102.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23tmL9ig7tMgj1k1L8x5oF1bkbNNwhUS54itHUtJLKgLswwVGo6L81kRSSUEDGa6N6drL.jpg)
Desde que se quemó este lugar, lo único que se ha hecho es pintar la fachada y tapar los ventanales, que antes eran hermosos vitrales, con pancartas para que los transeúntes no puedan observar hacia el interior, aunque de igual manera una vista lateral, desde el Ateneo de Cumaná, permite apreciar los despojos de lo que alguna vez fue una edificación de alto valor arquitectónico y cuya presencia era imponente. *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

body.title: Comer a lo Venezolano
body.body:
<center>![1001004340.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23xempWNJkssurGtTjqQvuYDfcFAvbs9kqMdYjncaj9bH7eCH3W1cgaNUMorFhnSdB4Ef.png)</center>

---

<div class=text-justify>

En estos días una amiga me preguntó: ¿Cómo es comer a lo Venezolano? No hubi mucho pensar, le dije aue por supuesto sirviendo en la mesa nuestra gastronomía, pero también se come muy a lo venezolano estando reunidos en familia o con amigos, compartiendo algun alimento, que aún cuando es poco, en Venezuela siempre se dice que *\

*, así que nadie se queda por fuera. En la noche, mientras pensaba en qué hacer de cena, recordé la conversación que tuve con ella. Y como tenia: jamón endiablado (diablitos), Toddy y otros productos Venezolanos, decidí preparar algo muy Venezolano. Cabe destacar que cuando tenemos productos venezolanos no los comemos todos a la vez, si no que vamos poco a poco, para que nos rinda ese sabor de nuestra tierra. |![1001000574.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23uQpVTvLkKhZNfdJhf8BV6WJEnAnEQ3sUuzaSNZu6R3RS5t4zn5QstpgESyd6DwCBwr8.jpg)|![1001000592.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23wMUEK95UUP1kHJQRHu6BuhgBo1yrNMBmHaoieuaikqAuUnvs7DLtqpjiXx6mH1sDAby.jpg)| |-|-| ![1001000594.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23wMYNm9yyfDcunDWtSktzsxZaikeuXKfba5FcDLSCXWQfjJimx8AgHxxzQ2qoceVjLni.jpg) Mientras preparaba unas arepas con diablito, tomé algunas fotografías para mi amiga, para enseñarle cómo se hacen, ya que ella es Ecuatoriana, y nunca ha probado estos alimentos. No la invité porque vivimos muy lejos, pero le guardé un tutorial jajaja. Mis niños pidieron Toddy, una bebida achocolatada y a mi esposo hace dias le había comprado una Malta Polar, para que la disfrutara, ya que a él le gusta muchísimo. |![1001003947.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23xVMatzw9ym5ZBXfFpKE74jJp48fnCsRWxu7F8nU3U9Qve9Nvoz6PbsNMm9dvMKQCMHA.jpg)|![1000998743.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23wMWDUR4accxQRWenZnFA9jadn7dD7R8ydnzScvaePg4GdXeTecWRDWhofZVJaUf6uhB.jpg)| |-|-| Algo que a mi me encanta es comer, pero lo que realmente valoro es la excelente gastronomía que comparto de mis dos países, la Venezolana y la de la Costa Ecuatoriana. Sin duda amo poder disfrutar de ambas en tiempos distintos o combinadas, y poder compartir con otros estas delicias. ---
![17801951828151191786511275337207.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23xATp9nePqX8jz3YfCuR2CVbaaH3HRctoG4Q72iG7HfLmhD4YJZrgB672kJ4z43pfVgC.gif)

body.title: 4 x 50 = 200 [Esp/Eng]
body.body:
>

4 x 50 = 200. Hoy tenemos una jornada muy diferente, claro está que vamos a realizar una rutina; sin embargo, no tendremos un circuito y lógicamente tampoco estaciones. Nuestro trabajo estará basado en el salto de cuerda y ejecutaremos 200 saltos, divididos en 4 ángulos distintos de 50 saltos cada uno. Decimos 200; pero en cada ángulo siempre nos pasamos de los 50 saltos. Realmente este tipo de movimientos es fantástico, es muy completo, quema calorías, mejora la resistencia y mejora el sistema cardiovascular. Por otra parte; el equilibrio y la coordinación, también serán elementos que podemos adquirir durante toda la jornada. Lo importante de todo ello; es que todo el cuerpo trabaja, pero el tren inferior es quien recibe más carga de trabajo. Los glúteos, cuádriceps y pantorrillas, sentirán el impacto de cada salto. Por su parte; todo el núcleo se mantendrá contraído como elemento estabilizador, mientras que los hombros, bíceps, antebrazos y muñecas, estarán activos en todo momento durante cada giro. No te quedes atrás, actívate con esta interesante jornada y trabaja a tu ritmo. >4 x 50 = 200. Today we have a very different workout. Of course, we’ll be doing a routine, but we won’t be doing a circuit, and naturally, there won’t be any stations either. Our workout will focus on jumping rope, and we’ll do 200 jumps, divided into 4 sets of 50 jumps each. We say 200, but in each set we always end up doing more than 50 jumps. This type of exercise is really fantastic it’s a full-body workout that burns calories, improves endurance, and boosts cardiovascular health. >In addition, balance and coordination are also skills we can develop throughout the session. The key point is that the entire body is engaged, but the lower body bears the brunt of the workload. The glutes, quadriceps, and calves will feel the impact of every jump. Meanwhile, the entire core will remain engaged as a stabilizing element, while the shoulders, biceps, forearms, and wrists will be active at all times during each turn. Don’t fall behind—get moving with this exciting workout and work at your own pace.

![1000463198.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/milik80/AKCGzgUnCgzENMmTKYRxQXXX9eZsTRRiv8vhNhZecKLqMpahWVwSQeT4GADwVLL.gif)Portada de mi Autoría Editada en/Cover of my Authorship Edited in [Canva](https://www.canva.com/es_419/)
Logos propiedad de/ logos owned by @hiveio, @fulldeportes
# **
[Fase de Calentamiento]()
** La fase de calentamiento debe ser de carácter obligatorio; y aunque los saltos de cuerda pueden ser tomados como calentamientos, en esta oportunidad tendremos dos ejercicios diferentes para tal fin. Recordemos que haremos 200 saltos y el cuerpo debe estar apto para esta acción. Vamos. ># **
[Warm-up Phase]()
** >The warm-up phase is mandatory; and although jumping rope can be considered a warm-up, this time we’ll be doing two different exercises for that purpose. Remember that we’ll be doing 200 jumps, so your body needs to be ready for this. Let’s get started. [**Calentamiento 1**, **CAMINATA EN SITIO CON ELEVACIÓN DE TALÓN**]() [Postura]() Piernas separadas al ancho de cadera; un pie apoyado completamente en el piso y el otro pie con el talón elevado. Se flexiona el codo del brazo opuesto al pie del talón elevado. El otro brazo extendido hacia abajo. >[**Warm-up 1**, **MARCHING IN PLACE WITH HEEL RAISES**]() >[Posture]() >Stand with your feet hip-width apart; one foot flat on the floor and the other foot with the heel raised. Bend the elbow of the arm opposite the raised foot. Keep the other arm extended downward.
![1000463157.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/roxys90/AKF8nZkmC9qdxtqrH7eETUvkTAe1vwRefNDiQz7t5AWMRHkdbdd2pMidDfKU2rE.gif)
[Ejecución]() Simplemente; sin despegar del piso las puntas de los pies, vamos elevando los talones de forma alterna y flexionando y extendiendo los codos. 3 minutos de acción. >[Execution]() >Let's keep rotating our wrists without stopping; as we take small jumps, we lift our knees one at a time. 3 minutes of action.
![1000463160.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/roxys90/AKCGP6ouz3mXMjnRiSQJZMU7noZ2at1ktN6wNUBZpxxJQQKj2TFYL8BTnpLxyPW.gif)
[**Calentamiento 2**, **PIERNAS AL FRENTE MÁS CRUCE INFERIOR Y SUPERIOR DE BRAZOS**]() [Postura]() Piernas al ancho de la cadera; codos flexionados con brazos a los lados. >[**Warm-up 2**, **LEGS TO THE FRONT WITH LOWER AND UPPER CROSSES**]() >[Posture]() >Legs hip-width apart; elbows bent with arms at your sides.
![1000463162.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/roxys90/AKCGLXuWx6nq8zXhXGYQTJsf8Fxf2viJWw2rER5eiFSMqAj9ytkxMrDNbR7okbN.gif)
[Ejecución]() Acción continua por 3 minutos. A través de pequeños saltos, vamos ubicando las piernas al frente de forma alterna. Al mismo tiempo, damos golpes inferiores y superiores cruzando los brazos. >[Execution]() >Keep moving for 3 minutes. Using small jumps, bring your legs forward one at a time. At the same time, throw your arms up and down, crossing them over.
![1000463166.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/roxys90/AK7xNf6fiV1zk1LdJjrr2wvbP1At9XsP4EFz3ATB1dBeZDQgmYchkes6HpAwLxs.gif)
Es muy importante determinar que si el cuerpo aún no está activo para la acción fuerte, se debe calentar un poco más. No olvides hacer pausas de 20 segundos entre ejercicios, y de 1 a 2 minutos entre series; la hidratación es extremadamente importante para reponer los líquidos y sales perdidas durante la acción. Por otro lado, debemos tratar en la medida de lo posible mantener una alimentación balanceada y un descanso adecuado, que contribuyan a la obtención de mejores resultados corporales. >It is very important to determine that if the body is not yet ready for intense activity, it should be warmed up a little more. Don't forget to take 20-second breaks between exercises and 1-2 minute breaks between sets; hydration is extremely important to replenish fluids and salts lost during exercise. On the other hand, we must try as much as possible to maintain a balanced diet and adequate rest, which contribute to achieving better physical results. # **
[Salto de Cuerda en 4 Ángulos de 50 Saltos Cada Uno]()
** Como dije antes; no tenemos un circuito, sino que vamos a presentar 4 ángulos distintos, donde estaremos realizando 50 saltos por cada ángulo, para que se pueda observar que realmente ejecutamos los 200 saltos. Nos vamos con 50 saltos de frente; 50 de cada lado (100) y 50 de espaldas. Seguimos activos y hemos quemado muchas calorías con esta rutina. Sígueme los pasos y actívate tu también. ># **
[Jumping Rope in 4 Directions, 50 Jumps Each]()
** >As I mentioned earlier, this isn’t a circuit; instead, we’ll be doing 4 different directions, performing 50 jumps in each direction, so you can see that we’re actually doing 200 jumps. We’ll start with 50 front jumps, 50 on each side (100 total), and 50 back jumps. We’re staying active and have burned a lot of calories with this routine. Follow along and get moving too.
![1000463176.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/roxys90/AKCGPm4Yx7K7fXg9r7byxMSgHLxPomgShc8TWnqMewJx8L4n5umndxrpuqDUaUi.gif)
![1000463182.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/roxys90/AKCGKLg9CAf9pq2Rs7eXkfarDmS6GiMV6t4b9dX6Pibwxr8xGxBwUmHdUf21acM.gif)
![1000463186.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/roxys90/AKDhYymzKwZFiB372o2og3xLSZ6jRCXvYryGhjF3DAMsmCSa3TQLrGsLMkaJ12K.gif)
![1000463188.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/roxys90/AKDhck4Wq5fZJvkDf55ZXmJHqpPpbfEWTMkZi1P39VVHSnNzU6mv1ZfjtD281qT.gif)
[**Relajación**, **ELEVACIÓN DE RODILLAS CON GIRO**]() [Postura]() Piernas con distancia al ancho de la cadera; codos flexionados con brazos a los lados, manos a nivel del pecho. >[**Relaxation**, **KNEELIFT WITH TWIST**]() [>Posture]() >Legs hip-width apart; elbows bent with arms at your sides, hands at chest level.
![1000463190.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/roxys90/AKF8op7CaoERiFKvJoXJEmGxoYDQcQzPhFYe7gLi2rDDuHcsXaD88ahyvukELFM.gif)
[Ejecución]() Respirando y exhalando; durante 3 minutos de relajación y paz corporal, suavemente elevamos las rodillas de forma alterna y las giramos hacia atrás. Se acompaña con el movimiento de brazos. >[Execution]() >Breathing in and out; during 3 minutes of relaxation and physical calm, we gently lift our knees one at a time and rotate them backward. This is accompanied by arm movements.
![1000463194.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/milik80/AK9Psyi98Zj9NB8KLb2PR64Cucm3hWcJ8DXfqVyHVh2t2kggdiYyTBYtM2Gi3Rr.gif)
Gracias por preferir nuestro canal. Recuerda que debes tomar descansos de calidad, hidratarte y alimentarte sanamente. Hasta la próxima y si deseas una rutina en particular, en los comentarios la puedes solicitar. >Thank you for choosing our channel. Remember to take quality breaks, hydrate and eat healthy. Until next time and if you want a particular routine, you can ask for it in the comments. #
**

body.title: 2026: sweeping the gallery
body.body:
Today, I spent some time browsing through my phone gallery, deleting photos that had quietly accumulated over the past months. It felt like a simple task at first, but as I scrolled through the images, each photo brought back a memory of a particular day, a moment shared, or an experience that had already passed.


![IMG_20260306_154055.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amayphin/Eou7pJJL4UQGzhJHJjE5CFMmwjRcshTrVTYVPgnspM5YfpW9ZgWQvRmajv5cKYZdCHC.jpg)


There were several food photos taken during birthday celebrations at work. I remembered the pizzas that were freshly served and the cakes that everyone enjoyed together. Looking at those photos reminded me how fortunate I have been to share meals and celebrations with my colleagues. 


![IMG_20260306_154104.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amayphin/EoK7HS2z6vsJjGKn4B6t3qqEbkP9YwoWsmzL1ZuoXaY1uQ63RmYjuqqPtCb9YW6r4Nm.jpg)


Birthdays at the workplace have always been small occasions that bring people together, and I am grateful for every meal and every moment of fellowship shared around the table.


![IMG_20260306_154050.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amayphin/EoCiB7mWw5oqqwgPx4tBB3uhVaayhPGi1qTgXjHDA5M3Jmjw5Nw3Ss6egQdiha5qkde.jpg)



Among the photos was one I took after attending Mass early one morning. It was a serving of puto cassava that I enjoyed outside a Seven Eleven store. 


![IMG_20260517_075623.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amayphin/EoeEviDmCDtpiquxNZGEd3dfFZsHFeQK3PAesxAZumuRX5H5wJ6cfQsiVcPyjmLRG6w.jpg)


The delicacy was sold at the cooperative store beside the Our Lady of Sacred Heart Church. Their small shop displayed many kinds of kakanin, native delicacies, sweets, and local treats. Looking at the photo brought back memories of that peaceful morning after Mass, enjoying a simple snack while watching the day begin.


![IMG_20260531_100619.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amayphin/23u64xNtZS577Gmmd8FaPG5GYCF3ZEck8uQhsoRiDkVGFUXaCp5CV6K6TurjtSZ2rp4QB.jpg)


Further down the gallery, I found pictures from an unexpected food trip at Foodcamp. It was one of those unplanned evenings after work when we decided to eat Korean samgyupsal. There was nothing special planned about that night, yet it became a memorable gathering filled with good food and good company. Sometimes the best moments happen without preparation.


![IMG_20260111_110752.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amayphin/Ep3eo195KyBFaxRbvkfoNfkph2dWQt6ifu7aLj6jtttW9rphVywuU7Hpx9CjboFvtSe.jpg)


Another photo showed a grilled duck prepared during a beach picnic. It was a bright and sunny Sunday filled with laughter, conversations, and shared meals by the sea. The image reminded me of the warmth of friendship and the simple joy of spending time outdoors with people who matter.


![ChatGPT Image May 31, 2026, 10_45_38 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amayphin/Ep5nc7ZLvfZp896a4ifqv2dCGFxRNbVKYTfsBF4CCMmndaKzgY5QpSHTkcFciszWVhZ.png)


The most recent photos were from our maja blanca cooking session at Marilyn's house. It was Rex who first thought about making it. We bought the ingredients together and started the preparation, fully aware that it would require time and effort. Throughout the process, there was plenty of laughter because none of us were entirely sure how the measurements would turn out. Rex worked hard, from preparing the gata to continuously stirring the mixture without stopping. By the end, he was completely exhausted, but the finished maja blanca was worth the effort.

As I deleted these photos today, I realized that letting go of the images does not mean losing the memories. The moments remain in my heart even when the files disappear from my phone. The food has long been eaten, the celebrations have passed, and the gatherings have ended, but the gratitude, laughter, and friendships remain. Sometimes making space in a gallery is also a reminder to appreciate the many blessings that have already become part of our story.

See you tomorrow 😊 

<sup>Photos are mine | Captured with Vivo 1901.</sup>

body.title: Childhood Adventures in a World of Imagination
body.body:
![PSX_20260531_094021.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmY6uX9BkXUvEaRxZD5291ajzfxpT6AY9fvf2D3dnso93A/PSX_20260531_094021.jpg)
![hive dividers-04.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdvc788wxsBSQHY3z21o3wSTU7hqRnyYc2JFEn2pEYSev/hive%20dividers-04.png)
There is something special about childhood that cannot be replaced by anything else. A simple toy can become a source of endless joy and imagination. Today, I captured a moment that reminded me of how creative children can be when they are free to explore and play.

In the picture, a child is happily playing with a toy truck on a patch of dry soil. To adults, it may look like an ordinary toy, but to a child, it can become a powerful vehicle carrying goods across distant lands, working on a construction site, or traveling through rough mountain roads. Every stone becomes an obstacle, and every path becomes a new adventure.

What I love most about moments like this is how children create their own stories. They do not need expensive gadgets or luxurious playgrounds to be happy. A little imagination is enough to transform a simple environment into a world full of excitement and discovery.

Watching children play also reminds us of the importance of enjoying life's simple pleasures. In a world where many people are constantly busy, children teach us to slow down, appreciate the present moment, and find happiness in ordinary things.

As the afternoon sun shines brightly, this small adventure continues. The toy truck moves forward, carrying dreams and creativity along the dusty path. It is a beautiful reminder that imagination has no limits and that some of the best memories are created from the simplest moments.
![hive dividers-04.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdvc788wxsBSQHY3z21o3wSTU7hqRnyYc2JFEn2pEYSev/hive%20dividers-04.png)

| Latin Name | Observation Date | Location |

|     Salticinae      |      May 30, 2026      |       Vodrochol, Ullapara, Bangladesh      | 

Yesterday morning, when I was out exploring nature, I saw this small but very interesting Jumping Spider (Salticinae). When I first saw this spider, it was hiding behind a leaf, only half of its body was visible. It looked like the spider was playing hide and seek. When I was taking pictures, the spider was gradually coming out from behind the leaf. These spiders are known for their sharp eyesight and quick hunting techniques.

When the spider completely came out of the leaf, its beauty and body structure were fully visible. This beautiful moment of the spider was worth watching. When the spider was gradually coming out from behind the leaf, I was also taking some pictures of it and enjoying its beauty.

The black and white pattern of the body of this spider, hairy legs and large eyes at the front gave it a different charm. Although small, they play an important role in maintaining the balance of nature, they live by eating various harmful insects in nature. Finding such small creatures in nature and observing their behavior always fascinates me. This beautiful Jumping Spider will also be a wonderful moment of my recent nature observation. I hope you will like it a lot and enjoy its beauty.

body.body:
/>

“Well, of course when Goody wasn't Goody yet and was owned by those other terrible people who Capt. Ludlow had to dogwalk straight out of the picture, he was like every other dog, so, bared teeth meant he was scared enough to fight you, but now since he has been here, Goody is just smiling.”

Eight-year-old Gracie Trent was explaining to her father's mother, Gladys Jubilee Trent, about how she had gotten Goody since the dog's owners had ever dared come back for the dog after running up on the Ludlows with some foolishness and finding out that –

“Yep, Robert Edward Ludlow Sr. is a man after my own heart, or I should say, out of the Lee branch of warriors using the gift right,” Mrs. Jubilee Trent said. “When a man stands up for what is right, he blesses all around, including deliverance of a dog into a smiling face matching his happy tail.”

“Yep, and see, this is why I get Edwina although she still needs to drink more holy water, because that's too much to be dealing with at eight years old when there are adults that do these things,” Gracie said.

“Yes, she also has her great-great-grandmother Hilda Lee's warrior spirit,” Mrs. Jubilee Trent said, “but you're right, Gracie, that it is OK for y'all to just be safe and cute at your ages.”

“I'm waiting for Edwina to get the Goody anointing,” Gracie said, at which point Gracie's mother, Mrs. Melissa Trent, who was just coming to bring some lemonade, had to retreat, laughing uncontrollably. “I'm waiting for the Spirit to get it through to her, like He has to Goody, that's she's safe and she also can have a smiling face to go with her always fashionably dressed tail.”

That got Gracie's father, Sgt. Vincent Trent, who had come to see why his wife was running with a pitcher of lemonade – he too was vanquished in laughing!

“Well,” Mrs. Jubilee Trent said calmly, “people go through different things and God works with them in good time, but He be steady workin', baby. We ain't gotta ever worry about that. We just keep praying, and giving people bottles of water to help them calm down while He works.”

“Ain't it the truth Grandma, ain't it the truth.”

>[E-Daily Reporter Lim Yoo-kyung] U.S. President Donald Trump has decided to appear as a major contributor to the 250th anniversary of the founding of the United States. The decision came after a series of famous musicians who had originally decided to participate in the event announced their absence.

>According to the Washington Post (WP) and the New York Times (NYT) on the 30th (local time), President Trump will be on stage as a representative cast member of the opening ceremony of the Great American State Fair at the National Mall in Washington, DC next month.
\

said Daniel Alvarez, an adviser to Freedom 250. The Great American State Fair will be hosted by Freedom 250, a pro-(親) Trump-leaning organization established by President Trump as an executive order to plan events marking the 250th anniversary of the founding of the United States.

>President Trump's direct appearance on the stage came after several music performers who were originally scheduled to appear at the event announced their absence one after another, fearing the political color of the event.
The organization announced the list of performers this week, but within a few days, more than half of the cast, including McBride and Michaels, canceled their appearances, saying, \
Michaels explained why he was absent from the event, saying on social media (SNS) X (formerly Twitter), \
\n\n>President Trump criticized the singers who canceled the performance through his SNS Truth Social as \
and offered to appear in person. \
\nPresident Trump then said of the event, \
adding that the rally will be \
\nIn another post, he claimed that the 250th anniversary event should be a rally for his supporters, \
\nIn response to a request for comment regarding the cancellation of performers' appearances, the White House did not disclose its position, saying, \

Lim Yoo-kyung (yklim01@edaily.co.kr )

Here is a natural and coherent English translation:

Why do far-right groups seem to lack a sense of shame?

It’s because admitting shame would reveal their vulnerability, and that could cause supporters who want a strong leader to turn away.

This is a very strange point, because acknowledging one’s mistakes is actually a sign of true strength. However, this phenomenon arises because their level is too low to understand that.

As the overall level of the American public continues to decline, their leaders will likely decline in quality as well.

It is worrying, because it doesn’t seem like our country is far from heading in the same direction.

body.title: The shadows between the game and the dip. Entry for the Shadow Contest/SMASH #428 (ESP/ENG)
body.body:
> Hola, buenos días, tardes o noches, comunidad de #shadowhunters. Una nueva publicación para esta casería de sombras en #hive, versión #428 del #contest #SMASH. --- El viernes estuve de visita donde unos familiares que están trabajando en una finca cafetera. Una parte de la casa está destinada a los dueños y posee unas amplias zonas verdes, piscina y algunos juegos para niños. Mientras recorría el lugar viendo lo que rodeaba la casa, iba mirando los diferentes árboles frutales que tienen: árboles de naranja, árboles de mandarina, árboles de guayaba (dulce y agria), árboles de guanábana, un árbol de guamas y árboles de mango. Puede que tuvieran otros tipos de frutas disponibles, pero no me di cuenta en el momento. La fotografía que comparto en esta ocasión es de un árbol de mango; este se encuentra entre la piscina y la cancha de futbol. Un buen lugar para tener una buena sombra y de paso atrapar un mango dulcecito para disfrutar después de estar en la piscina o un partido. Jajajaja. ---- Gracias por leerme y muchas gracias a los que votan o comentan. Están invitados a participar en este challenge [Shadow Hunters Community SMASh Contest- Round 428](https://ecency.com/@melinda010100/shadow-hunters-community-smash-contest-bbfcf2bf1b0b6). --- ---

> Hello, good morning, afternoon, or evening, #shadowhunters community. A new post for this shadow hunt on #hive, version #428 of the #SMASH contest. --- On Friday, I visited some relatives who are working on a coffee farm. Part of the house is reserved for the owners and features spacious green areas, a swimming pool, and some playground equipment for children. As I walked around the property, looking at the surroundings, I noticed the different fruit trees they have: orange trees, tangerine trees, guava trees (both sweet and sour), soursop trees, a guava tree, and mango trees. They might have had other types of fruit available, but I didn’t notice them at the time. The photo I’m sharing this time is of a mango tree; it’s located between the pool and the soccer field. A great spot to find some shade and, while you’re at it, grab a sweet little mango to enjoy after a dip in the pool or a game. body.title: My Actifit Report Card: May 29 2026
body.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/1f006e12-ad8c-464a-80c3-8322abde6c69.jpg) Hey Actifitters, Nothing special about yesterday, just a routine work day again. I discovered a major problem in one of the biggest projects we are currently working on, and the whole day was spent trying to find the root cause and fix it. Definitely not exciting. But with the sun outside, we made sure to take plenty of breaks in the yard. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/43d66c78-a482-4768-bf10-67ddda2244be.jpg) Le Chat was there of course, like I mentioned many times, even though she would never admit it, she enjoys hanging out with us. You can see it on her face!... ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/5213a878-db4d-43cb-8b7f-a25d626018d7.jpg) And of course we also went for our short daily walk. Kaia's not supposed to walk a lot, but a little activity is necessary for her, she just can't stay doing nothing all day! ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/f96642c8-1116-4367-abff-056dd42360b8.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/d6f5a5d4-af6d-4da2-ba62-e30fbf7b70e0.jpg) But of course I make sure she doesn't overdo it. Just a stroll along the forest edge, catching all the scents she can, and eating grass. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/c4ae32c4-2276-456f-8ccc-222f8b26678b.jpg) I was surprised Le Chat didn't join, but she actually was there, just hiding, or trying at least. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/25f07dc8-2301-4a5a-9ce2-ccb013b029cb.jpg) Just another short easy walk in the neighborhood and we were done for the day. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/c97218f4-ab42-4bc8-bbbf-f55343fa41c0.jpg) I wasn't done with that problem I mentioned at the very beginning though. Good news is that I think I found something that should work. More testing is needed over the weekend, but I am optimistic. It was once again very late when I stopped but if that works, it was worth it. As always, thanks for stopping by and see you tomorrow.
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@manuvert/actifit-manuvert-20260531t023347836z)_

body.title: Street photography from Venezuela - Monomad Challenge.
body.body:
![cover.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23uFVr2Nd6XGPXrK1KwB6oXwtewmRfdLgEh1FbrYjYQBtk8v1z1NiMgrJvWpc63zvUyhT.jpg)
Greetings to all my friends in this beautiful community, today I want to share with you a set of street photographs that I took throughout the entire city where I live. In this set of photos I wanted to focus on people, because they are the ones who create a story in each photo, these first two photos are linked because both gentlemen were drinking coffee:
  Un saludo a todos mis amigos en esta hermosa comunidad, hoy les quiero compartir un set de fotografias callejeras que tomé a lo largo de toda la ciudad en donde vivo. En este set de fotos quise enfocarme en las personas, pues ellas son las que crean una historia en cada foto, estas primeras dos fotos estan unidas porque ambos señores estaban tomando café:  
![IMG_6538.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23u616M3raik1smwh4hLsxA7Lu43fgLiqLES3WQW5w4w2dWUQ6x8YcfJMWnMcevdi6EyR.jpg) ![IMG_7435.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23ynYk8EuJXCiGYW7UnCs25GTiroEd3Fny7Rh8oXjGqUKW5na5DjfAEHBX5SzHFAkbyUS.jpg)
And in the same way, the following two photos are also related because the characters in both photos are doing the same thing, bringing food to their home!
  Y de igual manera, las siguientes dos fotos tambien estan relacionadas pues los personajes de ambas fotos estan haciendo lo mismo, llevando comida a su hogar!  
![IMG_7462.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23vhwwgm2VXD5tw7LL19WkWpZ6MtgbjG32UozC65Fm3vNsiZP2q8ofCJmA44PG9TVQYks.jpg) ![IMG_8115.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23w2qZmAxxcBwypM2W2j97HmrDfCjbo1Ghg7vgjtsee8gJ3XTRn5EKzo4tKSbu4XKqzzb.jpg)

  La siguiente foto la tomé porque en esta ciudad no es comun ver personas usando sombreros y siempre que los veo se me hacen muy interesantes:

body.title: Day 2875 | Walking, Shopping, Getting a Manicure, & Swimming
body.body:
https://images.hive.blog/DQmNjYhK93adNFwMwngE75RC2Qc5nyDrFYmF6kwRpoREVca/IMG_2308.jpeg
I started a challenge of taking 100 days off to mainly focus on my health and overall personal development and used this account as a personal blog to keep track of all my activity. I enjoyed it and continued afterward trying to build better habits and find a good balance between health, fitness, work, entertainment, and my personal life...

Days here in Thailand feel a lot longer that in Belgium and Saturday was a pretty busy one as I was set out to explore Blueport Mall to get some more stuff for my studio. I also feel like I'm the only one who does everything on foot here and in the 3 days here, I actually averaged over 30k steps which is quite crazy especially as the heat is no real limiting factor.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmaJvUej51J2jnFGoKZMie1DuG14wsCqzdgMFTsUEf9yTQ/image.png|https://images.hive.blog/DQmQNdBbsoiETHFzT85eXCw2b1Rq6bDUwEeQ2HtWAKNhHDd/image.png|https://images.hive.blog/DQmYjZQY87R3BzYbfZieYgezZoNvrxfyyrYxrTQRwowfgf7/image.png -|-|-

The main thing I was out to get was some kind of table for next to my bed and a lamp as this isn't there in the condo that I'm renting. I didn't find this at the Blueport Mall though so after walking there for a while, I made the walk toward Market Village Mall where I did manage to get an affordable lamp for around 10€ and also a shirt to wear during my upcoming Muay Thai boxing classes.

There are also a lot of nail stands in the basement of the Mall and I always wanted to try something like that out, so for 200 Baht (~5.6€), I got a basic manicure which took around 20-30 minutes I assume. I kind of enjoyed the process and the result is ok but also nothing spectacular.

On my way back to my condo, I stopped by the Seven Eleven were I picked up some \

food items which I ate once I got home. installed the lamp I bought and my condo is starting to feel a bit more like home especially because of the small JBL boxes that I bought the day before.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmbPHRgX3kVnM9PUtwSb7g6sCQnRFqnnagp33BgL1MmPG9/IMG_2314.jpeg I went for a quick swim and did some texting afterward to friends and family. I headed out again first to go inform at the Muay Thai Boxing Club and afterward just to explore the area a bit and continue to be amazed how much businesses, market, night food courts there are here. I stumbled upon the Baan Khun Por Food court which was actually quite active. I ended up eating there rice noodles with fish and curry coconut sauce which was ok but not something that gets on my list of things that I would instantly order again. https://images.hive.blog/DQmbLPP2iBmbJ3YgDcPKoVWxdZffRC1CMDCYRp4YtwYW4oa/IMG_2316.jpeg I keep being stunned how crazy affordable everything is here especially the food as for just a couple euro you can have a multi course royal meal. I also got myself a Coconut Smoothie No Sugar which was really good. https://images.hive.blog/DQmNwEEVbxx9jA7ydAps5SFSpEuRYbwGUga9uiDKYuD4LGd/IMG_2317.jpeg Once back home it was around 20:00 and I felt like going for another swim which was great again alone in a swimming pool where the lights were turned on. https://images.hive.blog/DQmNMUvnq9fvZPPoyJKqdMBA5BCxgxuuqP7rVdPhF2ZxyVh/IMG_2301.jpeg There was the Champions League match in the evening which kind of gave me a reason to go out and find a spot to possibly watch it. However, it mainly turned out in a long walk as I was not comfortable going into places where they broadcast it were there were few people while at the same time the ones that were more crowded I never saw a suited spot that was free for me to sit. So I basically searched for a super specific setup which lies within my comfort zone which I didn't find. Once back, it was already quite late and I went to bed after some screen time chatting with a match on Bumble who I likely will meet soon and I went to bed. Next Day Goals: I don't have that much planned on Sunday. The idea is to go to Market Village again and try out the food court there and get another shirt for my Muay Thai Boxing as I only bought one yesterday while I will need multiple. I will see where the rest of the day takes me.

body.body: y reconozco las condiciones de emigración de las ultimas oleadas ilegales de venezolanos fueron terribles. No voy a negar que ninguno de los países receptores estuvieran en las mejores condiciones para recibirlos, pero la verdad es que tampoco nosotros estabamos al cien por cien cuando recibimos millones de colombianos, centenares de cubanos o españoles, o sirios. Antes de la crisis, una tercera parte de la población era extranjera o de ascendiente extranjera. Y no les hicimos a ellos, lo que ellos les hicieron a muchos de los compatriotas nuestros en tiempos presentes. Y es triste ver que solidaridad entre pueblos de la que siempre se habló en discursos de intelectuales y politicos, y que muchos venezolanos pensaron que era real, pues no lo fue para muchos que era pobres.

body.title: Makina Sea Log : May 29, 2026
body.body:
Well it has seemed like getting Makina sea ready has been moving ahead nicely; yet it is often two steps forward and another step back. Once launched we were shocked to find, on our first sea trial, that the steering had been installed backwards during repairs on the rudder over the winter. It was a hairy 60 seconds or so, after leaving the dock, until we realized what was going on. The wheel had to be used tiller style to bring us back to dock without a scratch.
![makina-mast-dan.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmd76wWjec3gMAZRx13YQVtUQrzhp7twL4TsdzYdMrnpra/makina-mast-dan.jpg) Exposed rudder during repairs over the winter.
Even after the shipyard repaired their error the rudder, itself, seemed to be riding up a half inch or so when turning to port or starboard. They thought they may have missed a bushing during the winter repairs and have agreed to bring Makina back on the hard to fix what had been missed. While in the water and awaiting our spot in the queue to take Makina back on the hard we put her mast back in. The boom needs to still be installed; which we shall likely do over the upcomgin weekend; yet she is looking more like her old self again.
![makina-rudder-fix.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVVYTFecArMV8saQjax4AYfG9fsrXDSZbrkPcWtxH575d/makina-rudder-fix.jpg) Makina with her skipper and recently installed mast
With the haul out not scheduled until next Tuesday we turned our attention to other little projects to have her readied. One hold up had been to get a new Bimini and Dodger made. The fellow that we had been waiting on turned out to be too busy to fit us in. We decided to try something on our own using the old sails. Not sure that it was mentioned that new sails were made at the Stevens Sail Loft in Lunenburg earlier this spring. They have been there for decades and have done sails for the Bluenose II and most likely the original one.
![makina-new-sails.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQf3turEd3jvYGtm9PDDwxZgreTijhouPuBCaXqFcqKHG/makina-new-sails.jpeg) Makina's new sails
We have been trying to put a pattern together, using a tarp, to allow a local seamstress (Jill) to make the finished product out of one of the old sails.
![makina-bimini-mast.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdWCMxDsqf4Rzen5BhbhsqMmQYeMB4pjvpMoXzFV1FyVb/makina-bimini-mast.jpg) Blue tarp is being used to make a pattern for the finished bimini
Another project we have been moving ahead with is the wind generator. We have tested it and it seems to be in working order. It has not been used since my time as skipper of the Makina. The difficulty we have run into is the installation of the generator on its pole. We think we may have found a solution after a talk with Adam at a local metal works shop. We plan to drop round with the generator and its pole on Monday so that they can manufacture a metal base attachment piece. With the generator installed we should be able to almost double our electrical input from the solar at present during 14+ knot winds. There has been minor project testing previously installed items like thre diesel heater and the fridge which had originally been an icebox. Some rewiring was required. Although this has been a long month of delays we hope that's light we see at the end of the tunnel.
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
May the wind be at your back!

body.title: Is Life Really Unfair? A Different Way to Look at Reality
body.body: ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYVdmFd6AcNyDdGJjZqpJcqPTNM9B8LVqXmgiyyMM5Xgz/1780182852075.png)\n\nMany times in life, we hear people say, \

To be honest, I have said it myself more than once. Sometimes we work hard, stay honest, help others, and still watch someone else move ahead faster than us. In those moments, it feels like the world is not rewarding people fairly.

A few days ago, I came across an interesting idea. It challenged the way many of us think about fairness. At first, I disagreed with it, but after thinking deeply, I realized there was some truth hidden inside it.

The idea was simple: maybe life is not unfair. Maybe our expectations of fairness are different from how the world actually works.

Think about school. Two students study for an exam. One gets excellent marks, and the other fails. The student who failed may feel that life is unfair because they also worked hard. But sometimes hard work alone is not enough. The method of studying, understanding the subject, managing time, and even handling pressure can affect the result.

The same thing happens in jobs and businesses. Many hardworking people never become rich. At the same time, some people seem to move ahead quickly. It is easy to become frustrated when comparing ourselves to others. However, the world often rewards results and impact more than effort alone.

This may sound harsh, but if a person creates something that helps millions of people, society usually rewards them more than someone whose work affects only a few individuals. Whether we like it or not, this is often how things operate.

Another point that caught my attention was how we judge ourselves compared to how others judge us.

We usually judge ourselves based on our intentions.

\

But the world often judges us based on actions and outcomes. People see what we do, not what we planned to do. This does not mean intentions are worthless. Good intentions matter. However, intentions without action rarely change anything.

One area where many people struggle is relationships. Sometimes we like someone, care about them deeply, and hope they will feel the same way. When they do not, we may think life is unfair.

But if we look honestly at the situation, every person has their own experiences, preferences, dreams, and choices. They are not required to choose us simply because we like them. Their decision is about their life, not a judgment of our value as human beings.

I think this lesson can be applied to many situations. Rejection does not always mean failure. Sometimes it simply means that another person has chosen a different path.

Of course, I do not agree with everything in this viewpoint. Life can genuinely be unfair at times. Some people are born into difficult circumstances. Others face challenges that they never chose. Ignoring those realities would be unrealistic.

However, I do believe that many of our frustrations come from expecting life to follow rules that only exist in our minds.

The world does not promise equal outcomes.

It does not promise that every good action will be rewarded immediately.

It does not promise that every dream will come true.

What it does offer is opportunity, growth, learning, and the chance to improve ourselves every day.

For me, the biggest lesson is this: instead of asking whether life is fair, maybe we should ask whether we are understanding reality correctly.

The moment we stop fighting reality and start learning how it works, we give ourselves a better chance to grow, succeed, and find peace.

What do you think? Is life unfair, or do we sometimes have unrealistic expectations of fairness? I would love to hear your thoughts in the comments.

#


PASOS EN PLENILUNIO 

Sus pasos sobre la arena
sus huellas descalzas
atrás quedan borradas
por olas atrevidas
que se extienden barriendo 
con las blancas espumas
el molde de su pisada. 

Ella, toda encantadora
con estilo vivaz
sin parpadeo alguno
camina plácidamente 
radiante intrépida 
retando el fulgor
de la noche plenilunar. 

Danzarina inspiradora 
que va al compás suave
y seductora
emulando sin piedad
la noche esplendorosa
como una extensa Estela
que deja su brillo azulado 
sobre el inmenso mar. 

#

#


FOOTSTEPS IN THE FULL MOON

Her steps on the sand,
her bare footprints
are erased behind her
by bold waves
that spread out, sweeping away
with their white foam
the imprint of her footsteps.

She, utterly enchanting,
with lively style,
without a flicker of emotion,
walks serenely,
radiant and fearless,
defying the brilliance
of the full moon night.

An inspiring dancer
who moves to the gentle, seductive rhythm,
mercilessly emulating
the resplendent night
like a vast wake
that leaves its bluish glow
upon the immense sea.

今年老公单位组织的庆祝六一儿童节活动，对我们来说有着不一样的意义。这是老公在现在的单位参加的最后一次六一活动，因为不久之后，他就要调动去新的单位了。

回想前两年的节日活动，比今年精彩好多。第一年在青少年馆，第二年在研学农场，内容丰富，氛围热闹，孩子们玩得尽兴，对比下来，今年的活动安排是参观博物馆和消防大队，显得没那么好玩，因为前不久我们刚去过博物馆，没有再重复游玩的必要，我便让老公带着两个孩子单独去了消防大队。老二一直特别喜欢各类车辆，对消防车当然也很痴迷。

最让我感慨的，其实是人事的变迁。今年他们单位人员几乎大换血，很多去年还一起参加活动的同事，今年已经调离岗位去往别处。看着陌生的新面孔，再想起往年热闹的氛围，心里难免有些伤感。

不过孩子们的快乐丝毫没有减少，在消防大队，有专业的消防员耐心为大家讲解消防知识和展示救援装备。老大和老二还分别体验了佩戴消防头盔，穿戴消防服，近距离接触和学习消防安全常识，收获满满。对孩子们来说，这依然是一次很有意义很特别的六一体验。

中午因为我们另有安排，没能参加集体聚餐，也算是小小的缺憾。

明年的六一，就是老公在新单位的第一次节日活动了。不知道届时会是怎样的画面呢？

>The economic cooperation between Canada and China, which has been at odds with the Trump administration, is becoming visible.

>Chinese electric vehicles (EVs) have begun entering the Canadian market for the first time, Bloomberg News reported on the 29th local time.
It follows a bilateral trade agreement announced in January by Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney during an official visit to China, where he held a summit with President Xi Jinping, Bloomberg explained.
At the time, China lowered tariffs on Canadian rapeseed imports from the current 84% to about 15% from March 1 this year, and allowed Canadians to enter China visa-free.
Instead, Canada has decided to import up to 49,000 electric vehicles from China over the next 12 months by applying a preferential tariff rate of 6%.
Until last year, Canada had imposed tariffs of more than 100% on Chinese electric vehicles, effectively blocking imports.

>Hundreds of electric vehicles manufactured at Tesla's Shanghai plant have begun entering Canada in recent days under the new low-rate tariff regime, an industry source said on condition of anonymity.
Earlier, U.S. policymakers, including U.S. President Donald Trump, strongly criticized Carney for striking an EV deal with Xi and cutting Chinese tariffs on Canadian agricultural products in return.

body.title: Shape: search photos the way you remember them
body.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmerlin/23tbMFrkaiT2VDbf2zQEokKEUtc34QGp382ono7VuR4Htz45F8kmkHoxH26bzw4ntM5jZ.png)




*The most powerful image search on Hive — and it gets sharper every single day.*

Most search is basically reading over your shoulder. When you look for a photo, it isn't looking at photos at all — it's scanning the words underneath them. The title. The tags. The caption the photographer happened to type. If nobody wrote \

you'll never find that golden-hour shot, no matter how perfectly the light falls.

Shape doesn't work like that. **Shape looks at the picture.**

Every photo published on liketu gets read by Shape — not the words around it, the actual image. The light. The color. The composition. The mood. Who or what is in the frame, and how it's framed. Shape turns all of that into something it can search, so when you go looking, you're searching the photography itself — not the description someone may or may not have bothered to write.

That one difference is why Shape is the most powerful image search we've ever put in your hands. Here's what it actually feels like to use.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmerlin/23tbJmnsJNHgkgFZvvzYh7JPA2HKY7fa7VC8F5m14P8VHShZk4heiRUzPy4112U9MZCwW.png)



## What it feels like

**Type what you're picturing.** Describe the shot in your head — \

— and Shape finds photos that *look* like that. Not photos that contain those words. Photos that match the feeling. The photographer never had to use your language; Shape understood the image on its own.


**Search with a photo.** Have an image you love? Drop it in. Shape finds its closest visual cousins across the whole community — same energy, same palette, same composition — in about a second.

**Follow a creator's eye.** Love how someone shoots? Shape can surface work that feels like theirs, even from creators you've never heard of. It's the fastest way we know to fall down a beautiful rabbit hole.

**Then refine.** See something close? Say \

— and Shape adjusts. It feels less like querying a database and more like talking to someone with very good taste.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmerlin/23tkmmnJj6fGKR5WXVTbL5aanbS8CrVMssh71MjPybnvfXtjf9RGvTeLR5qQzLshojbYe.png)


## So why is it this accurate?

When Shape reads a photo, it doesn't slap a few keywords on it. It converts the image into a kind of mathematical fingerprint — a long list of coordinates that capture what the photo is actually *about*. Two photos that feel alike end up with fingerprints that sit close together. Two that feel nothing alike sit far apart. It's a map of *meaning*, and every photo on liketu has a place on it.

Here's the clever part: your words live on the same map. When you type \

Shape drops that sentence onto the very same map the photos live on — then simply looks at what's nearby. So a phrase and a picture can be compared directly, even though one is made of language and one is made of light. That's why Shape isn't thrown off by a missing caption, a wrong tag, or a different language. It isn't matching letters. It's matching meaning.\n\nThat's the whole leap from old search to Shape: keyword search asks *\

*

## And it only gets better as we grow

Here's the part we love most. A search like this gets *more* accurate as the community gets bigger — the exact opposite of feeling crowded.

Think back to the map. Every new photo published is a new point on it. The more photos there are, the denser the map gets — and the denser the map, the closer the nearest match is to whatever you're picturing. With a few thousand photos, the closest thing to your idea might be \

With millions, there's almost certainly a photo sitting right on top of the exact vibe in your head. Every creator who joins, every shot that goes up, doesn't just add content — it sharpens every search that comes after it.

So Shape isn't a feature that ships and stalls. It compounds. The liketu you search next year will be measurably better at finding your photo than the one you search today — with zero effort from you. The community does the work just by being itself.

That's the idea. Stop searching captions. Start searching photographs.

body.title: 😝National Mint Julep Day! / ¡Día Nacional del Mint Julep! 😎
body.body:
>

***National Mint Julep Day*** Celebrated every May 30th, is an occasion to enjoy one of the most refreshing alcoholic beverages of all time. This drink, considered a classic of the southern United States, is even the official beverage of the Kentucky Derby.

> El Día Nacional del Mint Julep, que se celebra cada 30 de mayo , es una ocasión para disfrutar de una de las bebidas alcohólicas más refrescantes de todos los tiempos. Esta bebida , considerada un clásico del sur de Estados Unidos, es incluso la bebida oficial del Derby de Kentucky. 

Unfortunately, the history of National Mint Julep Day remains a mystery, as we couldn't find the creator of this holiday or even when it was created. However, during our research, we did discover who invented the Mint Julep and when, so let's take a look. The Mint Julep, as it's known today, was invented by ***Jasper Crouch of Richmond***, Virginia. 
While other earlier drinks had used the term ***\

*** to describe a beverage, most of them used rum or gin. Other julep drinks prior to this one contained bourbon, but not with the same formula or the addition of mint as Jasper Crouch's recipe.

> Lamentablemente, la historia del Día Nacional del Mint Julep sigue siendo un misterio, ya que no pudimos encontrar al creador de esta festividad ni siquiera cuándo se creó. Sin embargo, durante nuestra investigación, sí descubrimos quién y cuándo se inventó el Mint Julep, así que vamos a analizarlo.
El Mint Julep, como se le conoce actualmente, fue inventado por Jasper Crouch de Richmond, Virginia. Si bien otras bebidas anteriores habían utilizado el término \

para describir una bebida, la mayoría de ellas utilizaban ron o ginebra. Otras bebidas julep anteriores a esta contenían bourbon, pero no con la misma fórmula ni con la adición de menta que la receta de Jasper Crouch. This classic drink is one of the easiest to prepare and, at the same time, one of the most delicious. It's made with bourbon, sugar, crushed or shaved ice, water, and, of course, fresh mint. It's a drink that has been enjoyed for over 191 years and will surely remain popular for the foreseeable future. ***Ingredients:*** Four sprigs of mint (leaves only, please) One and a half ounces of simple syrup or two sugar cubes Two and a half ounces of bourbon whiskey One sprig of mint for garnish Crushed ice Combine everything and don't forget to garnish the glass with the sprig of mint and add a straw. ***Congratulations, you've just made a Mint Julep!*** > Esta bebida clásica es una de las más fáciles de preparar y, a la vez, una de las más deliciosas. body.title: My Actifit Report Card: May 30 2026 - Another successful day at the Flea Market ✨
body.body:
#
ENGLISH CONTENT

Hello everyone in this community! This weekend, a market was scheduled as part of the activities for Ceramicist's Day, and I had the opportunity to attend as part of the group of artisans. I was quite happy with the invitation, since I'm relatively new to the city with my business, and I'm still looking to find my customers.
![1000427252.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EoK7KASTu325vJJx4wGCVgncdyvTUduQ4WjNXLtVmacBcfYGLg3S5FZRRbJX6PnDDHs.jpg)
**✨ All my products are labeled with names and prices. I understand that some customers are shy and prefer not to be approached right away. ✨**

I arrived early along with the other artisans, and in a good mood, we all arranged our creations on our respective tables. I was excited because I got a good spot and had chosen an outfit I really liked, which gave me a lot of confidence. That way, I was able to overcome my stage fright and talk to everyone who approached me about my products. Sales were great, and I even sold things I didn't think would sell, haha. When you get attached to your work, you almost cry when a product that's been in stock for a long time finally finds a new owner. Good luck to everyone who bought something today!
![1000427251.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EpVCU8jX82bzrNZX1X9wdKdeLsdPAvSunzfNCm9S9UQwpAy4ri1r72rbLdKHZQjB75J.jpg)
**✨ Cat who lay down to rest under my table. The sun was quite intense today ✨**

As I write these lines, I'm very tired, but satisfied. Tomorrow I'm going back to the market and I hope not only to maintain the same enthusiasm for serving the public and potential customers, but also to have such wonderful sales! Wish this artisan fairy luck! 🦋💚
### ✨ Thank you so much for visiting my post. I hope you found it interesting ✨
![sticker-hive-good-luck_eng.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/AJmmUV1yayiznHFJfUGf3NNWfH9ifhsnVHdRXhexXndn8Ky6G7nHMgfMBVmfQdV.gif)

#
💚 Until next time! 💚

![SEPARADOR.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23ydCF6RtBK44fyUqZnnPGvJWAgep2EUuKVgg1fmuih7CXvQzHPWpAqG5Q2SEJmUAZxCx.jpeg)
#
CONTENIDO EN ESPAÑOL

¡Hola a todos los integrantes de esta comunidad! Este fin de semana se pautó realizar un mercadillo como parte de las actividades del día del Ceramista, así que tuve la oportunidad de asistir como parte del grupo de artesanos. Yo estaba bastante contenta con la invitación, ya que soy relativamente nueva en la ciudad con respecto a mi emprendimiento, así que estoy buscando de hallar mi público.
![1000427252.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EoK7KASTu325vJJx4wGCVgncdyvTUduQ4WjNXLtVmacBcfYGLg3S5FZRRbJX6PnDDHs.jpg)
**✨ Todos mis productos etiquetados con nombres y precio. Comprendo que hay clientes tímidos que prefieren no ser abordados a la primera ✨**

Llegué temprano junto al resto de artesanos y con buena disposición, todos acomodamos nuestras creaciones en nuestras respectivas mesas. Estaba emocionada porque conseguí un buen lugar y había escogido un outfit que me gustaba mucho, lo que me daba bastante confianza. De ese modo, pude deshacerme de mi miedo escénico y hablarle a todos los que se acercaban sobre mis productos. Las ventas fueron muy buenas y vendí hasta lo que no pensaba que se vendería jaja Cuando le agarras cariño a tu trabajo, casi lloras cuando un producto que lleva bastante tiempo en stock, por fin encuentra un dueño nuevo ¡Buena suerte a todos los que fueron comprados el día de hoy!
![1000427251.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EpVCU8jX82bzrNZX1X9wdKdeLsdPAvSunzfNCm9S9UQwpAy4ri1r72rbLdKHZQjB75J.jpg)
**✨ Gata que se acostó a descansar debajo de mi mesa. El sol estaba bastante intenso el día de hoy ✨**

Al momento de escribir estas líneas, estoy muy cansada, pero satisfecha. Mañana toca volver al mercadillo y espero no sólo mantener la misma disposición para atender al público y potenciales clientes, sino también, tener tan maravillosas ventas ¡Deséenle suerte a esta hada artesana! 🦋💚
### ✨ Muchas gracias por haber visitado mi publicación. Espero que les haya parecido interesante ✨
![sticker-hive-buena suerte.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/AJmmnEQYeWpz9ahkrnTjX2iQeByWVPm34VwZiDp2JMRshUrYjySk8SdvUVoTPwp.gif)

#
💚 ¡Hasta una próxima oportunidad! 💚

![Banner.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/243qMECvxnUKyfFWvVxjRU8NeQxazLeXcSG2qyeexLvTPHNYJQJUmijkuPNe8qYacVGnd.jpg)

Die überarbeitete Version wird wohl noch zwei oder drei Tage brauchen. 

Denn die KI ist zu dumm eine ordentliche Grafik zu erstellen. Also Annahmen und Daten zu meinem Modell gestern fast 5 Stunden in eine Excel Tabelle eingepflegt.

Die Berechnungen müssen dabei noch grafisch sauber umgesetzt werden.

Bei den Berechnungen sind dann noch zwei Interessante Aspekte von mir entdeckt worden. Ich muss allerdings noch prüfen ob es schon vorher bekannt war. Ansonsten wäre es ebenfalls neu und würde das Standardmodell der Physik wahrscheinlich schlüssig ergänzen. 

Spannende Sache das ganze - und es macht richtig Spaß zu sehen wie sich das Puzzle Teil um Teil zusammen setzt.

body.title: [EN/PT] See you soon, my father-in-law
body.body: > # [EN] Today was my father-in-law’s last day with us, at least for now. Unfortunately, jobs in his field are hard to find in our region, and when they do come up, the pay is usually very low. Because of that, he often has to travel for work, working as a heavy machinery operator. This time, he went to São Paulo to work for a water sanitation company. To mark his departure, my wife and I prepared a special lunch: lasagna, his favorite meal. We chose lasagna because his mother used to make it for him, so we wanted to bring back that memory and make this moment even more meaningful. My wife is a great cook, and it turned out delicious — exactly the way he likes it. Even though it was a sad day because of the goodbye, it was also a very special and memorable one. My father-in-law is leaving, but it is not a farewell. He will stay there until the project is finished — or until he decides he doesn’t like the job and comes back sooner. Knowing him, that’s definitely possible, since he’s quite demanding. In the end, it was one of those days filled with a mix of sadness, gratitude, and the hope of seeing each other again soon. --- # [PT] Hoje foi o último dia do meu sogro conosco, pelo menos por enquanto. Infelizmente, o trabalho dele não costuma aparecer na nossa região e, quando aparece, geralmente paga muito pouco. Por isso, ele está sempre viajando a trabalho, atuando como operador de máquinas pesadas. Desta vez, ele foi para a cidade de São Paulo trabalhar em uma empresa de saneamento. Para marcar essa despedida, eu e minha esposa preparamos um almoço especial: lasanha, a comida favorita dele. Escolhemos justamente esse prato porque a mãe dele sempre fazia lasanha, então quisemos trazer essa lembrança de volta e deixar esse momento guardado na memória. Minha esposa cozinha muito bem, e ficou deliciosa — exatamente do jeito que ele gosta. Apesar de ter sido um dia de despedida e de certa tristeza, também foi um dia muito especial e marcante. Meu sogro vai, mas não é um adeus. Ele ficará por lá até a obra terminar — ou até decidir que não gostou do trabalho e resolver voltar antes. Conhecendo ele, isso também é bem possível, já que é bastante exigente. No fim, ficou aquele sentimento misturado de saudade, gratidão e esperança de reencontro em breve. --- For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@elderdark/en-pt-see-you-soon-my-father-in-law)

body.title: Una pequeña disculpa y una actualización 💙
body.body:
Quiero empezar pidiendo disculpas porque llevo varios días sin publicar nada. Sé que algunas personas estaban acostumbradas a leerme con más frecuencia, y no quería desaparecer sin decir nada.
Como les había contado anteriormente, he estado conociendo mejor a karlos, y la verdad es que todo ha estado siendo muy bonito. Hemos pasado tiempo juntos, hemos salido, paseado y visitado varios lugares. Algo tan simple como ir por un helado terminó convirtiéndose en uno de esos momentos que te hacen olvidar el reloj y disfrutar de la compañía de alguien especial.
Entre una cosa y otra, el tiempo parece escaparse más rápido de lo normal. Entre la escuela, la universidad, las responsabilidades diarias y los momentos que he querido dedicar a mi vida personal, he llegado a casa muchas veces cansada y sin la energía necesaria para sentarme a escribir como me gusta hacerlo.
No es que haya dejado de escribir ni que me haya olvidado de ustedes. Simplemente estoy viviendo una etapa en la que intento encontrar un equilibrio entre mis estudios, mis proyectos, mis amistades, mi tiempo personal y esta nueva historia que poco a poco estoy construyendo.
A veces la vida nos regala personas y momentos que merecen ser vividos con calma, sin prisas y sin estar mirando constantemente el teléfono o pensando en todo lo que tenemos pendiente. Y eso es justamente lo que he estado haciendo estos días.
Por eso quería tomarme este pequeño momento para agradecerles su paciencia y también para pedirles disculpas si me he perdido un poco. No significa que me haya ido; simplemente estoy aprendiendo a organizar mejor mi tiempo mientras disfruto de las cosas buenas que están llegando a mi vida.
Gracias por seguir aquí, por leerme y por acompañarme incluso en los momentos en los que el silencio dura un poco más de lo habitual.
Prometo volver pronto con nuevas historias, nuevas reflexiones y, quién sabe, quizás alguna que otra anécdota de nuestras aventuras por ahí.

Con cariño,

body.title: My Actifit Report Card: May 31 2026
body.body:
Day 2, and reality showed up pretty quickly 😅 After a strong start yesterday, I expected to keep the momentum going. Instead, today turned into one of those lazy days where everything felt slower than usual. I still got out in the morning for a short walk, mixed in a little jogging, and did a few basic exercises, but I never really found my rhythm. The plan was to make up the remaining steps through daily activities, but somehow the day just disappeared. A bit of sitting turned into a lot of sitting, and before I knew it, I was looking at a step count of just 5k. Not the result I wanted, but maybe this is a good reminder that challenges aren't won on motivation alone. Some days you'll crush the goal, and some days you'll barely get halfway there. The important thing is not letting one lazy day turn into a lazy week. Day 2 done — not proud of the number, but still showing up and being honest about it. How do you bounce back after an off day? Do you push harder the next day or just get back to your normal routine? #actifit #11kchallenge #day2 #lazyday #keepmoving

body.title: SPS DAO Project Manager Invoicing and Recap May 2026
body.body:
Greetings my fellow Splintenials. It's been a pretty interesting and busy month helping transition to the new situation with the DAO hiring the team via service contract and addressing unexpected pain points from the transition. We've also had a few security related incidents around the ecosystem and more things to go over. Let's dive in:

First up, the DAO has now fully converted out of its HIVE and HBD position. This took quite a bit of time to do efficiently, but ultimately it was for the best and patience paid off. We managed to exit our HIVE position at an average price of 8.15 cents per token (market price was 6.644 cents at completion) and we managed to exit our HBD position at an average price of $0.968 (market price $0.9535 at completion). We were able to take advantage of the HIVE pump thanks to swift action from the SPS treasurers.

This is probably a good place to summarize the outcome of the whole HIVE DHF agreement proposal from a while back which led to us acquiring such a live HIVE position. In total we spent $300,000 worth of Ethereum to acquire the HBD and HIVE that we sold for a grand total of $269,460 worth of stables. If we had held the [ETH that we converted](https://etherscan.io/tx/0x19b851b6058b8286e380e25daa05de70be80dab43968bafeb030e94bc5ab20e9), it would only be worth about $241,000 right now. Keep in mind we also secured over $400,000 of funding for the company by making this deal. So we can finally put the issue to rest on whether or not the DAO made a bad deal, any way you cut it, we cam out way ahead versus holding the ETH.

There were a few security issues that we had to deal with this month as well. Louis88 brought a very nasty bug to our attention that we had to immediately patch to secure the validator network. There's currently a bug bounty to reward him for doing so. There was also an issue with hive-engine being compromised and while we didn't directly lose anything due to it, the SPS DAO Treasurers decided to pull the SPS:DEC liquidity position that we had on that platform and the team is currently building an in-game SPS:DEC pool for us to utilize going forward. It should be ready in a few weeks. 

After the proposal to hire the team passed, we had to run several proposals related to approving 3rd party market fees as well as ratifying our previous burns. The team had previously made these decisions for us, but after the proposal passed that redirected all of those funds to the DAO, we had to reaffirm that we wanted to keep those old fees and burns in place. That is all resolved now.

I've been working closely with the team and helping to plan future events. Summer Fun will be starting soon and we have quite a few more projects in the oven. I'm not sure what all has been disclosed publicly yet, so I'm not going to spend too much time or energy discussing these upcoming developments, but suffice it to say we're quite busy.

As always, there's a lot going on and I'm optimistic for the future. I know there's a lot of uncertainty in the community right now and the markets are shaky as well, but I do hope that you all will continue on this journey with us. A lot can change over the coming months and I feel confident in our ability to deliver. Well, back to it then. Thanks for reading and until next time...
