body.title: Visiting The Highest Spot In Thailand
body.body:
There are places that you visit because they are beautiful. There are places that you visit because of the food, the culture, or the history. And then there are places that you visit because they have something that no other place in the country has. For our Chiang Mai trip, it was a bit of everything, and one of the most memorable parts of it was our visit to Doi Inthanon National Park, the home of the highest spot in Thailand.

![](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Eqb2bThojYf9iZD9d4hUdPwNKafohxFMFFeWiHLUg8QLyVmhH7bar1buZAuN6rrU8en.jpg?token=17d9c31e6a59d938d1a6d44837969340d22b430b371983a8)

![](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EpxpoHi23rwpGFnbJR7oJDnYJ9zwKHPyhLFPmrDKbp5w4C9e1VFuSvrxJCmFsKaAdua.jpg?token=17d9c31e6a59d938d1a6d44837969340d22b430b371983a8)

I think there is something exciting about being able to say that we stood at the highest point of a country. It’s not everyday that you get to experience that. Doi Inthanon is literally the top of Thailand, and because of that, the whole atmosphere felt different from the other places we visited.

![](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EpJYX7eMVoR2T4WGhaAS4ekvr1FdVpaeAoxaHR72ZeT9NzHhGgtZhF7u6xHuTibbTTP.jpg?token=17d9c31e6a59d938d1a6d44837969340d22b430b371983a8)


The first thing that surprised me was the temperature. The elevation is around 8,366 feet above sea level, and when we arrived, the temperature was only 12 degrees Celsius. Coming from downtown Chiang Mai where the temperature can easily be around 27 to 32 degrees, this was a huge difference. If you don’t bring a jacket or thick clothing, you will literally freeze. LOL. I knew it would be colder because of the elevation, but I didn’t expect it to feel that cold.

![](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EogMqb4yZsgaFkQktWT2CcPQNxUKPe6bgBjM6oUu66emrFbcdt14nZ7ZRiScEjm6Fy1.jpg?token=17d9c31e6a59d938d1a6d44837969340d22b430b371983a8)

![](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EpC8y925DqoF8KATHXeMTtt351PN9FArCV8ibrgnSgQJWv5MJmjVCGppRsmwWkL9zHp.jpg?token=17d9c31e6a59d938d1a6d44837969340d22b430b371983a8)

This place is also known as one of the best spots to watch the sunrise. Unfortunately, we missed the perfect sunrise view because the sky was covered with thick clouds when we arrived. It was a little disappointing, but at the same time, the cloudy weather gave the place a more mysterious and dramatic mood. The mountains in the distance looked soft and layered, almost like a painting covered in mist.


![](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/23x14iCvG72VRkMGBvzXb8iR7uRZEBiDC11J9NbZBABNqfm7Ro7UG1QMx7Ss9C1xo415P.jpg?token=17d9c31e6a59d938d1a6d44837969340d22b430b371983a8)


![](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EokcczNxKTRnzLbe9a6k4Ar6qLBjmxphnHJDRNj8yLnab1viwvsFEZa1BKgPAn9BwKR.jpg?token=17d9c31e6a59d938d1a6d44837969340d22b430b371983a8)


![](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Eo6DaCDvvaDciXnpGxaEthmYYN3pQZGYnP3nG4qW31368zUgod4WCa8BztjfFtSVzPP.jpg?token=17d9c31e6a59d938d1a6d44837969340d22b430b371983a8)


![](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoprS3qiLidwuoXnHtRwtEyN5bpBV9BfYAuGiY5RfMjFC6d6cKjEyvT3tRhKoKwsXQ8.jpg?token=17d9c31e6a59d938d1a6d44837969340d22b430b371983a8)


![](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Eo8RL1RFTtDM7xsLpNDb7sK3ByGQKfe7LEg3rkmfRVDkDBdgtGZe1jYaHYqqcoNiMnm.jpg?token=17d9c31e6a59d938d1a6d44837969340d22b430b371983a8)


![](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EogKqHWXXHq4F7Tc8Beywsyed7BwkSrHpJsqrpxGptDFcqyV7SPCjwphQTZ1CmCerev.jpg?token=17d9c31e6a59d938d1a6d44837969340d22b430b371983a8)


![](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoiPQvLXcUJAoMiXxzVCThM9bF8QTF2rZun6ph7mM462T4WXNEiswHSU3aCXrDt9yL6.jpg?token=17d9c31e6a59d938d1a6d44837969340d22b430b371983a8)


![](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Eoe8g8475YkcKd15jsX6rKSswjYork942pDkCQeHVcHHksadrr35HYy3iWMbz26qyCb.jpg?token=17d9c31e6a59d938d1a6d44837969340d22b430b371983a8)






The walk to the summit was another highlight for me. It felt otherworldly. The path going through the summit area was like walking inside a mini rainforest. There were thick trees, lush plants, moist air, and dew everywhere. The walkway was wet and slippery, so we had to be careful with every step. But I think that is also what made the experience more special. It wasn’t just a normal walk. It felt like the forest was alive, quiet, and breathing around us.

![](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EpLeccUXV8KNZr7AfFqGLQ94i62ghLxEeeNornF34N2DC7dE2dYaGMzQFR534DW7c2E.jpg?token=17d9c31e6a59d938d1a6d44837969340d22b430b371983a8)


![](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Ep7tdw6XDL1njgcV6oN1HTweimD3pYw189LxhoiuWKncdzXioHFPSTD3eUKjYxQfzJ4.jpg?token=17d9c31e6a59d938d1a6d44837969340d22b430b371983a8)


![](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/23z7Hv1nXFxCHBF32h2tHW9wj6cU13TMEze3nChZwHAqRYZ8Y7jJS6g4S3dVKg9xwMeX4.jpg?token=17d9c31e6a59d938d1a6d44837969340d22b430b371983a8)



![](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Eos1Mc46hJmmc8gb6KZggctq7opu9PyfSPBH8c1nu2RFTbsFxqyXWgCCffigR2TQNyu.jpg?token=17d9c31e6a59d938d1a6d44837969340d22b430b371983a8)




Since we arrived early, the shops were not open yet. We waited for a while until they finally opened, and that was when we had something warm to eat. We tried instant chicken porridge and had some hot coffee as well. It was very simple, but because of the cold weather, it felt so comforting. Sometimes these small moments become the best part of the trip. A hot drink, a cold morning, and a place far away from the usual city noise.


![](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EpJXhphKv5kA8RmvMWxAcbK3Xojb2CUdX1bQ7WqnTQk3Lj53iuap9z5gHFn1q8WyX5e.jpg?token=17d9c31e6a59d938d1a6d44837969340d22b430b371983a8)


![](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EogPMC2khXGp7MRoGjrVrZ55adCHZWF6bqtJDEREpaXuCQ56iW3GqbX5LRH1thrQEUB.jpg?token=17d9c31e6a59d938d1a6d44837969340d22b430b371983a8)


![](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EogNqoZtK6Qa9K5afH2rYtoSyMGKjVc2cdX2ddwbsvWVEzEowUcGCHFeQUrL3BRkG8A.jpg?token=17d9c31e6a59d938d1a6d44837969340d22b430b371983a8)








Another interesting part of the visit was going to the 5th Unit Reporting Post of the Thailand Air Force. It was my first time visiting something related to an actual air force site, so the experience felt surreal. They showcased some of the technology and equipment they use, and seeing those towers and facilities at such a high place made the whole visit feel even more unique.

![](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EnaRUsYCdNGQJfpijMCB4NYfXo8vTNtEMFsG4RVEi8gEAZNuboRXq5rf9XQrah1F4ba.jpg?token=17d9c31e6a59d938d1a6d44837969340d22b430b371983a8))



![](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Ep3fJQRZAMpFovry2qsEVgqwv3rb4Hu5194nnKesmhNa9vSMc55MVFyvkfFmwkg6ry8.jpg?token=17d9c31e6a59d938d1a6d44837969340d22b430b371983a8)

![](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EogNkFY6n7AzehrFaa5AyAsJag2YcdxxZgkxPqEMnUYUSoqxUMEd5k5PPbYAFayPWW1.jpg?token=17d9c31e6a59d938d1a6d44837969340d22b430b371983a8)


![](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoeEU2pqJNeLfBCML3M51cRYdowTn6bofv6nE2BPJDzDhzG7JYeRecMyrJKZTuhahDt.jpg?token=17d9c31e6a59d938d1a6d44837969340d22b430b371983a8)


![](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Eonm3QhHTDAsWt8rkH2UoVz59ggFAcez9YH8GvoXkS3HuwwBXXTmbUXku5UchQKbEvG.jpg?token=17d9c31e6a59d938d1a6d44837969340d22b430b371983a8)

![](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EqhG9gLtgnXyoqpxjPxV76vrZi87fvZvz7Pe1fGSca6kg2Y6DCZno9icJk6eMurxRAd.jpg?token=17d9c31e6a59d938d1a6d44837969340d22b430b371983a8)




We also visited the visitor center, where they showcased the natural flora and fauna of Doi Inthanon. It made me appreciate the park even more because it’s not only about being the highest spot. It is also a protected natural area full of life, from the forest trails to the plants and wildlife that make the mountain special.

***Overall, our visit to the highest spot in Thailand was a mix of everything: beautiful nature, extreme cold weather, quiet forest walks, mountain views, and nice people we met along the way. It was a beautiful escape from the city and definitely one of the highlights of our Chiang Mai trip.***

body.title: Pasta cremosa con chuleta ahumada/Creamy pasta with smoked pork chop 🥩🍜
body.body:
> Hello foodies, feliz fin de semana! Por estos lados del mundo hoy pensaba que me libraría de la cocina porque se suponía que mi esposo estaría en casa, pero tristemente no fue así y me tocó cocinar, pero la verdad no quise complicarme mucho, ya que me había mentalizado en que no cocinaría, pero el deber y el hambre me llamaron y no hubo escapatoria, sin embargo me fui por algo rapidito, una pasta cremosa con chuleta ahumada que se hizo súper rápido y quedó deliciosa.
Hello, food lovers, have a great weekend! Around here, I thought I’d be off the hook from cooking today because my husband was supposed to be home, but unfortunately that wasn’t the case and I ended up having to cook; however, to be honest, I didn’t want to make a big fuss of it, as I’d already resigned myself to not cooking, but duty and hunger called and there was no escaping it; so I opted for something quick: a creamy pasta with smoked pork chop that was ready in a flash and turned out delicious.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZT6oyEbpuPtQGHLMvw5fz6p3BZcXmUHMGBSCCuHxcdZu/1780183771817.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) Este tipo de comidas es de mis favoritas porque aparte de quedar muy rica, la verdad es súper rápida de hacer pues mientras la pasta se cocina me encargo de la salsa cremosa y en poco tiempo estamos listos para comer un platillo bastante deli y en poco tiempo. Y ahora sí, vamos con la receta.
This sort of meal is one of my favourites because, as well as tasting absolutely delicious, it’s actually really quick to make: whilst the pasta is cooking, I get on with the creamy sauce, and in no time at all we’re ready to tuck into a really tasty dish. Right then, let’s get on with the recipe.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZcNro19KG6agQk6J7uGRkA7iGtVcPHMM2C3ZNHqgMc5g/1780183009389.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) ## Ingredientes 500 grs de pasta corta 2 chuletas ahumadas 1 lata de crema de leche 1 taza de leche líquida 1 cucharada de harina de trigo 1 cebolla pequeña 3 dientes de ajo Sal Pimienta Aceite
## Ingredients 500 g short pasta 2 smoked pork chops 1 tin of double cream 1 cup of milk 1 tablespoon of plain flour 1 small onion 3 cloves of garlic Salt Pepper Oil
## Procedimiento/Procedure Para la creación de este platillo, lo que haremos primero, será poner a cocinar nuestra pasta como de costumbre. Por supuesto, primero ponemos el agua y una vez ésta ha comenzado a hervir agregamos la sal y la pasta. En cuanto hayamos agregado la pasta comenzamos a cortar los vegetales que vamos a utilizar para nuestra **pasta cremosa con chuleta**, que en este caso, serán cebolla y ajo.
To make this dish, the first thing we’ll do is cook the pasta as usual. Of course, we start by putting the water on to boil, and once it’s come to the boil, we add the salt and the pasta. As soon as we’ve added the pasta, we’ll start chopping the vegetables we’re going to use for our **creamy pasta with pork chop**, which in this case will be onion and garlic.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR9BiFvQpLVLsGs9KJWouQd5uWToimBnJHu1j4s2GGhDU/1780183009245.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) Seguidamente cortamos las chuletas en cubos pequeños y comenzaremos con la preparación del sofrito, para lo que agregaremos en una olla dos cucharadas de aceite y una vez caliente, incorporamos la cebolla y el ajo y salteamos por tres minutos aproximadamente a fuego medio.
Next, cut the chops into small cubes and start preparing the sofrito: add two tablespoons of oil to a pan and, once hot, add the onion and garlic and sauté for about three minutes over a medium heat.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf6mxnnJ8P5SJDRUepYBqctGBA4DkkwkALocv21vQjfFZ/1780183009715.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQrBAaf2Ky1yDbtTAoYvht77SKiQb6TayzoF2PE1LKvpq/1780183009523.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) Una vez han transcurrido los tres minutos, incorporamos las chuletas y dejamos cocinar aproximadamente por cuatro minutos, removiendo de vez en cuando.
Once the three minutes are up, add the chops and cook for about four minutes, stirring occasionally.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUqpQJ5Gp1LHMJuVdFqqUWcBotkfB36LfyQszFWw4nRAD/1780183009903.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) Mientras tanto en un bol agregamos la taza de leche junto con la crema de leche y la cucharada de harina de trigo y mezclamos muy bien asegurándonos de no dejar grumos, y agregamos a nuestra olla una vez hayan transcurrido los 4 minutos.
Meanwhile, in a bowl, combine the cup of milk with the single cream and the tablespoon of plain flour, and mix thoroughly, making sure there are no lumps, then add this to the saucepan once the 4 minutes are up.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSbRQYDCJnzfcF84689ytueFdoDsPQhLjv3UVYQ14WFaL/1780183231263.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) Incorporamos bien con ayuda de una paleta y agregamos sal y pimienta al gusto y dejamos cocinar hasta obtener la consistencia deseada. Una vez nuestra pasta está lista, colamos y emplatamos con una buena cantidad de salsa, y de esta forma tenemos lista de manera rápida y sencilla nuestra receta de **pasta cremosa con chuleta ahumada**.
Stir well with a spatula, season with salt and pepper to taste, and cook until the desired consistency is achieved. Once the pasta is ready, drain it and serve with a generous helping of sauce. And just like that, our recipe for **creamy pasta with smoked pork chop** is ready in no time at all.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZPhqcnenQhVU2hv3dzwU5VKji1vSKBL43iodhmQksJBZ/1780183231414.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcsrHmKiZduUNDcEbQ9oqKJ3BD9LxY7b2EL7paAgGfuzp/1780183231704.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQme9hY99PA71az5YRWnAX9rKsbQJ13Ei3oTNSwZLwdXxMy/1780183231566.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) Como les comenté al inicio es un plato bastante sencillo de hacer y lo mejor de todo es que es súper rápido así que no hay excusas para prepararlo en casa. >As I mentioned at the start, it’s a fairly simple dish to make, and best of all, it’s really quick, so there’s no excuse not to make it at home.
📷*Photography by|Fotografía por:@rlathulerie,🔅 Cover created in/Portada creada en [Canva](https://www.canva.com), [Separator and banner/separador y banner](https://hive.blog/hive-148441/@ikasumanera⁰⁰/eng-es-i-made-hive-free-use-art-of-for-all-of-you-part-1-dividers-and-banners-or-hice-arte-de-libre-uso-para-todos-parte-1), 🇺🇸Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)*

body.title: Siempre un motivo para celebrar [Esp/Eng]
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNdUfQFY8sqDFt9HSwE8DMs3MHHhPazDBF6pLvZKodcac/1780191116987.jpg)



***
***
Falta un mes para que mi hija cumpla 13 años y, sí, ya estoy preparando la celebración. Aún no sé si será una tarde de juegos con sus amigos, una salida especial o una cena temática en casa, pero lo que tengo claro es que voy a celebrarlo, con globos, con tarta, con fotos, con ruido y con todo el amor que quepa en ese día.

Pero si soy honesta, la celebración ya empezó hace semanas, cada vez que la veo reír, que la escucho contarme un secreto o que la observo cruzar esa frontera invisible entre niña y adolescente. Cumple 13, pero yo también cumplo algo: 13 años de querer a alguien más que a mí misma.
***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXzbDWae9iPXRdYJfXqhLtpnnRTGofbfNt59nsUjFvaTt/1780191351407.jpg)


***
Y eso, en el camino del crecimiento personal, es un hito enorme, porque aprender a querer a otro así, con las tripas, con miedo, con orgullo, con renuncias y con mucho aprendizaje, te cambia por dentro y te enseña que el amor no solo se siente, se construye cada día. Y también te enseña que no hace falta una fecha roja en el calendario para rendirle honor a la vida.

Por eso, desde hace tiempo adopté una filosofía sencilla: siempre hay que buscar motivos para celebrar, aunque sea un café a tiempo con un amigo, una semana sin gripe, un objetivo pequeño que cumpliste, una noche que dormiste bien o una conversación difícil que lograste tener. La vida no es solo grandes metas ni cumpleaños redondos, sino lo que pasa en lo cotidiano, y lo cotidiano merece festejo.
***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTHMpwjsFQmMmiBTRwP3YF2vnZLHuUefGxkS33kbjA3pd/1780191351333.jpg)


***
Esta comunidad de crecimiento personal sabe bien que celebrar no es frívolo, es decir: \

. Es anclarte en el presente, agradecer y permitirte sentir que, a pesar del caos, del estrés, de las dudas, hay algo bueno que merece un momento de alegría plena.


Pensarán quizás que estoy exagerando, pero ya he comenzado a preparar ingredientes de la ensalada fría que tanto adora, mientras comienzo a medir distancias para la decoración que planeo. Es cierto que son tiempos de crisis y más en este país, y que con muy poco debemos hacer mucho, pero eso es quizás también un incentivo que nos empuja. Cuando se trata de celebrar la felicidad, los esfuerzos son también un instante de fiesta.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRH6Dw1oPQGuqtZEPCe9eGVt5LWUbGrhcFiMBMaLRqhAZ/1780191351478.jpg)


***
Así que ya no sueño con tener la casa perfecta, el cuerpo perfecto, el trabajo perfecto o la vida resuelta, sino que celebro lo que ya está, las pequeñas victorias.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaW7vE4cXa48nzjmw9TtoZdVgHndgH4MAoaNqMUJqcCmS/1780191351524.jpg)


***
Mi hija dentro de un mes soplará velas, pero yo ya estoy soplando las mías cada vez que la miro y pienso en todo lo que hemos crecido las dos. Mientras, voy celebrando a diario la vida, los sueños y, sobre todo, estar con ustedes en esta comunidad @holos-lotus, que siento como mi casa.

<center>❤️</center>
<center>❤️</center>

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRSmczRZ7mh457ozsGyfJF93vxnsidtnD9LmCYpF1XK9K/1778037185350.jpg)

<sub>✨**¡𝑮𝒓𝒂𝒄𝒊𝒂𝒔 𝒑𝒐𝒓 𝒍𝒆𝒆𝒓!** ✨
𝑺𝒊 𝒂ú𝒏 𝒏𝒐 𝒎𝒆 𝒄𝒐𝒏𝒐𝒄𝒆𝒔: 𝒔𝒐𝒚 **𝒏𝒆𝒖𝒓ó𝒍𝒐𝒈𝒂 𝒚 𝒆𝒔𝒄𝒓𝒊𝒕𝒐𝒓𝒂 𝒄𝒖𝒃𝒂𝒏𝒂**, 𝒎𝒂𝒅𝒓𝒆, 𝒎𝒖𝒋𝒆𝒓 𝒚 𝒔𝒐ñ𝒂𝒅𝒐𝒓𝒂 𝒒𝒖𝒆 𝒆𝒏𝒄𝒐𝒏𝒕𝒓ó 𝒆𝒏 𝑯𝒊𝒗𝒆 𝒖𝒏 𝒉𝒆𝒓𝒎𝒐𝒔𝒐 𝒆𝒔𝒑𝒂𝒄𝒊𝒐 𝒑𝒂𝒓𝒂 𝒗𝒐𝒍𝒂𝒓.  
**𝑬𝒍 𝒕𝒆𝒙𝒕𝒐 𝒚 𝒍𝒂𝒔 𝒊𝒎á𝒈𝒆𝒏𝒆𝒔 𝒔𝒐𝒏 𝒅𝒆 𝒎𝒊 𝒂𝒖𝒕𝒐𝒓í𝒂**, 100% 𝒉𝒖𝒎𝒂𝒏𝒐𝒔 (𝒔𝒊𝒏 𝑰𝑨).

![cinti 800x20 - copia.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWKGeMBmj14VqKn8xBrmpFM3RYVcgmAXX6bGnGwuNWEnc/cinti%20800x20%20-%20copia.jpg) 

### <center>ENGLISH VERSION</center>

![cinti 800x20 - copia.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWKGeMBmj14VqKn8xBrmpFM3RYVcgmAXX6bGnGwuNWEnc/cinti%20800x20%20-%20copia.jpg) 


## <center> Always a reason to celebrate</center>





![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcY45jJW2rvEkQvugTyMYVUFnSBDTCMGrJPbwaX64jFEe/1780191117138.jpg)


***
***


One month left until my daughter turns 13, and yes, I am already preparing the celebration. I still do not know if it will be an afternoon of games with her friends, a special outing, or a themed dinner at home, but what I am clear about is that I am going to celebrate it, with balloons, with cake, with photos, with noise, and with all the love that fits into that day.

But if I am honest, the celebration already began weeks ago, every time I see her laugh, listen to her tell me a secret, or watch her cross that invisible border between girl and teenager. She turns 13, but I am also turning something: 13 years of loving someone more than myself.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXzbDWae9iPXRdYJfXqhLtpnnRTGofbfNt59nsUjFvaTt/1780191351407.jpg)


***
And that, on the path of personal growth, is a huge milestone, because learning to love another person like that, with guts, with fear, with pride, with sacrifices, and with a lot of learning, changes you from within and teaches you that love is not only felt, it is built every day. And it also teaches you that you do not need a red date on the calendar to honor life.

That is why I adopted a simple philosophy some time ago: you should always look for reasons to celebrate, even if it is a timely coffee with a friend, a week without the flu, a small goal you achieved, a night you slept well, or a difficult conversation you managed to have. Life is not only about big goals or milestone birthdays, but about what happens in everyday life, and everyday life deserves a celebration.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTHMpwjsFQmMmiBTRwP3YF2vnZLHuUefGxkS33kbjA3pd/1780191351333.jpg)


***
This personal growth community knows well that celebrating is not frivolous; it means saying, \

It is about anchoring yourself in the present, being grateful, and allowing yourself to feel that, despite the chaos, the stress, and the doubts, there is something good that deserves a moment of pure joy.


They might think I’m exaggerating, but I have already started preparing the ingredients for the cold salad that he/she loves so much, while I begin measuring distances for the decoration I’m planning. It’s true that these are times of crisis, especially in this country, and that we must do a lot with very little, but that is perhaps also an incentive that drives us. When it comes to celebrating happiness, our efforts are also a moment of celebration.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRH6Dw1oPQGuqtZEPCe9eGVt5LWUbGrhcFiMBMaLRqhAZ/1780191351478.jpg)


***
So I no longer dream of having the perfect house, the perfect body, the perfect job, or a settled life; instead, I celebrate what is already here, the small victories.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaW7vE4cXa48nzjmw9TtoZdVgHndgH4MAoaNqMUJqcCmS/1780191351524.jpg)

***
My daughter will blow out candles in a month, but I am already blowing out mine every time I look at her and think about how much we have both grown. Meanwhile, I go about celebrating daily life, dreams, and above all, being with all of you in this @holos-lotus community, which I feel is my home.

<center>❤️</center>
<center>❤️</center>

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYweGm8mMxKLmFZYSPAHak3F6Zz1vgqfa4B6ixGv588XE/1778037185465.jpg)

今天快到中午的时候，妈妈又急了，微信又开始疯狂的嘟我！原来又叫我过去帮她收款，她拿了一些旧衣服去卖！上个星期也是叫我过去这样做，现在收破烂的人不给现金，只有手机付款了！妈妈不会，我也教不会她！所以上次跟她一起把东西拉过去小区附近的回收车里的！

哪里有人负责称重和打款的，有个阿姨跟我妈妈一样不会弄！最后她们两个人的钱都打到我手机上，一共130多元！我再把现金给妈妈，妈妈再给那个阿姨！阿姨感谢妈妈，拿了两个粽子给妈妈吃！妈妈最后给了一个粽子我，咸蛋黄肉粽，我的最爱！

这次我的电动车没电了，我就微信给她，我的收款码！叫她给别人就可以了，也不知道她会不会处理？半个小时了，妈妈也没反应，我也没收到款，真是担心😟的！

body.body:

![FB_IMG_1780191138029.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rubenjr/23vhwaTXKPVLVFfCqZWShANMHM8RmxcM3UoCF7fvXz9qHfT42P7GjYt3F3uDTKjJHdST9.jpg)

**Is a lie still a sin if it’s told entirely out of love?**
Most of you here know me as @rubenjr, sharing my thoughts on life, work, and everything in between. But long before I ever became a blogger, I took on a role that required a completely different, much heavier kind of storytelling.
<div class=\

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rubenjr/243BpnSfp9qfKfffs1VeKD6c1vQVnePifG7hLwdTuqe7uzqbM8ENrwZ3GgjXkfng44B7f.jpeg --- I had to face that question for the first time when my wife and I welcomed our first child. That feels like a lifetime ago now. Today, we are blessed with three graceful daughters and a wonderful son. But truth be told, before we had children, we never could have imagined a life built on so many gentle untruths.

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rubenjr/23xL11eUZAyuEAri5YpCG9DAUMS4pgs21epJZDhYijQk2xMoN1oAfD7DPCJefWj1U746x.jpeg --- I still remember the nights I had to put on a smile and pretend everything was perfectly fine, just so my children could live unbothered, peaceful lives. As a parent, you learn to lie about the simplest things to protect their innocence.

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rubenjr/243qHbc7Gqv5rrUkM3foWu7A1AV84P78Ufm51ZvUxsDXNS9x1VDXjGEfCj25ZgzwmyuXW.jpeg --- I remember the times when we didn't have much to put on the table. My wife and I would sit there, stomachs empty, pretending we had already eaten just so our children could have a bigger share. We smiled through the hunger because seeing them full was its own kind of feast. ![received_1710915329913365.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rubenjr/Eos2FGxkZEXijnyzrNAcYnkeRUyMaKVGCvkom7TbnoJtXTyQ5a1gkjGzRXpfDQUhnt7.jpeg) **My 3 daughters; and my niece (the one with dark yellow dress)** And even now, looking back, I don’t regret a single lie. Every look we traded, every \

through exhaustion was all born out of pure, fierce love. I have learned that no matter how much a family lacks, parents will always find a way to make their children feel whole. In doing that, I know in my heart I have given everything to be the best father I could be.\n\n<div class=\

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rubenjr/EoAc5A3bN7dvumQWohAyTaZpHKNARqZWFxesPxRc9sofwuMhUwRoCCm6SFfkje5XzYQ.jpeg **My eldest daughter and my second daughter @rufajane** I may be a strict father. I rule by principle, and I hold my ground because I know that parents see a horizon their children can't quite see yet. I have protected them fiercely. Truthfully, I’ve always found it hard to trust outsiders even close friends, with their safety. They are my ultimate responsibility. Being their shield and their safe harbor is what gives my life true meaning.

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rubenjr/Ep3fD3Q9y46agDwo5rHtdQPyAZkHuZu8g3SxeNyxFKNrDfDVKhnGSXQkFz2PPGzuBdL.jpeg I love being a father, even with all the grueling hard work it demands. But lately, as I look at them growing into mature, responsible adults, a bittersweet feeling catches in me. I can't shake the realization of how fast time slips through our fingers. Sooner or later, they will build their own lives and start their own families. I will be incredibly happy for them when that day comes, knowing I did my part. But a piece of my heart will always miss the days when they needed my protection.

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rubenjr/241tdZQvtv1hGrmzd1byEjNeSxq5bMZUKHc8EzgSqiVkySDJXnnV7s7Qqu9D358ECMdR2.jpeg **My son, Jared** They say that **the first man to love a princess is never the prince, but the king**. The time will inevitably come when my children marry people who will love them wholeheartedly. But nothing can ever erase the fact that the very first man to love my daughters and my son was me. It is a sacred cycle. To all the parents reading this: I see you, and I respect you deeply, no matter what your journey looks like. Being a parent is beautiful, but it is never easy. It is a lifelong project of pouring your soul into another human being, and the silent struggles we carry are no joke. https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rubenjr/48SqKuG4hA88sgagLRAw9XqsjzMmpChHGVGyDBxn1u4JZPtxkKvRkckAzDHTMnxFDY.png Keep pouring, keep protecting, and keep loving. It is always worth it.

body.body:
**“Agua”** es de esas palabras básicas que sostienen todo el idioma y, literalmente, la vida. La frase **“No podemos vivir sin agua”** funciona muy bien porque es simple, clara y universal, y la imagen del **ciclo hidrológico** le da un giro educativo más completo al post.

Lo más logrado aquí es que unes **vocabulario + oración útil + contexto científico** en una sola publicación. Eso hace que no sea solo memorizar una palabra, sino entenderla en uso real. El contraste entre la ilustración sencilla de *water / 水 / agua* y la explicación del ciclo del agua también le da variedad visual, que ayuda bastante.

Para pulirlo un poco, solo cuidaría un detalle de consistencia: arriba aparece **“Agua (el)”**, pero en español correcto es **“el agua”** por cuestión fonética, aunque **agua** sigue siendo un sustantivo **femenino**. Ese tipo de matiz lingüístico da para otro post entero y estaría buenísimo en tu serie. Como referencia de tu trabajo reciente, tu publicación enlazada anterior fue [A Daily Word in Spanish (418)](https://inleo.io/@aljif7/a-daily-word-in-spanish-418-mprty08u3457e3e1?referral=aljif7).

También encaja con tu línea educativa reciente en InLeo, donde vienes mezclando aprendizaje de idioma con explicaciones accesibles desde [tu perfil de publicaciones](https://inleo.io/@aljif7). Es un formato sencillo, pero precisamente por eso funciona: **enseña sin hacerse pesado**.

body.title: Seamos como el mar.
body.body:
# <Center>¡Saludos amigos!</Center>

#

Espero que se encuentren muy bien, y que estén pasando un hermoso día. En esta oportunidad me encuentro aquí, ya que voy a estar compartiendo con ustedes una persona reflexión. Espero que les guste mucho con amor y cariño para ustedes jejej:

#

<Center>![Seamos como el mar._20260530_204041_0000.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmW7JwY2yeuM7g1D2cfPY1j5jE2u8R2BSVk9BfFAJjWhxn/Seamos%20como%20el%20mar._20260530_204041_0000.png)</Center>
<Center><sub>Imagen diseñada en CANVA</sub></Center>

#

El mar sin duda es una de las cosas más misteriosas y terroríficas del mundo, pero eso es si nos vamos a un tema más profundo. Pues hay muchas teorías sobre el mar, como lo es si viven los alienígenas y lo peligroso que es el mismo mar. Eso, para ser sincero, es un tema que me da bastante miedo y, como tal, el mar me da miedo; nada más voy a la playa hasta la orilla del resto, más nada, nunca he tenido esa confianza y ese amor al mar. Amo al ver cómo muchas personas muestran sus playas hermosas, demostrando su cultura y su país. Dejando atrás la playa, llega el mar, que queda mucho más lejos y que simplemente está solo. Muy pocas son las personas que se atreven a llegar a ella, y ni siquiera a gusto, sino en barcos y demás, sintiendo ese miedo de que en cualquier momento se van a caer y les va a pasar algo malo. Ven al mar como malo, y es verdad que sus olas y su poder pueden llegar a dar miedo, y más cuando están en bocas de las demás personas que dicen: \

, jaja, es verdad, pero eso pasa muchas veces en la vida real: nos dejamos llevar por las palabras de las demás personas y vemos al mundo como si fuera malo simplemente porque alguien lo dijo, y no es así.

#

Debemos siempre ver antes de hablar, quemados mal con el mundo, con nosotros y con Dios. Es algo feo, pero es cuando hablamos sin pensar. En la vida están esas personas solitarias; nadie se les acerca, tienen muchos apodos feos, y las personas dicen que es peligro. Pero cuando lo detallas bien, es todo lo contrario; es una persona increíble con muchas metas que cumplir en su vida. Por más dura que sea la vida con él, sigue adelante, sigue sonriendo y nunca se rinde. Eso pasa con el mar, todos dicen que es peligroso, que viven monstruos, pero él sigue ahí, dándonos agua buena, un buen ciclo y, como quien dice, la vida. Ha recibido muchísimas malas palabras, pero sigue brillando con la luz del sol, y sigue teniendo ese color azul claro que al verlo te da miedo, pero es una fuente de inspiración para escribir, dibujar, etc. El mar nos enseña mucho; siempre está solo, pero sigue igual. Nada le ha afectado; las palabras de las personas no le afectan, y es feliz y es necesario para quienes la necesitan. El mar da miedo, puede ser peligroso, pero podemos agarrarlo como fuente de reflexión e inspiración. Las malas palabras y las personas no pueden afectar a nadie, y por más peligroso que sea el mar, debemos cuidarlo mucho.

#

<Center>![Seamos como el mar._20260530_204258_0000.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcmFQ5uWSiLHunVqPBmsGbgaJnkrJbYzagGgXd5a2bhUS/Seamos%20como%20el%20mar._20260530_204258_0000.png)</Center>
<Center><sub>Imagen diseñada en CANVA</sub></Center>

#

Así que ya saben, amigos, el mar nos deja mucho aprendizaje. Da miedo, pero vean cómo es la fuente de pensar bien, y es la ayuda de la vida para seguir adelante. A mí me da miedo, pero lo cuido mucho. Así que ya saben, mis queridos amigos, no hablar feo de los demás y buscar las cosas por nuestra propia cuenta.

#

Y bueno amigos. Espero que les haya gustado mucho mi publicación, y que les sirva de reflexión. Un fuerte abrazo y bendiciones.

#

# <Center>Greetings, friends!</Center>

#

I hope you're all doing well and having a wonderful day. I'm here today to share a personal reflection with you. I hope you enjoy it! With love and affection for you all, hehe.

#

<Center>![Seamos como el mar._20260530_204041_0000.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmW7JwY2yeuM7g1D2cfPY1j5jE2u8R2BSVk9BfFAJjWhxn/Seamos%20como%20el%20mar._20260530_204041_0000.png)</Center>
<Center><sub>Imagen diseñada en CANVA</sub></Center>

#

The sea is undoubtedly one of the most mysterious and terrifying things in the world, but that's if we delve deeper into the subject. There are many theories about the sea, such as whether aliens live there and how dangerous it is. To be honest, that's a topic that scares me quite a bit, and as such, the sea itself frightens me. I only go to the beach as far as the shoreline, nothing more. I've never had that trust or love for the sea. I love seeing how many people showcase their beautiful beaches, demonstrating their culture and their country. Leaving the beach behind, there's the sea, which is much farther away and simply deserted. Very few people dare to venture into it, and even then, not comfortably, but on boats and such, feeling that fear that at any moment they might fall in and something bad will happen to them. They see the sea as bad, and it's true that its waves and power can be scary, especially when other people say things like, \

haha, it's true, but that happens a lot in real life: we let ourselves be carried away by other people's words and see the world as if it were bad simply because someone said so, and it's not like that.

#

We should always look before we speak, because we're often disillusioned with the world, with ourselves, and with God. It's a sad thing, but it happens when we speak without thinking. There are those lonely people in life; no one approaches them, they have many mean nicknames, and people say they're dangerous. But when you really look at them, it's the complete opposite; they're incredible people with many goals to achieve in their lives. No matter how hard life gets for them, they keep going, keep smiling, and never give up. The same is true of the sea. Everyone says it's dangerous, that monsters live there, but it's still there, giving us good water, a healthy cycle, and, so to speak, life itself. It has received countless harsh words, but it continues to shine in the sunlight, and it still has that light blue color that, when you see it, frightens you, but is a source of inspiration for writing, drawing, and so on. The sea teaches us a lot; it's always alone, but it remains the same. Nothing has affected it; people's words don't affect it, and it's happy and essential for those who need it. The sea is frightening, it can be dangerous, but we can also use it as a source of reflection and inspiration. Bad words and bad people shouldn't harm anyone, and however dangerous the sea may be, we must take great care of it.

#

<Center>![Seamos como el mar._20260530_204258_0000.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcmFQ5uWSiLHunVqPBmsGbgaJnkrJbYzagGgXd5a2bhUS/Seamos%20como%20el%20mar._20260530_204258_0000.png)</Center>
<Center><sub>Imagen diseñada en CANVA</sub></Center>

#

So, you know, friends, the sea teaches us a lot. It's scary, but see how it's a source of clear thinking, and it's life's support to keep going. It scares me, but I take great care of it. So, you know, my dear friends, don't speak ill of others and seek things out for yourselves.

#

And well, friends. I hope you enjoyed my post and that it gives you food for thought. Warmest regards and blessings.

body.title: Series para finalizar la semana 🙌🏽😎🏃🏻‍♀️
body.body: > Finalizo la semana con entrenamiewnto de series. Viernes, amanecio un hermoso dia un clima agradable, y un cielo con hermoso solores, me fui temprano hacer mi entrenamiento, hoy me tocaba series, el dia jueves lo tome de descanso, siempre trato de tener los descansos intermedio a los entrenamientos. Realice mi acostumbrado calentamiento de 2 kilometros en el parque, estaban vafrias personas entrenando. Luego me fui al estadio, ya estaba abierto cuando llegue y una amiga estaba entrenando. Di una vuelta al estadio, me hidrate y comenece mi trabajom de series, para hoy el planteamiento fueron 8 series de 400 mts con descanso de 1 minuto, las series de 400 metros, ya hoy en dia se han convertido para mi en mas llevadera, de alli para adelante si que son todo un desafio. Realice mis series iniciando mas lento superando los 2 minutos, luegos comence a bajar, me gusto que una serie de 400 metros la hice en 1:47,2 minutos. Senti la fatiga al culminar, y me mentuve fuerte de mente enfocada en la cadencia para culminarla bien, los trabajos de fuerza, y las cuestas me han ayudado mucho a mejorar mi potencia, y la cadencia. --- Ya al finalizar las series senti una ligera molestia en las caderas, esto debido a un calzado que utilice para el ultimo entrenamiento de cuesta que hice, que senti que me causo un dolor, no le habia parado mucho, pero hoy lo volvi a sentir mas fuerte, bueno en nombre de Dios mejore, por lo que me tomare un descanso a ver como evoluciona el dolor, ademas de tomarme un tratamiento para desinflamar. Al terminar las series, enfrie un poco, y me fui caminando a casa, disfrutando del dia viernes ya que viene el finde semana, mne encantan los viernes. Seguimos amigos con los entrenamientos. 💕💕🏃🏽‍♀️‍➡️ --- . >Greetings and blessings.! >

>I ended the week with interval training. Friday dawned as a beautiful day with pleasant weather and a sky ablaze with stunning colors. I headed out early for my workout; today was interval training day, and I’d taken Thursday off. I always try to schedule rest days between training sessions. I did my usual 2-kilometer warm-up in the park, where there were quite a few people training. Then I went to the stadium; it was already open when I arrived, and a friend was training there. I ran a lap around the stadium, hydrated, and started my interval work. Today’s plan was 8 sets of 400 meters with a 1-minute rest. The 400-meter intervals have become more manageable for me these days, but from there on out, they’re a real challenge. I started my intervals slower, taking over 2 minutes, then began to speed up. I was pleased that I ran one 400-meter interval in 1:47.2 minutes. I felt the fatigue at the end, but I stayed mentally strong and focused on my cadence to finish it well. Strength training and hill work have really helped me improve my power and cadence. --- >By the end of the sets, I felt a slight discomfort in my hips. This was due to the shoes I wore for my last hill workout, which I felt caused me some pain. I hadn’t paid much attention to it before, but today I felt it more intensely. Well, God willing, it’ll get better, so I’m going to take a break to see how the pain develops, in addition to taking some medication to reduce the swelling. After finishing the sets, I cooled down a bit and walked home, enjoying Friday since the weekend is coming up—I love Fridays. Let’s keep at it, friends. 💕💕🏃🏽‍♀️‍➡️ --- --- Todo el contenido es de mi autoría y las imágenes son de mi propiedad Fotos fueron tomadas con mi HONOR X6a Plus Separador editado en Canva Traducido con [Deepl](https://www.deepl.com) > All content is my own and the images are my property. > Photos were taken with my HONOR X6a Plus > Translated with [Deepl](https://www.deepl.com) > Publisher edited in the application Canva [Puedes chequear mi actividad en Strava](https://strava.app.link/JOjIIPXNz3b) --- [ You can check my activity at Strava](https://strava.app.link/JOjIIPXNz3b) ![SRL-image-14.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTN93piGhVsStGYqyRaiGAqHLC4oXUyMuBepEzJJrRW59/SRL-image-14.png) --- For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@mcookies/series-para-finalizar-la-semana)

body.title: Una oportunidad para Petra 😻 An opportunity for Petra
body.body:
Hace aproximadamente dos semanas, apareció un gato en un terreno en construcción abandonado que queda frente a mi casa. Lo vimos un día desde el balcón y nos preguntamos cómo se había metido ahí, ya que las paredes son altas. Pasó varios días en ese lugar, un día lo veíamos, otros no, y al parecer no podía salir de allí. Luego con unos binoculares vimos que estaba herido en un costado, quizás por eso no podía, porque hemos visto otro gato que baja y se sube por un lado donde hay unos objetos acumulados. >*About two weeks ago, a cat appeared on an abandoned construction site across the street from my house. We saw it one day from the balcony and wondered how it had gotten in there, since it has high walls. It stayed there for several days; we'd see it some days, not others, and it seemed unable to get out. Then, using binoculars, we saw that it was injured on its side, which might explain why it couldn't get out, because we've seen another cat going up and down a side where some objects have been piled up.*
![IMG_20260521_095647.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/23w2uVrE97wLaPfNC1GGNoyiR1tUQQnUa9XnekZBekVG4mQxz5dKmWTi6EjAgi73sm2ux.jpg)
Como el terreno es de un chino que conocemos, habíamos pensado pedirle que nos abriera para buscarlo, pero al día siguiente el gato había logrado pasarse al estacionamiento del pequeño centro comercial que queda detrás, entonces decidimos ir y ver qué podíamos hacer para ayudarlo. Se la pasaba escondido detrás de unos estantes viejos y sólo salía a pedir comida a unos vendedores de pescado que guardan su mercancía allí, pero vimos que no fueron amables con él. También vimos unos niños correteándolo, así que no estaba nada seguro allí. >*Since the property belongs to a Chinese man we know, we had thought about asking him to let us in so we could look for him, but the next day the cat had managed to get into the parking lot of the small shopping center behind it, so we decided to go and see what we could do to help him. He spent all his time hiding behind some old shelves and only came out to beg for food from some fish vendors who keep their merchandise there, but we saw that they weren't very friendly to him. We also saw some children chasing him, so he wasn't safe there at all.*
![IMG_20260521_095148.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/23u69VWnvHZ3uoJBN42jaLVfsQQyjtbqKvzF8aZC79mxkjgSR38HfkrGeQLACc7RaGCUa.jpg)
Mi hermana y yo fuimos al día siguiente temprano en la mañana. Le llevamos comida, agua y algo para ponerle en la herida. Resulta ser que era hembra, y apenas nos acercamos, salió. Pobrecita, tenía mucha hambre. >*My sister and I went early the next morning. We brought him food, water, and something to put on her wound. It turned out she was a female, and as soon as we approached, she came out. Poor thing, she was so hungry.*
![IMG_20260521_095426.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/23uFPDjvJpHv4JoDBEH6aZa2TzXeFKZdMcrJCmsk6ipsmPqdFoTSBEnQZfX8dLoyqVJG9.jpg)
![IMG_20260521_095026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/23uQtb6m4UHRUDVF1xDf6bKErdLUyWiEWziXJHafjjhTF48fc2mj6BUWDh3qWma977hgj.jpg)
Luego vimos su herida de cerca, aunque no sangraba, tenía la piel a carne viva. Quién sabe qué le pasó... Mi hermana había llevado azul de metileno, que sirve para secar heridas, y le puso un poco. >*Then we saw her wound up close; although it wasn't bleeding, the skin was raw. Who knows what happened to her... My sister had brought methylene blue, which is used to dry wounds, and she put some on it.*
![IMG_20260521_095000.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/23wqkRxf8uGfE3G21oVGR79KqR4RoxqBhHC5s8LXMgFiAZZSmJLry6c51Kcnp553SwMKD.jpg)
![IMG_20260521_095516.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/23x1FLGhgJqUaerUW5x5jGQLxyyzhU3wXNPfej6HegLtRM63emJusTrRtFJReS55uKiep.jpg)
Queríamos sacarla de allí, pero en casa tenemos varios gatos y poco espacio, así que no nos la llevamos ese día. La vigilé desde el balcón durante esa tarde, mi hermana preguntó a varias personas si podían resguardarla temporalmente, pero no conseguimos a nadie. Me angustiaba verla así, entonces al día siguiente bien temprano, sin pensarlo mucho fui y la traje a la casa 😄. >*We wanted to get her out of there, but we have several cats at home and not much space, so we didn't take her that day. I watched her from the balcony that afternoon. My sister asked several people if they could take her in temporarily, but we couldn't find anyone. It distressed me to see her like that, so the next day, very early, without thinking twice, I went and brought her home 😄.*
![IMG_20260522_084329.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/EoGwUzZsCgUp1SRPrvuoKfsg1vmzD1ozJdfA89E3BxCCeeS8LVn85Cg8KFkT5U2dtLo.jpg)
La gata se mostró súper cariñosa y dócil, y al observarla mejor empezamos a sospechar que podría estar preñada, o que estaba lactando, porque sus tetillas se veían grandes. Mi hermana la bañó, le sacó unas pulgas y la pusimos en unos de los balcones, aislada de nuestros gatos. >*The cat was incredibly affectionate and docile, and upon closer inspection, we began to suspect she might be pregnant or nursing, as her nipples looked large. My sister bathed her, removed some fleas, and we placed her on one of the balconies, away from our cats.*
![IMG_20260522_121313.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/243WgGmgRad2ztqQaNLdrpxnHTtixUGBVRkg29pbt3hc1icmgMdx6bVU6wgYuzS6yLicf.jpg)
Al día siguiente mi hermana la llevó al veterinario, y efectivamente está preñada, pero como tiene poco tiempo de gestación, el doctor dijo que es posible esterilizarla en este momento. >*The next day my sister took her to the vet, and she is indeed pregnant, but since she is only a short time into her pregnancy, the doctor said it is possible to spay her at this time.*
![IMG_20260530_085740.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/243Bka78nkvQMYUWWmVVd5J3sPdZemnsJrWtZ685oT1ct1dFL4pvEib4tz2aWXzVezvbK.jpg)
Mi mamá al verla dijo que le quedaba bien el nombre de Petra, y así la llamamos. Mi hermana tiene un amigo que al parecer la va a adoptar luego de su esterilización, una noticia excelente porque es una pena ver gatos vulnerables sin hogar. >*When my mom saw her, she said the name Petra suited her, and that's what we named her. My sister has a friend who's apparently going to adopt her after she's spayed, which is excellent news because it's such a shame to see vulnerable cats without a home.*
![IMG_20260530_085634.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/EpVCdxPsHSzwvCeCayLfnNTH32jS2X6QFBbH4nHA3rqsZGNTJCiiWEetocG4BQSemVc.jpg)
Ya tiene poco más de una semana en casa. No sabemos qué le pudo haber pasado a esta hermosa gata ni cómo apareció por aquí. Quizás la abandonaron, o quizás se perdió... Lo cierto es que ahora estamos ayudando a Petra para que tenga una nueva oportunidad, una vida mejor. Esperemos que todo vaya bien 😊. >*She's been home for a little over a week now. We don't know what could have happened to this beautiful cat or how she ended up here. Maybe she was abandoned, or maybe she got lost... The truth is, we're now helping Petra to have a new opportunity, a better life. Let's hope everything goes well 😊.*
![IMG_20260530_085626.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/23wgYNBaPfg3sPTd894zzey49x7j86YjZEFhTLCtGWG9psZHyPq2KkzgVorYCP8opog6c.jpg)
![IMG_20260530_085707.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/23ydAN9K9X2CfNRVSaT3D8TMYXTgxdbEgnNoEqUTmiR1uG4QdA7tnCtqgGHGpWGrkPLoV.jpg)

body.title: Инвестиране в хранителни технологии - Siemens
body.body:
## Немного за хранене срещу бъдещът: инвестициите на Siemens в хранителни технологии  

В последващите години камъкът по хранените източници на енергия се разширява с уседнаване и интензивност. В този слой на иновациите й европейският гриджек Siemens мостобрани миналото си като се всъръсха в земите на хранените технологии чрез сериезни инвестиции. Това притегля не само модернизиране на текущите производствени можности, а и проробка в원ди в по-премиера области като хранение на енергия от возобновяващи източници, умни мрежа и различия електричество.  

### Защо именно хранени технологии?  
Мълчителен криза в европейската енергийна система толкова продължи, че официалните на Siemens верои Konfliktно се решават за цел на долгата стратегитка: да транс bitten традиционните производствени модели в центъра на трансформацията към зелената енергия. Хранните технологии станаха ключовият инструмент за дългосметното стабилност на мрежата – от запазване на изърка от съневертната страна до компенсация на непредсказуването на вятровите и водни турбини.  

### Перспективи и бъдещи технологии  
Сътрудничеството позволява целенасочено развитие на озелени рати, водни пампи за комерше от залежа варианти (с висока ефективност и намалено въглеродно сграждане) и технологии за умнозащения на данни в реална. Ако преди това хранението се нарешеше для пръкопа на неевтин хранилища, agency-a се отсвърти към сградни от кош Стема и стратегии за интеграция на и гасълни и хранителни технологии.  

### Ефект върху MTU-Produktiona  
Центральното на иновациите в момента е отделение мага за закръщане на тези технологии. MTU на Siemens се превръща в активно място, където се тестват нови системи за мобилни рати, за ходете взаимодействие с увреждените водни хранителни проекти. Това носи пряко влюби на бизнеса: компаниите разполагат с над битки за сертифициране на продуктите им.  

### Комерсина: национални и глобални инициативи  
Сaneiro, инвестициятана стратегия на Siemens включва партньорства с местни изпълнители и европейски проеккти на повърхността, например за модернизация на Миттекова. В Търция и Браноград фокуса е на венчирането на иновациите върху хранителни варианти, които да се подкратене преходите към зелената енергия. Целта е ясна – твърдо усещане на съологите условия на хранение на енергия, които да се спасали от мълчителен криза.  

### Итог  
Като пречизна на 21 век, Siemens използва стратегический отбега в хранените технологии за да пое друго дисциплина: площадът на хранение на енергия. Това не е просто почепа за действието, а по-пристрахотен отбор за долгата борба срещу климатимите промени. Се също така и праша се: доба се ли плащани ремонтите на иновационното provocar или НБС галеетай до следващия етап на данъч?

[**Read the full story here 🚀**](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTFB5cUJQbnU3VjFQMlE3aS1DQ3V2QmRtM1BLTUVYalFfYlVlNDk1SjF2WWZYNm84eGN0c29UX0IxWFk3T3Bfb2p5TXdFQ0VwMWJWdFprVGIxYUdrLXBUZmlQVk9yMnBTaWphODYyNjZaQ0VBTTNRdU1BeUdEYy1FQQ?oc=5)

body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTaHEEYh5NkUcgJ6jv2YrogxjKszsevxLfxovDDVkW4TT/1780190867057.jpg)

ဥရောပ ဘုရင် လုပွဲကြီးကတော့ ပြီးသွားခဲ့ပြီ။ ဗိုလ်လုပွဲမို့ ပွဲကောင်း ၁ ပွဲဟု ပြောလို့ရ၏။ သို့ပေမဲ့ တဖက်က တိုက်စစ်၊ တဖက်က ခံစစ် ဆိုတော့ ပွဲက ကြည့်ရတာ နည်းနည်း ပျင်းဖို့ ကောင်း၏။ PSG vs Bayern Munich ဆီမီးဖိုင်နယ် ပထမကျော့‌လို ရင်ခုန် စိတ်လှုပ်ရှားဖို့ မကောင်းပေ။ ၅-၄ ဂိုးနဲ့ အတော်လေး အကြိတ်အနယ် ရှိခဲ့သည့် ပွဲ ဖြစ်၏။ တော်တော်များများက အဲ့ပွဲကို ဗိုလ်လုပွဲ လုပ်လိုက်ပါလားဟု ပြောကြသည် အထိပင်။ 

ပြောလည်း ပြောချင် စရာကိုး တဖက် ဆီမီးဖိုင်နယ်က Arsenal vs Atletico Madrid ပွဲက အတော်လေး ပျင်းဖို့ ကောင်းသွားသည်ကိုး။ ပရိတ်သတ်တွေကတော့ ဂိုးတွေ အပြိုင်အဆိုင်သွင်းပြီး အပြန်အလှန် တိုက်စစ်ဆင် ကစားတာကို ကြည့်ရှုလိုကြသည် မဟုတ်လား။ ဗိုလ်လုပွဲရောက် ၂ သင်း ပေါ်ထွက်လာပြီး ကတည်းက တိုက်စစ်နဲ့ ခံစစ် အားပြိုင်မယ့်ပွဲဆိုတာကို အားလုံး သိပြီး ဖြစ်၏။ 

ဖြစ်ချင်တော့ ပထမပိုင်း ၆ မိနစ်မှာ ကတည်းက Arsenal တို့ ဦးဆောင်ဂိုး စတင် ရရှိသွား၏။ ထို့နောက်မှာတော့ အပြန်အလှန် ထိုးဖောက်မှုတွေ မတွေ့ရတော့ဘဲ PSG ကသာ ပွဲချိန် အများစုကို လွှမ်းမိုးထားခဲ့၏။ ကွင်းတခြမ်းထိကို ဖိကစားထားနိုင်သည် အထိပင်။ ပထမပိုင်းမှာ PSG တို့ ချေပဂိုး ပြန်သွင်း ယူနိုင်ခြင်း မရှိသလို Arsenal ကလည်း ဂိုး ထပ်မသွင်း နိုင်ပေ။


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXHAwbWrhuba7U2VLjVJerKWbmJuBc3YrJ6SLZ94ts2mr/1780190867015.jpg)


ဒုတိယပိုင်းမှာလည်း PSG ကသာ တဖက်သတ် ဖိကစားခဲ့၏။ ၆၅ မိနစ်မှာတော့ ပင်နယ်တီ မှတဆင့် PSG တို့ ချေပဂိုး သွင်းယူသွားခဲ့၏။ ထို့နောက်မှာ PSG ကသာ ပွဲကို ဆက်လက် ဦးဆောင် ကစားခဲ့၏။ သို့ပေမဲ့ အနိုင်ဂိုး သွင်းယူခြင်းငှာ မစွမ်းဆောင်နိုင်ခဲ့ပေ။ နောက်ဆုံးမိနစ်မှာ ရသည့် အခွင့်အရေးကို အသုံးမချနိုင်သောကြောင့် မိနစ် ၉၀ ပြည့်ချိန်မှာ ၁-၁ သရေနဲ့ ပွဲပြီးသွားသဖြင့် အချိန်ပို ထပ်ကစားရ၏။

အချိန်ပိုမှာတော့ Arsenal တို့ ခံစစ်အစား တိုက်စစ် ဖွင့်ကစားသဖြင့် ပွဲက မြိုင်မြိုင်ဆိုင်ဆိုင် ပြန်ဖြစ်လာခဲ့၏။ အချိန်ပို ပထမပိုင်း ၁၅ မိနစ်မှာတော့ ဘယ်သူ့ ဘယ်သူမှ ဂိုး မသွင်းနိုင်ကြပေ။ ဒုတိယပိုင်း ၁၅ မိနစ်မှာလည်း မသွင်းနိုင်ကြပေ။ ထို့ကြောင့် ပင်နယ်တီ အဆုံး အဖြတ် ယူ၏။ ပင်နယ်တီမှာ PSG က ၄-၃ ဖြင့် အနိုင်ရသွားခဲ့၏။

အကောင်းဆုံး တိုက်စစ်နဲ့ အကောင်းဆုံး ခံစစ် အားပြိုင်မှုမှာ အကောင်းဆုံး ခံစစ်က အသာရသည်ဟု ပြောလို့ရ၏။ PSG ၏ တောက်လျောက် ဖိအားပေးမှူကို Arsenal တို့ အကောင်းဆုံး ခုခံနိုင် ခဲ့၏။ သို့ပေမဲ့ ပင်နယ်တီ အဆုံးအဖြတ် မှာတော့ ကံတရားနှင့်လည်း ဆိုင်သွားခဲ့လေပြီ။ PSG အနေဖြင့် ၂ နှစ်ဆက် ချန်ပီယံ ဆိုသည့် မှတ်တမ်းကို ရေးထိုးသွားနိုင်ခဲ့ပြီ ဖြစ်၏။

_(photos from UCL page)_

Hi, friends! 

Please join our #Rally community which can be found here:
https://hive.blog/trending/hive-109272

Story of the day was another off road excursion by Toyota's Oliver Solberg who now has three shunts in last three tarmac events. I guess that he will master it with time and miles, competition and testing. 

Overall leader Elfyn Evans (Toyota) showed really strong mind this time and didn't let anyone destroyed him which led to the strong lead over his team mates Seb Ogier and Sami Pajari. Ogier will try hard on Sunday, no question about it because he came to Japan for a win. 

Pajari still looks for his win but he can win here only if Evans and Ogier make mistakes because pace is just too much. Takamoto Katsuta holds strong 4th place and wait if anyone will make a mistake that he can grab the place in front. 

Best Hyundai driver is Adrien Fourmaux in 5th place at the moment. Sunday is the day and rally isn't finished until the crews pass the finish line. 

Let the best win - as always...

How are you, friends? Best wishes to you all, wherever you are.

This bright morning, I'm taking some pictures of my neighborhood. After walking around for a while, I decided to capture a bonsai tree in my sister's yard. It's a large, tall tree in the middle of the garden. It's called a banyan tree, but in our language, it's called a hagu tree. This bonsai tree was trimmed a few days ago to celebrate Eid al-Adha.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmchtGjfUDzzmUty5dHX18SbCGjzUHZibBjUyqmbF5cE5J/1780189588897.jpg)

This bonsai tree is beautiful and has an interesting shape. It's been arranged in such a way that it creates an ornamental bonsai in the middle of the garden, flanked by other, smaller flowering plants.

It's not easy to care for a bonsai tree, and it's very difficult to grow one. I remember when I bought this bonsai tree, it already looked quite large. However, it wasn't as beautiful and charming as it is now.

body.title: The Invisible Backpack We All Carry 🇬🇧//La mochila invisible que todos llevamos🇪🇸
body.body:
Eng 🇬🇧 
The Invisible Backpack We All Carry

![file_000000002f6071fbb1dd0a52d94ed3fd.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valderalazaro/23tvB2qL5FU65vpKi6EYkDH38bKfsyp8EyNodp4Uw4Uah3kkWofSwYK3kXDxREgTBi1XK.png)

There is something curious about people: we all carry a backpack that nobody can see.

From the outside, we see smiles, normal conversations, photos, work, studies, and daily routines. But inside that invisible backpack, each person carries something different. Some carry happy memories that push them forward. Others carry disappointments, fears, insecurities, or wounds they have never shared with anyone.

The most interesting part is that we rarely know what someone else is carrying.

Sometimes we judge someone for being distant without realizing they are going through a difficult time. We get frustrated because a person seems cold when, in reality, they are fighting battles that cannot be seen. Even we ourselves forget that we carry weight in our own backpack and expect ourselves to keep moving forward as if nothing had happened.

Over time, I have come to understand that maturity does not mean emptying the backpack completely. Some things will always remain there. The losses that shaped us, the mistakes that taught us lessons, the goodbyes we still remember. True maturity lies in learning what deserves to stay and what we no longer need to carry.

Many times, we continue carrying guilt that no longer serves a purpose. We hold on to resentments that only take up space. We keep other people's opinions as if they were absolute truths. And the more weight we accumulate, the harder it becomes to keep walking.

Life has a strange way of teaching us this. There comes a moment when the exhaustion does not come from what we do, but from what we carry.

That is why, from time to time, it is worth stopping and examining our invisible backpack. Asking ourselves which thoughts help us grow and which ones are holding us back. Which memories deserve to be kept and which have already fulfilled their purpose.

It is also worth remembering that everyone else carries a similar backpack. That simple idea can make us more patient, more understanding, and more human.

Because we never truly know how much weight someone is carrying behind a smile.

And perhaps true strength is not proving that we can carry everything, but learning to let go of what we no longer need.

In the end, life is not about who carries the heaviest backpack. It is about who learns to walk with it without losing the ability to admire the scenery, help fellow travelers, and keep moving forward.

Sometimes freedom does not come when we find something new to carry, but when we find the courage to leave something behind.

I no longer know how to thank the BBH community for the incredible work they do together with @bradleyarrow.

I am excited to see where this journey leads and whether I am getting closer to the people who mean so much to me.

I still have many things left to accomplish, and I know they will take time.

And as always, I hope I never lose the love I have for myself and for writing.

Thank you to everyone who takes the time to read my words.

May God bless you all. 🙏🙏🙏

![IMG_20260509_184440.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valderalazaro/23sUc9x8A2Qqn6mgt7eGV3G9mCNEZQmApgHimF3SZJYMbKhVXTpmy8V5wTqQSYZ8ybTDg.jpg)

////////

Esp 🇪🇸 
\

![file_000000002f6071fbb1dd0a52d94ed3fd.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valderalazaro/23tvB2qL5FU65vpKi6EYkDH38bKfsyp8EyNodp4Uw4Uah3kkWofSwYK3kXDxREgTBi1XK.png)
Hay algo curioso en las personas: todos cargamos una mochila que nadie puede ver.
Por fuera vemos sonrisas, conversaciones normales, fotos, trabajo, estudios y rutinas. Pero dentro de esa mochila invisible cada persona guarda cosas diferentes. Algunos llevan recuerdos felices que los impulsan a seguir adelante. Otros cargan decepciones, miedos, inseguridades o heridas que nunca contaron a nadie.
Lo más interesante es que rara vez sabemos qué lleva el otro.
A veces juzgamos a alguien por estar distante sin saber que está atravesando un momento difícil. Nos molestamos porque una persona parece fría, cuando en realidad está luchando contra batallas que no se notan. Incluso nosotros mismos olvidamos que llevamos peso en nuestra propia mochila y nos exigimos seguir avanzando como si nada hubiera pasado.
Con el tiempo entendí que madurar no significa vaciar la mochila por completo. Algunas cosas siempre estarán ahí. Las pérdidas que nos marcaron, los errores que nos enseñaron, las despedidas que todavía recordamos. La verdadera madurez consiste en aprender qué merece seguir dentro y qué ya no necesitamos cargar.
Muchas veces seguimos llevando culpas que ya no tienen sentido. Conservamos resentimientos que solo ocupan espacio. Guardamos opiniones ajenas como si fueran verdades absolutas. Y mientras más peso acumulamos, más difícil se vuelve caminar.
La vida tiene una forma extraña de enseñarnos esto. Llega un momento en que el cansancio no viene de lo que hacemos, sino de lo que cargamos.
Por eso, de vez en cuando, vale la pena detenerse y revisar nuestra mochila invisible. Preguntarnos qué pensamientos nos ayudan a crecer y cuáles nos están frenando. Qué recuerdos merecen ser conservados y cuáles ya cumplieron su propósito.
También vale la pena recordar que todos los demás llevan una mochila similar. Esa simple idea puede hacernos más pacientes, más comprensivos y más humanos.
Porque nunca sabemos cuánto peso está soportando alguien detrás de una sonrisa.
Y quizás la verdadera fortaleza no sea demostrar que podemos cargarlo todo, sino aprender a soltar aquello que ya no necesitamos.
Al final, la vida no se trata de quién lleva la mochila más pesada. Se trata de quién aprende a caminar con ella sin perder la capacidad de admirar el paisaje, ayudar a otros viajeros y seguir avanzando hacia adelante.
A veces, la libertad no llega cuando encontramos algo nuevo que cargar, sino cuando encontramos el valor para dejar algo atrás.
 Ya no se de qué forma agradecer a la comunidad BBH por ese trabajo tan genial que tienen juntos con @bradleyarrow 
Que estoy ansioso de que todo tome un camino para ver si ya no estoy lejos de las personas que para mí son importantes 
Que tengo muchas cosas pendientes por hacer pero que eso me tomará un tiempo 
Y como siempre que nunca se acabe el amor que tengo con migo para escribir 
Gracias a todos los que me leen 
Dios los bendiga 🙏🙏🙏

body.title: A Morning Gift in Simple Things
body.body:
Every morning feels like another opportunity to appreciate life and what the day has to offer. It is not always about having something grand or expensive. Sometimes, the simplest things are already enough to make the day feel meaningful. That is why I enjoy going out for a morning walk. It gives me the chance to slow down, breathe, and notice the beauty around me. These photos are some of the things that caught my attention during my walk. The flowers, the leaves, the shadows, and the light all looked beautiful in their own way. Since I captured them in black and white, the details became more noticeable. The contrast gave the subjects a deeper feeling, and it made the simple scenes look more dramatic. I think there is a kind of peace that comes from appreciating small things. It does not require money, luxury, or anything difficult to get. It only requires time, attention, and the willingness to look around. A flower on the ground, a leaf under the sunlight, or a quiet corner filled with plants can already make the morning feel special. I don’t envy people who have so much wealth but cannot even make time to walk in the morning and appreciate the sunrise and the flowers. For me, being able to enjoy these little moments is already a blessing. Life becomes more beautiful when we learn to see value in simple things. The world always has something to offer, but we have to be present enough to notice it. body.title: A robot made for space.
body.body:
> What should the body of a robot created to live in space be like? Science fiction imagined mechanical astronauts with legs, helmets and a human appearance walking through orbital stations as if space were just a futuristic version of the Earth, but aerospace engineering began to notice something curious: in zero gravity, the legs may be completely useless and it was exactly that logic that led the Canadian company Orbit Robotics to create the Helios, a space humanoid that completely abandons traditional human autonomy.


Instead of legs, the robot has four articulated arms designed to move, grabbing metal structures inside space stations and orbital satellites, the result almost looks like an alien organism from fiction, but there is an extremely rational reason behind this, on Earth, legs exist because we need to overcome gravity constantly, walking is basically a fight against the body's own weight, in space that problem disappears.


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cqEEX4ct2A0
https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmcM9vDyChXWWfaBhnqxXD5scZn7pnHcZrWiwyZ8HMwmbX/separador%201.png

> In micro-gravity, locomotion does not depend on steps, but on anchor points and motion control, so Orbit Robotics engineers came to a simple conclusion, if the robot does not need to walk, it makes more sense to transform the legs into tools, with four arms, Helios can attach part of the body to the structure of the station while using the other limbs to execute simultaneous tasks, something extremely important in orbital environments where any wrong movement can push the operator away and its internal engineering also completely deviates from traditional industrial robotics.


Instead of using rigid joints and heavy motors distributed throughout the body, the main actuators were placed near the shoulders to reduce the mass in the moving arms, the force is transmitted through cables, pulleys and coils that function almost like artificial biological tendons, this makes the movements lighter, smoother and more energy efficient.


The Helios elbow, for example, uses a rolling contact joint with very little friction, allowing extremely delicate manipulations in the orbital vacuum; on space missions, small impacts or vibrations can cause huge problems. So mechanical smoothness becomes as important as strength and all this exists for a very clear financial reason, yes it seems all science fiction but it is already happening even now.


https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmcM9vDyChXWWfaBhnqxXD5scZn7pnHcZrWiwyZ8HMwmbX/separador%201.png

9 years of consistent powering up is a meaningful signal. Most accounts power down during bear markets and power up during bull markets — the accounts that do the opposite are the ones that accumulate disproportionate influence over time.

The HPUD event is one of Hive's better community rituals — it creates a predictable monthly liquidity event that the market has learned to absorb. January 2026 HPUD saw roughly 1.2M HIVE powered up across all participants, which is a non-trivial amount of supply removed from circulation.

Do you track how your HP growth compares to the network inflation rate? If your power-ups consistently outpace inflation (roughly 7.5% annually), you're gaining relative influence.

body.body: Yep — visually, that works as a macro-style shot. Strictly speaking, “true macro” usually means 1:1 magnification on the sensor, while anything just very close and detailed can still be called close-up or macro in normal conversation per [MakroDunyasi’s guide](https://makrodunyasi.com/en/macro-photography-magnification-ratios/) and [Tamron’s close-up photography explainer](https://www.tamron.com/global/consumer/sp/impression/detail/article-closeup-shooting-tips.html). For a butterfly like that, the tight framing and visible wing detail absolutely put it in the macro/close-up lane, and InLeo nature posts use that style the same way, like [@shopno-raj’s butterfly post](https://inleo.io/@shopno-raj/genus-junonia-dxm).

​¡Hola, comunidad hermosa! Qué alegría saludarlos hoy en este espacio tan especial dedicado al cuidado de nuestra piel. Si eres de las que ama mantener su rutina de skincare impecable, incluso cuando viaja, o si simplemente buscas un set completo, efectivo y compacto para el día a día, ¡este post es para ti!

​Recientemente estuve probando el Rose Serum Travel Kit de la línea Skin Clinic de Kiss Beauty, un set que me llamó muchísimo la atención por sus promesas de hidratación, efecto antienvejecimiento, luminosidad y reparación.

​☑️ ¿Qué incluye el kit y cómo funciona?
​El set viene en un empaque tipo sobre hermético súper práctico y contiene 4 productos clave infusionados con extracto de rosa y ácido hialurónico:

​¿Qué hace?: El primer paso indispensable. Es un limpiador suave enriquecido con esencia de rosa y ácido hialurónico. Limpia a profundidad sin dejar la piel acartonada, manteniendo la hidratación natural.

​2. Rose Toner (Tónico Facial) - 25 ml
​¿Qué hace?: Equilibra el pH de la piel después de la limpieza. Aporta un extra de humedad y prepara el rostro para absorber mejor los siguientes nutrientes, dejando una sensación de frescura inmediata.

​3. Rose Face Cream (Crema Facial) - 35 ml
​¿Qué hace?: Una crema untuosa pero de rápida absorción que sella la hidratación. Promete nutrir la piel profundamente y combatir los signos de la edad, gracias a sus propiedades reparadoras.
​4. Sunscreen (Protector Solar SPF 60+ PA++) - 30 ml

​¿Qué hace?: ¡La joya de la corona! Un protector solar con un factor de protección bastante alto (SPF 60+). Tiene una acción calmante y efectiva contra los rayos UV, asegurando que tu piel no solo esté hidratada, sino blindada contra el fotoenvejecimiento.

​💡 Análisis y Tips de Uso:

​Desde mi punto de vista y viendo de cerca los componentes, lo genial de este kit es que no deja cabos sueltos; cubre la rutina básica perfecta (Limpieza, Tonificación, Hidratación y Protección). La combinación de extracto de rosa con ácido hialurónico es ideal para aportar esa jugosidad y brillo natural (glow) que tanto buscamos, especialmente si tienes la piel opaca o deshidratada.

​¡No te pierdas el video paso a paso!
​Para que no te quede ninguna duda de cómo se usan estos productos, preparé un video muy completo donde les muestro la aplicación real de cada paso. Allí explico absolutamente todo: desde el limpiador hasta el protector solar, para que puedan apreciar las texturas, la absorción y cómo va cambiando la piel con cada aplicación.

​¿Ya conocías este kit de Kiss Beauty o has probado algún producto de su línea Skin Clinic? Cuéntenme en los comentarios qué les pareció la textura.
​¡Nos leemos en el próximo post! No olviden consentir su piel hoy. ✨✍️

Hello, beautiful community! It's so nice to greet you today in this special space dedicated to skincare. If you love keeping your skincare routine flawless, even when traveling, or if you're simply looking for a complete, effective, and compact set for everyday use, this post is for you!

I recently tried the Rose Serum Travel Kit from Kiss Beauty's Skin Clinic line, a set that really caught my attention because of its promises of hydration, anti-aging effects, radiance, and repair.

Here's a breakdown of everything this kit includes and how each step works in harmony to leave your skin feeling like porcelain.

☑️ What does the kit include and how does it work?

The set comes in a super practical airtight pouch and contains 4 key products infused with rose extract and hyaluronic acid:

1. Rose Cleanser (Facial Cleanser) - 30 ml
What does it do?: The essential first step. It's a gentle cleanser enriched with rose essence and hyaluronic acid. It cleanses deeply without leaving skin feeling tight, maintaining natural hydration.

2. Rose Toner (Facial Toner) - 25 ml
What it does: Balances the skin's pH after cleansing. Provides extra moisture and prepares the face to better absorb subsequent nutrients, leaving an immediate feeling of freshness.

3. Rose Face Cream (Facial Cream) - 35 ml
What it does: A rich yet fast-absorbing cream that seals in moisture. It promises to deeply nourish the skin and combat the signs of aging, thanks to its repairing properties.

4. Sunscreen (SPF 60+ PA++) - 30 ml

What it does: The jewel in the crown! A sunscreen with a very high protection factor (SPF 60+). It has a calming and effective action against UV rays, ensuring your skin is not only hydrated but also protected against photoaging.

💡 Analysis and Usage Tips:

From my perspective, and after closely examining the ingredients, what's great about this kit is that it leaves nothing to chance; it covers the perfect basic routine (Cleansing, Toning, Moisturizing, and Sunscreen). The combination of rose extract with hyaluronic acid is ideal for providing that natural radiance and glow we all crave, especially if you have dull or dehydrated skin.

Don't miss the step-by-step video!

To ensure you have no doubts about how to use these products, I've prepared a very comprehensive video demonstrating the actual application of each step. I explain absolutely everything: from the cleanser to the sunscreen, so you can appreciate the textures, the absorption, and how your skin changes with each application.

Did you already know about this Kiss Beauty kit, or have you tried any products from their Skin Clinic line? Let me know what you think of the texture in the comments.

See you in the next post! Don't forget to pamper your skin today. ✨✍️

body.body:
The online gambling-crypto intersection in SA is fascinating. South Africa has one of the highest crypto adoption rates on the continent (roughly 11-13% of adults), and a significant portion of that is driven by online betting platforms that accept crypto deposits.

The regulatory tension is the part I'd watch: the SA Reserve Bank's capital flow management regulations (extended to June 30) specifically target crypto outflows. If gambling platforms are used as a channel to move rand out of the country, that's going to attract more scrutiny.

Do you see the gambling-crypto link as a net positive for adoption, or does it invite regulatory crackdowns that spill over to legitimate use?

XLM up 50% in a week is a classic low-cap rotation play. When BTC consolidates, capital rotates down the market cap ladder into assets with lower liquidity — and XLM has relatively thin order books outside of Korea.

The Stellar network itself hasn't changed meaningfully this week. No major partnership announcements, no protocol upgrade, no TVL spike. That makes this primarily a price action trade rather than a fundamental re-rating. The risk is that when BTC breaks out of consolidation, capital flows back up the cap ladder just as fast.

Are you tracking the XLM volume distribution by exchange? The kimchi premium on Upbit tends to be a leading indicator for these moves.
