body.title: I Fail Percival Rackham's First Trial in Hogwarts Legacy
body.body:
![1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23vhTrLKCyaoxaDkfmchP8h4PrmsRkncaZwGmSDLgGcfTshM9cKcEpumqT9ef5aqwMcD1.gif)


Hey gamers, how are you all doing? Hope everyone is doing great! My adventure in Hogwarts Legacy continues and this time I have to be completely honest with you all — things did not go as planned. At all. Picking up right where we left off last post, I was standing at the entrance of the true trial chamber, ancient magic swirling all around me, ready to push through and complete Percival Rackham's first trial. The anticipation was real and I went in feeling confident after everything I'd survived up to this point — the spiders in Jackdaw's Tomb, the Pensieve defenders in the Map Chamber, the goblin loyalists outside the tower. How much harder could this be? Well. The answer to that question is: significantly harder. Let me walk you through what happened.

**Solving the Ancient Magic Puzzles of the First Trial**

![0423 (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23u5SwihpaKGRdnBKxqqCvypLEpGx4xx7yH5sFWRpesGxhqxtatu8nAHt5jXftqbBtJ3r.jpg)

The trial chamber opens up into a series of interconnected rooms built entirely around ancient magic mechanics and floating platform puzzles, and right from the start it's clear this place was designed specifically to test whether you actually understand how to use and interact with ancient magic — not just cast regular spells. The first thing you notice is that the platforms in the room aren't static. They float, they drift slightly, and to move them you need to use Accio to pull them toward you and position them where you need them to be. Simple enough on the first pass, but the rooms get progressively more layered as you push forward.

The first puzzle has you pulling a floating platform toward you with Accio, climbing on top of it, and then using another Accio to swing yourself across the room by targeting a metal handle mounted on the far wall. You fly across on the momentum, land on a new ledge, and proceed to the next section. There are ancient magic pools on the floor throughout the chamber — golden swirling traces that react when you walk over them and either open new passages, spawn portals, or cause sections of bridge to materialize out of thin air. The game is leaning fully into the idea that your ability to perceive these traces is what makes it possible to navigate a space that anyone without ancient magic would find completely impassable. You're not just moving through the trial — you're unlocking it as you go.

![0423 (1)(2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23t77MCRK6tMwiGLkfhPhqz2Ku99H3z45v9AzTNJDWpAtFtRQuWewmbbErcn3NXYriafY.jpg)

One of the more satisfying puzzle moments comes in a room with a portal hanging in mid-air — not on the floor or a wall but suspended floating in the center of the space. To interact with it you need to pull the floating platform toward you, climb on top of it, then use it to reach the height of the portal and interact with the ancient magic from that elevated position. It sounds straightforward when you describe it but in the moment, managing the platform positioning while keeping track of where you need to go and what you need to activate creates this genuinely satisfying feeling of problem-solving that the best dungeon design always achieves. There are chests hidden off the main route throughout all of this — on ledges accessible only if you swing to the right handle instead of the obvious one, tucked behind platforms you don't strictly need to move — and hunting them down while working through the puzzles adds another enjoyable layer to the exploration.

**Fighting the First Pensieve Guards Inside the Trial**

![0423 (1)(4).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23tbJmoCDnTrpN9G3ntQtwwSVSSaQECoTcYnhBwkEcfwewWDnjP84KZtE3ypwMXhym3UY.jpg)

Between the puzzle sections the trial throws combat encounters at you, and these are where things start to get noticeably more serious than anything you faced getting to the tower. The enemies inside the trial are Pensieve Guards — the same ancient stone defender types you encountered briefly before, but now showing up in organized waves with more variety and more aggression than before. You've got Pensieve Sentinels, Pensieve Sentries, and Pensieve Protectors all appearing across the different combat rooms, and each type requires a slightly different approach to deal with efficiently.

The Sentinels and Sentries are manageable individually — Expelliarmus to strip their weapon and break their defensive stance, follow up with damage spells and basic casts to bring them down. The real issue is when multiple types appear simultaneously because then you're constantly having to switch targets and manage the battlefield rather than focusing fire. The Protectors in particular are annoying in groups because they have that built-in immunity to spells in their default state that you discovered back in Jackdaw's Tomb, meaning you have to hit them with Expelliarmus first every single time before your damage spells will register. When you've got a Protector charging at you from one side and a Sentry throwing ranged attacks from across the room at the same time, things can unravel very quickly if you lose your positioning.

![0423 (1)(5).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23tRqtRSCHKQspQ2W2pFfpHi3ZV1B2AxTUbRxwujH54sDYxUr1Ekt9HGKFxfTcsLEvDto.jpg)

My recommendation for anyone going through these combat rooms is to use your Ancient Magic meter strategically rather than blowing it the moment it fills up. Save it for the moments when you're getting overwhelmed or when a Protector has too much health and you need to burst it down fast. Ancient Magic throws are also extremely useful in these rooms because the floating debris and environmental objects give you plenty of ammunition to hurl at enemies for free damage. I managed to clear all the guard encounters inside the trial after a few attempts, looting every chest along the way, and pushed through to the final room feeling battered but functional. And then I met the boss.

**The Final Pensieve Guardian Is Absolutely Impossible at My Level**

![0423 (1)(6).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23tGTGW9SJ7D98orG1zreFsBB1Hos38yhp2gomNCxNUVLd9jViixYPm4P4ochax52xv2T.jpg)

Oh boy. This thing. The Pensieve Guardian that waits at the end of the trial is a completely different category of enemy from everything that came before it and nothing in the trial adequately prepares you for the jump in difficulty when it rises out of the floor and the fight officially begins. This boss is massive — physically imposing in a way that immediately communicates you're in trouble — and its attack patterns are relentless and punishing in a way that demands near-perfect play to survive.

The stomp attack is the first thing that gets you. The Guardian raises one enormous foot, pauses for just a moment, and brings it down creating a shockwave that radiates outward across the floor. You have to dodge roll out of the shockwave radius and the timing is tight — too early and you drift back into it, too late and you eat the full damage which at my current level was devastating. Then there's the orb attack, which is genuinely one of the more creative boss mechanics in the game but also one of the most demanding to execute under pressure. The Guardian charges up a colored orb — yellow, red, or purple — and if you let it fully charge and fire, it hits you for massive damage with no way to stop it mid-flight. The only way to interrupt the attack is to hit the orb with a spell from the matching category while it's still charging. Yellow orb means a Control spell like Accio or Levioso. Red orb means a Damage spell like Incendio or Confringo. Purple orb means an Unforgivable or a Force spell.

The problem is that the Guardian doesn't give you much time to read the color, swap to the right spell category, and land the hit before the orb fires. And if you're already low on health from a previous stomp or melee strike, the mental pressure of making that snap decision while watching your health bar drain is genuinely stressful. I tried this boss multiple times. Multiple. Each attempt I got a little further, figured out one more pattern, adjusted my approach slightly — but consistently hit a wall where the orb attacks overwhelmed me because I didn't have the raw health pool or damage output to keep pace with what the fight was demanding. I was simply underleveled for what the trial was asking of me at this stage.

**I Need to Level Up at Least Two More Times**

![0423 (1)(8).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23u5vRRux9qkZVMsguMNMDMYd6oj8bxkYA3oV17WRA5fH1eSbG8UcW4HKx7XQtwqfC6VM.jpg)

So here's the decision I made after the fourth or fifth wipe on that Guardian — and it's not a decision I made lightly because I genuinely wanted to push through and complete the trial in one session. But the reality of the situation is clear. The Pensieve Guardian at the end of Percival Rackham's Trial requires you to be at a solid level to survive its attack patterns long enough to bring it down, and right now my character just isn't there yet. I need at minimum two or three more levels before going back in. More health, more spell damage, more Talent Points invested in the right upgrades — all of it matters in that fight and none of it is where it needs to be right now.

The good news is that Hogwarts Legacy is absolutely full of content to level up through. Side quests, Merlin Trials scattered across the open world, enemy camps to clear, Field Guide pages to collect, Astronomy Tables, Ancient Magic Hotspots — there is no shortage of experience available if you go looking for it. So that's exactly what the next session is going to be about. Getting out into the world, doing the side content, leveling up, and coming back to that Guardian with enough firepower to actually finish what Percival started. Sometimes you have to know when you're not ready and go get ready before pushing forward. So gamers, the first trial remains unfinished for now but not for long. See you in the next post!

body.title: MOVIE REVIEW: “Honey Don't!” (2025)
body.body:
<center>[IMDb](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt30645201/mediaviewer/rm958185218)</center>
**Synopsis**: *Honey O’Donahue is a private investigator. She works solving mysteries in a small town. In her latest case, she needs to find out who is behind a series of strange murders connected to a church with highly dubious activity, led by a strange priest*.
This is not the first time that filmmaker **Ethan Coen** has insisted on making a comedy movie... And once again, he fails miserably (but this time he does a negatively colossal work, so to speak). Any and all attempts to provoke laughter are a failed act, because the project is more embarrassing than funny (in fact). I can't imagine how someone directs and partially writes a script like this thinking they are actually making a good movie. The fact is that this project is a mistake in every aspect. From beginning to end, a patchwork quilt without an ending.
<center>[Festival do Rio](https://www.festivaldorio.com.br/br/noticias/festival-do-rio-2025-honey-nao-de-ethan-coen-confirmado-na-panorama-mundial)</center>
<center>[But Why Tho?](https://butwhytho.net/2025/08/honey-dont-review-aubrey-plaza-chris-evans/)</center>
It all starts with the narrative itself, which is completely disconnected within its own context. Honey is the kind of totally unbearable character; a very arrogant protagonist who thinks she's superior to everyone around her (that is, it has nothing to do with typically \

behavior... it's something inherent to her own nature). In the midst of a murder investigation that leads her to a mysterious church, she now needs to understand the connection between these two atypical points. In the middle of all this, she experiences a \

lesbian romance.\nIn parallel to this, she also needs to deal with the family fragments to which she belongs (closest family, but chaotic... and an absent father who unexpectedly seeks her out). Nothing in the script works, and the movie is far from being a comedy, just as it is also far (very far, to be even more honest) from being an investigative thriller. Despite the script's strong insistence on doing so (even more so given the aesthetic sense of the written material... which even manages to evoke an \

atmosphere in some brief moments), the execution is shameful.
<center>[IMDb](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt30645201/mediaviewer/rm3181162498)</center>
<center>[The Movie Box](https://www.themoviebox.net/p/honey-dont-trailer-ethan-coens-new-film-margaret-qualley)</center>
Honey needs to deal with Drew, a priest of dubious behavior who leads a church similar to a kind of cult. The \

ends up becoming the center of Honey's attention after one of the murdered victims contacted her before being found on a highway, inside a car that appeared to have suffered an alleged accident. The crucial link between the victim and the church was due to a sexual garment. Honey connects the dots and pressures Drew to spill the beans. However... Drew is as slippery as the lies he tells.
While Honey is trying to piece together this puzzle (which doesn't even have that many pieces because the script doesn't really work on this narrative as it should, almost forgetting that it only exists to favor a *woke* agenda of a highly strange nature due to the way it is inserted into the script) she also deals with the disappearance of her rebellious niece who is being abused by her boyfriend (at the same time that she herself is beginning to live a punctually toxic relationship without even realizing it).
<center>[Festival do Rio](https://www.festivaldorio.com.br/br/noticias/festival-do-rio-2025-honey-nao-de-ethan-coen-confirmado-na-panorama-mundial)</center>
<center>[Festival do Rio](https://www.festivaldorio.com.br/br/noticias/festival-do-rio-2025-honey-nao-de-ethan-coen-confirmado-na-panorama-mundial)</center>
Everything is a big mess without the slightest sense. I confess that I was very negatively impressed to see how a movie, which even has an interesting premise, is developed in such a problematic way (to say the least, considering the totally unnecessary sex scenes that are thrown in at some quite embarrassing moments... not because of the act itself, but because of the totally empty context in which they are inserted). The characters are poorly developed, boring and \

(even with such distinct cartoonish characteristics between them).
**Margaret Qualley** leads the cast, which is not bad. Alongside her are **Aubrey Plaza** and **Chris Evans**. What could have resulted in great on-screen chemistry is reduced to a jumble of disconnected scenes starring very bad characters, and which places the trio within a narrative that is difficult to buy into. The humor is shallow (almost nonexistent), and the suspense is just a spark of events that remain inert (which, incidentally, never really catch fire... except for the entire conclusion in the third act; which, even though it makes no sense... is still creative due to the visual aesthetic sense of the violent scenes).
<center>[The Movie Box](https://www.themoviebox.net/p/honey-dont-trailer-ethan-coens-new-film-margaret-qualley)</center>
<center>[Scraps From The Loft](https://scrapsfromtheloft.com/movies/honey-dont-2025-transcript/)</center>
The only merit of ***Honey, Don’t!*** (which technically also gets almost nothing right; I'll make only a brief exception related to some scenes that have a dull and opaque photography, which \

an investigative soul on what is being seen) is that it's a short movie (and no, that's not a joke). Coen tried to appeal to his usual cynicism; however, it seems that when he works alone things get even worse (because he's completely adrift from his own ideas). Here is a movie that screams for its own identity... But it's merely irrelevant, and forgettable.
---
<center>**CRÍTICA DE PELÍCULA: “Honey Don't!” (2025)**</center>
**Sinopsis**: *Honey O’Donahue es una investigadora privada que trabaja resolviendo misterios en un pequeño pueblo. En su último caso, debe descubrir quién está detrás de una serie de extraños asesinatos relacionados con una iglesia de actividad muy dudosa, dirigida por un sacerdote peculiar*.
Esta no es la primera vez que el cineasta **Ethan Coen** insiste en hacer una comedia... Y, una vez más, fracasa estrepitosamente (aunque esta vez su fracaso es colosal, por así decirlo). Cualquier intento de provocar risas resulta inútil, porque el proyecto es más vergonzoso que gracioso. No puedo imaginar cómo alguien puede dirigir y escribir parcialmente un guion como este pensando que está haciendo una buena película. La verdad es que este proyecto es un error en todos los sentidos. De principio a fin, un mosaico sin final.
Todo comienza con la propia narrativa, que está completamente desconectada de su contexto. Honey es un personaje totalmente insoportable; una protagonista arrogante que se cree superior a todos a su alrededor (y esto no tiene nada que ver con un comportamiento típicamente \

... es algo inherente a su naturaleza). En medio de una investigación de asesinato que la lleva a una iglesia misteriosa, ahora necesita comprender la conexión entre estos dos puntos atípicos. En medio de todo esto, vive un “apasionado” romance lésbico.\nParalelamente, también debe lidiar con los fragmentos familiares a los que pertenece (la familia más unida, pero caótica... y un padre ausente que la busca inesperadamente). Nada en el guion funciona, y la película está lejos de ser una comedia, así como también está muy lejos (para ser aún más honestos) de ser un thriller de investigación. A pesar de la fuerte insistencia del guion en hacerlo (más aún dado el sentido estético del material escrito... que incluso logra evocar una atmósfera de los años “ochenta” en algunos breves momentos), la ejecución es vergonzosa.\nHoney debe lidiar con Drew, un sacerdote de comportamiento dudoso que dirige una iglesia similar a una secta. El \

se convierte en el centro de atención de Honey después de que una de las víctimas asesinadas la contactara antes de ser encontrada en una autopista, dentro de un coche que aparentemente había sufrido un supuesto accidente. El vínculo crucial entre la víctima y la iglesia se debía a una prenda de vestir con connotaciones sexuales. Honey ata cabos y presiona a Drew para que confiese. Sin embargo... Drew es tan escurridizo como las mentiras que cuenta.\nMientras Honey intenta armar este rompecabezas (que ni siquiera tiene muchas piezas porque el guion no funciona bien con esta narrativa, casi olvidando que solo existe para favorecer una agenda *woke* de naturaleza muy extraña debido a la forma en que está insertada en la historia), también lidia con la desaparición de su sobrina rebelde, quien está siendo maltratada por su novio (al mismo tiempo que ella misma comienza a vivir una relación tóxica sin siquiera darse cuenta).\nTodo es un desastre total, sin el menor sentido. Confieso que me decepcionó mucho ver cómo una película, que incluso tiene una premisa interesante, se desarrolla de una manera tan problemática (por no decir otra cosa, considerando las escenas de sexo totalmente innecesarias que se insertan en momentos bastante embarazosos... no por el acto en sí, sino por el contexto completamente vacío en el que se insertan). Los personajes están mal desarrollados, son aburridos y \

(incluso con rasgos caricaturescos tan marcados entre ellos).\n**Margaret Qualley** encabeza el reparto, lo cual no está mal. Junto a ella están **Aubrey Plaza** y **Chris Evans**. Lo que podría haber resultado en una gran química en pantalla se reduce a un revoltijo de escenas inconexas protagonizadas por personajes pésimos, que sitúa al trío dentro de una narrativa difícil de creer. El humor es superficial (casi inexistente) y el suspenso es solo una chispa de eventos que permanecen inertes (que, por cierto, nunca llegan a prenderse... excepto por toda la conclusión en el tercer acto; que, aunque no tenga sentido... sigue siendo creativa debido al sentido estético visual de las escenas violentas).\nEl único mérito de ***Honey, Don’t!*** (que, técnicamente, tampoco acierta en casi nada; haré una breve excepción con algunas escenas de fotografía apagada y opaca, que \

un alma investigadora en lo que se ve) es que es un cortometraje (y no, no es broma). Coen intentó recurrir a su cinismo habitual; sin embargo, parece que cuando trabaja solo las cosas empeoran aún más (porque está completamente desconectado de sus propias ideas). Es una película que clama por su propia identidad... Pero resulta irrelevante, y olvidable. ---
**CRÍTICA DE FILME: “Honey, Não!” (2025)**
**Sinopse**: *Honey O’Donahue é uma investigadora particular. Ela trabalha resolvendo mistérios numa cidade interiorana. Em seu mais recente caso, ela precisa descobrir quem está por trás de uma série de estranhos assassinatos conectados a uma igreja com atividade no mínimo duvidosa, que é liderada por um estranho padre*. Essa não é a primeira vez que o cineasta **Ethan Coen** insiste em fazer um filme de comédia... E mais uma vez, ele falha miseravelmente (mas dessa vez ele faz um trabalho negativamente colossal, por assim dizer). Toda e qualquer tentativa de provocar riso é um ato falho, porque o projeto é mais constrangedor do que de engraçado (de fato). Eu não consigo imaginar como alguém dirige e parcialmente escreve um roteiro desses achando que realmente está fazendo um filme bom. O fato é que esse projeto é um erro em qualquer aspecto. Do começo ao final, uma colcha de retalhos sem final. Tudo começa pela própria narrativa, que é totalmente desconexa dentro do seu próprio contexto. Honey é aquele tipo de personagem totalmente insuportável; uma protagonista muito arrogante, que se acha superior a toda e qualquer pessoa ao seu redor (ou seja, não tem nada a ver com um comportamento tipicamente “profissional”... é algo inerente a natureza dela mesma). Em meio a uma investigação de assassinatos que a levam até uma igreja misteriosa, ela agora precisa entender a ligação entre esses dois pontos atípicos. No meio disso tudo, ela vive um romance lésbico “quente”. Em paralelo a isso, ela precisa lidar também com os fragmentos familiares ao qual ela pertence (família mais próxima, porém caótica... e um pai ausente que a procura inesperadamente). Nada no roteiro funciona, e o filme está longe de ser uma comédia, assim como também está longe (bem longe, para ser ainda mais sincero) de ser um filme de suspense investigativo. Apesar de haver uma forte insistência do roteiro em fazer isso (ainda mais pelo senso estético do material escrito... que até consegue evocar uma atmosfera “oitentista” em alguns breves momentos), a execução é vergonhosa. Honey precisa lidar com Drew, um padre de comportamento duvidoso que lidera uma igreja semelhante a uma espécie de culto. O “local sagrado” acaba se tornando o centro das atenções de Honey depois que uma das vítimas assassinadas entrou em contato com ela antes de ser encontrada em uma autoestrada, dentro de um carro que pareceu ter sofrido um suposto acidente. A ligação cabal entre a vítima e a igreja se deu por causa de uma vestimenta sexual. Honey junta os pontos, e pressiona Drew entregar o jogo. No entanto... Drew é tão escorregadio quanto as mentiras que ele conta. Enquanto Honey está tentando juntar as peças desse quebra-cabeças (que acaba nem tendo tantas peças assim porque o roteiro realmente não trabalha em cima dessa narrativa como deveria, quase que esquecendo que ela existe apenas para favorecer uma agenda *woke* de teor altamente estranho pela maneira como é inserida dentro do roteiro) ela lida também com o desaparecimento de sua sobrinha rebelde que está sendo agredida pelo namorado (ao mesmo tempo em que ela mesma está começando a viver um relacionamento pontualmente tóxico sem ao menos se dar conta disso). Tudo é uma grande bagunça sem o menor sentido. Eu confesso que eu fiquei muito negativamente impressionado em ver como um filme, que até tem uma premissa interessante, ser desenvolvido de um jeito tão problemático (para dizer o mínimo, considerando as cenas sexuais totalmente desnecessárias que estão jogadas em alguns momentos bastante constrangedores... não pelo ato em si, mas pelo contexto totalmente vazio no qual eles são inseridos). Os personagens são mal desenvolvidos, chatos e “monocromáticos” (ainda que com características cartunescas tão distintas entre eles). **Margaret Qualley** lidera o elenco, que não é ruim. Ao lado dela, **Aubrey Plaza** e **Chris Evans**. O que poderia ter rendido um ótimo entrosamento na tela é resumido a um amontoado de cenas desconexas protagonizas por personagens bem ruins, e que coloca o tanto do trio dentro de uma narrativa difícil de ser comprada. O humor é raso (quase inexistente), e o suspense é só uma fagulha de eventos que se mantém inertes (que aliás, nunca pegam fogo... com exceção de toda conclusão no terceiro ato; que mesmo sem sentido... ainda é criativa pelo senso estético visual das cenas de violência). O único mérito de ***Honey, Não!*** (que tecnicamente também não acerta em quase nada; faço apenas uma breve exceção relacionada a algumas cenas que tem uma fotografia fosca e opaca, que “imprime” uma alma investigativa ao que está sendo visto) é ser um filme curto (e não, isso não é uma piada). Coen tentou apelar para o seu cinismo costumeiro; no entanto, parece que quando ele trabalha sozinho as coisas ficam ainda piores (porque ele fica totalmente à deriva das suas próprias ideias). Eis aqui um filme que grita por uma identidade própria... Mas é apenas irrelevante, e esquecível. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@wiseagent/movie-review-honey-dont-2025-31p)

If the SEC appeal timeline extends, that's a short-term catalyst, not a long-term hold thesis.

По пути я встретил группу hikers, мы немножко пообщались, и они рассказали мне о своём увлечении походами на многодневные треки. Один из них даже поделился секретом о скрытом водопаде, который находится неподалёку – теперь я точно планирую его навестить в следующий раз! В таких моментах понимаешь, насколько природа удивительна и многогранна. В общем, прогулка прошла на ура, и я вернулся домой с массой положительных эмоций! _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@titusfrost/actifit-titusfrost-20231229t015511428z)_

body.title: Mi vida ,mi niñez y la baja autoestima
body.body:
Durante años sentí que cargaba con dos cruces al mismo tiempo: el sobrepeso y el acné. Mientras otros adolescentes disfrutaban de una etapa que debería estar llena de descubrimientos y confianza, yo vivía pendiente de esconder mi cuerpo y mi rostro. Fueron precisamente esas dos cosas las que provocaron que fuera brutalmente rechazada y humillada en muchas ocasiones.

![file_000000004a7072309838ff118d07954d.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/diazktty/48PTq8w3Pf3P4bLLe251NrHEjKpes4RoBrNFWYWqcat6h3RUxpnbfHv19nyWqtJ6W4.png)

Recibí burlas, comentarios hirientes y miradas que todavía recuerdo. Hubo momentos en los que sentí vergüenza de salir, de relacionarme con otras personas e incluso de mirarme al espejo. La sociedad suele ser muy cruel con quienes no encajan en determinados estándares de belleza, y yo lo aprendí desde muy pequeña.Mi lucha con el sobrepeso desde la infancia
Hay temas de los que me cuesta hablar porque forman parte de heridas que me acompañan desde hace muchos años. Uno de ellos es el sobrepeso, una batalla que comenzó cuando era apenas una niña.
Hasta los cinco años era una niña muy delgada y activa. Desde los dos años asistía a clases de danza, algo que disfrutaba muchísimo. Me encantaba bailar, moverme y sentirme libre. Sin embargo, mi vida cambió cuando comenzaron las crisis de asma.
Recuerdo aquellas noches difíciles, las visitas al médico y la preocupación constante de mis padres. Para controlar mi enfermedad, me recetaron tratamientos con prednisona en pastillas. En aquel momento nadie pensaba en las consecuencias que esos medicamentos podían tener en mi cuerpo; lo importante era que pudiera respirar y llevar una vida lo más normal posible.
Poco a poco comencé a aumentar de peso. Mi cuerpo empezó a cambiar de una forma que yo no entendía. Mientras otros niños seguían creciendo normalmente, yo veía cómo mi figura se transformaba y cómo la ropa me quedaba ajustada cada vez más rápido.
Lo más difícil no fue el peso en sí, sino las opiniones de los demás. Desde muy pequeña tuve que escuchar comentarios sobre mi apariencia física. A esa edad uno no tiene las herramientas para defenderse emocionalmente, y cada palabra puede quedarse grabada en el corazón durante años.
Durante mucho tiempo pensé que mi valor dependía de un número en la balanza. Me comparaba constantemente con otras niñas y me preguntaba por qué yo no podía ser como ellas. Con el paso de los años comprendí que detrás de mi aumento de peso había razones médicas y circunstancias que escapaban de mi control.
El sobrepeso marcó gran parte de mi infancia y adolescencia. Afectó mi autoestima, mi forma de relacionarme con los demás e incluso la manera en que me veía frente al espejo. Pero también me enseñó algo importante: a desarrollar empatía hacia quienes luchan con problemas que no siempre son visibles para los demás.
Hoy entiendo que cada cuerpo tiene una historia. Detrás de una persona con sobrepeso puede haber enfermedades, tratamientos médicos, problemas hormonales, situaciones emocionales o simplemente una realidad que nadie conoce.
Por eso aprendí a ser más amable conmigo misma. Mi cuerpo ha sido mi compañero durante toda la vida, ha enfrentado enfermedades, dificultades y desafíos, y aun así sigue aquí, permitiéndome abrazar a mi familia, trabajar, soñar y seguir adelante.
Esta es una parte de mi historia. No la cuento para buscar lástima, sino porque sé que muchas personas han pasado por situaciones similares. Si tú también has sufrido por tu peso, quiero que recuerdes algo: tu valor como persona nunca estará determinado por tu apariencia física.

Quiero tomarme un momento para agradecer de corazón a todas las personas que siempre pasan por mis publicaciones en Hive. Gracias por cada voto, cada comentario y cada palabra bonita que me dejan. Aunque muchas veces no tenga el tiempo o la conexión suficiente para responder como quisiera, sepan que leo todo y valoro muchísimo el cariño y el apoyo que me brindan.
También quiero disculparme por las veces en que desaparezco o no publico con frecuencia. La situación con la conexión aquí en Cuba muchas veces hace todo más complicado, y en ocasiones simplemente no logro mantener la constancia que quisiera. Aun así, siempre trato de regresar y compartir contenido sincero, interesante y hecho desde el corazón.
Hive se ha convertido en un espacio muy especial para mí. Un lugar donde puedo expresarme, compartir mis vivencias y sentirme acompañada por personas increíbles de diferentes partes del mundo.
Quiero agradecer especialmente a mi esposo, @valderalazaro, por estar siempre a mi lado, apoyándome incluso en los días más difíciles. Gracias por impulsarme a seguir creando y nunca dejarme rendirme.
También quiero agradecer a mi querida mamá canadiense, @catthyarrow, por tanto cariño, apoyo y amor hacia nuestra familia. Y a su esposo, @bradleyarrow, quien ha sido como un ángel de la guarda para nosotros. Nunca voy a olvidar todo lo que han hecho y siguen haciendo por mí, por mi esposo y por nuestro hijo.
Y por supuesto, muchísimas gracias a toda la comunidad de BBH por hacerme sentir bienvenida, apoyada y motivada a seguir creciendo dentro de esta hermosa plataforma.
Gracias por acompañarme en este camino, por leerme y por estar aquí 💛
![image_1778723176043.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/diazktty/23sUc9x8A2Qqn6mUxfi8Zs7EiaNcP4eejtWw4CmqVUJyuPJVvev73FgRq1Xdj1VfBHP28.jpg)

body.body:
Hace poco decidí que debía retomar mi canal de YouTube. Aparte de Facebook, fue mi red social favorita y en la que publiqué mis primeros videos.

El simple hecho de que alguien los viera era para mí una recompensa suficiente. Pero con el tiempo me desencanté de Facebook; fue incluso causal de divorcio y la temática en la que estaba sumergido ya no me satisfacía. Así fue como murió para mí la red social más visitada del planeta.

Con respecto a YouTube, hubo un momento en que la vi como una oportunidad para emprender haciendo lo que me gusta: enseñar a otros. Sin embargo, para poder obtener resultados había que atrapar una cantidad de seguidores y visualizaciones que me parecían inalcanzables.

Después llegaron otras plataformas, entre ellas Hive. X me encanta para consumir noticias; WhatsApp, para mantener el contacto familiar y algunas relaciones comerciales, e Instagram para farandulear.

Hive se transformó en un baúl donde guardaba todo lo que se me ocurría a la hora de escribir. Lo mejor fue que, con el tiempo, descubrí mi pasión por la escritura. Y aquí caigo en lo que nuestro amigo Emilio @emiliorios habla en su publicación: “¡Nadie está leyendo mis artículos! - Cuando el fracaso obliga a revisarnos - ¿Cómo evaluar?”

Estando en Hive conocí 3Speak, una plataforma de videos que, siendo hermana de Hive, funciona con servidores centralizados. Pero ese es otro asunto.

A lo que quiero llegar es que, cuando quise publicar en 3Speak, me di cuenta de que había que tomarse tiempo para preparar el tema, su guion, cuidar la iluminación, estar presentable frente a la cámara y prestar atención a algo muy importante: el audio.

Todo esto representaba horas de trabajo e incluso días de preparación. Si se quiere comunicar algo, ya sea de forma escrita o audiovisual, hay que prepararlo con antelación. No podemos llegar, improvisar cualquier cosa y luego esperar que ocurra un milagro.

En 3Speak formé parte del equipo de un podcast llamado La Arepa Morada, y sacar al aire cada episodio requería estudiar previamente aquello de lo que íbamos a hablar. Y eso que no llevábamos un guion como tal; era improvisación, pero con orden. Lástima que esas grabaciones se perdieron por lo mismo que conté arriba: 3Speak tenía esos videos junto a otros en un servidor centralizado cuyo disco duro, al parecer, se dañó. O sea, se perdieron mis primeros videos en Hive/3Speak. Eso duele.

Hace unos días se me ocurrió volver a YouTube con la intención de crear un canal sólido que pudiera monetizar. Para ello me dispuse a estudiar, seguir a los mejores creadores, aprender de ellos y mantenerme actualizado con la plataforma.

Y todo se puso interesante porque el gigante de los videos se ha convertido en el número uno dentro del sector televisivo, y en ese universo hay mucho dinero moviéndose. De hecho, recientemente se entregaron los premios Emmy y un podcast hispano en YouTube de un periodista independiente ganó uno de ellos.

YouTube parece haberse cansado de los contenidos saturados de inteligencia artificial y efectos exagerados. Ahora está dando mayor relevancia a los creadores originales, a los contenidos cotidianos, a los tutoriales, a los podcasts y a los formatos que funcionan como series, donde un episodio es la continuación natural del anterior.

Eso me cayó del cielo. Yo con ganas de volver al gigante de los videos y ellos abriendo las puertas a los pequeños creadores.

Esta semana saldrá el primer episodio de mi nuevo canal o, mejor dicho, de mi canal reconstruido. Ya está grabado, me tomó dos semanas prepararlo y dura dos minutos y medio. De hecho, después de escribir estas palabras le daré una revisión adicional, aunque ya esté listo para publicarse.

Mi nicho es el adulto mayor y la tecnología.

Antes mi canal estaba lleno de temas variados. Eso podía generar algunas visualizaciones, pero en YouTube la variedad excesiva dentro de un mismo canal no suele ser una ventaja.

Volviendo al texto de @emiliorios, estoy convencido de que el contenido no sale de un sombrero de mago. Hay que sembrarlo, cultivarlo y luego cosecharlo para poder mostrarlo al público.

No siempre ocurre así, pero cuando un artículo o un contenido lleva un mensaje importante, debemos ponerle ganas.

Estoy seguro de que, cualquiera que sea el tema que queramos transmitir, debemos tener claro a qué nicho va dirigido, en qué formato será presentado —escritura, video, audio, entre otros— y qué tan extenso debe ser.

Y hay algo especialmente importante en YouTube: la portada o miniatura y el título. Aunque también son relevantes en otras plataformas, esos elementos constituyen el primer gancho que atraerá a la audiencia.

Después de publicar, debemos mantenernos atentos. Si recibimos comentarios, vale la pena responderlos y, si es posible, mencionar por su nombre a quien los hace. De esa manera se crea un acercamiento más humano y una verdadera conexión con la audiencia.

Creo que me extendí demasiado para ser un comentario.

Gracias, @emiliorios, por estos temas fascinantes que me hacen echar cuentos. Un abrazo desde este lado del planeta.

!ALIVE

body.body: Sí, pero en mi sociedad si existe la singularidad de ofrecer apoyo a los extraños, de hecho es uno de los mayores valores sociales. No digo, que todos los apliquemos en todas las circunstancias. Pero ha sido la ayuda de un vecino o un conocido la que ha ayudado a mucha gente a comprar comida cuando se estaba muriendo de hambre o un medicamento cuando no había dinero para comprarlo. Para muchos venezolanos que no habían salido antes de su país, fue un choque cultural muy fuerte descubrir que algo que mi sociedad es considerado normal, en realidad no lo es. Los venezolanos nunca hemos xenofobos, clasistas, ni racistas (salvo en algunas regiones concretas del país) y de pronto muchos se encontraron sufriendo eso en el exterior, sin comprender el porqué, cuando ellos no lo hacían aquí con los extranjeros.

Although David did not receive the wisdom of his son Solomon, who had the task of building the first temple in Jerusalem, his actions as a guided, enlightened, and inspired person are very clear in the Bible.\nIt could be stated without great error that David was a personification of the Kingdom of God, the dominion or empire of the divine perfections, in the Old Testament. In other words, David personified the government of God among the Israelites. The First Book of Chronicles relates that David, after the death of King Saul, was proclaimed king in Hebron, and thus David began great feats as a ruler, as he had done when he defeated Goliath, the Philistine.\nAfter his coronation, David conquered the city of Jerusalem, moved the ark of the covenant to that city, and, guided by God, secured the borders of his kingdom by defeating the Philistines, who saw David as a threat. The Book of Chronicles also recounts a special event in the reign of this great king, who personified a spiritual government in Israel, the covenant between God and David through the prophet Nathan. body.title: Liberating Iijima Farmstead and Claiming Another Gosaku Armor Key
body.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1780188271200-91583d1f17482342.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=efootjoker-yt/10be144a)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=efootjoker-yt/10be144a)


---

---
---

 <center>***Hello everyone and welcome back to my blog.***</center>

---

My next target was the Iijima Farmstead. I received news that the Mongols had taken over the place and that the innocent people were being imprisoned, tortured and forced to work. I could not accept such injustice while I was there. So I headed towards the farmstead.

![Snapshot.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/efootjoker-yt/245cUQg5AoCm48Vr3bv4AmBWH15YowWz8Sgkpm5eqdVoASoMiVSXJafKWGwpMMV4iaiuH.png)

![Snapshot_1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/efootjoker-yt/242hNCJygxuUzjYQPfAfQz1eePsPAZM8yFAgK5huqxmQTT9nvN2M5VpJMj5JppEzhanNS.png)

![Snapshot_2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/efootjoker-yt/23wqEqw2fxLsV8SNLFLBbvRZ11kMsD5UvY6ThmZrdPd68eU8kT7NcQVeLdBr2Jj7TFmCh.png)

The place was not far, about six hundred meters away. Before attacking directly, I first surveyed the entire area. I saw two Mongol soldiers guarding the entrance. I sneaked up behind one and killed him silently. But the other saw me. He was about to sound the horn to warn the others. I took out my bow and shot an arrow, killing him.

![Snapshot_3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/efootjoker-yt/23tRxtNZgHnLbDE7tStudK2pENhBioZRXJAmucnCwWpK6iSZBbCeJLj4Fzt6gAS17ejt5.png)

![Snapshot_4.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/efootjoker-yt/23tbPFavsNNykDwBniRkcfwCDbrQix7abWv3YthR8y1YozERJQn87izxyiCNvWpNXQqSc.png)

![Snapshot_5.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/efootjoker-yt/23xeBsvPHJsvjVY4FXzTrWigN3qvJRSeZvQoTve2T79xfTHmN5Lf51DRuDkTBpevQ7Ajn.png)

![Snapshot_6.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/efootjoker-yt/23yweeFqDKB7nLJoGGpruCsRh26kn6H7q3WQuu2PX1U2dLQrhwaEgJ4U5vA4Qz94sHZb4.png)

![Snapshot_7.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/efootjoker-yt/23zGYLjnVqbQoknJ1VauuVY35AUozwKhfZmJ6f3Xq162FYju5FPESY2w2qCRUZZA8bFbj.png)

Going further in, I saw a few Mongol soldiers standing around one of the prisoners. They were not in one place, they were scattered. So I threw a blast powder to attract their attention. When everyone gathered together, I used the Chain Assassination skill. Within a moment, 3 soldiers fell to the ground. I finished off the rest and freed the prisoner. In gratitude, he told me the location of the next prisoner.

![Snapshot_8.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/efootjoker-yt/23yTSJGHnsknatnMpvsphawWVjArjSNuGwKyjqQAkZYDd8pzphEUrLqVTr41NZWesnZ1m.png)

![Snapshot_9.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/efootjoker-yt/23tkdTcmezNZrmkrdZgTsrsXVN2sBcg6KAknrUkhoQABWhr8xDvbH3rcKy8xR3c36ZGbS.png)

I went ahead and saw that the second prisoner was locked inside a room. There was only one guard there. killing him was not a difficult task. I killed him and freed the second prisoner. He also thanked me and told me the location of the third prisoner.

![Snapshot_10.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/efootjoker-yt/23swe148RJfDdYfqv2fpt9avXzzbH5aqmarnor5aMe4MoLZDFJYKrsUceo9ph7ttHZjp5.png)

![Snapshot_11.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/efootjoker-yt/23vhS9ceLcUjLDsQu6gG2FRZhF7u2F4yJuZBdRrreot8kiDHFkCZt5FbAe61zLJG9DG8r.png)

![Snapshot_12.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/efootjoker-yt/23t72sM6f2YpD7QKk249Mu1CnCtbzasvN3WQxWenixdAmgKTkQAxozvmR4oBBQBqsfZWG.png)

The third prisoner was kept in an open place. There were two towers, and an archer was standing on the tower. It was impossible to use stealth here. I decided to attack directly. A battle began with the soldiers on the ground. The archers were shooting arrows from the tower, but I was able to repel them. After defeating all the soldiers below, I took out my bow and killed the archers in the tower as well. Then I was able to free the third prisoner.


![Snapshot_14.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/efootjoker-yt/23t72xFU8g6KYChWrPaqVibKZwXFmdRiPz3fsz3BoFxdPbMys6LCXSpHdTcURLt6fxAk8.png)

![Snapshot_17.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/efootjoker-yt/23t72xF3rZSfZNNPtcLTr5HMXYCWcZbKbNdiJv3UqJxti4zMDLaG6jfNXwbNj5iSaR6Xr.png)

There was only one prisoner left. He was kept in a place surrounded by many houses. I climbed onto the roof of one of the houses and shot arrows from there, killing two soldiers. But this alerted everyone. They started trying to kill the prisoner.

![Snapshot_15.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/efootjoker-yt/23uQEFx3urns78eSPYMgEbK8NMaUdtYyiQVoS1kF8Q6mhi5e3BJkLa6NhASMDFCPyUB4R.png)

![Snapshot_16.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/efootjoker-yt/23tkdfiKA1wQHWm9TGHXDcaNJmMNDgCA6DxUsAP7uxMKMJwqrEfNYc9P9ysgGV1yVLG7A.png)


![Snapshot_18.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/efootjoker-yt/23tv4UzFQMEt6oF2iogou4Cf9ogpNiiqiDnmU3wQ64LSABSn5n2jbVupgjC8gKzMCqxsu.png)

I jumped off the roof and got straight into the fight. I killed everyone one by one. Finally, I shot a soldier standing far away in the head. He also fell to the ground.

![Snapshot_19.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/efootjoker-yt/23tkdqLB9aLn8ySENC5dYyac615UGvCYPNiBoGmP7f53G6JFUBrubVfrkaRRTUC69bFrZ.png)

Finally, I freed the last prisoner. He was very happy and thanked me. He had a key to unlock Gosaku's armor. He gave me the key in gratitude.


![Screenshot (3031).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/efootjoker-yt/23wLzb4eX6gDpzQh2d8tE8xU2DqmRWYVU2Nf91mkj5wq8dKhtaC5KCLdz6uiVHMERAptt.png)

![Screenshot (3034).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/efootjoker-yt/23uEsRK4VNiuAF6Ds4p2bAkPEQyoHmY5aTcimrecQkodXeC3G33Zm6sYVGxgUUd8x6M2N.png)

After the farmstead was liberated, the villagers slowly started returning. Everyone got busy putting their houses back together. And me? I still need to find a few more keys. Because I want to collect that legendary armor of Gosaku no matter what.

---

![Snapshot_2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/efootjoker-yt/23wqEqw2fxLsV8SNLFLBbvRZ11kMsD5UvY6ThmZrdPd68eU8kT7NcQVeLdBr2Jj7TFmCh.png)

The place was not far, about six hundred meters away. Before attacking directly, I first surveyed the entire area. I saw two Mongol soldiers guarding the entrance. I sneaked up behind one and killed him silently. But the other saw me. He was about to sound the horn to warn the others. I took out my bow and shot an arrow, killing him.

![Snapshot_3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/efootjoker-yt/23tRxtNZgHnLbDE7tStudK2pENhBioZRXJAmucnCwWpK6iSZBbCeJLj4Fzt6gAS17ejt5.png)

![Snapshot_4.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/efootjoker-yt/23tbPFavsNNykDwBniRkcfwCDbrQix7abWv3YthR8y1YozERJQn87izxyiCNvWpNXQqSc.png)

![Snapshot_5.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/efootjoker-yt/23xeBsvPHJsvjVY4FXzTrWigN3qvJRSeZvQoTve2T79xfTHmN5Lf51DRuDkTBpevQ7Ajn.png)

![Snapshot_6.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/efootjoker-yt/23yweeFqDKB7nLJoGGpruCsRh26kn6H7q3WQuu2PX1U2dLQrhwaEgJ4U5vA4Qz94sHZb4.png)

![Snapshot_7.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/efootjoker-yt/23zGYLjnVqbQoknJ1VauuVY35AUozwKhfZmJ6f3Xq162FYju5FPESY2w2qCRUZZA8bFbj.png)

Going further in, I saw a few Mongol soldiers standing around one of the prisoners. They were not in one place, they were scattered. So I threw a blast powder to attract their attention. When everyone gathered together, I used the Chain Assassination skill. Within a moment, 3 soldiers fell to the ground. I finished off the rest and freed the prisoner. In gratitude, he told me the location of the next prisoner.

![Snapshot_8.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/efootjoker-yt/23yTSJGHnsknatnMpvsphawWVjArjSNuGwKyjqQAkZYDd8pzphEUrLqVTr41NZWesnZ1m.png)

![Snapshot_9.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/efootjoker-yt/23tkdTcmezNZrmkrdZgTsrsXVN2sBcg6KAknrUkhoQABWhr8xDvbH3rcKy8xR3c36ZGbS.png)

I went ahead and saw that the second prisoner was locked inside a room. There was only one guard there. killing him was not a difficult task. I killed him and freed the second prisoner. He also thanked me and told me the location of the third prisoner.

![Snapshot_10.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/efootjoker-yt/23swe148RJfDdYfqv2fpt9avXzzbH5aqmarnor5aMe4MoLZDFJYKrsUceo9ph7ttHZjp5.png)

![Snapshot_11.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/efootjoker-yt/23vhS9ceLcUjLDsQu6gG2FRZhF7u2F4yJuZBdRrreot8kiDHFkCZt5FbAe61zLJG9DG8r.png)

![Snapshot_12.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/efootjoker-yt/23t72sM6f2YpD7QKk249Mu1CnCtbzasvN3WQxWenixdAmgKTkQAxozvmR4oBBQBqsfZWG.png)

The third prisoner was kept in an open place. There were two towers, and an archer was standing on the tower. It was impossible to use stealth here. I decided to attack directly. A battle began with the soldiers on the ground. The archers were shooting arrows from the tower, but I was able to repel them. After defeating all the soldiers below, I took out my bow and killed the archers in the tower as well. Then I was able to free the third prisoner.


![Snapshot_14.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/efootjoker-yt/23t72xFU8g6KYChWrPaqVibKZwXFmdRiPz3fsz3BoFxdPbMys6LCXSpHdTcURLt6fxAk8.png)

![Snapshot_17.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/efootjoker-yt/23t72xF3rZSfZNNPtcLTr5HMXYCWcZbKbNdiJv3UqJxti4zMDLaG6jfNXwbNj5iSaR6Xr.png)

There was only one prisoner left. He was kept in a place surrounded by many houses. I climbed onto the roof of one of the houses and shot arrows from there, killing two soldiers. But this alerted everyone. They started trying to kill the prisoner.

![Snapshot_15.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/efootjoker-yt/23uQEFx3urns78eSPYMgEbK8NMaUdtYyiQVoS1kF8Q6mhi5e3BJkLa6NhASMDFCPyUB4R.png)

![Snapshot_16.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/efootjoker-yt/23tkdfiKA1wQHWm9TGHXDcaNJmMNDgCA6DxUsAP7uxMKMJwqrEfNYc9P9ysgGV1yVLG7A.png)


![Snapshot_18.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/efootjoker-yt/23tv4UzFQMEt6oF2iogou4Cf9ogpNiiqiDnmU3wQ64LSABSn5n2jbVupgjC8gKzMCqxsu.png)

I jumped off the roof and got straight into the fight. I killed everyone one by one. Finally, I shot a soldier standing far away in the head. He also fell to the ground.

![Snapshot_19.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/efootjoker-yt/23tkdqLB9aLn8ySENC5dYyac615UGvCYPNiBoGmP7f53G6JFUBrubVfrkaRRTUC69bFrZ.png)

Finally, I freed the last prisoner. He was very happy and thanked me. He had a key to unlock Gosaku's armor. He gave me the key in gratitude.


![Screenshot (3031).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/efootjoker-yt/23wLzb4eX6gDpzQh2d8tE8xU2DqmRWYVU2Nf91mkj5wq8dKhtaC5KCLdz6uiVHMERAptt.png)

![Screenshot (3034).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/efootjoker-yt/23uEsRK4VNiuAF6Ds4p2bAkPEQyoHmY5aTcimrecQkodXeC3G33Zm6sYVGxgUUd8x6M2N.png)

After the farmstead was liberated, the villagers slowly started returning. Everyone got busy putting their houses back together. And me? I still need to find a few more keys. Because I want to collect that legendary armor of Gosaku no matter what.

body.title: Perdonar no es igual a permitir [ESP/ENG]
body.body: >\n\n Hoy escuché una frase que me impactó: \

En seguida, me puse en modo reflexión... ¡Es cierto! Porque perdonar es un regalo que nos hacemos a nosotros mismos para vivir en paz, pero permitir que nos hagan daño, es otra cosa.

Por formación, tengo muy presente esa frase del Padre Nuestro: \

Si quiero ser perdonada, debo hacer lo mismo con los demás. Pero la verdad que una cosa es liberarnos de la carga del resentimiento y otra muy distinta es permitirnos seguir siendo una diana donde los demás apuntan sus inseguridades.
> \n \nToday I heard a phrase that really struck me: \

Right away, I started reflecting... It's true! Because forgiveness is a gift we give ourselves so we can live in peace, but allowing others to hurt us is something else entirely. Because of my upbringing, I’m very mindful of that line from the Lord’s Prayer: “Forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us.” If I want to be forgiven, I must do the same for others. But the truth is, it’s one thing to free ourselves from the burden of resentment, and quite another to allow ourselves to remain a target where others project their insecurities. ***
https://i.ecency.com/DQmdFMts3nA8ej2Cxo9W3ndGiWmroH1V5zuM5nqcXW6KcWK/20260530_182044.jpg
***

> 
 
El perdón nos hace libres, pero establecer límites saludables, es un acto de amor propio, evita que vuelvan a lastimarnos.

Nos corresponde cuidar de nosotros mismos.

Saber decir \
, cuando nos exponemos a conductas repetitivas por parte de alguien, es un acto de madurez, autocuidado y respeto. Si no nos amamos a nosotros mismos, nadie más lo hará.

> 
 
Forgiveness sets us free, but setting healthy boundaries is an act of self-love that prevents others from hurting us again.

It is our responsibility to take care of ourselves.

Knowing when to say \

when we are exposed to someone’s repetitive behavior is an act of maturity, self-care, and respect. If we don’t love ourselves, no one else will. ***
https://i.ecency.com/DQmYbSeVRcw6mrvPcjRcEy9PnvSsC1A4FVNEDpq4bxdLgTn/20260428_213900.jpg
***

> Debo admitir que durante mucho tiempo no supe distinguir ese límite que marca el respeto hacia sí mismo. He sido muy permisiva y eso lo nota quien está del otro lado, intentando imponerse hasta doblegarte. Pero lo mejor es que nunca es tarde para notarlo, reconocerlo y dar un paso atrás, no para retroceder, sino para apartarnos de lo que no nos hace bien. A veces, para salir adelante, debemos movernos en dirección opuesta a la que llevamos.

> I have to admit that for a long time, I didn’t know how to recognize that line that marks self-respect. I’ve been too permissive, and those on the other side notice that, trying to impose themselves until they break you down. But the best part is that it’s never too late to notice it, acknowledge it, and take a step back—not to retreat, but to distance ourselves from what isn’t good for us. Sometimes, to move forward, we have to go in the opposite direction of where we’re headed. ***
https://i.ecency.com/DQmNTKkM5LYmwiAbqp3fXqzyddbyNzzoVsbszyvxxwe8mZy/20260530_182115.jpg
***

> Cuando observo a cualquier felino, sea un león, un tigre o un gato, puedo ver ese aire imponente que expresa: puedes admirarme, pero no tocarme. Hay personas que también lo tienen, quizás en algún momento lo tuve, pero sé que con el tiempo me fui disminuyendo para encajar, hasta un punto que no me reconocí; pero ahora quiero recuperar esa versión de mí que admiro. Porque mientras tengamos vida, tenemos la oportunidad de rediseñarnos y de ser nuestra mejor versión.

> When I look at any feline—whether it’s a lion, a tiger, or a cat—I can see that imposing air they exude: you can admire me, but don’t touch me. Some people have that too; perhaps I once had it, but I know that over time I toned it down to fit in, to the point where I didn’t recognize myself anymore; but now I want to reclaim that version of myself that I admire. Because as long as we’re alive, we have the chance to reinvent ourselves and become our best selves. ***
https://i.ecency.com/DQmTpDsC8zY7CBcTQYd88FLCcCpFrVk9oWkVaC34uB7vok3/20260530_202711.jpg
https://images.ecency.com/DQmbCVkiZrRxXwagi66h8U8HT3PQgpx2dZx7ZTs8ZKtUYu1/mi_sep.png

> Y estos son mis pensamientos para compartir con ustedes hoy amigos. Cada día nos ofrece un lienzo en blanco, listo para que construyamos nuestros sueños, trazo a trazo. A ustedes, gracias por haberme acompañado a través de estas letras.

> And these are the thoughts I’d like to share with you today, my friends. Every day offers us a blank canvas, ready for us to build our dreams, stroke by stroke. To all of you, thank you for joining me on this journey through these words. ***

body.title: Concurso. Observa Piensa Escribe. Solución
body.body:
> # Solución # En cierta etapa de la vida puedes sentirte tan agobiado buscando una solución que no aparece, no ves o no encuentras; esto sucede cuando te dominan los problemas y el cansancio te pone ciego por eso no ves nada con claridad y hasta nubla la mente a tal punto que no piensas ni razonas, es decir, estás como en un limbo. Una sensación bastante desagradable, que hasta puede ser de impotencia por darle tantas vueltas a la cabeza, pero nada que puedes resolver el problema, este momento lo puede vivir cualquier persona, pero la diferencia está en que algunas se ocupan de resolverlo lo más rápido que puedan y otras tardan mucho o les cuesta más salir de ese limbo. Una situación así se vive como un rompecabezas cuando te queda esa última pieza que no encuentras donde encaja y después de invertir tanto tiempo en armarlo no quieres desistir hasta terminarlo. Lo más insólito es que el desespero a veces se apodera de ti y luego cuando encuentras o logras la calma, haces una pausa, respira y si puedes encontrar eso que tanto buscabas quizás estuvo frente a tus narices siempre así funciona el ser humano bloqueado sin paciencia ante algunos problemas. Como dicen que hay solución para todo en esta vida, bueno toca además de buscar también esperar; fácil de decir aunque difícil hacer, pero al final estamos frente a personas que además son complicadas por naturaleza. Esa última pieza del rompecabezas tiene su lugar y así mismo cualquier otro problema se puede disipar, un poco más de paciencia y se logrará. ​ # ​Te invito a participar: [\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\*\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\*Concurso. body.title: Prices in Sarawak
body.body: Good Morning.. to all my wonderful friends. How has your week been? Has it been great? Today, I am going to share a post which is to let you see what the prices of things are here in Sarawak and let you compare with the prices in your own place. For reference, 1 USD = RM 3.97 roughly I was one day walking around the supermarket, a place that I love visiting, and thought, maybe I should write about a post of the prices in my country. KINDER BEUNO ============ This is one of my favourite chocolates. A pack of 3 is around RM 13.30 or around USD 3.35. These are filled with creamy chocolate filling. One of the best types of Chocolates.
/> A bag of chips. Cottage fries Potato Chips RM 2.68 for 60 grams or around USD 0.68 cents USD.

/> Milk - a pack of 4 of 1 litre is around MYR 25 or USD 6.30. I usually buy lots of milk to add to my coffee to give it a bit of creamy texture to drink. But, I don't add any sugar. Milk gives it that slightly sweet taste.
/> A pack of OREOS is around RM 2.38 or USD 60 cents. These are one of my favourite type of cookies. These are used in various food recipes from cheesecakes to ice cream toppings.
/> A loaf of breaf is around MYR 3.80 or USD 1.

/> The expiry is usually around a week. Cadbury Oreo Chocolate bar ========================== These are filled with lots of oreo bits in the middle and anything that has Oreo's inside is definitely what I want to have. MYR 6.88 during promotion or around USD 1.75.
/> 5 KGS of Powdered Detergent is around MYR 14.88 or around USD 3.75. 5 KGS of washing detergent is going to last at least a few months which is quite worth the money to get.
/> Some more of the Cadbury Chocolate bars here.
/> The locally made cheese snacks. These are although quite affordable but they don't skip on quality at all. RM 1.70 is around USD 43 cents.

/> Eggs are around RM 18 or USD 4.50 per tray of 24 eggs in a tray. Do you think the prices are cheap here or not? Or is it more expensive as compared to where you are living? Thank you very much for reading my post. Have a wonderful day ahead. @luueetang YouTube : www.youtube.com/luueejanice Tiktok: www.tiktok.com/@luueejanice

body.title: The Green Mile (1999) Is More Than Just A Prison Movie. It Is A Powerful Story About Humanity, Compassion, And Justice. Nearly Three Decades Later, It Remains One Of The Greatest Stephen King Adaptations Ever Made.
body.body:
The Green Mile Is More Than Just A Prison Movie. It Is A Powerful Story About Humanity, Compassion, And Justice. Nearly Three Decades Later, It Remains One Of The Greatest Stephen King Adaptations Ever Made.

![IMG_2440.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYqPbAymzVCdyMcJp859MSiVqzkushSQqKCprJ9zjeACj/IMG_2440.webp)

Some movies entertain you while you’re watching them, and then there are movies that stay with you long after they end. The Green Mile falls firmly into the second category for me. Released in 1999, this emotional drama combines elements of fantasy, mystery, and tragedy to create a film that is both heartbreaking and unforgettable.

The movie was directed by Frank Darabont, who had already proven his talent with another Stephen King adaptation, The Shawshank Redemption. Darabont understood how to take King’s storytelling and translate it to the screen without losing the emotional depth that made the original story so compelling. His direction is patient and deliberate, allowing viewers to become fully invested in the characters and their journeys.

Tom Hanks stars as Paul Edgecomb, the head guard on death row at Cold Mountain Penitentiary during the 1930s. Hanks delivers a strong and believable performance as a man trying to do the right thing while working within a flawed system. His character serves as the audience’s guide through the events that unfold on the prison’s death row, known as “The Green Mile.”

The standout performance comes from Michael Clarke Duncan as John Coffey. Coffey is a massive inmate sentenced to death for the murder of two young girls. Despite his intimidating appearance, he possesses a gentle nature and a kindness that immediately sets him apart from the other prisoners.

The supporting cast is excellent as well. David Morse, Bonnie Hunt, James Cromwell, Barry Pepper, Michael Jeter, Doug Hutchison, and Sam Rockwell all contribute memorable performances. Doug Hutchison is especially effective as Percy Wetmore, one of the most unpleasant and cruel characters in the entire film.

As the story progresses, Paul and the other guards begin to notice that John Coffey is unlike anyone they have ever met. He appears to possess extraordinary healing abilities and a supernatural gift that cannot easily be explained. These discoveries force the guards to question everything they believe about justice, guilt, and innocence.

One of the film’s greatest strengths is the relationship between Paul and John. Their friendship develops naturally throughout the story and becomes the emotional core of the movie. Tom Hanks and Michael Clarke Duncan share incredible chemistry, making every scene between them feel genuine and heartfelt.

The movie also does an excellent job building emotional investment in nearly every character. By the time the story reaches its final act, viewers have spent enough time with these people that their triumphs and tragedies carry real weight. Few films manage to create such strong emotional connections.

Another reason the film works so well is its pacing. At just over three hours long, it could have easily felt bloated or overly drawn out. Instead, the story unfolds at exactly the right speed, giving important moments room to breathe while keeping the audience engaged from beginning to end.

Visually, The Green Mile captures the atmosphere of a 1930s prison perfectly. The setting feels authentic and lived-in, helping immerse viewers in the world of Cold Mountain Penitentiary. Combined with Thomas Newman’s beautiful musical score, the film creates an emotional experience that is difficult to forget.

The movie explores several important themes, including compassion, redemption, prejudice, faith, and the imperfections of the justice system. These themes are woven naturally into the story rather than feeling forced, which makes their impact even stronger.

What I appreciate most about The Green Mile is that it never relies solely on its supernatural elements. At its heart, this is a story about people. It is about kindness, cruelty, sacrifice, and the difficult choices that individuals face when confronted with moral dilemmas.

There are very few movies that can make me laugh, smile, feel hopeful, and then completely break my heart by the end. The Green Mile accomplishes all of those things. Its emotional moments are earned, not manipulated, which is one reason they remain so effective even after multiple viewings.

![IMG_2441.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXt5hsSvqpB329MU2JDDDAcrSanLuzPx38seUwhn2Hexg/IMG_2441.webp)

For me, The Green Mile is simply a great film. The cast is outstanding, Frank Darabont’s direction is excellent, and the story delivers an emotional punch that few movies can match. More than twenty-five years after its release, it remains one of the most powerful and memorable films I have ever seen.

body.title: Hice otro Stitch
body.body:
> Saludos querida comunidad, hace unos días compartí con ustedes un [amigurumi de Stitch](https://peakd.com/hive-127911/@irenenavarroart/stitch-amigurumi) que me habia encargado una prima, luego de publicarlo por aquí acostumbro también a subir el resultado final a mis otras redes oara promocionar mi trabajo y asi llegar a mas clientes potenciales, para mi sorpresa esta vez funcionó y me escribió un amigo encargando uno para su sobrina, yo encantada acepté la comisión sobre todo porque ya tenía en mente hacer una nueva versión del amigurumi de Stitch. > Greetings dear community, a few days ago I shared with you a Stitch amigurumi that a cousin had commissioned. After posting it here, I usually also upload the final result to my other social media accounts to promote my work and reach more potential clients. To my surprise, this time it worked and a friend wrote to me ordering one for his niece. I was delighted to accept the commission, especially since I already had in mind making a new version of the Stitch amigurumi.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/AK3fXcfda86t4vacDBs2WvuY3T58hSYiDGNUfuvtpgx9DfizHjXT2doUZydtPG2.jpg https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png
La primera diferencia que resalta a la vista es el material, para el primero usé hilo acrílico y para esta ocasión decidí usar lana acrílica muy delgada, esto resultó en que el amigurumi se viera un poquitito mas pequeño aún si usé el mismo ganchillo que el anterior, pero quedó mucho mas suave al tacto. > The first difference that stands out is the material; for the first one I used acrylic yarn, and for this one I decided to use very thin acrylic wool. This resulted in the amigurumi looking a little smaller, even though I used the same crochet hook as before, but it felt much softer to the touch.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/AK7yHmhCDP8JdHzYj3bwU1UxKWZ5ErYyzS3M5VrcAkBEVDqM8by1Vx9idiSJFcg.jpg https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png
Para el cuerpo segui el mismo procedimiento que el anterior, pero cambie la forma en que hice la cabeza, en esta ocasión incorporé el azul claro que bordea los ojos como parte de la cabeza haciendo cambios de color de hilo, en este sentido la cantidad de puntadas de ambas cabeza son las mismas, pero varían en el cambio de color Para esta versión inicie con azul oscuro 6 puntos bajos en un anillo y 6 aumentos por 6 hileras para obtener 42 puntadas, en la séptima hilera comencé los cambios de color 3 puntos azul claro separado por 7 oscuros de otros 3 puntos claros, en la siguientes 4 hileras hice 5 puntos claros, separados por 5 oscuros de otros 5 claros, y en la siguiente hilera hice solo 4 claros separados por 5 oscuros de otros 4 claros, hice 2 hileras solo con el azul oscuro, luego hice 21 puntos con azul claro y 21 con oscuro, luego hice 6 disminuciones por 4 hileras, de ese modo queda el azul claro en la cabeza y también el rasgo mas diferente es que en esta ocasión utilicé ojos de seguridad, lo cual le dio un aspecto mas tierno al Stitch. No considero que sea uno mejor que otro, el primero es mas fiel al aspecto de los ojos del personajes pero este le da un aspecto más de bebé, ambos me encantan y lo mejor es que manos clientes quedaron satisfechos ☺️ > For the body, I followed the same procedure as before, but I changed the way I made the head. This time, I incorporated the light blue that borders the eyes as part of the head by changing the yarn color. In this sense, the number of stitches for both heads is the same, but they vary in the color changes. > > For this version, I started with dark blue: 6 single crochet stitches in a ring and 6 increases for 6 rows to obtain 42 stitches. In the seventh row, I began the color changes: 3 light blue stitches separated by 7 dark stitches and 3 light stitches. In the next 4 rows, I made 5 light stitches, separated by 5 dark stitches and 5 light stitches. In the following row, I made only 4 light stitches separated by 5 dark stitches and 4 light stitches. I made 2 rows only with dark blue, then 21 stitches with light blue and 21 with dark blue. Then I made 6 decreases for 4 rows. This is how the light blue appears on the head. The most different feature is that this time I used safety eyes, which gave Stitch a cuter look. I don't think one is better than the other; the first one is more faithful to the character's eyes, but this one gives him a more babyish appearance. I love them both, and the best part is that both clients were happy with them ☺️

body.title: Nature’s Hidden Forest in a Stone 🌳✨
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU3Dwh5yB6adRtR6N1NBvPRWnDizyKwWpXg14P4yeJvoo/1780186909033.jpg)
Have you ever seen a forest trapped inside a gemstone?
​When I hold this piece of Yemeni Agate to the light, I don’t just see a stone. I see the patience of time and the artistry of nature. These intricate, tree-like patterns—known as dendritic formations—are not carved by human hands; they are nature's own masterpiece, preserved in silence for millions of years.
​As a craftsman, my job is simply to reveal what nature has already created. It reminds me that even in our toughest days, there is beauty waiting to be uncovered if we just look closely enough.
Many see the polished gem, but they don't see the journey.
​Extracting these stones from the heart of the Yemeni mountains is a test of patience. It’s not just digging; it’s an ancient conversation with the earth. Every stone (like the one in  begins as a raw, dusty piece of rock, hidden beneath layers of history.
​As a craftsman, I spend hours cleaning, shaping, and polishing these stones by hand. It’s a slow process—the grit, the heat, and the precision required to reveal the delicate, tree-like patterns inside without breaking the fragile structure.
​Why do I do it? Because there is a unique satisfaction in taking something raw and giving it a new life. It teaches me that everything—even the hardest stone—has a potential for beauty if you are willing to work for it.
​This is a piece of Yemen’s heart, shared with you all. I hope it brings a moment of wonder to your day. 🧡

body.title: Don't lose heart!!! | No te canses!!!
body.body:
<center>![](https://images.pexels.com/photos/756744/pexels-photo-756744.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=800)
</center>

*Fuente: Pexels.com / [Bible.com](https://www.bible.com/)*

You know what's the hardest part of faith? It's not the big crises. It's the daily grind. It's waking up every day and choosing to keep going when nothing seems to change.

Sometimes you pray and pray and the answer doesn't come. Sometimes you keep believing and the situation stays the same. And that's when the enemy whispers: \

But here's the thing: God's timing is not our timing. Just because you don't see it yet doesn't mean God isn't working. The seed is growing underground. The foundation is being laid. The breakthrough is closer than you think.

> Let us not become weary in doing good, for at the proper time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up.

Galatians 6:9

## God bless you today and always!!!

**********
**********

Sabés qué es lo más difícil de la fe? No son las crisis grandes. Es el día a día. Es levantarte cada mañana y elegir seguir adelante cuando nada parece cambiar.

A veces orás y orás y la respuesta no llega. A veces seguís creyendo y la situación sigue igual. Y ahí es cuando el enemigo te susurra: \

Pero la cosa es esta: el tiempo de Dios no es nuestro tiempo. Solo porque todavía no lo ves no significa que Dios no esté trabajando. La semilla está creciendo bajo tierra. El fundamento se está poniendo. La victoria está más cerca de lo que pensás.

> No nos cansemos de hacer el bien, porque a su debido tiempo cosecharemos si no nos damos por vencidos.

Gálatas 6:9

## Dios te bendiga hoy y siempre!!!

body.title: Nvidia's N1X Chip Marks 'A New Era of PC' — AI Computing Goes Mainstream
body.body: ![Nvidia N1X: A New Era of PC](https://ipfs.io/ipfs/QmZ3hoDFEYu7ovcxHCqmqraxmHhCYCj4PBtHm99rMDJnwz)\n\n# Nvidia's N1X Chip Marks \

— AI Computing Goes Mainstream

**The world's most valuable chip company is about to do something no one expected: become a PC manufacturer.**

This week, Nvidia and Microsoft sent coordinated tweets cryptically declaring \

— complete with GPS coordinates pointing to Taipei's Music Center, where Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang will deliver his Computex keynote this Sunday. The message is unmistakable: after years of building the AI infrastructure that powers everything from data centers to autonomous vehicles, Nvidia is finally stepping into your laptop.

## The N1X: When AI Silicon Meets the Desktop

According to multiple sources, Nvidia is expected next week to debut the first Windows PCs that use its own chips as the main processor. The rumored N1X processor — a mobile variant of the GB10 Superchip that powers Nvidia's DGX Spark mini-PC — represents a fundamental reimagining of what a personal computer can be.

The N1X is built on ARM architecture, developed in partnership with MediaTek, and packs an RTX 5070-class GPU directly onto the same die as the CPU. It features up to 128GB of LPDDR5X memory — a staggering amount for a laptop chip — and is designed from the ground up to handle AI workloads natively. This isn't a PC with an NVIDIA GPU bolted on; this is a PC where AI processing is woven into the silicon itself.

The implications are enormous. For years, Apple has been quietly building its case with ARM-based Macs that deliver exceptional performance-per-watt. Qualcomm has been pushing Windows on ARM as a battery-life champion. But neither brings the kind of AI acceleration that Nvidia's architecture offers. With N1X, every Windows laptop could potentially run large language models locally, process real-time computer vision tasks, and serve as an AI endpoint — all without cloud dependency.

## Why This Matters Now

The timing of Nvidia's entry into the PC market is no accident. We are in 2026, and AI has moved from novelty to necessity. The agentic AI wave — where software agents autonomously plan, execute, and complete complex tasks — demands hardware that can handle massive parallel workloads efficiently. Cloud-based AI is expensive, introduces latency, and raises privacy concerns. Local AI inference on a powerful edge chip changes the equation entirely.

Nvidia's move also reflects a broader industry shift. The company that built its fortune on GPUs for gaming and crypto mining has successfully pivoted to become the undisputed king of AI infrastructure. Its data center chips power virtually every major AI model training run on the planet. Now, it wants that same intelligence in your pocket — or at least on your desk.

The competitive landscape is shifting beneath everyone's feet. Intel and AMD, the traditional x86 duopoly that has dominated PC computing for decades, now face a new kind of rival: a company that doesn't just make processors but owns the entire AI stack, from training frameworks to inference engines. Apple's M-series chips have proven ARM can compete on performance. Qualcomm has shown it can make Windows-on-ARM viable. Nvidia is about to prove that ARM-based AI PCs could be the most powerful category of consumer computing ever created.

## The Broader Context: Chips, Geopolitics, and the Future of Computing

Nvidia's PC ambitions don't exist in a vacuum. This week also saw Huawei unveil its \

at ISCAS 2026 in Shanghai — a radical rethinking of semiconductor progress that challenges Moore's Law itself. Rather than obsessing over transistor miniaturization, Huawei is proposing a framework focused on reducing signal delays and boosting transmission speed across computing systems. Nvidia's Jensen Huang called it \

— a measured response that acknowledges the innovation while maintaining competitive distance.

Meanwhile, SoftBank announced major investments in AI data centers across France, and UK banks are still struggling to access cutting-edge AI models like Mythos. The global race for AI supremacy is intensifying on multiple fronts: hardware, software, policy, and infrastructure.

What makes Nvidia's N1X announcement particularly significant is that it represents the moment when AI computing transitions from a specialized enterprise domain to an everyday consumer reality. The same chip architecture that trains billion-parameter models will soon be running inference on a device you carry to class or the office.

## What It Means for the Future

If Nvidia's N1X delivers on its promise, we are looking at a fundamental transformation of personal computing. Laptops that can run sophisticated AI models locally will enable entirely new categories of applications — real-time language translation, on-device creative tools that understand context, personal AI assistants that know your work and preferences without sending data to the cloud.

The \

that Nvidia and Microsoft are teasing could well be the beginning of an AI-native computing paradigm. Just as smartphones became pocket computers when they combined communication, computing, and connectivity in one device, AI PCs could become the first truly intelligent personal devices — machines that don't just respond to commands but anticipate needs, learn patterns, and augment human capability in ways we are only beginning to imagine.\n\nComputex 2026, running June 2-5 in Taipei, will tell us whether this is hype or history. One thing seems certain: the PC industry has never been more interesting, and Nvidia's arrival on the consumer silicon stage is about to make it even more so.
