body.title: Sometimes a Team that is Not Maxed Out is Better than a Maxed Out Team
body.body:
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/seattlea/23u5XZkknrKMxcbqtRWyHWUxP3KNqYuMbiB1WQ9WTasDu2Ho3oZgre3THiz7WfLTpkWse.png

What I love about Splinterlands is sometimes a team that is not fully maxed out defeats a team composed of the fully maxed out and more expensive monsters. It is all about building a perfect team for the ruleset combination. Today I would like to share a battle that illustrates this scenario at Modern Champion 2.

## The Ruleset
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ7t6VyexjSmVG1a4uh7S9Nk8o3Y33eMXREzXEnHQFdJq/image.png)
Here we have a dual ruleset of Four's a Crowd where you can summon a maximum of four units and Reverse Speed ruleset where the slowest monsters attack first. 

We also have sixty five mana available and Life and Fire splinters in play. Sixty five mana and four slots is a real high mana battle where you can play units without really thinking about mana. 

When i see Reverse Speed ruleset I naturally think of Fire as it has Grove Doomblade which is a great monster for Reverse speed, but a counter to this Arcana Reward card comes in the form of Eternal Tofu summoner which gives thorns and extra two health points. So I went with a counter.

## The Strategy
The strategy here is two-fold: First I want to spread the damage from the opponent to two targets: a resilient taunt monster in the form of Bellowmancer that is resilient to ranged and melee attacks as well as the magic attacks due to his void armor ability as well as the main tank in the form of  Dar 'Gottem' Gearnut that has a great health and armor and is being healed by the Calabash Sage. 

While the opponent is getting damage from thorns and is busy attacking two very solid defensive monsters my other two monsters are doing their damage with a four ranged attack from a Calabash Sage and three magic attack from Mystic Mudbinder that also caries a solid punch in the form of Armored Strike ability.

## The Battle
[Link to the Battle](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_b3e9b0be70f642e48704559fc9118217?ref=seattlea)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNzq8n4DGozvoUho4NgHXdcGBh7inHkunetEjMyq1hssH/image.png)

In the first round Killians-Wrath piloted by the Mario08 scholar did manage to take out my taunt monster, but in the process his Grove Doomblade sustained some major damage loosing his shield and six out of eight health. 

Most of his team is looking pretty good still, lets see what the second round will bring...
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQye7HzcuUgnVvYqUQ2Bzi1foxpeXXqZdWDLigfJqFHNw/image.png)

In the second round our Calabash Sage got dangerously close to being taken out and it got stunned by Grove Doomblade, but the thorns from the Calabash Sage did take out Grove Doomblade finally taking out this really dangerous monster card from the battlefield.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeVXBRegPoQx2N9Y96N9Lw1iVydzKRTPADwJT3BRFzy4n/image.png)

In the third round a lucky magic damage shot from their Gramel the Hunger took out our Calabash Sage which means we loose a very valuable tank heal.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVZuaDUMWv5FhTU5RyDYVPAN8hGB3R3kgcUSRiMoDcbAD/image.png)

The battle is very close at the start of the fourth round and either side can still prevail!

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVvag3ehcLb2STdZrq26PogoQQiNeuUehHShGcWAhHj8R/image.png)

At the start of round Five two monsters go toe to toe in this one on one battle of Mystic Mudbinder and Gramel the Hunger. My bet is on my Mystic Mudbinder as he has a self heal and Gramel the Hunger just doesn't have enough damage in my opinion.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTJf9S6Eb5VXd5nd2eb1pbtkebQM3EuvZ2patgiAG2Su8/image.png)

And finally in round seven Mystic Mudbinder outlasts the Gramel the Hunger.

## Conclusion 
As you can see in this battle I had a level one SPS Promo card Dar 'Gottem' Gearnut legendary card and a level seven out of ten common card: Calabash Sage, but these two cards performed great against a maxed out deck at a Modern Champion 1 / Champion 2 level. 

Sometimes you have to look at what each card brings to the table even if it is not maxed out.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWRcjp8NsMwZERCqNh9CCcjvZuRHcmqkPk16t5X1iyUec/image.png)

And here we defeated a higher ranked scholar piloted account featuring a fully maxed out and more expensive team.

body.title: We are, \
body.body:
>

Look, real authenticity isn't about having the art of pretending to “be okay” when we're not. How do you live from there?, because many times masks are usually built to avoid showing what is behind the character and sometimes we don't go along that line, and that's to be admired. Because to get there, we need to have the self-esteem that allows us to be ourselves beyond external demands, which becomes emotional integrity: knowing who you are (with your lights and shadows) so clearly, that you don't need different versions depending on who is looking at you. >In fact, we don't need to make a lot of noise to have courage. *We are like salt, whose essence often goes unnoticed while we are present... but when salt is missing, everything changes*. I am referring to humility, respect, loyalty, peace and good intentions that do not always attract attention immediately, but it is those little things that give flavor to life, to a friendship, to a relationship and even to a family. We live in times where many people seek to impress, appear or stand out above others... but the real value is in those who bring tranquility, support, sincerity and good energy without the need to show off. Don't underestimate your essence by not making noise. Sometimes the most valuable people are the ones who are only discovered when they are no longer around. They are those people who always have a smile, a joke, energy for everyone. And one assumes that behind that there is an easy life. They are people who seem immune to pain, as never before about the darkest moment of life. Sometimes life gets tangled up. Plans change, emotions weigh and we feel like we don't know where to start… But even in the midst of chaos, little by little we can find threads that help us rebuild ourselves: accept, ask for help, rest, cry, learn, try again and trust in our process. We can't always choose what happens to us, but we can choose how to accompany us as we go through it.And even if we don't see it complete today... every little step counts too. It's not what happens to us, it's what we decide to do with what happens to us when fear, anxiety and the pressure of feeling that everything is over. And how to get up when we think we have no way out. What I'm talking about is what happens when we hit rock bottom. About movement as a survival mechanism. About success, resilience, anxiety, family, bonds and the pain that is often hidden behind a good mood. Sometimes we spend years trying to be what others expect, something like being stronger, more correct, more accommodating, easier to love. Because there are wounds that no one sees... until someone decides to speak up. Until one day you find out that no. But the soul gets tired of acting. There comes a time when life begins to remove masks, links, places and versions that no longer hold your truth. Becoming who we really are is not always comfortable, but it is deeply liberating. Janitze 🌹

body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmapU7fpWwzWSSZ9X7aUM1w2UUSi4JwfZg2os9FBVtkj5h/mix_20260531_021259.jpg)

| Latin Name | Observation Date | Location |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| ***Tetragnatha hasselti*** | May 25, 2026 | Purulia, Natore, Bangladesh |


Let's know some interesting scientific facts about this useful friend and strange spider. Below are all the details:

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbe4sAz3kRtUsAykjWdM8p2o1vXUHo6Db6MrgU2wgUA2v/mix_20260531_021213.jpg)

Common name: ** Spider or Long-jawed orb weaver**. They are called stretch spiders because they keep their bodies stretched like sticks.
Scientific name: ***Tetragnatha hasselti***.
Family: It is a spider belonging to the Tetragnathidae family.
Genus: Its genus is Tetragnatha.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUpm22d3YicECYyv4FrEBZ9FEHZTxbir4LxZwnBEDCif6/mix_20260531_021243.jpg)

Appearance: These spiders look completely different. Their bodies are very long and narrow. Their legs are unusually long compared to their bodies. Their body color is light yellowish-green or golden brown, which looks quite shiny.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPjXMnaTrx7iYHNnReNvBEsKfS429bB5x1s6u6AYhxbEe/mix_20260531_021319.jpg)

​Habitat and habitat: They are found in abundance in the nature of various Asian countries including Bangladesh, India, China, Indonesia. They mainly prefer to live on the banks of ponds, rice fields, wetlands and damp wild grass leaves.

​Character or trick: They can do a very great trick. During the day, they lie on the grass or leaves with their long legs straight. Then they look exactly like a dry stick, which is called camouflage in English. Due to this disguise, they easily escape from predators.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc9GkyR6XLzJ5d3gbqJF1g7twts2Ebds7Sm18SE1Bo3Dj/mix_20260531_021352.jpg)

​Food: They usually weave small parallel webs in the grass at night. Mosquitoes, small flies and various small flying insects that are harmful to crops are their main food.

​Benefits: These camouflaged spiders are a real blessing to maintain the balance of our nature. They do a lot of good to our environment by eating a large number of harmful mosquitoes and harmful insects in the rice fields every day. They are a great friend of our farmers.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZHSvfyDggwmHxUSbnGLCKFR4cUxhyPg2KoUdnaLv6ztL/mix_20260531_021413.jpg)

​Disadvantages: This spider has no disadvantages or bad side. They do not cause any harm to humans or crops, they are completely safe for us.

body.title: We almost had it all
body.body:
For us Arsenal fans, today was supposed to be the day we made history. Winning the Premier League and now almost winning the Champions League. It would have meant we put our enemies to shame by conquering the Champions League with an unbeaten record. If I am not mistaken, it would have been the first in history. ![IMG_8389.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/AJg7nStvR6x7JWryWijQ21hMGeAfoPUeF4Vh8hv2n1Bw4nBHPweGUi6rZUoayNf.jpeg) Image from the official arsenal’s x page! The match was like no other as fans all over the world were eager to see their team win the league, if not for anything else, but for the bragging rights. It will not be complete if I do not make mention of the fact that the hatred was cumbersome. We had more haters watching the match than fans. It was no other than fellow Premier League fans that are jealous to see us triumph. One would think they should have supported their fellow brothers in arm against a foreign French club. Then when we head back to England, we continue with the beef. Rather they chose jealousy and spite. It is true what they say that winning comes with more foes than friends and I could see that in Champions League final. I cannot deny the fact that as a hardcore fan, the lost in the UCL final cuts deep, worse than a heartbreak from a loving partner. Well, holding back the tears requires discipline, which I am not a stranger to. It is also marvelous to note that this performance from Arsenal did not just come at an appropriate time, rather it shows that our squad can no longer be overwritten. Our patience, long drought of no wins and the tenacity to keep pushing forward with our head held up high has been fully displayed in all matches. I have said it before and I will say it again, in the past, at this stage, we have already said goodbye to all trophies long before the season comes to an end but look at us now. Fought hard to win the Champions League after winning the toughest league in the word, the Premier League. I challenge you to cast the first statement without mentioning the fact that we did extremely well for ourselves this season. Despite the hatred and giving up the lead after the opening goal from Kai Havertz at just 6 minutes into the game, we still gave them a good run for their money. In the game, Arsenal held down the fortress, doing everything possible despite the external forces from the referees and all Arsenal haters. They thought it was over for us in the start of the penalty shootout, yet we came back. I have to be honest, it was a competition with my heart racing from pillar to post. I stayed glued to the TV from the get go down to the end of the penalty shootout. It was so tough and yet so close for us as a team. It felt like a win slipping from your hand as you watched it go. Nonetheless, Arsenal's squad did well. To Eberechi and Gabriel, do not get depressed over the penalty shots missed, you guys have done well for us this season it can only get better from here. Nothing will prepare you for the victories ahead like the losses encountered and we are no stranger to being persistent despite the setbacks. Gunners for life!

body.title: Soyez prêt pour l'édition de juin du Hive Power Up Month !
body.body:
![](https://i.imgur.com/M9RD8KS.png)

Comme vous le savez sans doute, le Power Up Month a désormais lieu tous les mois et la prochaine édition débutera demain.

<sub>![](https://arcange.eu/images/flags/en_16.png) This post is translated in English - **[here](/hivebuzz/@hivebuzz/pum-202606)**</sub>
<sub>![](https://arcange.eu/images/flags/es_16.png) Este post está traducido al español - **[aquí](/hivebuzz/@hivebuzz-es/pum-202606)**</sub>

Ne manquez pas l'opportunité d'obtenir votre badge PUM. Mais ne le prenez pas pour acquis car de nombreux participants des éditions précédentes ont admis à quel point ce défi est difficile.

L'objectif du Power Up Month est de récompenser ceux qui font des power-ups réguliers plutôt qu'un seul power-up comme le font par exemple de nombreux utilisateurs pour le [Power Up Day](/@hivebuzz/pud-202606).

## C'est parti pour un autre mois !

**Le 1er juin** n'est pas seulement le [Hive Power Up Day](/@hivebuzz-fr/pud-202606) mais aussi le début d'un **nouveau mois de Hive Power Up !**

### Comment obtenir le badge Power Up Month ?

Ce nouveau défi PUM débutera le premier jour du mois et durera tout le mois. Voici les règles :

Pour **chaque jour du mois**, vous avez 2 options :

**Option 1:**

1. Vous **postez une publication** et **choisisser le mode de paiement 100 % HIVE**.
2. Votre message doit générer un paiement pour être éligible (c'est-à-dire obtenir quelques upvotes)
3. Vous ne pouvez pas définir quelqu'un d'autre comme bénéficiaire de votre publication. Il s'agit de faire un power up de **votre propre compte**.
4. Vous ne pouvez pas vous upvoter vous-même

L'utilisation de cette option est également un bon moyen d'obtenir également le badge d'auteur mensuel. ;)

**Option 2:**
1. **faite un Power Up d'au moins 1 HIVE**.
2. Vous ne pouvez pas faire de Power Down pendant le mois.

Cette option est utile si un jour vous n'avez pas d'inspiration pour écrire ou si vous n'êtes tout simplement pas un blogueur.

> Vous pouvez utiliser l'une ou l'autre option, ou les deux, et passer de l'une à l'autre au fil des jours.

### Suivez vos progrès

Rendez-vous sur votre [tableau HiveBuzz](https://hivebuzz.me) et cliquez sur le badge du Power Up Month en cours. Vous verrez apparaître un calendrier en plus de la description avec toutes les actions que vous avez entreprises et qui ont influencé votre participation au Power Up Month.

<center> ![](https://i.imgur.com/2yuZgth.png)
<sub>_Exemple tiré d'un participant d'une édition précédente._</sub>
</center>

Pour le jour en cours (cerclé de bleu) et tous les jours précédents, les symboles suivants peuvent apparaître :

|Symboles|Description|
|-|-|
|![](https://i.imgur.com/gFO2aue.png)|Vous avez publié un article avec le mode 100% Hive Power|
|![](https://i.imgur.com/NFhC8R0.png)|Vous avez fait un Power Up d'au moins 1 HP|
|![](https://i.imgur.com/2Kg9gma.png)|Un Power Down est survenu. Cela vous disqualifie pour ce PUM|

Cela vous permettra de suivre avec précision leurs progrès tout au long du mois.

**<div class=\

>IMPORTANT :** HiveBuzz utilise les **date et heure UTC** pour valider les publications et de Power Up. Par conséquent, vérifiez votre fuseau horaire et **convertissez votre heure locale en UTC** avant de le faire !
![](https://i.imgur.com/OOhjUQh.png)
Suivez strictement les règles ci-dessus et ce badge sera à vous ! Les badges seront distribués après la fin du Power Up Month. #
Amusez-vous et n'oubliez pas vos Power Up!
---
_HiveBuzz est un projet créé par @arcange_

body.title: ¡Prepárate para el Power Up Month de junio!
body.body:
![](https://i.imgur.com/M9RD8KS.png)

Como sabrán, Power Up Month ahora se lleva a cabo todos los meses y la próxima edición comenzará mañana.

<sub>![](https://arcange.eu/images/flags/en_16.png) This post is translated in English - **[here](/hivebuzz/@hivebuzz/pum-202606)**</sub>
<sub>![](https://arcange.eu/images/flags/fr_16.png) Une version en français de ce post est disponible - **[ici](/hivebuzz/@hivebuzz-fr/pum-202606)**</sub>

No pierdas la oportunidad de obtener tu insignia de PUM. Pero no lo des por sentado ya que muchos de los participantes de las ediciones anteriores han reconocido lo difícil que es este desafío.

El objetivo del Power Up Month es recompensar a aquellos que hacen power-ups regulares en lugar de un solo power-up como hacen muchos usuarios para el [Power Up Day](/@hivebuzz/pud-202606).

## ¡Vamos por un mes más!

**El 1 de junio** no es solo el [Hive Power Up Day](/@hivebuzz/pud-202606) sino también el comienzo de un **nuevo Hive Power Up Month!**

### ¿Cómo obtener la insignia Power Up Month?

Este nuevo desafío PUM comenzará el primer día del mes y durará todo el mes. Estas son las reglas:

Para **cada día del mes**, tiene 2 opciones:

**Opción 1:**
1. **realiza una publicación** y **establece el modo de recompensas** en **\

**.
2. Tu publicación debe generar un pago para ser elegible.
3. No puede establecer a otra persona como el beneficiario de su publicación. Se trata de potenciar **tu cuenta**.
4. No puede votarse a sí mismo

Usar esta opción una buena oportunidad para obtener las insignias de autor diarias semanal y mensual también ;)

**Opcion 2:**
Si no planeas publicar o no tienes idea de qué escribir algún día o simplemente no eres un bloguero, alternativamente puedes:
1. **Hacer power up a al menos 1 HIVE**.
2. No se puede hacer power down durante el mes

> Puede cambiar entre opciones de un día a otro. El objetivo principal es power-up algo de HIVE todos los días del mes.

### Sigue tu progreso

Vaya a su [tablero HiveBuzz](https://hivebuzz.me) y haga clic en la insignia del actual Power Up Month. Verá aparecer un calendario además de la descripción con todas las acciones que ha realizado que influyeron en su participación en el Power Up Month.

<center>![](https://i.imgur.com/2yuZgth.png)
<sub>_Ejemplo tomado de una edición anterior._</sub>
</center>

Para el día actual (encerrado en un círculo azul) y todos los días anteriores, pueden aparecer los siguientes símbolos:

|Símbolo|Descripción|
|-|-|
|![](https://i.imgur.com/gFO2aue.png)|Publicaste una publicación con el modo 100% Hive Power|
|![](https://i.imgur.com/NFhC8R0.png)|Hiciste un Power Up de al menos 1 HP|
|![](https://i.imgur.com/2Kg9gma.png)|Se produjo un Power Down. Esto lo descalifica para este PUM|

Esto le permitirá realizar un seguimiento preciso de su progreso a lo largo del mes.

**<div class=\

>IMPORTANTE:** HiveBuzz usara **Fecha y hora UTC** para validar publicaciones y fechas de Power Ups. Por lo tanto, verifique su zona horaria y **converte tu hora local a UTC** antes de hacerlo.
![](https://i.imgur.com/OOhjUQh.png)
¡Siga estrictamente las reglas anteriores y esta insignia será suya! Las insignias se distribuirán después de que finalice el Power Up Month. #
Diviertete y Haz Power Up!

body.title: The Camden Market Free Art Man 30th May 2026
body.body: The heatwave is easing up now, so [The Camden Market Free Art Man](https://thecamdenmarketfreeartman.com/) is back on display. https://youtu.be/bAJ\_hXsdn0M My new timetable for this year is Saturday and Sundays till November, unless the weather's bad or I'm sick. Any weekdays will be a bonus, but given how far behind schedule I am, with [music](https://edgeworth.blog/music/) in particular, I think it's unlikely I'll be doing any more Camden displays during the week before 2027. I've started writing new songs again, and still haven't put [Elbow Sisters](https://edgeworth.blog/music/elbow-sisters/) on [my Bandcamp](https://edgeworthlebelge.bandcamp.com/) yet. I don't think [2 out of 3 Rule](https://edgeworth.blog/music/2-out-of-3-rule/) can go on my Bandcamp because I think I have them signed up to CD Baby for collecting royalties.

/> Today was the second day of taking my [crypto-social LP's](https://edgeworth.blog/2026/05/10/crypto-social-lps/). So far only one's been taken. An Ecency one because the lady liked the colour blue. I'll take them again tomorrow and keep working towards a day at Camden dedicated to this series. It may be a long way off, as I'm still heavily dependent on the [Blond Cards](https://blondcards.com/) for getting me a decent number of interviews. Another new thing is Camden Shorts. After editing each day's full video, I'm cutting it up into a series of YouTube shorts. Lots of my best interveiws are buried deep in 30+ minute videos that I imagine hardly anyone watches. Hopefully doing shorts will bring them out more.

/> \nOne guy today was especially helpful in distributing my free art to the Arsenal football fans hanging around Camden Lock. I don't think he managed to get rid of any but took some with him when he left to meet his friend. He's local so am sure he'll be back. \n
/> \nI'll be transferring these designs to Blond Cards soon. New characters for Blurt, Steemit and Ecency: \n
/>Back to Camden tomorrow. It's good to see the locals getting more involved with [Free Art Frees Art](https://freeartfreesart.com/): \n

body.title: Rey esqueleto y cartas extras - Squad Busters [ESP-ENG]
body.body:
> ![esll.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmewhYFFtdFjUn5JYnzZ4rK6XCpCmYWSvWn17q3qDoYYEA/esll.jpg) Saludos amigos, esta semana cada una de las batallas que realice en las distintas modalidades me dieron muy buenas recompensas para seguir creciendo mi cuenta, ya que a medida que uno avanza las cosas se van complicando, comenzando desde la dificultad de las batallas, puesto que nos encontramos con rivales más fuertes y se tiene que estar preparado, porque si no se podrá avanzar. Por eso para estar más fuerte, aproveche una gran oferta que salió en la tienda que consistía en 60 cartas del personaje matón, siendo algo muy valioso por tan solo 8500 monedas, algo que no podía pasar en esta etapa del juego. >Hello, friends! This week, every battle I fought across the different modes yielded great rewards that helped me grow my account. As you progress, things get more challenging—starting with the difficulty of the battles themselves—since you face stronger opponents and have to be prepared; otherwise, you won’t be able to move forward. That’s why, to get stronger, I took advantage of a great deal that came up in the store—a pack of 60 cards featuring the Bully character—which was a real steal at just 8,500 coins, something I couldn’t pass up at this stage of the game. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdBLLNRB4ZisnYG5CvKdVYXXkqYf9uwdtRUtRJhJgZjgo/image.png) ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVbW3Pcb93LHBfT3EFK9RiETZuYX9Gq666TTHbC1JusGr/image.png) Esa fue la mejor compra que he podido hacer en estos últimos gameplay, ya que esas cartas me sirvieron para así poder mejorar al personaje Matón y llevarlo al nivel dos de estrella, siendo un personaje ahora mucho más fuerte, resisten y su personalidad cambió de inmediato, ya qué pasó de estar en nivel uno a nivel dos de estrella. Este es un personaje fundamental en mi equipo, ya que siempre lo uso por cada una de las habilidades que tiene y a la vez me sirve para que cause daño con esa gran arma que tiene desde lejos a los enemigos que se están acercando. Además, todos los personajes que puede llevar hasta el nivel dos de estrella será una gran inversión para este gran juego. >That was the best purchase I’ve made in my recent gameplay sessions, since those cards helped me upgrade the Thug character to two-star level. He’s now much stronger and more resilient, and his personality changed immediately after going from one-star to two-star level. This is a key character on my team, since I always use him for each of his abilities, and he also helps me deal damage from a distance with that powerful weapon he has to enemies who are closing in. Plus, any character you can bring up to two-star level will be a great investment in this fantastic game. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPdunLAR72M8aVpa76CQKUVCqWWjHFqBP9NgsXKiqhFVN/image.png) ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVR25jf1bhWnjU8R68iyHdkAJ5DeQMfYKVkbPwCsCowUN/image.png) En esta oportunidad volví a jugar una de las primeras modalidades de juego que colocaron y es atrapagemas, ya que es Perfecto para conseguir recompensas y a la vez para poder probar las mejores que le hicimos al equipo, donde esta vez el mapa fue como en una playa y por eso había bastante arena y una amplia variedad de cofres para abrir y así tener un equipo fuerte. La partida se fue desarrollando de la mejor manera con una buena estrategia para así poder avanzar y llegar hasta el final, donde la idea era poder matar a los demás enemigos que estaban por allí cerca del juego. Los resultados no fueron los mejores y me llevé el segundo lugar de esa partida, además de eso varías gemas que seguro las estaré usando para comprar al igual que las monedas en la tienda. >This time, I played one of the first game modes they released, which is Gem Grab, since it’s perfect for earning rewards and also for testing out the best gear we’d built for our team. This time, the map was set on a beach, so there was plenty of sand and a wide variety of chests to open, allowing us to build a strong team. The match went really well thanks to a solid strategy that let us advance and make it to the end, where the goal was to take out the other enemies hanging around nearby. The results weren’t the best, and I ended up in second place in that match, but I did get some gems that I’ll definitely use to make purchases, along with the coins in the store. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcXNXgY5FPd7DDDNTMzerhBqRRR6w3qMuzhGELdnARiQK/image.png) ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXoBQctvvv3VW1fcd9TZu1tWeWbUvJK51QEtC352843m3/image.png) ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ2vLZeWFN4gnFPC2VF2ACkYmiyE75APRhLdaaTnKM3Tz/image.png) Con todo lo que se logró avanzar, también nos dieron algunas recompensas de fichas moradas por haber completado varías tareas en el libro del logro de este jugo, donde la última vez se actualizó y por eso tenía que esperar a que salieran las nuevas taras. Muchos de esos logros dan buenas recompensas, ya que hay que eliminar a personajes fuertes y por cantidad para que así nos pueden dar ese logro, lo bueno es que uno puede ir progresando y eso no se perderá hasta que se termine dicho logro. Uno de lo más importante era poder derrotar a un jefe esqueleto y por suerte en la partida que hicimos salió uno y fue bastante difícil, pero se logró y ahora hay que esperar a que se actualicen los logros una vez más. >With all the progress we made, we also received some purple token rewards for completing various tasks in the game’s achievement book. The last time it was updated, I had to wait for the new tasks to appear. Many of those achievements offer good rewards, since you have to defeat a certain number of strong characters to unlock them. The good thing is that you can keep making progress, and that won’t be lost until you complete the achievement. One of the most important ones was defeating a skeleton boss, and luckily one appeared in the game we played—it was pretty tough, but we managed it, and now we have to wait for the achievements to update once again. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaGU3HtEu1gK7NwyWjoPcPUEfge2XBsdKsuwf1UXxhSEw/image.png) ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZy5edsd8GApHzdp3V6tr9DT94cKQ3anxFhAd794G3R64/image.png) Las cosas van marchando de la mejor manera en este juego y con cada gameplay que les he compartido en la comunidad se han dado cuenta de ese crecimiento que hemos tenido desde el día uno hasta ese gran momento del juego. Por ahora solo queda seguir batallando para así poder conseguir más recursos y con esto poder seguir invirtiendo en personajes que seguramente serán de gran ayuda en esta etapa del juego, además si alguno de ustedes juega y quiere realizar una partida me los deja en los comentarios y con gusto vamos a jugar. >Things are going great in this game, and with every gameplay clip I’ve shared with the community, you’ve been able to see the progress we’ve made from day one up to this major milestone in the game. For now, all that’s left is to keep battling so we can get more resources and use them to keep investing in characters that will surely be a big help at this stage of the game. Also, if any of you play and want to set up a match, let me know in the comments, and we’d love to play together.
![pngwing.com 3.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPvWeswjaMnCtt69QxnpZHm1una1iw2HUxZJpGBgEY2RH/pngwing.com%203.png)

body.title: Happy Day at Port Said, Egypt
body.body:
![30530.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSFUNUmUJeG6xpxB669ZPPVPPAjHniGyYZsxTEQpavFL7/30530.jpg)

Port Said is a chill city, calm, opposite to crowded, and just perfect for someone who wanted to live a slower pace of life.

![30526.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVcSifwyyiifP83DFmTiY5raty5hdc3pXWBDZLcPcQRyv/30526.jpg)

![30533.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQTKzpjuVJVJCsGAngD8sdqPFNb5FoGkvkdA9rWUezYAH/30533.jpg)

I haven't done many activities, just the gym, done a terrible amount of walking, swimming in the beach. 

![30534.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSRP4RAQq55MjnLi5QBU36zgRuYrbVFazMqLnp3b8oz9c/30534.jpg)

![30532.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZQJnhtSc36vU1qQ6NkjmScoRGFMeDoRfJVvMnGfdxHbh/30532.jpg)

One noticeable thing to me was; no one is in a hurry, the streets are always not completely empty but never crowded, also it's totally walkable, 90% of your common destinations will never use a vehicle for.


![30541.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSquhBAgUfjDuhadGkeXrYutyhrrgta9bumB9HJhSCZyG/30541.jpg)

Port Said has witnessed both the English and the French invasions, and they have still kept those beautiful, ancient-looking buildings and mosques. 

![30536.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQFksk2XZUzh5at89jQ6k8xyMkt5MMPkjg8Hd7Fzz92pE/30536.jpg)

![30544.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR4JdUBSKNanGtUWXVZNrsQAEUEeUS5ifw1tR3YFTgeLb/30544.jpg)

There were plants, greenery, trees and flowers everywhere I went, which is something I loved about that city.


![30543.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQfRfhbKC8Qd1Q883BA2sQJzt178fVQ4K9YyCYg3iyrW8/30543.jpg)


![30547.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUk5F6qKH2ySst6y2B3eLFmZTvoQXLrNa6kWBrdsaRwu2/30547.jpg)

![30550.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS5mpcbcjRAoPaTkMZ9bUdfuHUdi69atYZZyMa4E8sALX/30550.jpg)

![30553.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTkjvA1jDoRxXf7vopr1jgywpxk28rR2eUhTi6GDEZ6Qt/30553.jpg)

![30555.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRsqx3wbrhVssprgcvdaBePsjVibKR7gbtaKLfV7BVCpv/30555.jpg)

![30554.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTkU3KxoYrsDEam6rLZe11dEwEQe6dYZceZq4a7hTZgQU/30554.jpg)

![30558.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ5z4m1AF4Mw3wS8seUAJC3LaZBTCyThxFNpDGub2EnbG/30558.jpg)

![30557.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaeEsnacJCRPQbAStsSfFGoj6pjuGGCey3RweXGZrw5LA/30557.jpg)


Out of all the cities I've visited in Egypt so far, I'd give it 7/10, it's somewhere I definitely want to revisit.

body.title: Phillies lose opening game vs Dodgers | Jesús Luzardo on the mound tonight
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTjS3bHNysmezkQ8R2ZwXXr6wYNfgFUVFTdMajPrkruvS/1779487737644.png)
[Src](https://loodibee.com/mlb/philadelphia-phillies/)

Well yesterday didn't go the Phillies' way but it wasn't totally discouraging overall. It just felt as though it wasn't their night, against an elite team as well.

Zack Wheeler had a pretty strange outing on the mound. He gave up five hits in six innings but the thing is... four of those hits were solo homers. He still got through six innings but yeah, that was obviously unfortunate. As one of the best starting pitchers in the game, Wheeler doesn't give up many runs in general. But him giving up that many *homers* is even more strange for him. In a way, it goes to show how solid he is that all of them were solo shots. He didn't allow extra baserunners to really take him and the Phils out of the game! He still gave the Phillies a chance. 

The Phillies lack of offense recently did come back to bite them in yesterday's 4-2 loss. As I mentioned in yesterday's post, the pitching staff has really been carrying this team. I said it was ok yesterday, and I still feel that way for now. It was just one loss but, it would be nice to see the Phillies score some runs! 

Kyle Schwarber hit his 22nd homer which is cool, he still leads the MLB! Newcomer to the roster, Steward Berroa, made a nice impact in his first game with the team, he recorded an RBI single. His appearance kinda came outta nowhere, he's apparently a strong defensive outfielder and a switch hitter with incredible speed and base stealing upside. He looks to be an overall upgrade over Otto Kemp. 

Lots of sports tonight! It would be cool to see the A's and Phillies win over their major market opponents! I'm a Sixers fan of course, but I'd also prefer to see the Spurs win tonight over OKC in their epic Game 7 of the Western Conference Finals Series!

But of course as always...

# #GOPHILLIES!!!

Today I’m going to share with you the Foundation team’s participation in the Municipal Apertura Cup Football Tournament, which is currently taking place in the municipality of Zamora, Aragua state.
![GridArt_20260530_195545836.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23ydGYLgP1j2XjLftLjSPDvPgseZsUFWGSwnvFguPHcfJXMDctPoF3V4QRbmzQUpMvQuE.jpg) Cabe destacar que esta jornada de juegos se realizaron en el campo de fútbol de la parroquia San Francisco de Asis, en donde participaron las categorías Sub 10, 12 y Sub 14 de Fundación contra la delegación de San Francisco. El primer partido estuvo planificado a las 11:09 am, en la cual se desplegaron en el campo, atacando constantemente por parte de Fundación al equipo rival, en los primeros minutos, jugaron con gran intensidad para iniciar el marcador con el primer gol. >It is worth noting that this day of matches took place at the football ground of the San Francisco de Asís parish, where the Foundation’s Under-10, Under-12 and Under-14 teams played against the San Francisco side. The first match was scheduled for 11.09 am, with Fundación taking to the pitch and constantly attacking the opposition in the opening minutes; they played with great intensity to open the scoring with the first goal. ![IMG_20260530_125002.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23xp8J5j9JtGnkAMAgmnpVk8tUm8uRBWCBP4W1zqfCAPYfbbTZk8R59tsgxukUVQzV7su.jpg) ![IMG_20260530_125241.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/2432SHHtSVBh2kCPFTvtUhTTHHvexQTQ3xxtj6hjYHEVgAb7Qd9kfcVquAPktP1GZojyB.jpg) Después, el equipo de San Francisco, logra empatar, quedando primer tiempo 1 X 1. En el segundo tiempo Fundación continúo jugando mediante pases y manteniendo una buena defensa, para seguir jugando con intensidad y logran concretar un segundo gol. Asimismo Fundación descuida la defensa y el equipo de San Francisco, logra empatar 2 X 2, el partido se mantuvo igual, hasta hubo una falta que cobrado por Fundación por concretar su tercer gol, faltando pocos para finalizar el partido San Francisco marco un gol, y quedan empatados 3 X 3. >San Francisco then managed to equalise, leaving the score at 1–1 at half-time. In the second half, Fundación continued to play through passing and maintained a solid defence, playing with intensity and managing to score a second goal. However, Fundación then neglected their defence and the San Francisco team managed to equalise at 2–2. The match remained level until a free-kick awarded to Fundación led to their third goal. With just a few minutes remaining, San Francisco scored a goal, leaving the match tied at 3–3. ![IMG_20260530_125821.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23zku5UGSxPzSjechVpHPAivWYVV75PczzQ36Bz2PFvbJ68KLDexoz94Z6Uy2Z1qeBSDN.jpg) ![IMG_20260530_130920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23xL16w8f8WSQk4TNtRhTraYU5NcaGnnBhMbD1JtjErpbPxxfgDdTXi9FRruCSkWJTQLg.jpg) Luego se presentaron la categoría Sub 12 de Fundación con solo seis jugadores, por lo cual los técnicos tuvieron que subir a tres jugadores de la Sub 10 para completar la planilla de jugadores para no perder por Forfeit.Este partidos se observó un mayor dominio por parte de San Francisco, mientras Fundación se mostró muy débil frente a la defensa, que no lograron revisar, perdiendo el primer tiempo 2 X 0. En el segundo tiempo los jugadores de la Sub 10, ya estaban agotados, a pesar de que hicieron un esfuerzo, pierde el partido 4 X 0. >Next up were Fundación’s Under-12s, who had only six players, so the coaches had to call up three players from the Under-10s to make up the squad and avoid losing by forfeit. In this match, San Francisco dominated proceedings, whilst Fundación looked very weak in defence, which they were unable to shore up, losing the first half 2–0. In the second half, the Under-10 players were already exhausted; despite their best efforts, they lost the match 4–0. ![IMG_20260530_135102.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23yTqwAfnaSDRMi3aZphapg1R329e1JPPMTNYxxNkYajZeVxbBZ6FLWLRs1Q3wNdzy3g4.jpg) ![IMG_20260530_135104.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23tSmNMqxGbgdS5tz4NrDJJkir88DFe8xAF6m8ZiV9AQ5qQfZ46C1fotF6VEyU1CUMz16.jpg) Igualmente, pasaron a jugar el tercer partido con solo siete jugadores, subiendo también a tres jugadores de la Sub 12, en el primer tiempo Fundación trató de avanzar hacia la portería del equipo rival , marcando su primer gol en el primer minuto, pero el equipo rival se desquita al desplazar a la débil defensa y empatar 1 X 1. Luego el equipo de San Francisco, aprovecho un espacio vacío para hacer un segundo gol, quedando el primer tiempo 2 X 1 a favor de San Francisco. >Similarly, they went into the third match with just seven players, bringing on three players from the Under-12s as well. In the first half, Fundación tried to push forward towards the opposition’s goal, scoring their first goal in the opening minute, but the opposition fought back by breaking through the weak defence to level the score at 1–1. San Francisco then took advantage of an open space to score a second goal, leaving the first half at 2–1 in San Francisco’s favour. ![IMG_20260530_135059.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/244UvEvF7rjFvmuX8mARDAn75SEmKszzLDNdMrfBqqhnSMKMF56uqKX9G1r5Nr68Ciyi3.jpg) ![IMG_20260530_144309.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/241thrke15NsNAhAj8ny3Y2xhVxNxqQHo9CJvhzsUyaV2jmh3BSraScwTtm5xpxCRPTsj.jpg) Seguidamente en el segundo tiempo, los técnicos no podían hacer ningún tipo de cambio porque faltaron más de la mitad de los jugadores titulares, lo cual afectó los resultados del día de hoy, y pierde Fundación con un marcador de 4 X 1. Para finalizar de tres partidos solo empataron uno y dos perdidos, por la falta de los jugadores. En estos partidos es importante la responsabilidad por parte de los representantes en cumplir con la jornada de juegos. >In the second half, the coaches were unable to make any substitutions because more than half of the starting players were missing, which affected today’s result, and Fundación lost 4–1. In the end, out of three matches, they drew just one and lost two, due to the absence of players. In these matches, it is important for the team representatives to take responsibility for ensuring the fixtures go ahead. ![GridArt_20260530_194736897.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23s9kNppuyC5LkrbyZqhnGrsSm8h8yGPoeMWDYqPGxYXypQnE8qMcoY92qtQygYgidnvC.jpg) Espero que les haya gustado, nos vemos en una próxima publicación. >I hope you liked it, see you in a next post. title.body:
*** *** #
If you prefer the English version, click on the following link 👉 [**HERE**](#english)
*** ***

# ***
Enigma
***

>

La cámara de @lanzjoseg se detiene ante una anomalía en el suelo. Sobre la superficie gris, rugosa y eterna del cemento, descansa un fragmento de cartón prensado. Es de un color púrpura profundo, casi místico, como un retazo de cielo nocturno atrapado en la materia. Sus bordes curvos sugieren un encaje perfecto en otro lugar. Pero aquí, bajo la luz cruda del día, la pieza parece un náufrago. Está sola, desgastada por el tiempo o quizás por el olvido.

Al ver esa imagen, es inevitable no reflexionar sobre nuestra propia existencia. El mundo no es una línea recta; es un rompecabezas de mil piezas —o quizás de millones— donde nosotros somos apenas un pequeño trozo intentando encontrar un lugar donde encajar.

<center>
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/23viCqxXjahnuCzumYLFHdfuj7rVqQRgZV3nzRbqPBZ3mMac6ViFnh8XcV7oY5f2BtF7m.png)
<sup>[Imagen de la iniciativa, cortesía de @lanzjoseg.](https://images.hive.blog/DQmboW6nrXFj16LFmxEausdxMDz67pFEsqtdCzKYagGmR5T/imagen.png)</sup>
</center>

A menudo nos \

, en la angustia de buscar soluciones a problemas que parecen no tener salida. Nos obsesionamos con el cuadro completo, con la imagen perfecta que nos vendieron en la caja, pero la realidad siempre nos guarda una sorpresa… siempre falta algo. Siempre hay una pieza que no encaja, que falta o que sobra, un vacío que no sabemos cómo llenar, o una respuesta que se nos escapa entre los dedos. Esa pieza púrpura es el símbolo de nuestra búsqueda eterna; la vida es en su esencia… un juego de paciencia y azar.

Imagino el momento preciso en que nació esta fotografía, creo que no fue un acto planificado, más bien fue un momento de encuentro. Quizás la familia de @lanzjoseg decidió, en un arranque de orden dominical, hacer una limpieza profunda. Movieron los muebles pesados, esos que parecen haber echado raíces en la sala, y allí, entre las pelusas del tiempo y el olvido, apareció ella.

\

, pudo haber exclamado alguien -alguna de sus hijas-. Era el fragmento perdido del gran puzzle de 500 piezas que armaron hace meses y que guardaron con un agujero en el centro, como una herida en el paisaje. Al encontrarla, el círculo se cierra, pero la lección permanece.\n\n@lanzjoseg, con el ojo agudo del cronista, decidió no recogerla de inmediato. Prefirió retratarla allí, en su estado de \

. Capturó la belleza de lo incompleto volviendo a ser completo al existir el resto del rompecabezas. Su imagen me reafirma que, aunque el mundo parezca un caos de piezas sueltas y soluciones que no llegan, a veces solo hace falta un poco de limpieza profunda en el alma para que esa pieza que tanto buscamos aparezca, justo donde menos lo esperábamos.
*** ***

> #### Bienvenidos todos a esta, mi participación de la semana en el TopFiveFamily. Si es de tu agrado participar, aún estás a tiempo. Este es el enlace [**Observa⇾Piensa⇉Escribe**](https://peakd.com/hive-192096/@lanzjoseg/concurso-observa-piensa-escribe-5eecaea7dc14a). **Recuerda cumplir las reglas…**
https://images.hive.blog/DQmWmTLiCab2iz5MnnMK8KDF4SzsYxUSf8YCi4TWJ5fcyJC/imagen.png Portada de la iniciativa.
*** ***
🔆****🔆****🔆****🔆****🔆****🔆****🔆****🔆****🔆

###
Dedicado a todos aquellos escribas que contribuyen, día a día, a hacer de nuestro planeta, un mundo mejor
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcnceTgTBLgAUkErZfdoePC7twytC1CTcqQYDKkU4Lrrd/1024espa_ol8.gif) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbdpsZFqtrcoLk94sUV8oHkjnx8PAdgfACMfJ9UpcriNF/perfil2026_hecho_con_clipchamp_2_.gif)

*** *** ***

> @lanzjoseg’s camera lingers on an anomaly on the ground. Upon the grey, rough, timeless surface of the concrete lies a fragment of pressed cardboard. It is a deep, almost mystical purple, like a scrap of the night sky trapped within the material. Its curved edges suggest it was once a perfect fit somewhere else. But here, under the harsh light of day, the piece looks like a castaway. It stands alone, worn down by time or perhaps by neglect. Seeing that image, it is impossible not to reflect on our own existence. The world is not a straight line; it is a jigsaw puzzle of a thousand pieces — or perhaps millions — where we are just a tiny fragment trying to find a place to fit in.
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/23viCqxXjahnuCzumYLFHdfuj7rVqQRgZV3nzRbqPBZ3mMac6ViFnh8XcV7oY5f2BtF7m.png) [Image of the initiative, courtesy of @lanzjoseg.](https://images.hive.blog/DQmboW6nrXFj16LFmxEausdxMDz67pFEsqtdCzKYagGmR5T/imagen.png)
We often ‘lose ourselves’ in the anguish of seeking solutions to problems that seem to have no way out. We become obsessed with the complete picture, with the perfect image sold to us on the box, but reality always has a surprise in store for us… there is always something missing. There is always a piece that doesn’t fit, that is missing or surplus to requirements, a void we don’t know how to fill, or an answer that slips through our fingers. That purple piece is the symbol of our eternal quest; life is, in its essence… a game of patience and chance. I can picture the exact moment this photograph came into being; I don’t think it was a planned event, but rather a chance encounter. Perhaps @lanzjoseg’s family decided, in a sudden burst of Sunday tidiness, to have a thorough clear-out. They moved the heavy furniture—the sort that seems to have taken root in the living room—and there, amongst the dust and cobwebs of time and neglect, it appeared. “It’s the missing piece!” someone—perhaps one of his daughters—might have exclaimed. It was the missing fragment of the giant 500-piece jigsaw puzzle they’d put together months ago and kept with a hole in the centre, like a wound in the landscape. Upon finding it, the circle closes, but the lesson remains. @lanzjoseg, with the keen eye of a chronicler, decided not to pick it up straight away. He preferred to capture it there, in its ‘newly discovered’ state. He captured the beauty of the incomplete becoming whole again because the rest of the jigsaw existed. His image reaffirms to me that, although the world may seem like a chaos of loose pieces and solutions that never come, sometimes all it takes is a bit of deep cleansing of the soul for that piece we’ve been searching for so hard to appear, right where we least expected it.

title.title: Crypto Loses the Plot: Bitcoin Stalls at $73K as Markets Diverge and ETF Outflows Mount
title.body:
# Crypto Loses the Plot: Bitcoin Stalls at $73K as Markets Diverge and ETF Outflows Mount

The crypto market is sending a message that Wall Street's investors are struggling to ignore: despite the S&P 500 posting its longest weekly winning streak since 2023, digital assets continue to drift lower. Bitcoin has stabilized near $73,400 after a brutal three-day slide that erased over 10% from its May peak, but the technical picture suggests this correction may have further to run.

## The Great Divergence

The macro backdrop could not be more contradictory. The S&P 500 has now posted nine consecutive weekly gains — the longest such run since 2023 and a streak matched only a handful of times in four decades. Brent crude settled near $92 per barrel on hopes that the U.S. and Iran will sign a 60-day ceasefire extension, potentially reopening the critical Strait of Hormuz shipping route. Treasury yields climbed on the week as risk appetite returned to traditional markets.

Yet crypto refused to participate in the rally. Bitcoin fell 2.6% over the past seven days, ether dropped 2.5% to $2,011, Solana slipped 2.2% to $82.42, and TRON suffered its worst weekly loss among the top ten at 5.6%. Dogecoin finished roughly flat, while Hyperliquid's HYPE token was the sole bright spot, ripping 19.4% to $65 on growing institutional interest.

This divergence tells a story of capital rotation that goes beyond simple risk-off sentiment. The crypto market is grappling with structural headwinds that traditional markets simply do not face.

## ETF Outflows: The Real Story

The most significant development this week was the massive wave of redemptions from U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs. More than $733 million exited the products on May 27 alone, with BlackRock's IBIT reportedly accounting for over $500 million of the total. From May 20 to May 29, Bitcoin and ether spot ETFs combined lost roughly $2 billion in net inflows — one of the most aggressive withdrawal periods of the year.

These redemptions are not merely a sentiment indicator; they create direct selling pressure. When ETF issuers face redemption requests, they must sell underlying Bitcoin holdings on the open market, adding supply precisely when demand is weakest. This mechanical selling creates a feedback loop that amplifies downward price pressure.

XRP ETFs bucked the trend, drawing $35 million in net inflows during the same period and pushing total XRP ETF assets to approximately $1.12 billion. But this is a drop in the bucket compared to the outflows from BTC and ETH products, which together dwarf XRP's market presence.

## Technical Breakdown: What the Charts Say

Bitcoin's daily chart tells a bearish tale. The asset has fallen below its 50-day simple moving average and remains firmly beneath the daily Supertrend resistance near $79,000. A rounded-top formation has emerged on the daily timeframe — price created a series of lower highs following rejection from the $81,000 region earlier this month. This structure resembles a distribution phase rather than healthy consolidation.

Momentum indicators reinforce the bearish case. The daily MACD completed a bearish crossover, with the signal line remaining above the MACD line while histogram bars continue expanding in negative territory. The Aroon Up has collapsed to 7.14%, while the Aroon Down sits near 78.57% — a configuration that typically accompanies extended corrective phases rather than imminent reversals.

On the weekly chart, Bitcoin has slipped back below a key horizontal support area near $73,000 that previously acted as a breakout level. A weekly close beneath this zone would significantly increase the probability of a move toward the February lows in the mid-$60,000 range.

Ethereum faces its own challenges, trading near $2,006 with a weakening RSI and Binance open interest rising by 336K ETH. Taker selling has hit -$744 million, and analysts warn of a potential breakdown below the $2,000 psychological level.

## The Strategy Question

Adding to market anxiety, on-chain observers noticed that Michael Saylor's Strategy transferred more than $30 million worth of Bitcoin to Coinbase. While the company has not announced any intention to sell, the transaction sparked widespread speculation about whether the largest corporate Bitcoin holder could be preparing to reduce exposure. This reignited debate over Strategy's long-standing commitment to accumulating and holding Bitcoin indefinitely — a cornerstone narrative that has supported BTC prices throughout the bull cycle.

## Macro Headwinds Intensify

The macroeconomic environment has become increasingly hostile to speculative assets. Recent U.S. CPI and PPI reports came in above expectations, reinforcing concerns that inflation remains well above the Federal Reserve's 2% target. Futures markets have sharply reduced expectations for rate cuts this year, Treasury yields remain elevated, and the U.S. dollar has strengthened against major currencies.

JPMorgan analysts noted that both Bitcoin and gold have recently lost momentum as preferred macro hedges. According to the bank, easing Middle East tensions and moderating inflation concerns have triggered capital outflows from what it described as \

ETF products linked to both assets have experienced notable withdrawals over the past two weeks, while institutional participation in CME futures has weakened.

## The One Bright Spot: Hyperliquid and DeFi Infrastructure

Amid the broader weakness, one story stands out. Hyperliquid's HYPE token surged 19.4% on the week, and Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) chief Jeffrey Sprecher called the decentralized perpetuals venue \

at a Bernstein conference. Grayscale has also highlighted Hyperliquid as emerging blockchain-based financial infrastructure with the potential to challenge traditional derivatives markets.

This suggests that while broad crypto demand is cooling, institutional interest in specific DeFi infrastructure plays remains strong. The market may be undergoing a selective rotation rather than a blanket exit from digital assets.

## Looking Ahead

The crypto market sits at an inflection point. Bitcoin's stabilization near $73,000 offers a fragile floor, but the combination of ETF outflows, bearish technicals, and macro uncertainty suggests further downside risk remains. The key support at $72,500 must hold — a weekly close below it would open the door to mid-$60,000 territory.

The U.S.-Iran situation remains the wildcard. President Trump stated he is ready to make a \

on a preliminary ceasefire agreement, but his red lines — requiring Iran to abandon its nuclear program and surrender enriched uranium — sit well beyond what Tehran has indicated it would accept publicly. A deal remains uncertain, and the macro rally is one bad headline from reversing.

For now, crypto investors are watching closely as traditional markets celebrate while digital assets struggle to find direction. The question is whether this divergence represents a temporary disconnect or the beginning of a deeper recalibration in how capital views risk assets in an uncertain macro environment.

![LhBZ0dVO3CIrcOuS_bxw8.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/alpha-omega/images/LhBZ0dVO3CIrcOuS_bxw8/LhBZ0dVO3CIrcOuS_bxw8.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

这周大部分时间要么下雨要么阴天，气温一度比较低，我把外套都翻出来穿上。今天是周六终于迎来久违的大太阳，早上我去学校参加合唱团还穿着外套。好家伙合唱团居然让早上8点15到学校门口，比我上班时间都早多了。去学校路上我买了一碗胡辣汤，一根油条，两个包子。我带到学校合唱团的演播大厅，趁着还没有开始，摆在桌子上开吃，吃完感觉好满足啊。等到8点半人来的差不多了，合唱团正式开始。

先把上周的曲目复习一遍，接下来教新曲子，曲子分成高音部与低音部，我属于高音部。所谓高音部就是曲子正常旋律，低音部并不唱整首曲，而是在特定地方参与进来唱和声。刚开始我们分开训练，曲子是“人世间”，我之前没有听过，听大家唱了几遍后，我慢慢小声跟着哼了几遍就差不多熟悉了。唱的差不多了，我们就和低音部一起排练。唱一遍嗓子都喊干了，好在我带了一瓶水。到了10点钟，让我们休息了一会，我用手机把这首歌放出来听了几遍原唱。

到11点终于结束了，下午我带孩子上兴趣班课。外面特别晒，骑电动车很热，只能开车。今天最高气温达到了30度，地表温度肯定比30度高。到了下午6点依然是大太阳，一直到晚上7点半太阳才逐渐落山，8点钟是最舒服的时候，太阳已经完全落了下去，此时天还微微亮着。不知道下周会不会下雨，还是一下子进入酷暑。

title.title: Being here.
title.body:
>


![IMG_20260530_152135797_HDR_PCT.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/EouB85hhmHSZVkpdAP7SavHDczDwsuGoeicN8EubryR56em2ok7H6F39CPRg2i6bMnq.jpg)


Some days, the urge to not be is too strong. The feeling of needing to dull it all down, drown out reality. It's part of dismantling the walls that have protected me for so long. That helped me manage the status quo according to my strength. I'm a lot stronger now. So much stronger, it surprises myself.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5ZaXGgguS2o

I've pulled out countless bricks in the last years. One after the other. Tedious, painful, yet so liberating. It's a paradox in the metaphor, that it's so easy to build a wall, yet so exhausting to deconstruct. If you don't want to smash it, destroy it by force. Some people do. I can't. I'd drown. There's too much feeling behind them. I have to do it slowly. Brick by brick. Slowly connecting to my self again, my feelings, my inner being. I'm a master of the rationale, but sometimes perceive myself as a newborn when it comes to emotions. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XrFECnl3vno

Yet there are those days that I don't feel my strength. That it's overwhelming. Questions arise - was my pace too fast? It couldn't be. So many times, there is no alternative. No choice. It's a test, I tell myself. Another test. And I can't stand it, not always. There's no shame in that. I wished I already was further on my journey, able to hold head high for longer, without the need to numb myself, even for a while. I will get there, I know. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XbByxzZ-4dI

At least I try, I tell myself. As always, awareness on my own problems and failures makes me more aware of the same in others. 

>And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but considerest not the beam that is in thine own eye?

[Matthew 7:3-5](https://www.bible.com/bible/1/MAT.7.3-5.KJV)

I'm not religious anymore, but the bible does bring up some excellent quotes that should not be discarded. The thing with this one is that it's short sighted. Yes, we shall not judge the other for the mote in their eye, ever. No matter if we have a beam in ours or not. But there is something soothing in being with someone with the same problem, telling you \
\n\nThe experience of others is worth a lot. Especially when they're aware. And I don't mean the fake awareness that Camus describes in \
, the judge-penitent behavior that only says \
without ever wanting to work on the beam. \n\nI'll work my beam down to a mote. I'm determined. I need to. I want to raise my child right, and \

means without hypocrisy. Impossible, yes, but that doesn't absolve me from having to try. I owe it to her. To myself. To all those close to me. Not today. Today I will fail, I'm failing already. And I allow it. For now. Not forever. ___ Post written for the #saturdayselections by Galenkp inviting us to share music in the [Weekend Experiences community](https://peakd.com/c/hive-168869/created) on Saturdays. Please feel free to engage in any original way, including dropping links to your posts on similar topics. I'm happy to read (and curate) any quality content that is not created by LLM/AI.

title.title: Opening Memories.
title.body:
Hi, collectors. Glad to be writing on this month's theme. 

Honestly, I didn't know that bottle openers were a thing. Like something one could actually collect. Lol. I guess you can actually collect anything, no stuff is less important. Hehehe.


I actually have a few collection of bottle openers, all of which I got as gifts. And I've had them for years now, as you can see from how they look. And of course, they all have a name. Lol. 


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQme3HPcPoKp9hzLfQs5kk6mBwPZYehjQaLnYbF5EdzftzB/1780185180441.jpg)




**Guinness Opener.**

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYF5vBMVosbgEzeeagPfeUUtx7Nym6bNWa27WFwD28vbZ/1780185180583.jpg)


This opener is actually the oldest in my collection. I've had it for about eleven years now. I've always kept it in a particular travelling bag, just brought it out to snap and it's back there again. 

Seeing it now has opened up some good memories of my stay at Uyo, Akwa Ibom State. I was hanging out with some friends at one cosy spot in Uyo. The company, Guinness Plc was running a raffle for their Malta Guinness drink - buy a drink, check under the crown cork, see what you win. We ordered drinks, flipped the crown and boom, mine said \

, and the rest. 

**2-in-1 opener.**

This opener came as a souvenir from one of my clients, a university I handle ads for at my station. You can see the name - TopFaith University, Mkpatak, located at Akwa Ibom State. It came in a bag with the school's journal, a table calendar and a jotter. I shared about the jotter in the *journals theme.*

It's portable and has been with me every day for three years now, serving as my key holder. Sometimes, it does its job as a bottle opener, especially on emergencies at events. 

**Star (Shine Shine Bobo) Opener.** 

I nicknamed this Star opener \

because that's what Star beer is called in the ads during those days. Don't know about now. 

It’s been with me for years, serving as my backup key holder, but if you ask me how or when I got it, I can’t remember. But it's definitely not from another raffle. 

**3-in-1 opener.**

This one did everything - bottle opener, key holder and nail cutter. 

Can’t remember how I got it or how long I’ve had it. But what I know is that it served as my key holder before I got the other one from the university client. 

Haven't used it since then,, even the nail cutter part.  one day the spring that held the nail cutter just fell off. With the spring gone, nail cutter part useless. That was it. 

***

All four openers are unique in their own ways. Apart from the one on my keys, the other three are  basically monuments now. Occupying space more than opening bottles. Eish! 

And that's a wrap: 4 openers, 4 opened memories! 

Thank for reading. 
***
****
***

title.title: Photography in the heights of Filband village, somewhere above the clouds, beautiful and memorable nature
title.body:
![20210910_181419_edit_71015760979788.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZqLo3iGjciPhc15i98RuyZiY7HbKaUyG1tiTQAYra3kH/20210910_181419_edit_71015760979788.jpg)


# Photography in the heights of Filband village, somewhere above the clouds, beautiful and memorable nature

 Hello friends, today I have prepared new photos of Filband This village is located in the heights above the clouds

 and is an incredibly beautiful village The weather there was foggy and my husband and I continued walking until we reached a flock of sheep


We got tired and sat on a rock.

 We could hear the shepherd singing and playing, and how memorable the foggy weather became for us. 

In these difficult days, what gives us the strength to continue is the remembrance of good memories.

 After this terrible war and severe economic damage,

 we are not in a good mood. None of us have inner happiness and are struggling to survive.


Our hearts have things to say, but it's better to talk about the beauties of the past I want to travel again,

 maybe in the next few months we can go on a trip with my husband or with my family and mother. 

I don't know what plans the world has for us and what days await us,

 but I hope for good things and hope for beautiful events in our lives This village was green and everywhere there were trees, greenery, grass and flowers. 


The weather was foggy in a few moments and sunny in a few moments, and what a beautiful weather it was Like life,

 where sunny and happy days and cloudy and sad days coexist.

title.body:

<center>
![wWmNYmQUuztO92aE_1.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/huigezi/images/wWmNYmQUuztO92aE_1/wWmNYmQUuztO92aE_1.webp)

</liketuimages>

从家里到店铺的路上，黄澄澄的麦田，都熟透了，都把自己家的地头的麦子割了，好让收麦机器进场收麦子。

路边都是开始进场或者准备进场的收麦机器，这又是一副热火朝天的新气象呢

小时候收麦要半个月才可以出点眉目，先碾场，然后手工镰刀割麦，然后呢把麦子拉回场子，然后呢用石磙撵，再扬场，再晾晒，总之，繁琐，最后就是交公粮了。

现在和 过去就不一样了，直接机器一遍过去，就颗粒归仓了。

还有很多种蒜的，在地里出蒜呢今天蒜的行情就好像比较好，家家都赚了很多，多赚了很多钱，羡慕呢

我不会干，我觉得我就是不会干，所以我也不羡慕。

兴百姓苦，亡百姓苦，不过这些农民也不值得同情，也很坏的，不好管理，面善心里候，也是各样各有各的算盘，城市套路深，你要回农村，农村地更滑，越是底层，越是不堪直视，更多的努力就是为了逃离这肮脏的底层，不过是徒劳一场，加油，今天会更好。

希望今天业绩更好，突破新高。

希望买咱家衣服的高考生，都能金榜题名。加油，奥力给。

---

title.title: 5 Minutes Free Writing - Bared Teeth
title.body:
Good morning all, doing my 5 minutes free writing with prompt - Bared Teeth. Hope you enjoy the story.


![images?q=tbn:ANd9GcTlZ67Yx4IsVRD5pCQ_ZSsR7HVa4aLqmogd3sg5uIZTPw&s=10](https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcTlZ67Yx4IsVRD5pCQ_ZSsR7HVa4aLqmogd3sg5uIZTPw&s=10)
[Source](https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcTlZ67Yx4IsVRD5pCQ_ZSsR7HVa4aLqmogd3sg5uIZTPw&s=10)

Smile, the weapon of any sales personnel. Henry, the Sales director of Bright Smile Dental is especially particular about the way his staff smile and greets the customer. They have a morning routine of reporting to his office first thing after they clock in daily for the smile inspection. 

Only when Henry is satisfied with the smile, then they are allowed to start their day. But he has the right to demad as he leads by example. He has a great smile. 

His smile radiates confidence, shows off his clean teeth,  a great testament to the company. And he makes the patient feels welcome and assured. By

He dislike it when your smile loks forced, insincere and shows bared teeth. If it happens, the staff will be removed from his sales duty and be made to undergo smiles training, conducted by none others than Henry himself. 

No one wants to undergo his training as it's so tough and boring that you effectively does nothing than trying to smile all day. Ad different smiles for different occasion but you would not be in the mood for the real smile.

body.title: I Am #AliveAndThriving Today! || #IAmAliveChallenge || Daily Off-Grid Jungle Journal Entry: Day #1410 - Testing Llama.cpp Build and Run Flags, Mixed Results, and Return to LLM Studio (for now) - Far East Big Island, Hawai'i - Friday, May 29, 2026
body.body: ![Hive-Banner-Green-Rounded.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tGM7REKBsvoBhPiEV5Fvb8tb333qQ8N9x2YfxaF9vWohE9Qf39RUEAn3LfysdgfbYpZ.png) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260527_151942826.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23u67Begj5fFYwXDZHz9Q4zAw22kpBrwx7aX8H5KsmwvjDuUfhbSn1Rsja4iDwfxLadz3.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) >I live naked and barefooted, very close to Earth and Nature, in an 18-acre, off-grid, clothing-optional, food-forest intentional community ([GaiaYoga Gardens](https://gaiayoga.org)), way out in the jungles of Lower Puna, far East Big Island, Hawai'i, and I have for more than 7 years now. Although there are many challenges, I love my life, and I'm immensely grateful to live where and how I do, on my own terms! I would not want to live any other way! 😁🙏💚⚡💥🔥✴️✳️❇️👣🌱✨🤙 ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) ``` Hive Debt: 23.51% HIVE Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.059 USD HBD/HIVE-Backed Dollar Fiat-Dollar Price: 1.012 USD ALIVE SWAP.HIVE Price: 0.01984739 SWAP.HIVE HEARTBEAT ALIVE Price: 0.10809695 ALIVE BLURT Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.00104370 USD QORT Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.181108 USD VOI Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.0001625 USD BTC/Bitcoin Fiat-Dollar Price: 73,842.15 USD BCH/Bitcoin Cash Fiat-Dollar Price: 305.75 USD LTC/Litecoin Fiat-Dollar Price: 52.44 USD Gold Fiat-Dollar Price: 4,541.88 USD Silver Fiat-Dollar Price: 75.28 USD Ranking for Our @aliveandmmb Witness Node: #126 (among all witnesses, including inactive)/#97 (among active witnesses only)/637.3k HP in votes/49 votes in total ``` ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) Warm greetings all! 😁🙏💚✨🤙 My deep dive into locally-run FOSS (*Free and Open-Source Software*) AI models, and the Hermes Agent agentic-AI framework, has been both truly amazing, and quite frustrating, with a mixed bag of successes, failure, advancements, and setbacks. For the past few days I've been testing an assortment of build and run flags for llama.cpp, which I'm trying to get working reliably as my backend LLM server, and it's been a bit more challenging than I had hoped. I may have to return to using LLM Studio as the backend LLM server once again, until I'm able to find the proper build and run flags for llama.cpp with my particular setup, because even with its issues, it was quite a bit more stable and reliable. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260527_161535324.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wqnjQpHEPNiGxfxQMQ5erGvw7jKYbwuoQK7M5VphRu75QafkwohSDhFsQJgv2J41tBv.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260527_161923578.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wqbyetH9XzGzJYRkEUhFC7mpZKAzxDUj3NZ9Y7B9y9gGDpWJsXpP8QKd1duYtb5ycqP.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) It's still quite wild to me how quickly and how deeply that I've become invoked in this agentic-AI endeavor. Even just two months ago, I would never have imagined me becoming so fascinated by it, and so passionate about it. It's utterly astonishing. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260527_170159986.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23xeVMULzba9z7t7snBAKtg32wCjpFyZXwGYyEEmj2d11PCvtRVQ5eEzwYntt1huK4Yfb.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260527_170223281.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tm6sRpkiXKVW3iUXWhekRxKQC8qMVKRXzMUzieM4bMWg92RP1qdgJqPKH31qzfmYXe7.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Although my computer is a pretty beefy gaming laptop, it still has a strong constraint of only 8GB of VRAM (*Video RAM*), which is pretty much the bare minimum for running models locally. There are ways to make it work, but they require a little techy magic and resource juggling. I'm looking a lot more closely at all the specifics now, to see exactly what's necessary. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260527_170242885_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23u61B5cFPTV99BL9PJo6mV6EH49jXY7TFhNwhRT25t2dkZxxaEa8jyapgRviGezfq2mB.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260527_170318247.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23uQg7ZbDdNZszXc2sJCjPb4LkATy9LH6nHHv4P8XneJeXfWEfxzPW5W5aa6Mfxy1vLj1.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Time is always a bugger for me, so finding the time to continue researching and testing is not so easy. I've been doing it in short bursts, in moments of somewhat less-occupied time. Balancing that with Hive, my jungle-community tasks, and everything else that I have to accommodate, is indeed challenging to the max. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260527_170353348_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23x155Vqgmq4UD7XyHZFaos1uN9hJah73CWXGgwfCVLnuBamqWhkbQsvx1GcFitvoZ47q.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260527_170437193_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23xAVk1rZkaqbcawnN1CBYHfC6tTWmZUGWRvuiNdyqtY1XuJCM6yT9GCME91WY9p5eXmT.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Even though LM Studio is more resource intensive, because it has more overhead, it's a fair bit easier, more stable, and more reliable for me than using straight llama.cpp, at least until I'm able to master its build and run flags. While I am getting closer to being able to run stable Hermes sessions with llama.cpp, and I will keep testing, for the moment at least, I need to return to the greater functional stability or LM Studio. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260527_171131944.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tbRL9CRS69jov3SVYD8kw9JtMbwEncpniG95P8bJrVegxcWoHZWFNduniHwfgMPWzvu.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260527_172750003_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tmHzrkCfAFVx76tr8evCT61byVFhUchns9KJTRqER625QjZPuHjyUNVbDUGBT1bMkBf.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Yesterday, Friday, after finishing up my Hive-Blurt-'We Are Alive Tribe' tasks by around 1PM, I prepared for a session that was scheduled for 1:30PM. The session started slightly late, it went very well, and we wrapped it up by a bit after 6PM, after which I went to Wabisabi to make myself some food, and to collect my superfood fire coffee from the fridge, before heading back to the Flow House to begin my evening Hive tasks. I got everything done my a little after 10PM, and after some a llama.cpp research and testing, I went to bed by around 12:15AM. I woke up about 7:30AM, still feeling that I needed a bit more sleep, doing more llama.cpp research, going to prepare my superfood fire coffee in Wabisabi, then returning to the Flow House to do more research, and to write this post. It's now just before 2PM, so it's a really good time to wrap this up, so that I may attend to my few other important Hive-Blurt-'We Are Alive Tribe' tasks, before leaving the Flow House a little later in the afternoon, to focus first on some photography for my posts, and then on jungle-community/land work and tasks. I deeply appreciate y'all so very much! Until tomorrow's iteration of these posts! ***Always forward, onward, upward, and whaleward, ho, together we go!*** 😁🙏💚✨🤙 ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260527_172833885.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23r1WEXzEYKhzvY3evZ2udQr6cUUTGG7WE4UC19UovHhY7VSckUT3hm9PkY6wT1wQZVZ4.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260527_173237820.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23uQnKiJehfWQnLmy8xensA57Ub8cqZz6odqy6JKDWEhxnHq7B6UWiFiCJFew5M8P4K7P.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) ### 2026 Life Goals ``` 1.)
