body.body:
> Hello Splinterland Warriors! How are you all? I hope you are blessed and well. In today's post, i will share a battle fight from the Frontier mode for the first time. As I was sharing the brawl battle fight, so today i am going to share the frontier ranked battle, as I started playing frontier format and want to upgrade to the next league. The season is ending soon, and i need to reach the next league, so sharing the first battle of the day that you can see below. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXE72341u7qe5wG37JfJHHsYNFhsA2SBqfobj8Hnoa5qP/image.png) [LINK](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_b822b5907438306e4718e914b1eec56e?ref=moeenali)
BATTLE LINE UP
In the battle line up i chose the Water Splinter and will try to use it in further battles because of having good cards. I was playing with Death Splinter but trying to use this water Splinter now in high mana battles and trying to upgrade the cards very soon so you can see the water cards in battle line up. https://images.hive.blog/DQmPav5hM74UdkscSWmGmMFZpax7QCwwmLCArCR68z229wP/l1.png
Marlai Singariel
https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/card_art/Marlai%20Singariel.jpg
Well, i have not explored these cards yet, but sharing it for the first time because of giving some victories with this splinter, it reminds me of the beta summoner that also adds +1 magic attack to all friendly monsters, and this one also do the same, but the mana is high as it costs 6 mana while the beta summoner in wild format costs 3 mana let's see the battle line up below. https://images.hive.blog/DQmPav5hM74UdkscSWmGmMFZpax7QCwwmLCArCR68z229wP/l1.png
RULESETS
No Ruleset applied

> https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/card_art/Port%20Guardian.jpg
In the first position, always try to use high-health and armored monsters to protect your backline monsters until the first monster is on the field so I went for this card, which has weak damage, but still I chose it to use it in the first position because of its enough health and armor to save the other friendly monsters and it stayed for a while to fight the first enemy monster and worked well.
https://images.hive.blog/DQmPav5hM74UdkscSWmGmMFZpax7QCwwmLCArCR68z229wP/l1.png

> https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/card_art/Great%20Bear%20Druid.jpg
In the 2nd position i went for a legendary card which is belongs to the foundation cards, but from the soulbound family i got it recently and used it here because of its high two attack type, one is magic and the other one is melee also the health of this card is enough to survive next after the first monster die so it worked well but because of its no armor it died also early but still worked well as the mana was enough i used this card in this battle because this one also occupy 9 mana.
https://images.hive.blog/DQmPav5hM74UdkscSWmGmMFZpax7QCwwmLCArCR68z229wP/l1.png

> https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/card_art/Vengeful%20Monk.jpg
In the next position, i went for a rare monster which is also from the neutral family that works great. Also, try to use the neutral monsters along with any Splinter, because sometimes you do not have enough cards in that specific Splinter, but can have some good cards like this in the neutral family so i went for this card, which is a perfect card. Most wanted card in the battlefield, everyone used this card because of its 2 damage and opportunity ability, and this one did a good job in weakening the backline team of enemy monsters.
https://images.hive.blog/DQmPav5hM74UdkscSWmGmMFZpax7QCwwmLCArCR68z229wP/l1.png

> https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/card_art/Saltwater%20Mage.jpg
Well, there is always a main monster in every battle, so my main monster of this battle was this epic monster, which i got two days ago, and because of this monster i won this battle that is why i shared this battle before i was using the death Splinter for my ranked battles but when i get this card i won some battles with this card so using this is must in upcoming battles because it has two damage and the one it gets from the summoner and also it targest the last enemy monsters with its sneak ability which worked very well and killed 3 to 4 monsters.
https://images.hive.blog/DQmPav5hM74UdkscSWmGmMFZpax7QCwwmLCArCR68z229wP/l1.png

> https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/card_art/Frostguard%20Warrior.jpg
In the 2nd last position, i used another rare card with ranged attack to give some damage in the form of ranged attack because i have used the magic and melee monsters only, so this one is used to give damage in the form of ranged especially the snipe ability to target the magic and ranged attack cards and it has enough damage because i did not find any good cards to have two ranged damage so that is why i choosed this one.

body.title: How Does One Know when HIVE Engine Swaps are Working?
body.body:
![bridge.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yintercept/EpEHMSru68jonxVQMzJj5Ehw7Y464pYZqifkFdR3xVdVfiYJ6SzqmTL1SVSAk1w5dJA.jpg)


I understand that there were some serious problems with the bridge used in cross chain swaps on Hive-Engine and that Hive-Engine temporarily suspended several of the swaps.

I am left wondering when HE will put the swaps back online. I have also wondered if there is a status page for the swaps?

I prefer to use the official swaps of Hive Engine. I've wondered if there were alternative swaps available on HIVE Engine or HIVE? blocktrades.us doesn't respond.

## Swap Accounts

One way to check the status of swaps is to examine the swap accounts using a block explorer. 

Here are a few of the accounts involved in swaps. Please drop additional accounts in the comment section.

### Honey-Swap

Honey-swap is the main swap between HIVE and HIVE-Engine. It is fun to parse this account as it shows how much hive is flowing to or from hive engine.

https://he.dtools.dev/@honey-swap?symbol=SWAP.HIVE


### Blurt

HIVE Side:

https://he.dtools.dev/@graphene-swap?symbol=SWAP.BLURT

BLURT Side

https://blocks.blurtwallet.com/#/@blurt-swap

### SteemIt

HIVE side:

https://he.dtools.dev/@graphene-swap?symbol=SWAP.STEEM

SteemIt side

https://steemblockexplorer.com/@graphene-swap

### BTC Swap

@btc-swap seems to handle transactions for LTC, DOGE and BTC. 

https://he.dtools.dev/@btc-swap

I suspect that one must examine transaction by transaction on the other side.

## Conclusion

I would look up more. These are the only swaps I've used in the last few years.

I generated the image of a dilapidated bridge [with Night Cafe](https://creator.nightcafe.studio/u/yintercept?ru=yintercept).

It is worthwhile to examine the transaction accounts before performing a swap. I really wish that there was a status page to let us know when the bridge is down.

body.title: Prompt #48 | There was a time in my life when I thought stress would get the better of me 🫨 [ENG/ESP]
body.body: The Silverbloggers Chronicles - **Prompt 48:** ##### How did you deal with stress or heartbreak? ![1000037652.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23tS12oAPKKX55GPbDWy7x7NPoWu7K1vjKj84oun9DgwXs7DEvwjdjUQM71SgePbaVFMs.png) Hello Silverbloggers friends, I hope you are enjoying this weekend. Here in my country it is quite hot, but we hope that the weather will cool down a bit soon so we don't feel so overwhelmed when going out into the street. It had been quite a while since I last visited this community, and I read @mairene1's post, which encouraged me to participate as well. I can talk about stress since I have been dealing with my emotions for a long time, maybe years, and it is something that is not so easy to control. I think the more one tries to maintain control, the harder it is to reach a state of tranquility, but I have tried many things and I would like to share a bit of my experience with you. In 2016, I began a very severe process of anxiety, stress, and deterioration of my health. There was a situation in the country that affected almost all of us, and perhaps I didn't know how to cope with it as well as other people did. I shut myself away for a long time and even stopped doing the things I enjoyed. I was very sad; I remember feeling like I was in a loop that I couldn't get out of. A year passed like this, where the stress kept accumulating; I had sudden mood swings, it was difficult for me, and I imagine it was also complicated for my family to see me that way. So sad and so hopeless. But it reached a point where I told myself I had to at least try to take the step to look for support. Family support is essential; my siblings and my mom were always very attentive to my health situation. I think no one else was as close in that way as they were. I was truly fortunate to have their support, but I knew I had to start taking the steps myself to manage to get out of that darkness. One day, exhausted, I simply decided to trust medicine and look for the necessary support; maybe for some it was something unnecessary, but for me, it was that lifeboat that saved my life. At first, I felt bad because of the prejudices that exist around mental health and seeking consultation with a professional, but it helped me a lot at the time. ![1000037653.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23ujdqvzfEsrykNvrwDhSt5wUcvDeCX4FpRGPeqGTx3KwEmM9xPSmDKV3sfNCogQktLSL.jpg) What I began to notice after therapies, medications, and a lot of advice and words from people close to me and outsiders, is that I had to put myself as a priority. Even though I knew that bending my mind away from the same taboo ideas I had about mental health—even though I am an open-minded person—would make me feel a lot of discomfort and would even lead me to a state of vulnerability in which I would have to adapt to a new reality that I might not like very much. But taking that first step for my health saved me like a miracle from God; I feel that He was the one who was closest every single day that passed when I didn't know what to do with so much stress. Changing my mindset to think more positively has helped me value who I am and who is by my side. Before, I was very negative and complained about everything; now, I try to always give thanks for both the good and the bad. That change of thoughts did not happen overnight; I had to go through many emotional ups and downs. But with the help of doctors and my own will and faith, I was able to move forward little by little, doing things that pushed me to believe more in myself, that let me know I had the potential to do anything I set my mind to, and not stay stuck with the idea that there was nothing I could do to change my reality. I listen to many mental health podcasts; I like being able to see the stories of other people who were able to move forward despite adversity. I also listen to music; this helps me relax and motivates me every day to give my best. I also try to take care of myself, dress up in something nice, and put on makeup, even though I don't know how to do it very well. I always try to fulfill the things I need to do, to remind my mind that I am a responsible person and that my word has value. I always look to connect with people who bring positive things into my life, surrounding myself more with those who accept me for who I am and who push me to improve in those aspects I still have pending. It is a whole process that lasts a lifetime, but to get out of stress, these are things that helped me a lot, and I certainly wish I had the same level of awareness back then that I have now. I hope this serves as a help or motivation to put yourselves as a priority 🫶🏼😊. --- >! [Spanish Version] > >Las crónicas de Silverbloggers - **Tema 48:** >##### ¿Cómo has afrontado el estrés o una decepción amorosa? > >Hola amigos de Silverbloggers, espero que estén disfrutando de este fin de semana. Aquí en mi país está haciendo bastante calor pero esperamos que pronto el clima baje un poco para no sentirnos tan ofuscados al salir a la calle. Tenía bastante tiempo sin pasarme por esta comunidad y leí el post de @mairene1 y me animé también a participar. Puedo hablar sobre el estrés ya que llevo bastante tiempo, tal vez años lidiando con mis emociones y es algo que no es tan fácil de controlar. Creo que mientras más uno intenta mantener el control es más dificil llegar a un estado de tranquilidad pero he intentado muchas cosas y me gustaría poder compartirles un poco de mi experiencia. > >En el año 2016 empecé con un proceso de ansiedad, estrés y deterioro de mi salud muy fuerte. Había una situación en el país que nos afecto a casi todos y que tal vez no supe sobrellevar como otras personas. Me encerré por mucho tiempo e incluso deje de hacer las cosas que disfrutaba. Estaba muy triste, recuerdo que me sentía como en un bucle del cual no podía salir. Así paso un año en donde el estrés se fue acumulando, tuve cambios de humor bruscos, fue difícil para mí e imagino que para mi familia también fue complicado el verme de esa manera. Tan triste y tan desesperanzada. Pero llegó un punto en el que me dije que tenía que intentar al menos dar el paso para buscar apoyo. > >El apoyo de la familia es primordial, mis hermanos y mi mamá siempre estuvieron muy pendientes de mi situación de salud. Creo que nadie más estuvo tan cerca de esa forma como lo hicieron ellos. Realmente fui afortunada de tener su apoyo pero se que tenía que comenzar a dar los pasos por mi misma para lograr salir de esa oscuridad. Un día agotada simplemente decidí confiar en la medicina y buscar el apoyo necesario, tal vez para algunos fue algo innecesario pero para mí fue ese bote que me salvó la vida. Al principio me sentía mal, por los prejuicios que hay sobre la salud mental y el buscar ir a consulta con un profesional, pero a mi me ayudó mucho en su momento. > >Lo que empecé a notar luego de terapias, de medicamentos y de muchos consejos y palabras de personas cercanas y externas, es que debía ponerme como prioridad aunque sabía que doblegar mi mente de las mismas ideas del tabú que tenía sobre la salud mental —a pesar de que soy una persona con mente abierta—, me haría sentir mucha incomodidad e incluso me llevaría a un estado de vulnerabilidad en el cual debería adaptarme a una nueva realidad que tal vez no me gustaría demasiado. Pero dar ese primer paso por mi salud me salvó como un milagro de Dios, siento que él fue quien más cerca estuvo en cada día que pasaba y no sabía que hacer con tanto estrés. > >Cambiar de mentalidad pensando más positivamente me ha ayudado a valorar lo que soy y quiénes están a mi lado. Antes era muy negativa y me quejaba por todo, ahora trato de siempre dar gracias tanto por lo bueno como por lo malo. No fue de la noche a la mañana ese cambio de pensamientos, tuve que pasar por muchas subidas y bajadas emocionales. Pero con ayuda de los médicos y de mi propia voluntad y fe, pude seguir adelante poco a poco haciendo cosas que me impulsaron a creer más en mi, que me hicieran saber que tenía potencial para hacer cualquier cosa que me propusiera y no quedarme con la idea de que no había nada que pudiese hacer para cambiar mi realidad. > >Escucho muchos podcasts de salud mental, me gusta poder ver las historias de otras personas que pudieron salir adelante a pesar de las adversidades. También escucho música, esto me ayuda a relajarme y me motiva cada día a dar lo mejor de mi. Busco también cuidarme, vestirme con algo bonito, maquillarme aunque no se hacerlo muy bien. Trato de siempre cumplir con las cosas que debo hacer, para recordarle a mi mente que soy una persona responsable y que mi palabra tiene valor. Busco siempre conectar con personas que me aporten cosas positivas, rodearme más de quienes me acepten por como soy y que me impulsen a mejorar en aquellos aspectos que aún tengo pendientes. Es todo un proceso que dura la vida entera, pero para salir del estrés estas son cosas que me ayudaron mucho y que sin duda me hubiese gustado tener el mismo nivel de conciencia que tengo ahora. Espero que les sirva de ayuda o motivación para ponerse como prioridad 🫶🏼😊. ![1000036591.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/EoH5GGWRAFPwDXXLBARiEGCJUDCp6CAFD1qEsgMuUe5Dt9qDVjRNtfAfJkxbVS266n9.png)

body.title: Strolling through the Bobures Spa and Pier | Paseando por el Balneario y Muelle de Bobures 🌊
body.body:
<details>

<summary>ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)</summary>

Hello, travelers from around the world. Happy Saturday night to everyone.

Continuing our tour of the town of Bobures, I wanted to show you a little more of this place that’s so special to Ricardo. As I mentioned, it’s located south of Lake Maracaibo, which means the beach is very close by. We were able to ride our motorcycle around the resort and take a short but very meaningful walk along the pier.

![InShot_20260530_091414041.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc6jGDnqxNmRPYh6RZK71woGsrXzgbfDJK9wYJF13x1z3/InShot_20260530_091414041.jpg)

This place was new to me, but it seemed very similar to other spots I’ve visited, like Los Puertos de Altagracia, La Vereda del Lago, or Santa Rosa de Agua, perhaps because they’re all part of the same body of water. First, we went to the beach resort, a spot where swimmers can enjoy the sun, the beach, and a refreshing dip. On the shore, there were restaurants, stands selling inflatables, and, of course, some tables and chairs under the palm trees for people who, I was told, come frequently and in large numbers to enjoy the weekend.

![20260405_105030.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS1YhDVLsAR3e32kQ1CGJ9PdxuMdX8JNvUxWgGQdcoFJn/20260405_105030.jpg)

![20260405_105154.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSgEGcBKqHQA15bBRacFHrsdkf7GnYUoBrtD4UTgo1c5o/20260405_105154.jpg)

![20260405_105217.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRvAJKKHbJqf5pdJeXB93Pm8rQnJNs6PrKC86gu9adt3H/20260405_105217.jpg)

![20260405_105232.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRJGy7PSxfcScHgrGiKZgNnJpgUiKvBHmrmFervHswV8z/20260405_105232.jpg)

![20260405_105540.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS4jPkny5EZwnFpYrmbBPCzmZ5LxtNksAZKrg3QSQPGaX/20260405_105540.jpg)

We decided to go straight to the pier, where there is a river and lake patrol station that appeared to be out of service or perhaps it was just closed at the time. We walked along the pier until we came upon a heron perched on a rock.

![20260405_105936.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUTEUudxVmqVr7wxynuKy1A1f4yjEqbeo1c7PuCM7CxE4/20260405_105936.jpg)

In this area, you could enjoy a pleasant breeze and the sound of the waves lapping at the shore. I really liked it, and I completely understand why it’s such a cherished and special place for Ricardo because, as the song by Cardenales del Éxito says: \

It’s impossible not to feel moved just standing in front of our lake, and even better, to keep discovering new places within my own state. ![20260405_110657.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbvSqYCv3FFCv4A97oM6uYgiuoLrQm3GMtq216QZ9m4Hk/20260405_110657.jpg) ![20260405_110022.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQuzxbYsgirFMRxDtSLkkn1M1xMt4iM7Aui6fd28zhYqG/20260405_110022.jpg) ![20260405_110029.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWjKiXwHUWKoWmFdefFQqGSAb1oqv47nWBRbG1XXE7edL/20260405_110029.jpg) ![20260405_110143.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcSPz5JprAivWhVW1WktqjG4mtSYjQzfeRXmQjCFMGJnS/20260405_110143.jpg) ![20260405_110204.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmT61vzdpF6LdfVeLhjVQrcnFLpQdpfFiVUM7H8qnLa6nF/20260405_110204.jpg) ![20260405_110240.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfFWWPdAp143RKjbNpFYkBDaTF9r8axKoxMRoqJLeooHK/20260405_110240.jpg) ![20260405_110509.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYNTFb5tFdKqhi9o5B4QCKjKbzA7sdQJYeZvH7MnCjfD5/20260405_110509.jpg) My heart, as always, was overflowing with love at the chance to discover this little corner of Zulia; what a joy that life and Ricardo brought me here. ![20260405_110257.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTyn6ebR6otqGKaDmkqWuPLhvDLdThau2p2GrDhn6SMuG/20260405_110257.jpg)

--- Photos taken with a Samsung Galaxy A35. Collage created in [Inshot](https://v.inshot.com/invite) Content owned by me. Translation by: [Deepl](https://www.deepl.com/es/translator)

>

Hola, viajeros de todo el mundo. Feliz noche de sábado para todos.

Continuando con nuestro recorrido por el pueblo de Bobures, quería mostrarles un poco más de este lugar tan especial para Ricardo, que como les comentaba se encuentra al Sur del Lago de Maracaibo, lo que quiere decir que la orilla de la playa esta muy cerquita, pudimos recorrer el balneario en la moto y caminar unos pocos pero muy significativos minutos por el muelle.

![InShot_20260530_091414041.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc6jGDnqxNmRPYh6RZK71woGsrXzgbfDJK9wYJF13x1z3/InShot_20260530_091414041.jpg)

Este lugar era nuevo para mi, pero se me hacía muy similar a otros sitios que he visitado como Los Puertos de Altagracia, La Vereda del Lago o Santa Rosa de Agua, quizás porque son parte de las mismas aguas, primero estuvimos en el Balneario, el lugar que esta apto para que los bañistas puedan disfrutar del sol, la playa y un buen chapuzon, en la orilla se encontraban restaurantes, ventas con inflables y porsupuesto algunas mesas con sillas debajo de las palmeras para las personas, que según me dijeron vienen con frecuencia y en cantidad a disfrutar del fin de semana.

![20260405_105030.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS1YhDVLsAR3e32kQ1CGJ9PdxuMdX8JNvUxWgGQdcoFJn/20260405_105030.jpg)

![20260405_105154.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSgEGcBKqHQA15bBRacFHrsdkf7GnYUoBrtD4UTgo1c5o/20260405_105154.jpg)

![20260405_105217.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRvAJKKHbJqf5pdJeXB93Pm8rQnJNs6PrKC86gu9adt3H/20260405_105217.jpg)

![20260405_105232.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRJGy7PSxfcScHgrGiKZgNnJpgUiKvBHmrmFervHswV8z/20260405_105232.jpg)

![20260405_105540.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS4jPkny5EZwnFpYrmbBPCzmZ5LxtNksAZKrg3QSQPGaX/20260405_105540.jpg)

Nosotros decidimos ir directamente al muelle, donde hay un comando fluvial y lacustre aparentemente sin funcionar o no se si en ese momento estaba cerrado, nosotros fuimos caminando por el muelle hasta acercarnos a una garza que se encontraba posando sobre una piedra.

![20260405_105936.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUTEUudxVmqVr7wxynuKy1A1f4yjEqbeo1c7PuCM7CxE4/20260405_105936.jpg)

En ésta zona se podía disfrutar de una agradable brisa y del sonido de las olas llegando hasta la orilla, me gustó mucho y entiendo perfectamente porque es un lugar tan apreciado y especial para Ricardo y es que como dice la canción de Cardenales del Éxito: \

, imposible no sentir emoción con solo estar frente a nuestro lago y lo mejor aún, poder seguir conociendo lugares dentro de mi estado.

![20260405_110657.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbvSqYCv3FFCv4A97oM6uYgiuoLrQm3GMtq216QZ9m4Hk/20260405_110657.jpg)

![20260405_110022.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQuzxbYsgirFMRxDtSLkkn1M1xMt4iM7Aui6fd28zhYqG/20260405_110022.jpg)

![20260405_110029.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWjKiXwHUWKoWmFdefFQqGSAb1oqv47nWBRbG1XXE7edL/20260405_110029.jpg)

![20260405_110143.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcSPz5JprAivWhVW1WktqjG4mtSYjQzfeRXmQjCFMGJnS/20260405_110143.jpg)

![20260405_110204.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmT61vzdpF6LdfVeLhjVQrcnFLpQdpfFiVUM7H8qnLa6nF/20260405_110204.jpg)

![20260405_110240.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfFWWPdAp143RKjbNpFYkBDaTF9r8axKoxMRoqJLeooHK/20260405_110240.jpg)

![20260405_110509.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYNTFb5tFdKqhi9o5B4QCKjKbzA7sdQJYeZvH7MnCjfD5/20260405_110509.jpg)

Mi pecho como siempre estaba hinchado de amor por poder conocer este rinconcito del Zulia, que alegría que la vida y Ricardo me trajeran hasta aquí. 

![20260405_110257.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTyn6ebR6otqGKaDmkqWuPLhvDLdThau2p2GrDhn6SMuG/20260405_110257.jpg)

body.body:
>

**Gratos saludos tengan todos mis queridod amigos viajerod de todas partes del mundo es un placer para mi saludarlos en este lindo viernes fin de semana, hoy les quiero mostrar la linda Iglesia San José.**

>**A warm greeting to all my dear travelling friends from all over the world; it is a pleasure for me to greet you on this lovely Friday at the start of the weekend. Today I would like to show you the beautiful Church of San José.**

Justamente me encontraba caminando por toda la avenida de Delicias con 5 de Julio, porque iba hacia el segundo Cementerio más antiguo de la ciudad de Maracaibo San José \

, pero no me dejaron entrar puesto que debia esperar el economo del lugar por lo que fui a caminar con mi hermano ya que debía aprovechar el el tiempo al máximo y aprovechar que no había sol, justamente prácticamente a una cuadra después se encuentra la Iglesia San José que me parece que tiene una linda arquitectura bastante impresionante pero a la vez sencilla.\n\n>I was actually walking along the stretch of Avenida de Delicias and 5 de Julio, as I was on my way to San José \

, the second oldest cemetery in the city of Maracaibo, but they wouldn’t let me in as I had to wait for the caretaker, so I went for a walk with my brother as I wanted to make the most of the time and take advantage of the fact that the sun wasn’t out. Just about a block further on is the Church of San José, which I think has beautiful architecture that is quite impressive yet simple at the same time. ![Collage de fotos horizontal Feliz San Valentín Sencillo Blanco y negro_20260530_185052_0000.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmb7iH6VqzD2fMFunaJktFL68jyLuGyhf8Ta1L3QVJYMo8/Collage%20de%20fotos%20horizontal%20Feliz%20San%20Valent%C3%ADn%20Sencillo%20Blanco%20y%20negro_20260530_185052_0000.png) Justamente en toda la avenida Principal de 5 de Julio podemos encontrar esta hermosa iglesia de San José, que rinde el tributo a la vida de este santo, es una de las iglesias más reconocidas que están distribuidas a lo largo de esta avenida, cabe destacar que la imagen de San José que se alberga en el interior de esta iglesia sale en procesión los 19 de marzo de todos los años y a su vez sale justamente al frente de la iglesia durante todo el domingo de la misericordia cuando peregrina la imagen de Jesús de la Divina Misericordia estas ambas se saludan, resaltan que este iglesia también presenta sus propios columbarios donde se puedan depositar y almacenar las cenizas de los fieles difuntos. >Right on the main avenue of 5 de Julio, we find this beautiful Church of San José, which pays tribute to the life of this saint; it is one of the most famous churches along this avenue. It is worth noting that the statue of Saint Joseph housed inside this church is carried in procession on 19 March every year and is also placed directly in front of the church throughout Mercy Sunday, when the statue of Jesus of Divine Mercy is on pilgrimage; the two statues are then greeted. It is worth noting that this church also has its own columbariums where the ashes of the faithful departed can be placed and stored. ![20260512_073718.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdzjZiLGfk4tWgDzbRb91coTqsFXjGtK5fEweXN1Rvhjw/20260512_073718.jpg) ![20260512_073717.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYzWJZAk9X6rr4gQq4WCLk5nJhAJZRSQmGX5mcqLWYonH/20260512_073717.jpg) ![20260512_073713.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaKNCEvMjthKmBvaJoDqZjxoSxv8HG4cu56tbJG3sUVaK/20260512_073713.jpg) ![20260512_073405.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdWddALtJbf4s8qVgupN7JvkWE1d97guroj5nwb5xzvsy/20260512_073405.jpg) ![20260512_073414.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmW8GEcLmUkMLuhz4eakWi81DxHhneuppr62dGRXH1tGKg/20260512_073414.jpg) ![20260512_073429.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZnhkA67gnLtP8614CnSr4iRW79LmY3736izByS8vXnSp/20260512_073429.jpg) ![20260512_073505.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQme6KQ2B9zPgEmJ599hoyxsbeWhJbwf72zZSrVxTWA3nQq/20260512_073505.jpg) ![20260512_073510.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmW1ic8efZf9AMJQfDJmKnKSLRfUHXi2XjkSzUPYamTy7F/20260512_073510.jpg) ![20260512_073515.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPjomiGZQCb4pekM8aLgedThU2CThSQnbZ4aQHSz7kFAT/20260512_073515.jpg) ![20260512_073519.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZCHGp24ithufMjLnde8qaFbShfAQAWMiubfct7aQZGoP/20260512_073519.jpg) --- Ahora bien al momento que fui a tomar la fotografía a las afueras del iglesia esta estaba totalmente cerrada espero poder algún día visitar su interior y poderles mostrarle lo hermosa que es por dentro, el diseño arquitectónico que posee esta iglesia es de estilo Art Deco, tardo aproximadamente 3 años en poder ser construida por completo su edificación se inició justamente en 1941 y terminó en 1944 desde ese entonces tenemos esta linda iglesia, este estilo se asemeja a el de un castillo en el que predomina las líneas rectas, un estilo elegante y sofisticado características de Europa del siglo pasado, es por lo que podemos ver sus bases rectas pintadas, en la parte superior se encuentra su cruz. >However, when I went to take the photograph outside the church, it was completely closed. I hope to visit the interior one day and be able to show you just how beautiful it is inside. The architectural design of this church is in the Art Deco style; it took approximately three years to complete. Construction began in 1941 and was finished in 1944, and we have had this lovely church ever since. This style resembles that of a castle, characterised by straight lines an elegant and sophisticated style typical of Europe in the last century. That is why we can see its straight, painted bases, with a cross at the top. ![20260512_073530.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQFo5RwgMhNpSi23kLXsQccZbqUH8GEgo7aUQDxhMQ7h1/20260512_073530.jpg) ![20260512_073542.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZhN9sFLpKRkB7PgLm82UvhNA5BkosMq1GbXSvxtCoSLk/20260512_073542.jpg) ![20260512_073550.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNoKT8ioTC7b777FrzNUssDw6ouYeeZ4o88Y74ntkq9xW/20260512_073550.jpg) ![20260512_073551.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbzqoDXgSTZFXACJc34eh2xyxxd7R7U3ck1QoCcqEuf5m/20260512_073551.jpg) ![20260512_073647.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmchU7urVDDHnqziSvV1mC24b3sh6cGcYjGqp9gi9A6cVa/20260512_073647.jpg) --- Podemos ver que esta iglesia posee otras puertas la del centro que es mucho más larga y ancha que esta conduce hacia hacia su altar, dos laterales que estas son bastante estrechas, altas, ambas puertas son de madera, me parece una iglesia bastante hermosa y con una arquitectura muy diferente, ya que normalmente las arquitecturas de las iglesias de Maracaibo están enmarcadas en un estilo neoclásico, antiguo, así como también, gótico, pero está posee un estilo arquitectónico bastante diferente y opuesto, a lo que estamos acostumbrados a las iglesias de Maracaibo, por lo que hemos podemos ver que es una arquitectura bastante elegante a su vez conservando rasgos europeos. >We can see that this church has other doors: the central one, which is much longer and wider than this one, leads to the altar; and two side doors, which are quite narrow and tall. Both doors are made of wood. I find it a rather beautiful church with a very distinctive architectural style, as churches in Maracaibo are usually built in a neoclassical or traditional style, as well as Gothic, but this one has a rather different and contrasting architectural style to what we are used to seeing in Maracaibo’s churches; we can therefore see that it is a rather elegant style of architecture, whilst retaining European features. ![20260512_073648.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmV1a7SNo8WQuZFQATFGCrmSJ75M2Zh1jnJybP5sx2B1Ue/20260512_073648.jpg) ![20260512_073712.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRWivV3RK9oVtS1n2J24EMbLY7nJGptUGFDGWRH7ExJ6q/20260512_073712.jpg) --- Por último, la ubicación de la iglesia es bastante fantástica, ya que es un punto bastante céntrico y comercial de gran afluencia en Maracaibo, ya que quien lo conoce la famosa avenida 5 de Julio que es una de las avenidas más largas que se pueden encontrar en la ciudad, sin duda alguna Maracaibo y sus iglesias no dejan de sorprendernos, quiero ir mostrandole cada uno de ellas y espero que esta iglesia San José les haya encantado, esta igleia nos ha dejado en volver por su gran elegancia nos vemos prontamente queridos amigos viajeros para conocer un nuevo lugar. >Finally, the church’s location is absolutely fantastic, as it’s situated in a very central and bustling commercial area of Maracaibo. Anyone familiar with the city will know the famous Avenida 5 de Julio, one of the longest avenues in the city. Without a doubt, Maracaibo and its churches never cease to amaze us. I’d like to show you each one of them, and I hope you’ve loved this church of San José; this church has left us wanting to return because of its great elegance. See you soon, dear fellow travellers, to discover a new place. ![20260512_073653.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZPqwPtRDrox5yXEJusfyy36WsGB54K7TZAfnEMWiWeLn/20260512_073653.jpg) Hasta pronto mis viajeros de todas partes del mundo me despido. >Farewell for now, my fellow travellers from all corners of the globe. ![20260512_073557.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZb3gEBs7YHArTdeW9gmGU8BT2Q9aFkJeWPYaZdSo72tn/20260512_073557.jpg) [//]:# (!worldmappin 10.66380 lat -71.62016 long d3scr)

body.title: Passport Stamps, Payment Rails, and the Quiet Geography of Leisure
body.body:
Here is the text:

***

Traveling through Vancouver in late autumn feels like moving through a city that hasn't decided what season it wants to be. The mountains hold snow at their peaks while the streets below stay wet and grey. Visitors from the United States often notice how different the payment infrastructure feels — tap-to-pay is ubiquitous, e-transfers are routine, and digital wallets are treated as standard rather than novel. Among the many platforms that have adapted to Canadian financial habits, online casino Canada PayPal options appeared relatively late, largely because PayPal's relationship with Canadian financial regulation required years of negotiation before gambling transactions could be processed cleanly. Now the integration is common enough that it sits alongside bank transfers and prepaid cards as an unremarkable feature of the digital leisure economy <https://echeckcasinocanada.ca/> The broader shift toward cashless transactions changed how people move money across every sector.

The question of when gambling became legal in Canada doesn't have a single clean answer. Federal law through the Criminal Code was amended in 1969 to permit provinces to run lotteries, and by 1985, the amendment granted provinces full authority to license and operate commercial gaming — horse racing, casinos, slots, the entire structure. What followed was a slow, uneven rollout across provinces: British Columbia and Ontario moved quickly, while others took decades to build regulatory frameworks. The patchwork quality of that history still shows up in how differently provinces handle licensing, taxation, and the approval of new operators.

Comparable timelines appear across other English-speaking countries, though the details diverge sharply. Australia legalized most forms of gambling at the state level throughout the 1970s and 1980s, with sports betting expanding dramatically in the 1990s. The United Kingdom has operated licensed gambling since the Betting and Gaming Act of 1960, later replaced and expanded by the Gambling Act of 2005, which moved regulation toward a single national body. New Zealand and Ireland followed their own paths, shaped by attitudes toward personal freedom, public harm, and how much governments wanted to be involved in running gaming operations themselves.

What cuts across all these jurisdictions is the tension between access and control.

That tension doesn't only appear in leisure. The same regulatory negotiation plays out in how countries manage financial technology, pharmaceutical pricing, alcohol distribution, and broadcasting rights — sectors where provinces, states, or territories hold authority that the federal government cannot simply override. Canada's federalism makes this especially visible. A traveler moving from Alberta to Quebec notices not just a language shift but a different relationship between commerce and public life, shaped by decades of separate policy decisions accumulating into distinct regional cultures.

Tourism researchers have noted that visitors often arrive with assumptions shaped by their home country's rules, then find themselves navigating a system that works differently than expected — not worse, but differently. The confusion rarely lasts long. People adapt quickly to new payment options, new opening hours, new tax structures at checkout. What takes longer to adjust to is the underlying logic: why this province handles something one way while its neighbor handles it another, what historical argument produced the current arrangement, and whether anyone is still reliably tracking whether it works.

---

[Posted](https://waivio.com/@waivio_hiddenfrontiersi/7q1mtn-passport-stamps-payment-rails-and-the-quiet-geography-of-leisure) by Waivio guest: [@waivio_hiddenfrontiersi](https://waivio.com/@waivio_hiddenfrontiersi)

body.title: 🪡Bandana hecha de retazos de tela de mangas de camisa🧵./🪡Bandana made from scraps of shirt sleeve fabric🧵.[Esp~Eng]
body.body:
>Saludos a todos en esta noche,de un momento a otro el clima cambio y empezó a llover,paso de estar soleado a estar nublado y con frío,ahora este clima provoca estar abrigado. Pero antes de abrigarme,llegó un cliente con unas camisas,y me pidió que le cortará las mangas porque eran camisas de manga larga y el las quería cortas. Cuando ví una de las mangas que es de una tela que me gustó,pero no era mucha tela y entonces pensé en mejor hacer una bandana con las dos mangas que corte y no podía desperdiciar esa linda tela. Los materiales que use fueron los siguientes:** # > Greetings everyone tonight. Suddenly the weather changed and it started to rain. It went from sunny to cloudy and cold, making it perfect for bundling up. But before I bundled up, a customer came in with some shirts and asked me to shorten the sleeves because they were long-sleeved and he wanted them short. When I saw one of the sleeves, it was made of a fabric I liked, but there wasn't much of it, so I thought it would be better to make a bandana with the two sleeves I cut off. I couldn't waste such a lovely fabric. The materials I used were the following: --- #
![1000277618.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbHb28NLzo6v8Ubok3hTZ12XzQqBmU9Yc1w5HqbxBCiLY/1000277618.jpg)
# # *
Materiales:|Materials:
* #
* **Retazos de tela de mangas de camisa** * **Tijera** * **Hilo** * **Alfileres** * **Un pedacito de liga elástica**
>* **Scraps of shirt sleeve fabric** >* **Scissors** >* **Thread** >* **Pins** >* **A small piece of elastic**
# --- # # *
Elaboración|Elaboration
* #
![1000277624.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbzzEL8rbcykfr7r9NnbzC4mjgbr6wLykAKrB4Z6RH2eb/1000277624.jpg)
![1000277625.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQp6bC7wqfu9RWiM8awLkyjLLoPVTwCge3uezXocNwWt6/1000277625.jpg)
![1000277652.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUsCez68TYLMEq61eYoK1ynRDC5vZJeSBfj1WmpBHKS89/1000277652.jpg)
![1000277708.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeCguRDUpyV3wb15RAFi1bh5FsrritsmTUQsWAJoyAd6j/1000277708.jpg)
# * #### Paso nro 1 **

>Comencé por cortar la base de la bandana,la medida es la de mi cabeza, entonces tome en cuenta eso,luego pase tanta cortar la parte en dónde va la liga elástica, entonces corte un pedazo de tela que fuera un poco más grande que la liga,ya que allí después voy a colocar la liga,está parte de la liga evitará que la bandana se caiga y quede mas ajustada a la cabeza.** > * #### Paso nro 1 > I started by cutting the base of the bandana, the size is that of my head, so I took that into account, then I moved on to cutting the part where the elastic band goes, so I cut a piece of fabric that was a little bigger than the band, since that's where I'm going to put the band later, this part of the band will prevent the bandana from falling off and will fit more snugly on the head. ---
![1000277626.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQme5jTLVSTVsu7deys9zwNPinCSx4Fh45aG7wj2GUYXPTz/1000277626.jpg)
![1000277626.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQme5jTLVSTVsu7deys9zwNPinCSx4Fh45aG7wj2GUYXPTz/1000277626.jpg)
![1000277712.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdSLc14RYxLzWqqzpRnHos5b2mdRfZ7aLfnZJMQUZ4YFM/1000277712.jpg)
![1000277713.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQma74fsPNEc9zzXJ8ewnw8LK5YDhjBexBFNvN2nEawpLfu/1000277713.jpg)
# * #### Paso nro 2 **

>Empecé primero por coser la base de la bandana,doble la tela de manera que queda un rectángulo, luego pase a coser en línea recta dejando los lados sin coser. Después le di vuelta a la pieza, y ya está lista está parte.** > * #### Paso nro 2 > I started by sewing the base of the bandana. I folded the fabric to make a rectangle, then sewed along the edges in a straight line, leaving the sides unsewn. After that, I turned the piece right side out, and that part is finished. ---
![1000277655.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmY2WDt2dAchRZDD12HrqQ55hXMfA2DDhd9e2spJkHNvcC/1000277655.jpg)
![1000277709.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeqKS48q3CG64TLGw6KU5BJyPWLKbg4KuuTzHNyWMb87L/1000277709.jpg)
![1000277714.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQgUzsqr8DfKmyP1MdRFHoxAfKhUsAZbjq4qAfC147f1F/1000277714.jpg)
![1000277660.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmY9jitz1mpWL5GiAs88hY88eQgLtVbsahmhXsRoZoXTXP/1000277660.jpg)
# * #### Paso nro 3 **

>Continúe cosiendo la parte de la pieza en dónde va a ir la liga,entoycosi solo el lado derecho para deja los lados sin coser,ya luego le di vuelta a la pieza,y coloque la liga adentro, aguante del lado en dónde voy a coser primero con un alfiler,luego cosí el otro lado,y así ya está parte está lista.** > * #### Paso nro 3 > Continue sewing the part of the piece where the elastic will go, I only sewed the right side to leave the sides unsewn, then I turned the piece over, and placed the elastic inside, I held the side where I was going to sew first with a pin, then I sewed the other side, and that's it, this part is ready. ---
![1000277715.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUFwtN7pTrGgU1aGjzm8mNE8JMW7GgihFTTRm6j9j6u52/1000277715.jpg)
![1000277665.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTysmxCiMd1m7hW4uSBcbsXebaRJQvxqCndcWDEYE7H7V/1000277665.jpg)
![1000277669.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfKeiKuAzCTKEyNFhbMY2m8b1fJuVZFyFvd3zQDBqoEAE/1000277669.jpg)
# * #### Paso nro 4 **

>Ahora era el momento de coser la pieza de la liga con la base de la bandana, entonces coloque la pieza de la liga en uno de los lados de la base,de modo que las esquinas vayan doblando hacia la pieza de la liga,yo aguante con un alfiler para que no se soltaran,y después pase a coser muy bien esa parte,luego hice lo mismo con el otro lado.Las costuras no quedan visibles en esa zona, porque después de que cosi le di la vuelta y las costuras no se ven.** > * #### Paso nro 4 > Now it was time to sew the elastic piece to the bandana base. I placed the elastic piece on one side of the base, folding the corners towards the elastic piece. I held it in place with a pin, and then sewed that part very well. I did the same with the other side. The seams aren't visible in that area because after I sewed it, I turned it inside out and the seams are hidden. ---
![1000277675.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPvZYcJSmm9DEyYovBiq1iVHrxmS5Wvy41F2PbnHxkxeA/1000277675.jpg)
![1000277677.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQKxqC9mV4Wc9Tq5jciTK14kmeEzewxZfd5bRr9XPqwdR/1000277677.jpg)
![1000277678.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbzfo9cAXgD46DiDXPAFMg3kC1AdPTTV8utFKvqMFZWaf/1000277678.jpg)
# * #### Paso nro 5 **

>Por último con un pedacito más de tela,para no dejar ya nada de tela cosi un rectángulo más pequeño,para coserlo en la parte del medio de la bandana,y así no se quede simple,y parezca un lazo y no una bandana recta.** > * #### Paso nro 5 > Finally, with a little more fabric, so that no fabric was left, I sewed a smaller rectangle to sew in the middle of the bandana, so that it wouldn't look plain, and would look like a bow and not a straight bandana. --- # *
Resultado|Result

body.title: Замок «Сент-Міклош - Чинаді́ївський замок
body.body:
У відпустці вирішив зробити невеликий тур по закарпатських замках. Деякі з них я відвідував вже не раз, інші — вперше. Крім Ужгородського та Мукачівського замків, цього разу завітав до Замку «Сент-Міклош» у Чинадійово.

https://cdn.rcimg.net/cryptotexty/194591d8/14edd6e570a12ed1008374443463c668.jpg?width=700

Поселення на цьому місці відоме з 1214 року. До радянських часів Чинадійово називалося Сент-Міклош (угорською — Святий Миколай). Чому з’явилася назва «Чинадійово» — достеменно невідомо, існує кілька версій.

Чинадіївську фортецю збудували в XIV столітті барони Перені. Згодом її добудовували графи Телегді. Серед відомих власників — княгиня Ілона Зріні, її син Ференц II Ракоці та графи Шенборни.

https://cdn.rcimg.net/cryptotexty/194591d8/a25432d06ba82e5974449f367f042831.jpg?width=700

Замок часто називають «Замком кохання» через легендарну історію кохання Ілони Зріні та графа Імре Текелі (він був молодшим за неї на 14 років). Кажуть, саме тут вони проводили таємні романтичні зустрічі. Є навіть окрема «спальня Ілони», яку показують туристам.

На двох поверхах замку розташовані експозиції: від давніх артефактів (наприклад, скульптура кельтського божества) до сучасних картин, фотографій та мистецьких інсталяцій. Також є цікаві потаємні ходи, прокладені всередині товстих стін.

https://cdn.rcimg.net/cryptotexty/194591d8/8c5abdb7f44c649dae308baf2d6f3aa7.jpg?width=700

У 2001 році замок віддали в концесію подружжю художників. Разом з однодумцями вони вже чверть століття реставрують споруду, проводять фестивалі та мистецькі заходи. Прямо біля замку я випадково зустрів Йосипа Бартоша — того самого художника, який відроджує цю фортецю. Ми трохи поспілкувалися.

Це справді позитивний приклад того, як приватна ініціатива може дати друге життя історичній пам’ятці. Нещодавнє зацікавлення українцями своєю історією, та зменшення ксенофілії й відчуття меншовартості - напевне збільшить кількість відновлених пам'яток.

Хай цей приклад надихає інших!

body.title: Enjoying a Hidden Gem: The Clear Waters Of Natural Spring Water
body.body:
>

The dry season is a time to think about refreshing destinations. I said this is a hidden gem, but actually, many people have already visited this tourist spot. 

![IMG_E3278.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/23uQnRSrk5QZf6FrP1qH986qUCKGpuVnh7ecqiuNZnQJTDTNb5uxTKPpUqSGHoG89AoS7.JPG)

![IMG_E3290.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/23wMaev3jYaXt1JYvtd8JYHVP1zCth4kUvtiwH4i1EFRXqPdpaf5PETWAYXNQkQgRnXDY.JPG)

![IMG_E3292.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/23w2o86m9nEzYwf1arr9L7yqWC8uDYAKWUDxcvRLrUnnNCXVQYj7fpR4Z9iVkTbNoMAVi.JPG)

It's called \

or Sungai Odo. It's located in Semarang, but far from the city center, so people often refer to it as a hidden gem.

![IMG_3297.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/EoeEtdkWGfGr5a9t2iX9j9nFmRefpP1oZcb5M4xesWjGfUS3ubZT7Z4vJFGw7jv93CY.JPG)


The best way to get here is by motorcycle for easy access. As you approach, the road becomes narrower, surrounded by dense trees. Be careful, the road is slippery.

![IMG_E3263.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/23tvZs1KAoG4F9DPwXuMAVDgit4NeZHgbpVxmY7r5tEEpkx3VRwU4QcE8a226BcfNr5UJ.JPG)


There's an entrance fee of IDR 10,000. After parking my motorbike, I carefully walked down to the river. A sign reading \

appeared.


![IMG_3298.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/EoiVJrUW7VmxpDv7F5AGckCnTYaCcR5Lq1WtQ237WeHtCNXcL8upXU8nibWhDK2vZPa.JPG)


![IMG_E3264.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/23vhuafrizZWy7S5uKgnZJxBCF1UoQQTbWmYruWKiBAPRzTTnQPsEbqwFGL3TPPD5dsx4.JPG)

The river flowed crystal clear, a beautiful bluish-green. With its natural spring water, it's no wonder so many visitors come to cool off, especially during the dry season.



I don't think this is actually a river, but rather a flowing spring. It's managed by the locals. Despite the management's intervention, this area has been left natural, with no pools like modern swimming pools.


![IMG_E3269.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/23wWnuFnpT26TqRi34jW1kJrehZcv8DLDAEYxbGVtXKjgZNWcvQ9F9rxm4gBMiqx7L8uz.JPG)

There are several sections of the spring's flow visible. At the end of the tourist area, there's also a smaller spring with no large pool.

![IMG_E3271.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/23w2j79wG28gJH46yUyUAqjroE8cuMbeyiTtvAysmw5JLpoSzX4bCg77knHggTmatxrYG.JPG)

![IMG_E3272.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/23tmDVCFzVH4yy3ZBnTX4RAPSQrm6errMHoreirBvkBbPNnTHwEvRuU5hnpffZKuK5ni7.JPG)

body.title: Todo en Subida 🚀 [ESP-ENG]
body.body:
![20260530_091238.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielvehe/23zS35q9fN8z8k5XAPaNEPzHaGRT7JBcCtamxbipnsFJfkt4ekYBnunq9SL9Q1L52K7re.jpg)

_________

Saludos a todos, hoy les tengo una sorpresa pero lo dejo para el final.

Corrí en subida, por mi zona, en la ruta más cercana. No tenía ganas de sacar el carro y tampoco muchas fuerzas para hacer la ruta larga de subida, así que me decidí por algo corto y aprovechando la mañana, porque me desperté temprano y no me dio más sueño; aunque salí tiempo después.

El recorrido estuvo relajado, sin mucho esfuerzo, fui despacio. Cuando llegué a la cumbre, el parquecito estaba solo y me provocó entrar. El sol bien fuerte me llamó para que lo recibiera por unos minutos; así que volví a mis viejos hábitos y tomé sol descanso para descargar la estática que tenía acumulada. Es increíble cómo siento una especie de liberación, o podrías decir alivio y bienestar, con tan solo pisar la tierra descanso. Tenía tiempo sin hacerlo.

Como muchos sabrán, esta semana fue increíble porque sucedió un hito en \

y pienso que muy importante en todo Hive. El inicio de la creación de aplicaciones con IA en la blockchain, por parte de estudiantes de bachillerato. Por supuesto que esto no es improvisado, aunque es un MVP, yo primero lo hice para poder enseñarlo. De hecho mi intención era solo hacerlo para la comunidad, no pensaba enseñarlo a los chicos, pero después de ver lo emocionante y poderoso que resulta, no quería dejarlos sin aprender esto.

Les hablo de esto en un post de Hive Run, ya que tengo que anunciar que este es la primera publicación que se hace desde la dapp que diseñé con IA.😁🎉 Es pero que carguen bien las fotos, tienen bastante resolución y pueden ser un poco pesadas. Veamos cómo se comporta esta dapp que está en modo de prueba, con acceso limitado. Si todo sale bien, yo creo que la semana que viene la lanzamos...

# English
Here is the translation into English, maintaining your enthusiastic, grounded, and conversational tone:

Greetings everyone, today I have a surprise for you, but I’ll save it for the end.

I ran uphill, around my area, on the closest route. I didn't feel like taking the car out, nor did I have much strength to do the long uphill route, so I decided on something short, taking advantage of the morning since I woke up early and couldn't fall back asleep—even though I ended up heading out a bit later.

The run was relaxed, without too much effort; I went slow. When I reached the summit, the little park was empty and I felt like going in. The very strong sun invited me to soak it in for a few minutes, so I went back to my old habits and took a sun-break to discharge the static I had built up. It's incredible how I feel a sense of release, or you could say relief and well-being, just by stepping barefoot on the earth. It had been a while since I last did it.

As many of you know, this week was incredible because a milestone took place in \

and I think a very important one for all of Hive: the beginning of high school students creating blockchain applications with AI. Of course, this isn't improvised; even though it's an MVP, I did it myself first so I could teach it. In fact, my original intention was only to make it for the community—I wasn't planning on teaching it to the kids—but after seeing how exciting and powerful it turns out to be, I didn't want to leave them without learning this. I'm telling you about this in a Hive Run post because I have to announce that this is the very first publication made from the DApp I designed with AI! 😁🎉 I hope the photos load well; they have quite high resolution and might be a bit heavy. Let's see how this DApp behaves since it's currently in testing mode with limited access. If everything goes well, I think we'll launch it next week... ______ ![20260530_091744.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielvehe/23xek3qnfdd8MJXG5cvWL385XHXkbQdVQJkVXZ8FmEoDPcpKB4LD3RqjWxPg95VzSxset.jpg) ![20260530_091804.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielvehe/23vhya4b1ghUPUwQ3ENSyTL4SqxakNbxFmXGeCJ9WFgSLc26R2MBchnV87CzfcCx8Cg5A.jpg) ![20260530_093549.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielvehe/23xp8LSDrqW7FgjcbSheniYvCqGjfHXPHGUUevip2eV22JxJY1e2cjWkCKNTdYJnFohHA.jpg) ![20260530_093559.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielvehe/244e81KwwwRC5ewX5NmEZeR2rPtNMXna9Zg2X2C2ZZKZgZx7L2PYhfHwSSXxHUG3xdZiA.jpg) ![20260530_093606.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielvehe/23xVM1m8tD6HiHVg9Vu9FSUP5p9D6ANDrSfckWLWCzqwEBVNn5rVkdVt43Cp8UQxYoNoH.jpg) ![20260530_093611.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielvehe/244oZAqajGozG5Ajh1MjhaF8HUnLP6U9TocpDswFTKXdquemcjVBHm4LuDpLQTfUCZVvu.jpg) ![20260530_094318.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielvehe/EqUdQmsMWiqgEogtin7VkBkewoU4kjhG118tr7Jc75qaQRXY8oQXztEPmYp5TkxExtL.jpg) * * *

body.title: Brain Imaging Study Suggests That Shifting Racial self identity Can Reduce Racial Ingroup Bias in Empathy and Increase Helping Behaviour
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVctEmg3sMUHV1UURvXnaHzZuPT71KgdDcPgQRx6zzUgN/image.png)
> Overview of the four-stage mask training procedure (MTP) using White facial images (A). Panel B presents racial identification scores for the test and control groups in Experiment 1. Means (blue/red) with standard error (SE) bars are shown as strip charts. P ≤ 0.001; n.s., not significant.
Credits: [Science.org](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12017320/figure/F1/)

One of the most compelling studies I've read recently examines the extent of an \

empathy more quickly with those within our own racial/ethnic group than those outside of that group. This has been accepted by social psychologists and a core assumption of multiple race-related theories. 

For years, we thought the ingroup bias was deeply rooted within human nature; however, this groundbreaking research published by the American Association for the Advancement of Science indicates we are much MORE flexible with respect to our empathy filters than we have previously been led to believe.

Our ability to \

our empathy filters becomes clear from this research wherein various participants were presented with a remarkably innovative and creative experiment called Mask Training.

In mask training, participants wore a 3D facial mask of another racial group and looked at their reflection in a mirror or digital screen of their mirrored image for approximately 10 minutes while following guided movements. Because these masks were specifically designed to reflect 3D movements created by all facial expressions, the mask created a sensory illusion of ownership over the face mask.

The researchers found that during this experience there was a change in how people identified themselves racially. Individuals who wore a mask reported more strongly identifying with the race of the face displayed on the mask.

After the experiment, the researchers noted in the brain scan a significant increase in the self-identity regions of the participants' brains. Participants actually began to see the face in the mask as being their own, and because of this, their interaction with individuals from different race(s) yielded significantly more empathy than before mask training took place.

Additionally, mask training created behavioural changes in multiple ways, including an increased likelihood of participants donating money/other resources to individuals from different racial/ethnic backgrounds. 

The research strongly shows that when you alter your self-perception, it fundamentally can change the way you engage with the world around you.

Reference:
Mei, S., Deng, Y., Zheng, G., & Han, S. (2025). Reducing racial ingroup biases in empathy and altruistic decision-making by shifting racial identification. Science Advances. https://doi.org/10.1126/sciadv.adt6207

title.title: A random Saturday morning
title.body:
by isalifestyle on Girly Isabella 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/girlyisabella [![A random Saturday morning](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/72ad3dcc-aaee-4b5e-ae0c-efa38f1463a5.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/urCc1Rp4EgDxxXR7USai2r) 
 
 Yesterday evening was spent traveling, so the body was tired when the night came. Sleep did not come early because there were one or two things to apply for online. The applications took time, and by the time everything was done, it was already *3 AM*. After sleeping late, the morning still came fast. By *7 AM* the eyes were open again. Even though sleep was short, there was work to do at home, so the day started with a general clean up around the surroundings. Sweeping, packing, and putting things in order took some energy, but it made the place neat.

After the cleaning was finished, a few friends called to play football at the field. There was no plan to stay long, but the game became interesting. Running, passing, and laughing with the friends made time move fast. Before anyone noticed, it was already *1 PM*. Coming back from the field, the body was weak and the legs were heavy. Since there was nothing else urgent, the next move was to go to BIT and rest. From *1 PM to 5 PM* sleep took over. Those four hours of rest helped the body recover from the early wake-up, the travel from yesterday, and the football stress.

When sleep ended at 5 PM, hunger was already there. Cooking became the next thing to do. Soup was prepared, and swallow was made to eat with it. The meal was simple, but it tasted good after all the movement in the day. That was basically how the day went — late night with applications, early morning with cleaning, football with friends till afternoon, a long nap at BIT, and then cooking and eating at night. It was swift, it was simple, and the body was tired by the end.
Thanks for visiting  
 ***
[**Check out today's video..!**](https://blurt.media/w/urCc1Rp4EgDxxXR7USai2r)

title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXpuez6bZ5kVLJdtzijethBqWk7zjaGMu2suNA8uDJ73Z/img_3891.png)
_____________________________________________________
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWHEtGSzYNc8APWLMgCv9vZHU1KcVXKJVCWbtG8GHPub7/img_3889.png)
_____________________________________________________

The plan for today was to play eFootball PVP in Division mode, but the network in the room would not cooperate at all. It kept lagging and dropping, so playing online properly was not possible. Since content was needed for the gaming posts, something had to be done. The posts usually cover Steemit Gaming, Cur8, and eFootball, and there was even a thought to try Call of Duty for the day. But the network dissolved too much, so that option was out. In the end, the choice was to just play an exhibition match offline and make something out of it.

Even with the bad network, the match started and a goal came in just a few minutes. That early goal gave some confidence, so the game was played more carefully. Because the connection was unstable and the player was only partially focused, a lower-tier team was picked instead of a strong one. Manchester B, which is Manchester City’s B team, was chosen to play against a tougher opponent. It felt risky using a weaker side, but it also made the match more interesting. Playing with less strength forced better control and smarter moves.

The result was surprising. The match ended 4-0, and it was a clean win. That kind of score had not been recorded before, so it felt like a first. The network problems made everything harder, but the win still came through. It was a rough game because of the lag and the choice of a lower team, but it turned out to be good content in the end. Now there is something solid to post about, and hopefully the network behaves better next time so PVP Division can be played properly.

title.title: 🌊 Finding balance by the ocean
title.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmeEwaCJQhza7KzoN5VnkrpK9MRXmLnrAvzsLHEzZFv8M8/IMG_9162.jpg 

There’s something magical about being near the sea. The sound of the waves, the fresh air, and the feeling of warm sand beneath your feet have a way of making everything slow down for a moment ☀️

As a nutritionist, I spend a lot of time talking about healthy habits, but one thing that often gets overlooked is the importance of rest. Taking a break, disconnecting from daily stress, and allowing yourself to enjoy simple moments is also part of living a healthy life.

Today was one of those days where I felt grateful for the little things. A beautiful view, a peaceful atmosphere, and the reminder that wellness is not only about what we eat, but also about the experiences that nourish our minds and hearts 💙

Sometimes the best thing you can do for yourself is pause, breathe deeply, and appreciate where you are right now.

The ocean always seems to remind me of that.

title.title: A's continue to struggle as they get crushed by the Yankees | J.T. Ginn on the mound for game two
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXAZV4uKdvipr2SETWhmTNs8j3j5bT2HWzmq4hgxvyDFi/1776541685498.png)
[Src](https://www.stickpng.com/img/sports/baseball/major-league-baseball-mlb/oakland-athletics/oakland-athletics-a-logo)

Well, if it wasn't official already, I think it's certainly official now. The A's are in a legit slump. After getting smacked by the Yankees yesterday, the A's have now lost six of their last seven games. 

A's starting pitcher Luis Severino struggled big time and was pulled from the game after just one inning due to shoulder soreness. It turns out he's got a right shoulder strain, and is going to be placed on the 15-day IL. Tough to see for Severino, and kinda wild it happened against his former team. 

Severino's injury comes only days after starting pitcher Aaron Civale was also sent to the 15-day IL due to shoulder tendinitis. So now two starting pitchers are unavailable for a bit, brutal!

This news only seems more spooky during this slump. But hey, better now than later in the year I guess. Hopefully they both recover smoothly. 

Besides the pitching having issues, this offense continues to struggle as well. The A's had eight hits yesterday but just couldn't get runners across home plate nearly enough. Nick Kurtz did hit his 9th homer at least. 

The A's won the first series they played against the Yankees back in April, it would be pretty cool if they could somehow win these next two games and win the season series against them. It won't be easy with how they've looked but ya never know. The Yankees have one of the best pitching rotations in the MLB too. 

J.T. Ginn has had a really strange few starts for the A's. In general he's looked really good but in recent history it's been a bit strange. He nearly had a no-hitter May 18th, and then on the 23rd he looked terrible. But in general, unless he has another bad start I guess, he's trending upwards lately. 

Tonight's a big test for everyone including Ginn. This is a major moment of the season it feels like, with the team slumping and two injured starting picthers. Maybe Ginn can play Superman on the mound, and maybe the offense can produce more, they're certainly due. 

A's, Phillies, and Western Conference Finals Game 7! Fun night ahead.

> Hello everyone, and welcome back! Today I am bringing you the absolute best of the motorsport world as we dive into the incredible Formula 1 race that took place this past weekend at the iconic Circuit Gilles Villeneuve. Situated on the artificial Île Notre-Dame in Montreal, Quebec, this beautiful 4.361-kilometer semi-permanent track gave us a spectacular show. The weekend was heavily shaped by the devastatingly strong pace of the Mercedes-AMG team, who showed immense dominance from the Sprint shootout all the way into the main Grand Prix, initially locking down the top steps of the grid and setting up a fierce internal battle. # Of course, these sophisticated machines do not drive themselves; they would be nothing without the sheer talent behind the steering wheel. George Russell and the young phenom Kimi Antonelli treated us to a beautiful, wheel-to-wheel battle between teammates. They fought relentlessly for every single centimeter of space through every corner, creating an atmosphere so tense that even their race engineers remained completely silent over the radio. Disaster struck on lap 30 when Russell's car suffered a catastrophic power unit failure. The unexpected breakdown forced him to retire, leaving everyone wondering how their thrilling battle would have naturally ended. # The drama in Montreal didn't stop there, as the track also bore witness to a classic clash of titans, reviving an iconic rivalry between world champions. The Dutch Lion, Max Verstappen, and seven-time champion Lewis Hamilton went head-to-head in a breathtaking duel where neither driver gave an inch. While Verstappen held tightly to second place for a long stretch, an excellent, aggressive overtaking maneuver around the outside of the corner allowed Hamilton to snatch the position away. Despite Mad Max raising his pace in the final laps to mount a counter-attack, it wasn't enough to reclaim the spot before the checkered flag. # By the time the race concluded, the podium told a fascinating story of the current grid dynamics. At just 18 years old, Kimi Antonelli secured a stunning victory, marking his fourth consecutive win and cementing his status as a serious championship leader. Right behind him, a renewed Lewis Hamilton locked in another podium finish, looking increasingly adapted to his new Ferrari seat. Meanwhile, Verstappen’s third-place finish signaled a crucial turning point, effectively breaking a recent podium drought for Red Bull. Additionally, Franco Colapinto delivered a stellar performance to finish in a phenomenal P6, proving this season has plenty of surprises left. # Without a doubt, this weekend delivered top-tier racing and plenty of unexpected twists for the fans. As the paddock packs up and prepares for the next legendary stop on the calendar, the excitement for what lies ahead is through the roof. title.title: Why Girls' Education Matters More Than We Often Realize
title.body:
When people talk about education, they usually focus on jobs, careers, and earning money. These things are important, but education has a much bigger role in society. One of the strongest reasons why girls' education matters is that educated women help raise educated and responsible children.
A mother is often the first teacher in a child's life. Before a child enters school, most of what they learn comes from their home. They learn how to speak, behave, respect others, and understand right from wrong. If a mother is educated, she is usually better equipped to guide her children in these early years.
Education gives women knowledge, confidence, and awareness. An educated mother can help her children with homework, encourage them to read books, and understand the importance of learning. She can also teach them critical values such as honesty, kindness, discipline, and responsibility. These lessons shape a child's character and influence their future.
Girls' education is not only beneficial for families but also for entire communities. When girls receive an education, they are more likely to make informed decisions about health, nutrition, and family well-being. They often become role models for younger generations and inspire other girls to continue their studies.
In many parts of the world, including some rural areas, girls still face challenges in accessing education. Poverty, cultural barriers, and lack of educational facilities can prevent them from attending school. However, every girl deserves the opportunity to learn and develop her potential. Education is not a privilege for a few; it is a right for everyone.
There is a popular saying: \

While both boys and girls deserve equal access to education, this saying highlights the powerful influence women have within the home. The knowledge and values they pass on can affect generations.
Educated women are also more likely to participate in community development, support social causes, and contribute to the economy. They become teachers, doctors, entrepreneurs, and leaders who help improve society. Their success benefits not only themselves but also the people around them.
As a society, we should encourage and support girls' education at every level. Parents, communities, and governments all have a role to play in ensuring that girls have access to quality education. Investing in girls' education is one of the most effective ways to build a better future.
In conclusion, girls' education is essential because educated women play a key role in raising and nurturing future generations. They provide guidance, knowledge, and moral values that help children grow into responsible citizens. By educating girls today, we create stronger families, healthier communities, and a brighter tomorrow for everyone.
What are your thoughts on girls' education? Do you think an educated mother has a special role in shaping a child's future? Share your opinion in the comments.

title.title: [ES/EN] Splinterlands – Summer Fun Event 2026: New Ruleset - New skins + Return of the Exemplars
title.body:
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmeEHJAHC2DR2xKEKn1mNLBcQW5FcUZrMUntBowhK9yp3y/Portada%20-%20Summer%20Fun%20Event.png</center>

<center>The summer of **2026** is finally here, and the **Splinterlands** team did not want to miss the opportunity to ignite the arena with a spectacular announcement. The upcoming **2 de junio de 2026** will mark the official landing of the brand-new seasonal event: [**Summer Fun Event**](https://hive.blog/splinterlands/@splinterlands/summer-fun-gift-boxes-are-coming-to-splinterlands), a festivity that promises to shake up our daily routines through the introduction of the coveted **Gift Boxes**, an aesthetic art update for our cards, and, most importantly for all players, an intriguing new ruleset that will reshape decision-making on the battlefield.</center>

><center>El verano de **2026** ya está aquí y el equipo de **Splinterlands** no ha querido perder la oportunidad de encender la arena con un anuncio espectacular. El próximo **2 de junio de 2026** marcará el desembarco oficial del nuevo evento de temporada: [**Summer Fun Event**](https://hive.blog/splinterlands/@splinterlands/summer-fun-gift-boxes-are-coming-to-splinterlands), una festividad que promete sacudir nuestras rutinas diarias a través de la introducción de las codiciadas **Gift Boxes**, una actualización de arte estético para nuestras tarjetas y, lo más importante para todos los jugadores, una nueva e intriga ruleset que reconfigurará la toma de decisiones en el campo de batalla.</center>

### <center>Summer Fun Gift Boxes</center>
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmS8ihzHPLY84hamT59EHJoCyGtsjSrbTi9Qocqcdj865p/2.png</center>

<center>The new event will introduce themed **Gift Boxes** containing multiple assets and skins. These are aimed both at buyers who want to send a gift to their in-game friends or keep them as souvenirs, and at those more focused on the economic aspect who want to get more value for their money and take advantage of these limited-time promotions.</center>

><center>El nuevo evento traerá nuevas **Gift Boxes** temáticas que contendrán múltiples elementos y skins, tanto para los compradores que quieran darle un regalo a sus amigos en el juego o tenerlas de recuerdo, como para los más interesados en el apartado económico que buscan obtener más por su dinero y quieren aprovechar estas promociones de tiempo limitado.</center>

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQMLDCs8usZv3YZmYBrHKRM53PcQ3uNxWMYjhaVvsccC1/Barra%20-%20Skins.png</center>

<center>When discussing the contents of the **Gift Boxes**, we must immediately talk about the skins. Linked to the opening of both these new boxes and traditional reward chests, the event will give absolute prominence to the aesthetic section through a complete set of summer-themed cosmetics.</center>

><center>Inmediatamente, si hablamos del contenido de las **Gift Boxes**, seguido tenemos que hablar de las skins. Ligadas a la apertura de estas cajas y de los cofres de recompensa tradicionales, el evento dará un protagonismo absoluto al apartado estético mediante un set completo de skins veraniegas.</center>

<center>As usual, there will be two main variations: the **Beach Bums** set, available in standard **Gift Boxes**, and the exclusive **Tidebreakers** set, which can only be found inside **Lavish Gift** and **Magnificent Gift** boxes. Both alternatives will completely transform the iconography and artwork of the arena's most iconic creatures to give them a fresh, relaxed, and festive touch.</center>

><center>Y como ya es costumbre, habrá dos versiones: el set **Beach Bums** especial para las **Gift Boxes** estándar, y las **Tidebreakers**, exclusivas de las **Lavish Gift** y las **Magnificent Gift**. Ambas alternativas transformarán por completo la iconografía y el artwork de las criaturas más emblemáticas de la arena para darles un toque fresco, relajado y festivo.</center>

<center>These skins do not just represent a visual achievement to showcase on the battleboards; historically, these limited cosmetics tend to become high-value trading assets once they are no longer distributed. I would have loved to show you all the designs, but so far, I haven't seen them uploaded to the official **Splinterlands** website to analyze and share the individual art of each one.</center>

><center>Estas skins no solo representan un logro visual para exhibir en los tableros de las batallas, sino que, históricamente, este tipo de cosméticos limitados suelen convertirse en activos de gran valor de intercambio una vez que dejan de distribuirse. Me hubiera gustado mostrarles todas las skins, pero por ahora no he visto que se hayan subido a la web de **Splinterlands** para poder verlas y compartirlas mostrando el arte de cada una individualmente.</center>

### <center>Energy Bombs</center>
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQrx18CRbJLc5jGdtkRKJ6uHrJDB4TT6jo97ngKsVJBzH/4.png</center>

<center>This event does not just bring recycled features from past celebrations; it introduces a brand-new item called **Energy Bombs**, which grants **5** points of energy to play in the **Wild** and **Modern** formats. This is a highly interesting idea that I hope can be transferred or obtained through other methods in the future.</center>

><center>Este evento no solo suele traer lo visto en otros eventos, sino que introduce un nuevo elemento llamado **Energy Bombs** que otorga **5** de energía para poder jugar en los formatos **Wild** y **Modern**. Una idea bastante interesante que ojalá se pueda transferir y quizás obtener de otras formas más adelante.</center>

### <center>New Ruleset: Deploying the Exemplars | Nueva Ruleset: Desplegando los Exemplars</center>
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSw63ZCZoi2XD2eX9mLCc99XQFsVHGBEWqrnbPaEeSqjL/5.png</center>

<center>This event brings us a highly interesting new ruleset that finally enables the use of **Exemplars** cards. This was one of the core promises made by the development team, and it redirects player attention back to a mechanic that many might have forgotten.</center>

><center>Este evento nos trae una nueva ruleset muy interesante con la que poder usar las tarjetas **Exemplars**. Esta era una de las promesas del equipo de desarrollo y vuelve a poner la atención de los jugadores en una mecánica que pudo ser olvidada por muchos, pero que puede convertirse en un punto de inflexión para el juego.</center>

<center>As stated when **Exemplars** were first introduced, this feature heavily alters team composition. It allows players to design the exact card their deck needs: from a resilient tank with a specific mana cost, to a support unit that reinforces allies, or a highly aggressive unit designed to eliminate enemies with ease. This can cause a massive shift in the meta and act as the ultimate surprise element in many battles.</center>

><center>Como se dijo cuando se presentaron los **Exemplars**, esta mecánica permite alterar mucho la composición de los equipos al poder diseñar la tarjeta que se necesite en el mazo: desde un tanque resistente con un coste de maná específico, una tarjeta de soporte que refuerce a los aliados, o una unidad muy agresiva que elimine enemigos con facilidad. Esto puede generar un cambio muy grande en el meta o ser el elemento sorpresa de muchas batallas.</center>

<center>Since this ruleset might not appear very frequently and its specific card builds won't be easily visible in past battle logs, reviewing your opponent's match history becomes even more critical to figure out what they might deploy. In fact, some opponents might choose not to use them at all if they haven't upgraded them sufficiently, preferring to stick to traditional cards.</center>

><center>Al no aparecer tan seguido esta ruleset y dado que los diseños específicos no se podrán ver fácilmente en el registro de batallas anteriores, se le da una importancia extra al revisar el historial de los oponentes para intentar averiguar qué pueden usar, o incluso puede que ni los utilicen si no los tienen muy evolucionados, prefiriendo usar otras tarjetas tradicionales.</center>

<center>Honestly, this is one of the rulesets I look forward to the most just to see what kind of **Exemplar** builds players will come up with. It is undoubtedly the most exciting part of this event for me.</center>

><center>Sinceramente, es una de las rulesets que más espero para saber qué clase de diseños de **Exemplar** se les ocurrirán a los jugadores, y es lo que más me emociona de este evento.</center>

---

<center>What about you, players? Are you planning to purchase the seasonal **Gift Boxes** to hunt down the exclusive **Tidebreakers** skins? What kind of custom **Exemplar** card are you planning to unleash on the battlefield once the new ruleset drops? Let me know in the comments below!</center>

><center>¿Y ustedes, jugadores? ¿Tienen planeado adquirir las **Gift Boxes** de la temporada para cazar las skins exclusivas **Tidebreakers**? ¿Qué clase de tarjeta **Exemplar** personalizada están planeando desatar en el campo de batalla una vez que llegue la nueva ruleset? ¡Déjenmelo saber en los comentarios abajo!</center>
