----

**S**ometimes, just sometimes, not always, the town seems to be saying goodbye, or perhaps it already has. And that's reflected in its streets, and I walk by taking photos which, perhaps, have more to do with the past than the present. That's how I end up thinking about \

those usually brief quotes you see on some gravestones in cemeteries, which I, by the way, rarely read... But it could also be about myself and my nihilistic tendencies, which seem to come and visit me from time to time ever since I can remember. Because here in town, there's no shortage of people who tell me, without blinking, looking me straight in the eye: \

... And well, I end up scratching my head and leaving them talking to themselves in the streets with all that optimism which, in the end, seems strange to me. And I usually have my doubts; don't think this is easy. They end up making me doubt even what my photos say and what I observe, and consequently, my own sanity. Because there are many people who approach me and say, \
And well, maybe that's true; perhaps the \
doesn't look so dramatic when photographed, and I'm addicted to drama, who knows... But anyway, whatever the reason, I invite you to continue reading this article and appreciate these \

which I sometimes, just sometimes, find in the streets...\n\n>**A**lgunas veces, solo algunas veces, no siempre; el pueblo parece despedirse o ya haberse despedido. Y eso se refleja en sus calles, y yo paso por allí haciendo fotos las cuales, quizás, tienen más que ver con el pasado que con el presente. Así es como termino pensando en \

, esas usualmente breves citas que se ven en algunas lápidas en los cementerios, las cuales yo, por cierto, rara vez leo... Pero también puede tratarse de mí mismo y de mi manía nihilista, la cual parece venir y visitarme de vez en cuando desde que tengo uso de razón. Porque aquí en el pueblo no faltan quienes me digan, sin pestañar, mirándome a los ojos: \

... Y bueno, yo termino rascándome la cabeza y dejándolos hablando solos en las calles con todo ese optimismo que, a la postre, ya me parece extraño. Y por lo general dudo, no crean que es fácil esto; pues terminan haciéndome dudar incluso de lo que mis fotos dicen y yo observo, también por ende de mi cordura. Porque es que hay muchos y se acercan y me dicen: \
. Y bueno, puede que sea cierto; a lo mejor es que lo \
no luce tan dramático cuando se le fotografía y yo soy un adicto a los dramas, quién sabe... Pero bien, sea como sea, los invito a continuar adelante en este artículo y apreciar estos \

, los cuales algunas veces, solo algunas veces, encuentro en las calles... ---- ![T01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23xemsoNhYn5ovkNmkAcghHcbvyT7BcN27adUbhY9sZRK4BFMXkaX91m47qfhE9F5m2fR.jpg) **📷 01 - Es hermoso cómo los lazos que creamos con nuestras mascotas pueden transformarse en un pilar tan importante en nuestras vidas.
Tus gatos no solo son una compañía, sino un apoyo emocional invaluable que te ayuda a enfrentar los días difíciles.

Sigue cuidándolos y permitiendo que sean tu refugio, pero también recuerda cuidar de ti mismo, porque eres el corazón de ese hogar lleno de amor.

title.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1780179404680-4f5bf21bf582a604.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=davidnollearth/062e3b30)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=davidnollearth/062e3b30)


---

This is the video series for an oil painting 'Wisteria' I did from 2016-2020.  The painting was destroyed in 2021 due to a number of reasons, but mainly: the painting's faulty experimental linseed-epoxide substrait, Covid-19 crushing lockdowns, extreme poverty, family attacks and ongoing US government (Big Tech + Big Media) censorship of me and my 30 years of artwork.

Its not ideal to not be able to show this piece, but I still gained the knowledge of how to do it and invented several useful oil painting mediums & varnishes used in its creation which never yellowed and still cannot be bought anywhere.

I am posting these videos for posterity and for people that are interested in seeing an oil painting created from start to finish in the Baroque style evolved for the 21st century.  I also must have deleted some of the initial videos when I did the quick underpainting, but what still exists, I give to you.

I hope this can be an educational experience as no gallery will show any of my controversial art even today.

---

title.body:
Bared teeth. 


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR2EA9dww4W69KWbrCfpvd1DgrHNdEE3oBzgGYAuntr4j/1780179654111.jpg)


Saturday market. Sweat on my neck. Tomato seller: “Last price, 2000 naira.” 

I smiled. Polite. Then I bared my teeth. 

Not my Pepsodent morning smile. Not clean teeth for fruit salad. This was different. This was survival teeth. Market teeth. 

“Abeg make we talk truth,” I said, teeth showing. “Sunday stew must enter my pot.” 

He bared his teeth back. Laughed. The whole market did it - buyers, sellers, children. Teeth as weapons. Teeth as shields. 

Morning I brushed them. Now I’m using them to bargain. 

Bared teeth = anger. Laughter. Hunger. “Don’t cheat me.” 

5 minutes later: 1500 naira tomatoes and a lesson. Sometimes you must bare your teeth to win. But wash them after 😂



I’m @nc6 Love how 2 words create full stories here.

so,What does “bared teeth” mean to you? Anger, smile, or survival? 👇

title.title: Hunter Assassin, The Ultimate Action Mobile Game You Need to Try
title.body: Hello Gaming Hive Community.\n\nI will love to introduce you all to an incredibly addictive mobile game I have been hooked on to lately. It is by name \

, developed by Ruby Games. If you are a fan of stealth, strategy, and fast paced action, this one is definitely worth adding to your rotation.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW28YYCqgv2tzSArbkQMivdpDBT7rxKDntqgekSukTkia/1780179435011.jpg)

The premise is simple but highly engaging. You play as a lone assassin navigating through various map layouts, tasked with eliminating enemies one by one.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTsxF2QBEs5hSa2qLp3tdvQYmYS5CCUb9fLy6JEGHwcrM/1780179460671.jpg)

There is a catch that keeps things intense. Your enemies are heavily armed with guns and flashlights, while you are equipped with nothing but a trusty knife. Success relies entirely on patience and timing. You have to shadow your targets, stay out of their flashlight beams, and strike quietly from behind. If you get spotted, they will open fire, and your health drops fast.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUnsCuMMHNVRqAjFJmnEx9K1i8Ce6auc1z7c9fZByA1XM/1780179486321.jpg)

What I love most about Hunter Assassin is its scaling difficulty. The controls are incredibly intuitive, which means just tap to move and attack making it easy to pick up, but it gets surprisingly challenging as you advance.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYqvAqKS9TzMz1Fz7cMXBfgEFmCGWj813npQJZSW1an8u/1780179511113.jpg)

I am currently sitting at Level 30 and the maps have become much more complex, requiring actual tactical planning. To keep up with the rising difficulty, the game allows you to upgrade your characters and weapons. I have already maxed out my gear to the highest level, which gives a great sense of progression and power as you slice through tougher stages.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXXubCGKWdgzAi4nV7kTCjHxwkfD3Eq3EkQaBEbaquRE8/1780179532877.jpg)

My young brother introduced me to the game a while back, and it quickly became my go to choice for killing time. It is the perfect just one more round type of game that keeps you entertained for hours without feeling repetitive. Because I have been enjoying it so much, I thought it was only right to pass the recommendation along to this awesome community.

Have any of you played Hunter Assassin before? What level are you currently on, and what is your favorite strategy for clearing crowded rooms?

Let us discuss in the comments below.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbiKRwe8kub6pZpm9Aas4uA4faMjUXi3kssCoLZmysoYR/image.png) [Joshua Gresham](https://images.unsplash.com/flagged/photo-1558837348-248f4f6dc86c?q=80&w=1170&auto=format&fit=crop&ixlib=rb-4.1.0&ixid=M3wxMjA3fDB8MHxwaG90by1wYWdlfHx8fGVufDB8fHx8fA%3D%3D) Sandra’s bared teeth are hilarious. She started losing teeth at age five. At some point, her mother's friend will always cajole her by shouting Sandra, say cheese.” Knowing that once she says cheese, she bares her teeth. Every time she sees me at the church, she runs to meet me, telling me that she has lost another tooth. When I ask her what she did with the teeth, she will happily say that her mother used the teeth to buy bean balls for her. Other times, she would say her mum had thrown the teeth onto their roof so that the Lizard would swallow the teeth and cause her own to grow. At some point, Sandra lost her smile because of her missing teeth. She was also tired of baring her teeth. Suddenly, everybody moved on and forgot about Sandra’s lost teeth. People also stopped asking her to bare her teeth. However, one Sunday, after the church service, Sandra happily ran to me, shouting aunty, aunty while she happily bared her teeth. I glanced through, joyfully embraced, and lifted her in celebration of the victory. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQKQuHfNRsZB5fKF5a6sbJeZd2M5qhkBshFbHk9P4PMkU/image.png) [Dmitry Rodionov](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1738747727021-a07e5ae4dab0?q=80&w=687&auto=format&fit=crop&ixlib=rb-4.1.0&ixid=M3wxMjA3fDB8MHxwaG90by1wYWdlfHx8fGVufDB8fHx8fA%3D%3D) Sandra bared her teeth for me, and it showed that all her teeth were fully intact, nothing missing, nothing broken. title.title: El teatro de las marionetas olvidadas
title.body:
Las calles están oscura, y el teatro está iluminado a punto de iniciar. Un pequeño niño llamado Samuel estaba jugando con su juguete y nota que en una esquina hay una puerta abierta, el niño curioso decide correr a ver qué había dentro, y lo que vió, lo dejo con las manos temblorosa.
Adentro había un montón de marionetas que parecían como si estuvieran destruidas, no tenían un ojo, otros sin brazos y solamente había uno que estaba completo. Samuel estaba a punto de salir y derrepente un señor cierra la puerta: —Que haces aquí pequeño, en tu casa no te han enseñado que nunca hay que entrar a un lugar desconocido —. Dice el señor.
________________________________________________
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVG6kN7gfwrhBJqMnKgoYAmwvUcVKXPMgRvWeEXQKG8KK/1780178041545.png)

Samuel queda impactado y decide huir, pero la marioneta que estaba completa cae al suelo: —hola pequeño, se te ha perdido algo?—. Dice la marioneta.
__________________________________________________
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVo3PPx63e2UnXjqCQirTtGY9tHhTtXT9piK2cTNDzEbY/1780178184255.png)

Samuel se asusta y estaba rodeado, a la marioneta se le empieza a crecer una sonrisa grande, y empieza a reírse cruelmente — Es hora de enseñarle a este pequeño mocoso, donde no se tiene que meter—. El niño ruega por qué no le hiciera daño, y la marioneta lo toma por la espalda riéndose, de pronto se escucha un disparo desde lejos.
¡Pum!

La marioneta gira su cabeza y ve como su creador se estaba desangrando poco a poco, cayendo por el impacto de un arma, al centro estaba una mujer:la mamá de Samuel.

Samuel sale corriendo hacía su madre, y la marioneta se ríe escalofriantemente: —vaya, vaya entonces llegó la heroína, por desgracia tu papel no te va a durar mucho, y tenlo por seguro, que vos y tu mocoso morirá este mismo día —. Dice la marioneta y se abalanza hacía ellos.
__________________________________________________
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeaqAwwBNKzNCzdGpFfjjT3q33D5mx7JBYN5GzkzhqkTY/1780178017884.png)

La mujer dispara y la marioneta cae destrozado, y sin alma, la mujer se alegra de ver a su hijo vivo y le dice: hay dios mío Samuel, cuántas veces te he dicho que no te alejes de mí hijo, por favor promete que no lo volverás hacer —.

 Dice la madre.
Samuel asiente con los ojos llorosos y se abrazan.
__________________________________________________

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSPhRk5oWcASikyQ4HRzdK4SK43hNmgNd1XgWVucnEhfX/1780178352991.png)

title.title: I LOVE MAGIC!
title.body:
![109243f7-e688-4389-97a1-3df6e76fa156.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYZzbnM3oGxgbUqxNAovcAkivS43EXdVjq8LTmHyEHS5g/109243f7-e688-4389-97a1-3df6e76fa156.png)

What seems more logical?
A scientific theory of evolution supported by experiments, genetics, fossils, observable evidence, and used every day in modern medicine, agriculture, and animal breeding...
Or a story about a magical old man who molded humans from clay and brought them to life with magic?
Which explanation better fits the world we actually observe?

Of course, not all religious people or even not even all christians believe that the story of Adam and Eve is a literal historical account. Many see it as a metaphor, a symbolic story about human nature, morality, and our place in the world.
But that raises an interesting question: where is the line between metaphor and history?

If Adam and Eve are symbolic, what about Noah's Ark? The Exodus? The Resurrection? At what point does a biblical story stop being a metaphor and become a real event?
Different believers draw that line in different places, which is why these discussions continue till this day. And yet millions of people around the world still accept many of these stories as literal truth.

The question is not whether faith has value. The question is - how we decide which parts of an ancient religious text are symbolic lessons and which parts describe actual history? The question is - what tools we should use to test it?

title.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1780177206272-6934d6ab54d7e8e4.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=davidnollearth/784f03f6)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=davidnollearth/784f03f6)


---

This is the video series for an oil painting 'Wisteria' I did from 2016-2020.  The painting was destroyed in 2021 due to a number of reasons, but mainly: the painting's faulty experimental linseed-epoxide substrait, Covid-19 crushing lockdowns, extreme poverty, family attacks and ongoing US government (Big Tech + Big Media) censorship of me and my 30 years of artwork.

Its not ideal to not be able to show this piece, but I still gained the knowledge of how to do it and invented several useful oil painting mediums & varnishes used in its creation which never yellowed and still cannot be bought anywhere.

I am posting these videos for posterity and for people that are interested in seeing an oil painting created from start to finish in the Baroque style evolved for the 21st century.  I also must have deleted some of the initial videos when I did the quick underpainting, but what still exists, I give to you.

I hope this can be an educational experience as no gallery will show any of my controversial art even today.

---

But you know, I can't just do it this easily, so I escaped next. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcURMswrtZCRmtZZzyShJLUcFPCXf8wm116qfDVZFAJhQ/screenshot_9_.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRSiT6fkcZmZ3mh6BTnxmcmuBLdD64Uiyhx3fTivMjiYx/screenshot_10_.jpg) After diving underwater, I climbed up that ladder, and then the tower when the captain was returning to the tower as well. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmP9RJf9JkniwyoZpgPJnLpJwt4NWsN3e2Uc9v6s6D3WAt/screenshot_11_.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYVm1YKzAiu3fLBxj9nQAgjv2XhY5Tm1uhx9LmeDXkJa4/screenshot_12_.jpg) I reached on top before the captain did, and when he stood at his watch position, I went toward him and I damaged him again. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV1sGdNZF1ZrYbnkdBa9mGgDCjxQgcjVyyxZdQELTysA8/screenshot_13_.jpg) I noticed there was this zipline before I even climbed up. And I already planned that I would try this zipline to escape the wrath of that captain after damaging him. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRE6fyq5UY3sPXYAWApWUWZTvARBD4ncnk5sJCGZVZ23S/screenshot_14_.jpg) When the captain was looking around for me, I noticed there was a Phylake not so far. title.title: Different Shoes, Different Journey to Greatness: LOH- Contest #290
title.body: Hello ladies, @ladiesofhive community. It is my pleasure to be here again to share my thoughts on  this week’s topic; \n\n\

Come to think of it, i have never wished or thought about swapping life with anybody, whether famous or not famous. I really admired and appreciate every one that has worked their way to the top, but for me, i will choose myself over and over again.

Instead of wishing to swap my life with someone else, i prayed to reach that place of purpose and fulfilment, where i am successful in my own being.

Not because i do not admire the successful people or appreciate the beautiful lives they live , but because i believe every individual was created by God to fulfil a unique purpose. Therefore, i will never desire or wish to fulfil another person's purpose but my God-given purpose.

Notwithstanding, every life carries it own burden. Many times,we admire people from a distance, their growth, achievement, success, and the beautiful life they showcase for us to see. Yet behind every famous life, there are pains, sacrifices, and battles both seen and unseen. Hence, the courage and the strength to overcome those challenging  phases are given differently.

The story of King Saul and David in the bible explains life perfectly. When David wanted to go to war, Saul ordered that  his armour be placed on David. But after  putting it on, he was unable to  move comfortably on it because it wasn't meant for him. Saul and David were wired differently to fulfil different purposes. Both were kings, both fulfilling purposes, not trying to be like each other.

 And that is exactly how life is.

Our shoes are different, even if another person's shoe were given to me to wear, i dont think i will have the capacity to carry them  comfortably because those shoes were designed for their journey not mine.

This is the reason i want to be my self, grow into the person God has called me to be, spiritually grounded, solution driven, mentally active, financially stable, emotionally stable, purposeful, creating impact, doing what i was created to do whether famous or not, not in the image of another person but in the fullness of who am really am.

Life is better and most fulfilled when you become your true self instead of trying to become a copy of someone else.

Thank you to the judge of the week, @saffisara for this week’s #contest 

Thank you for stopping by my blog, @pascalukandy 


#lifeofanursingmother

title.title: K-IX (Part-I : chapter 1)
title.body:
If you enjoyed my novel [Ragnarok Conspiracy](/fiction/@pibara/ragnarok-conspiracy-index), today I'm starting with a short chapter for a new novel, K-IX. A Sci-fi story about secrets, alien civilications and cosmic level destruction. As before, I'm writing and publishing my fiction HIVE-first. But also as before, what you get here is a work in progess, a draft that needs work. If you like to be part of my journey, stick around and follow my **K-IX** posts.  There might be some time between posts because **Merg-E** and **CoinZdense** are my priority over fiction writing right now.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pibara/23uFPFhWMKDL4kpJG3GK6NmsNhij8CX8SGFoQ1fSodTdUar5vW1SxytGkneTNgoQ3DT1n.png)

# Part I
## Chapter 1

*EdinBurgh May 2046*

“It’s not real!” Max insisted, and he didn’t care what Patricia thought, “Bianca is basically gen-Alpha, she grew up counting fingers, so how is she going to tell real from fake. There is no such thing as aliens!”

Patricia looked at him and sighed, and the look on her face made it clear to Max that she thought he was stupid.

“Bianca is old, but she is not ‘that’ old, she is only five years older than me, and you are two and a half years older than me too. If she is an Alpha, then so are you!”

Max looked at Patricia, he knew he was right, the aliens were AI, even if they managed to set up a life stream on every old school platform, no, “because” the lifestream was on all old school platforms, they were catering even to the Gen-Z dinosaurs still stuck on TikTok of all places.

“If it is real, why are neither of the Web 5.0 lattices chopping it?, while it’s all over QwenNet. Sure Bianca believes it, she has a QwenBox in her damn bedroom, she is an Asidrone”.

Patricia was visually getting agitated about Max’s comment about her sister.

“Bianca is no drone!” said Patricia, while grabbing Max’s hair at the top back of his head, “You take that back Max Bradfield!, you take that back ot I’m going to lick your face!”. Patricia pulled back his head a little bit, but Max wasn’t going to let a 12 year old girl get the better of him, he grabbed her hand and drove the nail of his middle finger into her wrist and Patricia quickly let go and took two steps back.

“Bianca’s QwenBox isn’t wired in Max, it’s not part of QwenNet, and she is not part of the ASI cult. She is a Beta, Max, a Beta like us, she isn’t even an agiphile like our parents are, she only has the old QwenBox because she is insecure. She is just a Grimhildite,  so if she said the aliens are real, the aliens are real!”

“Think for a minute, Patricia, why would two lone aliens come to earth and demand an audience with the United Nations to address the entire planet? And how on earth would the entire UN agree with that if they haven’t been able to agree on anything since emperor Vance invaded Canada back in ‘28”

Max looked at Patricia, and she just looked back at him the same way she looked at asidrones, the fools giving up 70% of their inference to the Storm, praying to a moving master node. Max looked at Patricia again. Was he wrong? Was he the one caught in a Web 5.0 bubble this time?

##### Hi everyone :)

Today I present another small gem collected from the stream bed in the mountains very close to my house.
Fortunately, there are many specimens ready to be scrutinized by my camera lens :)
This specimen is much lighter than those presented recently in previous sessions, but no less detailed.
In this first phase, it is possible to visualize the piece in its entirety and some nuances of its relief and composition, with special focus on the characteristic tonality of the different compounds that make up this gem.
In the next session, I will increase the scale and we will see the result :)

---

Among the numerous techniques available for macro photography, this method is arguably the most cost-effective and efficient for individuals possessing a camera with a removable lens. By simply detaching the lens and reversing its direction, and employing an inversion ring, the process becomes more manageable and streamlined.

<center><sub>F-stop: F/4 | Exposure time: 1/1250 sec. | ISO speed: ISO 100</sub></center>

---

##### Session Purpose
The goal of these macro photography sessions is to capture images with as much detail as possible within the capabilities of the technique used, always focusing on the meticulous observation and documentation of all visual characteristics and details. Furthermore, I aim to create attractive visual compositions for publication on this blog, seeking to share the beauty and complexity of this work.

---

##### Used equipments
Camera: Canon EOS 600D Digital SLR with CMOS sensor
Lens: EFS 18-55mm with f/5 maximum aperture, allowing shallow depth of field and capturing fine details.
Used inverter ring
Tripod: not used
Lighting: Adjustable LED lights to provide soft, even lighting, avoiding harsh shadows and highlighting the details of structures.

##### Camera Settings
Focus Mode: Manual focus to ensure precision in specific details of the structure.
Aperture: Variable aperture between f/4 and f/5 for adequate depth of field, ensuring all important details are in focus.
ISO: Low ISO setting (100) to minimize noise in images.
Shutter Speed: Adjust shutter speed as needed to avoid underexposure, while maintaining a value that allows you to capture sharp details.

---

To finish, i leave you with some considerations regarding these photo sessions:

> Observing all these pieces through macro photography reveals a fascinating dimension and breadth, full of minute details that ultimately assume significant importance in the visual composition. The complexity of these objects, when viewed from this perspective, takes on a beauty that is often overlooked by the indifference of the eye. The essence of macro photography lies in its ability to elevate ordinary objects to extraordinary levels, offering an intimate and captivating perspective.

The session is closed for today.
Hope you like it :)

body.title: Officiating Intense Semi-Final Games in Mabolo, Cebu City
body.body:
Good day hivers !
Just sharing  my journey as a referee in officiating intense semifinal games Barangay Mabolo , Cebu City. 
In Semifinal game , the intensity of the game is like championship  game because every team wanted to advance in the finals . So, they really wanted to win. Once the team advances to finals , only two option outcomes , either to become champion or second . So, either team will be receiving  sure prizes ,that is why, reaching the championship game is the goal for every team .

body.title: All day in the garage
body.body:
Unfortunately, I didn’t get many steps in today. I didn’t have much time for exercise, as I was wrestling with some furniture at a friend’s place and then with my car. I spent about nine hours in the garage replacing a few parts in the engine. The worst bit was removing the coolant radiators. I got burnt to a crisp. Once the job was done, everything was stinging. >Dziś niestety kroków było mało. Nie miałem zbyt wiele czasu na sport, gdyż walczyłem z meblami u kolegi, a później z samochodem. Siedziałem w warsztacie około 9 godzin wymieniając kilka rzeczy w silniku. Najgorzej było wyciągnąć chłodnice płynu. Spaliłem się jak rak. Po zakończonej pracy wszystko mnie piekło. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/786df03a-bfc9-40bf-8fb7-1bdaf261a4ec.jpg) My new bike has arrived, so there’ll be more about trips like this soon. I’ve actually ordered two. The second one is for my girlfriend, so we can organise trips together. Buying the bike was quite a struggle. Generally, it was hard to find anything in terms of parts and their availability. >Przyszedł nowy rower do mnie, więc niedługo będzie więcej o takich wyprawach. zamówiłem ogólnie dwa. Drugi dostanie moja wybranka, aby wspólnie organizować wycieczki. Z zakupem roweru było dosyć ciężko. Ogólnie ciężko było coś znaleźć pod kątem części i ich dostępności. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/eb493ed4-5d36-44d5-a11d-b410e0abce50.jpg) At the end of the day, I went to visit my parents, where I had dinner and finally got some rest. It was a really enjoyable and busy day. Unfortunately, there was no time for any proper sport, although wrestling with a car could count as sport. Have a lovely day! >Na koniec dnia pojechałem odwiedzić rodziców, gdzie zjadłem kolację i w końcu odpocząłem. Dzień był naprawdę udany i pracowity. Niestety bez czasu na większy sport, chociaż siłowanie się z samochodem można podciągnąć jako sport. Życzę miłego dnia!

body.title: Hope is not a Business Model
body.body:
I'm spending possibly too many hours in front of a screen, but no matter how hard I hit the road, it still feels like I'm too far away from where I want to be. It's a delicate balance, I admit. One that I struggle to find. Enjoying your life, and I mean that literally, while also keeping yourself accountable for your reality.


![a887a30a-2545-4417-9f87-c9d2a63d380f.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/meno/23xedS3NDjnKjaFmz7zFTptZpgGBxa7ix8T6KW6f1oeBsTKUt3x9GDth6SHWEEGs8kJ1g.png)


Over the past few weeks, however, I've had a lot of time to think about my current \

Please note the air quotes.

For a long time, many of us held onto the same idea. The markets would eventually turn around, greener pastures would emerge, and we'd finally be able to breathe a little easier. Maybe even enjoy some relief, if not outright joy.

Lately, though, I've started to question whether that plan, if I can even call it a plan, is realistic. Worse, I wonder if it's actually self destructive.

To be clear, I'm not quitting or anything of the sort. After nine years in this place, the crab bucket is too deep for my short claws. But I am taking a very serious look at where I'm investing my time and energy.

I need to become bear resistant.

It can't be that even if the market eventually turns around, I find myself right back in this exact position a year or two later. That's not sustainable. I suspect my liver isn't particularly fond of the arrangement either.

As much as it pains me to say it, I may have to conclude that the plan of simply living off crypto is not a particularly smart one.

About a year ago, I started working on a Point of Sale system. My goal was to help push the HBD economy forward. In that sense, it worked. But beyond that, not much happened.

Recently, though, I think I've identified a gap in the market. More importantly, I believe I've identified potential clients who actually need a solution. That's where my attention is heading now.

Is the world becoming one giant SaaS subscription?

It certainly seems that way. Then again, maybe that's exactly what people want. I'm not entirely sure.

What I do know is that I've been doing a lot of research, having a lot of conversations, and speaking with my first potential clients. Hopefully, I'll have some wins to report on that front soon.

A short description of the idea would be this: imagine something analogous to WordPress, but focused on image management and Point of Sale systems. A flexible core platform, extended through plugins that adapt to different needs and workflows. Something versatile enough to bend to the user's requirements rather than forcing the user to adapt to it.

Am I onto something?

I think so.

But this is one climb I suspect I'll be making by myself.

MenO

Not every day needs a complicated plan.

Sometimes all it takes is a comfortable outfit, a little confidence, and the decision to enjoy the moment. 💫

I loved how this look came together because it mixes casual and elegant pieces in a way that feels natural. The white top keeps everything simple, while the camouflage skirt adds a bit of personality and makes the outfit stand out without trying too hard.

Lately, I've been reminding myself that confidence doesn't come from wearing the most expensive clothes or following every trend. It comes from feeling comfortable with who you are and expressing yourself in your own way.

These little photo sessions have become one of my favorite ways to document my journey. Looking back at old pictures reminds me how much I've grown, not only in style but also in mindset. Every day is another opportunity to become a stronger, happier version of myself.

Thank you for joining me on this adventure and for always supporting my content. 🤍✨

Lepe stvari vredi ponavljati. Lepe misli, lepe fotografije, lepe trenutke...

Prozori na restoranu Stambolijski u Nišu plene svojim izgledom u svako doba dana i tokom svih godišnjih doba.

body.title: Museo Moderno
body.body:
***In Buenos Aires, in the San Telmo neighborhood, you'll find the Museum of Modern Art. I like to visit it often because there's always something interesting to see. I especially recommend it to tourists visiting my city. It's a very large space, with several floors accessible by stairs, although there's also an elevator. On the ground floor, next to the entrance, there's a very pleasant café. This is the entrance, the museum's lobby. The café is located behind the circular window you see there.***

En Buenos Aires, en el barrio de San Telmo, se encuentra el Museo Moderno. Me gusta visitarlo con frecuencia porque siempre hay algo interesante para ver. Se lo recomiendo especialmente a los turistas que visitan mi ciudad. Es un espacio muy grande, con varias plantas a las que se puede acceder por escaleras, aunque también cuenta con ascensor. En la planta baja, junto a la entrada, hay una cafetería muy agradable. Esta es la entrada, el hall del museo. La cafetería se encuentra detrás de la ventana circular que vemos allí.

![01-DSCN3762-web.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/parissousa/EorzpTyFE5M1jSWh9ugN8tGPLzaFZfRkjnUF2mXvKbGnNwTNGYnSDsbFyGbHQUEvCTE.jpg)

***Upon reaching the top of the stairs, we found ourselves in a space with several rooms housing temporary exhibitions. It's a pleasure to visit it from time to time, as there's always something new to discover.***

Ya subiendo las escaleras nos encontramos con un espacio con varias salas que albergan exposiciones temporarias. Por eso es muy agradable visitarlo cada tanto, porque siempre nos encontramos con nuevas cosas.

![02-DSCN3786-web.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/parissousa/Ep5o9o668X457ipCPvJaWqF9Gi6KE9R32cFPZ5fcahKCnTrmnnYECegrEZ2HLqP5oE8.jpg)

![03-DSCN3765-web.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/parissousa/EoiUFEJq5eusHdQVEiFMZpdpxkaC5rrtzjviiBv6GLaGRn9R9gYtDCV2u6Pv7coTX6y.jpg)

![04-DSCN3764-web.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/parissousa/Eq5FzKaLPPKapdSpTvatL7X7jZ1hXKRASSEx74VSUVfcyMscB6kKyLTJzSMJEuhTUok.jpg)

***I was telling you that I often visit this museum. I've already written about it before, but this time I want to show you the artist I discovered on my last visit. His name is Sergio De Loof, an artist I was previously unfamiliar with. Well… unfamiliar to me, because I soon realized he's quite a well-known artist with a very significant career. His work surprised me with its originality.***

Les contaba que suelo visitar este museo con frecuencia. Ya en otra ocasión hice una publicación sobre él, pero esta vez quiero mostrarles al artista que descubrí en mi última visita. Se trata de Sergio De Loof, un creador que hasta entonces me era desconocido. Bueno… desconocido para mí, porque pronto entendí que se trata de un artista bastante reconocido, con una trayectoria muy importante. Su obra me sorprendió por su originalidad.

![05-DSCN3768-web.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/parissousa/EpNpngG4M9uqkySFLyMsQdWPbkM4SWBRaSGE7iCMa8EgsdimJn7M2kxQ7eXCpNpc12r.jpg)

***Sergio De Loof was an Argentine artist closely linked to the underground scene in Buenos Aires. Self-taught and multifaceted, he worked as a set designer, designer, painter, photographer, and interior designer. What made his work special was his use of materials that society often considers cheap, disposable, or worthless. His famous Fashion Happenings featured unconventional models dressed in garments made from trash, repurposed objects, or donated clothing. De Loof was a pioneer in transforming the marginal into art and fashion, turning recycling into his own creative language.***

Sergio De Loof fue un artista argentino muy ligado al mundo del under en Buenos Aires. Autodidacta y multifacético, trabajó como escenógrafo, diseñador, pintor, fotógrafo y ambientador. Lo que hacía especial su obra era el uso de materiales que la sociedad suele considerar baratos, descartables o sin valor. En sus famosos Fashion Happenings desfilaban modelos poco convencionales, vestidos con prendas hechas de basura, objetos reutilizados o ropa donada. De Loof fue un pionero en transformar lo marginal en arte y moda, convirtiendo el reciclaje en un lenguaje creativo propio.

![06-DSCN3766-web.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/parissousa/EoK5mJxocjKygM8PXggxgUt2bnj5V5bpeGvQashcCkomRgh7trEJDUUWfKRocWAcToz.jpg)

![07-DSCN3767-web.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/parissousa/EoK6nA8JtKHSoinaRnARYbffHJmJPPuaaNp9sPRqtETpFzgkf6JGgkTZSU3kTTDmkoA.jpg)

![08-DSCN3772-web.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/parissousa/EpEHqhXu7vSAXghEwCAMF5xQAvkUfSqnWjfcomqkYz5PBRxm3cKqz3pktzQuLB7UF95.jpg)

***His work reflected a critical view of Buenos Aires' urban culture. De Loof was a key figure in the 1980s and 90s. Here are some details of his models.*** Su trabajo reflejaba una mirada crítica sobre la cultura urbana de Buenos Aires. De Loof fue una figura clave de los años 80 y 90. Aquí les muestro unos detalles de sus modelos.

![09-DSCN3771-web.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/parissousa/EoGyM8MRdYjXq6BhxUM7hpoxALq2LF8SqpVXzEZn29R8AsiwDi7neoYRChXQcze5Giq.jpg)

![10-DSCN3770-web.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/parissousa/EoiWkPBraeeQ3eWTAQA5bXUUhbb8VgK6cisAxSfNgmnkqHpAVfVLQavF5B62HE5GUV7.jpg)

![11-DSCN3773-web.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/parissousa/EoeFQt16kxN2aM4wSiER9VKA8FBNqoDp4v6YeF6wmXimcHPAV1PmtNKNfNDZpySRCes.jpg)

***In the center of the room stand these strange girls, who immediately draw attention. Around them, on the museum walls, hang paintings by various Argentine artists, creating an interesting contrast. The scene is striking: the figures in the middle seem to be conversing with the works that surround them, generating a strange atmosphere. It's as if the museum has transformed into a meeting place for different art forms.***

En el centro de la sala se encuentran estas extrañas chicas, que llaman la atención de inmediato. Alrededor, en las paredes del museo, cuelgan pinturas de distintos artistas argentinos, creando un contraste interesante. La escena resulta llamativa: las figuras en el medio parecen dialogar con las obras que las rodean, generando un ambiente extraño. Es como si el museo se transformara en un espacio de encuentro entre diferentes formas de arte.

![12-DSCN3769-web.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/parissousa/EowGCAMr4xvEL2Q9MBGvVxoD72AsqFKD5zCVW85VeaVXwZ6RGb5PbeHpHk9k6KhvZYM.jpg)

***One of the paintings we see behind the De Loof mannequins is by Alfredo Prior, an Argentinian painter. The work we see is called \

and dates from 1995. The technique is acrylic and enamel on canvas.***

Una de las pinturas que vemos detrás de los maniquíes de De Loof, es de Alfredo Prior, pintor argentino. La obra que vemos se llama La entrada del color en Venecia y es de 1995. La técnica es acrílico y esmalte sobre tela.

![13-DSCN3776-web.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/parissousa/EpvjtGSwmkw8HABUdsKq7Tqpatrg6guR9fkBBR3yruZKcmYBnRZZADcfjVaprqbtxSc.jpg)

***The work is presented as a diptych, divided into two very distinct parts. On the right side, the composition is simpler and with few details. In contrast, the left side is full of elements: from a distance it appears as a confusing jumble, but upon closer inspection, a multitude of figures and scenes gradually reveal themselves. This contrast between the sparse and the densely populated makes the work very interesting.***

La obra se presenta como un díptico, dividido en dos partes muy distintas. En el lado derecho, la composición es más sencilla y con pocos detalles. En cambio, la parte izquierda está llena de elementos: de lejos parece un conjunto confuso, pero al acercarnos descubrimos una multitud de personajes y escenas que se van revelando poco a poco. Ese contraste entre lo despojado y lo cargado de figuras hace que la obra sea muy interesante.

![14-DSCN3777-web.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/parissousa/EoEqUWZwxXyqKZrot3qo3NqPXNYSP1irGR9gzSftoyYiRWsXS3LDfnPbSKsFvSz4hy1.jpg)

![15-DSCN3779-web.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/parissousa/Eoc81gU2hcE9npUjERTBSNQ1jGv7uAYbuQFnZAkuqNQyzS3BmreNrfrk4GjGDgwLXyK.jpg)

***This concludes my visit this time, but I'll definitely be back and find another surprise. Until next time!***

Hasta aquí llegó mi visita en esta oportunidad, pero seguro volveré y me encontraré con otra sorpresa. Hasta la próxima!

![firma 2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/parissousa/23swi5k2aERD9cXxojnAtzH2LXTXsG8kxXmTT7i5HRortszSx3qfZHWt5WjiaY3PzPqju.jpg) ![separador -2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/parissousa/23swXQgUNzHCUaoqVQ7xJsMWUUjS9rSFiArbUmRBJqesDNP5aM1WKLPmC2Jhd24mfCZqm.png) [//]:# ([//]:# (!worldmappin -34.62205 lat -58.37054 long d3scr))

https://www.glitter-graphics.com/images/t/b/480x60/2603/2603079ms02ejozq3.webp

>Una pieza que quedó suelta, no encontramos donde encajar ni sus puntas ni sus aberturas. Parece tonto, pero así ocurre en la vida cotidiana da cada ser humano, cuando son niños se deja pasar un poco, se tilda a los niños de tremendos, mal educados o cualquier otro tipo de característica para decir que no encaja. Así crecemos, han crecido y siguen creciendo gran cantidad de niños, preguntándose ¿Por qué no encajo?

\n\n

>Una pieza de rompecabezas o puzle, no dice mucho, aunque se transmite un gran significado. Tristezas, soledades, desconsuelos, esa energía va en busca de lo mismo que siente a ver en donde puede unir sus partes para sentirse parte de una familia, grupo escolar, equipo de algún deporte, en un ambiente laboral, o simplemente en los espacios destinados para todos.

https://www.glitter-graphics.com/images/t/b/480x60/2603/2603079ms02ejozq3.webp

>Cada día, se observan muchas piezas sueltas del gran puzle de humanos, en fiestas sentados aparte, en reuniones laborales sin opinar, o solo lo necesario, en un ambiente universitario pensando solo vine a estudiar y obtener un título profesional, lo demás es agregado.

\n\n

>Mientras, en otros ocurre lo contrario, hacen miles de cosas para poder sentir que pertenecen a algo, alguien, que son parte de grupos, aceptan condiciones que para otros son intolerables, lo hacen solo por sentir que encajan, o sí o sí. Qué emociones despiertan en ellos porque después que se hacen conscientes, se dan cuenta viene la caída emocional y sentimental abismal. Superarlo es un trabajo inmenso, está de cada uno para superarlo.

\n\n

>Una pieza en un juego de puzle, tiene diversas posibilidades para encajar, a veces cuesta pero llega el momento de ver ese espacio donde encaja.

body.title: Got Awarded with Daily Prizes in Frontier League today
body.body:
![IMG-20260530-WA0014.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR6SuE4ABeDjYtYCC1PwMFcc9DbtgdJEpBbZ9udpgo6zX/IMG-20260530-WA0014.jpg)
Today has been a very hectic day for me being the day of the Champions league final against PSG and Arsenal. The PSG team are lucky to win the league after the penalties shoot out and as an Arsenal fan, that messed up my day because I was ready for celebration tonight. Be it as it may, that happens and there is hope for next time. I waited for my energy to power up to about 3 and still couldnt win a battle yet so I need to wait some more. While waiting, I then decided to play to play some battles in the FRONTIER league and won over five battles already. Our power supply was actually stable by noon but was turned off later so currently I do not have much battery. After winning five battles in the FRONTIER league, I was awarded with 2 foundation cards and one entry into the weekly FORTUNE draw. Atleast that was what I used to comfort myself for my football club loosing the Champion's league cup. Tonight would have been so fun because my fellow fans had already purchased 5 cows which was supposed to be used to celebrate our victory. But all the same we are still going to merry because it is not easy to play to the Finals especially in the Champions league. 

The cards which I was awarded with today are the BLACK WIDOW and the SPITTING CAMEL. Both being RANGED attack cards. But while the first card reduces an enemy's life by 2 ,the second one reduces their life by 1. The BLACK WIDOW has no special ability as you can see in the down bottom part of the card while the SPITTING CAMEL posseses a special ability. The first card belongs to the SKITTERKIN bloodline and also falls under the DEATH element category while the second card belongs to the MUNDANE BEAST bloodline and falls under the WATER category. I do not really use the first card because it does not lead me to victory most of the times I use it so I rarely make use of it when creating my team. The second card atleast leads me to victory most of the time that is why I do make use of it from time to time. When the power supply is being restored I'm gonna see what can be done to reach my target as promised before the end of the season as there are no plans of giving up anytime soon over here. Haha. Feel free to play the game with me by using my referral link below and also join the official discord server for future updates , keeping in touch with other community members and to get your questions answered in due time. Thanks guys for stopping by and have a good one.

body.title: ...one more page
body.body:
<div class=text-justify>


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/xrayman/Eq9WnoorHQfVc4sCz7oK6s6ygynN2aa7JF5j5bZhZXygNwGFFENuz3Ec6hb2oQhTj74.png)

Life can be compared to a book. 

In this book, we can’t skip chapters or reread the ones we like. We can’t tear out pages or go back. There are paragraphs we wish we’d never read. But we can’t skip them. Nor can we know what’s written there before we read them. 

We shouldn’t try to read the book too quickly, or too slowly. 

The story is constantly being written, and in a way, we can influence what appears in it or what might shape its direction. 

The characters who inhabit it sometimes cease to be part of it, and we would so much like to meet them again or deepen our understanding of them, and at other times darker characters end up leaving a greater mark on a particular chapter that is especially long and tedious. 

We shouldn’t try to know the ending of our book’s story. For once we reach the last page of that unique book, of each person’s story, there will be no more time for us to glimpse even one more page.

body.title: Waiting for Departure - My Actifit Report Card: May 30th, 2026
body.body:
<center>

### Welcome to  
## ***Liquid Eye’s*** Actifit Blog

# Saturday ☀️ 11796

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/F527D1B2-65AF-4D80-96E7-EEB7FA2B47931780175577.536676) 

Off to London today, and it was far more exhausting than expected, because starting at BER, nothing flew or ran as it should have. After my flight finally took off two and a half hours late, London turned out to be absolutely packed and just a mess today. I spent hours making my way through the city from Gatwick Airport to get to the ExCel convention center and the hotel. None of the trains were running as they should, and I don’t think I’ve ever ridden so many and such long escalators. The whole trip took 10 hours door-to-door, and that added up to quite a few steps, but I didn’t have the headspace for photos along the way, except at the departure airport, let alone the time or opportunity. 

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/F527D1B2-65AF-4D80-96E7-EEB7FA2B47931780175580.7390928) 

Auf ging’s nach London heute, und das war weitaus anstrengender als erwartet, denn heute ist angefangen am BER, nichts geflogen oder gefahren, wie es sollte. Nachdem mein Flug erst nach zweieinhalb Stunden Verspätung ging, zeigte London sich mir heute rappelvoll und einfach kaputt. Ich bin stundenlang vom Flughafen Gatwick durch die Stadt gegurkt, um zum ExCel Kongressgelände und zum Hotel zu kommen. Keine der Bahnen fuhr wie sie sollte, und ich glaube, ich bin noch nie so viel und so lange Rolltreppen gefahren. 10 Stunden hat das alles von Tür zu Tür gebraucht, und da sind einige Schritte zusammengekommen, aber für Fotos unterwegs außer vom Startflughafen hatte ich keinen Kopf, geschweige denn die Zeit oder Möglichkeiten.

>¡Saludos, amigos! Gracias por acompañarme en otro post. Hoy visitamos Sesimbra y quise aprovechar el día caluroso y agradable para escapar un poco de la rutina de mi casa con mi pareja e hija, y hacer unas tomas con el dron desde el Castillo, que es uno de los puntos más altos de la zona, a más de 200 metros. No es uno de los más altos ni tampoco el más bonito... pero creo que compite con los grandes porque tiene el mejor paisaje con la montaña de fondo.🗺️🚙 # Greetings, friends! Thanks for joining me for another post. Today we visited Sesimbra, and I wanted to take advantage of the warm, pleasant day to escape the daily grind with my partner and daughter, and get some drone footage from the Castle, which is one of the highest points in the area at over 200 meters. It's not one of the tallest, nor the most beautiful... but I think it rivals the greats because it boasts the best mountain scenery in the background.📍🏞️ ![0.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23xyNqtjQxW4UHVJg6PWJ1bMYy93ZebaxoMZTwtZfPz5h2hqKjdyE7jZbCVBJUkCViepH.jpg) #

Sesimbra is one of the most important towns on the southern bank of the Tagus estuary. Throughout its history, it has been a port for various civilizations and tribes. Records exist from prehistoric times to the Romans, who built an empire exporting fish and other resources extracted from the mountains. Of course, if you're not a big fan of the sun or hiking, it might not be worth doing a long trail in this area; however, some are easy, taking about an hour. Just be prepared, because summer here is incredibly hot!🗺️🏞️

With my experience on YouTube, I want to take things to the next level, so I'm looking to spend around 1,000–1,500 euros on a drone—possibly a Mavic 3. What would you recommend for YouTube? But listen up... I'm just an ordinary guy from the mountains; I already lost a drone on a beach, haha. I want something that can withstand strong winds. For my style, I don't want anything FPV. I think I'll really miss my Mavic Mini 2! And I'll give you my opinion over the next few years; I'll be very honest:📸🙇🏻‍♀️* *Increíble que hasta la fecha esté rondando los 500 euros, obviamente el kit completo con las baterías. Con mi experiencia en YouTube quiero pasar de nivel, así que quiero gastar en un dron que ronde los 1000-1500 euros, ¿posiblemente un Mavic 3? ¿Qué me recomendarían ustedes para YouTube? Pero atención... soy un tipo ordinario de montaña, ya perdí un dron en una playa, jeje. Quiero algo que resista mucho viento; para mi estilo no quiero nada FPV. ¡Creo que extrañaré mucho mi Mavic Mini 2! Y te dejaré mi opinión en estos años, seré muy sincero:🏰🏞️* ================================================================================= # GOOD: ✅The price-quality ratio is quite good! If you want something to get started as a blogger, it's a good option, especially if you're just starting out ✅It has good wind resistance; I tested it with gusts of over 45 km/h. For short takes, the battery is good while resisting winds of this strength, of course in sport mode. ✅It's a good camera since it captures 4K ultra HD images, but as I want 60fps I'll probably consider the Mavic 4 mini pro. ✅It is durable; the batteries still give me over 40 minutes of recording time, and in cinema mode, I can get up to an hour. It's resistant to small amounts of water; I've already pushed it to the limit by flying it in fog and light drizzle (not recommended) (🛑Never do it!!!). ================================================================================= # BAD: ❌ I really hated the signal, haha. It says it has a long range, but in almost all conditions, the signal cuts out after 2 km, sometimes even at 1.5 km. Worse still, it says it has a range of 10 km; I guess I could only ever reach that in a desert! ❌ The remote control system, lacking a screen, is inconvenient because the cable connecting the phone breaks very often, and it's not very practical for quick recordings. ❌ The lack of item tracking is a drawback; of course, I can't expect much for 500 euros, but it's one of the negative points. ================================================================================= ![DJI_0282.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23ycwC4xuaGyZefQp2b3TpsyuDf5SENsfdH85fCjYhWJ1kXxGwJTMGcW5C1uXRrVj3urR.JPG) ![DJI_0284.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/244KJfyjy5C9afwt8PP6itRankBaST2kivEZJeFnC5oDddMBFKezt6zsqwvtMKrDoJUL4.JPG) ![DJI_0286.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/243WMa3oZGTLptwYyPpUhSRfc7faJJshgCTfBd6MpvkTCwjEoNZ5BufCLBFLByA7AKjgK.JPG) ![DJI_0298.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/242DBvHrnWjVpN688ydDksDEv7EeK6SLUEiwtH8wSXryjuYamyz5DguEm3kVKocbrt7oR.JPG) ![DJI_0304.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23xyNRqEddLMx4SCXyHHFDrYBRX2CKFNw5dpFFdnaHsHHHS1qwduodQrsJ3VxFBXdNMRo.JPG) ![DJI_0308.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/biologistbrito/23uaBAiVYjGR6Sbtq6wy1XkJ9qPUjwDXW5XC4PBwu9cs48d8C7eg5r9rF7HDX5SaEiVUC.JPG) #

body.title: Post Graduate
body.body:
>

It is a big thing to graduate from high school in Finland. Not because it is rare these days, but it once was, which means the traditions have held firm. The main part is that they get a white cap that looks a bit like a sailor's hat, and they will often wear it every May the 1st for the rest of their lives. And then, after the school ceremony for parents, there is usually some kind of graduation party held at the home, with family and friends giving a flower and usually some money instead of a present.

Today it was one of my wife's nephew's turn to graduate and the party was held at their summer cottage, which is an old converted farm building. It is nice out there and really quiet, other than the sounds of the forest and today, congratulations for the graduate. I was designated photographer (which is about all I am good for in the family) and took a lot of photos of guests and some portraits of the graduate, which I have to sot through and edit. I joked with him that if there isn't a good enough one for his mum, I will use AI to render a better version of him.

> What a weird world when memories are faked.

*But that is an article for another day.*

---

---

Tonight though, I just wanted to write a bit of an appreciation post for my daughter, who is pretty awesome *most of the time* and is growing up fast. She was saying how it is about nine years away until she will graduate, which seems so long, but I reminded her it isn't that long. For her though today, it is a full lifetime and even when she gets there, it will be a half a life, but for me at that stage, it will only be a sixth of a lifetime. 

> Time moves faster and faster, the more we live.

As photographer, I am rarely in the photos and I am like an absent father if looking back through the many images from all the events. Perhaps I appear in some reflections or something, like a ghost. A reverse vampire - can only be seen in mirrors. But it is fun taking pictures of people and I wish I had the money for all the great lenses I would like to buy, but it is endless. I can do okay with what I have, but I have barely picked up the camera for people photography in ages. Smallsteps \

Foto tomada del teléfono de mi novio

<center> Español </center>
<div class=\

>Los que me conocen, saben que con el tiempo he aprendido a que las opiniones que dicen sobre ti, dicen más de esa persona que de ti. Sin embargo, hay veces en las que, como todo ser humano, nos sentimos vulnerables y se nos escapa de las manos que nos lastimen ciertas opiniones hacia nosotros. Pero recientemente viví una situación donde aunque intenté colocarme esa armadura de \
, realmente no pude y por primera vez en 32 años, lloré desconsoladamente delante de mis padres.

>Pensé que me dirían que no era para tanto, pero al ver a su hija frente a ellos llorando destruida por la simple posibilidad de que su relación tendría que acabar por decisión de terceros y más allá de eso sentirse tan humillada, no tuvieron palabras para decirme que simplemente ver reflejadas en mi, sus heridas internas de un pasado.\n\n
>Todo comenzó cuando la familia de mi novio se enteró que él tenía una nueva pareja y empezaron las típicas preguntas que siempre se hacen: \

, hasta ahí lo hicieron sin emitir ningún juicio. Pero ahí viene otro tema que hace casi un año quería escribir justo en esta comunidad pero por cosas de la vida no pude. Y es el tema de la diferencia de edad.\n\n
>Y es que sí, efectivamente mi novio y yo tenemos una diferencia de edad, \

por así decirlo. De hecho, fue uno de los impedimentos en un principio para dar el sí desde que queríamos. Sin embargo, la diferencia de edad entre mi novio y yo, jamás ha sido una barrera para entendernos o saber resolver nuestros problemas en la relación. Hasta me atrevo a decir (Sin generalizar ni faltar el respeto a nadie, claro está) que tiene más madurez emocional, que algunos que conozco que son mayor que él.\n\n

>Hace 2 semanas o más, le robaron el teléfono a mi novio. El día que lo supe, lógicamente me preocupé muchísimo porque saber que le pudo haber pasado algo a alguien que amas, siempre es algo que te deja como en alerta. Esa tarde lo acompañé a hacer las cosas que tenía que hacer y no lo dejé solo en ningún momento... Para ese momento, él se estaba comunicando con su mamá a través de mi teléfono y quedaron en irse juntos.\n\n

>Para que él pudiera estar comunicado con ella hasta el último momento, decidí acompañarlo hasta el trabajo de su mamá y que de una vez me conociera,ya que entiendo que al no saber con quién sale su hijo, le preocupa el hecho de que él en ocasiones se haya tenido que quedar en mi casa. Sí debo admitir que estaba un poco nerviosa porque no fue algo planeado (Además seamos sinceros, ¿Quién no se puso nerviosa o nervioso al conocer a la mamá de su pareja?) sin embargo fui con mi mejor actitud y colocándome una camisa de vestir. \n\n
>Al momento de conocerla, le mostré mi mejor sonrisa acompañada de un apretón de manos con su respectivo \

. Noté que la sonrisa no fue recíproca, pero no lo tomé personal; después de todo, uno siempre tiene demasiado estrés al salir del trabajo y no siempre hay ganas de estar sonriendo. Al momento de que mi novio y ella se fueron, sólo alcancé a despedirme de lejos de mi novio porque ya ella había caminado hacia adelante sin siquiera despedirse. Como mencioné anteriormente, no le dí importancia porque son cosas que a cualquiera le pueden pasar de olvidar despedirse.\n\n
>Días después, mi novio me dijo la frase que a muchos nos engrincha desde niños:\n\n***\

>En resumidas cuentas y para no hacer el cuento tan largo ni que esto vaya a parecer funa (porque realmente es un desahogo) me dijo que su mamá le dijo que le bastó ***sólo un minuto***, para saber que yo era pobre (por la camisa que vestía) cochina (porque tenía granos en la cara. Cabe acotar que tenía dos semanas bajo mucho estrés) poca cosa, vieja (Por la diferencia de edad con su hijo y porque tengo 32) demacrada (porque no me maquillo... Soy alérgica incluso al maquillaje hipo alergénico y nunca me ha gustado cómo me siento cuando lo he hecho) y que seguramente mis padres también eran viejos y si se morían no tenía ni cómo enterrarlos.\n\n

>Mis padres sí, son personas mayores debido a que mi mamá esperó tener una casa propia para buscar ser madre, pero por cosas que sólo Dios sabe, no pudo serlo a temprana edad. Supongo que las mujeres que hayan tenido una pérdida, entenderán el sentimiento. Y con respecto a lo otro, no entendí en qué le afecta si tuviera o no tuviera para hacerlo, porque además de eso jamás le pediría ayuda monetaria a ella o incluso a mi pareja.\n\n

>También dijo que yo no era nadie porque no trabajaba (Quienes me conocen saben que soy emprendedora) ya que si tú no trabajas en una oficina, estás trabajando para otra persona y no para ti. Técnicamente soy mi propia jefa y además de eso amo lo que hago.\n\n

>Mi novio intentó defenderme y su hermana y su mamá le dijeron que de paso era un ingenuo e inmaduro por creer que yo de verdad lo amaba (Mi pareja para mi pasó a ser una de las personas más importantes en mi vida) ya que el ser mayor que él impedía que yo en serio lo amara.\n\n

>Y por si fuera poco, le dijo que no esperaba que terminara conmigo ya mismo, pero que esperaba que tampoco fuera para siempre porque él merecía alguien mejor con quién vivir una vida y no con quién envejecer tan rápido ya que era lo que estaba haciendo conmigo (según ella)\n\n
>El camino fácil sería haberme dejado llevar por la rabia y odiarla; pero más allá de eso (Y como puse en mi presentación hace más de un año) mi lema es:\n\n***\

>¿Cuáles fueron las reflexiones que saqué de esto? Las personas mayores (Porque ella es mayor que yo por más de 10 años) no van a cambiar su manera de ver a las personas. Y si bien es cierto que pudiéramos \
para agradarle a alguien más, también lo es que vivimos en una sociedad que nunca estará conforme con nada, ya que ni con ellos mismos lo están. \n\n

>Y esto me lleva a la segunda reflexión; lo que odiamos o criticamos en otros, tiene que ver más con nosotros mismos que con ellos. O viceversa, lo que alguien te dice o hace no siempre tiene que ver contigo sino con esa misma persona. Tercera reflexión: Cuando las acciones de los demás, hagan que la vida te duela, revisa que heridas del pasado tienes por sanar. Ya que a veces la vida en su sabiduría, hace que incluso años después cuando ya has ignorado o bloqueado por completo esa herida, vuelve a doler para que esta vez hagas el correcto proceso de sanación. Cuarta reflexión: Más allá de no juzgar un libro por su portada porque el contenido puede sorprenderte mucho, aprende a ver más allá de lo que tus prejuicios te permiten observar; porque el día que a tu ser amado le duela la vida y tú no puedas estar para consolarlo, no importa si la persona que está a su lado es fea o bonita, sino el apoyo genuino que le brinda. Quinta reflexión: La vida siempre pondrá a prueba qué tanto amas lo que dices amar, pero de tu parte queda, si rendirte o luchar.
English

>Those who know me know that over time I’ve come to realize that what people say about you says more about them than it does about you. However, there are times when, like any human being, we feel vulnerable and can’t help but be hurt by certain opinions directed at us. But recently I went through a situation where, even though I tried to put on that armor of “Strong, nothing affects me,” I really couldn’t, and for the first time in 32 years, I cried my heart out in front of my parents.

>I thought they would tell me it wasn’t a big deal, but seeing their daughter in front of them, crying and devastated by the mere possibility that her relationship might end because of someone else’s decision—and beyond that, feeling so humiliated—they were at a loss for words. They simply saw their own inner wounds from the past reflected in me.\n\n

>It all started when my boyfriend’s family found out he had a new partner, and the typical questions began: “Where is she from?” “How old is she?” “What does she do?” Up to that point, they asked without passing any judgment. But here comes another topic that I’ve wanted to write about in this very community for almost a year, but for one reason or another, I couldn’t. And that is the issue of the age difference.\n\n

>And yes, it’s true—my boyfriend and I do have an age difference that’s “noticeable,” so to speak. In fact, it was one of the initial obstacles that kept us from saying “I do” as soon as we wanted to. However, the age difference between my boyfriend and me has never been a barrier to understanding each other or resolving our relationship issues. I would even go so far as to say (without generalizing or disrespecting anyone, of course) that he is more emotionally mature than some people I know who are older than him.\n\n

>About two weeks ago or more, my boyfriend’s phone was stolen. The day I found out, I was naturally very worried because knowing that something could have happened to someone you love always puts you on high alert. That afternoon, I went with him to run his errands and didn’t leave him alone for a moment... At that point, he was talking to his mom on my phone, and they agreed to meet up.\n\n

>So that he could stay in touch with her until the very last moment, I decided to go with him to his mom’s workplace so she could meet me right away, since I understand that not knowing who her son is dating makes her worried about the fact that he’s sometimes had to stay at my place. I have to admit I was a little nervous because it wasn’t planned (and let’s be honest, who hasn’t been nervous meeting their partner’s mom?). Still, I went with a positive attitude and put on a nice shirt. \n\n

>When I met her, I gave her my best smile along with a handshake and a polite “Nice to meet you.” I noticed her smile wasn’t returned, but I didn’t take it personally; after all, people are always stressed after work and don’t always feel like smiling. By the time my boyfriend and she left, I only managed to wave goodbye to my boyfriend from a distance because she had already walked ahead without even saying goodbye. As I mentioned earlier, I didn’t think much of it because forgetting to say goodbye is something that can happen to anyone.\n\n
>A few days later, my boyfriend said the phrase that has annoyed so many of us since we were kids: ***“We need to talk”***

>To cut a long story short and so this doesn’t sound like a rant (because it really is just me venting), she told me that her mom said it took her ***just one minute*** to realize that I was poor (because of the shirt I was wearing), dirty (because I had pimples on my face. It’s worth noting that I’d been under a lot of stress for two weeks) insignificant, old (because of the age difference with her son and because I’m 32) gaunt (because I don’t wear makeup… I’m allergic even to hypoallergenic makeup and I’ve never liked how I feel when I’ve worn it) and that surely my parents were old too and if they died I wouldn’t even be able to afford to bury them.\n\n

>My parents are indeed older because my mom waited to have her own home before trying to become a mother, but for reasons only God knows, she couldn’t do so at a young age. I suppose women who have experienced a loss will understand the feeling. And regarding the other point, I didn’t understand how it affects her whether or not I could afford to do it, because besides that, I would never ask her—or even my partner—for financial help.\n\n

>She also said I was a nobody because I didn’t work (those who know me know I’m an entrepreneur), since if you don’t work in an office, you’re working for someone else and not for yourself. Technically, I’m my own boss, and on top of that, I love what I do.\n

>My boyfriend tried to defend me, and his sister and mom told him that, by the way, he was naive and immature for believing that I truly loved him (my partner had become one of the most important people in my life), since the fact that I was older than him meant I couldn't possibly love him for real.\n\n

>And as if that weren’t enough, she told him she didn’t expect him to break up with me right away, but she didn’t expect it to last forever either, because he deserved someone better to spend his life with—not someone who would make him grow old so quickly, which was what she claimed I was doing to him.\n\n

>The easy way out would have been to let myself be carried away by anger and hate her; but beyond that (and as I wrote in my introduction over a year ago), my motto is: ***“Everything that happens, both good and bad, has a lesson, even if we don’t see it”***

>What lessons did I take away from this? Older people (because she is more than 10 years older than me) aren’t going to change the way they see people. And while it’s true that we could “change” to please someone else, it’s also true that we live in a society that will never be satisfied with anything, since they aren’t even satisfied with themselves. \n\n

>And this brings me to my second thought: what we hate or criticize in others has more to do with ourselves than with them. Or, conversely, what someone says or does to you isn’t always about you, but about that person themselves. Third reflection: When the actions of others cause you pain, examine which past wounds you still need to heal. Because sometimes life, in its wisdom, causes a wound to hurt again even years later—after you’ve already ignored or completely blocked it out—so that this time you can go through the proper healing process. Fourth reflection: Beyond not judging a book by its cover—because the content might surprise you greatly—learn to see beyond what your prejudices allow you to observe; because on the day your loved one is hurting and you can’t be there to comfort them, it doesn’t matter if the person by their side is ugly or beautiful, but rather the genuine support they offer. Fifth reflection: Life will always test how much you love what you say you love, but it’s up to you to decide whether to give up or fight.

Hey ! :)

Nun habe ich mir ebenso mal ein wenig Zeit gelassen, da bei mir auch viel los gewesen ist.

Du sprichst da was ganz wichtiges an, was ich ja auch immer wieder erwähne: die Eigenverantwortung. Steht bei mir ganz groß und ich kann zu deinem Text diesbezüglich nichts hinzufügen.

Einwecke ist auch ein Thema, dem ich mich näher beschäftigen möchte. Denn in den Fertigprodukten aus dem Supermarkt sind meistens auch Stoffe drin, die ich vermeide, wie bspw Pflanzliche Öle (Sonnenblumenöl, Rapsöl), sowie industriellen Salz und Zucker. Allerdings greife ich auch manchmal auf Sauerkraut vom Supermarkt zurück. Will jetzt echt mal mich dem widmen...

Bzgl den Wirkstoffen, die man raus extrahieren könnte... Dafür hat man ja destilliert und gab es die Alchemie.. Doch da muss ich auch erstmal den Überblick und Durchblick mir beschaffen ! :)
Glücklicherweise gibt es ja hier und dort Menschen, die noch eine Faszination an solchen Dingen finden und es dann auch nach draußen tragen. Einen Favorit unter all den habe ich auch nicht und irgendwie lerne ich für mich persönlich eher, wenn ich es direkt sehe, fotografiere, vergleiche, und dann Informationen beschaffe. Oft machts mir mehr Spaß keine Videos anzuschauen bzw von anderen Menschen beigebracht zu bekommen, sondern selbst zu lesen und im Internet/Büchern zu entdecken (wobei das ja auch eine Variante ist von anderen zu lernen). Und mit Pilzen kenne ich mich auch echt noch gar nicht aus, habs nur hin und wieder versucht. Würde gerne mehr die Pilze für Fermentation und Einwecken kennenlernen und nutzen.. anstatt dass es mir verschimmelt.


Liebe Grüße !

body.title: Man Got Seven Years Behind Bars For Offending A Cop
body.body: ![MoMagic is the creator of this image/Source: Pixabay](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2024/08/29/15/21/police-9007292_1280.png) Some of you may think that I have published this article strictly for laughs, but, in reality, I'm here to describe a serious miscarriage of justice. A man was chatting with a police officer online who was impersonating a 12-year-old girl, and he failed to keep his conversation with this cop Rated G. Below is a video about it. Norman Michael Achin Describes A Man's Ordeal With The Law After Committing A No-Contact Offense https://youtu.be/hQzfMjN5ntw?si=63Fjeo3ppc9fkQon Okay. So let me get this. According to Mr. Achin, this one man got seven years behind bars for what can be best described as a no-contact offense at worst. That is, he engaged in 20 second of a misuse of time as Mr. Achin stated in his video above. After this man gets out of prison, he is on probation for 3 to 5 years, and now he has to be on the sex-offender registry for 25 years. Every attempt he makes to reintegrate back into society is a Catch-22, thanks to the criminal justice system. Some of you may believe that this man got exactly what he deserved, but let's remember that there was no actual victim in this offense. Instead, there was an angry cop who wanted to throw the book at him. Now, let's look at the case in which a nameless 12- or 13-year-old boy violently, brutally, and forcibly raped the late Aubreigh Wyatt back when she was only 12 years old, not to mention, he drove her to suicide. There was a police investigation into the rape, but there was no arrest. This punk got away with ruining a young girl's life and indirectly ending it. One of these self-proclaimed child advocates can come flying at my face and stress that this punk was a minor and that he was the same age as his victim, but, at the end of the day, he poses a much greater danger to society than the man that Mr. Achin described in his video above. This punk that raped the late Ms. Aubreigh would now be 15 or 16 years of age. I'm always hearing stories about teenage boys in middle school or high school breaking into old ladies' homes and raping and even murdering them. If this same punk should do something this heinous in the future, we can thank the local authorities in Oceanville, Mississippi for letting him off the hook. ![Michael_schueller is the author of this picture/Source: Pixabay](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2017/01/24/19/46/portrait-2006207_1280.jpg) Ladies and gentlemen? Start paying attention to stories like the two ones above, because our criminal justice system is more concerned about getting convictions than it is about combating actual crime. For that reason, these cops are always looking for the easy arrest rather than dealing with the dangerous stuff that threatens our communities throughout the United States. Cops care more about make-believe minors than they do about actual minors. They're failing us as public servants, and we need to realize it or crime is going to continue to get worse and worse until it is way, way out of control. Some Americans already believe that the crime rate has reached that point of no return. **This article is copyright-protected.**

body.title: Shadow Hunters SMASh Contest - Round #428 Twilight Shadows III [Eng/Esp]
body.body:
> Happy weekend friends of [Shadow Hunters](https://ecency.com/created/hive-179017), we are resuming our contributions to the SMASH contest on Saturdays. I try to keep to the days when I share the shadows I find during my workdays, whether at the university or when I work in the lab, but this week and probably next week I will be quite busy, but we can always make an effort to dedicate a few lines to these wonderful initiatives. Just yesterday, when I had no activities at the university, I didn't take advantage of the moment to go hunting, but fate had a great opportunity in store for me to share with you in this SMASH [round #428](https://ecency.com/@melinda010100/shadow-hunters-community-smash-contest-bbfcf2bf1b0b6). I was taking out my clothes to put them in the wash since I'll be going to university every day again next week, so one of my priorities was washing my lab coat, which gets so dirty with every experiment that I need to wash it at home. That laundry basket is in my brother's room, and it was already getting dark. That's when I was treated to the city's sunset scene, with the sun beginning to dip behind the buildings but casting its last glimmers of light over the city. The shadows of my plants and the window bars were projected into the room through the window.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU5RNAg1EV9PwBQNPVtUV2qmyG1jaZGdY5wrq2T3Xp6nA/photo_2_2026_05_30_06_19_25.jpg)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXHNJvi7pkYrM4t7beRs1BzgY86pBZE2eqLu9G63bGCLq/photo_5_2026_05_30_06_19_25.jpg) --|--

> At first, I didn't think it was a shadow worth photographing, but given the position of the sun, practically on the horizon and illuminating the entire expanse of my window, you could see how the shadow lengthened from the window, across the room, up the bed, and finally projected onto the wall. It looks great because you can see the shadows of my plants right on the wall, which reminded me that they had already had a lot of sun and it was time to refresh them with some water, since these last few weeks have been really hot, with lots of sun, few cloudy days, and practically no rain. In the end, I liked the whole composition for this SMASH contest, because, as you know, I love the sunsets in my city, and whenever I can, I photograph them to build a sunset gallery. The highlight is undoubtedly this magnificent shadow cast by my brother's bedroom window. He's lucky because I don't have this view from my room, since the entire building is U-shaped, and therefore my window has a frontal view of the apartments, blocking my view of the city. That's why I cherish these moments so much, since I can't fully enjoy them from my window.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPeFC7JL4GWDaUnSSSoH81MAjZyuqAKdFGtKk1Y4kPuyj/photo_4_2026_05_30_06_19_25.jpg)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23tRvWxqnFqswK34rLXwwDzLFHimD2xstYf7ZmmjmX39TA7DFGfV3AbTDuBxHmK6AMydA.png)

> With that, I conclude my contribution to SMASH this week, friends. I hope you enjoyed this twilight shadow I captured at home. This is the third part, and I can assure you it won't be the last! See you in the next contest. Best regards.
--- # Versión Español ---
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPb9jf5LQEnALFBrguKRACVN61X3ynCdnfmrnhCsEMmp3/photo_6_2026_05_30_06_19_25.jpg)

> Feliz fin de semana amigos de [Shadow Hunters](https://ecency.com/created/hive-179017), retomamos nuevamente nuestros aportes al concurso SMASH los días sábados, intento mantener los días cuando les comparto las sombras que voy encontrando en mis días laborales ya sea en la facultad o cuando trabajo en el laboratortio, pero esta semana y seguramente la que viene voy a estar bastante ocupado, pero siempre podemos hacer un esfuerzo para dedicarle unas lineas a estas maravillosas iniciativas. Justo ayer que no tuve actividades en la universidad no aproveché el momento para salir de cacería pero el destino me guardo una genial oportunidad para compartirles en este SMASH [round #428](https://ecency.com/@melinda010100/shadow-hunters-community-smash-contest-bbfcf2bf1b0b6). Estaba sacando la ropa para ponerla a lavar ya que esta próxima semana nuevamente estaré yendo a la universidad todos los días, así que una de mis prioridades fue poner a lavar la bata de laboratorio que con cada experimento termina tan sucia que necesito lavarla en casa. Esa cesta de la ropa sucia esta en el cuarto de mi hermano y ya estaba atardeciendo, fue allí donde me conseguí con la escena del atardecer de la ciudad, con el sol comenzando a ocultarse detrás de los edificios pero proyectando sus últimos destellos de luz sobre la ciudad y entrando en el cuarto a través de la ventana se proyectaba la sombra de mis plantas y los barrotes de la ventana.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU5RNAg1EV9PwBQNPVtUV2qmyG1jaZGdY5wrq2T3Xp6nA/photo_2_2026_05_30_06_19_25.jpg)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXHNJvi7pkYrM4t7beRs1BzgY86pBZE2eqLu9G63bGCLq/photo_5_2026_05_30_06_19_25.jpg) --|--

> En un primer momento no me parecía una sombra que valiera la pena tomar, pero dada la posición del sol, prácticamente en el horizonte e iluminando toda la extensión de mi ventana, se podía ver como se alargaba la sombra desde la ventana atravezando el cuarto, subiendo por la cama hasta terminar de proyectarse en la pared y se ve genial por que justo en la pared se observan las sombras de mis plantas, lo que me recordó que ya habían llevado mucho sol y era hora de refrescarlas con un poco de agua ya que estas últimas semanas los días han sido realmente calurosos, con mucho sol, pocos días nublados y prácticamente ningún día de lluvia. Al final me gustó toda la composición para este concurso SMASH, porque como saben me encantan los atardeceres de mi ciudad y siempre que puedo las fotografío para ir armando una galería de atardeceres y el culmen es sin duda esta magnífica sombra generada desde la ventana del cuarto de mi hermano, es afortunado porque desde mi cuarto no tengo esta vista ya que toda la estructura del edificio se cierra en U y por tanto mi ventana tiene una vista frontal de los apartamentos cerrándome la vista a la ciudad. Es por eso que aprovecho y atesoro en gran medida estos momentos, ya que no puedo disfrutarlos totalmente desde mi ventana.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPeFC7JL4GWDaUnSSSoH81MAjZyuqAKdFGtKk1Y4kPuyj/photo_4_2026_05_30_06_19_25.jpg)
