> Con esto termino mi aporte al SMASH de esta semana amigos, espero que les haya gustado esta sombra crepuscular capturada en casa, ya es la tercera parte y puedo asegurarles que no será la última! Nos vemos en un próximo concurso. Saludos.

body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNNxBYP8w3zomZUa2n4Dx6FcwkLuGzjNdVmo36m88jidL/718112918.jpg 



When it comes to sketching the future, 100 years ago, though we are now hitting the limit of copper and moss law, and big players like Nvidia and Pivoting to light up sticks exactly, we were actually thinking about the teenagers and the future that comes after it. Light has always moved faster than our imagination. Even long before Nvidia started writing multi-billion dollar checks for technology companies that are into optics.

For decades, Moss law was our official contract with the future. Every couple of years, we'd cram more transistors onto a ship and stuff them up. Everything would get faster and cheaper as life was going on.

But underneath all this, there is a quiet problem that people saw early and the Nvidia team trying to solve. At some point, wires inside ship guests would think that moving electrons through them makes them impractical as time goes on. So there is a limit.

The thinner the wire, the higher the resistance, which means more heat and a lot of power is wasted. Another one is longer distance across a ship or chips introduces delay, noise and signal loss. You cannot just keep pushing more current through fragile tin metal and expect it to behave. 

It's going to have an effect on it. So there is a question both people are skipping. What happens if the wiring is actually the bottleneck, not even the transistor, is not even the algorithm, it is the metal? This question has brought out something else in the heart of scientists and those who are in line with fast internet.

The use of light to transmit information has changed its own story. The logic is simple. If electrons in copper are hitting fundamental and economic limits and we already know that light can carry far more information faster with less loss, then futuristic computing can't just be better than silicon.

It has to interconnect. Copper traces become... ...oil shaker. We've got electron becomes photons and the circuit board becomes a city lit by a highway of light instead of rivers of current.

As the years goes by, Intel start ruling out that an optical chip, which is a silicon photonics on a commercial roadblock, was a proof of content that this theory that I've been postulating since is not just a theory, it is very possible. In the beginning of 2027, we are seeing the end of this wall, breaking down the wall of AI. AI workload is exploding by the day and we are not wiring one CPU to one memory chip as ages before.

So now copper is getting more expensive and it's harder to scale at this performance. Aluminium, silver and other metal, though it has their own cost and practicality limit. But we are burning energy here.

NVIDIA multi-billion dollar bet on light has proven to be a successful one. They are the king of AI chip and they are now leading billions of optical technology all around the world and trying to break even to the new frontier. The idea here is simple.

If you want to train a lot parameters model when it comes to millions and you want to build a supercomputer, you cannot wire things together. You have to go deeper. You will need bandwidths that are very high and links that are very strong.

Then there should be a lower energy consumption because if you go to space to explore and we got everything from you but the cost of going to the space is far exceed the price of what you have bought then there is going to be an issue. Though we are seeing new devices and gadgets all over the market now and there is a need for everyone to put in and compete for what's left.

Today I’m sharing an outfit with my Red Carpet community. I want to tell you about what I did and what I wore. Since I love adventures, I’m sharing a really cute outfit for the evening I picked it out for a special dinner with friends, and to celebrate one of their birthdays. I’ll just say that we had an amazing time we ate delicious food, sang happy birthday, chatted, and had a really nice time. To make my outfit look this cute—because honestly, I really liked it let’s start from the bottom up, beginning with the high cut black boots I wore. I paired them with long black tights that I scrunched up a bit. Actually, the main idea was to wear white tights, but since the black ones were longer and I thought they looked cooler, I also put on some pantyhose I hadn’t worn any in years; I think I haven’t worn them since I was a little girl. I also wore a white cotton dress that hugged my body and a black faux fur jacket that looks pretty cute, in my opinion. My best outfits have always been the ones I’ve thrown together on the fly. I don’t always pay attention to matching things, but I always end up finding pieces that go well together when I’m getting dressed. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbupy9BfyijmwLCLePuQhxEqK31Psp2zzUciUER9VFkwc/1780173067826.jpg)

We are always working to make end's needs,  effortlessly busy from morning to night, and we forget to take care of the body that works for the money. We forget to take good care of our health not until we fall sick or issues arise. People are losing their lives to cancer, kidney failure and other life threaten disease because of lack of proper good health and unhealthy bad habits and foods.

Am this kind of person that thought that it's only sick people are to visit the hospital. Provided that am not sick to dieing, so I don't have any business with the hospital. But today I have come to lived with the regret and thought if would go back and rewrite that. I regrets the need of going to the hospital for checkup and knowing my health vitals, lack of quality rest and sleep, irregular exercise and eating healthy meals not just eating solely on junks. 

Now I have come to have more knowledge on good health and ways to maintain a healthy living that will make me live healthy, more productive in life and happliy. I now watch and eat healthy meals, exercise more to keep fit and take care of general wellbeing by always going to the hospital for proper checkup instead relying on self medication.

Another thing I might regret in future, if I don't handle now, spending quality time with my family and loved ones. Life is full of activities, busy there and then, and we focus more on achieving our goals and personal responsibilities and we neglect the need to be there for people that are so dear to us. I hardly call or visit, sometimes when I promise to be there to celebrate with them and create memories, I keep postponing and giving excuses not be present. I know I can't bring back time lost. To avoid further future regrets, I try as much as possible to always get in touch with them through phone calls and video calls, send messages and connect mainly through visiting and always celebrate with them as family.

Lastly another thing I don't want to regret in the future is not achieving my personal goals and dreams. To avoid regretting, I have laid out plans for myself, to be consistency and put more efforts in learning new skills, acquiring more knowledge and work towards achieving my dreams. Even success might not come as planned or immediately, one thing I know that I tried my best regardless.

Regret can not be avoidable in life, but we can reduce or avoid some from happening if we can be more careful and intentional towards it today. By treasuring our relationship with loved ones, chasing our dreams and proper taking care of our health. Am working towards achieving and building a future that I can reflect back on with fulfillment and not regret.

Thanks for reading through my post @amara24 blog. See you in my next post. Loads of love 🥰💕.

body.title: ZULIA BEER: Curiosities & Review (ENG-ESP)
body.body:
>

I ran into this #beersaturday initiative while looking for a decent excuse to validate my unhealthy relationship with alcohol, and frankly, the dynamic looked pleasant. So here I am, posting in the Beer community with a bottle in my hand, a couple of questionable life choices, and my phone gallery full of aesthetic photos of the most overhyped yet surprisingly decent beer in Venezuela: Cerveza Zulia.

#

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRyBT4CHhhyYvyPfyL5x1G9MqTao4HJ6R2yPkgfYrLjCC/1780174156838.jpg)

For years, the undisputed champion of the Venezuelan palate was Polar Pilsen. If you wanted to get drunk on a budget or pretend to be a tough guy at a corner liquor store, you’d buy a case of Polar. But let’s speak the truth: Polar has lost all its quality. It completely lacks consistency. One bottle tastes like an acceptable fermented essence, the next tastes like sparkling tap water, and the third doesn't even have that distinctive bitterness an honest beer should possess. I got tired of wasting my money and my liver on corporate laziness. That’s why Zulia became my default choice for public events, night walks after work, and surviving the heat.

#

### <center>*Context*</center>

#

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbjym88TAi6Bwq1d7q56qbLsK1vDw4bfjdPrZDbLP5kmx/1780174174949.jpg)

To understand this liquid, you need a little lesson in geography and sociology, mainly because foreigners think Venezuela is just one uniform tropical cliché. Zulia is a state in western Venezuela, but in reality, it is a sociocultural anomaly. The climate there is a damn three-dimensional oven, the people are loud, intensely festive, and possess a regional pride that borders on the delusional (but I love that intensity, I like them). There is a recurring meme on Venezuelan social media stating that Zulia is an independent republic. And frankly, it might as well be. They have their own slang, their own aggressive musical genre called *gaita*, and a free-spirited and stubborn character that refuses to bow down to the centralized culture of the rest of the country. Out of that chaotic and sun-scorched landscape, this drink was born.

#

### <center>*The German Origin (And why there is an eagle on my bottle)*</center>

#

I did a bit of research into why this brand looks so fundamentally different from any other generic beer logo in Latin America. It turns out that Zulia was created back in 1925 in the aforementioned burning city. The founders decided to build the brewery's formal aesthetics under the visual inspiration of the German Empire. That explains the majestic and slightly intimidating eagle printed on the label, a symbol strongly linked to Prussian and imperial German heraldry.

#

It sounds completely bizarre to find a German imperial eagle melting under the 40°C Caribbean sun, but Venezuela actually maintained a very close and almost toxic relationship with Germany at the end of the 19th and beginning of the 20th centuries. From military advisors and structural architecture to philosophical imports, the Teutonic ghost haunts quite a few historical corners here. But let’s not turn this into a history class; we came here to talk about getting drunk, not to dissect the geopolitics of the past. Still, one has to appreciate the irony: a beer inspired by cold European militarism, strictly designed to play dominoes and avoid fainting from the heat.

#

### <center>What does it taste like? Will I start playing aggressive dominoes and singing gaitas if I drink it?</center>

#

You are not going to turn into a Toxic Zuliano overnight. But you will notice something very specific about the liquid itself. Zulia is technically a standard Pilsner with 4.5% alcohol content. It is not a \

beer in terms of volume, but it behaves like one. The flavor profile was created to be extremely light, clean, and refreshing.

#

The master brewers created it so you could drink six or seven bottles in a row under a murderous sun without saturating the palate with a heavy and bitter cloyingness. I usually prefer much stronger and more bitter drinks. Zulia does not offer that depth. But it fulfills its function with honors.

#

### <center>*A Couple of Curiosities for the Intellectual Drunk*</center>

#

If you want to pass yourself off as someone smart at parties while holding a bottle, here are three facts about this brand:

#

-This is officially the longest-running beer brand in existence in Venezuela. It has survived brutal military dictatorships, crises, aggressive corporate takeovers, and somehow has managed not to evaporate in the infernal heat of its home state. It literally just turned 100 years old.

#

-Before the 2000s, Zulia was a fiercely regionalist product. If you weren't in the western part of the country, it was almost impossible to get; it was consumed exclusively by old men listening to *gaitas* and complaining about the government. However, in 2012, the parent company \
executed a massive and quite aggressive marketing campaign to take it out of its regional bubble. They changed their focus completely, transforming it from a local relic into the \

choice for the younger urban public. It went from being a grandpas' drink to the official sponsor of underground rock concerts like Caramelos de Cianuro and Desorden Público. # -It has officially (and legally...) crossed international borders. It is legally sold in countries like Peru, the United States, and several of the Antillean islands. So, if you live outside Venezuela and come across that distinctive blue label with the German eagle at your local liquor store, give it a chance, you won't regret it. --- ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYxZbhYytxFzc7mKAEp1TbWdHrL4P9nUJoBbRseCaTe1Z/1780174194866.jpg)
*Español*

>

Me topé con esta iniciativa del #beersaturday mientras buscaba una excusa decente para validar mi insana relación con el alcohol, y francamente, la dinámica me pareció agradable. Así que aquí estoy, posteando en la comunidad de Beer con una botella en la mano, un par de decisiones de vida cuestionables y la galería de mi teléfono llena de fotos estéticas de la cerveza más sobrevalorada pero sorprendentemente decente de Venezuela: la Cerveza Zulia.

#

Durante años, la campeona indiscutible del paladar venezolano fue la Polar Pilsen. Si querías emborracharte con poco presupuesto o fingir que eras un tipo rudo en una licorería de esquina, te comprabas una caja de Polar. Pero hablemos con la verdad: la Polar ha perdido toda su calidad. Carece por completo de consistencia. Una botella te sabe a una esencia fermentada aceptable, la siguiente te sabe a agua de chorro con gas, y la tercera ni siquiera tiene ese amargor distintivo que una cerveza honesta debería poseer. Me cansé de gastar mi dinero y mi hígado a la pereza corporativa. Por eso la Zulia se convirtió en mi opción por defecto para eventos públicos, caminatas nocturnas al salir del trabajo y para sobrevivir al calor.

#

### <center>*Contexto*</center>

#

Para entender este líquido, necesitas una pequeña lección de geografía y sociología, principalmente porque los extranjeros creen que Venezuela es solo un gran cliché tropical uniforme. Zulia es un estado en el occidente de Venezuela, pero en realidad, es una anomalía sociocultural. El clima allá es un maldito horno tridimensional, la gente es ruidosa, intensamente fiestera y dueña de un orgullo regional que roza lo delirante (pero amo esa intensidad, me caen bien). Hay un meme recurrente en las redes sociales venezolanas que afirma que Zulia es una república independiente. Y francamente, bien podría serlo. Tienen su propia jerga, su propio género musical agresivo llamado *gaita* y un carácter de espíritu libre y obstinado que se niega a doblegarse ante la cultura centralizada del resto del país. De ese paisaje caótico y calcinado por el sol nació esta bebida.

#

### <center>*El Origen Alemán (Y por qué hay un águila en mi botella)*</center>

#

Me puse a investigar un poco por qué esta marca se ve tan fundamentalmente diferente de cualquier otro logo genérico de cerveza en Latinoamérica. Resulta que la Zulia fue creada allá por 1925 en la ardiente ciudad ya mencionada. Los fundadores decidieron construir la estética formal de la cervecería bajo la inspiración visual del Imperio Alemán. Eso explica el águila majestuosa y ligeramente intimidante impresa en la etiqueta, un símbolo fuertemente ligado a la heráldica prusiana e imperial alemana.

#

Suena completamente bizarro encontrar un águila imperial alemana derritiéndose bajo el sol caribeño a 40°C, pero Venezuela de hecho mantuvo una relación muy estrecha y casi tóxica con Alemania a finales del siglo XIX y principios del XX. Desde asesores militares y arquitectura estructural hasta importaciones filosóficas, el fantasma teutón persigue unos cuantos rincones históricos aquí. Pero no convirtamos esto en una clase de historia; vinimos aquí a hablar de embriagarnos, no a diseccionar la geopolítica del pasado. Aún así, hay que apreciar la ironía: una cerveza inspirada en el frío militarismo europeo, diseñada estrictamente para jugar dominó y evitar un desmayo por el calor.

#

### <center>*¿A qué Sabe? ¿Voy a empezar a jugar dominó agresivamente y a cantar gaitas si la tomo?*</center>

#

No te vas a convertir en un Zuliano Tóxico de la noche a la mañana. Pero sí te vas a dar cuenta de algo muy específico sobre el líquido en sí. La Zulia es técnicamente una Pilsen estándar con 4,5% de grado alcohólico. No es una cerveza \

en cuanto a volumen, pero se comporta como una. El perfil de sabor fue creado para ser extremadamente ligero, limpio y refrescante.

#

Los maestros cerveceros la crearon para que pudieras tomarte seis o siete botellas seguidas bajo un sol asesino sin saturar el paladar con un empalagamiento pesado y amargo. Por lo general prefiero bebidas mucho más fuertes y amargas. La Zulia no ofrece esa profundidad. Pero cumple su función con honores.

#

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPLHZ7LHsQnLK1d3zFr8oNQQ537RrqDHEMBRBRrLMcKxm/1780174209018.jpg)

### <center>*Un Par de Curiosidades para el Borracho Intelectual*</center>

#

Si quieres hacerte pasar por alguien inteligente en las fiestas mientras sostienes una botella, aquí tienes tres datos sobre esta marca:

#

-Esta es oficialmente la marca de cerveza más longeva que existe en Venezuela. Ha sobrevivido a dictaduras militares brutales, crisis, adquisiciones corporativas agresivas y, de alguna manera, se las ha arreglado para no evaporarse por el calor infernal de su estado natal. Literalmente hace poco cumplió 100 años.

#

-Antes de los 2000's, la Zulia era un producto ferozmente regionalista. Si no estabas en la zona occidental del país, era casi imposible conseguirla; era consumida exclusivamente por viejos que escuchaban *gaitas* y se quejaban del gobierno. Sin embargo, en el 2012, la empresa matriz \
ejecutó una campaña de marketing masiva y bastante agresiva para sacarla de su burbuja regional. Cambiaron su enfoque por completo, transformándola de una reliquia local a la opción \

para el público urbano más joven. Pasó de ser la bebida de los abuelos al patrocinador oficial de conciertos de rock underground tipo Caramelos de Cianuro y Desorden Público. # -Ha cruzado oficialmente (y legalmente...) las fronteras internacionales. Se vende de forma legal en países como Perú, Estados Unidos y varias de las islas de las Antillas. Así que, si vives fuera de Venezuela y te topas con esa etiqueta azul distintiva con el águila alemana en tu licorería local dale una oportunidad, no te vas a arrepentir. ---
| *From my infinite humbleness... / Desde mi infinita humildad...* | | :---: | | @noxys |
---

body.title: Another €150 Million Champions League Campaign For PSG
body.body:
/></center>

[source](https://www.ekospor.com/UEFA-Business-Model)




Tonight was the Champions League Final which the winners Paris St Germain will receive a trophy and prize money of €25 million. UEFA runs the EURO's and Champions League, Europa and Conference League competitions. UEFA runs as a non profit sports organization which means the bulk of the profits generated go directly back to the clubs.

This being run as a non profit I did not know and thought it was being run like FIFA which is also non profit, but has questionable payments This is why the FIFA leadership remains in power so long through supporting those that vote favorably with increased payments to their region/country. The talk is the current President Gianni Infantino is expected to serve his term of 15 years earning an ever increasing bumper salary due to rising revenue and profits.   

UEFA like FIFA work on a 4 year cycle with the pinnacle of the cycle concluding with the EURO's and revenue will peak over €5 billion for those years. Non EURO years will see revenue reach an expected €4.5 billion which each year rises slowly.

Roughly 80% is rewarded to the clubs playing in the elite competitions whilst there is also a solidarity budget of around 15% given to clubs across Europe not competing plus assisting grass roots initiatives. This accounts for 95% and UEFA keeps only around 2.5% for administrative purposes and expenses which is still a healthy €125 million and hardly non profit and a big number.

It is interesting to see how the funds are paid out and why teams compete in their local leagues in order to qualify for European competition places.

Champions League - every team who qualifies earns the standard €18.6 million plus another bonus depending on the teams performance where they finish in the league table. Every win is worth €2.5 million and a draw is worth €700K. €11 million if you reach the round of 16, €12.5 million quarter finals and €15 million for the semis.

A team making it through and winning the final will walk away with around €144-150 million so PSG have achieved this two years in a row after this evenings victory.

UEFA earns roughly 81% of their revenue from broadcasting and media rights which is worth €4.07 billion (81%). Commercial rights in the region of €787 million (16) plus tickets and hospitality at €100 million (3%) which is a smaller figure than I would have expected. Putting this into perspective how valuable tv rights are UEFA earned 40 x more than stadium ticket sales.

It was not long ago there were rumors of a Super League which would compete separately run by the clubs excluding UEFA and one can see why this will never happen. The clubs wanted to generate more income for themselves against UEFA's model which is all inclusive giving back the revenue earned to the clubs competing. No one can compete against this model because it is not about making profits for themselves, but supporting the sport by giving it back. Any club supporting a break away would be crazy to even consider this.

body.title: A GENERATIONAL MISTAKE
body.body: One of the things I have tried to be cautious about is repeating the mistakes my dad made in raising me. Although I now understand that he was only trying so hard so I could survive and thus never really had time for me and my sister, I can not still shake the feeling of neglect I felt as a child and I think it would happen to me as well. I have not been really close to my siblings as I wish, and despite the fact that I have really good intentions and big plans for them, I have not done enough to really show them those plans and intentions.\n\n

/> I give them money from time to time, but it’s not enough and it was the same thing my dad did to me as a child. The issue is I have not found a way to connect with them, and the thought of that gives me the chills sometimes. I do not know how to connect with kids, I do not even know how to discipline them, I do not know how to relate with them to bring respect and all, I do not know how to shout at them, when I try to do it, I tend to overdo or under do it, unlike my sister who does it seamlessly. This is exactly how my dad was growing up, and it affected our father and son relationship. In order to try to avoid making the same mistake in future, I want to bring my brothers close. I am years ahead of them, and I want them to experience that fatherly love from me. If I can do it with them, I can do it with my kids as well. They say fatherhood changes a man, but I would want to start acting like a father before I really become one. ##### PICTURE CREDIT IS MINE

body.title: Five Minute Freewrite: Bared Teeth
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb1t5zvz61rtQGi9JnkYLLt3x8Ujz24i8VRvquHtzYpVb/1780174333178.jpg)
[Picture Source](https://unsplash.com/photos/bottles-of-aquafina-water-made-with-recycled-plastic-qXWFlxb45Uo)

Zydone Inc started as a sole proprietorship which specializes in packaging and distributing water in transparent cans and polythene. With time it conquered the market with many households preferring its water to others in thr market. The price too was affordable.

As time goes on, it became necessary to expand the business, hence it was incorporated as a full fledge water bottling and packaging company. Business was booming too. 

Duke also owns a water bottling company. But his business was not as flourishing as that of Zydone Inc. and because of how competitive the water packaging business is, his business started suffering serious setbacks. At first, paying his staff became a big problem for him. He had to downsize to remain in business. That strategy was not enough as his sales kept dwindling by the day. 

And as a last resort, Duke started packaging and selling his own water products in the name of Zydone. His business started booming until one day the bubble was bursted. A staff of Zydone paid an unscheduled visit to Duke's factory and discovered the passing off. He quickly reported to the management of Zydone who wasted no time to contact the regulatory agency. 

The regulatory agency stormed Duke's water factory and caught him in the act and made their report accordingly. Duke was arrested by the police and his factory sealed. body.title: Honesty Isn't Always Easy.
body.body: > Yes, I have told white lies. I'm not going to open this with a performance of moral perfection that nobody would believe anyway, I have looked someone in the face, understood exactly what the truth would do to them in that moment, and chosen something softer. Something safer, something that let them walk away intact, and I have sat with that choice afterward and wondered whether I did the right thing. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUobkv7N6ZmgSGcqVyLqW32E21q3CpYDhHUGNZFhbe8Qc/1780174349669.jpg) That wondering is actually where this whole conversation lives, A white lie, the way most of us understand it, is a lie told to protect rather than to deceive for personal gain, You tell your friend her presentation was great when it was average because she is already nervous and there is nothing she can do to change it now, You tell your relative his business idea has potential because he just invested his savings into it and your brutal honesty at this stage helps nobody, You tell someone their cooking is fine because they made it with love and you are a guest in their home, Small mercies, Tiny fictions we offer each other to keep the day moving. And honetly? I don't think all of those are wrong, I really don't. There is a version of radical honesty that is not actually about truth, It is about the satisfaction of saying hard things without caring what they land like, I have met people who use i'm just being honest as a license to be unkind, and they dress it up as integrity, It isn't integrity, Integrity includes knowing when to speak, how to speak, and whether your honesty is serving the other person or just serving your own need to feel righteous, truth without compassion is just cruelty with good branding. But.... And this is a big but. White lies have a way of growing in ways you don't plan for , you tell one small comfortable lie and then the next conversation builds on it and suddenly you are maintaining a version of reality that was never real, I have watched this happen, the friend who told someone their relationship looked fine when it clearly didn't, and that person stayed two more years in something damaging because everyone around them kept softening the picture, the family that kept telling a sick person things were okay until the person had no time left to make real decisions about their own life, White lies told with love can still cause damage just delayed, quieter damage that arrives when the person is least prepared for it. So where does that leave me personally? I think the honest answer is that it depends on what the truth is for, If the truth in this moment genuinely helps the person make a better decision, face something they need to face, or protect themselves from something coming then I will find a kind way to tell it even if it is uncomfortable. I owe people that, not brutality, but honesty wrapped in care. But if the truth in this moment serves nothing except my own desire to have said it? If it only wounds without offering anything useful? then I will choose my words carefully, not lie exactly, but not volunteer devastation either. The truth matters, It always matters. But so does the person you are telling it to. Both things can be true at the same time, That is the part nobody likes to sit with. ***[Image Source](https://unsplash.com/photos/brown-wooden-blocks-on-white-table-Pd3ml1YRPlg)*** ![1000573341.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/treasuree/23s9c1MqSx1HhT1yGGJrzoEBDBcyBewncBKsKPuN1kVPXLcoQ7uNM77SbgWqKK6ErUSTg.png)

body.title: Coffee, Creativity, and a Moment to Reflect ☕✨
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmV2zjzBDN5ihUgj6iQYqbrdnzjz5mAL2axL4kCSRwve5Z/IMG_3204.png 

One of my favorite things about being a designer is finding inspiration in the simplest moments.

Today I took a break from screens, deadlines, and endless drafts to enjoy a quiet afternoon with a warm cup of coffee and a small dessert. It may seem like a simple moment, but sometimes those are the ones that help me recharge the most.

While sitting there, I found myself thinking about future projects, new ideas, and all the goals I still want to achieve. Creativity doesn't always happen when you're working; sometimes it appears when you slow down and allow your mind to wander.

I'm learning to appreciate these pauses more and more. They remind me that balance is just as important as ambition.

A little coffee, a little reflection, and a lot of inspiration for what comes next. 🤍

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@nansi/coffee-creativity-and-a-moment-to-reflect--brp)

body.title: Our Recent Guild Brawl and Featured Battle
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfUbS897pcCc582But3UTtcnGnLAcF9P8s9mNd4YTmWKh/image.png)

Hello Splinterlands summoners and welcome back to my blog!

Our guild has just finished our recent brawl. We finished in eighth place this week, it was less than stellar and not our best performance. In today’s post, I’ll break down our overall results, highlight my personal performance, and showcase one of my favorite battles.

***


# Guild Rank and Personal Performance

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPvVRPyNqWmayjtfX9rnbtRA8BgAScYxbTM5zCjLe46Ae/image.png)

Our performance was not good in this week's brawl compared to last week. We finished in eighth place compared to last week's fifth place, putting us in the bottom of the standings. We won sixty two battles and and lost ninety eight, a less than fifty per cent result. There were a lot of room for improvement that we should look into as a guild.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSdoBB6vn9SiQ4G2UB1xE6kHnxCyWfL9j34yx2WeWzhDy/image.png)

My own performance was not as good compared to previous brawl. I won four battles out of eight for a fifty per cent win rate. Inspite of our bad brawl results, we still earned 4.1k merits and 42 SPS. It's still a decent reward for playing brawls. 

***

# Featured Battle

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWJj2J7fM2L6oasfRdY4eStAGgyBvMHkz6C6XhA8AHBkX/image.png)

The battle included Equalizer and Shades of Grey rulesets. I chose the Earth archon Kaylia Silverleaf who grants the Execute ability to elves as well as debuff the enemy's magic attacks. Since this is an Equalizer ruleset with low mana cap, I picked units with low mana to maximize the slots. In the tank position, I had the one mana Halfling Refugee. He's a capable tank that deals three melee damage. In second position I had the three mana Ironwing Juggernaut. He has the Charge ability and can attack from that position. In third is my best unit, legendary Bren Palesworn. He deals dual damage and has the Shapeshift ability, enabling him to receive the Bloodline Dominion ability from the archon. In fourth was Ujurak Elder who buffs the whole team with an extra health. Finally, I had Oshannus Unmade who deals two range damage. 


The enemy also had a weaker line up. He also had Halfling Refugee, Ironwing Juggernaut and Ujurak Elder in his team but they are only at level one. To complete his line up he had a couple of magic damage dealers. Their attacks were decreased by my archon. This put the enemy at a big disadvantage and my team took the victory in this battle.


[Replay the Battle](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sm_s7hrJ9tnUzStDI0Y00eY?ref=logen9f)

***

# Come Play Splinterlands!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfAX3xcPAwc8omveh7imyKtqbHntKgVLqLckGTCHSjPyw/image.png)

Start your Splinterlands adventure today with my [referral](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=logen9f). You can play the game for free in the Frontier Mode or take your game to the next level by purchasing a spellbook. Buying a spellbook allows you to earn SPS tokens and use the  market to sell in game assets. Also, we will both get 500 Credits which can be used top purchase cards once you buy a spellbook.

body.title: No te olvides... (Es/En)
body.body:
![IMG_20260530_164129.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jrobe/23wMggkdm5nKdGwDmCGkvJsSM16VxZzi28X3SxVeJQMcZ2w5iHZviL2W4oGAkB3fdeD1z.jpg)





>“No te olvides del de abajo” me señalo un amigo el otro día, al cruzarnos en la calle. Hacía tiempo que no coincidíamos. Es una de esas personas que se dedica a hacer el bien sin mirar a quien.

>Lo conocí precisamente en la calle. Un día, mientras hacia mi caminata diaria hacia el trabajo, me dio botella (en cuba se le dice a darte un aventón en auto, moto, etc.). 

>No lo conocía, pero conectamos rápido. Llegué al punto de mi destino, le agradecí y seguí mi camino.

>Par de días después, sucedió igual. Casi la misma hora, casi el mismo punto del trayecto. Otro aventón, otra conversación animada sobre la situación cotidiana del cubano. Así fueron sucediéndose más encuentros.

>En algún punto llegué a sospechar de mi buena suerte o de las buenas intenciones de aquel hombre que yo no conocí, pero que incluso en una ocasión, me cruzó en sentido contrario y viró a recogerme, para darme un aventón. Demasiada buena gente para mi gusto, pensé por un momento.

>Tiempo después supe que era un buen amigo de uno de mis familiares cercanos. Yo no lo conocía, al menos no lograba reconocerlo. 

>Pero, la verdad es que, amigo o no de alguien cercano a mí, es un alma solidaria, a la que no se le había subido la fama para la cabeza después de haber mejorado algo su situación económica.

>Volviendo a la frase del inicio, y a la reflexión que me generó… al leer los post de la iniciativa sobre la solidaridad propuesta por @damarysvibra, asocie la frase de ese amigo con la propuesta hecha en esta comunidad.

>Creo que una de las frases que primero acudió a mi mente fue una utilizada por los mayores de mi familia: Como me ves, te verás. 

>Es probable que no tenga el mismo sentido en ambos contextos, pero gramaticalmente hablando, simplemente la asocie.

>Y creo que tuvo que ver con la posibilidad de reconocer que todos, sin excepción podemos pasar por situaciones digamos que de indefensión, de vulnerabilidad, etc.

>Y eso no debe olvidarse, no desde una perspectiva oportunista, sino todo lo que implica en sí.

>Por ejemplo,  la posibilidad de ofrecer una mano a quien lo necesite conlleva por un lado, asumir una actitud empática y en correspondencia, analizar a la realidad en que nos movemos de una manera más crítica. 

>Desde ese punto, creo incluso que puede asumirse una actitud preventiva ante posibles situaciones complejas que podemos atravesar.

>Por otro lado, a además de hacer el bien en si mismo, que ya es una actitud muy noble y digna de respeto.

>El hecho de estar en posición de ofrecer algún tipo de ayuda, nos levanta el espíritu. 

>No por el hecho de sentirnos superior a la persona que a la que ayudamos, sino por el hecho de que cuando ofreces, estas en situación que te permite darte cuenta de lo que aun tienes, y puedes valorarlo más.

>Incluso, practicar la solidaridad creo que nos previene de creencias limitantes, casi que paranoicas. A veces me he sorprendido pensando: tanta bondad.. Que querrá a cambio?

>Puede que en ocasiones el contexto nos lleve a pensar de ese modo, pero eso también es un indicador de algunas fallas en nuestro modo de pensar, de lo que esperamos del mundo.

>Y la solidaridad precisamente, cuando la practicas, te permite abrir el espectro de tu mente. 

>Ya no miras con recelo a a quien viene con una mano amiga, sencillamente porque tu practicas ese modo de vida y no ves fantasmas porque conoces ese terreno.

>Bueno, agradecido por tu compañía hasta el final, te dejo un abrazo de amigo.

>Texto traducido al ingles por Google traductor. 

>Imagen tomada con mi teléfono Xiaomi Redmi.

>ENGLISH VERSION

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jrobe/23wMggkdm5nKdGwDmCGkvJsSM16VxZzi28X3SxVeJQMcZ2w5iHZviL2W4oGAkB3fdeD1z.jpg




>“Don’t forget the one downstairs,” a friend pointed out to me the other day as we passed each other on the street. 

>It had been a while since we’d run into each other. He’s one of those people who dedicates himself to doing good without expecting anything in return.

>I met him on the street, of all places. One day, while I was on my daily walk to work, he gave me a ride (in Cuba, that’s what they call giving someone a ride in a car, on a motorcycle, etc.). 

>I didn’t know him, but we hit it off quickly. I reached my destination, thanked him, and continued on my way.

>A couple of days later, the same thing happened. Almost the same time, almost the same spot on the route. 

>Another ride, another lively conversation about the daily life of Cubans. More encounters followed.

>At some point, I began to wonder about my good fortune or the good intentions of this man I didn’t know, but who, on one occasion, even crossed my path going the other way and turned around to pick me up for a ride. Too kind for my liking, I thought for a moment.

>Some time later, I learned he was a good friend of one of my close relatives. 

>I didn't know him, or at least I couldn't recognize him. But the truth is, friend or not of someone close to me, he's a compassionate soul, someone who hadn't let fame go to his head after his financial situation improved somewhat.

>Going back to the initial quote and the reflection it sparked... while reading the posts about the solidarity initiative proposed by @damarysvibra, I associated that friend's quote with the proposal made in this community.

>I think one of the first phrases that came to mind was one used by the older members of my family: \

>It probably doesn't have the same meaning in both contexts, but grammatically speaking, I simply made the connection.

>And I think it had to do with the possibility of recognizing that we can all, without exception, go through situations of helplessness, vulnerability, and so on. 

>And that should not be forgotten, not from an opportunistic perspective, but in all that it implies in itself.

>For example, the possibility of offering a helping hand to someone in need entails, on the one hand, adopting an empathetic attitude and, correspondingly, analyzing the reality in which we live more critically. 

>From that perspective, I even believe it allows us to adopt a preventative approach to potentially complex situations we might encounter.

>On the other hand, besides doing good itself, which is already a very noble and respectable act, being in a position to offer some kind of help lifts our spirits. 

>Not because we feel superior to the person we are helping, but because when you offer, you are in a position that allows you to realize what you still have, and you can value it more. 

>Furthermore, I believe that practicing solidarity prevents us from developing limiting, almost paranoid, beliefs. Sometimes I've caught myself thinking: so much kindness... 

>What does he want in return? Perhaps the context sometimes leads us to think that way, but that is also an indicator of some flaws in our way of thinking, in what we expect from the world.

>And solidarity, precisely when you practice it, allows you to broaden your mind. 

>You no longer look with suspicion at those who come with a helping hand, simply because you practice that way of life and you don't see ghosts because you know that terrain.

>Well, thank you for your company until the end, I send you a friendly hug.

>Text translated into English by Google Translate.

>Image taken with my Xiaomi Redmi phone.

Some atheistic determinists believe that there is no free will at all.  Others only believe in free will because the Bible said we have free will, but usually lean more to God is making the choices \

And it is more of a mess because people have an idea about reality that isn't real at all.  And you can't blame em, because there is a group of people who know, and don't want the public to know.  Hollywood movie producers make movies that reinforces a false view of reality.  The science that put on the TV is also to reinforce that false view.

This group wants to make sure you never understand how powerful you are.  They want you feeling powerless.  Like, \

## Time is not linear

This is the hard one.  Because humans are programmed, hard wired into your brain, to see time as linear.  We see the past as real and future as just a probability.  It is ok to see things this way, because it is how we set up this world so that we could witness how we create our future.

But, it isn't really real.

Our universe is created and destructed trillions of times per second.  Our lives are like a film reel.  A bunch of still images, that only by experiencing one after the other, rapidly, do we see movement.  Further, just like the film reel, our entire life is there to be viewed.  All of our past, and all of our future.

Many people reading these words would automatically jump to, \

We need to look at time differently. There is no past, there is no future. There is only the NOW. And every now, comes complete with a past and a future. So, you could say that an entire film reel is created every second of your life.

></center>
## Fate is chosen by you

Before your life, your life is planned out by YOU.

YOU chose your parents.  With your parents \

.  YOU chose how your life would be set up. What kind of parents they would be.  Would you have a normal childhood, or be shaped by neglect or child abuse?  (Yes, YOU, the large you, not in corporeal form, chose all these pieces to learn the life lessons you chose.  There are many super-powers you can get if you live through childhood abuse, and heal it.)\n\nYOU chose the major people in your life. All your friends were chosen (with their approval) by YOU.  Those fated meetings were planned.  Not planned in the specific, frame by frame happening that you experienced, but there was an energy, a template put over you, that guided the two of you to meet.  A feeling of \

.  And large parts of your life will be orchestrated so that you meet again, if the first meeting didn't work out.  This is why many people describe a meeting as fate.\n\nYou are in the driver's seat and you can choose not to interact with this other person.  However, know that this meeting was planned by YOU and them.  So, basically, you are saying no to your old friend.  But, we also choose the \
in our lives. (Its like playing cops and robbers with your friend.) So, if you have worked through the lessons in your life, and are way ahead of schedule, you may be saying no to a \
entering your life. (Most people cannot get to this level, even if i told them all that would happen.  And, if you are at that level, you may find yourself enjoying the \

></center>
## The intricacies of many timelines

Now, for the real mind melting stuff.

In that last interaction description, lets say you were advanced on you life lesson plan enough, that you could recognize, and choose consciously, to deal or not deal with the \

into your life.  What you will probably choose is BOTH choices.  One of you will say no, and the other one of you will say yes.  At that moment you will have two futures.  After that moment, you will have two entirely separate lives.  Going at the same time.

This universe is designed to play out ALL the options.  It is hard to discuss what this universe is trying to find, and we will only know when we have found it.  So, WE will try every option that we feel will lead to knew and novel endings.

There are many options that WE know how will end, and so they aren't explored. (think of all the choices you don't even engage with.  The next time you are trying to decide between A and B, and look at why C, D, E… aren't even thought of as possibilities)  Like, Schroedinger's Cat experiment.  People accept the end states cat dead and cat alive.  But there are other states that we don't consider because \
.  Like the cat not being in the box, but most scientists will explain this as \

.  But, seriously, there are many possibilities that we will just assume was a mistake.  The radioactive material is missing.  The poison wasn't really poison.  The entire experiment fell off the table.  But, but, there are more possibilities that we just ignore, like:  The cat is both dead and alive.  Sometimes you pour food in his bowl, and he comes, and other times he doesn't exist.  Or, instead of the cat dying or not, the scientists die or not.

AND there are so many places in there where the scientist can choose BOTH, and in one timeline the scientist is very sad for what they did.  And another where they scientist is glad that they chose to not even try the experiment and smuggled the kitty out.

This is just how the universe works.  You can become aware of it.  You can even learn to talk with yourselves that \
></center>\n\nSo, you have free will.  It is just that we (humans) tend to view the \
incorrectly.  Like, the choice to meet \

person was chosen long before you were born.  Or that it was not just a simple cause and effect.  That there were many layers involved in that cause and effect.  Or that we don't consider the emotions has part of the cause and effect, although they are often MUCH MORE important to how things turnout. \

people shout. Universe doesn't care about your science. If you comprehend how the universe really works, you can start steering your life to better (for you) outcomes. If you figure out what your life lessons are, than you can stop resisting them, and try to look for easy/fun ways to learn them. So, learn to feel the life choice points, and choose with a broader feel about what you would like your life to be like. Then you will feel like you have a little more control in your life.

body.title: Colour Dedication Doesn't Justify The Lie
body.body: There is a motto I have always lived on which is \

.

![1000723851.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikens/23t74ySHrnyPfdBsGXNxJaRe7n1pPXyJSbrfT5aWJjoeTBpKuo6f2fL9TRmZEFaY5ESDG.jpg)

Sometimes we try finding excuses for some mistakes we make because we think we are doing the right thing for the people we love, protecting them from getting hurt and preventing them from feeling sad but then we fail to realize that the hurt feeling they feel is actually not as deep as the wound it brings to them upon realizing that they were lied to.

We even go as far as crediting it a great attractive name just for it look nice that we are doing the best thing cos what else would justify naming a lie as being white? 
So those horrible lies were what? Rainbow?
No lie is bigger or smaller, a lie is a lie.

Some people may prefer it though. They don't want to face the hard truth but rather embrace the wrong path simply because it brings comfort. I don't want that so I don't do it either no matter how you may want to see me as. It is better that I keep silent about it than tag it as a white lie.

Just like a phrase I came across some days ago, that there are so many things we keep silent about but hides a lot of truth. That is, we know that saying the truth may hurt, cause relationship to fall out, break out in feelings but then we chose the path of remaining silent about it rathan lying about it in the name of protecting our so-called loved ones.

It does not mean that the truth wouldn't surface ever again but then it didn't came out to be a lie at the first instance.
If I am right, I think we once wrote on a prompt of **\

** here in Hive Learners and we had several inputs from writers with different views. So it got me thinking while writing this, that even when we kept silent about the truth so that we don't get to lie, does it still amount to be a lie? Like a Lie Of Omission.

![1000723876.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikens/23t7BZ4thMpeLSXK5uC8FrLtsb2PdZtP7LWRAPnCKyDPjNSHivViLnWE27Bg2pBcR6Vzv.jpg)

All the same, in my own perspective, I feel like it's still best to keep silent than saying a lot of things that withhold lies and deceits.
A relationship kept and built on lies, no matter the kind of love attached or the kind of bond we want to keep strong, it is prone to getting destroyed and shattered right in our presence at any time with no prior notice Just like a house built on poor foundation or sand,it won't last long as expected.

In summary, be it white lie, Red lie, Blue lie or any shades of colour we may want to give to our lies as name dedication, it still doesn't justify the wrong act of what we do. Being plain and maintaining relationships on truth makes it more stronger and help keep the right circle you can ever need for a positive growth.

I'll be dropping my 🖊️ here on the Hive Learners community prompt 

Thanks for reading through 🤗

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYUgnGMLKbxYXGCtWHHcWskTk5FVFLVmGAVM73dSf2iUG/1780170886794.jpg)

<center>•───────•°•❀•°•───────•</center>

Después de una larga y agotadora semana de trabajo, no hay nada que me llene más el corazón que dedicarle tiempo a los míos, como muchos saben, los días de semana llego bastante cansada de la rutina laboral, por lo que a veces el tiempo se nos va volando. Por eso, me encanta aprovechar los fines de semana para detenerme, respirar y, sobre todo, consentir a los más pequeños de la casa. ❤️

Hoy decidí meterme a la cocina con todo el amor del mundo y prepararles un delicioso arroz salteado, para mí, cocinarles sus platos favoritos es una de las formas más bonitas y sinceras de decirles cuánto los amo y compensar esos momentos en los que mamá tiene que estar fuera trabajando. ¡Ver sus caritas de felicidad al comer no tiene precio!

<center>•───────•°•❀•°•───────•</center>

Ingredientes:

El Arroz: ¼ de kilo de arroz (cocido previamente, preferiblemente del día anterior o frío para que quede bien suelto).

La Proteína: 1 chuleta de cerdo (cortada en cuadritos) y 6 rebanadas de jamón (cortadas en tiras).

Los Aromáticos: 2 dientes de ajo pisados, ½ cebolla (picada en cuadritos) y 1 ají (cortado en juliana/tiras finas).

El Toque de Color: 1 zanahoria pequeña (cortada en cuadritos).

El Sazón: Adobo, colorante Carmencita, pimienta molida y sal al gusto.

<center>•───────•°•❀•°•───────•</center>

Paso a Paso:

​Preparar la base de sabor:
En un sartén grande con un chorrito de aceite caliente, agrega los 2 dientes de ajo pisados y la cebolla, sofríe a fuego medio hasta que la cebolla comience a ponerse transparente y el ambiente se llene de ese aroma tan rico.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNuyFNkeGiQdu5qGtimc8L7c1tmXEktD9dT7kHNSwxBxv/1780173158180.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRrNmZWhNppbQxK6JKo3TTYRw7oZ9GcFg5zbhZFknYPTa/1780173158239.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQiySQ4B4Fe72H19aYFw8ZNsHo4B5dhKZ2AYodjvobkmX/1780173158295.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRmGEGCNCTYqTrNeetuy6Ni28o4ggh6bB61SCCzqf5EHo/1780173158342.jpg)



​Cocinar la chuleta:
Añade los cuadritos de chuleta de cerdo al sartén. Sazónalos con un toque de adobo, pimienta y una pizca de sal. Cocina bien hasta que la carne esté dorada y en su punto.

Incorporar los vegetales y el jamón:
Agrega la zanahoria en cuadritos y el ají en juliana. Cocina por unos minutos para que la zanahoria se ablande un poco pero mantenga una textura firme. Luego, incorpora las tiras de jamón y mezcla todo para que los sabores se vayan abrazando.

El gran salteado final:
Agrega el arroz poco a poco al sartén, yo lo cociné el mismo día con sal y un poco de Carmencita para darle color , lo deje reposar para poder realizar el salteado, aquí está el arroz en plena cocción.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR5kAvr2cjoLnK8UEZHkhimq1UzXUL9xqwqjSAyGppL4h/1780173109437.jpg)


Sube un poco el fuego y saltea con energía, mezclando todo muy bien para que el arroz absorba todos los jugos de la carne, el jamón y los aliños. Rectifica la sal y la pimienta si es necesario.

<center>•───────•°•❀•°•───────•</center>

Les cuento que la cocina estaba impregnada de un olor increíble; ya el ajo, la cebolla y la chuleta se estaban dorando perfectamente y yo estaba inspirada. ¡Y en ese preciso instante, se fue la luz!
Se imaginarán la escena: yo en la cocina a oscuras, con los niños esperando por su comida favorita y el arroz salteado a mitad de camino. 

Pero como buena mamá (y porque el hambre no espera), no me dejé vencer por el apagón.

Encendí la linterna del teléfono, con un ojo en el sartén y otro cuidando que no se quemara nada en la penumbra, continué con la receta, al final, el ají en juliana, el toque de la Carmencita y todo el sazón se juntaron en perfecta sintonía, demostrando que ni la falta de electricidad puede apagar las ganas de consentir a los que uno ama.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeKmxJp4S54dLQw2BdjHyHWgqEzhDHdg4w2SJY2kdyFfq/1780172254026.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeQ3gJ6isYEMj8afBgq6Hto2YpyasprEZonYZazSwpKME/1780172254073.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWyuriKcWbfjfogWUPpJ98iff3YU23hA5vo3ZrByv4VKe/1780172254115.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmag3Qo9DkPQ3hCMZZNMLompp9bcdSzDcEEGATktkm125L/1780172254153.jpg)

<center>•───────•°•❀•°•───────•</center>

Me despido por hoy, deseándoles que terminen de pasar un fin de semana maravilloso, lleno de descanso, unión familiar y, por supuesto, ¡mucha comida sabrosa!

Cuéntenme en los comentarios: ¿cómo va su fin de semana?, ¿les ha tocado alguna vez terminar de cocinar a oscuras como a mí? ¡Los leo!

Les mando un abrazo enorme y muchísimas bendiciones. ¡Hasta la próxima publicación!

🔴 📷 Todas las fotos compartidas en esta publicación son de mi total autoría, capturadas con mucho cariño para compartir este momento con ustedes.

body.body:
Welcome to my blog 

Today, I will be taking you along on how to prepare porridge beans and white rice in the local way.


![IMG_20260530_090217_536.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pinkbeee/23yd7nd3XhZ31SxMrWzrxyQ4YCo24w8z4DTyiEaHrbZ2yRrrxQeFvLvbtbe39vWLxnRSH.jpg)


First of all, select the shaft from your beans after which you wash the beans with clean and cold water, rinse it into the pot and placed it on fire.

After placing on fire allow to cook for about 30 minutes, remove from fire and shifter it. After shiftering the beans, rinse it with clean water and place back on the fire.

Add water according to the amount of the beans in the pot and allow to cook, check if the beans is soft and when the beans is soft, add some ingredients to the beans.

Ingredients to be added include chopped onions, blended crayfish and pepper, dried fish, seasoning cubes, salt, palm oil, spices (if necessary) then cover the pot and allow to cook for extra 5 to 10 minutes.

Your porridge beans is ready. Switch off the fire and take it down.

Time to cook your rice.

Wash your raw rice and parboil, after parboiling it, return into the pot, add some water and salt, after which you can place on fire.

Allow to cook for about 30 minutes untill entirely soft. Remove from fire and set to dish. Your food is ready. White rice and porridge beans.

body.title: In Motherhood, Some Days Are Good, Some Days Are Bad
body.body:
Some days, being a mother feels easy. Other days, it feels like I'm running on empty and just trying to make it through the day without falling apart.

I've learned that motherhood isn't about always being strong. There are days when I'm exhausted before the day even begins. Days when my thoughts are all over the place, when I feel overwhelmed by responsibilities, and when I wish I could simply take a break from everything for a little while.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVaTsBUXZNbG6QUaFMmBdzZaVW8skFWXjnpgwTbGJMqv4/1000221887.jpg 

[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/ai-generated-mother-child-crying-9650272/)

But motherhood doesn't really pause.
No matter how tired I feel, there are lunches to prepare, questions to answer, messes to clean up, and little arms reaching for hugs. My children still need me, and somehow that gives me the strength to keep moving, even when I don't feel strong at all.

For a long time, I thought I needed to be the kind of mother who had everything under control. The mother who never got frustrated, never felt tired, and always knew exactly what to do. As the years have gone by, I've realized that isn't realistic. I'm human, and like everyone else, I have difficult days.

What matters most is that I keep showing up.
My children don't see all the worries that stay in my mind late at night. They don't know about every moment of self-doubt or every time I question whether I'm doing enough. What they remember is that I was there. They remember the bedtime stories, the hugs after a bad day, the laughter in ordinary moments, and the comfort of knowing they could count on me.

I've stopped chasing the idea of being a perfect mother, that is when I don't know any thing because perfection isn't what my children need. They need love, they need consistency , they need someone who will be there for them, even on the days when life feels heavy.

So I take it one day at a time. Sometimes one hour at a time.
Some days are harder than others, but every day I choose to keep going. Not because I'm always strong, but because I love my children more than words can explain. And most of the time, that love is enough to carry me through.


**Thanks for checking on my blog and have a wonderful day**

body.title: When a White Lie Feels Like the Right Choice
body.body: To be honest, I have told a white lie before in some situations , and I believe it's the same for most people as well. Growing up as a child, I was taught to embrace truth even in the point of death, and I was taught to be honest even in tough situations, and I grew up with that. Telling lies became so fearful to me, and whenever I saw a person lying like his life depends in it, I usually shook my head. However, as I continue to grow into adulthood with many life experiences, I begin to see situations where truth can be very tough to deliver at some point, and if I do, it could have severe effects on human lives. ![17801729926777325379536845573995.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nkemakonam89/48QQygJwM1i6GYAT89hNFCsTkMJuWPqamsvoZPxQWN9HcPtP6P4ZXs8F4JhKcjocnQ.png) One of those experiences was when my mom was kidnapped. My grandma was worried that Mum's phones were switched off for days, and she has yet to hear from her since she left for the trip to the north. She never spoke with my mom to be sure she reached successfully, and that is enough to get her worried. While we were in a tight situation, calling police, praying, and doing a lot, Grandma kept asking a thousand and one questions about my mom's whereabouts. I had no choice but to cook up white lies to tell her so she could be calm while we kept searching for Mum. If we had broken the news to her , knowing that she is suffering from high blood pressure, that truth of kidnapping may have affected grandma life. Yea, I saw the white lie as a narrow escape to save my grandma. So do I think it is okay to tell a white lie when the truth might be devastating? Well, I will say yes, but only when it's needed, just like the case I described above. Personally, I am of the opinion that white lies shouldn't be used for personal gain. We shouldn't tell white lies to manipulate others or run away from our responsibility. As long as you have a good intention and it's a temporary something, then it's fair enough to tell a white lie and protect something without causing harm to anyone. But then, truth remains the best option generally; there's no need to romance a lie. The way we present a truth with compassion can save us from troubles, and in our daily lives, we can't go wrong with telling the truth. There are situations where white lies can help, but we shouldn't make it a habit at all; otherwise, we would have trust issues with people around us. body.title: White Lie Is Also A Lie
body.body:
>One among many other traits my father dislikes immensely is telling lies. You can do certain things, and my Dad would overlook, but the moment you tell a lie, he would handle you with an iron fist. I don't know why he despised the character so much, but I am glad that the training he gave us became a part of me. There are many things I can easily do, but you see, telling lies, especially in critical matters, I would rather remain silent. Lies are always very sweet to the ears of the listener and lips of the deceiver until the truth comes out. Within a split second, what once made you happy would break your heart into pieces and ruin your entire day. To be honest, all lies are lies whether they are white or black. If it is not the truth, then seriously, it should not be told. We all tell lies. As careful as I am about lies, there are times when I am forced to lie, but I can't say I am proud of it. Even if it was told for a good purpose. There are situations in life when telling lies can be considered an option, especially if it's going to save a life or prevent a situation from becoming worse. But my concern is that in the end, the truth would come to light, and when it finally does, people would not consider the fact that you did what you had to do for a good reason. Imagine, for instance, someone's father is critically sick, and because you didn't want to make them worried, probably because they are writing an examination or attending to a crucial project, you told them all was well. The person felt relaxed and probably concentrated on the project. Sadly, the father passed away, and they got the information. How do you think that person would react to you? So, whether it is a white lie or not, it should not be told. The Bible says, “the truth will always set us free,” and I believe it. It may be bitter, it may be painful, but it's always the best option. It won't take long before we take the truth and accept things as they are. But imagine you accepted something and dwelt with it only to discover that it was a lie, that pain would always live with you. Some people say they don't like the truth because it is painful, but I would always prefer it. Hurt me with the truth, at least I know it is real, and I will heal. But a single lie can ruin one's life for life, a single lie can break a trust that took a long time to build. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ6ZEKqFRyueVGhwyvevW7Ra2wdqhSqdQWo9pWzRG6vDg/1780172963722.jpg) After considering all these, the disadvantages of lies are far greater. If we are wise enough, we should keep away from it by all means. Let anyone who thinks there are certain lies that are innocent keep believing what they believe; eventually, they will realize that lies bring nothing but disappointment, no matter how innocent they may look. ------ N.B: All Images Were Generated By Gemini AI ------

Thanks For Reading

Its not ideal to not be able to show this piece, but I still gained the knowledge of how to do it and invented several useful oil painting mediums & varnishes used in its creation which never yellowed and still cannot be bought anywhere.

I am posting these videos for posterity and for people that are interested in seeing an oil painting created from start to finish in the Baroque style evolved for the 21st century. body.title: Running on Fumes
body.body:
<div class=text-justify>



![IMG_5861.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/23tmHRDiZM6gQ8kM7vKSCTT9F3J9keRvUVj6WMz95pGfJAcew2t9e1KfV47mzVLSZQQzQ.webp)


I recently realized how difficult it is to be the strong one in relationships. The one people run and get so used to because they assume you carry things well that they forget you’re carrying anything at all.

They see the smiles, quick replies, and the moments where you still show up despite being exhausted, and take it as if your cup is always full. But, the truth is far from that. Sometimes you are running on fumes, just hanging by a thread, surviving quietly, pouring from a place that has already gone dry. And I think that’s where I currently am. My own cup is empty. 

It was my birthday on the 25th but no one remembered because I didn’t make a post. I was fighting my demons alone but not one person I called a friend called to check in. It skipped their minds, they were occupied with work or are dealing with their own demons too, probably, but trust that no matter what, even if I had tears in my eyes on my friends birthdays, I would pick my phone up and wish them a happy birthday. 

I have become more quiet than I used to be socially. I disappear sometimes and now replying to anyone feels like work. Even the smallest things suddenly feel heavy. It’s not hatred, I couldn’t hate my friends. Neither is it pride or lack of love. It’s simply me reflecting exhaustion in its rawest form.

![IMG_5862.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/23tGaDXGecjFrhW43KCfgPE5ntvthZCnqAbjYQMtAhDoRT6HhfeYvez217oZj9ikbvWMN.jpeg)

I think many people underestimate how emotionally draining life can become when you are constantly expected to be available for others while silently battling your own storms but they’re never available for you. 

Even the strongest soldiers need rest. Even the people who comfort everyone else sometimes need to be comforted too. The listeners need someone to listen to them. Strong friends need softness. Those cheerful ones sometimes cry in private. And the people always checking up on others also want to experience what it feels like to be checked on without asking first.

In all of this, strength is not the absence of vulnerability. In fact, real strength is being honest enough to admit when you are no longer okay. This phase feels so strange to me because I am used to being the giver, being dependable and used to pouring into others without hesitation. But now, for once, I just want to be held emotionally without feeling guilty for it.

I think a lot of us are secretly carrying this same feeling. Walking around tired, smiling through burnout, trying to function while emotionally running on empty and hoping someone notices the silence.

So if someone you love suddenly becomes distant, quieter, slower, or emotionally unavailable, maybe pause before taking it personally. Some people are not withdrawing because they stopped caring. We are simply trying to survive enough to feel like ourselves again.

<sup>[img](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/clock-time-gear-gears-face-blue-70182/)</sup>

<sup>[img2](https://pixabay.com/photos/clockwork-church-gears-time-clock-4651185/)</sup>



</diva>

body.title: (ESP-ENG) Work and motherhood. HELP!
body.body: >Welcome, Hivers, to this new post. A few weeks ago, I mentioned that it was time for me to go back to work, and between all the appointments and adjusting my schedule, I’ve had a hard time sitting down to write. In fact, I’m typing with one hand while feeding my baby melon with the other, a scene you can probably imagine, ha ha ha. \n\n

>Bienvenidos Hivers a este nuevo post, hace unas semanas comenté que me tocaba reintegrarme al trabajo, y entre tantas consultas y adaptaciones del horario me ha costado sentarme a escribir, es más, estoy escribiendo con una mano, mientras con la otra le doy melón a mi bebé, una escena que se pueden imaginar jajaja. \n\n

>Going back to work brought up a lot of feelings, ranging from guilt to relief. Part of me felt guilty about leaving her, even if just for a few hours, because for months I’d been with her practically 24/7. And another part felt at peace, because I could free myself up a bit and work.\n\n

>La vuelta al trabajo trajo consigo muchos sentimientos, desde la culpa hasta la tranquilidad. Una parte de mí, se sentía culpable de dejarla, aunque fuera por unas horas, porque durante meses estuve prácticamente 24/7 con ella. Y otra se sentía tranquila, porque podía liberarme un poco y trabajar.\n\n

>The first day was awful for both of us. My mom offered to help me take care of her, so with a heavy heart, I left her with her bottles full of breast milk that morning. I went to work crying, until I calmed down a bit and was able to get through the day’s tasks. However, we ran into a problem: my baby wouldn’t take the bottle. There was no way she would take it, and she cried a lot, according to what my mom told me, until one of her coworkers managed to distract her and she took a little from the bottle. \n\n

>El primer día, fue horrible para ambas, mi mamá se ofreció a ayudarme a cuidarla, así que con todo el dolor del mundo se la dejé en la mañana con sus teteros llenos de leche materna. Me fui al trabajo llorando, hasta que me tranquilicé un poco y pude cumplir con las obligaciones del día. Sin embargo, tuvimos un inconveniente, mi bebé no quiso agarrar el tetero, no hubo forma ni manera de que lo agarrara, y lloró mucho, según lo que me comentó mi mamá, hasta que una compañera de ella, logró distraerla y tomó un poco de tetero. ![Mujeres_Ensayo-removebg-preview.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/izzieperez/EoCgcTa9nDFaBGnMEnxDhXiy6jZHJUuBc8wdWDDBhBFtgTq4MA73sftJeSsdsCVMH46.png)

>For reference, I managed to pump 8 ounces of milk over the previous two days, and she only drank two. A process that, by the way, was not at all easy, because I even had to buy another pump, an electric one, since the manual one wouldn’t extract any milk, if anything, less than a quarter of an ounce.\n\n

>Para referencia, logré extraerme 8 onzas de leche en los dos días anteriores, y solo tomó dos. Un proceso que, por cierto, no fue nada sencillo, porque tuve que comprarme incluso otro extractor, uno eléctrico porque el manual no me sacaba nada de leche, si acaso menos de un cuarto de onza. \n\n

>When I left work, my mom was already waiting for me with my daughter nearby. As soon as I saw her, I picked up my baby, who had started crying again, and put her to my breast; that was the only way to calm her down and get us both settled. After that, everything was easier, even though I had to pump milk when I got home because my breasts were sore.\n\n

>Al salir del trabajo, mi mamá ya me esperaba con mi hija en una zona cercana, apenas la vi, tomé a mi bebé que ya había empezado a llorar nuevamente y le di su tetica, esa fue la única forma de calmarla y que nos tranquilizáramos las dos. Ya luego todo fue más sencillo, aunque llegue a la casa teniendo que extraerme leche, porque me dolía el pecho.\n\n

>The following Tuesday we had our 6-month checkup, and we got the go-ahead to start complementary feeding. So far, it’s been almost two weeks of getting used to making her meals and letting her try different things. However, I haven’t been able to give her much variety yet, but she has tried: melon, apple, banana, carrot, squash, plantain, meat, and chicken, seasoned with onion, garlic, and cilantro.\n\n

>El martes siguiente tuvimos la consulta de 6 meses, y nos dieron el permiso de comenzar alimentación complementaria. Hasta la fecha tenemos casi dos semanas, acostumbrándonos a hacerle comidas, dándole a probar varias cosas, sin embargo, todavía no le he podido dar más variedad, pero ha probado: melón, manzana, cambur, zanahoria, auyama, plátano, carne y pollo, aliñado con cebolla, ajo y cilantro. ![Mujeres_Ensayo-removebg-preview.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/izzieperez/EoCgcTa9nDFaBGnMEnxDhXiy6jZHJUuBc8wdWDDBhBFtgTq4MA73sftJeSsdsCVMH46.png)

>The pediatric gastroenterologist who treats us gave us the green light to start giving her eggs, oats, and citrus fruits as soon as she turns 7 months old. Also, she lifted the restriction I had been under, due to my daughter’s cow’s milk protein allergy, I hadn’t eaten any dairy products or derivatives for a month, so starting now, for one month, I can eat buffalo cheese.\n\n

>La gastropediatra que nos atiende, nos dio luz verde para que apenas cumpla los 7 meses podamos darle huevo, avena y frutas cítricas. Además, me levantó el castigo que tenía, debido a la alergia a la proteína de la leche de vaca de mi hija, tenía un mes sin comer ningún producto lácteo o derivado, a partir de ahorita por un mes puedo comer queso de búfala. \n\n

>Now I can go to work with much more peace of mind; I’ve left her with my mom, my dad, and even my husband. She eats very little, but she eats her snacks and drinks her bottles of milk, even if it’s just a little, which puts my mind at ease. With God’s help, between now and when she starts daycare, she’ll get used to all her meals and eat on her own schedule.\n\n

>Ahora puedo irme al trabajo con mucha más calma, la he dejado con mi mamá, mi papá e incluso con mi esposo; come poco, pero come sus meriendas y sus teteros de leche, aunque sea un poquito, lo que me deja mucho más tranquila. Con el favor de Dios, de aquí a que comience el maternal, se acostumbrará a todas sus comidas y comerá solita en su horario. \n\n

>For now, we’ll keep gradually getting her used to not nursing as much and eating more. We have good days and days when it’s tough, but we’re getting there. For now, I’ll sign off, and if you have any recommendations for complementary feeding, I’ll be reading them. Until the next post.\n\n

>Por ahora, seguiremos acostumbrándola poco a poco a que no coma tanta teta y si coma más. Tenemos días buenos, y días donde es difícil, pero ahí vamos. Por lo pronto, me despido, y si tienen alguna recomendación para la alimentación complementaria, los estaré leyendo. Hasta el próximo post. ![Despedida.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/izzieperez/23wgeu2SiZqWYVkz6J6eo7Xtxn9Yb3hdhrNenpqmPWUMptr1tm7wNJ9jWMRZ22Qwt2sNK.png) Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)

body.title: HIVE GALAXY - Energy balance
body.body: /> Hello friends! In game we have different resourses: Metal - and metal mine Crystal - and crystal mine HE3 - fuel Energy - Starting capacity 100 Level for Buldings is from 0-100, with level caps (bonuses) on 25,50,75 and 100 (milestones)

/> Main buildings, we have HQ (base), and they make limit for other buldings, you cant upgrade metal mine 2 if you have HQ 1, so first upgrade HQ than other buildings. Other buldings use energy like resourse (without energy they dont work).

/>

On energy buildings we have 4 different kind of buildings.

Solar panel work on day and produce energy (on night not work) - they dont give capacity, only produce energy.

BASIC STARTING CAPACITY = 100 (100 energy)

Fusion reactor USE fuel (HE3) to produce energy, can work on day and night no problem, also they give 1 capacity per upgrade, so max lvl buidling is 100, they give 100 capacity.

At moment my fusion dont eat HE3 so i need to make code for that, because HE3 is important for ships, for upgrades etc...

Batery, in reality give capacity, so i change formula and make batery for focus to make big capacity.

On 100 lvl they give 9700 capacity.

100 capacity is starting,

100 capacity is bonus for 100 lvl fusion reactor, 100 capacity is bonus for 100 lvl electric network,

so total 10000 capacity.

Also we have artifacts, research, commanders, so we can boost this numbers a little.

Code functions:

// ── ENERGY FUNKCIJE ──  
function getEnergyGen() {  
const b = buildings;  
return 0.005  
\+ (b.solar?.level || 0) \* 4  
\+ (b.fusion?.level || 0) \* 12  
\+ (b.battery?.level || 0) \* 1  
\+ (b.grid?.level || 0) \* 1;  
}

So with 0.005 basic energy per second, player need near 6h to make 100 energy full (4x per day)

Because in reality batery dont produce electric power, network also dont produce power,

i change produce power and now need to make balance again...

In research we have upgrade for capacity of batery, they add 2 capacity per lvl, on 25 lvl they give bonus +50 etc...

Now i think about add DAY - NIGHT in game with virtual timer, mabey 12h day 12h night or more day less night we will see that.

Electric network now dont have capacity, i add only 1 per level and 1 income per level, they have different purpose.

They give less drain of energy from other buildings, that is very important end game.

Also instances need energy, but i think to rework numbers by levels, because we have 4 different dificulty (i need work that also)

Soooo

That is all about now, stay tuned ;)
