body.title: Celebrating 🎉🎉 the 66th anniversary of our studio.
body.body:
>

**<center>ESPAÑOL</center>**

El pasado lunes 25 del presente mes se celebraron los 66 años de la fundación de la casa de estudio madre de nuestro municipio conocido como Liceo Nacional \

, desde hace un tiempo cada año para estas fechas se organizan una serie de actividades culturales, deportivas, recreativas, para conmemorar esta fecha; este año no fue la excepción, así que, el día lunes comenzando desde la mañana con una hermosa decoración con globos de los colores del tricolor venezolano: amarillo, azul y rojo, la actividad se llevó a cabo en la cancha techada que está ubicada en la parte posterior de dicha institución. Contamos con la presencia de las autoridades educativas del municipio, el personal directivo, administrativo, docente, obreros, representantes y alumnos de nuestra majestuosa casa de estudio.

> **
ENGLISH
** Last Monday, the 25th of this month, we celebrated the 66th anniversary of the founding of our municipality’s flagship educational institution, the Liceo Nacional “Maduel Cedeño.” For some time now, a series of cultural, athletic, and recreational activities have been organized around this time each year to commemorate the occasion; This year was no exception. On Monday, starting in the morning with beautiful decorations featuring balloons in the colors of the Venezuelan flag—yellow, blue, and red—the event took place on the covered court located at the back of the school. We were joined by municipal education officials, as well as the school’s administrative, teaching, and support staff, representatives, and students from our esteemed institution. ![1000908713.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23y8ufG5oYCigbmnUAz4QmnJaJhjoeCHAPjXRTAZ574jHMd2kDJE99EWpVwBRsV9V62RU.jpg) ![1000908653.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23zknLds9eGUq4LVPY1qgBaWQvCx5oeW9CCLrUJAy5Xz1iB4qkEi9fSxUMquxuKdr9xcx.jpg)

> La actividad estaba pautada para las 9 de la mañana, dando inicio con la lectura por parte de una docente de la institución de la historia de la fundación de nuestra casa de estudio; seguidamente se dio inicio a las actividades programadas, dentro de ella se realiza cada año una actividad llamada: encuentro de saberes y hacerles, donde cada grupo de estudiantes de 5to año organizados por sección presentan bailes típicos de los estados venezolanos, los alumnos vestidos acordes a las coreografía realizan tres bailes por sección ya que cada una debe representar tres estados; los vestuarios estuvieron hermosos, coloridos muy acordes al tema que le correspondió a cada una de las secciones. Otras de las actividades que se realiza es el desfile de los llamados trajes ecológicos, son hermosos trajes realizados con material de provecho, cada año organiza un traje desde 1ro a 4to año, la coordinación a la cual estoy adscrita que es la coordinación de tercer año elaboramos un traje llamado la cueva de Amalivaca, que forma parte de la leyendas y tradiciones de nuestro municipio, modelado por una estudiante de tercer año acompañada de una hermosa niña y dos estudiantes más que formaban parte de dicha coreografía, así cada uno de los años correspondientes presentó su traje ecológico. Otra de las actividades que resaltaron es que cada sección desde 1er año hasta 5to año, organizado con su profesor orientador elaboramos una torta, porque no hay celebración sin torta Jejejeje ; se dispuso un mesón donde se colocaron todas estas tortas y al final de la actividad después que se cantó el cumpleaños feliz, organizados así mismo, nos dispusimos a nuestras aulas a compartir el pastel con nuestros estudiantes. Antes de culminar la actividad se hicieron reconocimientos a las personalidades de la institución, además se incluyeron coreógrafos que ayudaron a montar los bailes típicos colaborando con los estudiantes, representantes activos que también ayudaron a dicha actividad, fue una hermosa celebración ya preparándonos para el próximo año para la celebración del 67 aniversario!! Gracias por visitarme ! Dios te bendiga🙌

>\n\nThe activity was scheduled for 9:00 a.m., beginning with a teacher reading the history of the founding of our school. Following this, the programmed activities commenced. One of these activities, held annually, is called \

where each group of 5th-year students, organized by section, presents traditional dances from Venezuelan states. The students, dressed according to the choreography, perform three dances per section, as each section is responsible for representing three states. The costumes were beautiful and colorful, perfectly suited to the theme assigned to each section.\n\n Another activity we do is the parade of so-called \
These are beautiful costumes made from recycled materials. Each year, a costume is created by students from grades 1 through 4. The third-grade coordination I'm assigned to created a costume called \

which is part of the legends and traditions of our municipality. It was modeled by a third-grade student accompanied by a lovely girl and two other students who were part of the choreography. Each grade presented its eco-costume in this way.\n\nAnother highlight was that each section, from first to fifth grade, organized with their homeroom teacher, made a cake. Because there's no celebration without cake! A table was set up where all the cakes were displayed, and at the end of the activity, after singing \

we all went to our classrooms to share the cake with our students. Before the event concluded, recognition was given to prominent figures within the institution. Choreographers who assisted the students in staging traditional dances were also included, as were active representatives who contributed to the activity. It was a beautiful celebration as we prepare for next year's 67th anniversary! Thank you for visiting! God bless you! 🙌 ![1000908711.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23yJLgxUvbbWVjFkfEW8pV9xRJTZi79ALPT7dF8a74yFQK6co1SWZfXnq1Fj2eR5yD6zz.jpg) ![1000908690.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23vYctZUr4GfkZELQRsey4Ahb524tXJamixuGtrVbAT1FXTqHZzKkGgkGspqiLiXJQX14.jpg) ![1000908694.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/241EtVXWb8EF4LZekVQNSJeha94oRBp1rK2EeP7xdvztWivBXbj8MajPDKWBqgGHbngFe.jpg) ![1000908664.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23wqXgypqFfJXbYF5Pv6wLxoAa4A4K1U7VHvS4wDhq1fY6sz9fjng3Pb1YG4dnXebJmvP.jpg) ![1000908662.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23wC3QzhavNe9zwTgmTfNMRqgKwKqxHGbPbzDTMbcs2DQzDbHZQhb2vqxtBiTa649jKXn.jpg) ![1000908654.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23yd1qzynmeW4yVDDAcQR3ZVsLgpY9HBUqin4JNHMF2YxYeRQboAqz2cMHkERyKL8AEAU.jpg) ![1000908653.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23zknLds9eGUq4LVPY1qgBaWQvCx5oeW9CCLrUJAy5Xz1iB4qkEi9fSxUMquxuKdr9xcx.jpg) ![1000908634.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23vsEFoSPJWTgHzmTwAob4NyESkBvDUrxRS6svxFQBGytMiRWPEjxGJ6vqRZCFid9SPEr.jpg) ![1000908553.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23wMcP3eXUVsjRECtbt8xAcjKV7JBtDDesvt5Qjvy55XKqnHTAwN5AtJpwuV1joWNMtEy.jpg) ![1000908563.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23xebXG2Cj1PCFcSR5XJaSQJFzoas8Zv63YdCYT68PdZkQTe5XjqaLEr7hNnqXsxrSCHv.jpg)

body.title: Road trip in the new area of Uzzano./ Viaje por carretera en la nueva zona de Uzzano.
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS6FfAF41PhtbSyK4ZhBJZNT7Db473qPvVjC5ecyFnsUm/1780168720528.jpg)

Good morning and happy Saturday, friends! How are you? Today I'm taking you on a short road trip to Uzzano. The weather was nice, so we took the opportunity to wander around a bit. Uzzano is part of the Nievole Valley, like many of the places I've told you about recently. It's located just above Borgo a Buggiano, which I've already visited and will be returning to soon because some of my relatives are getting married there. Uzzano is divided into a new area and an old one. Today I'll take you to the new one, but I hope to visit the old one soon. Uzzano is a very large municipality, divided into several hamlets such as Santa Lucia and Santa Maria, many of which are dedicated to saints. Part of Uzzano was once marshy, like many other villages in the Nievole Valley that bordered the Padule, but the entire area was obviously later reclaimed. Uzzano is located on mostly flat land, and the new part faces almost entirely the main road, branching off into many small roads, lanes, and paths across the plain. It is surrounded by some fields because this too was once an extremely rural area.

> ¡Buenos días y feliz sábado, amigos! ¿Cómo están? Hoy los llevo de excursión a Uzzano. El tiempo estuvo agradable, así que aprovechamos para dar un paseo. Uzzano forma parte del valle de Nievole, como muchos de los lugares de los que les he hablado últimamente. Se encuentra justo encima de Borgo a Buggiano, que ya visité y al que volveré pronto porque algunos familiares se casan allí. Uzzano está dividido en una zona nueva y otra antigua. Hoy los llevaré a la nueva, pero espero visitar la antigua pronto. Uzzano es un municipio muy grande, dividido en varias aldeas como Santa Lucia y Santa Maria, muchas de las cuales están dedicadas a santos. Parte de Uzzano fue antiguamente una zona pantanosa, como muchos otros pueblos del valle de Nievole que bordeaban el Padule, pero obviamente toda la zona fue desecada posteriormente. Uzzano se asienta sobre un terreno mayormente llano, y la parte nueva da casi por completo a la carretera principal, ramificándose en numerosos caminos, senderos y sendas que atraviesan la llanura. Está rodeada de campos, ya que esta zona también fue en su día un área eminentemente rural.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSUJoDAr1jQBRncwzLgcbu6FDukZijPKCRCRsH6JnDkGm/1780168587895.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfPmyPJiN1qRBmzx5Kp5tfsfnf9Q99W9gQnwW2riwx3MY/1780168588119.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPrnp4ZxM7Whz9v1ZKiaUhxynmavtuML89fQkthHExZPR/1780168588363.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRj94bNTE43jjaFdSJrLhFPzXtzj1Q1uScpCT8PvNd7dS/1780168588670.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQoDXyxRzpRi6CY6qcXKvDRqxeTvLW5bAjT5A3tdGWW9R/1780168611030.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNxa8dmFdt7DEmCABDmJ7H1g5AK147CXeazdiv2rpmdkA/1780168611234.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR4dDkjUYTYUm4y7G6Fi9gUP2HhX8rqhBnDWJfDZfxCFZ/1780168611514.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV8A4PgJovktP9d4GxYcHLbtGJGbVGNLRUFHB3ZpZFyQj/1780168611810.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXZNLFWH7ZjM7yQE4G67kkqLSYwie4NnckB2xK4AMLtSR/1780168612131.jpg)



Uzzano is crossed by the Pescia River and other streams, which facilitated rural settlements. This place has ancient Lombard origins; it was once part of Florence and then passed under Pistoia. The part we visited is very quiet, with wide tree-lined avenues—I love the area's tree-lined streets, they're very charming—pretty villas, colorful houses, some truly charming, and wide, quiet, spacious streets. Of course, there are also various green spaces, fields, factories (it's still a very active area), more modern houses with unique shapes, and, of course, clusters of pastel-colored houses. I liked the area we visited; it gave me the impression of a truly serene and peaceful place. However, reading here and there, I saw that Uzzano is full of things to see, churches scattered throughout the hamlets, and of course, the medieval old town. I absolutely must visit. In the meantime, I hope you enjoyed this taste of Uzzano. See you soon, blog friends, and have a great Sunday!

> Uzzano está atravesada por el río Pescia y otros arroyos, lo que facilitó el desarrollo de asentamientos rurales. Este lugar tiene antiguos orígenes lombardos; formó parte de Florencia y luego pasó a formar parte de Pistoia. La zona que visitamos es muy tranquila, con amplias avenidas arboladas (me encantan las calles arboladas de la zona, son encantadoras), bonitas villas, casas coloridas, algunas realmente encantadoras, y calles anchas, tranquilas y espaciosas. Por supuesto, también hay varios espacios verdes, campos, fábricas (sigue siendo una zona muy activa), casas más modernas con formas singulares y, por supuesto, grupos de casas de colores pastel. Me gustó la zona que visitamos; me dio la impresión de ser un lugar verdaderamente sereno y tranquilo. Sin embargo, leyendo aquí y allá, vi que Uzzano está lleno de cosas que ver, iglesias dispersas por las aldeas y, por supuesto, el casco antiguo medieval. ¡Sin duda tengo que visitarlo! Mientras tanto, espero que hayan disfrutado de esta muestra de Uzzano. ¡Hasta pronto, amigos del blog, y que tengan un buen domingo!

body.title: Truth, Lies, and Human Emotions
body.body:
We live in a world where people now classify lies into different categories just to justify their actions or, in their opinion, to protect the other person from the weight of knowing the truth. Is that a justifiable reason to tell, like, and can we for any reason categorize lies into different aspects, just as we've got white lies? All the above questions and several others are what I'll be responding to below. I'd also be talking about whether I've ever told a white lie, the reason behind my actions, and what follows it. ![1000721302.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vickoly/23y8sjNJDvt1uxAtVjGsLhGcfASdHmLcWsn42d5yTtpsCh4GwRXKY4GuEjwYkz2tJZ6cH.jpg) To start with, I'd like to let you know that yes, I've told what I considered a white lie before; it's not a one-time thing, and even recently, just less than a week ago, I still told it. And I'd like to tell you about it; maybe you would probably agree with me on the lie I told and whether it's a legitimate reason to tell a lie. So to start with, as some of my friends and family here might have known, my wife recently just gave birth to our beautiful daughter, and this has led to numerous friends and family calling to congratulate us as well as pray for us. Among the callers is the one to whom I told the white lie. So it happened that just two days before our daughter's naming ceremony, I was called by my uncles that their mother, who happens to be my own mother's elder sister, died after a prolonged illness. I was deeply touched by the loss because she had been like a mother to me for years, treating me just like her own because I stayed close to her. Not long after the call, my mother's mother, who happens to be my daughter's great-grandmother, called to congratulate me and to also inquire if I'm hearing from her daughter (my mother's elder sister, who just passed), and I told her yes, I'm hearing from her, and she's fine. Even though I know I just lied to her, I can't stand the weight of telling her the truth and what I'll do to her—that her daughter, who she just inquired about, is dead. I know the news that most likely will be fate to her, given her age and what the weight of losing her child would cost her. For that reason I lied to her and later called my mum to let her know what I did and why, and she said I did the right thing. Because even my mother, who happens to be a junior sister to the deceased, didn't handle the news well, how much more so Mother, who's in her 98th year on earth? Given the nature of this particular situation and several other white lies I've told, I think it's better to tell this kind of lie for the safety of the other person so that the weight of the truth won't lead to more severe or devastating outcomes. That's about it on my take on this topic; as far as I know, lies are lies regardless of why they've been told. Still, I think it's better to withhold the truth than to say it and cause more havoc. *** All photos are mine. ***
Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@vickoly/truth-lies-and-human-emotions-4ql)

body.title: Splinterlands | The LIFEWARD CHANNELER is a 2 Mana Tank Card with Magic
body.body:
![Kaylia Silverleaf.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23y8uj7XJHjeSxJYEU8BcJd7R1nNfHKxMZB5KTx4GoDvoVU9gzSVpWHVJVqFadxU1uKTE.jpg)

 --- 


### Hello Splinterlands Warriors,

Welcome back to another juicy and fresh Splinterlands post, everyone and I guess all of you are doing pretty well in your lives and enjoying a pleasant and wonderful day with your family and friends. Now, for those of you who are actively focusing on building your influence in this amazing Web3 strategy-based card game and continuously trying hard to improve your NFT cards, tokens and asset collection, I guess all of you are currently busy fighting in the ranked season arena battles and trying to squeeze out every last trophy that you can before the current season finally comes to an end. Right now, if we take a quick look at the ongoing ranked season timer, only around 18 hours and 30 minutes are left before the reset happens, so the final battle rush is already in full swing and please hurry if you are yet to catch your goal.

 --- 


![Screenshot 2026-05-30 at 11.24.38 PM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23vrrxJVdNKmsV6d7UT3yjwkLr9LH5v8NciM6EsRe45UqEAG5Rzw26Us6MHq4GZBhbNjr.png)

 --- 



Now, talking about my own progress in the frontier mode of this game, I am currently playing in the highest Gold I league tier with a trophy count of around 4,020. Honestly, I am not expecting too much from this season anymore, because I have a low energy meter already, but I will still try my best to somehow push toward the 4,200 trophy mark before the reset happens.

 --- 


![Screenshot 2026-05-30 at 8.46.38 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23tGVhrLyVc8NuChiT2PmpnZUi6zMDrkKh8HzfRRVt9w3LVD1CJvQ63R3XHBAkW2HvNor.png)

 --- 



Apart from ranked grinding, I also received a pretty cool reward today from the daily wheel. I managed to win a special Vega Tattoo skin for my avatar’s face, which honestly looked quite awesome and unexpected. On the other hand, if we take a look at the weekly Frontier raffle, I currently hold 39 entries and there are still around 1 day and 17 hours left before the raffle draw takes place. My target this time will probably stay around 54 entries because I am already running pretty low on battle energy.


 --- 


![Screenshot 2026-05-30 at 8.03.56 PM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23wMMymVzepWKZ9PpA7DmuqqmtGwe15SGW8a1NTQVPdxh5TMbakgJ1qPXHgEuAoCaqLTx.png)

![Screenshot 2026-05-30 at 8.08.14 PM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23wMMmgbXjK8r8GSjkobN8bfa9iAPfqHwLeWAHo3Y45yLAQk4KdzdnnbdU2sCde5QrCNE.png)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23u5ZX7RFXbwpkBQzXd6Kt7q4dRgy7eeJJSFKvSsXv8mum8RLtndku6gjrLxCNvv1hhjZ.png)

 --- 




Apart from that, today I also opened a total of 6 Foundation packs that I had earned from the last 2 days of daily Frontier mode missions. The pulls actually turned out insane this time because I managed to get a jackpot of 2 Legendary cards, 1 Epic card, 7 Rare cards, including 4 Archons, 1 Gold Foil Common, and the rest regular Common foil cards, which I would say is a great pull for just 6 packs.

 --- 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/AJivGih73WWRUdrv5GXySTWkEbFdWHCqPppRYB2Axebaf8dSY7zMwDerThnEyVa.png)


 --- 



### Lifeward Channeler

Now, moving forward, let us come to the main topic of this post, as today I will be discussing another very interesting monster card from the newest card set. As you have already seen in the title and thumbnail above, today I will be talking about the Lifeward Channeler. So if you are interested in learning more about this monster card, let us take a deeper dive without any further delay.

The Lifeward Channeler is a monster-type card that belongs to the Life element and comes from the Drakoshan bloodline. By rarity, this card is a Rare monster, so you will require a total of 115 CC cards in order to upgrade it to its maximum level. One of the biggest highlights of this monster is definitely its tiny mana cost of only 2, which makes it an extremely flexible option for almost every type of battle, especially low mana limit matches and the ones with Little League ruleset. The attack type of this monster is Magic, and apart from its decent magic attack, it also comes with an extremely heavy armour and health combination for such a low mana card. At its maximum level, this monster gains a total of three abilities that make it both defensive and amazingly supportive at the same time. Let us now take a closer look at its league-wise stats and abilities below to find more about this monster.



 --- 




![Screenshot 2026-05-30 at 11.19.06 PM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/EoneCJTSSBxtTwyMv6acXi1fNgrWukV4KYBUudKWm71qavfoDe8jB9pxaDRf3d5tX9c.png)


 --- 


#### BRONZE

At level 2, this monster already possesses impressive stats for just 2 mana. It carries 1 magic attack power at 3 speed with a gigantic 5 armor and 5 health. Apart from these defensive stats, it also gains the Weary ability and this ability becomes more dangerous as battles become longer because enemy monsters slowly start losing turns due to exhaustion.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/AJmsi2AgPJVHCF2w9oPgiN5jQxVctgMrZYsqGLFJ5qAWMjgQYLxE8jQJ4X7XQYJ.png)



`WEARY` – At the beginning of round 1, Weary units have a 10% chance to become Exhausted. This chance increases by 10% every round up to a maximum of 80%. Exhausted units skip their turn and cannot retaliate.



#### SILVER

When you upgrade this monster further to level 4, its stats improve and it now carries 1 magic attack power at 3 speed with 6 armor and 6 health. At this level, it also unlocks another extremely useful defensive ability called Void Armor. This ability makes the monster extremely effective against magic attackers because incoming magic damage is forced to go through its huge armor first.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23vhnpvhpT9t4k1vc4o7dqSiagys8jscSxiG89Nd34KULXLk7knwQcYgxkHi7FfByeFrQ.png)


`VOID ARMOR` – Magic attacks hit armor first before damaging health.



#### GOLD

As this monster gets upgraded further and reaches level 6, its stats improve once again and it now possesses 2 magic attack power at 3 speed with 6 armor and 7 health. Even though it does not gain any new abilities at this level, the increased attack and health make it much stronger in battles.

#### DIAMOND / CHAMPION

Finally, when you upgrade this monster to its maximum level of 8, its stats improve even further and it now carries 2 magic attack power at 3 speed with 6 armor and 8 health. At this level, it also unlocks another very useful support ability called Tank Heal. This ability becomes extremely useful when paired with gigantic frontline tanks because it continuously restores their health during battle and itself when the first one dies.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23wC12FmVi3tRfNN4c4KtMpapx9tqRv1mxZ3EDgCZDmFWCcWc9ay2X8igSwa1PF7rVJ2P.png)


`TANK HEAL` – Each round, restores 1/3 of the max health (rounded down) to the allied unit in the front position.



Last but not least, I think this monster is honestly one of the most overpowered low mana defensive cards introduced recently. For only 2 mana, you get a monster with a huge armor and health combination along with decent magic attack power and strong utility abilities. Personally, I think this monster works best either in the second position supporting a frontline tank with Tank Heal or even directly at the first position itself because its defensive stats are already massive enough to survive multiple big attacks. The Weary ability is also very interesting because longer battles slowly become more difficult for enemy monsters as they start getting exhausted and skipping turns. If you manage to keep this monster alive for multiple rounds, the ability becomes extremely annoying for your opponent. Another is the Void Armour ability. Since enemy magic attacks are forced to hit its gigantic armour first, this monster becomes a pure anti-magic wall. Finally comes the Tank Heal ability, which is probably the best support ability on this card. If you place a gigantic frontline monster before this card, it will continuously heal your tank every round. Once the frontline monster falls, the Lifeward Channeler itself can then move forward and continue tanking damage while still remaining difficult to eliminate. Overall, I think the Lifeward Channeler is an insanely valuable low mana support and tank card that can fit into many different lineups. What do you think?

#### I hope you enjoyed reading my post about LIFEWARD CHANNELER. Let me know your thoughts about today's post in the comments section below, and I look forward to seeing you all in my next post.

body.title: Celebrating our friend the motivational speaker's 73rd birthday | Beers that stir up memories
body.body:
>

In my country, Venezuela, beer consumption is extremely high. Of course, I can't have the most detailed statistics, but in a block of thirty families, I can say that two families don't drink beer. They use it for everything: if they are happy, if they are sad, if they are hot or cold, beer is good for everything




<center>![IMG_20260523_221614.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbxBWeeuvU26D8cbWFzRQBgKnc8GFVskSjkbMnguqhZKa/IMG_20260523_221614.jpg)</center>


Last Saturday we were able to get together to celebrate the birthday of a member of our group. She organizes outings and takes us on trips, and at 73 years old, she gives us words of encouragement that motivate us to keep going. This time, we gathered to celebrate her birthday with a 70s theme. You can remember the music from that era; it's a time when I was very young, but I was able to remember my aunts, uncles, and other relatives from that time with their beautiful clothe

<center>![IMG_20260523_221630.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNWZ4dJNAtfg8WTb5qqTHTNf9zkd1Anud4NoFhKjzpjCF/IMG_20260523_221630.jpg)</center>


Beer is great company. We have many brands here, but these ones you see in my post are the best sellers. For me, the light one is the best. I don't know what it is about the blue Solera, but it makes me feel exhausted and sleepy. It hits me hard, as we say here in Venezuela when something upsets our stomach, haha. The light yellow beer is milder, and many say it makes you need to urinate a lot.



<center>![IMG_20260523_221631.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVYQx7f3DzwknBHmaZxD6rqSvuQ3RGDgcutVvbUh1YpHF/IMG_20260523_221631.jpg)</center>


I'd like to spend more time with my friends; they look so happy. That night we danced to \

(The Spider with Hairs), tonight we stayed up all night, also to the music of Michael Jackson, merengue, salsa, and other melodies that made us feel like we were floating back to the time of John Travolta.
![IMG_20260523_221618.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQTDQ3Np4AWJuWVi7CtxeTvLLfpJMnRCXpUW4JB47bVQz/IMG_20260523_221618.jpg)
The birthday girl is a very special person; she's very cheerful. She dressed in a 70s-themed outfit: miniskirt, fishnet stockings, platform shoes, and more. Beer was the star of the night. A beer is something that brings back memories, stirs up many emotions, and makes us feel happier than usual.
![IMG_20260523_221606.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdDYkLKin93hPnvjQdnedHqQB6oJW4u8Qjn3TZe4s13cf/IMG_20260523_221606.jpg)
![IMG_20260523_214346.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUv9rZDwc4Z3VCuSRQmfbBYh17Ah4E95k17rCacYkqATx/IMG_20260523_214346.jpg)
A beer combo at this five-star hotel costs $12 and includes a bucket of 10 beers. There's a varied menu, and the food is good at reasonable prices.

body.title: The Evolution of Slot Games: Atmosphere and Style as Key Drivers of Engagement
body.body:
The Evolution of Slot Games: Atmosphere and Style as Key Drivers of Engagement

While slot games were once seen simply as a way to pass the time, many modern projects now focus on atmosphere, visual style, and emotional engagement. This is why slots with unusual themes are increasingly attracting the attention of players around the world. One such project is Tombstone RIP - a game designed in a dark and intense style inspired by stories of abandoned towns and Wild West legends. This type of presentation creates a unique mood and helps the project stand out among countless similar online games.

Developers today aim not only to add gameplay features but also to build a complete atmosphere capable of keeping players engaged for long periods. The visual aspect plays a particularly important role in games like these. Detailed interface elements, dark color palettes, thematic effects, and immersive soundtracks create the feeling of a small interactive adventure. As a result, the gameplay feels more dynamic and emotionally engaging. More information about the project can be found here: [https://wikipediaslots.com/games/tombstone-rip](https://wikipediaslots.com/games/tombstone-rip) It is also worth noting that modern gaming platforms are designed with user convenience in mind.

Most games run smoothly on both desktop computers and mobile devices, allowing players to launch them without complicated settings or additional software. The popularity of such projects can be explained by the fact that users are increasingly searching for more than just standard slot games. Players are drawn to projects with distinctive style, immersive atmosphere, and memorable presentation. It is this combination of design, convenience, and engaging gameplay that makes such games highly popular among fans of online entertainment.

Hola,amigos de la comunidad. 
Hoy quiero compartir con ustedes una serie de fotografías que capturan dos de las cosas que más paz y felicidad traen a mi vida: la majestuosidad de la naturaleza y la luz de mi hija.

En la primera imagen pueden ver a mi pequeña, lo más hermoso y sagrado que ha llegado a mi camino. Verla allí, contemplando la inmensidad del paisaje con su inocencia, me hace reflexionar sobre la velocidad con la que pasa el tiempo y lo afortunada que soy de guiar sus pasos. Ella es mi motor y mi mayor inspiración.

También quise capturar estos imponentes paisajes montañosos. Caminar entre estos árboles antiguos, sentir la frescura del aire y contemplar el horizonte me transmite una paz genuina, un esplendor que solo la tierra nos puede regalar. Cada rincón tiene su magia, desde los senderos de tierra hasta las copas de los árboles que tocan el cielo.

Al final del día, estas fotos me recuerdan que, sin importar el enfoque que le demos a la vida, lo más perfecto del amor es aprender a amar la imperfección de cada detalle. No necesitamos escenarios perfectos ni momentos planificados; la verdadera belleza está en lo espontáneo. Cada uno de nosotros enfoca, ama y admira de una forma completamente diferente, y esa diversidad es lo que hace que nuestro paso por el mundo sea único y que cada día sea una aventura llena de amor retos y logro.

English 

Hello, friends of the community.
Today I want to share with you a series of photographs that capture two of the things that bring the most peace and happiness to my life: the majesty of nature and the light of my daughter.

In the first image, you can see my little girl, the most beautiful and sacred thing that has ever come into my life. Seeing her there, gazing at the vastness of the landscape with her innocence, makes me reflect on how quickly time passes and how lucky I am to guide her steps. She is my driving force and my greatest inspiration.

I also wanted to capture these imposing mountain landscapes. Walking among these ancient trees, feeling the freshness of the air, and gazing at the horizon fills me with a genuine sense of peace—a splendor that only the earth can bestow upon us. Every corner holds its own magic, from the dirt trails to the treetops that touch the sky.

At the end of the day, these photos remind me that, no matter how we approach life, the most perfect thing about love is learning to love the imperfection in every detail. We don’t need perfect settings or planned moments; true beauty lies in spontaneity. Each of us focuses, loves, and admires in a completely different way, and that diversity is what makes our time on this earth unique and turns every day into an adventure filled with love, challenges, and achievements.

---

> A visit to a nursery always fills the mind with a strange peace. Seeing the green nature around and the variety of trees, it feels like I have entered a piece of heaven. A few days ago, I had the opportunity to visit a nursery. The purpose was to buy some plants of my choice for my garden. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXudY4sRZ5Gbyk4sTz1Pfsp4ntGnHm1Sd6qYHGxNpXJgh/image.png) When I went there, I was completely surprised. The nursery had a huge collection of diverse plants. Starting from small indoor plants to large fruit and flower trees, they were arranged in rows. The air was filled with the sweet smell of earth and the aroma of fresh leaves. It took quite a while to decide which ones to keep and which ones to buy among all these trees. After looking around for a long time, I chose a few flowers and fruit trees of my choice. Among the flower trees, I chose some excellent seedlings that would greatly enhance the beauty of the house. Along with this, I also bought some nutritious and fresh fruit seedlings. Especially when I saw the green leaves and fresh fruits of the lemon tree, I could not control myself anymore. Just thinking about taking care of the trees made me feel a kind of joy. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWYtvvyzx5vCs4N9EdHJjhHNxQLEZR4NeA5kZ23x8kE8Y/image.png) Gardening is not just a hobby. It is actually a great way to relieve mental fatigue. Those wonderful moments in the nursery and the experience of buying plants will remain in my memory for a long time. Now I just have to wait for these little seedlings to grow up under my care and fill the entire garden with flowers and fruits. description.title: I'm sorry Tola, I lied.
description.body:
I remember the first time I told a white lie. It was in secondary school, when my best friend, Omotola, asked if her performance in the school play was good.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXvnM9r9CT7rvVFYu5iZRorLFkDgMLHxeLtYP4JTLkLKS/1780169389718.jpg)

Truthfully, she had stumbled over her lines, her voice cracked, and the audience had laughed at the wrong moments. But when she looked at me with those hopeful eyes, I said, “You were amazing.” Her face lit up, and for a moment, I felt like I had given her wings.

That night, however, I wrestled with guilt. Was it kindness, or was it cowardice? Omotola went on believing she had done well, and when the teacher later gave her harsh feedback, she was devastated. 

She even asked me why I hadn’t warned her. My lie, meant to protect her, had only delayed the pain and made it worse.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZKQECYdkQLKfRMKSbNstGMom9e3xaGnNbwHF2b4EA8ch/1780168992298.webp)

Years later, I faced a similar dilemma with my younger sister.  She had auditioned for a role in a movie which in my opinion she aced but then these things are not about how well you act but how many people you can get to like or vote on your content.

When the rejection email arrived, she was crushed. She asked me if maybe the team had made a mistake. I wanted to say yes, to soothe her, but I remembered Tola.

 Instead, I told her the truth: “They didn’t choose you, but that doesn’t mean you’re not brilliant. It just means you’ll have to try again and build yourself to a point where you become a force to be reckoned with.” She sulked, but later she thanked me for being honest. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZKQECYdkQLKfRMKSbNstGMom9e3xaGnNbwHF2b4EA8ch/1780168992298.webp)

So, is it ever okay to tell a white lie? I think it depends on the intention and the consequence. A white lie about liking someone’s cooking when you don’t, that’s harmless.

But a white lie that shields someone from reality can rob them of the chance to grow. The truth may sting, but it also heals. Lies, even small ones, often fester. I’ve come to believe that honesty, delivered with compassion, is the better path. 

You don’t have to be brutal. You can soften the truth, frame it with encouragement, and remind the person of their strengths. When Omotola asked me about her play, I could have said, “You had great energy, but maybe practice will help with the lines.” That would have been truthful, yet kind.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZKQECYdkQLKfRMKSbNstGMom9e3xaGnNbwHF2b4EA8ch/1780168992298.webp)


Life is full of moments where we’re tempted to lie for comfort. But comfort without truth is fragile. It breaks the moment reality intrudes. Truth, though painful, builds resilience. It teaches us to face the world as it is, not as we wish it to be.

So, here's what I feel, white lies may feel merciful in the moment, but truth, spoken gently, is the greater mercy. Lies delay pain but truth prepares us for it. And in the end, it is better to be trusted for honesty than remembered for false comfort, don't you think so too?

description.title: A Lie... But Not For you!!!
description.body:
![Blue and Yellow Professional Webinar Youtube Thumbnail (48).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23zbKCMzoziADFsu4jBcTM11k719zTwvdrCEo1nw4emnq2RFDHVNr4LQx4pU3y452QuhX.png) ***
![2dk2RRM2dZ8gKjXsrozapsD83FxL3Xbyyi5LFttAhrXxr16mCe4arfLHA37mQtCuynkak9C9VAyTtPNZ193z3v9HzUXNRYfNBKpop4B452wXWGAr95ns7Froa3QYr2tHe7aDsDXTJuz6E8PeAV3edWS3NGxHQJHC9xJn9eUpGW.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23uEz3qUu1cpWPYjmp2LnK1i4RcXoAhocX2Rzpq9uYyMScovNm77MZBozX7i1NM59BnSf.png) When it comes to truth and lies, there is usually a thin line where things go gray. This is because not everything is black and white; there are instances where certain rigid rules will not be followed because, if they are, there could be consequences. There are moments to lie, and also moments to tell the truth. In the end, what matters the most is how excusable the lie is and if you’ll ever get to tell the truth. If you lose your job, and you’re feeling sad about it, your child notices your countenance and questions you on it. You could tell them that everything is fine and you’re simply in your feelings, even though nothing is fine and you have no idea where your next meal might come from. You just don’t want him to worry. Telling him straight up that you’ve lost your job will most likely put him in a place where he has to imagine all the ways that things could go wrong with no source of livelihood. ![2dk2RRM2dZ8gKjXsrozapsD83FxL3Xbyyi5LFttAhrXxr16mCe4arfLHA37mQtCuynkak9C9VAxm3nacdB7gLmLiZLuYVhHeNsRgxL6WKJoam3hs2B7ZLAp2jwaLFEwoAbLKzAfpv2DhtyvHbJunTbU58RMbxtkvefNK4qj8EA.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23uQkLUmr2XGp8UpLcdtKeQrWDNnK5jemLpyFynqgRKtzZaqtByEwcX3DoUEyB8Pwi9DN.png) So yeah, there might be time to tell lies, and at every other time, it’s best you go with the truth. When it’s a lie told to protect, it’s permissible. But when it’s a lie told strictly to deceive and take advantage of the other person, then you have a problem. Because the only person who will gain from such an act is you, and it’s just cruel because many times, people in this situation end up getting hurt. And with the first definition and examples I gave, we have the fundamentals of white lies. Their revelation might not have disastrous consequences, but it could hurt the people involved. It’s just like lying that you enjoy the food your woman cooks when, in actuality, you don’t like it at all. You only say that to make her happy. If she finds out you’ve been lying about that, she will be hurt, but it will never be enough to break up the relationship. But then, a deliberate lie, like telling her you want to see the mechanic when you’re actually going to see a female friend, its discovery will not only hurt her, but also serve as a reason to destroy the relationship. So, you see? While one is designed to protect the interests of others, the other simply serves to deceive and trick whoever the lie is being told to. And should it be abolished altogether? I don’t think so. White lies protect many people from having heart attacks and high blood pressure. It also helps bearers of bad news ease their way into the telling, in a way that the recipient can handle it without going off the lid. This is an important part of society, and it’s up to us as individuals to uphold our morals and ethics and be honest with ourselves as we ask, \

![IMG_20230528_111642~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/244xS7pJVBS2EcjA99Z1w5HjFettUYJDFDXebvWvXmH2Lq92JVcGvKE7AvY7d6aZxSCt6.jpg) ***
Thank you for reading. Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments below, I would love to know what you’re thinking. Till we meet in the next post.

description.title: Truth Can Kill Too.
description.body:
Well, I want to believe a lot of us are a victim of this, we've one time or the other tell a white lie, and we've one time or the other been told one too... 



But then, what do we mean by a white lie, a white lie is one told to avoid hurting someone's feelings. Meaning a white lie is usually told with good intentions and not with the sim of hurting the feelings of others. But like its name goes... white lie. It means it is not the truth either.



![1000718621.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23xVM1nY3TXzWNcVxoPTottsozt9nmPkfqg1M8d7vKGoyPecmM18KuyuR6ZvBFo2MdVGF.jpg)



And like I said earlier, either knowingly or unknowingly, we all have told a white lie at a time or the other. I'm also saying I've told a white lie countless number of times too. There are times it goes well and did what's intended for it to, other times it didn't. But even when I tell it and it does what I intend for it to, I still kind of feel a bit somehow about it...maybe because I know what I did and said is not entirely the truth.



Now, I don't think a white lie is bad, reason is because certain situations will require you to withhold the actual truth. There are some truth that you cannot tell directly to the person involved because it will be too heavy for them to carry. And I would love to cite an instance of this....



Its almost two years now when I lost a very close friend of mine, before his death he was sick, and was admitted in the hospital for weeks. I wa every close to his family so I'd go there always to check on him, or even to allow his mum go and rest while I stay with him. So, one day the doctor asked that I come together with his mum, the doctor said he's not sure his mum will be able to handle what he's about to say, but he needed to tell them, so they can be prepared.



In short, he broke the a sad news that their son, which is my own friend have less than 3days to live, that there's nothing they can do about it. The woman indeed couldn't hold it in, she shouted and had to be taken out. They didn't even allow her see her son for the rest of that day because the message, the fear and all is written all over her face....


Now, here's where the white lie came in, I stood with my friend for the rest of that day, I kept calm, feigned, and acted like everything was alright. And as if he knew something happened, he asked me what the doctor that called us in said, he asked if everything was okay and how long they said his recovery will take. At that moment, I almost cried. If it was his mother that was there then, I'm sure there's no way she would be able to hold back her tears.



![1000718641.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23y8vEvDG6aVZZk4fjv2B6pqSPtFWiUjwHoMZFFm6tvjACqAcCmNVXbZxf3u5FJtciqSL.jpg)


I took my time to calm myself down before responding to him, because tell me what good it will be for me to tell him he's having less than 3 days to live, how will he feel about it, such a truth could even make him go into shock kill him before that three days.




*\

*  I said it in a funny way and he smiled, that was how I quickly switched the topic into another thing. Even though it was a lie, obviously he won't have the opportunity of being on his feet anymore, still I didn't regret telling him that. What he needs at that moment is to have his loved ones come around so he will enjoy his last moments on earth. He just needs to enjoy the rest of his numbered days, that I know, and I as well know he won't even want to hear such a hurtful or hurting truth from me.




But then, even though the intention of white lie is not to cause harm, we should endeavor to tell the truth when necessary too. Telling white lies shouldn't become a habit.






🌹


**Images are mine.**

**Thanks a lot for taking your time to read through, kindly do well to stop by my blog @marsdave for more exclusive and amazing content.**

I am standing here, immersed in the absolute silence of an early summer night, admiring the silhouette of Sicily across the Strait. The beauty of these lands, the magic of Southern Italy—where Calabria and Sicily meet—is truly indescribable. It is a spectacle that, even for those of us born in this land, often leaves us speechless, caught in a moment of pure awe.
Perhaps a photograph cannot fully convey the depth of the sensations one feels before such a sight: the dance of the lights, the breath of the sea, and the profound peace of the night. Nevertheless, I have tried my best to capture the essence of this moment, hoping to share a glimpse of what it means to see and experience such beauty.

> Hello everyone, how are you doing today? Hope you are having a great time. This will be *Week 219 Edition 03* of our Weekly Featured Content. ![Copy of Copy of Copy of TPEP's Friday Feature.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kronias/23xVTyFLGvEj7ZJjypsvkhoZ92HH1YqHzmkCYTXqLVmNNNi7E3rDLfQ42zxZrRPFUU9zu.png)
Made With Canva
So, last Saturday we had our hangout as usual, and it was just so much fun that we did not want it to end. We are currently on the third topic for this week, which is “A WHITE LIE”. But before we proceed with the details of the topic, let us take a look at the winners of the last topic, which was “IN FOR THE MONEY”. This topic was geared toward each member of the community, telling us their thoughts on hospitals and clinics that prioritize money over the lives and well-being of their patients. From the high cost of health care to the rigid rules in place when a person is unable to pay up. We got to see that while this is all a business, many times, what separates a sick person from the land of the dead is the amount of money that they have to spend on healthcare. And for those who don’t have enough to meet the standard of the hospital, their lives may hang in the balance. This was an enlightening topic, indeed. ***
> For this topic, we went through every entry post, and that is every post with the #hl-exclusive & #hl-w219e2 tag. And with the number of wonderful posts out there, it was quite difficult to make a selection. But eventually, we did just that. And so, the posts that will be featured not just for their exceptional content, but also for their level of engagement with other authors, will be listed below. ![hl_footer.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcnAnsqHA4KMYRqnS9QzWMpQUxM71wRhKabXz7paozHKJ/hl_footer.png)

Featured Contents


[CAN PEOPLE AFFORD HEALTHCARE?](https://peakd.com/hive-153850/@rimurutempest/can-people-afford-healthcare-a6n) by @rimurutempest
*For this author, he told us that in some countries, the government has helped to subsidize the cost of healthcare for the citizens. Taking care of one’s health can be financially draining, and so he suggested that instead of waiting for our health to deteriorate to the point where it becomes a money pit, we can take care of our health with regular exercise and better control of our diets. This will help a lot.*
[IS HEALTHCARE A RIGHT OR A LUXURY?](https://peakd.com/hive-153850/@nhaji01/is-healthcare-a-right-or) by @nhaji01
*For this author, she told us that healthcare is a fundamental part of human life, and it’s not limited to our hospital visits, but also how we take care of our health outside the hospital as well. Nothing that’s done in a hospital is done for free because the staff of the hospital also need to get paid, and the place needs to be maintained as well. So much goes on in a hospital.”
[BETWEEN THE OATH AND THE INVOICE](https://peakd.com/hive-153850/@ladyaryastark/between-the-oath-and-the) by @ladyaryastark
*This author told us that there are a lot of shortcomings in the health industry. While some hospitals are state-funded, others are private and strictly for profit. And at this point, there is nothing much that can be done, because most public hospitals are not equipped enough to handle the load, and most private hospitals are too expensive for the common man.*

The first 3 authors will receive 100 ECENCY Points [ Sponsored By Ecency Team (@melinda010100) ] and 1 $PANDAMINER each as a reward next Monday. These posts were selected because of their special attention to detail and how they followed the topic. There were a lot of good ones out there, but we just could not pick them all. But then, we have some honorable mentions listed below:

Honorable Mention

[HAVE MEDICAL PRACTITIONERS FORGOTTEN THEIR OATHS?](https://peakd.com/hive-153850/@vickoly/have-medical-practitioners-forgotten-their-oath-7ps) by @vickoly [ARE DOCTORS STILL IN IT FOR THE LOVE OF SAVING LIVES?](https://peakd.com/hive-153850/@idksamad78699/are-doctors-still-in-it-for-the-love-of-saving-lives-7bf) by @idksamad78699 [DILEMMA OF BEING A MEDICAL RACTITIONER](https://peakd.com/hive-153850/@emrysjobber/5a3e9bf9b6bed) by @emrysjobber These are posts that were also found to be quite exceptional. ---- ---- ![hl_footer.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcnAnsqHA4KMYRqnS9QzWMpQUxM71wRhKabXz7paozHKJ/hl_footer.png)
AND NOW, WE MOVE ON TO THE NEW TOPIC!

Good afternoon @avdesing. The question of the middle ground always poses a conflict for me. I try to understand its use and in your publication I share many of your reflections although I do not idealize the society that our grandparents lived. My grandparents lived through a civil war and on many continents, other grandparents suffered one of the greatest carnages that humanity has experienced, World War II.

I could continue complaining... but it doesn't make much sense. What you raise in the last part is very important... I believe that the only salvation for humanity is the self-regulation of society. Out with bureaucracies, planners, creators of public opinion... life can be very simple. Thank you very much for sharing this reflection.

A very big hug!! Happy weekend!!

description.body:
<center>![Yellow and Brown Organic Abstract Food YouTube Thumbnail_20260530_135749_0000.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS17rmmmXd7cEdwMrTMAomJBDu8BnJovn6je4ZHxP91xz/Yellow%20and%20Brown%20Organic%20Abstract%20Food%20YouTube%20Thumbnail_20260530_135749_0000.png)
</center>


<center>![Yellow and Brown Organic Abstract Food YouTube Thumbnail_20260530_142854_0000 (1).png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYFS61ZjBgM1R4uZrtoJLrRmy2ZHqSUfdErsDzADWmRzm/Yellow%20and%20Brown%20Organic%20Abstract%20Food%20YouTube%20Thumbnail_20260530_142854_0000%20(1).png)</center>


<div class=\

>Holi 😊🥰...Saludos querida comunidad gastronómica,dime que no se te antoja un delicioso manjar o dulce de lechoza preparado por tu mamá o tu abuela 🥺y a quien no ,nosotros los venezolanos siempre tenemos un bonito recuerdo de nuestras abuelas y madres preparando este delicioso manjar para temporadas de semana Santa y decembrinas,siempre recuerdo desde que tengo memoria a mi abuela cortando mas de tres lechozas(papayas) para elaborar para nuestra familia este delicioso dulce ,al verla crecer haciendo cada vez este delicioso manjar cultivé el arte también de copiar sus recetas ,aunque ella siempre me acompañaba y me enseñaba a hacerlo no habia tenido oportunidad de hacer uno yo solita sin ayuda de ella para ver que que tanto me había aprendido la receta y hacerla como ella🤭 lógicamente nunca me saldrá igual ,ya que cada persona tiene un sazón diferente y el de ami abuela es único y especial que siempre nosotros disfrutábamos en cada comida que hacía. # > Hi 😊🥰...Greetings, dear foodie community! Tell me, don't you crave a delicious papaya dessert made by your mom or grandma? 🥺 And who wouldn't? We Venezuelans always have fond memories of our grandmothers and mothers preparing this delicious treat for Holy Week and Christmas. I remember, as far back as I can remember, my grandmother cutting more than three papayas to make this delicious dessert for our family. Watching her grow up making this delicious treat, I also cultivated the art of copying her recipes. Although she always accompanied me and taught me how to make it, I hadn't had the opportunity to make it on my own without her help to see how much I had learned the recipe and make it like her. 🤭 Of course, it will never turn out exactly the same, since everyone has a different touch, and my grandmother's is unique and special, something we always enjoyed in every meal she made. #
![IMG_20260530_134638_820.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQYLHhts7m8t651KsSMYNiqqjhc57aD9izyq9CwfnN333/IMG_20260530_134638_820.jpg)
#

>El dulce de lechoza mi abuela siempre siempre lo hacía acompañado con coco ya que ella desde tiempo ha preparado el famoso pan de horno que consiste en hacer rosquitas y empanadas de harina de maiz blanco previamente remojado y horneado,de relleno era este popular dulce que tiene su orígen en la ciudad del Táchira-San Cristóbal aquí mismo en Venezuela y en muchas partes del país lo preparan de diferentes maneras,también es popular en la isla de margarita y en Colombia,en este caso les compartiré la receta de como mi abuela me lo enseñó y consiste en rallar nuestra papaya agregar panela de papelón agua y algunos clavitos de olor para el gusto,estos clavitos no pueden faltar en la receta ya que le da al dulce el peculiar olorcito de especia, así que acompañame a hacerlo😊. # > My grandmother always made papaya candy with coconut, since she's long been known for her famous oven-baked bread, which consists of small, ring-shaped pastries and empanadas made with white cornmeal that's been soaked and baked. This popular sweet, which originated in the city of San Cristóbal, Táchira, here in Venezuela, was filled with it. It's prepared in many different ways throughout the country, and is also popular on Margarita Island and in Colombia. In this case, I'll share the recipe my grandmother taught me: grate your papaya, add panela (unrefined cane sugar), water, and a few cloves to taste. These cloves are essential to the recipe, as they give the candy its distinctive spiced aroma. So, join me in making it! 😊 # ---
![IMG_20260530_123854_710.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXVSkqf8YhW52sq2RhtLok5xDipGaP5hrz1omXCok1Kd9/IMG_20260530_123854_710.jpg)
![Yellow and Brown Organic Abstract Food YouTube Thumbnail_20260530_142854_0000 (1).png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYFS61ZjBgM1R4uZrtoJLrRmy2ZHqSUfdErsDzADWmRzm/Yellow%20and%20Brown%20Organic%20Abstract%20Food%20YouTube%20Thumbnail_20260530_142854_0000%20(1).png)
# |INGREDIENTES /5 porciones|INGREDIENTS /5 portions| |--------|--------| |•Clavitos de olor al gusto|•Cloves to taste| |•1 Lechoza madura (papaya)mediana|•1 Medium ripe papaya| |•300 ml de agua|•300 ml of water| |•1 cucharada de azúcar|•1 tablespoon of sugar| |•1 panela de papelón|•1 panela of papelón| #
![Yellow and Brown Organic Abstract Food YouTube Thumbnail_20260530_142854_0000 (1).png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYFS61ZjBgM1R4uZrtoJLrRmy2ZHqSUfdErsDzADWmRzm/Yellow%20and%20Brown%20Organic%20Abstract%20Food%20YouTube%20Thumbnail_20260530_142854_0000%20(1).png)
## _
Procedimiento:
_ ### _
Procedure:
_ # ### Paso 01
>Empezamos haciéndole cortes a la papaya fuera de la cáscara para que bote ese líquido blanco el que llamamos \

una vez la termina de botar la lavamos y procedemos a cortar las partes de arriba y abajo el palito de donde nace nuestra papaya y la base. # > ### Step 01 > We start by making cuts in the papaya outside the peel so that it releases that white liquid which we call \

. Once it finishes releasing it, we wash it and proceed to cut the top and bottom parts, the stick where our papaya grows from, and the base.


<center>![IMG_20260530_124047_477.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmY6iPsJKRC7vA4A6bQiF84sbiYAkTH64ETaSZ7Kj4KLDG/IMG_20260530_124047_477.jpg)
</center>

<center>![IMG_20260530_124127_069.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQma81nFMAzzrVa4iQtKBx9R8kdhRVPaEvKSimM71nfJ7qh/IMG_20260530_124127_069.jpg)
</center>


---

### Paso 02
<div class=\

>Pasamos a pelar por completo nuestra lechoza sin dejarle rastro de su cáscara ya que está es amarga y la cortamos a la mitad. # > ### Step 02 > We proceed to peel our papaya completely without leaving any trace of its peel since it is bitter, and then we cut it in half.
![IMG_20260530_124416_805.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmap12GHMAX1r6DXfiXbXxcGXpYtCCNYSHXSGD23RiysLk/IMG_20260530_124416_805.jpg)
![IMG_20260530_124457_195 (1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVgV9Jo1J6LJBzS1mki5RT79HvG9V65PiM8wqWkUBnZwV/IMG_20260530_124457_195%20(1).jpg)
--- ### Paso 03

>Es momento de retirar las semillas que tiene nuestra lechoza y cortaremos la lechoza en cuatro partes como rebanadas limpiando la bien sin que quede semillas en el interior,la lavamos bien y con la parte mediana del tallo vamos a ir rallando cada rebanada de lechoza así como si estuviésemos rallando zanahoria,me hizo recordar literal a la zanahoria rallada por su color 🤭 # > ### Step 03 > It's time to remove the seeds from our papaya and cut it into four slices, cleaning it well so that no seeds remain inside. We wash it well and with the middle part of the stem we grate each slice of papaya as if we were grating a carrot. It literally reminded me of grated carrot because of its color 🤭
![IMG_20260530_124751_726.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYK8C3TA8pXE3haefcMMjUZUYTHxd9CYEBjTd63GFob8F/IMG_20260530_124751_726.jpg)
![IMG_20260530_125410_843 (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anne002/EpCAr191Ekgf6XBWGRU7XSPtYdtEKpzFAyiDeREQimQvA6ezdA5VgtnZPMimJmaXZiV.jpg)
--- ### Paso 04

>Nos vamos a agregar nuestro papelón para ello lo corté en varias partes para no agregarlo entero y se pueda derretir mucho más rápido mientras hierve la lechoza rallada,luego agregamos agua los 300 ml y llevamos a fuego medio en una olla grande para evitar que se derrame el dulce mientras se cocina. # > ### Step 04 > We're going to add our unrefined cane sugar; for this, I cut it into several pieces so that it doesn't add it whole and can melt much faster while the grated papaya boils. Then we add 300 ml of water and put it over medium heat in a large pot to prevent the sweet from boiling over while it cooks.
![IMG_20260530_125420_096.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdRguaH5BzV38kicsjybt8foWtf4JzmLeBLJTqTPVJFhw/IMG_20260530_125420_096.jpg)
![IMG_20260530_125458_170.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSZqaTYwctXoMBWhg9z1naUE48joggwbdmVYoZ1iqMxbW/IMG_20260530_125458_170.jpg)
![IMG_20260530_125622_178.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaQSs6Auo48c9LYnWpQGnUd9gzi6cxzf2Xn5cnZcdN3Wi/IMG_20260530_125622_178.jpg)
--- ### Paso 05

>Pasamos a agregar los clavitos de olor,aquí estaban los clavitos de olor pasando por inspección de olor conmigo,no podía dejar de oler lo rico que estaban esos clavitos 😁😄,se los agregamos directamente y esperamos que comience a hervir. # > ### Step 05 > Next, we added the cloves. Here were the cloves undergoing a smell inspection with me. I couldn't stop smelling how delicious those cloves were 😁😄. We added them directly and waited for it to start boiling.
![IMG_20260530_125708_197.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSUrYqgMvSa9rKQn8YpsRr1ZE9ySVF7UA9R9PE8AZMEL8/IMG_20260530_125708_197.jpg)
![IMG_20260530_125726_627.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfRYhowwvj4S5Dm76H4YHRDXF2JqvMBkoxVyK6HbWg4aC/IMG_20260530_125726_627.jpg)
--- ### Paso 06

>Cuando se haya derretido la panela de papelón agregamos la cucharada de azúcar y dejamos cocinar durante 30 minutos nuestro dulce semi tapado.Sabremos que nuestro dulce está listo en 3 pasos:(1)Se torna cristalino nuestra ralladura de lechoza ,(2)Se recoge del fondo, (3)Podemos observar que tiene un tono brilloso en la superficie ,retiramos del fuego dejamos enfriar durante 1 hora y asi podremos agregarlo en las bandejas para servir. # > ### Step 06 > Once the panela has melted, add the tablespoon of sugar and let our sweet cook semi-covered for 30 minutes. We will know that our sweet is ready in 3 steps: (1) Our papaya grating becomes crystalline, (2) It collects from the bottom, (3) We can observe that it has a shiny tone on the surface, remove from the heat, let it cool for 1 hour and then we can add it to the trays to serve. #
![IMG_20260530_130506_342.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSk35QDpyzQ27duquBkjbyuiaggdEpUFwQV7TfcNcLmEv/IMG_20260530_130506_342.jpg)
![IMG_20260530_130716_753.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNdEfhb3Y4uGb13ZJT2mnTSRvMqrvGTNaX49ZUtRsY3oq/IMG_20260530_130716_753.jpg)
![IMG_20260530_135432_015.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP3Htg9CMg464LwcM4AVMru74e8Bc4hAQbe3dTHpeMkJZ/IMG_20260530_135432_015.jpg)
---
![Yellow and Brown Organic Abstract Food YouTube Thumbnail_20260530_142854_0000 (1).png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYFS61ZjBgM1R4uZrtoJLrRmy2ZHqSUfdErsDzADWmRzm/Yellow%20and%20Brown%20Organic%20Abstract%20Food%20YouTube%20Thumbnail_20260530_142854_0000%20(1).png)
## _
Resultado:
_ ### _
Result:
_ #

>Ya podremos disfrutar de nuestra deliciosa receta de dulce de lechoza o manjar de papaya como prefieras llamarlo,me alegraría saber que a partir de esta receta aprendiste a hacerlo y te haya gustado mucho,hasta aquí llegamos al final de nuestra receta y me despido de ustedes deseando poder volvernos a encontrar en otra receta más conmigo,saludos y buen apetito 👩🏻‍🍳. # > Now we can enjoy our delicious papaya candy recipe, or papaya pudding, whichever you prefer to call it. I'd be happy to know that you learned how to make it from this recipe and that you liked it a lot. This brings us to the end of our recipe, and I'll say goodbye, hoping we can meet again in another recipe with me. Cheers and bon appétit! 👩🏻‍🍳 #
![IMG_20260530_134556_337.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmf68ykBduHWcvYXT6Xe92th4PSRYom4wiTFejhE2RB5cv/IMG_20260530_134556_337.jpg)
![IMG_20260530_134607_376.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXJhbrSN7WrLo7gVg2Bwp7xpENiKoUtvnnb1XYcrwk8X8/IMG_20260530_134607_376.jpg)
![IMG_20260530_134633_837.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWMgPmiaCczv7tiuxCdn5gJS98VPnivyMJyvuXxwhjrou/IMG_20260530_134633_837.jpg)
![Yellow and Brown Organic Abstract Food YouTube Thumbnail_20260530_142854_0000 (1).png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYFS61ZjBgM1R4uZrtoJLrRmy2ZHqSUfdErsDzADWmRzm/Yellow%20and%20Brown%20Organic%20Abstract%20Food%20YouTube%20Thumbnail_20260530_142854_0000%20(1).png)

description.title: DETAILS OF HIS CRUCIFICATION AND RESURRECTION
description.body:
‎Hey pals...i have some good news about His resurrection and the things needed to learn from it.

Have you ever been in a room when something so significant happened that the air itself seemed to change? That is the closest I can get to describing what Matthew records at the moment Jesus breathed His last. Because when Jesus died, it was not just hearts that were moved. The earth moved too.
‎
![IMG_20260529_160438_045.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnpetra/AKDhw2NhsJyHpJqfH5v3tXUTAJYqcqUZ2Ym4xRa9FZeELMAfJfCBfg4XJUixuMP.jpg)


‎\

(Matthew 27:50-51).
‎
‎This was not a coincidence. This was creation responding to the death of its Creator.
‎
‎A Real Earthquake
‎
‎The Bible records a literal earthquake at the exact moment Jesus died. And here is something worth knowing. Modern geological research has found evidence of a significant seismic event in that region around the first century. Studies of sediment layers near the Dead Sea point to earthquake activity that lines up with the timing of the crucifixion.
‎
‎This does not scientifically prove the crucifixion happened. But it does something meaningful. It shows that Scripture and science are not in conflict here. They are pointing at the same moment. They are echoing the same event.
‎
‎The Message
‎
Creation Recognised What People Rejected
‎
‎Think about who was present at the cross. The crowds mocked Him. The religious leaders dismissed Him. The soldiers crucified Him. The people who should have known best seemed to understand the least.
‎
‎But the earth responded.
‎
‎The ground trembled beneath their feet as if creation itself was bearing witness to something the human crowd was refusing to see. The One who spoke the world into existence, who called light out of darkness and set the stars in place, was hanging on a cross. And the world He had made felt it.

![IMG_20260528_174938_636.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnpetra/AK2DzDF22bAqySgbZaXkqnSQKBT8yLXSecT9hCg9p1yZFHD1xqoA1DqW9HTv5Q9.jpg)

‎
 The Veil Was Torn and Access Was Opened.At that same moment, three things happened at once. The earth shook. The rocks split. And the curtain inside the temple was torn in two.
‎
‎That curtain was not decorative. It was a physical barrier between ordinary people and the presence of God. Only the high priest could pass beyond it, and only once a year, and only with the right preparation. That curtain was a daily reminder that sinful human beings could not simply walk into the presence of a holy God.
‎
‎But when Jesus died, that barrier came down. Separation ended. Access was opened. The way to God was no longer restricted to one man, one day, one ritual. And notice the detail Matthew gives us. It was torn from top to bottom. Not torn by human hands reaching up. Torn from above, by God Himself, reaching down.
‎
‎ Even the Hard Things Broke
‎
‎\

(Matthew 27:51).
‎
‎Rocks do not break easily. They are dense and stubborn and they resist change. But on that day, even the hardest things gave way.
‎
‎I think there is something deeply personal in that detail. If rocks can split at the death of Jesus, what does that say about the hard places in a human heart? If the ground itself can shake, what does that say about a life that has felt immovable for years? No one is too far gone. No heart is too hardened. No situation is beyond the reach of what happened on that cross.
‎
 A Soldier Saw the Truth
‎
‎After everything, after the darkness and the earthquake and the way Jesus died, a Roman centurion standing right there at the scene said something remarkable. \

(Matthew 27:54).
‎

![IMG_20260527_113057_245.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnpetra/2423uVRAqtV1xKNDKjiDP5USVRjGsGxuSp2YPGoFtQyD3QQQVdF4M5a2NvDbAC3f6m5bp.jpg)

‎Not one of the disciples. Not a religious leader. A Roman soldier. Someone with no background in the Scriptures, no expectation of a Messiah, no reason to say what he said. And yet he said it. It took darkness, an earthquake, and the way a man died on a cross to open the eyes that theology and tradition had somehow kept shut in others.
‎
‎Prophetic Insight
‎
‎The earthquake was not only a physical event. It was a spiritual disruption. Everything that could be shaken was shaken. Sin's power was confronted. Death's grip was challenged. Hell's authority was called into question.
‎
‎And here is what I find quietly comforting about that. God still shakes things. Not to frighten us, but to wake us up. Not to destroy us, but to break what has been keeping us bound. Sometimes what feels like chaos in a life, in a season, in a heart, is actually God doing something. \

(Hebrews 12:26). The shaking is not the enemy. It is often the evidence that God is near and at work.
‎
‎A Devotional Moment
‎ The sky has gone dark in the middle of the afternoon. The air is heavy. A crowd that was shouting has gone quiet. And then the ground moves beneath your feet.On the cross, Jesus breathes His last breath.
‎
‎And the earth, the very earth He formed with His hands, trembles in response. Not in anger. Not in chaos. In recognition. In witness. In the awful, sacred weight of what has just happened.
‎
‎A Declaration
‎
‎Lord Jesus, thank You for what You accomplished on the cross. When the earth shook, You were breaking chains. When the curtain tore, You were opening the way. Shake anything in my life that is not from You. Break every hard and stubborn place in my heart. I receive Your access, Your freedom, and Your truth. In Jesus name, Amen.
‎
‎The Takeaway
‎When Jesus died, the earth shook, because heaven was changing everything. What looked like the darkest ending the world had ever seen was, in the same moment, the most powerful beginning.
‎
‎If this spoke to you today, share it with someone who needs the reminder. What looked like the end was actually the beginning of everything.
‎ You're reading from your handsome friend John Petra!

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@johnpetra/details-of-his-crucification-and-resurrection--gux)

---

## The Battle Pass Changed The Game


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wrestorgonline/23tvAw4i2yhs3hZ3QnhCifZ8KVKseVR4zN5B72JS1YmM9LQVwGyMnnpBUuYWczsHTw2hW.png)


The WOO Battle Pass gave players more reasons to log in, play matches, earn rewards, and push their organization forward.

With free and premium reward tracks, daily activity, quests, and more ways to earn, the Battle Pass has already become one of the biggest updates WOO has released so far.

You can read the full Battle Pass announcement here:

https://peakd.com/hive-191258/@wrestorgonline/massive-woo-update-battle-pass-launch--more

The results have been huge.

More matches.
More activity.
More rewards.
More reasons to play.

But we are not stopping there.

---

## Land Rewards Are Now Live


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wrestorgonline/Eo44nPzUnj8GvWLsG7J9C4gEhvf91yK2L8hECA6sqFBCveEq46k353PM9j7aKiL5Ezt.png)


Land owners now have a brand-new way to benefit from the WOO ecosystem.

If you own staked land with a **Training Center**, your land can now generate weekly WOOJOBBERS pack rewards.

Every Monday at **5:00 UTC**, land rewards will be calculated and added as claimable value on the new Land Rewards screen.

Once rewards are available, players can simply click **Claim**, and the packs will be distributed automatically.

No manual tracking.
No waiting.
No guessing.

Just stake, build, earn, and claim.

---

## How Weekly Land Rewards Work


![Untitled-1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wrestorgonline/23uEwtcGJnx5BpiUogUBoAPgDLpB1H5fDyxNbwLKDSeXCoJ4LXc6YNAwwGZe9akTdb96G.png)



Land Rewards are based on your Training Center and your land multiplier.

Each week, the game calculates your reward based on the level of your Training Center. The higher your Training Center, the better your possible weekly pack range.

Current Training Center reward ranges:

| Training Center Level | Name | Weekly Pack Range |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Level 1 | Boiler Room | 0–1 packs |
| Level 2 | Iron Works | 1–2 packs |
| Level 3 | The Forge | 1–3 packs |
| Level 4 | Apex Dojo | 2–4 packs |
| Level 5 | Pinnacle Institute | 3–6 packs |

Each week, the game rolls within your Training Center’s range. Then your land’s star multiplier is applied.

That means stronger land and upgraded Training Centers can produce significantly better rewards over time.

---

## Land Stars Now Matter Even More


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wrestorgonline/23uQg2mdsbwWRVfYJ4f8QWnyk1LNKjKNTWbjD4KPM4MwVYHSqqmVDQJHugjpsS7tbLCWb.png)

Every land NFT has star values based on:

- Population
- Wealth
- Fans

Those stars create your land’s overall multiplier.

| Total Stars | Tier | Multiplier |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 3★ | Common | 1.00x |
| 4★ | Uncommon | 1.10x |
| 5★ | Rare | 1.30x |
| 6★ | Elite | 1.60x |
| 7★ | Epic | 2.00x |
| 8★ | Legendary | 2.75x |
| 9★ | Mythic | 4.00x |

This gives high-star land even more long-term value inside the WOO ecosystem.

A 3★ land starts with a 1.00x multiplier.

A 9★ Mythic land has a massive 4.00x multiplier.

That means premium land now feels even more premium.

---

## Progress Toward Your Next Pack Is Saved

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wrestorgonline/23tkjaSKRRKDBwS4muzrKjYy7zShYtaF6VtUg6kzhGgeqSGgqbfhTXkwzZXZKUv3kcKaC.png)

One of the best parts of this system is that partial progress is not wasted.

If your weekly reward calculation creates an uneven value, the completed packs are added as claimable rewards, while the remaining progress is saved under **Progress to Next Pack**.

For example, if your land generates 3.4 packs, you would receive 3 claimable packs, and the remaining 0.4 progress would carry forward.

That progress continues building toward your next pack.

Every fraction matters.

Nothing is thrown away.

---

## This Is A Huge Utility Boost For Land Owners


![Untitledd-1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wrestorgonline/23uQNnCFrnXGYzxVasxA5qufzMxNCquRvQ6eDcZseKFxAbzPMK9Biz2VgA1w2x4Grjrcg.png)


This update greatly increases the utility of WOO land.

Land is no longer just something you own.

Land is now becoming a productive part of your WOO organization.

With Land Rewards, owners can generate WOOJOBBERS packs passively through upgraded Training Centers. That connects land ownership directly to gameplay, roster building, and long-term progression.

If you own land, now is the time to check your city and think seriously about upgrading your Training Center.

The better your Training Center, the better your possible weekly rewards.

---

## Upgrade Your Training Center



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wrestorgonline/23tkmmL7Y23ycX5hgazBceKUfABgDtHFFFeRgVD7eQmk5fMpspF2XR492XbNynSrezM4W.png)



Every land owner should take a close look at their Training Center.

Training Centers are now one of the most important upgrades for land-based rewards.

A higher-level Training Center increases your weekly pack range, which means more chances to generate WOOJOBBERS packs every Monday.

If you want to get more out of your land, upgrading your Training Center should be one of your top priorities.

Build your city.
Upgrade your Training Center.
Increase your rewards.

---

## WOOJOBBERS Keep Becoming More Important



![Unssstitled-1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wrestorgonline/23uExFhkHoBpHZPN6ZML9NPdkrDBWUFWdcGw4s5YXabUas6RoHFcjTJp7ReyPtuoNZoUF.png)



WOOJOBBERS continue to become a major part of the WOO game economy.

Players use WOOJOBBERS to build out rosters, fill match slots, compete in events, progress through the Battle Pass, and stay active in the game.

WOOJOBBERS have already been distributed through events, rewards, and gameplay systems.

Now, land owners have another way to earn them.

This connects land, buildings, packs, matches, and rewards into one stronger ecosystem.

That is exactly the kind of foundation WOO needs as the game continues to grow.

---

## More Activity, More Rewards, More WOO


![Udddddntitled-1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wrestorgonline/23tvAw5fcF9WKBt8RyVfticMQXTr1uqRxPCqh8Ju3AzSFAgsfVjzyMK2b9QXmDXwZPmGX.png)


The Battle Pass helped create a massive increase in daily activity.

Land Rewards now give land owners another major reason to stay involved.

Together, these updates are pushing WOO into a much more active and rewarding phase.

Players have more to do.
Land owners have more to earn.
The ecosystem has more utility.

This is what we want WOO to become.

A game where activity matters.
A game where ownership matters.
A game where building your organization matters.

---

## What Is Coming Next?


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wrestorgonline/23wBy2WWeot4QXbzbiQ53FC5ecudoiEQRGCJ4RT5kECp92d8jGF9F1pKhnyKtUq95tGMB.png)


We are not slowing down.

The WOO team is already working on more improvements that will continue to push the game forward.

Coming soon, players can look forward to:

- A new ranking system
- A major player UI graphic overhaul
- More improvements to the game experience
- More reasons to compete, climb, and build your WOO organization

The upcoming ranking system will give players another major reason to compete and keep improving.

The upcoming UI graphic overhaul will help make WOO feel even more polished, modern, and game-like.

The Battle Pass was a major step.

Land Rewards are another major step.

And there is more coming.

---

## The Momentum Is Real


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wrestorgonline/23u5bYCmc1My1dFRZc4XDDynBJBLCTyBvemhcuz1LWVbiFUhHC2ixLBb4VzuVxM7VqwKw.png)


This is another major building block for Wrestling Organization Online.

The Battle Pass brought new daily progression.

Land Rewards bring stronger land utility.

The upcoming ranking system will bring more competition.

The upcoming UI overhaul will bring more polish and excitement to the player experience.

WOO is growing piece by piece, system by system, update by update.

If you are already playing, keep grinding.

If you own land, upgrade your Training Center.

If you have been watching from the sidelines, now is a great time to jump in.

The rewards are growing.

The activity is growing.

The momentum is real.

And WOO is just getting started.

**WOO!**
