description.title: The Blockchain That Rewards Creativity and Community (HIVE Network)
description.body: That simple question lies at the heart of Hive, a blockchain network that has been quietly building a decentralized ecosystem where creators, writers, developers, gamers, and entrepreneurs can connect, share, and earn. In a world dominated by social media giants that profit from user-generated content, Hive offers a different vision where users own their accounts, control their content, and receive rewards for the value they create.
alt=\

/> **What Is Hive?** Hive is a decentralized blockchain network designed for social media, content creation, gaming, finance, and Web3 applications. Unlike traditional social media platforms, Hive does not have a central company controlling user accounts or content. Instead, it operates through a distributed network of witnesses, developers, and community members. This means: * No central authority owns your content * Your account belongs to you * Transactions are fast * Fees are virtually nonexistent * Users can earn rewards for participation Hive was created with the goal of empowering individuals while encouraging innovation and community-driven growth. * * * **Why Hive Is Different?** Most social media platforms follow a simple business model: Users create content - the platform earns money. Hive changes this equation! When users contribute valuable content, they can receive rewards from the community through the Hive reward system. Whether you're a writer, a photographer, a musician, a gamerdeveloper, an entrepreneur, etc. Hive provides opportunities to build an audience and earn from your contributions.
alt=\

/> **Fast and Fee-Free Transactions.** One of Hive's greatest strengths is its speed. Many blockchain networks struggle with high transaction fees and network congestion but Hive takes a different approach. Users can publish content, transfer tokens, vote and interact with applications without paying traditional transaction fees. This makes Hive especially attractive for everyday use and micro-transactions that would be impractical on many other blockchain networks. * * * **A Growing Ecosystem.** Hive is much more than a blogging platform. Over the years, an entire ecosystem has emerged around the blockchain, popular areas include: **1\. Social Media** * Platforms allow users to publish articles, interact with communities, and earn rewards. **2\. Gaming** * Blockchain-based games enable players to own digital assets and earn cryptocurrency. **3\. Finance** * Users can participate in decentralized financial activities using Hive-based tokens and applications. **4\. Communities** Hundreds of niche communities exist for topics such as: * Technology * Photography * Travel * Finance * Health * Education * Entrepreneurship Whatever your interests, there's likely a community waiting for you.
alt=\

/>

**Ownership Matters.**

One of the most powerful aspects of Hive is digital ownership.

On traditional platforms, accounts can be restricted, content can be removed, and users have limited control over their data.

Hive offers a different model.

Users hold cryptographic keys that provide direct control over their accounts.

This creates a more open and resilient ecosystem where individuals maintain ownership of their online presence.

For many users, this principle alone is one of Hive's most compelling advantages.

* * *

**Opportunities for Creators.**

Content creation remains one of the most popular activities on Hive.

Successful creators often focus on:

*   High-quality articles
    
*   Educational content
    
*   Personal experiences
    
*   Tutorials
    
*   Photography
    
*   Market analysis
    
*   Travel stories
    

The key is consistency.

Building relationships, participating in communities, and creating valuable content can help users grow their audience over time.

Hive rewards contribution, engagement, and community involvement.

* * *

**Challenges and Reality.**

Like every blockchain project, Hive faces challenges.

The cryptocurrency market can be volatile.

Building an audience takes time.

Rewards are not guaranteed.

However, many users view Hive as a long-term opportunity rather than a quick way to earn money.

The strongest participants are often those who focus on learning, networking, and contributing value to the ecosystem.

* * *

**Looking Toward the Future.**

As Web3 continues to evolve, Hive remains one of the most established decentralized social blockchains in operation.

Its combination of:

*   Fast transactions
    
*   No transaction fees
    
*   Strong communities
    
*   Content rewards
    
*   Decentralized governance
    

positions it as a unique platform within the blockchain industry.

Whether you're a writer, developer, entrepreneur, investor, or simply curious about decentralized technology, Hive offers an opportunity to participate in a growing digital economy built around community ownership.

* * *

**Final Thoughts.**

Hive is more than a cryptocurrency network.

It is an experiment in digital ownership, community governance, and creator empowerment.

In a world where attention has become one of the most valuable resources, Hive gives users the chance to benefit directly from the value they create.

The future of the internet may not belong solely to large corporations.

It may belong to communities.

And Hive is helping to build that future today.

* * *

**_What do you think about Hive and the future of decentralized social media? Share your thoughts in the comments below._**

description.title: BeerSaturday 465 - Shawi Beach (Le Trou du Diable)
description.body:
Here's my contribution to [**BeerSaturday 465**](https://peakd.com/hive-187719/@detlev/beersaturday-465) with a New England IPA brewed by [**Le Trou du Diable**](https://troududiable.com/), it's the **Shawi Beach**. Normally at this time of year, my fridge is more lagers, which are more refreshing. But this week the temperatures haven't been great, with rain. It's nothing like the conditions in Europe. But I prefer it this way, especially in the city and at work.

> *Voici ma participation au [**BeerSaturday 465**](https://peakd.com/hive-187719/@detlev/beersaturday-465) avec une New England IPA brassée par [**Le Trou du Diable**](https://troududiable.com/), il s'agit de la **Shawi Beach**. Normalement en cette période de l'année, mon frigo est plus rempli de lagers, plus rafraichissantes. Mais cette semaine les températures n'ont pas été formidables avec de la pluie. On est loin des conditions en Europe. Mais je préfère comme cela, frais surtout en ville et au travail.*

![Shawi Beach by Le Trou du Diable](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23yJGF8CogarEVpVmfshg9aRwwcQSYG5WCPHnJbNRoRkvY2jvYCHD4SjgEnBVcAajpDd2.JPG)

Here is a map of Quebec where I can show you the exact location of the brewery. The brewery [**Le Trou du Diable**](https://troududiable.com/) is located in **Shawanigan**, not far from Trois-Rivières, between Montreal and Quebec City.

> *Voici la carte du Québec ou je peux vous montrer précisément la localisation de la brasserie. La brasserie [**Le Trou du Diable**](https://troududiable.com/) se trouve à **Shawanigan**, pas très loin de Trois Rivières entre Montréal et Québec.*

![Brasseries.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23tHNv6A1rk2yhEn9PjgWe84coajR3f7BEVLDYrEGVQkk8mkZnymue1freNaNivqndgVn.jpg)

![line_hive.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/xoycoMPQ-line_hive.jpg)

# Shawi Beach (Le Trou du Diable)
***

## 📜 Brewery / *Brasserie* :

![DSC00455.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23ywwhKwUmUPg8zbuMVJp1E4Vvefp8EdErpirXT1GP3JDuWTB2wfrY7iBzjYLoT9RUt11.JPG)

The brewery [**Le Trou du Diable**](https://troududiable.com/) (The Devil's Hole) was founded in 2005 in Shawinigan by **André Trudel** and **Isaac Tremblay**, two childhood friends with a passion for beer. Its name comes from a rock formation on the St. Maurice River that creates quite turbulent waters. It was a great success for the town, with a restaurant and even a performance venue; the brewery revitalized the area. In 2017, it was acquired by the beer giant **Molson Coors**. It's now far from being a microbrewery, although it has managed to retain its authenticity.

> *La brasserie [**Le Trou du Diable**](https://troududiable.com/) a été créée en 2005 à Shawinigan par **André Trudel** et **Isaac Tremblay**, deux amis d'enfance, passionnés de bière. Son nom provient d'une formation rocheuse qui se trouve sur la rivière St-Maurice qui provoque des eaux assez tourbillonnantes. Cela fut un gros succès pour la ville avec un restaurant et même une salle de spectacle, la brasserie a redynamisé la ville. En 2017, elle a été achetée par le géant de la bière **Molson Coors**. Nous sommes loin maintenant de la microbrasserie bien qu'elle a su garder son authenticité.*

***

## 🍺 Tasting / *Dégustation* : 

![Shawi Beach (Le Trou du Diable)](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23wgKh7baN1fWdCznQrW1BV86zzdtMogXgcJPuPmP2jUsrD1ZZBcQgU1FyxS7Swm4DFDf.JPG)

This is **Shawi Beach**, a NEIPA with 6.5% ABV, hopped with DDH for even more flavor. In the glass, it's a straw yellow, not entirely opaque, actually quite transparent with a light head. It doesn't resemble your typical NEIPA, especially with the double dry hopping. On the palate, it's fairly smooth for a NEIPA, but fruity as it should be, leaning more towards apple with a refreshing finish. It's not a classic NEIPA, but it's especially good on warmer days. It's crisper, a NEIPA for summer 😀 or as its name suggests, the beach.

> *Il s'agit de la **Shawi Beach**, une NEIPA avec 6.5% d'alcool avec un houblonnage DDH pour avoir encore plus de saveurs.  Dans le verre, la robe est jaune paille pas entièrement opaque, même plutôt transparente avec une \

mousse. Cela ne ressemble pas aux NEIPA habituelles, surtout avec le double dry hopping. En bouche, c'est assez doux pour une NEIPA mais fruité comme il se doit, mais tirant plus sur la pomme avec une finale rafraichissante. Ce n'est pas une NEIPA classique mais bonne surtout quand les journées ne sont pas si froides que cela. C'est plus croustillant, une NEIPA pour l'été* 😀 *ou comme le dit son nom, la plage.*

![DSC00458.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23ywqEqgDo2ronh8Kc76DLja3XgyUskgNjUWgbjRNgF6GpuYax5YzSkSfiF6xHyhBFbWD.JPG)

## Design

<div class=\
>\n\n
/>
>\n\n

/> However, I'm really not a fan of the design. Even the color palette, orange and blue, is strange. But at the grocery store, I wanted a NEIPA and I'd never tried this style from [**Le Trou du Diable**](https://troududiable.com/). It was a good opportunity... / **FR** : *Par contre le design, je ne suis vraiment pas fan. Même la palette de couleurs, orange et bleu, est étrange. Mais à l'épicerie, je voulais une NEIPA et je n'avais jamais gouté ce style par [**Le Trou du Diable**](https://troududiable.com/). C'était l'occasion...* ![line_hive.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/xoycoMPQ-line_hive.jpg) **Have a great week.** / ***Très bonne semaine à tous***. **Cheers / Santé / Salud 🍻**

description.title: The Pressure to Perform Instead of Being Real Online
description.body:
<div  class=text-justify>

I watched a short clip yesterday that came to my mind immediately I read the prompt. It was about a young man promoting books that will help his audience make money after condemning some books, I recognised the condemned ones, though I'm yet to read them. But that's not the point here.

![file_00000000cb7c71f49c5bb216e06a955f.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/merit.ahama/23xoymWQ29s7GcMiznEqri1ryVYtRPfKLB2gkhaY2YWpdppwSv6rwgT75LjDC7GZAktqb.png)

I noticed something about this young man but didn't want to feel weird thinking about such when I look at a random person on social media, so I went down to the comment section. What I saw there were all craziness and more people pretending to be who they really are not, crazy!

I saw comments like *\

* and more like that. It will make a lot of sense why they were saying all that in the comments if you see him. More than looking unkempt and almost not serious, I noticed how he was trying so hard to blend in to what social media wants... Fakes. He seemed like he had just gone through some brief difficult situations before he set his phone for a recording, makes me wonder about his real life. That got me wondering if I really want to be on camera growing my social media page because I'm seeking for validation or some sort of approval from people. I know I've got something to give to my audience should I grow my pages but it's only a very thin line between doing it for the impact I'll make and doing it to seek approval. ![file_0000000074ec720aa178468f0de776ed.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/merit.ahama/23w2cS919WiUgpGrYJHfKFowzH89t8spMWgzvekqhBcGndWvkyXMMDBQCvdDASsTsiqat.png) So yeah, that's one of the main reasons people feel the need to hide their true selves. They think that showing who they really are will bring lots of disvalidation because people do think differently. It's a sad situation but there are still people out there who are being real and people love them. I think the use of AI have raised the standards even high that people even fear to show their processes, their real lives and their real thoughts on a topic. We'd think it should be the opposite but that's not the case at all. To be real in this era takes a lot of courage and I wish it for every one. description.body:
# Duty cycle

**Source:** https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Duty_cycle

As a ratio, duty cycle is unitless and may be given as decimal fraction and percentage alike.
An alternative term in use is duty factor.[7][8][9]

![Image 1](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/0/02/PWM_duty_cycle_with_label.gif)

Electrical and electronics[edit]
In electronics, duty cycle is the percentage of the ratio of pulse duration, or pulse width (PW) to the total period (T) of the waveform. It is generally used to represent time duration of a pulse when it is high (1). In digital electronics, signals are used in rectangular waveform which are represented by logic 1 and logic 0. Logic 1 stands for presence of an electric pulse and 0 for absence of an electric pulse. For example, a signal (10101010) has 50% duty cycle, because the pulse remains high for 1/2 of the period and low for 1/2 of the period. Similarly, for pulse (10001000) the duty cycle will be 25% because the pulse remains high only for 1/4 of the period and remains low for 3/4 of the period. In power applications (such as motors and actuators), the duty cycle is often defined by the component's ability to dissipate heat; exceeding the rated duty cycle allows thermal energy to accumulate faster than it can be released, potentially leading to insulation failure or component burnout.
Electric motors typically use a duty cycle of less than 100%.  For example, if a motor runs for one out of 100 seconds (or 1/100 of the time), its duty cycle is 1/100, or 1%.[10]
Pulse-width modulation (PWM) is used in a variety of electronic situations, such as power delivery and voltage regulation.
In electronic music, music synthesizers vary the duty cycle of their audio-frequency oscillators to obtain a subtle effect on the tone colors.  This technique is known as pulse-width modulation.
In the printer / copier industry, the duty cycle specification refers to the rated throughput (that is, printed pages) of a device per month.
In a welding power supply, the maximum duty cycle is defined as the percentage of time in a 10-minute period that it can be operated continuously before overheating.[11]
Power electronic converters use the duty cycle to control output voltage and current. In a buck converter, the average output voltage goes up and down with the duty cycle pretty much in lockstep. But with boost converters, things get less straightforward—the relationship isn’t linear. The duty cycle also impacts switching losses, current ripple, and overall efficiency, so nailing down tight control over it is a big deal in today’s DC-DC converters and motor drives.[12]

![Image 2](https://wikimedia.org/api/rest_v1/media/math/render/svg/f34a0c600395e5d4345287e21fb26efd386990e6)

The concept of duty cycles is also used to describe the activity of neurons and muscle fibers. In neural circuits for example, a duty cycle specifically refers to the proportion of a cycle period in which a neuron remains active.[5]

![Image 3](https://wikimedia.org/api/rest_v1/media/math/render/svg/15562c43f2a554e966c8e652ecd7d659845f222b)

One way to generate fairly accurate square wave signals with 1/n duty factor, where n is an integer, is to vary the duty cycle until the nth-harmonic is significantly suppressed. For audio-band signals, this can even be done \

; for example, a −40 dB reduction in the 3rd harmonic corresponds to setting the duty factor to 1/3 with a precision of 1% and −60 dB reduction corresponds to a precision of 0.1%.[13]

![Image 4](https://wikimedia.org/api/rest_v1/media/math/render/svg/ec7200acd984a1d3a3d7dc455e262fbe54f7f6e0)

Mark–space ratio, or mark-to-space ratio, is another term for the same concept, to describe the temporal relationship between two alternating periods of a waveform. However, whereas the duty cycle relates the duration of one period to the duration of the entire cycle, the mark–space ratio relates the durations of the two individual periods:[14]

![Image 5](https://wikimedia.org/api/rest_v1/media/math/render/svg/897969e05008873bbb057d62cfe074f2fc7ef511)

where  and  are the durations of the two alternating periods.

![Image 6](https://wikimedia.org/api/rest_v1/media/math/render/svg/5026ed7ee0beef6b4280d2013485823f8264f2ee)

description.title: A helpful friend surrounded by childhood memories: the Asian pintail dragonfly
description.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV251hdDNJrgqLRsDdYQxUoj2a5Tfeu4rQLdgh5AuhqT4/mix_20260530_231839.jpg)


| Latin Name | Observation Date | Location |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| ***Acisoma panorpoides*** | May 26, 2026 | Purulia, Natore, Bangladesh |


Hello friends, how are you all? I hope you are all doing well and healthy.

Today I am going to share with you a macro photo of a beautiful little dragonfly taken from my garden.

Seeing this dragonfly made me feel like I was back in my childhood. In my childhood days, these dragonfly were seen in abundance in the nature of our village. We used to play a lot with our friends by catching them. These dragonfly were so clever and fast that it was very difficult to catch them with our bare hands. As soon as we got in their reach, they would quickly fly away. So we came up with another idea. We would apply 'Glue of the Jigar tree' to the head of a thin bamboo stick. Then, very carefully, we would go behind the dragonfly and grab the stick, and when they got stuck in the glue, we would gently release them and tie a light thread to the dragonfly's tail. Then, holding one end of the thread, we would fly them into the sky.
Those days and childhood memories were really great. We used to do these things every afternoon with joy. But now that I have grown up and learned to understand nature, I regret it very much. If I had understood how beneficial this little creature is for our environment and nature when I was a child, maybe we would never have hurt or killed them like this under the guise of playing.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTt6RzCazuAPsYSbsK5phDbtuNkC3F6hf8kvbuddCCX8Y/mix_20260530_231909.jpg)

​Let's find out some wonderful scientific facts about this beneficial friend of ours, the dragonfly. Below are all its detailed information:

​Common name: Asian pintail or Grizzled Pintail. It is called trumpet tail because its tail looks a lot like a flute.
​Scientific name: Acisoma panorpoides. This dragonfly in the photo I took is basically a female dragonfly.
​Family: It is a small insect belonging to the Libellulidae family.
​Genus: Its genus is Acisoma.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVRWwMg4Wbz7CYUhkV8gVpTvG3icqheSF151e3WNXWAgu/mix_20260530_231403.jpg)

​Size: dragonfly of this species are quite small in size. They are usually only 25 to 30 millimeters long.

​Habitat and habitat: They are found in abundance in the nature of various South Asian countries including Bangladesh and India. They mainly prefer to live in pond banks, swamps, damp wild grasses and bushes.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTN7UZgpuzKgiEf4Tj73brJVivVo8RRzvhTcTFFzC6QW9/mix_20260530_231931.jpg)

​Food: Although they look very small, they are very fierce predators. Mosquitoes, small flies and various small insects harmful to crops are their main food.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdU6f3fYYkJdgRqw6pqXiT8YVhPA9qiJgYDtpcM2H57WB/mix_20260530_231449.jpg)

​Reproduction: Their reproduction process is quite wonderful. Female or female dragonfly lay eggs in the calm water of ponds or swamps. The babies that hatch from the eggs are called nymphs. They spend their lives underwater until they grow up and grow wings.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdJTYXiXEXJ5CHVPgarwBjBzK4d1RZeBKpvEDnskUUidd/mix_20260530_231949.jpg)

​Benefits: These dragonfly are a great friend to maintain the balance of our nature. They benefit our environment by eating a large number of harmful mosquitoes and crop pests every day. They are a great friend to our farmers.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQme5EPv69zuKS1u6fgRdT3zef1Zu5GN8JgJvtXKwpzYUcv/mix_20260530_232034.jpg)

​Disadvantages: This little dragonfly has no disadvantages or bad sides. They do not cause any harm to humans or crops, they are completely safe.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbZT73v8DN347o3zFweBefi3AxJiXLW1JfW5yqsC2iLhg/mix_20260530_231713.jpg)

I was very happy to meet this little friend and take pictures of it. I hope you all liked my childhood story and the wonderful information about this grasshopper.

Thank you all very much for reading my post.

  I learned about them from various sites including iNaturalist, Wikipedia and Google.

(All posts are written in Bengali and translated into English using Google Translate.)

>कल शाम की कुछ तस्वीरें साझा कर रही हूँ। सूर्यास्त के समय मैं बाहर थी और सामने का नज़ारा बहुत सुंदर लग रहा था।


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQMR3MRtJ39K5zPVhA6puqqqxNP2Am12iPQZjRQUZDrvP/img_4595.jpg)



The sky had beautiful shades of orange, peach, pink, and blue spreading across the horizon.The colours seemed to form layers of their own. Near the horizon, the colours were lighter and softer, and as my eyes moved upward, the shades gradually became deeper. 

>आसमान क्षितिज पर फैले नारंगी, पीच, गुलाबी और नीले रंगों के खूबसूरत शेड्स से भरा हुआ था। रंगों की भी अपनी अलग-अलग परतें नज़र आ रही थीं। क्षितिज के पास रंग हल्के और नरम थे, और ऊपर की ओर देखते ही वे धीरे-धीरे गहरे होते जा रहे थे।

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVX3kui3DKrbSRqpwsFhf1xoSjq3yD1PKrV53Q4pxDaaV/img_4592.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXZW1ujdeqFmryPLSMzyUo9s7FYhzGVEQrxEPpY2XE4hC/img_4593.jpg)



The hills looked just as beautiful. There were so many layers of them stretching into the distance that it was difficult to tell where one ended and the next began. The farther hills appeared lighter and hazier.

>पहाड़ियाँ भी उतनी ही खूबसूरत लग रही थीं। उनकी इतनी सारी परतें दूर तक फैली हुई थीं कि यह पहचानना मुश्किल था कि एक पहाड़ी कहाँ खत्म हो रही है और दूसरी कहाँ से शुरू हो रही है। दूर की पहाड़ियाँ हल्के रंग की और धुंध में ढकी हुई दिखाई दे रही थीं।


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb6qi5PqdnMAkXdRDTyssUKeU4YBLCSSU5CrKfJ3HheSg/img_4594.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUobSe4sgTFXuPKuBA8LLxyGQQ7bqcUY84KYfuBC4itzL/img_4596.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXb9ubHNLDyRsKzNT54nWRBPXyawVsbndJTu8qULmgtcY/img_4597.jpg)

The nearest hill had winding roads that were clearly visible from where I was standing.

> सबसे नज़दीक वाली पहाड़ी पर बनी घुमावदार सड़कें वहाँ से साफ़ नज़र आ रही थीं, जो पहाड़ी के साथ-साथ घूमती हुई आगे बढ़ रही थीं।

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU5Dpy2R9DmxHUexEx3x3P5B6pWwzekvQCXKFrJSHzokM/img_4598.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUjQ1tXzs2TJ5uTqJ8YUPFEE9UvYNXpob9oxZ7TNvjJPh/img_4599.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZymGFYdKLs3Ye55WZBdK9FpQ9WDsCkB8vZh2qNeb57sA/img_4600.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcf5U6pqNtgyGp6dBx4r1BdNXzNTgexLSt5p8pZwjJ7JK/img_4601.jpg)

While the sun was slowly setting, I glanced behind me and spotted the moon hanging in the sky. It looked small but really beautiful.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfSaqMJ6wpuDpnLT7d8we8TcyNNX57wxb7cwxcKud8L1P/img_4602.jpg)

>जैसे-जैसे सूरज ढल रहा था, मैंने पीछे मुड़कर आसमान की ओर देखा तो चाँद भी दिखाई दे रहा था। वह छोटा-सा लग रहा था, लेकिन बहुत सुंदर।


That's all for today folks. Happy snapping. 💜💙

description.title: Dziennik #95/2026 - samotność
description.body:
![preserved-eggs-symmetry-7599705_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ataraksja/23t7934jj2TnoEbgpnSmx4gDCyMo8g97EtBmPifT5RBxLPBBP34YDtFbp3k68z9K7ZNZG.jpg)

*Źródło: Pixabay*

---
<div class=\

> Dobry wieczór. Pospałam dzisiaj. Wczoraj wieczorem wzięłam nowy zestaw leków czyli stabilizator nastroju x 2 + antydepresant + nasenne i było ok. Trochę się bałam, bo nie wiedziałam jak organizm zareaguje, ale było naprawdę w porządku. Nie ścięło mnie momentalnie tylko łagodnie zasnęłam i dość dobrze spałam. Obudziłam się w nocy jakieś dwa razy co było zajebistym wynikiem, bo zwykle budzę się jakieś sto razy. Jak wstałam to poszłam na spacer z psem i na zakupy. Źle się dzisiaj czuję. Czuję przejmujący smutek taki aż do szpiku kości i samotność, która zniewoliła mi serce. Nie mam z kim porozmawiać o tym co przeżywam, jestem sama na froncie i jest mi z tym ciężko. Dlaczego tak jest nie chcę tego rozwijać. Mimo wszystko cierpię. W chuj. Przeleżałam cały dzień w łóżku gapiąc się w ścianę. Zamiennie w sufit. Szczytem produktywności było umycie głowy, ale ja mam akurat pierdolca na tym punkcie, że musi być umyta codziennie, więc nie wiem czy bym się podniecała tym. Popołudniu pojechałam na miting i było ok. Kolega wyprawiał stoją szesnastą rocznicę trzeźwości. Był to dla mnie wyjątkowy dzień, ponieważ Leszek był jedną z trzech osób, dzięki którym uwierzyłam we wspólnotę AA. Na początku swojej drogi byłam na innym mitingu i nie spodobało mi się bardzo, bo było dużo w moim odczuciu siewców prawdy objawionej. Aż trafiłam na sobotni miting gdzie był właśnie Leszek, Heniu i Jurek. Mogliby być moimi dziadkami albo ojcami, ale przyjęli mnie bardzo ciepło, zaopiekowali się mną i sprawili, że pierwszy raz w życiu poczułam się mniej samotna i że gdzieś przynależę. Jurka już z nami nie ma, to już jakoś dwa lata jak nie żyje - nieodżałowana strata. Na mitingu porozmawialiśmy, zjedliśmy ciasto i każdy poszedł w swoją stronę. Po powrocie do domu zabrałam psa na spacer i właśnie na tym spacerze spotkałam mojego serdecznego kolegę z ostatniego odwyku. Fantastycznie było go spotkać! Porozmawialiśmy trochę, wyściskaliśmy się i umówiliśmy się na kawę i spacer w drugiej połowie czerwca, bo tak nam terminowo pasuje. A może uda się wykombinować coś wcześniej. Takimi ludźmi powinnam się otaczać - serdecznymi i trzeźwymi. Nie mam planów na wieczór. Chcę po prostu przetrwać. Strasznie chce mi się płakać, ale nie leci żadna łza. Czuję się jakby mi ktoś zajebał w splot słoneczny. Czuję się jakby mnie ktoś przejechał czołgiem. Czuję się jakby mi z serca odpływały ostatnie krople krwi. Czuję się jak nikt. Jest mi kurwa ciężko i chcę tylko przetrwać chociaż kompletnie nie mam pomysłu jak to zrobić. Do jutra.

> We participate in various games. Actually, there are two options in a game, either win or lose. But we should never give up hope. description.title: Wenn man nicht mehr weiß welcher Tag ist
description.body:
Hallo Freunde,

wieder einmal haben wir erhöhte Temperaturen gehabt und wir haben es hier gemerkt. Ich finde es immer wieder spannend wie man merkt, wenn die Temperaturen hochgehen. Wir hatten hier in Nürnberg jetzt ein paar sehr warme Tage und in der Arbeit war die Hölle los. Es waren Tage in denen es regelmäßig über die 30 Grad ging und in den Autos ging es noch weiter hoch. 

___


![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-26 at 14.48.56.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/satren/23zkkM1F4YHmycvBuNmDEybEkCibk33o1AwctoRMGYTLqEjWFdy5x76kGkPjz6Vdd237k.jpeg)


___

Wir standen etwa ne Stunde an der Einsatzstelle und haben den Patienten vor Ort versorgt und als wir wieder im Auto waren um zu putzen und zu dokumentieren, dachte ich mir, ach du heilige Scheiße, was ist eigentlich hier los. Und dann habe ich am Radio gesehen, wir haben 40 Grad in der Sonne, man muss dazu sagen, Temperatur wird nie in der Sonne gemessen, sondern im Schatten, da es in der Sonne weiter aufheizt. Ich finde es immer wieder schön wie dann die halbe Wache aussieht wie Krebse. Ein Grund um Sonnencreme in Massen zu verwenden.

Das Problem ist auch, dass wir eine immer ältere Bevölkerung haben und je Älter ein Mensch ist, desto schwieriger ist es für ihn mit der Hitze umzugehen und das merkt man. Renter trinken zu wenig, aufgrund ihres Stoffwechsels, und gleichzeitig sind sie vorerkrankt und haben vor allem mit dem Kreislauf zu kämpfen. Und genau da hat man einige Probleme. Die Hitze spielt da mit rein und sorgt für Kollapse, übrigens die andere Gruppe die da viel betroffen ist, sind junge Menschen, ihre Körper entwickeln sich schneller als früher und da kommt der Kreislauf manchmal nicht mehr mit und bei der Hitze setzt er dann aus. 

Und so kam es jetzt auch in den letzten Tagen zu einigen Reanimationen. Die Hitze verstärkt vieles was davor schon da war und schon hat man immer in den ersten Tagen Probleme, auch in der Belegschaft, viele Kollegen fallen gerade Krankheitsbedingt aus, weil wir seit Monaten am Limit arbeiten und die Hitze jetzt den Rest gibt. Mich hats letztens auch ein paar Tage erwischt, der Kreislauf hat nicht mehr mitgespielt und hat ein paar Tage ruhe gebraucht. 

Mal schauen wo das alles noch hinführt. Ich bleibe gespannt.

description.title: TELLING A LITTLE WHITE LIE
description.body:
Hello everyone your welcome to my blog

Lying is bad, so we were taught growing up, this is what we also teach our kids, but the truth is that it is something we also do as humans. We are not proud of it, I for one isn’t proud of it, but sometimes it seems as the safest option because the truth can destroy as much as it can build.


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmaEPpThJxyJzx9KXyE57FwWJ8CV35ptzKM9zydsizE5HV/31433.png 

  
In life, we can notice in our surroundings that everyone has told a white lie at least once in life. What is a white lie? Well, it is very simple to understand it's like when a person who lies to avoid hurting someone or they want to avoid some bad situations. It is considered harmless, but I don't think the same way, I feel it's complicated depending on the situation.

I won't say that I have never lied before, but I won't address it as a white lie. Because a lie is a lie, why would I try to justify it by naming it \

? I'm mature enough to take the accountability of my actions. I would call it white lies if it was a lie told to the teacher about homework, or lying about eating a chocolate secretly, or making a birthday suprise or anniversary surprise.

So, lying for these kinds of stuffs are not going to hurt someone or it's nothing unforgivable in fact people like these kinds of lies as the intentions are pure. So, I won't lie to protect people I care about. Like they need to know the truth anyhow. If after some time they learn the truth from someone else, then they will lose faith in me, and if I repeat it at some point, they will not trust me again.

Well, intention matters a lot, but that doesn't mean if an outfit is making someone look pale, we shouldn't inform them. Like I want someone to guide if my outfit was not suitable for me. I would take the feedback and observe myself, and if I feel he/she was right, then I would change. So, our bond feels more understandable. I know truths can be very painful, but we should never lie.

A white lie is something I believe should be used to give surprises or to joke around but not to hide something from someone. So long ago, one of my friends had shown her art to me, and instead of calling it perfect, I gave her a few compliments and advice so that she could make her art better. Why would I lie to make her feel better? I was not way too direct with my opinion. I did not want to discourage her. She needed an honest review with kindness, not fake reaction. I thought her as my true friend and wanted to see her successfully become an artist, that's why I do not support such lies.

Well even after telling the white lie for a moment a person should know the bitter truth after the situation no matter how hard it is to tell. Maybe in that situation it is not right to say because the other person might does not capable of accepting the situation. But when things go normal and after the moment you should tell the truth no matter whatever it is, or how bad it is to accept or to say. I genuinely believe that rather then giving a fake hope by a white lie is better to say the bitter truth even though it hurts.


Some believe that honesty must always prevail above all other considerations. They argue that telling the truth to people is the most respectful and mature response. However, although I agree with this perspective somewhat, I also feel that there is a fine line between being honest and being brutal. We can be truthful but considerate towards a person's feelings at the same time.

Maybe you told a friend their cooking tasted delicious even though it didn't, or perhaps you claimed you were busy to avoid making someone feel bad. These fibs are called white lies. They are generally small, harmless fibs told with good intentions. However, some people feel that you should always be honest regardless, while others believe white lies aren't really harmful at all. In my opinion, white lies can sometimes be appropriate, but they need to be handled very carefully and with care.

Thank you for stopping by my blog

description.title: Wycieczka na rzepaki
description.body:
Ależ to była przejażdżka! 

Idealne wykorzystanie wolnego piątku. Świetne odreagowanie od mówienia, narracji, opowiadania, poruszania gdańskich tematów. Na rowerze planowanie trasy jest specyficzne. Prawie zawsze zdarza się improwizacja. 

Relacji z tej wycieczki prowadzonej na żywo, możecie też posłuchać pod tym adresem. Zapraszam.

Wstępny plan zakładał drogę na zachód. Na oku miałem wieś Warzno, jezioro Tuchomskie oraz lasy Gdyni. Do dyspozycji miałem mój zwykły, stary rower. elektryk w reklamacji no i służy bardziej do zarabiania. Co z tego wyszło?

Na początek droga przez las z Oliwy do Owczarni. To przedłużenie ulicy Kościerskiej. Spotyka się też nazwę Dolina Czystej Wody, Dolina Świeżej Wody, Dolina Ewy - nazwy te średnio się przyjęły bo są kalkami niemieckimi w lesie, który znacznie różni się od tego sprzed stu lat. 

Dla mnie to jest rowerowa autostrada na Kaszuby. Wymagająca bo cały czas pod górę z najtrudniejszym fragmentem na końcu lasu. Na Stravie widzę, że oznaczono ten odcinek jako podjazd 4 kategorii. 98 metrów przewyższenia na odległości 3 km. Jechałem sprawnie i według rejestratorów i stravy w wielkim wyścigu moich przejazdów tą trasą zająłbym 4 miejsce.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/racibo/23uFHTnBxUqfvWtvg7f4jDxkhEx4uv5Eg1qxzw85Tkgw8c8rDHyVfpn8Xu379fBfUHpcx.png)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/racibo/23zbAvryLByRuk6crKr12wTWk14CKGaqQruRKBoL927tDZBq1DH85Jnpy3wtnxyx3mk7U.png)


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/racibo/242DDux5m7fZ4kXSxWKe7Wbem6FtMNdYTXRfH3hZsVJsB75mGuCFLFbtNWgLKioNFJzaB.png)

Pierwsze osiedle/wieś to była Owczarnia (dawniej Schaferei). Nie byłem tu parę lat także spodziewałem się nowych osiedli. Jednak tego nie było. Nadal spokój, nadal stadnina po lewej. Osiedle to składa się z kilku domów odciętych nieco od dzielnicy Osowa obwodnicą. Przed wojną była to polska wieś graniczna z Wolnym Miastem Gdańskiej (mapa z granicą wyżej)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/racibo/23x1BcRXcbVr6sSAN7yBkH9n8941FCuKF218wW1pPYXmy76xdXHCiHZhaoDoZyxKi36H2.png)
*Jechałem trasą która na mapie łączy Schaferei i miasto po lewej*

Następnie przejazd przez Nowy Świat (część Osowej). Tu już się sporo zmieniło. Rozwój widać, nowe hale, nowe przedsiębiorstwa. Kiedyś była tu głównie przesypownia.
*Nowy Świat - część Osowy w Gdańsku*

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/racibo/AKGa1FJ95DwHtuR8ZESBqDZ6zKCtbSsjoSARp7cJyNXqWk6i17f9jk8EKTdoDSi.png)


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/racibo/23tmmN8ti1UWJEuEtpKJTC3CHYT7V3qL2Ht2fRVVREHBYioiSyuLJsVq3CHZLkVvyNsk4.png)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/racibo/2432BmD4D1a5ojtH4tXrEE3DkVjv8iZp6m4rFGTGFZ5zHqRTvRXR7C7UWtpnJQHPFHdsq.png)

Pierwszy postój zrobiłem sobie tuż za granicami Gdańska. Zachodnia część miasta leży na Pojezierzu Kaszubskim i to tu właśnie czuć. Jezioro Wysockie. Latem robi się z niego kąpielisko. 

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/racibo/23uQk45DQmEYAyJ7ASKURc3agHQ4WjQT24Xwgd7JgrEKkeQ4FY4EtT7nLfz5mno1eKeXH.png)

W końcu zaczął się las. Las wyjątkowy i zupełnie inny od tego przez który jechałem do Owczarni. Płaski, świerkowy, z trawą na dole. 

Za Obwodnicą Metropolitalną (nowość) zaczęły się rzepaki. Tego roku widziałem je jedynie z pociągu. W czasie majówki jeszcze ich nie było. Pojawiły się dopiero w drugiej połowie maja.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/racibo/23zGZvEYjvFgbWwehFhu5EvTQMd13xqGRzN2wovgbX4p3rKQDqscVM1YNKc498ysBf9N1.png)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/racibo/243BbptXcQE2CExqMRhssh9wR1czrSHnSerNRSqiRyvZwokHFKJTVYA4Bh8irJXmPv4NC.png)

Przejazd przez wieś Tuchom to była w końcu wieś. Właśnie po to jechałem na zachód. Było dość kaszubsko, w zagrodach było też sporo koni. Kusiły też miody do kupienia. Nad jeziorem Tuchomskim kusiły za to lody w Dworze Oleńka. Płoty mnie jednak przestraszyły. Pojechałem szukać dzikiego brzegu. Nie znalazłem go, ale nie przykładałem się do poszukiwań. 

Piknik zrobiłem przy płocie już za znakiem wsi Warzno. Widok mi pasował, słońce też, słychać było żurawie (sprawdziłem w aplikacji). Widok był taki:

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/racibo/245mq1uhTWq8S4ecG2NTgrN5SvdJWDtzRYn3J9YTqErgcunUiXoC8bbudyoowxjxiyjWy.png)

Teraz przede mną była trudna decyzja którędy wracać. Pojechałem na północ do Dobrzewina. Ta wieś okazała się olbrzymia obszarowo, choć realnie niewielka. Byłem też na Syberii (część tej wsi się tak nazywa). Niosło mnie tam gdzie najładniej.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/racibo/242hQRM16HPLLYeEc815EAsWXH3hknS1L9cdmYnMVfTZi9rtTSNnocaosM2cxGgeqYoy6.png)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/racibo/245cUQcNUh47dkHjWhc22qqkvGjtNSVCNLBgiquD3AExgKCWS89bKpq7wjThdDuh9wBJr.png)
*Widok z miejsca na północ od jeziora Tuchomskiego*

Powrót był już dość przełajowy. Rowerem da się jechać przez łąkę. W Borocu zakoczyła mnie pełnoprawna droga rowerowa.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/racibo/2458FuSeDttMf7dg2KHGUG9GnoQC2Dj1XZMzS4spX9Rc24bPfXo4JgojyxHnaGLuH3hy7.png)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/racibo/23wMUMu8pEMwckYi2GQRd3EuAEdaq8S83u4zFyC7cV1Z3RtVCE22JRkms9Vzy5iP3HHwW.png)

Na koniec historia na Michaiła, który kiedyś skomentował moje zdjęcie przedstawiające ten krzyż:

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/racibo/23zGaVY2p2npWbaUqZfFnRrS5gANW49NLk43QgBKzQ2C8aFNEKDMLjEMgyTUuddKcKZGB.png)

To miejsce gdzie zginął jego dziadek w 1945. Szukał jego grobu i trochę się w to zaangażowałem. Dziadek ów został pochowany w pobliskim Głodowie na cmentarzu wojskowym.

Wycieczka genialna, regenerująca. Polecam

description.title: A white lie or lie of hypocrite?
description.body: <div class=\

>

Since our childhood time our elders always inspire us to tell the truth all the time and not to tell lies. Lying is a sin and it was never encouraged by anyone but almost all of us tell lies for various reasons. Sometimes we do it to protect ourselves and sometimes we do it for selfish reasons and sometimes it can be done considering something good in return. A lie is indeed a lie and there is also one kind of lie that is being told for the overall good and we tell acknowledge it as a white lie. Suppose our mother told us to eat food otherwise ghosts would come and it was a white lie as it was done for good of us and to eat well and healthily. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdsyevEYo5gTuGcojQEEmqSTDVa1zNH2a5uEeyJpUmnFf/image.png) If there are no negative consequences of a lie or little negative consequences for greater benefit of a lie we consider it as a white lie. Sometimes we do it intentionally and sometimes it can be unintentional. Is it a good thing? Do you think that telling a white lie is acceptable? If it’s acceptable, then who is the determiner of that a lie is a white lie? Is it an easy thing to determine? In my opinion if there is guarantee that a lie has no negative consequences or little negative but acceptable consequences it can be considered as a good life or white lie, but it should have good consequences at the end in long run. It’s unfortunate that in very few cases anyone can guarantee there will be no negative consequences of a lie. Most of the so-called white lies are actually the thought of the person who is telling the lie. The person just finds an excuse to cover the biased opinion of the person by marking it as white lie. I believe that in only few cases there is the existence of white lies and the other so called white lies are just the lies told by hypocrites. You must be thinking why I used the word hypocrites. It’s because it’s why they think good for others but in reality, it’s not necessarily true. I have seen many situations where parents tell lies to the children, considering it white life, but it actually destroyed the good future of their children. So, those parents were hypocrites and ended up harming their children. In my case I am someone who doesn’t need to lie usually because I don’t care about the opinion of others and I am not accountable to give answer to anyone about my actions unless it’s reasonable. I just can avoid anyone and if a truth hurts anyone, I don’t hesitate to tell it as I feel that harsh truth is quite good. The people who know me and care about me will understand it well and if anyone is not ready to accept it, they are allowed to go out from my life. Getting out of my life won’t make any huge difference in my life as I know myself well. I think unless it was for fun purpose I didn’t tell a lie in recent days and I can’t remember any of it when I told lies let alone white lies. Even if I told lies I wouldn’t tag it as a white lie either.

description.title: The Name They Called First When the Office Was on Fire
description.body:
I believe  that the part that one hardly talks about is that no one plans to betray anyone. It is a process that happens gradually. It is just like borrowing a man something, and he has failed to return those things until you look around and realize that you have borrowed him something that cannot be given back. Yeah, that is what I mean. I have seen this happen to someone who is very close to me who worked at one of these big firms in Lagos. He was a very kind man who loved to fix problems without anyone noticing. The company he worked for, when their account went wrong, he was the one who stayed late to make sure everything went back to normal even though nobody wanted to touch it. His boss liked him. Or that was what he thought. When some of the company's clients wanted to stop working with them, someone had to to fill in the shoes, and that was how that man's name appeared on the official report of the person who mismanaged timelines. The same MD who once said everyone should look up to him and also call him brother every time they meet. This man just went quiet for days and refuses to shout. I believe that silence was him processing a lot of things he never expected from people he was loyal to. Because those people shouting his name when things were going well were the same people who pulled the string to make him fall. There is always this particular kind of sorrow that comes with being thrown under the bus, especially from people who we trusted and put our hope in. And it is something different from when Strongers does it. That injury usually takes time to heal. And watching this man rebuild slowly and never back down taught me that I should not let someone's power define my name. And this was how this man in question survived. ![253920.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenproject/253920.png) --- Thank you for reading. >

description.title: The little things are so big—that's what I want to hold on to
description.body: <div class=\

>

![Banner horizontal sobre hostal boutique vintage rojo y beige_20260530_142851_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jemima1996/48JAWtUx2BaBx2EAhV4yxmLzXdoPckTeAWb5bEmT3pgYFiWJjbDJBDtBHfgjyDmipi.jpg) There are a ton of stimuli all around us that, honestly, make it super easy for us to get things—especially that false sense that we’re doing fine and don’t need to try any harder. There’s an overwhelming amount of information, and somehow we’ve also been convinced that the more material things we have, the happier we’ll be and the fewer needs we’ll have. But the truth is, when we really think about it, having a lot usually just causes us to lose focus on what’s important. So this would be my answer to question number 3: for me, it’s absolutely essential to live a simple life. Why? Because I know from experience—because I’ve lived it—that not having a simple life is a massive distraction, a distraction from the things that are essential and that I know do me a world of good. ![IMG_20260530_134543.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jemima1996/23wMVzwd6pnjxN9XvSUqDMNRL2ahLjYrekg3eEsFdhVzKgc1Xiw29yKzyiRNGgnCXQYNm.jpg) For example, I could easily focus on making more and more money so I can buy the latest things, stay up to date, and get the things that influencers promote so intensely. And in the end, what would be the point? It would be a vicious cycle that would never end in my mind and that would leave me completely exhausted—and not just exhausted, but wondering, “What’s the point of all this?” On the other hand, being able to live a simple life and knowing how to appreciate it has taught me to notice the little things—those things that I feel are the ones I’ll remember and be grateful for with affection when I die. For example, having strived so hard to ensure that my relationships with others are truly deep—not just about hanging out for a bit and taking a photo, but about having people with whom I can have conversations, even uncomfortable ones, about life and what each of us needs to improve. ![IMG_20260530_134632.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jemima1996/23xAVKMcrNgmpUjS8xPULWFG1KCyTMF2a3UJhCZFfn2zj6Lb8qdiNdgTgQiWaF7iesHWZ.jpg) When you focus on spiritual things rather than material things, you naturally feel that desire not to want so much, but only what you need. How does this relate to fulfillment? Well, the truth is that when we do what we were created to do as human beings, we inevitably feel happy. The more stimuli there are and the more we fall for them because society teaches us that we must acquire things, the less fulfilled we feel. Instead, we experience this insatiable desire for more and more and more things. For me, feeling content or fulfilled is the same as being satisfied with the things I have and with what I’ve achieved. And this doesn’t mean I don’t have bad days when I feel a little down and wish I’d achieved more—no—but when those feelings fade, what remains is a sense of gratitude for having done what I did, for having lived my life the way I have so far. Even without as many material possessions as other people, I feel that I have the most important things clearly in mind. ![IMG_20260530_134711.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jemima1996/23vsE9YSnm5goJf2uHTPZkrjSZtLxhFcrMzbDPM6qezdhA6PyuuMx7xvrozhs95bMb9Z5.jpg) Starting with the fact that I don’t want to please a bunch of people who don’t even know what they want, because every day they want something new. I simply hold on to my desire to improve every day and to know that the meaning of life is much more than just having a few material things. So, I feel that the simple life I lead is completely connected to this sense of being satisfied and grateful. Because I feel that, in order to be fulfilled, one must also be light. And being light means not having a bunch of things weighing you down, whether they’re material possessions or even the mental burdens we all honestly carry. So, here I am, trying with all my might to be light so that I can also be fulfilled.

![Banner Horizontal Minimalista Joyería (400 x 150 px)_20241205_220827_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jemima1996/242DZCJkjqsqAFYiumZQQ3ztrn1pMQZK9AWwd8kja6ekrSknbNMVppTN8UJPK4LPCP7rg.png) -Content entirely of my authorship and inspiration. -Original text in Spanish, translated at DeepL. -Personal photographs, taken with my Huawei p30 Lite Phone. -Banners designed in Canva Pro.

description.body: <div class=\

> Hello splinterlands family. Participating in Guild Brawl in Splinterlands and earning Merits from it has always been one of the most exciting experiences. I have been playing Brawl regularly for quite some time and trying to accumulate some Merits in various ways. Finally, a total of 9,858 Merits were accumulated in my account. For a long time, I was thinking of saving these Merits and buying some Gladius cases or packs from the Guild Store at once. Today, the day finally came when I decided to buy 4 Gladius cases, and at the same time, collect some Blood Stones and Power Stones to improve the quality of the cards. This whole process and the excitement that was working in my mind while opening the packs were really different. Through today's writing, I am sharing my wonderful experience with you step by step. My first goal after entering the Guild Store was to buy a Gladius case. We all know that the price of a Gladius case is 2,000 Merits. Since I had 9,858 Merits, I decided to buy 4 packs. A total of 8,000 Meritswase is needed for the 4 packs. As I selected 4 on the screen and prepared to buy, I was filled with joy and curiosity as to what kind of cards I would end up getting from these packs. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV4JfZDU54v9zSn2Pg8uWPew5kz67UpHWikCXuvgwuKMr/1780165657563.jpg) After purchasing 4 packs using Merits, I had 1,858 Merits left in my account. Before opening the Gladius cases directly, I thought it would be a good idea to not miss the opportunity to improve the quality of the cards. So I decided to use the remaining Merits to buy some stones. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRbaNdxctEoh4m75vPNJhinzuwZqEP1GzfK7dVFt2Hk6x/1780165615053.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbcPrFaGQXvtMD7qk1XNDa5sARpHqjPTM8uk3TFibszgk/1780165615103.jpg) Blood Stones are available in the Guild Store, which doubles the chance of getting Gladiator Legendary cards. From my remaining 1,858 Merits, I first selected 15 Blood Stones to buy. Since our Guild Lodge had a 10% discount, I got these 15 Blood Stones for 810 Merits. This increased my chances of getting a Legendary card a little. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcbhXByNqpFco2mwW2ZWHjCxJX8arqUJApgedkQhAgMDH/1780165601819.jpg) After buying the Blood Stones, I had 1,048 Merits left. This time, I decided to use the remaining Merits to buy Power Stones, which helps double my chances of getting a Gold Foil card. With the discount, the price of 14 Power Stones came to 1,008 Merits. I bought them immediately, so that I could get the maximum benefit during my opening. Now I had the necessary stones and 4 Gladius cases ready. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQtiVorPCD5dR4BPQhZ2sSVtMNUA6m7Q6yb9hWoNY7cyV/1780165590988.jpg) After all the preparations, the real thrill came. When I entered the pack opening screen, I saw five cards lying face down in front of me. At this point, my heart rate increases a bit, because behind each card there may be a powerful gladiator card that can help a lot in the next brawls. This moment before opening the cards was really great. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXfajZ35F4nvEDyUZwruHSbDzfCWobXmVdoDryQY6wD5n/1780165580713.jpg) As soon as I opened the first pack, a big surprise awaited me. As soon as I turned over the first card, I saw a gold foil card! The card was the 2-manor Helmet Kharafax, which was added to my collection directly at level 3. Gladiator cards are already very effective, and getting gold foil on top of them is really a joy. By getting this one card, my entire effort to buy the pack today felt like a success. In addition, in this first pack, I also got Crash Wonderford, the rare Alfredo, Chimney Wallstop, and Ysgald Vorst. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcfrTeJA6Z2gMK4fZ946XqD5nn3tzuZPL6jWbMSoWqEZ5/1780165567795.jpg) The gold frame of the Helmet Kharafax card looked amazing because it was gold foil. I hope its stats and design will contribute a lot to the gameplay. Below I have shared a close-up picture of this wonderful card, which was the main attraction of today's opening. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcPqTNkXQmQhVByx3Vk7pZ924TLLj5dbGoQTwBzbULuUi/1780165558424.jpg) After this incredible joy of the first pack, I decided to open the second pack with great enthusiasm. Although there were no gold foils or legendary cards in the second pack, I found several useful cards that would enrich my deck. This pack contained Alva the Crusher, Bertrol Gibson, Catrelba Gibson, Chimney Wallstop and the rare category Relenor Cleaver. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWZCDLipPXUv53zSFBTztgqsyx9BxU8q7Wp7cFBZTqHB9/1780165544777.jpg) Then I proceeded to open the third pack. After opening this pack, I found that it contained Alva the Crusher, the rare category Relenor Cleaver, another rare card Cotripus Bane, Witch of Warwick and Catrelba Gibson. Getting two rare cards in the same pack was also a great achievement. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQvPM7cNjCnh6DrE1aPe9gkqhwoDxTu49kDPZBgE65iKL/1780165533815.jpg) Finally, I opened my fourth and final pack. In this last pack, in addition to the regular edition Helmet Kharafax card, I also got Bertrol Gibson, the rare category Ajax Lightfoot, the rare category Liza Fox and Catrelba Gibson. The pack opening session ended quite satisfactorily with the two rare cards in the last pack as well. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVk4RDyGbxqjXAFv4SJKmh5s8M7rDkbGAjYu4L6suaBqM/1780165521974.jpg) Overall, the experience of buying and opening the 4 guild packs or Gladius cases today was a great one for me. My Gladiator card collection is now stronger than ever, with a gold foil card and a few useful rare cards. I hope to use these new cards to bring good results for our guild in the upcoming brawls. It's the little moments like these in Splinterlands that make the game so much more enjoyable. Be sure to share your recent pack-opening experience. description.body:
# Coefficient of performance

**Source:** https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coefficient_of_performance

The coefficient of performance or COP (sometimes CP or CoP) of a heat pump, refrigerator or air conditioning system is a ratio of the useful heating or cooling provided to the work (energy) required.[1][2] Higher COPs equate to higher efficiency, lower energy (power) consumption and thus lower operating costs.
Instead of converting work to heat (which has a maximum efficiency of 100% and a COP less than or equal to one), heat pumps, air conditioners and refrigeration systems use work to move existing heat from one place to another. Less work is required to move heat than to generate heat. Usually, more heat is moved than the amount of work put in so the COP usually exceeds 1, especially in heat pumps. Most air conditioners have a COP of 3.5 to 5.[3]
While the coefficient of performance is a term commonly used with heat pumps, it is also applicable to any energy system that behaves in a thermodynamically open manner, receiving energy from the local environment, whether it be electromagnetic, electrostatic, or any other viable form.[1]
A difference between the dimensionless terms efficiency and COP is that the numerator in COP is the heat moved or generated, in contrast to the numerator in efficiency being only the heat generated. Additionally, efficiency cannot be used to evaluate the ability of a device to cool, because the useful output energy is undefined in this case.
As an example, if a heat pump has an internal compressor efficiency of 70% and the user supplies 1.2 kW of power to run the unit and 6.5 kW is drawn from the local thermal environment, then COP is 6.5/1.2 ≈ 5.417. The efficiency is already taken into account in the 6.5 kW; if the compressor efficiency is higher, it is expected to be higher than 6.5 kW (more heat moved) for the same input power.
The COP is highly dependent on operating conditions, especially absolute temperature and relative temperature between sink and system, and is often graphed or averaged against expected conditions.[4] 
Performance of absorption refrigerator chillers is typically much lower, as they are not heat pumps relying on compression, but instead rely on chemical reactions driven by heat.[5]

where

The COP for heating and cooling are different because the heat reservoir of interest is different. When one is interested in how well a machine cools, the COP is the ratio of the heat taken up from the cold reservoir to input work. However, for heating, the COP is the ratio of the magnitude of the heat given off to the hot reservoir (which is the heat taken up from the cold reservoir plus the input work) to the input work:

![Image 2](https://wikimedia.org/api/rest_v1/media/math/render/svg/30bf313607b8a1a632422445f7ee778c8e0a9e5e)

where

Note that the COP of a heat pump depends on its direction. The heat rejected to the hot sink is greater than the heat absorbed from the cold source, so the heating COP is greater by one than the cooling COP.

![Image 3](https://wikimedia.org/api/rest_v1/media/math/render/svg/0fac2c7057575d2ac57196c7a7cbf3f0c6afe61c)

Theoretical performance limits[edit]
According to the first law of thermodynamics, after a full cycle of the process  and thus .
Since , we obtain

For a heat pump operating at maximum theoretical efficiency (i.e. Carnot efficiency), it can be shown[7][6] that 

![Image 4](https://wikimedia.org/api/rest_v1/media/math/render/svg/13dae3333f2a0925a72532ed1dd844bc91261734)

   and thus   
where  and  are the thermodynamic temperatures of the hot and cold heat reservoirs, respectively.
At maximum theoretical efficiency, therefore

which is equal to the reciprocal of the thermal efficiency of an ideal heat engine, because a heat pump is a heat engine operating in reverse.[8]
Similarly, the COP of a refrigerator or air conditioner operating at maximum theoretical efficiency,

![Image 5](https://wikimedia.org/api/rest_v1/media/math/render/svg/d9b933b507e5ff1a1faad74740d4241fb31de1f1)

 applies to heat pumps and  applies to air conditioners and refrigerators. 
Measured values for actual systems will always be significantly less than these theoretical maxima.
In Europe, the standard test conditions for ground source heat pump units use 308 K (35 °C; 95 °F) for  and 273 K (0 °C; 32 °F) for . According to the above formula, the maximum theoretical COPs would be

Test results of the best systems are around 4.5. When measuring installed units over a whole season and accounting for the energy needed to pump water through the piping systems, seasonal COP's for heating are around 3.5 or less. This indicates room for further improvement.
The EU standard test conditions for an air source heat pump is at dry-bulb temperature of 20 °C (68 °F) for  and 7 °C (44.6 °F) for .[9] Given sub-zero European winter temperatures, real world heating performance is significantly poorer than such standard COP figures imply.

![Image 6](https://wikimedia.org/api/rest_v1/media/math/render/svg/42bc8a07f7c57074d713f4f1d42f62fbe6d94fd3)

As the formula shows, the COP of a heat pump system can be improved by reducing the temperature gap  at which the system works. For a heating system this would mean two things:

Reducing the output temperature to around 30 °C (86 °F) which requires piped floor, wall or ceiling heating, or oversized water to air heaters.
Increasing the input temperature (e.g. by using an oversized ground source or by access to a solar-assisted thermal bank[10]).
Accurately determining thermal conductivity will allow for much more precise ground loop[11] or borehole sizing,[12] resulting in higher return temperatures and a more efficient system.  For an air cooler, the COP could be improved by using ground water as an input instead of air, and by reducing the temperature drop on the output side by increasing the air flow. For both systems, also increasing the size of pipes and air canals would help to reduce noise and the energy consumption of pumps (and ventilators) by decreasing the speed of the fluid, which in turn lowers the Reynolds number and hence the turbulence (and noise) and the head loss (see hydraulic head). The heat pump itself can be improved by increasing the size of the internal heat exchangers, which in turn increases the efficiency (and the cost) relative to the power of the compressor, and also by reducing the system's internal temperature gap over the compressor. Obviously, this latter measure makes some heat pumps unsuitable to produce high temperatures, which means that a separate machine is needed for producing, e.g., hot tap water.
The COP of absorption chillers can be improved by adding a second or third stage. Double and triple effect chillers are significantly more efficient than single effect chillers, and can surpass a COP of 1. They require higher pressure and higher temperature steam, but this is still a relatively small 10 pounds of steam per hour per ton of cooling.[13]

![Image 7](https://wikimedia.org/api/rest_v1/media/math/render/svg/27aab22b67f3f7b9d5240600003c80d3fc4c67d0)

Seasonal efficiency[edit]
A realistic indication of energy efficiency over an entire year can be achieved by using seasonal COP or seasonal coefficient of performance (SCOP) for heat. Seasonal energy efficiency ratio (SEER) is mostly used for air conditioning. SCOP is a new methodology which gives a better indication of expected real-life performance of heat pump technology. [14]

> Me rompe el corazón que te sientas así y entiendo perfectamente lo que puede ocasionar la incertidumbre del desempleo y más cuando alguien depende de ti. Porque ese empleo representa el ingreso que necesitas para sentir seguridad, estabilidad y la tranquilidad de poder proveer a tu hijo. No tengo las respuestas del porqué no se te ha dado aún, pero sé que aunque a veces te quiebres, sigues siendo un roble que no pierde la fe. Nada en esta vida es eterno, ni siquiera el sufrimiento, así que estoy segura de que más temprano que tarde, volverás a respirar sin agonía. Y llora todo lo que necesites, esas lágrimas sacan de ti el dolor, la tristeza y la desesperación... es mejor que guardarse todo adentro. No te rindas nunca, no se sabe si una de esas llaves sin probar, es la que abre a puerta a lo que tanto deseas. Te envío un gran abrazo, esperando que te toque aunque sea un poquito.

> It breaks my heart that you feel this way, and I fully understand what the uncertainty of unemployment can do to you—especially when someone depends on you. Because that job represents the income you need to feel secure, stable, and at peace knowing you can provide for your child. I don’t have the answers as to why you haven’t been given that job yet, but I know that even when you feel like you’re breaking, you’re still an oak tree that never loses faith. Nothing in this life is eternal, not even suffering, so I’m sure that sooner rather than later, you’ll be able to breathe again without agony. And cry as much as you need to—those tears release the pain, sadness, and despair from you… it’s better than keeping it all bottled up inside. Never give up; you never know if one of those untried keys is the one that opens the door to what you desire so much. I’m sending you a big hug, hoping it touches you even just a little. ***

description.title: The Little Beauty of the Afternoon from Lhoknga Seaside Park
description.body:
----
Aceh never runs out of natural charm and one of the real proofs is the existence of the Lhoknga Seaside Park which is located in Mon Ikeun village, Lhoknga District, Aceh Besar Regency.
----

![IMG-20260531-WA0003.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTNeTkN84nUk9bbcQRnU2RoDaYRXaZkvvbP94U2y93K3y/IMG-20260531-WA0003.jpg)

<div class=\

>

Hello, all my friends in the #Worldmappin community. I hope you are all healthy and happy, allowing you to go about your daily activities as usual. I hope you all have a wonderful day.

In this blog, I want to share one of the tourist destinations in Mon Ikeun Village, Lhoknga District, Aceh Besar Regency.
When it comes to Aceh's natural charm, its natural beauty is unmatched. One clear example of this is the Lhoknga Seaside Park, which I visited and shared some photos of in this blog.

So, please continue to follow my blog to explore this place and see it in my short articles.

![IMG-20260530-WA0223.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPRv7htMC7Eo3ZFU8wyW5HdSRuUut9qdm1PQLrDCLbosS/IMG-20260530-WA0223.jpg)

![IMG-20260530-WA0222.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTvMsFzBXgounaRiGLN3gATsq8VzZo99yZL1n7b83rppM/IMG-20260530-WA0222.jpg)

![IMG-20260530-WA0221.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbA6EiaJ9sQgeG7WkQfUUHzCJarSqo4YNDRqVqx4TC4SN/IMG-20260530-WA0221.jpg)

![IMG-20260530-WA0218.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmae4mQbdRM1oTQTbiPRG3i9h5hDd9osiPy9UjeXcqe6ug/IMG-20260530-WA0218.jpg)

![IMG-20260530-WA0220.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmef8r41xgFf47i5GJtUdzyNWHYuyUvSHpy9mhQDnBH9MM/IMG-20260530-WA0220.jpg)

![IMG-20260530-WA0219.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmT3pk9DbtYnwigbFLzBr9WvyARBYaqUmQr7fyU1KbifDs/IMG-20260530-WA0219.jpg)

![IMG-20260530-WA0217.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTvEvkUgo2LTXc5pg7s1PAseEPDSrsCa7EEKX4gxgSoMj/IMG-20260530-WA0217.jpg)

Time seems to slow down, giving everyone the opportunity to savor every moment and its beauty.
For anyone seeking serenity, beauty, and peace, Lhoknga Seaside Park is a destination not to be missed. That's all I can say about the place I'm sharing in this blog.

My friends...
While on vacation last weekend in Banda Aceh, one tourist destination caught my attention. I stopped by and enjoyed the area's atmosphere. The combination of serenity, beauty, and peace left me in awe, and I highly recommend this destination. Furthermore, its strategic location is also an added advantage.

I personally caught a glimpse of the place and knew of its existence while traveling due to the advertising banners posted along the road about 1 km before arriving. Above are some of the photos I took during that time.

![IMG-20260530-WA0225.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWvsXqWnDuxW75TS7E3pCPeR5DaxDNRivhxpK5cwiTK7p/IMG-20260530-WA0225.jpg)

![IMG-20260530-WA0227.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWz3GnkT44c6J4jMnFenUb6482sUSu9S9xDkYmC52saxr/IMG-20260530-WA0227.jpg)

![IMG-20260530-WA0226.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeAWbWZbcVCiHW5BkzfwqT5UiaszuH8RkVzPVzGCfx3n2/IMG-20260530-WA0226.jpg)

Upon arriving at the main attraction, Lhoknga Seaside Park, I immediately thought about the motorcycles on the side of the road.

My friends...
Despite being located on the main road, Lhoknga Seaside Park still offers extraordinary tranquility and beauty. It's no wonder this destination is frequently visited by motorists, especially those passing through this area due to its strategic location.

![IMG-20260530-WA0230.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmV1qLRcvHEXxxpq8YaoE9MmaAEd28mWsWQ9thnCR7biaZ/IMG-20260530-WA0230.jpg)

![IMG-20260530-WA0235.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbX6dBRjeaeFtLS9kaocKdkBMU7bbX5B8zb8TYCr9CDHh/IMG-20260530-WA0235.jpg)

![IMG-20260530-WA0232.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUcwuDsRHHyKSPC6Zj4h1wsFeebMEFVKaV1Shsm38CrCo/IMG-20260530-WA0232.jpg)

![IMG-20260530-WA0240.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTK8sUwyJzsZa2EU6W7FKnPf3DnXzMu5UDi81TjQTUEG2/IMG-20260530-WA0240.jpg)

![IMG-20260530-WA0233.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYByGqjD7rigmUQETBCneFTmnFcnp5wsYUr9sxrSuRgqy/IMG-20260530-WA0233.jpg)

Upon arriving at the main point of the Lhoknga Seaside Park area, I was immediately captivated by the eye-catching ocean view, with the expansive blue sea seemingly merging with the sky, creating a calming gradation of colors.

My friends...
The atmosphere offered here is ideal for spending time with family or friends while enjoying the pristine natural beauty. It's no wonder this park is a favorite spot for many visitors to picnic, chat, or simply laze under the shade of the trees. As I mentioned above, one of the park's main attractions is its strategic location and easy access from Banda Aceh City.

![IMG-20260530-WA0236(1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZo2usAz9KBoB5UQpzQb9wxZCTiVS3WaVyJ8ah1GxEev7/IMG-20260530-WA0236(1).jpg)

![IMG-20260530-WA0236.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZo2usAz9KBoB5UQpzQb9wxZCTiVS3WaVyJ8ah1GxEev7/IMG-20260530-WA0236.jpg)

![IMG-20260530-WA0234.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNS6e49LUQFWPrkGAQY5t6iWtWBGoTGqrKwK4Fvk5dSLK/IMG-20260530-WA0234.jpg)

![IMG-20260530-WA0231.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWKYEDA6z1SG7j4ioYMRTDDjvxFkoi8Bykr83P3QsWdGy/IMG-20260530-WA0231.jpg)

On the edge of this beach, rocks have been installed which are arranged very neatly to protect the Highway Current, also besides that in this beach area the big waves that hit the rocks on the edge of the beach produce a distinctive sound so that it creates a natural Symphony that soothes the heart and mind, not only that, the crashing of the waves also adds aesthetics to the natural scenery around the Park in my personal opinion.

![IMG-20260530-WA0238.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSSnG6nF21MZVkEhn6H2Jrkgz99Hj5bzaYmvzNYt7ji8V/IMG-20260530-WA0238.jpg)

![IMG-20260530-WA0239.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdgqAF4tBC1tPxs2F7ibgmYGAg8c41GMFeNQNqbLT3hjp/IMG-20260530-WA0239.jpg)

These are some of the images I've shared about one of the tourist destinations in Aceh Besar Regency. I hope you all enjoy and are entertained by what I've shared. I also extend my deepest gratitude to all of you who have taken the time to view and read my blog to the end.

Please leave your comments, support, and input, which means a lot to me so I can make this blog even better in the future.

That's all for now.
Greetings everyone.
See you in my next blog

**Source:** https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Root_mean_square

Given a set , its RMS is denoted as either  or . The RMS is also known as the quadratic mean (denoted ),[2][3] a special case of the generalized mean. The RMS of a continuous function is denoted  and can be defined in terms of an integral of the square of the function.
In estimation theory, the root-mean-square deviation of an estimator measures how far the estimator strays from the data.

The RMS value of a set of values (or a continuous-time waveform) is the square root of the arithmetic mean of the squares of the values, or the square of the function that defines the continuous waveform. 
In the case of a set of n values , the RMS is

The corresponding formula for a continuous function (or waveform) f(t) defined over the interval  is

and the RMS for a function over all time is

The RMS over all time of a periodic function is equal to the RMS of one period of the function. The RMS value of a continuous function or signal can be approximated by taking the RMS of a sample consisting of equally spaced observations. Additionally, the RMS value of various waveforms can also be determined without calculus, as shown by Cartwright.[4]
In the case of the RMS statistic of a random process, the expected value is used instead of the mean.

In electrical engineering[edit]

The RMS of an alternating electric current equals the value of constant direct current that would dissipate the same power in a resistive load.[1]

![Image 5](https://wikimedia.org/api/rest_v1/media/math/render/svg/e151fd454540fc1476cf6dd41b0b2a666a157c8a)

Average electrical power[edit]

Electrical engineers often need to know the power, P, dissipated by an electrical resistance, R. It is easy to do the calculation when there is a constant current, I, through the resistance. For a load of R ohms, power is given by:

However, if the current is a time-varying function, I(t), this formula must be extended to reflect the fact that the current (and thus the instantaneous power) is varying over time. If the function is periodic (such as household AC power), it is still meaningful to discuss the average power dissipated over time, which is calculated by taking the average power dissipation:

So, the RMS value, IRMS, of the function I(t) is the constant current that yields the same power dissipation as the time-averaged power dissipation of the current I(t).
Average power can also be found using the same method that in the case of a time-varying voltage, V(t), with RMS value VRMS,

This equation can be used for any periodic waveform, such as a sinusoidal or sawtooth waveform, allowing us to calculate the mean power delivered into a specified load.
By taking the square root of both these equations and multiplying them together, the power is found to be:

![Image 6](https://wikimedia.org/api/rest_v1/media/math/render/svg/0416a78ac28f73940431b62ab4f8fd9ee84bbfde)

Both derivations depend on voltage and current being proportional (that is, the load, R, is purely resistive). Reactive loads (that is, loads capable of not just dissipating energy but also storing it) are discussed under the topic of AC power.
In the common case of alternating current when I(t) is a sinusoidal current, as is approximately true for mains power, the RMS value is easy to calculate from the continuous case equation above. If Ip is defined to be the peak current, then:

where t is time and ω is the angular frequency (ω = 2π/T, where T is the period of the wave).
Since Ip is a positive constant and was to be squared within the integral:

Using a trigonometric identity to eliminate squaring of trig function:

but since the interval is a whole number of complete cycles (per definition of RMS), the sine terms will cancel out, leaving:

A similar analysis leads to the analogous equation for sinusoidal voltage:

![Image 7](https://wikimedia.org/api/rest_v1/media/math/render/svg/4c06917fda36301e83e166bdd3a27bf625f52031)

where IP represents the peak current and VP represents the peak voltage.
Because of their usefulness in carrying out power calculations, listed voltages for power outlets (for example, 120 V in the US, or 230 V in Europe) are almost always quoted in RMS values, and not peak values. Peak values can be calculated from RMS values from the above formula, which implies VP = VRMS × √2, assuming the source is a pure sine wave. Thus the peak value of the mains voltage in the USA is about 120 × √2, or about 170 volts. The peak-to-peak voltage, being double this, is about 340 volts. A similar calculation indicates that the peak mains voltage in Europe is about 325 volts, and the peak-to-peak mains voltage, about 650 volts.
RMS quantities such as electric current are usually calculated over one cycle. However, for some purposes the RMS current over a longer period is required when calculating transmission power losses. The same principle applies, and (for example) a current of 10 amps used for 12 hours each 24-hour day represents an average current of 5 amps, but an RMS current of 7.07 amps, in the long term.
The term RMS power is sometimes erroneously used (e.g., in the audio industry) as a synonym for mean power or average power (it is proportional to the square of the RMS voltage or RMS current in a resistive load). For a discussion of audio power measurements and their shortcomings, see Audio power.

In the physics of gas molecules, the root-mean-square speed is defined as the square root of the average squared-speed. The RMS speed of an ideal gas is calculated using the following equation:

where R represents the gas constant, 8.314 J/(mol·K), T is the temperature of the gas in kelvins, and M is the molar mass of the gas in kilograms per mole. In physics, speed is defined as the scalar magnitude of velocity. For a stationary gas, the average speed of its molecules can be in the order of thousands of km/h, even though the average velocity of its molecules is zero.

When two data sets — one set from theoretical prediction and the other from actual measurement of some physical variable, for instance — are compared, the RMS of the pairwise differences of the two data sets can serve as a measure of how far on average the error is from 0. The mean of the absolute values of the pairwise differences could be a useful measure of the variability of the differences. However, the RMS of the differences is usually the preferred measure, probably due to mathematical convention and compatibility with other formulae.

RMS is used in audio engineering to measure signal volume, particularly in the case of audio processing. The alternative volume measurement is peak volume, in analog as the signal Vpp, or in digital as the -dB peak below clipping given the encoding format. Signal RMS in this context is often used as the comparator signal for compression, which produces a \

effect in compression by responding more slowly to sharp transients like those on drums.[7] RMS is also used as a mastering metric to compare against other time average units such as LUFs.[8]

Relationship to other statistics[edit]

Geometric proof without words that max (a,b) > root mean square (RMS) or quadratic mean (QM) > arithmetic mean (AM) > geometric mean (GM) > harmonic mean (HM) > min (a,b) of two distinct positive numbers a and b[note 1]
The standard deviation  of a population or a waveform  is the RMS deviation of  from its arithmetic mean .  They are related to the RMS value of  by [9]

.
From this it is clear that the RMS value is always greater than or equal to the average, in that the RMS includes the squared deviation (error) as well.
Physical scientists often use the term root mean square as a synonym for standard deviation when it can be assumed the input signal has zero mean, that is, referring to the square root of the mean squared deviation of a signal from a given baseline or fit.[10][11] This is useful for electrical engineers in calculating the \

RMS of a signal. Standard deviation being the RMS of a signal's variation about the mean, rather than about 0, the DC component is removed (that is, RMS(signal) = stdev(signal) if the mean signal is 0).
