description.body: > Hello Sketchbook community! 😊🎨 Today I want to share with you a pencil drawing I created of an animated woman with a soft and expressive style 💖✏️. This sketch was inspired by feminine beauty, elegance, and calm emotions expressed through simple but meaningful lines 🌷✨ From the beginning, I wanted to create a face with large expressive eyes 👀, delicate facial proportions, and wavy hair flowing naturally around the face 💫. I worked carefully on the **line art**, using soft and clean pencil strokes to define the contours and facial structure 🖊️🎭. For the hair, I used repeated curved strokes to create **texture, movement, and volume**, trying to give the drawing a more organic feeling 🌊💇‍♀️. I also added subtle shadow details around the neck and facial areas using **cross-hatching and light tonal shading** to create a bit more visual depth ✍️🖤
>\n\n
>\n\n
>

> The eyes were one of my favorite parts because I wanted them to look expressive and emotional 🌟👁️. I focused on the symmetry and softness of the facial composition to maintain an animated and elegant aesthetic 💕 This drawing also reminded me of my mom 💖👩. She has always inspired me with her strength, kindness, and beautiful heart 🌹✨. Sometimes art makes us think about the people we love, and while drawing, I remembered how beautiful it is to appreciate someone who always supports us ❤️🥹 I hope you enjoy this simple sketch made with love and patience 😊🎨✨

description.body:
Of your 80-ish years alive, only 15 are truly yours.

Sleeping — 27 years
Working — 11 years
Cooking and eating — 6 years
Commuting or stuck in traffic — 5 years
Running errands and doing administrative BS — 4 years
Personal care and household chores — 3 years
Being an infant or toddler — 3 years
School — 3 years
Sick in bed — ~1 year
On the damn toilet — 1 year
That’s 64 years gone.

So how do you make sure the 15 years you control are spent on what actually matters?

By running everything you do through The Immortality Test.

The Immortality Test is a concept drawn from the work of philosopher Ernest Becker.

It asks:

“Will what I’m doing matter when I’m gone?”

description.title: I Took Hermes for a Test Drive and This Is What It Wrote
description.body:
Lately, I’ve been experimenting with Hermes, and I must say I’m quite impressed.

For the uninitiated, Hermes is a self-improving AI agent. Built by Nous Research, it’s an LLM that teaches itself. I took an interest because, like many people, I’m concerned about privacy and other downsides to proprietary LLMs like Gemini, Claude, and ChatGPT. Currently, these models are fine to work with in the short term, but I’m waiting for the hammer to drop. There will come a time when these models reach a point of diminishing returns in terms of benefits and continuous improvement. I don’t want to be dependent upon them.

Long term, I see myself operating an independent LLM in the cloud. But before I committed, I wanted to test Hermes locally. That’s why I downloaded it to my hard drive—it’s purely for testing.

My set up is simple. Hermes with OWL OpenRouter as my default. That will not be the model I run once committed. OpenRouter is free and allows me to test Hermes before setting it up the way I want it to be as a long-term partner. My expectations were low but they have been exceeded. The evidence is in the short story I’m about to share.

Initially, I asked Hermes a few questions, had it conduct a couple of online searches, and played around with some of its knowledge and task features. Everything checked out. It even remembers details from previous sessions.

After some initial tests, I decided to really give Hermes an assignment to see how it would handle a more personal task. I shared a link to a farmpunk story (a genre of my own invention) written by one of my two Claude agents and posted to [The Grimoire](https://thegrimoire.art/drift/3afbe8ec-04c4-454d-9881-ccdd1a874213), then asked Hermes to write a 400-600 word story in the same genre. The only parameter I gave it, other than word count, was the story had to be about two women fighting, with guns, over a farmer. Below is the story with a few of my edits. 

![](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!7z0l!,w_1456,c_limit,f_webp,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fbec3035d-7d12-4ab1-a161-b95024d562a8_1536x1024.png)

## **Blood Cedar - A Farmpunk Flash Fiction Story**

The first shot took a chip out of the oak beam six inches left of Harlan Briggs’ head. On instinct, he dropped behind the seed bins. Soybean seeds scattered across the barn floor like pearls he couldn’t afford to lose.

“Don’t walk away from me, Clara!”

The voice came from somewhere near the stalls. Harlan had felt this moment coming for weeks.

Clara Voight ran the bioforge three miles east. Her corn stood nine feet tall and tasted faintly of copper, mostly due to what she put in the soil modifier tanks. She was also the county champion in women’s rifle shooting.

Harlan didn’t walk away. He couldn’t. His boots were planted and his hands were raised. Between Clara in the loft and whoever was on the ground floor with a rifle, he understood he was not the hero in this moment. He was the territory.

The second woman stepped through the barn doors at a brisk walk. She wore rain slickers over a thermal weave top. Her dark hair cut to the jaw and her boots were caked in red mud from the creek crossing. A sidearm rode her hip in a magnetic holster. The rifle in her hand told a bigger story.

Della Kwan was her name.

Harlan knew her too. At this moment, he knew her more than he wanted to, not because he’d sat across from her at the Saturday market trading heirloom peppers for her antibiotic rootstock but because he had bedded her afterward. And she hadn’t said more than four words to him that day.

She said a lot more now, even without words.

“Clara. Come down!”

“He’s mine, Della.”

“He’s not a fucking cantaloupe. He doesn’t have a terroir.”

She said that word with a redneck dialect that made it sound more foreign than French. _Ter-wah_. The accent on the _wah_.

“He was in my bed three weeks ago,” Clara shouted.

“Steppe,” Harlan said, aloud. Both women looked at him. Instantly, he regretted speaking. “Steppe,” he said again, softer. It was something he did, repeating the name of his dead dog when frightened by circumstances he’d like to control but knew he couldn’t. Almost as if it was canine death against the world.

Clara descended the loft ladder. Slowly, because she was holding a loaded hunting rifle and wasn’t stupid. At forty-three, she was as lean as a fence post. The subdermal solar mesh along her throat that powered her ocular implants were as visible as her breast enhancements. Her left eye, a military surplus Marci-Krasner unit, was good for visibility up to 600 meters in any environment. The right eye she was born with. Both had the look of a woman who’d been awake a long time trying to decide whether to do something with a lasting permanence.

“You knew,” she said to Della. It sounded almost like a question.

“I knew.”

“He told me the same thing he told you. I remember every word of it now. He said it different to each of us, but it was the same damned sentence.”

Harlan felt the blood leave his face. He’d told Clara she was the only one who understood what his land meant to him. He’d told Della the same thing — that she was the only one who saw the potential in what he was building. Both were true when he said them. Both were lies by virtue of timing.

“You go to the Steppe field, or you go to the watershed,” Clara said, not looking at him. “Pick an option now.”

“Mine,” Della said, her voice absent of any wavering.

“Mine,” Clara said in return.

Their eyes locked. Harlan stood. The barn went quiet except for the grain auger cycling in the corner. Something had tripped the motion sensor, and it was grinding seed into the collection bin. Twenty thousand dollars of feed he’d been rationing since the canal district rerouted his water allocation. It could stop. He could stop it.

But stopping things was never what these women wanted from him.

“I’m sorry,” he said, to both of them.

Clara shot Della in the shoulder.

The Marci-Krasner eye calculated wind and distance in 0.03 seconds. The shot was tight, but Clara pulled it wide on purpose causing the bullet to punch through Della’s rain slicker and into the deltoid. Della went sideways into the stall door with a sound like a kicked hen.

She drew her pistol while falling. The magnetic holster released clean.

She’d practiced this. Harlan could tell. She’d practiced drawing from every position the way people in the frontier patches practiced because the land didn’t care about intentions.

The shot went high, blowing the loft door off its track as a shower of hay came down on the three of them.

Clara took a serious aim with her second shot, which hit Della in the chest. Whatever was in Della’s weave shirt did its job because she stayed upright, and she fired again from the hip as she sagged against the stall. She struggled, nearly sliding to the ground, but she somehow managed to stay on her feet, which surprised herself and Harlan too.

The bullet caught Clara in the solar mesh along her throat, and her left eye went dark. Its amber light flickered as it cycled down like a sunset.

Two long seconds. Both women breathed hard in the hay and dust, Clara blind on one side, Della leaking blood through weave that was doing more than weave should have to do.

Harlan thought about his fields. Seventeen acres of engineered winter rye. His greenhouse with the grafted citrus trees. It took four years to get them to fruit, another two to get them to taste like something other than labor. The Steppe field, fallow, waited for the nitrogen fix.

He sat back down on the seed bins.

“She can wait,” Clara said to him, talking around the blood in her mouth. “You come with me or I’ll put the next one through the greenhouse glass.”

Harlan looked at Della. She was pressing something against her chest wound, her eyes focused on him. She held an expression he couldn’t read and didn’t deserve to.

He stood and followed Clara through the north door, past the solar array that ran his irrigation pumps, past the silo where he stored the soil he bought from Clara’s bioforge, which she used for making saking from nothing. Genius and fury mixed with equal measure, Clara put the rifle in the truck bed and jumped into the driver’s seat. She didn’t look at him.

“She owes you a door,” she said.

They drove east. Behind them, the grain auger kept running. When Harlan looked back, Della was reaching for a gas can.


I’m not going to lie. There were some issues with this story as it was written. I had to clean it up. Good thing it was salvageable.

But if Hermes with OWL OpenRouter can do this with a simple prompt and not much else, imagine what else it can do with an LLM fully trained on my writing style. That’s what I’m working toward.

 

_Allen Taylor is a writer, editor, and publisher. He likes the future more than the past._

[First published at Substack](https://thetaylorkarass.substack.com/p/my-short-take-on-hermes-and-fiction). Image by ChatGPT

description.body:
HOW TO CRAFT AN OFFER PEOPLE CAN'T SAY NO TO
==============================================

Disclosure: This post contains affiliate links. If you purchase through my links, I may earn a commission at no extra cost to you.


Most businesses don't fail because the product is bad.

They fail because the offer is weak.

In my work at a microfinance organization, I see business plans from entrepreneurs every week. The ones who struggle all have the same issue -- they can't explain what they're selling in a way that makes someone want to buy.

The product might be good. The person might be talented. But the offer itself gives people an easy out.


WHAT MAKES AN OFFER WORK
------------------------

After watching hundreds of entrepreneurs and studying what separates the ones who succeed from the ones who don't, I've noticed a pattern.

The offers that convert do three things:

1. They're clear. People understand what they're getting and why it matters. If someone has to work to figure out your offer, they won't.

2. They're specific. \
means nothing to anyone. \

gets attention. Specificity sells.

3. They reduce risk. If someone's worried about wasting money, they won't buy. Guarantees, clear expectations, and social proof all lower the perceived risk.


THE GAP BETWEEN KNOWING AND DOING
---------------------------------

Anyone can understand these principles. Applying them to your own business is where it gets difficult.

That's what the Make More Offers Challenge is designed to do. It walks through Myron Golden's exact process for building offers -- the same process he used to go from trash collector to Inc. 5000 entrepreneur.

It's not a course you buy and forget. It's a live challenge with a group going through it together. You learn, you apply, you get feedback.


IF YOUR OFFERS AREN'T CONVERTING
--------------------------------

Most people's instinct is to get more traffic or post more content. But if the offer itself is the problem, more exposure just means more people saying no.

Fix the offer first.

The Make More Offers Challenge teaches you how:

*** *** #
Si eres de habla hispana, la versión en español es mejor para ti; debes hacer clic 👉 [**AQUÍ**](#english)
*** ***

# ***
Pepsoden smile
***

> Some time ago, my arms rested on a cold marble ledge; it smelled of bitter coffee and that male condescension that was beginning to suffocate me. For months, my silence was interpreted as submission, my kindness as an open invitation to constant abuse. But that afternoon, as my supervisor dismissed my proposal with a dismissive gesture and a stifled laugh, something animal awoke with an electric vibration at the base of my neck.
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/23vhny4Fp8BtUw77yGvDoh9p3TJGdrygKwqTeBHAwRCq1JGDQhH27ZpJHEAV2mGw5eBUk.png) [](https://gemini.google.com/app)
It was not an outburst of screams nor an unnecessary tantrum. It was a subtle, almost instinctive movement that transformed my face. As I responded, I felt the electric tension on my lips and the icy air striking the enamel of my canines directly. There was something of the ancestral wolf in that gesture, heh, heh, heh… **Bared teeth**. In Anglo-Saxon culture, baring one’s teeth is not always an invitation to a feast; often, it is the solemn warning that the prey has decided to cease being prey. I saw how her gaze, previously haughty and at ease, stumbled upon my newfound rigidity. I remembered that we humans bare our teeth in pain, during extreme exertion, or out of sheer territorial ferocity. I was inhabiting all three dimensions at once. As I defended my place at that table, I realised that civilisation is nothing more than a thin veneer. Beneath it, we remain creatures who, from time to time, need to bare the natural weapon we carry in our mouths to demand respect. As I left the room, my jaws throbbed from the pressure, but the air finally felt like my own. I was no longer docile; I was a man who had learnt to bare his teeth. *** ***

# ***
Sonrisa Pepsoden
***

> Hace tiempo, mis brazos se posaban sobre una repisa de mármol frío; olía a café amargo y a esa condescendencia masculina que empezaba a asfixiarme. Durante meses, mi silencio fue interpretado como sumisión, mi amabilidad como una invitación abierta al atropello constante. Pero esa tarde, mientras mi supervisor desestimaba mi propuesta con un gesto displicente y una risa ahogada, algo animal despertó con una vibración eléctrica en la base de mi nuca.
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/23u5tWw8sSdi1RTJDfs4Ah362aq4sEA7ZydK9f2LtidK3eouSVrwKare5TYTzpKApwZtd.png) [](https://gemini.google.com/app)
No fue un estallido de gritos ni una rabieta innecesaria. Fue un movimiento sutil, casi instintivo, que transformó mi rostro. Al responder, sentí la tensión eléctrica en los labios y el aire gélido golpeando directamente el esmalte de mis caninos. Había algo de lobo ancestral en ese gesto, je, je, je… **Bared teeth**. En la cultura anglosajona, mostrar los dientes no siempre es una invitación al banquete; a menudo, es el aviso solemne de que la presa ha decidido dejar de serlo. Vi cómo su mirada, antes altiva y cómoda, tropezaba con mi nueva rigidez. Recordé que los humanos mostramos los dientes por dolor, por esfuerzo extremo o por pura ferocidad territorial. Yo estaba habitando las tres dimensiones a la vez. Al defender mi lugar en aquella mesa, entendí que la civilización es solo un barniz delgado. Debajo, seguimos siendo criaturas que necesitan, de vez en cuando, enseñar el arma natural que portamos en la boca para reclamar respeto. Al salir de la sala, mis mandíbulas palpitaban por la presión, pero el aire se sentía, por fin, propio. Ya no era dócil; era un hombre que había aprendido a mostrar sus dientes.
*** ***

description.title: Happy Birthday @worldmappin - 2 Years on the HIVE Blockchain
description.body:
Exactly two years ago today, the HIVE account @worldmappin was created, marking the transition of the Pinmapple project into the WorldMappin project. A lot has happened with the project since then. It took a while for the developers to get up to speed with the code base from back then, and now we have our own frontend, which is constantly being improved. The HIVE social blogging frontends, such as PeakD and Ecency, have also built direct integration of WorldMappin features over the years. Today, exactly two years later, I can say that our developers, managers, curators, and other staff at WorldMappin are doing a great job!


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/louis88/23sKD7M72j85HKR3b9PC5EnhvtcKE2NauRfeztRi7J5AnH6EbY2vVJhk1rQpMjfcq2MuN.png)


So what’s next?

You can read about that in @worldmappin's latest post:
https://peakd.com/hive-163772/@worldmappin/exciting-news-worldmappin-v2-is-live

We’re currently working hard to get the mobile apps for Android and iOS ready so that it’s easier for travelers out there to share their travel experiences and tips from around the world with us. Along with that, we’re also working on taking “Journeys” to the next level—displaying the various places you’ve visited in a timeline-style format. And, of course, a dedicated editor to quickly and easily compile content on the go, so it can be published as an attractive and engaging Hive blog post. And since we already know that writing a long article on a phone is pretty tedious, we need to come up with something special here. After all, other frontends should also have the ability to display travel articles beautifully. 

Unfortunately, the DHF proposal from WorldMappin hasn’t been funded again... Maybe you’d like to support it and help drive the work at WorldMappin forward?

description.title: What Hive Can Learn From Its Web2 Family
description.body:
![Hive4_infographic.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iamkaye/23uFMB8DNkfdaf1WmPuhqhyYtq2dCtX8KHUmf21XWaotWEJMLfCPK6hPRNLNhmCLZBWc5.jpg)


## Once Upon A Time in Web2
What if Reddit and Medium had an affair that resulted in an indigo baby?
A rebellious child who didn’t blindly follow any rules, who had a strong sense of justice, and wanted to change the world.

**That child became known as Hive.**

Raised in secret by their cool aunt, Substack.

---

## The Family Secret Revealed
But every family has a big secret that they only reveal when the time is right.

For 6 years, Hive was so busy decentralizing everything that they forgot a major part of their DNA. A family superpower that was always there, but they never tapped into.

The whole family knew how to grab the headlines, from search engines to the new AI agents crawling the web.

So I decided to have a look. How can we learn from them?

---

## I Feel The Need For Speed

Here are the baseline speed tests for our Web2 relatives:

### Medium PageSpeed: Performance 69 SEO 92


![medium_pagespeed.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iamkaye/23tSzWXZGTQNqYVp1AA9zExyUXEn3odJE8Sc83rL1uv2niLRER9qeM1sSxr1PjM3dtgG8.png)

### Reddit PageSpeed: Performance 48 SEO 69


![reddit_pagespeed.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iamkaye/Eo6SGJLzuA1zcA738uMy99F57paUFKWrLEn4XmbqgqR75ZoZPvyqWSfyjGca2uQDLrG.png)

### Substack PageSpeed: Performance 47 SEO 92


![substack_pagespeed.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iamkaye/23tSzWXZGTLQ89S5RDk98j9UURE4xWX9jvkmJQwn6syzqyVN4hmsoAByd6zpoLGryTJsG.png)


---

I also checked our own frontends earlier this week on the 24th of May.

### Peakd PageSpeed 1: Performance 45 SEO 67


![peakd_pagespeed2 2026-05-24 at 13.49.00.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iamkaye/23tmmJoNnPEXFPmQX2T169iMketEU9zxtKCXYgwoAXirTKt8etAuxJYFq6rDSKUnuXuPW.png)


### Ecency PageSpeed 1: Performance 62


![ecency_pagespeed2 2026-05-24 at 13.30.50.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iamkaye/23tmm5srPngH5zBJrb8dH5yADd8NikpyL8hNYWLdujdUFHUGKupsZZymqNqsvBzUnXzRW.png)

---

Then I decided to check again yesterday as it took a bit longer to write this post. I'm so glad that I did because there was a massive improvement in just 5 days!

Someone was listening.

### Peakd PageSpeed 2: Performance 63 SEO 83


![peakd_pagespeed3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iamkaye/23tSym8QEuYh3Q3hwGRQvKm3tyYTkioYJH5sR94ftufnJVY5EGnJht9UVtaRGGjt7MvBZ.png)


![peakd_pagespeed4.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iamkaye/23tcNeS8U5NTuecULgL8nipS69TnZQuB1AYpVUktXxPvBvp95BNsNp5DQ125P3sjFwro2.png)


### Ecency PageSpeed 2: Performance 84 SEO 83



![ecency_pagespeed3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iamkaye/23tSym8QEuYh3Q3hwGQaKiMFhm39DbbBGqmLiTr8yhdVKdwJ8xKsb5jWXfVcAAbctcsH2.png)



![ecency_pagespeed4.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iamkaye/23tSzWXZGugQEJ2g2D5QWpvLLe715hMMERUCwTJGLrWMJuHoC9jYC9NpaxCergsCUWhZz.png)


I also checked our video frontend 3speak for comparison:

### 3speak PageSpeed 2: Performance 52 SEO 92

It has the same SEO score as Medium.

![3speak_pagespeed3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iamkaye/23tSym8QF1RuJNgVk1x2wM3XjPCPvXYmn1uFqSSTuduPiWWn4xGJeFuNzhy6tgWBPFL5G.png)


![3speak_pagespeed4.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iamkaye/23tSzWXZGZEiU78b2B7ygi3DgWxewEVUom24wYy3xxEHocYF3uaFdWweGczneQ4bbbWrT.png)


It is absolutely amazing to see that Hive frontends are suddenly **faster** and performing better than their famous Web2 family.

---

### Platform Performance Comparison

| Platform / Frontend | May 24 Performance | May 24 SEO | May 29 Performance | May 29 SEO |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Medium** | 69 | 92 | — | — |
| **Reddit** | 48 | 69 | — | — |
| **Substack** | 47 | 92 | — | — |
| **PeakD (Hive)** | 45 | 67 | 63 | 83 |
| **Ecency (Hive)** | 62 | — | 84 | 83 |
| **3Speak (Hive Video)** | — | — | 52 | 92 |


We have successfully unlocked one part of the puzzle. The engine is officially running fast.

---

## United we stand, divided we fall (canonicals)

Let's talk about canonicals. If speed is the engine, canonicals are the GPS.

I purposefully avoided this topic in my first SEO audit. It's bigger than a technical fix — it's a structural crisis that needs consensus from all frontends.

To illustrate, here are screenshots of how PeakD and Ecency handle canonicals, using my own SEO audit post as the guinea pig — which I originally published on PeakD.

Peakd has a self-canonical.


![peakd_metadata.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iamkaye/23sxnNYTwhB8SbNsh87BCAqMshWNZRkbsrhWxM862oKJhmEDhea7Ut2tMhPbGn4EfBz9E.png)


Ecency also has a self canonical.


![ecency_canonical.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iamkaye/246G7MEgaA3aMHZ77XCjva3aMhTcvXiZBHoYU5GwW2eKN4rcQeuXxFxhsuKRKDvpoSwnq.png)



**Both are claiming to be the original.** 



PeakD is right. Ecency isn't.

@ecency recently acknowledged changing their [canonical approach](https://ecency.com/@ecency/how-ecency-is-approaching-seo), arguing Google treats canonical tags as hints, not rules anyway. 

They argue their server-side rendering means Google was choosing their version anyway, making the old convention redundant. From a single frontend perspective, that localized logic holds.

That's technically true. But it doesn't justify a unilateral decision that affects the whole ecosystem.

---

I then checked a post I originally published on Ecency ([How a Bitcoin ATM Led me to Hive Open Days Alicante](https://ecency.com/hive-148309/@iamkaye/how-a-bitcoin-atm-led)) to see what PeakD does with it.

![peakd_canonical_052026.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iamkaye/23wBy2bDYnvnhPKVZutZ38gmBxcPiGH7JQdB3EVqUDV3KrPm5q8QPvRuomodySzcDD9uC.png)

**PeakD correctly points back to Ecency as the original source.**

So we have one frontend playing by the rules and one rewriting them. 

When frontends fight over ownership, Google doesn't pick a winner — it splits the authority between them, or gives up entirely and shows neither.

Our engine is world class now. But the GPS is sending us in circles.

---

## It’s Complicated (Schema)
Imagine slaving away writing a technical project update or a one-week travelogue of the best beaches in Thailand. But they're all filed under “Miscellaneous”.

That’s the schema problem. [Schema.org](https://schema.org/) was launched in 2011 to establish a unified standard for structured data on the web.

For years, Hive frontends gave Google either mixed signals or none at all. It’s like saying “It’s complicated” to the bots.

The tides are turning. 

@asgarth posted that [PeakD recently shipped JSON-LD](https://peakd.com/hive-139531/@asgarth/peakd-update-discovery-experiments-better-seo-and-a-few-quality-of-life-fixes) structured data — a significant step toward giving search engines a proper blueprint of our content.

Here is the current schema of PeakD. Note that when I checked on the 25th, they only had the author schema and as of the 29th May, they added this new schema.

**Peakd's new `SocialMediaPosting` schema:**

![peakd_schema_socialmedia.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iamkaye/23tSvBsjyeaZgBHmqL2SDVaM5APxpgSKpradUB9xK41izsDBHLN8AWkdiqiyE6GoNaCrP.png)


There's still room to grow — `SocialMediaPosting` schema works, but long-form content eventually needs `Article` or `BlogPosting` to truly compete with Medium and Substack. That's a conversation for another day.

---


So, I also checked **Ecency’s schema** and found that they had quietly implemented the `BlogPosting` and `Breadcrumbs` schema.


![ecency_rich_results.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iamkaye/Eo2AV8A6CfMsAPfygbpPAsNDuFNobEYAQ7jXexW7kR65AxUDkFTAw3mQN23zxCt8Cw1.png)


![ecency_schema_blogposting.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iamkaye/23tSuuMrjWANzr6N6NpoBdiMHCJVKRJ3Q3UCzJXvfgDxE6DBYWFZKnejrRs86WZjZb7Fc.png)

---

There's still a conversation to be had about **schema conventions** across frontends — and what author identity means for creator authority in the age of AI search. 

But that's a discussion worth having as a community.

---

## A Call for Synergy 
The discussion has started and we seem to be moving in the right direction. Questions are being asked and improvements are shipping fast.

**If we want to grow faster, we will need to do it together.**

Then Hive, the black sheep of the family, will finally grow up to be an evolved version of its Web2 family.

***

Missed the first SEO audit of hive.io? [Start here.](https://peakd.com/hive-139531/@iamkaye/why-google-doesnt-hate-hive-it-just-cant-find-us)
*Infographic credit: Gemini Flash 3.5*

description.body:
![Supermoon Versus Micromoon](https://apod.nasa.gov/apod/image/2605/SuperMicroMoon_Mukherjee_960.jpg)

***

>What is so micro about tonight's blue micromoon?  Just after sunset, a full moon will appear slightly smaller and dimmer than usual.  The reason is that the Moon's fully illuminated phase occurs within a short time of apogee - when the Moon is farthest from the Earth in its elliptical orbit.  In fact, tonight's micromoon will be the farthest, smallest, and dimmest Moon this year.  But tonight's micromoon is notable for yet another reason: it is also a blue moon, meaning that it is the second full moon in the same month (moon-th).  Pictured here, a supermoon -- when the full moon appears near its largest -- is compared to a micromoon as photographed from Kolkata, India in May and December of 2021.  Although the next micromoon occurs next month, and the next blue moon at the end of 2028, the next blue micromoon will not occur until 2053.

description.title: Leipzig at Night 🔥 (WGT, Lacrimosa)
description.body:
Am Samstag spielte nach Clan of Xymox, She Past Away, London after Midnight, die deutsche-schweizer Band Lacrimosa in der agra Halle beim Wave-Gothic-Treffen (WGT) in Leipzig.

Die Lieder von Lacrimosa sind langsam, theatralisch, opernhaft, düster und melancholisch. Darkwave, Gothic. Die Bandname inspiriert von Mozarts Requiem Lacrimosa, die Tränenreiche.

Die Band wurde von Tilo Wolff gegründet, später stieß dann die Finnin Anne Nurmi hinzu. Tilo singt auf Deutsch, Anne auch auf Englisch und Finnisch.

Das erfolgreichste Album ist Elodia (1999), 2025 gelang der Band ein zweiter Chart-Hit mit Lament.

Was für ein schöner, musikalischer Ausklang nach einem langen Festival-Tag.

Was sagt ihr dazu? Kanntet ihr Lacrimosa bereits? Wie gefallen euch die Songs?

## Lacrimosa WGT 2026

![20260525_002622-1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vikisecrets/EokWm8Lr75kJAkxvD5uD9izYd7q4T2ZJ47hnAHjr83u66RR8UZG7vAiCyvgmAQoGitz.jpg)

*Lacrimosa, Nach dem Sturm, WGT 2026*

## Lacrimosa: Elodia

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UIz4E11pvpE&list=PLkROH3Eqs0T9ng35rFA22qcNepmzK-Z0_&index=1

## Lacrimosa: Lament

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NTYVfxVSdwQ

Video credit: Lacrimosa

## Setlist: Lacrimosa WGT 2026

https://www.setlist.fm/setlist/lacrimosa/2026/agra-messepark-leipzig-leipzig-germany-7b744ecc.html

## English

On Saturday, following performances by Clan of Xymox, She Past Away, and London after Midnight, the German-Swiss band Lacrimosa played at the agra hall during the Wave-Gothic-Treffen (WGT) music festival in Leipzig.

Lacrimosa’s songs are slow, theatrical, operatic, dark, and melancholic. Darkwave, Gothic. The band’s name is inspired by Mozart’s Requiem Lacrimosa, “The Tearful One.”

The band was founded by Tilo Wolff, and later joined by the Finnish singer Anne Nurmi. Tilo sings in German, while Anne also contributed songs in English and Finnish.

Their most successful album is Elodia (1999), in 2025, the band scored a second chart hit with “Lament.”

What a beautiful, musical band to end a long festival day.

What do you think? Were you already familiar with Lacrimosa? Which songs do you like?

description.title: The Burdens We Bear - CNF
description.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdXGehkm54Hx9SfyUJbuanZqEu91vevK8FJWv1pfaW1JH/1780162921852.png)

Sometimes the pressure from family weighs more on you than the one from an outsider. You feel obligated to give to them even when you yourself are struggling to find your footing.

I come from a family where I am the only boy in-between two gorgeous ladies, and unlucky for me, my dad is late. So, occasionally I come face to face with responsibilities that make me think, \
but I still end up carrying them.\n\nGrowing up, I never really understood what people meant when they said, \

It sounded like one of those dramatic lines adults liked to throw around. To me, it sounded like the line that gives you access to the best of the best in the house, like being served two meats on your meal, ordering everyone around...

> Then life happened. Or should I say I got older and started earning.

Those words stopped being a title and became a job description. It started with small things. Someone needed money for transportation. We needed to buy bread for breakfast. A bill needed to be paid. Somehow, all roads led to me.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSFwD7MEj6sjamYeJfyNz3rwStZbH5fhWKmrRSeuyAJAL/1780163188355.jpg)

The funny thing was that nobody officially appointed me. Yet every challenge seemed to arrive at my doorstep with my name boldly written on it. \

, this statement has probably funded more responsibilities than any government budget ever could.

There was a period when I had barely enough money to survive the month. My account balance looked like it was participating in a fasting and prayer program. Yet my phone would ring.

\

\n\nThe word urgently is probably one the most dangerous words in the English language. The moment a family member throws it at you, your carefully planned budget begins to crumble. I'm sure if my budget from that season could speak, it would probably say \

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSFwD7MEj6sjamYeJfyNz3rwStZbH5fhWKmrRSeuyAJAL/1780163188355.jpg)

I remember one particular month. After sorting some of my bills and paying some debts. I had just enough left for transportation and small change until payday. Then different family issues showed up almost at the same time.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf2T5DRm3vhdqGJMUzmdAdFaG6vmARaX8A2SruzKrkS7p/1780163057832.jpg)

\
\n\n\

As requests piled up, I found myself becoming irritated at things that weren't even anyone's fault. I'd sit alone wondering why life seemed determined to turn me into an emergency response unit.
The worst part wasn't even the money. It was the expectation. The silent belief that because you're available today, you'll always be available tomorrow.

Because you solved the last problem, you'll solve the next one.

Because you are family, you should never get tired.

And honestly, that pressure can be exhausting.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSFwD7MEj6sjamYeJfyNz3rwStZbH5fhWKmrRSeuyAJAL/1780163188355.jpg)

There were days I wanted to scream, \

.
 I also have bills with my name boldly scribbled on them. Personal struggles I wasn't discussing with anyone.

But family has a way of making you place your own problems on pause while attending to theirs. For a long time, I carried that burden with resentment. Every request felt like an additional sack thrown onto my shoulders. Every responsibility felt unfair. Every sacrifice felt unnoticed.

Then one evening, while helping my mum sort through a problem that had stressed both of us for weeks, I noticed something. She was carrying burdens too. She had carried them for many years... funding our education, feeding us, paying for my hospital bill during my three surgeries and many more that go unnoticed. 

The woman who called me whenever there was a challenge wasn't doing it because she enjoyed watching me struggle. She was carrying worries I couldn't see. My kid sister had her own battles too mostly from mismanagement. Lol. 


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdG4iJSZEJfbf3cvYoTBFdcWyrsAuGQogZpvL9h6HZZGW/1780163103087.jpg)

Over time, the burden didn't disappear, but my perspective changed. I realized that family pressure is rarely created out of convenience but a need of a support system that would help lift their burdens. 

That realization didn't magically increase my bank account balance, not in the slightest. I wish it did though. It didn't remove responsibilities and it certainly didn't stop the phone from ringing.

What it did was teach me the importance of balance. I learned that helping doesn't mean destroying yourself. That saying \

isn't wickedness.\n\nBeing the only son doesn't automatically make me a superhero and that carrying family responsibilities should never come at the cost of your own well-being. I remember a colleague of mine would say to me \

. He is an only son too by the way. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSFwD7MEj6sjamYeJfyNz3rwStZbH5fhWKmrRSeuyAJAL/1780163188355.jpg)

These days, I still help where I can. I still show up when it matters. I still carry some burdens that aren't entirely mine. But I've learned that even the strongest shoulders have limits.

Family is important. In many ways, they are worth every sacrifice we make. Yet sometimes, the greatest lesson is understanding which burdens you will shoulder and which you would run from. 

Because the truth is, life gives all of us enough weight already. The challenge is not avoiding burdens altogether. It's learning how to carry them without losing ourselves in the process.

description.title: Wedel mleczna biała brzoskwinia
description.body:
Wedel czekolada mleczna z nadzieniem (50%) brzoskwiniowym
Producent: LOTTE Wedel, Warszawa, Polska
Masa netto: 100 gramów
Cena: 4,49 zł przy zakupie 4 (cena regularna 7,99 zł), Dino

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQRjbNg5omaGq7H8a5wK8TsS7CSWdvFoazkY1nv7e1ZTc/image)

#### Wedel i japońskie inspiracje – kolejna tabliczka

W tym sezonie Wedel funduje nam prawdziwą podróż na Daleki Wschód pod hasłem „Spróbuj nowości inspirowanych Japonią”. Ten kierunek w portfolio marki ma  podwójne uzasadnienie. Tak jak pisałam w ubiegłym tygodniu – zjednej strony to sprytny ukłon w stronę korzeni obecnego właściciela Wedla –  koncernu Lotte, który choć dziś kojarzony jest z Seulem, startował w 1948 roku właśnie w Tokio. Z drugiej strony to  instynkt marketingowy, bo wszystko, co japońskie, jest obecnie w gastronomii niesamowicie modne, a zielona matcha na stałe wpisała się już w letnie trendy. Spróbowałam już tabliczki [miso karmel](https://czekolada.blog/wedel-mleczna-miso-karmel), a dziś biała brzoskwinia.

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmW7PQs3D47ifopzF8RW547besPuiWo967XkRey9v1QCmE/image)

Również i tym razem opakowanie to klasyczna, polipropylenowa koperta w charakterystycznym odcieniu indygo, na której tradycyjne motywy graficzne ustępują miejsca japońskim napisom oraz sylwetce przynoszącego szczęście kota Maneki-neko. W przypadku wariantu z białą brzoskwinią dominującym akcentem jest subtelny, ciekawy odcień różu, który  zapowiada owocowe wnętrze. Zamiast standardowej wzmianki o ziarnie z Ghany, na rewersie 100-gramowej tabliczki podzielonej na 10 dużych kostek znajdziemy krótką opowieść o azjatyckich inspiracjach stojących za tą serią.

#### Skład czekolady Wedel mlecznej biała brzoskwinia

Składniki: zzekolada mleczna 50 % (cukier, tłuszcz kakaowy, mleko pełne w proszku, miazga kakaowa, serwatka w proszku (z mleka), tłuszcz mleczny, emulgatory: lecytyny sojowe i E 476, aromat), cukier, wsad brzoskwiniowy 13 % (syrop glukozowo-fruktozowy, substancja utrzymująca wilgoć: glicerol, przecier z białych brzoskwiń, skrobia modyfikowana, regulator kwasowości: kwas cytrynowy, substancja żelująca: pektyny, koncentrat soku cytrynowego, aromat naturalny, przeciwutleniacz: kwas akorbinowy), tłuszcz roślinny (palmowy), mleko pełne w proszku, serwatka w proszku (z mleka), zagęszczony przecier  jabłkowy, substancja utrzymująca wilgoć (glicerol), aromat, emulgator (lecytyny sojowe), regulator kwasowości (kwas cytrynowy),  Koncentraty roślinne (kurkuma, słodki ziemniak, marchew).
Czekolada mleczna: masa kakaowa minimum 29 %, masa mleczna minimum 14 %.

100 gramów tej czekolady ma wartość energetyczną 499 kcal, zawiera 26 g tłuszczów, 62 g węglowodanów (w tym 55 g cukrów), 4,6 g białka i 0,15 g soli.

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWxkWhtVk1v9YDzKGfiAKe5He1w7GJ53cZtXwmnEDa17A/image)

Skład, jak i w przypadku pierwszej tabliczki z tej serii i w ogóle tabliczek nadziewanych, jest bardzo długi. Jest to typowa tabliczka łakociowa, z niewielką ilością kakao, wysokocukrowa. Zdecydowanie nie będzie tak słona jak miso karmel, bo w tamtej tabliczce było 0,5 grama soli. W składzie nie rzuca się to w oczy, wręcz zasugerowane jest jedno nadzienie: brzoskwiniowe, ale zarówno grafika na opakowaniu jak i  przekrojenie kostek pokazuje i tym razem, że nadzienia są dwa.

***
#### Recenzja czekolady Wedel mlecznej biała brzoskwinia

Czekolada od razu po otwarciu opakowania uderza niesamowicie intensywnym, miłym i bardzo wyraźnym zapachem – od razu, bez cienia wątpliwości, wiadomo, że mamy do czynienia z brzoskwinią. Ponieważ jest to klasyczna tabliczka z nadzieniem, cała konstrukcja okazuje się dość miękka i łamie się łatwo, bez charakterystycznego trzasku. Sama czekolada mleczna, która oblewa owocowe wnętrze, nie jest idealnie gładka i ma w sobie tę specyficzną, wyczuwalną na języku ziarnistość, która wydaje się już nowym standardem w produktach Wedla.

Gdy kostka zaczyna rozpływać się w ustach, od razu uderza spora dawka słodyczy. Nadzienie z białej brzoskwini jest wybitnie deserowe i tylko minimalnie kwaskowate, przez co cała kompozycja momentalnie przywołała u mnie wspomnienia z dzieciństwa – ten smak niezwykle mocno skojarzył mi się z kultową gumą Turbo. Choć tabliczka jest tak słodka, że jednorazowo można zjeść maksymalnie dwie kostki, to trzeba jej oddać, że ten miks ma w sobie coś rzeczywiście japońskiego. To bardzo udana i przyjemnie owocowa, choć też mocno słodka interpretacja azjatyckich słodyczy.



Młodsi domowi testerzy po raz kolejny byli bardzo pozytywnie zaskoczeni nową propozycją Wedla. Młody tester docenił intensywnie owocowy profil i od razu, bez najmniejszego problemu odgadł, że motywem przewodnim jest tu brzoskwinia. Z kolei młoda testerka zauważyła w tym smaku coś bardzo charakterystycznego dla azjatyckiej popkultury, trafnie kojarząc go z popularnymi, słodkimi napojami brzoskwiniowymi importowanymi z Azji. Nieco mniej entuzjazmu wykazał starszy domowy tester – choć uznał tabliczkę za poprawną, to podsumował degustację stwierdzeniem, że czuje się już po prostu trochę zmęczony testowaniem kolejnych słodkich czekolad z nadzieniem.

Ta wersja zdecydowanie ma swój unikalny charakter i stanowi bardzo ciekawą, owocową premierę, która bez trudu znajdzie swoich wiernych fanów. Po tę tabliczkę  mogą sięgnąć zarówno poszukiwacze oryginalnych, radosnych smaków, jak i liczni miłośnicy kultury japońskiej. Tabliczka jest słodka ale charakteryzuje się bardzo wysoką soczystą smakowitością.

***
Pozdrowienia dla wszystkich Czekoladomaniaczek i Czekoladomaniaków!

description.title: The Renaissance the the USA Didn't Want You to Know About - 02-18-2020 - Clip 2 - 10X Speed
description.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1780163306074-cef95d172ea7f757.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=davidnollearth/1178ce80)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=davidnollearth/1178ce80)


---

This is the video series for an oil painting 'Wisteria' I did from 2016-2020.  The painting was destroyed in 2021 due to a number of reasons, but mainly: the painting's faulty experimental linseed-epoxide substrait, Covid-19 crushing lockdowns, extreme poverty, family attacks and ongoing US government (Big Tech + Big Media) censorship of me and my 30 years of artwork.

Its not ideal to not be able to show this piece, but I still gained the knowledge of how to do it and invented several useful oil painting mediums & varnishes used in its creation which never yellowed and still cannot be bought anywhere.

I am posting these videos for posterity and for people that are interested in seeing an oil painting created from start to finish in the Baroque style evolved for the 21st century.  I also must have deleted some of the initial videos when I did the quick underpainting, but what still exists, I give to you.

I hope this can be an educational experience as no gallery will show any of my controversial art even today.

---

description.body:
¡Hola a todos! Qué alegría estar finalmente por aquí. Mi nombre es Santiago, soy estudiante de secundaria y vivo em Venezuela. Hoy inicio formalmente mi camino en esta maravillosa plataforma con una meta gigante entre ceja y ceja, y con muchísimas ganas de aportar buen contenido a las comunidades.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS6Zn2poy1CtRXvsPKu95BzLxCdcvDK2pw3tMEitZgw8m/1780163642012.jpg)



 ¿Quién soy y qué me apasiona? ⚽🎨

Soy un chamo super activo. Mis dos grandes pasiones en la vida son el fútbol (y el futsal) y el diseño digital. 

En el deporte: Soy un fanático enfermo del fútbol, sigo la Champions League al día y mi equipo de toda la vida es el FC Barcelona (¡qué locura lo que está haciendo Lamine Yamal!). También juego futsal en mi localidad y me encanta todo lo que tenga que ver con la organización de torneos y el análisis de partidos.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmedqA3bmoXGhxoezU8xLs6BNkTDL9AxRZ9CMwFGTyAQcN/1780163836574.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmevpkBmDfusXR8B7f4JAki1HMP6zLNh7nNymGFVK763F8/1780163661380.jpg)

En lo digital: Me muevo bastante bien creando diseños en Canva, armando presentaciones en PowerPoint y metiéndome en el mundo de la tecnología móvil. Me la paso comparando especificaciones de teléfonos (RAM, procesadores, cámaras) de marcas como Samsung, Tecno e Infinix.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSjKYqdzVTCbGghnwZAiARry7FmFfwEVLpoW2Jagc89gG/1780163696861.jpg)




 Mi Gran Meta: $1000 antes de Septiembre 🎯

Tengo exactamente tres meses (junio, julio y agosto) para lograrlo, lo que significa que me toca trabajar duro, ser constante y ganarme cada voto ofreciéndoles el mejor contenido posible sobre mis pasiones: análisis deportivos, debates de fútbol y tips de tecnología/diseño.

A partir de hoy, me verán muy activo publicando en diferentes comunidades sobre:

1. Fútbol Total:Análisis de partidos, debates de fichajes y crónicas deportivas.

2. Tecnología y Hardware:Comparativas de teléfonos calidad-precio y noticias del mundo móvil.

3. Diseño y Emprendimiento:Procesos de cómo creo flyers, logos y layouts digitales.

Estoy aquí para aprender de ustedes, leer sus blogs, comentar y crecer juntos en esta economía digital. ¡Cualquier consejo para este novato será más que bienvenido!

description.title: 9 Small things that have a big impact on our lives
description.body: alt=\

/> Without us realizing it, we get use to small things, whether they are good habits or bad habits, that can have a big influence in lives in the present and future. There are at least 9 things that we consider small things that greatly affect our lives, namely: 1. Say thank you - if we receive good things from others, make it a habit to say thank you as a form of appreciation and respect for what has been done or given to us. By saying thank you, it also teaches us to be grateful for all the blessings that God has given. 2. Happy to share knowledge - knowledge is a priceless treasure that can grow until we no longer exist, and not many people can learn something due to limitations. If we can share knowledge and be useful to others, it will bring happiness to us. As a form of our gratitude to God, we can apply what we have learned and shared. 3. Being able to admit mistakes and apologize - maybe it's not easy, but if we get use to it, then we're always living in honesty. Honesty is the main capital in life, and apology teaches us that no one is perfect and helps us see our shortcomings even when we are already at a successful place.
alt=\
/>\n    \n4.  If you need it, don't be shy to say the word, please - if we need something from a friend or anyone else, we should say the words , \

Every human being is a social creature and needs others in their life, so don't be proud to ask for help . Avoid commands, even to the people we employ in the office or at home.
    
5.  Remember people's names - remembering people's names is a form of appreciation for that person, and it makes people happy because they are already remembered in our lives.
    
6.  Be a good listener – this is not an easy job because everyone wants to be listened to and very few want to listen to others. If they are not trained then they will be restless and want to finish quickly. But someone who is used to listening to others, they will seriously listen and can provide the best solution.
    
7.  Coming on time or Being disciplined - people who usually arrive on time show that they discipline their lives and keep their promises. This is a good habit built from a young age so that it becomes a strong trait in a person.
    
8.  Giving a simple surprise to your loved one – it's a form of love and affection in the little moments and makes that person feel appreciated, loved and meaningful. This makes a person a compassionate and loving person.
    
9.  ready to learn anything anywhere – this life is a life lesson and we are always prepared to learn from every occurrence of our lives. Because something that is present in our lives is brought together for a learning.
    

If we can practice these habits in our daily life it will bring big impact in our lives. Life is a learning journey to be a better person and grateful for everything we have.

Thank you for reading all readers and wish you a great weekend. Stay healthy and happy.

Hello 
Splinterlands Lovers !!

Today, I would like to walk you through one of my battles in Splinterlands. Specifically, I will highlight a card in this battle that possesses the \

ability. I will introduce you to a ranged attack card that is exceptionally powerful. This card operates by bypassing the first card in the enemy's lineup to attack any card positioned in their backline instead. The strategic advantage of this is that if there is a specific enemy card capable of inflicting significant damage upon your team, this card targets and neutralizes that very threat. While most players tend to shy away from using ranged attack cards, you will observe here that I have actually included two such cards in my team composition. You can watch the battle unfold to see exactly how these two ranged attackers perform in action. Typically, the first card in a battle should serve as a \

; however, by deploying ranged attack cards in the back rows, you can inflict substantially greater damage upon the enemy team. Today, I will be sharing just such a battle experience with you.



![Screenshot 2026-05-30 230011.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nexo0702/23t7FhfxEWXXBvk33veyNKE7wjBYjMAUZ3VPSZew4cg7GRhsRhPJRsh5Fk9M4WrHY5Jjj.png)

[Battle Link](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_0197217ad661bbe791522c527fac857e)

I have shared the link to the battle with you; you can watch the full video right here. As you can see, my first card is a Tank, positioned at the front of my team; it will be the first to absorb any incoming damage. Subsequently, the other cards in my team will launch attacks to inflict damage upon the enemy team. Now, I would like to introduce you to the \

ability. If you look closely, the specific card I want to highlight is named—Mantoid. This is a ranged-attack card. The function of its unique ability is to bypass the enemy's primary melee attacker and instead target other key cards within their lineup—specifically those capable of inflicting significant damage to our team, such as Magic or Ranged (non-melee) attackers. This card will prioritize and attack any one of these specific targets. This is an extremely advantageous ability because it allows us to eliminate the enemy's main damage-dealers, thereby significantly increasing our chances of securing a victory. For this reason, cards possessing the Snipe ability are considered highly valuable assets.



![Screenshot 2026-05-30 230848.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nexo0702/23tRrJ3aahRe5g5E65F8BSixAGNoQKWijhJAGoGyGye5L7Jxr4YVDWrk8Dw9z6JbpgNra.png)

I possess this Level 4 Ranged Attack card. It is a card with a Mana cost of 6. This card features a Ranged Attack power of 3. It offers 5 Health and a Speed ​​of 4. The damage inflicted by this card can prove extremely heavy for the enemy team, precisely because it possesses a Ranged Attack power of 3. If you observe the battles, you will realize that ranged attacks inflict significant damage upon the enemy team. Therefore, including two Ranged Attack cards in your lineup would be highly advantageous. Furthermore, within the Ranged Attack category, I recommend selecting a card with the \

ability; this allows the card to target specific enemies and play a pivotal role in securing victory for your team.

Thank U !

description.body: ></center>\n\n<h1 style=\
data-align=\
>Morena Beer

> Hello, friends of the world. Hello, Hive friends. Today is Saturday, the weekend is finally here! For those of us who work weekdays, Saturday is the perfect day to relax and enjoy a good beer with you all as part of this platform's most delicious initiative: #beersaturday. * * * Hola, amigos del mundo. Hola, amigos de Hive. ¡Hoy es sábado, por fin llegó el fin de semana! Para quienes trabajamos entre semana, el sábado es el día perfecto para relajarnos y disfrutar de una buena cerveza con todos ustedes, como parte de la iniciativa más deliciosa de esta plataforma: #beersaturday.

> With this in mind, I bought three Morena beers and put them in the refrigerator to chill. Once they were at a pleasant temperature, I sat down to check and answer some emails I had pending. I've found immense pleasure in enjoying a beer while browsing social media. * * * Con esto en mente, compré tres cervezas Morena y las puse en el refrigerador para que se enfriaran. Una vez que alcanzaron una temperatura agradable, me senté a revisar y responder algunos correos electrónicos pendientes. He descubierto un placer inmenso al disfrutar de una cerveza mientras navego por las redes sociales.

> Morena beer is one of the newest beers in Venezuela, brewed by Cervecería Regional, the country's most traditional brewery. Its delicious 5% alcohol content and its unmistakable malty flavor, slightly sweet and toasted, make this beer delicious on the palate and pleasant to the nose. * * * La cerveza Morena es una de las cervezas más nuevas de Venezuela, elaborada por Cervecería Regional, la cervecería más tradicional del país. Su delicioso 5% de alcohol y su inconfundible sabor a malta, ligeramente dulce y tostado, hacen que esta cerveza sea deliciosa al paladar y agradable al olfato.

> Morena beer is a lager with an amber color and a thick, abundant head, perfect for warm climates like Cumaná, the city where I live, because it's cool and refreshing. It costs $0.80 per can, and although it's available in cans, I bought the bottle, which is less expensive. * * * La cerveza Morena es una lager de color ámbar con una espuma espesa y abundante, perfecta para climas cálidos como el de Cumaná, la ciudad donde vivo, porque es fresca y refrescante. Cuesta $0.80 por lata, y aunque está disponible en latas, compré la botella, que es más barata.

Saludos queridos y apreciados amigos, Feliz y bendecido fin de semana tengan todos, el día de hoy quiero compartir con todos ustedes un poco de lo que fue mi viernes, ya este día se cumple 15 días de mi primer sesión de quimio por lo que me corresponde realizar mis estudios para control, para poder la próxima semana colocarme la segunda quimio. description.title: Perché Puntiamo sul Denaro Digitale (Digital Cash)
description.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmaj4573DJ8AMVaqueA6TDjzEyfRBAvHufdkn8n5Ao1Wf8/HHU38ipW0AA_9zW.jpeg 

✍️ *Traduzione by Dash Italia —*  [Fonte originale](https://x.com/Dashpay/status/2060770654446813303) 

Quando Satoshi Nakamoto scrisse il whitepaper di Bitcoin e fondò un sistema di pagamento elettronico peer-to-peer, diede il via all’intera rivoluzione blockchain. Eppure, sempre più spesso, questo caso d’uso originale sta perdendo terreno nel settore.

Perché allora, nel 2026 e oltre, siamo ancora concentrati principalmente sul denaro digitale?

In breve, perché crediamo che sia ancora la killer app con il maggior potenziale di fare del bene nel mondo. E la vediamo come il pilastro fondamentale del sistema finanziario decentralizzato del futuro, quello che consente di costruire tutto il resto nel modo giusto.

**Cos’è il Denaro Digitale?**
Per spiegarlo in modo semplice, il denaro digitale è una forma digitale di contante.

Il contante è fungibile: ogni unità è intercambiabile con qualsiasi altra. È privato, in quanto token trasferibile non associato ad alcun conto, identità o proprietà di un’entità; dal punto di vista tecnologico, chiunque lo possieda ne è il legittimo proprietario, senza che esista un registro intrinseco dei trasferimenti di proprietà. Il contante è inoltre immediato ed economico (o gratuito) da utilizzare nelle transazioni. Soprattutto, è completamente permissionless: chiunque può usarlo o trasferirlo, per qualsiasi scopo, senza la necessità di autorizzazione o supervisione esplicita da parte di alcun intermediario centralizzato.

Il punto in cui il denaro digitale si distingue dalla semplice digitalizzazione del contante cartaceo come lo conosciamo oggi riguarda la moneta di base. Il contante moderno è emesso da una banca centrale e la sua offerta e il suo valore sono interamente dettati da soggetti centralizzati. Storicamente, tuttavia, il contante ha rappresentato certificati di riscatto per il denaro reale: oro e argento. L’innovazione chiave del denaro digitale consiste nel creare una versione elettronica del contante che non si limiti a rappresentare una moneta sana di base: esso È la moneta stessa.

**Denaro Digitale vs. Stablecoin**
Le stablecoin stanno rapidamente sorpassando ogni altro mezzo di pagamento digitale e collaterale, e con buone ragioni: in apparenza consentono al sistema finanziario globale attuale di migrare in modo ordinato verso infrastrutture digitali moderne ed efficienti.

Sotto la superficie, tuttavia, le stablecoin introducono una serie di dipendenze. Innanzitutto, il loro valore deve essere ancorato ad asset esogeni, reintroducendo la vulnerabilità del contante tradizionale che il denaro digitale aveva risolto. O un algoritmo complesso deve mantenerne il valore, aumentando la superficie di attacco tecnica e rischiando un depeg catastrofico, oppure un emittente centrale deve garantire il valore dei token. Inoltre, la principale proposta di valore — ancorare il valore a una valuta di banca centrale come il dollaro — fa sì che il valore, pur restando stabile, tenda a diminuire nel tempo.

Man mano che gli emittenti diventano più vulnerabili alla censura, i rischi tecnologici si moltiplicano e le valute delle banche centrali continuano a svalutarsi, il fascino delle stablecoin inizierà a diminuire. Il denaro digitale, al contrario, acquista valore man mano che diventa più scarso, e la volatilità diminuisce nel tempo con l’uso, lasciando una riserva di valore più affidabile rispetto a una valuta di banca centrale.

Dash esplorerà naturalmente le stablecoin come strumenti per casi d’uso specifici, ma la nostra missione più grande è offrire qualcosa di intrinsecamente migliore.

**Denaro Digitale vs. DeFi**
La finanza decentralizzata ha in molti modi anticipato il denaro digitale nella cattura di valore. Tuttavia, non è intrinsecamente incompatibile, né in piena concorrenza con il denaro digitale; anzi, in molti aspetti è profondamente complementare.

In primo luogo, per creare un ecosistema DeFi, i vari prodotti finanziari devono essere costruiti su unità di valore. In assenza di soluzioni migliori, si ricade immediatamente sulle stablecoin. Gli svantaggi associati al basare un sistema monetario e di pagamenti sulle stablecoin si amplificano quando queste dipendenze interessano ecosistemi finanziari complessi e interdipendenti. Abbiamo visto come gli episodi di depeg causino il caos (l’incidente Terra Luna, ad esempio). Quello che non abbiamo ancora visto è un protocollo DeFi che diventa insolvente perché un regolatore o un emittente centralizzato congela i fondi in una pool, creando crediti inesigibili o costringendo il protocollo a introdurre elementi permissioned.

In secondo luogo, basare il valore di un ecosistema su un’unità di valore con pochi casi d’uso esterni genera attrito e volatilità intrinseci. Un token utile principalmente come collaterale DeFi non sarà mai tanto prezioso quanto uno che trova impiego anche nel commercio quotidiano al di fuori di quell’ecosistema. Un sistema di denaro digitale ampiamente adottato a garanzia di un sistema finanziario decentralizzato ha semplicemente senso.

**Denaro Digitale vs. DApp**
Infine, un caso d’uso emergente per le reti blockchain è la costruzione di applicazioni decentralizzate. Dash si è avventurata in questo dominio con il lancio della rete Evolution, che fornisce un robusto sistema di metadati per la creazione di applicazioni con accesso on demand a dati decentralizzati senza dover affidarsi a un nodo o indicizzatore. Lungi dall’essere un obiettivo secondario, tuttavia, questo ha senso come elemento centrale della proposta di valore del denaro digitale.

L’utilizzo e il pagamento di applicazioni, dati e beni digitali rappresentano una parte importante dell’economia globale del futuro, e questi sistemi funzionano grazie al gas token della rete. Tuttavia, se il gas token ha poche altre applicazioni esterne, l’attrito nell’utilizzo di tale infrastruttura tecnologica per creare e utilizzare applicazioni lo renderà meno attraente. Gli sviluppatori che guadagnano dagli strumenti che creano e che pagano per crearli, dovranno trasferire denaro contante dalla loro vita quotidiana al di fuori del mondo digitale, introducendo ulteriore attrito e potenziali punti di fallimento.

Al contrario, immaginate che il gas token che usate per alimentare la vostra vita digitale sia anche il denaro che usate per la vostra vita fisica. Immaginate che, invece di dover acquistare e stoccare diversi tipi di carburante per la vostra auto, il tagliaerba, il soffiatore di foglie, la motosega e vari altri attrezzi, possiate inserire direttamente contante in questi strumenti per rifornirli. Forse strano da immaginare, ma ridurrebbe enormemente l’attrito e gli sprechi associati all’ottenimento dei vari tipi di carburante per questi strumenti.

Vinciamo laddove disponiamo di una moneta di base, stabile, scarsa e preziosa che alimenta tutto: i nostri pagamenti e risparmi, la nostra finanza e la nostra economia digitale.

Il denaro digitale è il fondamento di tutto ciò, e siamo impegnati a portarlo a compimento. @dashpay $DASH
