description.title: Poynting vector
description.body:
# Poynting vector

**Source:** https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Poynting_vector

An electric dipole (oscillating here along the z-axis) results in dipole radiation, whose electric field strength (colored) and Poynting vector (arrows) are shown for its x-z plane.

In physics, the Poynting vector (or Umov–Poynting vector) represents the directional energy flux (the energy transfer per unit area, per unit time) or power flow of an electromagnetic field. The SI unit of the Poynting vector is the watt per square metre (W/m2); kg/s3 in SI base units. It is named after its discoverer John Henry Poynting who first derived it in 1884.[1]: 132   Nikolay Umov is also credited with formulating the concept.[2] Oliver Heaviside also discovered it independently in the more general form that recognises the freedom of adding the curl of an arbitrary vector field to the definition.[3]  The Poynting vector is used throughout electromagnetics in conjunction with Poynting's theorem, the continuity equation expressing conservation of electromagnetic energy, to calculate the power flow in electromagnetic fields.

In Poynting's original paper and in most textbooks, the Poynting vector  is defined as the cross product[4][5][6]

where bold letters represent vectors and

E is the electric field vector;
H is the magnetic field's auxiliary field vector or magnetizing field.
This expression is often called the Abraham form and is the most widely used.[7] The Poynting vector is usually denoted by S or N.
In simple terms, the Poynting vector S, at a point, gives the magnitude and direction of surface power density that are due to electromagnetic fields at that point. More rigorously, it is the quantity that must be used to make Poynting's theorem valid. Poynting's theorem essentially says that the difference between the electromagnetic energy entering a region and the electromagnetic energy leaving a region must equal the energy converted or dissipated in that region, that is, turned into a different form of energy (often heat). Poynting's theorem is simply a statement of local conservation of energy.
If electromagnetic energy is not gained from or lost to other forms of energy within some region (e.g., mechanical energy or heating), then electromagnetic energy is locally conserved within that region, yielding a continuity equation as a special case of Poynting's theorem:

![Image 1](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/3/3a/Shotcut-dipole-axis-labels-larger.gif/330px-Shotcut-dipole-axis-labels-larger.gif)

where  is the energy density of the electromagnetic field. This frequent condition holds in the following simple example in which the Poynting vector is calculated and seen to be consistent with the usual computation of power in an electric circuit.

Example: Power flow in a coaxial cable[edit]
We can find a relatively simple solution in the case of power transmission through a section of coaxial cable analyzed in cylindrical coordinates as depicted in the accompanying diagram. The model's symmetry implies that there is no dependence on θ (circular symmetry) nor on Z (position along the cable). The model (and solution) can be considered simply as a DC circuit with no time dependence, but the following solution applies equally well to the transmission of radio frequency power, as long as we are considering an instant of time (during which the voltage and current don't change), and over a sufficiently short segment of cable (much smaller than a wavelength, so that these quantities are not dependent on Z).
The coaxial cable is specified as having an inner conductor of radius R1 and an outer conductor whose inner radius is R2 (its thickness beyond R2 doesn't affect the following analysis). In between R1 and R2 the cable contains an ideal dielectric material of relative permittivity εr and we assume conductors that are non-magnetic (so μ = μ0) and lossless (perfect conductors), all of which are good approximations to real-world coaxial cable in typical situations.

Illustration of electromagnetic power flow inside a coaxial cable according to the Poynting vector S, calculated using the electric field E (due to the voltage V) and the magnetic field H (due to current I).
The electric field in a transmission line complying with Snell's law.
DC power transmission through a coaxial cable showing relative strength of electric () and magnetic () fields and resulting Poynting vector () at a radius r from the center of the coaxial cable. The broken magenta line shows the cumulative power transmission within radius r, half of which flows inside the geometric mean of R1 and R2.
The central conductor is at voltage V and draws a current I toward the right, so we expect a total power flow of P = V · I according to basic laws of electricity. By evaluating the Poynting vector, however, we are able to identify the profile of power flow in terms of the electric and magnetic fields inside the coaxial cable. The electric field is zero inside of each conductor, but between the conductors (), symmetry dictates that it is in the radial direction and it can be shown (using Gauss's law) that they must obey the following form:

W can be evaluated by integrating the electric field from  to  which must be the negative of the voltage V:

so that:

![Image 2](https://wikimedia.org/api/rest_v1/media/math/render/svg/ac8a515de34f0af7d15de46f73bf674950d444a8)

The magnetic field, again by symmetry, can be non-zero only in the θ direction, that is, a vector field looping around the center conductor at every radius between R1 and R2. Inside the conductors themselves the magnetic field may or may not be zero, but this is of no concern since the Poynting vector in these regions is zero due to the electric field being zero. Outside the entire coaxial cable, the magnetic field is identically zero since paths in this region enclose a net current of zero (+I in the center conductor and −I in the outer conductor), and again the electric field is zero there anyway. Using Ampère's law in the region from R1 to R2, which encloses the current +I in the center conductor but with no contribution from the current in the outer conductor, we find at radius r:

Now, from an electric field in the radial direction, and a tangential magnetic field, the Poynting vector, given by the cross-product of these, is only non-zero in the Z direction, along the direction of the coaxial cable itself, as we would expect. Again only a function of r, we can evaluate S(r):

where W is given above in terms of the center conductor voltage V. The total power flowing down the coaxial cable can be computed by integrating over the entire cross section A of the cable in between the conductors:

Substituting the earlier solution for the constant W we find:

that is, the power given by integrating the Poynting vector over a cross section of the coaxial cable is exactly equal to the product of voltage and current as one would have computed for the power delivered using basic laws of electricity.
Other similar examples in which the P = V · I result can be analytically calculated are: the parallel-plate transmission line,[8] using Cartesian coordinates, and the two-wire transmission line,[9] using bipolar cylindrical coordinates.

![Image 3](https://wikimedia.org/api/rest_v1/media/math/render/svg/12a535a7bdc520ab5cfa9e856b5d61dade695ff4)

In the \

version of Maxwell's equations, this definition must be replaced by a definition in terms of the electric field E and the magnetic flux density B (described later in the article).
It is also possible to combine the electric displacement field D with the magnetic flux B to get the Minkowski form of the Poynting vector, or use D and H to construct yet another version. The choice has been controversial: Pfeifer et al.[10] summarize and to a certain extent resolve the century-long dispute between proponents of the Abraham and Minkowski forms (see Abraham–Minkowski controversy).
The Poynting vector represents the particular case of an energy flux vector for electromagnetic energy. However, any type of energy has its direction of movement in space, as well as its density, so energy flux vectors can be defined for other types of energy as well, e.g., for mechanical energy. The Umov–Poynting vector[11] discovered by Nikolay Umov in 1874 describes energy flux in liquid and elastic media in a completely generalized view.

The Poynting vector appears in Poynting's theorem (see that article for the derivation), an energy-conservation law:

where Jf is the current density of free charges and u is the electromagnetic energy density for linear, nondispersive materials, given by

where

E is the electric field;
D is the electric displacement field;
B is the magnetic flux density;
H is the magnetizing field.[12]: 258–260 
The first term in the right-hand side represents the electromagnetic energy flow into a small volume, while the second term subtracts the work done by the field on free electrical currents, which thereby exits from electromagnetic energy as dissipation, heat, etc. In this definition, bound electrical currents are not included in this term and instead contribute to S and u.
For light in free space, the linear momentum density is

![Image 4](https://wikimedia.org/api/rest_v1/media/math/render/svg/9a1ffcbe909cd08415207195e71d98bc2998d557)

For linear, nondispersive (in which all frequency components travel at the same speed) and isotropic (for simplicity) materials, the constitutive relations can be written as

where

ε is the permittivity of the material;
μ is the permeability of the material.[12]: 258–260 
Here ε and μ are scalar, real-valued constants independent of position, direction, and frequency.
In principle, this limits Poynting's theorem in this form to fields in vacuum and nondispersive linear materials.  A generalization to dispersive materials is possible under certain circumstances at the cost of additional terms.[12]: 262–264 
One consequence of the Poynting formula is that for the electromagnetic field to do work, both magnetic and electric fields must be present. The magnetic field alone or the electric field alone cannot do any work.[13]

In a propagating electromagnetic plane wave in an isotropic lossless medium, the instantaneous Poynting vector always points in the direction of propagation while rapidly oscillating in magnitude. This can be simply seen given that in a plane wave, the magnitude of the magnetic field H(r, t) is given by the magnitude of the electric field vector E(r, t) divided by η, the intrinsic impedance of the transmission medium:

where |A| represents the vector norm of A. Since E and H are at right angles to each other, the magnitude of their cross product is the product of their magnitudes. Without loss of generality let us take X to be the direction of the electric field and Y to be the direction of the magnetic field. The instantaneous Poynting vector, given by the cross product of E and H will then be in the positive Z direction:

![Image 5](https://wikimedia.org/api/rest_v1/media/math/render/svg/c3e6bb763d22c20916ed4f0bb6bd49d7470cffd8)

Finding the time-averaged power in the plane wave then requires averaging over the wave period (the inverse frequency of the wave):

where Erms is the root mean square (RMS) electric field amplitude. In the important case that E(t) is sinusoidally varying at some frequency with peak amplitude Epeak, Erms is , with the average Poynting vector then given by:

This is the most common form for the energy flux of a plane wave, since sinusoidal field amplitudes are most often expressed in terms of their peak values, and complicated problems are typically solved considering only one frequency at a time. However, the expression using Erms is totally general, applying, for instance, in the case of noise whose RMS amplitude can be measured but where the \

amplitude is meaningless. In free space the intrinsic impedance η is simply given by the impedance of free space η0 ≈ 377 Ω. In non-magnetic dielectrics (such as all transparent materials at optical frequencies) with a specified dielectric constant εr, or in optics with a material whose refractive index , the intrinsic impedance is found as:

In optics, the value of radiated flux crossing a surface, thus the average Poynting vector component in the direction normal to that surface, is technically known as the irradiance, more often simply referred to as the intensity (a somewhat ambiguous term).

Formulation in terms of microscopic fields[edit]
The \

(differential) version of Maxwell's equations admits only the fundamental fields E and B, without a built-in model of material media. Only the vacuum permittivity and permeability are used, and there is no D or H. When this model is used, the Poynting vector is defined as

![Image 6](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/0/09/CoaxPoyntingVector.png/960px-CoaxPoyntingVector.png)

where

μ0 is the vacuum permeability;
E is the electric field vector;
B is the magnetic flux.
This is actually the general expression of the Poynting vector[dubious – discuss].[14] The corresponding form of Poynting's theorem is

where J is the total current density and the energy density u is given by

where ε0 is the vacuum permittivity. It can be derived directly from Maxwell's equations in terms of total charge and current and the Lorentz force law only.
The two alternative definitions of the Poynting vector are equal in vacuum or in non-magnetic materials, where B = μ0H. In all other cases, they differ in that S = (1/μ0) E × B and the corresponding u are purely radiative, since the dissipation term −J ⋅ E covers the total current, while the E × H definition has contributions from bound currents which are then excluded from the dissipation term.[15]
Since only the microscopic fields E and B occur in the derivation of S = (1/μ0) E × B and the energy density, assumptions about any material present are avoided.  The Poynting vector and theorem and expression for energy density are universally valid in vacuum and all materials.[15]

Time-averaged Poynting vector[edit]
The above form for the Poynting vector represents the instantaneous power flow due to instantaneous electric and magnetic fields. More commonly, problems in electromagnetics are solved in terms of sinusoidally varying fields at a specified frequency. The results can then be applied more generally, for instance, by representing incoherent radiation as a superposition of such waves at different frequencies and with fluctuating amplitudes.
We would thus not be considering the instantaneous E(t) and H(t) used above, but rather a complex (vector) amplitude for each which describes a coherent wave's phase (as well as amplitude) using phasor notation. These complex amplitude vectors are not functions of time, as they are understood to refer to oscillations over all time. A phasor such as Em is understood to signify a sinusoidally varying field whose instantaneous amplitude E(t) follows the real part of Em ejωt where ω is the (radian) frequency of the sinusoidal wave being considered.
In the time domain, it will be seen that the instantaneous power flow will be fluctuating at a frequency of 2ω. But what is normally of interest is the average power flow in which those fluctuations are not considered. In the math below, this is accomplished by integrating over a full cycle T = 2π / ω. The following quantity, still referred to as a \

, is expressed directly in terms of the phasors as:

![Image 7](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/13/Electric_field_in_a_transmission_line_showing_skin_effect.png/250px-Electric_field_in_a_transmission_line_showing_skin_effect.png)

where ∗ denotes the complex conjugate. The time-averaged power flow (according to the instantaneous  Poynting vector averaged over a full cycle, for instance) is then given by the real part of Sm. The imaginary part is usually ignored[12][clarification needed], however, it signifies \

such as the interference due to a standing wave or the near field of an antenna. In a single electromagnetic plane wave (rather than a standing wave which can be described as two such waves travelling in opposite directions), E and H are exactly in phase, so Sm is simply a real number according to the above definition.
The equivalence of Re(Sm) to the time-average of the instantaneous Poynting vector S can be shown as follows.

The average of  the instantaneous Poynting vector S  over time is given by:

The second term is the double-frequency component having an average value of zero, so we find:

According to some conventions, the factor of 1/2 in the above definition may be left out. Multiplication by 1/2 is required to properly describe the power flow since the magnitudes of Em and Hm refer to the peak fields of the oscillating quantities. If rather the fields are described in terms of their root mean square (RMS) values (which are each smaller by the factor ), then the correct average power flow is obtained without multiplication by 1/2.

Resistive dissipation[edit]
If a conductor has significant resistance, then, near the surface of that conductor, the Poynting vector would be tilted toward and impinge upon the conductor.[9]: figs.7,8  Once the Poynting vector enters the conductor, it is bent to a direction that is almost perpendicular to the surface.[16]: 61  This is a consequence of Snell's law and the very slow speed of light inside a conductor. The definition and computation of the speed of light in a conductor can be given.[17]: 402  Inside the conductor, the Poynting vector represents energy flow from the electromagnetic field into the wire, producing resistive Joule heating in the wire. For a derivation that starts with Snell's law see Reitz page 454.[18]: 454 

![Image 8](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/f/f2/Coax-poynting.png/500px-Coax-poynting.png)

The density of the linear momentum of the electromagnetic field is S/c2 where S is the magnitude of the Poynting vector and c is the speed of light in free space. The radiation pressure exerted by an electromagnetic wave on the surface of a target is given by

Uniqueness of the Poynting vector[edit]
The Poynting vector occurs in Poynting's theorem only through its divergence ∇ ⋅ S, that is, it is only required that the surface integral of the Poynting vector around a closed surface describe the net flow of electromagnetic energy into or out of the enclosed volume. This means that adding a solenoidal vector field (one with zero divergence) to S will result in another field that satisfies this required property of a Poynting vector field according to Poynting's theorem. Since the  divergence of any curl is zero, one can add the curl of any vector field to the Poynting vector and the resulting vector field S′ will still satisfy Poynting's theorem.
However even though the Poynting vector was originally formulated only for the sake of Poynting's theorem in which only its divergence appears, it turns out that the above choice of its form is unique.[12]: 258–260, 605–612  The following section gives an example which illustrates why it is not acceptable to add an arbitrary solenoidal field to E × H.

Poynting vector in a static field, where E is the electric field, H the magnetic field, and S the Poynting vector.
The consideration of the Poynting vector in static fields shows the relativistic nature of the Maxwell equations and allows a better understanding of the magnetic component of the Lorentz force, q(v × B). To illustrate, the accompanying picture is considered, which describes the Poynting vector in a cylindrical capacitor, which is located in an H field (pointing into the page) generated by a permanent magnet. Although there are only static electric and magnetic fields, the calculation of the Poynting vector produces a clockwise circular flow of electromagnetic energy, with no beginning or end.
While the circulating energy flow may seem unphysical, its existence is necessary to maintain conservation of angular momentum. The momentum of an electromagnetic wave in free space is equal to its power divided by c, the speed of light. Therefore, the circular flow of electromagnetic energy implies an angular momentum.[19] If one were to connect a wire between the two plates of the charged capacitor, then there would be a Lorentz force on that wire while the capacitor is discharging due to the discharge current and the crossed magnetic field; that force would be circumferential to the central axis and thus add angular momentum to the system. That angular momentum would match the \

angular momentum, revealed by the Poynting vector, circulating before the capacitor was discharged.

Hola querida amiga, agradezco tanto que te hayas detenido aquí a dejarme estas cálidas palabras. 
No sabes lo impresionante que ha sido para mí tener un gato tan cerca, lo que para otros es natural o cotidiano, para mí es algo extraordinario.
Nunca olvidaré esa primera vez, cuando yo estaba distraída conversando con una colega y de repente la tenía a ella en mis piernas. Luego de mi sutil grito de susto, sentía el corazón acelerado y me quedé paralizada. Nunca imaginé vivir el escenario de un gato en mis piernas, jajaja.
Los animales me inspiran ternura, pero no me gusta la idea de encariñarme con ninguno y como dije antes, de asumir la responsabilidad de darles todo el cuidado que ellos necesitan, porque me conozco y sé que me tomaría todo a pecho.
Pienso que quien tiene un animalito debe cuidarlo como es debido y no hacerlo sufrir.
Un gran abrazo amiga 🤗

[Pixabay](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2020/10/19/18/57/red-rose-5668720_1280.jpg)


**Un nuevo sol cada mañana
derroche de luz y calor 
la vida nace temprana
en un destino de amor**

**Una sonrisa primero
al nacer nos encontramos
es el amor verdadero,
así es como comenzamos**

**Va caminando la vida
descubriendo la verdad
aprendiendo en la caida
el valor de la amistad**

**El amor llega a la puerta
sin presentar un aviso.
Nueva etapa se despierta
se cumple así el compromiso**

**Se alzan las manos unidas 
se construye un nuevo hogar 
con promesas compartidas 
que el tiempo ha de respetar** 

**Los hijos son la promesa
de un futuro prominente
ellos serán la cabeza
cuando tu ya estés ausente**

**El cabello ya es plateado
torpes se vuelven las manos 
otro nos dará el bocado
cuando ya somos ancianos**

**Llega noche inesperada,
se apaga el último aliento,
la historia ya fue contada
solo nos queda el lamento**

**Así el ciclo ya se cierra,
volveremos al origen,
el alma al cielo se aferra
donde los sueños dirigen**

title.title: 🍺 A Nymph in a Parisian Shop: How Corsican Kiara Won My Heart
title.body: > ![BEER.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm/23xetCdLuE16K2bPYMP4mMW5KY9eawhXkYt1T4RGUxGjqo78t4j4VaQdCnLhUGBoTzSMJ.png) At the beginning of May, I popped over to Paris for a day. As is usually the case with me, I immediately started scouting for local beer to add to my collection of travel souvenirs. I even found one perfect candidate, but the prospect of carrying a glass bottle around for half a day of intense sightseeing thoroughly cooled my enthusiasm. I let it go, naively assuming I’d just grab something at the shop next to the parking lot at the end of the day (as an aside: if anyone is looking for a cheap and safe parking spot in Paris, I’d happily share this secret location!). Unfortunately, there was no trace of my desired beer in the shop next to garage, and the local selection was completely barren. Somewhat defaultingly, I opted for **Kiara** from a craft brewery called *Kiara - La Petite Brasserie de Corse*. And you know what? It turned out to be one of the most pleasant surprises of the year. ![IMG_4691.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm/23yTonGKtw5BDJm2i4hEsSNjag9mZJA4Gw8xhFv8WPHCZEt66nj43hocChBitHX1Cp89G.jpg) ### 🔬 **Corsica, Aléria, and the Nymph of the Roman Lake** The brewery is located near Aléria, in Corsica. The beer's name refers to a mythological nymph who, according to legend, was born from the Étang de Diane (Diana's Lake)—an ancient lagoon located just a few hundred meters from the brewhouse. This is one of the most mysterious corners of Corsica, known since Etruscan times, where the Romans used to harvest oysters two thousand years ago. The legend of Kiara is deeply rooted in Corsican identity, and the name itself holds a dual meaning: in Italian, it signifies brightness and clarity (*chiara*), while in Corsican, it connects directly to local folklore. This isn't a cheap marketing gimmick. It’s a statement: this beer is born from this land, this water, and this air. ![IMG_4692.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm/AKuu9JeFjSfLFUyRTQFiQHQd39jrydo99dgqtkovS1YhYoh6sB5h1trFtBqUVgv.jpg) ### 👨‍🔧 **A Mechanic Who Learned from a Belgian Master** The mastermind behind the project is a Corsican under the age of thirty, Ghjuvan Petru Pieri. A mechanic by trade, he decided to ditch the spanners in favor of hops. He spent eight months learning the complex craft of brewing under the guidance of a renowned Belgian master. This explains his love for organic Belgian ingredients, which the brewery currently relies upon. As he admits: *“For now, we import, but our ultimate goal is to plant barley and malt it ourselves on-site. It’s a massive project that requires serious resources, but that’s exactly what we want to achieve: to boast a beer that is one hundred percent Corsican.”* ![IMG_4694.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm/242hfLcKzM8vEZkHqdhu6aFWcyPtiJrmV1GDeA2fPqvnYmConENoTtamH3XXYchAK2qdN.jpg) Ghjuvan develops the brewery alongside Michaël Mattei, and the entire adventure launched on the lands of the *Clos Poggiale* estate, managed by the main investor of the venture, Jean-François Renucci. The duo experimented heavily with different malts, yeasts, and fermentation temperatures while listening closely to consumer feedback. The result? On May 12, 2020, the proud founders posted an electrifying message on Facebook: their Kiara Bière Blonde had won a gold medal at the prestigious Frankfurt International Trophy in Germany. All this, less than a year into their brewing journey! ### 🌿 **Bière Kiara Blanche – Tasting Notes** Kiara's label catches your eye immediately—forget about boring, traditional folklore motifs. Instead, it features a clean, colorful, and contemporary design. But what’s inside the bottle? ![IMG_4695.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm/AK7yGJWVkMck1vpfAP4ZR7nuiGTy4W7UZaKmuRis4bNrXwATxaKWHhTvhQebQ35.jpg) * **Style and Profile:** This is a top-fermented Pale Ale (100% barley malt), unfiltered, sitting at 4,5% ABV, and delivering a genuine aromatic explosion. * **Appearance:** The beer pours a bright, golden, and incredibly luminous hue, topped with a delicate white head. * **Aroma:** Immediate, intense, and incredibly pleasant. It hits you with fresh mango, passion fruit, and a hint of citrus. No synthetic flavorings here—the well-selected hops do all the heavy lifting. * **Taste:** And here came the biggest surprise. Upon taking the first sip, I didn't expect a *bière blonde* to be this light yet so explosive in flavor. The bitterness is low and perfectly balanced, leading into a clean, refreshing finish with a lovely fruity echo. At 4,5% ABV, this beer is tailor-made for a scorching Corsican afternoon on the beach, but—as I had the chance to experience myself—it performs just as brilliantly during the recent Belgian heatwaves we've been having. ![IMG_4693.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm/23wgUE7iXjVAZDWhSdQAedC65DyFWbMQyYn4TBijKfPU5NePbXRqNwjMVzNKnXgdTMayE.jpg) ##### **📊 Technical Specifications:** | Parameter | Value | | --- | --- | | **Style** | Wheat Beer - Witbier / Blanche | | **Alcohol** | 4,5% ABV | | **Malt** | 100% Organic Barley Malt (from Belgium) | | **Fermentation** | Top-fermented, bottle-conditioned | | **Pasteurization** | Unpasteurized, unfiltered | | **Format** | 33 cl bottle | | **Brewery** | La Petite Brasserie de Corse, Aléria | ![IMG_4700.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm/23y8udDpzVmbNiynmUW9DrCk8LF718Hj5wPpJz38b4UnPdXsJqbt2YtSRE9c6BHCvZoyF.jpg) ### **Summary** Bière Kiara Blanche is a beer that wins you over with its authentic story and strong identity. Frankfurt doesn't award gold medals for good looks, and Ghjuvan Petru Pieri has proven he truly knows his way around a brew kettle. The marriage of Belgian expertise, organic ingredients, Corsican sunshine, and a dash of mythology from Diana's Lake has yielded an outstanding beer. Next time I'm in an ABC or a French supermarket, I will hunt for it with radar-like precision. I highly suggest you do the same! ![IMG_4699.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm/AK9QZEoeEXZEq84HXPpruUZKoVWDdaAfaQQTuMKg7YpvocMyjjLj1f3EsPFBXDS.jpg) **⭐ Rating: 9/10** --- #### [POLSKA WERSJA] ### **Nimfa w paryskim sklepie, czyli jak korsykańska Kiara podbiła moje serce** Na początku maja wyskoczyłem do Paryża na jednodniową wycieczkę. Jak to zwykle w moim przypadku bywa, od razu zacząłem rozglądać się za lokalnym piwem, które mogłoby zasilić moją kolekcję pamiątek z podróży. Znalazłem nawet jednego idealnego kandydata, ale wizja noszenia szklanej butelki przez pół dnia intensywnego zwiedzania skutecznie mnie schłodziła. Odpuściłem, uznając naiwnie, że kupię coś na sam koniec w sklepie obok parkingu (na marginesie: gdyby ktoś szukał taniego i bezpiecznego parkingu w Paryżu, chętnie podzielę się tą sekretną miejscówką!). Niestety, w sklepie obok parkingu po moim wymarzonym piwie nie było śladu, a z lokalnych marek ziało pustką. Trochę z braku laku zdecydowałem się na **Kiarę** z rzemieślniczego browaru *Kiara - La Petite Brasserie de Corse*. I wiecie co? To było jedno z najbardziej pozytywnych zaskoczeń tego roku. ![IMG_4691.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm/23yTonGKtw5BDJm2i4hEsSNjag9mZJA4Gw8xhFv8WPHCZEt66nj43hocChBitHX1Cp89G.jpg) ### **🏝️ Korsyka, Aléria i nimfa z rzymskiego jeziora** Browar mieści się nieopodal miejscowości Aléria na Korsyce. Sama nazwa piwa nawiązuje do mitologicznej nimfy, która wedle legendy narodziła się z Étang de Diane (jeziora Diany) – starożytnej laguny leżącej zaledwie kilkaset metrów od warzelni. To jeden z najbardziej tajemniczych zakątków wyspy, znany już Etruskom, gdzie Rzymianie dwa tysiące lat temu... hodowali ostrygi. Legenda o Kiarze jest głęboko zakorzeniona w korsykańskiej tożsamości, a samo imię brzmi dwojako: po włosku oznacza jasność i czystość (*chiara*), a po korsykańsku odsyła wprost do lokalnych mitów. To nie jest tani chwyt marketingowy. To deklaracja: to piwo rodzi się z tutejszej ziemi, wody i powietrza. ![IMG_4692.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm/AKuu9JeFjSfLFUyRTQFiQHQd39jrydo99dgqtkovS1YhYoh6sB5h1trFtBqUVgv.jpg) ### **👨‍🔧 Mechanik, który uczył się od belgijskiego mistrza** Za całym zamieszaniem stoi niespełna trzydziestoletni Korsykanin Ghjuvan Petru Pieri. Z zawodu mechanik, który postanowił porzucić klucze francuskie na rzecz chmielu. Sztuki warzenia uczył się przez osiem miesięcy pod okiem jednego z uznanych belgijskich mistrzów. Stąd też jego miłość do belgijskich surowców BIO, na których obecnie bazuje browar. Jak sam przyznaje: *„Na razie importujemy, ale docelowo chcemy sadzić jęczmień i słodować go samodzielnie na miejscu. To ogromny projekt, wymagający zasobów, ale dokładnie do tego dążymy: chcemy pokazać światu produkt w stu procentach korsykański”*. ![IMG_4694.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm/242hfLcKzM8vEZkHqdhu6aFWcyPtiJrmV1GDeA2fPqvnYmConENoTtamH3XXYchAK2qdN.jpg) Ghjuvan rozwija browar wspólnie z Michaëlem Mattei, a cała przygoda zaczęła się na ziemiach posiadłości *Clos Poggiale*, należącej do głównego inwestora, Jean-Françoisa Renucciego. Chłopaki od początku kombinowali z różnymi słodami, drożdżami i temperaturami, uważnie słuchając swoich klientów. Efekt? 12 maja 2020 roku dumni założyciele wrzucili na Facebooka elektryzującą wiadomość: ich Kiara Bière Blonde zdobyła złoty medal na prestiżowym konkursie Frankfurt International Trophy w Niemczech. I to niespełna rok po uwarzeniu pierwszej warki! ### **🌿 Bière Kiara Blanche – degustacja** Etykieta Kiary od razu rzuca się w oczy – zapomnijcie o nudnych, tradycyjnych motywach folklorystycznych. Mamy tu czystą, nowoczesną i pełną kolorów grafikę. A co w środku? ![IMG_4695.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm/AK7yGJWVkMck1vpfAP4ZR7nuiGTy4W7UZaKmuRis4bNrXwATxaKWHhTvhQebQ35.jpg) * **Styl i parametry:** To klasyczne pale ale górnej fermentacji (100% słodu jęczmiennego), niefiltrowane, o mocy 4,5% ABV, które funduje nam prawdziwą aromatyczną eksplozję. * **Wygląd:** Piwo mieni się jasną, złocistą i niezwykle świetlistą barwą. Jest klarowne, zwieńczone delikatną, białą pianą. * **Aromat:** Natychmiastowy, intensywny i cholernie przyjemny. Uderza świeże mango, marakuja i lekki cytrus. Zero sztucznych aromatów – całą robotę robią tu dobrze dobrane chmiele. * **Smak:** I tu nastąpiło największe zaskoczenie. Po pierwszym łyku nie spodziewałem się, że to *bière blonde* okaże się tak lekkie, a jednocześnie tak potężne w smaku. Goryczka jest niska, idealnie zbalansowana, a finisz czysty, rześki, z bardzo przyjemnym, owocowym echem. Przy 4,5% alkoholu to piwo stworzone na upalne, korsykańskie południe na plaży, ale – jak miałem okazję sprawdzić na własnej skórze – przy belgijskich upałach, które ostatnio nas nawiedziły, sprawdza się równie genialnie. ![IMG_4693.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm/23wgUE7iXjVAZDWhSdQAedC65DyFWbMQyYn4TBijKfPU5NePbXRqNwjMVzNKnXgdTMayE.jpg) ##### **📊 Parametry techniczne:** | Parametr | Wartość | | --- | --- | | **Styl** | Wheat Beer - Witbier / Blanche | | **Alkohol** | 4,5% ABV | | **Słód** | 100% słód jęczmienny BIO (z Belgii) | | **Fermentacja** | Górna, refermentacja w butelce | | **Pasteryzacja** | Niepasteryzowane, niefiltrowane | | **Format** | Butelka 33 cl | | **Browar** | La Petite Brasserie de Corse, Aléria | ![IMG_4700.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm/23y8udDpzVmbNiynmUW9DrCk8LF718Hj5wPpJz38b4UnPdXsJqbt2YtSRE9c6BHCvZoyF.jpg) ### **Podsumowanie** Bière Kiara Blanche to piwo, które wygrywa autentyczną historią i mocną tożsamością. Frankfurt nie daje złotych medali za ładne oczy, a Ghjuvan Petru Pieri udowodnił, że doskonale wie, wokół którego gara się kręci. Belgijska szkoła, ekologiczne surowce, korsykańskie słońce i szczypta mitologii z jeziora Diany dały nam piwo wybitne. Następnym razem we francuskich sklepach będę go szukał z radarową precyzją. Wam polecam zrobić to samo! ![IMG_4699.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm/AK9QZEoeEXZEq84HXPpruUZKoVWDdaAfaQQTuMKg7YpvocMyjjLj1f3EsPFBXDS.jpg) **⭐ Ocena: 9/10** --- ### **My beers in 2026:** ***Austria*** - title.title: Mummy is for Everyone
title.body:
There are days she feels stressed out, but a cry from her little child sends a fresh burst of energy through her body.  
She rises to the situation to listen, attend, and resolve the problem. She tries not to take sides but ensures peace prevails between siblings. She intervenes with much love to ensure safety and unity.

There is no written standard or manual for motherhood but they sure do the best with everything placed in their hands.

This week she could barely get a good night's sleep, but the peace that shuns the chaos is knowing her children are doing fine again.

It’s like her heart starts working better and life just got back from pause.

One way I release my bottled up emotions is to write what comes to mind.  
Yes, I decided to commend and self-pat every mother holding everyone up.  

A man once said: \

And he was right.

A mother’s tale cannot tell it all. Her strength is sometimes shaky, but her faith and zeal are so strong.  
They are often the last to sleep and the first to wake up to prepare them for school, remind them about the early morning flight, interview, or a job.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU4tES5bzpVnigDsZfVMvPPg6ercCY4evbhifgDKdNUmQ/1780161877358.jpg)

In their minds is an endless quest for perfection, orderliness and beauty.  

They create a chore roster more than a food timetable, all in a bid to conquer dirt, fear, failure, and even generate support to keep the family afloat together.

With each passing day the chores increase, the laundry basket fills again, and the groceries soon run out. There stands a human being on duty 24/7, 365 days a year plus she nurses — some even dare till two years or more.  
They carry their young in their body, heart, arms, and lips forever.
O my child, they rarely forget birthdays because it was also their birth thirst.

The mother wears many caps, but only few put feathers on them.

Here I am letting every mother know that you are capable, beautiful, and amazingly the best mother ever.  
Sending you love, endless happiness, money, and good health.
Stay strong and sassy 🥂💐

Dear mothers, what is the one thing that you do when you get overwhelmed?

title.title: Desfrán – Day 70
title.body:
<center>



The three plants have been in the ground for nearly a month now, and are well adjusted. They are forming massive leaves, and shooting off new growth every time I visit them. We got some good rain in the last week and I am happy to see them standing strong afterwards, one of the storms was quite strong so I am thinking if they can handle that they will be good to handle just about anything thrown at them at this point. I am going to start a new seedling to fill in the hole that is empty. I think I have given it long enough to see if the new seed would come up. Honestly it was a very small seed compared to the others of that strain. So maybe it was a dud.

https://i.postimg.cc/3rFyT9Mz/20260530-115512.jpg



https://i.postimg.cc/hj4MPVZP/A1.png Strain:|Desfrán |
-|-|
https://i.postimg.cc/3NVZBV8d/B3.png Dominance: | 100% sativa
https://i.postimg.cc/FRPpf1wb/C2.png Nutrients used: | Happy Frog Soil / Ocean Forest soil. Big Bloom, Grow big:All FoxFarm products.
https://i.postimg.cc/D08g1nK9/D3.png Lineage: | Destroyer x Meao Thai landrace
https://i.postimg.cc/KcHQxkPx/E2.png Current growing stage: | Vegetative |
https://i.postimg.cc/8Pf45p4W/F1.png Current plant age: | 70 days old
https://i.postimg.cc/vZRzxJ2K/G2.png Sex: | Feminized
https://i.postimg.cc/YC1x6dJC/H1.png Location: | Central Virginia


https://i.postimg.cc/J0xt57cK/20260530-115454.jpg

Now we can start to see them from further away, last time you could barely see them among the mulch pile.

https://i.postimg.cc/v8t1sXFR/20260530-115516.jpg

They are a strong green color now, I think the pots they were in were stressing them previously. So now they are quite happy with their new holes they live in outside.

https://i.postimg.cc/G3xBCz0Z/20260530-115521.jpg

I love waiting a few day and coming out to check on them, always surprised by their growth. When I grow indoors I tend to check on them every day, so its more uprising when I grow outside.

https://i.postimg.cc/DfPWT5kk/20260530-115523.jpg

At this point in the grow I always wonder how big they will be by the end.

https://i.postimg.cc/mZycsVf4/20260530-115527.jpg

You cannot really smell them unless you handle the leaves at this point, but soon you will smell them from a far.

https://i.postimg.cc/DfPWT5kf/20260530-115531.jpg

Now they have all this new growth, and leaves fan leaves forming. They are going to become very thirsty.


https://i.postimg.cc/44QKgwkN/20260530-115602.jpg

I am trying to water them every three to four days right now. But soon they will need water almost every day if not every other at the very least.

https://i.postimg.cc/mZycsVfF/20260530-115605.jpg

Too bad that seed did not come up, it was the last of that strain. So whatever I plant will be something a little different.

https://i.postimg.cc/Y2z4H8KW/20260530-115632.jpg

Hoping they all get big enough for me to use the framing I built around them.

https://i.postimg.cc/7YP5Y7wh/20260530-115647.jpg

I still have a bunch of netting I can use, but honestly I may just let them grow to full size and just see how it plays out.

https://i.postimg.cc/dtQhtdwD/20260530-115706.jpg

Until I get the bud rot situation fixed in my outdoor flower portion of my grows no point to build out the netting and scrog them.

https://i.postimg.cc/BQZjQD4L/20260530-115730.jpg

A comparison to how big the fan leaves are now, I love seeing them grow. They are loving the light as much as my solar panels.. :-P

body.title: Humanity and Sacrifice | A Quick Eid Update!
body.body:
### Hey Hivers! 

I have been a bit late here I wanted to share why, along with a few thoughts that have been on my mind.

I have been thinking about what it really means to give. To me the ultimate test of faith is choosing the exact same good things for others that we would choose for ourselves. It’s not just a nice saying it’s a proper mindset that should guide everything we do from helping a stranger to supporting our own friends or relatives.

The real meaning of sacrifice is giving up something we love for a bigger and better cause. In Islam sacrifice isn't just about the physical ritual. It’s a way to get closer to God and earn His pleasure. *There is a beautiful verse in the Holy Quran that says* **neither the meat nor the blood reaches God, but what truly reaches Him is your piety and pure intentions.**


We can see the greatest example of this in the story of Prophet Abraham and his son Prophet Ismael. When God tested them both father and son completely trusted the divine plan. Sadly nowadays a lot of people focus so much on the ritual but they forget the actual spirit behind it the deep devotion and the heartfelt conversation they had which is the main thing Father was going to sacrifice his own son for the sake of his Almighty.

With everyone facing tough economic times right now the world can feel a bit selfish. That’s why true sacrifice today means stepping outside our own desires to help humanity. It’s about treating people with the same respect love and empathy we want for ourselves. That’s the most beautiful kind of giving to give the same exact thing we choose for ourselves.


## My Eid Days: No Sleep, Qurbani, and Catching Up with Friends

This brings me to **Eid-Ul-Adha** which we just celebrated! For those who might not know this is a major Muslim festival centered entirely around this beautiful concept of devotion, charity and sharing with the community.

Because of Eid my schedule went completely out the window which is why I couldn't sit down to write a proper post but I spent some of my time to engage with others! 

Here is a little peek into how I spent my days:

To be honest, **the night before Eid, I didn’t sleep at all.** I stayed up the whole night. Right after offering the Eid prayers in the morning we got straight to work with the Qurbani which is the main thing of this Eid.

Once that was done it was time to distribute the meat. I made sure that whatever we packed and gave to others was *exactly* the same quality as what we kept for our own home. No picking the best parts for ourselves everything was shared equally and honestly that is the true spirit of sacrifice after all.

By the time we finished everything I was completely running on empty. I crashed so hard that I didn't wake up until 5:00 PM the next evening. Once I finally woke up and rubbed the sleep out of my eyes I met up with my friends and we went out to hang to relax and to enjoy the Eid vibes.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaxxXtLwww9xGY1oPDPWkfKpjoc5EvdwYiVEZ4knGwdiU/1780161123458.jpg)


And just like that the days flew by in a blur of duties with family and friends. It was busy and tiring but incredibly rewarding.




### How was your week? How do you try to bring a little bit of selflessness into your daily routine? Let me know in the comments!

El negro es un color que muchos asocian con la tristeza o la formalidad, pero para mí representa fuerza, elegancia y también un lienzo en blanco. Sí, en blanco. Porque vestir de negro me recuerda que puedo pintar mi día con los colores que yo elija: optimismo, gratitud, amor y resiliencia.

Black is a color that many associate with sadness or formality, but for me, it represents strength, elegance, and also a blank canvas. Yes, a blank canvas. Because wearing black reminds me that I can paint my day with the colors I choose: optimism, gratitude, love, and resilience.

body.title: Mother Mary - 2026 || This Movie is Worth Your Worship || [Movie Review]
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUdkHazTHVLFd9PkuQBiDQVALRJErZw3C6XSEdWhYu2du/1780161201747.jpg)

Mother Mary 🤔 where am I gonna start? Okay let me ask you this? Have you watched a movie that reach into your chest, grip something you didn't even know was sitting there unresolved, and just hold it  just to make you look at it. Mother Mary is the second kind. It's the kind of A24 film that will split a room completely down the middle, and honestly, I understand both sides. But let me tell you what happened. Let me actually walk you through it, because this one deserves that.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfYVMFUTRLVs3nyJD4uT2uxM1LLJ7yB2RrETJ6MTTJNzv/1780161438825.jpg)


The film opens with Sam Anselm — played by Michaela Coel in a performance that honestly should be illegal — speaking bitterly to an unseen listener, laying bare a sentiment that she deserves neither love nor hate.  It's a cold, strange way to open a movie. No context nor warmth just a woman and her unprocessed grief dressed up as indifference and then — the film shifts to a dazzling scene with pop icon Mother Mary, performed by Anne Hathaway, singing her song \

to a chorus of devoted fans.  

 The contrast is immediate and jarring and completely intentional. One woman in the shadows of something that broke her. One woman blinding in the spotlight. And the film quietly whispers — these two were once inseparable.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd1772zFP8b2pV2rui8y4cch4DX49NVK841mA4x1rAo5G/1780161454197.jpg)


Before Mother Mary became the iconic pop star she is at the start of the movie, she and Sam were best friends, soulmates in the truest artistic sense. Mother Mary as the singer and songwriter, and Sam as the designer who created MM's image through fashion and fabric. 


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZqiJxEyGtFUBfTT1wG53BxbQfEWT82UR4WqLrU63NLNs/1780161465740.jpg)

They made each other famous and then, at their peak, Mother Mary broke the relationship.  She said she wanted to express herself differently and Sam, Sam had to watch the person she built walk away and keep shining without her, I felt that in my spine.

Mary is planning a bold comeback after a troubling onstage fall that had rumors swirling about a possible suicide attempt. In the days leading to her return, she frets over the dress she must wear — a piece that must somehow feel like her again. Her travels take her to London, where the urgency pushes her toward a reunion with the designer she hasn't seen in over a decade and so Sam and Mary are back in the same room for the first time in years and you can feel every inch of the distance between them.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmexBW61rxkHYDCQvXRGEVDuztx6cs6dB6JXdhtN1ShKnk/1780161476587.jpg)


Old resentments are laid bare as a vengeful Sam forces Mary to confront the end of their creative partnership. Despite launching Mary's career together, Sam was denied credit and cut out of her inner circle entirely.  That detail lands like a slap the woman who dressed you, who built you, who poured her entire artistic soul into your image — erased. Like she never existed. I sat with that for a long time because I've seen versions of that story in real life. The uncredited woman, the invisible collaborator. It is one of the oldest and cruelest betrayals in creative spaces.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbX2McHEr9ixyc4HXcTs3R3BDaZbF6jUXFyCrDzqs3jmQ/1780161486418.jpg)


Then the supernatural element arrives, and this is where Mother Mary becomes something else entirely. When Sam goes to see Mary perform one last time, the pain cracks something within her. She grinds her teeth so hard her molars crack. After the broken teeth are extracted, something revelatory happens. Her open wounds become an escape hatch for the resentment that has literally been gestating in her body — taking the form of a swath of red fabric. A ghost made of grief.  I know that sounds wild. It is wild but it is also one of the most poetic visual metaphors I have ever seen for what unprocessed heartbreak actually does to a person's body.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmam4rVZpdTZPaAMPhoawefWTQfw3AtUaz7QVxGy9NHay2/1780161497248.jpg)


Mary then recalls meeting a fan named Imogen played by FKA Twigs — who leads her into a séance. The women summon a spirit that possesses Imogen, who takes Mary's hand and cuts it. The red ghost appears and tries to enter her wound, but Mary escapes — for now. During her last concert, the ghost appears again, causing her fall.  Nobody can see the red ghost but Sam and Mary.  Only the two people who shared that wound.

And then the ending. Oh my my, the ending. Sam leads a reluctant Mary in a ritual to exorcise the spirit using her dressmaking tools. Taking Sam's shears, Mary slices open her own chest and Sam pulls out the ghost — turning the spirit of their mutual trauma into harmless fabric. Mary apologises for having wronged Sam. Her team rushes her to the show and Sam, alone, crafts the red fabric into a dress.  
The final look features a red dress made from fabric infused with the red spirit — symbolising transformation and release. The film closes on this eerie, image.

Art made from the wreckage of a broken relationship. Pain turned into something you can wear. David Lowery described this film as being about how art can take something terrible and turn it into something beautiful and somehow, impossibly, it does exactly that.

body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdWSh6teccKceWMV8U37S3UCivSeN3nDZvdtp7cfBEYV7/img_3921.jpg)

Hi, great minds.
I’m truly delighted to be a part of this community.
My name is Dada Iyanuoluwa Openheaven, though I’m popularly known as “Heaven.” I’m a 21-year-old from Lagos, Nigeria, born on the 11th of October into a family of six. Originally, I’m from Ekiti State in the western part of Nigeria, popularly known as Yoruba Land.
Interestingly, if I were asked to speak deeply about my indigenous culture, I might struggle a little, as I was born and raised in Lagos and have mostly experienced life in the city.
Currently, I work as a personal aide to my Area Youth Pastor, a role that has helped me grow in responsibility, service, and leadership.
I am currently studying guidance and counseling at one of the prestigious universities in Lagos, Nigeria-Lagos State University of Education, Epe campus, 200lv.
 Additionally, I have a strong interest in tech, which led me to develop my skills in coding using HTML (HyperText Markup Language) and CSS (Cascading Style Sheets) to create and clone web interfaces, produce basic graphic designs for small businesses, social media posts, and friends. I earned an online certificate in product management and completed a two-week training in project management. Currently, I am learning software testing. Developing these skills, even if some are not yet at an expert level, has given me valuable exposure and shown me that life favors those who believe in self-development to become valuable assets.
My writing style is deeply influenced by my melancholic personality. I have little interest in writing stories, fiction, articles, or essays, but I am very passionate about creating pieces that captivate readers, challenge their perspectives, and encourage them to be objective, logical, rational, and critical in their thinking.

body.title: MLB:  El jonrón como solución  [ESP/ENG]  ||  OPINION
body.body:
La zafra acaba de redondear su primer tercio (Increíble ¿verdad?) y algo ha quedado en evidencia: los lanzadores han tenido ventaja. Cuando cambió la regla de tiempo entre lanzamientos, se preveía un largo período de ajuste para los pitchers que les llevaría un par de temporadas. No ha sido así. Primordialmente, porque la regla se viene usando desde hace un quinquenio en las menores. Así las cosas, los equipos se han visto en dificultades a la hora de hacer carreras. Ya la baja ofensiva no puede ser explicada por bates fríos propios de la temporada estival. Y tanto dependen ahora los equipos del jonrón para anotar carreras que ayer, en una inusitada jornada, 4 encuentros de pelota fueron resueltos con cuadrangulares de oro. Se le dice así, al jonrón conectado para dejar en el terreno al equipo contrario. El contingente venezolano tuvo una jornada donde ejemplificó los tres tipos de cuadrangular existentes que cambian la cara de un partido. Vamos a explicarlos. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     The campaign has just crossed the first-third mark (wild, right?) and one thing is crystal clear: pitching has the upper hand. When the pitch clock rule rolled out, everyone expected a brutal learning curve for the arms on the bump, thinking it would take a couple of seasons to adjust. Not quite. Mainly because these guys have been working under that clock for five years down in the minors. Because of that, ballclubs are absolutely scratching for runs. You can't just blame the lack of offense on early-season cold bats anymore. Teams are relying so heavily on the long ball to push runs across that yesterday, in a bizarre slate of games, four matchups were decided by walk-off homers. That's the golden blast that leaves the road team out on the field. The Venezuelan contingent had a day that perfectly showcased the three types of game-changing big flies. Let's break them down.

# ---

![Acuña.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/23w2oCqCrsThj8dMEwAKKMUEDJcHK4ZPFPmKnbDQKAyEjsPV2gcY8LJYB26eToNpJ35Rt.jpg) Screenshot from [video](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/braves-vs-reds/2026/05/29/824515/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
#
     El jonrón básico adelanta a un equipo por una carrera. Ronald Acuña Jr. lo hizo. Por segundo día consecutivo el tipo se voló la cerca, pero en ésta oportunidad lo logró al 4to. lanzamiento del partido de los Bravos de Atlanta visitando a los Rojos de Cincinnati, en cuenta de 1-2 sin gente en base. Una curva a 79 MPH cayendo hacia sus tobillos, fue devuelta con swing de gradas por encima de la pared del jardín izquierdo del Great American Ballpark, a una distancia de 429 pies desde la goma. Significó una carrera para adelantar a los indígenas, en un partido que terminaron ganando por marcador de 8-3 sobre los Reds. Con la victoria, los Bravos siguen manteniendo el mejor balance de ganados y perdidos de todas las mayores y lideran sin despeinarse el este de la liga Nacional. La derrota pone a los Rojos a 6 juegos de la vanguardia del centro de la misma liga. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

      The solo shot gives a team a one-run lead. Ronald Acuña Jr. did just that. For the second straight day, the guy went yard, but this time he did it on the fourth pitch of the ballgame with the Atlanta Braves visiting the Cincinnati Reds, on a 1-2 count with nobody on. A 79 MPH curveball breaking down toward his ankles was turned around with a moonshot swing over the left-field wall at Great American Ball Park, traveling 429 feet from home plate. That big fly put the Braves on top in a game they ended up winning by a final score of 8-3 over the Reds. With the W, Atlanta keeps holding the best record in all of the majors and is absolutely cruising at the top of the National League East. The loss drops the Reds six games back of the lead in the NL Central.

# ---

![Chourio.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/23vhsZ9xo6pD4enMhyzKmGogv1HsXugP3qLavCgrACY6UvD5LLTsjvXh2iRPFpE6fRDMi.jpg) Screenshot from [video](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/brewers-vs-astros/2026/05/29/824191/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
     El jonrón de múltiples carreras para acercar a un equipo en el marcador y le entrega oportunidad para ganar el juego. Éste espécimen fue ejemplificado por el jardinero central venezolano de los Cerveceros de Milwaukee Jackson Chourio. Alta de la quinta entrada de visita en Daikin Park y perdiendo por marcador de 4-1 ante los Astros de Houston. Con un hombre en primera, el lanzador sideral cometió la equivocación de lanzarle una sweeper a 84 MPH por el medio del plato ¿resultado? El maracucho hizo un swing demoledor que hizo volar la pelota hasta los pasillos del segundo piso, donde se encuentra el área de comida rápida en los jardines, para acercar un marcador a 4-3 todavía debajo pero por una carrera. Más tarde, los lupulosos empataron en el octavo y voltearon el juego en el décimo, para una trabajada victoria de 5-4. Los Cerveceros han encontrado la fórmula de hacer carreras sin jonrones, pero cuando éstos aparecen son bienvenidos. Lideran la central de la Americana 4.5 juegos por encima de los sorprendentes Cardenales. Houston está a 3.5 juegos de los Marineros. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     A multi-run blast shrinks the deficit and puts a team back in striking distance. This type of big fly was showcased by the Milwaukee Brewers' Venezuelan center fielder, Jackson Chourio. Top of the fifth on the road at Daikin Park, trailing 4-1 against the Houston Astros. With a runner on first, the Houston hurler made the mistake of leaving an 84 MPH sweeper right down the pipe. The result? The Maracaibo native put a violent swing on it, launching a missile into the second-deck concourse right by the outfield food court, cutting the deficit to 4-3—still down, but just by a run. Later on, the Brew Crew tied it up in the eighth and flipped the script in the tenth for a hard-fought 5-4 win. Milwaukee has found a recipe for scratching across runs without relying solely on the long ball, but when they leave the yard, they’re more than welcome. They lead the NL Central by 4.5 games over the surprising Cardinals, while Houston sits 3.5 games back of the Mariners.

---

![Tovar.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/23tvgfExQasd5E4AzgedhMYFM9av3xSaSukDLHcEfUByD4YMarfD8VvmvEHuJJmVCLcRs.jpg) Screenshot from [video](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/giants-vs-rockies/2026/05/29/824353/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
     Finalmente, está el cuadrangular más dramático. Ese que sirve para apagar las luces del estadio e irse a descansar. Pero en el caso del campocorto venezolano Ezequiel Tovar, fue mucho más espectacular, porque lo hizo por partida doble: Al comenzar el octavo de los Rockies en Denver, perdían 4-1 vs. los Gigantes. Con un hombre en primera, Tovar pescó una recta de cuatro costuras a 95 MPH y la mandó a volar por todo el jardín central a 441 pies del plato, para un dantesco jonrón que puso las cosas 4-3. Pero los Gigantes no se quedaron quietos y fabricaron dos más para alejarse en el noveno 6-3. Luego de que su compañero Hunter Goodman empatara las cosas con cuadrangular de 3, Tovar vino a batear en el noveno con uno en base. Lo que sucedió a continuación parece guión sacado de película de Hollywood: Ezequiel esperó sentado una curva de nudillos a 81 MPH y le dio con el alma a esa pelota en conteo de 1-3, para un estacazo de 406 pies, ordenando que las luces del estadio se apagaran. Ciertamente los Rockies no irán a postemporada, pero tendrán recuerdos mágicos sobre ésta linda victoria. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     Finally, you have the most dramatic big fly of them all—the one that lets you turn out the lights and head home. But in the case of Venezuelan shortstop Ezequiel Tovar, it was way more spectacular because he pulled off a double dose of magic. Heading into the bottom of the eighth in Denver, the Rockies were trailing 4-1 against the Giants. With a runner on first, Tovar hunted down a 95 MPH four-seamer and absolutely crushed it to dead center field, a 441-foot monster shot that made it a 4-3 ballgame. But the Giants wouldn't go away quietly, scratching across two more in the top of the ninth to push their lead to 6-3. After his teammate Hunter Goodman tied things up with a clutch three-run blast, Tovar stepped up to the dish in the bottom of the frame with a man on base. What happened next felt straight out of a Hollywood script: Ezequiel sat all over an 81 MPH knuckle-curve on a 1-3 count and put his whole soul into that ball, launching a 406-foot walk-off tank to turn the lights out. The Rockies certainly aren't postseason bound, but they'll have plenty of magical memories from this beautiful victory.

#

####      ¡Gracias por leer..! // Thank you for read..! #

body.title: Hardcore Townsmen! #10 The Bandit Counterattack [ENG🇬🇧|ESP🇻🇪]
body.body:
> Hello Hive Gamers! Today I bring you the 10th part of my hardcore Townsmen run. I had barely finished my latest constructions when the bandits attacked the village again, and this time they came in full force. The guards managed to intercept one group near the castle and repelled them, but another group reached the houses in the east. Just before they could loot my resources, a guard arrived and pushed them back. # ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW9XstpmHNC9VUutMHazzjsMD5vZWvYRaFj5NsHqePkvh/1780114027191.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcuiu6Meo8k8JN3dm3XNphxc43CBWBThJ29GqR6XbUA1P/1780114053182.jpg) However, even though they were defeated, they left me a serious problem. Some of them managed to set buildings on fire before leaving. They torched my brand-new tool workshop and one of the wool farms in the east. Both buildings were outside the range of my fire towers, so I had to act fast to avoid losing that massive investment. # ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVj2R9q8nh6bJErvz3W2UdQvcmmNJbrrTXv74geoarmJ2/1780114078583.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXVfY2HrSjdeU2Yat1oRqSnkcHDd6sNAPRdGPziV2W6Gq/1780114078700.jpg) I ordered the construction of new fire towers immediately. In record time, the townnies built them and put out the flames, completely saving the gold and materials I had invested in those structures. The production is back on track, but this was a clear warning. I need to urgently invest in better equipment for the city guard and increase the number of soldiers if I want to survive the next waves. In this winter, one mistake can cost you the entire game. # ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWDn6hH2Ymixbf8gcQZF9eyKDeyB9p1N4NZmxLxfERnbE/1780114137863.jpg) |

body.title: Resident Evil: Zero [Let's Play] - 02 - Stinger
body.body:
*The scorpion fight was easier than I thought it'd be.*

----

**Resident Evil: Zero** is a prequel to the Resident Evil series set right before the mansion incident. The game follows the new STARS member Rebecca and the wanted criminal Billy as they try to survive zombie outbreak! **RE0** features a Dual Protagonists system letting the player switch seamlessly between Rebecca and Billy. Most puzzles require coordination between the two characters.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmb51ZWXX1A9cHzfW8XHHjkeTSo2BSUjSYerQZHauNLQzz/1000072766.webp 

 
I played RE trilogy for the PS1 when I was younger and the first Remake for a bit... But this is the first time I play **Zero.** As I played, I was surprised at how much this game adds to the lore, especially for Umbrella Corp. while still doing its own thing. There are fewer zombies in this game, instead there's a lot of Leeches and feral animals.

While I'd recommend this game to Resident Evil fans, I'm not too fond of how slow the game feels. Too much backtracking. Some Puzzles feel like too much filler, but I loved a few puzzles in my playthrough. I used a guide when I got stuck though... You can watch my playthrough below:


----

body.title: Desayuno criollo venezolano: Queso blanco, perico, arepa y café con leche [ESP/ENG]
body.body: # Desayuno criollo venezolano: Queso blanco, perico, arepa y café con leche [ESP/ENG]\n\n<div class=\

>

Hola amigos amantes de la cocina y que día a día me leen en la comunidad de @hivefood, espero que todos pasen un feliz fin de semana junto a sus seres queridos. Sean todos bienvenidos a mi blog.

![25.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23tbwM8GtD3xUNfY6vAfiTv94iqppU4opLELR6Jb2DtPbu1LutmZkPSBGCFFWeDAaT3S5.jpg)

Hoy les traigo un delicioso y muy criollo desayuno al estilo venezolano: Huevos con tomate y cebolla popularmente llamado perico, acompañado de queso blanco rallado, las tradicionales y venezolanas arepas y de bebida una taza de café con leche popularmente llamado blanquito.

![23.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Eokf7386iT3UZZUV9J4Y5CaikhdgGYUh1QCkhP76LGLVbSQ1EsMx5kh4c8LNp63S7Dy.jpg)

Un desayuno es la primera comida del día: es el clásico, este que hoy les presento es el auténtico y reconfortante Desayuno Venezolano tradicional y sabroso. Representa el calor de hogar, la mezcla perfecta entre lo crujiente, lo jugoso y el abrazo que da el café recién colado y agregándole leche aun  mas deliciosos.

![20.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoeHHsN9S2GLqnCtzuxaw2kVaA3xmvgkkoSTnsKqPbojmrFPHvmgiHQr4KGKEoUhWYm.jpg)

![21.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23yd1Z7uK4vQD1bcSdqFjJzpPt7oGfZP8RxbjNCJZxJ6fMt6uyLvHaGmgNmYXMfdGNF9r.jpg)|![22.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23tvnk7FxEfdWUMHpm6yCeUJmJukcAhPkfgBcAE2fDjKkWZ281fvqxnNVdhY5VKnWfrJL.jpg)
-|-

Ahora paso a nombrarle los ingredientes y el paso a paso para obtener este crujiente, nutritivo y deliciosos desayuno.

# Ingredientes
* 3 huevos de tamaño mediano
* 1 tomate grande
* 1/4 de cebolla blanca
* 100 gramos de queso rayado blanco
* harina de maiz
* cafe
* leche
* 2 cuharadas de aceite
* sal al gusto

![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EpGRc7RsCfUFXaatAvNAKmhjz7hWurvEXKJJeHCMCuSsnC3XcaP65hrKQohEVrTRJZD.jpg)

# procedimiento

lo primero que hice fue hacer las arepas, buscando un tazón agregando agua , sal y la harina, luego empecé amasar  cunado estaba no muy dura sino con una textura suave hice ls arepas y luego en una plancha bien caliente y engrasada las coloque para que se cocinaran, tardaron aproximadamente 30 minutos porque a mi me gustan crujientes.

![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoryKyxYDh94qpiwyGE1UKysNuinobb9VHUh1MQ1FK4wbvGu74ay5UQ6WECfeF7bXL1.jpg)|![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EogNo5kUzUnUsGyXWQVyhgUqiRdmJz12k5fRhqMZXaQRgvpm2c3DihfYy7rd3xX23Ji.jpg)
-|-

![22.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23tvnk7FxEfdWUMHpm6yCeUJmJukcAhPkfgBcAE2fDjKkWZ281fvqxnNVdhY5VKnWfrJL.jpg)

Luego inicie a prepare el perico, busque un sarte lo coloque en la estufa, le agregue agua, sal y deje que que el agua estuviese hirviendo para agregar primero el tomate cortado en cuadros pequeños, le agregue la sal y deje cocinar  5 minutos para ablandarlo, luego lo fui triturando, le agregue la cebolla picada, deje 3 minutos y le agregue las 2 cucharadas de aceite, revolví, agregue los huevos, revolví y deje 3 minutos mas y luego ralle el queso y emplate.

![12.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wgS3mcmHMSs8sMm8grY6zs33yiSLhxWjSxq9wYWdN4ifF8ugPFSYZbG981sveU44dv9.jpg)|![15.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23vsSbaoNWiHVGQaop6NbqYwVotaMQskXecx64yWUT6ekHEvX5JZxzcQpTk6pfyDQd4VF.jpg)|![16.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23yTekCeZx5Dss2sTrmuQiutsAwLCeqoJrpkXrKLbiKBtsVwwXupHo3BaLf2KnzxHEb7R.jpg)
-|-|-

![17.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wMcsXt4WPJVctArF7wtPC1piJGfwaQtDuGXAiEzLzZFWgWFMXUCKSwxgQM5ZANAjEgE.jpg)|![18.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wMewVmCn9h4mJoNa9Wm532CkdpPVwnpKTPZTibbNVXNfb2N1A59e2ranpWFxdmY4JW6.jpg)
-|-

![20.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoeHHsN9S2GLqnCtzuxaw2kVaA3xmvgkkoSTnsKqPbojmrFPHvmgiHQr4KGKEoUhWYm.jpg)

Hasta aquí mi post, espero que sea de su agrado, nos vemos pronto y deseo que tengan un genial fin de semana, lleno de infinitas bendiciones. saludo a tos. dios los bendiga grandemente.

* Fotos tomadas con Iphone 8 plus
* Portada diseñada con Canva

<div class=\
> # English Version # Traditional Venezuelan Breakfast: White cheese, perico, arepa, and coffee with milk

> Hello, fellow food lovers who read my posts every day in the @hivefood community! I hope you all have a wonderful weekend with your loved ones. Welcome to my blog. ![25.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23tbwM8GtD3xUNfY6vAfiTv94iqppU4opLELR6Jb2DtPbu1LutmZkPSBGCFFWeDAaT3S5.jpg) Today I’m bringing you a delicious, authentic Venezuelan-style breakfast: eggs with tomato and onion, popularly known as “perico,” served with grated white cheese, traditional Venezuelan arepas, and a cup of coffee with milk, popularly known as “blanquito.” ![23.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Eokf7386iT3UZZUV9J4Y5CaikhdgGYUh1QCkhP76LGLVbSQ1EsMx5kh4c8LNp63S7Dy.jpg) Breakfast is the first meal of the day: it’s the classic one. What I’m presenting to you today is the authentic, comforting, traditional, and tasty Venezuelan breakfast. It represents the warmth of home—the perfect blend of crispiness and juiciness—and the comforting embrace of freshly brewed coffee, made even more delicious with the addition of milk. ![20.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoeHHsN9S2GLqnCtzuxaw2kVaA3xmvgkkoSTnsKqPbojmrFPHvmgiHQr4KGKEoUhWYm.jpg) ![21.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23yd1Z7uK4vQD1bcSdqFjJzpPt7oGfZP8RxbjNCJZxJ6fMt6uyLvHaGmgNmYXMfdGNF9r.jpg) |![22.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23tvnk7FxEfdWUMHpm6yCeUJmJukcAhPkfgBcAE2fDjKkWZ281fvqxnNVdhY5VKnWfrJL.jpg) -|- Now I’ll list the ingredients and the step-by-step instructions for making this crispy, nutritious, and delicious breakfast. # Ingredients * 3 medium-sized eggs * 1 large tomato * 1/4 white onion * 100 grams of grated white cheese * cornmeal * coffee * milk * 2 tablespoons of oil * salt to taste ![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EpGRc7RsCfUFXaatAvNAKmhjz7hWurvEXKJJeHCMCuSsnC3XcaP65hrKQohEVrTRJZD.jpg) # Procedure The first thing I did was make the arepas. I put water, salt, and flour in a bowl, then started kneading. Once the dough was soft rather than hard, I shaped the arepas and placed them on a very hot, greased griddle to cook. They took about 30 minutes because I like them crispy. ![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoryKyxYDh94qpiwyGE1UKysNuinobb9VHUh1MQ1FK4wbvGu74ay5UQ6WECfeF7bXL1.jpg) |![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EogNo5kUzUnUsGyXWQVyhgUqiRdmJz12k5fRhqMZXaQRgvpm2c3DihfYy7rd3xX23Ji.jpg) -|- ![22.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23tvnk7FxEfdWUMHpm6yCeUJmJukcAhPkfgBcAE2fDjKkWZ281fvqxnNVdhY5VKnWfrJL.jpg) Then I started preparing the perico. I took a pan, placed it on the stove, added water and salt, and let the water come to a boil. I then added the tomatoes, cut into small cubes, along with some salt, and let them cook for 5 minutes to soften them. then mash them, add the chopped onion, let it cook for 3 minutes, and add 2 tablespoons of oil. Stir, add the eggs, stir again, and let it cook for 3 more minutes. Finally, grate the cheese and serve. ![12.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wgS3mcmHMSs8sMm8grY6zs33yiSLhxWjSxq9wYWdN4ifF8ugPFSYZbG981sveU44dv9.jpg)|! [15.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23vsSbaoNWiHVGQaop6NbqYwVotaMQskXecx64yWUT6ekHEvX5JZxzcQpTk6pfyDQd4VF.jpg)|! [16.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23yTekCeZx5Dss2sTrmuQiutsAwLCeqoJrpkXrKLbiKBtsVwwXupHo3BaLf2KnzxHEb7R.jpg) -|-|- ![17.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wMcsXt4WPJVctArF7wtPC1piJGfwaQtDuGXAiEzLzZFWgWFMXUCKSwxgQM5ZANAjEgE.jpg)|! [18.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wMewVmCn9h4mJoNa9Wm532CkdpPVwnpKTPZTibbNVXNfb2N1A59e2ranpWFxdmY4JW6.jpg) -|- ![20.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoeHHsN9S2GLqnCtzuxaw2kVaA3xmvgkkoSTnsKqPbojmrFPHvmgiHQr4KGKEoUhWYm.jpg) That’s all for this post. I hope you enjoyed it. See you soon, and I hope you have a wonderful weekend filled with endless blessings. Best wishes to all of you. May God bless you abundantly. * Photos taken with an iPhone 8 Plus * Cover designed with Canva * Text translated with DeepL Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@morepina/-desayuno-criollo-venezolano-queso-blanco-perico-arepa-y-caf-con-leche-espeng-jje)

body.title: UN PLATO MUY RICO, ARROZ CON SALSA DE POLLO-----A VERY DELICIOUS DISH, RICE WITH CHICKEN SAUCE
body.body:
Buenos dias a todos, como lo pueden notar amigos soy un adicto a la  salsa de pollo, que se prepara de la siguiente manera, cortamos el pollo en trozos pequeños, pechuga y agregamos la olla en la cocina, le agregamos un poco de aceite, cebolla, ajo, el pollo antes mencionado, sal a gusto y lo revolvemos y dejamos que se cocine bien, luego le agregamos un poco de agua caliente, salsa de tomate maduros cortado en trozos bien pequeños y luego crema de leche, vamos revolviendo muy despacio y de esa manera nuestra salsa con pollo ya esta lista.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/prm4031/23tH9jWC3HaVMD1Cuf2YQBqb5m5JHRgqjNbjFtNum8NpY4bpmoQ8ZD1hafhnrRNoRPx8c.png)

Para cocinar el arroz, agregamos la olla en la hornalla de la cocina con agua, cuendo la misma esta caliente le agregamos el arroz y revolvemos muy despacio, cuando se cocina le quitamos el agua y listo, ya tenemos la salsa esta ves la misma abajo o sea primero y luego el arroz blanco.

MUCHAS GRACIAS POR LEERME Y SEGUIRME.

TRADUCIDO AL INGLES

Good morning everyone, as you can notice, friends, I am addicted to chicken sauce, which is prepared as follows: we cut the chicken into small pieces, breast, and add it to the pot on the stove. We add a bit of oil, onion, garlic, the aforementioned chicken, salt to taste, stir it, and let it cook well. Then we add a bit of hot water, ripe tomato sauce cut into very small pieces, and then cream. We stir very slowly, and that way our chicken sauce is ready.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/prm4031/23tH9jWC3HaVMD1Cuf2YQBqb5m5JHRgqjNbjFtNum8NpY4bpmoQ8ZD1haf

To cook the rice, we place the pot on the stove with water, when it is hot we add the rice and stir very gently, when it is cooked we remove the water and that's it, we already have the sauce this time the same below that is first and then the white rice.

Thank you very much for reading and following me.

Not every moment needs to be intense to be meaningful.
Some simply leave an afterglow—a quiet impression that lingers long after everything else has faded.
