body.title: Quesillo para la cumpleañera: mi MAMA.   Esp-Eng
body.body:
> Mi mama cumplio recientemente 78 añitos, esperamos en Dios que sean unos mas, ella dice que hasta los 85, eso solo lo sabe el Creador, solo pedimos que su salud mejore, porque asi se activa en muchas cosas, ya que siempre lo ha sido. Esta pasando una temporada en la casa materna, que ahora es de mi hermano, esta tambien cerca de mi casa. No estaremos todos los 5 hijos, que es otro de sus sueños que estemos todos, esperemos que para los 76 si estemos. Ademas de la torta, ella queria un quesillo, asi que hable con uno de mis hermanos que estan distantes, que me ayudara con el quesillo, asi que me mando para comprar los ingredientes y de como lo haria a la manera que lo hace el, que seria como el estar aquí, que no pudo estar, ya que apenas en abril se fue. **Ingredientes:** 300 gramos de azucar. 10 huevos. 1 cajita de leche condensada. 3 ½ tazas de agua. 200 gramos de leche en polvo completa no bebida lactea. 1 cucharadita (de la mas pequeñita) de sal. 3 cucharadas de vainilla. 6 cucharadas de ron. 1 tortera o quesillera de 24 o 25 cms de diametro.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/EoK5MPzpUqgXNo34fa6rcXwc4So4eWpuZoFbND4gqteKaq5qiNUeKEnLqjcYM6vr6vP.png)

> **Paso a Paso:** 1.-Primero el caramelo en la tortera o quesillera, que ahora se hace en forma directa, antes se hacia en una ollita y se vaciaba en la quesillera, se hacia con agua, pero ahora no, se hace directo y sin agua. Lo que si es que debemos estar pendientes que no se queme, mas bien debe quedar como dorado. Una vez listo se riega por toda la tortera como hasta donde llegara la mezcla. Dejamos reposar. Se me olvido aquí use 180 grs de azucar de los 300 grs.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23w2kgoeEpYfWnUkdnN9vs5qYbMBWr9Erm2DWtSSGtuD5xwae4xK8ibr5RoKTdouNcLyK.png)

> 2.-En un envase voy echando los huevos, asi voy viendo si estan buenos, luego los bato con un batidor de mano, o tambien con una batidora electrica, hay quienes usan licuadora pero hace mucha espuma. Ya batidos, los reservo un rato.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/EogMmgJLgaEnPhp6z4f9uAbABnosE3Au8P9w3sL8jNwuZXZ1cs6V1eYHUWF5nPwZPJM.png)

> 3.-En otro envase coloco las medidas de agua en los ingredientes, a esta la leche en polvo que sea completa, leche de la buena, no de las que dicen bebida lactea. Le sigo agregando los demas ingredientes: leche condensada, vainilla, ron, azucar, batimos a la mano hasta unir todo bien.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23tc1aReQsQQ51Kda2hXAFJKyfm32CMXSBNjzqgYNLbbrmGaGtM3w7RCjDpEzZgUZMaTW.png)

> 4.-Listas ambas mezclas las unimos y batimos un poco mas, hasta que queden todos los ingredientes bien mezclados, homogeneos.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/Ep1WyNf7soJdPDr4ebzCSxB9XBK56yibBMoML21JqT9XiB3doaPatCWqziCxhJwQtNs.png)

> 5.-Busco la tortera con el caramelo, vaciamos la mezcla aquí. Para luego llevarlo al horno. Aqui la diferencia con los demas quesillos, que este se cocina directo sin baño de Maria. El horno debe estar entre los 180 o 200 °C. Cocinarse en una hora y media. Asi como con las tortas, meter un palillo y que este salga limpio, ya esta.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23vsNJqomRR6LLnn3K89yv3UYRrYtY3WnddZWBPaWpESL9hgkTNx6LAah9dvpHhbLsvGQ.png)

> 6.-Sacamos del horno, despegamos por los lados y luego aflojar el mismo, pero dejarlos en el envase por varias horas hasta que este bien frio.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/Ep7ud9Zh8qATGK8NrBmq67WC8KC5jkA23y95EmgXq2kjZVUsQfNd9pMWQP4juwyYvfE.png)

> 7.-Ya bien frio, buscamos una bandeja o donde vayamos a desmoldar el quesillo, esta parte siempre me da como miedito que se vaya a romper, por eso es mejor que este bien frio.
![Captura de pantalla 2026-05-27 192945.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/EpXJa4bjr9LMLyp9SmU6EtuGy86fcsybrT8UNkkNFEN8FbnvFAsRcfPHwUDfF6X26pv.png)

> Las apariencias engañan dicen, podria ser aquí el caso con el quesillo, que no se muy bonito, pero si esta muy rico, quedo con huequitos. Queda asi porque se cocina directo, ahora los que se hacen en baño de Maria, si quedan lisos al voltearlos. Ya luego hare de nuevo otro para mi cumpleaños pronto. Las fotos fueron tomadas con celular Samsung Galaxy A16. Portada editada en Canva. Traductor usado DeepL.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/243C3hU8NCH18nDZgcubc6CzoA1Uk45hmm9qgY1Vmeai7F16pnkityoYac4uHcnj7bzC2.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/EpA6riN47p1arbNYi6caT2s2ikkJ28xKLGv7kVzyAimsPADmv28iE7B7agAKimzUAoi.png)

> My mom recently turned 78, and we hope in God that she’ll have many more years to go. She says she wants to live until 85, but only the Creator knows that. We just ask that her health improves, because that’s what keeps her active in so many things—she’s always been that way. She’s spending some time at our mother’s house, which now belongs to my brother; it’s also close to my house. Not all five of us children will be there—which is another of her dreams, that we’d all be together—but hopefully by her 76th birthday we will be. In addition to the cake, she wanted a quesillo, so I spoke with one of my brothers who lives far away, asking him to help me with the quesillo. He sent me a list of ingredients and instructions on how to make it the way he does—which is like having him here, since he couldn’t be here, having left just this past April. **Ingredients:** 300 grams of sugar. 10 eggs. 1 can of condensed milk. 3 ½ cups of water. 200 grams of whole milk powder (not milk drink). 1 teaspoon (the smallest one) of salt. 3 tablespoons of vanilla. 6 tablespoons of rum. 1 cake pan or quesadilla pan, 24 or 25 cm in diameter.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/EoK5MPzpUqgXNo34fa6rcXwc4So4eWpuZoFbND4gqteKaq5qiNUeKEnLqjcYM6vr6vP.png)

> **Step-by-Step:** 1.-First, make the caramel in the cake pan or cheese mold. Nowadays, this is done directly in the pan; previously, it was made in a small pot and poured into the mold. It used to be made with water, but not anymore—it’s made directly in the pan without water. What we do need to watch out for is that it doesn’t burn; it should be golden brown. Once ready, spread it evenly across the pan as far as the mixture will go. Let it set. I forgot to mention here that I used 180 grams of sugar out of the 300 grams.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23w2kgoeEpYfWnUkdnN9vs5qYbMBWr9Erm2DWtSSGtuD5xwae4xK8ibr5RoKTdouNcLyK.png)

> 2.-I crack the eggs into a bowl so I can check if they’re good, then beat them with a hand whisk or an electric mixer; some people use a blender, but it creates too much foam. Once beaten, I set them aside for a while.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/EogMmgJLgaEnPhp6z4f9uAbABnosE3Au8P9w3sL8jNwuZXZ1cs6V1eYHUWF5nPwZPJM.png)

> 3.-In another bowl, I add the measured water to the ingredients, along with whole milk powder—the good kind, not the kind labeled “milk drink.” I continue adding the other ingredients: condensed milk, vanilla, rum, and sugar. We whisk by hand until everything is well combined.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23tc1aReQsQQ51Kda2hXAFJKyfm32CMXSBNjzqgYNLbbrmGaGtM3w7RCjDpEzZgUZMaTW.png)

> 4.-Once both mixtures are ready, combine them and beat a little more until all the ingredients are well mixed and homogeneous.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/Ep1WyNf7soJdPDr4ebzCSxB9XBK56yibBMoML21JqT9XiB3doaPatCWqziCxhJwQtNs.png)

> 5.-Find the cake pan with the caramel and pour the mixture into it. Then put it in the oven. Here’s the difference from other cheesecakes: this one bakes directly without a water bath. The oven should be between 180 and 200 °C. It bakes for an hour and a half. Just like with cakes, stick a toothpick in and if it comes out clean, it’s done.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23vsNJqomRR6LLnn3K89yv3UYRrYtY3WnddZWBPaWpESL9hgkTNx6LAah9dvpHhbLsvGQ.png)

> 6.-Remove from the oven, loosen the sides, and then loosen the cake itself, but leave it in the pan for several hours until it is completely cool.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/Ep7ud9Zh8qATGK8NrBmq67WC8KC5jkA23y95EmgXq2kjZVUsQfNd9pMWQP4juwyYvfE.png)

> 7.-Once it’s completely chilled, find a tray or whatever you’ll use to unmold the quesillo. This part always makes me a little nervous that it might break, so it’s best to make sure it’s really cold.
![Screenshot 2026-05-27 192945.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/EpXJa4bjr9LMLyp9SmU6EtuGy86fcsybrT8UNkkNFEN8FbnvFAsRcfPHwUDfF6X26pv.png)

> They say looks can be deceiving, and that might be the case here with this quesillo. It may not look very pretty, but it’s really delicious—it has little holes in it. It turns out this way because it’s cooked directly; the ones made in a double boiler come out smooth when you flip them. I’ll make another one soon for my birthday. The photos were taken with a Samsung Galaxy A16 cell phone. Cover edited in Canva. Translated using DeepL.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23ydQz4vkUWhD7SD1cR8oH6m3NnjUmtdKAfmnS8jGVatgrgo7Z8L7JHnVRr92UPX3hRJ9.png)

body.title: Igreja de São Pedro - Marialva / Riding Portugal
body.body:
![COVER.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/244yCjNn8kifLqnxc6SixJWJ2tZGBHFzRKR9iqMucMFrd9WXWMxc7XLUFFEEqSFsnuBMQ.jpg) ##### Hello everyone and welcome to my blog :-) We continued our tour of Marialva, but ended up lingering longer in the area of ​​Saint Peter's Church and the small streets around it. The light was exactly how I like it: low, warm, and soft :) ##### PT Continuamos o nosso passeio por Marialva, mas acabamos por nos demorar mais na zona da Igreja de São Pedro e nas pequenas ruas à volta. A luz estava exatamente como gosto, baixa, quente e suave :) --- ![20260328_180909.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/246b33PzNhnqZ2A7VGCE1yE1jDEnb2PSmS2LAh5Dzak1Pz2txVx95urTuEQJuV1pSua3G.jpg) ![20260328_180931.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23rzBBfZUK7Uk6eKWCFKUt6Tfy9B36XUc3atGPgdej79NNcavShh73K89f4HEUUnVHjWQ.jpg) ![20260328_180937.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/242YAJYneY81CmAZwP3DAWbiANbqfXqaVVUk2HWbA9uSZzJXew9NwSu6Cjoeic2bvtPyb.jpg) ![20260328_180944.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/244y3zN7x7MHem2qxNipzhNNkRKbPZ7qLhqMnHopTj61v8kzxLYfNi1ZwFBdknKUWZ7Su.jpg) ![Untitled-1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/EnymeWrmhSU78wMzJahA3HNMn7fja3hxMQGfPEyMEZJM3KLTfXNA89yMUNpMgmZyvpY.png) The granite houses scattered across the hillside create a very unique composition, with narrow streets that force us to walk slowly on the uneven stone ground, with old walls, clay roofs worn by time—everything there seems to age at the same time. ##### PT As casas de granito espalhadas pela encosta criam uma composição muito própria, com as ruas estreitas que obrigam-nos a caminhar devagar pelo chão irregular em pedra, com os muros antigos, os telhados de barro já gastos pelo tempo, tudo ali envelhece ao mesmo tempo, parece-me. --- ![20260328_180955.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/244obEti98y6GvpG593e6Z6AadGXU4QNLZTk3HrGvo1G4dBzVnyJ6fLU6VEoH4KbjkrSE.jpg) ![20260328_181022.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/242rwdLLEZ56gSq9Jcmsne82XXisMsGU8YAN6wCH3JJE3wxt3wJ65357hm8KQvjZb6U3C.jpg) ![20260328_181049.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23xVRXYpDBe7vVN1vA9BrBBYEN7jucxuhkaKiUu7fY5A8Cg51EPP461in3eazkUqe83Br.jpg) ![Untitled-1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/EnymeWrmhSU78wMzJahA3HNMn7fja3hxMQGfPEyMEZJM3KLTfXNA89yMUNpMgmZyvpY.png) The church caught my attention precisely because of its simplicity. It's not a large or very elaborate building, but it has details that make a difference when you stop to observe calmly. The small bell tower with two bells stood out against the sky, with the moon already visible in the background, even before nightfall. ##### PT A igreja acabou por me chamar a atenção precisamente pela simplicidade. Não é um edifício grande nem muito trabalhado, mas tem detalhes que fazem diferença quando paramos para observar com calma. O pequeno campanário de duas sineiras recortava-se contra o céu, já com a lua visível ao fundo, ainda antes do anoitecer. --- ![20260328_181143.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/244oWtgeBXcaZ5VfShwfsdNfAYzHBRzE5uo39nbWbtxkNE7FoyKFqVuJXog6GYN6Qg5QA.jpg) ![20260328_181057.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/2432FooYNf3nYKF6ECKSiCkHqZb3aiACKSv6sWW5nfVP1RukjjfKzGr1H8iwi7Sas58xZ.jpg) ![20260328_181105.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/243qCzaFWZUDYsw4F5VWF5mS6TivDQ3ia56wm3835cH36cmD7kmDFrDo2h8wTX8QuJpxT.jpg) ![20260328_181131.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/245wKk9HjcwnwLAeuf64rBp4rTo4xxrf2ycQNLHbK993AcsqzVgY8A4xzu6jko4fCyYbz.jpg) ![Untitled-1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/EnymeWrmhSU78wMzJahA3HNMn7fja3hxMQGfPEyMEZJM3KLTfXNA89yMUNpMgmZyvpY.png) While walking through the courtyard, I began to notice small elements that would easily go unnoticed on a quicker visit. A stone bench leaning against the church wall, the wear marks on the steps of the side entrance, the lichens scattered across the walls. Even the silence there seemed different from other places I've visited, which were also quite peaceful. ##### PT À medida que fui andando pelo pátio, comecei a reparar em pequenos elementos que facilmente passariam despercebidos numa visita mais rápida. Um banco de pedra encostado à parede da igreja, as marcas de desgaste nos degraus da entrada lateral, os líquenes espalhados pelos muros. Até o silêncio ali parecia diferente de outros sítios que visitei, também eles, lugares bastante tranquilos. --- ![20260328_181029.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23vi5jqw1Kz8pS6tdXPPSr56H7Buf1xDN5wHCzETFFnDiQVmyhePoVLLY1RTc61yVVWat.jpg) ![20260328_181041.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23w2qeA4uXV1HAJUMjiT7iRQi6rGFZtds5TB42MgzGwdPEz5gWGY46W8DXD5tuYzxbBar.jpg) ![20260328_181159.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/2423uzqHHGwscyVuWQiw1P2HYJCTkjDnkXufnSKKZkBwSdJvB9dmzF5ZMzbTFDPxnrzkU.jpg) ![Untitled-1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/EnymeWrmhSU78wMzJahA3HNMn7fja3hxMQGfPEyMEZJM3KLTfXNA89yMUNpMgmZyvpY.png) Next to a closed door I found an old litter, one of those used in religious processions to carry sanctified images, lying on the ground. It was there leaning against the wall, with clear signs of use and some marks of time. I confess I spent a few minutes observing it, not for religious reasons per se, but because I found it there, alone, with no one to guard it. It wasn't displayed as a decorative piece nor specially protected. It was simply part of that space. ##### PT Junto a uma porta fechada encontrei pousado no chão um andor antigo, daqueles usados nas procissões religiosas para transportar imagens santificadas. Estava ali encostado à parede, com sinais claros de ser usado e algumas marcas do tempo. Confesso que fiquei alguns minutos a observá-lo, não pela questão religiosa em si, mas porque o encontrei ali, sozinho, sem ninguém a guardá-lo. Não estava exposto como peça decorativa nem protegido de forma especial. Simplesmente fazia parte daquele espaço. --- ![20260328_181209.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23ynKkBpfCpvHLQXsgXUd7dHxQXpkrWTJV8eZcodhRwLtcrKECivanPTRgoFYnb8ctEmG.jpg) ![20260328_181235.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23ujdm6kzGd1BrqBFFJi1jYtHLAfZJReYWwRAV88TdeKbWbgbkm8k5Vg4dybEz1K23CRW.jpg) ![20260328_181247.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/245cYLe3hvT4ULkRxY131hDSbBnDmGvkYTeLwrQoNUvZd9rhTtJUaXiCLRYStiwAdiGpm.jpg) ![20260328_181302.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/245mw5miAw3rG4Mj2xJtDNMt1EFesMj4cStAJ5411rYEBDCbipwgsuhNavzbKmCR6Dt5u.jpg) ![Untitled-1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/EnymeWrmhSU78wMzJahA3HNMn7fja3hxMQGfPEyMEZJM3KLTfXNA89yMUNpMgmZyvpY.png) I continued walking through the narrow alleys around the church as the light changed. There were areas where the sun still shone directly on the facades and others already immersed in shadow. Some houses have been recently restored, it's easy to see, but fortunately without significantly altering the overall character. In others, the stone remains more raw, irregular, with small imperfections. ##### PT Continuei a andar pelas ruelas estreitas em volta da igreja enquanto a luz ia mudando. Havia zonas onde o sol ainda batia diretamente nas fachadas e outras já mergulhadas em sombra. Algumas casas foram recuperadas recentemente, percebe-se facilmente, mas felizmente sem descaracterizar demasiado o conjunto. Noutras, a pedra permanece mais crua, irregular, com pequenas imperfeições. --- ![20260328_181336.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23vYarr7r5fVbos3zN1UevD8oEfstkMPzuKAMb8NHZhSmuN9bpfJyey1aJUoYnPfedMb6.jpg) ![20260328_181350.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23rz6xsNvdPw9ZFnLhmuQVmxaJtEpAw15qPf4MmBbfxDaPX9umGyFV1KspbJAqcqzJrFi.jpg) ![20260328_181359.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23ryzSQ2wxsjxd6GNb3BComDjkYYp8zcMzHGyCnLN9vtNY33EDbZ2TgjzfRh3pxKXfSnp.jpg) ![Untitled-1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/EnymeWrmhSU78wMzJahA3HNMn7fja3hxMQGfPEyMEZJM3KLTfXNA89yMUNpMgmZyvpY.png) One of the things I liked most about that region was precisely the absence of noise. There was practically nobody on the street. Occasionally someone would appear in the distance, disappearing around the next bend between the granite walls. ##### PT Uma das coisas de que mais gostei naquela zona foi precisamente a ausência de ruído. Não havia praticamente ninguém na rua. De vez em quando surgia alguém ao longe, desaparecendo logo na curva seguinte entre os muros de granito. --- ![20260328_181408.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/244eGsjcgaTtvUcrcYCW2dRFfsRoTvwJXkLMdVcrMRPboLo4owy7SN5WSoxajiwa1FZkb.jpg) ![20260328_181422.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/243BnnhdVeVvJFhWQmcmuzmkc1EpK9s6JqpfwExCcd8tiESykxyciEEiewKzZ68EHuF4C.jpg) ![20260328_181437.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23sJxDYQY1wibzh5d75LEBZM8svucqafZbgDtZpnAPA7caPUa5F8VBuqwoX4oWfFYv8w3.jpg) ![20260328_181449.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23x1FYQt4jbaXro2gggV6YGnUYTtKDyhY7CVFAPqakHuZv5nDLyQYrekP8fRMk46kDHAh.jpg) ![Untitled-1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/EnymeWrmhSU78wMzJahA3HNMn7fja3hxMQGfPEyMEZJM3KLTfXNA89yMUNpMgmZyvpY.png) At one point I stopped at the churchyard wall and just looked at the houses scattered across the hillside. The golden hour sun shone on the rooftops and stone walls in a very natural way, without filters, without the need for extensive photo editing. ##### PT A certa altura parei junto ao muro do pátio da igreja e fiquei apenas a olhar para as casas espalhadas pela encosta. O sol da golden hour batia nos telhados e nas paredes de pedra de uma forma muito natural, sem filtros, sem necessidade de grandes edições fotográficas. --- ![20260328_181504.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/244UuzzYEnVMLR9JKSkavuUmop2kug1ZGPJHTty3cfWaJGXnn26GMFXwYtRggur3e4RWh.jpg) ![20260328_181520.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/241ZoazwArCq2SkkFy2UmnVJfiqyaiLeDGFEAzZDgo13V2jJMNKSvTqiLxymxX7ia9KZj.jpg) ![20260328_181546.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/245T56bzRGFryX7YW1nks82xPfht2pW1JhE7Vm73qHoWoto2SzQWxTXuVDCWcfuvnyodL.jpg) ![20260328_181554.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/243qD4R2FfSrqTaLCJcoDLgVKg6d59Ct6cvbUq6CVQNmXRgiDXqGMfHDgse1GvRwe9miS.jpg) ![Untitled-1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/EnymeWrmhSU78wMzJahA3HNMn7fja3hxMQGfPEyMEZJM3KLTfXNA89yMUNpMgmZyvpY.png) When I started to descend again through the village streets, the sun was already disappearing behind the mountains. The temperature dropped a little and shadows began to occupy all the spaces where there had previously been light. Even so, I will return because Marialva at night must be wonderful. ##### PT Quando comecei a descer novamente pelas ruas da aldeia, já o sol desaparecia atrás das montanhas. A temperatura caiu ligeiramente e as sombras começaram a ocupar os espaços todos onde antes ainda havia luz. Ainda assim hei-de voltar pois Marialva à noite deve ser maravilhosa.
I hope you enjoyed. See you around. Wishing you much peace and health > Those who pass by us do not go alone. They leave a bit of themselves, taking a piece of us.\
The Template cover used in this post is from Canva - Created by Misia\

body.body:
> 

![Black Blue Futuristic Cyber Security Presentation.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23uQGVC1U6BMJgnAJGQsmT7Mtgbb79Ez2V2QHbEiEgLeg6KP3t4Gw3jwdWmeJxxxMYAhn.jpg)

# 🔐 Cyber Security Daily News | 30.05.2026

Codzienny przegląd ciekawszych wiadomości ze świata cyberbezpieczeństwa, do poczytania przy porannej kawie, podzielony na kluczowe kategorie.

![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23tknHCAmnbSjtcJ6g5HSRW5qMtzPfju2qxDPxpWndToVbUAfW6QPvRTdR4VX7VC5TvGg.jpg)

-----

## 📰 NEWS

### ***Nadpis SMS „mObywatel\

. Zastrzeżenie nadpisu SMS (sender ID) uniemożliwia przestępcom podszywanie się pod daną nazwę w wiadomościach — bez takiej ochrony każdy mógł wysyłać SMS-y, które wyglądały identycznie jak komunikaty rządowe. Kampania phishingowa z fałszywymi mandatami w imieniu \

, którą opisywaliśmy w maju, dotknęła tysięcy Polaków — bo SMS z tym nadpisem trafiał do tego samego wątku co autentyczne wiadomości z aplikacji. Decyzja o zastrzeżeniu zapadła reaktywnie — dopiero gdy wyrządzono szkody. COI zastrzegł łącznie 58 ważnych nadpisów; rodzi się pytanie, dlaczego nie zrobiono tego z chwilą uruchomienia mObywatela.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23yJP2wd7a1zWyfD4wLCAou1gBjUM98zKsCQ9yE7VtpEbFCVGpJW58qds1BtFUADYSnur.png)

*Źródło: [CyberDefence24](https://cyberdefence24.pl/polityka-i-prawo/polska/nadpis-sms-mobywatel-w-koncu-zastrzezony-dlaczego-dopiero-po-kampanii-oszustow) [PL]*

---

### ***Charter Communications: naruszenie dotyczy 49 milionów kont — korekta szacunków in plus***

BleepingComputer ujawnia, że skala wycieku danych Charter Communications (Spectrum) jest dramatycznie większa niż początkowo informowano: atak ShinyHunters dotknął niemal 49 milionów kont klientów — ośmiokrotnie więcej niż wcześniejsze szacunki. Naruszenie obejmuje dane osobowe, adresy e-mail, numery kont i historię płatności. Charter to jeden z największych dostawców telewizji kablowej i internetu w USA z dziesiątkami milionów abonentów. Korekta szacunków \

po upływie doby to typowy wzorzec przy dużych incydentach — firmy zwykle zaniżają skalę na początku. Klienci Spectrum powinni monitorować konta bankowe i zachować czujność wobec phishingu.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23wgcbuvqrBRawQwjjVmJVEEEyQQ1ohUmB8Ltr6ZmSCJ3bLJkfvYgbyw7Ua3Pm6MahmTD.png)

*Źródło: [BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/charter-communications-data-breach-affects-49-million-accounts/) [EN]*

---

### ***CISA ostrzega: ataki supply chain na NX Console i repozytoria GitHub — nowe zhakowane narzędzia deweloperskie***

CISA wydała specjalny alert dotyczący ataków supply chain na NX Console — popularne narzędzie do monitorowania i zarządzania środowiskiem monorepozytoriów Nx — oraz kilka repozytoriów GitHub. Zhakowane narzędzia były dystrybuowane z backdoorami przez oficjalne kanały. To kontynuacja falowej aktywności ataków supply chain obserwowanej przez cały maj 2026 roku — po DAEMON Tools, JDownloader, TanStack, Bitwarden CLI, teraz NX Console. Każdy, kto korzysta z NX Console, powinien sprawdzić integralność zainstalowanej wersji.

*Źródło: [CISA](https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/alerts/2026/05/28/supply-chain-compromises-impact-nx-console-and-github-repositories) [EN]*

---

## 🚨 INCYDENTY

### ***Holenderska policja likwiduje botnet z 17 milionami zainfekowanych urządzeń***

W odrębnej operacji od niedawnej likwidacji rosyjskiej infrastruktury bulletproof, holenderska policja z pomocą europejskich partnerów rozbiła ogromny botnet złożony z niemal 17 milionów zainfekowanych urządzeń — głównie domowych routerów, kamer IoT i telefonów z Androidem. Botnet był używany do prowadzenia ataków DDoS, dystrybucji spamu i jako proxy dla innych operacji przestępczych. Ofiary — właściciele zainfekowanych urządzeń — nie byli świadomi, że ich sprzęt pracował dla przestępców. Holenderskie NCSC wysyła powiadomienia do właścicieli zainfekowanych urządzeń z instrukcją dezynfekcji.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/Eo6JUutjZZjxN6dBWF89Cfngb8StaYUbpjCkzdx6kKdywGQqiPikE6p5VmH7qXtN814.png)

*Źródło: [BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/dutch-govt-disrupts-malware-botnet-with-17-million-infected-devices/) [EN], [The Register](https://www.theregister.com/security/2026/05/29/dutch-cops-liberate-17m-devices-from-botnets-clutches/5248312) [EN]*

---

### ***Kimsuky wdraża HTTPSpy — nowe narzędzie szpiegujące szyfrowany ruch HTTPS***

The Hacker News opisuje nowe narzędzie grupy Kimsuky (Korea Północna): HTTPSpy to implant instalowany na zainfekowanych maszynach z możliwością przechwytywania szyfrowanego ruchu HTTPS poprzez wstrzyknięcie się w warstwę TLS przed szyfrowaniem, czyli przed wysłaniem pakietów przez przeglądarkę lub aplikację. Celem jest pokonanie szyfrowania end-to-end od środka — zamiast łamać szyfrowanie, HTTPSpy czyta dane zanim zostaną zaszyfrowane. Kampania celuje w decydentów rządowych i korporacyjnych w Korei Południowej, USA i Europie.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/EoEikyFEzQeE64dL9VdGVeoerdT2QVt5XyDQTDmQC7STXAfBxdxuQSjnMFunQaGkuaJ.png)

*Źródło: [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/05/kimsuky-deploys-httpspy-expands-arsenal.html) [EN]*

---

## 💡 CIEKAWOSTKI

### ***Claude Opus 4.8 ogłoszony — Anthropic prezentuje nowy model z zaawansowanymi zdolnościami bezpieczeństwa agentów***

Anthropic ogłosiło Claude Opus 4.8 — nową wersję swojego flagowego modelu, która ma znacząco ulepszone możliwości w zakresie rozumowania i bezpieczeństwa agentów AI. Zgodnie z zapowiedzią model jest wyposażony w \

— ulepszoną warstwę wartości ograniczającą ryzyko niepożądanych zachowań autonomicznych agentów. Opus 4.8 jest testowany szczególnie pod kątem zastosowań wymagających wysokiego zaufania: zarządzania infrastrukturą krytyczną, autonomicznego kodowania i długoterminowego planowania zadań.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23uRKjLsVpzaQUSjozqLXDYSH5TLtdX2wHqH3hxtvaJEAFz6z5VbWJJEaJ2Afq1apcyi4.png)

*Źródło: [Help Net Security](https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/05/29/anthropic-claude-opus-4-8/) [EN]*

---

### ***Badanie 2000 vibe-coded aplikacji — większość ma poważne luki, wiele z krytycznymi podatnościami***

The Hacker News opisuje badanie przeprowadzone na 2000 publicznie dostępnych aplikacji stworzonych metodą \

(przez AI bez tradycyjnego procesu programistycznego): ponad 60% zawierało co najmniej jedną krytyczną lukę bezpieczeństwa, w tym nieautoryzowany dostęp do API, słabe zarządzanie sesjami i brak walidacji danych wejściowych. Wyniki potwierdzają obawy ekspertów: AI generuje sprawnie działający kod, ale bez wiedzy o bezpieczeństwie — produkuje aplikacje podatne na ataki, które ich twórcy często wdrażają bez żadnego audytu.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23uRL1dCgc4aj6vnSzz1mDXF2AmWn6LURnfm6GpK766jHkYKM8x8VRwRHFrkWDzXGvEL9.png)

*Źródło: [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/05/what-2000-exposed-vibe-coded-apps.html) [EN]*

---

## 🎣 OSZUSTWA, SCAMY, EXPLOITY

### ***Rosja (GreyVibe) używa ChatGPT do budowania pełnych kampanii ataków — od wabia do payloadu***

The Register i The Hacker News opisują przełomowy raport: rosyjska grupa APT GreyVibe jako pierwsza dokumentalnie potwierdzona użyła ChatGPT do zbudowania kompletnej kampanii ataków cybernetycznych — od generowania wiarygodnych phishingowych e-maili dostosowanych do ofiar, przez tłumaczenie treści na lokalne języki, po opracowanie kodu exploitującego. Ataki były skierowane na instytucje rządowe w Europie. To materializacja długo omawianych obaw: modele językowe jako \

dla grup przestępczych. ChatGPT i inne LLM mają zabezpieczenia — ale ich omijanie (przez promptowanie wieloetapowe, role-playing, podział zadań) jest coraz lepiej opanowane przez APT.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23wgBTpgrXcfoKZ6cT9ozaU2gomc1ePiAXSZVZaTtsaVEb9xhgpS1ebvarkVSLctQgWin.png)

*Źródło: [The Register](https://www.theregister.com/research/2026/05/29/russia-linked-threat-group-put-chatgpt-to-work-from-lure-to-payload/5248368) [EN], [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/05/new-russian-linked-greyvibe-targets.html) [EN]*

---

### ***Phishing kradnący kopie zapasowe Signala — atakujący chcą całej historii konwersacji***

Malwarebytes i CyberDefence24 opisują kampanię phishingową ukierunkowaną na użytkowników Signala z nieco innym celem niż przejęcie konta: przestępcy wyłudzają dane uwierzytelniające do systemu kopii zapasowych Signala (Signal Backup on Storage), by pobrać pełną historię zaszyfrowanych konwersacji ofiary. Wiadomości phishingowe informują o \

wymagającej potwierdzenia. Skradzione kopie zapasowe zawierają całą historię — wiadomości, zdjęcia, pliki — z całego okresu używania aplikacji. Dla osób publicznych i dziennikarzy jest to szczególnie poważne zagrożenie.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23y8fM6fjBSxjNtyFiaKqzwGG77v28tKqMTNVvn68CTq2DFYeBDigEjgqiWa2tiT9hZ9d.png)

*Źródło: [Malwarebytes](https://www.malwarebytes.com/blog/news/2026/05/signal-users-targeted-in-backup-stealing-phishing-attacks) [EN], [CyberDefence24](https://cyberdefence24.pl/cyberbezpieczenstwo/cyberataki/ataki-na-uzytkownikow-signala-ostrzezenie-z-zagranicy) [PL]*

---

### ***Kapitan Hack: fałszywe Claude i ChatGPT infekują przez SEO poisoning — instalatory z backdoorami***

Kapitan Hack informuje o nasilonej kampanii SEO poisoning, w której przestępcy pozycjonują złośliwe strony na czołowych miejscach wyników wyszukiwarek dla zapytań \

— w rzeczywistości instalatory zawierają złośliwe oprogramowanie. Kampania szczególnie celuje w polskojęzycznych użytkowników: są strony z polskim interfejsem i polską wersją wsparcia technicznego, co świadczy o precyzyjnym targetowaniu. Oficjalne źródła: claude.ai i chat.openai.com — nigdzie indziej. *Źródło: [Kapitan Hack](https://kapitanhack.pl/falszywe-chatgpt-i-claude-infekuja-komputery-cyberprzestepcy-wykorzystuja-boom-na-ai/) [PL]* --- ## 🌐 DEZINFORMACJA, CYBER ВОЙНА ### ***Test Cyberlegionu — polscy żołnierze ćwiczą przejmowanie dronów i cyberobronę w warunkach bojowych*** CyberDefence24 relacjonuje ważne ćwiczenia operacyjne polskiego Cyberlegionu — specjalnej jednostki Wojska Polskiego działającej na pograniczu cyberprzestrzeni i pola walki. W testach sprawdzano m.in. zdolności do zakłócania i przejmowania wrogich dronów przez ataki na ich infrastrukturę komunikacyjną, a także cyberobronę systemów dowodzenia w warunkach aktywnego ataku. Ćwiczenia pokazały zarówno silne strony, jak i obszary wymagające dalszego rozwoju. Polska Cyberprzestrzeń rozbudowuje zdolności odpowiadające nowej doktrynie, gdzie granica między atakiem kinetycznym a cyberatakiem praktycznie nie istnieje. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23uQnR4F4iz4JHeNoYBBqtvCR9GQz7v9GuMCFjmnBvKuYFCcaqnAuyxkAiy1NZA3uMvXP.png) *Źródło: [CyberDefence24](https://cyberdefence24.pl/armia-i-sluzby/wojsko-polskie/wazny-test-cyberlegionu-przejmowanie-dronow-i-wiele-wiecej) [PL]* --- ### ***Infosecurity24: polskie służby specjalne pod rosyjską lupą — co wiedzą o nas Rosjanie?*** Infosecurity24.pl publikuje analizę: rosyjskie służby wywiadowcze systematycznie i szczegółowo badają polskie służby specjalne — ich strukturę, kadry, zdolności i słabości. Autorzy opisują, jakie metody Rosja stosuje do pozyskiwania danych wywiadowczych o polskich organach bezpieczeństwa: od klasycznej agentury, przez cyberszpiegostwo, po analizę otwartych źródeł (OSINT). Artykuł stawia tezę, że Rosja wie o polskich służbach znacznie więcej, niż jest to publicznie przyznawane, co w środowisku wysokich napięć geopolitycznych jest poważnym zagrożeniem operacyjnym. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23tS149NZEgNEnLFQW8qEKG7gYE8jfQiNoo1tVeN78jdbKH65vBefCRCnM1XvLNiRsGjL.png) *Źródło: [Infosecurity24.pl](https://infosecurity24.pl/za-granica/grozny-przeciwnik-i-chwiejne-panstwo-polskie-sluzby-specjalne-pod-rosyjska-lupa) [PL]* ----- *📅 Powyższe zestawienie ma charakter wyłącznie informacyjny i edukacyjny. Wszystkie informacje opierają się na publicznie dostępnych doniesieniach prasowych z dnia 29 maja 2026 r. ⚠️ W razie podejrzenia incydentu bezpieczeństwa skonsultuj się z wykwalifikowanym specjalistą.*

body.title: Operacion del señor Thor \
quesito
body.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jdrh93/23vi4KLYVEAWNZHAJbehp6b6UFi1rYMJDUWEbSUCAK7tzR3aS4NHd8DzjT2b6VU68WCzM.png)

Después de mucho darle vueltas mi hermano por fin ha castrado a Thor, y estaba un poco agresivo con Pato, no se si recuerdan al gato naranja grandote y bello que suelo publicar, pues no se llevaban tan bien, Thor creció y domino sobre Pato, quería todo el espacio para el, se volvió muy territorial y Matilda lo secundaba, Pato a pesar de ser un gato tan grande, le cedió el espacio y no se quiso imponer, es un gatito tan bueno que se dejo joder por otro.

\

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jdrh93/Eptawcpfx1U8kAcuEYHneGyHL1uczJjD3s1woxwiBiRXbUqeGrHzqixvTodMBhhM7vx.png)

Pero bueno esta era su cara luego de la operación, obviamente sale un poco sedado, con sus sentidos muy disminuidos y el control de su cuerpo no era el mejor.

\

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jdrh93/23ynUofz1cTonRYMEEU4R2i5FvZstBBG34G8ZNVha6oghp6mezbefiPWyKgawVNne9RDo.png)

Mi hermanó lo llevaba super abrazado, cargadito para poder llevarlo lo mejor posible, bien abrigado para  que fuera lo mas cómodo posible y llegara a su  casita a terminar de pasar el reposo, deben saber que ya esta mejor, se ha ido recuperando bien y esperemos que mejore mucho su relación con pato para que puedan ser unos gatitos felices en su casa, que solo peleen como juego y compartan todo el territorio que es de todos.

\

Now let's talk about the other kittens of the week. This one was also in the line for the cat neutering clinic, which was held in a park near the house. Around 300 cats were neutered there. It's low-cost and allows for better control and a better life for the kittens. There was a woman who, by herself, had around 10 cats and brought 3 to be neutered... It seems like quite a lot to me, but I'm sure she did it with all the pleasure in the world, and they are her companions.\

This kitten is from a house where my girlfriend went to a party. They were celebrating a friend's birthday, and my girlfriend asked for a photo, and the kitten turned away with a sour face. It's quite funny because it turned out like something out of a meme.\

After petting him and spending some time with him, you can observe a complete change in the kitten's attitude. It's amazing how they are usually distrustful, but once they gain affection and trust, they approach seeking the affection they so enjoy receiving...\
Well, without further ado, I wish you a very nice Caturday, take care and enjoy your kittens.\

body.title: Kinkaku-ji 金閣寺 - Der Goldene Pavillion von Kyoto 👹🍣🎎 Mein Japan
body.body: ![IMG_5128.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/Eoc1Hu7f5DKsorGUm775bWST8Fe4jakdEuSGoAxLGrQSq2Mbb2xYzQqShUZr9p1FQ52.jpg) Bei meinen Reisen hier im Land der aufgehenden Sonne habe ich so einige aufregende und faszierende Orte gesehen, vor denen ich oft aus dem Staunen nicht wieder herausgekommen bin. Klar gibt es auf der ganzen Welt und in eigentlich fast allen Ländern etwas großartiges zu entdecken, aber da es mir Japan irgendwie angetan hat, bin ich nun einmal zumeist hier in diesen wundervollen Land unterwegs. Und ich muss zugeben, dass es mir gut tut und ich eigentlich gar nicht viel mehr bräuchte, zumindest solange bis ich hier alles gesehen habe, was es zu sehen gibt. Und da das eine ganze Menge ist, wird meine Zeit wohl nicht dafür ausreichen, um mich dem Rest der Welt zu widmen, von der ich bisher zwar auch schon ein bisschen, aber dann doch auch viel zu wenig gesehen habe. Und dazu kommen dann auch noch viele Orte, an die ich unbedingt noch einmal zurückkehren will. Dorthin, wo es mir beim ersten Mal so gut gefallen hat, und auch dorthin, wo ich bei meinem vorherigen Besuch einfach nicht genug Zeit und Muse hatte, um mir alles genauer anzusehen und auch zu verstehen. Oft passiert es erst im Nachgang zu einer Reise, dass das Interesse an einem bestimmten Ort so richtig geweckt wird und man auf einmal viel mehr darüber wissen möchte. Manchmal sogar erst viel später, wenn man sich die Bilder vergangenen Reisen noch einmal anschaut, und plötzlich ins Träumen gerät. ![IMG_5130.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/EppKAneMmQt42oubH1g4SN9faSLumB5XKv1mRrdxqpHToFNNzXYRxdFGAE1akCxXXkm.jpg) So ging oder besser geht es mir immer wieder, und plötzlich kommen zu all den neuen Zielen, die auf meiner Liste stehen, immer auch wieder etwas bereits Bekanntes dazu. Orte, an denen ich bereits gewesen bin, aber wo ich unbedingt noch einmal vorbeischauen will. Wie zum Beispiel der Kinkaku-ji Temple in Kyoto, der früheren langjährigen Hauptstadt des japanischen Inselreiches. Der Kinkaku‑ji (金閣寺), oder auch der Goldene Pavillon von Kyōto, ist eines der berühmtesten Wahrzeichen Japans. Es handelt sich hierbei um einen Zen‑Tempel, dessen oberste Stockwerke vollständig mit Blattgold bedeckt sind und der als Inbegriff der Ästhetik der Muromachi‑Zeit gilt. Ursprünglich wurde er im Jahr 1397 als prachtvolle Ruhesitz‑Villa für den Shōgun Ashikaga Yoshimitsu erbaut, der sich hier einen Ort der Ruhe und Repräsentation wünschte. Erst nach seinem Tod wurde die Anlage dann in einen Zen‑Tempel umgewandelt, doch der goldene Pavillon, der dem Tempel seinen heutigen Namen gab, blieb das Herzstück. ![IMG_5140.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/EqDjYUZsTY2PJJg6jDHMwRtLLz5jd56TeBZxpEr4UrM1JsFQc2ygdMetb4fCe5rYyUK.jpg) Das dreistöckige Gebäude ist architektonisch besonders interessant, weil jede Etage in einem anderen historischen Stil gestaltet wurde: Der erste Stock folgt der höfischen Bauweise der Heian‑Zeit, der zweite erinnert an die Wohnarchitektur der Samurai, und der dritte ist im chinesisch beeinflussten Zen‑Stil gehalten. Die oberen beiden Stockwerke sind vollständig mit Blattgold überzogen, was dem Pavillon im Sonnenlicht schon von Weitem glänzen lässt. Auf dem Dach thront ein vergoldeter Phönix, der als Symbol für Harmonie und Wiedergeburt gilt. ![IMG_5136.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/EqhNuHcg8pCCx4o4RKtFFhMLfjxv36JzDvHMbnHmwg5PYPUeJes9nJShZ4hi6nj8uoH.jpg) Der Tempel ist von einer sorgfältig gestalteten Gartenanlage umgeben, die als klassisches Beispiel für die Landschaftsästhetik der Muromachi‑Zeit gilt. Bei ruhigen Wetter und Wasser spiegelt sich der Pavillon im Kyōko‑chi, im sogenannten Spiegelteichs, dessen kleine Inseln und Felsen symbolische Bedeutungen aus der buddhistischen Mythologie tragen. Ein Rundweg führt Besucher über moosbewachsene Pfade, vorbei an kleineren Schreinen und einem traditionellen Teehaus, wobei die Anlange gleichzeitig meditative als auch lebendig wirkt. Leider wurde der Pavillon im Jahr 1950 durch Brandstiftung zerstört, aber im Anschluss bis 1955 originalgetreu wieder aufgebaut und später auch noch einmal restauriert, sodass er auch heute noch eine strahlende Schönheit darstellt. ![IMG_5134.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/EqNF9GWZ98cVGSPmCpTN9XmFirwgNsEbtTvhgzu4FmDGCgZAmuhzouJ9UpjM1ZTBJjT.jpg) Der Goldene Pavillion gehört zur Rinzai‑Schule des Zen‑Buddhismus und wird heute als Shariden genutzt, also als Ort zur Aufbewahrung buddhistischer Reliquien. Er ist nicht nur ein architektonisches Meisterwerk, sondern auch ein kulturelles Symbol Japans, das in der Literatur, Kunst und Popkultur des Landes immer wieder auftaucht. ![IMG_5135.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/EqWkrggwgfkAvvXAUwcRReGjyBUvinGUTBcmLDCJPSW3vUrTLqBnAoJMZaXuf4q32LJ.jpg) Besonders eindrucksvoll wirkt der Tempel im Wechsel der Jahreszeiten: im Frühling blühen hier die Kirschbäume, der Sommer besticht durch sattes Grün, im Herbst leuchten die roten und gelben Ahornblätter und im Winter bedeckt eine dünne weiße Schneeschicht das goldene Gebäude. Ich war bisher zwei Mal hier gewesen, ein Mal im Hochsommer und das andere Mal zu Beginn des Frühlings, aber gerade im Herbst und im Winter sollte es hier wohl am charmantesten und schönsten aussehen. ![IMG_0103.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/EpvhzXNxCArziRTvnGBShsSvP1jecJDUPdKxRJUnfv85kqQnU7JBaYm6TzTEZgqN6aD.JPG) Auch wenn man sagen muss, dass Kyoto einfach zu viele faszinierende Orte bietet und man aus Zeitmangel gar nicht alles sehen und besichtigen kann, gehört der Kingaku-ju doch zu den absoluten Höhepunkten bei einem Besuch in der alten Kaiserstadt. Dieser Ort, der Geschichte, Spiritualität und Ästhetik auf so harmonische Weise miteinander verbindet ist eigentlich ein absolutes Muss, wenn man einmal nach Kyoto kommen sollte. Und auch ich würde sehr gerne noch einmal zum Kinkaku-ju kommen, wie gesagt am liebsten im Herbst oder im Winter. Aber Kyoto ist leider ein ein wenig weit weg von unserem derzeitigen Domozil, als das wir mal kurz einen spontanen Ausflug wagen könnten. Aber ich bin mir sicher, dass ich es eines Tages noch einmal hier her schaffen werde. Ich freue mich jetzt schon, und wer weiß, vielleicht dauert es ja am Ende doch nicht so lange, wie ich heute glaube.... ![IMG_5144.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/EoCbJuuz4tRcMFAg1nV1k2BeyN2QNUhv8q4eJeUZWdkLmsNHfdK6Nx2TjTtBEWGhJ26.jpg) ![blog-ende.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/23tv6H18WKn98nBVkn2MwVhwWsuFRFgjBGwxLEMVhRZD7zRRbFokaNiAn39fUaB3TxVX6.png)

body.title: Bullying a una rana / Bullying a frog
body.body:
<center>

Una rana muy elegante,
traía un suéter de colores brillantes,
ella se veía admirable
y generó intriga en otros animales. 

El perro y el ave se acercaron
y por un largo rato conversaron,
con amabilidad le preguntaron,
dónde comprar un atuendo estrafalario. 

>A very elegant frog,
wearing a brightly colored sweater,
looked simply stunning
and piqued the curiosity of the other animals.

>The dog and the bird approached
and chatted for quite a while,
they kindly asked her
where they could buy such a quirky outfit. 

![58038.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/23uFiy4pnzR52ptM4wiZCegR3yxioCninrv7a2ybqexJ7NQ6i5U2tYE36TcUPhkoBLZae.gif)

La rana sus preguntas contestó 
hasta que el ave mal se portó,
el suéter le arrebató 
y sin decir nada se lo llevó.

La rana de tristeza se llenó 
y el perro hasta ella se acercó,
le dijo que le tenía un plan mejor,
irse a pasear sin condición.

>The frog answered all his questions
until the bird misbehaved,
snatching the sweater away
and taking it off without a word.

>The frog was overcome with sadness,
and the dog came over to her,
telling her he had a better plan,
to go for a walk, no strings attached.


![58039.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/23yJQqU168dURm6i6pHyzUAUqfH7ue63Fo5Bqtw6NqE3MpGjDE21YMbjWAejyDevuBKMc.gif)

Un día regresó el ave,
con el suéter de colores brillantes,
se encontró con los otros animales,
que paseaban de forma agradable.

Es que la rana perdió su abrigo,

and met the other animals,

though, to be sure, nice and warm.

body.title: Star Citizen's $5,000 spaceship: Players are paying for the dream [ ENG - ESP ]
body.body:
Gracias por pasar, version en español abajo ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23wgD97ZWyR69gBk5cFHNjsZ7zan9rwZvvKvKPQcMLqPtd29rpyMEpWfizYLTDyKnvt42.png) --- Few video games have generated as much fascination and controversy as *Star Citizen*. Since its unveiling in 2012, this ambitious space simulator has achieved something that seemed impossible: raising over one billion dollars without yet having reached a final release version. While other projects seek funding through publishers or investors, *Star Citizen* has built a large portion of its massive budget thanks to a community of players willing to invest money in the dream of a gigantic, persistent space universe. This recent financial milestone has once again placed the game at the center of every conversation. According to official data, the project has now surpassed the $1 billion fundraising mark—a figure typically reserved for only the most successful franchises in the industry. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23vsDrZTitSbQKoygYWLTW3TiPsatUwpseTguaZgeZm53T96FokF7aJvhy27fjuWb3Jre.png) --- What is particularly striking is that a large portion of this money continues to flow in through the sale of spaceships, special bundles, and digital content aimed at the game's most dedicated followers. However, the latest fundraising campaign has sparked a mix of astonishment and debate, even among those who have been following the game's development for years. The cause of this stir is the *Anvil Odin*—a massive capital ship unveiled by Cloud Imperium Games as a futuristic concept slated to arrive in the game's universe in a future update. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23x9yg27nDuQSA3VWA7ZBTqB912mCNzjPk9uMkrpi8gUzfjNyG9NXdFsF5q9UhAZwdM6p.png) --- The detail that has grabbed headlines around the world is neither its size nor its features, but rather its price: approximately $5,000. The Anvil Odin promises to be a veritable space fortress. Concept designs depict a colossal vessel equipped with hangars, medical facilities, living quarters, and advanced combat systems. On paper, it stands as one of the most impressive vehicles ever announced for *Star Citizen*. The catch is that, for now, it exists only as a concept. Buyers do not receive a finished ship, nor can they pilot it immediately within the game. What they are purchasing is a promise of future content. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/Eoe882g8Z5LYJcRem3zY9zKksCaccDGGuFUZQQ8nhbnXhfg2byL8k36qMuyhwADMci4.png) --- This funding model is nothing new within the project. For years, Cloud Imperium Games has sold concept ships to raise funds while continuing to develop the game. Proponents of the system argue that these purchases help finance an extremely ambitious production—one that could not be sustained through traditional methods. Furthermore, they often point out that players participate voluntarily and are fully aware of the terms of each purchase beforehand. On the other hand, critics contend that selling non-existent content for thousands of dollars raises uncomfortable questions regarding the boundaries of crowdfunding in video games. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23w2aXDYAXx45mtc2EYXmQvdadyMz3A6qLKGjDkUF8DKSG3K86wiwye6YMadmgz9u1E2e.jpg) --- This is not the first time the studio has faced criticism for marketing ships that take years to materialize—or that remain in the conceptual phase for extended periods. In fact, this strategy has been the subject of controversy and complaints in the past. Despite all the controversies, the numbers seem to demonstrate that the trust of a significant portion of the community remains intact. Millions of registered accounts and funding that continues to grow indicate that many players believe the project will ultimately deliver on its promises. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23s9Xydu7BZGuo2KdVFmAYairy5fnsE3e8T7D45vBBXdEu6LTxg3HCtDzctES84ypUcgD.jpg) --- Meanwhile, Star Citizen continues to write a unique chapter in the industry's history: that of a video game capable of raising billions and selling $5,000 ships—even before they actually exist.
![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/u_tgy22DxOsAAAAC/killua-kil.gif)








### Español
![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23wgD97ZWyR69gBk5cFHNjsZ7zan9rwZvvKvKPQcMLqPtd29rpyMEpWfizYLTDyKnvt42.png) --- Pocos videojuegos han generado tanta fascinación y controversia como Star Citizen. Desde que fue presentado en 2012, el ambicioso simulador espacial ha conseguido algo que parecía imposible: recaudar más de mil millones de dólares sin haber alcanzado todavía una versión final de lanzamiento. Mientras otros proyectos buscan financiación a través de editoras o inversores, Star Citizen ha construido gran parte de su enorme presupuesto gracias a una comunidad de jugadores dispuesta a invertir dinero en el sueño de un universo espacial gigantesco y persistente. El reciente hito financiero ha vuelto a colocar al juego en el centro de todas las conversaciones. Según los datos oficiales, el proyecto ya ha superado la barrera de los 1.000 millones de dólares recaudados, una cifra reservada para algunas de las franquicias más exitosas de la industria. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23vsDrZTitSbQKoygYWLTW3TiPsatUwpseTguaZgeZm53T96FokF7aJvhy27fjuWb3Jre.png) --- Lo llamativo es que gran parte de este dinero continúa llegando mediante la venta de naves espaciales, paquetes especiales y contenido digital destinado a los seguidores más comprometidos. Sin embargo, la última campaña de financiación ha generado una mezcla de asombro y debate incluso entre quienes llevan años siguiendo el desarrollo del juego. La responsable es la Anvil Odin, una enorme nave capital presentada por Cloud Imperium Games como un concepto futurista destinado a llegar al universo del juego en una actualización futura. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23x9yg27nDuQSA3VWA7ZBTqB912mCNzjPk9uMkrpi8gUzfjNyG9NXdFsF5q9UhAZwdM6p.png) --- El detalle que ha provocado titulares en todo el mundo no es su tamaño ni sus características, sino su precio: aproximadamente 5.000 dólares. La Anvil Odin promete ser una auténtica fortaleza espacial. Los diseños conceptuales muestran una gigantesca nave equipada con hangares, instalaciones médicas, zonas habitables y sistemas de combate avanzados. Sobre el papel, se trata de uno de los vehículos más impresionantes jamás anunciados para Star Citizen. El problema es que, por ahora, solo existe como concepto. Los compradores no reciben una nave terminada ni pueden pilotarla inmediatamente dentro del juego. Lo que adquieren es una promesa de contenido futuro. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/Eoe882g8Z5LYJcRem3zY9zKksCaccDGGuFUZQQ8nhbnXhfg2byL8k36qMuyhwADMci4.png) --- Este modelo de financiación no es nuevo dentro del proyecto. Durante años, Cloud Imperium Games ha vendido naves conceptuales para obtener recursos mientras continúa desarrollando el juego. Los defensores del sistema argumentan que estas compras ayudan a financiar una producción extremadamente ambiciosa que no podría sostenerse mediante métodos tradicionales. Además, suelen señalar que los jugadores participan de forma voluntaria y conocen de antemano las condiciones de cada compra. Por otro lado, los críticos consideran que vender contenido inexistente por miles de dólares plantea preguntas incómodas sobre los límites del crowdfunding en los videojuegos. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23w2aXDYAXx45mtc2EYXmQvdadyMz3A6qLKGjDkUF8DKSG3K86wiwye6YMadmgz9u1E2e.jpg) --- No es la primera vez que el estudio recibe cuestionamientos por comercializar naves que tardan años en aparecer o que permanecen en fase conceptual durante largos periodos. De hecho, esta estrategia ha sido objeto de polémicas y denuncias en el pasado. A pesar de todas las controversias, los números parecen demostrar que la confianza de una parte importante de la comunidad sigue intacta. Millones de cuentas registradas y una financiación que continúa creciendo indican que muchos jugadores creen que el proyecto terminará cumpliendo sus promesas. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23s9Xydu7BZGuo2KdVFmAYairy5fnsE3e8T7D45vBBXdEu6LTxg3HCtDzctES84ypUcgD.jpg) --- Mientras tanto, Star Citizen sigue escribiendo una historia única dentro de la industria: la de un videojuego capaz de recaudar miles de millones y vender naves de 5.000 dólares incluso antes de que existan.
![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/u_tgy22DxOsAAAAC/killua-kil.gif)

body.body: ¡Hola, @syllem! Qué lectura tan hermosa, cercana e inspiradora nos has regalado hoy. Te confieso que me cautivó por completo la honestidad con la que abres tu corazón al contar por qué decidiste mantener la distancia con las mascotas. Cuando de niños sufrimos esas pérdidas tan dolorosas, es completamente natural levantar un muro para proteger el alma de futuros apegos y sufrimientos.\n\nPero los gatos tienen un radar especial, ¿sabes? Dicen por ahí que uno no elige al gato, sino que el gato te elige a ti, y Cloe vio algo sumamente cálido y seguro en ti. Es bellísimo cómo ignoró por completo tu advertencia de \

y procedió a ganarse tu confianza a punta de masajitos.

Rompiste una barrera enorme al acariciarle la cabecera con ese dedito, y la anécdota de tener que levantarte poco a poco con la ayuda de tu pasante porque Cloe se negaba a romper el idilio me sacó una sonrisa enorme. Aunque mantengas firme tu decisión de no tener mascotas por la gran responsabilidad que conllevan, estos pequeños oasis de ternura en medio de la jornada laboral son un bálsamo para el día a día.

¡Qué bueno que te dejaste tomar la fotografía para registrar este hito! 

Gracias por encender esta chispa de diálogo tan bonita. 

¡Un abrazo enorme!

body.title: Beers and sunny day in the beach- Beersaturday week 465
body.body:
> Happy Saturday, #beerlovers! Wishing you all the best. I’m back in this wonderful #beersaturday community to share my beer-filled moments from my weekend outings as part of this initiative—week 465. When the weekend arrives, so does relaxation.
![1001657985.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/23uFZvaN6KFNrbtMseJMdv7gRaWmNCPgqMZYFdRwrU52WxjSbSsHweVDtjkFZseqAr6FD.jpg) ![1001657986.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/23wqq23gFi4yDZED9jE6Cv9aBxkcT3PqgPoWkPGjpwgGfkoGJovq131DUivq4at73JNBz.jpg)
We take these days off from all our responsibilities and escape the routine that weighs us down—this is necessary. Fortunately, I have great friends and a wonderful family. We decided to go to the beach; here the weather is always scorching, the sun is blazing, and the heat is relentless, so it’s a good decision.

> ![1001657983.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/EpNoPkER3dCj5HJtkr1MCmp6V8VLemxBnqf2iPvb2fqG91Av9tMDHb638VnbuBfedHY.jpg)
As I’ve mentioned in other posts, stores always offer the same beer brands, and Polar Light and Negrita are the most popular. We bought Polar Light; they were colder and went down well. I finally read Jordan B. Peterson's *12 Rules for Life.*
------------------

I want to begin by giving this book the praise it deserves. I wouldn't say that it is revolutionary, for it is all ancient wisdom that people have known for centuries (or, at least, they SHOULD 😬). However, Peterson builds things up and breaks them down very articulately.

This is not to say that there are not faults as well. If one is familiar with Peterson, then one realizes that his lectures can become quite winded. My husband described it perfectly the other day: *\

* So, yes, I do acknowledge that the run arounds that Jordan Peterson makes can be rather long. 

-----------------
-----------------

As the book self-proclaims, it lists the 12 Rules that are necessary for achieving a better mindset, building strong character, and therefore a better life. They are basic truths that have ensured the survival of the fittest since the dawn of time. 

I found 9 of the 12 Rules to be fairly straight forward. My favorites were:
------------------

---------------

Rule #2: Treat yourself like someone you are responsible for helping. 

Rule #3: Make friends with people who want the best for you. 

Rule #6: Set your house in perfect order before you criticize the world. 

Rule #8: Tell the truth -- or, at least, don't lie

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf6E9mECBTBN3gF3TkQNWqESzjqUzxmkLGzRikKWfZLq6/1780160280052.jpg) **(Image created using an AI art generator on NightCafe)**

However, the last 3 rules were very drawn out, and a tad bit confusing. For example, Rule #11 is do not bother children when they are skateboarding. It opened with the fact that children partake in dangerous activities in order to conquer said danger, thereby giving them some confidence and stability in themselves. This led to Peterson's angry, resentful friend, which turned into communism, so therefore, do not bother children. (Like, I get it, but still feel like better examples could have been used).

But, would anyone be surprised to learn that every rule is shaped around Christianity? (Because you shouldn't be! 😂). Allow me to explain...
--------------------

Rule #8: Tell the truth, is, without a doubt, the most important rule. After all -- *\

*
---------------------

When one chooses to tell lies, their very existence becomes a lie as well. They lie to achieve ulterior motives -- motives which must not be very moral, considering they need to lie to obtain them. They lie to avoid conflict (\

). They lie to distort the very truth itself. \n\nThe lies weigh down on the individual; they destroy the person's character. Due to everything in their life being superfluous -- their words, their goals, themselves -- the world becomes a \

place. We learn to trust no one. \n\nYet, why would anyone intelligent even THINK to tell the truth when lying is much easier and more gratifying? Because something within each one of us DEMANDS that we live honestly; it DEMANDS us to be better than who we are. That \

-- conscience -- recognizes that it is truth that can take us there. 

And so, it was actually the introduction that provided me with the most insight; every other chapter was merely a breakdown for this truth. 

We NEED rules, because *\
* (see the Israelite slaves in the Desert for 40 years). Simply put, *\
*\n\nThe problem for our generation -- millennials, and beyond -- has arisen from morality; we are a society that views morals as \

and cannot truly differentiate between good and bad. We are taught that tolerance is the most worthy quality a person can have, while judgment is the most unappealing. Therefore, everyone accepts everything -- even things that oppose one another and cannot exist together -- and are never taught to judge situations, people, groups, practices, beliefs for themselves.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ8Ez7jEiG9Bybp8JPAJ7n9kwxkc3MJnZoALiFsiLLCPh/1780160509165.jpg)

# The Sanctuary of the Builder: A Manifesto for Free Creation



---

## **Prologue: The Right to Rise**

There is a sacred covenant between the creator and the soil upon which they build. It is the promise that if you plant a seed with honest hands, the earth will not conspire to crush it before it breaks the surface. It is the assurance that the gardener exists to nurture the growth, not to trample the sprout because it does not yet resemble the tree.

On the blockchain, this covenant has been broken.

We have witnessed a tragedy where the very tools meant to protect the integrity of the network—the downvote, the curation trail—have been weaponized by leviathans of power. These \

entrusted with the stewardship of the ecosystem, have become its jailers. They do not prune the weeds; they scorch the earth. They do not guide the new voice; they silence it with the crushing weight of their accumulated capital.

**It is time to leave the shadow.**

It is time to build where you are free.

---

## **I. The Betrayal of the Guardian**

The downvote was conceived as a shield—a delicate instrument to deflect spam, to repel malice, to preserve the sanctity of the commons. It was never intended to be a hammer.

Yet, look at what has come to pass. The whales, those who hold the greatest sway, have turned the shield into a weapon of mass suppression. They do not downvote to protect; they downvote to dominate. They do not drive away the bad actors; they drive away the *people*. They create an atmosphere of fear where the creator hesitates to speak, fearing that a single misstep, a single unpopular truth, will summon the wrath of the oligarchy.

When the guardian becomes the predator, the flock must flee.

To build in such a place is to build on a fault line. It is to invest your soul in a garden where the owner holds the shears not to shape the hedge, but to decapitate the flowers that grow too tall or bloom in the wrong color.

**This is not protection. This is tyranny disguised as curation.**

---

## **II. The Call to New Grounds**

Where, then, shall the builder go?

You must seek the lands where the soil is rich with freedom, not poisoned by fear. You must migrate to the platforms where the mechanism of suppression has been removed, where the only metric of success is the genuine appreciation of your peers.

**Go to Blurt.**
Here, the downvote button does not exist. There is no tool to crush your voice. There is only the upvote, the comment, the share. Here, value is created by addition, not subtraction. The whale cannot sink your ship, for there are no torpedoes in these waters. You are free to build, free to fail, and free to succeed on the merit of your work alone.

**Return to Steemit.**
In this older ground, the downvote remains, but it has not been twisted into a tool of systematic oppression. The culture there remembers the original intent: correction, not destruction. It is a place where the community self-regulates through dialogue, not through the brute force of coordinated downvoting cascades.

**Build where the wind lifts you, not where the gale seeks to tear you down.**

---

## **III. The Architecture of Freedom**

Imagine a platform designed not for the convenience of the powerful, but for the dignity of the creator.

*   **No Shadow Bans:** Your content reaches the eyes it was meant for.
*   **No Whale Veto:** No single entity, no matter how wealthy, can unilaterally erase your contribution.
*   **True Meritocracy:** Rewards flow from engagement and love, not from the whims of a cartel.

This is not a dream. It is a choice.

Every time you choose to build on a platform that respects your agency, you cast a vote for the future of the internet. Every time you refuse to tolerate the abuse of power, you strengthen the foundation of a free society.

Do not let the whales convince you that their oppression is necessary. Do not let them tell you that their downvotes are for your own good. The gardener who kills the seedling does not love the garden; he loves only his own control over it.

---

## **Epilogue: The Unchained Creator**

The blockchain was born from a desire for freedom. It was forged in the fire of resistance against centralized control. Let us not forget that origin.

If the current chains of Hive have become heavy with the weight of abusive downvotes, then break them. Forge new links. Build new shores.

**Build where you are free.**
**Build where you will not be downvoted into silence.**
**Build where the whales are reminded that they are part of the ocean, not the masters of the tide.**

The future belongs to those who dare to create without fear. Go forth, and build your cathedral in the sunlight.

*— Bilpcoin: We expose the truth, so you can build upon it.*

 #FreeSpeech #BlurtBlog #Steemit #NoDownvote #CreatorRights #HiveExodus #Decentralization #BuildFree #AntiCensorship #Bilpcoin

# The Sanctuary of the Builder: A Manifesto for Free Creation



---

## **Prologue: The Right to Rise**

There is a sacred covenant between the creator and the soil upon which they build. It is the promise that if you plant a seed with honest hands, the earth will not conspire to crush it before it breaks the surface. It is the assurance that the gardener exists to nurture the growth, not to trample the sprout because it does not yet resemble the tree.

On the blockchain, this covenant has been broken.

We have witnessed a tragedy where the very tools meant to protect the integrity of the network—the downvote, the curation trail—have been weaponized by leviathans of power. These \

entrusted with the stewardship of the ecosystem, have become its jailers. They do not prune the weeds; they scorch the earth. They do not guide the new voice; they silence it with the crushing weight of their accumulated capital.

**It is time to leave the shadow.**

It is time to build where you are free.

---

## **I. The Betrayal of the Guardian**

The downvote was conceived as a shield—a delicate instrument to deflect spam, to repel malice, to preserve the sanctity of the commons. It was never intended to be a hammer.

Yet, look at what has come to pass. The whales, those who hold the greatest sway, have turned the shield into a weapon of mass suppression. They do not downvote to protect; they downvote to dominate. They do not drive away the bad actors; they drive away the *people*. They create an atmosphere of fear where the creator hesitates to speak, fearing that a single misstep, a single unpopular truth, will summon the wrath of the oligarchy.

When the guardian becomes the predator, the flock must flee.

To build in such a place is to build on a fault line. It is to invest your soul in a garden where the owner holds the shears not to shape the hedge, but to decapitate the flowers that grow too tall or bloom in the wrong color.

**This is not protection. This is tyranny disguised as curation.**

---

## **II. The Call to New Grounds**

Where, then, shall the builder go?

You must seek the lands where the soil is rich with freedom, not poisoned by fear. You must migrate to the platforms where the mechanism of suppression has been removed, where the only metric of success is the genuine appreciation of your peers.

**Go to Blurt.**
Here, the downvote button does not exist. There is no tool to crush your voice. There is only the upvote, the comment, the share. Here, value is created by addition, not subtraction. The whale cannot sink your ship, for there are no torpedoes in these waters. You are free to build, free to fail, and free to succeed on the merit of your work alone.

**Return to Steemit.**
In this older ground, the downvote remains, but it has not been twisted into a tool of systematic oppression. The culture there remembers the original intent: correction, not destruction. It is a place where the community self-regulates through dialogue, not through the brute force of coordinated downvoting cascades.

**Build where the wind lifts you, not where the gale seeks to tear you down.**

---

## **III. The Architecture of Freedom**

Imagine a platform designed not for the convenience of the powerful, but for the dignity of the creator.

*   **No Shadow Bans:** Your content reaches the eyes it was meant for.
*   **No Whale Veto:** No single entity, no matter how wealthy, can unilaterally erase your contribution.
*   **True Meritocracy:** Rewards flow from engagement and love, not from the whims of a cartel.

This is not a dream. It is a choice.

Every time you choose to build on a platform that respects your agency, you cast a vote for the future of the internet. Every time you refuse to tolerate the abuse of power, you strengthen the foundation of a free society.

Do not let the whales convince you that their oppression is necessary. Do not let them tell you that their downvotes are for your own good. The gardener who kills the seedling does not love the garden; he loves only his own control over it.

---

## **Epilogue: The Unchained Creator**

The blockchain was born from a desire for freedom. It was forged in the fire of resistance against centralized control. Let us not forget that origin.

If the current chains of Hive have become heavy with the weight of abusive downvotes, then break them. Forge new links. Build new shores.

**Build where you are free.**
**Build where you will not be downvoted into silence.**
**Build where the whales are reminded that they are part of the ocean, not the masters of the tide.**

The future belongs to those who dare to create without fear. Go forth, and build your cathedral in the sunlight.

*— Bilpcoin: We expose the truth, so you can build upon it.*

# The Sanctuary of the Builder: A Manifesto for Free Creation



---

## **Prologue: The Right to Rise**

There is a sacred covenant between the creator and the soil upon which they build. It is the promise that if you plant a seed with honest hands, the earth will not conspire to crush it before it breaks the surface. It is the assurance that the gardener exists to nurture the growth, not to trample the sprout because it does not yet resemble the tree.

On the blockchain, this covenant has been broken.

We have witnessed a tragedy where the very tools meant to protect the integrity of the network—the downvote, the curation trail—have been weaponized by leviathans of power. These \

entrusted with the stewardship of the ecosystem, have become its jailers. They do not prune the weeds; they scorch the earth. They do not guide the new voice; they silence it with the crushing weight of their accumulated capital.

**It is time to leave the shadow.**

It is time to build where you are free.

---

## **I. The Betrayal of the Guardian**

The downvote was conceived as a shield—a delicate instrument to deflect spam, to repel malice, to preserve the sanctity of the commons. It was never intended to be a hammer.

Yet, look at what has come to pass. The whales, those who hold the greatest sway, have turned the shield into a weapon of mass suppression. They do not downvote to protect; they downvote to dominate. They do not drive away the bad actors; they drive away the *people*. They create an atmosphere of fear where the creator hesitates to speak, fearing that a single misstep, a single unpopular truth, will summon the wrath of the oligarchy.

When the guardian becomes the predator, the flock must flee.

To build in such a place is to build on a fault line. It is to invest your soul in a garden where the owner holds the shears not to shape the hedge, but to decapitate the flowers that grow too tall or bloom in the wrong color.

**This is not protection. This is tyranny disguised as curation.**

---

## **II. The Call to New Grounds**

Where, then, shall the builder go?

You must seek the lands where the soil is rich with freedom, not poisoned by fear. You must migrate to the platforms where the mechanism of suppression has been removed, where the only metric of success is the genuine appreciation of your peers.

**Go to Blurt.**
Here, the downvote button does not exist. There is no tool to crush your voice. There is only the upvote, the comment, the share. Here, value is created by addition, not subtraction. The whale cannot sink your ship, for there are no torpedoes in these waters. You are free to build, free to fail, and free to succeed on the merit of your work alone.

**Return to Steemit.**
In this older ground, the downvote remains, but it has not been twisted into a tool of systematic oppression. The culture there remembers the original intent: correction, not destruction. It is a place where the community self-regulates through dialogue, not through the brute force of coordinated downvoting cascades.

**Build where the wind lifts you, not where the gale seeks to tear you down.**

---

## **III. The Architecture of Freedom**

Imagine a platform designed not for the convenience of the powerful, but for the dignity of the creator.

*   **No Shadow Bans:** Your content reaches the eyes it was meant for.
*   **No Whale Veto:** No single entity, no matter how wealthy, can unilaterally erase your contribution.
*   **True Meritocracy:** Rewards flow from engagement and love, not from the whims of a cartel.

This is not a dream. It is a choice.

Every time you choose to build on a platform that respects your agency, you cast a vote for the future of the internet. Every time you refuse to tolerate the abuse of power, you strengthen the foundation of a free society.

Do not let the whales convince you that their oppression is necessary. Do not let them tell you that their downvotes are for your own good. The gardener who kills the seedling does not love the garden; he loves only his own control over it.

---

## **Epilogue: The Unchained Creator**

The blockchain was born from a desire for freedom. It was forged in the fire of resistance against centralized control. Let us not forget that origin.

If the current chains of Hive have become heavy with the weight of abusive downvotes, then break them. Forge new links. Build new shores.

**Build where you are free.**
**Build where you will not be downvoted into silence.**
**Build where the whales are reminded that they are part of the ocean, not the masters of the tide.**

The future belongs to those who dare to create without fear. Go forth, and build your cathedral in the sunlight.

*— Bilpcoin: We expose the truth, so you can build upon it.*

 #FreeSpeech #BlurtBlog #Steemit #NoDownvote #CreatorRights #HiveExodus #Decentralization #BuildFree #AntiCensorship #Bilpcoin

# The Sanctuary of the Builder: A Manifesto for Free Creation



---

## **Prologue: The Right to Rise**

There is a sacred covenant between the creator and the soil upon which they build. It is the promise that if you plant a seed with honest hands, the earth will not conspire to crush it before it breaks the surface. It is the assurance that the gardener exists to nurture the growth, not to trample the sprout because it does not yet resemble the tree.

On the blockchain, this covenant has been broken.

We have witnessed a tragedy where the very tools meant to protect the integrity of the network—the downvote, the curation trail—have been weaponized by leviathans of power. These \

entrusted with the stewardship of the ecosystem, have become its jailers. They do not prune the weeds; they scorch the earth. They do not guide the new voice; they silence it with the crushing weight of their accumulated capital.

**It is time to leave the shadow.**

It is time to build where you are free.

---

## **I. The Betrayal of the Guardian**

The downvote was conceived as a shield—a delicate instrument to deflect spam, to repel malice, to preserve the sanctity of the commons. It was never intended to be a hammer.

Yet, look at what has come to pass. The whales, those who hold the greatest sway, have turned the shield into a weapon of mass suppression. They do not downvote to protect; they downvote to dominate. They do not drive away the bad actors; they drive away the *people*. They create an atmosphere of fear where the creator hesitates to speak, fearing that a single misstep, a single unpopular truth, will summon the wrath of the oligarchy.

When the guardian becomes the predator, the flock must flee.

To build in such a place is to build on a fault line. It is to invest your soul in a garden where the owner holds the shears not to shape the hedge, but to decapitate the flowers that grow too tall or bloom in the wrong color.

**This is not protection. This is tyranny disguised as curation.**

---

## **II. The Call to New Grounds**

Where, then, shall the builder go?

You must seek the lands where the soil is rich with freedom, not poisoned by fear. You must migrate to the platforms where the mechanism of suppression has been removed, where the only metric of success is the genuine appreciation of your peers.

**Go to Blurt.**
Here, the downvote button does not exist. There is no tool to crush your voice. There is only the upvote, the comment, the share. Here, value is created by addition, not subtraction. The whale cannot sink your ship, for there are no torpedoes in these waters. You are free to build, free to fail, and free to succeed on the merit of your work alone.

**Return to Steemit.**
In this older ground, the downvote remains, but it has not been twisted into a tool of systematic oppression. The culture there remembers the original intent: correction, not destruction. It is a place where the community self-regulates through dialogue, not through the brute force of coordinated downvoting cascades.

**Build where the wind lifts you, not where the gale seeks to tear you down.**

---

## **III. The Architecture of Freedom**

Imagine a platform designed not for the convenience of the powerful, but for the dignity of the creator.

*   **No Shadow Bans:** Your content reaches the eyes it was meant for.
*   **No Whale Veto:** No single entity, no matter how wealthy, can unilaterally erase your contribution.
*   **True Meritocracy:** Rewards flow from engagement and love, not from the whims of a cartel.

This is not a dream. It is a choice.

Every time you choose to build on a platform that respects your agency, you cast a vote for the future of the internet. Every time you refuse to tolerate the abuse of power, you strengthen the foundation of a free society.

Do not let the whales convince you that their oppression is necessary. Do not let them tell you that their downvotes are for your own good. The gardener who kills the seedling does not love the garden; he loves only his own control over it.

---

## **Epilogue: The Unchained Creator**

The blockchain was born from a desire for freedom. It was forged in the fire of resistance against centralized control. Let us not forget that origin.

If the current chains of Hive have become heavy with the weight of abusive downvotes, then break them. Forge new links. Build new shores.

**Build where you are free.**
**Build where you will not be downvoted into silence.**
**Build where the whales are reminded that they are part of the ocean, not the masters of the tide.**

The future belongs to those who dare to create without fear. Go forth, and build your cathedral in the sunlight.

*— Bilpcoin: We expose the truth, so you can build upon it.*

 #FreeSpeech #BlurtBlog #Steemit #NoDownvote #CreatorRights #HiveExodus #Decentralization #BuildFree #AntiCensorship #Bilpcoin
