## 🫎 LUCKIN COFFEE VS STARBUCKS 

The Chinese coffee chain Luckin Coffee is rapidly closing the gap with Starbucks 



1️⃣ 26 new stores per day! It opened 9,499 new locations over the past 12 months 
2️⃣ 33,596 stores in total, now directly challenging Starbucks' 41,129 locations
3️⃣ Revenue has surged 187% since 2023, with annual growth running at 47%. Starbucks, by comparison, is growing at a modest 2.1%
4️⃣ Better profitability margins: EBIT margin of 9.6% versus 7.6% for Starbucks

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ7UwNXJuDDYhq3dDzwuvuL3m3YMpMoG3C1zkQL7A2Pq8/img_7973.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbYH1cKNGnaipGxDwbbcFVWq3xeupB7Z2Qdw3kPCiCaJq/img_7972.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWeztPzTGjhujcNCypXatanKcsCBmDhuBJSNXbtKyZaC4/img_7971.png)

Despite its impressive growth, Luckin Coffee trades at a much more attractive valuation compared with Starbucks, which is currently in a turnaround phase 

On the other hand, Luckin Coffee does not offer the attractive dividend yield that Starbucks provides 

How do you view the coffee sector from an investment perspective? 

---

## DELL IS DRIVING WALL STREET CRAZY

Remember Dell as the company that supplied reliable PCs and office monitors? 💻

Forget that image. What we've been witnessing over the past few months is not just a recovery, but a complete transformation 

In just one year, Dell's stock surged by an extraordinary 277%, reaching an all-time high of $419 

Last week, the company reported remarkable results 

1️⃣ Revenue climbed to $134 billion
2️⃣ Earnings per share soared to $12.59

Today, we are seeing a clear and aggressive re-rating by investors 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW1nVrHZYhT3tCTRPbcnk2rujo75sLVM1DqjXf5KfRHpS/img_7976.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUzQrt2MCtf3g3f1L8hnF6Kefbf4EGXLP7NBFfzNLBnPF/img_7975.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSEpWAikeqLAiBhxhe3Eg87quCe844RWiFSHgA5vSFyTd/img_7974.png)

Dell's forward P/E ratio has jumped to 23x. The market is no longer valuing Dell as a traditional hardware company focused on PCs. Instead, it is increasingly pricing the company as a high-growth AI leader 

What is your investment view on Dell? 

---

## OLIGOPOLIES AND INVESTING

In the investing world, Warren Buffett calls it an Economic Moat 

The deeper the moat, the harder it is for competitors to threaten a company's profits 

And where do the deepest moats exist? In monopolies, duopolies, and oligopolies 

###Monopolies

1️⃣ TSMC: Advanced semiconductor manufacturing
2️⃣ ASML: EUV lithography systems
3️⃣ Fair Isaac: Consumer credit scoring in the United States
4️⃣ CoStar: Commercial real estate data in the United States

###Duopolies

1️⃣ Visa / Mastercard: Electronic payments
2️⃣ Airbus / Boeing: Commercial aircraft manufacturing
3️⃣ PepsiCo / Coca-Cola: Soft drinks and beverages

###Oligopolies

1️⃣ Alphabet / Microsoft / Amazon: Cloud infrastructure
2️⃣ Fortinet / CrowdStrike / Palo Alto Networks: Cybersecurity
3️⃣ AT&T / Verizon / T-Mobile: U.S. telecommunications

Do you follow any of these markets?

# The Sanctuary of the Builder: A Manifesto for Free Creation



---

## **Prologue: The Right to Rise**

There is a sacred covenant between the creator and the soil upon which they build. It is the promise that if you plant a seed with honest hands, the earth will not conspire to crush it before it breaks the surface. It is the assurance that the gardener exists to nurture the growth, not to trample the sprout because it does not yet resemble the tree.

On the blockchain, this covenant has been broken.

We have witnessed a tragedy where the very tools meant to protect the integrity of the network—the downvote, the curation trail—have been weaponized by leviathans of power. These \

entrusted with the stewardship of the ecosystem, have become its jailers. They do not prune the weeds; they scorch the earth. They do not guide the new voice; they silence it with the crushing weight of their accumulated capital.

**It is time to leave the shadow.**

It is time to build where you are free.

---

## **I. The Betrayal of the Guardian**

The downvote was conceived as a shield—a delicate instrument to deflect spam, to repel malice, to preserve the sanctity of the commons. It was never intended to be a hammer.

Yet, look at what has come to pass. The whales, those who hold the greatest sway, have turned the shield into a weapon of mass suppression. They do not downvote to protect; they downvote to dominate. They do not drive away the bad actors; they drive away the *people*. They create an atmosphere of fear where the creator hesitates to speak, fearing that a single misstep, a single unpopular truth, will summon the wrath of the oligarchy.

When the guardian becomes the predator, the flock must flee.

To build in such a place is to build on a fault line. It is to invest your soul in a garden where the owner holds the shears not to shape the hedge, but to decapitate the flowers that grow too tall or bloom in the wrong color.

**This is not protection. This is tyranny disguised as curation.**

---

## **II. The Call to New Grounds**

Where, then, shall the builder go?

You must seek the lands where the soil is rich with freedom, not poisoned by fear. You must migrate to the platforms where the mechanism of suppression has been removed, where the only metric of success is the genuine appreciation of your peers.

**Go to Blurt.**
Here, the downvote button does not exist. There is no tool to crush your voice. There is only the upvote, the comment, the share. Here, value is created by addition, not subtraction. The whale cannot sink your ship, for there are no torpedoes in these waters. You are free to build, free to fail, and free to succeed on the merit of your work alone.

**Return to Steemit.**
In this older ground, the downvote remains, but it has not been twisted into a tool of systematic oppression. The culture there remembers the original intent: correction, not destruction. It is a place where the community self-regulates through dialogue, not through the brute force of coordinated downvoting cascades.

**Build where the wind lifts you, not where the gale seeks to tear you down.**

---

## **III. The Architecture of Freedom**

Imagine a platform designed not for the convenience of the powerful, but for the dignity of the creator.

*   **No Shadow Bans:** Your content reaches the eyes it was meant for.
*   **No Whale Veto:** No single entity, no matter how wealthy, can unilaterally erase your contribution.
*   **True Meritocracy:** Rewards flow from engagement and love, not from the whims of a cartel.

This is not a dream. It is a choice.

Every time you choose to build on a platform that respects your agency, you cast a vote for the future of the internet. Every time you refuse to tolerate the abuse of power, you strengthen the foundation of a free society.

Do not let the whales convince you that their oppression is necessary. Do not let them tell you that their downvotes are for your own good. The gardener who kills the seedling does not love the garden; he loves only his own control over it.

---

## **Epilogue: The Unchained Creator**

The blockchain was born from a desire for freedom. It was forged in the fire of resistance against centralized control. Let us not forget that origin.

If the current chains of Hive have become heavy with the weight of abusive downvotes, then break them. Forge new links. Build new shores.

**Build where you are free.**
**Build where you will not be downvoted into silence.**
**Build where the whales are reminded that they are part of the ocean, not the masters of the tide.**

The future belongs to those who dare to create without fear. Go forth, and build your cathedral in the sunlight.

*— Bilpcoin: We expose the truth, so you can build upon it.*

 #FreeSpeech #BlurtBlog #Steemit #NoDownvote #CreatorRights #HiveExodus #Decentralization #BuildFree #AntiCensorship #Bilpcoin

body.title: Charity Begins at Home: The Best Way to Practise Charity
body.body: is a saying that is well known not only in Africa but throughout the world. To the best of my knowledge, I have always seen this saying as a reminder of the importance of starting acts of kindness and charity from within our own homes. It is true that whether charity begins at home or somewhere far away, it is still charity. However, between the two, one seems more important. I believe that when charity begins at home, things become more balanced and meaningful. ![Add a heading_20260530_155602_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/youngezeblinzz/23ywHUQEPhK9fnpoGF1KAN4nCTmA5GzSKi6ZSAo7FuqGfLgfNRKSP6MEt9SYL62fhSELj.png) > Image created by me using canva For instance, if I decide to keep my surroundings clean, it will benefit not only me but also everyone living around me. On the other hand, if my environment is dirty and I ignore it while spending my time cleaning other people's surroundings, it would mean that I care more about other people's environment than my own. Is that really a wise decision? Such an action seems inappropriate and requires serious reconsideration. Another question that comes to my mind is this: Why is it often easier for people to help those who are far away than those within their own homes and communities? From what I have observed, this is not a new phenomenon. It happens in many societies around the world. One reason, in my opinion, is that people do not always appreciate those who are closest to them. This reminds me of the saying that a prophet is not honored in his own town. Appreciation motivates those who genuinely help others. When a person's kindness is recognized, they are encouraged to continue doing good. However, when their sacrifices are ignored or taken for granted, they may become discouraged and choose to direct their charitable efforts elsewhere. In addition, some people may prefer to perform charity in places where their actions will receive more attention and recognition. For example, they may choose to visit orphanages or other public places where their generosity can be seen by many people. This can help build a positive image in society. I am not saying that everyone who visits an orphanage for charity is seeking attention. Certainly, many people do it with sincere intentions. However, among a large number of people, not everyone may share the same motive. One thing remains constant: whether charity is performed at home or outside the home, it is still charity. Nevertheless, I strongly believe that charity that begins at home is the best way to practise charity because it allows us to care for those closest to us before extending our helping hands to the wider world. # Thank You 💙 # ![@youngezeblinzz_20260530_051701_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/youngezeblinzz/23w2aHqjRY6Do5oNSZSyadNa1GQi3HBZa6tSyvhiY7iJnkDeXNwqmkrdjPk6CXL2a81y2.png)

# The Sanctuary of the Builder: A Manifesto for Free Creation



---

## **Prologue: The Right to Rise**

There is a sacred covenant between the creator and the soil upon which they build. It is the promise that if you plant a seed with honest hands, the earth will not conspire to crush it before it breaks the surface. It is the assurance that the gardener exists to nurture the growth, not to trample the sprout because it does not yet resemble the tree.

On the blockchain, this covenant has been broken.

We have witnessed a tragedy where the very tools meant to protect the integrity of the network—the downvote, the curation trail—have been weaponized by leviathans of power. These \

entrusted with the stewardship of the ecosystem, have become its jailers. They do not prune the weeds; they scorch the earth. They do not guide the new voice; they silence it with the crushing weight of their accumulated capital.

**It is time to leave the shadow.**

It is time to build where you are free.

---

## **I. The Betrayal of the Guardian**

The downvote was conceived as a shield—a delicate instrument to deflect spam, to repel malice, to preserve the sanctity of the commons. It was never intended to be a hammer.

Yet, look at what has come to pass. The whales, those who hold the greatest sway, have turned the shield into a weapon of mass suppression. They do not downvote to protect; they downvote to dominate. They do not drive away the bad actors; they drive away the *people*. They create an atmosphere of fear where the creator hesitates to speak, fearing that a single misstep, a single unpopular truth, will summon the wrath of the oligarchy.

When the guardian becomes the predator, the flock must flee.

To build in such a place is to build on a fault line. It is to invest your soul in a garden where the owner holds the shears not to shape the hedge, but to decapitate the flowers that grow too tall or bloom in the wrong color.

**This is not protection. This is tyranny disguised as curation.**

---

## **II. The Call to New Grounds**

Where, then, shall the builder go?

You must seek the lands where the soil is rich with freedom, not poisoned by fear. You must migrate to the platforms where the mechanism of suppression has been removed, where the only metric of success is the genuine appreciation of your peers.

**Go to Blurt.**
Here, the downvote button does not exist. There is no tool to crush your voice. There is only the upvote, the comment, the share. Here, value is created by addition, not subtraction. The whale cannot sink your ship, for there are no torpedoes in these waters. You are free to build, free to fail, and free to succeed on the merit of your work alone.

**Return to Steemit.**
In this older ground, the downvote remains, but it has not been twisted into a tool of systematic oppression. The culture there remembers the original intent: correction, not destruction. It is a place where the community self-regulates through dialogue, not through the brute force of coordinated downvoting cascades.

**Build where the wind lifts you, not where the gale seeks to tear you down.**

---

## **III. The Architecture of Freedom**

Imagine a platform designed not for the convenience of the powerful, but for the dignity of the creator.

*   **No Shadow Bans:** Your content reaches the eyes it was meant for.
*   **No Whale Veto:** No single entity, no matter how wealthy, can unilaterally erase your contribution.
*   **True Meritocracy:** Rewards flow from engagement and love, not from the whims of a cartel.

This is not a dream. It is a choice.

Every time you choose to build on a platform that respects your agency, you cast a vote for the future of the internet. Every time you refuse to tolerate the abuse of power, you strengthen the foundation of a free society.

Do not let the whales convince you that their oppression is necessary. Do not let them tell you that their downvotes are for your own good. The gardener who kills the seedling does not love the garden; he loves only his own control over it.

---

## **Epilogue: The Unchained Creator**

The blockchain was born from a desire for freedom. It was forged in the fire of resistance against centralized control. Let us not forget that origin.

If the current chains of Hive have become heavy with the weight of abusive downvotes, then break them. Forge new links. Build new shores.

**Build where you are free.**
**Build where you will not be downvoted into silence.**
**Build where the whales are reminded that they are part of the ocean, not the masters of the tide.**

The future belongs to those who dare to create without fear. Go forth, and build your cathedral in the sunlight.

*— Bilpcoin: We expose the truth, so you can build upon it.*

 #FreeSpeech #BlurtBlog #Steemit #NoDownvote #CreatorRights #HiveExodus #Decentralization #BuildFree #AntiCensorship #Bilpcoin

# US Draft Peace Deal with Iran Includes '$300 Billion' Reconstruction Fund as Trump Withholds Final Signature

**Source:** https://www.ibtimes.co.uk/us-iran-draft-deal-300-billion-fund-1799701

A draft memorandum of understanding between Washington and Tehran has been reported to include a proposed $300 billion (£223.6bn) postwar fund for Iran. The New York Times reported that the proposal has been described differently by each side at the table — with an Iranian official calling it a 'reconstruction programme,' while two diplomats familiar with the latest draft referred to it as an international 'investment fund' that the United States would help facilitate if a final deal is reached.The fund's inclusion comes after Tehran had earlier in negotiations demanded what it called reparations for wartime bombardment damage. Iranian officials estimate the total damage from the conflict at between $300 billion (£223.6bn) and $1 trillion (£745.2bn). Despite the enormous figure, the draft has yet to receive final approval from US President Donald Trump, and active negotiations remain ongoing.BREAKING: The proposed US-Iran peace deal includes a $300 billion reconstruction fund for Iran, per NYT.The program is being called an international \
which the US would facilitate in the final deal.This comes as Iran demands \

to end the war.— The Kobeissi Letter (@KobeissiLetter) May 29, 2026
From Reparations to 'Investment'The rebranding of Tehran's reparations demand into an 'investment fund' appears to be a deliberate diplomatic manoeuvre. The American side redefined the amount as an international investment fund, intentionally avoiding the words 'compensation' or 'reparations,' according to diplomats familiar with the draft. This idea has been attributed to Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner.The distinction matters considerably in Washington's domestic political context, where any payment framed as war reparations would likely face significant congressional opposition. Proposals tied to the fund include the stimulation of real estate projects in Tehran and the creation of a broader investment mechanism as an incentive for the agreement. As part of the broader plan, Iranian negotiators have proposed allowing large American oil and energy companies to enter the Iranian market through joint ventures once sanctions are lifted.Frozen Assets and a 60-Day TruceThe reconstruction fund is not the only financial matter under discussion. In parallel, the issue of Iran's access to $24 billion (£17.9bn) in frozen foreign bank assets is being negotiated. Iran has insisted on receiving at least $20 billion (£14.9bn) of that amount during the negotiation stage to stabilise its economy, while the United States is exploring mechanisms to channel these funds through third countries such as Qatar, according to diplomats familiar with the talks.Beyond the financial provisions, the draft agreement is reported to cover several other critical issues. US and Iranian negotiators have reached an agreement on a memorandum of understanding to extend the ceasefire by 60 days and launch subsequent talks on Iran's nuclear programme, though Trump has yet to give his final approval. The draft also includes provisions to end the blockade of the Strait of Hormuz, a vital global waterway for energy trade whose closure has amplified pressure on both sides to reach a resolution.Unlike Obama unfreezing $1.7 billion in Iranian funds held since the 1979 revolution, Trump is offering Iran a $300 billion outright bribe to let him get out of the mess of the war he started so he can claim a victory and move on. https://t.co/VoOJ6yy0zA— Damon Linker (@DamonLinker) May 28, 2026
Reactions and Remaining GapsThe revelation of the $300 billion figure drew immediate and sharp reactions online. Political science lecturer Damon Linker of the University of Pennsylvania posted on X that Trump was 'offering Iran a $300 billion outright bribe to let him get out of the mess of the war he started so he can claim a victory and move on.' Former Republican lawmaker Adam Kinzinger posted: 'Uh, what?'Both sides have narrowed their differences compared to earlier talks, but disagreements remain over several provisions. Brief clashes between US and Iranian forces in recent days have intensified pressure on negotiators to reach a deal. Iran is reported to be prepared to sign with approval from its top leadership, but the American side has yet to receive that final authorisation from the President.The emergence of a $300 billion reconstruction fund in a US-Iran draft deal marks a pivotal, if unresolved, moment in one of the most consequential conflicts of the decade. Should Trump ultimately sign off, the agreement would not only reshape relations between Washington and Tehran but could also redefine how postwar economic reconstruction is packaged in modern diplomacy — with enormous implications for global energy markets, regional stability, and the precedent it sets for future conflict resolution.

body.title: South Africans Have A Weakness For Online Gambling
body.body:
/></center>

[source](https://businesstech.co.za/news/lifestyle/860043/south-africans-throwing-money-into-a-black-hole/)

Gambling throughout Africa is on the rise as more and more betting apps are launched across the continent. South Africa has seen a spike in off shore \

apps which are illegal as these are not regulated. There is a big difference with betting apps being legal and gambling apps illegal. The slight difference is sport betting and the roll of a dice are prediction type bets whereas gambling like poker and slots are games you are physically involved with and can determine the outcome. Gambling across the African continent is up by 27% and this is largely being driven by South Africa. The growth of the online gambling industry is growing at a rate of 50% year on year for the last 3 years. Gambling is now listed on the consumer price index sitting in 12th position one place below beer. This is another weird statistic knowing not only can the locals not handle their alcohol and have a weakness for beer you wonder how they can afford to even drink let alone gamble. I would not say South Africans are addictive, but these stats prove that they must be. I am not sure if this is down to a lack of education yet somehow it has to be part of the problem.

/></center>

[source](https://businessreport.co.za/news/south-africa/2025-10-26-think-online-gambling-is-legal-in-sa-the-truth-may-surprise-you/)

A court ruling over 14 years ago stated it was where the gambler was located being illegal and not the server. This is the loophole that all these online gambling apps are using to grow their business and like everything in South Africa parliament has not got around to changing the laws. This was set for legislation in 2007 and pushed for 2009 and never got around to finalizing the online gambling laws.

The crazy thing is if someone wins on an offshore platform and is not paid out there is no legal action one can take as it was an illegal transaction. Nearly R1 trillion of the R1.5 trillion is via online offshore gambling sites.

This is actually quire shocking when you consider the official unemployment rate at 32.7% and 60% unofficial. SA Stats has suggested that 55% of all disposable income is now spent gambling online. This is now affecting phone service providers who have reported stagnant growth as customers are spending less using their services. Clothing retailers have also noticed a dip in sales with very slow growth so this trend is now filtering through having reduced what spend there was.

US listed companies like Super Group exited the US markets and have now concentrated on South Africa due to the growth. the number of sports betting companies operating in South Africa has now climbed by 40% since 2021. Back in 2021 there were roughly 280 registered betting companies and now this is well over 400.

The offshore gambling sites operating in South Africa are operating in a grey area and are not having to pay any taxes so this is extremely lucrative. The R1 trillion is generating no taxes and for a government hungry for tax you wonder why nothing has happened for the last 17 years. It is almost like it is being ignored and you do wonder who is benefitting from this because as we know someone always is.

# The Sanctuary of the Builder: A Manifesto for Free Creation



---

## **Prologue: The Right to Rise**

There is a sacred covenant between the creator and the soil upon which they build. It is the promise that if you plant a seed with honest hands, the earth will not conspire to crush it before it breaks the surface. It is the assurance that the gardener exists to nurture the growth, not to trample the sprout because it does not yet resemble the tree.

On the blockchain, this covenant has been broken.

We have witnessed a tragedy where the very tools meant to protect the integrity of the network—the downvote, the curation trail—have been weaponized by leviathans of power. These \

entrusted with the stewardship of the ecosystem, have become its jailers. They do not prune the weeds; they scorch the earth. They do not guide the new voice; they silence it with the crushing weight of their accumulated capital.

**It is time to leave the shadow.**

It is time to build where you are free.

---

## **I. The Betrayal of the Guardian**

The downvote was conceived as a shield—a delicate instrument to deflect spam, to repel malice, to preserve the sanctity of the commons. It was never intended to be a hammer.

Yet, look at what has come to pass. The whales, those who hold the greatest sway, have turned the shield into a weapon of mass suppression. They do not downvote to protect; they downvote to dominate. They do not drive away the bad actors; they drive away the *people*. They create an atmosphere of fear where the creator hesitates to speak, fearing that a single misstep, a single unpopular truth, will summon the wrath of the oligarchy.

When the guardian becomes the predator, the flock must flee.

To build in such a place is to build on a fault line. It is to invest your soul in a garden where the owner holds the shears not to shape the hedge, but to decapitate the flowers that grow too tall or bloom in the wrong color.

**This is not protection. This is tyranny disguised as curation.**

---

## **II. The Call to New Grounds**

Where, then, shall the builder go?

You must seek the lands where the soil is rich with freedom, not poisoned by fear. You must migrate to the platforms where the mechanism of suppression has been removed, where the only metric of success is the genuine appreciation of your peers.

**Go to Blurt.**
Here, the downvote button does not exist. There is no tool to crush your voice. There is only the upvote, the comment, the share. Here, value is created by addition, not subtraction. The whale cannot sink your ship, for there are no torpedoes in these waters. You are free to build, free to fail, and free to succeed on the merit of your work alone.

**Return to Steemit.**
In this older ground, the downvote remains, but it has not been twisted into a tool of systematic oppression. The culture there remembers the original intent: correction, not destruction. It is a place where the community self-regulates through dialogue, not through the brute force of coordinated downvoting cascades.

**Build where the wind lifts you, not where the gale seeks to tear you down.**

---

## **III. The Architecture of Freedom**

Imagine a platform designed not for the convenience of the powerful, but for the dignity of the creator.

*   **No Shadow Bans:** Your content reaches the eyes it was meant for.
*   **No Whale Veto:** No single entity, no matter how wealthy, can unilaterally erase your contribution.
*   **True Meritocracy:** Rewards flow from engagement and love, not from the whims of a cartel.

This is not a dream. It is a choice.

Every time you choose to build on a platform that respects your agency, you cast a vote for the future of the internet. Every time you refuse to tolerate the abuse of power, you strengthen the foundation of a free society.

Do not let the whales convince you that their oppression is necessary. Do not let them tell you that their downvotes are for your own good. The gardener who kills the seedling does not love the garden; he loves only his own control over it.

---

## **Epilogue: The Unchained Creator**

The blockchain was born from a desire for freedom. It was forged in the fire of resistance against centralized control. Let us not forget that origin.

If the current chains of Hive have become heavy with the weight of abusive downvotes, then break them. Forge new links. Build new shores.

**Build where you are free.**
**Build where you will not be downvoted into silence.**
**Build where the whales are reminded that they are part of the ocean, not the masters of the tide.**

The future belongs to those who dare to create without fear. Go forth, and build your cathedral in the sunlight.

*— Bilpcoin: We expose the truth, so you can build upon it.*

 #FreeSpeech #BlurtBlog #Steemit #NoDownvote #CreatorRights #HiveExodus #Decentralization #BuildFree #AntiCensorship #Bilpcoin

Arsenal vs PSG: Champions League Final Showdown Promises European Glory

Football fans around the world are set for a thrilling night as Arsenal take on Paris Saint-Germain in the UEFA Champions League Final at the Puskás Aréna in Budapest. The match is one of the biggest fixtures in European football, with both clubs aiming to etch their names into history.

Arsenal enter the final full of confidence after winning the Premier League title, their first league championship in over two decades. Under manager Mikel Arteta, the Gunners have developed into one of Europe's most disciplined and exciting teams. They are now chasing their first-ever UEFA Champions League trophy, a title that has eluded them throughout their history.

On the other side, PSG arrive as the defending European champions. Led by Luis Enrique, the French giants have once again demonstrated their attacking strength throughout the competition. With stars such as Ousmane Dembélé and Achraf Hakimi available, PSG will be aiming to secure back-to-back Champions League titles.

The final is expected to be a fascinating tactical battle. Arsenal have built their success on defensive solidity and teamwork, while PSG possess one of the most dangerous attacking units in world football. Many analysts believe the contest could be decided by small moments of brilliance or defensive mistakes.

For Arsenal supporters, this match represents an opportunity to witness history. For PSG fans, it is a chance to confirm their club's status among Europe's elite. Whatever the outcome, football lovers can expect an unforgettable Champions League final filled with drama, passion, and world-class talent.

Prediction: Arsenal 2–2 PSG after normal time, with the winner potentially decided in extra time or penalties.

body.title: Green Fields, Forest Paths & Sunset Jogging: Another Active Day\nMy Actifit Report Card: May 30 2026
body.body:
Asslamoalekum and hello to #Actifit community. Welcome to another blog. I hope you are all doing well. I am also doing pretty well. It was another wonderful day here in my village. It rained cats and dogs last night. So the weather became very pleasant. I got uo bit late in the morning. It was weekend, so I relaxed in the afternoon. In the evening I decided to go for my daily workout. I am the to be consistent in my physical activity. Believe me I am feeling very active and my fitness is getting better day by day. I prefer jogging over running and walking.But today's physical activity was a mix up of joging and walking. I think if we start jogging or walking at least five days in a week then we can live a healthy life. But unfortunately most of us don't spare time for physical activities. They don't go for walking or jogging and ultimately they fall ill. Almighty ALLAH build our body for moving not for relaxing all the day. I feel myself pretty much lucky that I am persistent in my physical activities. I am regular in my exercise . I try to complete 6k steps regularly. Today first I went for walking alone at a very natural and soothing place in m y village Pai Khel. I crocrossed famous railway track of my village that is built by British Government before the establishment of Pakistan. I took some pictures there and passed away. I tried to shoot these pictures in a different way. Here are the pictures I managed to take today. It's midday, and the sun is blazing, heating us to our very souls.

It's a beautiful day to go to the beach and enjoy the beauty of life while cooling off in the sea and watching the waves dance from one side to the other. But I'd better stop dreaming for today and start putting the laundry in the washing machine. There will be plenty of vacation days with lots of beach, sun, and sand.

body.title: [Esp/Eng] ✨Lindo servilletero para la cocina.  // Cute napkin holder for the kitchen.✨
body.body:
<div class=text-justify>

###### <center>✨¡Hola amigos amantes de la creatividad! Espero que estén todos bien.✨</center>

<center>¡Buenas tardes, amigos! Espero que estén pasando una excelente semana. Por mi parte, estoy contenta de pasar por acá a compartir una linda idea con ustedes. En esta ocasión les comparto el paso a paso para elaborar un lindo servilletero. Hace mucho no hacía uno; y es que suelen ser muy resistentes y la decoración no me cansa tan rápido, por lo cual la dejo intacta por un tiempo. Como ven, esta vez me fui por algo más gracioso para la cocina sin que deje de ser tierno; es por eso que pensé en elaborar una linda maceta con algunas flores y un pequeño ratón asomado.</center>

**🔸Sin más que añadir, a continuación los dejo con el paso a paso:**

> ###### <center>✨¡Hello friends who love creativity! I hope you are all well.✨</center>

> <center>Good afternoon, friends!I hope you're having a wonderful week. I'm happy to stop by and share a lovely idea with you. This time, I'm sharing the step-by-step instructions for making a cute napkin holder. It's been a while since I made one; they tend to be very durable, and I don't get tired of the decorations so quickly, so I leave them untouched for a while. As you can see, this time I went for something a bit more whimsical for the kitchen, while still keeping it sweet. That's why I decided to make a cute little flowerpot with some flowers and a tiny mouse peeking out.</center>

> **🔸Without more to add, then I leave you with the step by step:**

---

<center>![portada defi.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/EoGzJhHqUbtvvxbpygjVmnufq1L6VD666YyjvtSQWucP3ozYV1BDR5vLx3H3VkvsPFX.JPG)</center>

---

<div class=\

> **♥️ESPERO QUE TE GUSTE, ¡Empecemos!**
**♥️I HOPE YOU LIKE IT, Let's start!**
---
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)

> - Cartulina escarchada dorada. - Cartón grueso. - Foami gris. - Foami marrón. - Foami verde. - Foami rosa. - Tela con el diseño y color deseado. - Rollo de cartón delgado. - Pinturas y marcadores. - Pegamento. - Tijeras. - Regla. - Hoja blanca. - Lápiz.
- Gold glitter cardstock. - Thick cardboard. - Gray foam. - Brown foam. - Green foam. - Pink foam. - Fabric in the desired design and color. - Thin cardboard tube. - Paints and markers. - Glue. - Scissors. - Ruler. - White paper. - Pencil.
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)

> ###### ✨PASO 1: Lo primero que debemos hacer es tomar la hoja blanca y comenzar a dibujar las ideas que tengamos en mente para este servilletero. Mi primera idea fue un conejo saliendo de la maceta, pero recordé que ya he elaborado muchas decoraciones con conejos, así que, como segunda opción, se me vino a la mente un ratoncito. Al estar lista la idea en la hoja blanca, es momento de transferir a los colores correspondientes de foami, como explico a continuación: ✨Cabeza: 2.8 cm de circunferencia en foami gris. ✨Orejas: 3 cm x 2.9 cm en foami gris. ✨Cuerpo: 3.2 cm x 2.5 cm en foami gris. ✨Patas: 1.2 cm x 1 cm en foami gris. ✨Maceta: 6.5 cm x 1.5 cm y 4.8 cm x 5.2 cm en foami marrón. ✨Enredadera: 4 cm x 2 cm en foami verde. ✨Pasto: 12.5 cm x 3 cm en foami verde. ✨Flores: 1 cm en foami rosa.

> ###### ✨STEP 1: The first thing we need to do is take a blank sheet of paper and start sketching out our ideas for this napkin holder. My first idea was a rabbit popping out of a flowerpot, but I remembered I've already made many decorations with rabbits, so as a second option, a little mouse came to mind. Once the idea is ready on the blank sheet of paper, it's time to transfer it to the corresponding colors of foam, as explained below: ✨Head: 2.8 cm in circumference, gray foam. ✨Ears: 3 cm x 2.9 cm, gray foam. ✨Body: 3.2 cm x 2.5 cm, gray foam. ✨Legs: 1.2 cm x 1 cm, gray foam. ✨Flowerpot: 6.5 cm x 1.5 cm and 4.8 cm x 5.2 cm, brown foam. ✨Vine: 4 cm x 2 cm, green foam. Grass: 12.5 cm x 3 cm in green foam. ✨Flowers: 1 cm in pink foam.
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)
|![IMG_20260513_093944.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/Eoc926xoLLfn8hVbfZDEQXMEoYBeD6rN1wmfDTYwQkrHa1ZWTGiMkHVZTduKuMJR6Yf.jpg)|![IMG_20260513_094021.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/EowHY2udz9LeSeT8BPwo8KTp3Pms5EhLzXHadTe8xtdcmxLyfTqDtRvFeYLv9AtQTtN.jpg)| |-|-|
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)

> ###### ✨PASO 2: Al estar recortadas todas las piezas, es momento de dar color a los bordes con pinturas o marcadores que hagan contraste; siempre es mejor utilizar tonos más oscuros y, aunque casi siempre se utiliza un tono más oscuro del color original de cada pieza, a veces, como es el caso de la maceta y el ratón, queda bien un borde en color negro, ya que al momento de difuminar, da el color perfecto para piezas oscuras.

> ###### ✨STEP 2: Once all the pieces are cut out, it's time to color the edges with contrasting paints or markers. It's always best to use darker tones, and although you almost always use a darker shade of the original color of each piece, sometimes, as with the flowerpot and the mouse, a black border works well, since when blended, it creates the perfect color for dark pieces.
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)
|![IMG_20260513_095223.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/EoeGKWkd7ijGhC2KLwzgRACA5mgFVpy9Q7ZQau3vLbGzAC7z1UPvt2P6SkJoq8jJEfZ.jpg)|![IMG_20260513_095328.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/Eos2MBJWXRbL5W7FEh98wonduhq3sqESR1eyLwf5nR2iRkJiQfH1NdRAyoj1EFuFYW7.jpg)| |-|-|
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)

> ###### ✨PASO 3: Al estar secas, viene mi parte favorita, que es dar detalles más específicos, con marcadores, como ojos, nariz, boca, cejas; definir mucho mejor las orejas con un tono rosa, al igual que definir el pasto, las flores y, por supuesto, la maceta. Al estar secas las piezas, es momento de pegar hasta formar la decoración.

> ###### ✨STEP 3: Once they're dry, comes my favorite part: adding more specific details with markers, such as eyes, nose, mouth, and eyebrows. Define the ears much better with a pink tone, as well as the grass, flowers, and, of course, the flowerpot. Once the pieces are dry, it's time to glue them together to complete the decoration.
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)
|![IMG_20260513_100927.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/EoeGRJ7vk4rZvqFzmXCvxRuLiJXtWKsA9FXqQZV1RDqLHfBfXtJLjG31cfnDVt7AjWQ.jpg)|![IMG_20260513_101007.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/Eos2D63yNfnY2UTRhmraBAXszWcTovTpBcMWYABEKyyiGPMhPEBeT9nrT1r9BhCeqLq.jpg)| |-|-|
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)

> ###### ✨PASO 4: Ahora vamos con la base y estructura del servilletero; para eso, vamos a tomar el cartón grueso y vamos a recortar un cuadrado de 15 cm, al cual le recorté las puntas redondeadas para dar un mejor acabado. Seguidamente, tomamos la cartulina escarchada dorada, recortamos un cuadrado con las mismas medidas del cartón y pegamos encima.

> ###### ✨STEP 4: Now let's move on to the base and structure of the napkin holder; For this, we'll take the thick cardboard and cut out a 15 cm square, rounding the corners for a neater finish. Next, we'll take the gold glitter cardstock, cut out a square the same size as the cardboard, and glue it on top.
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)
|![IMG_20260513_094050.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/EpJYaQPpcR3rqnRv3gVz6kodDAam1aZRHDm9w1emGL9qjYWYHp8NkC3ctA1Zo4rU4zt.jpg)|![IMG_20260513_094056.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/EpA3uMAV753KV7oswJ2FcmHqhLVVCDG5uzxekbogHJnmRvZrf86Ly7mKxN4aATZw2f9.jpg)| |-|-|
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)

> ###### ✨PASO 5: Tomamos el rollo de cartón; en este caso lo recorté a una medida de 23 cm, busqué una tela con el color y diseño que hiciera combinación con la decoración y pegué hasta cubrir del todo el rollo. Al estar listo, pegamos en forma vertical en el centro de la base de cartón y, finalmente, en uno de los bordes de la base, pegamos la decoración del ratón.

> ###### ✨STEP 5: We'll take the cardboard tube; in this case, I cut it to 23 cm. I'll find a fabric with a color and design that matches the decoration and glue it on until the entire tube is covered. Once that's done, we'll glue it vertically in the center of the cardboard base, and finally, on one of the edges of the base, we'll glue the mouse decoration.
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)

>  ![383239.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/242Nua7kMAnbJmPtzZ1WLDoS81PpjGmhcbNWJpSv7x9npzSMgf9AKDoKztSzBJ47otqkE.png) Hola, hola, buenos días, ¿cómo están, amigos, por aquí? Todo muy bien, gracias a Dios, hoy en mi día de trabajo en casita, como todos los fines de semana, específicamente los sábados. Espero que por allá también estén superbién. Pasando un lindo fin de semana, yo les comento que estoy superemocionada porque la próxima semana es mi graduación y, aunque no quiero que llegue porque sé que va a pasar superrápido, estoy superemocionada también.
Hello, hello, good morning! How are you all doing over there? Everything’s going really well, thank goodness. Today I’m working from home, as I do every weekend—especially on Saturdays. I hope you’re all doing brilliantly over there too. Having a lovely weekend. I’m just saying I’m absolutely thrilled because next week is my graduation and, although I don’t want it to come because I know it’s going to fly by, I’m absolutely thrilled as well.
![20260529_165421.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23vi1fAffTHHtSwdzu7KdvuzmAXLkuPBDqSwYWkrt1fumH7PUmu7uh2z9ep7WXveScRig.jpg) ![20260529_165423.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23uQrDkktjTcvpyBjaGHg45cPrr1Z3DH8d7NJwTvzXXPPdEEUK2teXh2byVN93yodVdSS.jpg) ![20260529_170733.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23tbrtpQ5JUF7qxat6j5vhr4XV4pwH18E5R9NjxLBgadRZgQLDBbbMp1eyNzYJweS6nwr.jpg) ![20260529_171956.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23xVM9USM6nQ2rDdZc6unGu3zhdD84HxNmqgZJzrUqShcqAiW9yZSWPAJYoFRcvaGrRuH.jpg) ![20260529_183036.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23vhudeQKVNbSDHBfueh8ZuMg6pY3zyhByZBXvLKN4dG6oMuHm9jnEHxjcVXgGuvsPStZ.jpg) Saben que, por situaciones personales, no había podido comprarme nada aún para todo el proceso de la graduación, así que decidí aprovechar esta oportunidad para salir un rato a dar una vuelta por los centros comerciales de la isla y el primer centro comercial que yo siempre visito. La verdad es que al principio yo estaba bastante asustada, porque ya tengo la fecha montada encima ye, cuando llegué, a pesar de que recorrí varias tiendas, no lograba conseguir algo que me gustara. Todo me quedaba así, tipo forro de la lavadora; a pesar de que no soy gorda, sentía que todo lo que me probaba me quedaba superhorrible y nos tocó supercaminar mucho a las tiendas del Sambil.
You know, due to personal circumstances, I hadn’t been able to buy anything yet for the whole graduation process, so I decided to make the most of this opportunity to pop out for a bit and have a look around the island’s shopping centres – starting with the one I always visit first. To be honest, I was quite panicked at first, because the date is right around the corner, and when I got there, even though I went round several shops, I couldn’t find anything I liked. Everything looked like a washing machine drum on me; even though I’m not fat, I felt that everything I tried on looked absolutely awful, and we ended up walking ages to the shops in Sambil.
![20260529_172419.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23uQrWgnKZZKgsPZmNfSPb2QVzsxAUHwzGxdMCFtYFydwBDbFHyiZ43BZgyfanypdhBMK.jpg) ![20260529_173920.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23tmJB3MWgrFZ1w6e9iGN1jutyqE2ewkHamg9roE5K9qzJphBVtU2anmJpA9iMUS6koL6.jpg) ![20260529_174056.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23u64kMNYpWKmpvok7KEXFAGMtnjnBaKomoEUkpafyMM1wpaJMeY5aC4NqTT5fXWyNphe.jpg) ![20260529_174346.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23uFWDF57ggt8CcKnhDEivvf5y1Ehgke9VJiUxLLScAfzb4AwzEKSniUK7igpe5CKBtPj.jpg) ![20260529_172506.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23zS3AhZgoXyBpPMX2fq8wnPzEck26t6YvksWjLL65KtFA63NbuGZE6RjU2YUm188ky4X.jpg) Al final de todo sí, conconseguí que quería, tal vez no de la manera que lo quería, pero para ser de la manera que yo lo necesitaba, tenía que haber sido con tiempo, pero ahora que no tengo tiempo tocó improvisar y A pesar de todo sí, me gustó bastante solo que aún no lo voy a. Mostrar para que sea una sorpresa, el día de la foto qué pasó, pero la verdad es que caminamos bastante. Me cas cansó súper gracias a Dios conté con el apoyo de mi familia, nos va a llevar a un barco y ellos me ayudaron a elegir un lugar especial para ese día aprovecho también para decir que en el sambil, por esos 2 días hubo un descuento de 20% y 30% por los dias Sambil en las tiendas que la verdad está súper espectacular además de que también cashea tenía el 10% por los días Araguaney.
In the end, yes, I got what I wanted – perhaps not exactly as I’d hoped, but it turned out just as I needed it to. It should have been planned well in advance, but as I didn’t have time, I had to improvise. And despite everything, yes, I really liked it – I just won’t be showing it yet so it remains a surprise. As for what happened on the day of the photoshoot, well, the truth is we walked quite a lot. I got really tired, thank God I had my family’s support; they’re taking us on a boat and they helped me choose a special place for that day. I’d also like to mention that at Sambil, there was a 20% and 30% discount for the ‘Sambil Days’ in the shops, which is actually absolutely brilliant, and on top of that, I also had a 10% discount for the ‘Araguaney Days’.

body.title: Lessons from small mistakes: The priceless wealth of a successful life, My Actifit Report Card: May 31 2026
body.body:
> Assalamu Alaikum. I hope you are all well and are having a healthy and beautiful time in your respective positions. Today I want to share my feelings on a topic that is deeply related to our daily lives. The topic is the importance of learning from small mistakes. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/95b7f0de-13c5-41c5-87cc-964c7600d4a3.jpg) We often think that big failures in life teach us the most. But the reality is that before big failures, countless small mistakes come before us as warnings. Those who give importance to those small mistakes can largely avoid big problems in the future. I often hear a saying - people never stumble over big mountains, they stumble over small stones. The simpler the saying, the deeper its meaning. While walking on the path of life, we often neglect small things. We think they are not that important. But those neglected small mistakes eventually become the cause of big problems. Many such incidents have happened in my own life. Sometimes not doing anything on time, sometimes not giving importance to someone's words, and sometimes being careless about my own decisions - I had to face many unnecessary problems because of these small mistakes. Then I realized that no matter how small the mistake is, it is very important to learn from it. I think that making mistakes is a natural characteristic of humans. There is no person in the world who has never made a mistake. However, the true identity of a person lies not in his mistakes, but in what he has learned from those mistakes. If someone makes the same mistake again and again, then he is not only making a mistake, but also wasting his opportunity to improve. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/0878f796-2041-4b07-9184-c3e8faa16cf9.jpg) Small mistakes act like a mirror for us. They show us our weaknesses, carelessness and limitations. If we can accept them and try to correct ourselves, then we can gradually become more mature and experienced people. Every day in life brings an opportunity to learn something new. So I think that we should not see any mistake as a matter of shame but should take it as a step towards learning. Because a small lesson today may save us from a big danger in the future. Finally, if you want to be successful in life, you should not only be ready for big challenges, but also give equal importance to small things. Because only if we can avoid small stones on the way, we will be able to move forward towards our destination safely. The foundation of big success lies in learning from small mistakes.

body.title: 29 May 2026, Freewriters Community Daily Writing Prompt Day 3118: A Bad Day for All Concerned
body.body:
This post was inspired by today's 5-minute writing prompt in the Freewriters Community - [**29 May 2026, Freewriters Community Daily Writing Prompt Day 3118: throw him under the bus**](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/29-may-2026-freewriters-community-daily-writing-prompt-day-3118-throw-him-under-the-bus)

Enjoy !



![scharfsascha-london-263671_1280.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alonicus/23x19AeypnmXfRAgq2GWSjYgNEubW6sZGoj8A1RAjsgugzedkqfnNamH2h5T9t5E5kUSe.jpg)

*Image by <a href=\

>Pixabay* This one is a true story, from quite a few years ago. Back in the late '80's, I used to drink in South Wimbledon, at the Leather Bottle pub. That was after the legendary Southampton pub in Surbiton was closed down. The Leather Bottle was a pretty average pub - not a dive, but not some fancy upmarket gastro-pub either. That came later; it was used as a regular location for filming The Bill (a UK police-themed TV series that ran for decades). They spent the money doing the place up, and the producers decided it was no longer fitted the look they were after. You can see what I mean if you look it up on Google Earth, it's got a daft blue paint scheme and silly little picket fences blocking off where we used to park our bikes. But the great thing about the Leather Bottle was that it had awesome live music every night and on Sunday lunchtimes. The landlord (whose name I won't give here) was a really lovely bloke if he liked you. But he was Irish, and incredibly fiery if he didn't like you or you broke the rules. One lunchtime, someone he'd previously had trouble with came in. The landlord spotted him, and told him he'd been barred and to get out. They troublemaker started to kick off, so the landlord grabbed him by the collar and dragged him outside. I don't know anyone who admitted seeing the actual fight, but it ended when the landlord shoved the idiot into the road, right in front of a number 131 bus. Splat. Permanently barred. From the pub, and from life. The landlord went down for several years, and we got a new landlord with less of a short fuse. I heard the story a little while later, from the father of a girlfriend who was a bus driver based at Merton garage; he drove the 131, but it was a colleague of his driving that day. Poor chap was pretty traumatised. So yeah, a bad day for all concerned. Also... oops, I spent a bit more than 5 minutes typing this up. D'oh ! That's what happens when you get carried away by a story.....

body.title: Garden May Journal 2
body.body:
Hello gardeners, how are you?
I can already complain that I'm tired, when the winter will come to rest, I'm kidding.
A lot of work is behind us, and it's normal for fatigue to come.
I planted a new batch of radishes right next to the cherry tomatoes. It's warm and with watering the radishes arrive quickly.
![20260522_172244.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/AJpjrSQhvbVQ9Zj9j2cJQjvFjMsXhUa8JPAZjkkCjQdfhqonNucr1Y37bRjjWos.jpg)
There is a lot of dill this year and my wife regularly picks it and adds it to dishes and salads.
![20260524_125417.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/AKLt5WqsLpeaBuBYs2u2TQN9ze2y6HrLUt6LJgKAksnkjWRDG8BZMwgfELKXZXj.jpg)
And of course, no dish can be complete without onions and garlic.
![20260524_125134.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/AKDgZT9dRhnn1xQ6LwqE5eT5tj6nba2kRj3XNt3bnsCLSszLvmpWcBoDxudFRKH.jpg)
And our cherries have ripened a lot more this year ,my son could hardly wait.
![20260530_150831.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/EpxsivTYv5h8NjiMCyGCXjspVispcv5gH3jzWabdGSxWRMC3XrrpVpDpyteS5m7VhcR.jpg)
And of course we sweeten it all with new baked potatoes
![20260529_190141.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/23zS9kZWf4aYSZ8w7RscDYw7EkjnyJFUXdQ34LEexU62cDr97oxGZpvckRxvdEwX3P7gz.jpg)
We picked the peas about 2-3 weeks ago and yesterday we picked them all off.
![20260529_190005.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/Ep1WRU5t4Ra7rRWb2oXa5VpowgPskrmCoJKkgeLtkwPHVYH77u1Z9BB7tpKv2Qt78c7.jpg)
We plan to plant our peppers in the garden next week . But I got a few varieties of peppers and tomatoes from a friend . I marked each row to keep track of how each variety is doing in my garden .
![20260524_131019.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/AK55uP3m79UTRAxscuJQTqnsUbFTqkbzmcBoCo6wgwgkScWfjoyoeaiFhwHqFKR.jpg)

![20260524_131007.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/AK2E1PEnuoqVv61H8QXQ8qGHfSKVspE92rVahJ8kBCyxLfZGzVWVyWxcWuUqzyK.jpg)
We also installed a watering system, we installed arches on which we will later hang the shade net, and we mulched with straw.
![20260528_194335.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/EpNmuB5CoRce44p9DntSQA4znMCWJJ6JaQC1sbE7k3VCMWs1pPSPkQNju86SoxY5WQk.jpg)
It's getting crowded in the garden, we're watering it part by part. It's roughly divided into four parts. To relieve the water pump and make sure it has good pressure.
![20260528_194314.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/23xp6c8r5tdTzsaxdGm45DRwrHanVA4xh2fZiP7g43iwwt4FAwxZVsi5dRtndWYrumTD7.jpg)

![20260528_194307.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/23z79YcBPLv4LmqTcc41JzgRssP4ASbDHQ7diJwf5dcUHuecoXcRyGrSPQkHgFoeru6XJ.jpg)
A meter-long green bean and cucumber are thriving in a small fairy garden.
![20260529_181940.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/23x17EN1XgUQBvWtNNVcyrSFtAz2B4kFdeh1Krc56hHWicZ7u1GgfjAccUC44EUcK75f7.jpg)

![20260529_182004.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/23tbsGTLaCSiq4KHMjzQQRa4CZPRgXhVXcaogwc3XuNhTm74YXWhNC9f4ZkU6K2xk4XF5.jpg)
The marigolds have bloomed in the greenhouse, and I think the cherry tomatoes will too.
![20260529_182023.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/23zbKTTDy9S1b6LFXTeSD2ZMbm5KyEAcgLXNCtbbsZWpDPHETzreN1m7DW8h1cpqB8tdQ.jpg)

![20260529_182028.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/242rneKFajU1Cm7Ug3cRc9JHdarujpfe3fdRJd5Xr43voBTgzQmd5BFngwXDBj86X6pQ8.jpg)
We made a little space for Albicia under the cypress trees.

![20260524_125006.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/AJmrKwe2KFdTkeYv9V7XAYbk7xyXai5bk8eahq585AfK9zonC8K5VibEubNEaGJ.jpg)
The little chicks that have grown up I tried to let them into this part where there is a lot of grass. I put some plastic nets to protect the raspberries but. It seems I made a shelter for them there :)
![20260529_182218.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/23xp4FPLx5LKj8cbfaAzVwqFohto2zhVc46jNLWhPDN7opUzJF8zgwrY5NK7mUFgQhmmn.jpg)




I know that many of you like, and we like too, to sit down and rest after work.![IMG20260524214016.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/Eo8J93fy1B2bb3iQKNYHcWWoyj4Ce7b2cH7xmC5pJ7b6a8rLWnB85xJUKjcYm4qGrCW.jpg)


![IMG20260524214121.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/Eo1uVGQaJ8KMgnTzSsdKD4q7jwssSyvuSkcieoneN11HufA3qUViahad8Cd6z4fiTPd.jpg)
I almost skipped the roses :)

![20260530_151859.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/23uQr599E3Bkz5YVLdrnwnVeJScRVZd1Cc7hSbgUt7Aeph6KBK5U84ZTLLfe8t2LbTVBp.jpg)![20260530_151908.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/Eos1ppE49aJRdMjoCw3cutcti4zZc2FCg3cLv4QrbqZeYe1Ds9tEkC539YyLmNouHs3.jpg)


---

Thanks for reading.
Until next time.
Stay healthy.
Markone85.

body.title: Rattle Carousel and recycling ( en/ e n/ es)
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVrumC6ZWaHnGD8HMXwxn7yo6madf3j17S8L4Z6nDybbW/1780155969350.jpg)


ENGLISH VERSIÓN 

¡Greetings and good day to all!


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRGpFYvZFDDUzsv4qAmBB5i4UxDh6qrnhuSVyd9xLwSnF/1780156669874.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmednZq25vuWcziLtbbaBQ1zjQPPvCm6T8ZhTSvvMdJXxp/1780156670068.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeyL2hcavLBjqCGE4THwmWSAfRmFoHB3h9jar9nCmbJb2/1780156670284.jpg)

It is always a pleasure for me to enter this community and share with you my experiences in the world of crafts, and specifically in traditional crafts.

In this artistic path, I like to venture into crafts from the recycling of things that go to the world of waste.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaaHPxvYVXQW98LEpzbGJ8etQenD5Ah7HW7o6EGti8fw5/1780156799731.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbjc4n4GZT1jwetwGXaGEqHurZfnYWogjKXdEdKsMAXYx/1780157785210.jpg)

Craft is a hobby to which I feel very attached and it helps me disconnect from the tensions and emotions that larger works produce. This type of work is less intellectual and requires concentration and manual precision, in which even different trades or skills are mixed.

In this case, I bring you a piece in which I used different elements of industrial equipment and products that I describe below.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQzAxvRwCKBeRqRsZzcBrZzgnA9g58xukN7n3TsYWZbej/1780156901458.jpg)


_Component of a washing machine.  
_Deodorant ball.  
_Lollipop sticks.  
_A bottle for rum.  
_A horn component.  
_Fine sweet wire.  
_Soda can ring.  

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXod9y72JdTwFT6nDbDn8wDj4Me6awk3fjV2fkQx9UKND/1780157129924.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUGfgWENxbYkS58Cgt7nyXRsNTz6qJxp4pCGXsucC8WMQ/1780157130173.jpg)

I also used a cutting pliers and a bowling pliers.  
I bought oil and a flat oil paint brush.  
Homemade glue and industrial talc.  

The objective is to assemble the different elements in the bottle to make a hybrid between a rattle and a carousel.  

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVeJhwGupSZXU57gRDqUPtYesF5SY5sKJhL9gNva35LFV/1780157323472.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR1wyt3ix5VJbkfUv8wDKDH5XzdJdCdNvjRDt9gnMc7KN/1780157323730.jpg)

I applied a paste based on homemade glue and industrial talc to the bottle to create texture throughout the glass body. I then applied a coat of blue oil paint and then drybrushed it to visually enhance the relief effect.  

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbCwjPX8FEFiPigHN9AvihsBm6BQDLEY3w6guC3gdaKGg/1780157569977.jpg)

With the lollipop sticks, the candy wire and the rings I made the pendants, and with the washing machine piece, the head of the carousel-shaped rattle.

The rest of the work is explained in the step-by-step photo report. This is a new variant of the bottle decoration that is traditionally done in this type of craft.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV4QLs4JWa9juN6vDPerejnh2TqaP2Y32ejBGkKKaPgdD/1780157708840.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQZrNenXmV7mJZ6vP5q3Qh4f3yREoydFq8ir8CWoob3Qx/1780157709159.jpg)

Thank you for joining me.

VERSION EN ESPAÑOL 

>Saludos y buen día para todos!

>Siempre me es muy grato entrar a esta comunidad y compartir con ustedes mis experiencias en el mundo de las manualidades, y específicamente en la artesanía tradicional.

>En este derrotero artístico, me gusta incursionar en la artesanía a partir del reciclaje de cosas que van al mundo de los desechos.

>La artesanía es un hobby por el que siento mucho apego y me sirve para desconectar de las tensiones y emociones que producen las obras de mayor envergadura. Este tipo de trabajo es menos intelectual y requiere de concentración y precisión manual, en el que se mezclan incluso diferentes oficios o habilidades para los mismos.

>En este caso, les traigo una pieza en la que empleé diferentes elementos de equipos y productos industriales que a continuación les describo.

>_Componente de una lavadora.  
_Bolita de desodorante.  
_Palitos para chupachups.  
_Una botella para ron.  
_Un componente de bocina.  
_Alambre dulce fino.  
_Anilla de latas de refresco.  

>También utilicé una pinza de corte y una pinza de bolear.  
Compré aceite y un pincel plano para óleo.  
Pegamento casero y talco industrial.  

>El objetivo es ensamblar los diferentes elementos en la botella para realizar un híbrido entre sonajero y carrusel.  

>A la botella le apliqué una pasta a base de pegamento casero y talco industrial para crear textura en todo el cuerpo de vidrio. Después, le apliqué una capa de pintura de aceite azul y, posteriormente, a pincel seco para realzar visualmente el efecto de relieve.  

>Con los palitos de chupachups, el alambre dulce y las anillas hice los colgantes, y con la pieza de la lavadora, la cabeza del sonajero con forma de carrusel.

>El resto del trabajo lo explica el reportaje fotográfico del paso a paso. Esta es una nueva variante de la decoración de botella que tradicionalmente se realiza en este tipo de artesanía.

body.body: Hello, friends, bird lovers, and community. It is a pleasure to post nice photos of a baby bird in this contest this week. We were traveling to the eastern part of Norway. The area we were the Norwegian River Glomma, surrounded by the sides of the arm of the Glomma River. While walking around, we wanted to cross a small lower bridge to get there, but we decided to walk along the water. I don't know exactly what the green stuff is on the water. Is it spring pollen or duckweed? In the beginning, we didn't notice because the water surface wasn't clear, a little cloudy sky, and evening around 5 pm. But as we walked further, we found Plenty of ducklings were floating on the water, swimming nicely with their parents. It was nice to watch them, and as we had our camera, Lumix Panasonic FZ300, we tried to take some photos, many of them blurry because those ducklings were very active and quick to swim. It was a long distance.\n\n
/> We were walking towards this small bridge, which had one side of duckweed? covered water and the other side of clean water.

body.body:
# Violet ray

**Source:** https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Violet_ray

Another electrode used with the same set.
A violet ray is an antique medical appliance used during the early 20th century to discharge in electrotherapy.  Their construction usually featured a disruptive discharge coil with an interrupter to apply a high voltage, high frequency, low current to the human body for therapeutic purposes.[1]

Nikola Tesla introduced his first prototype violet ray at the World's Columbian Exposition in 1893.[citation needed] Most of the antique violet rays in the US were produced before the Depression era, and some of the larger US manufacturers of violet rays were Renulife, Fitzgerald, and Fisher.  Companies who manufactured violet ray devices made many other types of electrical appliances as well, e.g. Star Electric, which also manufactured stock ticker machines.  Many of the companies who were able to continue manufacturing violet rays after the Depression stopped making them due to World War II, when they began manufacturing radio coils and other electrical components for the war instead.[citation needed]
A typical violet ray device consisted of an ungrounded, electrical control box that controlled the interrupter and housed the magneto coil, and an attached bakelite or other handle housing which contained the high voltage coil and an insertion port for attachments.  Glass, evacuated tubes of varying shapes and for different therapeutic uses could be inserted into the bakelite handle to apply the resulting current to different parts of the body. 

Colorful cover of Virex manual with recommended violet ray treatments for various diseases and conditions, about 1900.
Violet ray treatments were said to cure everything from lower back pain to carbuncles.  From an antique Master Violet Ray manual c. 1920 comes this treatment advice:

Brain Fog - Use Applicator No. I over forehead and eyes. Also treat the back of head and neck with strong current in direct contact with the skin. Treat the spine and hold the electrode in the hand. Ozone inhalations for about four minutes are also of importance.
For catarrh, this treatment was directed:

Catarrh, Nasal - In this condition the Nasal Tube is used within the nose with a mild current within the nasal passage, two to five minutes on each side, followed by an application with the Surface Electrode externally over the area of the nose. Use Ozone Generator.

![Image 1](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/9/94/Hochfrequenz_309.jpg/250px-Hochfrequenz_309.jpg)

During the 1940s and 1950s, makers of violet ray devices were subjected to numerous lawsuits and multiple actions by the US government including recalls, seizures, forfeitures, and orders to have them destroyed.[2][3][4][5][6][7][8] 
The last manufacturer of violet ray electrotherapy devices in the US was Master Electric. The company was subjected to a 1951 lawsuit in Marion, Indiana, and the devices were seized by the FDA.[9] While their manufacture was prohibited in the US by case law, violet ray electrotherapy devices are still manufactured by companies outside of the US.[citation needed]

Jon Burge of the Chicago Police Department, who was dismissed in 1992 following allegations of torture of suspects by Burge and detectives working under him in the 1970s and 1980s, may have used a violet ray.  The violet ray was suggested independently by two museum curators after they were given victims' descriptions of one of the several electrical devices used by Burge.[10]
American clairvoyant Edgar Cayce advocated use of the violet ray in almost 900 of his readings.[11]
Since the 1990s, under the name \

, violet ray devices have more recently become popular as relatively safe electrical stimulation devices for erotic electrostimulation.[12]

body.body: <center>[Empire](https://www.empireonline.com/movies/news/steven-spielberg-alien-obsession-resolved-in-disclosure-day-exclusive/)</center>\n***Disclosure Day*** is finally coming to theaters next month. **Steven Spielberg**'s next movie deals with a subject that sparks the interest of millions of people around the world: the existence of extraterrestrial beings. However, this time, the script's argument (written by Spielberg himself, alongside **David Koepp**) goes a little deeper into this \

that is quite popular in science fiction movies, because it's not just about their existence.\nEverything focuses mainly on the idea that we are not alone on planet Earth. In fact (according to the script's idea), we have never been alone. The plot will explore this thought, questioning everything we have known about this subject so far. Since we are not alone, don't we deserve to know the whole truth? How will we react? How will we coexist? How will we survive? So many questions... Without answers.\nThe timing of this movie's release is simply perfect. Here is one of the best and most intelligent cinematic marketing strategies ever made in the history of cinema. Basically, because the movie's release is \

with the official release of materials (until then kept under absolute secrecy) that have been released by the **Donald Trump** administration. The mix of dirty politics, cinema, and real life has never been as \

as it is now.
As a cinephile, I am really eager to see how Spielberg will address this theme within this unprecedented perspective on what he does. His admiration for this theme makes me even more eager to watch the project, because it is something very personal to him. The technical work is surreal, and all the material released so far has created an atmosphere of suspense that is leaving me quite intrigued. The truth is out there, but we can't see it yet.
---
<center>**Merecemos saber toda la verdad.**</center>
El día de la revelación*** finalmente llega a los cines el próximo mes. La nueva película de **Steven Spielberg** aborda un tema que despierta el interés de millones de personas en todo el mundo: la existencia de seres extraterrestres. Sin embargo, en esta ocasión, el argumento del guion (escrito por el propio Spielberg, junto con **David Koepp**) profundiza en este \

tan popular en las películas de ciencia ficción, porque no se trata solo de su existencia. Todo se centra principalmente en la idea de que no estamos solos en el planeta Tierra. De hecho (según la idea del guion), nunca hemos estado solos. La trama explorará esta idea, cuestionando todo lo que hemos sabido hasta ahora sobre este tema. Dado que no estamos solos, ¿no merecemos saber toda la verdad? ¿Cómo reaccionaremos? ¿Cómo coexistiremos? ¿Cómo sobreviviremos? Tantas preguntas... Sin respuestas. El momento del estreno de esta película es simplemente perfecto. Se trata de una de las mejores y más inteligentes estrategias de marketing cinematográfico jamás vistas en la historia del cine. Básicamente, porque su estreno coincide con la publicación oficial de material (hasta entonces mantenido en absoluto secreto) divulgado por la administración de **Donald Trump**. La mezcla de política sucia, cine y vida real nunca ha estado tan “candente” como ahora. Como cinéfilo, tengo muchas ganas de ver cómo Spielberg abordará este tema desde esta perspectiva sin precedentes en su trabajo. Su admiración por este tema me entusiasma aún más, porque es algo muy personal para él. El trabajo técnico es surrealista, y todo el material publicado hasta ahora ha creado una atmósfera de suspense que me tiene muy intrigado. La verdad está ahí fuera, pero aún no podemos verla. ---
**Nós merecemos saber toda a verdade.**
***Dia D*** está finalmente chegando aos cinemas no próximo mês. O próximo filme de **Steven Spielberg** trata de um assunto que desperta o interesse de milhões de pessoas ao redor do mundo: a existência de seres extraterrestres. No entanto, desta vez, o argumento do roteiro (escrito pelo próprio Spielberg, ao lado de **David Koepp**) vai um pouco mais a fundo nesse “fetiche” que é bastante popular em filmes de ficção científica, porque não se trata apenas sobre a existência deles. Tudo se concentra principalmente na ideia de que nós não estamos sozinhos no planeta Terra. Na verdade (segundo a ideia do roteiro), nós nunca estivemos sozinhos. A trama explorará esse pensamento, colocando em dúvida tudo o que até então nós sabemos sobre esse assunto. Uma vez que nós não estamos sozinhos, nós não merecemos saber qual é toda verdade? Como iremos reagir? Como iremos coexistir? Como iremos sobreviver? Tantas perguntas... Sem respostas. A época de lançamento desse filme é simplesmente perfeita. Eis aqui uma das melhores, e mais inteligentes estratégias de marketing cinematográficas já feitas dentro da história do cinema. Basicamente, porque o lançamento do filme está “alinhado” com o lançamento oficial dos materiais (até então mantidos sob sigilo absoluto) que vem sendo divulgados pela administração de **Donald Trump**. A mistura de política suja, cinema e vida real nunca foi tão “quente” quanto agora. Enquanto cinéfilo, eu estou realmente ansioso para saber como Spielberg irá tratar desse tema dentro dessa percepção inédita em relação ao que ele faz. A admiração dele por esse tema me faz ter ainda mais vontade de assistir ao projeto, porque se trata de algo muito pessoal para ele. Some of the best days are the ones that combine simple pleasures. A delicious homemade meal, a peaceful walk surrounded by nature, and a few moments to stop and appreciate the beauty around us. 💚

Today's lunch was one of those meals that felt both healthy and satisfying. The shrimp rice was full of flavor, and the fresh avocado added the perfect touch. Taking care of ourselves doesn't mean giving up delicious food—it means learning to enjoy food that nourishes both the body and the soul. 🍤🥑

After that, I spent some time outdoors exploring beautiful trails lined with tall trees. There is something incredibly calming about walking through nature, listening to the sounds of the forest, and leaving behind the noise of everyday life for a little while. 🌿🍃

One of the highlights of the day was reaching a stunning waterfall hidden among the trees. Sitting there, watching the water flow endlessly, reminded me how important it is to slow down sometimes and simply enjoy the present moment. ✨💧

Life moves quickly, but days like these remind me that happiness often lives in the small things: good food, fresh air, and beautiful places that make us feel connected to the world around us. 🤍

>Welcome to this section where we’re talking, chatting, and showcasing this amazing nature.

\n\n

>And although it may not seem like it, absolutely all of these photographs were taken between 1 and 3 a.m. here in Punta de Mata, Monagas State, where the brightness of the sky represents a beauty inexplicable to the human eye, since this glow is the result of the fire and flames emitted by gas burners.

\n\n>

>This red hue and the glow in the sky are due to the intense orange and red light generated by the combustion of gas in the burners, which scatters and reflects in the atmosphere, especially when there are clouds, fog, or high humidity, as these act as a screen that bounces the light back toward the surface, while the microparticles and soot suspended in the air amplify the diffusion of these warm colors, creating a phenomenon of nighttime glow visible from a great distance.

\n\n

>As I mentioned earlier, these photos were taken at dawn, so it’s a bit puzzling. Although I’ve just explained why, at first glance it seems a bit illogical that the sky would be so bright at this hour of the morning, since these are usually the hours when the sky is darkest just before sunrise and after midnight. These photos were taken with my cell phone, and only one of them has been edited with a collage effect applied using the EPIK app.

>Being out on the street at this late hour is usually for people who go out to have fun and party, or at least I think that’s the most common time when people are out on the streets. However, I had just come from a long night working at a food and vegetable warehouse, since I’m working as hard as I can to get by in this country’s situation, which is wearing me down. Nevertheless, I don’t plan on letting myself get beaten down.

\n\n*
>Thanks to everyone who reads these posts all the way to the end—I’m grateful.
