title.title: The scorching heat and the soothing reflection of the trees by the pond
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb4dXxq5H26XDwpnm34B4CoCRgN3ViR7jsapjFpj62DCU/polish_20260530_220034392.jpg)


Hello friends, how are you all? Hope you are all well and healthy.

Today I am going to share with you some beautiful moments and pictures of natural shade by my pond.

It is quite hot now. In this heat, it becomes difficult to go outside sometimes. Still, I have to go out for my daily work. I have to go to my pond at least once a day. If you have a fish farm or pond, you have to take a lot of care of it, especially during this scorching heat.
The water in the pond gets very hot in the heat of the sun, so you have to check the water condition regularly. This afternoon, I went to the pond to see if everything is okay.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmabVhcjARQKr37oa42SSymKaChbGhran2uWemWd4XE8hw/mix_20260530_210547.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfDjqqREgNq9LZKrLYybHnHLyRiczmnf8uNS34GiMaXxd/mix_20260530_210609.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXfnQw2AHzDWRWDBabnPjhGX9LoD4Xr1LVQm3x8tkDAPW/mix_20260530_210652.jpg)

Despite it being afternoon, it was very hot today. There was no wind at all, due to which I was sweating and feeling restless after looking around the pond. So I thought I would stand on the bank and take a rest. That's when the natural scenery around me caught my attention. In the sweet afternoon sun, the various plants and grasses on the pond bank were casting beautiful dark shadows on the ground.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRTwWANZsXkwewoKZEXwj9dpgfoPkqpronVyTN3xeS4iP/20260530_175748.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTZcWS6ZGM65jNgSDcE8BpfxfB8a2vLyatGxCR9booxr5/mix_20260530_205724.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSAumcMsF7w86MKS3hPBvzw3ituSa2FiXoXdzQqueXUBy/mix_20260530_205911.jpg)

Those of you who live in the village know that there are many wild grasses and creepers on the banks of the pond. When the afternoon light falls on the ground through the gaps in the trees, it is very beautiful to see.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYcZy4MjojQzEQJQZhvW8uAdbhzTepnJDpYyWr6fkFTrM/20260530_175932.jpg)

I also noticed that the shadows of the grass and trees on the banks were not only falling on the ground, but also on the calm water of the pond. These shadows of the trees on the water looked like mirrors.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV8c99b2S1jmY5UHN74UbYr9Ve9gSz2k8H5hHgm98VEN1/mix_20260530_205955.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVckNU79m211PeSnF2ZNjrWsTtJ9i7BGfcoh9azxvNuFJ/mix_20260530_210105.jpg)

Seeing this calm scene around me, the pain of the heat eased a little. I immediately took out my mobile phone from my pocket. I remembered the Shadow Hunters competition on the Hive platform. I thought, I will capture these beautiful shadows on camera and share them with you.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeT5Na7jDzLaE6DqEnTCN4UJXv9DW6JuQyhoxXQ1X36oq/mix_20260530_210515.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZZ7woA6xxMaJsWaV6UD78Y4ncVTVuAZQXeGFzNvpRhoE/mix_20260530_210449.jpg)

There is nothing expensive or magnificent here. Just some very simple plants on the banks of the pond in our village, and the play of sun and shadow. If you don't take a little time to notice, you will not realize how much beauty is hidden in these simple things.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb66FMvN7cqpRnGewMmpnPr8vqEwTJpHMxxzSaMAYCkEe/mix_20260530_210148.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRZdskQVJkRgNzPWWmK5ng5eMexrgGAuugbav7wpYB8vr/mix_20260530_210037.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbQo5c2UUCVjc7ah2H1zmyhENHek4jHtnW6SPb7ThDSCt/mix_20260530_210629.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRMDtXDyZ2zYXV5kYCwWBsrhKDUVRLHQQykuuzxPM3Ybk/mix_20260530_210715.jpg)

I hope you all enjoy these simple natural shadow pictures that I took. You all take care of yourself and be careful in this heat.

Thank you all so much for reading my post.

title.body:
>Hola buenos días a todos y feliz día de sábado,espero la estén pasando bien en este día,por mi parte yo me encuentro hoy aqui para unirme a la iniciativa semanal, observa, piensa y escribe.** # > Hello everyone, good morning and happy Saturday! I hope you're having a good day. I'm here today to join the weekly initiative: observe, think, and write. ---
![1000277364.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmboW6nrXFj16LFmxEausdxMDz67pFEsqtdCzKYagGmR5T/1000277364.png)
# # **

>La nueva imagen se trata de una pieza de rompecabezas,y parece estar tirada en el suelo,algo así como perdida. Cuando ví está imagen se me vino a la mente un juego de rompecabezas,que siempre he querido uno pero de los que son más de mil piezas,pero además de ser un juego muy entretenido,aquí la curiosidad es la pieza que está sola sin ningún tablero al cual unirse.** # > The new image is of a puzzle piece, and it appears to be lying on the floor, somewhat lost. When I saw this image, it reminded me of a jigsaw puzzle, one I've always wanted, but one with more than a thousand pieces. Besides being a very entertaining game, what's curious here is the piece standing alone, without any board to join it to. --- # **

>Me recordó a una publicación que ví pero no recuerdo en cuál red social, pero hablá sobre  TEA,y había varias imágenes de piezas de rompecabezas y varios rompecabezas. Allí leí que los niños con TEA,son como una pieza de rompecabezas,pero no una pieza normal,si no una pieza diferente,a la cuál el tablero del rompecabezas se debe adaptar a la diferencia de esa pieza,en el caso de tablero se refiere a la familia. La familia es la clave a que el niño o la persona se sienta que pertenece,aunque la familia es clave para todo en el entorno familiar. Y si pensamos un poco,si el tablero está desordenado,esa pieza o las piezas se pueden perder o no encuentran su lugar para encajar.<div>**

#

> It reminded me of a post I saw, though I can't remember which social media platform it was on. It was about Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD), and it had several images of puzzle pieces and various puzzles. I read there that children with ASD are like a puzzle piece, but not a normal one; they're different, and the puzzle board must adapt to that piece's uniqueness. In this case, the board represents the family. The family is key for the child or person to feel a sense of belonging, even though the family is crucial to everything in the family environment. And if we think about it, if the board is jumbled, that piece, or those pieces, can get lost or can't find their place to fit.







---

#


**<div class =\

>Hoy en día no hay piezas sin encajar ni solitarias, solamente son piezas diferentes,que tienen su manera de ver el mundo,de sentir de expresarse. La paciencia es clave para hacer que esa persona se moldee y se vaya adaptando al tablero con varios ajustes y actualizaciones que cada vez se actualiza para ayudar a adaptar a esa personita.** # > Today, there are no mismatched or isolated pieces; there are only different pieces, each with its own way of seeing the world, feeling, and expressing itself. Patience is key to helping that person mold and adapt to the board through various adjustments and updates that are constantly being made to help that little one adapt. --- # **

>Brindemos apoyo a todos por igual ya que todos somos una pieza del rompecabezas,con nuestra propia variedad, forma y colores.** # > Let's support everyone equally, as we are all a piece of the puzzle, with our own variety, shape, and colors. --- # **

>Gracias a todos por leer este apartado,los animo a ser parte también de esta gran iniciativa.** # > Thank you all for reading this section, I encourage you to also be part of this great initiative. # **

la tarde del 19 de Mayo recibo una llamada de mi mamá avisandome que a mi mamá la iban a llevar al hospital centrar con un dolor muy fuerte, rapidamente me fui hasta alla y desde ese momento sentí mucho miedo porque al llegar la vi muy mal 😔 tenia hipotension sumado a un dolor abdominal horrible, y en el hospital tuvieron mucho tiempo sin atenderla, ahi es donde digo que el sistema de salud es UN ASCO en este pais, que viven de apariencias porque realmente aqui nada sirve, no hay medicos de verdad, simplemente puro estudiantes, \

como les decia mi mamá, despues de tantas carreras logramos que atendieran a mi mamá y comenzaron a ponerle algo para estabilizar su tension porque sin eso no podian ponerle mas nada

El dia avanzó, llegó la moche, una noche larga donde estuvo muy incomoda, el aire no servia, tenia calor, la camilla era incomoda, le dolia, se quejaba, no podia hacer pipi😔 le pusieron una sonda y despues de 4 soluciones con solo 1 para el dolor que de paso fue una que NO DEBIAN ponerle, aun despues de todo ese liquido mi mami siempre tuvo la sonda vacia, comenzaron a mandarle examenes y le pusieron oxigeno porque ya le costaba mucho respirar 


![1003146329.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/milagrosmhbl/23tvo334WM8iVLErDmcLs84jzp86tUUTZqdfueH8Zd183oWmQ27NatVupRf96GPqck4ym.jpg)

Quisiera dar todos los detalles pero al mismo tiempo revivo cada segundo y me lleno de ire e impitencia de que siento que me la tuvieron todo el dia como jna pelotica, para al final pasarla a cuidados kntermedios y luego de 2 horas muriera por un paro respiratorio😭 fue horrible cuando me llamarpn para decirme \

esa frase desgarró mi alma y aun resuena en mi mente junto a su cuerpo tendido en aquella camilla donde veia como se moria mi madre💔💔 

Es el momento mas duro que he vivido hasta ahora y daria mi vida porque todo esto fuese un sueño, la busco en cada esquina de la casa, siento que en cualquier monento llegará, a vecda siento que todo esta normal y basta pasar por sus cenizas para ver que si esta pasando todo esto💔💔

Mi madre tenia muchos defectos, como todos, pero yo LA AMARÉ toda la vida y si de verdad existe esa vida eterna, lo unico qje pido es volverla a ver😭💔


![1003155806.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/milagrosmhbl/EppKHSGVPx2n5vAFNM8efucyE7NNaerziNrkwVCffrR2GDQXzPShStTciFz9N2Tk38U.jpg)

## <center>  **ENGLISH:** </center> 

Today I just need to vent a little here. It has been 11 long, heavy days since my sweet mom closed her eyes forever, leaving an immense void in our lives 💔 Everything happened so fast and so suddenly that I struggle every single second to accept that she is gone.
​On the afternoon of May 19th, I received a call from my mom letting me know that they were taking her to the central hospital with severe pain. I rushed over there, and from that very moment, I felt terrified because when I arrived, I saw her in terrible shape 😔 She had hypotension along with horrible abdominal pain. The hospital left her waiting for a very long time without any medical attention. That’s why I say the healthcare system in this country is DISGUSTING. They live off appearances because nothing here actually works. There are no real doctors, just pure students—\

(health-killers), as my mom used to call them. After running around desperately, we finally got them to look at my mom, and they started giving her something to stabilize her blood pressure, because without that, they couldn't give her anything else.\n​The day went on, and night came—a long night where she was extremely uncomfortable. The air conditioning wasn't working, she was hot, the stretcher was uncomfortable, she was in pain, she was groaning, and she couldn't pee 😔 They placed a catheter, and after four IV bags with only one for the pain—which, by the way, was one they SHOULD NOT have given her—even after all that fluid, my mom's catheter bag was always empty. They started ordering tests and put her on oxygen because she was already struggling hard to breathe.\n​I wish I could give all the details, but at the same time, it makes me relive every single second, filling me with rage and helplessness. I feel like they just tossed her back and forth all day like a toy, only to finally transfer her to intermediate care, where she died two hours later from respiratory arrest 😭 It was horrible when they called me to say, \

That phrase tore my soul apart, and it still echoes in my mind alongside the image of her body lying on that stretcher, watching my mother die 💔💔 ​This is the hardest moment I have ever lived through, and I would give my life for all of this to be just a dream. I look for her in every corner of the house, feeling like she will walk in at any moment. Sometimes I feel like everything is normal, but then I just have to walk past her ashes to realize that all of this is actually happening 💔💔 ​My mother had many flaws, like everyone else, but I will LOVE HER for the rest of my life. And if eternal life truly exists, the only thing I ask for is to see her again 😭💔

Today just felt like one of those days where a selfie was necessary. Nothing too planned, nothing too serious… just a simple moment, a little smile, and capturing how I feel right now. Sometimes it’s nice to pause for a second, look at yourself, and appreciate the moment you’re in.

I like these spontaneous photos because they feel real. No pressure, no perfection — just me being me. A quick selfie can hold so much: your mood, your energy, even your confidence in that exact moment. And today, I’m feeling calm, happy, and comfortable in my own skin.

It may seem like a small thing, but these little moments are the ones that stay. So yes… today tocó selfie, and I’m here just enjoying it. ✨

Hoy fue uno de esos días donde tocó una selfie. Nada planeado, nada complicado… solo un momento sencillo, una sonrisa y capturar cómo me siento ahora. A veces es bonito hacer una pausa, mirarte y valorar el momento en el que estás.

Me gustan estas fotos espontáneas porque se sienten reales. Sin presión, sin perfección — solo siendo yo. Una selfie puede guardar mucho: tu ánimo, tu energía, incluso tu seguridad en ese instante. Y hoy me siento tranquila, feliz y cómoda conmigo misma.

Puede parecer algo pequeño, pero estos momentos son los que se quedan. Así que sí… hoy tocó selfie y la estoy disfrutando. ✨

title.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![ytbXIK3tLKYkYOO2_1000027959.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/muwangxuan/images/ytbXIK3tLKYkYOO2_1000027959/ytbXIK3tLKYkYOO2_1000027959.webp)

![0rsvW4tWVkBqh8Ja_1000027956.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/muwangxuan/images/0rsvW4tWVkBqh8Ja_1000027956/0rsvW4tWVkBqh8Ja_1000027956.webp)
![5bj8lNFDFpBWhqvO_1000027957.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/muwangxuan/images/5bj8lNFDFpBWhqvO_1000027957/5bj8lNFDFpBWhqvO_1000027957.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

很好奇，大家都是怎么保持一段关系的?
曾经以为能相处一辈子的朋友，慢慢就发现没了什么共同话题。
曾经关于海枯石烂的情话，最后都演变成了相看两厌。
本应该是最亲密的家人，最后也是经常无话可说……
面对这种情况，大家都是怎么弄的？
关于这点，我今天刚好看到一个比较赞同的答案，那就是：真正维系一段高维关系的，是共同成长！
靠花钱买包包，买礼物，或者靠性，靠责任，靠外出旅游。
这些都能暂时性的延长一段关系，但时间一过，新鲜感又没了。
这个月买了包，下个月又得买，今年出去旅游，明年大概率还得去，不然又会面临没有新鲜感的困境。
真正能延长一段关系的，是共同成长，或者各自成长也行。
总之，就是要有增量。
让对方感觉到，这个月的你和下个月的你是不一样的。
人还是那个人，但又多了新的探索关卡等待你去解锁。
其实人和人之间就像解密游戏，我们玩游戏，如果所有关卡都打完了一遍。
很多时候，我们会选择做的是换游戏，而不是重玩一遍，人也是这样。
过那么三五年，基本上真的是你撅屁股都知道你要放什么屁。
那时候，这款游戏或许真的就玩到头了。
而双方共同成长，其实就是在保持这款游戏一直在更新新的关卡。
那才有继续玩下去的愿望。
所以，以前或许有人会问我，都毕业了，为什么还要保持学习，或者问所谓的个人成长是不是鸡汤。
现在又多了一个答案，那就是，或许它对你职场生涯并没有太多的帮助。
但它能让你增加更多新鲜感，让和你相处的人感觉你这个人知道的更多了，有新关卡能解锁了。
从而慢慢延长一段关系的时间。
否则，如果我们一直不成长，一直不发生改变，你今年说的话题，三五年后还在说，那人家也会烦的。
人嘛，就是这样，就图个新鲜感，不是嘛？

---

title.title: 🦋 Every Scar Tells a Story
title.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbXGpFAzFknLuBubBcF76wbtsonoDjeaw3hahXg8ewyEs/IMG_5208.PNG 

People often see a tattoo and focus on the artwork.

But for me, tattoos have never been just about appearance. They are reminders of chapters, lessons, struggles, and moments that shaped who I am today.

Every line, every detail, every color carries a piece of my story. Some memories are beautiful, some are painful, and some taught me lessons I never expected to learn. But all of them helped build the woman I have become.

As a lawyer and a single mother, I spend most of my days being practical, responsible, and focused on the future. Yet moments like this remind me that I am also someone with dreams, emotions, and experiences that deserve to be remembered.

Life leaves marks on all of us.

Some are visible.
Some are hidden.
Some become part of our skin.
Others become part of our soul.

The important thing is not avoiding the marks life leaves behind. The important thing is carrying them with pride, knowing they are proof that we lived, loved, struggled, and continued moving forward.

And when I look back at my journey, I don't see imperfections.

I see a story still being written. 🦋

title.title: When Darkness Falls, the Sun Leaves Hope Behind || Pictures Of The Setting Sun
title.body: > People have written stories about the sun. The sun is love. The sun is rising. The sun teaches people to swim when they are sunken. I have made some pictures of sunsets. If we look deeply into the sun, a person is lost inside the sun and a romantic scene emerges. I look at the sun with great love every day. When the sun is setting, darkness falls on the earth. That darkness is temporary. But even in this darkness, many stories, love, romantic scenes, and the sky are hidden. If you look at the pictures of the setting sun, you will see a very beautiful scene. This sun that you are seeing is the sun of my village. This is the setting evening of my village. And the same sun must be visible in your village too, but its appearance will be unique. Somewhere you are seeing that this same sun that I am seeing is clearly visible from the trees of my village and is setting while being hidden by the trees. And somewhere at the same time this sun must be rising and rising from the rivers, oceans, streams, and waterfalls. The sun is the same, but its style and its love are unique. If it is sinking in some place, then from somewhere it must be seen as a lake. Its rising and its setting are both romantic sights, and many photographers and painters have painted these scenes with their brushes and shown them in a beautiful way. This sun is today as well as it was thousands of years ago. This sun is here today, it will be here tomorrow and it will remain until the Day of Judgment, but the Arab eyes that saw it are no longer there today. Those eyes that saw it thousands of years ago and disappeared must have been experiencing the sights of this sun, just as we are doing today. I see the sun in a very unique way. The sun is not just a sight of sunrise and sunset, but the sun is the capital of our life. Life is impossible without the sun. If the sun rises for one day and does not rise for two days, people spend many hours waiting for the sun. When the sun hides in the embrace of clouds or the sun starts peeking through the clouds, that peeking presents a very beautiful sight. The hiding of the sun, the rising of the sun, all these sights take a person to a new world. Today I am sharing with you pictures of the setting sun. When you see these pictures, you will feel that the sun is setting very slowly and it seems as if the branches of the trees are hugging the sun. I am kissing the sun and the sun is also setting, hugging the branches of the trees and saying, I will come again in the morning, and then we will sit together and talk. Be it a river, an ocean, or the high peaks of mountains, we see beautiful views of the sun everywhere. When the sun is setting in the middle of the ocean or a river, many eyes travel thousands of miles to see this view and reach the shores of the sea. And then there are some places where the view of the sunset is very romantic. People travel hundreds of kilometers to reach this place and watch the sunset. Seeing the sun setting, many eyes become tearful and many hearts are filled with hope. They find a new path and new hope. They are saying goodbye to the sun with the hope that they will meet again in the coming days. And the sun also has the same message that it will come and then rise again and then spread its rays of love in the world. So we have to learn to love the sun, we have to learn hope from the sun, we have to rise and never sink. I often write in my writings that the sun leads us to success. If we watch the sunrise early in the morning and make it a part of our life and then take a short walk, we can achieve a lot in our life. Similarly, in our busy life, if we activate ourselves with the sunrise for a little while, we can also achieve a lot. I am saying this because we have to change our lives. We have to change our lifestyle. Has the sun changed our lifestyle? This is the question we should ask ourselves. And when you look for the answer, you will get the same answer. The sun has also changed its lifestyle. Every day changes. If you watch the sunrise and sunset a little and then the sun's journey throughout the day, you will find its lifestyle has changed. Sometimes the sun will whisper to you in the clouds, sometimes you will find it playing with the clouds. Sometimes it will hide in the clouds and sometimes it will heat you with such a bright sun that It will be difficult for you to go out. Sometimes, when it is summer, people run away from the sun and go out in search of shade. Then, when winter comes, people are in search of the sun's rays and sunshine. They embrace the sun and then warm their bodies with the light of the sun. Then, when the sun rises, its appearance is even different. When it sets, it is even different. The sun has changed the lifestyle of the day. And we, humans, have to change our lifestyle. And when we change our lifestyle, then life will change. ![IMG_20260529_185153.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYmqxqKLR13yPUHewxNiDpfcgSvcnkcBZwa3eQC6ViXui/IMG_20260529_185153.jpg) Look carefully at these sunset pictures. title.title: Physically, Mentally and Emotionally Exhausted
title.body:
/>If someone is overly tired, it will affect them physically, mentally and emotionally. Whilst we usually think of the physical side of things, our mental and emotional health suffers equally and as a result our overall lives are affected. When we are too tired, the tasks of everyday living can feel over whelming and impossible to manage.

If a person is mentally exhausted it can have an impact on their levels of concentration, memory and decision making abilities. If you're brain isn't fully rested it can become difficult to concentrate on anything for long periods and as a result mistakes are made and memory is failing. Tasks may have previously been effortless, now they require a high degree of thought and effort. When things like this start to happen continually the person may feel inadequacy and like they're not doing things properly because more and more things need doing, yet they cannot concentrate for long enough.

When someone is too tired emotionally it will affect how they cope and deal with situations. Simple issues will appear much more overwhelming than they are and you will find that your emotional stability cannot be controlled. When someone is tired they can be prone to become irritable, upset or feel anxious or overwelmed by the emotions that they are unable to keep under control. This can often cause withdrawal from friends and family.

Extreme tiredness can occur through various factors such as a lack of sleep, overwhelming tasks, emotional upset, nutrition, health problems or the wrong balance of work/play. Either way, ignoring being overly tired is something we cannot do because our health suffers.

Recognizing tiredness and doing something about it is vital if you are going to prevent further physical and mental damage. Rest, eating the right foods and maintaining a reasonable amount of exercise is a start, taking breaks and keeping our expectations realistic can stop ourselves from feeling over whelmed. Getting help may also be something we need to do if we can't deal with our exhaustion alone, so the help of a doctor can rule out anything more serious.

It is not just sleep that too much tiredness will affect, but mental and emotional health also need to be treated as important, with the right rest we can recover from our mental and emotional depletion, allowing us to live a happier, healthier and less stressed life with all the energy we require to tackle things.

title.title: Why does breathe smell bad? Common causes and simple solutions
title.body:
![Depiction_of_a_person_who_has_Halitosis_(or_bad_breath)_(hy).png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZwqjUhaX6xKQJnXSSQPBuwp4WSN19rXKbPF8NNBBZ6DR/Depiction_of_a_person_who_has_Halitosis_(or_bad_breath)_(hy).png)
Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/w/index.php?search=halitosis&title=Special%3AMediaSearch&type=image

Bad breath, also known as halitosis is a common and really an embarassing condition. It is an offensive and unpleasant maldour coming from the mouth. Usually it is a temporary condition, but when it is chronic, it reduces patient's confidence, social interactions and overall quality of life.
Many people experience bad breath occassionally, especially after consuming certain foods, but if we have persistent bad breath, it reflects some underlying conditions and shuld be dealt accordingly.

**Categorization**
Halitosis is categorized as genuine halitosis, pseudo-halitosis and halitophobia.
*Genuine halitosis*: socially unacceptalbe malodour coming out from the exhaled air.

*Pseudo-halitosis*: condition in which patient complains of having bad breath but clinicians cannot establish it through the means of any scientific test.

*Halitophobia*: Despite adequate medical treatment, patient complains of bad breath although it is not evident clinically and socially.

**Causes of bad breath**
The cause of halitosis is usually multifactorial.
a) Poor oral hygiene: Most common cause. Intraoral micrbial communities colonize the tongue and teeth, gums forming a biofilm. It produces volatile sulphur compounds like methylmercaptan and hydrogen sulfite.

b) Dry mouth: Saliva produced by glands like parotid glands and submandibular glands cleanse the oral cavity. When saliva secretion is low, it may lead to multiplication of anaerobic bacterias leading to foul breath. Hyposalivation naturally occurs at night during sleep causing bad breath at morning.

c)Food and drinks: Certain food items like garlics, onions and spices may lead to bad breath.

d) Gingivitis: Inflammation of the gums can produce an unpleasant odour.
e) Smoking and tobacco use: produces bad breath to to chronic mucosal inflammation. Tobacco users are more likely to have gum disease.

f) ENT diseases: Several ENT causes like tonsilltis, tonsillolith, tonsillar cysts, chronic sinusitis and post-nasal drip may cause bad breath.

![Tonsillolith_in_mouth.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQendrdCn1H7udu1vYDmZneXRm9jfLY45NQmaUeW8mW2M/Tonsillolith_in_mouth.jpg)
Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/w/index.php?search=Tonsillolith&title=Special%3AMediaSearch&type=image

g) Underlying systemic causes: Conditions like diabetes mellitus, Gastro-esophageal reflux disease, liver and kidney diseases may cause halitosis.

**How can we get rid of bad breath?**
a) Maintain good oral hygiene: Make habit of brushing twice daily. Good oral hygiene is the foundation of fresh breath and overall health.  Brushng teeth twice daily removes food particles and debri preventing the sulfur producing bacteria from multiplying in the oral cavity.

![Clean_Your_Teeth_Immediately_After_Eating_(21879774811).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXbzqeA8RvTc8HJQ1Tu8qpfLtktpHBtePh5UJQjvcCNYm/Clean_Your_Teeth_Immediately_After_Eating_(21879774811).jpg)
Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/w/index.php?search=brushing+teeth&title=Special%3AMediaSearch&type=image

b)Mechanical scrubbing of the dorsum of tongue : removes tongue coating which is the foremost cause of halitosis. The tongue can be scraped by a variety of dental tools to remove the tongue coating.

c) Gargle: Make habit of gargling the oral cavity with solutions containing chlorhexidine, zinc, stannous fluoride and amine fluoride. Povidone iodine gargle can also be used.

d) Use of pahrmacological probiotics: Pprobiotics are the benificial bacterias that help to maintain a healthy balance of bacteria in the body. A probiotic capsule containing the bacteria *Lactbacillus reuteri , Lactobacillus salivarius* and xylitol is very benificial.

e) ENT checkup for conditions like chronic sinusitis, management of tonsilloliths, chronic tonsillitis and post nasal drips.

f) Treatment of systemic illnesses like diabetes, malignancies, liver and kidney diseases.

*References*:
1) https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10506127/
2) https://emedicine.medscape.com/article/867570-overview#a10
3) https://www.mayoclinic.org/diseases-conditions/bad-breath/symptoms-causes/syc-20350922

title.title: The Future of Work: Change Is Inevitable
title.body: ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQkTB7Q39aHQqqGkqqYuXfStz8aAKf4VdDy3oS7kQMQu4/1780155199648.png) Currently, I'm a student, and I do not have any job experience or have never tried for it. And that doesn't mean that I don't think about it, actually I do and I'm genuinely not that worrieabout how the future of work and how it will look like. As our technologies are improving day by day, there are always new inventions and it is changing very fast. People are already worried if their jobs will still exist in the next ten years. That is honestly an interesting question because it's not possible to predict the future, but by looking at the present, we can try to make some gusses. I personally think that in some sectors jobs are going to disappear, and some will change, like it will evolve. Currently, there are so many new inventions such as machines, robots, and artificial intelligence. They are doing the tasks that once required human workers. AI tools have already taken all over the world. They have lots of useful feature which helps people with writing, data analysis, creating images, giving ideas, and many more things. So, I think AI has already replaced a few jobs that may not need human workers in the future. However, I do not think of it as a problem. It's not possible that humans will become usless because human beings are inventing those new technologies for the betterment of society. New technologies might decrease few options, but it will often create new opportunities. Now, people have new options to their list to apply as AI specialist, app developer, social media managers, and many more. These jobs provide enough money for their employers. So, it may reduce some job opportunities, but it will continue to grow and create new careers. In the future, there will be jobs that we can't even imagine today. As a student, I believe that if I focus on learning new skills, then I can cope up with it in the next 10 years. Because mentally, I have prepared for it. I just need to go with the flow so I will be able to adapt. I do not think that people should only focus on one specific job. They should learn other things as well, so if the job changes or dissappears permanently, then they can handle it properly. Skills take time to learn, so if we leave it for tomorrow, maybe we might not ever be able to start. For that reason, we should start now. Also, I want to say that creativity comes from a human being, and an AI can't create new ideas unless a human being gives the information, so these things can never be replaced. People who know how to adapt they will have a better chance of succeeding in the future. I hope the governments will take precautions to avoid such collapses in the future. If students are trained from the very beginning, then later in life, they won't suffer from any kind of change. Anyway, our human abilities will always remain within us, and it's valuable, so even if the technologies are advanced, they can't beat us. In conclusion, I don't think anyone can predict the future and know which jobs will exist in ten years. So, we should not stay in constant fear or worry about it. We should just stay prepared for the situation and have the willings to learn new skills. I'm a student now, so I will take the new possibilities as a challenge. I think it will be exciting and it will be a huge opportunity for me. ____ This is my entry to a contest of [indiaunited](https://peakd.com/hive-197685/@indiaunited/indiaunited-new-contest-and-last-ae0ff15b5f76c), I would love to invite you to participate! ____ The images are created with [Gemini](gemini.google.com) and edited with [Canva](www.canva.con) ____

到了周五，就发懒了，什么都不想做，只想好好的休息，昨天晚上回来，就一直追剧，我是个剧迷，为了看完一个电视剧，我会一直盯着电脑，总想看完才甘心，昨天还算理智，发现年纪大了，太晚睡，身体存受不住。

可能昨天太晚睡,今天上午睡了好久，唯一好的是，我早上去凤山运动了一小时，今天很热闹，很多的舞友都在，而且湖里面开了好多的河花，很是漂亮，我沿着呼还走了一圈，拍了好多的荷花，真的很漂亮。

明天飞翔队去广州莲花山，我放弃跟团了，还是在家多陪陪欢欢，还是以孩子为最重要，要不然，都不知以后孩子后长大，会变成什么样，说到孩子，周五公司搞一个培训，就是读懂孩子的情绪，怎么做会沟通的父母。

本来是上班太忙了，想着那么忙，学着放松一下，而且欢欢都读初二，我想这个培训很适合我们参加，刚开始以为是老师讲课，没有想到倒成为家长发言讲问题，一起讨论问题。

都是说孩子玩游戏，担心孩子没有学习，做父母焦虑，问题说出来，大爱谈了一下，最后一个结论，对孩子不要要求太高， 只要孩子能活着，健康就好，谈了一下，感觉还是学到了很多的东西，聊一下，还是好很多。

本以为自己是个好妈妈，一直在学家庭教育，没有想到，有些妈妈更优秀，不仅在学，而且还考心里咨询师，还有什么教通育证，都是好历害的，真的要跟他们学习，不仅孩子优秀，而且自己也优秀，自己还是要多交流。

Salvation is not something we get because we are much religious of how often we go to church everyday. Salvation is a gift of God's grace received through faith in Jesus Christ. 

>Ephesians 2:8-9 says, “For by grace are ye saved through faith... not of works, lest any man should boast.” 

Salvation comes ffom God, it is a result of how good we are to people and how we tend to follow the teachings of Jesus Christ.

Religion can be beneficial when it encourages people to worship God, learn His Word, and live according to His will. The Bible emphasizes that genuine faith should produce obedience, love, and good works. Therefore, while religion itself does not save, a sincere faith in Christ that is expressed through a godly life is essential for salvation.

title.title: Everyone’s on Mobile Now… That’s Why It Feels So Quiet
title.body:
A Big Hello to all WOO Fans! 🥳🥳🥳 WOO! 

Now that we've hit the weekend again, here’s a theory that I don’t think enough people are talking about:

What if WOO isn’t quiet? What if it’s just **moved somewhere else**?

>*I have gotten some feedback that reminders are pretty useful when it comes to the regular events held in WOO. So here I am again with a quick reminder for any upcoming events.*

---

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/blitzzzz/23tbGk6hJjTQLuiQ21a2iV581p8LmaTbPbdTYLTYGFMhQ7QoeHEuYGYcUXnzYXXmMPEfS.png)

---

With all the mobile improvements that just dropped, I’ve found myself doing something I didn’t do as often before. Checking in *constantly*. But not in long sessions. Just quick ones. And that changes everything.

* Mobile improvements have shifted gameplay from long sessions to frequent micro-interactions.
  
Before this update, most of my WOO time was concentrated. Sit down, play, log out. Now? It’s scattered throughout the day. A quick check here, a couple of matches there, claim something, move on. And that kind of activity doesn’t create the same visible “spikes” of engagement.

* Players are more active than ever, but less centralized in their activity.
  
This is the key point. Activity hasn’t disappeared. It’s just spread out. Instead of everyone being online at the same time for events, players are logging in at different times throughout the day. That makes the game feel quieter, even if it’s not.

* The game is becoming part of daily routine rather than scheduled play sessions.
  
Honestly? That’s a big shift. WOO isn’t just something you sit down to play anymore It’s something you check in on. That kind of integration changes how the community feels.

So yeah, if the weekend feels quiet, it might just be because everyone’s playing differently now. Not less. Just smarter, shorter, and more often.

---

**TLDR: This is a reminder to all my readers (and WOO fans) that baring any last minute sudden surprise events, this weekend should be a relatively quiet one. 😜**

Well, that's it for today. We will continue again tomorrow! 😁 WOO! 🎉

title.title: La pieza que faltaba / The missing piece
title.body:
**La pieza que faltaba** Hace tiempo, en los días de pandemia estuve armando un rompecabezas qué encontré en mi armario, recordé que cuando lo guarde estaba completo quedó olvidado ahí, los chicos crecieron, los entretenimientos avanzaron a la par con la tecnología y ese mundo que se formaba con piezas intercaladas nadie más le dio forma. Resulta que desempolvando los juegos de mesa para entreterme en esos días de angustia, sobresaltos y quedate en casa, encontré un rompecabezas de un mundo y quise armarlo, son muchas piezas así que no fue fácil darle forma en un solo día, se que los rompecabezas son para personas de menos edad pero al igual que ellos en ese tiempo yo también necesitaba desarrollar nuevamente la paciencia, distracción, concentración, tomar decisiones acertadas y encontrar soluciones prácticas, alejarme de las redes sociales y de noticias nefasta que solo me traían angustia, ansiedad y un gran desorden mental. >**The Missing Piece** A while back, during the pandemic, I was putting together a jigsaw puzzle I found in my closet. I remembered that when I put it away, it was complete and then forgotten. The kids grew up, entertainment evolved alongside technology, and that world I had built with interlocking pieces was never fully realized. It turns out that while dusting off my board games to keep myself entertained during those anxious, stressful, and stay-at-home days, I found a world-themed puzzle and wanted to put it together. There are so many pieces, so it wasn't easy to complete it in a single day. I know puzzles are usually for younger people, but like them, I also needed to rediscover patience, distraction, concentration, how to make sound decisions and find practical solutions, and how to disconnect from social media and the awful news that only brought me anguish, anxiety, and a great deal of mental turmoil. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmboW6nrXFj16LFmxEausdxMDz67pFEsqtdCzKYagGmR5T/1780154345095.png)
_Imagen propiedad @lanzjoseg_
Los días avanzaron y mi desorden seguía esparcido, después de armar bordes, ordenar montañas de piezas por colores y empezar a encajar piezas de pronto pude dar forma a mi mundo, pero que frustración sentí cuando descubrí que me faltaba una pieza, busque, revolví todo pero no encontré nada, lo arme pero quedé con ese vacío de que algo faltó, sin embargo tuve la certeza de que todo tiene solución y sentido. >The days went by and my mess remained scattered. After assembling borders, arranging mountains of pieces by color, and starting to fit pieces together, I was suddenly able to give shape to my world. But what frustration I felt when I discovered that I was missing a piece! I searched, I turned everything upside down, but I found nothing. I put it together, but I was left with that emptiness that something was missing. However, I was certain that everything has a solution and a purpose. La imagen que nos trajo el amigo @lanzjoseg, esta semana me llevo a ese momento, pero también a mirar desde una perspectiva diferente, pensé en tantas personas que perdieron a un ser querido en la pandemia, un familiar, un amigo, vecino, ellos no solo vivieron frustración sino un gran dolor emocional, los vieron darle batallas al Covid-19, hicieron lo imposible para que sobrevivieron y perdiero la batalla, los sobrevivientes sin embargo quedaron con ira, culpa, dolor, tristeza, aprendieron a vivir con esa pérdida, incompletos porque una parte de ellos se fue con su ser querido, siguen aquí sin respuesta, sin encajar, insatisfecho, como una pieza perdida del rompecabezas de la vida misma, jamás van a estar enteros, solo les queda confiar en las promesas de nuestro Señor Jesucristo, viviendo sus vidas con ese vacío en su corazón, poco a poco volvieron a la calma, a tomar forma de nuevo pieza por pieza, sin desespero, aprendieron a confiar, a buscar y encontrar el lugar correcto pero saben que esa pieza que perdieron en esa pandemia jamás volverá a encajar ni habrá otra parecida, nada volvió a ser igual. >The image our friend @lanzjoseg shared this week took me back to that moment, but also allowed me to look at it from a different perspective. I thought about so many people who lost a loved one in the pandemic—a family member, a friend, a neighbor. They not only experienced frustration but also immense emotional pain. They saw them battle Covid-19, did everything possible to help them survive, and lost the battle. The survivors, however, were left with anger, guilt, pain, and sadness. They learned to live with that loss, incomplete because a part of them went with their loved one. They remain here without answers, without fitting in, unsatisfied, like a missing piece of life's puzzle. They will never be whole again. All they can do is trust in the promises of our Lord Jesus Christ, living their lives with that emptiness in their hearts. Little by little, they returned to calm, taking shape again piece by piece, without despair. They learned to trust, to search and find the right place, but they know that the piece they lost in that pandemic will never fit again, nor will there ever be another. Similar, but nothing was ever the same again. Esta es mi participación en el concurso semanal de la comunidad Top Family en [Observa Piensa Escribe](https://hive.blog/hive-192096/@lanzjoseg/concurso-observa-piensa-escribe-5eecaea7dc14a)
>
_¡Gracias por leer!_
>
Hasta una próxima oportunidad .
>
_Thank you for reading!_
>
Until next time.

¡Hola @noraydaap!

Un texto conmovedor y de una gran realidad, en él transformas la frustración por los objetos que fallan en una metáfora perfecta de la resistencia humana.

Pienso igual que tú: a veces la casa parece rendirse, pero tu escrito demuestra que lo que realmente se sostiene no son las paredes ni los electrodomésticos, sino el espíritu de quienes la habitan.

Es una reflexión bella, llena de fuerza y que no pude pasar por alto. Un amanecer maravilloso está por llegar a Cuba y, aun cuando la mejoría no sea inmediata, la rendición de las casas, de las mentes y de los espíritus se desvanecerá, transformándose en verdadera fuerza para vivir mejor.

Mis mejores deseos para ti y todo tu país salen de forma expresa desde este lado del planeta.

!ALIVE

title.body: > How are you all? I am sure you are all doing well as usual. Today I will discuss another new crypto with you, I hope you like it. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPUnc1RpXdnrPULpov8Go7BiWNiy9qdYgfp8sXq3wjpLz/Screenshot_20260530_233149.jpg Recently, there has been a good movement in the market regarding the LAB token, so I have made an analysis of its chart and market data. Currently, the token is trading in a price range of about $7.67, which shows a positive growth of about 39% in 24 hours. However, the most interesting thing is that the huge gap between its 24-hour high and low price—$13.53 to $5.52—indicates that the market is currently experiencing extreme volatility. Analyzing the daily chart (1D), it can be seen that the token has been in a pretty good bullish momentum for the past few days. The price is well above the MA(7) and MA(25) lines, which indicates an uptrend. However, there was a rejection near the previous high of $9.05. The market cap is currently around $3.31 billion and the fully diluted valuation (FDV) is $7.67 billion. One thing to note here is that the token has a liquidity of only $6.51 million. Since the liquidity is quite low compared to the market cap, the price can fluctuate very quickly if a large buy or sell order comes in. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUtVzz8rGbabk4YbjgJ5rUThzqmLztZjPXkXryXuU6oaG/Screenshot_2026_0530_233203.jpg On the other hand, the 1-minute (1m) short-term chart shows a slightly different picture. After the big pump, some profit booking and correction are currently being observed at the micro level. The price has touched the resistance of $8.00 and is currently trying to consolidate around $7.66. It is very important to hold the support level of $7.57 in the short-term. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbTCwCsqVpz8qYuXoNUEpeSmri4xCBqVE5Z8nFJqhZKBP/Screenshot_20260530_233224.jpg 43.15% of the total supply of the token of 1 billion is currently in circulation. With the exchange balance at around 174.56 million LAB, there is a possibility of selling pressure in the market at any time. Those who are thinking of taking new entries, it would be better to wait a little while rather than falling into FOMO directly in this high volatile zone. It would be wise to observe how the price reacts to the support level and make the next decision. title.title: El precio del Legado.
title.body:
<center>
![1001033257.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zullyscott/EpA32MeNvrsJRrpu84t2dyaF2AW5cnVegW6UGHwFDzy3MHKqNVzmg9txCfkHE3vVRai.jpg)
</center>


Imaginemos un reino antiguo, de esos donde caballeros y doncellas llegaban a bailes invitados por el Rey y la Reina. Imaginemos también que esos reyes tienen hijos, pero hay uno, el primogénito, que algún día también será rey y ya se le ha estado preparando para eso, pero aunque haya mucha preparación hay una cosa para lo que nunca se está listo, para la muerte. 

Heredar un reino en épocas pasadas traía una consecuencia instantánea, que esa persona de quien recibes el legado habia muerto. Mucho se habla del legado que dejan los padres a los hijos, estos pueden ser materiales o en valores, creencias o sencillamente nada. Lo cierto es que algo por lo general se deja en la vida de los otros al irnos de este mundo. 

Estos últimos 6 meses como familia hemos perdido 4 personas muy amadas, entre ellas una tía que adoraba y mi papá, también dos tíos muy queridos. Afrontar las pérdidas una tan seguida de otra siento que aún nos tiene en shock como tribu familiar, pero vamos asumiendo poco a poco cada uno a su manera. 

Por la razón anterior, mi prima, hija de mi tía y más que mi tía, mi Nany y maestra de preescolar, persona que de alguna manera trató de mantener un trato maternal conmigo desde que perdí a mi mamá a temprana edad. Su hija, mi prima, como les contaba, me llevó al cuarto de mi tía y además de sentir muchas cosas por el vacío de la ausencia, me ofreció escoger algunos zapatos y prendas que le pertenecían. 

Para que entiendan el sentimiento, primero debo contarles que desde que mi papá enfermó y se puso más delicado, más o menos los últimos dos años, esta servidora tenía en su haber un sólo par de zapatos y unas chancletas para estar en casa, solo eso y ese extremo minimalismo no era por gusto sino porque la economía no permitía comprar otro, un día se dañaron y los mandé a coser y así seguí usándolos. Tenía ya un año deseando tener un nuevo par de zapatos. Es entonces cuando esta semana entro al cuarto de mi tía y allí estaban varios pares de zapatos, incluso unos exactos a los que quería. Y fue inevitable llorar un poco, porque si, alli la vida diciendo \

acabas de heredar esto de tu tia, pero a qué costo. Preferiría mil veces tener mi único par de zapatos y seguir ahorrando para comprar los que quería, pero tenerla a ella allí con vida, riendo, bailando, conversando, mostrándome las últimas manualidades que había hecho o dándome seguramente algún objeto, libretita o zarcillos de mariposa o aguacates que compró porque sabía que me gustaban. Entonces agarré los zapatos, agradecí a mi prima, quién me dijo que luego revisariamos la ropa, pero en mí había tristeza y no alegría, porque está herencia o legado representa la ausencia de la persona amada y duele. 

También está el otro punto de vista, agradecer, sentir que parte de algo que le perteneció tiene su esencia y ahora lo uso, así que una partecita de ella anda conmigo. Pero pasa, como a los herederos de los reinos, que para ser reyes deben haber muerto sus padres, así que, el peso del legado muchas veces es la muerte y el dolor. 

Con mi papá, sucede algo distinto, fue un hombre desprendido al punto que su único equipaje fue una caja con poca ropa, una cartera vieja y dentro solo había una foto de uno de mis hijos, una moneda y 5 bolívares que ya no pertenecen al cono monetario actual de mi país. Mi hermana y yo bromeamos diciendo que la mitad era de ella y la mitad mia. Pero realmente su legado fue otro, más intangible, de valores, de actitud, de ver a alguien levantarse cada día con la esperanza de la vida, mientras yo pasaba por un cuadro depresivo severo donde cada día pensaba como quitarme la mía. Y cuando se fue, dormido, tranquilo. Pensé \

pero dejaste la enseñanza de que  quién te ama siempre buscará la forma de encontrarte, que quién ama la vida a veces no necesita un propósito, solo disfrutarla y vivir el presente, la conversación con el nuevo amigo que hiciste en un kiosko, comerte un caramelo, la emoción de fumarte un cigarro a escondidas porque sabías que era una travesura, vivir porque la vida está allí para vivirla y hasta el último momento disfrutar de esos pequeños detalles que se dan y que no tomamos en cuenta. Pero igual, el click, la enseñanza llega cuando te das cuenta que ese ser ya no está en ese cuerpo, cuando tocas sus manos frías y su cuerpo empieza a endurecer y sabes que ya no lo verás hablar o sonreír más. Y qué importa si no hubo una herencia más allá de una caja de ropa, una moneda recogida de la calle y un billete antiguo. Algo de ti siente que ese legado pesa porque lo trae la muerte, esa señora indomable que decide cuándo ya es suficiente que sigamos disfrutando o no de esto llamado vida. 

Se ven tantos casos de peleas en familia tras la muerte de alguien que ha dejado bienes, me pregunto si ellos sentirán ese peso del legado que les han dejado, que eso ahora les pertenece porque alguien dejó de existir, alguien a quien amaban, aunque a veces se da que no lo amaran.

Ésta reflexión es de las muchas que van llegando ahora que ya soy huérfana completa, ya no hay madre ni padre, incluso no hay esa tía que te trataba maternalmemte y se alegraba de tu visita y ofrecía unas arepitas con caraota y suero, no importa si le decías que habías comido, negarse era un sacrilegio, y ahora siento que su casa es tan distinta sin ella. 

Y aquí estoy, con varios pares de zapatos, una moneda y un billete viejo. Sintiendo que el intercambio fue injusto, tal vez que no merezco tenerlos por el precio que han costado. 


Abrazo gigante.
Se les quiere .

Zully🥰

Hello everyone. Today I'm sharing this painting I did over a year ago, depicting one of Venice's inner streets. It focuses less on detail and more on the interplay of light and shadow. Watercolor on Arches rough grain paper, 29.7 x 42 cm.

Hola a todos. Hoy les presento esta obra que pinté hace más de un año y que refleja una de las calles interiores de Venecia, sin hacer tanto énfasis en el detalle y buscando principalmente los efectos de luz y sombra. Acuarela sobre papel Arches grano grueso 29.7x42 cm.

title.title: The beauty of butterflies.
title.body:
> |Latin Name|Observation date|Location| |-|-|-| |Genus Tarucus|30/06/2026| Bangladesh| ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfLnMjva29h6R2q16ji5BtUSFqtggbTdFEc3zhpj2y3V5/1780154808321.jpg) In our busy city lives, we often overlook the small beauties around us. But if we stop for a moment, we see some creations of nature that instantly calm our minds. This little guest captured by my camera lens today is such a strange and beautiful creation. This butterfly, perched on a green leaf with its wings spread, is originally known as the Panthera. The first thing that catches your eye when looking at the picture is the intricate craftsmanship of its wings. The black and dark brown stripes on the white wings look like the strokes of a skilled artist's brush. It's like a little zebra flying with its wings spread! Not only that, but it also has small bright eye-like spots on the underside of its wings and a light tail-like part. This design of nature is not actually an ordinary form, it is a great defense strategy. When birds of prey come to attack it, they mistake these fake eyes and tail for the butterfly's head. And it attacks the wing tips without hitting the main body. As a result, the butterfly can easily escape and fly away. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcc3F46cMWnHN5vZNB2UjWUTPpoSsPvKU7eydYZdytg2a/1780154808384.jpg) The presence of this butterfly amidst the bright background of green leaves is like a perfect color combination of nature. Although they are quite small in size, their role in our ecosystem is immense. By pollinating flowers, they help the plant world reproduce and maintain the balance of nature. Such a sight is now quite rare in the crowded urban concrete. If we create a small garden on the balcony or roof of our house, countless colorful butterflies can make our daily lives more beautiful. This picture reminds us that you don't have to spend a lot of money to enjoy the most beautiful things in the world, all you need is a beautiful mind and a little time to look. |

title.title: Rebetiko Mix
title.body:
by Siberiann on Paul Lindstrom 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/paulindstrom [![Rebetiko Mix](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/bc770cf7-fe27-4154-9880-fa4162cc7b79.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/cDAnE3GnRVibGxz3qzCdCw) 
 
 Las calles empedradas del Pireo y los barrios marginales de Atenas a principios del siglo XX no eran escenarios para conciertos formales, sino el caldo de cultivo de una necesidad visceral de expresión. Allí, entre el humo denso de los tekedes y el olor a anís, nació algo que trascendía la mera melodía; era el lamento de los desarraigados, de aquellos que habían cruzado el Egeo huyendo de la catástrofe de Asia Menor en 1922. No se trataba de música hecha para complacer a la burguesía ni para ser aplaudida en teatros pulcros, sino de un desahogo colectivo que mezclaba las escalas orientales traídas desde Smyrna con la crudeza de la vida urbana griega.

Los instrumentos definieron esa identidad sonora de manera irreversible en rebetiko. El bouzouki, con su cuello largo y sus cuerdas metálicas, se convirtió en la extensión del alma del intérprete, capaz de llorar o gritar según la presión de los dedos. Acompañado por la baglamas, pequeña y fácil de ocultar bajo la chaqueta cuando la policía prohibía su uso, y el guitarra, creaban una textura sonora áspera, directa, sin adornos innecesarios. La voz no buscaba la perfección técnica del bel canto, sino la verdad desgarrada, a menudo ronca, cargada de ese dolor específico que los griegos llamaban kaimos.

Durante décadas, este género fue estigmatizado, asociado incorrectamente con la delincuencia, el hashish y la marginalidad. Las autoridades lo veían como una amenaza al orden moral, lo que paradójicamente fortaleció su carácter subterráneo y auténtico. Los rebetes, esos personajes nocturnos con sus sombreros inclinados y sus actitudes desafiantes, cantaban sobre la prisión, el amor no correspondido, la pobreza y la traición. No había espacio para la hipocresía; la letra era un espejo implacable de la realidad inmediata.

Con el paso del tiempo, especialmente después de la Segunda Guerra Mundial y la posterior guerra civil, el sonido comenzó a transformarse. La influencia del jazz y de las orquestas más grandes suavizó los bordes más ásperos del estilo original del Pireo. El bouzouki eléctrico hizo su aparición, cambiando la dinámica rítmica y permitiendo que el rebetiko saliera de las tabernas oscuras para entrar en los clubes nocturnos más amplios y, eventualmente, en la conciencia nacional. Lo que antes era motivo de vergüenza para muchas familias, se convirtió en un símbolo de resistencia cultural y de identidad helénica moderna.

Hoy, cuando se escuchan esas grabaciones antiguas, con su calidad de audio imperfecta y sus silencios cargados de tensión, no se percibe solo un género musical extinto, sino la memoria viva de una comunidad que supo transformar el sufrimiento en arte. La evolución del rebetiko demuestra cómo la música puede actuar como un archivo emocional de un pueblo, sobreviviendo a prohibiciones, guerras y cambios sociales, manteniendo intacta esa capacidad única de conectar con la vulnerabilidad humana más profunda.

La sombra alargada del rebetiko no se limitó a las salas de concierto, sino que se filtró como tinta indeleble en la narrativa griega moderna. Escritores como Nikos Kazantzakis o Stratis Myrivilis capturaron esa atmósfera de fatalismo y dignidad herida, incorporando personajes que vivían al margen de la ley moral establecida, donde el honor se medía con códigos propios y no con los impuestos por el estado. La literatura dejó de ser solo un ejercicio estético para convertirse en cronista de esa subcultura, describiendo con precisión quirúrgica los gestos, el lenguaje cifrado de los mangas y la filosofía de vida que rechazaba el conformismo burgués.

En la pantalla grande, el cine griego de mediados del siglo XX adoptó esta estética visual y emocional con fuerza. Directores como Giorgos Tzavellas o más tarde Theo Angelopoulos utilizaron el rebetiko no meramente como banda sonora, sino como un personaje más que dictaba el ritmo narrativo. Las escenas nocturnas, iluminadas por luces tenues y envueltas en humo, reflejaban la dualidad del género: belleza y decadencia entrelazadas. La moda también absorbió este imaginario; el traje oscuro, el pañuelo al cuello y la postura desafiante dejaron de ser indumentaria de delincuentes para transformarse en símbolos de una elegancia ruda y auténtica, influenciando incluso a diseñadores contemporáneos que buscan rescatar esa masculinidad vulnerable y estilizada.

Musicalmente, las ondas expansivas fueron aún más lejos. El rock psicodélico de finales de los sesenta y el movimiento hippie encontraron en las escalas modales del rebetiko un terreno fértil para la experimentación, viendo en ellas una conexión espiritual con el oriente que buscaban explorar. Bandas internacionales comenzaron a samplear viejas grabaciones de Markos Vamvakaris o Vassilis Tsitsanis, fusionando esos lamentos ancestrales con beats electrónicos y texturas modernas. Incluso el jazz mundial reconoció en la improvisación limitada pero intensamente emocional del bouzouki un paralelismo con el blues, estableciendo un puente transatlántico de dolor compartido. Esta permeabilidad demuestra que el género nunca estuvo encerrado en su tiempo histórico, sino que actuó como una raíz profunda que alimenta constantemente nuevas ramas artísticas, manteniendo viva la conversación entre el pasado marginal y la expresión cultural contemporánea.

El rebetiko trasciende la definición estricta de género musical para erigirse como un pilar fundamental en la construcción de la identidad griega moderna. No se trata simplemente de una colección de canciones, sino de un archivo sonoro que documenta la transición traumática de una sociedad agraria y tradicional hacia una realidad urbana, industrial y fragmentada. Este proceso de adaptación cultural, marcado por el desplazamiento masivo tras la catástrofe de 1922, encontró en el rebetiko su voz colectiva, permitiendo a una población desarraigada negociar su lugar en un mundo nuevo y hostil. La UNESCO, al reconocerlo como Patrimonio Cultural Inmaterial de la Humanidad, validó lo que los practicantes ya sabían: que esta música es un testimonio vital de resistencia y supervivencia.

Su importancia radica en la capacidad de dignificar la experiencia del marginado. En una época donde la pobreza y el exilio eran estigmas sociales, el rebetiko transformó esa vergüenza en orgullo estético y ético. Creó un espacio seguro donde las emociones prohibidas —la desesperación, la rabia, la nostalgia extrema— podían ser expresadas públicamente sin juicio. Esta catarsis compartida fortaleció los lazos comunitarios en los barrios obreros, estableciendo códigos de conducta y solidaridad que perduraron mucho más allá de la vida nocturna. El género actuó como un amortiguador social, absorbiendo el shock de los cambios políticos drásticos, desde la dictadura metaxista hasta la ocupación nazi y la guerra civil, ofreciendo una narrativa alternativa a la historia oficial impuesta por los poderes fácticos.

Además, el rebetiko desafió las nociones rígidas de pureza cultural nacional. Al integrar elementos otomanos, balcánicos y mediterráneos, demostró que la identidad helénica no era un monolito estático, sino un tejido dinámico y multicultural. Esta hibridación, inicialmente rechazada por los nacionalistas más conservadores, se reveló posteriormente como la esencia misma de la modernidad griega. Hoy, su legado se observa en cómo las nuevas generaciones reinterpretan la tradición, no como una reliquia de museo, sino como un lenguaje vivo capaz de dialogar con problemas contemporáneos como la crisis económica o la migración. La vigencia del rebetiko reside precisamente en esa universalidad de su mensaje: la búsqueda de libertad individual frente a la opresión estructural, un tema que resuena con igual fuerza en cualquier latitud y época.

Es todo por hoy.

Disfruten del mix que les comparto, esta vez, sin voz, solo instrumental. 

Chau, BlurtMedia…

title.body:
> ![IMG-20260513-WA0008~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXmd8kqPG6aHN43Gwo7QZSc2vbB8Jxo9t7CUnXLsgyfWA/IMG-20260513-WA0008~2.jpg) Friends, I hope you are all well. Today I have come to share with you one of my favorite hobbies. As a responsible family member, I have to live a routine life. Starting from cooking, cleaning the house and finishing all the household chores, a large part of the day is spent. But all the fatigue of the day disappears in an instant when I sit down to create something new by mixing the sweetness of my mind. I always love to give new forms to ordinary things. Whenever I can find a little time after the daily chores of the house, I sit down to create these beautiful wallmats. To be honest, it takes me days to create one wallmat or mirror art. Because I don't have the opportunity to sit together for a long time while managing the family. Still, I enjoy doing this patient work, it is a kind of mental peace for me. In today's post, I have brought 4 different designs of wallmats made by myself ![IMG-20260513-WA0010~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfB7MDD3CHQa9EFGmfkTTiEu1nAWNsXWruzZtuCQgGwX9/IMG-20260513-WA0010~2.jpg) The first design is made with a deep green border around a small mirror. I have embellished the design with beautiful white vine leaves and small mirror pieces using clay or glue. ![IMG-20260513-WA0009~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUsYDnxUyChctLrjJYAb4X9uKVHKhwCKT6Y4u4oBTPaeD/IMG-20260513-WA0009~2.jpg) The second design is a minimalist theme in black. I have used a golden thread-like border around the mirror and small golden leaf motifs on a black background, which has given it a royal look. ![IMG-20260513-WA0006~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPqSsDsgszFY7wv87oXJKR9VzUCHiZvPD5a1aYqVdoRJ4/IMG-20260513-WA0006~2.jpg) The third design is a colorful mandala-inspired wallpaper. There are bright pink petals in the middle and a small sun or flower design on the top. The combination of bright yellow and light blue around it makes it quite attractive. The fourth design is made on a completely floral theme. The mirror is decorated with beautiful young green leaves and pink flowers on a light pink background, which greatly enhances the beauty of the room when hung on the wall. It would be unbelievable if you did not do it yourself that it is possible to create something so beautiful with ordinary household items like clay, acrylic paint and a curved mirror. When a work takes shape little by little, day after day, the joy is indescribable. Please let me know in the comments how you liked my small efforts and wallets. Your comments will inspire me to do better in the future. Everyone stay safe and healthy, thank you. ___ |

It does not come with thunder. It does not arrive with accusation. It comes in the silence after a lie has been told, in the hollow space between what you said and what you know to be true. They are words of invitation. An invitation to rise, not because you have failed, but because you are capable of more. The finest writers of the human condition have always understood: growth is not a punishment for being flawed; it is the privilege of being alive. --- ## **II. The Architecture of Trust** Trust is not a thing given lightly. It is built, brick by brick, word by word, promise by promise. It is the foundation upon which every meaningful relationship rests—between friends, between lovers, between communities, between a person and their own conscience. And yet, how easily we undermine it. We tell ourselves small lies to avoid discomfort. We offer half-truths to preserve an image. We rationalize silence when honesty is required. We convince ourselves that the lie is for *their* good, when in truth, it is for our own convenience. But trust, once fractured, does not heal with time alone. It heals with truth. It heals with accountability. It heals when the one who broke it chooses, deliberately and humbly, to rebuild. *Do better.* This is not a command from without. It is a whisper from within—the part of you that knows, always, the difference between the path of ease and the path of integrity. --- ## **III. The Courage of Honesty** To stop lying is not merely to cease speaking falsehoods. It is to begin living in alignment. It is to look at the person who trusts you and say, *\

The greatest writers of moral courage—from Seneca to Baldwin, from Woolf to Havel—have taught us this: honesty is not the absence of fear. It is the decision to act *despite* fear. It is the choice to value truth over comfort, relationship over reputation, growth over the illusion of perfection.

When you lie to those who trust you, you do not merely deceive them. You deceive yourself. You teach yourself that your word has no weight, that your promise has no meaning, that your character is negotiable.

## **IV. The Practice of Becoming**

Being a better person is not a destination. It is a practice.

It is the daily choice to listen more than you speak.
To apologize before you are asked.
To give credit before you take it.
To hold space for someone else's pain without rushing to fix it.
To sit with your own discomfort long enough to learn from it.

And still—you rise. Again. And again. And again.

So here is the invitation, offered not in judgment, but in hope:

Look at the life you are building.
Look at the people who walk beside you.
Look at the person you see in the mirror when no one else is watching.

And ask yourself, with gentleness and with courage:

*Is this the legacy I want to leave—not in grand gestures, but in daily choices?*

## 🍜 Slurp City Awakening: The Ultimate Pork Noodle Brunch at Nai Lue, Om Noi!

### 🇬🇧 Review by Sakol, Your Ultimate Food Guide

**Wake up and smell the broth, my fellow foodies!** Sakol is back in action! Are you having one of those late mornings where you just need something spectacular to kickstart your day? Well, grab your chopsticks because today I am taking you to a legendary spot in Om Noi: **Nai Lue Restaurant (ร้านนายลือ)**. The moment you step out of your car, the heavenly aroma of simmering herbs and spices hits you like a beautiful, delicious brick.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZp2Uw6pAAevWG7FhFxhhuimLoL6VoskcvkLmY1xSpHKc/image.png)


Today’s brunch is a masterclass in Thai noodle perfection. Let’s dive right into this glorious feast!

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQNWGJBn6eFSt2mfzV6tHzgghRC6o15G6NdGG6KbUHBvG/image.png)


* **Braised Pork Soup with Plain Rice (Kaolao Moo Tun + Khao Plao):** Oh, sweet mercy! Let’s start with the heavyweight champion. The broth is a deep, dark mahogany, singing with the aroma of star anise, cinnamon, and secret herbs. And the pork? *It literally melts in your mouth.* It’s been braised so perfectly that the fat just dissolves on your tongue. Spooning this rich, savory soup over a plate of steaming hot rice is what I call a \

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTbSbgaWkFaDbczHePccgVHo53xVrw1Kzd8939krhF3qZ/image.png)


* **Egg Noodles with Pork in Thick Broth (Ba Mee Moo Namtok):** Next up, we switch gears to the bright, bouncy yellow egg noodles! The star here is the \

broth—a rich, thickened, ultra-savory soup that clings to every single strand of the noodles. The chewiness of the Ba Mee mixed with the intense, spicy, and herbal punch of the broth is an absolute flavor explosion in your mouth. You don’t even need to add condiments; it’s perfect right out of the pot!

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZp2Uw6pAAevWG7FhFxhhuimLoL6VoskcvkLmY1xSpHKc/image.png)


* **Rice Noodles with Pork in Thick Broth (Sen Lek Moo Namtok):** You can’t go to a boat noodle shop without trying the classic *Sen Lek*. The flat, translucent rice noodles are the ultimate vehicle for soaking up that hardcore Namtok broth. They are sticky, chewy, and coated in a glorious glaze of soup, tender pork slices, and morning glory. One loud *SLURP*, and you are instantly transported to noodle paradise!

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUZVmprzb3QUYvrYPgDaV24niLhLdLi8mFgCJ3GSjQuEp/image.png)


**Sakol’s Final Verdict:** Nai Lue in Om Noi isn't just a meal; it's an experience that wakes up every single cell in your body. Rich, intense, and insanely satisfying. If you are ever in the area, drop everything and go get your slurp on! **10/10, an absolute must-try!**


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX9gj9WowxNieNK7z86kiuVY1wGjrfVzBHCnKSu1AL8Xa/image.png)

Trust is not broken by a single deception. It is broken by the repetition of it. It is broken when the ledger screams truth and the gatekeepers whisper fiction, expecting the garden to flourish anyway. And so they leave. Not with fanfare. Not with protest. title.title: How was today's stormy day in Haldwani?
title.body:
Hello, Ram Ram, Namaste, Satriyakaal to all Hive users. Today, I'll tell you how today's stormy day was in Haldwani. My city, Haldwani, has unpredictable weather because today, it was a sunny day with much hot weather during the day, and in the afternoon, the weather changed into black clouds, but it was fine, and again the weather changed into a sunny day. But, as I went to tuition and as we went inside, the weather was fine, and there was no sign of rain, but after almost one hour, all the black clouds covered the sky with their darkness, and in the summer, where the sun generally sets down around 7:30 pm, the sun today setted at 6:00 pm and that was weird but, it wasn't too because before some years there was full night scene during the day around 2:00 pm. 


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmarbLRPXhdsQujXaBNumbFYspgJu28ANxbVVanQisfezL/chatgpt_image_may_30_2026_08_53_57_pm.png)




[img src](chatgpt.com)


Now let's talk about today, the weather has become furious, and there was a crazy environment in the tuition. We all started talking because it was a moment like joy and excitement that, wondering what would happen next, and me and my friend had joined two benches and we lied on the last seats of the class where no one could see us behind a big bench. All the children's parents started calling the tuition teacher because the weather was too furious. Slowly, all the parents started coming to take their children home, and almost all the students were gone, only 3-4 were left, including me because my mother was also there and we had come in a scooty. But, the weather was not suitable for driving scooty and one aunty had came there to take his child home, by booking an auto, and she lived near our house. But his child was gone earlier with his friends in the car, and she came there by booking an auto and then, my mother and I also shared the auto and went in the same auto because, as I told you, she lived near me. 



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSp8GCJYrL9BiB4jbnKckPP273UuaydcdtUigntjSq4Vc/afddsf.jpg)




[img src](https://www.magnific.com/free-photo/lightning-strike-cloudy-sky-night-time_12647136.htm#fromView=search&page=1&position=1&uuid=2a8fe089-b1ad-4627-9a26-f7f347935120&query=stormy+weather)



And the special thing was that the aunty had already paid and booked the auto, so she also refused to take the money for the auto, and she said I have already booked the auto, and my kid didn't come in the auto, so someone should come in the auto, because of which the money would not be wasted. And we do not have to pay the money for the auto, so how did this god plan things earlier? Where aunty's son had gone earlier, but aunty came in an auto, and we lived near her, so, we also went in the auto, and we also went safely home. I think that god sends different people to help each other in every situation, even if a person doesn't believe in god. Because all the people on the earth are like god's children and like our mother's intention is never to harm their children like that only god shows us path in every situation.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNx6QLXmH5UyvwweRZkWq3JtBtRhMvh46sr9f88PdABFY/ljgsdkljgf.jpg)



[img src](https://www.magnific.com/free-photo/vertical-shot-pathway-middle-grassy-field-with-trees-cloudy-sky_9759484.htm#fromView=search&page=1&position=2&uuid=2a8fe089-b1ad-4627-9a26-f7f347935120&query=stormy+weather)

So, for Today, this much only till further goodbye.

中午看了北邮原创的话剧《寻找李白》，非常好看，中途我都极度流泪，久久不能平静。

李白是一位为革命事业壮烈牺牲的中共地下党员。这部话剧通过李白妻子、儿子、战友等不同时空当事人的回忆，从不同角度完整刻画了李白，让我们不仅看到了他作为革命作为英雄的坚定不移的革命信仰，同时也看到了他身为普通人的温情和牵挂。

每个演员的表演都很有张力，都能把我代入到当时的环境里，看着他们相爱相伴相离，看着一封封电报带着必胜的决心千里奔波，看着李白面对刁难和凌辱时顽强不屈，视死如归……

有些地方真的特别触动我，比如说，被敌人发现后李白最后用明文发出“再见”的电波，仅仅二字，饱含了对妻儿的告别、赴死的决绝以及革命必胜的信念！李白只上过四年小学，十五岁，还是个孩子的时候他就加入了革命，经过长征的淬炼与磨砺后，是个真正的革命战士。当党组织委派他传译的工作时，他果断接受了任命，从零开始，从认识字母开始学习通信方面的知识，最终练就本领，发出稳定的独特的电波，成为党组织传递情报的可靠砥柱。以当时的条件成就这番辉煌，现在的我们实在没有资格遇到难题就放弃！

李白夫妻俩是一对革命夫妻，在合作和生活中建立了深厚的感情，二人情谊十分可贵，互相照顾交流革命事业让他们看到了彼此身上可贵的精神和人格，所以成就了如此一段美丽的佳话。

有些舞台设计也特别棒，看得我热血沸腾情不自禁！我好像也明白了我们这个专业的重大意义，所以以后要加倍努力学习了！

title.title: Tomorrow Never Comes
title.body: Have you ever felt this You dream big you want success but when it’s time to take action, you say, I’ll start tomorrow. If you also dream big but fall victim to laziness, then this story can change your life. In a small village surrounded by greenery and tall trees lived a young man named Aamir. Aamir was twenty five, strong, healthy and full of dreams. He often told his friends,One day I’ll be the richest farmer in this village. My fields will shine like gold and people will come to me for advice. The villagers knew about his dreams, but there was one problem Aamir was very lazy. When the sun rose and other farmers went to their fields, Aamir would still be lying in bed. While people worked hard under the sun he would sit in the shade just dreaming. For every task he would say, I’ll do it later. He had plenty of plans, but no action at all. One evening, Aamir’s uncle a wise and experienced farmer came to see him. He looked at Aamir’s empty field and said,Son, you talk about golden crops but all I see here is barren land. Aamir laughed and said, Don’t worry, Uncle, I’ll start tomorrow. His uncle sighed because he had heard that tomorrow many times. He took two seeds out of his pocket and gave them to Aamir. He said, These are no ordinary seeds. The first seed is of ambition. If you water it daily and work hard, it will grow into a tree and bring you success. The second seed is of laziness. It will grow on its own very fast and destroy your entire field. Now the choice is yours which seed will you grow? Aamir thought,Obviously I’ll plant the seed of success. But the next morning he again said, Not today tomorrow. Days passed. Eventually he planted both seeds and then forgot about them. A few weeks later, when he went to his field he was shocked. The seed of laziness had grown rapidly. Weeds had spread everywhere and the seed of ambition was weak almost dying. His uncle returned and said, Aamir this is your life. Ambition is a tiny seed. It needs daily effort and attention otherwise it dies. But laziness grows on its own and ruins everything. Hearing this, Aamir’s eyes filled with tears. For the first time he understood the reality. Dreams alone are not enough action is necessary. The next morning, Aamir got up before sunrise. He pulled out the weeds with his own hands. His hands got injured his body grew tired but he didn’t stop. He watered the seed every day. Slowly, that seed grew into a strong tree that gave him success, respect and wealth. And Aamir he was no longer lazy. He became the most successful farmer in the village. This story isn’t just about a field it’s the story of your life. Inside every person are two seeds one of ambition one of laziness. Ambition only grows when you work hard every day. Laziness grows on its own and kills your dreams. If you truly want to succeed, don’t wait for tomorrow. Start today. Kill laziness and bring your dreams to life.
