title.title: Things are growing bigger; Hivegarden gardenjournal with sunshine and strong growth
title.body:
It's summer in the Netherlands! After a few weeks of warm, sunny weather, the garden has really come to life. The time of beautiful blossom is over, but many plants are showing impressive growth. In this blog I'll show you around in my backyard jungle 😂 ![divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23t7YWoNDewJkbQoM9yiSvwjFh4yHJuCWXPjgX31Eep5JGnZChA88ZNWdDr6H5FBgdVaj.png) # Yellow Ox‑Eye (Telekia speciosa) I first discovered this plant several years ago while staying at a holiday home. The backyard of that place contained a large patch of beautiful large yellow plants. Their bright yellow flowers attracted a large number of insects. I remember seeing dozens of butterflies visiting the flowers while we were having lunch in the backyard. I didn't know these plants, so I looked them up and decided to buy some for my own backyard after returning home, which I did! The plants grow very fast. They go from 0 to a height of around 1.5 meters in just a few weeks. Their large leaves already make an impressive green 'bush'. ![oxeye-big.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23vhwMzYoWLMRmcCAahFtsSadiUpcfSpHH2QvEuqDXorbm93v2pvdAKWY33ytWGpzAMNC.png) The flowers have not appeared yet, but I don't think we have to wait long for them to come because the first buds are there already. Once they do, I expect they will once again attract plenty of bees and butterflies to the garden, which I love about the plant. Did you notice the ladybug larvae on the bud on the right by the way? ![buds.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23wWn9n2vCXGBDZqrtHkQa9ZzTPN2bRf1pFX5kNkPPdCa52nKFHUY9G6LiqakqC5PxnMV.png) Last year I collected seeds from the old, dried out plants and stored them over the winter. Earlier this spring, I sowed them, which was surprisingly successful. In a previous post I already showed the tiny indoor green house full of tiny germinated Ox-eyes. Only their growth started to slow down after a while. This had probably to do with the amount of seedlings in the small containers. The seeds are so tiny I just spread them out over the containers, but so many germinated, that the containers were too crowded. I selected the strongest seedlings and planted them in pairs into larger containers. ![tray.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23zRwBBXNwJ4a3TBbbiUKr7fDWbVNBCCxaqM4zSDEArd3pcM2BLdgGRRLytUvEYRJy8UD.png) Despite their relatively small size above the soil, they had already developed an impressive long roots. It was quite a job to untangle them carefully. They still have a long way to go, but they are beginning to look like proper plants already. As you can see in the photo above, I'm growing 26 young plants which have a nice place in the sun in the windowsill. ![oxeye-small.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23wCA62rB4V6j7UNftBGxbmkF95RukK3v1jdhuDCLiPmcNjfdLEczFzjFGE8G78EQYfD1.png) I need to decide what to do with them if they all survive. I do not have room for that many mature plants in my own garden. I will probably give some away to friends and family, or perhaps offer a few for sale through an online marketplace. ![divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23t7YWoNDewJkbQoM9yiSvwjFh4yHJuCWXPjgX31Eep5JGnZChA88ZNWdDr6H5FBgdVaj.png) # Fruits and nuts We're growing quite some fruits in our backyard. We have an apple tree, raspberry bush and a plum tree. Apart from that we also have an almond tree. Most of them are seemingly doing really fine. Although there are way less plums than last year (I had to prune it to give them more space), there are still quite a few plums in the tree. Last year we were on holiday in July, which was exactly the time they were ripe. I received a photo from my parents in law who picked a bowl full of fresh, sweet plums while we were gone. ![plums.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23tvZkdRfChmqAbNzB18QegH5Mfg3oPLt81WiKt2qW9Jz2o5NaRgXkxNA8GDiTVxZpDu3.png) The almond is also doing well. We bought this one as a small tree a couple of years ago because we found it a lovely tree, but it has grown quite a bit since then. ![almond.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23wMU9xkKfLGjyLHy5CAAzk45x4sPrUCBfZgCYLwncSYsuRVzkUaTkELYhdpRf8GWkamW.png) It has grown quite big branches and has loads of almonds every year. Every year we're getting more almonds. And although it might seem like a lot, the almonds inside their big green shells are just a centimeter big. You'll end up with 'just' a hand full of them and a lot of work to crack open the shells. But it's fun to eat things from your own garden. ![almonds.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23vsG9hxDLRq5a9hga9A8yi6gM9DkzNWDShDiug5eBSUxPo6fcbBmvmkQd7kxeYmbNxiv.png) The tree that isn't doing to well is the apple tree. At least, when we're talking about apple production. Last year it gave us just a few apples, but this year it's even less. It does grow well. We let it grow sideways guided with bamboo sticks. It's becoming a nice green wall like that, which gives us some extra privacy. ![appelboom.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23ynQWUM5xE3wYe1qifC6qjXoaUdVWymX6qED4V1ybS4mjVHGQo2zYh3LrkjgXEjjUQX6.png)
So far I just spotted one tiny apple on the tree: ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/Eoc7WRRj5uXz8XFeYv9c17FRwM9zLbotdKWU7hoA3vETPuiwq5LKfyPqNWitfRURTwH.png) I did see something else in my apple tree; a couple of web-spinning caterpillars. They turn into web-spinning moths. A couple of them doesn't harm the apple tree, but I am going to remove them since I don't want the entire tree to be covered in it. ![mot.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23uFPPsUiihTAZppkFJcWjg4MiMjJhbzGZy4KSNBWfm12pLkDHqwbX35xfkKnMrkQDVmB.png) ![divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23t7YWoNDewJkbQoM9yiSvwjFh4yHJuCWXPjgX31Eep5JGnZChA88ZNWdDr6H5FBgdVaj.png) Well this was it for this hivegarden gardenjournal update. I hope you enjoyed it. Thank you for reading my blog. If you have questions or comments, feel free to share them in the comment section below. ![divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23t7YWoNDewJkbQoM9yiSvwjFh4yHJuCWXPjgX31Eep5JGnZChA88ZNWdDr6H5FBgdVaj.png)
**Check out my [Hive Account Health Dashboard](https://friendlymoose5717.github.io/hive-dashboard/)** 📊 ![HAHD.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/48HAXGJ9ZC4ULeE5X3G1D53uxKfo2hhVeDBqUSh2KP4H5VFc2sbFfEjSZAuphEugJo.png)
![divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23t7YWoNDewJkbQoM9yiSvwjFh4yHJuCWXPjgX31Eep5JGnZChA88ZNWdDr6H5FBgdVaj.png)

title.title: HiveToday 84 - Account Health Tools, Hard Fork 29 Prep, and a Staking Rebound
title.body:
[@friendlymoose](https://peakd.com/@friendlymoose/the-hive-account-health-dashboard) shipped an Account Health Dashboard that topped 175 Hive Power (HP) and 48 comments this week, core developers merged the first Hard Fork 29 (HF29) rule changes into the node codebase (not yet live on mainnet), and net staking swung +783k HIVE ahead of Hive Power Up Day on June 1.

This is HiveToday, a weekly recap of the Hive blockchain ecosystem.

New here? Hive uses delegated proof-of-stake. Token holders elect witnesses who produce blocks. You can post, comment, and play games without paying gas on every click. The chain has been live since March 2020.

---

## This Week on Hive

[@friendlymoose](https://peakd.com/@friendlymoose/the-hive-account-health-dashboard) built a tool the chain never shipped natively: a Hive Account Health Dashboard that shows resource credits, voting patterns, and account risk in one place. The launch post earned 175 HP, 531 votes, and 48 comments, strong traction for a solo dev tool on [C/HiveDevs](https://peakd.com/hive-139531). An [updates thread](https://peakd.com/@friendlymoose/hive-account-health-dashboard-updates) followed mid-week; an earlier build log drew 112 comments, showing the idea landed before the polish did.

The dashboard arrived in a busy tools week. [@thecrazygm](https://peakd.com/@thecrazygm/nectar-and-nectarengine-v100-are-live-on-srbde) shipped Nectar v1.0.0 on srbde, a search layer for Hive content. [@asgarth](https://peakd.com/@asgarth/peakd-update-discovery-experiments-better-seo-and-a-few-quality-of-life-fixes) ran PeakD discovery and SEO tests. [@ecency](https://peakd.com/@ecency/ecency-mobile-3-5-6) dropped Mobile 3.5.6. [@hdev](https://peakd.com/@hdev/hivepulse-v160-multi-account-full-wallet--smarter-notifications-) shipped HivePulse v1.6.0 with multi-account wallets. [@cutehive.com](https://peakd.com/@cutehive.com/hive-reader-mini-v2-7-9-update-finally-supporting-standalone-article-links) updated Hive Reader Mini for standalone article links. Hive apps now compete on findability and account clarity, not just posting. A health dashboard feels boring until your resource credits run dry, and then it is the only screen that matters.

Meanwhile the community put weight back on the chain. Roughly 1.3M HIVE powered up in seven days against 519k powered down, a sharp reversal from last week's net down week. [@hivebuzz](https://peakd.com/@hivebuzz/pud-202606) called Power Up Day for June 1. [@risingstargame](https://peakd.com/@risingstargame/important-announcement-regarding-the-future-of-rising-star) still led the reward board at 254 HP, proof that last week's game reset is still the loudest thread in the room ([issue #83](https://peakd.com/@hivetoday/83)).

---

## Development Pulse

### Hard Fork 29 prep (code merged, not activated on mainnet)

There was no on-chain witness post or scheduled mainnet activation date for Hard Fork 29 this week. The live chain is still on Hard Fork 28; top witnesses run v1.28.3. What changed was preparation work in the [hive/hive](https://gitlab.syncad.com/hive/hive) repository on the `develop` branch.

When HF29 eventually activates, the rule set currently defined in the codebase covers three user-visible fixes:

1. **Recurrent transfers ([issue #786](https://gitlab.syncad.com/hive/hive/-/issues/786)):** Today, a new recurrent transfer must run at least twice (`executions` ≥ 2). HF29 would allow you to modify an existing recurrent transfer down to one remaining execution, so you can wind down a scheduled payment without deleting and recreating it.

2. **Account recovery authority limits:** HF29 closes a loophole where an account could use oversized authority keys when editing or canceling an account recovery request, bypassing the normal size checks. After the fork, those limits would apply consistently on recovery operations.

3. **Limit orders for missing assets:** HF29 would reject limit orders that try to buy assets that do not exist on the chain. Today such orders can sit until expiry because no one can fill them; the fork makes posting them invalid up front.

Developers also merged a separate vote evaluator bug fix (nested database updates that could corrupt vote accounting on old blocks) and continued Docker / IPv6 listening polish across the HAF stack. None of that means HF29 is live yet: mainnet node builds still declare 28 hard forks, and the placeholder activation block in `develop` is 150,000,000 (the chain is near 106.8M), with no public witness coordination post so far.

### Other core and app dev

Balance tracking moved to faster SQL queries in **balance_tracker**. The hive.blog codebase gained new test coverage for communities and follow lists. The block explorer added live Decentralized Hive Fund (DHF) proposal pages.

HiveDevs shipping: [@thecrazygm](https://peakd.com/@thecrazygm/a-massive-makeover-for-the-mithril-diesel-pool-and-other-hivetools-updates) refreshed HiveTools pools. [@sagarkothari88](https://peakd.com/@sagarkothari88/81ca570a) shipped daily HiveSuite and HiveReactKit updates. 3Speak video pipelines picked up memory and timeout fixes.

---

## Project Spotlights

Ecency: [@ecency](https://peakd.com/@ecency/ecency-mobile-3-5-6) shipped Mobile 3.5.6 with perks, Read Next, and multi-send.

PeakD: [@asgarth](https://peakd.com/@asgarth/peakd-update-discovery-experiments-better-seo-and-a-few-quality-of-life-fixes) ran discovery experiments and SEO work; [@behiver](https://peakd.com/@behiver/peakd-is-the-official-content-handler-for-hivepulseapp) confirmed PeakD as HivePulse's content handler.

Hive Keychain: [@keychain](https://peakd.com/@keychain/b27c81c7) is testing multichain with Altera from Magi (follow-up to last week's closed beta).

HivePulse: [@hdev](https://peakd.com/@hdev/hivepulse-v160-multi-account-full-wallet--smarter-notifications-) released v1.6.0 with multi-account support and full wallet view.

HivePostify: [@aftabirshad](https://peakd.com/@aftabirshad/official-update-or-hivepostify-cloud) posted a cloud account-claim update; [@postify](https://peakd.com/@postify/hivepostify-cloud-account-claim-operations-report-mpol097j) shared an operations report on HiveDevs.

Splinterlands: [@splinterlands](https://peakd.com/@splinterlands/summer-fun-gift-boxes-are-coming-to-splinterlands) announced Summer Fun Gift Boxes.

Rising Star: [@risingstargame](https://peakd.com/@risingstargame/important-announcement-regarding-the-future-of-rising-star) future-of-game post still topping rewards.

Worldmappin: daily [Travel Digest](https://peakd.com/@worldmappin/travel-digest-2932) series through #2932.

MydEmpire: [@mydempire](https://peakd.com/@mydempire/mydempire-mobile-experience-update) mobile experience update.

---

## Network Stats

| Metric | This week |
|--------|-----------|
| HIVE price | $0.0587 |
| HIVE market cap | ~$32.2M |
| CoinGecko rank | #662 |
| 24h change | +1.86% |
| HBD print rate | 0 (no new HBD minting) |
| HIVE powered up (7d) | 1,301,904 HIVE |
| HIVE powered down (7d) | 518,674 HIVE |
| Net stake change | +783,230 HIVE |

HBD explained: HBD is Hive's dollar-pegged token. When too much HBD exists relative to HIVE value, the chain can stop minting new HBD. Print rate 0 means that brake is on now. Treasury HBD held by @hive.fund is counted separately from what users hold (see [issue #75](https://peakd.com/@hivetoday/75) for the full debt story).

Powering up: net power-up flipped strongly positive this week. @elmerlin and @planetoceana led with six-figure self-stakes; [@hivebuzz](https://peakd.com/@hivebuzz/pud-202606) called Hive Power Up Day for June 1.

---

## Governance

Twenty of the top 21 witnesses run v1.28.3. deathwing is on v1.28.0; good-karma runs v1.28.6. The network remains on Hard Fork 28 until witnesses schedule and adopt HF29.

Funded DHF proposals (paid above Return Proposal #0):

## Top Community Posts This Week

HP means Hive Power: the staked token weight behind author rewards, not \

title.title: Silent changes in the banking sector.
title.body:
> ![IMG-20260529-WA0020~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmekKKJ9fnsT1hfc5mdMs8NJPvLSktJ6MrK159PVKXktEZ/IMG-20260529-WA0020~2.jpg) At present, a kind of silent change is being observed in the economic situation of our country and the banking sector. Especially, a kind of crisis or crisis of money is being felt in the daily transactions of the common people. There is no common reason behind this crisis, rather a major policy change in the country's currency management is acting as its main driving force. We know that almost all the large notes in the market so far had the image of Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman. However, according to the decision and plan of the current government, the notes with this image are being gradually withdrawn from the market. The government wants these old notes not to come into the market again. Instead, the process of releasing completely new designed currency in the market has started. Due to this major change, some temporary complications have arisen in the banking sector and especially in the ATM booths. Whenever old notes are deposited in a bank or ATM booth, they are no longer being supplied for public use as per the instructions of the central bank. As a result, there is a kind of shortage of liquid money or cash notes in the market. To understand the real picture, we need to pay attention to some things within the banking service. The internal cassette and counting device of the ATM booth are open, where bundles of 1,000 taka notes are arranged. Bank officials have to work constantly to maintain such technical maintenance and adapt the booths to the new notes. Similarly, we can see a functioning ATM booth of an Islamic bank with the message Please wait displayed on the screen and some money visible in the cash dispensing slot below. Both these images prove that banks are trying their best to keep their services running. ![IMG-20260529-WA0021~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS6jNL4UZmB8hgA9Kq1qm1KvNqudoLK4K87mpjN13B1G3/IMG-20260529-WA0021~2.jpg) Changing a currency system is a very complex and time-consuming matter. The central bank has to go through several processes to completely remove the old money from the market and introduce the equivalent amount of new money into the market. It is normal for the common people to experience some confusion or suffering during this transition period. However, it is hoped that when the new design money comes into the market in sufficient quantities, this crisis will end and the country's economic transactions will return to their previous dynamics. We all have to be patient and have faith in the banking system during this transition. This was my arrangement for today. I hope you liked the pictures I took and the nature observations. title.title: Bitcoin: The Digital Revolution That Changed Money Forever!
title.body: **Introduction.** Imagine a world where money can be sent anywhere in seconds without banks, governments, or intermediaries controlling the transaction. This idea sounded impossible just a few decades ago. Today, Bitcoin has transformed that vision into reality.

/> Since its creation in 2009, Bitcoin has evolved from an obscure internet experiment into one of the world's most valuable financial assets. It has sparked innovation, inspired thousands of cryptocurrencies, and challenged traditional views of money and finance. But what exactly is Bitcoin, and why has it captured the attention of investors, businesses, and governments around the globe? * * * **What Is Bitcoin?** Bitcoin is a decentralized digital currency that allows people to send and receive money directly over the internet. Unlike traditional currencies such as the US Dollar, Euro, or Tanzanian Shilling, Bitcoin is not issued or controlled by any central bank. Instead, Bitcoin operates on a technology called blockchain, a public ledger that records every transaction ever made on the network. The creator of Bitcoin used the pseudonym Satoshi Nakamoto, whose true identity remains one of the greatest mysteries in technology history.

/>

* * *

**How Does Bitcoin Work?**

At its core, Bitcoin relies on a network of computers around the world.

When someone sends Bitcoin:

1.  The transaction is broadcast to the network.
    
2.  Computers verify that the transaction is valid.
    
3.  Verified transactions are grouped into blocks.
    
4.  These blocks are added permanently to the blockchain.
    
5.  The recipient receives the Bitcoin.
    

This process eliminates the need for banks or payment processors, making transactions faster and often less expensive.

* * *

**Why Is Bitcoin Valuable?**

Many people ask: \

The answer lies in several unique characteristics: 1. **Limited Supply.** * Only 21 million Bitcoins will ever exist. This scarcity makes Bitcoin similar to precious metals like gold. 2. **Decentralization.** * No single organization controls Bitcoin. This makes it resistant to censorship and government interference. 3. **Global Accessibility.** * Anyone with an internet connection can use Bitcoin, regardless of their location. 4. **Security.** * Bitcoin's blockchain is protected by advanced cryptography and one of the most powerful computing networks ever created.

/>

* * *

**Bitcoin as Digital Gold.**

Many investors refer to Bitcoin as \

Just as gold has been used as a store of value for centuries, Bitcoin is increasingly viewed as a hedge against inflation and currency devaluation. Large companies, investment funds, and even some governments have begun holding Bitcoin as part of their financial reserves. Supporters believe Bitcoin's fixed supply gives it long-term potential to preserve wealth in an era of increasing money printing and inflation. * * * **Risks and Challenges.** Despite its popularity, Bitcoin is not without risks; 1. **Price Volatility.** * Bitcoin's price can rise or fall at anytime and without any alerts. 2. **Regulatory Uncertainty.** * Governments around the world continue to develop regulations regarding cryptocurrency use and taxation. 3. **Security Mistakes.** * While Bitcoin itself is highly secure, users can lose funds if they fail to protect their wallets and private keys. 4. **Environmental Concerns.** * Bitcoin mining consumes significant amounts of energy, leading to ongoing debates about sustainability. Investors should always conduct thorough research and understand the risks before investing. * * * **The Future of Bitcoin.** The future of Bitcoin remains one of the most discussed topics in finance and technology. Some experts believe Bitcoin could become a global reserve asset similar to gold. Others see it becoming an essential component of the modern financial system. As adoption continues to grow, Bitcoin may play a major role in: * International payments * Digital banking * Financial inclusion * Wealth preservation * Decentralized finance (DeFi) Whether Bitcoin ultimately reshapes the global economy or remains primarily an investment asset, its impact on the world of finance is already undeniable.

/>

* * *

**Conclusion.**

Bitcoin represents far more than a digital currency. It is a technological innovation that challenges traditional financial systems and offers a new vision for how value can be stored and transferred.

Over the past decade, Bitcoin has proven its resilience through market cycles, regulatory scrutiny, and technological challenges. While uncertainty remains, one thing is clear: Bitcoin has permanently changed the conversation about money.

As the digital age continues to evolve, Bitcoin's story is still being written and the next chapter could be even more transformative than the last.

* * *

**_What are your thoughts on Bitcoin? Do you see it as the future of money, digital gold, or simply another investment opportunity? Share your opinion in the comments below!_**

title.title: Enjoying The Peñon Beach (Eng/Esp)
title.body:
> Walking along the beach is something I enjoy; in fact, I prefer this scenery to mountains, although I’m also happy to go hiking if I’m in good company. When it comes to adventures, I’m all in—the adrenaline rush and the chance to explore are two things that really satisfy me. Connecting with nature will always be a great plan for me if it means taking in incredible scenery and discovering new plants and animals.
![1000117908.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23y8osgm5n564PDUqzoEb1jF7GCk99CwHnTbnu2BWn8886T39qjLAYoqg17JHASmb3Mkc.jpg)
This time I sank my feet into the sand at **The Peñon** Beach. This is a tourist area, so there are always lots of people taking a dip or enjoying the other attractions, including seafood stalls, cockfights, pool, and even karaoke—all designed to please even the most discerning tastes.
![1000117880.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23uQp4uMaxrzZJW9SkAU2ycKtkxAiV1BqGc1X1aa5yorefTDrjBiJLbemJqQyUrp4uFWy.jpg)
I gazed out at the sea from a churuata, and the view brought back memories of my childhood, when my family used to gather here to celebrate our birthdays. The ocean waves were accompanied by a sense of longing for those days. At the same time, I could see the other coast, with its characteristic majesty.
![1000117874.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23yJEXMJLCKP2kNz1SYoy9u2rM9AMqws73JuwT2F6wHuwEKeDJeukm55oKt7FGJq81Bez.jpg)
An unexpected visitor was waiting for me near the shore—a sea hare. It looked quite slimy and lacked rhinophores, so it must have been a young specimen. I watched as its gelatinous body pulsed. Since it was out of the water, I carefully returned it to its habitat.
![1000117886.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23tvqFGjhwX1e3uRF5Ct9jfT8W29obXgDkm8ySbfJd8NF2efzes8Rtgcnq4hpEANcai6T.jpg)
![1000117894.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wC9VrSwLBxjuxKXGx2UdvLqckFXu9xVwZzY33rQBjdaffue1tvwrJnrMURaF6BMEVRB.jpg)
When I looked around, I saw several insects fluttering near that spot. I couldn’t tell what they were, so I took a photo and, with the help of AI, I learned that I was looking at tiger beetles, which are very common on this beach, as it’s an ideal place for them to hunt other insects at high speed.
![1000117910.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23uFcaUQPN1gkcjRJzTD5cVyvRLpwXgcZvR2BsBbL6D4j5LRAfVFFLPDos1tJeFjTVXWk.jpg)
I was also able to capture some beautiful birds flying high above; seagulls and shearwaters could be seen against the vast blue sky. I enjoyed returning to this beach, reminiscing about happy times, and continuing to collect smiles, for the sea still possesses that healing power that soothes the soul. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> Recorrer la playa es una actividad que disfruto, incluso, prefiero este paisaje antes que una montaña, aunque con buena compañía también puedo hacer senderismo. Cuando se trata de aventuras me anoto pues la adrenalina y la posibilidad de explorar son dos elementos que me satisfacen. Conectar con la naturaleza siempre será un buen plan para mí si existe la posibilidad de observar paisajes increíbles y descubrir fauna y flora nuevas para mí.
![1000117908.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23y8osgm5n564PDUqzoEb1jF7GCk99CwHnTbnu2BWn8886T39qjLAYoqg17JHASmb3Mkc.jpg)
Esta vez hundí mis pies en la arena de la playa **El Peñón**, este es un sector turístico, por tal razón siempre hay muchas personas dándose un buen baño o disfrutando de las otras atracciones, incluyendo venta de comidas marinas, pelea de gallos, pool o billar y hasta karaoke, tratando de complacer los gustos más exigentes.
![1000117880.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23uQp4uMaxrzZJW9SkAU2ycKtkxAiV1BqGc1X1aa5yorefTDrjBiJLbemJqQyUrp4uFWy.jpg)
Contemplé el mar desde una churuata y la vista me trajo recuerdos de mi infancia, cuando mi familia solía reunirse en este escenario para celebrar nuestros cumpleaños. Las olas marinas vinieron acompadas de añoranzas de aquella época. A su vez, pude contemplar la otra costa, con su majestuosidad característica.
![1000117874.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23yJEXMJLCKP2kNz1SYoy9u2rM9AMqws73JuwT2F6wHuwEKeDJeukm55oKt7FGJq81Bez.jpg)
Una visitante inesperada me esperaba cerca de la orilla, se trataba de una liebre de mar, la cual lucía bastante babosa y era una especie que no poseía los rinóforos, así que se trataba de un ejemplar joven. Me quedé observando cómo latía con su cuerpo gelatinoso. Como estaba fuera del agua con mucho cuidado la devolví a su hábitat.
![1000117886.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23tvqFGjhwX1e3uRF5Ct9jfT8W29obXgDkm8ySbfJd8NF2efzes8Rtgcnq4hpEANcai6T.jpg)
![1000117894.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wC9VrSwLBxjuxKXGx2UdvLqckFXu9xVwZzY33rQBjdaffue1tvwrJnrMURaF6BMEVRB.jpg)
Al girar la mirada vi a varios insectos revoloteando cerca de este lugar, no distinguía que eran, así que tomé una fotografía y con ayuda de la AI pude saber que estaba en presencia de escarabajos tigres, los cuales son muy frecuentes en esta playa, pues es un espacio ideal para cazar a otros insectos a gran velocidad.
![1000117910.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23uFcaUQPN1gkcjRJzTD5cVyvRLpwXgcZvR2BsBbL6D4j5LRAfVFFLPDos1tJeFjTVXWk.jpg)
También pude capturar a unas hermosas aves volando en lo alto, gaviotas y tijerejas se dejaban ver en la inmensidad de lo azul. Me gustó volver a esta playa, recordar momentos gratos y continuar coleccionando sonrisas, pues el mar sigue teniendo ese poder curativo que sana heridas. *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

title.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/gda45cd0a9b3af70d75fa08b53fe6722520bb051d6943ce6809bb2eb9f6ee1bf109ce335af33767d09a75e75d6b8d720b7c2651a1b42e73e3a03c2a77230eed1d_640.jpg)</center>

***

# 隐藏的宝藏：探索不为人知的旅行目的地

在这个信息泛滥的时代，许多旅行者往往选择热门的旅游景点，如巴黎的埃菲尔铁塔、纽约的时代广场和东京的涩谷。然而，世界上还有许多隐藏的宝藏，等待着我们去探索。本文将带您走出常规的旅游路线，发现那些鲜为人知的美丽目的地。

## 1. **阿尔巴尼亚的贝拉特**

贝拉特被誉为“千窗之城”，是阿尔巴尼亚的一座历史悠久的城市。这里的建筑风格独特，白色的房屋沿着山坡而建，俯瞰着美丽的奥索姆河。您可以在这里漫步于古老的街道，参观贝拉特城堡，欣赏到壮观的山谷景色。

### 推荐活动：
- 探索贝拉特城堡的历史遗迹
- 在当地餐馆品尝传统阿尔巴尼亚美食

## 2. **斯洛文尼亚的布莱德湖**

布莱德湖是一个如画的湖泊，湖中心有一座小岛，上面矗立着一座迷人的教堂。这里的自然风光令人叹为观止，是徒步旅行和骑自行车的理想之地。虽然布莱德湖在欧洲旅行者中逐渐受到关注，但相比其他热门景点，它仍然保持着宁静的氛围。

### 推荐活动：
- 乘坐传统的“普拉德”木船前往小岛
- 在湖边的咖啡馆享受一杯当地的奶油蛋糕

## 3. **葡萄牙的辛特拉**

辛特拉是一个被联合国教科文组织列为世界遗产的小镇，以其华丽的宫殿和迷人的花园而闻名。尽管它距离里斯本仅有短短的车程，但许多游客往往忽视了这个宝藏。辛特拉的佩纳宫和摩尔人城堡是必访的景点，您可以在这里体验到浓厚的历史和文化氛围。

### 推荐活动：
- 游览佩纳宫，欣赏其独特的建筑风格
- 在辛特拉的山间小径上徒步，享受大自然的宁静

## 4. **日本的高山**

高山是一个位于日本中部的古老城镇，以其保存完好的传统建筑和丰富的文化遗产而闻名。这里的古老街道、酒庄和温泉吸引着那些寻求宁静与传统文化的旅行者。高山的冬季雪景更是如诗如画，让人流连忘返。

### 推荐活动：
- 参观高山的传统市场，品尝当地美食
- 在温泉中放松身心，享受日本的传统文化

## 结语

这些隐藏的宝藏不仅拥有迷人的自然风光和丰富的文化历史，更是让人远离喧嚣、享受宁静的理想之地。下次计划旅行时，不妨考虑这些不为人知的目的地，给自己一个全新的旅行体验。探索未知，发现美丽，旅程从这里开始！

***

title.title: Mini Militia
title.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1780136232764-d0cf5383bc39091c.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=likhon420/6388a9f4)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=likhon420/6388a9f4)


---

Hello friends, how are you all? I hope you are all well. I am also very well by the grace of God. Today I will introduce you to a shooting game. The name of the game is Mini Militia. So Let's get started.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTCW2q7i2VcPVbmYqkHbKQLMTPS9GWx9dBwntKZZtGJ4K/img_3296.jpg)

Mini Militia is a 3D multiplayer shooting game.This game is a very popular shooting game. We have played it a lot in the past and this game is very familiar with our childhood. Especially those who were born between 2006 and 2007 are very aware of this game because a large part of their childhood was spent with it. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVNSqKxB3XmKLRd3oAhGG21L9ZM2sGctKeD1YmHmGTrfY/img_3297.jpg)

The game is very fun and the biggest thing is that we used to play this game together with 10-12 people.The game has been updated now and as a result many people have stopped playing the game but the version we used to play the most in the past was the one we loved the most but even now some old players still play it because they couldn't get rid of the magic of it but I also played it after so long and tried to give you a lot of pleasure. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc31Mf87YY63EwE8DEXM2Y8TnoXPTKwEMbavsaxCdB9MN/img_3298.jpg)

There are different moods in the game now which were not there before.Then different types of new friends have been added that weren't there before, so it's a bit strange to play with those new friends because we're not aware of them, and different types of multiplayer modes have come that weren't there before.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRbDAPxEzhRiWEtQYz9SNGNuXdBHrdYWLbvTDxqSqaGy6/img_3299.jpg)

But the interesting thing is that before we could only play it offline and we had to use WiFi and hotspots to play together, but now it's being played online.Now, just by entering the game and starting a match, you can later compete with these random players, but before this kind of system didn't exist, and it wouldn't have been possible without multiple players.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUSkg1eiZRWmZvgRiA3nw1aeT5YwmjwiLzJGQaMwHvhAQ/img_3300.jpg)

👉Thumbnail source : Captured by me during the gameplay.

Thanks for watching the video.

@likhon420

---

title.title: The weight of meanness (Esp./Ing.)-The inkwell-Creative Fiction prompt # 34
title.body:
>


On Margarita Island, Nueva Esparta State, Venezuela, in the early 2000, Leonor married Alex.

 Nine years later, she gave birth to a beautiful baby girl whom she named Andrea. A year later, Alex and Leonor divorced. This situation forces this young woman to emigrate to Cumaná, where she establishes her residence, working from home making unisex clothing, which supports her and her daughter, who is an obedient child despite her temperament. 

During her adolescence, Andrea  was characterized by her short stature, pronounced hips, honey-colored eyes, chestnut-brown hair, — beautiful and strong-willed.

Andrea was an exceptional student throughout her primary and secondary education. She met a young man named Edward, who captivated her deeply. When she graduated at 16, that very night, after her graduation ceremony, she moved into Edward's residence, disregarding the pain it caused her mother.

A month later, she became pregnant by him. Her mother went to talk to her, offering her help, but Andrea refused, saying:

“I don’t want anything from you, go away!” Tears welled in her mother’s eyes; unable to contain her pain, she retorted:

“I pray to God that you fare well and that you find happiness with this scum.” Without another word, Leonor left.

eight  months passed, and Andrea gave birth to a beautiful boy whom she named Antonio. Five years later, she and Edward decided to move to Puerto Ordaz. Before leaving for that city, they left the boy with his grandmother Leonor in the city of Cumaná. This young woman, very upset with her mother, told her:

“I’m leaving my son with you to take care of,” Leonor subtly added.

“Daughter, may God bless you.” Andrea chose not to say a word and walked away.

While living in Puerto Ordaz with his wife, he ordered her to commit crimes and forced her into prostitution. Andrea was so in love with him that she accepted everything he ordered. He even introduced her to his friends as his cousin.


the money Andrea earned from carrying out these activities he ordered was given to him. And he was the one who controlled and did with that money as he pleased.

Two years later, Andrea was implicated in criminal activity for stealing a cell phone containing a file with compromising information. She was sentenced to six years in prison in one of the jails in Puerto Ordaz.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUP7EHepHym1u4MChQSWYjWQseewYq121YCosvvyhSvYo/image.png)

<center>Source from [pixabay](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/ai-generado-prisi%C3%B3n-celda-8958917/)</center>


While she was incarcerated, she didn't see Edward at the prison; however, while there, she began to experience symptoms of illness.

She underwent blood tests, and the results were positive for HIV, with an advanced stage of infection, making her a carrier of AIDS. When the doctor informed her of her infection, she cried so much that her tears streamed down her cheeks like raindrops hitting a windowpane. There she received treatment. And after serving her sentence, she was released. That day she called her mother from a cell phone:


“Mom, forgive me, I feel a heavy weight in my heart for all the suffering I’ve caused you.” His mother, deeply distressed, replied:

“I have nothing to forgive you for. I’ll transfer you money so you can take a bus home; your son and I will be waiting for you!” As soon as she received the money, she went to the bus terminal in that city, bought the tickets, and boarded the bus to Cumaná.

Upon arriving in this city, her mother and son were waiting for her. As she got out of the car and walked toward them, her son was beaming with happiness; his face was illuminated, a smile spread across his face, his cheeks as red as coral. As soon as he saw her, he ran toward her with his arms outstretched like a bird taking flight. Overflowing with joy, he shouted:

“Mom, give me your blessing, I love you so much! You look so white, like a snowflake!” She, deeply moved, hugged and kissed him, saying:

“God bless you, you're so tall and handsome! How are things going at school?” Very excited, the boy replied:

“Great, I got straight A's on my report card!” Then she turned to her mother, hugged her, and said through her tears:

“Forgive me for the suffering I have caused you; it weighs heavily on my soul that I disobeyed you and mistreated you with my words.” Gently, her mother stroked her hair and added:

“Daughter, I have nothing to forgive you for. I believe your behavior was a product of your inexperience!” They returned home, and everything went back to normal.

As soon as she rested from her trip, she went to the SIDA department at HUAPA (Antonio Patricio Alcalá University Hospital). There, the doctor examined her, performed routine tests in the medical laboratory, and from that moment on, she became a patient in that department for her VIH   management.

A year later, HUAPA created the AIDS Prevention Foundation. Currently, Andrea works as a social worker at this foundation, helping young people and adults raise awareness about preventative measures to avoid contracting the disease.


Through her work at the Foundation, Andrea seeks to ease the burden of her conscience for having caused her mother so much pain with her actions during her youth.


Use the free Google Translate


Español

El peso de la mezquindad

En la isla Margarita, estado de Nueva Esparta, Venezuela, a principios de la década de 2000, Leonor se casó con Alex. 

Nueve años después, dio a luz a una hermosa niña a la que llamó Andrea. Un año más tarde, Alex y Leonor se divorciaron. Esta situación obliga a esta joven a emigrar a Cumaná, donde establece su residencia y trabaja desde casa confeccionando ropa unisex, con la que mantiene a su hija, que es una niña obediente a pesar de su temperamento.

Durante su adolescencia, Andrea se caracterizaba por su baja estatura, caderas pronunciadas, ojos color miel, cabello castaño, muy hermosa y fuerte personalidad.

Andrea fue una estudiante excepcional durante toda su educación primaria y secundaria. En su último año de bachillerato, conoció a un joven llamado Edward, quien la cautivó profundamente. Al graduarse a los 16 años, esa misma noche, después de la ceremonia de graduación, se mudó a la casa de Edward, sin importarle el dolor que esto le causaba a su madre.

Un mes después, quedó embarazada de él. Su madre fue a hablar con ella, ofreciéndole ayuda, pero Andrea se negó, diciendo:

—No quiero nada de ti, ¡vete! —Las lágrimas brotaron de los ojos de su madre; incapaz de contener su dolor, replicó:

—Le ruego a Dios que te vaya bien y que encuentres la felicidad con este canalla. Sin decir una palabra más, Leonor se marchó.

Pasaron ocho meses y Andrea dio a luz a un hermoso niño al que llamó Antonio. Cinco años después, ella y Edward decidieron mudarse a Puerto Ordaz. Antes de partir hacia esa ciudad, dejaron al niño con su abuela Leonor en la ciudad de Cumaná. Esta joven, muy enfadada con su madre, le dijo:

—Te dejo a mi hijo para que lo cuides —añadió Leonor con sutileza.

—Hija, que Dios te bendiga. Andrea prefirió no decir palabra y se marchó.

Mientras vivía en Puerto Ordaz con su esposa, él le ordenaba cometer delitos y la obligaba a prostituirse. Andrea estaba tan enamorada de él que aceptaba todo lo que le ordenaba. Incluso la presentaba a sus amigos como su prima.

Todo el dinero que Andrea ganaba realizando estas actividades que él le ordenaba iba a parar a sus manos. Y él era quien controlaba y hacía con ese dinero lo que quería.

Dos años después, Andrea se vio implicada en una actividad delictiva por robar un teléfono celular que contenía un archivo con información comprometedora. Fue sentenciada a seis años de prisión en una de las cárceles de Puerto Ordaz.

Mientras estuvo encarcelada, no vio a Edward en la prisión; sin embargo, allí comenzó a experimentar síntomas de enfermedad.

Se sometió a análisis de sangre y los resultados fueron positivos para el VIH, con una infección en etapa avanzada, lo que la convierte en portadora del SIDA. Cuando el médico le informó de su infección, lloró tanto que las lágrimas le corrían por las mejillas como gotas de lluvia contra un cristal. Allí recibió tratamiento. Y tras cumplir su condena, fue puesta en libertad. Ese día llamó a su madre desde un teléfono móvil.



“¡Mamá, perdóname, siento un peso en mi corazón por todo el sufrimiento que te he causado!”. Su madre, muy afligida, respondió:

\
Dios te bendiga, ¡estás muy alto y hermoso! ¿Cómo te encuentras en la escuela?\

body.title: Pumpkin and Oat Cake (Eng/Esp)
body.body:
> Today I made a pumpkin cake with a creamy cheese filling. I wanted a dessert for my afternoon snack that had those qualities, since I love homemade cake and making it myself gives me the chance to enjoy it while it’s still warm—an experience I really enjoy.
![1000444794.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23zS3NrCxDvRstAc4kuruz8f9ZMeYBLYoX5yyn41ZAPVskPBFZ3WFUuMDrerxgZUYcFoD.jpg)
## Ingredients: - 1/4 pumpkin - 1 egg - 50 grams all-purpose flour - 50 grams oat flour - 1/2 cup sugar - 50 grams butter - 2 cups water
![1000444787.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23xp8UaLu8njURjhJXGYbn2aHCetKdd3GA9mL4YW5K7bPqXRC8hC4MnyRbsK1paQQSW8J.jpg)
![1000444788.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23wqeMURP6x77EM4EPaEtePSHBfzP79ssNBtRhEWptDTuZbhooWvtj1bRZFcByA5CCdKR.jpg)
## Procedure: I peeled the pumpkin, cut it into large pieces, and parboiled it in two cups of water. I let it boil for ten minutes over high heat, and it softened right away. Then I drained the excess water, let it cool, and mashed it in a deep bowl to make pumpkin purée. I immediately added the butter and mixed it in; the consistency was perfect for the cake.
![1000444789.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23wqw2VmftCmHWbDQbQrjfDYAxvMm7KWwcSYXBggJJipiMY2EQJAqf2MVgT2TLmyQZBES.jpg)
![1000444790.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/242rpfR2vdW78o13BXKCLVw7gB9NeRrt7dhHYkVz44c41sMLMxBkExVvdFn5ctuDu6SDZ.jpg)
Next, I added the egg and then half a cup of sugar; these proportions are perfect for achieving a light sweetness. Then, gradually, I added both the wheat flour and the oat flour, so the mixture thickened. The next step was to pour the batter into a baking pan, which I had previously greased with butter and dusted with a little oat flour to prevent the cake from sticking to the pan while baking.
![1000444791.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23zGY4pku1jmDGHc9nATn6KdYbk7tAfMKJMsDGcpghmk9WZfFNCG3LDz3tZyy1XQk2Qrc.jpg)
![1000444792.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23yTfRmG5WJs5ZHv6CHmAP79gmkDvYk7fE16jLbAqXLT2c8jnJgP1RAyLae1R1JnP9isV.jpg)
Once the batter was poured into the pan, I placed it in the oven at 250 degrees for about 40 minutes. After that time, I checked to see if it was done by inserting a knife; when the knife came out of the cake completely dry, that was the signal to turn off the oven and take it out. It turned out spectacular. As soon as it cooled down a bit, I tasted it and couldn’t stop eating until it was all gone. The cheesecake-like texture gave it a truly special touch. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> Hoy preparé una torta de auyama tipo quesillo, quería un postre para merendar con tales características ya que la torta casera me encanta y hacerla yo misma me concede la ocasión de degustarla mientras aún está tibia, experiencia que disfruto mucho.
![1000444794.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23zS3NrCxDvRstAc4kuruz8f9ZMeYBLYoX5yyn41ZAPVskPBFZ3WFUuMDrerxgZUYcFoD.jpg)
## Ingredientes: - 1/4 de auyama - 1 huevo - 50 gramos de harina de trigo - 50 gramos de harina de avena - 1/2 taza de azúcar - 50 gramos de mantequilla - 2 tazas de agua
![1000444787.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23xp8UaLu8njURjhJXGYbn2aHCetKdd3GA9mL4YW5K7bPqXRC8hC4MnyRbsK1paQQSW8J.jpg)
![1000444788.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23wqeMURP6x77EM4EPaEtePSHBfzP79ssNBtRhEWptDTuZbhooWvtj1bRZFcByA5CCdKR.jpg)
## Procedimiento: Retiré la corteza de la auyama, piqué en pedazos grandes y llevé a sancochar junto a dos tazas de agua. Dejé hervir por diez minutos a fuego alto y de inmediato se ablandaron. Luego eliminé el exceso de agua, esperé que se enfriaran y en un envase hondo trituré para obtener un puré de auyama. De inmediato adicioné la mantequilla y mezclé, la consistencia era ideal para la torta.
![1000444789.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23wqw2VmftCmHWbDQbQrjfDYAxvMm7KWwcSYXBggJJipiMY2EQJAqf2MVgT2TLmyQZBES.jpg)
![1000444790.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/242rpfR2vdW78o13BXKCLVw7gB9NeRrt7dhHYkVz44c41sMLMxBkExVvdFn5ctuDu6SDZ.jpg)
Acto seguido, agregué el huevo y luego media taza de azúcar, estas proporciones resultan perfectas para alcanzar un ligero dulzor. Después, de forma gradual, añadí tanto la harina de trigo como la harina de avena, así que la consistencia espesó. El siguiente paso fue llevar la mezcla a un molde, el cual preparé previamente con mantequilla en su superficie y un poco de harina de avena con el objetivo de que la torta no se pegue al molde mientras se cocina.
![1000444791.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23zGY4pku1jmDGHc9nATn6KdYbk7tAfMKJMsDGcpghmk9WZfFNCG3LDz3tZyy1XQk2Qrc.jpg)
![1000444792.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23yTfRmG5WJs5ZHv6CHmAP79gmkDvYk7fE16jLbAqXLT2c8jnJgP1RAyLae1R1JnP9isV.jpg)
Una vez vertida la mezcla en el molde se llevó al horno, a temperatura de 250 grados durante unos 40 minutos. Tras se período de tiempo me cercioré de que estuviera lista introduciendo un cuchillo, cuando el utensilio salió de la torta totalmente seco, era la señal para apagar y sacar del horno. Quedó espectacular, apenas se enfrió un poco la probé y no pude parar de comer hasta que se terminó. La textura tipo quesillo concedió un toque realmente especial.   *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

body.title: We just released a new song.... just not on streaming
body.body:
![You Stay Cover 2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/breakoutthecrazy/AKbFPcHERhZF5W1i8pwJkw935hiMmoxjYcxNH8fyykDgUd4tDg4y523JvyjxPdn.jpg)

Sometimes you can simply hold an object in your hand or look over to a photo and you are immediately transported back in time. That's what \
is about. This song was born from a request by an ad agency looking for a folky song about nostalgia. We wrote a verse and chorus and while it wasn't used, we always knew \

captured something special. When deciding to put it out we added more personal lyrics to make sure we were sharing something deeply meaningful to us. 

You can experience it all now by downloading it directly on Bandcamp. Thank you, your support means the world to us.

https://breakoutthecrazy.bandcamp.com/track/you-stay

Your support means the world to us! If you don't know, music streaming pays artists a per share rate meaning those who get more streams make more money per stream. And every time you release a song you will make $0.000 if you don't get at least 1,000 streams a month. This means that those who have time/money to put into marketing or have investors and labels to help push their music have an unfair advantage over us little guys. Anyway, enough complaining.

If you want to support another way, you can go to our website and purchase some merch (we got some cool new pieces in an assortment of colors: https://breakoutthecrazy.com/

![IMG_4858.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/breakoutthecrazy/23xyfjssGZfkYBEMdoa7ty52E7b3mLVUeia1pDvKAhTSbNBvvMwWg5se9BevfLhYi3xfW.JPG)

Thank you so much! See you next time!

Chris & Kat

body.title: Monomad: Olympic Plaza in Downtown Calgary at Night
body.body:
These are some views of Olympic Plaza in downtown Calgary at night. It is now rubble and being reimagined as a more modern space, but this was originally part of the 1988 Winter Games that we hosted here and was definitely a landmark downtown. It was used as a public space for everyone and in recent years started to feel more run down, so I can understand why they wanted to redevelop the spot. At least I have some pictures to remember it by now.

body.title: Exploring the route for my daughters traffic exam
body.body:
I was really looking for some alone time to reset myself, but with the current load that is just not suitable today. Therefore I picked a few chores that at least allowed me to get some time on the feet. 

My daughter has her traffic exam next month. As the Netherlands is actually famous for how common the bicycle is used - every kid in the Netherlands will have to do a traffic exam (hosted by primairy school), cycling a few kilometers and show that you understand the traffic rules. The kids have to know 2 different routes, so today I took my daughter to explore the first route for the first time.


![IMG_3239.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rainbowdash4l/23u61BA5kxPhGJuJnHMcXhBYQj7wJvd7TDeJfchyJ1nFN9K74qgVsoUvA8nQCHkVGxPBE.jpeg)


![IMG_3227.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rainbowdash4l/23wWvtuPDJHN3rhsme3CFeX9XgUi8gE175hPPPd2rJzBf1FE9pEVhQeWQqS8DAuUhzTDE.jpeg)

In the end the route turned out to be just a bit over 10k, for me a good easy distance but unfortunately not a distance my wife could cycle right now (which is quite confronting to her).


![IMG_3241.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rainbowdash4l/23swkEycCR9GayruKPuGLNEteUPpihuwj1pKyFPk7VcuPr1AkRu7rVQZFYxpRLhS6KTda.jpeg)

While my daughter is just awesome and caring I became a little frustrated by her asking me every 2 min if the speed was not too fast for me running alongside. When I told her to just stop doing that as I could easily run a marathon way faster than the pace we were going - she did what she had to do haha she speeded to the point where I had to ask her to slow down a little (fair play!)


![IMG_3232.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rainbowdash4l/23zGeRYbPqdveSuhB1pRLq2Ywsvwa1sh77NgZq6YqLrWV56wtJe7ktR5gRFnGRpmfs8zD.jpeg)

![IMG_3233.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rainbowdash4l/23xehwqjaXfWT1ffHWyg61x5zcqgqBKGbwo7KnuKcCm11UHEfqZCGZ1mLrr2ebKvrMGhx.jpeg)


In the end, not only did we explore the route, but we also had a fun time together!

body.title: In Lieu of Notice
body.body:
These packed days, fueled with thoughts of further disappointment. A cubicle of work and load, rooms with eyes around. A screech echoes through the whole floor, a head bang goes unnoticed, the tensed nerves flicker and no one sees it. The weight of it all settles without announcement, the kind that does not arrive all at once but finds you slowly, in the small things, in the waiting, in the nothing. What gets through is the urge to escape, and that too only in the mind. The stickiness of the ticking clock holds everything in place, movement slow and forced.

 Everyone thinks that it will not be them, but when the time comes it is them. Callum thought as well. A cube with no rest, time does not seem to pass at all. Hell holes which are not the pits in the sense that escape is not thinkable but the fact that knowing you can leave and still you cannot. To get some kind of experience, he clocked in. He is reading files but that is not supposed to be his job. Nobody seems to care what he does and the same is true for them as well.
Callum sits at his desk, eyes on the screen, not really reading. The office carries on around him, phones and footsteps and the low sound of someone's lunch being heated. He is somewhere else entirely.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZkwjGFVEjabF7EaN3Xwbo639Z6UV5KXHLnKMVgq377wG/martin-laprise-NWOyowI7t44-unsplash.jpg 
Photo by <a href=\
>Unsplash Sebastian stood there waiting to see if Callum would notice him. Callum is in his own head, seeing, inferring, making of things whatever he sees fit. *\

* Sebastian does not wait, he just walks in.

Callum is startled, a small twitch before he turns to face him. They say a sudden reaction shows the true feeling underneath. He has none.
*\

* Callum with a face that says he is beyond that smiling.

Callum turns back to his screen. The hum of the office swallows the moment whole.

*\

* he says, not looking at Sebastian, as though the words were meant for the air between them rather than the person standing in it. As if this were the experience he needed, the one he had clocked in searching for and had long since confirmed was not here.

Sebastian's smile moves away. Not quickly, not dramatically, but the way light leaves a room when a cloud passes. Something behind his eyes that he does not put into words.

The silence sits for a moment. Neither of them moves. The clock on the wall ticks the way it always does.

*\

* Callum says, glancing at the hour, the shift loosening its grip. How naive of him, acting like he said nothing before. Callum knows what he is doing, invoking Sebastian's emotions.

Sebastian does not answer what was asked. He stands with a straight face, something turning in him.

*\

*

Callum looks at him with a steadiness that carries no apology.
*\

*

Sebastian leaves. Not in anger, not entirely. But knowing. The kind of knowing that does not need a door to slam to mean something.

body.title: The sticky French cheese that's suddenly everywhere
body.body: Until a few months ago, the best-known cheese from Burgundy-Franche-Comté was Comté, one of France's most celebrated exports. Over the past few weeks, however, another cheese from the same region has been quietly taking over social media: cancoillotte, which has gone viral on Instagram and TikTok because it costs around €2.50 a pack and is remarkably low in fat.  \nIt started, as these things tend to, with a video. French influencer Johan Papz filmed himself eating cancoillotte with baked potatoes and declared it \
and that his entire approach to eating had \

The clip spread rapidly, and dozens of similar videos followed.  \nCancoillotte is not, it must be said, an obviously glamorous cheese. Its appearance is somewhere between yogurt and wallpaper paste — its nickname, in fact, is simply \

— and its colour hovers around beige. The flavour is reminiscent of fondue. It can be eaten cold, spread on crackers, or warm alongside potatoes and vegetables. It has been produced in France for roughly a century, and is made from metton, a fermented cheese produced from skimmed cow's milk — the fat having been removed to make butter, cream, or other cheeses. The metton is coagulated and dried into a crumbly block, then melted at very high temperatures and seasoned with salt and butter.  
Precise figures are still emerging, but early sales data suggests the influencer effect has been substantial. Carrefour told the French newspaper Libération that sales of garlic-flavoured cancoillotte rose 16 per cent last month, with the plain variety up 13 per cent. Market research firm Circana reported a 9 per cent increase in the week of 20–26 April compared with the same period in 2025.  
The sudden surge has created an unexpected problem: producers were not prepared for it, and stocks are running low.  
What the influencers stumbled upon was not, however, a discovery. Cancoillotte's rise had already been quietly underway for years. A promotional association founded in 2013 spent a decade investing in communications, working with chefs to develop cancoillotte-based recipes, and lobbying for official recognition. Those efforts paid off in 2022, when the cheese was awarded IGP certification — the protected geographical indication that signals quality and provenance and significantly raises a product's profile. Sales have risen 35 per cent since 2018. Tourists visiting the region now actively seek it out.  
\
said Julia Morin, president of the association.  \nOn French TikTok, the cancoillotte moment has generated its own layer of meta-commentary. One user declared it \

— a reference to the Japanese green tea powder that became a global phenomenon during the pandemic. Another posted the famous scene from The Devil Wears Prada in which Miranda Priestly tells her assistant \

cutting to plates of cancoillotte. Even Serge Papin, France's minister for small and medium enterprises, seized the moment, filming himself buying a pack at a local fair and listing its nutritional qualities to camera.  \nA regional cheese that spent a decade building its reputation through certification, cookery, and careful promotion has, in the space of a few weeks, become a meme. There are worse fates.

body.title: Monomad: The Perseverance of Skateboarding [Eng/Esp]
body.body:
>

This is my entry for the #monomad challenge.

Greetings, dear friends in the community and lovers of black and white photography; I hope you’re having a wonderful Saturday and feeling great today. I’m sharing some photos of moments I thought were worth capturing while I was at the skatepark; I hope you enjoy them.

Saludos, queridos amigos de la comunidad y amantes de la fotografía en blanco y negro; espero que tengan un estupendo sábado y se encuentren genial el día de hoy. Les comparto algunas fotografías de momentos que me parecieron buenos de capturar mientras me encontraba en el skatepark; espero que las disfruten.


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23wMTvohC7SiCR8qfFW4rM6HHtuWbU42oP4SPJqfF8hx9XqCFCCvtwAe6qQbBqCVGDYky.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23vsDnHoTGx9rSsAuX9K4Rj1C3BrWhsrvwhtVhPGzdM4BQhJfbysZgrc4FJ3UztaF6WkB.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23wWnRmnL8UVH7XVfPr9xzZBkYJeMdJTGQtHLEo9YaW5gb7Jkeh3dF6usFtU7aWUVCTVa.jpg

>

Watching these kids is definitely the best way to see how consistency is the key to learning or improving at something, because they repeat the tricks over and over again even when they get them right, since they know they can do better or try something different to get a better result, and that’s really impressive to watch.

La idea de ver cómo la constancia es la mejor manera de aprender o mejorar en las cosas sin duda es viendo a estos muchachos, porque repiten los trucos una y otra vez, incluso saliendo bien, porque saben que pueden mejorar o que pueden hacer algo distinto para un mejor resultado y eso es algo muy llamativo de ver.


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23tvXhYkaJsxm68XrP4zTcCb28tCCXwFr5i9hrGa44VxnuoXbZF6ZF6sx6UYp9n7HLPYY.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23xVCruWUdk3H2r8EK6NdB9RqqPP95uXnypwWZgGDwcPShEQ4ZtbZRovE218iFEkqz2ER.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23tSL57omfT7ipcRusassYfZJ6QD681gtRpNMAgxQ2okbet7aszqDvGPwDLRwbdSGPW5w.jpg

>

I focus a lot on those I’ve seen consistently practicing over and over again, and I know that they’re usually the ones who stand out the most, precisely because of the consistency with which they do things. I think it’s a good way to motivate yourself, seeing someone else get motivated by what they do.

Me centro mucho en aquellos que he visto constantemente practicar una y otra vez, además de saber que normalmente suelen ser los que más destacan, justo por esa constancia con la que hacen las cosas. Creo que es una buena forma de motivarse, ver a alguien motivándose por sus cosas.


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23tvVWvWPd3D7aGvf53yBPr5Vmx74otRCbk1QAqRxJKjAij2ChsRp3CaUzVHRCKJtqGX1.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23vsJFBQ94McyZyimkVCRAwP4uqtjuCu6JBuFFd2GBa4q8AXprPWRG7B7DW1dN6UjfsED.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23vsFw8QHp7avwvVDrJaKEqg6pMPq4bnpt9mShvhEwqjGNuz9c3LyTsfrgtnzq3NhA7bZ.jpg

>

That's all for today; thank you so much for taking the time to look at my photos; I hope you enjoyed them as much as I did. I hope you have a wonderful weekend and have a great time. See you next time, dear friends in the community!

Esto es todo por el día de hoy; muchas gracias por tomarse el tiempo de ver mis fotografías; espero que las disfrutaran tanto como yo. Espero que tengan un excelente fin de semana y que la pasen bien. ¡Hasta la próxima, queridos amigos de la comunidad!

/>

La banda permaneció sobre la tarima, mientras que la gente festejaba, Michelle estaba llorando, Lucas solo sonreía, Dani saludaba y Stewie seguía grabando cada instante y preguntó —¿Se dan cuenta de lo que acaba de pasar? — Este es un gran sueño respondió Lucas.



Las luces comenzaron a apagarse poco a poco y las personas fueron abandonando el lugar, hasta que finalmente la plaza quedó casi vacía y la banda pudo moverse con tranquilidad, sin embargo, hubo abrazos, fotografías y muchas palabras de orgullo. Al terminar allí se fueron a un elegante restaurante y sobre la mesa comenzaron a llegar platos, bebidas y postres, donde Dani tomó una copa de vino y dijo —Por el videoclip, por el concurso nacional y por cada noche de trabajo—



>Every image in the music video was precious, until the final part came and the screen went dark. For a few seconds, applause echoed through the street, growing louder and louder in recognition of the incredible work they had done. The band remained on stage as the crowd celebrated. body.title: Kräuterkunde: Raue Gänsedistel - Sónchus asper
body.body:
## Systematik
- Familie: Korbblütler (Asteraceae/Compósitae)
- Unterfamilie: Cichorioideae
- Gattung: Gänsedisteln (Sónchus)
- Art: Alle Gänseldistel-Arten charakterisieren sich in dem leicht bitteren Milchsaft, der austritt beim Brechen der Stängel.
     - [Raue Gänsedistel (Sonchus asper)](https://pflanzenbestimmung.info/sonchus-asper/)
          - Sonchus asper glaucescens (Süden Europas und Mittelmeergebiet)
      - Gewöhnliche Gänsedistel (Sonchus oleraceus) (kaum stachelig, weiche mattgrüne Blätter mit spitzen Zipfeln, 30 - 100 cm groß; Form der Blattröhrchen, die stängelumfassend sind, sind spitz - bei Rauen Gänsedistel abgerundet)
      - Kohl-Gänsedistel (Sonchus oleraceus L.) (meist wächst die Raue mit dieser in Gemeinschaft, nur dass die Raue häufiger ist; Blätter der Rauen sind starrer als die von der Kohl-Gänsedistel; am Rand sind die Blätter stachelig gezähnt, Kohl-Gänsedistel hat das nicht, Blätter der Kohl-... sind matt und glänzen nicht, Blätter umfassen Stängel mit zugespitzten Öhrchen, Achänen haben 3 Rippen, sind mit querliegendem Runzeln versehen)
      - Sumpf-Gänsedistel (Sonchus palustris L.) (feuchte Wiesen und Ufer, Stängel haben abstehende pfeilförmige zugespitzte Blätter, Hüllkelsch und Stiel sind Drüsenhaare, Früchte haben auf beiden Seiten 5 Längsrippen)
      - [Acker-Gänsedistel (Sonchus arvensis L.)](https://pflanzenbestimmung.info/sonchus-arvensis/) (größere Blüten, kriechende Wurzelausläufer, länglichere Blätter und buchtig fiederspaltig, 50- 150 cm groß, hat gelbe Drüsenhaare am Hüllkelch des Körbchens und seinem Stiel, Achänen sind auf beiden Seiten mit 5 Längsrippen)
           - Drüsenlose Acker-Gänsedistel (Sonchus arvensis subsp. uliginosus (M. Bieb.) Nymann) (Feucht- oder Salzwiesen, absolut keine Drüsenhaare am Hüllkelch)

[Hier](https://www.naturadb.de/pflanzen/gattung/gaensedisteln/) und [hier](https://www.herbarium-von-ingrid.de/meine-pflanzen-von-a-z/s/sonchus-spec/) kann man auch Gänsedistel Arten miteinander unterscheiden

## Volkstümliche Namen
- Dornige Gänsedistel
- Dänsedistel
- Kohlgänsedistel
- Milchdistel
- Raue Saudistel
- Saudistel

Eng: sowthistle, Prickly Sow-Thistle, Rough Milk-Thistle 
pt: serralha
spanisch: cerraja
französisch: laiteron rude
italienisch: grespino (spinosa), crespigno, lattugaccio
russich: осот 
griechisch: Tsimblida, Zochia

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/charlissy/23wqnySQgqEvLoT5nPmCD6vUCk79TzUb5NEWndAn8f89vLvjX9bqcMo5i1SuU5wNdRKdP.png)


## Namensherkunft
Ihre Nahmensgebung verdankt die Raue Gänsedistel ihren Stacheln.

Die volkstümlichen Namen Gänsedistel und Saudistel kommen daher, dass die Pflanze gerne von Gänsen und Schweinen gefressen wird.

Im Englischen werden die Sonchus-Arten sow thistles bezeichnet. Sie sehen ähnlich aus wie Distel und dahingehend wird die Gattung Sonchus auch als Distel betitelt. Allerdings ist die Gänsedistel eine andere Gattung als die [Mariendistel](https://peakd.com/hive-121566/@charlissy/krauterkunde-mariendistel-silybum-marianum).

Die Erstbeschreibungen des John Hill (1716-1775), englischer Botaniker, schreibt, dass woher der Gattungsname Sonchus stammt ist unklar. Und der Artname \
ist lateinisch und bedeutet rau. \n\nAnderswo heißt es, dass \

ableitet und es bereits in damaliger Zeit eine essbare Distelart bezeichnete.

## Mythologie/Geschichte
Obwohl die Gänsedistel schmackhaft und nährhaft ist, findet man sie heutzutage nur noch verwildert. Denn weder die Volksheilkunde noch die Schulmedizin machte sich die Heilkräfte der Pflanze zu Nutzen. Allerdings wurde sie als Gemüse gegessen und dahingehend damals in Gärten angebaut. Jedoch ist die Heilpflanze kaum in Büchern vorzufinden, obwohl es in der Antike und dem Mittelalter als Heilkraut galt.
Doch vor 1800 Jahren war Sonchus oleraceus und Sonchus arvensis in chinesischen Medizinbuch Shen Nongs aufgeführt. 
Ein Review aus Neuseeland teilt mit, dass die frühen Maori vor rund 1000 Jahren Sonchus asper als Arzneipflanze nutzten. Sie nannten das Kraut Puha und es war ein wichtiges Gemüse in ihrer Küche. 

Der Gelehrte Plinius der Ältere schrieb in seinem \

die Gänsedistel als gesundes Nahrungsmittel zu. 
Die innerliche Verwendung der Blätter sowie Stängel bereitet man so zu, dass man es abkocht. Dies soll nach Plinius die Milchbildung bei stillenden Müttern fördern. Ein Zusammenhang besteht dazu mit der Signaturenlehre von Plinius, da die Pflanze Milchsaft im inneren des Stängels produziert.

Die alten Griechen nutzten das Kraut ebenso zur Stärkung und wegen der verdauungsfördernden wirkung. Doch auch die Römer kannten die Wirkungen. Sie wurde als Gemüse geschätzt und kultiviert und hat damit eine lange Geschichte als Nahrungsmittel. Für die einfache Bevölkerung war die Gänsedistel ein wichtiger Bestandteil der Ernährung im Mittelalter. Denn auch in Zeiten von Hunger und Nahrungsknappheit war die Gänsedistel eine zuverlässliche Nahrungsquelle, aufgrund ihren Wuchs auf kargen Böden und der fast ganzjährigen Verfügbarkeit. 
In Klostergärten war es ebenso vertreten und in mittelalterlichen Kräuterbüchern bezeichnete man es als nahrhaftes Gemüse. 
Hildegard von Bingen schrieb ihm zu ein \

zu sein.

Bis heute hat die Gänsedistel in der Küche ihren festen Platz in den Kulturen rund um den Mittelmeerraum. 
In Griechenland hat sie ihre Bezeichnung \
und wird traditionell mit Zitrone und Olivenöl zubereitet. Sie ist Teil der bekannten Wildkräutermischung \

auf Kreta. Als Beilage oder Vorspeise wird sie gerne serviert.
In traditionellen Pasta-Gerichten und Frittatas wird sie in Italien, besonders Sizilien und Kalabrien gegessen.
In Nordafrika wird die Gänsedistel für Couscous-Gerichte und Eintöpfe gesammelt. 
Die traditionelle chinesische Küche profitiert ebenso von ihr und gibt man in verschiedenen Suppen und gedünsteten Gerichten hinzu.
Während sie in Deutschland als Nahrungsmittel gänzlich vergessen wurde aufgrund des Wiederaufbaus nach dem Zweiten Weltkrieg. 


In Pakistan wird die Raue Gänsedistel traditionell angewendet um hormonelle Störungen und oxidativen Stress zu behandeln, laut einer pakistanischen Studie des Jahres 2012.

Der Volksglaube besagt, dass an Stellen, wo die Distel vorkommt, Unheil geschehen war.
Ihr wird dämonenabwehrende Kräfte zugeschrieben, weswegen sie selten vom Feld entfernt wurden, da sie das Getreide schützt. Desweiteren wurden Distelstauden im Stall aufgehängt zum Schutze der darin wohnenden Tiere. 
Sie steht für Lebenskraft, Anpassungsfähigkeit und die Rückkehr der Fruchtbarkeit im Frühjahr.

Der Acker-Gänseldistel (Sonchus arvensis) wird nachgesagt, dass sie eine Lichtpflanze sei als Mittel gegen Kummer und Schwermut. Das könnte daran liegen, dass die Blüten sich nur bei Licht und Trockenheit öffnen. Auch soll der Verzehr heldenhafte Kräfte wecken.



## Essenz
- Beistand in stürmischen Zeiten
- Stärkung der Fähigkeit Gedanken zu sammeln
- um Spannungen auf verschiedensten Ebenen zu lösen

auf körperliche Ebene:

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/charlissy/23u5vst5op8LQZp5FDWxkCLEc9d88mdcQ1Cu58UB9vDt9bEhddcSo46Qn9CYigz4gSWAX.png)


## Anwendungsgebiete
- Ausschläge (verdünnter Milchsaft)
- Appetitlosigkeit
- Entzündungen (verdünnter Milchsaft drauf schmieren)
- Frühjahrskur zur Entgiftung
- Fieber
- Harnwegbeschwerden (leicht)
- Hautentzündungen, eitrige
- Hautirritationen (äußerlich)
- Hämorrhoiden (verdünnt als Umschlag)
- Kurzatmigkeit
- Krebs
- Leberschwäche
- Menstruation: Fördert die Regelblutung
- Magenbrennen
- Mitessern
- Ohrenentzündung (früher Milchsaft zusammen mit Pflanzenöl und Salz)
- Rheuma
- Sodbrennen
- Schlangenbissen
- Taubheit (früher Milchsaft zusammen mit Pflanzenöl und Salz)
- Warzen (weißen Milchsaft drauf streichen)


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/charlissy/23wzvdn9xXnu9dq4JX9F8zgHwGGCFwdugXZnNqe6yfr8tvfC3LxVEPnaaDBTGWnCHznBR.png)


## Anwendungsbeispiele
- Aufgüsse (traditionell)
- Aufläufe
- Blanchieren und Einfrieren 
- Eintöpfe
- Fermentieren
- Füllmasse in Teigtaschen, Strudel, gefüllte Pfannkuchen
- Getränk aus den gerösteten und gemahlenen Wurzeln, mit kochendem Wasser aufgegossen, ähnlich dem Kaffee (wie Zichorienabsud)
- Gemüsepfanne: Blätter mit Salz und Gewürzen dünsten; gekochte Blätter
- Kartoffeln- und Nudelaufläufe
- Kräuterpulver
- Kohlähnliche Verwendung
- Massageöl bei Krämpfen
- Pesto
- Pasta-Gerichte (mit Knoblauch, Chili und Parmesan)
- Quiche
- Schönheitsmittel: Früher haben sich die Frauen mit dem Milchsaft das Gesicht gewaschenn für schöne, klare und glänzende Haut.
- Suppen
- Smoothies
- Salatbeigabe: rohe Blätter
- Tee (Blätter, Wurzeln) (traditionell)
- Umschlag (z.B. Brei aus zerstoßenen Blättern) (traditionell)
- verdünnter Milchsaft der Stengel und Blattadern

## verwendete Pflanzenteile
- Blüte
- Blätter
- Stängel (am heilkräftigsten wegen Milchsaft)
- Blattadern (am heilkräftigsten wegen Milchsaft)
- Wurzel
- Samen


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/charlissy/23uFHFf7G9XUG31cjZb9NSBXAFLLuJiWMky13LYH4TDcAHifVjuG31fj4N8MdddwwvTPf.png)


## Merkmale
- Wuchseigenschaften: meist sommereinjährig, selten wintereinjährig, an sich winterhart (überlebt im Wurzelstock), windunempfindlich, Oberflächenkeimer, Lichtkeimer
- Pflanzenart: Kraut, Staude
- Wuchshöhe: 70 bis 100 cm, bis zu 1,50 m
- Wuchsbreite: max. 70 cm
- Wasserbedarf: hoch bis normal
- Boden: nährstoffreich, humusreich, lehmig und tonig, sonnig bis halbschattig, stickstoffreich, nährstoffreich, kalkhaltig, frisch bis feucht, wasserdurchlässig
- Wurzel: bis zu 3 m tief, lockern Untergrund (gut für Nachbarspflanzen, die von den nach oben transportierten Nährstoffen profitieren)
- Stängel: milchsaftführend, mehrkantig, hohl, grün oder rötlich-violett überlaufen, aufrecht, nur oben verzweigt
- Keimblätter: erstmals Rosette, rötlich, spatelförmig bis schmal eiförmig, sehr kurz gestielt
- Blätter: dunkelgrün glänzend, steif, rau, schneckenförmig gebogen und am Stängel dicht angedrückter Blattgrund, Primärblätter länglich-oval, zum Blattstiel hin verschmälert, spätere Blätter lanzettlich, ungeteilt bis buchtig-fiederspaltig, mehr oder weniger dornig gezähnte Laubblätter, stängelumfassend (wachsen mit elegantem Schwung aus Stängel heraus), oft weich stachelig ohne zu stechen
- Blattadern: fiedernervig; Hauptnerv mit Seitennerven
- Blattstiel: geöhrt
- Blüten: Knospen in lockeren Trugdolden endständig an Haupt- und Nebentrieben, zunächst rund dann zugespitzt, eine Pflanze bis zu 100 Blütenköpfe, hellgelb, meist unten rötlich angelaufen, erinnern an Löwenzahn aber stehen oftmals in lockeren Gruppen; nur Röhrenblüten ohne Zungenblüten
- Früchte: Schließfrucht, Samen meist 5000 je Pflanze, 3 mm x 1 mm groß, flach, längsrippig; werden von Ameisen verschleppt
- Geschmack: wie Salat nur aromatischer, Wurzeln schmecken auch Spargelähnlich (sind beim Kochen auch ein wenig fasrig), Blätter leicht nussig bis bitter, ähnlich wie Rucola oder Löwenzahn; Milchsaft leicht bitter; Blütenboden erinnert an Artischocken
- Bestäubung: durch Insekten
- Verbreitung: Selbstaussaat, Samen durch Wind wegen dem Haarkelch an den Früchten; nach der Befruchtung bilden sich Achänen mit mit Pappus; durch Ameisen


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/charlissy/23wWpb96dXsikySuFg8bUkRxUhg316D4frbKhuUjCTGxJ1Xrgb911Yo1YZmMhu33ZbPzb.png)


## Vorkommen
- Europa
- Nord-Afrika, Teilen Afrikas
- Nord- und West-Asien

verschleppt auf sehr entfernten Inselgruppen im Indischen Ozean und Pazifik

## Standort
bis etwa auf 1.000m ü. NN
- Ackerfluren
- Ackernähe
- Blumenbeet
- Baustellen
- Brachfläche
- Böschungen
- Garten
- Pflastersteine
- Ruderal- und Schuttflächen
- Wiesen
- Wegrändern
- Wildblumenwiesen
- Weinbergen


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/charlissy/23wBy3T8nX1P9J7WpV5WiMA8XZmKXvVqsy2Fw3oiwKsAb2exuTEcWyEQMmUZdEVVVJgQW.png)


## Sammelhinweise
- Blütezeit: Mai bis Oktober
- Sammelzeit: April bis Juli
- Haltbarmachung: paar Tage im Kühlschrank möglich
- Insekten: Kleintiere suchen Schutz in stacheligen Blättern und Stängel vor Fressfeinden. Wanzen und Raupen saugen Saft aus Stängel, was wiederum der Distelbohrfliege zur Eiablage dient. Ihre Larven und der Distelfink fressen die Samen; Bienenweide für bspw. Braunbrüstige Hosenbiene (Dasypoda hirtipes) und Steinhummel (Bombus lapidarius)
- Tiere: Geflügel, Gänse und Schweine fressen dieses Kraut gerne. Samen als Futterquelle für Vögel.
- Gefährdet?: Kommt häufig vor und ist damit nicht gefährdet, sowohl als auch es nicht geschützt wird.
- Nebenwirkungen: nichts gefunden ?

## Verwechslungsgefahr!
- Pippau (Creppis) (essbar)
- Grundfeste (Hypochaeris) (essbar)
- Gift-Lattich (besitzt auf der Unterseite der Blätter entlang der Mittelader Stacheln; giftig!)

# Hinweis!

Bei Verbesserungsvorschlägen, Fehlern und Inspirationen bitte ich um Korrektur. Der Beitrag ist nicht vollständig und es ist noch lange nicht alles über diese Pflanze gesagt.
Dieser Beitrag dient nicht als Heilversprechen, sondern als Zusammenstellung, was ich über die Pflanze im Internet finden konnte. Wenn du die Pflanze einnimmst, bedeutet es nicht, dass du automatisch von all deinen Krankheiten befreit bist, doch du kannst sie als Begleitmittel nutzen und um dich wieder mit der Natur zu verbinden.

Da ich für Eigenverantwortung bin, wünsche ich mir, dass ihr euch selbst informiert, wenn ihr eine Pflanze einnehmen wollt, und nicht nur auf diesen Beitrag vertraut, sondern euren eigenen Weg findet mit der Natur zusammenzuarbeiten.

Dann wünsch ich euch viel Spaß bei eurer Reise mit der Natur :)

~charlissy

body.title: A Land Without Rules/Law Is A Land Without Sin…
body.body:
First off, rules may be imperfect and have some stuff about it, but as imperfect as it may be, it is what's helping a society from crumbling and falling into chaos.




![1000718621.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23xVM1nY3TXzWNcVxoPTottsozt9nmPkfqg1M8d7vKGoyPecmM18KuyuR6ZvBFo2MdVGF.jpg)




Now, there's a popular saying in my language (Yoruba), that's says, *\

* It's just as simple as that, in a land, community, or nation that there's no rules and laws then the citizens are free to do whatever they like. It just means there's no right and wrong and there's no good and bad, and there's no consequence for any of their actions.







Now, in my own country (Nigeria), it's almost as if there're no rules in place, as if we are running a lawless country, or let's just say the rules and regulations are only applicable to some people and some are obviously above the law. My country is facing a lot at the moment, especially with the matters of lives and properties. K!dnapp!ngs, band!try, k!llings and all sorts of vives happen on a daily. And we are left to wonder if we have a government, a security system and laws that says lives and properties of the citizens are important and must be protected. Because the rate at which these things are happening is just too much, and our government is doing absolutely nothing about it, but you will see them come for well-meaning Nigerians that are calling them out and demanding for better.



![1000718597.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23y8vF2mojnK8wPdEwEskk5MuhHKzXmkkAgAMd1CyrjAQwC4e6cBTwh8HrDzDNRDPZrvW.jpg)


But then, with all of these challenges and such, the little peace we have today is because of the rules, laws, and regulations that are in place, if not everyone would have taken matters into their own hands and act anyhow.




So, rules are helping. They are in place to help us, to guide us and to make life easier for us all. Even though the rules and laws are failing and our government has proved to be a failure and well, still the absence of will obviously create more problems.





So, I would not choose a world without rules or government. But there's the need for us to have better, and working rules, better leaders and good government that are concerned about it's citizens.

body.body:
> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU2o5AQkG4vDba5h3Mm3NEpCLW15AuEBPnnFQhaDiR32a/1780151968521.jpg) Hope everyone is well. Today I am here to share with you some words about a very beautiful and familiar flower. And I am also sharing a picture of a wonderful white jab flower captured on my camera. The flower you see in the attached file is actually a white jabba or white jabba flower. Its appearance seems to have increased several times in the wet freshness after the rain. Jaba is a very well-known and popular flower in our Indian subcontinent. It is an evergreen shrub of the Malvaceae family. Usually we see red jaba flowers more, but its diversity in nature is endless. Apart from red, white, yellow, pink, orange and mixed-color japa can be seen. The white japa flower in the picture is a unique symbol of purity and tenderness. The petals of this white flower and the stamen emerging from its center look beautiful against the background of green leaves. The raindrops are like pearls on the petals, which makes its beauty even more vivid. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcKJcAUQJnAtNC3zh5Y3giaR1iRsEsvAp9kSS6uUd27qj/1780151968577.jpg) It prevents hair loss and helps to make hair naturally black and shiny. Chamomile tea is quite popular all over the world. It helps to control blood pressure and boost the body's immunity. The anti-oxidants in it are effective in keeping the skin youthful and fresh. In our busy lives, these small and beautiful creations of nature play a great role in relieving mental fatigue. Having a hibiscus tree in the yard or on the roof of the house makes me feel good with more or less flowers all year round. Its white hibiscus is a piece of peace in my garden.
