Alchemic Dharma & The Imposters
“Alchemy is a word that essentially measures the increasing ignorance of humans across millennia.”
There are a lot of self-styled alchemists out here these days. It’s a cool word. I like it. If there were not so many alchemists out here already I’d claim the title. I’d spell it with a K. Alkhemist. Closer to its original spelling. 
Alchemy has an interesting etymology. It’s a word that travels through the millennia. As a long-lived fascination, it gets redefined along the way by every civilization that embraces it. 
As many already kno,w the “chem” in alchemy is the same chem that’s in “chemistry.” And the way I understand it, the same chem, in Kemet. That’s Egypt, if not greater Africa. So let’s start there. It’s not a great mystery. In ancient Egypt, Khem referred to the black earth of the Nile region, differentiating it from the non-black desert sands. 
In ancient Greek, Khēmeia,  referred to, \

We can see where this is going. It should be no secret to anyone by this point in time that the Greeks were heavily indebted to Egypt for its knowledge, wisdom, maths & philosophies. We are a bit more generous than those that accuse the Greeks of “stealing” African wisdom. The contemporaries knew from whence the knowledge came. It was their descendants circa the 18th century, again, being generous, that chose to conveniently forget the lineage. \nDigression. We suspect that chimera, is lexiconical alchemy, mixing the original root to define the melding of living critters rather than metals. \nArabic, Al-kīmiyā. \

the definite article, “al,” attached to the Greek root. We also get a hint right here, that “earth” can easily be removed, leaving alchemy to be defined simply as a “black art.” 
Another reminder that it was the Arabs of Islam that prompted the European Renaissance. Another quasi-awakening. “Thanks infidels. Now you must die!” 
Medieval Latin, Alchimista. One who practices alchimia. 
English. Alchemist. Dropped the “al” in some words (chemistry), but kept it in the mystical branch of alchemy. 
Let’s review. Alchemy literally means, \
(Khem), is also the root of the ancient name for Egypt itself: Kemet, \

So an alchemist, etymologically, is someone working with the dark, fertile, primordial matter, the soil from which things grow and into which things decompose. This is not accidental. The goal of alchemy, transmuting lead into gold, was always a metaphor for transforming the base self into the enlightened self, using the same dark, patient, earthy process that turns compost into soil and soil into grain.
So the original alchemists were farmers, or at least growers of grains. This would have seemed like magic and miracles back in its day, when it was brand new. Like writing. 
As humanity “advanced” into the future, it would be legitimate to consider extracting metals from rock and making weapons, and stuff, as alchemy. Granted, second generation. Making iron from rock, or even fire from sand would fit the bill of, “miracles” or magic. Anybody could grow food, climate permitting. But to make things go boom! That’s some serious alchemy. 
Then, humanity got carried away. Thought they could change base metals, with no exchange value, into gold. Along the way, they discovered “chemistry.” It should not surprise anyone that the Germans are the best chemists in the world. We will just leave that right here. And put a warning label on it. 
The 21st century alchemist, doesn’t work with actual dirt, or metals, or chemicals. It’s all abstract. The magic is transmuting terror into survival, and countless other abstract formulas. Some of these cats don’t seem to get it. Yet. But they are genuinely trying. 
Props! 
Others, as there have always been, and always will be, are charlatans.  
Here’s where we get to the Impostor part of the scenario. Our impostor fancies herself a fitness alchemist. Unfortunately our main character was sucked into one of these fly-by-night certification scams and she was taught the motions without the deeper elements of function, metabolism, connective tissue, Krebs cycle, and all that funky stuff. 
This example runs parallel to Renaissance alchemists, that read the book. Ignorant of the symbolism within, they followed the spells to the letter. Bad move. Thus, many of them ended up frustrated, sick, imprisoned, or dead. Some executed by the crown for feeding the royal pet some supposed cure, that killed it. 
Ooops. (That’s arf ful.) 
We are witnesses, by way of social media, to something very similar. Only today the industry is a bit more savvy. They know they are frauds. Most of them anyway. The ones who know, know that there are no promises or guarantees to their mumbo-jumbo. What the public doesn’t know, is that the alchemy is on the individual. Same with fitness coaching. Maybe a healer can determine why you are in the kind of pain that you can’t explain to your mechanic. 
“It’s making this funny kinda ‘squirching, boing-boing, brrratchunk’ kinda sound, and then, I just feel, y’know, kinda off. I can’t really explain it. And I just wanna cry all night long.”
You have demons! Everybody does. Most humans don’t call them demons, and even more don’t want to confront them. All kidding aside, this is a real thing. For countless reasons, many having to do with self-identity, or keeping that Impostor in tact, humans don’t want to disturb that facade. Less everything comes crashing down. But we’ve detoured once again. 
Damn. It was a toll road too!    
Remember friends. This stuff is for entertainment purposes mainly. If these essays help you, that’s a bonus. They are not meant to help you. But the are not meant to hurt you either. If you’re triggered and need help, find help, get help, help yourself. 
We’re a little bit drowsy, but otherwise okay. Last day of the month tomorrow. June is nigh. New grooves for the Substack channel.

>U.S. President Donald Trump suffered one after another in a federal court on the 29th (local time).
The court order temporarily suspended the payment of compensation through the Anti-Weaponization Fund, which is being created to support those who suffered damage from the judicial weaponization for political purposes under the former Democratic Party. In addition, the order to restore the original was issued when he added his name to the Kennedy Center in Washington D.C. and changed the name to the Donald J. Trump and John F. Kennedy Memorial Performing Arts Center.

>Blocking the Judicial Damage Relief Fund
According to the Associated Press and other sources, Judge Leonie Brinkema of the Virginia District Court ordered a temporary suspension of compensation payments through the fund. It also banned the administration from proceeding with the fund-raising process while the lawsuit is in progress.
A hearing to decide whether to extend the order will be held on the 12th of next month.
Earlier, the legal group Democratic Forward filed a lawsuit claiming that there was no legal basis for the fund.
The fund will be created by the administration on the condition that Trump withdraws a $10 billion lawsuit against the IRS over the leak of his and his family's tax payments to the media.
The $1.776 billion fund is considered to compensate Trump aides and supporters.
However, the fund has been criticized from the beginning. This is because there have been concerns that the support could include those who participated in the January 6, 2021 parliamentary riot. Criticism has been raised among the ruling Republican Party as well as the Democratic Party.

>\

According to the Wall Street Journal (WSJ), Washington Federal District Judge Christopher Cooper ordered that Trump be removed from his name and returned to his original name, the Kennedy Center.
To change the name, it must be approved by Congress.
Judge Cooper said the Trump name should be removed from the name of the center, Washington, DC's leading cultural venue, and ordered the administration to remove all signs with Trump's name within 14 days and remove the reference to the \
from official materials.\nPreviously, the Kennedy Center's board of directors unanimously voted to rename the center \

in December last year.
The court also suspended plans to suspend operations for two years from July in the name of full renovation.

to allow children to receive a permanent residency in the U.S. if they pay $1 million.
Reporter Song Kyung-jae (dympna@fnnews.com )

Efforts to glorify Trump are being checked.
It shows that the United States still has a system capable of stopping such absurd actions.
I hope they come to their senses and govern properly—
if they seize this rare opportunity, I believe they could achieve an unprecedented boom.

After healing and finding empty supplies, I backtracked through eerie red alarm lights to find an infected room. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYTzgt7kF8u8RUX1qxXokMsw4sZa4AgxMxg8TmnHFcky9/screenshot_1_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaBBbm6mKKMfZBiCEWyy5tEAnaqa7TRqNUVxHuLCvvQaj/screenshot_2_.png) After upgrading my gears, I turned on the generator first and then I activated the circuit breaker, which gave electricity to the whole facility. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc6emjXLMRwCo3KwczKW3v2XriLrez8g88ATWXQQzU7PH/screenshot_3_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmY37iAc8yVzBknxnZZSY4cWPwXLc6YegZf2uzrNKJTsDm/screenshot_4_.png) Then I went for this door that was still a little stuck after pressing the button, so I had to push it open to advance. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeJBSkKYRTL3A4tzwzsxCqdEkGmbyCnJUJpnqSe2oigt4/screenshot_5_.png) Right after getting out of the door, I found it was not only me. There were three clickers who came out of their locked cabins as well and I first tried a blank shot to lure them toward me. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYuopm2WSn5jJoe1UhrceMEbf2oFvbSQZjhtRmpSekP7p/screenshot_6_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQPpepJuH2SAoQJiAi1fyb5Uq6uGWyxRkggfrZnqpkj5K/screenshot_7_.png) My plan was to blow their heads up with shotgun shells, and I knew only one bullet would be needed to take down one of them. And I did it right, just like I wanted, with the few bullets I had. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcu28hELpWq1Gg9tmEvuhcYbVR1aEgzLRxRotY5Hp2Boo/screenshot_8_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXebs6LK5xxWXY1wDZw14nqYWTGk76S5zRpkFgA4dPCxG/screenshot_9_.png) When I was assured that there are no more demons around, I started checking around the cabins that were once locked. And suddenly this stalker attacked me, whom I did not see at all. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdkUhs4xL6ToXTZb1rFsPhdgjLPkXBT16VGD6Y6yawM2Z/screenshot_10_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaVuwvaicyZQnHUUXxNVqJnegJubhLsHgLVYPMYBo7k8H/screenshot_11_.png) After pushing it away, I started flaming it up using my flamethrower to burn it down quickly. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdPhfVsPnUw4amS3AfvLC9ujwcGiDN6YuJRFHhL5FyYbQ/screenshot_12_.png) Then I took some time to try and bandage and heal up because I did not know what was waiting for me ahead. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcXyt5YQNRWkFkPvXQ9fseYvDXKAmWjVNmvKq8yBVLdKz/screenshot_14_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXREEHWEhZVcTL472znr8Hk84TXDL6GTAJLaS5w3JbMwF/screenshot_13_.png) And then I found another med box, hoping it would have the tools I needed, but it was also empty. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS43dhQRhfUcuwTnzwHEg28qZx1Pbdec71k1dHAnaVfhs/screenshot_15_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcuD4zwSqEVtYEuCZdc5ZbmGaxQ3Xjd6Gy22z5PQ41qxu/screenshot_16_.png) I came out of the cabin and I started moving to the area that I passed before, but this time it was different as I could see the red lights and different noises around, which made the whole environment scarier. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaJom1HoU993eMbrWthqRLEJzzyVqp5xtRTUGfEG9Qrm2/screenshot_17_.png) Then I reached this door that was once locked, but it was unlocked this time. And I noticed there were overgrown infections inside, which told me something bad happened there. We'll check what happens next in another post. --- Image Source: In game screenshots. End of the post. Peace. --- ▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=bong1011/81544dc0)

body.title: When Strategy Is Tested and Reality Speaks
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaj3vrGRtKW3VnMqCFQd8CiVRheV2UH7axDbTcrHKhdNd/brawl_thumbnails.png)

**Translation:**

Greetings, Splinterlands warriors!

On this occasion, I’d like to once again share my experience from the latest **Brawl** with my beloved guild, **ClaNFT**. As we all know, Brawl is one of the most exciting features in Splinterlands because it’s where guild members fight under their team’s name to compete for Crowns, Merits, SPS, and of course, guild pride. Win or lose, there’s always an interesting story to take home.

As usual, I was once again placed in **Fray 12**. It feels like this position has become my permanent address every time a Brawl begins—whether because it suits me well or because my guildmates have grown used to seeing me play there.

Interestingly, this Brawl wasn’t very crowded. Out of the nine available battle slots, I only had to fight in **six active matches**. The remaining three slots were automatically counted as wins because the opposing guild did not fill those frays.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZtgaEV3EqC7Ma9ApRSoTnghL9vgYtff1HXBiHip3PMBu/my_battles.png)</center>


On paper, this situation looks advantageous. However, as the saying goes, numbers can sometimes be kinder than reality.

Out of the six matches I actually played, I only managed to win **one battle**. The other five had to be conceded to my opponents. In the end, I secured a total of **four wins**, consisting of one actual victory and three automatic ones.

To be honest, my personal result this time was not very satisfying. Automatic wins still count, but they feel different compared to victories earned through real strategy and combat.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdb5xSdTSvrKMmFHy65ZJf9qbHt9NZuUEw9zjoP7YTtSn/all.png)</center>



Fortunately, Brawl is a team effort—not an individual struggle.

Even though my performance wasn’t shining, my guildmates performed much better. Overall, **ClaNFT** recorded: 104 wins, 31 losses, and 312 points.

That result was enough to secure **third place** in this Brawl.

As a reward for our collective effort, the guild earned: **2,400 Merits** for each fully participating member and **24,416 Staked SPS** for players who own a Spellbook.

In my opinion, this is still a solid result. It may not be the top position, but it shows that ClaNFT can compete with other strong guilds.

## One Memorable Victory

Among the six battles I played, there was one match that I believe is worth remembering—and learning from.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUNJeRC8YoDXh7TaGXHyvaq33ZbC2FbzQF7bSM1tgyLNi/brawl_battle.png)


You can view the battle here:
<center> 👉  [**LINK BATTLE**](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sm_6IKk4LtVcpjev1bBfmNs?ref=rqr4)  👈</center>

Why did I choose this match? Because it was the only victory I truly earned through my own strategy and calculation.

The opponents in Fray 12 this time were truly formidable. Almost every player I faced used high-level cards with well-thought-out combinations. Several times I felt I had built my best team, only to find that my opponent had an even better answer.

In the battle I won, everything went according to plan. The monster placement felt right, the attack sequence worked effectively, and for once, luck was on my side. In Splinterlands, a single victory like that can feel more valuable than several easy wins due to absent opponents.

## Lessons from This Brawl

There’s one lesson that stood out again after this Brawl: other players never stop improving.

Sometimes we focus too much on strengthening our own collection and forget that others are doing the same. They acquire new cards, develop new strategies, and adapt to the ever-changing meta.

This Brawl served as a reminder that last week’s victories do not guarantee success next week. Every match must be treated as a new challenge.

For new players, joining an active guild like ClaNFT is not just about earning Merits and SPS. Even casual discussions about rulesets or team compositions can spark ideas you hadn’t considered before. That’s why I always recommend new players to actively engage in discussions, not just show up to claim rewards.

As usual, I haven’t used the Merits I earned yet. The amount is still not enough to open **5 Gladius Cases** at once.

So for now, I’ll keep saving. Once I have enough, I’ll definitely share the results of opening those Gladius Cases in a future post. Who knows—I might get a rare Gladiator card or even discover a new favorite.

## Closing

That’s the story of my Brawl this time. For those of you experiencing a losing streak, don’t be discouraged. In Splinterlands, losses are often a more diligent teacher than victories. Keep trying new strategies, gradually strengthen your card collection, and make use of your guild community to learn.

See you in the next Brawl. May SPS find its way upward soon, may Merits quickly reach 10,000, and may luck be on our side when opening Gladius Cases. Happy battling, Splinterlands warriors! ⚔️

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXuXxp6GBhwB1HpXvoabLn8Dt8QaRKSe1WNYDzqX1v6Vk/chaos_logo.png)

Talk about Splinterlands,
If you haven't tried out this fantastic game called Splinterlands yet, I invite you to [**Join**](https://splinterlands.com?ref=rqr4).
It's free, but you'll need to invest in a beginning deck or buy gaming cards to gain real assets like cards and tokens. 

___


If you already joined the splinterlands, and are looking for a place to grow. We need **YOU**. We are a chill, social guild looking for a few more active members! If you think you might be a fit, join us in our [**Discord**](https://discord.gg/5u638vHPVh)

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZAXaBtYPQQcQ4fDb2DMaFETkzmZ5DNhevYHW4pANVaM2/banner.png)</center>

body.body:
# LIMA STREET DIARIES: BACK TO CLASS AND THE BUS CHRONICLES / DE VUELTA A CLASE Y CRÓNICAS DEL BUS [ENG-ESP]
### Urban Photography / Fotografía Urbana

<center>


![_DSC3191.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cabzphoto/EpEHE1Y5qW4BPrefkNPdkNE9UoEbz1wUAXTvxNs3wudTnBYyF48QUV1e2Bmc8fUHC7Z.jpg)

*“Learning new skills, embracing the struggle, and finding art in the daily commute.”*
*“Aprendiendo nuevas habilidades, abrazando el esfuerzo y encontrando arte en el trayecto diario.”*

</center>

![linea separadora hive.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cabzphoto/23u5LMZycR2ks1nWRqsVWJkcVyTpYcmV9JKkGrKrTj1mTsSwXWn33PjZ99nQYGWJQaLRV.png)

<div class=\

>

### English

Hello friends of the Black and White community and MonoMad! I’m currently listening to my social media workshop class, learning a little more every day. At first, I felt total embarrassment being 43 years old, back in classrooms with 18 and 21-year-olds, but I’ve finally broken the ice. Now, I’m only focused on learning and growing. 

Time has become very tight, and things in my country are complicated; everything is getting more expensive, and stability is harder to maintain. But here we are, pushing forward. The little time I have for street photography is spent on the buses, or while walking to class or another specific destination. To make matters worse, debt is currently preventing me from buying the gear I’d like—I even made the mistake of buying a huge, \

photography backpack that is completely non-functional for street photography! 

Anyway, I’m starting my beautiful mornings with a lot of sleep—I’ve been awake since 5 AM—but I’m giving it my all. Today, I leave you with my daily journey, featuring that peculiar bus conductor. Many vibes and blessings to you all!

### Español

¡Qué tal, amigos de la comunidad en Blanco y Negro y del MonoMad! Por acá escuchando mis clases del taller de redes sociales, aprendiendo cada día un poco más. Al principio sentía una vergüenza total, a mis 43 años, volviendo a las aulas entre jóvenes de 18 o 21 años, pero bueno, ya rompí ese hielo y solo me estoy enfocando en aprender y crecer. 

El tiempo se ha acortado y las cosas en mi país están complicadas; cada día todo es más caro y es más difícil mantener una estabilidad, pero ahí estamos, dándole. El poco tiempo que tengo para hacer *street* es en los buses, caminando a clases o hacia algún lugar en especial. Ahora las deudas no me dejan comprar algunas cosas que desearía para la cámara (hasta cometí el error de comprar una mochila fotográfica demasiado grande y \

que no es funcional para la calle). En fin, empezando mis mañanas hermosas con mucho sueño —estoy despierto desde las 5 a. m.—, pero a darle con todo, mis amigos. Les dejo mi viaje de todos los días con esa peculiar cobradora. ¡Muchas vibras y bendiciones para todos! > **¡Kachkaniraqmi!** — *(Quechua: Until we meet again)* ![linea separadora hive.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cabzphoto/23u5LMZycR2ks1nWRqsVWJkcVyTpYcmV9JKkGrKrTj1mTsSwXWn33PjZ99nQYGWJQaLRV.png)
## 🖼️ LA GALERÍA / THE GALLERY
![_DSC3238.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cabzphoto/23wC3LB8NSzDv98mkQVYygRAxKcswbAyrPZjhKTkvbfZtE9uE7gTdeMzfa5XY183VDRPz.jpg)
![_DSC3236.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cabzphoto/EoGysGS4Cjm8ogeDwVaKak8W7tjngwjkeSua3tttUgwK8GgXUa4c2MtwAZe3uev4pfQ.jpg)
![_DSC3235.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cabzphoto/48TJjfJY8fTws3ZKdu9qo2prWKBMbrZMD9Sz2R9rQgChfzBkH7aKcqetGH6LzLwKV2.jpg)
![_DSC3160.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cabzphoto/23yTWEe9VcWTg7ZyP5bUASfw75XN8WuxC571DWy8BftSZhP11xNo7gUyCEBkxWeqkeYuA.jpg)
![_DSC3127.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cabzphoto/23tkmzKmJxmfCm9f7bSNb5b4HTjP7ythUMwiKx6HGw7AeA6LVUoA6wb9uXZK8qrN5StVh.jpg)

body.title: Under the open sky in the evening.
body.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mofijul/EoAcA4NN7wajPMNX29VMauyfLj4GBLtRVwijnqJ39VEoP7Z79Z6UtRK4Q6rrdD27BWx.png)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mofijul/EpA2RjGGfoqWD4DH9578FxSPA1jdy6uLJzKBJjNhCovtkewMq1YkqtTysR7gDDgLgGT.png)


Hi friends, how are you all? I hope you are well. Friends, sometimes there comes a time when you feel very lonely even when many people are around you. I think it happens to everyone at an age when people feel very lonely despite having thousands of people around them. And this kind of feeling can come at any age; maybe you think that you are old enough to see a lot and feel this way. But I can tell you one thing for sure: it can happen at any age. It is wrong to say that you need to be old enough to feel this way.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mofijul/EoErWuRegCwNrfDzNyJCYSjJnnKFFmRcujYdNQdvbhyqX25MTqrXuM1PDEcHCNG8JEf.png)

But there is a common thing here: many people see something so difficult at a very young age and face such a difficult reality that it forces them to think that they are alone among thousands of people. Many people have to take care of their family while they are studying at a very young age; then will their feelings be the same as the feelings of another friend of their age? Do you think I said anything wrong?

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mofijul/EpGRkQZ6AfaGeixBwws915XsfHjxifUHHmkovWA2jqaXfMzzay3zcKE5J8grxRRZSct.png)

The world is a very difficult place. When a person is surrounded by everything, he does not understand what a difficult day is. Whenever his position starts changing, different feelings slowly start forming inside him, and these feelings become a burden after a while. As I feel now, that is why I have told you something. I am very worn out inside; life is passing through many things, so it felt like a burden, so I tried to lighten it up by sharing it with you at least a little. I hope you have understood something from my short sentence.

body.title: Der Wiener HIVE Stammtisch HIVE MEET UP VIENNA 28.05.2026  [GER/ENG]
body.body:
Meine Vision war es schon immer, auf Bühnen zu stehen und Menschen zu coachen. Gemeinsam zu wachsen, über Wege und Möglichkeiten von Online-Einkommen zu sprechen – aber vor allem über das richtige Mindset. Ich will über HIVE sprechen, Vorträge halten und den Menschen da draußen zeigen, welchen echten Mehrwert das Bloggen auf unserer Blockchain bietet.


![IMG_7051.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23ywsPefaeHzv9iNhudHcXe9ymxhXRamMfciqEVadjsJbnZwVPgsSX2XjtEKsWeRGh3zG.jpeg)










Fiktion oder bald Realität?

Nun, *never say never*. Auf den **#HOD (HIVE Open Days)** in Alicante habe ich extrem viel gelernt und mitgenommen. Ich bin zwar kein Blockchain-Experte, aber das musst du auch gar nicht sein, um hier mit Spaß an der Sache erfolgreich zu bloggen.

Der **Wiener HIVE Stammtisch** entstand schon lange vor meiner Zeit und gehört definitiv zu den beständigsten regelmäßigen Meetups auf HIVE. Für mich ist er fast schon ein Pflichttermin. Ich freue mich jedes Mal darauf, coole Leute zu treffen, gut zu essen und sich über Gott und die HIVE-Welt auszutauschen.

So war es auch diesmal am 28.05., als sich eine feine Runde von Hivern traf, um über „Diverses“ zu philosophieren. Mit am Start waren diesmal @reiseamateur aus Graz, @pantha.rhei, @stayoutoftherz und ich, @schmidi.

Die Learnings und den Spirit aus Alicante habe ich natürlich direkt mit zum Stammtisch gebracht. Eines ist mir bei den HIVE Open Days nämlich glasklar geworden: Wenn ich HIVE aktiv nach außen trage und bewerbe, dann kommen auch neue Interessenten zu solchen Events. Das heißt natürlich nicht, dass jeder sofort bleibt und täglich bloggt – aber der erste Schritt ist getan.

Abgesehen vom fantastischen Essen stand für mich in Alicante der Spaß an erster Stelle. Ich habe Spanien einfach genossen. Es war dieser ganz besondere Spirit der Community, der das Event ausgemacht hat – die Vorträge ebenso wie die Side-Events, wie zum Beispiel unser Ausflug auf die Insel Tabarca.

Genau diesen Vibe möchte ich im kleinen Stil auch in die Wiener Meetups bringen: Learnings teilen, Netzwerken mit tollen Menschen und Treffen, von denen jeder mit einem echten Mehrwert nach Hause geht. Wir sollten die bestehenden Communities nutzen, um uns noch besser zu vernetzen, HIVE sichtbarer machen und auch auf meinem YouTube-Kanal bzw. Anderen immer wieder darüber sprechen.

![IMG_7025.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23uQzkLn5KZC52fxmTgKHQkEPrAZtTjs8bCexYMMaPjKxVQUaE144ehUPDvFsUv8HNL6p.jpeg)

Versteh mich nicht falsch, aber ich habe neulich beim Spielen von „Cashflow“ (dem Brettspiel von Robert T. Kiyosaki) wieder eine wichtige Lektion gelernt: **Im Team geht vieles leichter.** Gemeinsam bricht man deutlich schneller aus dem Hamsterrad aus, als man denkt.

Genau so sehe ich das auch bei HIVE. Wenn du etwas verändern willst, frage dich zuerst selbst: *Will ich das überhaupt und was kann ich aktiv dafür tun?* Fang bei dir selbst an und schau, was möglich ist. Schieb die Verantwortung nicht auf andere.

Fakt ist: Das sind im Moment noch Visionen und Gedanken, die ich hier teile. Aber sie können der Meilenstein für zukünftiges Wachstum sein. Alleine sind uns oft die Hände gebunden, aber es ist der Anfang vom Anfang. Und wenn du nie startest, wird sich definitiv gar nichts ändern.

Neben diesen großen Themen haben wir beim Stammtisch natürlich auch über aktuelle Herausforderungen gesprochen, hervorragend gegessen und philosophiert. Für die Zukunft wünsche ich mir zwar wieder den einen oder anderen der „alten Garde“ zurück an den Tisch, aber ich sage immer: Es sitzen genau die richtigen Leute am Start – und der Rest kommt durch das Dranbleiben von ganz allein.

---

## Englische Übersetzung (English Version)

**My Vision: Mindset, the Stage, and the Spirit of Alicante**

![IMG_7050.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23wqs1dRwrDCpXLKcLM9sK4Fd8bytoP98LimaAhuka97DdLyXpY168anhgF9w4QZ1oyqr.jpeg)

My vision has always been to stand on stages and coach people. To grow together, to teach people about online income strategies – but even more importantly, about the right mindset. I want to talk about HIVE, give presentations, and educate people on the incredible value of blogging on this blockchain.

![IMG_7049.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/EokeZ3zsATNHhdXTgHrU3yAACr9FEt4cYmCHxN3NsiWBgrgXEdtCCi3Rp8L8R7BqJMQ.jpeg)

Fiction or reality?

Well, *never say never*. I learned and gathered so much inspiration at the **#HOD (HIVE Open Days)** in Alicante. I’m certainly no blockchain expert, but you don't need to be one to enjoy blogging here and have fun with it.

The **Vienna HIVE Stammtisch** was established long before my time and is definitely one of the longest-running regular meetups on HIVE. For me, it’s pretty much a must-attend event. I always look forward to connecting with great people, enjoying good food, and talking all things HIVE.

It was no different on May 28th, when a small group of Hivers gathered to chat about \

Joining the table were @reiseamateur from Graz, @pantha.rhei, @stayoutoftherz, and myself, @schmidi.

I brought my key takeaways and the amazing energy from the #HOD straight to our local meetup. One thing became crystal clear to me in Alicante: if I actively promote HIVE to the outside world, new faces will show up at these events. Of course, that doesn’t mean they will all start blogging instantly and stick around forever, but the first step is taken.

Besides the fantastic food, having fun was my top priority in Alicante. I simply love Spain. It was the unique spirit and the community vibe that made it so special – the presentations just as much as the side events, like our trip to the island of Tabarca.

I want to bring that exact same vibe on a smaller scale to our meetups in Vienna: sharing insights, networking with great people, and creating meetups where everyone walks away with real value. We need to leverage existing communities to network better, promote HIVE more externally, and talk about it regularly on my YouTube channel.

![IMG_7019.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23xpErKWDREZcpyCBC8RgKXgMsyoGGu4cauhwjauK7nRhXCyUL3bvm4P9i3FdsWfEhynG.jpeg)

Don't get me wrong, but I recently relearned a valuable lesson while playing \

(the board game by Robert T. Kiyosaki): **Everything is easier as a team.** Escaping the rat race happens way faster when you do it together.

That’s exactly how I see things on HIVE. If you want to change something, first ask yourself: *Do I really want this, and what can I personally do to make it happen?* Start with yourself and explore what’s possible. Don't pass the buck to others.

The fact is, these are just thoughts and ideas I’m putting out there right now, but they could be the milestone for future growth. On our own, our hands are tied. But this is the beginning of the beginning – and if you never start, absolutely nothing will change.


![IMG_7052.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23wCJA7imeBkirrWAPxjYrUwAajLfZDYjJdRDBRodiJ9drbbrZWeH3EnCkk6znwECvxM8.jpeg)


Alongside these big picture topics, we also discussed some current challenges, enjoyed delicious food, and philosophized into the night. For the future, I’d love to see a few more faces from the \
return to the table, but I always say: the right people are always the ones who show up – and everything else will follow as long as we keep moving forward.

body.title: Returning home on the pulse.🥰
body.body: > Bismillahir Rahmanir Rahim Assalamu Alaikum wa Rahmatullahi wa Barakatuh. ***

> Hello my dear friends. I am @rasel72. From #Bangladesh. *** ![6VvuHGsoU2QBt9MXeXNdDuyd4Bmd63j7zJymDTWgdcJjnzpfwESDrh57po9DeTZoGfSTcYbVK6YLHWMy9fTaPFc6aQkgejxSHWnYiHdn5MxpTNhL8YRxeyqCiJugdt.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmat9ig5sW9HDWiHMbGpZVsWJsWouGeFciYTgcw9m2V4L1/6VvuHGsoU2QBt9MXeXNdDuyd4Bmd63j7zJymDTWgdcJjnzpfwESDrh57po9DeTZoGfSTcYbVK6YLHWMy9fTaPFc6aQkgejxSHWnYiHdn5MxpTNhL8YRxeyqCiJugdt.jpeg)
Thumbnail

> How are you all? I hope you are all well. I am also well. I have appeared among you again, with another new post of mine.  I have been busy with various things for the past few days and could not find time to write a post, which is why I could not share the post with you. That is why today I have come to you again to share the moments of my life- No matter how much people leave their homes and live in different parts of the country due to necessity, at a certain time or moment they leave all their busyness and work and return to their homes. In my case, this is no exception. After Eid of the last Ramadan month, I rushed from home to Ghazipur. After that, I spent 50 long days finishing my exams and tuition. Even though I wanted to, I could not rush home. I had also left my newly married wife behind 🙂. I could not rush to her due to the pressure of responsibility and tuition. Sometimes I would feel very bad, then I would tell myself that after how many days the Eid holiday will be, I would go home and spend a good time with everyone. Although my exams ended on the 10th, I had not decided to come home until the 20th. ![1000055419.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmRP4EtGMdCHwwUaKaCuBpqBW1TceA3S26maZyrruVGTrq/1000055419.jpg) Actually, the main purpose of coming home early was to give my wife time and share the joy of Eid by spending some beautiful moments with my parents. For this, I tried to book train tickets 8 days in advance. I had not decided to come home on the 20th, so I started looking for tickets on the 12th. But since Eid was coming, all the tickets were booked 10 days in advance. After searching a lot, I got a ticket by changing the station. It was booked immediately. I got off at Kumarkhali station, but I bought a ticket till Khoksha station. Because there were no empty seats till Kumarkhali station. My ticket cost 405 taka including the 20 taka charge. However, I have one problem that after buying the ticket to come home, the days do not want to go. 😄 It just seems like time flies. Anyway, after buying the ticket, I felt a little happy. I will go home after 50 days. So the joy was more than the pain. By the 19th, I finished all my tuitions and gave everyone Eid leave. Then I also did some shopping to come home. On the morning of the 20th, I finished all my work and left at around 10:30 am to come home. My train will leave Dhaka Kamalapur Station at 3 pm. But I have to go from Gazipur Duet Area to Kamalapur Station, that's why I left the room in such a hurry. I took an auto, to Joydevpur Station, there I was waiting for the train to go to Dhaka Kamalapur Station. The train was very late at 12:40 pm. I stood at Joydevpur Railway Station for about 2 hours. Then I took the train to Kamalapur Station after 2 pm. I went there and offered Zuhr prayers first. Then I started waiting for my train. The train arrived at around 2:40. I boarded the train and found my seat. The train left at exactly 3 pm. As time passed, I felt happier and happier 🙂 Because after so many days, I was returning home to my loved ones again in a short time. ![1000055185.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmTuMfn25o7C2vRarBUNrDwEkjLv9MANopMkdFYfPBHV8i/1000055185.jpg) ![1000055211.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmSHExFgMjrRVAyxEj88JsyPoc38Deaz497UTCCo7VaEAr/1000055211.jpg) ![1000055221.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmeSVNjYgThYax45pXAQ5GkS5ZYFRuVMvf6SomTrMGYzH9/1000055221.jpg) I reached Kumarkhali station at 7:10 pm. Then I got off the train, bought a rose for my beloved wife. Then I left for home in the van. I reached home at around 7:40 pm. I met my mother first before going home. Every time I go home, I hug my mother first. There may be no one else in this world like my mother. Then I went to my room. After traveling for more than 9 hours, I finally reached my destination. My mind was filled with peace as soon as I reached home. In fact, every human life is like this, when we return home after a hundred busy days, a different kind of peace works. Which cannot be explained. I hope that like me, many of you are returning home to your relatives with Eid-ul-Azha in front. I shared this emotional moment of returning home with you. I hope everyone liked it. Everyone will be well and healthy. I will see you again with a new post of mine. #
>Thank you very much everyone for reading today's post.

body.title: Land Needs A Season Permit Too
body.body:
https://youtu.be/xG8vs7s8fv4

I know I'm going to get a lot of pushback for this - and maybe rightfully so since land is not as developed as it needs to be - but I do think some kind of season permit is needed for land. Maintenance is probably going to fill this void once buildings are in place so it might be a moot point and solved within the next couple of months, but the reason for this is because land suffers from the same problem Wild Format did before the season permit was introduced. Someone can pay only once for a card or land and earn in perpetuity without ever adding value back into the ecosystem. If this goes on for too long or at scale, the whole system becomes unsustainable.

body.title: Retracing Our Steps             ...Part 2               ....Reliving the Dream
body.body:
*He knew the body had a spiritual aspect and “spirit,” was real, because of his experiences—which, he could suppress, but not erase from memory. ― Sol Luckman*


![Reliving a Dream.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcdqG8prizMP27S2cjBJEVtWuXcxHofjS74o1Tn7yhS53/Reliving%20%20a%20Dream.png)
*Reliving the Dream*


I experienced a vivid flashback of a moment spent with Carrie, my deceased wife, but it was more than a realistic memory—I relived the event. The event was so concrete and real it shocked me and I felt that I might be the result of the head injury I suffered as a result of the accident that took Carrie’s life. I was so troubled by the incident that I confessed my concerns to Cat Eaton, the wife of my publisher and a long-time friend.

“Are you sure you didn’t doze off and dream?” Cat asked, looking concerned. I handed her a glass of Yellow tail and sst down beside her on the couch. I shook my head. “It came on me suddenly—frankly, I thought I was having an aneurism—and then, there she was and I was reliving that day at Holmes Beach—one of my happiest memories.”

Her eyes brighten. “Then maybe it was serendipity—you know, one of those once in a lifetime occurrences that are magical but impossible to fathom.” “Maybe,” I concede, but still continue to frown. I’m struggling to wrap my mind around something that may turn out to be a never-to-be repeated event. “Do you think Carrie was trying to reach out and comfort you?” Cat asks suddenly. My heart leaps at the suggestion—it was a notion in back of my mind I was hesitant to voice—partly because of reticence, but mostly because it was a sacred moment, and vocalizing it might somehow diminish its wonder.

I pondered how to answer as I stared into the fire thinking of that last kiss. “You know, Cat, if Carrie somehow gave me this one last moment, I want to savor it the rest of my life.” She leans over and hugs me. “You are very special Daniel Gregg—you’re one of the sweetest, most romantic men I know—and if anyone is entitled to a magical moment it’s you.”

Cat’s encouragement helps me deal with the aftermath of my experience and it consoles me to know she doesn’t think me delusional. But the more I think about the incident of reliving the past I begin to doubt Carrie had anything at all to do with it. She seemed as helplessly caught up in the moment as I was. Since people just don’t spontaneously relive events, there has to be some other explanation.

But if Carrie didn’t cause it, what did? Could it have been triggered by one of those anomalies the neurosurgeon detected in his tests? It’s a possibility—and then a thought hits me: *What if such a beautiful experience turns out to be simply the result of a blood clot in my brain?*

I resolve to have an answer and the only way is to try to repeat the very steps that enabled me to travel back and be with her. It doesn’t feel ghoulish or morbid to want to relive moments with Carrie. I’m not attempting to hold a séance—I just want to access my own lived experiences. I got out the photo albums, but this time, choose our trip to BC. I find Carrie’s journal entries from our ski weekend at Whistler and also retrieve her ski jacket. Once again I spent an hour perusing the photos, and then read her journal entries. As soon as I hold her ski jacket, the same sensations occur as before—the same blinding flash, the momentary blackout and then, awakening in another place surrounded by familiar sights and sounds—and Carrie’s voice.

“It’s so magical here, Daniel—high in the mountains, in a winter fairy land.” The joy on her face is childlike and innocent. We’re standing in the Whistler village with huge fluffy snowflakes falling about us. I kiss her slowly, savoring the moment, and the world creeps away, leaving only my image reflected in her eyes. We have a romantic dinner in a local steakhouse and walk the streets peering in windows and marveling at the mountain peaks towering above us. And just as we’re about to go up on a ski lift, everything goes dark and when I open my eyes she’s gone.

It went that way over the next few weeks—I’d experiment with different photos and personal objects of Carrie’s and discover I could relive all kinds of moments from our lives—not all romantic or happy, but all of them real. In mid May, the neurosurgeon informed me my memory loss was in fact related to an area of the brain where he observed anomalies and suggested surgery might help. I politely declined, and Cat agreed. She sat on my couch smiling, a glass of Shiraz in her hand.

“I told you a long time ago to fall in love for at least once in your life, Daniel—well, you did and you and Carrie enjoyed several happy years together. So now I’m telling you, go back and fall in love over and over again. You love Carrie, Daniel—love always returns.” She’s a wise woman, Cat, and like me, an incurable romantic. She shares my passion for the Thirties, rainy days and sappy romances—and now, being enchanted by revisiting a lost love.

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmeMUGUekC6BKpnXjdpo7wd4ajenZmBxmAchTY72UthSnS/xlm.png 


Let’s be completely honest with each other. If you have been looking at the crypto charts this week, it impossible to miss the massive rally of Stellar (XLM), which shot up by more than 50% in a matter of days. When a token prints massive green candles, the natural human reaction is FOMO. Your hands start shaking, and you want to instantly market-buy because you are terrified of missing out on the next big train.

But hold your horses for a second! Do not run straight into the market when the price is already sitting at the very top of the canopy.

Trading cryptocurrency is identical to managing an orchard. If you only buy plant cuttings when they are fully grown and selling at premium prices, you will eventually find yourself holding a broken branch right before the harvest season ends. The \
stage for emotional buyers is pure excitement driven by greed, but the \

stage is almost always filled with regret and a portfolio stuck at the absolute peak of the market.

So, what is the actual solution to this problem? We must look closely at the objective reality behind the charts. Stellar’s sudden massive upward movement did not happen because of magic; it was driven by specific market dynamics, underlying liquidities, and broader speculation across the digital asset space. The only way to survive and thrive here is to stop chasing vertical pumps. If you train yourself to calmly analyze market corrections, locate strong support zones, and manage your risks professionally, you will gain something far better than luck: financial longevity and consistent compounding profits.

body.title: Caribbean panorama: Ultimatums and Storms (May 24–30, 2026)
body.body:
![InShot_20260422_154840996.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yecier/23uQph8nVQCdurXCWQ4zxMahzgRbpyfF6D4UEjwPXvDdyVo8ZWqCGWu7tpMRLam45o8jP.jpg)

A week of stark ultimatums and brewing storms has pushed the Caribbean deeper into a period of high-stakes uncertainty. From a collapsing energy system in Cuba to the threat of electoral chaos in Haiti and an unprecedented political standoff within CARICOM, the region is being tested on multiple fronts simultaneously.

## Cuba: Blackouts, Indictments, and a Military Shadow

Cuba’s humanitarian crisis deepened dramatically. Rolling blackouts now extend beyond 22 hours a day in several provinces, paralyzing economic life and triggering a new wave of spontaneous \

— pot-banging protests — in neighborhoods of Havana, Santiago, and Holguín. The government, in an unusual move, acknowledged that the situation is unsustainable and issued a plea for emergency fuel from Mexico and Caribbean allies.\n\nCompounding the tension, the United States has given the clearest signal yet of a possible military confrontation. A senior Pentagon official confirmed that the USS Nimitz Carrier Strike Group, already in the Caribbean, has repositioned closer to Cuban waters. While officially described as a \

Havana has interpreted the move as a direct threat linked to last week’s indictment of Raúl Castro. In response, Cuba placed its armed forces on a heightened state of alert and publicly warned that it will  *\

* Meaning that the regime will sacrifice the people to stay in power. 

## Haiti: Elections in Jeopardy as Gang Violence Surges

In Haiti, the fragile path to restoring democratic order is in serious doubt. The Provisional Electoral Council (CEP) warned this week that unless security is restored to at least 60% of the Port-au-Prince metropolitan area, the August presidential elections cannot be held. This assessment came as gang violence in Cité Soleil escalated further, with reports of over 100 people killed in turf battles since mid-May. The United Nations reported that nearly 2,000 people were newly displaced this week alone, straining already overwhelmed humanitarian resources.

## CARICOM: Trinidad and Tobago's Ultimatum Deepens the Crisis

The leadership crisis at the Caribbean Community (CARICOM) reached a breaking point. Prime Minister Kamla Persad-Bissessar of Trinidad and Tobago delivered an ultimatum to her fellow heads of government: either a new, transparent process to select the Secretary-General is initiated by June 15, or her country will suspend its participation in the bloc's statutory meetings. The deadlock, originally sparked by the reappointment of Dr. Carla Barnett in a process some deem illegitimate, now threatens to fracture the 15-member organization at a time when regional unity is most needed to face external pressures.

## Economy and Climate: A Mixed Forecast Under Darkening Skies

On the economic front, the region received sobering news. The Economic Commission for Latin America and the Caribbean revised its 2026 growth forecast downward to 2.0%, citing the combined drag of elevated oil prices, a slowdown in North American tourism demand, and the disruptive impact of the Caribbean’s ongoing instability on investor confidence. A notable exception is Guyana, whose oil-driven economy is projected to expand by an extraordinary 38% this year, further widening the income gap within the region.

Adding to the region’s woes, the National Hurricane Center confirmed the formation of Tropical Storm Beryl in the central Atlantic. Early models place several Lesser Antilles islands, including Dominica and Martinique, within its potential path for the coming week, forcing governments to activate emergency protocols even as they battle other crises.

## Puerto Rico: A Grid in Recovery Mode

In a small but significant bright spot, Puerto Rico's governor announced the energization of the first 350 megawatts of new temporary generation brought online this week, providing some relief to a population exhausted by a decade of unreliable power. The repair of the island’s fragile grid remains a marathon effort, with the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers accelerating work on storm-hardening projects ahead of the hurricane season's peak.

This week has laid bare a region in danger of fragmentation — politically, economically, and even by the forces of nature — yet still searching for collective answers to threats that no single island can face alone.

body.title: Cooking Blog: Ginisang Munggo For Our Lunch
body.body:
![Ginisang Munggo.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EouA7dhWvxwNywR1MtaT8Cj3Gd3RTTKEAeKPGnGDBfjH7mudDEZnexKkwcxV4cXw2mj.gif)
Hello, how are you? When they say Friday is Ginisang Munggo day, people mean it, but sometimes we eat it on Saturday LOL. But there is this myth that my parents said that eating Munggo at night is not good, but why, whenever there are leftovers from lunch, it is fine to eat it at dinner hahaha. I don’t get the logic sometimes, so parents are more stubborn, so we just go with the belief. Ginisang Munggo is the easiest and most budget-friendly dish to cook. Imagine this dish can feed us, here we are, five in this household. ----
Ingredients I Used:

>
  • 1 tbsp. Cooking Oil
  • 1/2 cup Meat
  • 4 Cloves Garlic
  • 1 Red Onion
  • Thumb Ginger
  • 5 Tomatoes

>
  • 2 tbsp. Fish Sauce
  • 1l of Hot Water
  • Chicken Broth Cube
  • 5 Green Chilis
  • Cup of Malunggay Leaves
  • 1 Cup Munggo
-----
Let's Cook!

> ![2.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoeFNuDdCCoc8rficw9LGvXeNhDAihFnC58eoci4gqzxdZAnCVuCmBGngEUWQihmf3i.JPG) In a pot with the Munggo, I added enough water to cover the beans, and then I boiled it until the water almost evaporated. And then I run the pot into running water, and that way it removes the skin of the bean. -----

> ![4.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EogNp4rnEsvu6pagTpbKYMGE9SZLQE9RQ7L9d9Xi1tzEpPjPAagAdWpgCerqVWDmFMf.JPG) When almost all the skin is removed, I place the pot onto the stove, and then I pour a litre of water into it to make the boiling process faster. Just let it boil for a moment. -----

> ![6.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoCjbtc34rXygmZKdLEvAj6fxiEv1VxB55XsYLxd2cM5snBsMEUugQ6SvihdcKFaBDA.JPG) In a pan, I added about a tablespoon of cooking oil, and then I am going to add the meat. -----

> ![8.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoeFTie6FpZ9DQU8WqH8fdLndCJ5qWErnz599Xc8JFgVhUZEdhVAEqgdLddg9aNMwAt.JPG) Let it cook until the texture turns crispy. The meat I used has a lot of fat on it, so I removed the excess oil from the pan. ----

> ![10.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eoc84XQcsE7uA8WFFDr5rBGiZ4ziCHZjecoDzHqWENz8amTPJAe9zfsKUp8baVfwmH4.JPG) I added the garlic, red onion, and ginger, and let it sauté until the aroma comes out. ----

> ![12.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EopuJVjS1K27v9Kn4Shn9Jjm5y9XBxf1TtSikn8crHnFTfFoWAq2ypQomAYqs1afdSk.JPG) Then I added the tomatoes, cook it until their texture of it turn in a mushy, that way it can give more color and flavor to the dish. -----

> ![14.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eos2JJMxBiBueHs4XxEcvFDbDbLXV3HxGpkH1t5EaZJJvitvy43DacU4kcUyvb5T648.JPG) Then I added two tablespoons of fish sauce and let the fish sauce seep into the tomatoes for a few seconds. ----

> ![16.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EowHXqquDSTkn67C6TPxwrcp8swgc2gerdQMkzzxJVVMDRDLsCVGv7uPr7aAwgbJ4MT.JPG) Mix everything up to incorporate all the flavors and ingredients. ----

> ![18.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoeEyRdnfhoE1Z8bJivQ1gKj84FNvZAABf12ZDoq6zMRB2ppW762XECAGPkcMxvPaXd.JPG) And then I transfer all of them into the pot of Munggo beans I am boiling earlier. ----

> ![20.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoeFKXhENHfKhEiwoJ4UZf2bYWMjrsoDfq2WmEZdHToonXivTnrx3k4jqrigHeAxvKP.JPG) When I transfer everything up, I wait for it to boil. ----

> ![23.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eoc7ziH4UkQkt8USmSSdK2KM7UG17pyoWNUUbU7dMtHY8AT1kXTqWWBhfH9D99ho2iM.JPG) And then I added one chicken broth cube and let it boil for about 15-20 minutes. It is up to you if you want a runny or thick consistency. -----

> ![25.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eoc7yiWRDmzhk55tVZrYqpDB2f6uymJecBZupgMi6eC5V5y8wPcTJjAt6bHGiyzRdAC.JPG) After that, I added the green chilis and then boil it for about 3 minutes. ----

> ![27.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eoc7wsbQ4mxv5xW3s6fb2zUpoDiXSmc75xvtKJuN5j23ycR4hRhTgXprdBCdjEwmMxC.JPG) For the final ingredient, I am going to add the malunggay leaves and cook them for about two minutes, and done! ----

> ![29.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoiVkj8nSMbBb7Br54qGPJJGBRkiTvqZvyauaXzBbfZ8Cxd5o9xdx2dxhsmk9cGg9uL.JPG) This is what it looks like. I suggest you eat it while it is still hot, that is the best time to eat it. ----

> ![32.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoEs23hrpw3zFtuBkdgntM94zooGphBURKzwADw9Ket89M3iPhJxHGCS26TCH6g6SuG.JPG) Serve hot and plated. ____ ![34.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EowHWprfDg5pmAdLXa7JwSNSX8Emq1mRDKWkZT8KMXx5pv2N78MCRMfFaotFx59pwVm.JPG) Happy eating. ----
Thank you for visiting, see you on my next blog. :D Please take care of your mental health as well. I hope you are okay today :))
----

LOL it is a 50+ year project that is not going to be finished for another few years at least... ![IMG_20260529_101457.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23ujZTT1oMZZXvSLC1baEoMpHi8t3AQntbJCaYWCt44obNJU6v9hxAdESoYWmkNhTKPT8.jpg) The trail is not even 10 miles long and I expected the hills to be way worse than they were. This is coming down to the end by the river. ![IMG_20260529_102246.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/244xpv9hSULAhYezKPAJhjBDpu8ZcDH5wNF5kxFQzZ6uMVU1wDqFUtWzozTgJQh6a3WFc.jpg) Annnnd the Spokane River. Finally managed to get this ride in. ![IMG_20260529_102637.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23y8mM8QdzZnMveMZgQNjY1BKw2gXYdewhLVKKG1GGmkZEyB1gADLcrgZKEZyP11dttqb.jpg) I wanted more miles so headed east on the Centennial trail and hit Boulder Beach right at 12.5 miles where I turned around for the ride back to the start. ![IMG_20260529_104114.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tvYD5qcLkHixZVAVsm7pBig5TpfbH7BLBYbDdBX7eK9BSoGKxTYtbBNuUpjca2QsBvo.jpg) ![IMG_20260529_104118.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tSSNRsg16LXAb2N8fm1rZRnYRQcs9mpc7CAVk7jG8trYAxNF5f8LHVx11DFD7SzTj8c.jpg) The Centennial trail runs along the Spokane river from the Idaho border down to Nine Mile Falls which is like 25+ miles one way. It is a paved path the whole way. ![IMG_20260529_104139.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23wqeDSCSbqQiwYTGk6jTqWVBFPdisQ6B7UZdQ2rVfzsb2Q8rQnjfUJUFUXFyQN3RSHfX.jpg) Rode past Minnehaha climbing area. ![IMG_20260529_104243.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/2449t4jEBitFVjQpg254iqWiLhnWuiCKsA7p79u2LGawtSk8p1YAzK4BCVe5L1uZaEheS.jpg) ![IMG_20260529_104255.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/242DDuvmrUos5tFAmUPWJ4EC22mY27wTsUmZ9kmJC1BoSJeVUPot8MQ7AuWx6PYjrnN1j.jpg) Then it was the climb back up the hill. It was a lot easier than I expected and thanks to a tail wind I was hauling ass through Hillyard. ![IMG_20260529_105150.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/244oSRqt8f8VMBJtWyBkb3fGk1JYqyQPE4mDSDWjvqiShb79WQEwEiXD541MZAhhMxvFz.jpg) Made it back to my car in pretty good time. Loaded up the bike and headed for home. ![IMG_20260529_112625.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23wzxrveq7a5qCaLDz13zDwDWRi5y7tmwDbmHkJWLB7LSJ2gMtvdy6PAU5Pcr53hT4Lme.jpg) ![bike 5-29.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tGeHemoBssZ2DhTcvUm8CksdqJToKEHvtWqB6g5L9sVt1A2zpvSqbwnK8Mmz5i89fA4.JPG) ![bike 5-29 graphs.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/EnypY88HPBGV79aGwjshR8LPkhcEghJGizD1GTmaDMsnTVdp2XYmjj3NKNXYTuJCKxZ.JPG) ![bike 5-29 stats.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23swe9aqjnKyGvZgHJ9PMfzrNsCaat3HFfCtwkDDNfVBHptdrn5gJAtB58SVis753KUp4.JPG) Quite stoked I managed PRs on a number of distances! ![bike 5-29 PR.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tGVhjLkSxMwZbh7zkif4KoG4H8NoTmomLozxDmFdm7fxJjVVGeVFgEiyRTbzUKoPBE9.JPG) So many segments! I had not realized but that was my 7th day/ride in a row... 111 mile week and my 2nd longest weekly distance so far. ![bike 5-29 PRs.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23swi68yJQvBFSrgck2G4Mw9JqKZzMvWRAeqAgfK1PL3ZVhJazMoxX5m9jSFrmuQypVcU.JPG) After getting home I devoured food then spent time working on the irrigation parts supply list and trying to design the sprinkler layout. I ended up out in the garden later and got more scapes picked. ![IMG_20260529_150915.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23wC7qztPvpKNVrCCPR7J41dDonneNk7x9opq99N7ZQrYA6LASQT6rb7Uicikz6PRdcak.jpg) Boys got home from school while I was picking and a bit later I went for a wander up the hill to check the fence line. ![IMG_20260529_154109.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/245cUKs8o6xNsRpxj4ocmajmK5uQkp7u896jusRNQymaULRo3qyo2AqcZpWUhfdCHA6Qp.jpg) In the evening I made dinner and we had more thunderstorms come rolling through but the one just spit on us as it broke apart within miles of the farm. Some thunder though that the dog went barking mad about. I took a well deserved shower after it had passed. ![IMG_20260529_191737.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23yTbBzaxUyMVUE4D2vAsBF9CocpsYNqK9ZshQHiyGSFgvLEAFzGJBHLSSX2rsGtNHAC6.jpg) ![Screenshot_20260529-191746.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tRxX9aatHrjwayvN4UNticyFAtU1eyTmjiNCK1zEep62TtW1UzPNWmzwQ5EnT6vwYmo.png) More rain inbound this morning but will be a couple hours before it hits it looks like. Giro is on now, PDC is on now, everyone else is sleeping in, then this afternoon we are going to Flight 509 as it is closing in a couple weeks, will install the cadence and speed sensors on my mtn bike so I am not swapping between bikes, work in the garden, keep up on the alpaca, and work on the irrigation planning some more. Nearing halfway to my 2500 miles/4000 K for the year! Just 76 miles left! I should do that in 3 rides at most though next week will be a bit busier so might manage it. ---

body.title: The Silverbloggers Chronicles - Prompt # 48 How did you deal with stress or heartbreak? ESP/ENG
body.body:
![Red Black Modern Cinema Movie Presentation.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23w2jFtF7iiki4xVu9xgjKwDXD8CxkXt9Viogcu12T42wCgQgKrVENMFhTmvcWUum1zHF.jpg)
(Cover designed by me in canva editor)
>Portada diseñada por mi en el editor de Canva

Wow! Dealing with stress and sadness has never been easy for me (if I'm being completely honest with you), but who has ever been able to escape both? Telling you I have a foolproof technique would be a massive lie because the truth is, my first reaction to sadness is usually to run away. But since it's something you can't escape, I end up facing it, trying to find something positive in it. Sadness is just another emotion we have to deal with; it shows us that we're human, that we can't do it alone, that we're vulnerable, and it makes us empathetic. And well, something that's been helping me a lot lately is hearing God's word. I know not everyone is a believer, but if you truly are, hearing words of encouragement, hearing prayers focused on healing and peace, and even better, hearing God's word in the Bible, is very comforting, and it has truly helped me a great deal. >¡Wow! Lidiar con el estrés y la tristeza nunca ha sido fácil para mi (si soy completamente franca con ustedes) pero ¿Quién ha podido escapar de ambos? Decirles a ustedes que tengo una técnica infalible sería una mentira del tamaño de una catedral porque la realidad es que por lo general ante la tristeza mi primera reacción es huir, aunque como es algo de lo que no se puede escapar termino enfrentándola tratando de sacar algo bueno de ella, y es que la tristeza es una emoción más con la que se tiene que lidiar, nos muestra que somos seres humanos, que no podemos solos, que somos seres vulnerables, nos vuelve empáticos. Y bueno, algo que últimamente me ha estado ayudando mucho es oír la palabra de Dios, yo sé que no todos son creyentes, pero si realmente lo eres, oír palabras de aliento, oír oraciones que están enfocadas a la sanación y la paz, y mejor aún oír la palabra de Dios es la biblia es muy reconfortante y la verdad es que me ha ayudado mucho.

![kh.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23ywnjg1MCbT45wDsfH1XJ825DEJqGMf7UnqPuRz7c3vnrvzb5piKNjSrcxtvJjEna4y5.jpg)
[Oración para Dios](https://www.youtube.com/@paradios)

As for stress, I find it a bit harder to manage. I'm not someone who can react well under stress; I feel like I lose control and inevitably release it through tears (I don't know, it's an instinctive reaction). I don't function well under pressure, and that's why I try to avoid stress. However, it's not always possible to avoid it, is it? So what to do? Well, the same thing I do when I feel sad. When I feel overwhelmed by a burden, I turn to God, I ask for guidance and direction.

>En cuanto al estrés esto me cuesta un poco más gestionarlo, no soy una persona que pueda reaccionar bajo estrés, siento que pierdo el control e inevitablemente lo dreno mediante lágrimas (no lo sé, es una reacción instintiva) no funciono bajo presión y por eso intento no exponerme al estrés, sin embargo no en todas las circunstancias se puede evitar ¿no? entonces ¿Qué hacer? pues lo mismo que hago cuando me siento triste, cuando siento que no puedo con una carga recurro a Dios, le pido orientación y guía.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23tS2tinRu2WZ77B6sCu4CvKVvDvv4S1P3zmfwdUUFHDMtHc7632j3T2S4P3XjnWFFk8f.png)
[Pixabay Autor:](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/gente-emoci%C3%B3n-dram%C3%A1tica-mujer-1492052/)

Thank you so much for reading my post! I hope you'll be encouraged to participate in these weekly #Silverbloggers activities. I'll leave a link to the original post here.

body.title: Saying Goodbye to Malapascua Island: A Bittersweet Journey Home
body.body:
>

Namaste, everyone! It's me again, @rufajane, back with another blog to share.

If you’ve been following my Malapascua Island adventures, then you already know how hard it is to leave a place that brings you so much comfort. The trip is officially over, and reality is calling us back home. Yes, you read that right—this blog is about how my very last day in Malapascua went. It’s going to be a short one, though, since our final morning on the island was a bit of a whirlwind!


![Blue Paradise Text Picture Postcard.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rufajane/23xKxeeU4ziPUpDCqNzA2PLA2JqHE93g1opzoCzDP9qM8ZR1vrKWi3Mf7JABfz18xLc5V.png)


### **The Early Morning Rush**


Because my mother is a Master Teacher, she had to be on duty on Monday morning, which meant we needed to head out early. We woke up at the crack of dawn—3:30 A.M. sharp—to pack up and get ready to leave by 5:00 A.M.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rufajane/EoK7oNfXZLAqBTH3KU8X4mpd791LjEExbUMv3EPyofZshKw82Q7oyjUGbqr89DF3tyj.png)

Fortunately, we were offered a private pumpboat, which saved us the stress of hunting for a ride so early. Since Maya Port in Daanbantayan, Cebu is only about a 30-minute boat ride away, we calculated that we’d easily make it back before my mom’s 8:00 A.M. duty hour. Plus, we had our own car waiting for us, which made the journey seamless (and let's just say, our car is pretty fast!). Still, the moment we pushed off from the shore, I already felt a pang of sadness, like a piece of me was being left behind.

### **What I’ll Miss the Most**


I truly miss how the island made me feel. Even now, whenever I look back on those days, tears come to my eyes thinking about how precious that time was. Our friends there were incredibly hospitable and went out of their way to make us feel welcome.

<div class=\

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rufajane/23wgQHcygMmPpKjQ3h155HSDanHjwb4xCb7idkqAK9MBG8G5dh2sDKPmwg8EJWmbd7Pdt.png More than anything, I miss the simple, happy moments we shared around the dinner table. Even though I don't personally eat sea urchins, just watching everyone else enjoy them so much brought a real warmth to my heart. So, if you were to ask me where I want to go for my next holiday, my answer is simple: \

body.title: The Field is Life [Channel Review] ESP/ENG
body.body:
![Black Horror Vlog Youtube Thumbnail (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/23wMU92FM3gqovCvZXGDzkbqZtno13mK1ihHZGw5qoVuBCDJSSc1AWwC777qX7c8RGHTU.jpg)
[Fuente](https://www.youtube.com/@Elcampoesvidaok)

Today I'm here to tell you about a channel I recently discovered. I actually found the content on TikTok, if I'm not mistaken, or maybe it was on Instagram. The videos were short, so I decided to look for them on YouTube to see if they had longer ones, and sure enough, I found them. The channel is called El Campo es Vida (The Countryside is Life), and as the name suggests, the content focuses on rural life. It even has a few videos about ingredients you can find in the countryside and other rural areas to make potions and infusions that serve as home remedies. There's also a pretty comprehensive, entertaining, and above all, informative video about how to tell real honey from artificial honey. However, the videos that make the biggest impact and dominate the channel are the ones focused on the paranormal. >Hoy vengo con la intención de hablarles de un canal que descubrí hace poco, realmente el contenido que yo encontré fue a través de Tik tok, si no estoy mal, o quizá fue en instagram, el caso es que el formato era corto, de modo que me propuse buscar el contenido en youtube para ver si tenía videos largos y efectivamente lo encontré, el canal se llama El Campo es Vida, y tal como su nombre lo indica el contenido va enfocado a los asuntos del campo, incluso tiene algún que otro video donde habla sobre ingredientes que se pueden encontrar en el campo y demás area rurales en general para elaborar pociones e infusiones que sirven de remedios caseros, también tiene un video bastante completo, entretenido y sobre todo informativo acerca de como diferenciar la miel real de la artificial. Sin embargo los videos que más impactan y que imperan en casi todo el canal son los que están enfocados en el tema paranormal.

![080.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/23uQJQ3XkFSknDtA8N7Z5JTA2oLYyWaQr8jRG8pji66nSA18uUXrM3q17iAneKLcGTRKe.png)
[Fuente](https://www.youtube.com/@Elcampoesvidaok)

The concept is very minimalist. Behind the narrator, you won't find elaborate sets or special effects, not even supporting images. It's simply the narrator sitting in a hammock, recounting stories that happened to his family in the countryside, or perhaps a few stories from his own subscribers. The best part, aside from the stories themselves, is his narration style, emphasizing the most important parts, respecting pauses, and even imitating characters' voices and using onomatopoeia to enhance the narrative. I think this style feels more personal, more intimate, as if you were listening to a live story from a family member or friend.

>El concepto es muy minimalista, detrás del narrador no vas a encontrar una gran escenografía ni tampoco efectos especiales, ni siquiera hay imágenes de apoyo, es simplemente el narrador sentado en una hamaca mientras cuenta historias que le ocurrieron a su familia en el campo o quizá alguna que otra historia de sus propios suscriptores. Lo mejor de todo, a parte de lo interesante de las historias, es la manera en que él hace la narración, haciendo énfasis en las partes más importantes, respetando las pausas e incluso imitando voces de personajes y haciendo onomatopeyas para enfatizar la narrativa. Pienso que este estilo es más personal, más cercano, como si estuvieses escuchando una historia en vivo y en directo de algún familiar o amigo tuyo.
![kño.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/23tSMiVXSkV9HVsn1A6miVSSoeU5a6HFXY4iVFApppcrNrsgTaJGzpeAqc6NgPkFFwBzM.jpg)
[Fuente](https://www.youtube.com/@Elcampoesvidaok)

The video that scared me the most is one about a man riding a horse at night through the mountains. Suddenly, he heard a baby crying, or at least what sounded like a baby. He put it on his back and continued on his way. From the moment he picked up the baby, he noticed the horse becoming restless. Then the supposed baby started behaving very erratically and inappropriately for a child its age. It spoke, saying it had a tail and points, and in an adult tone of voice. To top it all off, it transformed into a hideous creature that crawled back into the mountains. However, what makes each story terrifying is the emphasis he gives to every word, the focus and passion of his narration, the tone of voice that changes depending on the character—everything. I, at least, find it very interesting.

>El video que más me dio miedo es uno sobre un hombre que iba a caballo de noche por una montaña, de pronto escuchó a un bebé llorar, o lo que al menos parecía un bebé, entonces lo subió sobre su espalda y continuó el camino, aunque desde el mismo momento en que tomó al bebé, él notó que el caballo se empezó a poner inquieto, sin embargo después el supuesto bebé empezó a tener un comportamiento muy errático e impropio de un niño de su edad, hablaba diciendo que tenía cola y puntas, y además con un tono de voz adulto, y para colmo se convirtió en una criatura espantosa que se fue arrastrando hacia el monte. No obstante lo que vuelve aterradora cada historia es el énfasis que él le da a cada palabra, el enfoque y la pasión de su narración, el tono de voz que va cambiando según el personaje, todo, de verdad que a mi al menos me resulta muy interesante.
https://youtu.be/Sd4Me9ZrtEo
[Fuente](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Sd4Me9ZrtEo)

I think there should be more channels like these that connect us a little more to our roots. I don't know what country the man in the videos is from, but regardless of where he is, he reminds us that stories are similar in all countries. Grandparents and other older people who live or have lived in rural environments are always wary and cautious, and they never refuse advice, especially to skeptics from the city. >Pienso que debería existir más canales como estos que nos conecten un poco más a nuestras raíces, yo ignoro de que país es el hombre que aparece en los videos, pero independientemente de donde sea nos hace recordar que las historias son similares en todos los países, los abuelos y demás personas mayores que viven o han vivido en entornos rurales siempre suelen ser desconfiados y precavidos, además jamás niegan un consejo, en especial a los escépticos de la ciudad.

![khk.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/Eo4A7FntKwJTyUNqe6Xnwgbddaxfe8TsaMk8DY1vuaygpDDBBzyLfEWpMNAn7s7DSdD.jpg)
[Fuente](https://www.youtube.com/@Elcampoesvidaok)

Well, with nothing more to add for now, I'll say goodbye, sending you virtual kisses and hugs.

>Bueno, sin nada más que agregar por ahora me despido enviándoles besos y abrazos virtuales.
![_Miniatura de Youtube Procrastinación Simple Dorado y Crema.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/245n5WzTfDjt8QuC1CfX1iGPu5crq9bsYhnHjwPHUAnBL93vKUMEPGEND9gUCyLLvHj4k.jpg)

body.body:
![Un día en mi vida Miniatura de YouTube Amarillo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23tmBC5efmP4x9bYcfP5cQPsdrDtR2qCNCGNQiqyYV4RRgnn3xgmiZEhCqZhA6uKEMTTj.jpg)

Hello everyone! How are you? Today I'm excited to answer the questionnaire because I'm really interested in this week's questions. >¡Hola Hola, gente de internet! ¿Cómo están? hoy me dispongo a responder el cuestionario con mucha emoción porque me llaman mucho la atención las preguntas para esta semana.

1️⃣ What is your favorite safe heaven for relaxation and why?

>¿Cuál es tu paraíso seguro favorito para relajarte y por qué?

My favorite place to relax has always been the beach because the sound of the waves is like a balm that washes away your worries. When you put your feet in the water (as long as it's not cold), it feels like a caress from nature, a reminder that God is there to comfort us and that everything will be alright if we leave our affairs in His hands. Besides, the sight of the waves crashing against the shore and how the sky and sea meet on the horizon is simply mesmerizing. My particular favorite time is sunset because of the way the orange light of the sun looks on the water and the pink and lilac clouds around it.

>Mi lugar favorito para relajarme siempre ha sido la playa porque el sonido de las olas es como un bálsamo que sirve para llevarse tus preocupaciones, cuando metes los pies en ele agua (siempre y cuando no esté fría) puedes sentir como si fuese una caricia de la naturaleza, un recordatorio de que Dios está ahí para reconfortarnos y que todo estará bien si dejamos nuestros asuntos en sus manos, además la visión de las olas rompiendo contra la playa y como el cielo y el mar se juntan en el horizonte es simplemente fascinante. Mi momento específico favorito es el ocaso por como se ve la luz naranja del sol en el agua y las nubes color rosa y lila a su alrededor.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23wMewXB9dGTx9c8ZYLT4a1dWYWbUPK2bMUyvQcM43Cj19yCQq53ejcoohDbwjdwfS3T5.png)
[Fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/mar-atardecer-bote-amanecer-4747601/)

2️⃣ If you could swap lives with a famous person, who would it be, and why?

>Si pudieras intercambiar vidas con un personaje famoso, ¿quién sería y por qué?

I think if I could choose a character to swap my life with, at least for a day, regardless of whether the character is fictional or a real-life personality, I think I would choose Luna Lovegood from Harry Potter. I would love to have her knack for stating facts without caring what others think. She is frank, objective, practical, and direct, like few people truly are. Furthermore, she sees far beyond the obvious and is not afraid of judgment. She doesn't care if they call her \

; she simply does what she wants, dresses how she wants, and says what she wants.

\n\n>Creo que si yo pudiera elegir a un personaje para intercambiar mi vida, al menos no sé, por un día, sin importar si el personaje es de ficción o una personalidad de la vida real, creo que elegiría a Luna Lovegood de Harry Potter, me encantaría tener su facilidad para tirar factos sin importarle el que dirán, ella es franca, objetiva, practica y directa, como pocas personas lo son en realidad, además ella ve mucho más allá de lo evidente, siempre y no teme a los juicios, no le importa que la llamen \

simplemente hace lo que quiere, viste como quiere y dice lo que quiere.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23wMRvDWp7aYaTYjyZXFyD3NNASxziCh4uRYnJjgY7wv4rD3dcL2MLHvQPZuEJ2nHDH1t.png)
[Fuente](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/539728336602468282/)

And well, people, that's all for today's post, I hope you liked it. Thank you very much as always for supporting my work, I welcome new readers, I love you all very much, I send you a hug and I'll see you in another post.

>Y bueno, gente, esto ha sido todo por el post de hoy, espero que les haya gustado. Muchas gracias como siempre por apoyar mi trabajo, le doy la bienvenida a los nuevos lectores, les quiero mucho a todos, les envío un abrazo y ya nos encontraremos en otro post

.\n\n- Iran w dalszym ciągu nie podziela tego entuzjazmu. Rzecznik irańskiego MSZ powiedział, że Teheran stanowczo odrzuca język ultimatum i określenia mówiące, że Iran \

dwa drony MQ-9 Reaper. Według informacji podawanych przez Teheran, jeden z takich dronów miał też zostać zestrzelony w zeszłym tygodniu nad terytorium Iranu.

body.title: César se estanca
body.body:
<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYqwHXGNkBbuNXazUd2Ne1mgAHNYY7Sr38kaF6JM3V8BY/20260530_092115.jpg)<sub>[X](https://x.com/i/status/1961408547595427963)<sub><center>

---
César Prieto ha sido bajado nuevamente a la sucursal de Triple A de Los Cardenales de St. Louis. La desición fue tomada hace pocas horas, después de que el cienfueguero no pudo conectar ni siquiera un hit en 17 turnos que le fueron concedidos.

César llevaba par de semanas activado por los Cardenales, pero no me había pronunciado al respecto, esperando a que las cosas les fueran bien. De esta manera lo resaltaría en nuestra plataforma, como ya lo hemos hecho con otros peloteros debutantes.

Esta segunda vez en las Mayores, logró conectar varios batazos con poder, pero la buena defensa de los rivales impidió que saliera del bache ofensivo. Así las cosas, el telón bajó para César por ahora. No creo que sea el final para él, y espero tener la razón. No me imagino la barrera psicológica que debe tener ahora mismo en su mente, pero  ante las derrotas, la mejor solución para los seres humanos es no rendirse, y seguir trabajando por mejorar, mientras existan posibilidades, claro está.

Creo que un cambio de equipo le vendría bien. Otra vez vuelvo con la cantaleta, pero es posible que algún otro equipo haya visto algo en César que los Cardenales no vieron, además de que un nuevo comienzo puede ser suficiente para despegar al fin.

Otras figuras como José Adolis García y Randy Arozarena pertenecieron a esta misma organización, y una vez salieron de allí, explotaron como dinamita. El caso más interesante fue el de Adolis. No sé, tal vez hay algo sobrenatural en St Louis que impide a los cubanos brillar allí. Ya veremos si César logra romper esa maldición en otro momento. Ahora tiene que trabajar.
