body.title: 【大阪】🏨 Toyoko Inn Osaka Namba Nippombashi
body.body:
在还没去大阪之前，我上 ᴀɢᴏᴅᴀ 物色了多间酒店，发现在大阪的酒店价格都蛮贵的，平均都得 500 多马币。 这次我和米特到大阪游玩，米特对酒店是有要求的，他不想要公共浴室，所以必须选有浴室的酒店房间，还要求要有浴缸的。 我在 ᴀɢᴏᴅᴀ 里面发现了一家连锁酒店，貌似整个大阪地图里到处都有他们家的身影。 ---
**大阪五天四夜之旅
18/5/2026 - 22/5/2026**
--- 这次出行，我选的酒店是 ……
**东横INN大阪难波日本桥**
![Toyoko Inn Osaka Namba Nippombashi](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/EqDj5C8qfaQTCetVgL3b6tBJU5QF2XhFqwmqaxcecFqfi694vBKryEh67XV17Rab2sF.jpeg) **Toyoko Inn** (东横INN／東横イン) 是日本很有名的连锁商务酒店，主打：便宜、靠近车站、包免费早餐，日本全国几乎到处都有。 我就是看中他们家的超高性价比才选了 **Toyoko Inn** 为我第一次旅游日本的酒店。为什么？因为两个字：省钱！ 中午 12 点抵达酒店，这时间可以办理入住手续，只是拿房卡需要等到下午 3 点，但是可以先寄存行李再出去玩。 | ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/23wX1RDkGuJDYybuXBKP2WoEF1aiy7fgCwrnWvxGPLBjW6jLSPiMA5fPyuXS3ARNmACgF.jpeg) | ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/23w2qMJKMcUr4t7X8NK5XBCDW8j7rdYraB3usDPg6z4BrrUcznYZvQUDzdMCNxZ7GYeTK.jpeg) | |-|-| |
电梯
|
走廊
| 下午 3 点前我们就回来酒店拿房卡和行李上楼了，我们被安排的酒店房间在 12 楼，搭电梯上楼。日本的电梯门竟然是这种带透明玻璃的，好新奇。走廊也很干净卫生…… 来到房间门口，敲三下门表示尊敬，然后滴卡开门，米特推啊推，门就是不开，最后才发现原来门是“拉”的…… ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/EorzuPr4eR5jYda8VjKzBwNSqTKZKdyCMUNe5f1ZTaKQSUQLDchyRkADeRDjkMQaLbo.jpeg) 大床房，大床靠墙，有窗户，阳光正明媚…… ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/EonmsTcnTUE4PZRsdXyMXPSjzo8SsV4EMLBGhvKsf7zZPGYgsk47tYdhMc7BCqsooWP.jpeg) 这是面相门的方向…… ## 浴室 首先我们来看看浴室…… | ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/23zbMtZrqLfx7sGnyzXehshUAH9ZwZo6dgTbjwFC4rAnoPoFafspAKKZhd2WSpuUM45Vw.jpeg) | ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/23xVGvbzvXMWgdpsySCtP4AvZwRhYCYx3vgFbXTqThUZMiyP7KzmbeDFagcyrFXYQ7PkX.jpeg) | |-|-| 浴室没有干湿分离，是一体式的，有智能马桶、洗手盆、花洒和浴缸。米特爱死这浴缸了，每天都要在里面泡半小时。 ### 看看浴室有什么配置： * **浴巾** (两条) * **面巾** (两条) * **抹脚布** (一条) * **一次性牙刷牙膏和洗手液** ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/EoK7qkx2n1T4QRXt5CjbgBZtWKiXJqdmxYU73HYd5gJG8uVV9zfmxBRpGKBG3FkcXcf.jpeg) * **沐浴露 洗发露 护发素** ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/EonmW3VuA8VVdCBKMoMUh9ZRXWu34HThgCfiMDN4WAYGd2WSr45Lx6F5C5Qe9xqH9yt.jpeg) ### 再看看房内设施： * **垃圾桶** ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/EpVC1o7LZJ5mXjTMbmebQj17TMK4VphGdUSK4gcq4jdF29b1hcp4LoUro8JLaLqLGC5.jpeg) 早就知道日本要做垃圾分类，来到看到有两个垃圾桶还真不意外。 * **小冰箱** ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/Eoc84XdD9LcNqcYUX1QhFyuteELgxW3t5NknrZxhhvWNeqJ96zc9ychL1xmHtKhyPqm.jpeg) 每天在便利店买的饮料都能往里塞。 * **吹风机** ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/EonmvGv4KbgdsHNfA7PCxpy39agco4r8dysiJxAYscwy4chwoEZXk7TtN6qioA7Dksf.jpeg) 风力不够我宿舍的吹风机大，但吹干头发还是比较快的。 * **热水壶** ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/EoeFTiGRGvEBHLkenK9zwdz4o8aK6mwshAKxdMR6eTJ8tBXjZKravUPE2SCqdBm5YUX.jpeg) 听说日本的水龙头里的水是可以直接煲来喝的，真的吗？我没敢试…… * **电视机** ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/Ep3fHJEXm9VUKhfcP6abEQRni8KytNcnDxfiKVAcjQCDAaz8izHVL8vRShGYH9Wd1Z6.jpeg) 电视只有免费电视台看，想另外看单片电影就要付费，我翻着翻着发现还有小黄片，当然也是要付费啦！ * **空调** ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/EoEsPnqMibEedbjQgH3T1nXHbVc6Gz5aEofgUSLwHW1ogqdWokmhAdJGkFQTVREUHYN.jpeg) 果然国外的空调都有制热功能，遥控器上写着冷或热的汉字，米特不会看就乱按，幸好他没按错制热功能。 ## 早餐 **Toyoko Inn** 酒店只要订房就默认包早餐，早餐时间是 06:30 - 09:00 * **饮料** ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48Z6nhFqB4X3mNvuZmh38UHSZLzu5VQcbG2D8tmCkq1GevgoWictSNGXVLNXfPeF7h.jpeg) ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48ikG69vHSWTFCnqnHA6SmVHGUHWdoLGkmRpVqtaroCAgnnuQ1p6iw2Np9fi7Av1sx.jpeg) 有咖啡、热茶、冷茶 * **食物** ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48TKQXq1Dsxzst5UoLndibP9R4W2bp2VBZVqPw56eSCr2nNj1H5Gfi7V7MkCLUbMwE.jpeg) ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48ToMAhaodp2W1BiV4xZbFZH41oiEb7iYP18JXUhkFph94U9ytRYouLgucCGXbYXmB.jpeg) ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48ZaxLxnuTVwDc61t7ycecL5vRx2o6vkkQ9EBWzmshGAuyjdiYSmnNQjctFahZjuzf.jpeg) ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48gL2iTceo1i6eBaGzNuKgsBQh5PzK84X88JschQMVrtUnu4anKLpXgWGvvLUcBxSU.jpeg) ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48PwnVpWgLMTaNBW4C5Seh35Rrc1FhFac81x5YcqFnStpzkLQHWmWSUtW6qbNmEpvn.jpeg) 日式早餐还有简单的西式早餐…… 那个打饭机还真让我长见识了，碟子一放，按个按键，饭就自动从机器里面“吐”出来，好有趣！ 更有趣的是早餐有“章鱼烧”吃！ ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48TosqvcXxNjSBG9VRyKNDPYuqXuc7z6tCdkJG6UExoCmDAWsMWU3V984uj1knyzc4.jpeg) 早餐：日式咖喱饭、香肠、章鱼烧、蛋卷、炸鸡块、蘑菇汤、味增汤，再加一杯咖啡。 酒店是我在 ᴀɢᴏᴅᴀ 预订的…… ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/Eo4Jo4pzagCesXLTyQY432ysddyEkAVwWiEFTUuAFWW1Up1N38tqYnejL2nDPh9U5Zi.jpeg) **价格：马币 RM910.42** 五天四夜人均 450++ 有没有很香？

Slayer

Slayer, an undeniable Titan of American metal, emerged from Huntington Park, California, in 1981. Formed by guitarists Kerry King and Jeff Hanneman, drummer Dave Lombardo, and bassist/vocalist Tom Araya, the group initially honed their skills on heavy metal covers before defining their own, far more aggressive sound. Their collaboration with Metal Blade Records, beginning with a compilation appearance and self-financed debut, quickly generated underground buzz, positioning them at the forefront of the burgeoning thrash metal scene. Their commitment to relentless speed, uncompromising brutality, and visually provocative themes solidifying their status with the 1986 landmark album, Reign in Blood, often cited as a definitive extreme metal masterpiece.  
Widely recognized as one of the \

of thrash metal alongside Metallica, Megadeth, and Anthrax, Slayer carved a unique, unsettling niche within the genre. While their peers often experimented with melodic or technical elements, Slayer never strayed from their ferocious core, characterized by fast tremolo picking, chaotic, complex guitar solos, lightning-fast double bass drumming, and Tom Araya’s piercing screams. Their lyrical content, consistently exploring grim, controversial topics such as death, war, and the occult, coupled with inverted crosses and spikes, cemented their reputation as the most intense and unrelenting band in the lineup. Despite massive commercial success and multiple Grammy wins, Slayer maintained their raw, unfiltered sound until their final tour, leaving an immortal legacy and an indelible imprint on the heavy metal genre.

---


Here's what eBay had to say about one of these guitar picks 

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/1d9610a9-4e3b-4be3-9dd7-97194d0a2300.jpg)

---
---

This collection is a remarkable physical record of rock history, featuring a diverse array of guitar picks gathered from some of the most legendary North American tours. Each piece represents a specific moment in time, coming directly from the hands of the most influential touring bands of the last 20 to 40 years. From the thrash metal precision of Megadeth to the grunge-era icons like Eddie Vedder, these picks are more than just gear—they are tangible artifacts from the high-energy arenas and stadiums that defined a generation of music.
The significance of these picks lies in their connection to the peak of live performance culture across the continent. Over the past four decades, touring reached a massive scale, and these picks were used by artists who headlined the most iconic festivals and venues in the world. Whether it's a specialty \

design or a classic tour-stamped plectrum, having items from bands that shaped the sound of the 80s, 90s, and 2000s makes this a curated chronicle of modern rock’s touring legac. I'm putting this guitar pic together. Alphabetical order over the next few weeks and months. --- ---

body.title: L’expansió del xacal daurat a Europa: el nou predador adaptable
body.body:
El **xacal daurat** (*Canis aureus*), també conegut com a xacal comú, és un cànid de mida mitjana originari de regions d’Àsia i del sud-est d’Europa. Històricament present de manera marginal als Balcans, ha experimentat una de les expansions més ràpides i espectaculars entre els mamífers europeus en les darreres dècades. Avui es considera un símbol de la resiliència ecològica en un continent marcat pel canvi humà i climàtic.

### Un immigrant que conquereix el continent

Fa mig segle, el xacal daurat estava restringit principalment a zones costaneres del Mediterrani i la Mar Negra al sud-est europeu. Des dels anys 1950-1960, però, ha iniciat una expansió cap a l’oest, el nord i el centre del continent. Actualment es troba en més de 30 països europeus, amb poblacions estables en almenys 20 d’ells. S’ha registrat des dels Balcans fins a països bàltics, Alemanya, França, Itàlia, Àustria, Polònia i fins i tot observacions aïllades a Escandinàvia.

A la Península Ibèrica, la presència és encara puntual però significativa: s’han confirmat registres a Àlava (2023) i un exemplar filmat a prop de Saragossa (2024), fet que obre el debat sobre una possible colonització futura.

### Causes de l’expansió “silenciosa”

Diversos factors impulsen aquest avanç:

- **Declivi del llop**: La persecució històrica del llop (*Canis lupus*) ha creat buits ecològics que el xacal, com a mesopredador, omple fàcilment. Allà on els llops disminueixen, els xacals augmenten. L’activitat humana actua com a “escut” contra els llops, protegint els xacals en zones humanitzades.

- **Canvi climàtic i paisatge**: Hiverns més suaus, paisatges fragmentats, agricultura intensiva i disponibilitat de deixalles faciliten la dispersió i supervivència.

- **Alta adaptabilitat**: Omnívor oportunista, s’alimenta de rosegadors, conills, fruits, carronya i residus humans. És capaç de viure en boscos, zones agrícoles, zones periurbanes i fins i tot prop de grans ciutats.

- **Capacitat de dispersió**: Els individus joves poden recórrer grans distàncies, cosa que accelera la colonització.

Un estudi recent publicat a *Nature Ecology & Evolution* prediu que el xacal daurat podria ocupar fins al **75% del territori europeu** (uns 2,4 milions de km²), especialment zones de la Península Ibèrica com Portugal i Espanya.

### Impactes ecològics i socials

L’arribada del xacal genera oportunitats i reptes. Positivament, ajuda a controlar poblacions de rosegadors i altres plagues. Negativament, pot competir amb guineus, gats feréstecs i altres predadors autòctons, i ocasionalment predar sobre animals domèstics petits.

A diferència del llop, el xacal és més discret i tolerant a la presència humana, cosa que facilita la seva integració en paisatges modificats. Això planteja qüestions de gestió: cal tractar-lo com a espècie invasora o com a part de la nova biodiversitat de l’Antropocè?

### Perspectives de futur

Amb la seva intel·ligència, reproducció ràpida i plasticitat ecològica, el xacal daurat sembla destinat a consolidar-se com una espècie permanent a gran part d’Europa. Els científics recomanen un monitoratge estricte, programes de detecció precoç i estratègies de convivència que minimitzin conflictes amb l’activitat ramadera i humana.

L’expansió del xacal daurat recorda la del coiot a Nord-amèrica: animals mitjans que aprofiten els canvis provocats pels humans per conquerir nous territoris. Europa, amb la seva densitat de població i diversitat de paisatges, ofereix un escenari idoni per a aquesta nova pàgina de la història natural.

La natura no para de canviar. El xacal daurat ens recorda que, en un món en transformació, la flexibilitat és la millor estratègia de supervivència.

Hola amigos de #Liketu, desde que comencé en este mundo acostumbro a hacer fotos en momentos especiales para compartirlos después pero algunas veces me complico por el tema Electricidad y conexión y me demoro en subir las fotos y hasta olvido que están ahí y voy acumulando y acumulando jjj y hoy mientras pasaba el tiempo en apagón encontré las que les comparto hoy. 

Estas fotos las hice hace par de meses, comiendo una de mis frutas preferidas ***guayaba***, su objetivo principal era dar envidia jjj a una persona que aunque no es su fruta preferida teníamos la costumbre de enviarnos fotos de alimentos que nos gustan o todo lo contrario. Por ese motivo saqué mi mejor sonrisa \

🤣🤣  y posé como si mi vida dependiera de ello.

Al final nunca llegué a enviar esa foto🥹 y quedó en mi galería hasta que volví a verla y decido compartirlas con ustedes, para los que les gusten y los que no 🤭. Solo puedo decirles que estaba riquísima y ojalá tuviera un saco🤪.

Saludos y bendiciones 😊

______
______



 Hey #Liketu friends, since I started in this world I've made a habit of taking photos of special moments to share later, but sometimes I run into problems with electricity and internet connection, and it takes me a while to upload the photos, and I even forget they're there, and they just keep piling up, haha. And today, while I was passing the time during a power outage, I found the ones I'm sharing with you today.

 I took these photos a couple of months ago, eating one of my favorite fruits, ***guava***. Their main purpose was to make someone jealous, haha. Even though guava isn't their favorite fruit, we had a habit of sending each other photos of foods we like, or the complete opposite. That's why I put on my best \

smile 🤣🤣 and posed like my life depended on it. 

I never ended up sending that photo 🥹 and it stayed in my gallery until I saw it again and decided to share it with you all, for those who like it and those who don't 🤭. All I can say is it was delicious and I wish I had a jacket 🤪. 

Best regards and blessings 😊

Siento los sabores del olvido 
el aire fresco de la tempestad infinita
algo renace entre los dientes 
son los antiguos zapatos del misterio 
un hechizo perdido entre deseos 
el pudor de una madre al descender 
entre las espinas del destierro.
Nada apaga mi luz 
las nubes abundan fértiles 
entre los rayos y las voces 
de piedra es el camino 
de mármol la razón antes quebrada 
Dejo de existir 
me salva la lluvia del deshielo
la verdad oculta entre tinieblas 
y el deseo de palpitar 
en los avatares del tiempo.

body.title: The Rise of Mobile Applications in Digital Entertainment
body.body:
The Rise of Mobile Applications in Digital Entertainment 



Mobile applications have completely transformed the digital entertainment industry. What once required desktop computers and complicated software installations can now be accessed instantly through smartphones. Mobile apps have become one of the most important innovations in digital technology, attracting millions of users globally. The main reason for the popularity of mobile apps is convenience. Users can now access content and services anytime and anywhere without relying on traditional desktop devices. Whether traveling, relaxing at home, or following live events, mobile apps provide instant entertainment directly from a handheld device. 



Modern applications offer a huge variety of content and features. Interactive games, live streaming, social networking, multimedia platforms, educational tools, and entertainment services are all available through mobile platforms. This diversity helps developers attract users with different interests and preferences. Technology has significantly improved the quality of mobile experiences. 

Advanced graphics, responsive interfaces, and smooth performance now allow smartphone users to enjoy experiences similar to those available on desktop platforms. Live interactive content is especially popular within mobile applications. Real-time video streaming technology allows users to engage with creators, participate in events, and access entertainment directly from mobile devices. Artificial intelligence is beginning to influence mobile systems as well. AI tools help personalize recommendations, improve customer support, and detect unusual account activity for additional security. 



Mobile applications also focus heavily on fast payments and account management. Secure digital wallets, instant transactions, and simplified account systems improve the overall user experience. Streaming culture has further accelerated the popularity of mobile apps. Many users enjoy watching creators broadcast live content directly through social media and streaming platforms as [pinup app](https://pinup-bets-bd.com/mobile/). The growth of digital currencies and blockchain technology has also influenced mobile application development. Some apps now support cryptocurrency transactions, creating faster and more flexible payment systems. User well-being tools are increasingly integrated into mobile platforms. Screen-time controls, activity tracking, and personalized settings help encourage healthier and more balanced digital habits. 



Security remains a major priority for developers. Modern apps use encryption systems, biometric login options, and advanced authentication technologies to protect personal and personal information. Competition between technology companies continues driving innovation. Developers constantly improve app performance, visual design, and user features to attract new audiences and maintain engagement. Virtual reality may eventually reshape the future of mobile applications. Advanced mobile hardware could support immersive digital environments and interactive experiences directly through smartphones. 



The global expansion of internet access and mobile technology continues fueling industry growth. Millions of users are expected to adopt new mobile applications and digital services in the coming years. In conclusion, mobile applications have become a central part of modern digital entertainment. Their accessibility, technological innovation, and interactive features continue transforming how users experience online content and services worldwide.


---

body.title: 🎼 Reflexión: «La Soledad» (ESP/ENG)
body.body:
> ✳️ Saludos cordiales, hivers de @holos-lotus espacio para **el crecimiento personal y desarrollo del Ser.** ***
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcgEMWNuoP6Zaaouivp3sWGTpLdvMiKuN6czJQPHm3aB8/1780146633319.jpg) [UNSPLASH](https://unsplash.com/es/fotos/una-mujer-con-un-vestido-blanco-con-las-manos-en-el-aire-3XBvRHVCg6s)
***

>

Pablo Milanés lo dijo cantando. La soledad no es gris. No es pequeña. No es esa cosa triste que la gente evita. Es un pájaro grande. Y multicolor. Grande porque ocupa espacio. Cuando llega la soledad de verdad, no se puede ignorar. Está ahí. Te mira. Te respira encima. La mayoría huye. Ponen música. Llaman a alguien. Abren diez pestañas en el navegador. Cualquier cosa para no ver al pájaro. Pero el pájaro no se va. Solo cambia de forma. No se va porque tiene algo que decirte. Y tú no quieres escucharlo. Prefieres el ruido. Todos prefieren el ruido. 

Es multicolor porque no es una sola emoción. A veces es azul cielo y lastima suave. A veces es rojo y da rabia. A veces es amarillo y de repente escribes algo que no sabías que llevabas dentro. A veces es verde y crece algo nuevo en medio del silencio. El problema no es la soledad. El problema es que nos enseñaron a tenerle miedo. Nos enseñaron que estar solo es fracasar. Que hay que estar acompañado siempre. Que el silencio es enemigo. No se le tiene miedo. Se la mira. Se la nombra. Se aprende qué colores tiene hoy. Porque cambian. Como cambia el cielo. Como cambia uno. Uno siempre cambia.

Hay una diferencia enorme entre estar solo y sentirse solo. Estar solo es un hecho. No hay nadie en la habitación. Fin. 

Sentirse solo es otra cosa. Se puede sentir soledad en medio de una fiesta. Se puede sentir compañía estando completamente solo. Eso lo sabe cualquiera que haya leído un libro bueno o escuchado una canción que le atraviesa. El pájaro grande y multicolor no es enemigo. Es maestro. Pero maestro estricto. No te enseña nada si corres. Te enseña cuando te quedas. Cuando te sientas y dices: \

Ahora qué es la pregunta difícil. La que no tiene respuesta fácil. Ahora qué es silencio. Y en ese silencio, escuchas lo que siempre estuvo ahí. Esa voz que no es voz. Esa idea que no tenía forma. Ese permiso para ser sin tener que mostrar nada a nadie. Pablo Milanés no escribió una canción triste. Escribió una canción verdadera. Porque la soledad bien vivida no es vacío. Es vuelo. El pájaro no está enjaulado. Está en el aire. Y sus colores no son para asustar. Son para recordarte que sentir es humano. Y que sentirse solo, de vez en cuando, es necesario. No todo el tiempo. Pero de vez en cuando sí. Si hoy tu soledad es azul cielo, déjala ser azul cielo. Si es roja, no la tapes. Si tiene todos los colores mezclados y no sabes cómo se llama eso, quédate un rato más. El pájaro se irá solo. Pero volverá. Y cuando vuelva, ya sabrás recibirlo. Porque la soledad no se mata. Se integra. Como todo en esta comunidad de es-holos lotus. Como todo en la vida. La vida es dura a veces. La soledad también. Pero una y otra están hechas de los mismos colores. Los que tú elijas ver. **© Marabuzal, 2026. Contenido Original. Todos los derechos reservados.** ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVDUKVA6YugQdRrhGACmnps8ddBkV8W6UwGEo9DwaNQxF/1768408479017.jpg) ***
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcgEMWNuoP6Zaaouivp3sWGTpLdvMiKuN6czJQPHm3aB8/1780146633319.jpg) [UNSPLASH](https://unsplash.com/es/fotos/una-mujer-con-un-vestido-blanco-con-las-manos-en-el-aire-3XBvRHVCg6s)
*** **🎼 Reflection: «Loneliness» (ESP/ENG)**
> ✳️ Warm greetings, hivers of @holos-lotus, a space for **personal growth and self-development.**

>

Pablo Milanés said it in song. Loneliness isn't gray. It isn't small. It isn't that sad thing people avoid. It's a big bird. And multicolored. Big because it takes up space. When true loneliness arrives, you can't ignore it. It's there. It looks at you. It breathes down your neck. Most people run away. They put on music. They call someone. They open ten tabs in their browser. Anything to avoid seeing the bird. But the bird doesn't leave. It only changes shape. It doesn't leave because it has something to tell you. And you don't want to hear it. You prefer noise. Everyone prefers noise.

It's multicolored because it isn't just one emotion. Sometimes it's sky blue and it hurts gently. Sometimes it's red and it makes you angry. Sometimes it's yellow and suddenly you write something you didn't know you had inside. Sometimes it's green and something new grows in the silence. The problem isn't loneliness. The problem is that we were taught to fear it. We were taught that being alone is failing. That you always have to be accompanied. That silence is the enemy. You don't fear it. You look at it.  It is named. One learns what colors it has today. Because they change. Like the sky changes. Like one changes. One is always changing.

There is a huge difference between being alone and feeling alone. Being alone is a fact. There is no one in the room. End of story.

Feeling alone is something else. You can feel lonely in the middle of a party. You can feel companionship while completely alone. Anyone who has read a good book or heard a song that moves them knows this. The large, multicolored bird is not an enemy. It is a teacher. But a strict teacher. It doesn't teach you anything if you run. It teaches you when you stay. When you sit and say: \

Now what is the difficult question. The one with no easy answer. Now what is silence. And in that silence, you hear what was always there. That voice that is not a voice. That idea that had no form. That permission to be without having to show anything to anyone. Pablo Milanés didn't write a sad song. He wrote a true song. Because solitude well lived is not emptiness. It is flight. The bird isn't caged. It's in the air. And its colors aren't meant to frighten you. They're meant to remind you that feeling is human. And that feeling alone, from time to time, is necessary. Not all the time. But sometimes, yes. If today your loneliness is sky blue, let it be sky blue. If it's red, don't cover it up. If it has all the colors mixed together and you don't know what to call it, stay a little longer. The bird will fly away on its own. But it will return. And when it returns, you'll know how to welcome it. Because loneliness isn't killed. It's integrated. Like everything in this community of holos lotus. Like everything in life. Life is hard sometimes. Loneliness is too. But both are made of the same colors. The ones you choose to see. This one surprised me. BTC expected volatility dropped to its lowest level in 9 months. Some people see this as the calm before the storm — either way up or way down. The market is basically holding its breath right now.

If you had leveraged positions — ouch again. Nearly a billion dollars in crypto positions got liquidated when bitcoin slipped to that six-week low around $73K. Michael van de Poppe says its just a cooldown tho. Take that as you will.

This could be huge. The SEC Chair announced that Trump is going to sign a crypto market structure bill soon. More regulatory clarity means more institutional money flowing in. Thats been the missing piece for along time.

**My take**

We sitting in this weird quiet period where everything feels uncertain but the building blocks are all falling into place. The people who accumulate during these boring sideways markets are usually the ones smiling later.

What you all think — ready for the next leg up or still waiting? 👇

body.title: [ESP/ENG] Contraseñas: entre la infancia y el mundo digital
body.body:
**Una introducción necesaria** 

@palabras1 me invitó a participar en esta iniciativa que mucho agradezco porque hace algunos días tuve un encuentro laboral en el que tratamos el tema de la seguridad de las contraseñas a raíz de un hackeo que le hicieron auna compañera nuestra y le llevaron gran parte de su capital.

En ese intercambio hablamos de muchos temas, pero, yo abordé parte de ideas que quiero compartir con ustedes, sobre las contry las relaciones personales.

Antes de continuar, invito a @ericvancewalton y a @palomap3 para que nos dejen sus impresiones en toro a este tema.



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTdppGgEZGeggxYgmkTVaVxeLGPF1KiRbhsA95fCZkL51/1779999765042.jpg)[fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/inicio-de-sesi%C3%B3n-clave-seguridad-7626811/)



**Claves de la vida**



Las contraseñas han acompañado nuestra existencia de formas más profundas de lo que solemos reconocer. No son solo combinaciones de letras y números que protegen cuentas digitales; son símbolos de confianza, de acceso y de pertenencia. 

Desde la infancia, aprendimos que había palabras mágicas que abrían puertas invisibles: el “abracadabra” en los juegos, la clave secreta para entrar al club improvisado con amigos, o aquella contraseña que definía quién era parte del círculo íntimo y quién quedaba fuera. Esos códigos eran más que juegos: eran pactos de complicidad.  

Hoy, en un mundo digitalizado, las contraseñas se han convertido en guardianas de nuestra identidad. Protegen nuestros correos, nuestras cuentas bancarias, nuestras redes sociales y hasta la memoria digital de nuestras vidas. La importancia de cuidarlas es vital: una contraseña débil puede abrir la puerta a la vulnerabilidad, al robo de datos o a la invasión de nuestra privacidad. En este sentido, las contraseñas son como llaves invisibles que sostienen la arquitectura de nuestra seguridad personal.  


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZgUqWfAkmzhXr2pfQXhhxqnZBuZUicPgWLS1tTJr3stz/1780017302694.jpg)[fuente](https://pixabay.com/photos/data-security-keyboard-computer-1590455/)

Las contraseñas y yo

Soy de la era analógica y, el encuentro con el mundo digital me resultó algo difícil. Es por ello que, en mis inicios tuve problemas con las contraseñas, se me hacían difíciles de recordar hasta que empecé a combinar claves que mi mente podía procesar y evitar que fueran tan fáciles que pudieran ser descubiertas o tan difíciles que pudieran olvidarse.

Aprendí, con el tiempo y algunos problemas, sobre la necesidad de proteger bien mis activos, redes y otros espacios digitales, para evitar males mayores y pérdida de identidad y de recursos.

Es por ello que, desde mi posición de líder familiar les he explicado sobre la necesidad de guardar bien las contraseñas, no compartirlas con nadie y evitar poner elementos como fecha de cumpleaños o nombre de un ser querido porque los que se dedican a hacer daño estudian a sus víctimas y hacen mucho daño.

**Contraseñas emocionales** 

Sin embargo, más allá de lo tecnológico, las contraseñas también tienen un eco en nuestras relaciones interpersonales. ¿Acaso no confiamos nuestras “contraseñas emocionales” a quienes dejamos entrar en nuestra vida? Revelar secretos, compartir fragilidades o abrir el corazón son actos que requieren confianza, como si entregáramos una clave única. 

En este plano, las contraseñas pueden ser esenciales: sin ellas, no hay acceso a la intimidad; con ellas, se construyen vínculos sólidos. Pero también es cierto que, en ocasiones, las contraseñas se convierten en barreras: cuando alguien no logra descifrarnos, cuando decidimos no compartirlas, se levantan muros que dificultan la cercanía.  



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTt61S35r7V3Px3YHV2w6Cvc6YLSRh48j2zAAbpYybxdD/1780017771130.jpg)[fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/contrase%C3%B1a-computadora-proteccion-2271736/)


**Un comentario final** 

La vida nos enseña que las contraseñas, sean digitales o emocionales, deben ser cuidadas. No todas se entregan a cualquiera, no todas se repiten sin pensar. Algunas se guardan como tesoros, otras se cambian cuando ya no protegen lo que deberían. En definitiva, las contraseñas son reflejo de nuestra necesidad de seguridad, de pertenencia y de confianza.  

Para terminar mi entrada en la iniciativa quiero dejrles dos décimas espinelas relacionadas con el tema en cuestión y espero que les guste.

**Título: Contraseñas**


Contraseña de la infancia,  
secreto de mi rincón,  
abría con ilusión  
la puerta de la fragancia.  
Hoy la vida me distancia,  
pero guardo la memoria,  
de claves hechas historia,  
de juegos y de candor,  
contraseñas del amor  
que sostienen mi victoria.  


En la red y en la emoción  
la clave siempre resguarda,  
protege lo que se guarda  
y define  conexión.  
Es símbolo de pasión,  
de confianza y de cuidado,  
un secreto bien guardado  
que en mi vida se refleja,  
contraseña que me deja  
mi destino asegurado.  


*Nota: Utilicé el traductor DeepL Translate*

  


**ENGLISH** 




**A necessary introduction**

@palabras1 invited me to take part in this initiative, which I truly appreciate because a few days ago we had a work meeting where we discussed password security after a colleague suffered a hack that led to the loss of a large part of her funds.

During that exchange we talked about many topics, but I touched on some ideas I want to share with you — about passwords and personal relationships.

Before going any further, I invite @ericvancewalton and @palomap3 to share their thoughts on this topic.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTdppGgEZGeggxYgmkTVaVxeLGPF1KiRbhsA95fCZkL51/1779999765042.jpg)[fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/inicio-de-sesi%C3%B3n-clave-seguridad-7626811/)



**Life’s keys**

Passwords have accompanied our existence in deeper ways than we often recognize. They aren’t just combinations of letters and numbers that protect digital accounts; they are symbols of trust, access, and belonging.

From childhood, we learned that there were magic words that opened invisible doors: “abracadabra” in games, the secret code to enter an improvised club with friends, or that password that defined who was part of the inner circle and who was left out. Those codes were more than games — they were pacts of complicity.

Today, in a digitalized world, passwords have become guardians of our identity. They protect our emails, bank accounts, social media, and even the digital memory of our lives. Taking care of them is vital: a weak password can open the door to vulnerability, data theft, or invasion of our privacy. In this sense, passwords are like invisible keys that uphold the architecture of our personal security.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZgUqWfAkmzhXr2pfQXhhxqnZBuZUicPgWLS1tTJr3stz/1780017302694.jpg)[fuente](https://pixabay.com/photos/data-security-keyboard-computer-1590455/)


**Passwords and me**

I am from the analogue era and the encounter with the digital world was somewhat difficult for me. That is why, in my beginnings I had problems with passwords, they were difficult for me to remember until I started to combine passwords that my mind could process and prevent them from being so easy that they could be discovered or so difficult that they could be forgotten.

I learned, over time and some problems, about the need to protect my assets, networks and other digital spaces well, to avoid greater evils and loss of identity and resources.

That is why, from my position as a family leader, I have explained to them about the need to keep passwords well, not to share them with anyone and to avoid putting elements such as birthday or name of a loved one because those who are dedicated to doing harm study their victims and do a lot of damage.



**Emotional passwords**

However, beyond technology, passwords also echo in our interpersonal relationships. Don’t we entrust our “emotional passwords” to those we let into our lives? Revealing secrets, sharing vulnerabilities, or opening our hearts are acts that require trust — as if we were handing over a unique key.

In this realm, passwords can be essential: without them, there is no access to intimacy; with them, strong bonds are built. But it is also true that sometimes passwords become barriers: when someone fails to figure us out, when we decide not to share them, walls go up that make closeness difficult.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTt61S35r7V3Px3YHV2w6Cvc6YLSRh48j2zAAbpYybxdD/1780017771130.jpg)[fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/contrase%C3%B1a-computadora-proteccion-2271736/)

**A final thought**

Life teaches us that passwords whether digital or emotional must be cared for. Not all of them are given to just anyone, not all are repeated thoughtlessly. Some are kept like treasures, others are changed when they no longer protect what they should. Ultimately, passwords reflect our need for security, belonging, and trust.

To close my entry for this initiative, I want to leave you with two décimas espinelas (Spanish ten‑line stanzas) related to the topic. I hope you like them.



**Title: Passwords**



Childhood password,
secret of my corner,
I would open with hope
the door of fragrance.
Today life distances me,
but I keep the memory
of passwords that became history,
of games and of candor,
passwords of love
that uphold my victory.



On the net and in emotion
the key always protects,
it safeguards what is kept
and defines the connection.
It’s a symbol of passion,
of trust and care,
a well‑kept secret
reflected in my life,
a password that leaves me
my destiny assured.



*Note: I used the DeepL Translate tool.*

body.title: Day 2: A sunny day
body.body:
Told you I was gonna draw! So I return with a drawing! And I had to check and apparently it has been 2 months since I actually posted or had the time to be around again so now I wonder how long I can beactive this time around cuz mining season is just so unpredictable and I hate this uncertainty. I have tried just pointing and sketching tho but that could only take me so far. I am hoping to do fan art again to see if I can save up hive again but for now, I just wanna be active. 
And I was catching up to the prompts I was following and so here is my day 2 UwU a sunny day
Tho it's anything but sunny but for me, I it's a sunny day, I'd just wish to be a fish in water like this

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdQoHTauAX794JmnPjNERjorRaxyfwnfSVm9HFdJyyAQd/messenger_creation_58c1e181_cfa6_4415_bdc4_716a7eef275b.jpg)
>Materials: Watercolor, pencil colors, white acrylic marker
Duration: 1.5 hours


Well, it took 2 hours cuz of the drying but yes UwU I love my fishes! I would say that I'm happy my art is a lot more colorful and still colorful and that my color theory and blending is still pretty on point XD

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdqVmYkSma5WuWD1byQdePChz155oYbKLtm2tBzTa9fcV/messenger_creation_78ab2dd1_d7c3_4bfe_ac79_2ac3e0691a08.jpg)
But to get to my pretty fishes, I started with blob and a really messy watercolor base

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd1fEPNqiV6sAsCmNDN6EvbsRouyeAo34EEmqD6wXSuz9/messenger_creation_2c156247_cf5c_4673_8476_4a08ad77ff0b.jpg)
Then after that dried , I had to pen it in a little cuz my pencil lines got smudged and I needed definition here.  So I did the rocks and plants and the fish

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPcReQFoRwXvzmGmZq3tiwkTATaxHqiuNYvpUz22dAnSH/messenger_creation_47784e7b_7d3a_4847_a1cd_cde211e79584.jpg)
Then I kind of just did another layer of watercolor so I wouldn't have to try filling so much of he gap and texture with pencil color because my brain works like that, always wanting to do a solid color then adding in details with different testures and quite honestly, I tihink the pencil color part was what took the longest because I was switching between 2-4 pencils with different shades and I was also just debating on how to do the fih in water. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdQoHTauAX794JmnPjNERjorRaxyfwnfSVm9HFdJyyAQd/messenger_creation_58c1e181_cfa6_4415_bdc4_716a7eef275b.jpg)
Overall, I think stressing over the process made it com out well for me and that makes me happy because I came out good and cuI still got it in me UwU

------------

For now, this is it for me! I have a fun run to attend to tomorrow so I'll have to keep you guys posted on that and how much I've been training in the gym lately on top o work too. 
Happy weekends and I'll see you guys again reaalllll soon!

body.title: 「Vicky's Life」短剧｜《黄雀风》（白方文x韩雨彤）PART 2
body.body:
![IMG_5306](https://s1.img-e.com/20260331/69cb636502051.jpeg)

在同男主分手的这些年里，她曾经帮助某个在她落魄时拉过自己一把的女性。无独有偶对方也有个赚钱不多却酗酒打老婆孩子的丈夫，她们利用风和烟头策划了一场谋杀。

为了不被发现他们还做了完美的不在场证明，但这一切逃不过老刑警的眼睛。在她被盘查的时候，男主即使挺身而出证明女主当时跟他在一起，顺利躲过了警察的盘查。

这部剧里的剧情不能说完全光彩，比如后来女主的高中同学带着一身伤找到他。无论是短剧还是现实我都由衷感叹，嫁人千万不要嫁给穷人，因为同样的剧情一再上演。

女主跟他策划好了「意外」，就在执行的时候差点被蹲守在楼下的老刑警抓到。千钧一发之际男主出现化解了危机，之后她们听了他的建议用更稳妥的方式化解了危机。

从我的角度来说非常能感同深受女主的想法和做法，只是我做不到她那么决绝。我很喜欢韩雨彤对这个角色的理解，很压抑遇事果断决绝，只有面对男主的时候才笑。

从演员的角度来说，两位主角的演技都特别棒。女主的上头说过了，男主虽然不显山不露水却妥帖的很。我是第一次看这个男主的剧，感觉他将这个本子吃透了演的很棒。

总的来说，这部剧很适合懂原生家庭之痛的人看，推荐。


（本篇完）


————————


喜欢影视剧、美食和旅行的天秤座80后妹纸，喜欢一切新奇温暖的事物

如果你喜欢我的文章，欢迎留言与我交流

body.title: Enjoying the Beautiful City of Alexandria
body.body:
![6050.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYsAHf9sZgGNkoBdRPYi3ikShTgkrTN5Hfm7ZdFgTmYU6/6050.jpg)

One thing I have learned over the years is how easy it is for us, as human beings, to take things for granted. We become so familiar with the people, places, and sights around us that we stop noticing them. What was once beautiful slowly becomes ordinary simply because we see it every day.

But I have come to believe that beauty is everywhere. The difference is not in what we are looking at, but in how we choose to look at it. It takes a curious soul, a soul that is willing to search, to find beauty in the world around it. Once you develop that habit, you start seeing things differently. Suddenly, beauty appears in places that others walk past without a second glance.

Many of the places and scenes I photograph are probably passed by thousands, maybe even millions, of people. They go about their day without noticing anything special about them. Yet when I stop and look, I find something worth admiring every single time. A certain light, a reflection, a color, or simply a feeling that catches my attention.

What fascinates me most is that this even applies to the view outside my room window. It is a view I have seen countless times. By all logic, I should be used to it by now. Yet somehow, I never am. Every time I look at it, I find myself appreciating it all over again. It still gives me the same sense of peace and admiration that it did the first time.

So if there is one message I would like to leave today, it is this: do not take things for granted. The world is full of beauty, often hiding in the most familiar places. Slow down, pay attention, and allow yourself to see what has been there all along. You may be surprised by how much beauty has been waiting for you to notice it.

body.title: Exploring the Outdoors / Explorando Al Aire Libre
body.body:
> **English** ###
**Exploring the Outdoors**
I'm back in the park again; my visits are more routine now. The day is a bit chilly; I see my friends resting at the foot of the trees, while others lie on the dry ground. It all seems deserted, and the atmosphere feels desolate. That's the impression I got from the pictures I took, but looking at it from another perspective, I see that the cats' indifference is due to their daily rest. Perhaps they're exhausted from their nightly hunts, since the terrain in parks is more extensive, making it harder to catch prey. >***Español*** >##### **Explorando Al Aire Libre** >De nuevo estoy en el parque; mis visitas son más rutinarias. El día está un poco frío; veo a mis amigos descansando a los pies de los árboles y otros se encuentran en la tierra seca. Pareciera todo desértico y el ambiente se siente desolado. Es la impresión que me dio al ver las imágenes que capturé, pero viéndolo desde otra perspectiva, observo que la indiferencia de los mininos se debe a su descanso diario. Quizás agotados por la cacería que emprenden todas las noches, ya que el terreno en los parques es más extenso y se hace más difícil atrapar las presas. ![IMG_20260425_133742.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/EoeFpMFbEFYWuAgT5Go83xR3a2GBH9AwCn2na7TkgFmDW6SXqr44dePmNi8GWuW9n8j.jpg) ![IMG_20260425_124043_MP.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23vsQfo1NjPZqLLLy1aWS36QoX5kREaA9TyPkpXwmxTNcVBx71X77kvrA6iTVDK1bGdmv.jpg) ![IMG_20260425_125149_MP.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23tmQT1s586Y6Zt3M7uUr8dfbJ2ngzGHc1uGHogFgwFYdRMEtHogCHTerYCf27ZiAEvRU.jpg) ![IMG_20260425_133759.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/EoAbeZqLrCyCPs4EhSDRvRAxagfgEQDXni1pTJfDHUkkcTG9PH2RMJJKY5KRuoq1vvn.jpg) Then, when dawn breaks, they arrive exhausted and drained. And at this hour, when I arrive to exercise, I find them in that state of excessive relaxation, recharging their energy. Today I left relatively early for a walk; since the park is fairly close, I walked all the way here and forgot to bring them some food. I realized, when I was looking for something to give this little one who approached me on the way, that I regretted forgetting the cat food. >Luego, cuando amanece, ya llegan agotados y sin energías. Y a esta hora en que uno llega a ejercitarse, los encuentra en ese estado de relax excesivo, recargando sus energías. Hoy salí relativamente temprano para caminar un poco; como el parque me queda un poco cerca, me vine hasta acá caminando y olvidé traerles algún alimento. Me di cuenta, cuando buscaba para darle a este pequeño que me abordó en el camino, que lamenté haber olvidado la gatarina. ![IMG_20260425_134152-COLLAGE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/AJmtLzEhHA2RZtYctqoJrQGBMdXHmoFAxJfmS92j6Z1Gs53zeVeK4VEC2Yjkjg1.jpg) ![IMG_20260425_124014_MP.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/Eo4DU6VtagR27EwmiNq8HUQgpV5NokZ85mD78jfBzejQEPs1PiAkCns2BRaPhU3zsrj.jpg) Despite seeing many kittens along the way, the only one that approached me was the tiny feline I sensed was hungry. I was annoyed with myself for forgetting the food. Later, on the path, it was lucky because I saw a family sharing a snack in the park offer it some food; that gesture filled me with satisfaction. >A pesar de haber visto muchos gatitos en el camino, el único que se me acercó fue el pequeñín felino que presentía que estaba hambriento. Me molesté conmigo misma por haber olvidado el alimento. Después, en el camino tuvo suerte porque observé a lo lejos que una familia que compartía una merienda en el parque le ofreció algo de comida; esa acción me llenó de satisfacción. ![IMG_20260425_133645-COLLAGE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/AK2EhNzXt6xRa5twqNab2hvLksUtm3du9Q5ob1UfQR68bTeWrwykRmaXQTM1LGG.jpg) ![IMG_20260425_123954_MP-COLLAGE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/EoEs2A5AsXHbTPGRoiBtCMrSwLzrxQssVWSMKPXMgQYn7WaKJHcN42QZqj75URvaBaQ.jpg) Well, dear friends of the Caturday community, cat lovers, although the day continued with its strange atmosphere, I carried on with my routine walk, trying to see the environment from a different perspective to fully enjoy nature because we always have another day. Here are some pictures of our friends. They always present themselves with their distinctive features. >Bueno, queridos amigos de la comunidad de Caturday, amantes de los gatitos, aunque el día continuó con su atmósfera extraña. Yo seguí con mi caminata rutinaria, tratando de ver el ambiente desde otra óptica para disfrutar a plenitud la naturaleza porque siempre tenemos otro día. Aquí les tengo imágenes de nuestros amigos. Siempre se presentan con sus señas particulares. ![IMG_20260425_133723-COLLAGE (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/EouAbGnzJ3L44owdkZ9HPnMua9dznCBcFByu7qGtLzzxtfNtBWCHgbriHE7g9TsVvat.jpg) ![IMG_20260425_134120-COLLAGE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23tmQNdCAt6Ytxfkadc4VvGTfLCf2yTmjKFoeuWnxHZMzZaS6QfZET8g8ieNwgJucqXzb.jpg) ![5s4dzRwnVbzGY5ssnCE4wXzkeAEXyVtgk1ApQTwHMTp6y5PvEo1yennAbzQkJ9G8uVvM1WjDyTeCvUuTiNFbfpF1J9yKTEBESC7RtqAxoD6Bxcoo9NaddDxcS5uE8yY95UEuz59CpRNk6DkRm9KA8gUJKK44W396P5RhjnE.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23tvASVrTgFFPYz1s62q3C9eFbkQRo9rWE2uxH6GMt4TsfTQCNqzbmpm3djenunLN6PA8.png)

Hi, everyone! How are you? I hope you're doing great. Do you like old TV shows? I don't think *Rebelde* is old enough to be called that, to be honest, but it is a few years old. I remember watching it as a kid with my sister, but my memories are pretty vague, so I decided to watch it again. I’m already past episode 300 and I really like it. It’s a fun show with some very realistic elements. That said, my opinion of the characters has changed quite a bit, but I guess that’s just normal when you rewatch a show after so many years.

>Hola a todos! Cómo están? Espero que muy bien ¿les gustan las series viejas? Rebelde no creo que sea lo suficientemente vieja para decirle así la verdad pero si tiene sus cuantos años, recuerdo haberla visto de niña junto con mi hermana pero mis recuerdos son muy vagos así que decidí volverla ver, ya voy más allá del capítulo 300 y me gusta mucho, es una serie divertida y que tiene algunas cosas muy reales, lo que si es que mi opinión sobre los personajes ha cambiado bastante pero supongo que son cosas normales que pasan cuando vuelves a ver una serie después de tantos años.

body.body: Sí, esa lectura tiene más sentido: de niño manda la curiosidad y el peligro entra después, cuando ya tienes el mapa adulto de “lo que pudo haber pasado”. La psicología del desarrollo lleva años mostrando que la percepción del riesgo y ciertos miedos cambian con la edad, no porque el recuerdo sea falso, sino porque el significado del recuerdo madura después [PMC](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5066709/) [Taylor & Francis](https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/full/10.1080/21594937.2024.2425539). Tu ejemplo del coralillo lo clava perfecto: el miedo no estaba en la escena, estaba en la interpretación tardía; como recurso narrativo, eso es mejor porque vuelve la memoria más honesta y más inquietante. Y sí, esa tensión entre inocencia y retrospectiva puede afilar mucho el texto, igual que en tu forma de contar experiencias vividas en posts como [este de @aljif7](https://inleo.io/@aljif7/pressured-to-breathe-why-a-35-year-ol...).

body.body: Pero de verdad que no encuentro ningún pedazo de recuerdo de miedo. Quizás ese miedo sólo existe en los adultos al echar una mirada retrospectiva de lo que pudo ocurrir catastróficamente. Por ejemplo, otro recuerdo que tengo es una vez que me detuve a ver una serpiente en un hoyo en el camino de una ranchería a la escuela del pueblo. Mi curiosidad por ver cómo lanzaba la arena hacia afuera me hizo acercarme a ver y pude ver los colores brillantes de la serpiente. No sentí miedo. Tendría unos 7 años. Años después cuando vi que esos colores que vi eran los del coralillo entonces se me enchinó la piel al imaginar una mordedura mortal de esa serpiente. Bueno, veo que se puede mejorar la narración con los puntos que mencionas. Anotado y tomado en cuenta Rafiki.

body.title: A Mirror in the Machine
body.body:
Hive has served as a digital diary for me. Though anonymity on Hive would encourage me to share personal struggles and my financial goals, I now realize that personal matters, particularly family issues, should be kept private. During my early months on Hive, I shared my crypto goals, both weekly and monthly. I also shared my difficulty in my workplace. This time, I prefer keeping them to myself.   

Last night, I had a dream. I am tempted to write an article about it, but I have second thoughts. I decided to bring it to God in prayer. 

As 2026 started, I started to start anew in my marriage. I thought it was easy. Last 19 March, I wrote in my prayer diary:

> To bring you honor for whatever happens to my marriage and family, either a peaceful co-existence living separate lives or reconciliation and restoration via forgiveness, repentance, and restitution.

The apostle Paul wrote the Christians in Rome:

> For from him and through him and for him are all things. To him be the glory forever. Amen! (Romans 11:36).

Though it's hard to understand how the mess in my marital life could bring glory to God, I trust in his providence. If not in time, perhaps in the afterlife; only then will I have the complete picture that would give sense to the ugly details. 


<center>![MirrorInTheMachine.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rzc24-nftbbg/23tbGnVx7Y8DV9m8FjmwbC9zyV7C6KMkMxsZMK7dDvuq7M3qyuoddFttdJ8DpqXpPA3dZ.png)</center>

<center>[Source](https://chatgpt.com/s/m_6a1addad86e88191b0572ae6c22064f6)</center>


Shifting my attention from a highly emotional tone to something wholesome reminds me of a conversation in a group chat. The idea came from my brother-in-law. He prompted AI to create an unhinged bio of himself. I was amazed with the outcome, and so I followed suit.     

The unhinged bio created by AI provided me an overview of my digital footprint. I am glad to see that what I wrote in the past served as a reference in creating such a bio. AI identified seven unique insights that described me:

- The loss of 49% of my portfolio in 2015.

- My use of the Elliott Wave Principle for trading.

- Tracking progress on-chain via autobiographical blogging.

- Blogging about economics, spirituality, theology, and personal life.

- My goal in increasing my HIVE Power (HP) through blogging.

- My pursuit of micro-strategies for financial freedom and mission work, and

- My plan to incorporate micro-earnings and micro-yields into a mission program. 

Looking back to that 49% loss in the stock market, my loss in crypto is far bigger. However, the mindset was changed. I no longer enjoy short-term profit. I am looking for a long-term play. I have been on this chain close to five years. I am willing to wait five years more. 

As for my content, the above description is accurate. 

Regarding my goal to increase my HIVE Power (HP), the strategy changed. I no longer see blogging as the way to do it. I prefer exploring selected Hive Engine tokens as more strategic, even without community support.  

The last two seem far-fetched at this time. I have difficulty convincing my real-time acquaintances about the potential of Hive. I still have to see initiative in chain activity among 10-plus people I onboarded on Hive.

Out of six paragraphs created by AI to describe my bio, I love these three:

> He writes like a man chased by both conviction and curiosity—documenting his life on-chain as if future historians (or angels) might audit his posts. His blog is part diary, part theology, part economic experiment, and part quiet rebellion against a world that told him years of writing should earn nothing.

> He believes in small beginnings: micro-earnings, micro-faithfulness, micro-obedience—stacked over time until they look suspiciously like providence.

> No one is entirely sure whether he is early, late, or exactly on time—but he’s definitely not idle.

### Grace and peace!

body.title: Reencuentro bajo el mismo cielo
body.body:
>Feliz sábado mis amigos, espero tengan un maravillosos día, hoy les comparto este poema que nace de la felicidad de encontrarme con mi hermana después e 5 largos meses y volver a caminar juntas bajo el mismo cielo.
![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc9WkZFdxXcg9NsL3BuxA3aqkdSKC5ii1g4xFBBqXwGLW/imagen.png) Cinco meses de distancia se desarman en un día, el paisaje se hace eterno, ¡cuánto te amo, hermana mía! Las nubes forman parte de este lienzo tan divino, dibujando los caminos que hoy nos llevan de la mano. Por Valencia caminamos, entre el asfalto y la altura, tu presencia me devuelve la más cálida ternura. No importa el tiempo lejos, ni la espera en el sendero, volver a ver tus ojos es el sol que tanto quiero. Hoy las nubes nos acompañan, el azul se vuelve arte, y mi alma solo sabe que no quiere amarte. Qué fortuna verte y tenerte aquí a mi lado, en este viaje hermoso que el destino nos ha dado. ... ![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYjZ3tksWgAUTbBkPMcDnKsREz8Um9zN1LCsN8D4TW846/imagen.png) *Fotografía de mi propiedad

What I am about to share today is a wonderful day for me and for my Girlfriend, as her Son will be celebrating his 8th Birthday today. I am happy to be present and will help the preparation by doing the decoration and others. It was an opportunity for me to help in the preparations and before I get started sharing with my blog post. Let me share my thanksgiving and appreciation to all who always support me here. Most especially and will never missed to give thanks, the Admins, Curators and all commenters. Thank you for all the support I always received. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQmmDChqUo9TYXRK98Ca8vYijfoPAj9nCNq5bZZyCg9KF/1780143065939.png) A week ago, my Girlfriend already told me that her Son's Birthday will be coming today, and so she told me, if I can help by just doing the simple decoration, and I am happy to help that is why I said yes. Whenever my Girlfriend asked me a favor, I always willing to do it most especially when it comes to her Son. And also, knowing that it is her Son's Birthday that is why I am happy to help. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSHWLzQYYRLqi6F9CfSDg13DZPmQmXoqKHFeXH5Kfs5wH/1780143282179.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWke59YHmGBnGHbeAeQVXfxVmNcjJLjr8UYcdheJjvGLX/1780143282228.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ6CSM9xCheDhEaRBUyqNvwLVQkxC62Wa1BKsCbrqYLrZ/1780143282283.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYnAFjkoBggBeBJN2SZSpDkYSdFWnGUfxsyGg2nf6qfmF/1780143282328.jpg) The Birthday Celebration of my Girlfriend's Son will be happening by night and so I have decided to go to their house by 5:00 in the afternoon so I can start doing the decorations and many more. As I arrived, I immediately started the simple decoration based on what my Girlfriend' wanted, and she even the one who bought some decorations that I'll be using through online. It was just a simple decorations with a foil curtain as background with some balloons so it can add beauty on the decoration. With the cake, I have also add some decors on it, so it will be nicer to looked at. After more than an hour, I finally finished the simple decoration and I must say that all though it is simple at least it is nice to see, and I thank God for that. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfU7C6tFZSSXefqW4wFFbQ5qjTaPpFQZfJcZzaUpXY3Fy/1780143966958.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRbVu9V1TJ854ampQF26gRfUKdamKCQLjDRtqx7DJBL4u/1780143967018.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYZ1hgua2tFdLPCKTswki7cWK1sdAh7G3wgriQX3hHxmm/1780143967077.jpg) Now, that was around 7:30 in the eve when the foods were already done cooking and so it is also time for the simple Birthday Celebration of my Girlfriend's Son. What we have did now is we arrange first all the foods in the table and call my Girlfriend's Son to go near as his Grandfather will be the one who will declare prayers and declarations to him. During this time, the Birthday Celebrant is full of happenings as we prayed for him. We just thank God for His provisions and all the blessings to this simple Birthday Celebration. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcyksRE7CH7NGcKtpk9E5q8ksYCawkbbgYd7TkNsupSQH/1780144452582.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeNNNnmethJGaYc8VrgwJ4WLY5PweKtNUvHpgd9kXqYBH/1780144452660.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV3LM6q8NswcuZ2DrqFXPBpdMp6B5TYo9pCRQ5tYPqb8W/1780144452712.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV6XMPMKTWMzpFxEgYAVJXdojDjXEkAwZzxuePsvKST3a/1780144452765.jpg) Finally, just after the prayers and declarations it is now time for us to take our dinner knowing that it is already dinner time. We have now then prayed for the foods, so we can have our dinner. We have now taken our dinner and call all the visitors to go inside so they can have their dinner. All the foods being prepared today are all delicious, and we also thank the husband of my Girlfriend's Older sister, for he is the one who cooked all the foods. Everyone have then take their dinner and even to me. After I have captured some photos, it is now time for me too to have my dinner and I must say that all are delicious. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVogKd72tEfUEc1mgSeMMiphJu6z8RnLoWwLe6cEGRTX6/1780144761879.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbRgzWWDL7cpNfn1PT84MtaqgNEo1dzLhnxiUULysPHwY/1780144761934.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmco6QwgRGoWgzhTjfA4vLywyUy14GDS2ELY85yrvAaiaQ/1780144761984.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPCgqjrRqz5XqUB1SQE4p2spx9f8T5UwoZanCyosWyGFY/1780144762047.jpg) That was around 8:30 in the evening when we have finally finished our dinner and everyone of us have been very full and their were other visitors coming. This would be all for today's post, and until next time again, I just want to thank everyone in advance who will drop by on my blog post. **To God be all the Glory!** 😇🙌☝️ **Your Friend** **_@godlovermel25_**

body.title: Fast Driving
body.body:
Sometimes I do feel like some road accidents that happen are due to the drivers carelessness, which is also sometimes motivated by their passengers.

There are people who drive so carelessly that it makes you wonder if they have some extra lives at home or maybe they feel like they get to respawn every time they die, like they do in the video games.

![1001122630.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/prayzz/23t74yMFmc78T6XqGH71LdGBUjigvSwutV9Kmo3dABKWXGq1b7eY7LPoYW7kXKFQPcGdz.jpg)
<sub> [photo by Christian Englmeier](https://unsplash.com/photos/timelapse-on-road-J7EUjSlNQtg) </sub>

Some few weeks ago, I was on my way back home from a different state that I had traveled to, and I could remember that while on that journey, a group of young men kept antagonizing the driver, telling him that he was the slowest driver they'd ever met and that he could always go faster.

And the crazy thing was that with each statement they made, the driver made sure to add more speed. It was obvious that their words were getting to him, and he probably would do anything just to prove them wrong about his driving skills.

Luckily for us, we also had people with brains in the vehicle, people who plan to live a long, fulfilled life like myself, and it was those people who had immediately spoken up, telling the driver to ignore the words of those men and instead drive responsibly.

Watching that entire situation unfold made me wonder what would have been the case if that bus had only been filled with people who had the mindset of the group of guys who only wanted him to hit the highest speed on the vehicle.

And who knows, maybe this same situation may have been the cause of one of these many accidents that we see on the roadside where a vehicle would slam into a truck parked at the roadside, instantly killing everyone in the vehicle.

And I honestly don't even get why people drive fast, to be honest, because the way I see it, driving fast can only guarantee two things: the first being that you get to your destination on time, and the second being that you don't get there at all.

I don't know about you guys, but if I'm doing something that has a 50/50 chance of me dying, I probably won't do it at all, unless not doing it would also mean that I die.

So why drive fast with the possibility of dying when you can always get there maybe a few minutes late and still be alive?

body.title: ɪɴ ᴀ ɢʀᴀʏ ᴡᴏʀʟᴅ ᴏғ ᴡʜɪᴛᴇ ʟɪᴇs
body.body:
>
‎My perspective of the world has always been simple till it wasn't. My principles are guided by what is right or wrong, bad or good, black or white. Nothing too complex beyond what is considered ordinary but as I grew older, I understood that there are other things that exist in between, things we can't quantify with words. 
‎
‎Situations we can't really explain, it requires us to do things we consider to be wrong but feels so right at the moment. It is always easy to judge others when we see them do things we feel like we would never do, but when we find ourselves in a similar situation we would realize everyone is just trying to survive which makes us all human.
‎
‎Is it ok to tell a lie, when the truth might be more devastating? If I were an average person, I would have said no but based on the experience I have had, life is not black and white. There are times when we tell lies to protect the interest of others, it might seem inappropriate but I believe the truth should not be used to hurt people. I know the truth should matter always but if the truth you are telling, does more harm than good, it might make you reconsider.
‎
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRBVM56JLczRrHbZXv6rNYYKVX7uQSEqXeA3gs2jQohyN/1780145036885.png)

‎I had an experience about 6-7 years ago, though I have narrated it in a similar prompt but its relevancy still remains because it is the only time I had gone through an experience such as this.
‎
‎I live in a house with a family of six, as the second child of the family I am good with numbers as if I studied commerce before coming to earth. For that reason I'm closer to my mum than my other siblings because I assist her in managing the finance aspect of her business. Which means my account was used mostly for her transactions, sometimes she will purposeful keep some funds in my account for safe keeping.
‎
‎While I was doing my national diploma in gateway polytechnic, she kept about 50k in my account for reasons I wasn't aware of. She told me she will make use of it by December, We were around August then. During that time it was almost time for us to pay our school fees, I was still expecting mine from my parents.
‎
‎I had this friend then named Ebenizer, he was my room mate in ND1 till I moved to another community in ND2. His parents at the moment were struggling with their finances which made it difficult for them to cater for his academic needs including school fees. He was at the blink of dropping out, because exam was approaching. I took pity on him and offered to help because I felt like I was in the position to do so.
‎
‎He promised to return the money by September, I had it at the back of my mind that since December was still far from the current month, we will be fine as long as he keeps his promise. I gave him 30k out of the money that was kept in my account to add to the amount he had gathered to complete his school fees. When it was time for me to pay for my school fees, my dad sent me 5k to add to the money in my account for my school fees. He told me he had already spoken to my mom about it. He wasn't aware that I had used out of the money already. I couldn't tell him what I had done, I just nodded \

to what he said.
‎
‎My present situation now seem similar to the mess my friend was and I can't pressure him for the money because the date he promised is still far away. I could have informed my dad or Mom but I didn't want to damage the trust my mum had in me. I sourced around for the money but it wasn't enough to cover for the amount I needed, though I knew it was silly but at the moment my ego was all I had to protect.
‎
‎On the long run, i found a guy who made me an offer to buy my phone, I was using Infinix hot 4 pro, though the amount he offered was not up to the amount I bought the phone but due to my desperate needs for money, I had no choice but to sell the phone. I was bitter all week because I was \

😅. My exam was extremely stressful because I had a lot of materials I could have used on my phone for but I couldn't, it affected my examination performance a lot. ‎ ‎The exam lasted for about 2-3 weeks. I was already preparing for a way to get a new phone with the remaining money I got from selling my phone. So I waited till September in school to get the money back from him and that was how I was able to purchase a new phone and went home. ‎ ‎Was it worth it? Well, I never told my parents about it till today but I knew, if I had told them they would have understood and refunded the money which would have saved me from the agony and stress I experienced. But the truth is, it would have damaged the trust my mom have in me and I don't know if my parents might decide to reach out to my friend, which feels inappropriate because the mess was not his fault. Do I feel the lie was justified? I believe it was, which is why I wasn't too pained when I find myself paying for the consequence of my action. ‎ ***** ***** ‎_***This write-up was inspired by weekly featured content titled ***A white lie*** in hive learners community.***_ ‎ ****** ***** ‎ ‎_***Cover Image - generated using chatgpt***_ ‎ **** ***** ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVNhTyUg4Aq2RTHWnTXsaS4758biE3M9xtHurNqYAe8XT/img_0.8353900969042101.jpg) ‎
***THANKS FOR VISITING MY BLOG***
‎![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVNhTyUg4Aq2RTHWnTXsaS4758biE3M9xtHurNqYAe8XT/img_0.8353900969042101.jpg)

body.body:
Tu enfoque funciona **muy bien** porque no conviertes a los duendes en monstruos, sino en una **presencia ambigua**: traviesa, fascinante y desorientadora. En la tradición de los **chaneques** en México —muy fuerte en Veracruz— suelen aparecer como seres pequeños ligados al monte, al agua y a los parajes apartados; no siempre dañan, pero sí **“pierden”** a la gente, sobre todo a los niños, y justo por eso el susto no necesariamente viene del juego, sino de **descubrir que ya no sabes volver**. Eso encaja bastante con lo que cuentas: risa, confianza, ausencia de miedo al principio y luego la desviación del camino [Cultura Genial](https://www.culturagenial.com/es/leyenda-de-los-chaneques/) [Conoce Veracruz](https://conoceveracruz.com/duendes-o-chaneques/) [El Momento Veracruz](https://elmomentoveracruz.mx/2025/07/01/leyenda-de-los-chaneques-en-veracruz-que-son-realmente/).

La pregunta que dejas —**“¿Por qué se asustaría un niño si los duendes juegan con él?”**— está buena porque le da la vuelta al cliché. La respuesta más fuerte, narrativamente, es esta: **un niño no se asusta del juego; se asusta cuando entiende que el juego no lo controla él**. Ahí está el filo del recuerdo: primero hay maravilla, luego extrañeza, luego la posibilidad de perderse. Eso tiene más fuerza que pintar a los chaneques como simples “malos”.

También suma mucho el anclaje local: **La Guadalupe, el Riachuelo, la ciénega, el agua cobriza, los manglares**. Ese detalle aterriza el relato y lo vuelve creíble incluso para quien no comparta la creencia. El folklore vive de eso: de un lugar concreto donde “a alguien sí le pasó”, no de una leyenda flotando en el aire.

Si quieres pulir el texto, yo reforzaría tres cosas:

- **Entrar antes al episodio**: la introducción es buena, pero la escena con los duendes es lo más potente; conviene llegar ahí un poco más rápido.  
- **Cortar justo donde nace la inquietud**: cuando el niño deja de seguir por curiosidad y empieza a seguir sin entender.  
- **Rematar con una frase seca**: algo como *“No les tuve miedo mientras reían. El miedo empezó cuando comprendí que ya no iba por mi camino.”*

Y sí: el valor del relato está en que **no suena a moraleja**, suena a memoria. Eso le da peso. En vez de explicar demasiado si eran reales o no, te conviene dejar esa grieta abierta. Ahí vive el cuento.

body.title: ¿Por qué se asustaría un niño con los duendes si juegan con él?
body.body:
Blog de aljif7
Hive account
@aljif7

PLATAFORMA: Hive
FECHA: Sábado 30 de mayo de 2026.
Área: Narrativa personal

Hola qué tal?

En estos días me ha venido el recuerdo recurrente de cuando me perdieron los duendes en una ranchería del pueblo don de nací. Actualmente la zona costera de Veracruz se conoce como Costa Esmeralda. Por aquellos años sólo se conocían los pueblos que agrupan Costa Esmeralda. Cada Pueblo tuvo su origen en los repartos de tierras. Así que los ejidatarios tenían una parcela y su lote en el pueblo donde normalmente se establecía la casa. 
Y como he leído notas de que los niños se asustan al ser tomados por los Duendes, también conocidos como Chaneques, pues me di a la tarea de contar mi historia desde mis recuerdos más nítidos. 
Bueno, para darle un poco de sabor a este pasaje de mi vida, digamos que es parte de mi sección que llamo
> Cuentos que si son cuentos
> 
Y entonces me vino a la mente la pregunta:

> ¿Por qué se asustaría un niño si los duendes juegan con él?
> 
Ocurrió hace mucho tiempo…
Eran los años setentas, en una parcela de mi abuelo Rubén que era parte del pueblo donde nací; La Guadalupe, Veracruz. El arroyo pasaba cerca, le llamamos El Riachuelo. Curiosamente donde desemboca el riachuelo el pueblo se llama Riachuelos. Quedó poco comunicado a raíz de un cambio de la construcción del puente de Gutiérrez Zamora. A diferencia de otros ríos el agua toma un tono cobrizo, quizás por los restos de hojas secas de los manglares que se unen al Riachuelo al caer.

Y bueno, regresando a los duendes; a mí me perdieron, me desviaron del camino a orillas de una ciénega cuando era pequeño. Habré tenido unos cinco años y recuerdo cómo estaba caminando en dirección hacia la parte cenegosa. Yo iba riendo con esos seres pequeños, como yo. No recuerdo haber sentido miedo. Tampoco recuerdo haber intercambiado una sola palabra con los duendes. Sólo recuerdo como saltaban y reían mientras me guiaban por un camino que parecía fácil de seguir. Tenían la piel rojiza. No tenían pelo. Se desplazaban al interior de la ciénega sin dificultad, saltando de un lado a otro. Y no recuerdo que hayan querido hacerme daño. Al parecer nos la pasamos carcajeando mientras caminábamos. 
![Screenshot 2026 05 30 at 7.56.55 PM](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdQnSinq1V7G2Ppuc4PyPXLZZEUQQhvXB22vrBy9aiP3P/Screenshot%202026-05-30%20at%207.56.55%E2%80%AFPM.png)
(Hice un collage de imágenes para la cubeta de maíz)

Me encontraron porque mis padres siguieron los granos de maíz de nixtamal que se iban cayendo mientras yo llevaba una cubeta llena de maíz nixtamalizado.
Vivíamos a orillas de una ciénega. Era la parcela de mi abuelo, como ya mencioné antes y por un lado estaba mi tío Felipe y mi tía Inocencia, y por otro lado estábamos nosotros.
Devolviendo el nixtamal a mi tía
Mi madre le había pedido prestado nixtamal a mi tía unos días antes. Y ese día por la tarde mi madre había cocido maíz, había terminado de hacer el nixtamal. Así que tocaba devolver el nixtamal a mi tía.

–¡Llévale el nixtamal a tu tía! Chencha (así le decíamos).
El atardecer estaba por morir. Justo tenía el tiempo para llevarle el nixtamal a mi tía antes del anochecer.
Mientras caminaba, por alguna razón tomé un camino que me alejaba de la orilla de la ciénega. Yo veía el camino fácil de caminar, como una vereda rodeada de los pastos de la ciénega. Y de repente habré perdido la noción de a dónde iba ya que estaba riendo y jugando con esos seres extraños mientras caminaba con la cubeta en la mano derecha. La cubeta estaba tan llena, copeteada que los granos de maíz iban cayendo sobre las hierbas. El nixtamal, al caer, se asentaba firmemente en el suelo por el peso húmedo que le queda después de la cocción. Además, lo pegajoso del nixtamal ayudaba a que se quedara sobre la maleza. Los granos de color amarillo fueron la señal que más tarde ayudaría a mis padres a encontrar el rastro del camino que había tomado.
Lo único que recuerdo que me contaron mis padres es que me encontraron riendo.
Al ver que empezaba a anochecer fueron a casa de mi tía Chencha. Le preguntaron si había llegado con el nixtamal.
_¡Buenas tardes Chencha! ¿Ya te trajo el Nixtamal Alfredo?
–No. Aquí no ha venido Alfredo. Y hemos estado en casa toda la tarde.
Mucho más preocupados que unos minutos antes... se miraron para intercambiar qué seguía hacer. 
Así que se dieron a la tarea de buscarme antes de que cayera la noche, regresando por el camino habitual que yo había tomado. Llevaban un par de candiles porque ya empezaba a pardear. Lo bueno es que encontraron los granos de maíz antes de que la luz de la tarde se desapareciera por completo. Me llamaban por mi nombre, pero yo no escuchaba nada ya que estaba muy entretenido con esos seres de mi tamaño pero que saltaban de un lado a otro con tal facilidad que me hacían reír.

Pues esa es mi historia con los duendes. Y esta misma me ha llevado a curiosear sobre lo que se dice sobre los duendes en mi cultura. Y lo que he encontrado me ha dejado sorprendido.
Creo que lo dejo para otro post en el que describiré los aspectos culturales de los duendes o los chaneques en Veracruz. 

¡Fructífera y regocijante jornada! 

¡Feliz fin de semana!

[Nota: Me encantó la imagen generada con qwen.ai, pero tuve que hacer algunas correcciones haciendo collage de imágenes para darle más vida al maíz, al nixtamal, otras imágenes que me generó la IA no tenían esa expresión de inocencia y regocijo. Creo que me llevó más tiempo la imagen que el texto :))]

body.title: Tour of University Avenue in the San Luis sector (Eng - Esp)
body.body:
> **
INGLÉS
** University Avenue is a major thoroughfare in the city, connecting it to the Antonio José de Sucre Highway and parts of the Sucre municipality. It's located in the San Luis sector, home to the beach of the same name and several important buildings. While running errands in this area, specifically near the University of the East (UDO), I took the opportunity to explore the neighborhood. Besides the university, the area boasts important businesses, residential complexes, and tourist resorts and hotels, thanks to its proximity to the beach. We began our tour at the University of the East, the most important educational institution in the eastern region. Further along, we passed several residential complexes, hotels, and a view of San Luis Beach, which offers beautiful scenery and warm waters perfect for cooling off from the heat. This area of ​​the city is popular due to the presence of the beach, considered the largest urban beach in Venezuela. The University of Oriente is the brick-colored building, with a perimeter wall of the same color. Although it was inactive for some time, it has resumed its academic activities, providing study opportunities to residents of the city and surrounding areas. Next, we find a hotel and one of the most important companies in the city and the country, Polar. In addition to producing various food products, they produce the well-known beer whose logo is a white bear. They also make the famous malt beverage and have a foundation that provides training in gastronomy and entrepreneurship to local residents. The silos, as they are known, are the iconic symbol of this company, along with the famous white bear, located at the entrance to the structure. Following this is an ice company, and then another closer view of the Polar silos. Next, we see the gas station and residential buildings. Moving forward, we see several offices belonging to government entities, these stand out for their colorful lettering as well as the walls painted in striking colors, then a hotel, several residential complexes and the trees that abound in this area, there are Pines, Neem, among others, further on are the beautiful palm trees typical of tropical areas and much of the coast in the state of Sucre and Cumaná.

> **
ESPAÑOL
** La avenida Universidad es una importante arteria vial de la ciudad ya que la conecta con la autopista Antonio José de Sucre y sectores del municipio Sucre, además se ubica en el sector San Luis donde se localiza la playa homónima e importantes construcciones, durante unas diligencias por esta zona de la ciudad específicamente por la Universidad de Oriente (UDO) aproveché para hacer un recorrido por esta zona, donde además de la universidad se encuentran importantes empresas, conjuntos residenciales, complejos turísticos y hoteleros, dada su cercanía con la playa. Iniciamos el trayecto en la universidad de oriente, la casa de estudio más importante de la región oriental, luego tenemos varios complejos residenciales, hoteles y una vista de la playa San Luis , que ofrece hermosos paisajes y cálidas aguas para refrescarse del calor, esta zona de la ciudad es concurrida, debido a la presencia de la playa, considerada la playa urbana más grande de Venezuela. La Universidad de Oriente es el edificio de color ladrillo, con la pared perimetral de ese mismo color, aunque estuvo varios inactiva, retomó sus actividades académicas brindando oportunidades de estudio a los habitantes de la ciudad y zonas adyacentes, luego encontramos un hotel y una de las empresas más importantes de la ciudad y el país, Polar está además de producir varios rubros alimenticios, produce la conocida cerveza que tiene como insignia un oso de color blanco, también elaboran la famosa malta y tienen una fundación que brinda formación en las área de gastronomía y emprendimiento a los habitantes de la zona. Los silos, como se le conoce son el icono representativo de esta empresa y el famoso oso blanco, ubicado a la entrada de la estructura, a continuación se encuentra empresa de hielo y seguidamente otra vista más cercana de los silos de la empresa Polar, luego se aprecia la estación de servicio y edificios residenciales; avanzando, vemos varias oficinas que corresponden a entidades gubernamentales, estas destacan por sus coloridas letras al igual que las paredes pintadas de llamativos colores, luego un hotel, varios conjuntos residenciales y los árboles que abundan en esta zona, hay Pinos, Neem, entre otros, más adelante se ubican las hermosas palmeras típicas de las zonas tropicales y gran parte de la costa en el estado Sucre y Cumaná. ![Rec.
