> My favorite part of this trip was definitely the beach area. The view was absolutely beautiful; the blue of the water and sky seemed to merge, and the breeze was so pleasant it made me want to take a dip in the refreshing water. We made a short stop on the beach to calmly observe the scenery and enjoy the nice breeze. Since it was early, there were few people on the beach, which allowed me to take a short walk, feel the sand between my toes, and contemplate the vastness of the sea. This city has definitely been blessed with a long coastline and many beaches to relax on with the family and enjoy the enchanting seascape. Then we move on to the palm grove area, which I really like. The view is equally beautiful; the landscapes, including palm trees and the sea in the background, fascinate me because they bring back fond memories of my childhood when I traveled with my parents and sisters during school holidays to visit my grandmother and cousins. Those were the most anticipated holidays, visiting the beach and building sandcastles. Such beautiful and fun times! I think that's where my love for the beach and its beautiful scenery comes from.

> Mi parte favorita en este recorrido fue sin duda el área de la playa, definitivamente la vista del paisaje es hermosa, el color azul del agua y del cielo parecen unirse, además la brisa del lugar es agradable e invita a darse un chapuzón en su refrescante agua, hicimos una pequeña parada en la playa para observar el paisaje calmadamente y disfrutar la agradable brisa en este lugar, como era temprano habían pocas personas en la playa, lo cual me permitió hacer una pequeña caminata, sentir la arena en los pies y observar la inmensidad del mar. Definitivamente esta ciudad ha sido bendecida con una extensa costa y muchas playas para relajarse en familia, y disfrutar el encantador paisaje marino, luego avanzamos hacia la zona de las palmeras que me gusta mucho, la vista es igualmente hermosa, los paisajes que incluyen palmeras y el mar al fondo, me fascinan porque taen lindos recuerdos de mi infancia cuando viajaba con mis padres y hermanas en las vacaciones escolares a visitar a mi abuela y primos, eran las vacaciones más esperadas para visitar la playa hacer castillos de arena, que tiempos tan hermosos y divertidos, creo que desde allí proviene mi amor por la playa y sus lindos paisajes. ![Rec. body.title: Why Are More Students Looking for Smarter Ways to Manage Academic Pressure
body.body:
Academic life has become increasingly demanding. Students are expected to balance coursework, projects, examinations, part-time jobs, internships, and personal responsibilities all at once. While education creates opportunities for growth and career advancement, the pressure associated with it can sometimes become overwhelming.

Many students enter college with enthusiasm and ambition, only to discover that managing multiple deadlines is far more difficult than anticipated. As assignments accumulate and expectations rise, students often search for effective strategies to maintain productivity without sacrificing their mental well-being.

The modern educational environment rewards consistency, organization, and efficient time management. However, achieving all three can be challenging when every subject demands significant attention. This is why students are actively exploring different ways to stay on top of their academic responsibilities while preserving a healthy work-life balance.

## The Importance of Managing Workload Effectively

One of the most significant factors influencing academic success is workload management. Students who plan their schedules carefully often find it easier to complete assignments on time and maintain better grades.

Creating weekly study plans, breaking large projects into smaller tasks, and setting realistic goals can dramatically improve productivity. These techniques help reduce stress and prevent last-minute rushes that often lead to poor-quality work.

Research has also shown that productivity is closely connected to mental health. Students who ignore rest and recovery frequently experience burnout, reduced concentration, and declining academic performance. Learning how to balance achievement with well-being has become an essential skill in higher education.

For a deeper understanding of this relationship, many students explore resources discussing [balancing mental wellbeing with high-stakes academic performance](https://windgustnews.net/the-productivity-paradox-balancing-mental-wellbeing-with-high-stakes-academic-performance/), which highlights the importance of maintaining productivity without compromising emotional health.

## Why Students Seek Academic Support

Academic support services have become increasingly popular because they provide guidance during particularly demanding periods. Students may seek assistance for various reasons, including complex assignments, language barriers, limited time, or difficulties understanding certain subjects.

Seeking support does not necessarily indicate a lack of ability. In many cases, it reflects a student's desire to learn more effectively and manage responsibilities efficiently. Educational support can take many forms, including tutoring, mentoring, study groups, and professional guidance.

When deadlines begin to overlap, some students even search online for phrases like **pay someone to do my assignment** because they feel overwhelmed by competing academic and personal commitments. Such searches often reflect the intense pressure students experience rather than a simple desire for convenience.

## The Role of Organization in Academic Success

Organization plays a crucial role in helping students stay productive. Well-organized study routines can reduce stress and improve learning outcomes.

Effective organization techniques include:

### Creating Detailed Study Schedules

A structured timetable helps students allocate sufficient time to each subject. Scheduling study sessions in advance prevents procrastination and ensures steady progress.

### Prioritizing Tasks

Not all assignments carry the same weight. Identifying high-priority tasks allows students to focus their energy where it matters most.

### Tracking Deadlines

Using digital calendars and reminder apps can help students stay aware of upcoming submission dates and avoid unnecessary panic.

### Maintaining Study Notes

Clear and organized notes make revision easier and improve information retention during exam preparation.

## How Digital Tools Are Transforming Student Life

Technology has significantly changed how students learn and organize their academic responsibilities. Educational apps, cloud storage platforms, note-taking software, and productivity tools provide convenient solutions for managing coursework.

Beyond traditional study methods, students are also finding creative ways to enhance their learning environments. Many learners use visual organization techniques to improve focus and motivation.

A growing trend involves creating aesthetically organized study materials and digital planners. Resources about [using unique fonts to organize your academic life](https://letrasdiferentes.pro/the-art-of-digital-study-grams-using-unique-fonts-to-organize-your-academic-life/) have gained popularity among students looking to make their study routines more engaging and structured.

Visual organization can make study sessions feel less overwhelming while encouraging consistency and creativity.

## Balancing Academics with Personal Well-Being

Success in education is not solely determined by grades. Long-term achievement depends heavily on maintaining physical and emotional well-being.

Students often perform better when they:

*   Get adequate sleep each night

*   Exercise regularly

*   Maintain healthy eating habits

*   Take scheduled breaks during study sessions

*   Stay connected with friends and family

*   Practice stress-management techniques

Ignoring these areas can negatively affect concentration, memory, and overall academic performance. Developing healthy habits supports both educational and personal growth.

## Building Sustainable Study Habits

Short bursts of intense studying may occasionally help before an exam, but sustainable habits produce better results over time.

Students who consistently dedicate manageable amounts of time to studying tend to retain information more effectively than those who rely on last-minute cramming.

Some useful strategies include:

### The Pomodoro Technique

This method involves studying for focused intervals followed by short breaks. It helps maintain concentration while preventing mental fatigue.

### Active Learning

Rather than simply reading textbooks, students can engage with the material through discussions, practice questions, and teaching concepts to others.

### Goal-Based Learning

Setting specific and measurable objectives provides motivation and helps track progress throughout the semester.

### Reflection and Improvement

Regularly reviewing study methods allows students to identify what works best and make necessary adjustments.

## Navigating High-Pressure Academic Periods

Certain times during the academic year are particularly stressful. Midterms, final examinations, dissertation submissions, and major projects can create significant pressure.

During these periods, students should focus on realistic expectations and effective planning. Breaking large assignments into smaller sections can make them feel more manageable. Seeking clarification from instructors and utilizing available support resources can also reduce anxiety.

Some students may once again find themselves searching for solutions using terms such as **pay someone to do my assignment** when facing multiple deadlines simultaneously. However, developing strong time-management and organizational skills often provides a more sustainable path toward long-term academic success.

## Conclusion

Academic challenges are unlikely to disappear, but students can develop the skills necessary to navigate them successfully. By combining effective planning, healthy routines, modern technology, and reliable support systems, learners can manage demanding workloads while continuing to grow personally and academically.

Education is about more than completing assignments; it is a journey of learning, self-development, and preparation for future opportunities. Students who focus on balance, resilience, and continuous improvement are better equipped to handle challenges and achieve their goals.

As educational expectations continue to evolve, the ability to adapt, stay organized, and maintain well-being will remain among the most valuable skills a student can develop.

body.title: Paradox Drive New Pokemon TCG Pocket Set
body.body: Paradox Drive B3a set is [out now](https://www.pokebeach.com/2026/05/all-109-paradox-drive-cards-revealed-for-pocket) in Pokemon TCG Pocket mobile game. We have Ancient & Future cards in the mobile game. The two featured cards are Koraidon ex and Miraidon ex. | | | |---|---| | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/036-Koraidon-ex-Paradox-Drive.jpg | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/019-Miraidon-ex-Paradox-Drive.jpg | Note: This post is long. Read and see what you want.   ## Ancient Cards --- Here are the Ancient cards in this set. Some were covered earlier while some are new. | | | | |---|---|---| | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/025-Scream-Tail-Paradox-Drive.jpg | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/004-Slither-Wing-Paradox-Drive.jpg | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/003-Brute-Bonnet-Paradox-Drive.jpg | | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/026-Flutter-Mane-ex-Paradox-Drive.jpg | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/034-Great-Tusk-Paradox-Drive.jpg | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/035-Sandy-Shocks-Paradox-Drive.jpg |   From these Ancient Pokemon above, I think Great Tusk and Koraidon ex is a good duo. The otehr Ancient attackers are kind of bad. Two Fighting Energy from Great Tusk for 80 damage is good. Twenty damage to each of your Benched Pokemon is not that bad of a drawback. Then come in with Koraidon ex. | | | | |---|---|---| | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/047-Roaring-Moon-Paradox-Drive.jpg | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/053-Walking-Wake-Paradox-Drive.jpg | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/054-Gouging-Fire-Paradox-Drive.jpg | | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/055-Raging-Bolt-Paradox-Drive.jpg | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/069-Ancient-Booster-Energy-Capsule-Paradox-Drive.jpg | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/072-Professor-Sada-Paradox-Drive.jpg | Raging Bolt from the above is the most dangerous attacker with its one hit knockout attack. Save the one hit knockout attack on a strong attacker like a Mega Pokemon ex. The energy requirements are high though.   ## Future Cards --- Like with the Ancient cards, some Future cards were covered in an earlier post while some are new. | | | | |---|---|---| | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/005-Iron-Moth-Paradox-Drive.jpg | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/013-Iron-Bundle-ex-Paradox-Drive.jpg | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/017-Iron-Hands-Paradox-Drive.jpg | | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/018-Iron-Thorns-Paradox-Drive.jpg | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/051-Iron-Treads-Paradox-Drive.jpg | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/027-Iron-Valiant-Paradox-Drive.jpg | What stands out from the Future Pokemon above are Miraidon ex and Iron Valiant. Iron Valiant's ability reduces the cost of Future Pokemon attacks by 1 Colourless Energy. Miraidon ex's attack does more damage if there are more Lightning Energy on it. Legendary Drive can be used once during your turn when this is Benched from your Hand. Then you may switch Miraidon ex into the Active Spot and move Energy from your Benched Pokemon to Miraidon ex. Iron Moth's attack can be big if you get coin flip lucky.   | | | | |---|---|---| | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/028-Iron-Leaves-Paradox-Drive.jpg | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/029-Iron-Boulder-Paradox-Drive.jpg | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/030-Iron-Crown-Paradox-Drive.jpg | | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/070-Future-Booster-Energy-Capsule-Paradox-Drive.jpg | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/073-Professor-Turoa-Paradox-Drive.jpg | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/046-Iron-Jugulis-Paradox-Drive.jpg | Out of these six, I think Iron Crown is a good attacker. For two Colourless Energy, the Enumerating Blade attack does 10 base damage plus 20 more damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokemon. As there is a maximum of 3 Benched Pokemon, this attack's maximum is 70 damage. Add the Future Booster Energy Capsule Tool to Iron Crown to add 20 more damage.   ## Other Notable Cards --- **Espeon & Umbreon** | | | |---|---| | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/020-Espeon-Paradox-Drive.jpg | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/037-Umbreon-Paradox-Drive.jpg | This set does include some Eeveelutions. Espeon's Hypnoblast for 1 Psychic Energy is not bad. You deal 40 damage and put the opponent's Active Pokemon to Sleep. Umbreon's Confuse Ray requires 1 Dark Energy and one Colourless Energy for the attack. The attack deals 50 damage plus Confusion. It seems slightly weaker than Espeon's attack but still annoying for the opponent.   **Glimmet & Glimmora** | | | |---|---| | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/044-Glimmet-Paradox-Drive.jpg | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/045-Glimmora-Paradox-Drive.jpg | Glimmet is an okay attacker in the early game. The artist for this card did include Pikachu for whatever reason. Glimmora is the Stage 1 evolution of Glimmet. The Venomous Hit attack is simple. One Dark Energy for 30 damage plus Poison. The Shattering Crystal ability activates when this Glimmora is Knocked Out. Flip a coin and if it is Heads, the opponent does not get any points for the Knockout.   **Terapagos ex**

>Image Source   Terapagos ex is a bulky Basic Pokemon ex. This has 150 HP, a two retreat cost and one attack. Prism Impact for any 3 Energy does 80 base damage plus 20 more damage for each type of Energy attached to this.   **Juliana and Area Zero Stadium** | | | |---|---| | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/071-Juliana-Paradox-Drive.jpg | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/074-Area-Zero-Paradox-Drive.jpg | Juliana is a niche Supporter cards that puts a random Stage 2 Pokemon from deck into your hand. If you play duplicate copies of a Stage 2 Pokemon, this random search is not random as you get the Stage 2 Pokemon you want. Area Zero stadium can be used once during each player's turn. Shuffle a Basic Pokemon from their hand into their hand. Then you draw one card. My problem with this Stadium is that you can redraw the same Basic Pokemon you put in the deck.   ## Illustration Art Cards --- As with every new set, there are illustration art cards. I feature a few here. | | | | | |---|---|---|---| | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/075-Snom-Paradox-Drive.jpg | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/077-Iron-Boulder-Paradox-Drive.jpg | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/078-Glimmora-Paradox-Drive.jpg | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/079-Raging-Bolt-Paradox-Drive.jpg | | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/080-Hawlucha-Paradox-Drive.jpg | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/081-Iron-Bundle-ex-Paradox-Drive.jpg | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/082-Miraidon-ex-Paradox-Drive.jpg | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/084-Koraidon-ex-Paradox-Drive.jpg |   | | | | | |---|---|---|---| | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/085-Terapagos-ex-Paradox-Drive.jpg | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/086-Juliana-Paradox-Drive.jpg | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/087-Professor-Sada-Paradox-Drive.jpg | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/088-Professor-Turoa-Paradox-Drive.jpg | | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/090-Miraidon-ex-Paradox-Drive.jpg | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/091-Flutter-Mane-ex-Paradox-Drive.jpg | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/092-Koraidon-ex-Paradox-Drive.jpg | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/093-Terapagos-ex-Paradox-Drive.jpg |   ## Shiny Cards --- In this set, the amount of shiny cards is not as big. Here are a few. | | | | | |---|---|---|---| | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/095-Charcadet-Paradox-Drive.jpg | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/096-Tadbulb-Paradox-Drive.jpg | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/098-Diglett-Paradox-Drive.jpg | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/099-Dugtrio-Paradox-Drive.jpg | | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/106-Bellibolt-ex-Paradox-Drive.jpg | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/107-Mega-Altaria-ex-Paradox-Drive.jpg | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/108-Roaring-Moon-Paradox-Drive.jpg | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/109-Iron-Valiant-Paradox-Drive.jpg |

“Alchemy is a word that essentially measures the increasing ignorance of humans across millennia.”
There are a lot of self-styled alchemists out here these days. It’s a cool word. I like it. If there were not so many alchemists out here already I’d claim the title. I’d spell it with a K. Alkhemist. Closer to its original spelling. 
Alchemy has an interesting etymology. It’s a word that travels through the millennia. As a long-lived fascination, it gets redefined along the way by every civilization that embraces it. 
As many already kno,w the “chem” in alchemy is the same chem that’s in “chemistry.” And the way I understand it, the same chem, in Kemet. That’s Egypt, if not greater Africa. So let’s start there. It’s not a great mystery. In ancient Egypt, Khem referred to the black earth of the Nile region, differentiating it from the non-black desert sands. 
In ancient Greek, Khēmeia,  referred to, \

We can see where this is going. It should be no secret to anyone by this point in time that the Greeks were heavily indebted to Egypt for its knowledge, wisdom, maths & philosophies. We are a bit more generous than those that accuse the Greeks of “stealing” African wisdom. The contemporaries knew from whence the knowledge came. It was their descendants circa the 18th century, again, being generous, that chose to conveniently forget the lineage. \nDigression. We suspect that chimera, is lexiconical alchemy, mixing the original root to define the melding of living critters rather than metals. \nArabic, Al-kīmiyā. \

the definite article, “al,” attached to the Greek root. We also get a hint right here, that “earth” can easily be removed, leaving alchemy to be defined simply as a “black art.” 
Another reminder that it was the Arabs of Islam that prompted the European Renaissance. Another quasi-awakening. “Thanks infidels. Now you must die!” 
Medieval Latin, Alchimista. One who practices alchimia. 
English. Alchemist. Dropped the “al” in some words (chemistry), but kept it in the mystical branch of alchemy. 
Let’s review. Alchemy literally means, \
(Khem), is also the root of the ancient name for Egypt itself: Kemet, \

So an alchemist, etymologically, is someone working with the dark, fertile, primordial matter, the soil from which things grow and into which things decompose. This is not accidental. The goal of alchemy, transmuting lead into gold, was always a metaphor for transforming the base self into the enlightened self, using the same dark, patient, earthy process that turns compost into soil and soil into grain.
So the original alchemists were farmers, or at least growers of grains. This would have seemed like magic and miracles back in its day, when it was brand new. Like writing. 
As humanity “advanced” into the future, it would be legitimate to consider extracting metals from rock and making weapons, and stuff, as alchemy. Granted, second generation. Making iron from rock, or even fire from sand would fit the bill of, “miracles” or magic. Anybody could grow food, climate permitting. But to make things go boom! That’s some serious alchemy. 
Then, humanity got carried away. Thought they could change base metals, with no exchange value, into gold. Along the way, they discovered “chemistry.” It should not surprise anyone that the Germans are the best chemists in the world. We will just leave that right here. And put a warning label on it. 
The 21st century alchemist, doesn’t work with actual dirt, or metals, or chemicals. It’s all abstract. The magic is transmuting terror into survival, and countless other abstract formulas. Some of these cats don’t seem to get it. Yet. But they are genuinely trying. 
Props! 
Others, as there have always been, and always will be, are charlatans.  
Here’s where we get to the Impostor part of the scenario. Our impostor fancies herself a fitness alchemist. Unfortunately our main character was sucked into one of these fly-by-night certification scams and she was taught the motions without the deeper elements of function, metabolism, connective tissue, Krebs cycle, and all that funky stuff. 
This example runs parallel to Renaissance alchemists, that read the book. Ignorant of the symbolism within, they followed the spells to the letter. Bad move. Thus, many of them ended up frustrated, sick, imprisoned, or dead. Some executed by the crown for feeding the royal pet some supposed cure, that killed it. 
Ooops. (That’s arf ful.) 
We are witnesses, by way of social media, to something very similar. Only today the industry is a bit more savvy. They know they are frauds. Most of them anyway. The ones who know, know that there are no promises or guarantees to their mumbo-jumbo. What the public doesn’t know, is that the alchemy is on the individual. Same with fitness coaching. Maybe a healer can determine why you are in the kind of pain that you can’t explain to your mechanic. 
“It’s making this funny kinda ‘squirching, boing-boing, brrratchunk’ kinda sound, and then, I just feel, y’know, kinda off. I can’t really explain it. And I just wanna cry all night long.”
You have demons! Everybody does. Most humans don’t call them demons, and even more don’t want to confront them. All kidding aside, this is a real thing. For countless reasons, many having to do with self-identity, or keeping that Impostor in tact, humans don’t want to disturb that facade. Less everything comes crashing down. But we’ve detoured once again. 
Damn. It was a toll road too!    
Remember friends. This stuff is for entertainment purposes mainly. If these essays help you, that’s a bonus. They are not meant to help you. But the are not meant to hurt you either. If you’re triggered and need help, find help, get help, help yourself. 
We’re a little bit drowsy, but otherwise okay. Last day of the month tomorrow. June is nigh. New grooves for the Substack channel.

body.title: Aventura fascinante en el Museo del Mar: Sala de Barcos y de Buceo [ Esp-Eng]
body.body:
> **
ESPAÑOL
** Bendiciones abundantes y eternas para todos los miembros de esta comunidad de @worldmappin. Es un placer saludarlos y desearles un día feliz y lleno de bendiciones. Que Dios los colme de bendiciones. Continuando mi recorrido por el Museo Marítimo, hoy les comparto mi visita a la sala de barcos. Allí se pueden apreciar varias maquetas, incluyendo la escuela naval Simón Bolívar, muy conocida en el país por los diversos viajes que ha realizado para la formación de nuevos cadetes. Esto les ha permitido experimentar diferentes mares y las actividades y el entrenamiento necesarios para la vida de un marinero. Este espacio está decorado con todo tipo de elementos marítimos: anclas, timones y numerosos barcos que hacen referencia a importantes acontecimientos históricos. Uno de los que más me llamó la atención fue la Kon-Tiki, una de las primeras balsas construidas por el ser humano para viajar a diferentes lugares. La balsa se exhibe dentro de una botella de vidrio y, como la mayoría de los objetos del museo, está protegida para su conservación y longevidad. También podemos ver un buque oceanográfico; es blanco y lleva el logotipo de la Universidad de Oriente. A continuación, se presenta el buque oceanográfico Guaiquerí 1. Según la descripción de su ficha técnica, inició sus operaciones en 1902, recorriendo diversas zonas acuáticas entre Cumaná y Carúpano. La principal actividad de estos buques es realizar exploraciones en aguas marítimas, estudiando las especies marinas, el lecho marino y la famosa Fosa de Cariaco, ubicada en esta zona del país.

> **
ENGLISH
** Abundant and eternal blessings to all members of this @worldmappin community. It's a pleasure to greet you and wish you a happy and blessed day. May God's blessings flood your lives. Continuing my tour of the Maritime Museum, today I'm sharing my visit to the ship hall. There you can see several ship models, including the Simón Bolívar training ship, well-known in the country for the various voyages it has undertaken to train new cadets. This has allowed them to experience different seas and the activities and training required for the life of a sailor. This space is decorated with all sorts of maritime elements: anchors, helms, and many ships that reference important events in history. One of the ones that caught my attention the most was the Kon-Tiki, one of the first rafts built by humans to travel to different places. The raft is displayed inside a glass bottle and, like most of the items in the museum, is protected for its preservation and longevity. We also see an oceanographic vessel; it is white and bears the logo of the University of Oriente. Next is an oceanographic vessel named Walkery 1. According to the description on the data sheet, it began operations in 1902, traveling through different aquatic areas between Cumaná and Carúpano. The main activity of these ships is to carry out explorations in maritime waters, learning about marine species, the seabed, and the famous Cariaco Trench located in this area of the country. ![1000476686.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23u5ZX6RzWhMQgoudihTPVhzcUF8CShqwZcfgQ8AeuezB7vU4chkoPnfnkakAHhrb3v45.jpg) ![1000476692.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EoK4NpmSn4Riq6tp6aVy6w9TwWn3vJaabD9kqbtE2kxTUiPpKf3Vp264gWR2HrC1ovU.jpg) ![1000476687.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EoGwR5KsZvfqQtS1pus5Ahv5xShpS9nG9RnDDyZzJBU3WBfUSJ7stn7t9cSgnAs95mX.jpg) ![1000476688.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EoGvS4rQAukeweLpFvPtMXvrfs2TqYTJk66AZaw3eyKyzv47nZQ6s2rnu59qPmShzV8.jpg) ![1000476689.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EoGwuMvvDSBVF2fC8x81axhLwYRzAi2SmjkEVmaw6ET7ZvYYXTxFocE7MLjYmqoxEBe.jpg) ![1000476690.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EoeCvjGfNcRUpYSB2XP8tcXSxcMHPDW9vrS1Rhyc8ZywaNCRidEiap9Ep2RvKLcpSZx.jpg) ![1000476691.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EoGvS4bxLsyVUoKSkNCJSNzfBrJCmmHPrxq5gAFTp5TuXpbJ7Xd9qtZ9H6CoCri797A.jpg) ![separador virgilio 1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48fPJW5oSR5NrT5insR3hayLh9ET1ifvCG8zGp4Rfk8EhMtUrcwakXhr5g3cRk6Y8x.gif)

> Continuando el recorrido, vemos otro barco, blanco con detalles burdeos, más grande que los anteriores. Un hermoso faro ilumina la sala con su luz tenue. Alrededor, hay zonas pintadas de negro que crean un llamativo contraste con la luz del faro. También se encuentra un timón de madera y otro más pequeño debajo, a la derecha de la entrada. El suelo es de baldosas de cerámica blanca. Tenemos una vista parcial de la sala y de los diferentes barcos que se encuentran en ella. Podemos ver la balsa Kon-Tiki, el faro al fondo y las mesas de exposición a ambos lados. Otro barco muy llamativo es la carabela de Cristóbal Colón. Según la ficha informativa, a finales del siglo XV, los monarcas españoles apoyaron al navegante Cristóbal Colón en su viaje hacia los países del este de Asia. Embarcó en tres carabelas: la Pinta, la Niña y la Santa María, descubriendo un nuevo territorio en América. Este es uno de los más llamativos por la forma de las velas y las cruces rojas que cada una lleva, que representan la corona española de la época colonial. A continuación, tenemos algunos carteles que muestran el arte de la pesca. Estos se encuentran en la sala de buceo, donde, además de leer información importante sobre los diferentes tipos de pesca.

> Continuing along the tour, we see another ship, white with burgundy accents, larger than the previous ones. There's a beautiful lighthouse whose soft light illuminates this room. Around the room are areas painted black, creating a striking contrast with the light from this eye-catching lighthouse. There's also a wooden wheel and another smaller one located beneath it at the entrance on the right. The floor is white ceramic tile. We have a partial view of the room and the different ships located there. We can see the Kon-Tiki raft, the lighthouse in the background, and the display tables on either side. Another very striking ship is the one known as Christopher Columbus's caravel. According to the information sheet, at the end of the 15th century, the Spanish monarchs supported the navigator Christopher Columbus on his voyage to reach the countries of East Asia. He embarked in three caravels: the Pinta, the Niña, and the Santa María, discovering a new territory in America. This is one of the most eye-catching because of the shape of the sails and the red crosses that each one bears, representing the Spanish crown of the colonial era. Next, we have some posters that show the art of fishing. These are located in the diving room, where, in addition to reading important information about the different types of fishing. ![1000476693.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Eou6LNWbRnPt74oK8NZCZhatB5rHgRpnjoVKan3tXkr2ZYkeZYfH7znaiiheGEbhVaE.jpg) ![1000476694.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23u5tiVvHsQLihRvafq9nAQD1jth85q5LFAxjg1TvBVPMr3Q1wPWPhqcrjs7owBuDtChJ.jpg) ![1000476695.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23wC2yS45bEErLuKtfY9y18SRytFpjP3Mpun4FLUtoFFprUNs8sxR2oLKkKAT7rzc49t2.jpg) ![1000476696.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EoK4LkDcYhM6bSdA8DdCpq2tSgpszFYaNTfdRXLatJF4CpdU28idEwR9bbcNCZdvPs6.jpg) ![1000476697.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23xKmkJ6885VpPkCZ9dE7MsQF5Ty2MCG45SKt6Fx4n1wHjN26TBHY26keVne8L3UtwQ7Z.jpg) ![1000476698.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EoprsjupGi1D17SugC9UxYxEeBs7QYZWyMrFQYdbWUNTejYDHhfNLdpnzkTV4VYACcb.jpg) ![1000476699.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23u5vaxXBMVKR13pDCeMmuMrSDmR2HbcZmh7fJukTFdV7CzwFxGhEFZD1CaBmhuBw3tPU.jpg) ![1000476700.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23tmFZDQa5R6qjDzmTabBcRqtDE6oNULdo2BPKXctEAoXVf8Mgt2oFBJ2UzREf15fFSyZ.jpg) ![1000476701.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EoCbNrSRPnj9f3zbzn8Lp4QM5cHMz5oozcziSg3thLCUamMbTXMJ6UXvZwmHa8YAe5Y.jpg)

> ![1000476705.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EonjyFztewuArin3x8zHTU16DUcLpv3nKvNnJURMhvXzjfFFzcPwfbpQhKpdU6KHSQg.jpg) ![1000476708.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EobzLSiEnVAnNkymvjMhDMQNC7Wa579GBA6TbfDN6HaaXaQVGqoBHcsMdjp9VjAxqQ5.jpg) ![1000476707.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Ep1WsZcEu1UCoAskMnEwddisdfeELawmkKVhU3zNUwgE3vbuMfByZFwgYUntZ3YPSjH.jpg) ![1000476710.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Ep3dpZCnWt6aXe1Jk8GZsD5Lz8qU53uiMQn8y4Ckikj5XB9NdsVf1Cv2fo2pDUXFkyD.jpg) ![1000476709.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpJXhwkH4JRKZxXTHdABzZX9a4D2Rbc5DdGLRDjdAZHCoQuWygJEyEn9P2GbQXYNdGu.jpg) ![1000476713.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EogMQ4W56Aj3CRnBHDzwJi55Djbty8GyJpuEGvKaihEotxNMHkdnHeWwcgTmGG8X5sL.jpg) ![1000476712.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Eoprx7Fc2hf3ZnJoFCh81T6eCM4Y3bQVpKHtUGhb1Uw8Vy8iUL2C4rxezt9fkz7V7iZ.jpg) ![1000476706.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EogMLKrhwCbXn32HxvfyG6wMcYEL7DwrwppVQEzXTCCVTHtU8j5tz1y9TZsYa3WVoyC.jpg) ![separador virgilio.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48KdAZ2oktyDRja9ez5m3v1qBY6PZfFU8sSGEE17ey9FUfktwmCJiLv2c2YiZggq73.png)

body.title: UNESCO TREASURE HIDDEN IN THE MOUNTAINS
body.body:
![Kopia – Beyond the route (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23xAnSqiGhF13VSHTUbQQThtBCrwAYNpQNXELzgWT1CadikBmvyvZmFxbWPb91A7TvU3z.jpg)

It was finally time to show you another church from Beskid Niski. Before going on this trip, I had not spent much time researching which churches were particularly worth visiting. In fact, I probably would never have seen this one, as it was not located anywhere along my planned route. However, while my friend and I were talking to a priest in Smerekowiec, he told us about a church in Kwiatoń that had been added to the UNESCO World Heritage List. I decided that even though it meant driving a few extra kilometers, it would definitely be worth visiting. In the end, I managed to see it literally at the last moment — just before leaving the area and just before sunset.

>No to przyszedł czas na pokazanie Wam kolejnej cerkwi z Beskidu Niskiego. Zanim pojechałam na tę wycieczkę, nie szukałam zbyt dokładnie, które cerkwie warto zobaczyć. Pewnie nawet bym jej nie zobaczyła, ponieważ nie znajdowała się w żaden sposób na mojej trasie. Jednak gdy z koleżanką rozmawiałyśmy z księdzem w Smerekowcu, to właśnie on powiedział nam, że w Kwiatoniu znajduje się cerkiew wpisana na Listę Światowego Dziedzictwa UNESCO. Stwierdziłam więc, że pomimo konieczności nadrobienia kilku kilometrów, warto będzie ją zobaczyć. Udało mi się to zrobić dosłownie rzutem na taśmę – tuż przed wyjazdem i tuż przed zachodem słońca.


![20260321_173544.jpg](image-2-20260321_173544.jpg)![20260321_173629-2.jpg](image-3-20260321_173629-2.jpg)![20260321_173813.jpg](image-4-20260321_173813.jpg)![20260321_173544.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/2458LVW1WV1rqSyXJVr5tsnByaoGUDvA5sr3gUL2Dga9Pc5x9oeUNxZtePYPZTUs6usD6.jpg)

![20260321_173629.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/243q8yhg9ZEe2Rd39762LFrPtuduGrVrji7Dm6BorPDuLA7SidR3MZRDACntuWXmuvYXu.jpg)

![20260321_173813.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/242rpewiTkCZd9KmP8qScN3a8CFNymRjRM5GQKPcdCpR3q9z2ehXFQPGmR2We5bqg8G6Y.jpg)

---

*The last photo above is my entry for Around The World: Challenge - #4/7*

---

The ORTHODOX CHURCH OF ST. PARASKEVA was built in the second half of the 17th century. The architectural style it represents is the Lemko style. Its most distinctive feature is its relatively tall bell tower, especially when compared to the surrounding churches. The tower rises more than 30 meters high, making it one of the tallest wooden church towers in the entire Carpathian region. The whole structure was built of wood, of course without the use of modern building materials.


>CERKIEW ŚW. PARASKEWY została zbudowana w drugiej połowie XVII wieku. Styl, który reprezentuje, to styl łemkowski. Jej najbardziej charakterystycznym elementem jest dosyć wysoka, jak na okoliczne cerkwie, wieża dzwonnicza. Mierzy ona ponad 30 metrów wysokości i tym samym jest jedną z najwyższych drewnianych wież cerkiewnych w całych Karpatach. Całość została wykonana z drewna, oczywiście bez użycia współczesnych materiałów budowlanych.

![20260321_173642.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/243Ly6JAoMYsXQXdww3Dxh91UTA7hqRcNQxygr9mWJ6hmVaLXhWfXt9ZBsvRkB7eT8S2U.jpg)

![20260321_173515.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/243zXRyTzACXGJCCkGU42uQJYMVcUrDfzEUhBvSPbX3yk5F5fP6pxgbTtUigssT1t3Yv8.jpg)

![20260321_173701.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/2458HmMoiQtxEgFT4btbUJ22u4H53RFcs3V9w3nhk3dVugxKe121MYCktUXXM7KZFbZmA.jpg)

In 2013 the decision was made to add this church to the UNESCO World Heritage List. It was included alongside other wooden churches of Poland and Ukraine, as it was recognized as one of the finest examples of wooden sacred architecture in the Carpathians. Honestly, this does not surprise me at all, because the church looks truly impressive, at least from the outside. Unfortunately, I did not have the opportunity to go inside, as it was closed.

>W 2013 roku podjęto decyzję o wpisaniu tej cerkwi na Listę Światowego Dziedzictwa UNESCO. Znalazła się tam obok innych drewnianych cerkwi Polski i Ukrainy, ponieważ została uznana za jeden z najlepszych przykładów drewnianej architektury sakralnej Karpat. I tak właściwie wcale mnie to nie dziwi, ponieważ cerkiew prezentuje się naprawdę bardzo dobrze, a przynajmniej z zewnątrz. Do środka niestety nie miałam okazji wejść, gdyż była zamknięta.



![20260321_173520.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/2458LVTxk4UhLCpsv2JrEKnmUzpJA39g7LNoSEzDnbR8RQo3RTqHjd9FAoGRQQLQgmM7V.jpg)

![20260321_173743.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/EoGxNXrnTJ1S9C28StxqELTXNFgD358jdc1UXuz9RoorWwogKoLtbXvu1BvkxqjwHjX.jpg)

For many years, the church served as the center of religious life for the local Lemko community, who inhabited these areas for centuries. Their culture is still visible today in the architecture of the region. Despite the passage of time, the church continues to fulfill its original function as a place of Orthodox worship, but it is also one of the main tourist attractions of the entire region. Every year, it attracts thousands of tourists from different parts of the world.

body.title: Why Luxury Retailers Prioritize Premium Jewelry Packaging
body.body:
In the competitive world of luxury retail, presentation is just as important as the product itself. This is especially true in the jewelry industry, where appearance, exclusivity, and customer experience significantly influence purchasing decisions. [Custom jewelry packaging](https://www.annaigeejewelrybox.com/) has become an essential investment for luxury retailers because it enhances brand perception, protects valuable products, and creates a memorable unboxing experience. Premium packaging serves as the first physical interaction a customer has with a jewelry piece, making it a critical component of the overall brand experience.



![download (95).jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/0a9058e612cf146fa7f5cb131e3fd520f4df0149fa48bf9fe1ba6b532bc4fac7)



Luxury retailers understand that customers purchasing fine jewelry are not simply buying an accessory; they are investing in a symbol of elegance, status, and personal meaning. Whether it is an engagement ring, a necklace, a bracelet, or a pair of earrings, the packaging must reflect the value and prestige of the item inside. High-quality jewelry boxes, velvet-lined interiors, magnetic closures, and sophisticated finishes help communicate exclusivity and craftsmanship. When customers receive beautifully packaged jewelry, they immediately associate the product with quality and attention to detail.

Another reason premium jewelry packaging is a priority is brand differentiation. The luxury jewelry market is highly competitive, and retailers constantly seek ways to stand out. Unique packaging designs featuring custom logos, premium materials, and elegant color schemes help establish a strong brand identity. Customers often remember distinctive packaging long after the purchase, increasing brand recognition and encouraging repeat business. Well-designed packaging can even become a marketing tool when customers share their purchases on social media, generating organic exposure for the brand.

Product protection is equally important. Luxury jewelry pieces are often delicate and highly valuable, requiring secure storage and transportation. Premium packaging is designed to safeguard items from scratches, dust, moisture, and physical damage. Durable boxes with protective inserts ensure that jewelry arrives in perfect condition, preserving both its appearance and value. This level of protection also reduces the likelihood of returns or customer dissatisfaction caused by damaged products.

The emotional aspect of jewelry purchases further highlights the importance of premium packaging. Jewelry is frequently given as a gift for significant life events such as weddings, anniversaries, birthdays, and graduations. Elegant packaging enhances the sense of anticipation and excitement when opening the gift. A luxurious presentation adds emotional value to the purchase, making the experience more memorable for both the giver and the recipient. This emotional connection can strengthen customer loyalty and increase the perceived worth of the jewelry.

Sustainability has also become a growing focus among luxury retailers. Many brands are adopting eco-friendly packaging solutions without compromising quality or aesthetics. Recyclable materials, responsibly sourced paper, and reusable jewelry boxes allow retailers to appeal to environmentally conscious consumers while maintaining a premium image. Sustainable packaging demonstrates corporate responsibility and aligns with modern customer expectations.

Ultimately, premium jewelry packaging is more than a container for a product. It is a powerful branding tool, a protective solution, and an essential part of the customer experience. Luxury retailers prioritize high-end packaging because it reinforces their brand values, enhances product presentation, and creates lasting impressions. By investing in exceptional packaging, jewelry brands can elevate customer satisfaction, strengthen their market position, and ensure that every purchase feels truly special.

body.body:
Уряд Португалії подасть до парламенту проєкт реформи системи соціальної допомоги. Мета - запровадити єдину соцвиплату замість нинішніх 13 різних виплат.

Зміни мають заохотити отримувачів допомоги виконувати “соціяльну роботу” або вчитися на постійних курсах, а не просто отримувати гроші. Це можуть бути волонтерство, прибирання міст, робота у муніципальних чи благодійних організаціях тощо.

Слід очікувати більше перевірок та складніші умови отримання виплат. Працездатні отримувачі допомоги та члени сімей муситимуть виконувати соціально корисні роботи до 15 годин на тиждень. Виняток - пенсіонери, особи з інвалідністю та студенти.

Посилять правила для негромадян ЄС. Вони зможуть претендувати на соцпідтримку тільки після 1 року легального проживання в Португалії.

Економісти наголошують: европейська модель “соціальної держави” більше не життєздатна. Причини - старіння населення, зростання державних витрат на оборону та інші.

body.title: New Pew accessories RMR
body.body: I've got a milestone Birthday coming up soon. For my 50th Birthday, I had my sights set on a .338 Lapua Magnum rifle. It took me another 4 years to save up the money for the one I wanted due to some unexpected disruptions. \n\n![PXL_20260503_123421425.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ksteem/EpA2VLrnCE9hbbFY6BRaBS4Aqnc5JC7kw1b9HkW3AgbpuVpWJQq6ewbaggWN8vAdR7R.jpg) For those that don't instantly recognize, this is typically referred to as a \

(even though mine is green). RMR phrase was coined from the Trijicon Ruggedized Miniature Reflex sight used in military operations. It has become a generic term for these style sights.

This time, I planned ahead. I seldom spend money on myself and don't have many needs. However when I saw a product come out that I had literally been waiting on for decades, I had to pull the trigger on the purchase (get it haha). 

Once decided, of course accessories were in order. I don't leave many of my pew's in their stock configuration. I won't mention where this is going yet, you'll have to come back for the next post.

So, what is this thing? It is the new OSight X from Olight. It's no secret that I've become slightly addicted to the Osight torches, but this RMR style sight is fantastic. 

Most of my other RMR's have been standardized on the Vortex Venom. I would happily replace every one of them with this new Osight if I could. I haven't seen how well it will hold up to the torture tests, and doubt it will ever knock Trijicon out of the top slot for field or military use, but for general purpose home, target, and hunting, this thing is fantastic.

There are several key things that stood out for me on this one.
Standout features:
**Battery replacement** - not needed, recharges with the cover, always fully charged if stored with cover on. Some other sights you have to actually remove the sight (messing up your zero) to replace the battery, not this one.
**Automatic on when detects movement**, automatic off to save battery.
**Dual sight picture** - You can choose between the 3mm dot, the 3mm dot with 32mm circle around it (my favorite), or just the circle.
**Bright, variable strength brightness control** that I actually found myself turning down.
**The charging cover**, that not only keeps the battery topped up, but can then recharge the sight several times before charging the cover and also displays the charge level.
**Long lasting Battery Life** - Promoted at over 77,000 hours for the sight itself, then 308,000 hours with the charging cover, equal to about 3 full charges.
**Came with mounting plate **and 4 sets of screws for different adapters. (Very nice touch).
**Compatibility** with huge list of weapon and mount systems.


![PXL_20260503_122910805.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ksteem/EoeEubMAJD3svVbDjA7oZHGt2V8eRZrhbLhgnouUTMNQ19YgX5D7izZeWzK1JrpXbXW.jpg) Here is the cover.

# Learn Ethical Hacking (#42) - Custom Exploit Development - Writing Your Own

![leh-banner.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc2LpoeHUPesc4Dy8haRKLJgfuDY6UBKdc3sED8Dz3JH9/leh-banner.jpg)

### What will I learn

- **Why custom exploits matter** -- when off-the-shelf modules fail and you need to write your own;
- **Memory corruption fundamentals** -- the stack, heap, registers, and what happens when software crashes;
- **Buffer overflows** -- smashing the stack to control the instruction pointer;
- **Shellcode** -- writing position-independent code that spawns shells;
- **Return-to-libc** -- calling system functions without injecting code;
- **Writing a Metasploit module** -- turning a PoC into a reusable exploit;
- **Debugging workflow** -- using GDB and x64dbg to analyze crashes and develop exploits;
- Defense: ASLR, DEP/NX, stack canaries, and why modern software is harder to exploit.

### Requirements

- A working modern computer running macOS, Windows or Ubuntu;
- GDB (Linux) or x64dbg (Windows) installed;
- Basic understanding of C and assembly language;
- The ambition to learn ethical hacking and security research.

### Difficulty

- Advanced
