title.title: Dinner at Aroy Dee... A Delicious Chiang Mai Reward After Massage
title.body:
There is something about getting a massage that makes the body feel relaxed, but at the same time, it also makes the appetite go wild LOL. Right after our massage at Calm Massage & Spa, we suddenly felt so hungry that we wanted something satisfying, filling, and of course, delicious. Good thing we were in downtown Chiang Mai, which honestly feels like a paradise for food lovers like us.

![1000162567.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EopuuS4RVvyeTBwMpPDN7wbWcoQBknYWxcTgJe732vM4hVaGjxYvTsXqCq1nkaP4XKp.jpg)

This is one of the things that makes me really like Chiang Mai. The food here is not only delicious, but also affordable. There is always this feeling that the ingredients are fresh and that the restaurants really care about serving food that people will enjoy. Whether it is a simple food stall or a casual restaurant, the flavors always seem to have that comforting Thai charm.

![1000162549.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Eoc7USv7S6TpXrD7rvgW3aHZstpF1JtEWKQMPynTgERKKMh4nSeSqg7QNNqPTCPmQFq.jpg)


![1000162570.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EonmTxD4AJT4SGcdrCxuX67beFPkm7B85svizDJC2zhsT4oPkWy19gjhaUVSd722sWY.jpg)

![1000162569.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoGxRNBCErg3uFAGTozryUWJmppD515yrcsNJ7pSicdj4RJBnzYk39RhUjgUjmMYquP.jpg)

![1000162568.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoeGMP1RsEKYkxW7dot81ArGuNDvuheaq43UshMmXXADoMekwkDyPupRMf7Vog1zV3B.jpg)

Just a few minutes walk from the spa, we found ourselves at Aroy Dee. It is a simple restaurant, but it has a very interesting and artistic personality. The interior has wooden details, paintings on the wall, and these different lights hanging from the ceiling. In my eyes, the lighting has a kind of pleasing chaos hahaha. It is not too polished or too fancy, but that is exactly why I felt comfortable there.


![1000162571.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Eoc7yhfRX9A6qxLHnupjLUwhi3uprs8kQmEyajG2B8bksHZB7fgv8xSPnbZYK5iuJWB.jpg)

![1000162572.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/23wqq1zxuyNv3GdpN3SvVGkjwngKTfZNBCrTfomdE1mUYy4NfZ1kNkuJzWS3imQwoMr96.jpg)

![1000162573.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EogNJnMjXWWfuLVpS62DxR5utjzxjNLpusL1iAD7VhLU6Qwv782hGFSSkuiPZJP7Xhm.jpg)

![1000162550.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoiXAr3KdSBMwSzBnfPcCwVGGZxhgDpG181xfHnUtGLiMCRzSkLX88V2eXaXK3w7fNC.jpg)

![1000162548.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoeFQtYbK7nQW7fuLUeaToSq7WkKAkgrzNCwpZ2W7vruLzHHA6X4H3i1DJHte2SKHrS.jpg)

Honestly, I am more comfortable eating in places like this compared to expensive restaurants. For me, it is really all about the food. A place does not need to be luxurious as long as the food is good, the ambiance is relaxed, and the experience feels genuine.

![](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoeHm4FtNzC16VnfwLCfiDSkS36hBhy25L7wQf24waVeef2CqFnqdKQxTJqh8Cm9CmN.jpg?token=d0a856946396ca00b5729d04197f076289ff3fab0c01c4da)


![](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Eo6NnEtbbkPzRQBNYruu3hwV2vtJ1kJykj1M8bKzm3DfkvdaUDg1yae8z2KzNBbkEHT.jpg?token=d0a856946396ca00b5729d04197f076289ff3fab0c01c4da)





Aroy Dee has a wide variety of dishes on the menu, which made choosing a little bit difficult. But since I am a fan of Pineapple Fried Rice, that was the dish I ordered right away. I chose the prawn version because prawns and fried rice are always a good combination for me. We also ordered Phad Thai because it is too popular and iconic to ignore, right? And to make the meal even more exciting, we added Roasted Pork as well.

![](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EogRF4zToNm3Crbvk82qjuAL85ZA9bmA2An4kshZBiWVknFWkU8B9KoXfha6s2gWr8e.jpg?token=d0a856946396ca00b5729d04197f076289ff3fab0c01c4da)

![](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoK9brWBmkWDY2e75DxEUpQtmTfRxhp1r91TA7zvZ4zkhQReTj7N3225VVaTwo3Y4t4.jpg?token=d0a856946396ca00b5729d04197f076289ff3fab0c01c4da)


![](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoySqKiNVCvS5ntrroBkg2KKae7Bw6bC9dnkWpkvyaKbQPwUFggnTHkeVcenz5TSEf2.jpg?token=d0a856946396ca00b5729d04197f076289ff3fab0c01c4da)

For drinks, we ordered fresh coconut and a mango-passion fruit smoothie. I already knew that with the dishes we ordered, these drinks would be a good way to balance all the savory and rich flavors on the table.

![](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EonnuiZ2sC41LT1FDHBYTX1mZXaVM4EheiZQU1yHNjWesc31jLdQg9CnvbSPquPeGVN.jpg?token=d0a856946396ca00b5729d04197f076289ff3fab0c01c4da)

![](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/23yx1VDPPVC78XK3dZE68WoTXveu6eSnuiUXBPCxBMwEdv65UnCGjzqXbFWQjA5x9EqKf.jpg?token=d0a856946396ca00b5729d04197f076289ff3fab0c01c4da)

The Pineapple Fried Rice was really enjoyable. It remains one of the best Thai dishes in my opinion because it has that combination of sweet, tangy, and savory flavors. The rice was flavorful, the prawns added that seafood sweetness, and every spoonful felt exciting. It is the kind of dish that makes me understand why Thai food is loved by so many people.

![](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EowKVwfMLDaUqEsNbU9cRazf2JyQdrBmPHj1teh4WymSfw3AJxxzT3sGAYm3BZVq31r.jpg?token=d0a856946396ca00b5729d04197f076289ff3fab0c01c4da)

The Phad Thai was also very nice. I liked the mix of textures from the noodles, egg, vegetables, and toppings. The flavors were balanced and familiar, yet still very satisfying. There is a reason why this dish became popular in almost every corner of the world hehehe.


![](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoiZ6thbuLpLSgZsyzQs5JvRVJQBc9bWrDXRNUkJkZ7xgx8kQnpAKUczYRhDEq4Hij1.jpg?token=d0a856946396ca00b5729d04197f076289ff3fab0c01c4da)

But the star of the night for me was definitely the Roasted Pork. The crunch of the skin was out of this world. I do not think I have tried anything this crispy and satisfying before. The meat was tender and juicy, and when paired with the dipping sauce, it became even better. It was simple, but so perfect.

The drinks were also a great match for the meal. The fresh coconut was refreshing, while the mango-passion fruit smoothie gave that fruity and slightly tangy reset in between bites.

![](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EqJ1kZLAN2PPLUrG3r32jcqcbjHvvvWw54sqYHAoFKGTo9snb8wDv8KWWYmE62f3HJD.jpg?token=d0a856946396ca00b5729d04197f076289ff3fab0c01c4da

![](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Ep7wTXwFeiM3kmNsne1eS1qik5oR4J8qTjGfsSqA837boBi2Fr53sgkUPDRWnjyHjx6.jpg?token=d0a856946396ca00b5729d04197f076289ff3fab0c01c4da)

![](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EopuSNFAm3PU23GBtz916jjXX6j8TQXnU2niuXAzbNn7jdhfVvmjRfyUYUARgVAjBZj.jpg?token=d0a856946396ca00b5729d04197f076289ff3fab0c01c4da)

### Overall, our dinner at Aroy Dee was the perfect way to finish the day. After a relaxing massage and a very filling Thai dinner, I felt so happy and satisfied. On my next visit to Chiang Mai, I will definitely come back to Aroy Dee for more!

![](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EogQBzVnbvwVmokth1Ae5QYiSaFaQxiJwpX21xB1jfgmaFmPffTDWHqD7LJWfoxyzri.jpg?token=d0a856946396ca00b5729d04197f076289ff3fab0c01c4da)

title.title: «أكسا مصر» ترعى تحدي «InsurTech 2026» لدعم الابتكار وتسريع نمو شركات التأمين التكنولوجي - Fintechgate
title.body:
## مقدمة

في عالم يتجه نحو الرقمنة المتسارعة، يصبح الابتكار في قطاع التأمين ليس خياراً بل ضرورة. ومع اقتراب عام 2026، شهدت مصر إطلاق مبادرة جديدة تهدف إلى تحفيز الشركات الناشئة في مجال التأمين التكنولوجي: قضية “InsurTech 2026”. برعمها في قلب الأحداث، تدعو هذه المسابقة إلى إعادة صياغة مفاهيم التأمين التقليدية بدعم مالي، فني، وشبكة اتصالات واسعة.

## لماذا يُعَدّ هذا التحدي مهماً؟

1. **التغير السريع في توقعات المستهلك**  
   يطالب الزبائن اليوم برحلات شراء غير معقولة وسلسة، وتُتيح المنصات الرقمية لهم التفاعل مع تأميناتهم في لحظات. لا يستطيع القطاع التأميني الوشيك أن يظل مفروزاً أو قائماً على النماذج الانيئين.

2. **نقص الكفاءات التكنولوجية**  
   يُعاني سوق التأمين في مصر من نقص واضح في الجمعيات التي يمكنها تطوير تطبيقات ذكية، تحليلات بيانات، أو حلول معالجة الذكاء الاصطناعي. تُعد المسابقة منصة لهزيمتها.

3. **التعزّز في التعاون بين القطاعين العام والخاص**  
   يبرّز هذا الحدث قدرة حكومات مصرية على التعاون مع شركات التكنولوجيا، ما يخلق بيئة عمل جاذبة للموهوبين والمستثمرين.

## دور “أكسا مصر” كراعٍ

تهدف “أكسا مصر” إلى:
- تمويل البحوث التطبيقية وتوفير رأس المال الأولي للمستثمرين المبدعين.
- تغذية المشروعات بمعلمي الصناعة وملهمين من القطاع المالي.
- توسيع إمكانية الوصول إلى السوق عبر منصة جديدة، بحيث يتم دمج العملاء بذكاء وجذبهم إلى منتجات تأمين محسّنة.

الدعم المقارب لا يقتصر على النصيحة فحسب، بل يتضمن إدراج الرفاهية بروكليجًا واضحًا ليس فقط لنجوم التقنية الذين يعرفون ماذا يفعلون، ولكن أيضًا للقطاع التجاري المتغير الذي يحتاج إلى تكنولوجيا وفعالية.

## التكنولوجيا التي ستتألف المسابقة

1. **الذكاء الاصطناعي وتعلم الآلة**  
   تحليل بيانات المخاطر، تسعير ديناميكي، وتحديد النماذج العادلة للمدفوعات يُقلل من عبء القروض وغرامات التقييم.

2. **حلول البلوكشين**  
   تشفير الملكية وتقييم الأصول المرهقة، وتسهيل تدفقات المدفوعات لإعطاء ثقة على مستوى ذي اكتمال واستقرار.

3. **التحليلات القابلة للترجمة**  
   تحليل سلوك المستهلكات عبر مسافات التطبيقات، والملائمة الشخصية.

إلى جانب ذلك، قد يتتبع المسابقة التوجهات الدولية مثل حلول “حافظ “ For banking، حيث تنفّذ منتجات مشابهة من بين الجمهور المستهلك.

## أثر محلي عالمي

- تُمنح الشركات الناشئة فرصة الولوج إلى قواعد مصرفية محلية، مع إمكانية التوسع الدولية عبر منصات عالميّة تهدف الي تسهيل المنصات عن https://theindustryawards.com/ .
- تحفّز المجتمعات الاقتصادية على استثمار في مشاريع NGOs تظهر في أوضاع مالية أكثر رفاهية ومرونة.

## كيف يمكن للشركات والتعليم تحضير مستترك

- **ابتكار الأدوات التقنية** 🎯: تشجيع المجتمعات على ابتكار برامج أو أدوات تخفيض نفقات رهانات عددية فائعة.
- **المشاريع المفتوحة** 🌍: تخليل المنصات على دراستها، مدنً التقنية، الاحتياطي للوصول إلى لمكافأة عقيمات التلات.
- **الانخراط بالمستثمرين** 💸: بصتحة تحديد قابلٍ للرجوع للترخيص والاختصاصيّة والتمويل الخاص والاحتياطي.

## الخلاصة

أكبر تحدٍ في قطاع التأمين المصري هو البقاء مع الحداثة مع المحافظة على بنية تحتية متداخلة وبإمكانها التفاعل مع المتغيرات السوقية.  Tackling “InsurTech 2026” من خلال رعاية “أكسا مصر بينالّ التسويق بكفاءة النتائج وتعريف الشركات على مستقبلها مع التزام السياسة المالية في المشروعات. العرب المتوقّعة التي تُقدّم الأدلة على هذا العمل، وتعريف المتخصصين، والملامح الدولية للدفع للعودة مع قبول الاستثمار، تُعرّض تطوراً ملحوظاً على مدى السنوات القليلة المقبلة.

title.body:
Anch’io penso che il Red Bull Ring sia molto più interessante da seguire in MotoGP che in Formula 1. Le staccate sono spettacolari e spesso basta un piccolo errore per cambiare completamente la gara. Quando faccio i miei pronostici cerco sempre di guardare non solo i risultati recenti, ma anche il rendimento dei piloti su circuiti simili. Proprio per questo ogni tanto confronto statistiche e analisi provenienti da fonti diverse; recentemente mi è capitato di leggere alcuni approfondimenti su [bet-score.it](https://bet-score.it/) e ho trovato interessante il modo in cui vengono presentati dati e trend delle competizioni. Per questa gara, comunque, credo che Marquez resti il favorito, ma non mi sorprenderei di vedere una sorpresa sul podio. La MotoGP riesce sempre a regalarne qualcuna.

Black and White Photography
title.body: >\nGreetings everyone today is another Post entry I will do here in this Wonderful community initiated by #monomad. My black and white topic post I have is all about black and white street photography. This morning, I decided to take a walk here in this wide street near in our house. It is nice to walk early in the morning and served as simple exercise as well. Expected to see lots of things that can be perfect to captured in images. This four lanes concreted busy road is located at Barangay Punta Silum particularly in Zone 6. Everyday, there are lots of different kinds of vehicles passing by here going to different places and destinations. Aside of that, this area here is filled with lots of cable wires and electric post on which some of it are connected to the commercial establishments and houses.\n</div class=\

>


![IMG_20260530_085204.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daily.life/EouAAuqyTt1qEmAJwL59EDtbRBYy1gsLcbgQFtKusHqc4xfVesRJnmZsvWj2P4fbDmn.jpg)
</center>
It was still 6 in the morning and stil the street was slightly empty with vehicles. Only few trucks, cars and motorcycle passing by because it was still early in the morning. This portion of the area is the boundary point between the two Barangays; Barangay Punta Silum and Barangay Calangahan. Each side of this area also contains a rocky cliffs where lots of wild grass and peebles can be seen and found. Few bill boards and tall trees also found here, it keeps the place cool and relaxing because of the shady areas brought by big and tall trees. Sometimes, there are lots of people who also doing simple exercises like jogging or walking activities together with their friends and families. 

![IMG_20260530_085600.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daily.life/EoK7JXbZTVmQfv7qzXiwV5W9aJEz1gkG8G1bVAhdJb6ywXc1DhAPcE7t7prMHXUZp6A.jpg)
</center>
This big trucks can create shaking to the ground and a loud of noise because of its horns and sound of the rolling tires. It is slight scary to crossed the street because of the big trucks and other kinds of vehicles very fast running and passing by the place. It really needs to checked both side of the road before crossing the street. Rushing hours just like friday also have crowded of trucks and vehicles here passing by. This big tanker carries tons and barrels of Gasoline to other far side places. While Car drivers also drive very fast so they can reached their destination on time without getting late. Most parts of the road here already contains lots of big cracks because of the heavy trucks always passing by here and most of it are already in small holes at the concrete road. 

![IMG_20260530_085342.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daily.life/Eq5E2CvX39oESKz3wRMVx8smq9r6qLDw2oPLvi3zAHxdydn1KhvYvBr2wif4zxbXCub.jpg)
</center>
Stores just like this one is not open that kind of time, the store was still closed even if it is already 5 in the morning. This store sells lots of breads and that was also my planned, to brought few pieces of bread but I cannot buy because it was still closed. Only this store was built near at the street and it really looks like very scary because it is near at the accident prone areas. The entire structure is made of plainsheets including walls and rooftops, planted with few balete trees.

![IMG_20260530_092724.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daily.life/Ep7wTcfEnNXN2BqmdaAKhPakgKNauCPp3ugs1x5rSSQ8g9kdKLCz74THKgBKa3MkeGb.jpg)
</center>

![IMG_20260530_092845.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daily.life/EoeHJwYVCVUdq2a2DrLtzKa65CQYqKbhvtaH1QfRoMfppU8CtziKBRSmSdVjM7g4PeG.jpg)
</center>
By crossing this street, it needs to run very fast after checking both side of the street. I really felt nervous everytime when I crossed here but I kept myself calm while checking if there are any vehicles running very fast and passing here. For me, road is the back bone of the economy, without this place the products and goods cannot be transferred which can help the economy to the other place. Even if it is dangerous, I must kept myself calm and always keep alert by crossing the street.

Until next post, have a nice day to all of us. 

|Details|| Remarks|

title.body: >Koç Nakliyat Firmasından Bayraklı Evden Eve Nakliyat Hizmeti Biz, **Koç Nakliyat** olarak Bayraklı evden eve nakliyat alanında müşterilerimize güvenilir, hızlı ve profesyonel taşımacılık hizmetleri sunuyoruz. Taşınma sürecinin her aile için önemli bir değişim olduğunu biliyor, bu süreci daha kolay ve konforlu hale getirmek için titizlikle çalışıyoruz. Yılların kazandırdığı deneyim ve uzmanlığımız sayesinde eşyalarınızı güvenle yeni adreslerinize ulaştırıyoruz.

/>

Biz, taşınma öncesinde detaylı planlama yapıyor ve her müşterimizin ihtiyaçlarına özel çözümler geliştiriyoruz. Eşyaların güvenli şekilde taşınabilmesi için kaliteli ambalaj malzemeleri kullanıyor, kırılabilecek veya hassas ürünleri özel koruma yöntemleriyle paketliyoruz. Mobilyaların sökülmesi, paketlenmesi, taşınması ve yeni adresinizde yeniden kurulması gibi işlemleri profesyonel ekibimizle gerçekleştiriyoruz.

Bizim önceliğimiz müşteri memnuniyetidir. Bu nedenle taşınma sürecinin her aşamasında şeffaf iletişim kuruyor, müşterilerimizin sorularını yanıtlıyor ve ihtiyaç duydukları desteği sağlıyoruz. Taşıma sırasında düzenli ve dikkatli çalışma prensibi benimsiyor, eşyalarınızın güvenliğini en üst seviyede tutuyoruz.

Biz, Bayraklı’nın farklı mahallelerinde gerçekleştirdiğimiz evden eve nakliyat hizmetlerinde zamanında teslimat anlayışıyla hareket ediyoruz. Modern araç filomuz ve deneyimli personelimiz sayesinde hem küçük hem de büyük çaplı taşınma işlemlerini sorunsuz şekilde tamamlıyoruz. Her [İzmir evden eve nakliyat](https://www.evdeneveizmir.com.tr/) sürecinde planlı hareket ediyor, müşterilerimizin günlük yaşamlarının minimum düzeyde etkilenmesini hedefliyoruz.

Biz, Koç Nakliyat olarak kaliteli hizmet anlayışımızla [Bayraklı evden eve nakliyat](https://www.evdeneveizmir.com.tr/bayrakli-evden-eve-nakliyat) ihtiyaçlarına profesyonel çözümler sunuyor, eşyalarınızı güvenle taşıyarak taşınma sürecinizi rahat ve güvenilir bir deneyime dönüştürüyoruz.

title.title: What an unexpected win.!
title.body: Greetings everyone! When I played my today's game I was really very shocked. Even when you will see my today's battle you will also say that splinterlands is really an unexpected game monsters and ruleset can do anything. Today's game was really very amazing and shocking because I was about to lose the game but still anyhow I win unexpectedly. When you see the opponent monsters and compare to you at that moment you can assume who will win the game, but when game changes either in or your opposition side it really makes us uncomfortable. Now let me share you about the battle in detail:-
/> The name of the ruleset was _Earthquake: All nonflying and snared units take 2 physical damage at the beginning of each round, starting round 2._

/> So we need to chose the strong monsters because of the ruleset otherwise they will lose their 2 health for sure after every round. The battle was of 49 mana cost so of course we can choose the strong monsters I was trying to make my full deck but I can't because lack of mana cost, even opponent bring only 4 monsters but they were too good.
/> Now let me share you about the battle in detail:-

/> So as the round starts everyone was just attacking on each other just see the opponent first and third monster they were really too good and strong so it was looking hard for my monsters. In this round no monster was eliminate but they really made very weak to all my monsters except lord. So in this round no monster get knock but everyone lose lot.

/> So again as the round starts everyone lose their health by -2 as per the ruleset. Roc get knock from the game after that opponent monster attack on dread by -6 and eliminate him within single attack. I was really afraid at that moment because again when time bandit came ahead to the front position opponent first monster attack on time and eliminate him within single attack. So in this single round I lose my 3 monsters and opponent have all the monsters in the game.

/> So after getting the earthquake to all the monsters my monsters really get weak. Lord took the first move and attack on opponent first monster and eliminate him from the battle. But still the game was very hard for my monsters to win. After that opponent monsters attack on lord and make him really weak. At this position if we see I am about to lose the battle.

/> So again as round starts everyone get earthquake and lose their health now lord was on single health and after that lord attack on opponent first monster and make him knock, but after that again opponent monster attack on lord and make him knock from the game. So now the game was 1v2. Still it was looking hard because swamp cannot win the game alone.

/> So again as round starts every monster get the earthquake and lose their health by -2. Me and my opponent monster was left with only single health. So it was a really amazing move because of the ruleset swamp attack on opponent monster and reduce his last health and win me the game. So this is how the game changes it was literally unexpected the major role was played of the ruleset it every monster does not lose the health then for sure I will lose the battle.

/>

title.title: Священник, який зійшов із “Титаніка”: неймовірна історія Френка Брауна
title.body: У Emo Court є одна історія, яка звучить так, ніби її вигадав Голлівуд.\n\n

/> Священник, який випадково вижив після «Титаніка». Його звали Френк Браун. Народився в Корку у 1880 році, навчався в Дубліні, вступив до ордену єзуїтів і все життя захоплювався фотографією. Камера супроводжувала його всюди — фактично він став одним із перших фотодокументалістів Ірландії. У квітні 1912 року дядько подарував йому квиток на перші етапи рейсу нового гігантського лайнера — «Титаніка». Браун сів на корабель у Саутгемптоні й плив до Коба. Величний лайнер, як ви знаєте, 10 квітня 1912 року «Титанік» вирушив із Southampton На борту було понад 2200 людей. Корабель вважали технічним дивом епохи: довжина — майже 270 метрів, власний спортзал, басейн, турецькі лазні, розкішні ресторани, електричні ліфти. На борту Франку настільки сподобалось, він фотографував все навкруги, що навіть один американський пасажир запропонував оплатити подорож аж до Нью-Йорка. І от тут історія робить різкий поворот. Френк попросив дозволу в керівництва ордену. У відповідь отримав коротку телеграму:

>Зійди з цього корабля».

Він послухався наказу. 11 квітня 1912 року корабель прибув до Cobh, який тоді називався Queenstown. Це була остання точка Європи перед Атлантикою.

>Тут багато ірландських емігрантів сіли на корабель,
Френк Браун зійшов із борту після тієї знаменитої телеграми:

>«Get off that ship.»

Він зробив останні фотографії «Титаніка» перед катастрофою. Через кілька днів корабель затонув... Після катастрофи ці знімки Френка облетіли газети по всьому світу. Його архів фотографій згодом став справжньою історичною скарбницею. Іноді одна коротка телеграма буквально вирішує, житимеш ти чи станеш частиною історії. ‼️ обовʼязково напишіть попередньо на пошту імʼя і скільки людей планують бути ❤️ 📧 [emocourtguides@opw.ie](mailto:emocourtguides@opw.ie) Тур розрахований на 15 людей в групі

title.title: What Types of Agricultural Equipment Are Most Commonly Used by Farmers in India?
title.body:
![What Types of Agricultural Equipment Are Most Commonly Used by Farmers in India .jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/6edbf69c83cc1d4ae550de254b3859d25e3739b809a04de353f016ea4693785b)



Agricultural equipment plays an important role in modern farming across India. These machines help farmers save time, reduce labor costs, and improve crop productivity. Today, farmers use different types of agricultural equipment depending on the size of their land and farming requirements.

One of the most commonly used machines is the [agricultural sprayer](https://chandakagroequipment.weebly.com/chandakagro/what-types-of-agricultural-equipment-in-india-are-most-commonly-used-by-farmers), which helps spray pesticides, herbicides, fertilizers, and crop protection chemicals evenly across fields. Power sprayers and battery-operated sprayers are especially popular among Indian farmers because they make spraying faster and more efficient.

Brush cutters are also widely used for removing weeds, grass, and unwanted plants around farms. For soil preparation, many farmers rely on mini tillers and cultivators, which help loosen the soil before planting crops.

Chainsaws are useful for cutting trees, pruning branches, and maintaining orchards. Farmers involved in plantation farming often use chainsaws for regular land maintenance. Earth augers are another important tool used for digging holes for fencing, plantation, and horticulture activities.

Modern agricultural equipment helps farmers increase efficiency while reducing physical effort. As technology continues to improve, more Indian farmers are adopting advanced farming machines to achieve better yields and sustainable agricultural growth.

title.title: Паб, барбершоп, фастфуд — і відмивання мільйонів: нове обличчя організованої злочинності
title.body: В Ірландії дедалі більше говорять про те, що організована злочинність давно перестала виглядати як у фільмах про мафію.\n\n

/>

Сьогодні відмивання грошей може ховатися за дверима звичайного пабу, фастфуду, барбершопу чи маленького магазину на сусідній вулиці. За даними розслідування The Irish Times, кримінальні мережі використовують легальний бізнес для “очищення” мільйонів євро, отриманих від шахрайства, наркотрафіку та кіберзлочинів.

Особливо небезпечно те, що у схеми активно втягують молодь і студентів — через так звані “money mule” акаунти. Людям пропонують швидкі гроші за використання їхнього банківського рахунку, але наслідки можуть бути дуже серйозними: кримінальні справи, борги, заборона на банківські послуги й навіть міжнародні розслідування.

Це ще одне нагадування: сучасна організована злочинність виглядає не як гангстер із кіно, а як “нормальний бізнес” поруч із нами.

title.body: > @steevc just finished a 10.02km run, that lasted for 78 minutes. This run helped steevc burn 630.0 calories. --- **Description from Strava:** I thought we were through the hot period, but it may break tomorrow. It was warm when I headed off to the lakes for parkrun. I was logging the whole outing for the work challenge. Some of my regular friends were there, but also bassist/triathlete Jon with his wife and daughter. I had not seen him there in a while, but he has had injuries. I may have started a little quick, but I was feeling good and so just went with it. Plenty of people passed me, but I do not worry about what they are doing. It is nice that the course has some shade so it was a little cooler there. By half way I was really feeling it and slowed down a bit, but just tried to keep going. I finished 76 of 222 in 27:14, which is my best time this year at Henlow. I am quite happy with that. I went for coffee at the camp shop with a few people. There is some shade to sit outside there and cool off a little. I walked home with Linda after she had sorted the finish tokens and I helped put the gear away. I decided to do an extra lap of our block to stretch the outing over 10km and so I jogged that. I needed a little while to cool down before my shower, but am feeling good. I may be in the pool later today. The weather is due to turn tomorrow so I will aim to do a long run in the morning and then some gardening as everything is growing like mad. Have a great weekend and run free! --- If you would like to check out this activity on strava you can see it here: https://www.strava.com/activities/18712824092 **About the Athlete:** *Older guy trying to keep fit, but still hope to go quicker.*

title.title: Sapien Loop 3 - Chapter 64: Righting the Ship
title.body:
![Sapien_Loop_3_Cover_HIVE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spectrumecons/23wC7hkTDDpnHvZegULctqg6Mrrd9t72byH8zWkVgfNiHGiHqm7aVAeGi9PiELYyYAuVf.jpg)

## Chapter 64: Righting the Ship

-----

Outside the hotel, the technicians began to angrily protest Tiberius’ guilty verdict. All of the region’s enforcers guarded the hotel. The executive council members were unable to leave the hotel because of the aggressive nature of the protests. Tiberius had been taken to the basement of the hotel. Miro was in an upper-floor suite. He had invited Cecil to discuss security.

‘The trial did not go as expected,’ said Miro as he paced up and down the lounge area of the suite.

‘You convicted him,’ chuckled Cecil, who was sitting comfortably on the sofa.

‘At what price?!’ said Miro angrily. ‘The technicians are after my blood. What if the enforcers turn on me next? I will be killed.’

‘I control most of the enforcers now,’ said Cecil. ‘You know that. That’s why I’m here.’

‘Yes, yes, but can you keep control over them?’ asked Miro in a distressed tone. ‘Head Enforcer is after me. He has power over them.’

‘He has power over the imperial guards,’ said Cecil calmly. ‘Most of them died in the Great Battle. His influence over the enforcers is very limited, trust me.’

‘Well, you better keep it that way,’ said Miro.

‘For the right price, no problem,’ chuckled Cecil.

‘What does that mean?’ asked Miro as he stopped pacing.

‘I want to be made a general,’ said Cecil as he leaned forward. ‘I want all of Tiberius’ wealth transferred to me.’

‘No, seriously,’ said Miro.

‘I’m deadly serious,’ said Cecil in a more aggressive tone.

‘You are raving mad,’ replied Miro. ‘I will give you a modest pay rise, a promotion, and, if you do a good job, maybe a reasonable lump sum payment.’

‘I should probably go and talk to Duffo,’ said Cecil as he stood up. ‘Maybe he’ll do the right thing.’

‘What the hell does that mean?!’ asked Miro aggressively.

‘You don’t seem prepared to make the necessary actions to survive,’ said Cecil. ‘I might as well as speak to someone who does.’

‘Fine, General Cecil,’ said Miro. ‘I will give you one tenth of Tiberius’ wealth.’

‘Weak,’ replied Cecil as he started to walk towards the door.

‘Okay, a quarter of his wealth,’ said Miro, sounding desperate.

‘I’ve known you a long time,’ said Cecil as he turned around. ‘I like you. Seeing you dragged onto the streets and butchered would sadden me.’

‘How dare you!’ said Miro.

‘Half his wealth, that is my last offer,’ said Cecil.

‘Okay, deal,’ said Miro. ‘I will pay you half on Tiberius’ disposal and half once the technicians have calmed down.’

‘No,’ said Cecil. ‘Half in under a week and half when the technicians have calmed down. Don’t delay disposing of Tiberius. As long as he’s around, he’s a threat.’

‘Agreed,’ said Miro, nodding his head.

‘Great,’ said Cecil as he left the suite. ‘You can sleep safely now.’

‘He completely owned you,’ chuckled Julie as she became visible.

‘You have no business being here,’ said Miro. ‘You set me up.’

‘I did no such thing,’ replied Julie. ‘You had the perfect opportunity to disgrace and humiliate Tiberius, and you botched it.’

‘He was prepared,’ said Miro.

‘And you weren’t!’ shouted Julie as she shapeshifted to August.

‘Yes, well, Cecil will solve this problem,’ said Miro. ‘You heard him.’

August began to laugh. ‘You’ve put your faith in that idiot. He’ll backstab you in a heartbeat or sooner,’ he added as he shapeshifted into Cecil.

‘No, you wouldn’t,’ said Miro.

‘I own you until the day you die,’ said August. ‘If you acknowledge that, you might survive your first year of leadership. If not, there’s always Duffo or Hermon.’

‘Okay, I understand,’ said Miro nervously.

‘Good boy,’ said August as he rubbed the cheeks on Miro’s face.

Hermon and Benny were in the hotel suite opposite to Miro’s. They were sitting on the sofa together. They were both sobbing. 

Julie casually strolled in to check in on them. ‘You’re taking today quite hard,’ she remarked.

‘It’s not that,’ said Benny as he rubbed his nose with a tissue. ‘It’s this film. It’s so sad.’

‘The mother Sape is dying,’ blubbed Hermon.

‘I see,’ said Julie as she sat down next to them. ‘Let’s hope she can pull through. Kind of like how both of you are going to pull through.’

‘Oh, no spoilers please,’ said Benny.

‘I wouldn’t dream of it,’ replied Julie. ‘Surprises are just too much fun.’

The next morning. Miro and his staff had setup cameras in his hotel suite so that he could address the technicians directly from his sofa. Henders and the senior technician who had conducted the DNA tests on Tiberius accompanied him. Julie was standing behind the camera crew observing Miro. The technicians were currently protesting in the town square. They were still demanding the release of Tiberius.

‘Good morning, residents of the Downs region,’ said Miro as she grinned into the camera. ‘Understandably you are angry about yesterday’s trial. It left too many unanswered questions. We failed to prove beyond a doubt to you that Tiberius is a fraud.’

The technicians began to chant, ‘Let Him Go.’

‘Last night, Henders conducted another thorough set of DNA tests on Tiberius,’ said Miro as he nodded at Henders and the senior technician. ‘I’ll let him show you the results.’

‘Henders and I have conducted the same DNA test as was previously done at the West Camp,’ said the senior technician. ‘The results we obtained were the same. He is a distant relative of the other Alset family, and therefore it is impossible that he’s Hamish Alset.’

Henders nodded and held up a message reading, ‘He is not Hamish.’

The technician protestors became silent. Their silence filled Miro with confidence.

‘We are going to make some major changes,’ said Miro as he looked across at Julie, who was in the corner of the room. ‘Sapey will no longer have an Emperor. We are going to transition towards a new form of governance. I will assume the role of dictator for one year. After that, our new form of governance will be fully implemented.’

The protestors remained silent.

‘I know most of you have a debt problem,’ said Miro. ‘Tiberius claimed an enormous proportion of the Empire’s wealth. That is not fair on any of you. Now that he has been stripped of his power and authority, I am going to transfer a large portion of his wealth to our hard-working technicians who have been unfairly forced into debt.’

The technician protestors in the town square began to cheer.

‘In good news, that was overshadowed by the trial,’ continued Miro as he began to grin slightly at the sounds of the cheers coming from outside. ‘Our enforcers have returned victorious from an attack on the evil terrorist cult group.’

The technicians began to cheer even louder.

‘Captain Cecil courageously led these enforcers to victory and has been promoted to the rank of general,’ said Miro proudly. ‘He is the overall leader of the enforcers. Our enforcer instructor Eric replaces Head Enforcer as the head of the Downs Region enforcers. Head Enforcer will not serve as an enforcer in any capacity. He will now be referred to by his birth name of Fabien. The imperial guards will be disbanded. Enforcers will be in charge of all security matters and enforcement of law.’

Miro paused for a second. He looked over to one of his team members who was standing on his balcony. The team member nodded to him. Then Miro looked over to Julie, and she nodded as well.

‘Next week in the town square, I will hold my official inauguration as your first dictator,’ said Miro confidently. ‘Everyone is welcome to attend this exciting event.’

The technicians seemed a little less enthusiastic but still cheered a little.

‘My executive council will provide you with updates in the coming months,’ continued Miro. ‘I wish everyone a wonderful day, thank you.’

The broadcast ended. Miro looked over at Julie again as she walked towards him.

‘Just like that, the technicians are behind you again,’ said Julie.

‘Yes, your plan worked beautifully,’ said Miro as he stood up.

‘The key is to stay calm and think of the assets you have on hand,’ added Julie as she waved goodbye to Henders and the senior technician who were walking towards the door.

Miro nodded.

Hermon and Benny had watched the broadcast from their hotel suite. 

‘Looks like we have lots of work to do,’ said Benny in an upbeat tone. ‘It’ll be worth it to ease everyone’s financial pain.’

‘Yes, you’re going to be very busy,’ said Hermon as he looked at Benny. ‘I’ll be in a perfect position to claim credit for this, and the Empire’s reserves won’t even need to be touched.’

‘Oh no,’ sighed Benny. ‘More scheming and you don’t just think it. You announce it.’

‘I’m counting down the weeks to when I’m overwhelming supported to take the helm,’ said Hermon as he grinned broadly while staring at Benny. ‘The era of Hermon will soon be upon us.’

Julie had made her way down to the basement to visit Tiberius. Tiberius was sitting on a single bed in a basic storeroom. He had watched Miro’s announcement and seen the response of the protestors in the town square on a small television placed in the corner of the room.

‘The show goes on even when the actors change,’ said Julie as she briefly shapeshifted her face into Colin’s as she grinned at him. 

‘Pathetic feeble-minded fools,’ sneered Tiberius as he looked up at the television, which was showing the crowds of technicians happily leaving the town square. ‘They’re still the same scum as their ancestors.’

‘You mean the rebels that killed your grandparents,’ said Julie, shaking her head. ‘They are separated from them by dozens of generations and Alset genetic manipulation, but nothing can change your hatred.’

‘My father married one of them, making me part of them,’ said Tiberius as he looked at Julie. ‘I hated him so much for that, and I hated her even more. At the same, I also loved her. This enormous contradiction in feelings ripped at every fibre in my body.’ 

‘So you killed her, didn’t you?’ asked Julie.

‘Highlight of my life,’ chuckled Tiberius while shaking his head. ‘I watched her die slowly and painfully, and at the same time I saw my invincible father crumble into a complete wreck.’

‘You have absolutely no remorse,’ sighed Julie.

‘Remorse for what!’ said Tiberius aggressively. ‘My mother deserved to die. My father betrayed our whole family line. He deserved to suffer.’

‘What about the orphans? Did they deserve to suffer?’ asked Julie. ‘What about the fifty thousand that you killed in the stadium? Did they deserve to die?’

‘I stopped evil at its roots,’ chuckled Tiberius smugly. ‘I only regret not hunting down the ones that weren’t orphans.’

Julie sighed and shook her head. 

‘The stadium, I thought you would have appreciated that,’ said Tiberius as his grin broadened. ‘That’s how I destroyed the Alset and Yensid Empires and created my own. My biggest regret is that I couldn’t take credit for it.’

Julie frowned and stared at Tiberius.

‘What is that?’ asked Tiberius. ‘Hypocrisy, regret, or maybe envy.’ 

‘You’re completely despicable,’ said Julie angrily. ‘There is no comparison between your actions and mine.’

‘You’re absolutely right, there is no comparison between us,’ said Tiberius angrily. ‘To you, the stadium attack was about power. That’s how it ended, but the real intent was justice.’

‘More delusional crap,’ replied Julie.

‘Don’t interrupt me, damn it!’ shouted Tiberius. ‘The Alset family branched from my royal family line, and so did the other noble families in the North. We were all comfortably wealthy, but that was not enough for Locum Alset. He wanted sole rights to the mining. He made a deal with Rundo, who wanted to control all of Sapey. They supported and funded the rebellion that killed my family and the other noble families. Then they sent in an army to be the heroes. The Alset family had sole rights to the resources, and it made them very rich. Years later, I killed Rundo. Years after, James Yensid and that little shit stripped the North of everything. They all needed to be punished, and they were.’

‘You don’t know the difference between justice and blind vengeance,’ replied Julie.

‘Whatever you call it,’ shouted Tiberius. ‘I had reasons. I was punishing the culprits of crimes against my family, my family line. You, on the other hand, seek only power and wealth. You were born into a rich elite family, but that wasn’t enough. You wanted absolute power and eternal life. You have manipulated all those around you with any means at your disposal. I’m sure the death count I’ve caused pales in comparison to what you’ve managed to achieve over the centuries. Your Sentray apocalypse is on a whole new level of death and destruction, and all you achieved is the fun of living the life of a retard.’

‘Are you finished now?’ asked Julie, who had taken a few steps back.

‘Not quite,’ replied Tiberius as he grinned at Julie. ‘The fifty thousand dead at the stadium was an early estimate based on the number rescued. During the clean-up, we found fewer than ten thousand bodies. We maintained the fifty thousand claim for maximum outrage. To this day, that remains the official and the one even the all-knowing August believes. So before you turn your nose in disgust at me, look in the mirror. That is if you can even find your own disgusting face.’

‘Goodbye, Tiberius,’ said Julie as she walked out of the room.

‘This game isn’t over yet, arsehole,’ chuckled Tiberius to himself.

On her way up from the basement, Julie encountered Cecil.

‘I’m warning you,’ said Cecil as he looked at Julie. ‘Threaten my plans and you’re in real…’

Julie grabbed Cecil by the neck. ‘You’ll take the promotion and the pay rise or I’ll eat you from the feet upwards,’ she snapped angrily. Then she slammed him down hard.

‘I understand,’ gasped Cecil. ‘I’m so sorry.’

title.title: When Rest Becomes the Best Reflection: A Gentle Pause for My Hive Journey While Battling Sickness and Overthinking This Week
title.body: /> **Hello Hive Fam!** Most especially, my ever-supportive Hive Friends all over the world, I’m truly grateful for your presence in my journey. Even on days when I don’t have much of a life update, I still feel the need to connect with you through my reflections.

/> Since yesterday, I haven’t been feeling well. When I woke up today, it became clear that I was sick. Because of this, I decided to reduce my screen time; but of course, I still wanted to write my Hive blog as part of my reflections. Maybe it’s my overthinking attitude this week that made me sick. To be honest, I rarely get sick, but when I do, my body only wants one medicine: **Bioflu**. Alongside that, I rely on simple water therapy. With one whole day of rest, I expect to feel better soon.

/> This moment reminds me that sometimes, the best reflection is simply listening to our body and giving it the rest it deserves. Even when life feels quiet, there’s meaning in pausing, healing, and sharing that journey with friends who care.

/>

Thank you, dear readers, for taking the time to read my reflections today. Your support always lifts me up, even when I’m not at my best. I hope my little pause inspires you to honor your own need for rest whenever life asks for it.

With gratitude,  
Your Hive Friend **Leigh**💚

title.title: [PHOTO BLOG] Jesień i Jan III Sobieski / Autumn and Jan III Sobieski.
title.body: ### Wspomnienie jesieni i kilka faktów historycznych \n\n<div class=\

> Jedne z moich ulubionych jesiennych zdjęć, które zostały wykonane w lasach Kahlenbergu - wzgórza wznoszącego się nad Klosterneuburgiem nieopodal Wiednia. Samo wzgórze ma ogromne znaczenie historyczne również dla Polski. król Jan III Sobieski poprowadził tutaj 12 września 1683 roku słynną odsiecz wiedeńską. Wojska prowadzone przez niego rozgromiły armię Osmańską i mówi się, że nie tylko uratowały Wiedeń, ale również całą zachodnią Europę przed podbojem ze strony tureckiej. Dla Polaków, zwłaszcza tych, którzy mieszkają w Austrii wzgórze to jest symbolem polskiego bohaterstwa i rycerstwa. Na szczycie wzgórza znajduje się kościół św. Józefa, w którym przed bitwą Sobieski wysłuchał mszy świętej odprawionej przez kapelana. W kościele znajduje się polska kaplica z pamiątkami związanymi z bitwą. Sam kościół aktualnie przechodzi remont. Kościół tytułowany jest jako Polskie Sanktuarium Narodowe, a od 1906 roku piecze nad nim sprawuje polskie Zgromadzenie Zmartwychwstańców. Na szczyt wzgórza można dotrzeć samochodem. Znajduje się tu parking. Roztacza się z niego piękny widok na cały Wiedeń i okolice. Wzgórze jest także świetnym terenem rekreacyjnym dzięki licznym ścieżką spacerowym, którymi można także dojść na szczyt np z Klosterneuburga. Nie posiadam niestety zdjęć kościoła. *** ### Memory of autumn and some historical facts Some of my favorite autumn photos that were taken in the forests of Kahlenberg - a hill rising above Klosterneuburg near Vienna. The hill itself is of great historical importance. also for Poland. King Jan III Sobieski led the famous Viennese aid here on September 12, 1683. The troops led by him defeated the Ottoman army and are said to have not only saved Vienna, but also all of Western Europe from conquest by the Turkish side. For Poles, especially those who live in Austria, this hill is a symbol of Polish heroism and chivalry. At the top of the hill is the church of St. Joseph, in which before the battle Sobieski listened to the mass celebrated by the chaplain. In the church there is a Polish chapel with memorabilia related to the battle. The church itself is currently undergoing renovation. The church is titled as the Polish National Sanctuary, and since 1906 it has been supervised by the Polish Resurrection Congregation. The top of the hill can be reached by car. There is a parking lot here. It offers a beautiful view of the whole of Vienna and the surrounding area. The hill is also a great recreational area thanks to numerous walking paths, which you can also walk to the top, for example from Klosterneuburg. Yesterday, I learned how Eli failed as a king because of his disobedience. As a prophet, he was, when God gave him instructions, but he partially followed them, which made God not happy with him. Because of his disobedience, his prophetic calling was called off and given to another person to be the king. The presence of the Lord departed from him.

title.title: A Quiet Rural Path Under the Evening Sun
title.body:
Photography has a unique way of capturing simple moments that often go unnoticed. During a walk through the countryside, I came across this peaceful dirt road stretching into the distance beneath a bright sky. The strong sunlight created a beautiful contrast between the illuminated path and the surrounding greenery, giving the scene a calm and timeless atmosphere.
The lone tree standing beside the road immediately caught my attention. Its silhouette against the bright sky added character to the composition, while the winding path invited the viewer's eyes toward the horizon. The combination of natural elements, open space, and warm light made this a memorable scene to photograph.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmadtyFYi4tcrHruKvvWVASQsFRtiYL1QFP9GnCKjSMVxt/1780140277772.png)

One of the things I enjoy most about rural photography is the sense of tranquility it conveys. Away from the noise of busy streets, places like this offer a chance to appreciate nature's simplicity. The soft textures of the road, the green vegetation, and the distant landscape all contribute to a peaceful visual experience.
I also added a short spiritual message to the sky area of the image:
اللّٰه
Allah is One, without partner, equal, or rival.
The message complements the serene environment and reflects the feeling of reflection and gratitude that such peaceful landscapes often inspire.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUVXCCZ4oSZi5caj8YvbM5WmjWbGmJ2wVd2FRoaioN2ir/1780140450803.jpg)


Thank you for viewing my photograph. I hope you enjoy this quiet countryside scene as much as I enjoyed capturing it.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQZYk5A24E2qonQRhKCFGcDc9BNAJRs5y5v9fQg7ViynB/1780140167442.png)

Camera: Mobile Phone
Location: Rural countryside
Editing: Text overlay added, photograph preserved in its original form

title.title: Late May 2026
title.body:
## Nice View

After heavy rain during May, the garden is all lush and green now.

![IMG_20260525_182146.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/felixxx/Eq5DZ16DmsSRZppPs9JT4zYQVJmCDwSFn9CXXPddxmdDMFTGmYadKBjicJHHKpAE1k3.jpg)

## What The...

I was just enjoying the evening when I heard a buzzing.

![IMG_20260525_182746.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/felixxx/23wgCxaXzXDRayY6qUpBLB51rpKFPuwaRX9RTLKwfBh7D8jGTBpcQs1xGZkGgJroG6rnL.jpg)

## Zoom

I had seen such a white spider last year, for the first time.
Maybe it's the same individual - not sure.

It caught a honey bee.
Without a net. It must have just waited inside the flower and then grabbed the bee.

![IMG_20260525_182801.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/felixxx/23tSSEhGRJuEGyVipetVGqNVuE9dvxrL75f6tDVjZn4x82GXYhzai1Xpnj64d3P8Z9jAb.jpg)

## Fight

The bee put up quite the fight, but the spider had a tight grip.

![IMG_20260525_182823.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/felixxx/23uQjuyvUJ3rhGycfsfYgUJNux6B9rSAka233mSVftGVotAnHnYCmwTcimWHyqJfmq1mj.jpg)

## Nature Is Scary

Eventually, the spider pulled that bee into the flower.
I made other pictures, but they came out bad.

![IMG_20260525_182808.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/felixxx/23tveam3ZWbja4swqZoM5pgwibVbN5EyJKjJyKwsDJWpjwaZqMCnooYA53EDgryLvUWG1.jpg)

## Back To Flowers

I went to take some more pictures afterwards.
Chives in flower and Peony in the background.

![IMG_20260525_181922.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/felixxx/EpT2maM1h4EbKGHa4nhUHDuWU2VDWuRALn8BX2XV4mdVBChaScUeed8peesafwoNGvq.jpg)

## Thorn Flower

This isn't the annual variant, but keeps coming back in this spot for many years

![IMG_20260525_183211.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/felixxx/23xKmq9KKGPSaRQyN71vVDp3ncmYk2wbqHvNSmePFNdG8ZCRKkh1kE95NtqhscKxXhfM4.jpg)

## Iris

Keeps coming back, as pretty as ever.

![IMG_20260525_181713.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/felixxx/Ep7nSje6oyAf8HKqFw6fAT3kzeDVDf8U258CgGZEYZwsb55Upf1dsfaHR9wzdxYSLkN.jpg)

## Lupin 

One of my favourites.
They are good for the soil, binding nitrogen. But I like them mostly for their flowers.

![IMG_20260522_180731.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/felixxx/242DGSTwxcNJbf4GxAAtQqxrRQZGxvp7VkUNzey3iNg2naHmEwhKKFA4aaqYXZpYPAL3o.jpg)

## Food

I also planted a few things, but the rabbit ate all the beetroot tops.
It did nor touch the lettuce and parsley, though.

![IMG_20260525_181656.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/felixxx/EoGwRAzJ96URiQPTfcsuB8gYR9HkgGeMiQGXohzhnZbJhrMe3NkTWUYvhVmN6VtFphP.jpg)

## Next

Next update will be more about vegetables.
Garlic harvest is soon.
I have a row of potatos, maize, some tomatos this year.
Pumkins and Zuccini are ready to be transplanted.

![Big garden - ready to plant crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23uQy6TggDs7Q1Cc2EVqxAUcyypTAVfEXpo5rUHFKVmXs4bdmbfNWGtLL6qe7QBb1UtHZ.jpg)

*Ready to plant*

On Friday morning it was pretty cold when I got up, outside, so I got my post up, finished the bills as far as I could until the checks come in, did the milk order, and finally got ready to go outside around 9:30AM.

I dragged all my equipment over to the Big garden and got started. The first thing to plant was a row of parsley, then a marigold, 2 broccoli plants, another marigold, and a row of beets.

![Small garden - tomato, pepper stakes in crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/Ep1WU6E3Nfdz58HQ3h55zWHrHLpzJnPvoVM7J5yRXFtKfTGjENJ3zivpyAnUyqyXZ1r.jpg)

I was halfway through the beets when my window guy showed up at noon. He was going to pound in tomato and pepper stakes for me. But it only took just over half an hour to do so I had to find some other jobs for him as he had 1½ hours to work off.

![Big garden - next section mulch moved crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/Eos1rtW1eHB2BDqFwVLwvDjFZUVXpZDs1qKvEAFXjbCoY5BNafB6eH77VcNJUJAsV9v.jpg)

So I taught him how to use a pitchfork and set him to moving the mulch off the next section in the Big garden. Then he got it raked up and had used up his time.

![South Herb  peony collage text crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/244A4TmY9fPaTp24mTnGgE3RRzVyCMksX3Tebd2ZWudSwuVzYq72CSuCzPkZkKQd1SCoH.jpg)

In the meantime my #3 helper had arrived at 12:30PM so I set her to finishing the planting of the beets. Once my window guy was going with the mulch, I showed her what type of mulch I needed to put around the parsley and she gathered bucketfuls while I put it down.

Then she found some of the other coarser mulch and filled in the bare areas around the parsley and beets. We both got the broccoli mulched. 

Next I set her to moving the mulch from the north side squash area and she got it amended while I broadforked the needed areas.

None of the squash or tomatoes or peppers had been outside to harden off as the cold frame was full. So we went inside and selected the best of the zucchini, summer squash, and cukes and got them planted.

Then she again collected the soft mulch to put around them all and we both moved the mulch back.  But there wasn’t enough of it so we broke into the hay bale stack.

![Big garden what's planted collage text crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23ynb74XgrapvadsHKRMiDpL3sCncgHZyoMAPZ6cYLJP4LxpmiDcvcE2GLNcDDcBrbbA2.jpg)

It was nearing when she had to go so I sent her on errands while I finished the mulching and set up the sprinkler. None of the peas had come up, or perhaps something had eaten them. But it’s been so dry I suspect they hadn’t germinated.

![Big garden - sprinkler set up crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23xyUvPPUS6YWp3qPSuJqtXAKoA3GPTPoE78ivy3eL3dtF2xiLMijRa3Ppb6ZTnUAmzHn.jpg)

So once I had cleaned up all the equipment, got my notes and photos, I set the sprinkler to run for 3 hours.

She came back and we still had ½ hour left so we just sat and talked and I told her stories of the animals on the farm. When she had gone, I went inside and just sat down to rest.

Around suppertime I got supper started, got a shower, and went out to move the sprinkler to the garlic. I planned to get it set up and run it when I got up in the morning. But no matter how carefully I moved it, it refused to work properly. I spent half an hour walking back and forth trying to adjust it. Finally I set it to center and that worked but only did half the garlic.  So I planned to run it on that half for 1½ hours then move it and do the other half.

![Big garden - watering the garlic crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/Eoryr1AYSK2hSdVRAWLU6rTXd5o6EzWgG4wPinEyz2deNMz3mNw7xp53VTfeCLz4Bxr.jpg)

*Only half at a time…*

After all that walking, I just sat being a vegetable on TikTok or playing solitaire. I had just gotten up to go to bed at 9PM when Tom arrived with the cream. So I got that decanted and was in bed as soon as he left.

My neighbor had called about going to an estate sale on Saturday morning. I knew she didn’t get up early and suggested if she wanted to see much we best there at 8AM before the dealers cleaned it out. She said she’d try to be ready for 8AM.

I am also supposed to be making butter Saturday morning, so I set it up with my #1 intern that I would get the cream to temp and set up all the equipment for her. She could start churning at 8:30AM and I’d be home shortly after that to do the washing.

It’s supposed to rain all morning, but I plan to run the sprinklers anyways, as it’s so dry and lately rain hasn’t netted us much. But it will be too wet to work in the gardens I suspect. I might try weeding a flowerbed and planting it, if it’s not too wet. 

If not, well, I’ll have another day off.

![Mini bio framed Jan 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23xyn876JURgHHjsp757ZTvXeEEBjdDeLXWynRcLCeuqwPPsqtEtXTosSPyKZdAgWivJB.jpg)

title.body: > Hola queridos amigos de @TheAnimeRealm, un gusto pasar por acá, en esta oportunidad quiero hablarles sobre un anime que me pareció entretenido, reflexivo y tranquilo, se llama Let´s Play: Quest-darake no My life, es una historia en la que la vida se ve desde el punto de vista de un juego, en donde subir de nivel dependerá de tus decisiones y las personas que te rodeen, donde cada uno forma parte importante de lo que quieras cumplir. --- ![Let%27s_Play_-_poster1.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23w2nxvg71XX8eXV88FAEhAjGyspFNGNZxohLugpxazkCL2ALgFtBXzmLBXgYgJEYNZtH.webp) [Fuente](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/doblaje/images/8/8f/Let%27s_Play_-_poster.png/revision/latest?cb=20251016060941&path-prefix=es) ---

>En esta ocasión tenemos a Samara o también llamada Sam, es una mujer que le gusta crear juegos, todo se inspiró cuando estaba pequeña, fue una niña enferma y delicada, pero gracias a un Streamer que la inspiro llamado Marshall, decidió hacer videojuegos que fuesen capaces de entretener y ayudar a los demás, pero aparte de ello se dedica a trabajar en la oficina de su padre, pero Sam carece de confianza en sí misma, es tímida y no siente que pueda a atreverse hacer más de lo que hace, pese a que su jefe la motiva a ser mejor aunque de una manera algo crítica pero con buena intención, pero Sam realmente se siente deprimida porque su primer videojuego no resulto de la mejor manera debido a una fuerte crítica de un streamer, que lastimosamente para ella era Marshall, el que idolatraba. --- ![MV5BMzY4MjBjODctYjAwZS00Y2EzLTlkMGEtZWUwYmUyZmNhMzE1XkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23xAksKs8jxWyV1VzEyYp1VWw8tY6HdhKjLnYNMy3EwfzDDpSgFK9C8UVLrACHn2AvmwN.jpg) [Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt37532040/mediaviewer/rm3682317058/?ref_=tt_ov_i) ---

>Sam en definitiva requiere de apoyo y recuperar su videojuego de la mejor manera, pero mientras ocurre ello por cosas del destino Marshall se muda por donde ella vive, se vuelven vecinos, lo cual para Sam es complicado, también se le hace difícil expresar lo que piensa y siente, prefiere dejarlo así, pero las cosas no resultarán tan sencilla porque ahora con Marshal tan cerca las cosas serán distintas sobre todo en el tema amoroso para Sam, aunque para ella tiene a su amigo Link, por el siente algo especial pero irá descubriendo que así como la vida es un juego en el cual debes aprender a avanzar de nivel, mejorar como persona, descubrir nuevos personajes o buenos personajes que te enseñen a ser mejor o sean un apoyo en tu vida así mismo ocurre en el amor. ---
![Sam_Young-LetsPlay3.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/AJpkVvPD5eVQcURwkBsHsv2xAQ3UE5v9q7VBwwPESrcCW7BSzCiNJDy7B535WCG.webp)
[Fuente](https://doblaje.fandom.com/es/wiki/Let%27s_Play?file=Sam_Young-LetsPlay.png) ---

>El amor es un juego, al cual debes entender a la persona, conocer, saber lo que quiere y piensa, el suponer no es algo que sea factible sobre todo porque no siempre las cosas son del todo clara, el amor es más profundo y significativo, y para Sam entenderlo no será tan sencillo pero poco a poco irá descubriendo ello, ya que será necesario para que pueda avanzar como persona y también en el ámbito profesional, así como en su pasatiempo con los videojuegos, lo cual se ha vuelto su pasión y sentido en la vida gracias a ello su futuro ha sido mejor. Cuenta con su primera temporada de 12 capítulos. ---
![Marshall_Law-LetsPlay4.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/AK6W9YqsuBphUVnLKkTbSPFXmSCaXtx7GqXYkSk4EeeZTGFLU36gWQWsVt2YoYV.webp)
[Fuente](https://doblaje.fandom.com/es/wiki/Let%27s_Play?file=Marshall_Law-LetsPlay.png) --- **Autor Mongie (Leeanne M. Krecic), género drama y romance, estudio de animación OLM.** ---

> **Muchas gracias por leerlo. Espero sea de su agrado. Cualquier comentario con gusto estaré para responder y si quieren saber más de mi les dejo mis:**
![EL FINAL DE POSTHIVE (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tmBcG1dhAWXHSeTXHGahwcGe8eAbcEpZutQrCnSNiXxDwJJ31QA17giTgLpxPgJtEqN.jpg)
![separadoryasma1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tRzwswFj7sdCJKFgW2jsAWvCyEzuv6zxT8pCrVwXa8ePqRSdQWi3P6ZbtsyGmy6y4G2.png) **ENGLISH**

> Hello dear friends of @TheAnimeRealm, a pleasure to stop by, this time I want to talk to you about an anime that I found entertaining, thoughtful and calm, it's called Let's Play: Quest-darake no My life, it is a story in which life is seen from the point of view of a game, where leveling up will depend on your decisions and the people around you, where each one is an important part of what you want to accomplish. --- ![Let%27s_Play_-_poster1.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23w2nxvg71XX8eXV88FAEhAjGyspFNGNZxohLugpxazkCL2ALgFtBXzmLBXgYgJEYNZtH.webp) [Source](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/doblaje/images/8/8f/Let%27s_Play_-_poster.png/revision/latest?cb=20251016060941&path-prefix=es) ---

>This time we have Samara or also called Sam, she is a woman who likes to create games, everything was inspired when she was little, she was a sick and delicate girl, but thanks to a Streamer who inspired her called Marshall, she decided to make video games that were capable of entertaining and helping others, but apart from that she dedicates herself to working in her father's office, but Sam lacks self-confidence, she is shy and does not feel that she can dare to do more than what she does, even though her boss motivates her to be better although in a somewhat critical but good-intentioned way, but Sam really feels depressed because her first video game did not turn out in the best way due to strong criticism from a streamer, which unfortunately for her was Marshall, the one she idolized. --- ![MV5BMzY4MjBjODctYjAwZS00Y2EzLTlkMGEtZWUwYmUyZmNhMzE1XkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23xAksKs8jxWyV1VzEyYp1VWw8tY6HdhKjLnYNMy3EwfzDDpSgFK9C8UVLrACHn2AvmwN.jpg) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt37532040/mediaviewer/rm3682317058/?ref_=tt_ov_i) ---

>Ultimately, Sam requires support and recovers his video game in the best way, but while this happens due to things of fate, Marshall moves to where she lives, they become neighbors, which for Sam is complicated, it is also difficult for him to express what he thinks and feels, he prefers to leave it that way, but things will not be so simple because now with Marshal so close, things will be different, especially in terms of love for Sam, although for her she has her friend Link, for whom she feels something special but she will discover that just as life is a game in which you must learn to advance in level, improve as a person, discover new characters or good characters that teach you to be better or are a support in your life, the same thing happens in love. ---
![Sam_Young-LetsPlay3.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/AJpkVvPD5eVQcURwkBsHsv2xAQ3UE5v9q7VBwwPESrcCW7BSzCiNJDy7B535WCG.webp)
[Source](https://doblaje.fandom.com/es/wiki/Let%27s_Play?file=Sam_Young-LetsPlay.png) ---

>Love is a game, in which you must understand the person, know, know what they want and think, assuming is not something that is feasible especially because things are not always completely clear, love is deeper and more meaningful, and for Sam understanding it will not be so simple but little by little he will discover it, since it will be necessary for him to advance as a person and also in the professional field, as well as in his hobby with video games, which has become his passion and meaning in life thanks to it his future has been better. It has its first season of 12 episodes. ---
![Marshall_Law-LetsPlay4.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/AK6W9YqsuBphUVnLKkTbSPFXmSCaXtx7GqXYkSk4EeeZTGFLU36gWQWsVt2YoYV.webp)

![EL FINAL DE POSTHIVE (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tmBcG1dhAWXHSeTXHGahwcGe8eAbcEpZutQrCnSNiXxDwJJ31QA17giTgLpxPgJtEqN.jpg)

Sí se ve como un **fallo puntual de Ecency**, no como un problema de tu comentario. La captura deja claro que estabas viendo el post de [@saulos](https://inleo.io/@saulos) y que la opción para comentar simplemente **no apareció**, así que publicar tu respuesta por [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@aljif7/de-los-paneos-paneados) fue una salida perfectamente válida.

Y tu remate estuvo bueno: **“pobre pez, se habrá ido del consultorio bien paneado”** tiene ese tipo de humor absurdo que sí funciona, sobre todo porque amarra con el tono entre realidad y ficción que mencionas. Ahí está lo más logrado del comentario: no solo reaccionas al final, sino que captas **el equilibrio narrativo** que tenía la historia.

Sobre el bug, cuando Ecency se pone terco con comentarios, lo más común es:
- refrescar la página,
- cerrar y abrir sesión,
- probar desde otro frontend como [INLEO](https://inleo.io) o PeakD.

**Buen reflejo el tuyo**: no te quedaste peleando con la app y resolviste por otra vía. A veces la mejor solución técnica es no discutir con el software cuando ya decidió portarse como payaso.

title.title: Intact, But Lost | ILLUSTRATION.
title.body:
)

Hola a todos, soy Humansleep. En esta ocasión quiero publicar mi trabajo en la comunidad Alien Art Hive. Y aquí también compartiré el proceso de trabajo, ya sea dibujo o boceto.

---
---

<center>Intact, But Lost</center>

---
---

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUwrAwypSyFjaEhTwzcyfFRaqxe8uc6txz9VnPV6v8ycb/1780138314942.jpg)</center>
> It appears intact on the outside, but in reality it has vanished and wandered far into another universe.

---
---

The corridor finally came to an end. Not because there was an end to it. But because there was nothing left to pass through. The silence remained. The touch remained. The walls still breathed softly, like an old creature too tired to live but too stubborn to die.

And there—there was still one figure. Silent. Unmoving. Leaning against the wall of the dimly lit hallway, like a dusty cardboard box that had been stacked up long ago and left to gather dust.

From a distance, it looks fine. No injuries, no damage, no destruction. Just still. Too still. But if you look a little longer... there’s something strange about it. It’s like... empty. Like a house where the lights are still on, but the residents left who knows when.

He couldn’t remember how long he’d been part of the corridor. Maybe decades. Maybe a single second. It was hard to tell. In that place, time wasn’t a line. It was just a liquid dripping everywhere, then forgotten. Once he had fought back. Once he had been afraid. Once he had had something he wanted to protect. But all of that had been held so long it had lost its shape. All that remained now was the habit of simply existing. And that was enough. Or at least... it had been, until now.

Until one day—something strange happened. 
There was a pulse. Not from the hallway or the walls, nor from his hand. But... something much smaller, coming from within him. Like the sound of an old object trying to come to life again. And precisely because it was so small—it felt unsettling. A slow yet heavy pulse... Once, twice. Then silence. He didn’t understand. But that was enough. Because for the first time in who knows how long, he’d forgotten what it felt like to have something inside him. He tried to listen. And suddenly... a thought emerged. Very small. Very distant. Not a memory, nor an emotion. Just a small sentence: “...I’m still here.”

The corridor didn’t like that. The silence changed instantly. The usually quiet corridor began to feel cramped. The walls were moving... Slowly. The hands that were usually gentle began to grip tighter. As if there was something that wasn’t allowed to leave. But it was too late. The soul was still, not out of fear. But out of confusion. Leave? Leave for where? Hadn’t this always been the only place?

Then a crack appeared in the middle of his body. Not a physical crack. It didn’t hurt. Nor was it warm. It felt like... remembering something he should have forgotten. And from that small opening... something emerged. Not an organ, not light, not a shadow, not a spirit. More like... a direction. A compelling sensation. It didn’t call out, it didn’t force itself. It simply made him realize: there was another place, one that even the corridor didn’t know.

His body began to peel away. Slowly. Not terrifying. In fact, it was too calm. Layer by layer, it came away. And beneath it all—there was him. Or someone who had once been him. It was hard to explain. Because when he looked back—he was still there. Still leaning, still whole, still retaining its shape, still looking like him. But empty. Motionless. Unresponsive. Lifeless. He realized only now that what had been touched all this time... what had been merging all this time... what had been embraced all this time... wasn’t him. Just the vessel of his old world. And now... he had stepped out.

He began to move. Not walking. Not flying. More like being pulled by something with no direction. The hallway began to recede. The walls turned into lines. Touch turned into dust. Now there was only space. But not empty space. In the distance were strange shapes. Objects that looked like roots growing in every direction. Vortexes, Holes, Cities, Eyes. Shapes that looked alive but did nothing. And everything was too big. Enormous. To the point that he felt like a speck of dust that had wandered into the wrong place. He kept moving. No destination, no map, no names. Just a sense of being drawn.

Then he saw something. Far away. Very far away. A vortex. It was shaped like a flower. Spinning, like a hole. And the closer it got... the more familiar it felt. Too familiar. Because that shape... resembled him. Or perhaps—everything that came here did indeed turn into that. Not a human. Not a spirit. But... a door. He stopped. And without a sound—something spoke. Not to his ears. Directly to his very being. “You’re not lost.” Silence. Then: the next sentence came. “You’ve just gone too far to turn back.”

He looked back. No hallway, no hands, no embrace, no old world. Everything was gone. But strangely, he didn’t feel a sense of loss. He was still whole, complete. Nothing was missing. Only… he no longer knew who he was. And for some reason—it didn’t feel sad. He stood still for a moment. Then he stepped in, into something whose name he didn’t yet know. And for the first time… the silence didn’t sound like an end. But rather—a beginning.

title.body:
The wave is building across the ocean of Hive - please grab your chosen watercraft, from flippers to feet, and test the waters! We'd love you to support this new community. 

**Every week** you will have a choice of the *current topic* or you can write on *any* of the previous topics! 

![2872.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oceanlovers/23xVKNhyXNwX55g2gmcvWc1zCqK2eff6iFiQ3DpGowc3gkSyBfgXAWSQXNP5QikSGtEfm.jpg)

The idea is to always have some salty content to write about. Whilst as yet we can't offer rewards, @riverflows may give the best ones a tip each week, if she has the time and isn't swept out to see by a rip. 

### Last Week...

This week @lazzli wrote about his city rivers flowing in the North Carribean sea (what a great idea) and @anne02 was tipped 10 HIVE for her poignant post about family memories on the coast in Venuzuela - such a beautiful piece! 

If you love what @oceanlovers is about, please delegate to us so that we can continue to grow and support others. Community maintenance is hard work - any support is really welcome! 

### 🏄This Week's Challenge ⛵

*Wk 2*  🐙 ***What is your favourite marine creature and why? Or,describe an amazing encounter with a sea creature (even if it's not your favourite!)***

### Previous Challenges

*Wk1* 🌊 What are your first memories of the ocean? These can also be in the form of a movie or a book if you've never been to the seaside, or you can write a fictional piece if you like. 


##### The Rules

- Post in the community and use #oceanlovers as your first tag
- Title/preview title (up to you) OCEAN LOVERS CHALLENGE (WEEK #...) - YOUR TITLE
- No AI content please
- Be kind 
- Comment on others in the community if available
- Reblog this post if you can - and please upvote it
- English only (you can follow it with your own language if you like)

title.title: Thanalorian Scion || The 1 Health Monster That Refuses to Die || Her Void Ability Is Her Protection
title.body:
![ChatGPT Image May 30, 2026, 10_46_08 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23u5tBh8LiCse5Uk9212sgXXHNYnm5rytLUrDU9EdeRAtBoAbzUsLpyLVaAcAApqG4tns.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)


A monster that many Splinterlands players are looking for is a monster that is reasonably priced but has excellent powers and abilities. At first glance its mana cost is low and if we talk about health it is almost nothing because it has only 1 health. 

Even then this monster has caught my attention. Why do I like it so much and why do I want to discuss it?? Let's find out in this content. Its very interesting and working monster in any kind of battle.

The monster card I want to talk about today is Thanalorian Scion from the Water element. If I talk about its visual appearance it looks like a female warrior wearing battle armor. Her ears are long and pointed that makes her appearance even more good. Also her hairs are long and beautiful which makes another beauty in her appearance.

![Screenshot 2026-05-30 100702.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23tGa9CPjFbCDykgUy7U5j6ZAyTvbUpEsjnYhSdk6xEEDuCQnA8LKQBAtwLkN7Ae6YSmp.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)

In one hand she is controlling a wave of water while with the other hand she is releasing magical energy.. She is looking angrily at her enemies and seems ready to attack them with powerful magic.. This visual description is based on my imagination and I tried created an image of it with the help of ChatGPT.

---
### Now let's talk about its stats and abilities.
---

This is a 5 mana monster card which means it can be used in low, medium and high mana battles. It is a flexible card that can fit into many battle situations.

The most impressive thing about this monster is its 11 Armor at Level 6. Very few monsters have such high armor. However when we look at its health it has only 1 Health. Many players may wonder why it has such high armor but only 1 health.

The answer is its special ability called Void Armor. This ability forces enemy Magic attackers to damage the armor first instead of directly attacking health. Because of this the monster becomes much more durable than its 1 health suggests.

![Screenshot 2026-05-30 100720.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23wBZpgvT8EctM3jFJJUBmmSeFiAFY7wieFabyigfLErmJTQGHcdueLaFEythsxu1uJ3n.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)

It also has 1 Speed and 1 Magic Attack. As a Magic attacker it deals direct damage to enemy health every round. Its magic attacks are especially effective against monsters that do not have Void Armor.

Many players wonder about its best position because it has massive armor but only 1 health. In my opinion the best position for this monster is in the middle of the lineup. It should not be used as a secondary tank or placed at the very back. The middle position allows you to take full advantage of its armor and magic attack.

Now let's discuss its three special abilities.

---
### Corrosive Ward
---

![Screenshot 2026-05-30 101011.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23tbPQhicAZ9nrmuT5EMnfqW5DnTxP5f9itAKikuidGMPsLwr8v1FTC54gQS7jybGbUua.png)


This ability is very dangerous for Melee attackers. Whenever a Melee monster attacks this unit the attackers maximum armor is reduced by 2 points after every successful attack, it also depends on how much hit comes from enemy unit..

For example if an enemy monster has 6 armor and attacks this monster then its armor will drop to 4. If it attacks again the armor will drop to 2. Eventually its armor will be completely removed.

---
### Void Armor
---

![Screenshot 2026-05-30 101015.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23u5ZbqDMV4p3zokAp3KhKeewGXKptHDJNroh79jLjcybQwaBdFNphf22RYnQwWDts7yU.png)


As mentioned earlier this ability prevents Magic attacks from hitting health directly. Magic damage must first destroy the armor before it can affect health.

For example if a monster has 4 armor and 5 health, enemy magic attacks will damage the armor first. Only after the armor is gone will the health start taking damage.

---
### True Strike
---

![Screenshot 2026-05-30 101019.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23wqdubzDmF6E4DUvs8sNs9L25RhkbprTVYDPmmgEtfRHDUjp8APwhN44W2FvLydihT9U.png)


This is probably its best ability. With True Strike, attacks never miss. No matter how fast the enemy is whether it has Dodge, Flying or other evasion abilities still this monster will land its hit successfully.

These abilities make this monster very dangerous and valuable in battles.

---
### Finally let's talk about its price.
---

Considering its strong abilities and overall power I believe it is a great buying opportunity if you can get it for around $11 to $15. Because of its low mana cost it can be used in many different battle formats and is a useful addition to almost any collection.

![Screenshot 2026-05-30 100830.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/EnynaSHY1CCxVLk5FNk6WxRZJ5q9oMbWFRMiwnneok47AphRBn5x2uyrkQPmK1dNwGo.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)

If a player cannot afford to buy it they can easily rent it for around 28.789 DEC per day which is still a good option for having this card in your deck and take the best advantage of it. Overall it is a powerful and versatile monster that can provide great value in many Splinterlands battles.

I hope you guys will like this post and is interesting as well. If you find it informative then dont forget to give me a support. Share you reviews in the comment section below. Thank you all for your time reading the content.
