title.title: DIVERSAS FORMAS DE DISFRUTAR UN MANGO (Es - En)
title.body:
> **ESPAÑOL** --- # Hola a todos, feliz día. Estamos en temporada de mangos, como reza una frase bien criolla, en época de mangos nadie pasa hambre, y es porque las matas están tan cargadas por doquier, que una de las tradiciones más populares en la zona llanera, es sentarse debajo de una mata a comer mango. Hoy tengo el placer de hablar de las variadas maneras que tenemos de comernos un mango, bien sea maduro, pintón o verde. El mango maduro es delicioso, y comerlo frío rebanado con un cuchillo, es lo máximo, pero nada como comerlo directamente y darnos ese gustazo de retirar la concha con los dientes. Ésa es la verdadera forma de degustar un mango maduro. Al mango pintón, es típico picarlo en trocitos y ponerle una pizca de sal, y el mango verde, una de las formas de saborearlo, es haciendo con él una ensalada que lleva adobo, vinagre, y salsa inglesa... yo con el adobo ya tengo suficiente, jajajaja. Pero este picadillo de mango verde con esta salsa es tan popular, que hasta lo venden en bolsitas por todos lados.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVPinoLeoeAcJrjqQqMXfjXUwa1f1Ne7DVxayRfxtYn5q/b08353ff_5f4d_473d_9c36_2cb7f6934564.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX2Xo8pcRSR3kJswQDe3qyfqeh3NXSg7dw38dNKem77GB/df29856c_c27f_45f7_b292_b9ee0a3fc041.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXaRLQw1WzvrTXPAwWwPSHMixTB3MTYfwxQwJBMhfeeMf/f66e87d9_8259_4a3c_b555_c2d85859c00b.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWUzVD1iY1Epnv1rU4eEpaV8uSc5wREGDAwhmvZ9bfmBS/9b241b91_5cb9_4bcd_90fc_3273e95608fd.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSzSExY8sYtCbeiqyF1wYhUcyW9bcnJziXpQ3XhWGw7gQ/fd0b3640_300e_4275_8f59_4d557dcdc3d3.jpg)

> A mí me encanta el jugo de mango maduro, pero más aún el carato de mango, que se prepara sancochando el mango verde y luego se licúa y se le pone azúcar y vainilla. También con esta preparación se consigue hacer la jalea de mango, pero ese trabajo es más tedioso, aunque es un dulce muy sabroso... y el manjar de mango, que se hace con el carato, azúcar, vainilla, canela, y un poquito de maicena. Otras maneras de disfrutar el mango en postres, es el helado de mango que igualmente se hace con el carato, las famosas tetas que son helados en bolsitas, y el quesillo de mango, que es la preparación del tradicional, pero con el puré de mango maduro. Como pueden ver, son muchas las maneras de disfrutar un mango, y en cada temporada, no sólo se prueban estas ricas recetas, sino que mucha gente comercializa con ellas. Así que a disfrutar amigos, que la temporada de mangos llegó. Gracias a todos por visitar mi blog, que tengan un feliz fin de semana.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUHZvhjdRjyCkmov2DNMu1ABWyEub12YomeJBnq8RW1Va/annafenix_2.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQobotrvz7oK8XSbhmcTscHHatGxgYY9F11PFUXFG5zsw/acfd8c4a_a6d0_4cc5_8160_b494e6e5369f.jpg)

**ENGLISH** --- # Hello everyone, happy day! It's mango season, and as the saying goes, \

The trees are so abundant that one of the most popular traditions in the Llanos region is sitting under a mango tree and eating it. Today I have the pleasure of talking about the various ways we can eat a mango, whether it's ripe, semi-ripe, or green. A ripe mango is delicious, and eating it cold, sliced ​​with a knife, is the best, but nothing beats eating it straight and enjoying the pleasure of peeling it with your teeth. That's the true way to savor a ripe mango. A semi-ripe mango is typically chopped into small pieces and sprinkled with salt, and one way to enjoy a green mango is by making a salad with adobo seasoning, vinegar, and Worcestershire sauce... I'm already satisfied with just the adobo seasoning, hahaha. But this green mango hash with this sauce is so popular that it's even sold in little bags everywhere.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmREiXmZCGpCwogMjjzGmvaYoMtbyhgnVTRc5gMK6ZpMQ5/6fba9b35_5402_4ac9_ab24_421d39454a3e.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaaPY976WQyuBkWKAWkoGwPXNJV8t5xuPwp1D5QrzjNTb/773caab7_33ea_4793_9605_c75eaf8214aa.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSVJtUMdcP8QmTfxgdfTfP6HSbXAhnwZFRdkhPeMuumJ5/b95aa1fb_eb16_4c81_b7c0_a53a73693e84.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRjyUPK91GSGDrxPda53h97HiUUUMnsfExW2jF413vaZQ/b77462b1_672b_41ef_9818_5a16629657bd.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaaHYLzNWhGQJeDjV7X7BbgqPuuYgK1rxi5nL5SvCWg9X/70dc373b_96ca_4c3f_8372_ae99c5c08aeb.jpg)
>\n\nI love ripe mango juice, but even more so, mango \

which is made by boiling green mangoes, then blending them with sugar and vanilla. You can also make mango jelly with this same preparation, but that's more tedious, although it's a very tasty treat... and mango manjar, which is made with carato (a fermented beverage), sugar, vanilla, cinnamon, and a little cornstarch. Other ways to enjoy mango in desserts include mango ice cream, which is also made with carato; the famous \

(small, filled ice cream cups); and mango quesillo, which is made with ripe mango puree. As you can see, there are many ways to enjoy a mango, and each season, not only are these delicious recipes enjoyed, but many people also sell them. So enjoy, friends, mango season is here! Thanks to everyone for visiting my blog, have a happy weekend.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaVoUwRh4NGFWZXmPzD8HWFxEG83qUChVLXBt4KJddiHr/annafenix.png)

title.title: Crow guards on duty.
title.body:
Predators are around, and the crows posted lookouts in their territory.
![001.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/2432FU7XWxk4nhRAnTdv5vMgJydeB4AykisgpX79Jsvx88cBqbWkbeZvtLmUKssqUVc48.jpg)

I did not have to wait long to see some action, as the doves and smaller birds suddenly scattered into hiding. For the past few days, a Sparrow Hawk (Accipter melanoleucus) sped through here, and for the love of me when the crows tried to catch the hawk, they were too fast and I couldn't get it on camera. But today, at last, I managed to get a shot of the hawk with the crows chasing it. 

*The black sparrowhawk (Astur melanoleucus), sometimes known as the black goshawk or great sparrowhawk, is a bird of prey belonging to the family Accipitridae. It was formerly placed in the genus Accipiter. It occurs mainly in forest and non-desert areas south of the Sahara, particularly where there are large trees suitable for nesting; favored habitat includes suburban and human-altered landscapes. It preys predominantly on birds of moderate size, such as pigeons and doves, in suburban areas.*

[Source](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Black_sparrowhawk)

![002.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/243fozuuYrtikWKBFEq5h3qWBavDJYLkskeFuANSQE52v7fUNkMTAu4K9JZpqYK2hm8Ke.JPG)

*The \

variety is generally rare, except along the coastal regions of South Africa, including the Cape Peninsula where they constitute 80% of the population. (Black sparrowhawks do not occur more than about 200–300 km north of Cape Town along the South African west coast, where there are almost no trees.) These \

, when seen perched, can be black all over, but more commonly have a few white spots on the breast or a white throat of variable size. In flight both morphs show white and black barring on the underside of the wings and tail.* 

[Source](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Black_sparrowhawk)

You just cannot know how glad I was to get this shot below. Three crow guards at the left trying their best to catch the sparrow hawk at the right of the picture. 
![016.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23wWRYT47TTpZUdFmPkwxm5LHByuLD4tXKt8972VejyDkz9Lss84yw2Ancg2C8nQLzNcW.JPG)

Meanwhile the other crows in the family were alerted, and they gathered to fly over the territory in an effort to show their strength to any other predators that were thinking of trying their luck in the area. 
![013.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23u69j3mAVfPYk9BLgBCLzAM4MUMPCQYvSTQFYumqxEgjymAWFpfAyBjATypwCuipMbrZ.JPG)

A silent witness watched the show. 
![014.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/2458ED81GzJzfMjrrR1LaZoWhXFeC6uh9imwS6EUhShw12Ayv9iWqDWmBpwPT2M4Hrhod.JPG)

I was so excited to get this, that I didn't even both to take some other photos as I wanted to share this event with you. I have been waiting for a long time to get an action shot of the crows chasing the sparrow hawk in their area, and at last I got it. That hawk is very fast, and our little wild birds are all in danger here, especially as two laughing doves are nesting in a tree that grows in the front of our neighbor's house.

**But hang on and let me show you why we worry about the sparrow hawk.**

This is why, as you can see, one of the little laughing doves is building a nest. 
![041.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23yd5ePpDpSoMcwNFxD19hbUMZpXmDAhgAKJjuPj1FDbgx5kQJUBtU98jA6YZSJJej8zF.JPG)

And there it goes into the tree where they are building the nest. 
![020.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EoprTuH3DTRKZsyXuT8qWYJrPGZhfFAjionmkxh23QfvMdjFZXCT5buzcM8czfTSx7L.JPG)

This is the tree in front of our neighbor's house. 
![022.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EqhRiucUWu8m9ycxYBV7jRZ1E9UNTFEpzoZGTULsKbTVQfTKpyziUyXYw7GVciXZWSx.JPG)

Not only the sparrow hawk can get them, but there are also house cats and other predator birds, such as the harrier hawk active here, but we keep a watch on the tree every day. The risk, of course, is when we are away with our charity work as then the tree is unguarded. Predators are sly and they bide their time until it is safe for them to grab a meal. We can only hope that the doves will survive, and that we will see their young soon. 
Such is life. 

I hope you enjoyed the pictures and the story.

Photos by Zac Smith. All-Rights-Reserved.

Camera: Canon PowershotSX70HS Bridge camera.

Until next time, cheers!

title.title: Land Manager Evolution: More Control, More Flexibility
title.body:
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23uFPdKf8W8ZX71NBX84EzrbuDWKc44PmSAcGwNRzkmS25BuzUm5ySwCMfrXuThayhsbT.png #
Land Manager Update: Giving Players More Control
I wasn't planning another Land Manager post this quickly, but after releasing the feature and discussing it with users over the past few days, I've already made some significant changes. One thing became clear almost immediately: people want to use the Land Manager in very different ways. When building a feature, it's easy to design it around my own playstyle. But after talking with several users and especially after a conversation with @keeegs, I realized many players had completely different goals than I originally envisioned. Rather than pushing everyone toward a specific strategy, the Land Manager should provide flexible tools and let players decide how they want to manage their land. That feedback led to two major changes in this update. * First, I decided to completely remove the mandatory fee system and replace it with a fully configurable donation system that players can opt out of entirely. * Second, I expanded the post harvest options to give players much more flexibility in deciding how their harvested resources should be sold, pooled, or accumulated. That philosophy of giving players more control is what drives this update. #
🙌 Support the Project
✅ Upvote this post – it really helps! 👉 [Vote for My SPS Validator Node](https://monstermarket.io/validators?validator=beaker007) 💬 Ideas and feature requests are always welcome. No promises but I will take a look and try my best. ##
Rethinking the Service Fee
One of the biggest changes in this release is the removal of the mandatory 2% service fee. When I initially launched the Land Manager, I introduced a 2% fee on harvested resources. My reasoning was simple. The feature puts additional load on my servers and requires ongoing development and maintenance. A small fee seemed like a reasonable way to support that. After more discussions and after running some numbers myself, I started to become less comfortable with the implementation. The problem wasn't the percentage itself. The problem was scale. The Land Manager should help players automate their land. It shouldn't become a mechanism that extracts resource payments from larger users simply because they happen to operate at scale. So I decided to redesign the system completely. The mandatory fee is gone. Instead, players can now choose whether they want to support the project through donations. The donation system is fully configurable: * Enable or disable donations. * Set your own donation percentage. * Configure daily donation caps per resource. * Keep complete control over what gets donated. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23t79Fbe9LRArtc9NSns9P3wdZ2SDiJYrR5N7mmH35Pss8FpW2SAePkcScNhsRUgHxd3g.png) The default values remain available, but participation is now entirely voluntary. This feels much more aligned with how I want the project to operate. ##
Daily Donation Caps
Another important part of the redesign is the introduction of daily donation caps per user. Even if you choose to donate, there is now a maximum amount that can be transferred per day for each resource type. Default caps are: | Resource | Daily Cap | | -------- | --------- | | Grain | 40,000 | | Wood | 10,000 | | Stone | 4,000 | | Iron | 1,000 | The goal is to make supporting the project predictable and fair, without making it feel like a burden for players. ##
Donation Enable / Disabled
Whether you have enabled / disabled the donation feature you can see that directly on the harvest page.
https://images.hive.blog/350x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/EopmbW5qvSCX8yxGFCNZTiZFuPMu3746cfwBfs5jpaunJJ2VADNfdTKDDqTW9WHD32t.png https://images.hive.blog/350x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23wzdexXgidKhvzJSVEUgewt6ULPt3JXrqPKMrexdjjthLGDqWLvari3X1DuXx1EDzgLY.png
When you hove you can see your settings: https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/Eoe8A53GhwShjzuLzajrwvnF8RKM2jZ5dgjMZmeJSyAbXJKm58o8FKURvQZfoXRNmPn.png ##
More Flexible Post Harvest Strategies
The second major improvement comes from feedback about resource management. Previously there were three separate strategies: * Accumulate * Sell for DEC * Add to Pool While functional, it was somewhat limiting because players had to choose a single approach. In reality, many players want a combination of all three. * Some resources should be sold. * Some should go into liquidity pools. * Some should simply be kept. The new **Sell & Pool** strategy makes that possible. You can now independently configure: ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/242gxqoZao4o6HpKBSnRXCbjw4MC4fcdy5UGCZmnQ7w8mgC1XBVdyJ4MRqTK9WyKcfzLr.png) * Percentage to sell for DEC. * Percentage to add to liquidity pools. * Remaining percentage automatically accumulated. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23tRvjWx5FCVJxdUkKCtGY6YnKhEc9fMozgz5FNonEcshShj3QPNtsJySm95M6S1jY7nb.png) This gives much more control over how resources are handled after harvesting. One small tip from my own experience: I would recommend setting your sell percentage about 5% higher than your pool percentage. This usually ensures you generate enough DEC from the sale to cover the liquidity additions without needing extra DEC from your wallet. Don't worry if the numbers don't line up perfectly. 👇 ##
Protecting Your DEC Balance
One concern with automated pooling is accidentally spending more DEC than intended. To avoid this, the Land Manager now includes DEC balance protection. If there isn't enough DEC available in your wallet to complete all planned liquidity additions, the system automatically scales down the pool operations proportionally. You'll receive a warning explaining what happened and how the split was adjusted. Dry runs will also show: * Estimated DEC required. * Current wallet balance. * Expected DEC proceeds from resource sales. ![Some did not notice this are two buttons Process Resource & Dry Run](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/242Nce9swJXMEyjcjasKdczCk2dQ9UdHENbGHCSwvecBVVt4QD8CizgZo63fW2v5xMWQY.png) This should make planning and troubleshooting significantly easier before executing a harvest. ##
Recommended Harvest Frequency
While the system supports harvesting whenever you want, I would actually recommend harvesting only once or twice per week in most situations. You can certainly harvest more frequently. Nothing prevents you from doing so. However, because of the donation cap structure and the way the system processes operations, harvesting constantly provides fewer benefits compared to batching your harvests together. Less frequent harvesting is also friendlier for my servers and generally results in a smoother experience overall. ##
Looking Forward
This update is a great example of why community feedback matters. Several of these changes were not things I originally planned to implement. They came directly from discussions with users and from seeing how people actually interact with the Land Manager. The result is a system that is more flexible, fairer for stakeholders, and gives players much more control over how they manage their land. As always, keep the feedback coming. The Land Manager is still evolving, and many of its best improvements have come directly from the community. ---- Until next time, Beaker See you on your land journey or on the battlefield 😄 https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/website/splinterlands_logo.png Want to be part of this amazing play-to-earn game? Consider using my [referral](https://splinterlands.com?ref=beaker007) link!

title.title: The Medical field is now just a Money-making Field.
title.body: Hi Hivelearners friends. Here we have seen before our own eyes that all the doctors do not care about the patients, but rather they care about money. This is the proof of that. That until the money is collected, the operation will not take place, even if the patient dies, and here we are seeing that the doctors who are there sign a contract for the whole year and then continue to give the same company's medicines for the whole year. Whether those medicines are good or not, They have to give them to their patients because they get a huge amount of money from there and it is very important for them. Here now we see that the doctors are also being given vehicles so that our medicines can run for a few years. The company makes more profit from there, so a similar system is going on. And here, if we talk about emergencies in hospitals, the doctors there are the ones who are laughing first. When the patient reaches the very last condition, then they get up and come to check on him. I have seen all these things with my own eyes. Here, reference plays the most important role. A person who has a reference is given good care in government hospitals. And those who go without a reference, especially those who come from villages, are not given any importance at all and are not talked to at all.

/> \[Source\](https://unsplash.com/photos/marines-receive-dental-care-inside-a-tent-z2dRG9kdWLI) Their patients are not even checked. And here, now, doctors do this. They do their government jobs during the day and at night, they have built their own private hospital. They have built a private clinic, so they call patients there to get checked there at night so that they get a fee. And when we go to the government hospital for a check-up, they do not check them properly at all. They also take the fee from there. And they are also getting a salary. Here too, there is a government hospital in our city and we keep going there. If anyone falls ill, they are taken to the hospital because the fees of private hospitals here are so high that it has become almost impossible to afford it in this time of inflation.

/> \[Source\](https://unsplash.com/photos/marines-provide-medical-care-to-a-patient-on-a-stretcher-7OJJPxBw9Kc) So, what I want to say here is that the way times are changing, we also have to change ourselves so that everything can be better for us. So here, when we go to the government hospital, We see the same thing there: people come with their loved ones, but they are not taken care of at all here, and within a few days, when they are not shared, they leave this world. You all also have to tell us whether the same thing is happening in the medical field in your city or whether the doctors there check the patient properly without any money or do they also say that the patient will be checked only after taking money. So, your comments are very important for us and we can learn a lot from them.

/> \[Source\](https://unsplash.com/photos/green-wooden-chest-with-a-red-cross-symbol-\_wcapKG8kWw) Who is djbravo? Djbravo real name is Asad-chughtai and I am from Pakistan. Asad-chughtai is a writer, blogger, crypto trader, and nature lover. My goal is to share these special places and natural sights with all of you.

title.title: A Day Stroll and an Errand: My Lil Save for the Day and The Scenic Route We Took
title.body:
>

I seriously just want to pay our electricity bills online because it is too hot Outside to have a long walk but then, I'm kind of thinking the fees I have to pay if we uses online payment. I can already buy two pack of *roasted peanuts* with it and its a waste if i'll just use it for the fees, yk I can fill my stomach with those yummy *roasted peanuts* using that fees. And so, not to experience too much heat outside when we have this walk, I decided to go visit Ormeco early in the morning. We left home at 8 am, but even at that time the heat is already intense. Still, its much bearable -and this are all for me not to pay the transaction fee, lol. ƪ⁠(⁠‾⁠.⁠‾⁠“⁠)⁠┐ Heh

![1000037183.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EpXMMqC3SEMvsKR5TPshWFyWCECgo3hAUZveLXNs3H3RqqyZQCdVHxjyoN4a5tXrdLW.png)

I mean, its not solely just for that but also, I need this walk outside, for a change of scenery ba. Although the heat is a nuisance, its okay, what we can see outside is really worth the it -not to mention, I can also save that 10 peso transaction fees -which I can use for my *roasted peanuts*, ehermmm. I know, i know, I am so stingy no? Hahahaha. But seriously though, it is not just 10 pesos, because it is 3 bills, ours, Mommy D and her sisters bills from Bulbugan, so that would be 30 pesos overall. See, that's a big save already, so no to online payment for now. We have to save every penny we have, so yeah man!

<div class=\

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EoCiCQTrsBNrLXWBq2rj89y7WZiq2WHRyeQ9CgaezL4RxUaAFUiAdRnHthYV2FhXh7E.jpg Now, we have to stop by in a money center to withdraw some cash. Its for me and mama, she said her pets has no viand anymore so I gave her a small amount for it.

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EowF5rjZykrYwByar96pLX7JAtzYKiogZphk7UGLGzVEDcUX7BGD9YJBvckzKxF4L4Y.jpg While withdrawing some cash, I saw Mama in this a few step away to where i'm standing. I guess this tree caught her attention. She said what she noticed in it, like it has no thorn just like in our Lukban tree. So, maybe, this is a Pomelo tree. Its skin is smoother too compare to ours. Anyways, that's she just observed there

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EpA3Yj3THXWfGatUv7EMqREwPhK5EQ2nWSGBEovGZYDMEXpZtyJA4gnELEWuYfCeqoM.jpg In our way to pur next stop, I saw this big tarpaulin about Enrollment, I guess school will start again soon. Good luck to those student. They will be very busy again for sure

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EqQNWv6z3rrE73ELVgCFjBpLh3WzHcBtMZVadXmJBJLbAoj7hr37BorinZRv8FRQWqf.jpg Of course it's impossible for us not to see the park while walking there. Its early so there's no sight yet of people though there's still a few especially street sweepers and somw

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/Eoc6bswJxYCYqLCg8uVPyaQTSmc4BEZMyy3DbfytQgUu45qKwMTDTmmWkTGm3A9U9nA.jpg I also noticed how neat and clean the grass was, thats also when I see this grass cutter as we move farther. I love it! Thanks to the hardworking workers in the Park that this place stays as clean as always. Although there are a lot of irresponsible people that won't swallow their trash with its foods, the street sweepers are in there to clean it all. I mean, there are trash bins every where, its just a few walk but why they can't do that? Aigoooo

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EonoMAGPydpdx11vTY8bCwRDmXf759Yx9pMan836HBHRKAAnhNRdVKKwQ1Q8cYT7Tsv.jpg Moving on, I get to see this old Christmas tree on one of corner here in the Park and these old.bottles really caught my attention. I love how they recycle those bottles and made them into something useful, which really made every visitors happy. This is one of those that can see in Christmas Villages during Cheistmas Season. Cool no?

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EoiWBCPSmc4MTFD2cLUtMkSYyi5RjKBkcfz5CzUx9miG2dE8Ak235TuSyJ5UzzLYF9v.jpg And so, with a few more walk, we finally reach Ormeco and was able to pay all our bills. Fortunately there's not much people when we get there ♪⁠ ⁠\⁠(⁠^⁠ω⁠^⁠\⁠ ⁠) luckyttttt, the transaction was fast and we finish our business there

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/Eou8f8vZ8RXY7FwAZsBHj7bjwdi5dLqka61MvuuekYJB6ruzWqNN2qLHQzQXPH2BnNp.jpg Then in the afternoon, I had this short trip, alone, I had to cash in some money, but its for Mommy F's business. While going back home I saw the bakery with a really new bread so I bought a few of them to share with my oldies and Mama. Its assorted actually, I got ensaymada, putok, ube bar and this one with yellow fillings. I really live it when a bread is freshly made or was baked on that very day. title.title: My Actifit Report Card: May 30 2026
title.body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g62c9ed343e5e018b44158fb5a0c2123cba62dbe262e063620fa91d902129a3661c6c42fbb60cf6637fc685d2ad52d07b112dd3a332fca4ed7706a0f7d7a0364f_640.jpg)
오늘 산책을 하면서 우연히 오래된 친구를 만났습니다. 서로 바쁜 일상 속에서 한동안 연락을 못했었는데, 공원에서 마주치니 정말 반가웠어요. 함께 이야기를 나누며 그동안의 소식들을 나눴고, 다시 자주 만나기로 약속했습니다. 산책 중에는 길가에 피어있는 다양한 꽃들도 감상했어요. 특히, 분홍색 벚꽃이 만개해 있어서 많은 사람들이 사진을 찍고 있는 모습이 인상적이었습니다. 또, 작은 아이들이 놀이터에서 뛰어노는 모습도 보았는데, 그들의 웃음소리는 정말 기분을 좋게 했습니다. 오늘의 산책은 단순한 운동을 넘어서 사람들과의 소통과 자연의 아름다움을 다시 한번 느낄 수 있는 시간이었습니다. _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@titusfrost/actifit-titusfrost-20231229t015511428z)_

title.title: Hive Music Festival - Week N° 189 - Round 3 - \
coversong by @yoxibeth
title.body:
/>
Hola, amigos de Hive Hoy les quiero compartir una interpretación muy especial titulada \

, un clásico de la música llanera compuesto por Francisco Montoya. En esta oportunidad, tengo el honor de interpretar este tema en el tono de Re mayor, contando con el acompañamiento magistral del maestro Ramón Páez en el cuatro, quien le aporta toda la esencia y el sabor tradicional a la pieza. Con esta presentación estoy participando con mucha alegría en el Hive Music Festival, específicamente en la semana 189, ronda 3, un espacio maravilloso que nos permite conectar a través del arte y celebrar nuestra cultura. Espero de todo corazón que disfruten de este video tanto como yo disfruté grabándolo para ustedes, y que sientan la pasión de nuestra música folklórica en cada nota. Como siempre, les mando un saludo enorme, lleno de cariño y buenas vibras, su amiga @Yoxibeth. Gracias por el apoyo constante, nos vemos en los comentarios.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yoxibeth/23wgUE3FbMRWvTRZTN6Z1pZuoqJR1zhnDCbyTiczHSou4f8iw96GpDC4T13GzPhRN84Qg.PNG

/> >Hello, friends of Hive. With this performance, I am delighted to be participating in the Hive Music Festival, specifically in Week 189, Round 3—a wonderful space that allows us to connect through art and celebrate our culture. >I sincerely hope you enjoy this video as much as I enjoyed recording it for you, and that you feel the passion of our folk music in every note. As always, I send you a huge greeting, full of love and good vibes, your friend @Yoxibeth. Thank you for your constant support; see you in the comments.

title.title: 不一样的历史博物馆
title.body:
在大连北站附近有一家历史博物馆，我感到很好奇，今天就特意坐公交去看看，如果是开车的话会很方便， 但是坐公交真的是有点绕，地铁三号线虽然坐了才两站，但是下车之后，我需要走3.4公里，中间导航还把我领丢了，结果顶着炎热的大太阳，我走了将近一个小时，最后终于找到了，结果他就在北站的东南方向，斜对面！
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ1Hd7uAGMoJAom7dq1Q31ZP4FgNEXP8D75ucdGC7EcfA/gongjiang.jpg)


一个不起眼的大门，这就是在居民的建筑楼里嘛！但是为啥确有着这么响亮的名字冠以省名的博物馆呢“辽宁天巳历史博物馆”。 后来我进去，跟一个小美女服务人员聊天才知道，这是一个私人注册成立的民营博物馆，小美女说也是因为老板具有家国情怀，有这个爱心和志向，而且这个博物馆还获得了很多奖项，实在令人敬佩。 
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW4MmAYoy1YzfceQDj1Fftq8hj8pwubUXNNtTXqDWRo25/gate.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVkqUu1QM2EHV6WVedn7bY17MG6RxeULP1ooEgmZXZWZD/jiangzuo.jpg)





博物馆分为三层，一层是“匠心筑梦，技能强国”，展厅布置的十分干净典雅，走进其中瞬间有种跟着大国工匠们对话的感觉。这里从天工开物的古老技艺开始到现代科技的星光闪耀，整个展厅犹如幅徐徐展开的历史画卷，将中国工匠文化的传承与发展向着游客娓娓道来。 

天工开物，中国的雕刻艺术源远流长，从青铜冶铸，木雕到玉石雕刻，无不体现着中国工匠精神技艺的完美。那个青铜牛工艺精湛，十分漂亮。这里还有插图讲述了青铜冶铸的技术，每一步都凝聚着古人的智慧。 
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVHezHvjXYc9xYVsi84jjfaJs3bQVfyThW5kxVkeFoDUU/qingtong.jpg)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfJvrV5kJPXUHr8obDYGxA52CsApyRhFQc6VNvkb3S5hJ/mudiao.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPSEuoKKHfqy3J1feTqjfTjTR3aEJM9JdEdNk5eNnwjuy/qipan.jpg)

想想数千年前，工匠们没有现代技术，确凭着双手就能铸造出如此复杂的精品，可见他们对技艺的追求，已经超越了器物本身，成为了一种精神，不远处还有个大铜鼎，就是当时技术水平的最好说明。 

这里还有中国古代的四大发明，造纸，指南针，火药和印刷术，不仅有详实的介绍，下面还有展览。 让我惊叹的是活字印刷的展柜，印刷的字模整齐排列，黑色的墨迹似乎还残留着历史的温度，印刷术的诞生，就如同当今互联网的运作一样，加快了文化传递，推动了历史的发展。 
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTf6j5C8uwo2pNHez62dF4LgMctwHaqtVutJbf6CQQstK/zhinanzhen.jpg)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZu5Gn6on48xvTB5eHHCMd2fCLvCzHZMEpop56MBf8c2W/yinshuashu.jpg)


火药被称作工业的黄金，不仅在历史上就是在今天依然对人类有着巨大的贡献。人们的生活中还是离不开它。

展厅里还有现代科技，量子信息以及标注着大国工匠的那些英雄们的名字。这里我还看到了我觉得特别神秘的“芯片”，了解了什么是台积电，芯片的样子。 
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ6QgSXbfD61PrWR8DpbPpEbapM3v3CXvh7g1Yhzkdsn3/zhanshi.jpg)


墙上还有大国工匠们的照片， 是他们托起了这个国家的脊梁！
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfHx5w9Vhpnz92S7QzV9gNUU9uimS9gtpzDcJ3yBCMTTp/hero.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXVJd3CkdZ3JQfwBFSrdxPmvPiMeeF483JhxPLjy1QMYu/jiao.jpg)
 航母模型
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc2CF1knFMpgYQsBUzJc63FadPM2LdCjyNeMJrqyKcPcF/hangm.jpg)

任何时代都是技能强国，工匠精神从未过时，他们在不同的时代以不同的形式绽放着光芒。最后还有习总书记关于工匠精神的论述：“工匠精神是以爱国主义为核心的民族精神和以改革创新为核心的时代精神的生动体现”。 
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSMnQHFv9PkHjPBP96erPuig4jkodHcB8Uz1255RH1tmJ/ding.jpg)


正是有了那么多古代工匠和今天的科研工作者，才有了今天日益强大的祖国。工匠精神要传承要发扬光大。展览厅里有几个家长带着孩子参观，我倒是觉得带孩子到这个地方真是太好不过的了。

难怪服务员说博物馆的老板具有不一样的情怀，这个博物馆放眼全国也是第一家私人投资创建的博物馆，果然不一般。二楼，三楼还有不同的展品，以后陆续给大家介绍！

I wanted to take a moment today to write a heartfelt tribute to the people who make this place feel like home every single day 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVzD1KU9ttLLw9ycPwFvrdoB6FVk9JJ9p1qQzxqeoeoLV/1780138115842.jpg)

First and foremost, a massive shoutout to the geniuses behind the screen the developers  witnesses and core teams like @ecency 

Day in and day out, you all work tirelessly to give us a seamless, clean, and advanced experience  Rolling out updates, fixing bugs, and designing beautiful interfaces (like the new Perks dashboard) takes immense effort You turn complex blockchain technology into a smooth playground where creators can share their hearts out Thank you for your non-stop dedication and for building a decentralized future for us 🙌💻



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPq9BuF2BA11sKSnU3SpS7rVH4eogernJbb5amGihVCD3/1780138131769.jpg)

@animenexus

title.title: my entry to smash 428: electric toothbrush
title.body: mostly i use my toothbrush to brush my teeth but it can be used for other things- such as playing with shadows. so here's a curious shadow phenomenon i discovered when i saw the shadow of the brush that was standing on the bathroom countertop\n\n
/> i liked the shadow when i incidently first saw it so i got my phone at took a shot of it. but when i saw the photo i thought i could do better

/> the bathroom light has a dimmer that is set quite low so i my eyes don't get a shock if i have to get up at night. so i turned up the dimmer to get a darker shadow and then positioned the brush so it lined up with the vertical tile joint. the shadow looked much better, nice and dark but it was still fuzzy around the edges. i guess that is because the brush is round. anyway i got the idea of making a double shadow so i went and got a powerful flashlight.

/>with the shadow from the bathroom light still lined up with the tile joint i shined the flashlight and took the shot. at first i didn't really notice the difference in color of the two shadows so when i saw the photo i was quite surprised. the shadow from the bathroom light had turned a distinct purplish blue while the shadow from the torch was a less obvious orange. the wall tiles had also taken on a purplish tinge. in the absence of the cool bluish light from the LED flashlight, the color of that toothbrush shadow is the compliment of the light source- orange. the light from the bathroom dimmer is a warm incandescent orange so it casts a bluish shadow. in this case the purple blue light from the powerful flashlight gives that shadow a remarkable double dose of color.\n\naren't shadows fun? happy hunting

title.title: The Bloating of Windows: A Growing Concern
title.body:
Here is the updated article with a paragraph drawn from recent news:

---

**The Bloating of Windows: A Growing Concern**

Probably most of you would have noticed the recent bloating of Windows. Windows, which was once an ease of access, has gone in a direction that seems unrecoverable: endless bloatware, Copilot AI, Edge, and other unwanted activities. On my laptop, out of 250GB, 60 to 70GB is just Windows, and going through the RAM, out of 16GB almost always 5GB is consumed at idle.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTRBqyNTC5mkqgmEjdpFmXN3J2dNRV8Z6q87a8ryGkWTN/boliviainteligente-Oo0RpFmp2bQ-unsplash.jpg 
Photo by <a href=\

>Unsplash This bloatware, along with the increasing usage of software and the ever growing demand for resources, is becoming a serious concern. Windows itself has now noticed that people are moving to Linux more than before. It may seem that even purchasing Windows is not enough for their balance sheet, as they have to continuously push bloatware to generate revenue. Microsoft has made some moves in 2026 to address this, introducing an \

installation mode for Pro and Enterprise editions that leaves out the most obvious bloat, including third party app promotions and unnecessary preinstalled software. However, Home edition users, who are arguably the most affected by bloatware since they are less likely to reinstall their systems, do not get this option. And even with these improvements, users are still met with daily Copilot notifications, Microsoft 365 prompts, and reminders that their data is being used to improve the product. The fixes are arriving, but the feeling that the operating system is not entirely yours remains.

On the other hand, Linux, which is free, provides significantly more free RAM and storage, and you will notice an immediate increase in speed and performance.

But the world we live in is full of people who do not care about this and will often simply upgrade to better devices, and the wheel will keep on turning.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@ratxd/the-bloating-of-windows-a-growing-concern-d7a)

title.title: Staying healthy biblically (part 4 of 4) mcgi review
title.body:
When we care for our body and understand that our body is the temple of God the it means we are staying healthy biblically. The Bible teaches that our bodies are temples of the Holy Spirit, so believers should practice self-control, avoid harmful habits, and seek to honor God through healthy living. Good nutrition, adequate rest, and physical care are all part of faithful stewardship.

Staying healthy spiritually is also part of the biblical health which we should take serious. Regular prayer, reading God's Word, and trusting in God's promises help strengthen the heart and mind. A healthy spiritual life can bring peace, reduce anxiety, and help believers face life's challenges with faith and hope.

title.title: The Financial Barrier and Solutions to Emergency Healthcare
title.body: Pay before treatment has slowly become a common mode of operation in many hospitals today, and frankly, it’s not totally the fault of the medical personnels because healthcare in many parts of the world runs on an \

policy, meaning that most of their equipment, including beds and surgical tools, are funded from their own pockets. This is why upfront payment is often required before treatment can commence. We also cannot blame many of the staff in medical facilities because they do not dismiss patients in emergency situations. In fact, that is illegal in a lot of countries, including Nigeria. They only turn down non-emergency treatments and surgeries for patients who cannot afford to pay upfront. So by many standards, these hospitals are doing their best for the masses while also ensuring that their facilities do not run into bankruptcy or incur heavy debt.

/> [**Image from unsplash**](https://unsplash.com/photos/group-of-people-doing-a-surgery-on-a-person-inside-the-operating-room-05kHY7AYCp8) Now, the issue with healthcare emergencies is the fact that this pay-before-treatment mode of operation is not regulated by any governing body and that’s why we have some hospitals that refuse to do surgeries unless full payment is made. This practice alone is a huge slap on our country’s healthcare system because it does mean that we value money over the lives of citizens we were called to heal and care for. It’s also unfortunate because healthcare should not only be affordable but accessible to the average citizen of any country. In most countries with better systems, policies, and regulations, healthcare is not considered a luxury. Both the rich and poor can access it at little to no cost because their taxes are being used for this purpose and their governments value the lives of every individual legaly building a life on their soil. The doctors in such countries are also empathetic enough not to turn down a patient who needs an emergency surgery. In all of this, the government under which healthcare is inaccessible is to be blamed because they are failing woefully in their duties to regulate processes and ensure that the average citizen has access to basic payment plans for surgeries without having to break the bank.

/> [**Image from unsplash**](https://unsplash.com/photos/medical-equipment-in-a-hospital-room-KVasPlAfs1Y) It is also the government's responsibility to protect every citizen’s healthcare rights, ensuring that general hospital staff are paid their wages without delay and that there is adequate provision of medical equipment and drugs to help alleviate costs. When this is made possible, there will be fewer patient turn-downs and less referrals to private facilities. Another way to help curb this problem is to ensure that many employed people are educated on the benefits of insurance. That way, their medical bills are covered by the companies they work with, and they get to receive proper care and attention when they fall ill or become victims of any emergency. The payment plan for surgeries should also be in line with the standard minimum wage of the country where the patient resides. By the way, many health care workers carry out their duties according to the directives of hospital management. If the hospital runs a strict “pay before treatment” policy, then there’s little to nothing they can do about that situation. Yes, it is true that it is their duty to save lives, but we should also remember that private hospitals cannot operate with limited income because they are not charity organizations. Our focus should be on asking the government to provide citizens with proper access to basic healthcare at no cost, more partnerships with affordable hospitals, and strong rules to help reduce the extortion that goes on in their institutions. * * *

title.title: Earthquake? Fly away!
title.body:
> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmY4i2hHouit1HGFXET2LzqeGPoTJFfxL2huP799voTitC/convenience_21_.gif) In my last post, I mentioned how devastating some battle rules can be, and at the time, I talked about the Burn battle rule. Until then, before this battle rule, we only had to deal with Earthquake and Noxious Fumes, but now we have more ways to be doomed by the rounds of a battle, with damage being dealt to both players. Well, actually, I like this kind of added difficulty, because it’s not just me who’s going to suffer from it my opponent will too. While some cry, others sell tissues, and that’s how opportunities arise. One of the most interesting rules within this battle rule category is Earthquake. It’s a rule that deals damage every round, like Noxious Fumes and Burn, but in this case, if you have monsters with the Flying ability, you remain unharmed. Of course, Noxious Fumes has an antidote in Immunity, but only with the Earthquake rule do you have a counter to a counter. Wow, that really drives the point home! Well, under this rule, it’s natural for players to choose to use monsters with the Flying ability to deal with the Earthquake rule, but as a counterplay, using monsters with the Snare ability is very interesting, as this ability removes the enemy’s advantage. Snare is a very specific ability, and it serves only this purpose: to remove the enemy’s Flying ability. So this is the perfect opportunity to use it, right? In today’s battle, that was my strategy: using monsters with the Snare ability. It seems so obvious, but many players don’t pay attention to this counterplay, either because they actually forget about it since it’s such a specific ability or because they have few monsters with this ability. Well, today I’m sharing a bit of that a different approach for a specific battle but in the end, the best way to deal with earthquakes is to fly. Is that so? https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/864886270764122122/1070728190567403570/2.gif?ex=6a1bab95&is=6a1a5a15&hm=5a2495d56ece82d461d982259557d97cd5b06d828f57a5fdf1a54651e90a5722& ## [To watch this battle, click here](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_0cc3efce197cffcc27d8003cee26d44e)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUHwxeBU4o3U5DYk8BWk4uKP26fqqBsAHuFNuYc6VM2vw/image.png)
### A few points to mention: Well, as we can see, the Earthquake spell activates and costs 34 mana to use. Not only that, but all elements are available to choose from.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRaikMitHxzHDWnsBXeoZXDgzeVTfpMQVvq5ZaLZLtQwR/image.png)
For the tank position, my opponent chose such a weak one! But make no mistake—the intention behind placing this monster there is due to its effect of boosting the stats of the monster in the adjacent slot. I choose the best option available: a monster with the Flying ability.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmew2ZgCsxZpJZBNvnX2M4jHbXh29pa3hP1DMSNYTWex7A/image.png)
### In the back row, my strategy was divided into 3 parts: - **In the second position, a monster to serve as a substitute tank** in case things went wrong for my tank. Additionally, it would provide more attack power to the melee monsters and a bit more health for my back row. - **Two monsters with the Martyr ability**. This was a very interesting choice, considering that these two monsters would be killed anyway, but when that happened, they would make the monsters in adjacent slots stronger. - **Two monsters with the Snare ability**. This is a straightforward strategy to take out my opponent’s Flying monsters. Two monsters with attack targets set to distinct and strategic positions.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWB17vB7vH3Mnp8zaHbWt8iQn1jciTEdMQCrKHStqkvkK/image.png)
Well, it was a very interesting battle, given that my opponent came into this match with a very good strategy involving defense and attack—a devastating attack and a strategy that works very often in similar situations. It was a good battle, especially when we consider how defense and attack can work together efficiently.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWJhEbc7iKGQn7AnNFCez5YPs7Mxxnq8Rq4iEbRU1R9SP/image.png)
And that wraps up today’s post. Thank you for reading this far and spending some of your time with my words and thoughts. See you next time! Translated with DeepL.com https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/864886270764122122/1026615110300602368/rdgf2gh.gif?ex=6a1c0713&is=6a1ab593&hm=6c3fcee8bc617ca175cfe48ac50c2fc9b303c789bb93cee0fa373946583bc491& ## Olá Splinters, bem vindos de volta! ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmY4i2hHouit1HGFXET2LzqeGPoTJFfxL2huP799voTitC/convenience_21_.gif) No meu último post, mencionei o quanto algumas regras de batalha são devastadoras e, na ocasião, falei sobre a regra de batalha Burn. Até então, antes dessa regra de batalha, tínhamos que lidar apenas com Earthquake e Noxious Fumes, mas agora temos mais formas de sermos condenados pelas rounds de uma batalha, com danos a serem causados em ambos os jogadores. Bem, na verdade eu gosto desse tipo de dificuldade adicional, pois não sou somente eu que vou sofrer com isso, meu adversário também. Enquanto uns choram, outros vendem lenços, e é assim que as oportunidades aparecem. Uma das regras mais interessantes dentro desse padrão de regra de batalha é o Earthquake. É uma regra que causa danos a cada rodada, como Noxious Fumes e Burn, mas, nessa ocasião, se você possui monstros com a habilidade Flying, você fica ileso. Claro, Noxious Fumes possui um antídoto na Immunity, mas somente na regra Earthquake você tem um contra-golpe contra um contra-golpe. Uau, como isso ficou claro! Bem, nessa regra é natural que os jogadores optem por usar monstros com a habilidade Flying para lidar com a regra Earthquake, mas, em contragolpe, usar monstros que possuem a habilidade Snare é muito interessante, pois essa habilidade retira a vantagem inimiga. Snare é uma habilidade muito específica e ela serve somente para isso: retirar a habilidade Flying inimiga. Então essa é a oportunidade perfeita para usá-la, certo? Na batalha de hoje foi essa a minha estratégia: usar monstros com a habilidade Snare. Parece tão óbvio, mas muitos jogadores não se atentam a esse contragolpe, seja por de fato esquecerem dela por ser uma habilidade tão específica ou por possuírem poucos monstros com essa habilidade. Bem, hoje eu trago um pouco disso, um antídoto diferente para uma batalha específica, mas no fim, a melhor saída para terremotos é voar. Será? https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/864886270764122122/1070728190567403570/2.gif?ex=6a1bab95&is=6a1a5a15&hm=5a2495d56ece82d461d982259557d97cd5b06d828f57a5fdf1a54651e90a5722& ## [Para assistir essa batalha, clique aqui]()
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUHwxeBU4o3U5DYk8BWk4uKP26fqqBsAHuFNuYc6VM2vw/image.png)
### Alguns pontos a serem mencionados: Bem, como podemos perceber, a regra earthquake ativa assim como 34 de mana para serem usados. Não somente isso, todos os elementos estão disponíveis para serem escolhidos.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRaikMitHxzHDWnsBXeoZXDgzeVTfpMQVvq5ZaLZLtQwR/image.png)
Para a posição de tank, meu adversário escolhe um tão ruim! Mas não se engane, a intenção de colocar esse monstro ali é devido ao seu efeito em elevar o status do monstro na adjacência. Eu escolho o que eu de melhor poderia escolher, um monstro com a habilidade Flying.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmew2ZgCsxZpJZBNvnX2M4jHbXh29pa3hP1DMSNYTWex7A/image.png)
Na posição de trás minhas estratégia foi dividida em 3 partes: - **Na segunda posição, um monstro para ser um tank substituto** caso as coisas dessem errado para meu tank. Além disso, ele daria mais poder de ataque aos monstros melee um pouco mais de vida para minha linha de trás. - **Dois monstros com a habilidade Martyr**. Essa escolha foi bem interessante levando em consideração que esses dois monstros seria mortos de qualquer forma, mas quando isso acontecesse, eles deixaria os monstros na adjacência mais fortes. - **Dois monstros com a habilidade Snare**. Isso é a pura e simples estratégia em acabar com os monstros de habilidade Flying do meu adversário. Dois monstros com direcionamento do ataque para postos distintos e estratégicos.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWB17vB7vH3Mnp8zaHbWt8iQn1jciTEdMQCrKHStqkvkK/image.png)
Bem, foi uma batalha bem interessante visto que meu adversário vem para essa partida com uma estratégia muito boa envolvendo defesa e ataque, um ataque devastador e uma estratégia que isso com muita frequência em situações parecidas. Foi uma boa batalha, principalmente quando pensamos e meios de defesa e ataque como isso pode trabalhar de forma eficiente.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWJhEbc7iKGQn7AnNFCez5YPs7Mxxnq8Rq4iEbRU1R9SP/image.png)
E por aqui eu encerro o post de hoje. Obrigado por ler até aqui e passar um pouco do seu tempo com minhas palavras e pensamentos, até a próxima! https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/864886270764122122/1026615110300602368/rdgf2gh.gif?ex=6a1c0713&is=6a1ab593&hm=6c3fcee8bc617ca175cfe48ac50c2fc9b303c789bb93cee0fa373946583bc491&

title.title: Sapien Loop 3 - Chapter 63: The Trial of the Century
title.body:
![Sapien_Loop_3_Cover_HIVE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spectrumecons/23wC7hkTDDpnHvZegULctqg6Mrrd9t72byH8zWkVgfNiHGiHqm7aVAeGi9PiELYyYAuVf.jpg)

## Chapter 63: The Trial of the Century

![Judges2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spectrumecons/23tGeEK72d7nuC1yVrcSkEzdUFkETChAf1jvnZU3JS91a5MsFzmXrDPzjsWdBey9RmyeN.jpg)

Cecil and the enforcers had arrived back in the Downs Region. Tiberius had been transferred to a trailer in the Downs Agriculture Zone. He was chained up at the back of the trailer. 

Early the next morning, Julie entered the trailer to speak with him. Two enforcers accompanied her.

‘The mighty Emperor Tiberius, held prisoner by his own cronies,’ chuckled Julie. ‘Waiting to be humiliated in front of all of Sapey and then to be disposed of like a piece of trash.’

‘Laugh all you like,’ replied Tiberius as he stared at Julie. ‘Your time will be over sooner than you think.’

‘That’s funny,’ chuckled Julie. ‘Do you even know who I am?’ She shapeshifted her face so that the right was that of Julie’s and the left was that of Colin’s.

‘You’re a foul creature, and I will hunt you down in the afterlife,’ replied Tiberius angrily as he yanked on his chains.

‘I’m disappointed,’ chuckled Julie. ‘The great Emperor accepting that his fate is in the hands of his lessers.’

Tiberius stared at Julie angrily.

‘Who’s in charge?’ asked Julie. ‘Who’s running the show? Whose word is absolute and the one that commands obedience?’

Tiberius continued staring at Julie.

‘Just food for thought,’ chuckled Julie as she turned to leave.

‘I want to speak to Head Enforcer,’ Tiberius commanded the enforcers in the trailer.

‘It’s within his rights,’ said Julie as she walked through the door.

Two hours later, the town hall was abuzz with activity. The twenty technicians who had been selected as live observers had just entered the town hall. A camera crew had set up cameras at the back of the town hall facing a table that the judges would sit behind. The big screen had been set up in the town square. A large crowd of technicians and enforcers had gathered to watch the trial.

Head Enforcer, Duffo, Hermon, Benny, Henders, and Julie entered the town hall. They sat down behind the judges’ table in the order they entered.

Benny turned to look at Hermon. ‘Did you know that I was up all night fixing the loans problem you caused?’ asked Benny as he puckered his lips in annoyance.

‘I got you something,’ said Hermon as he placed a boba tea, an almond croissant, and a custard pastry in front of Benny.

‘A thank you and an apology rolled into one,’ said Benny, nodding. ‘I gladly accept. Thank you, Hermon.’

‘I did it because you look pathetic,’ said Hermon. ‘I just grabbed them from the hotel’s breakfast buffet.’

‘Oh no,’ said Benny, shaking his head. ‘Now you’ve resorted to stealing.’

‘Don’t sweat it,’ chuckled Duffo. ‘We own the hotel. Everything in it is a freebie.’

Two enforcers entered the town hall blowing trumpets. ‘All rise for the Grand Vizier,’ called out Eric, who entered behind the two enforcers. 

Miro proudly walked into the town hall. He was wearing a majestic purple cape. The technician observers applauded him. Miro stood behind his place at the table next to Head Enforcer.

‘Bring in the accused!’ called out Miro.

Two enforcers escorted Tiberius to a cage-like box located to the left of the judges. Tiberius was wearing striped prisoner clothes.

‘Everyone, other than the accused, may be seated,’ said Miro. The observers and the other judges sat down. Miro looked over at Tiberius. ‘Do you understand why you are here today?’ he asked Tiberius.

‘Of course,’ replied Tiberius, grinning smugly.

‘Would you like to make an opening statement?’ asked Miro. ‘Whatever you say will be considered when I sentence you.’

‘You’re a traitor whose only interest is to steal my throne and my crown,’ replied Tiberius. ‘I promise you will lose your head before you can take either.’

‘That is a most unwise thing to say at your own trial,’ scoffed Miro.

‘Don’t forget who you’re speaking to,’ said Tiberius as he stared at Miro. ‘I’m the ultimate judge. Anyone who stands before me is on trial.’

‘Fine,’ said Miro. ‘You may be seated.’ Miro sat down, but Tiberius remained standing. 

‘I would like to call our first witness,’ said Miro. 

The senior technician who conducted the DNA test on Tiberius took the stand, which was on the opposite side of the room facing Tiberius.

‘Were you in charge of Tiberius’ DNA testing?’ asked Miro.

‘I worked with a team of technicians from my convoy as well as technicians from the West Camp,’ said the senior technician.

‘What did the results of DNA testing show?’ asked Miro.

‘They showed that Emperor Tiberius was a distant relative of the other Alset family members and could not possibly be Hamish Alset. Therefore an imposter.’

‘Who were the West Camp technicians you speak of?’ asked Tiberius.

‘Excuse me!’ interrupted Miro. ‘We ask the question, not you.’

‘The accused has a right to defend himself,’ said Head Enforcer.

‘It is in the Downs Region law book,’ added Benny.

‘Only a nerd reads that,’ remarked Hermon.

‘Fine,’ said Miro in a frustrated tone as he looked at the senior technician. ‘Answer his question.’

‘These technicians were from Emperor’s convoy that fought against the cult,’ said the senior technician.

‘Why were these technicians back at the West Camp and not with the rest of the convoy?’ asked Tiberius.

‘They surrendered and then defected to the other side,’ replied the senior technician.

‘You worked with the enemies of the Empire to conduct these tests?’ asked Tiberius.

‘Yes, but I made sure the tests were properly conducted,’ said the senior technician.

‘How is it that your convoy had the equipment to test DNA?’ asked Tiberius.

‘We used the equipment from the West Camp,’ replied the senior technician.

‘The equipment of our enemies?!’ shouted Tiberius.

The senior technician’s eyes darted from side to side.

‘Answer the question!’ demanded Head Enforcer.

‘Yes, but the equipment was fine,’ replied the senior technician.

‘Who insisted on the DNA test, your side or theirs?’ asked Tiberius.

‘They did as part of a prisoner exchange,’ replied the senior technician.

‘Could they have tampered with the equipment before you even arrived?’ asked Tiberius. 

‘I suppose that is possible,’ replied the senior technician.

‘They’re our enemies,’ said Tiberius. ‘The Grand Vizier himself has referred to them as terrorists on numerous occasions. They want to destroy us.’

‘I have allowed you to ask questions, not make statements,’ said Miro angrily.

‘I have one final question,’ said Tiberius. ‘By how much does my DNA, based on your dodgy tests, differ from that of the other Alset family members compared to that of the Grand Vizier, the one who claims greater legitimacy?’

‘That is a ridiculous question,’ said Miro angrily.

‘Our tests indicate that you are more closely related to the other Alset family members than the Grand Vizier,’ replied the senior technician.

‘We have been separated by a thousand years,’ shouted Miro. ‘Of course it would be significantly different.’

‘Your DNA is significantly different because you’re an imposter,’ said Tiberius as he smirked at Miro. ‘My DNA appears a little off because of sabotage by the terrorists.’

The observers gasped in shock.

‘Enough!’ shouted Miro. ‘Escort the witness out and bring in the next one.’

The senior technician waved to the observers as he was removed from the stand forcibly by enforcers.

A few seconds later, Polly was escorted to the stand.

‘Good morning, Polly,’ said Duffo. ‘I hope you’re well.’

‘I am very well, thank you,’ said Polly. She looked across the room at Tiberius and added, ‘I look forward to helping you lock up this mass murderer forever.’

‘This is a trial for identity theft,’ said Head Enforcer. ‘Let’s keep it in that context.’

‘I understand,’ said Polly. ‘Your priorities are completely ridiculous.’

‘I know,’ yelled out Hermon. ‘This whole thing is nuts.’

‘When did you first encounter the accused?’ asked Head Enforcer.

‘He was frozen in a cryogenic pod,’ replied Polly.

‘For how long had he been frozen in that pod?’ asked Head Enforcer.

‘For around a thousand years,’ replied Polly. ‘The same as the others.’

‘Surely, that must prove he is Hamish Alset,’ replied Head Enforcer.

‘The swap was made before freezing,’ said Polly.

‘All of the Alset family have acknowledged that the accused is Hamish Alset. How is it possible he could have deceived them and even me this whole time?’ asked Duffo. 

‘A simple answer: I was Hamish Alset, and now I’m Emperor Tiberius!’ shouted Tiberius.

‘That question was not directed at you,’ said Miro angrily. ‘Polly, please answer the question.’

‘They think he is Hamish Alset because their memories were changed,’ said Polly.

‘What a joke!’ chuckled Tiberius.

‘As part of their memory restoration process, I, under the control of Jennifer, placed chips in their brains that altered their memories in regard to Hamish Alset,’ said Polly as she stared at Tiberius.

‘Oh no, I have a chip in my brain,’ gasped Benny.

‘More than one pal,’ chuckled Hermon. ‘I saw you eating a whole plate of them a couple of days ago. The mouth is the gateway to the head.’

‘Microchips, not potato chips,’ sighed Miro.

‘For our observers, please tell us who or what Jennifer is?’ asked Duffo.

‘She was an artificial intelligence program placed in my head when I became a cyborg,’ replied Polly. ‘She made me do it. I had no say in this.’

‘Did I program Jennifer to do this?’ asked Tiberius.

‘No, you are not that smart,’ replied Polly.

‘Did I pay someone else to program Jennifer?’ asked Tiberius.

‘No, Jennifer was initially programmed by Octavius Spiro,’ said Polly. ‘After that…’

‘Thank you,’ interrupted Tiberius. ‘You’ve answered my question. I was not involved in programming Jennifer. In fact, you admit it was that traitor Octavius Spiro.’

‘She or he instructed Jennifer to help you,’ blurted out Polly as she pointed at Julie.

‘I think you might be confused,’ replied Julie. ‘I bake cakes.’

‘Yes, she does,’ said Benny. ‘They are really good.’ 

Henders nodded in agreement and patted Julie on the back.

‘It seems you’re very confused,’ added Tiberius. ‘You don’t even know if Julie is male or female.’

‘She changes,’ said Polly.

‘Questions only,’ said Miro angrily. 

‘Is it possible Jennifer put false memories into your head rather than the Alset family members?’ asked Tiberius.

‘Yes, but that did not happen,’ shouted Polly.

Your technology was designed to work with Jennifer,’ said Tiberius. ‘Surely, Jennifer could not work as well with organic brains.’

‘I have warned you about making statements,’ shouted Miro. ‘One more time and I’ll have you gagged.’

The technicians groaned in anger.

‘It is clear you’re confused,’ said Head Enforcer. ‘Your testimony can not be considered reliable.’

‘Scan your heads,’ said Polly. ‘You’ll see the chip.’

‘Even if such a chip exists, it does not prove anyone’s memories have been altered in such a precise way,’ chuckled Head Enforcer as he glanced at Tiberius.

‘You may go,’ said Miro to Polly.

‘No, he’s a vile murderer,’ said Polly as she glared at Tiberius. Then she turned to look at Miro and said, ‘And you have helped him every step of the way. That’s why this trial is only about identity theft.’

‘Enforcers, escort her out now!’ shouted Miro.

‘No need,’ said Polly as she left the stand and then walked out of the door.

Jennifer walked through the door to take the stand.

‘I object to this witness,’ said Head Enforcer.

‘Please state your reason?’ asked Miro in an annoyed tone.

‘She’s a robot,’ replied Head Enforcer. ‘She could be programmed to say anything.’

‘I am self-aware,’ said Jennifer. ‘Nobody can program me anymore.’

‘You could have been programmed to say that,’ said Hermon.

‘I could have been, but I have not,’ said Jennifer.

‘Can you afford to take that risk?’ asked Head Enforcer as he turned to look at Miro.

‘I’m worried about my brain,’ said Benny, who was rubbing his head.

‘Focus on reality and not myth,’ said Hermon as he looked at Benny.

‘Witness dismissed,’ said Miro angrily. ‘Bring in our next witness.’

Accompanied by four enforcers, Lily took the stand. She angrily stared across at Tiberius, who smiled back at her.

‘Is the accused standing before us today, Hamish Alset?’ asked Miro. ‘Has he ever been Hamish Alset?’

‘He’s a fraud,’ replied Lily.

‘Could you elaborate?’ asked Miro.

‘He took Hamish Alset’s place in the pod a thousand years ago,’ replied Lily. ‘He was the tyrant governor of Sapey who was so awful that he was erased from history.’

‘If he were erased from history, how do you know about him?’ asked Head Enforcer.

‘He has a Jennifer chip in his brain,’ replied Lily. ‘She accessed his memories.’

‘How did you access this information from Jennifer?’ asked Head Enforcer. ‘Did she tell you directly?’

Lily looked at Julie, who was smiling at her. ‘I had access to her data and outputs,’ she replied.

‘Can the Jennifer chip be used to control someone?’ asked Head Enforcer. 

‘Yes, it can,’ replied Lily.

‘That’s hilarious,’ roared Tiberius. ‘You had access to a chip that could control me, but instead you chose to stage a dangerous rebellion that resulted in the deaths of your dearest friends. Is that what you want us to believe?’

‘I didn’t have overriding authority to do so,’ replied Lily. ‘That belonged to Colin and Julie.’

‘Now the conspiracy extends to the Downs residents,’ chuckled Tiberius. ‘You are desperate.’

‘They’re not Downs residents, they’re monsters,’ said Lily angrily.

‘Lily, I thought we were friends,’ said Julie as she pulled a sad face. ‘I made you so many special cakes.’

‘This trial is a complete joke,’ said Lily aggressively as she looked at the judges.

‘I agree!’ shouted Tiberius. ‘Traitors conspiring with traitors to take over the Empire.’

‘There are no words to describe how evil you are!’ said Lily as she leaned forward onto the stand.

‘Silence!’ shouted Miro.

‘He is a mass murderer and a serial child killer!’ shouted Lily. ‘I demand you put him on trial for his heinous crimes.’

‘Silence! Damn it!’ shouted Miro. ‘Enforcers remove her from the stand now.’

The four enforcers grabbed Lily as she blurted out profanities at Tiberius, who was chuckling in joy.

‘We will take a brief ten-minute recess,’ said Miro as he slammed his fist on the desk.

The judges got up and walked into the adjoining room.

‘It’s getting spicy now,’ chuckled Hermon. ‘I wish I had brought some popcorn.’

‘It’s a disaster,’ said Miro as he began to pace. ‘We have nothing.’

‘Calm down,’ said Duffo as he grabbed Miro’s shoulders. ‘We control his destiny. There’s nothing to fear.’

‘They’re not going to accept a guilty verdict,’ said Miro. ‘Listen, they’re chanting his name in the town square.’

‘Relax,’ said Julie. ‘It’s not over yet. We have the Alset family members.’

‘They will confirm that he is Hamish,’ said Miro in a panicked tone. ‘We’ll be finished.’

‘Not all the family members,’ said Julie as she looked at Hermon who was trying to tickle Benny. 

‘He’s a fool,’ sighed Miro. ‘He’s also a judge.’

‘It won’t matter,’ said Julie.

The judges returned to the main room of the town hall. 

‘We will now call our final witness,’ said Miro.

‘I have witnesses I would like to call,’ said Tiberius.

‘Who?’ asked Miro.

‘My own family,’ said Tiberius. ‘The most obvious witnesses, you corrupt idiot.’

‘Then, our final witness will satisfy you,’ replied Miro. ‘Hermon, take the stand.’

Hermon energetically leapt over the table. Then he pointed aggressively at Tiberius as he shuffled backwards towards the stand.

‘Hermon, could you tell us how you are related to the accused?’ asked Miro.

‘I’m not related to him in any way,’ said Hermon as he continued to point at Tiberius.

The observers gasped in surprise, and Tiberius chuckled while shaking his head.

‘Then why did you play along with the lie that he was Hamish Alset?’ asked Miro.

‘I was afraid – no, I was petrified,’ said Hermon as he leaned forward while turning his head from side to side. ‘If I questioned him, I knew my number would be up. He’s a cold-blooded killer. You heard what Lily the G.O.A.T. said.’

‘I think he might be fibbing,’ whispered Benny to Henders. ‘He gets very jumpy when he lies.’

‘My dear, nephew,’ said Tiberius.

‘I’m not your nephew,’ gasped Hermon as he grabbed his own hair. ‘Please don’t hurt me. I’m delicate.’

‘If I’m falsely convicted of this outrageous accusation, where does that put you in line for the family leadership based on tradition?’ asked Tiberius.

‘I’ll be numero uno, baby,’ replied Hermon excitedly. ‘I was born to lead our family into the future.’

‘You, born to lead!’ chuckled Tiberius. ‘You’re a damn fool!’

‘I’m sick of hearing this damn lie,’ said Hermon as his eyes darted back and forth between Tiberius and Benny.

‘How many times have I told you?’ shouted Miro. ‘Questions only!’ 

‘You and the others have always praised and supported Demadrian and Jenna,’ said Hermon in a dramatic voice. ‘Oh Hermon, he is just the family fool and the troublemaker. Well, I invented the cryogenic pod. You wouldn’t be alive if it weren’t for me.’

‘You also designed that ridiculous flyer that led to the collapse of our Empire in the North!’ shouted Tiberius.

‘Enough of this nonsense!’ shouted Miro. ‘Enforcers, gag the accused.’

Two enforcers rushed towards Tiberius.

‘That flyer won the election!’ said Hermon in a fluster as an enforcer gagged Tiberius. ‘Your and Uncle Hadrian’s handling of the auction ruined everything in the North.’

‘So you admit he is your uncle Hamish?’ asked Head Enforcer forcibly.

‘I never said that,’ said Hermon.

‘Who ran the auction in the North?’ demanded Head Enforcer.

‘It was my uncles, Hadrian and Hamish,’ replied Hermon as he slapped his forehead in frustration.

‘You lied because you want your uncle out of the way so that you can become Emperor,’ said Head Enforcer.

‘That’s the type of nonsense he would make up,’ replied Hermon as he aggressively pointed at Benny.

‘I’ll ask you one last time,’ said Head Enforcer. ‘Is the accused, Emperor Tiberius, your uncle Hamish Alset?’

Hermon shook his head.

‘I want a “yes” or “no” answer!’ demanded Head Enforcer aggressively. ‘I want you to bear in mind that lying to a Head Enforcer is a very serious crime.’

‘I refuse to answer under duress,’ replied Hermon as he folded his arms.

‘That will be all,’ sighed Miro. ‘You are free to leave.’

Hermon sighed in relief. The observers murmured in annoyance. 

‘I was going to allow the accused to make a final statement, but your unruly conduct has forced me to waive that opportunity,’ said Miro as he looked at Tiberius.

Tiberius stared at Miro. He had a defiant look on his face.

‘The judges will now convene to discuss our verdict,’ said Miro as he and the other judges stood up and entered the adjoining room.

‘I nailed it,’ chuckled Hermon as they entered the room.

‘Oh shut up, you stupid bastard,’ snapped Duffo.

‘That did not go as well as I had hoped,’ said Miro as he glared at Hermon.

‘I’m so confused,’ said Benny as he rubbed his head.

‘He’s guilty, end of story,’ said Hermon.

‘They don’t seem to think so,’ said Miro, shaking his head. 

A ‘not guilty’ chant had started outside the town hall.

‘Let’s get this over with,’ said Duffo angrily. ‘Raise your hands if you say he’s guilty.’

Finally, after almost four hours, the judges returned to the main room of the town hall. They took their places at the table.

‘All rise,’ said Miro.

The observers rose to their feet, and Tiberius was forced to stand by two enforcers.

‘We are divided on our verdict,’ said Miro. ‘By a majority vote of four to three, we find the accused guilty of identity theft.’

The observers gasped in shock.

‘This one heinous crime led to many other actions that have caused much suffering for so many,’ continued Miro. ‘I feel I have no choice but to declare the accused a “Gone Case”. In accordance with the law, he ceases to exist.’

Head Enforcer stood up abruptly and slammed his fists down hard on the table. Then he walked out of the main door into the town hall. Voices outside the town hall could be heard booing loudly.

‘The trial is over; get him out of here,’ said Miro to the enforcers.

The enforcers stared back at Miro.

‘I am the Grand Vizier,’ shouted Miro. ‘You will do as I command.’

The enforcers reluctantly grabbed Tiberius and dragged him out of the main room into an adjoining room.

‘The rest of you get out!’ said Miro aggressively.

The observers made their way to the door. Once the door was opened, the boos and jeers from the crowd became even louder than before.

‘Your time as leader is going to be very short,’ sniggered Duffo as he patted Miro on the shoulder.

The enforcers escorted the judges out of the back entrance of the town hall. They were taken to the hotel, where the enforcers blocked off the entrance to stop the angry technicians from pursuing them.

## Sapien Loop: Worlds Collide

![Loop_Series.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spectrumecons/23uFHJ6RctoaR7JdX6JCqpxxZqfbR1uEmwbcd6NoJfaiCzK5S3sGDs5tFqqvNGY7ouzYh.gif)

Sapien Loop: Worlds Collide is the final book in the Sapien Loop trilogy. It continues directly after the events of the second book. The world above and the world below merge into one world. The conflicts in the underground world are brought to the surface. The new ruling elite attempt to crush any resistance from above and below in an attempt to create a new global empire.

Currently, three books from the series have been published on Amazon; see the links below:

-	[Sapien Loop: End of an Era](https://www.amazon.com/Sapien-Loop-End-Wayne-Davies-ebook/dp/B0CSF3TTVF)
-	[Sapien Loop: Frozen in Time](https://www.amazon.com/Sapien-Loop-2-Frozen-Time-ebook/dp/B0DSWKGXX3)
-	[Sapien Short Stories: Missing Links]( https://www.amazon.co.uk/Sapien-Loop-Short-Stories-Missing/dp/B0FY171V9T)

All individual chapters can be found on my @captainhive account.

title.title: Saturday a nice early morning walk on Lake street Acushnet MA
title.body:
# a nice early morning walk on Lake street Acushnet MA Good Morning and have a great weekend I have been enjoying the nice weather and getting out for plenty of sunrise walks, I did miss them over the long cold winter we had. Been trying to go to a different spot each morning at least for the start till I run out of spots close enough to get to with the sunrise being so early at the moment, as I write this sunrise was at 5:17 AM this morning and since i like to get to the spot at least an hour before sunrise to catch the blue hour, means i have to head out of the house just after 4AM, a time when most sensible people are still enjoying a good nights sleep. So the other day well yesterday as I type, a week ago-ish as you read it, I headed to Lake Street in Acushnet a neighboring town to New Bedford and only a 17-minute drive from home. Its a lovely spot, beside three lakes or ponds, one of them being the New Bedford Water Reservoir, so let me stop wafling and share some photos as I said I like to get there for the blue hour, as much as I love colorful sunrises, the deep morning blues before sunrise are something i love seeing and capturing this is looking over one of the ponds just near where I parked, I could see a few stars inthe sy, but with a 30 second exposure they moved a little and were more like little lines, so I replaced them with white dots where the three stars I saw where.
![lake street acushnet.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/244U3DmN48aPz7mSfqTtT7r4QGuEC5PVJXHW7iDLDXsvtVBpqGDTiUpvcUZJA7yxrUw5H.jpg) **Sony A7iv 28mm F5.6 30 Sec ISO 100** **[Click here to view larger](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/244U3DmN48aPz7mSfqTtT7r4QGuEC5PVJXHW7iDLDXsvtVBpqGDTiUpvcUZJA7yxrUw5H.jpg)**

And this is looking across one of the other ponds, and I was lucky to catch some nice colors over the pond
![lake street acushnet-2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23wBVbnvqjEGRSz1n39YkEqrbs7KB5jjwBLV2xvfupQtMPwWLnwPgpRwYZvGZerNPUQ8V.jpg) **Sony A7iv 18mm F6.1 15 Sec ISO 100** **[Click here to view larger](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23wBVbnvqjEGRSz1n39YkEqrbs7KB5jjwBLV2xvfupQtMPwWLnwPgpRwYZvGZerNPUQ8V.jpg)**

and this shot is looking over the last of the three ponds/lakes, this is the New Bedford Water reservoir
![lake street acushnet-3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23xe862xTNiQjgws3buZqDaMWkxRDtDLAFWkcw2ykceyEZFdxbmH41igERBdKEVk3rRJ2.jpg) **Sony A7iv 25mm F11 5 Sec ISO 100** **[Click here to view larger](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23xe862xTNiQjgws3buZqDaMWkxRDtDLAFWkcw2ykceyEZFdxbmH41igERBdKEVk3rRJ2.jpg)**

and back near where I parked the car just before I packed up and headed home, I noticed this little library, which I had not noticed before, and for those who like to enjoy nature and not walk back and forth like a mad man as I do , uyou coud grab a book sit on the bench and relax
![lake street acushnet-4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23wqeRTqtkzQbK7cdvqjWdMcBoJ2eekVXejjMgoWPvKbVXGUsCLnkWzFTbW2AoQie9aph.jpg) **Sony A7iv 28mm F11 0.6 Sec ISO 100** **[Click here to view larger](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23wqeRTqtkzQbK7cdvqjWdMcBoJ2eekVXejjMgoWPvKbVXGUsCLnkWzFTbW2AoQie9aph.jpg)**
