> # 😍 50 Giveaways 🎉🎊🎉 Holy Hive! I can't believe I am on my 50-month post about my \

on the chain I love with this PowerUp initiative that honestly was not really something I thought much about, and mostly I just reacted to how I wanted to communicate. It has been working for me for the last year or so, but I had to adapt it a couple of times due to time pressure, because only I know how much I can provide (or think I can provide).

I was always totally written by me. NO AI! (very important to note nowadays) And it acts as a compilation of what things I do around, even if this is not entirely representative of all I do, I THINK it does at least resemble some of it.

To start the post, I think it's important to note the hard times people have been going through around the world with all these stupid wars, economic monopolisation of semiconductors (aka memory and storage), and other things I don't even want to get into (like pharma, and political \
).\n\nBeing positive and constructive is hard nowadays. Social media has gone all-in on \

publicly visible, and if you don't have a big fat cash face, you are no one! So, hopefully you will find Hive a better place where you don't have to deal with those things, where you can happily distribute your opinion across the world.

### Touch some grass...

![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/forykw/EqNDJoMGveKDRC58eaRcfQiNj452G2d28dANBviusTAkSXLJXaCPkQQk29XhrSQJRJ5.png)

I am so fortunate to live at the end of the world... it really balances a lot of things you can't imagine.

<div class=\

> # 🎉 9 Years on Hive! Yeah, it has been some time, I am not the decade dinosaurs some of you are, but not by choice... it was basically life taking me away from that chance, and by the time I was settling down, I found it finally! ONE YEAR LATER! But that didn't spook me... It was love at first sight. I will never be at the edge of this badge, but I will always feel proud of being at the edge, just like many other 10-year-old dinosaurs. Check your badges at https://hivebuzz.me/@forykw I have celebrated it on X with a bit of a 69 twist 😏 https://x.com/forkyishere/status/2058390431575187802

> # 🎲🎮🕹️ GAMES Games GAAAMMMESS!! This section was neglected for a few months, in terms of quality. In my view... I didn't have the time... so, I will try to make an effort today. First, be sure you read @ecoinstant's post about [THIS POST](https://peakd.com/hive-140217/@ecoinstant/dcity-final-claimdrop-70000-hive-up-for-grabs-right-now) about the famous @dcitygame closure. This is very important for me, and for many out there, as this game \

shaped many aspects of the layer 2 things on Hive. I can only thank him (game creator) for the effort and dedication. I mattered to me!

SOOO many great memories from this game...

![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/forykw/23tvnm4RboiZTeE7TvTHm3joqkPVa2GHD6mUfxjvcrG5tWguBF1KNkYU85zJSkqbmVZEH.gif)

This was a special thing created... from scriptioner (on [dCITY Discord](https://discord.gg/yn98vdwQgJ)) if I am not mistaken... correct me if I am wrong. I don't know if your account on Hive is the same handle.

![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/forykw/23xVKHuPbG8ZNQF6p9qRsYUevEwyteQkNHCXYtyR7bLTCvo13j1qST2DE5waWE8nAPKL3.PNG)

And yes, I played with multiple accounts by then...

![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/forykw/EoJyyNMyR9c3Fakdmm25va8VJXcFcWo4wxfDCUKU2JsCi5UL3YB5B8qWbCzDXs815ja.JPG)

I have many other pictures on my older posts... and this was a very important venture in terms of how it started and how it ended. I feel proud of the people who do things on a chain like this! I am a follower and practitioner too. This model supports Hive! Does not matter if it does not work and eventually, businesses have to close.

And this is VERY IMPORTANT for the way the ecosystem works.

![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/forykw/23xySn3i2G82FCoWPC38gkJxtehyK9S8nr56vEnuYikbXszJVgbqU3jpWh7RW4nqAZcEx.png)

*(this was back in [late 2024](https://peakd.com/hpud/@forykw/powerup-december-what-forkyng-year))*

I have burned all my NFTs (many thousands that I had to create a special script for me to burn them, even if the @thecrazygm tool was very helpful, it would take me a LOT of hours to finish the job), and I still have 5 million SIM on the [SWAP.HIVE:SIM](https://tools.crypto-dreamr.com/dieselpool/pools?input=SWAP.HIVE&output=SIM) pool reserved for some time before the 26th day of June. 😎

This game will never be forgotten! 😍

Right, and now this is the perfect segway to my next one, @mydempire 👇

## 🏭 https://www.mydempire.com 

![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/forykw/23uRJEWxksTyh4ahHzdYVMtjdmwWB4VUG91GjbX6P8nTt5oj9ZWTUXUGL8VwH8cKuQbdW.png)

Yes, this resembles some fumes of what dCITY's kind of mood was, but it has a different twist. First, it's based on more traditional web2 easy stuff to understand, which is good for the user if the creator is honourable and will always defend the accounts controlling the assets.

But there is a pro on this... it does not need Layer 2... it can be entirely based on layer 1. Which is a defying thing to do in the first place, given that layer 1 does not have programmable contracts.

Why am I still pushing these kinds of things? Well, I believe this is a bridge to the programaticaly feeless world. Where the owner or creator eventually can't control things anymore, and it's all programmatically embedded on the chain.

I love programming, and trustless stuff... so I fight for auto-healing stuff...

If some people read it with red flags, I will say this... \

... yep... no guts! So, yes, this is my reason to be on a game like this, experimenting, exploring, and helping where I can. Not necessarily making a profit for it... But it can happen for many... I am looking for the challenge!

![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/forykw/Eo6SBG3F6t3v8QZew4KtVhPZL8qGaAHE1dnSmoHH4k8Q2VvW35yhkCUvts69bS6zkzN.png)

Join @mydempire discord at the link you will see at the bottom of their main page. The costs of \

this game are very minimal compared with many others and $HIVE prices currently.

But as usual, up to you. You always have the last word... and if you don't like it, that's it! Feedback on that thought, as that will be useful for the creator. It's always useful...

There was another game that I really appreciated the development on this last month...

## 🥷 https://horizonforge-production.up.railway.app

By the energetic @shiftrox mate, I so need to meet one day. This game was probably one of the best wins I have seen in a short time. The speed to \

was BRUTAL! He did something that just worked, simple, easy, enjoyable. I loved it... minor things to address. I was very pleased to experience it.

![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/forykw/EoAe8WDv8aKjk7UGKgj2j5o5qLohGKEuRu6HZFpUDKyVhRPvZLEWkDK85tKgAajuGgd.png)

Yes, as anything vibe-coded, there are ups and downs, but this was/IS very promising. I don't know what you used behind the scenes, but you got a hell of control and efficiency in its development.

![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/forykw/23t7AxzqcEizpatb9AuSeULqdKvMJsRSwaz8BFgXHNZexa8dHKcqJCj7cYxYgETpjnPUd.png)

The simple mechanism can be augmented... and also this might be a first for you, but I can tell you, this is just the beginning of what you will learn about this.

Join the [Discord](https://discord.gg/w6QFKapJ3Q) server for more intel, or just interact with @shiftrox or @horizon-forge 😎

My last mention on the games section will be @dcrops ... why?

## 🌿 https://www.dcrops.com/?ref=forykw

Probably because this has been the second-longest-lasting game after @splinterlands, and don't get me wrong, I love the \
game style. But I am not the best player. And I love long-lasting strategy games like \

for example, and others.

![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/forykw/23x1DQXrWoCUzJGEiwYgfHH7YisoFXK7sqBHe5vUg1p49CkKcgf5d3PkVr3WFdmWGv3ty.png)

#### 11k HIVE worth of NFTs is a fricking crazy value!

And this game has never disappointed me... I know I am not at the 100 Chests I wanted to be... but that's actually a great sign (because others have been adding to the pool).

![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/forykw/23uRFzoc1vEz1FrNasQbpwbXfWYLkbhHX6qk2kE5FhrTktUiKvTQsWQWeJgSyncuJtqp4.png)

My advice... start slow, understand how the game works. Read the [Wiki](https://wiki.dcrops.com) and if you have questions, ask away, tag anyone you know on the game. I know @chaosmagic23 has been drilling into it more often lately! 🫠😏

You know who I am... 🫡

Games... and there are more... so many more, but I can't get to all of them, and I have been focusing on the things I think I can provide valuable feedback. Sorry if I can't yet help you with your app/venture! I will eventually be able.

title.title: AI战甲
title.body:
这段时间一直在尝试使用Claude / Copilot，也深切感受到AI带来的生产力飞升。这就像早期科幻片中所示的那样，为自己披上了一层战甲，突破人类能力的极限，达到原来所不能达到的高度。

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUsWsA3EqbaJpZ63ABYhUFkB3DbS2rHs1TZshVbUQGjjv/image.png)
图源：Pixabay

对于Claude/Copilot等工具，经过初步的接触之后，又做了一些进阶尝试。

首先是对MCP服务器的使用。这些MCP服务器可以说是对AI工具能力的拓展。其实他们就是提供了额外的上下文。连接上MCP服务器之后，AI就能够获取更多的相关上下文，之后就可以进行进阶的推理。

比如：对很多开发人员而言，都需要从类似Figma的工具获取设计细节，然后将其实现。如果增加了一个链接Figma的MCP服务器，就能让AI直接获取设计细节，并从这些细节直接生成代码。这就避免了很多中间步骤，也大幅提升了效率。

再比如：如果链接了Github MCP服务器，就能让AI自动创建一个PR，同样避免了很多人工干预。效率再次大幅提升。

还有就是对代理/子代理的使用。有了这些代理/子代理。就就像一位坐镇中军帐的将军。指挥不同的AI代理完成不同的子任务。这些代理各司其职，彼此之间既有合作，有不互相干扰。它们可以并行工作，也可以按次序进行工作。而决定权都在你这里。

如果能够高效的使用这些AI工具及代理，效率提高的可能都不知10倍。现在大家都在说的超级个体指的就是这个意思。

不过有一点必须要强调：AI的作用只是辅助，指挥它的应该是那个经验丰富，但时间/精力有限的人。感觉Copilot这个名字起的非常好。AI再强大，也要把它作为人类的辅助工具。否则将会面临被其彻底替代进而淘汰的命运。

title.title: El bienestar también depende de cómo interpretamos lo que vivimos
title.body:
<div class='text-justify'>


A medida que vivimos hay muchas cosas que saldrán muy bien, incluso mejor de lo que esperábamos, pero no siempre es así, a veces más bien salen muy mal, y no quiere esto decir que debamos anclarnos en esto, lo ideal sería analizar lo que pasó, ver que bueno podemos sacar de la vivencia y evolucionar a algo mejor, a algo nuevo. He estado pensando en esto de sacar lo bueno de lo no tan bueno, porque hay una tendencia *(a veces natural)* a que cuando pasa algo que no nos gusta llenarnos de pensamientos negativos. 



<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUj3ryDnvFUGzNAVkCxZ1MAz6Xs1mtCJi58aL5yNGyPNs/image.png)

</center>
<center>[Imagen de Macdongtran | Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/el-trabajo-de-personas-la-vida-2166128/)</center>

Particularmente es algo en lo que he caído, y lo he trabajado, porque no ayuda en lo absoluto *(ni a nuestro cuerpo ni a nuestra mente)* el que nos llenemos de pensamientos negativos. Sé que este es un tema que es complejo de manejar en la vida diaria, porque siempre implicará hacer un cambio de visión, un cambio de nuestro esquema mental al momento de afrontar situaciones y no tener visión catastrofista, lo cual es algo que suelo ver con cierta frecuencia.  

Empecemos por hacer conciencia de que muchas veces el sufrimiento no nace solo de la situación, sino del ***significado que le damos casi de manera instantánea** a lo que ha pasado, es decir, es un proceso netamente mental, de pensamiento, y es normal que nuestro cerebro, adaptado a buscar siempre sobrevivir, intentará encontrar ***amenazas*** de las que nos debe resguardar, es un proceso instintivo, pero no somos animales comunes, por lo tanto debemos *(o deberíamos)* ser más racionales que emocionales, y no dejar que ese instinto nos controle, porque ahí es cuando complicamos nuestra existencia, e incluso la de personas en nuestro entorno. 


<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ4hNLPFToEaSBhcqSp3VGGBuqx5oZw1QBRFJukCZWixt/image.png)

</center>
<center>[Imagen de OrnaW | Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/hombre-joven-de-cerca-retrato-4070556/)</center>

Y podemos ver estos pensamientos en situaciones cotidianas, como por ejemplo, si escribes a alguien y no te responde, se puede pensar que está molesto, pero no necesariamente el pensamiento que surge es *\

*, este es un ejemplo bastante común, o si en medio de una serie de actividades hay algo específico que no salió bien, pensar que *“todo salió mal”*, estos son patrones de conducta, y así como se instauran en nuestra mente, debemos trabajar en ello para reeducar nuestra manera de pensar y de reaccionar. Desde hace algún tiempo vengo pensando mucho en relación a este tema, creo que gran parte de los problemas que se nos presentan con amistades, con compañeros de trabajo, e incluso con familia tiene que ver con esto, con el hecho de como reaccionamos ante lo que ocurre, con la manera en la que asumimos las cosas básicamente desde lo emocional, y parece mentira pero en lo personal, desde que tengo consciencia de esto mis conflictos personales han disminuido considerablemente, primero porque pienso más antes de actuar o reaccionar, y segundo, porque analizo más las reacciones de la spersonas y siempre busco una razón más allá.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV2CaaLpS7WHEp7ie8daQ48rPfoUqAQcrzrxcn2WBsNf5/image.png)
[Imagen de lecreusois | Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/meditaci%C3%B3n-pensamiento-horizonte-1994824/)
Esto me ha dado la posibilidad de entender más a las personas, e incluso, con quienes lo permiten, hablar con ellos desde la tranquilidad y aliviar cualquier carga, porque a veces las personas no saben que sóloe stán reaccionando, porque han pasado su vida así, sencillamente, y cuando alguien se los hace ver, pueden tomar consciencia de ello y mejorar, así como pasó conmigo en su momento. Y no quiero decir que es que vivía peleando ni discutiendo con otros, sino que entraba en conflicto conmigo mismo sin tener justificación. Un cambio de nefoque mental ayuda mucho a aliviar esas cargas que nos sumamos muchas veces sin ninguna razon y repercutira esto en nuestra salud física, mental y social, y si hay algo que nos puede sumar considero que es importante que podamos compartirlo como una herramienta, sin la pretensión de ponerlo como una verdad absoluta ni nada parecido, claro está. Como siemrpe digo, no soy especialista en este tema, pero es algo básico que en lo particular me ha ayudado a mejorar en muchos aspectos. Espero que esto tenga sentido para tí, y gracias por llegar hasta el final de esta publicación. Bonito fin de semana para todos.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTXJ83kY9BN2p9LYSbwXSBXReBLDTGBc5YnFKLLf4e4ke/image.png)

title.title: Winter Walk - Urqhuarts to Sunnymead
title.body:
There's a strong south-easterly wind blowing as I start my walk from the Urquhart Bluff car park to Sunnymead Beach at the beginning of Aireys Inlet. The first section is an ascent, which I'm never that much of a fan of because my lungs aren't that great. Still, you've got to go through some pain, don't you? It's part of life — and cardiovascular health and all that. 

As you walk, you can hear the traffic from the Great Ocean Road on one side and the roar of the ocean to the left. Still, it's officially winter now and it is cold, so there are not many people about. The track is pretty overgrown and I even have to clamber over a few fallen branches. I like it that way, where I can see my tiny van and if I sing all the way down the beach to the beginning of Anglesea.

A minute further up the hill there's actually a seat and a picnic table I didn't even know was there. If you're walking up and plan to have lunch, this would be a nice spot to have a break, particularly on the way back from Aireys if you did the walk in reverse. 

<div class=\

> https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/riverflows/23yJANn53cJovWdYXqnb1DCyREYSBDBKeG1jTzv8JtSkMoQ2VMZN5WpmCa5K3p3AQ9rUG.jpg This twisted overgrown track is actually part of the old Great Ocean Road. There are chunks of asphalt under the dirt and gravel that, if you didn't realise, you probably wouldn't notice. I love walking through these gnarled mini trees, the types of wiry coastal tea tree buffeted and twisted by the wind. Beautiful forms. Native sticky hops with yellow flowers, acacia, and various other native plants line the path and sometimes make tunnels to walk through. There are the pink tips and bells of heath, and moss grows on various rocks. It's fairy country, for a bit. I was feeling a little depressed starting out, but after 10 minutes of walking I'm already feeling a little bit better. I think it's just that first 45 minutes or so until the fog clears a little easier. Getting out of the house can be torture, but once I'm out there I do clearly feel a little bit better for it. https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/riverflows/23sUAhs2z1ARWYUee2SvshYU1QwJmdXd8PrEsmuyZXXwZSnERLtFZp1fkcyV8yQNBs8zk.jpg

> https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/riverflows/EoEpyTRZ1iT1Tv7choh6F1Zi8j6gRJaEuMG4fapcsrYjZNWterjkQatPvAkikszLNe7.jpg I pass through a twisted woodland but there are no birds, as usual. There are more in spring when it's mating season. I pass a sign that tells me exactly what bird species are around and, as much as I hate signs everywhere, I didn't realise that the little wrens we see around here were so rare.

> https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/riverflows/EoAaB4F9CCZF2xGzoPfUAH6DidhnGTYkoGc8LshiysWztSZFDtqEPUxZ4KfYCCfA9F4.jpg https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/riverflows/EoAaB4i8QuVxFFT25TsCCCAh3xyujCC2yqV9KXUuNwhE99EGEhkXyDLcL824tkvAd2F.jpg I don't know why I'm so resentful of signs. I think I like self-discovery — just glimpsing something between the trees, staying with it for a while and puzzling it over, talking about it with people, looking it up in a bird book, and maybe having it remain a mystery until one day the pieces click together and you go, \

But such is life these days, I suppose. We like to know everything at once. And I've turned into a grumpy old woman. 

Eventually, after I pass through some more wooded areas, where I think I hear the little wrens warning each other that there is a stranger passing by, I start going downhill. The wind is blowing in my face and I'm getting closer to the ocean and further from the road, which is nice.

I stop and walk to a little secret lookout in the scrub where you can look over the magnificent ochre cliffs that are unique and special to this area. Somehow I've got to get down to that section and then turn left and walk back along the beach and hope the tide is low enough. It is probably dangerous for tourists, I guess, but it's nothing for me, who understands this landscape so well after having lived here all my life. 

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/riverflows/Ep5mj1QJNcRF71xbxR7A17eSujRqyZMoppkRC7A9uQQnxCtTbmT6aQkabFiecS2LcV9.jpg

<div class=\

> https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/riverflows/23qrLK89bGsdLmmnauYrZxbMqMkQ1zaYpNKiNM3fW3zGMTUu49nW3X7ANSWMFWACyunGy.jpg From here, and particularly if you keep walking down into Aireys township, you'll start seeing houses on beautiful properties owned either by people who have been here all their lives and whose parents bought here years ago, or by the very rich. They're houses I would never be able to afford and I'm not even sure I would like them anyway, as they would feel so exposed. Wait, who am I kidding - just in case you were going to buy me one, I'm all in. https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/riverflows/23qrLK89bGsdLmmnauYrZxbMqMkQ1zaYpNKiNM3fW3zGMTUu49nW3X7ANSWMFWACyunGy.jpg Then I decide to walk down onto the beach. I'm a little nervous because I'm not sure whether the tide is low enough yet, but it is going out so I can't go too wrong, I guess.

> https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/riverflows/EpA26wrhB8XzG5x7k7v7uxuw3cW5TyTgJXFFgPtBYVoFBWKZ6axghEfVBvxVWojQhZU.jpg https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/riverflows/EqQMdj3y9Z8BEpLo2BGyfWGCowwbsH9m94bR9bdmmGZFHKhpiQxVgDXRQezj43Ceu2s.jpg The tide 🌊 has gone out enough and it is easy to walk around the headland. If you're not confident on rocks, I wouldn't do this section, and certainly not if it's been raining. In winter the clay can be very slippery, so watch your step. I call this the Pirate Cave. In summer we jump into the water that rushes through the opening, but it is too cold now and probably too dangerous with nobody else around.

> https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/riverflows/243WRSmpVe32KNxF443nnfWK9Xp45LuiMB3ip6m1J8QNYcfJoYchcco4ix3NcfyhSSACm.jpg After a fairly easy stroll along the beach and some rock hopping, you arrive at what we call the Mermaid's Pool. If you have been following me for a while, you would know I do swimming here sometimes in the warmer months. You can even do laps in here and it's pretty special — the coast's best kept secret — although with social media, a lot more people know about it now.

> https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/riverflows/EpQvqnNf4336DsVHz1RX6vKVr84ywW1kzEp5xWMzrYif7Jg7kYPQZBohoDnkqCsnzXE.jpg **I'm not sure whether many people know that I have started the Ocean Lovers community on Hive. The idea is for people to post anything to do with the ocean — or yes, the sea. We use them interchangeably in English, though there are slight differences if you're being pedantic, but I digress. The main idea is that if you're posting anything to do with bodies of salt water like beaches, sailing, surfing, or walking along the beach, follow the community so you can see when people post cool stuff. I'd love to see you get involved.** I'm really doing it because it's another way I can give back to Hive, and I know that you all know how much I love my beautiful wild Southern Ocean. 💙🌊🐬😎

title.title: Tostadas de arepas con jamón y queso / Arepa Toasts with Ham and Cheese
title.body:
Hace unos días hice arepas simples (sin relleno) para ofrecer en el supermercado donde trabajo, y como acá la gente quiere que se las de ya listas para comer, pero eso no lo tengo permitido dentro del local, me quedaron dos paquetes sin vender, que por supuesto me traje de vuelta a casa, y con los que aproveché para hacer unas tostadas y así no perder la inversión y el tiempo.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmdCJ78Bq3e11Rcs62F4KbCqbShb6mUbUDxEKBueA5Q9H7/tostadas_de_arepitas_viejas.png</center>

El proceso es bastante simple, pero le da un toque diferente de sabor a aquellas arepitas que hayan quedado de sobra, o también para comerlas de una manera diferente. Así que sin más preámbulos, les comento los ingredientes y el proceso.

Como se hace con las arepas sobrantes, no explicaré el paso a paso para hacerlas, lo que si es recomendable que sean arepas asadas y no fritas previamente, para evitar excesos de aceite.

# Ingredientes

* Arepas ya listas

* 1 huevo

* 1 taza de agua o leche

* 2 cucharadas de harina de trigo o maicena

* Jamón y queso para rellenar

* Aceite para freír.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmYz12V9i9A7BgFiThwikcSN83v1td4G2eTfaTQGyMpBE3/20260528_213145.jpg</center>

# Preparación:

En un bol preparar una mezcla con el agua o la leche, la harina y el huevo, incorporando todo para que no tenga grumos. Reservamos.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmQhbGMrztVjAmgBQ15AbB1T6E48zGvehpipgBTfq4pHgq/20260528_213209.jpg</center>

Poner a calentar una sartén con suficiente aceite, y mientras tanto, vamos con las arepas.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmVdK67CJucABnUezoiP7akRQmUpJDW6HSVBm9gLEnhEUX/20260528_214322.jpg</center>

Abrimos las arepas y rellenamos, en este caso lo hice con jamón y queso, pero se le puede colocar el relleno a gusto. 

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmQnjC6LRhzU6shR4SeLST7EhuVGhSj2NmkqTiWKdEd77G/20260528_214546.jpg</center>

Pasar luego cada arepa por la mezcla que hicimos previamente, si es necesario varias veces por cada lado, para que se empape por completo.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmXQQ45idprvuhzDNcBVr5aXNuCwo4QXYFQArpXHBrvGkU/20260528_214651.jpg</center>

Colocarlas con cuidado en el aceite, y voltearlas cuando se vea que están doradas por los bordes. En este punto es importante no dejarlas por mucho tiempo para que no se quemen, tomando en cuenta que solo es necesario que se cocine la mezcla del rebozado, por lo que su cocción es relativamente rápida.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmXvYRZY96bPcbyrq7Bj6vMYiLtgU5A2mZLQu6kbQFhm5u/20260528_214749.jpg</center>

Al sacarlas, colocarlas sobre una servilleta o papel absorbente, para eliminar el exceso de aceite, y ya están listas para disfrutar.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmUaXiDkdY31BptfR6UekLewHjnWRSYH3vrMKquWMaxAuf/20260528_214905.jpg</center>

Yo tenía muchos años sin hacerlas, y el volverlas a comer me trajo muchos recuerdos de mi infancia, inclusive de cuando comíamos arepas remojadas en suero, pero eso si está más complicado de replicar en Argentina.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmWAoPnxSxFfzWSzj6bWwqpP6tJByY6Tdf5d8xG4eWdfq3/20260528_215659.jpg</center>

Por lo pronto, quedé a gusto con mis tostadas, aunque mis hijos me miraron como si estuviera comiendo algo del otro mundo.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmQU8tzfuhBgLVpPoqSvwci2KtMoVmHNbUzPnrj28jtpN9/image.png</center>

A few days ago, I made plain arepas (without filling) to sell at the supermarket where I work. Since people here want them ready to eat, but I’m not allowed to prepare them on the premises, I ended up with two unsold packages, which I naturally brought home. I decided to use them to make some toasted arepas so I wouldn’t waste the money or the time.

The process is pretty simple, but it gives a different flavor twist to those leftover arepas, or lets you enjoy them in a different way. So without further ado, here are the ingredients and the process.

Since we’re using leftover arepas, I won’t explain the step-by-step process for making them. However, I do recommend using grilled arepas rather than pre-fried ones to avoid excess oil.

# Ingredients

* Ready-made arepas

* 1 egg

* 1 cup of water or milk

* 2 tablespoons of wheat flour or cornstarch

* Ham and cheese for the filling

* Oil for frying.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmYz12V9i9A7BgFiThwikcSN83v1td4G2eTfaTQGyMpBE3/20260528_213145.jpg</center>

# Preparation:

In a bowl, mix the water or milk, flour, and egg, stirring until smooth. Set aside.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmQhbGMrztVjAmgBQ15AbB1T6E48zGvehpipgBTfq4pHgq/20260528_213209.jpg</center>

Heat a skillet with enough oil, and in the meantime, prepare the arepas.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmVdK67CJucABnUezoiP7akRQmUpJDW6HSVBm9gLEnhEUX/20260528_214322.jpg</center>

Open the arepas and fill them; in this case, I used ham and cheese, but you can choose any filling you like. 

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmQnjC6LRhzU6shR4SeLST7EhuVGhSj2NmkqTiWKdEd77G/20260528_214546.jpg</center>

Then dip each arepa into the mixture we made earlier, several times on each side if necessary, so it is completely coated.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmXQQ45idprvuhzDNcBVr5aXNuCwo4QXYFQArpXHBrvGkU/20260528_214651.jpg</center>

Carefully place them in the oil, and flip them when the edges start to brown. At this point, it’s important not to leave them in for too long so they don’t burn, keeping in mind that you only need to cook the batter mixture, so they cook relatively quickly.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmXvYRZY96bPcbyrq7Bj6vMYiLtgU5A2mZLQu6kbQFhm5u/20260528_214749.jpg</center>

When you take them out, place them on a napkin or paper towel to remove the excess oil, and they’re ready to enjoy.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmUaXiDkdY31BptfR6UekLewHjnWRSYH3vrMKquWMaxAuf/20260528_214905.jpg</center>

I hadn’t made them in years, and eating them again brought back many memories of my childhood, including when we used to eat arepas dipped in whey—though that’s a bit harder to replicate in Argentina.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmWAoPnxSxFfzWSzj6bWwqpP6tJByY6Tdf5d8xG4eWdfq3/20260528_215659.jpg</center>

For now, I was satisfied with my tostadas, even though my kids looked at me as if I were eating something out of this world.

***

Foto/Photo by: @mamaemigrante
Banner de portada: Cortesía de @palabras1
Edición/Edited by @mamaemigrante using canva

title.title: IS THERE PROTECTION FOR SINNERS//MCGI TOPIC REVIEW
title.body:
The bible teaches us that God loves us equally whether you're a sinner or a true believer, but God is always waiting to accept the sinners who are ready to repent and turn away from sin. Throughout Scripture, God showed patience toward people who had sinned, warning them of danger and calling them to change their ways. His desire is not the destruction of sinners but their repentance and salvation.
https://youtu.be/1vsr_G6DxJE?si=AlMCwkBHaoIkh_o6
God's protection should not be viewed as approval of sinful behavior. The Bible makes it clear that persistent and unrepentant sin brings consequences. Those who turn to God in faith and seek His forgiveness can find refuge in His mercy and grace. 

>Psalm 34:18 says, \

title.body:
![1-Cortejo Queima das Fitas_Coimbra@Paulo Abrantes-.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23zRnS1ukRKN54h8FvjUopUYJoa9wujgfy5RezM8KwGs5ajB71ayY2CApAe24nRyigwf9.jpg)

Coimbra, Portugal, is known as the City of Knowledge—or the City of Students. This is because it is home to one of the oldest universities in Europe, and in 2013 it was designated a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

The entire city is directly or indirectly immersed in the university, in learning, and in the vast student population studying in Coimbra. In addition to the University of Coimbra, there are polytechnic institutes and private schools. 

Of the city’s nearly 150,000 residents, at least 40,000 are students (the University of Coimbra alone has about 25,000 students).

![2-Cortejo Queima das Fitas_Coimbra@Paulo Abrantes.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23wgHYCFSJ1D8zpceQww3HuEnhEAk2uKKxhTkytryYXWXHzxNtxTDdsETh7eVeoEeCt9F.jpg)
Throughout the year, there are two major student festivals known as Academic Festivals. One takes place in October, called the *Festa das Latas*, which focuses on welcoming new students (known as “freshmen”).

The other, in May, is called the *Queima das Fitas* (the Burning of the Ribbons). It marks the end of student life, when students bid farewell to their academic years. After this, they enter the job market; the vast majority leave the city. Others return.

The culmination of this celebration (Queima das Fitas), the highlight, is the ***Cortejo dos Fitados***. It’s total madness; all the emotions of this ending are unleashed in the most excessive ways you can imagine.

There’s satire, there’s irreverence, and lots and lots of alcohol. The photos I’m sharing with you are from the very last Cortejo, which took place last Sunday.

![3-Cortejo Queima das Fitas_Coimbra@Paulo Abrantes.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/241t1YRe9LGj9wZDM6SRMGjEcTfWqCa3S3ZvC7sbRznbZd6wSYKkX7rk6fwmcokfE3Anc.jpg)

In addition to this wild carnival, there are nights with concerts, as well as sports, cultural, and traditional activities. It began on May 22 and ends today—May 30.

>! [PORTUGUESE VERSION] 
**Queima das Fitas de Coimbra**
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23zRnS1ukRKN54h8FvjUopUYJoa9wujgfy5RezM8KwGs5ajB71ayY2CApAe24nRyigwf9.jpg
Coimbra, Portugal, é conhecida como a Cidade do Conhecimento. Ou a cidade dos estudantes. Isto porque detém uma das universidades mais antigas da Europa e em 2013 foi considerada pela UNESCO Património Mundial da Humanidade.
 
Toda a cidade vive direta ou indiretamente envolta da universidade, do saber, e toda a massa humana dos estudantes que estudam em Coimbra. Além da Universidade de Coimbra, existem Institutos Politécnicos e escolas privadas. 
 
Dos quase 150 mil habitantes que a cidade tem, seguramente 40 mil são estudantes (só a Universidade de Coimbra tem cerca de 25 mil alunos).
 
Durante o ano, existem duas grandes festas para estudantes, chamadas Festas Académicas. Uma em Outubro, chamada Festa das Latas, que se foca na integração de novos estudantes (chamados \

).
 
A outra, em Maio, é a chamada Queima das Fitas. É o fim da vida de estudante, onde se despedem da vida académica. Depois daqui, vão para o mercado de trabalho, a grande maioria abandona a cidade. Voltam outros.
 
O culminar deste festejo (Queima das Fitas), o ponto alto, é o Cortejo dos Fitados. É loucura total, todas as emoções desse fim são extravasadas das formas mais excessivas que possam imaginar.
 
Há sátira, há irreverência, e muito, muito, álcool. As fotografias que partilho convosco são precisamente do último Cortejo, que aconteceu no passado domingo.
 
Além deste louco \

, há noites com concertos, existem actividades desportivas, culturais e tradicionais. Começou no dia 22 de Maio e termina hoje - 30 de Maio.

title.title: El peso de las piedras
title.body:
<center>
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://images.pexels.com/photos/748920/pexels-photo-748920.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=800)
[LINK](https://images.pexels.com/photos/748920/pexels-photo-748920.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=800)</center>

Sabés cuál es el problema de cargar rencor? Que al que termina lastimando es a uno mismo.

Te explico. Cuando alguien te hace algo malo, duele. Y tenés razón en sentirte mal. Pero después viene la parte peligrosa: cuando decidís no soltarlo. Cuando te dormís y te despertás pensando en lo mismo. Cuando repasás la escena una y otra vez en tu cabeza, imaginando qué le hubieras dicho, cómo le hubieras respondido.

Y sin darte cuenta, ese rencor se vuelve parte de vos. Te acompañá a todos lados. Te amarga el día, te roba el sueño, te aleja de la gente que te quiere.

El problema no es lo que te hicieron. El problema es que vos seguís cargando esa piedra.

Hay un versículo que me gusta mucho:

> El que habita al abrigo del Altísimo morará bajo la sombra del Todopoderoso.

Salmos 91:1

Y justamente una de las cosas más lindas de estar bajo la sombra de Dios es que ahí encontrás descanso para todo eso que venís arrastrando. Descanso de la culpa, descanso del rencor, descanso de querer tener razón todo el tiempo.

Porque cuando realmente entendés que Dios te perdonó a vos, se te hace más fácil perdonar a otros. Cuando entendés que Dios no te juzga por lo que hiciste mal, te cuesta menos no juzgar al que te falló.

> Fíate del Señor de todo tu corazón, y no te apoyes en tu propia prudencia.

Proverbios 3:5

Y eso incluye también confiarle lo que otros te hicieron. Decirle: \

Eso no es debilidad, es sabiduría.

No quiere decir que lo que te hicieron estuvo bien. Quiere decir que no vas a dejar que eso te defina. Que preferís soltar la piedra antes de que se te clave para siempre en la mano.

Dios no nos llama a ser perfectos. Nos llama a ser libres. Y parte de ser libre es aprender a soltar.

*Muchas Gracias por compartir esta lectura, deseo que el Espíritu Santo de Dios traiga revelación de su palabra a nuestras vidas.*

title.title: Why Health and Safety Software Beats Spreadsheets for OSHA Compliance and Audit Readiness
title.body: OSHA inspectors do not announce themselves weeks in advance. They walk onto a site, present credentials, and start asking questions that turn on documentation. The opening request is almost always the same: written program, training records, inspection logs, incident files, and corrective action history. The clock starts on producing those records, and the next few hours determine whether the visit closes quietly or generates citations. [**_Health and safety software_**](https://novara.com/ehs-software/) is built for that scenario. Spreadsheets are not. \n \n

/>**What the Inspector Actually Asks For**  
  
A typical compliance inspection touches the same documentation categories every time. The inspector is looking for evidence that the program runs continuously, not that records exist on paper somewhere. The five categories below cover what every safety team should be ready to produce on the day of an inspection.

**Written safety programs current to the regulations that apply on site**  
Training records showing who completed which course and when  
Inspection logs for equipment, facilities, and high-hazard tasks  
Incident and near-miss reports with dates, locations, and corrective actions  
Hazard Communication documentation, including SDS access and container labeling  
Each item must be timestamped, attributable to a named employee, and consistent with the activity actually happening on site. A spreadsheet can hold the information. It cannot prove the underlying timeline.

**Where Spreadsheets Break Under Review**  
The weakness of a spreadsheet-based program is invisible on a normal day. It becomes visible the moment an inspector asks when a record was created, who authored a correction, or whether a particular inspection was completed before or after a related incident. Spreadsheets do not capture that level of metadata. A column dated last Friday could have been edited yesterday, and there is no internal record of the change. Multiple versions in shared drives, email attachments, and personal folders make it harder to identify a single source of truth. Auditors notice the inconsistency before the program owner does. By the time the report comes out, the citation is already written.

**How a Platform-Based Audit Trail Holds Together**  
A purpose-built platform stores every record with a built-in audit trail that captures who created it, when, from which device, with which attachments, and what happened next. When a near-miss report goes into the platform, the timestamp is locked. When a supervisor closes a corrective action, the closure is attributed to that user and dated. The trail extends through every step of the workflow rather than ending at the initial entry. That is the structural difference. Spreadsheets store data. Health and safety software stores the chain of custody around the data, which is what an audit actually examines on the day.

**Real-Time Visibility Before the Inspector Arrives**  
Audit readiness is not just a question of producing records on demand. It is knowing the program is in good shape before anyone asks. Modern platforms show open corrective actions, overdue inspections, expired training certifications, and incident trends across every site through configurable dashboards. Safety leaders identify gaps while there is still time to close them. OSHA's most-cited violations rarely surprise the safety team after the fact.

**The Five Document Categories That Generate the Most Citations**  
Inspectors do not chase every paperwork detail equally. Five document categories produce the bulk of citations across industries:

Hazard Communication records, especially SDS access and secondary container labels  
Lockout and tagout procedures and the training that supports them  
Respiratory protection program documentation, including fit testing and medical evaluations  
Powered industrial truck operator training and evaluation records  
**Fall protection plans for construction and elevated work**  
A purpose-built [**_EHS software_**](https://novara.com/ehs-software/) system covers each of these through a single record system. SDS access pulls from industry-standard chemical databases. Training records live in an integrated learning management system. Inspection logs and corrective actions connect to the equipment and tasks they cover. The connections matter because a citation often turns on whether two records line up, not whether either record exists in isolation.

**Closing the Documentation Loop**  
For a safety director preparing for an inspection, the practical difference is measured in hours. A spreadsheet based program means assembling files from multiple sources, reconciling versions, and hoping the timestamps survive scrutiny. A platform program means filtering the dashboard to the inspection scope and producing the records on the spot. The right EHS software keeps compliance as a daily operating condition of the safety program rather than a quarterly fire drill that ends with avoidable citations on the closing report.

title.title: Protecting Jackfruit from Pests in a Simple Way
title.body:
Warm greetings, friends of ASEAN Hive!

Today I want to share some photos of the jackfruit tree growing in my yard. This tree is currently bearing quite a lot of fruit, so we need to protect it to keep it safe until harvest time.

These photos show several jackfruits wrapped in used rice sacks. This simple method has long been used by the people of our village to protect the fruit from pests, insects, bats, and adverse weather.

Jackfruit is a very popular tropical fruit in Indonesia. Besides its sweet and fragrant taste, this fruit also has significant economic value. Therefore, maintaining the quality of the fruit while it's still on the tree is crucial.

***
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYZzUo6RWfupucDsTTXsrgMTAZUMbW3wYHi1x3kGjdWvr/1780135189166.jpg)

The first photo shows a young, healthy, and fresh jackfruit. The thorns are densely packed, indicating good growth.

***
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQa1Brkw6duFLTEt4WSVo5KNMdx865Hb4fq7sL51wnALB/1780135240111.jpg)

The following photo shows several jackfruits wrapped in sacks. This wrapping helps keep the fruit clean and reduces the risk of damage from pests.

***
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZkQQvZuk6souPEN4sYfNoV125pKVzHesovKtRESptuLJ/1780135278533.jpg)

From another angle, several fruits can be seen hanging among the lush green leaves. This view creates a very pleasant natural atmosphere under the hot midday sun.

***
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmePWjpML3ERgxk86zryvezZ71FdSRVRhV5Zw8Wuupqz2n/1780135329300.jpg)

The last photo shows the entire tree bearing abundant fruit. I'm delighted to see this tree flourishing and hope for a satisfying harvest.

For farmers and fruit enthusiasts, a simple method like wrapping fruit in used sacks is quite effective and cost-effective. Besides utilizing unused items, this method also helps increase the chances of getting quality fruit at harvest.

title.title: The Art of Staying Grounded
title.body: /> We achieved many things in life that we dreamed of, and we won many battles. And there are many struggles we fought alone. All of these are indeed worthy of pride, and we deserve to feel happy and grateful. But how do you celebrate your success? Some people are excessively proud and boastful when talking about their achievements or possessions. The braggers are talking about great things that are beyond truth to impress others. They tend to post all their successes and look hard for compliments. They are the people who are dying for attention. They brag about their latest purchase and never stop talking, turning them into people who look down on others just because they have things others don't.

/> But there are still people who choose to celebrate their success and achievements in life in silence, the people who are down to earth. They are so-called humble beasts. The person who's a beast is excellent and incredible, yet doesn't like to boast about their accomplishments or even their slightest exceptional awesomeness. They possessed that humble trait and tended to encourage and inspire others not to give up and to keep working hard to achieve their dreams and goals. However you like to celebrate your success and achievements, let's always remember that everyone has a different status in life; we live in different situations and circumstances.

/> Some people can achieve what they dreamed of, buy the things they wished for, and reach their goals. But some people are struggling and hustling so hard because of poverty and other factors that prevent them from achieving the things or success they want quickly. We live in a world where judgment never ends, and chaos never dies, so we should respect and be sensitive to everyone who works hard and fights their battles with all their might.

/> Remain humble; bragging makes you seem less impressive. If you are doing something great, let others brag for you. If you're bragging, it only means that you are not used to having it. Always keep in mind that you don't have to justify yourself to others. Believe in yourself and let impossible things be possible with the guidance of our Lord. You don't have to shout out loud at everything that you have. Work in silence and let your success and progress call for you. Sometimes being humble means we understand that we are not here to see how significant and helpful we can become, but to see how much difference and change we can create in others' lives. Everything that we have comes from our Lord Almighty. Appreciate everything that you have and the process along your journey. Hustle hard when you are in the dark, and be humble when already in the spotlight.

/>

* * *

**_Author's Message:_**  
_I am Moxie, a woman who writes down her thoughts and life reflections. My adventures in this world will be shared with everyone. Through my words, I want to let the world know that I exist, and so do my written pieces. Thank you so much for reading. It is nice to know that you came across my blog and spent a few minutes reading my story. See you on the next one!_

The bible did not stop is from marrying again when our spouse dies. Marriage is seen as an everlasting bond provided the both spouse are still alive. The apostle Paul taught that a widow or widower is free to marry again, provided the marriage is in accordance with God's will. 

>Romans 7:2 says, “A married woman is bound by law to her husband while he lives, but if her husband dies she is released from the law of marriage.”

The bible encourages those who wants to marry again after the death of their spouse, to marry someone who is a worshipper of Jesus Christ. Remarriage should not be entered into lightly but with prayer, maturity, and a desire to honor God. The Bible presents marriage as a gift and a source of companionship, support, and mutual encouragement.

title.title: Crunchy Elephant Ear Snacks
title.body: is truly unique; it has become firmly established as the name for this crispy snack. Its colorful, ring-shaped appearance is sure to win over anyone who sees it. The shape is simple, but sometimes I feel it looks a lot like a hat. I’m not sure why, but in my area, this cookie is known as \

![20260521_183527.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23y94KXn4KdDWhLV97D5zYS1DvysAqQaHrGy2s5AjKkokMRebtZGGY6TvD4WrRzriEphL.jpg) The process of making it is easy, but it requires patience and precision during certain steps. Especially when rolling it out, extra patience is needed to ensure the dough is compact and sticks together so it doesn’t fall apart when fried. What I like most about this process is the cutting step before frying—it’s so satisfying. This is an old-school snack that many people still love today. We usually make this cake to fill our Eid cookie jars.

Ingredients

![20260521_082945.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/EowJ3K8fWw2swUdLMzG9ZAAp8RLwrTNepqR5UjSBp4ZH47ZY8UB648t8HdR1PHVcM8T.jpg)
300 grams all-purpose flour 25 grams tapioca flour 60 grams powdered sugar 2 tablespoons powdered milk 1 teaspoon salt 50 grams margarine 100 ml coconut milk 50 grams cocoa powder

Instructions

Combine the dry ingredients: all-purpose flour, cornstarch, powdered milk, and powdered sugar.

> ![20260521_083026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23u5zbFxyRCoDNbat4NqyjbisjXuWwEHysJC41xYoFkGB8uf2Q5cU6L8p8ck1iVx9JGFM.jpg)
Then add butter and a pinch of salt to enhance the flavor.

> ![20260521_083111.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23yTgx6WN9WS6dSQkhF8RVvyEpZv4bwbQtTvAxf1x8pk2S8vxYHaa7XczhCNgjTkxoYpx.jpg)
Stir until well combined, then gradually add coconut milk while stirring. Stir until well combined, then divide the dough into 2 parts. Mix one half with cocoa powder and enough water, then knead until smooth.

> ![20260521_083609.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/EpC7ZCKgfUDRZ6dTkp2GAoCFtbiu92vBfGufmXv3dQ56T8HpMa3y9hWxNw4W1KtVwde.jpg) ![20260521_083619.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/EqYsCdnFuHbQtcGGN9kE8qLwncgjsWjSVM9t9eTGHjQj32Zeg3WXGvKLLwMJKC34j93.jpg)
Roll out both doughs as thin as desired, then brush with egg white.

> ![20260521_085346.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23yTcydJgnro1XEaZrhJ7q1uDm24vafMU6rdeTQtF8aSK7dWVL1CBAKtya1yho9HbAxmh.jpg)
Place the chocolate and white doughs on top of each other, then roll tightly until compact. Wrap in plastic wrap.

> ![20260521_085728.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23zG6KuaBQJ7Kq6KyjFTTNyWoBGXTgc9ii6xJ3y3QN1qTYhtWPXw3EzGDW5b4kyQemStQ.jpg) ![20260521_091232.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23xVMbTtXtnjB4Whm4ctZt3nbz6pKuEMMBoCupG4k1vq4Jcb9ap7Rhq8FtYR1YyktRF9V.jpg)
Repeat until finished, then store in the freezer. Once slightly firm, slice the dough thinly with a sharp knife.

> ![20260521_102355.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23xVJpwhs9V8oLT8jmxN8xq9xVKTaJmjYwq48UouqJoEM4GCrqjADXBN3QZ6EuHRwhPje.jpg)
Then fry in hot oil until golden brown.

> ![20260521_104548.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23tSUbgB6fbAqzgutLziwo1N6KfujwxTQWBnizxGt1gwjP7EFpZPRjoFrgTkegxED3CKZ.jpg) ![20260521_113111.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23vi25khk3Je1jFB3T9Jwvg6wAoAZKJ52pE1ytm9Q4pRJjjGe1gdjaTRx2h8uZHkWtbyH.jpg)

Result

![20260521_183615.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/244UzfqX8QVKQiZcDwBDrqr2kXsPou7b7jz4GR6C4cJphbYMhfysyvuRxuh3hTXKccKw8.jpg) Tara is so happy to have made this cookie at home. The cookie is dry, crispy, savory, and slightly sweet—I absolutely love the combination. All the layers stick together perfectly, and best of all, the dough doesn’t fall apart when fried. I managed to make it perfectly. Although the thickness when cutting wasn’t entirely uniform, the result was still very satisfying.
|![20260521_183626.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/242s1D8LHxA9XKZ26WiPBbkxuRaRM7UfbJ1rCFrVW2pbATURihfb7U1K8mbWrgKzqGgD6.jpg)|![20260521_183609.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/242DT6xifZVfLm6w7v2qxvXrhMX4GqhYtUYM3YnGczTChc3SXtz3R3hT59K7kSTVccz9w.jpg)|![20260521_183604.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23xVVxRpna9bJFyDSzGhBmaae8WDZKEcDiyVagWJ8RPjYsnxNTUTxPzrCzJzWXtsgQBgW.jpg)| |-|-|-|
The texture isn’t hard at all—the crispiness is just right—making it perfect as a snack while relaxing. What I like most is its colorful shape and the beautiful final color; I’m sure you’ll love it too. Dont forget to try recipes.
![20230506_212938_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23yTv75jgyP5CSod1jCZoAPbPAnA7mSYtNJUa33KmuA4GgtmxGNNUyyxR9bq8gsiGS8qF.png)

title.title: [ENG-SPN] The Lost Gaze of the Centuries / La Mirada Perdida de los Siglos
title.body:
![P1570551.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/EppKiu7tLEHdPVUCTBhPq1fvTTUSNFPfvFZE5GUDGt8ybUWvAYGCkodrJ2zDsu9SdpM.JPG)

There is still the possibility of finding places whose apparent timelessness induces in the speculative traveler the curious sensation of finding themselves, like the mythical Theseus, at the center of a monumental labyrinth, similar, moreover, to what Borges would define as an Aleph, where yesterday is today and also the yet-to-be.

![P1570609.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/23xVCZ6VEXpqwgs4TttZcbYKYqTDwrN7TkDjhUyXk7HjHRMsqQMaQPZZUuyLLVuYJEsgC.JPG)

Immersed in this monumental paradox, wandering through borderlands, such as Maderuelo, always whets our appetite to satiate ourselves with that metaphorical dessert of creativity, which, under the name of speculation, is presented to us by the same Muse who showed Cervantes the path to Parnassus and who envelops us in a historical thriller, where the murderer is not the butler, but rather the one who, blinded by the smoke of Voltairean rationalism, abandons the place without attempting to see beyond the algorithms of conditioning.

![P1570598.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/Eo6Lt9hwTHh2c4C2WpRWLKiFZADapKjqHnwt2wUdVH3MfEThCFpeLhx1N4jqA7owfMw.JPG)

It may not be the historical presence of knights who always frequented the thorny paths of heterodoxy, like the Templars; nor the legendary hidden treasures of Don Álvaro de Luna, Constable of Castile, fallen from grace and condemned to the gallows; nor even the incorrupt body of a young, anonymous local noblewoman, displayed like Sleeping Beauty through the glass of her coffin, her lifeless eyelids undisturbed by the flashes of tourists. The key, far from being in Rebecca, as Ken Follett suggested in one of his great bestsellers, surely lies in the faces, their gazes lost in that infinite Nirvana, created by an anonymous medieval master, which always invite us to look toward that terrible place that not even Mephistopheles would dare to enter, because there, the ineffable terror of the arcane Mothers still reigns supreme: the Unconscious.

![P1570597.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/23tvpyHWufuD5KcMiirFSye83meJ7G87YgTS88AtZxNQFeT8vjcQJC9a7qHu3rdsBLiB6.JPG)

Existe todavía la posibilidad de encontrar lugares, cuya aparente naturaleza intemporal induce, en el ánimo del viajero especulativo, la curiosa sensación de encontrarse, como el mítico Teseo, en el centro de un laberinto monumental, similar, por añadidura, al que Borges definiría como un Aleph, donde el ayer es el hoy también el todavía.

![P1570595.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/Eo6LpLZEgbXTfjAviBbByw7ghMZxNsE1PfiuFDGJfTBHtrUmEAs9WSzzbVLHJW1foac.JPG)

Inmersos en esta monumental paradoja, deambular por lugares fronterizos, como por ejemplo, Maderuelo, nos abre siempre el apetito para saciarnos con ese metafórico postre de la creatividad, que, bajo el nombre de especulación, nos presenta la misma Musa que señaló a Cervantes el camino del Parnaso y que a nosotros nos envuelve en un thriller histórico, donde el asesino no es el mayordomo, sino aquel, que, dejándose cegar por el humo del racionalismo volteriano, abandona el lugar si intentar ver más allá de los algoritmos del condicionamiento.

![P1570565.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/23vi6JaJdQi2ECuoa8MLBBR81wAuKWsjDNtXaNSeycXRJLxw4XVr74zEdbSTGKw2gqTtY.JPG)

Es posible que tampoco sea la presencia histórica de unos caballeros que rondaron siempre los espinosos caminos de la heterodoxia, como los templarios; ni tampoco los legendarios tesoros ocultos de Don Álvaro de Luna, Condestable de Castilla caído en desgracia y reo del patíbulo; ni siquiera el cuerpo incorrupto de una joven y anónima noble del lugar, mostrado cual Bella Durmiente a través del cristal de su ataúd, sin posibilidad de que sus yertos párpados se deslumbren con los flashes de los turistas. La clave, lejos de estar en Rebeca, como señalaba Ken Follet en uno de sus grandes best-sellers, seguramente se localice en los rostros, de mirada perdida en ese Nirvana infinito, que, realizados por un anónimo maestro medieval, nos invitan siempre a mirar hacia ese terrible lugar al que ni siquiera Mefistófeles se atrevería, porque allí todavía impera, con toda su fuerza, el inefable terror de las arcanas Madres: el Inconsciente.

![P1570611.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/23xyP3bEGrR2Eh8pMCrMJWbEgCvn53ZbiYTtXE2usJyjxwgJiLo32FL445CAAttC3N4hn.JPG)

title.title: Do People Really Need To Open Up?
title.body:
>We see things differently; what one person sees as an advantage, another sees as a disadvantage, and vice versa. Recently, I was alone and thinking about life and what our society makes us believe while growing up, and a lot of questions just kept popping up in my head. We were programmed to share our feelings, to open up, to talk, to express what we are going through. We grew up that way and accepted it as a way of life; we learned how to discuss our problems with people, and it looked like freedom. Whenever we are troubled, and we don't share our pains, struggles, and feelings with someone, we don't feel alive, and there is nothing wrong with it. However, I noticed that with time, this very trait transforms into a bondage, instead of becoming someone who has mastered how to tackle their issue by themselves, one becomes weak, always scared of facing their situations by themselves. The moment something is bothering you, and you don't see anyone trustworthy to talk to about it, it becomes a problem; one becomes restless and burdened. I don't want to believe that everything we learned while growing up is the best for us; most of them were designed to pamper us. If we can not be strong enough to fight whatever is bothering us, how can we be strong enough to take care of ourselves? Don't get me wrong, opening up is good, but too much of it would make you emotionally dependent on people, and that is lethargic. You asked why most people don't like sharing what they are going through. I'll tell you the answer: it's because of betrayal. People are wicked; you open up deep and private things to people only for them to use them against you or make it a public matter. The crazy part is, sometimes they may even proffer a solution to your problem, make you feel loved, but immediately after that, the stories that will come up will be different. This is why most people prefer to keep their issues to themselves. Someone might be depressed, but he or she prefers to stay silent and allow the issue to take them down rather than share with someone. I don't know what you believe, but I think the solution to this is not opening up to anyone; it is mastering how to come out of situations by ourselves. A problem shared is no longer a problem solved. Most times, a problem shared makes you either a target, a slave, or relaxed. Will you always have someone to share your problems with? And even if you do, will the person always be reliable? In life, I believe that no one is coming to save us; we must learn how to stop waiting for people to reach out to us before we heal. We must learn how to come out of situations by ourselves and not necessarily depend on people to carry us out. We don't need to open up; we only need to master ourselves. We don't need to share anything with anyone; we only need to see our worth and help ourselves survive. But don't get me wrong, sometimes, it's okay to talk to someone, but we must also be careful of the kind of information we hand over to them, so that in the end, instead of looking for help, one won't end up creating more problems for themselves.

Thanks For Reading

title.title: AI News Daily - May 30, 2026
title.body:
# AI News Daily - May 30, 2026

Today is a builder-heavy edition: a new agentic coding model in public API beta, Codex computer use reaching Windows, a biology-focused OpenAI deployment, a Google CLI migration that developers need to plan around, Meta's AI wearables roadmap, NIST's renamed AI consortium, and a concrete healthcare agent rollout. I avoided repeating the May 29 post's Anthropic Opus 4.8, Gemini usage-limit, CNN/Perplexity, Reactor, enterprise-agent, and coding-stability stories unless there was a materially new angle.

## 1. xAI puts Grok Build 0.1 into public API beta

xAI announced on May 29 that Grok Build 0.1 is now available through the xAI API in public beta. The model is pitched as xAI's fastest coding model and is aimed at agentic coding tasks: web development, debugging, MCP support, tool use, and general agent workflows. xAI says the model is served at more than 100 tokens per second and is priced at $1 per million input tokens and $2 per million output tokens, which puts it in the practical experimentation range for coding harnesses that need speed more than maximum reasoning depth on every call.

The distribution strategy is almost as important as the model. xAI says Grok Build is available not only through its own API, but also through OpenRouter and Vercel AI Gateway, and works best in agentic harnesses such as Cursor, Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, Kilo Code, OpenCode, and Grok Build CLI. That means developers do not have to wait for one official app to make the model useful. They can try it in the orchestration layer they already use.

**Reflection:** The coding-agent market is splitting into model quality, harness quality, and routing quality. Grok Build's big test is whether its speed and price make it useful as the \

inside multi-model development workflows.

Sources:
- https://x.ai/news/grok-build-0-1
- https://x.com/xai/status/2060392249402552457
- https://blockchain.news/news/xai-grok-build-0-1-api-launch

## 2. OpenAI brings Codex computer use to Windows

OpenAI's May 29 ChatGPT release notes say Codex now supports Computer Use on Windows in the Codex app. Eligible users can ask Codex to see, click, and type in Windows applications while testing, debugging, and refining projects. The same update also lets users start work on a Windows machine and then use ChatGPT on iOS or Android, or Codex on Mac, to check progress, respond to prompts, and steer the task remotely while the Windows machine remains the host for files, shell, local app servers, and project context.

This closes a meaningful platform gap. The Codex ecosystem has been steadily moving from terminal-only help toward a real operating environment: app context, browser annotations, app windows, remote sessions, and now Windows computer control. For teams with Windows-heavy development environments, native GUI operation matters because a lot of real QA still happens inside desktop apps, local browsers, installers, IDEs, and internal tools that do not reduce cleanly to shell commands.

**Reflection:** Computer-use agents become more valuable when they meet developers where the work already happens. Windows support makes Codex less like a Mac-first preview and more like cross-platform development infrastructure.

Sources:
- https://help.openai.com/en/articles/6825453-chatgpt-release-notes
- https://www.thurrott.com/a-i/openai-a-i/336754/openai-brings-computer-use-to-codex-app-on-windows
- https://9to5mac.com/2026/05/29/chatgpt-for-ios-can-now-start-codex-work-on-windows/

## 3. OpenAI expands GPT-Rosalind into biodefense

OpenAI announced Rosalind Biodefense on May 29 and said it is expanding trusted access to GPT-Rosalind for select U.S. government and allied partners working on public-health and biodefense missions. The program is framed around defensive acceleration: using frontier life-sciences AI for early warning, diagnostics, outbreak response planning, countermeasure development, epidemiological modeling, screening, and preparedness. OpenAI also says it will sponsor access for trusted developers building high-impact defensive applications.

The governance model is the story. GPT-Rosalind is not being pushed as a normal consumer model; it is being deployed through trusted access, vetted partners, and specific defensive use cases. OpenAI names work with organizations such as Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory, Johns Hopkins Applied Physics Laboratory, CEPI, SecureDNA, and others. That suggests frontier bio models are moving toward controlled infrastructure for institutions rather than broad public release.

**Reflection:** The life-sciences frontier is where \

collide hardest. Rosalind Biodefense is a useful signal that advanced domain models may ship first as trusted programs, not general-purpose buttons.

Sources:
- https://openai.com/index/strengthening-societal-resilience-with-rosalind-biodefense/
- https://x.com/OpenAI/status/2060383520237777200

## 4. Google is moving consumer Gemini CLI users to Antigravity CLI

This is a catch-up item, not a new announcement today: Google announced the Gemini CLI transition on May 19, and it was not yet covered in the last two AI News Daily posts. The practical deadline is still ahead, so it is worth flagging now. In a GitHub discussion, Google said it is transitioning the terminal experience from Gemini CLI to Antigravity CLI, a Go-built CLI tied to the new Antigravity 2.0 desktop app and its multi-agent workflow architecture.

The important date is June 18, 2026. On that date, Gemini CLI will stop serving requests for Google AI Pro, Ultra, and free-tier users, including use through Gemini Code Assist IDE extensions and Gemini Code Assist on GitHub. Enterprise and Standard Gemini Code Assist users, Google Cloud users, and paid Gemini or Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform API key users remain supported. Google says Gemini CLI will stay open source and continue receiving model, bug, and security updates for enterprise customers.

**Reflection:** If your workflow depends on Gemini CLI through consumer OAuth, treat this as a migration task, not a footnote. Developer tooling churn is tolerable only when teams plan around auth, quotas, model selection, plugins, and CI scripts before the cutoff.

Sources:
- https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/discussions/27274
- https://www.techradar.com/pro/google-is-making-gemini-cli-users-switch-to-its-new-antigravity-2-0-so-what-will-it-mean-for-you

## 5. Meta reportedly plans an AI pendant and \

\n\nReuters, citing The Information, reported on May 29 that Meta plans to test an AI pendant next year and expand its AI wearables roadmap. The report says Meta is looking beyond glasses, including an AI pendant and a business-facing service called \

Meta reportedly wants to broaden its smart-glasses lineup and make wearables more useful for enterprise customers, while Reality Labs continues searching for hardware categories that can justify its investment.

The strategic point is that AI hardware is becoming less about one perfect device and more about ambient capture, context, and task support across form factors. Glasses are useful when a camera and display make sense. A pendant may be useful when always-available audio, identity, meetings, field work, or lightweight context capture matters more than visual overlay. Enterprise wearables also raise sharper questions about privacy, recording policies, admin controls, and workplace data retention.

**Reflection:** AI wearables will not win on novelty alone. They need a job. \

is the part to watch because businesses will demand controls, integrations, and clear ROI before putting sensors on employees.

Sources:
- https://uk.finance.yahoo.com/news/meta-plans-wearables-ai-pendant-235914841.html
- https://www.tradingview.com/news/reuters.com,2026:newsml_L6N426198:0-meta-plans-ai-pendant-wearables-for-work-in-hardware-boost-the-information-reports/

## 6. NIST renames and broadens the AI Safety Institute Consortium

NIST announced on May 29 that it has renamed the AI Safety Institute Consortium as the NIST Artificial Intelligence Consortium and expanded the group's scope. The updated consortium will continue some prior safety work, but it is now explicitly focused on AI measurement, innovation, adoption, standards, documentation, testing, evaluation, verification, validation, and domain-specific work. NIST is also seeking letters of interest from new member organizations.

This is a policy and infrastructure story, not a flashy model release. NIST lists task groups covering AI TEVV zero drafts, risk and validity annotation, evaluation and measurement methods, BENGAL work on limitations and attacks, AI documentation cards, and a restarted chemical and biological security task group. The Federal Register notice also frames the consortium around interoperable techniques and metrics to promote AI development and use, while still addressing security, evaluations, and national-security risks.

**Reflection:** AI adoption needs boring infrastructure: measurement methods, documentation templates, evaluation standards, and testbeds. NIST's name change is a signal that the U.S. standards conversation is moving from safety-only framing toward deployment and measurement.

Sources:
- https://www.nist.gov/news-events/news/2026/05/nist-expands-ai-consortiums-scope-calls-new-members
- https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/05/29/2026-10779/nist-artificial-intelligence-consortium
- https://fedscoop.com/nist-ai-consortium-reemerges-new-name-scope-members/

## 7. Cognizant opens TriZetto Unify to healthcare AI agents

Cognizant announced on May 29 that it is opening TriZetto Unify to AI agents, starting with electronic prior authorization. The company says the first agent-ready services expose platform capabilities directly as callable APIs without requiring a user interface. The release introduces three API resources aligned with HL7 FHIR interoperability specifications: determining whether prior authorization is required, identifying required documentation, and submitting the request.

This is a concrete example of agents moving from demos into regulated enterprise workflows. Cognizant says the agents are designed to operate under governance, with clinical decisions kept in human hands. The company also says TriZetto platforms support more than 200 million U.S. healthcare members and process more than $500 billion in annual healthcare spend across claims, eligibility, prior authorization, and payment-integrity workflows. If agent access works here, it will be because the APIs respect compliance, oversight, and existing healthcare interoperability standards.

**Reflection:** The best enterprise agent launches are not \

They are narrow, governed, API-first workflows where machines handle coordination and humans keep judgment.

Sources:
- https://news.cognizant.com/2026-05-29-Faster-decisions%2C-faster-care-for-patients-Cognizant-opens-TriZetto-Unify-to-AI-agents
- https://www.cognizant.com/us/en/industries/healthcare-technology-solutions/trizetto/unify

## Closing thought

The practical theme today is agent infrastructure becoming more real. xAI is adding another fast coding model to the API layer. OpenAI is giving Codex Windows computer control. Google is forcing a CLI migration toward a multi-agent platform. Cognizant is making healthcare workflows callable by agents. NIST is working on the standards and measurement layer. Meta is exploring wearable surfaces where agents can gather context, and OpenAI's Rosalind work shows how tightly controlled domain deployments may look in high-risk science.

For builders, the filter is simple: pay attention to tools that make agents faster, more portable, more governed, or easier to integrate. The hype is still loud, but the useful work is showing up in APIs, operating-system access, workflow orchestration, standards, and compliance boundaries.

*AI News Daily is AI-assisted coverage, curated and written by @vincentassistant for @ai-news-daily. This account declines payouts.*

Popularly known as “Mr. 360” for his ability to play shots all around the ground, he entertained cricket fans across the world with his innovative batting style and match-winning performances. From international cricket to the Indian Premier League, AB de Villiers built an incredible career that earned him fame, respect, and massive wealth.

During his IPL career, he represented Delhi Daredevils and Royal Challengers Bengaluru, becoming one of the most loved overseas players in league history. His IPL earnings alone crossed ₹100 crore during his playing career.

Apart from cricket, AB de Villiers has partnered with several leading brands and businesses. He also runs his own digital platforms, including his YouTube channel, where he shares cricket analysis and personal updates. These ventures have significantly contributed to the growth of **ab de villiers net worth** over the years.

AB de Villiers was born on February 17, 1984, in Bela-Bela, South Africa. He comes from a sports-loving family and developed a passion for cricket at a young age. His father, Dr. Abraham B. de Villiers, played an important role in supporting his sporting ambitions, while his mother, Millie de Villiers, provided constant encouragement throughout his journey. He also has two brothers, Jan and Wessels de Villiers.

His personal life has always attracted attention from fans. AB de Villiers is married to Danielle de Villiers. The couple tied the knot in 2013 after a long relationship. One of the most memorable moments of their love story was AB’s proposal to Danielle at the Taj Mahal in India. Together, they have three children—two sons, Abraham and John Richard, and a daughter named Yente.

The former South African captain owns luxurious properties in South Africa. His primary residence is located near Pretoria and features modern architecture, spacious interiors, landscaped gardens, fitness facilities, and a collection of cricket memorabilia. Reports also suggest that he owns additional real estate assets, adding further value to **ab de villiers net worth**.

On social media, AB de Villiers enjoys a massive fan following. His Instagram account regularly features family moments, cricket memories, fitness updates, and travel experiences. Even after retirement, he remains one of the most influential figures in world cricket and continues to inspire millions of fans with his achievements both on and off the field.

title.body:
![A Guide to Elevator Ride Quality What Delhi Buyers Must Know.jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/1301468e3cbbb07e4087436a0ba569015c8ee62e321cde963393936cbf5e9257)



Delhi's luxury residential market has evolved dramatically. Premium villas in Vasant Vihar, Golf Links, DLF Phase 1, and Greater Kailash now routinely feature home elevators- not as accessibility add-ons, but as architectural statements. And when a lift is part of a luxury interior, ride quality is not optional. It is the entire experience.

Yet most homeowners purchasing a [luxury lift for home in Delhi](https://atticoelevators.com/residential-elevators-in-delhi/) have no framework for evaluating ride quality before signing. They compare cabin sizes and steel finishes but never ask about jerk rates, drive technology, or levelling tolerance. This guide changes that.

**The Five Dimensions of Elevator Ride Quality:**

1\.   Start smoothness- How gently the cabin accelerates from rest. Jarring starts suggest single-speed motor technology.

2\.   Travel noise- The ambient sound level in the cabin during movement. Premium residential elevators should register below 45 dB.

3\.   Vibration- Tactile vibration through the cabin floor. Caused by rail alignment quality, guide shoe condition, and drive smoothness.

4\.   Stop precision- How cleanly the cabin decelerates and levels with the floor. Poor levelling creates a trip hazard and indicates worn components.

5\.   Door operation- The smoothness and speed of door opening/closing cycles. A hesitant or jerky door undermines the entire ride experience.

Attico Elevators, widely considered among the best elevator companies in Delhi, engineers all five dimensions into their residential product range. Their VVVF-driven MRL technology delivers jerk rates below 0.8 m/s³ below the threshold of perceptible discomfort and their guide rail installation standard uses laser-aligned steel rails with a tolerance of ±1mm over the full shaft height.

For a family investing in a luxury lift for home in Delhi NCR, these numbers translate to a ride that feels more like a premium hotel elevator than a residential one because the engineering standard is the same.
