title.title: Student Success in Modern Higher Education: Balancing Health, Performance, and Technical Learning
title.body:
## Introduction

Today’s academic environment demands far more than memorizing theories or submitting essays on time. Students are expected to communicate clearly, lead confidently, and adapt their writing styles across different academic levels. Whether it is managing public speaking anxiety, balancing coursework pressure, or transitioning from undergraduate writing to MBA-level expectations, success now depends on a blend of communication, critical thinking, and adaptability.

This article explores how students can navigate these evolving demands while strengthening both written and visual communication skills.

***

## Student Leadership and Public Speaking in Academic Life

Leadership roles in academic settings often require students to step outside their comfort zones, especially when it comes to public speaking. From presentations and group discussions to formal events, communication anxiety is a common challenge among student leaders.

Developing confidence in speaking does not happen overnight—it involves practice, structured preparation, and gradual exposure to speaking environments. Many student leaders also struggle with balancing these responsibilities alongside heavy coursework, making time management a critical skill.

For a deeper understanding of how student leaders manage communication stress while handling academic pressure, this resource provides valuable insights into practical strategies and real experiences:

[How Student Leaders Navigate Public Speaking Anxiety and Heavy Coursework](https://celebrityintro.co.uk/how-student-leaders-navigate-public-speaking-anxiety-and-heavy-coursework/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Key approaches often highlighted include:

*
    Practicing structured speech outlines before delivery


*
    Using small-group discussions to build confidence


*
    Breaking coursework into manageable study blocks


*
    Developing mindfulness techniques to reduce anxiety


Together, these strategies help students become more effective communicators while maintaining academic balance.

***

## The Shift in Academic Writing: From Undergraduate to MBA Level

One of the most noticeable transitions in higher education occurs when students move from undergraduate studies to postgraduate programs such as an MBA. The expectation for writing quality changes significantly—not just in terms of grammar or structure, but in analytical depth, argument clarity, and strategic thinking.

Undergraduate writing often focuses on explaining concepts and demonstrating understanding. In contrast, MBA-level writing requires:

*
    Critical evaluation of real-world business scenarios


*
    Evidence-based decision-making


*
    Concise yet powerful argumentation


*
    Integration of data, theory, and professional insight


Students who fail to adapt to this shift often struggle with clarity and academic performance.

A detailed exploration of how writing evolves at higher academic levels is discussed here:

[Beyond the Essay: Why Today's Classrooms Demand Both Written Rigor and Visual Literacy](https://worldrisemag.com/shift-your-writing-style-from-undergraduate-to-mba-level/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

This transition highlights an important truth: academic writing is no longer just about essays—it is about communicating ideas like a professional.

***

## The Expanding Role of Visual Literacy in Education

Modern classrooms are not limited to text-based communication. Visual literacy—the ability to interpret, analyze, and create visual content—has become an essential academic skill.

Students are now expected to work with:

*
    Infographics and data visualizations


*
    Presentation slides with strong visual storytelling


*
    Charts, diagrams, and multimedia content


*
    Digital learning platforms and interactive tools


This shift reflects the real-world demand for professionals who can communicate ideas not only through words but also through visuals. Employers increasingly value candidates who can simplify complex information using visual formats.

The integration of written and visual communication helps students develop:

*
    Stronger analytical thinking


*
    Better audience engagement


*
    Improved information retention


*
    More persuasive communication skills


***

## Balancing Coursework, Communication, and Skill Development

As academic expectations grow, students often face the challenge of balancing multiple priorities. Coursework, presentations, group projects, and skill development all compete for time and attention.

To manage this effectively, students can adopt a structured approach:

*
    Prioritize tasks based on deadlines and complexity


*
    Use planning tools or digital calendars


*
    Break large assignments into smaller milestones


*
    Allocate time for skill-building activities like writing and speaking practice


Consistency is more effective than last-minute effort. Students who gradually build communication and writing skills tend to perform better across all academic areas.

***

## Conclusion

Success in modern education is no longer defined by academic knowledge alone. It depends on how effectively students communicate, adapt their writing style, and manage academic pressure. From developing confidence in public speaking to mastering MBA-level writing and embracing visual literacy, these skills collectively shape academic and professional success.

title.title: 쇠소깍 산책길
title.body: 2년전 제주에 처음 왔을 때, 저희 가족은 주말마다 제주 곳곳을 찾아다녔습니다. 여행으로 제주에 왔을 땐 관광지로 유명한 곳을 찾아다녔고, 제주에 살게 되고 나서는 관광지를 가도 다음 코스를 생각하는 것이 아닌 한곳에 오래 있으면서 관광으로 왔을 때 보지 못했던 것을 좀 자세히 보게 되었습니다. 그리고 아주 유명하지는 않지만 그래도 여기 좋다더라하는 여행으로 왔을 때 2순위, 3순위로 생각해두었던 곳들도 찾는 여유가 생긴 것 같습니다. 제주에 온 첫해, 여행으로는 자주 왔었지만 못 가봤던 쇠소깍을 더운 여름날 가족들과 갔었습니다. 아직은 관광객 모드였던 때여서 테우라 불리는 나룻배를 타고 쇠소깍 계곡을 경험했었습니다. 당시 날씨가 너무 덥고 습했던 터라 계곡이긴 했지만 시원함보다는 빨리 시원한 카페를 가고 싶은 마음이 간절했었습니다. ㅎ 배를 타고 쇠소깍 계곡 물길을 거슬러 오르고 내리면서 계곡도 좋치만 계곡 주위의 산책코스가 참 좋다라는 얘기를 들었었으나 그땐 그럴 마음의 육신의 여유가 없기도 했었습니다. 최근에 소금막 검은모래해변을 다녀오면서 쇠소깍 산책길을 걸어보기로 했습니다. 산책코스 시작 지점에서 바라 본 쇠소깍 선착장의 모습입니다.
/>계곡쪽을 바라보면 영락없이 강원도 계곡입니다. ㅎ\n\n
/>이 계곡 옆으로 나무데크길이 이어져 있고 중간중간 경치 좋은 곳은 전망대도 있습니다.\n\n
/>조금 여유롭게 전망대 하나하나 모두 내려가보았습니다.\n\n
/> 전망대에서 바라본 계곡물은 푸른 에메랄드빛이 났습니다.
/>배에서 보던 계곡과는 또 다른 매력이 있어 보였습니다.\n\n
/>이 계곡물이 시작되는 곳은 물이 아주 졸졸졸 흐르고 있었습니다.\n\n
/> 아주 말라버린 계곡은 아니었지만 하류에 비해서 물의 양이 아주 줄어 있었구요.
/> 이정도 오니 쇠소깍이라기 보다는 제주에서 종종 보이는 마른계곡처럼 보였습니다. 쇠소깍 계곡이 효돈천의 일부라는 것도 알았습니다.
/>올레길 말고 각지역에서 만든 스탬프 투어 길들이 있는데 여기는 E멍길이 있네요.\n\n
/>이젠 다리를 건너서 반대길로 쇠소깍을 구경해 봅니다.\n\n
/> 여름이 다가와서 그런지 곳곳에 넝쿨들도 많고 나무의 가지치기 작업이 한창이었습니다. 산책길 시작점에서 선착장을 봤다면 이곳은 산책길 끝에서 바라본 쇠소깍 선착장입니다.
/> 길은 끝났지만 풀들을 헤치면서 더 나아가 봅니다. 건너편으로 소금막 검은모래해변도 보입니다.
/> 더 이상 가기엔 풀들이 너무 많이 자라 있어서 딱 여기까지만 갔습니다.

/>

너무 덥지 않다면 이렇게 쇠소깍 주변으로 산책길을 걸어보는 것도 좋을 것 같습니다.  
천천히 구경하면서 걸으니 왕복 1시간쯤 걸렸습니다.

title.title: Ollies Christening Today
title.body:
Today is the big day for Ollie. We have had this planned for over a month, and over the last number of weeks, we have chipped away at preparing ourselves.

We bought his outfit for him a couple of weeks ago, and he looks so smart and grown-up in it. 

****

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUKSBV8sy5sopoVpAY384YUpPeeWWzu11Hhton2snj5D1/image.png)

[Source](https://www.google.com/imgres?q=christening&imgurl=https%3A%2F%2Fm.media-amazon.com%2Fimages%2FI%2F714s3NUyMqL.jpg&imgrefurl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.amazon.ie%2FSursurprise-Christening-Decorations-Communion-Confirmation%2Fdp%2FB0BMXGQM4W&docid=IYP6TU1xCuCdXM&tbnid=Xc76zNJLaXsdMM&vet=12ahUKEwjCwNW21uCUAxVOQEEAHWRdBtUQnPAOegQIZBAB..i&w=1600&h=1600&hcb=2&ved=2ahUKEwjCwNW21uCUAxVOQEEAHWRdBtUQnPAOegQIZBAB)

**Double Christening**

Aimee's brother and his partner's child is also getting christened today, so we decided to go splits on renting a venue and doing the food/ preparing it.

Aimee and I were asked to be godparents to their son, too, so we'll go up with Ollie, and then hand him off to his godparents, so we can go up with Sonny.

When we organised Kalebs Christening it was so much stress that we didn't really get a chance to enjoy the day until it was all over. So, being able to share the burden of planning the party has been great.

All of the kids are going to be there, our kids, Aimee's Nephews, and my nieces, as well as cousins, so I think they are all going to really enjoy the day.

****

**Prep**

Aimee's dad made a couple of lemon cakes (which are amazing) he also made a few platters of sausage rolls. My dad is making sandwiches, and Aimee's brother is doing sandwhiches too. 

We also booked a few platters of food from the pub, and we bought some nibbles, like crisps and sweets.

One of our neighbours made us a balloon arch, which was really nice of them and looks great, and we bought a few banners and bits and pieces like that, which we put up.

We were going to hire a kids' entertainer, like we did for Kaleb's Christening, but couldn't really find anyone.

****

**A Big Get Together**

There are about 90 people invited, but some can't make it, so we're thinking about 60 or so will be here today. 

It is going to be a lot of fun seeing everyone, especially friends and family who we don't see regularly. 

These days, it's hard to get out and meet up with people, so events like this, where everyone is out together, are a great way of having some overdue catch-ups. 

Our friend Luke from Norwich is over for it too, and he'll be here until Tuesday, so we'll be able to spend a nice amount of time with him.

title.body:
<center>

My first console was the Atari 2600, way before most on here were not even a twinkle in a parent's eye.

Back in the day I had to purchase it on credit, a couple of hundred quid back then doesn't seem much, but it equates now to well over £1k. Thought I was the bees knees, and I guess I was.

\

. How wrong can one be!

Progression to the Sega Master System, the Mega Drive, a brief flirtation with floppy disc driven commodore amiga sytem , fell in love with the Monkey Island games and lemmings!

Where are we now? The PS5, \

will fracture more instead of sharing.  They will compete in hash rate, each trying to get to 51% which means the network will be more secure, because of competing bad actors.

I do not feel the last bitcoin will be mined.  It is weird, but bitcoin is really only a first step, and not an ultimate money itself.

Like i mentioned above, the future money will be some sort of AI powered, super-barter system.  Which works even better because we are dealing with a bunch of groups, (that are mostly self sufficient) and not a bunch of individuals.

title.title: Matanzas en 100 miradas #20 La ciudad que nació alrededor de una iglesia. [ES/EN]
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd7y8r3KZ3rmgxybG1ayBQLjAQfDhCSaJWSMt5yti14Yz/screenshot_20260110_181801_01.jpg)

Hola comunidad #worldmappin.

---
## 📌 Matanzas en 100 miradas #20  
### La ciudad que nació alrededor de una iglesia
---

Esta serie nace de caminar sin prisa y mirar con intención.  
Hoy la mirada se detiene en uno de los lugares más antiguos y simbólicos de Matanzas: la Catedral de San Carlos Borromeo.

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmShwzvycein8YmfGrLYXAKNByENjkhZ4BH9VFXmhN4JG6/screenshot_20260529_085206_01.jpg)

---

Hay edificios que forman parte de una ciudad.
Y hay otros alrededor de los cuales la ciudad parece haber comenzado.

La Catedral de Matanzas pertenece a este segundo grupo.

Mucho antes de que existiera la ciudad tal como hoy la conocemos, ya se levantaba allí una cruz, ya se celebraba una misa, ya se intentaba construir un templo. El 12 de octubre de 1693 fue colocada y bendecida la primera piedra por el obispo Diego Evelino Hurtado de Compostela, en una ceremonia considerada por muchos historiadores como el acto fundacional de la ciudad.

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVb23C9exafVLrKbarZXjsBrm8UJY9pKALH4hCD8Pda9P/screenshot_20260529_085442_01.jpg)

---

En aquellos primeros tiempos la iglesia era muy distinta a la que vemos hoy. Se trataba de una construcción provisional hecha con hojas de palma real y materiales mucho más humildes. Pero incluso así, el lugar ya tenía una enorme importancia simbólica.

Con el tiempo llegó un fuerte temporal.
Y el templo cayó.

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSn86fAfCHMF9xGK4z27Qgh8gLu1G3bMg32rTxLWgeqRx/screenshot_20260529_090803_01.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVdcMmE4puWkbxvYvmaMm4ExaMmAUpBodfRgcqUzHCqSc/screenshot_20260529_090809_01.jpg)

---

La historia de esta Catedral también es una historia de destrucción y reconstrucción.

Después del derrumbe se inició nuevamente la construcción, hasta que en la primera mitad del siglo XVIII comenzó a tomar forma el edificio que terminaría convirtiéndose en una de las iglesias más importantes de Cuba. A lo largo de los siglos sufrió ampliaciones, reformas y restauraciones. Se añadieron torres, capillas, pisos de mármol y detalles decorativos que todavía hoy pueden apreciarse.

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWxKxR9VQJbxs7kDteReRncp1RivQx9Vja5zYPMoT4j55/screenshot_20260529_091618_01.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWBTN2NiKXrdcpfEBQ1ckGBzfJrUspF5goprPbkshdBjD/screenshot_20260529_091624_01.jpg)

---

Su interior guarda frescos, altares y uno de los elementos más singulares del país: el único Vía Crucis completo en lienzo que existe en Cuba.

Pero más allá de su valor religioso, la Catedral también guarda la memoria de Matanzas.

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQaGkPWxVDoKitYd4Zi6uuGFiF4rNV8Fk6a5KaEryhke5/screenshot_20260529_091858_01.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcgL2iGzWPYS9KvzQm7AiB3kodddfixMmezpqsHzsQbHM/screenshot_20260529_091904_01.jpg)

---

En sus archivos quedaron registrados bautismos y documentos relacionados con figuras importantes de la cultura y la historia cubana, entre ellas José Jacinto Milanés, José White y el poeta Plácido.

Es como si parte de la ciudad hubiera quedado archivada entre sus paredes.

La Catedral está ubicada en pleno corazón histórico de Matanzas, en la calle Jovellanos, muy cerca del Parque de la Libertad y del antiguo centro urbano entre los ríos San Juan y Yumurí.

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf1gzMgKmtx42hN7fmqCFS3D3NTEoNeTM4Kkapq8gLLp3/screenshot_20260529_092205_01.jpg)

---

Y precisamente hablando del entorno aparece algo curioso.

A diferencia de muchas iglesias construidas durante la época colonial y el posterior período neoclásico, la Catedral de Matanzas no tiene un gran parque frontal abierto directamente ante ella. Según me comentaba mi hija, ingeniera civil, Matanzas fue una ciudad planificada desde sus inicios, algo que no ocurrió de igual forma en muchas otras ciudades cubanas que crecieron más espontáneamente.

Cuenta además una teoría muy conocida entre los matanceros que, tras el derrumbe de la primera iglesia, el espacio urbano cambió y se utilizó el área que originalmente funcionaba como plaza frente al templo. Por eso hoy la Catedral parece integrada de otra manera dentro del tejido urbano.

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSyNrJ3UKvuzWpctuxMzSDxFLqaPiXGnikW4HVkYcSzAK/screenshot_20260529_104747_01.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQMDkgM6HjBoFfXWREkKmMrQ4jk42tgcH33TUKcPqtygY/screenshot_20260529_104757_01.jpg)

---

Los pequeños espacios laterales que muchos llaman parques realmente funcionan más como patios abiertos alrededor de la iglesia, mientras que el verdadero gran parque público de la zona terminó siendo el actual Parque de la Libertad.

No sé cuántas personas notan ese detalle al pasar.
Pero una vez que se piensa, resulta imposible no verlo.

Y quizás eso sea precisamente lo más interesante de esta serie.

Descubrir que las ciudades hablan incluso a través de aquello que aparentemente falta.

Hace algunos años tuve además una experiencia particular relacionada con este lugar.

Cuando se realizaba la restauración que devolvió parte del esplendor a la Catedral y que concluyó en 2017, yo trabajaba en una cooperativa de construcción. En una ocasión fui allí a visitar a unos amigos restauradores que participaban en los trabajos.

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPp9xVCiRDHTKR1y2bKJdr1H99KNJMfFrUNn3K9Wrj2cU/screenshot_20260529_090359_01.jpg)
***Imagen de la restauración 2016***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW487BepKSkfvLd6VqsgQh5zRi1PEEvCfpq9Dhy2wXWuH/screenshot_20260529_090441_01.jpg)
***Imagen de la restauración 2016***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXYM2L39k5v5tHhXLX7XVbu7nniHMCH5z4fdHhhcPPFWj/screenshot_20260529_090353_01.jpg)
***Imagen de la restauración 2016***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW536ndHNYv2W46drXEhGvXuRkMm4tUqMR9PS4Dgiy2ML/screenshot_20260529_090450_01.jpg)
***Imagen de la restauración 2016***

---

Recuerdo el interior lleno de andamios, el movimiento constante, el polvo, las herramientas, y al mismo tiempo la sensación de estar dentro de algo mucho más antiguo que todos nosotros.

No era simplemente una obra.
Era una parte de la ciudad intentando conservarse a sí misma.

Y quizás por eso la Catedral sigue impresionando.
No solo por su arquitectura.
No solo por su historia.

Sino porque ha permanecido allí mientras Matanzas cambiaba a su alrededor.

Ha visto crecer calles.
Ha visto desaparecer estructuras.
Ha sobrevivido tormentas.
Ha acompañado generaciones enteras.

Y todavía continúa siendo uno de esos lugares donde la ciudad parece respirar más despacio.

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQFyktMg5pc44vZBHRvSGnNgB29kvVF3zrBZ93TWyugHz/screenshot_20260529_105346_01.jpg)

---

En uno de los laterales del entorno cercano hay también una enorme rueda dentada convertida casi en elemento escultórico, parcialmente abrazada por la vegetación. Muchos pasan junto a ella sin saber realmente su origen. Tal vez sea una de esas piezas industriales que terminaron integrándose silenciosamente al paisaje urbano, recordando también el vínculo histórico de Matanzas con la industria y el puerto.

Porque en esta ciudad incluso los objetos olvidados parecen terminar contando algo.

---
Esta fue otra mirada.  
Nos vemos el próximo fin de semana en otra mirada de Matanzas.
---

Las imágenes son de mi propiedad hechas con el móvil y la portada de la serie fue editada por mí en Canva y acompañará toda la serie. La traducción al inglés fue realizada con DeepL Translate.

- - -
# English Version
- - -

---
## 📌 Matanzas in 100 Views #20  
### The City That Was Born Around a Church
---

This series is born from walking without haste and looking with intention.  
Today the view pauses at one of the oldest and most symbolic places in Matanzas: the Cathedral of San Carlos Borromeo.

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmShwzvycein8YmfGrLYXAKNByENjkhZ4BH9VFXmhN4JG6/screenshot_20260529_085206_01.jpg)

---

There are buildings that become part of a city.
And there are others around which the city itself seems to have begun.

The Cathedral of Matanzas belongs to the second group.

Long before the city existed as we know it today, there was already a cross standing there, a mass being celebrated, an attempt to build a temple. On October 12, 1693, the first stone was placed and blessed by Bishop Diego Evelino Hurtado de Compostela in a ceremony considered by many historians to be the founding act of the city.

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVb23C9exafVLrKbarZXjsBrm8UJY9pKALH4hCD8Pda9P/screenshot_20260529_085442_01.jpg)

---

In those early years, the church looked very different from the one we see today. It was a temporary structure made from royal palm leaves and much humbler materials. And even so, the place already carried enormous symbolic importance.

Then came a powerful storm.
And the temple collapsed.

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSn86fAfCHMF9xGK4z27Qgh8gLu1G3bMg32rTxLWgeqRx/screenshot_20260529_090803_01.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVdcMmE4puWkbxvYvmaMm4ExaMmAUpBodfRgcqUzHCqSc/screenshot_20260529_090809_01.jpg)

---

The history of this Cathedral is also a story of destruction and reconstruction.

After the collapse, construction began once again until, during the first half of the 18th century, the building started to take the form that would eventually become one of the most important churches in Cuba. Over the centuries it underwent expansions, renovations, and restorations. Towers, side chapels, marble floors, and decorative details were added, many of which can still be admired today.

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWxKxR9VQJbxs7kDteReRncp1RivQx9Vja5zYPMoT4j55/screenshot_20260529_091618_01.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWBTN2NiKXrdcpfEBQ1ckGBzfJrUspF5goprPbkshdBjD/screenshot_20260529_091624_01.jpg)

---

Inside, the Cathedral preserves frescoes, altars, and one of the most unique religious treasures in the country: the only complete Stations of the Cross painted on canvas in Cuba.

But beyond its religious value, the Cathedral also preserves the memory of Matanzas.

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQaGkPWxVDoKitYd4Zi6uuGFiF4rNV8Fk6a5KaEryhke5/screenshot_20260529_091858_01.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcgL2iGzWPYS9KvzQm7AiB3kodddfixMmezpqsHzsQbHM/screenshot_20260529_091904_01.jpg)

---

Its archives contain baptismal records and documents connected to important Cuban cultural and historical figures, including José Jacinto Milanés, José White, and the poet Plácido.

It is almost as if part of the city itself had been archived within its walls.

The Cathedral stands in the historic heart of Matanzas, on Jovellanos Street, very close to Liberty Park and the old urban center between the San Juan and Yumurí rivers.

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf1gzMgKmtx42hN7fmqCFS3D3NTEoNeTM4Kkapq8gLLp3/screenshot_20260529_092205_01.jpg)

---

And speaking about its surroundings reveals something curious.

Unlike many churches built during the colonial and later neoclassical periods, the Cathedral of Matanzas does not have a large frontal square directly facing it. According to something my daughter, a civil engineer, once explained to me, Matanzas was a city that was planned before it was fully built, something that did not happen in the same way in many other Cuban cities that grew more spontaneously.

There is also a well-known local theory suggesting that after the collapse of the first church, the urban layout changed and the area that originally served as the square in front of the temple was repurposed. That may explain why today the Cathedral feels integrated into the urban fabric in a different way.

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSyNrJ3UKvuzWpctuxMzSDxFLqaPiXGnikW4HVkYcSzAK/screenshot_20260529_104747_01.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQMDkgM6HjBoFfXWREkKmMrQ4jk42tgcH33TUKcPqtygY/screenshot_20260529_104757_01.jpg)

---

The smaller side areas that many people call parks actually function more like open courtyards surrounding the church, while the real large public square nearby eventually became what is now Liberty Park.

I do not know how many people notice that detail while passing by.
But once you think about it, it becomes impossible not to see.

And perhaps that is precisely one of the most interesting things about this series.

Discovering that cities speak even through what apparently is no longer there.

Some years ago I also had a personal experience connected to this place.

When the restoration that returned part of the Cathedral’s splendor was taking place and eventually concluded in 2017, I was working in a construction cooperative. On one occasion I visited some friends who were involved in the restoration work.

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPp9xVCiRDHTKR1y2bKJdr1H99KNJMfFrUNn3K9Wrj2cU/screenshot_20260529_090359_01.jpg)
***Image of the 2016 restoration***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW487BepKSkfvLd6VqsgQh5zRi1PEEvCfpq9Dhy2wXWuH/screenshot_20260529_090441_01.jpg)
***Image of the 2016 restoration***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXYM2L39k5v5tHhXLX7XVbu7nniHMCH5z4fdHhhcPPFWj/screenshot_20260529_090353_01.jpg)
***Image of the 2016 restoration***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW536ndHNYv2W46drXEhGvXuRkMm4tUqMR9PS4Dgiy2ML/screenshot_20260529_090450_01.jpg)
***Image of the 2016 restoration***

---

I still remember the interior filled with scaffolding, the constant movement, the dust, the tools, and at the same time the feeling of standing inside something far older than all of us.

It was not simply a construction project.
It was a part of the city trying to preserve itself.

And perhaps that is why the Cathedral continues to impress.
Not only because of its architecture.
Not only because of its history.

But because it has remained there while Matanzas changed around it.

It has seen streets grow.
It has seen structures disappear.
It has survived storms.
It has accompanied entire generations.

And it still remains one of those places where the city seems to breathe more slowly.

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQFyktMg5pc44vZBHRvSGnNgB29kvVF3zrBZ93TWyugHz/screenshot_20260529_105346_01.jpg)

---

On one side of the surrounding area there is also a huge gear wheel that has almost become a sculptural element, partially embraced by vegetation. Many people pass by without truly knowing its origin. Perhaps it is one of those industrial pieces that silently became part of the urban landscape, also reminding us of Matanzas’ historical ties to industry and the port.

Because in this city even forgotten objects eventually seem to tell a story.

---
This was another view.  
See you next weekend in another view of Matanzas.
---

The images are my own, taken with my mobile phone, and the series cover was edited by me using Canva and will accompany the entire series. The English translation was made with DeepL Translate.

---

Thank you for reading.
Special thanks to @bradleyarrow for supporting the community.

title.title: The K-Drama That Made Me Fall in Love with Korean Dramas
title.body: If someone had asked me which k-drama made me to love k-drama . I honestly didn't understand the hype around them. I thought they were probably just another type of TV series. That changed completely when I watched \

.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRjr9K3gVRqQQxVbgyvTAFqv7wD5UoTw8BdhZrGSCBmRh/1000221572.jpg 
 
*Image was a screenshot from the movie* 

I came across this drama when I visited a friend who is  a k-drama lover.At first, I wasn't sure if I would enjoy a historical drama because I usually preferred modern stories. But after watching a few episodes, I found myself completely hooked. Before I knew it, I was staying up late just to watch one more episode.

What drew me in the most was the story of Soo Baek-hyang herself. She wasn't a perfect character, and that's one of the reasons I loved her. She went through so many struggles, heartbreaks, and difficult decisions, yet she remained strong and kind. Watching her journey felt emotional because I found myself rooting for her every step of the way.

The drama also surprised me with how many emotions it made me feel. One moment I would be smiling, and the next I would be frustrated, angry, or even close to tears. The characters felt real, and their relationships weren't always simple. There were secrets, betrayals, sacrifices, and moments that made my heart ache.

My favorite scene is the moment Soo Baek-hyang discovers the truth about who she really is. I still remember how emotional that scene was for me. Everything she believed about her life suddenly changed. You could see the shock and pain on her face, and it felt so genuine that I couldn't help feeling emotional too. It wasn't just about learning that she had royal blood; it was about realizing that her entire life had been built on hidden truths.

What made that scene even more powerful was knowing everything she had already gone through before reaching that moment. Instead of breaking down completely, she found the strength to face reality and move forward. That was the moment when I truly admired her character.

Another thing I loved about this drama was the beautiful historical setting. The costumes, the palace scenes, and the traditions made the story feel rich and immersive. Even though the drama has many episodes, I never felt bored because there was always something happening.

Even today, whenever someone asks me which K-drama made me fall in love with the genre, my answer is always the same: *The King's Daughter, Soo Baek-hyang*. It will always have a special place in my heart because it was the beginning of my K-drama journey.




**Thank for checking on my blog and have a wonderful day**

title.title: Bulls Stay in Control as S&P 500 Notches 9th Consecutive Gain
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdpYjJZfNidsAWpkg9M4Ze6YTgjFUJBFsy5zXKNtMBuyo/img_1169.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdgUnZjUPVcABzqdPk5DmVpDUiP2yx3AJ8MbYbhDoAEXi/img_4612.png)

**Marching to 10,000?**

The S&P 500 is on fire! This week marked yet another green close, the 9th in a row. Fueled by progress in negotiations between the U.S. and Iran, the index gained another 1.2%, reaching a fresh all-time high just shy of 7,600 points. Over the past twelve months, the S&P 500 is now up an impressive 28%. What a rally!

I recently heard an analyst argue that this bull market could still have another 2–3 years to run, potentially pushing the S&P 500 toward the 10,000-point mark. The reasoning? The AI narrative remains very much alive, and several highly anticipated IPOs may still be ahead, including companies such as SpaceX,  OpenAI￼, and Anthropic. Looking back at the late-1990s bull market, some observers note that the final market peak only arrived after a wave of major IPOs, one to two years later.

Of course, none of this is guaranteed. But it does suggest that sentiment remains broadly bullish for now. At the same time, investors should stay cautious: bull markets often end in periods of extreme optimism and euphoria. Enjoy the ride, but keep an eye out for the signs that the cycle may be nearing its peak.

title.title: ‎The One Thing I'd Change If I Could Turn Back Time
title.body:
‎Hi Hive,
‎
‎I believe everyone has at least one memory that makes them pause and wonder, \

No matter how happy we are with where we are today, there are moments from the past that we wish we could revisit.
‎ https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVFdxtf1i3p3F7K2kELJvenG2LuynN7RnrF2Dusdw1pYX/buivuong-pen-4715847_1920.jpg 


‎[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/pen-write-girl-letter-paper-ink-4715847/)
‎
‎For me, that moment was when I let fear stop me from taking a chance.
‎
‎A few years back, an opportunity came my way. It was not anything guaranteed, and there was a real possibility that it could have failed. At the time, I spent days thinking about all the things that could go wrong. Instead of focusing on the potential rewards, I focused on the risks. In the end, I decided not to go for it.
‎
‎To be honest, I initially felt comfortable with that decision. There was no pressure, no uncertainty, and no chance of embarrassment. Life simply continued as normal. But as time goes on, I started thinking about that opportunity more often than I expected.
‎
‎What even bothered me was not that I missed out on success. The truth is, I don't even know if I would have succeeded. What bothered me was never finding out.
‎
‎I would see other people taking chances in their lives, starting businesses, pursuing their dreams, or simply stepping outside their comfort zones. Every now and then, I'd find myself wondering where I might be today if I had shown a little more courage back then.
‎
‎If I had the power to turn back the hands of time, I would not change every mistake I have ever made. Many of those mistakes taught me lessons that I still carry with me today. But I would go back to that particular moment and tell myself to stop overthinking and just try.
‎
‎I'd tell myself that failure is not as scary as it seems. Most people recover from failure and grow because of it. Sometimes failure is the foundation of success. Regret, on the other hand, tends to stay around much longer.
‎
‎As I have gotten older, I have understand that life doesn't come with guarantees. Sometimes you win, sometimes you lose, but at least you know you gave it your best shot. Looking back, that's what really matters most.
‎
‎Even though I can't change the past, but that experience has changed the way I approach opportunities today. Whenever fear starts whispering reasons why I should not do something, I remind myself of that missed chance and ask, \

‎
‎And most times, that question gives me the answer I need.
‎
‎Time only moves forward, and maybe that's how it's supposed to be. But if I learned anything from that experience, it's that courage often opens doors that fear keeps 
‎
‎
‎![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYaWnApEziAtLL5Zwv3ZNbDjRfSfG6h5njgTrpyasnE6y/1775569275821.png)

一年一度的启动会开始了，这是27届的启动会。不知不觉，从19届跨越到27届，已经度过了8个年头。

每当这个时候无比隆重，每个人身着正装。我们这套蓝色的正装是公司为我们量身定做，价值 1000 多呢！衣服上都有个人的工号与名字。一件长袖上衣，一件外套，一条裤子，还搭一条裙子和一条丝巾，但丝巾我从来没系过。西装是纯羊毛的，我每次都丢洗衣机里面。

会议开始每个大区都喊团队口号、理念、目标之类的。每次都是我们大区最简单的，别人的都非常用心，我们经理特别不爱花心思在这上面，就 8 个字搞定了。等我们喊完口号，都会引来一阵笑声，就觉得我们总是出其不意呀！

升国旗仪式，每次会议必须要举行

各个产品的销冠，差点我就上台了

下面开始进行颁奖，基数 50 万以下的增量奖，还有基数 50 万～100 万以上的增量奖。太可惜了，这些奖都与我无关呀！

书香校园专项 PPT

金煌光护眼灯销售规划

节目:万马奔腾迎日出

接下来是个人、省区还有大区表态环节。其他大区表态都是震耳欲聋、激人奋进、慷慨激昂，唯独我们大区连台面都没有上，直接在座位上喊。

各个领导发言，从产品研发中心主任到总经理，再到我们的董事长。我们每次的活动他都会参加。他真的是我们这些人崇拜的对象啊！从一位高中的物理老师下海经商到现在，非常的成功，几大板块都做的很好。

第二个节目《奔跑吧兄弟》

本次会议大赛我都是在观众席上鼓掌，永远当个观众，下次能不能也上我上台过过瘾

title.title: 當然可以！以下是一個關於自然的部
title.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/ga331c9793cbd23fd2507ccff4bdb8110d0dc313287c09dd7781f3738b0ad24549d406aeaa308808c20d4b67a08e091fc97f93c8cb60cd42ab4cdaea1068c927f_640.jpg)</center>

***

# 自然的美

自然是我們生活中不可或缺的一部分，它以其壯麗的景觀和多樣的生態系統吸引著無數人。無論是廣闊的森林、波濤洶湧的海洋，還是高聳入雲的山脈，自然都展現了其無與倫比的美麗和力量。

## 自然的元素

### 1. 山脈
山脈是地球上最壯觀的地形之一。它們不僅提供了壯麗的景色，還是許多動植物的棲息地。登山健行是人們親近自然的好方式。

### 2. 河流
河流是生命的源泉，它們滋養著周圍的生態系統。河流的流動聲音常常讓人感到平靜，並且是許多文化中重要的象徵。

### 3. 森林
森林是地球的肺，提供了氧氣並吸收二氧化碳。它們是許多動植物的家，並且對於保持生態平衡至關重要。

### 4. 海洋
海洋覆蓋了地球的70%以上，是地球上最大的生態系統。它們擁有無數的生物，從微小的浮游生物到巨大的鯨魚，海洋的生物多樣性令人驚嘆。

## 自然的保護

隨著人類活動的增加，自然環境面臨著許多挑戰，如氣候變化、污染和生物多樣性的喪失。因此，保護自然變得越來越重要。我們可以通過以下方式來保護我們的自然環境：

- **減少塑料使用**：選擇可重複使用的產品，減少一次性塑料的使用。
- **支持可持續產品**：選擇環保和可持續來源的產品，支持那些尊重自然的企業。
- **參與植樹活動**：參加當地的植樹活動，幫助恢復自然棲息地。
- **提高意識**：通過教育和宣傳，提高人們對環保的意識。

## 結論

自然是我們共同的家，保護自然環境是每個人的責任。讓我們一起努力，珍惜和保護這片美麗的土地，讓未來的世代也能享受到自然的恩賜。

***

***带雨有时种竹，关门无事锄花。拈笔闲删旧句，汲泉几试新茶。*** 古人的这几句诗写的太美啦，但其实种地、伺弄花草可是相当累人的活呢。

![20260530_081636.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYojy88xy9eK79FewVNqtXQcn3Xuc7r3SPVwgvLNghJh7/20260530_081636.jpg)

话说五一期间父母过来玩的时候，想要帮我种地、栽花，倒不是为了好看——在他们的观念中，院子里光秃秃或者杂草丛生，说明这家人比较懒惰。

不过我说什么也没让他们弄，都那么大年纪了，再让他们帮我做农活，我咋能过意得去呢？

而且我并不在意别人如何看我，懒惰咋啦，懒惰碍着谁啦？

不过最终我还是决定弄一些花草，和别人如何看待无关， 就是想让院子变得好看一些，自己看也舒坦呀。

和媳妇出发去造化大集买花

当天晚上就把花都栽种到花盆里，但是累得我不想动，也就没拍照。

第二天开始栽种秧苗，翻地是个累人的活呀

![20260530_081717.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVJUv4n2xW8LBLbjEy61CgYJELEnqzmoX19cCqU1iu6f7/20260530_081717.jpg)

菇娘、辣椒、茄子，小苗有点少，改天我再去买一些苗
![20260530_081732.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQGN6AAJBQLtoBY4BuueDFeiYAr25RcWcxkCYTyVMCykZ/20260530_081732.jpg)

干农活实在是太累了，就这么点花、这一堆葱和这几根苗，就把我累个半死，现在还是腰酸背痛啊。

title.title: Criminal Record
title.body:
Do you know the difference between order and chaos? https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/original/cZO6ZHtaX7B0zxmBDhW0ID3k7V6.jpg
[Source ](https://www.themoviedb.org/tv/204490-criminal-record/images/backdrops)
Edited in Photoshop & Canva App
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/245cUBXzvWF8QVukk8UvqTFX6FutvCzv1TyGDA8ybnR5QKA1v6nMvGS4j6y81Qg9M2HLn.jpg
Who doesn't love a good police thriller? Among British series, there are always some that stand out, and that was certainly the case with Criminal Record. I'd been wanting to watch it for a while; it already has two seasons, but I finally got around to watching the first, which has an excellent start. I watched the first three episodes back-to-back, and then I had to find time, whenever I could, to watch the whole thing. A call to the emergency services triggers a series of events that delve into a past case and pit two police officers from different jurisdictions against each other. Detective June Lenker is very intelligent and one of those idealized police officers typical of fictional stories. A woman who pays attention to every detail and has a sense of justice that's very hard to find in real life. On the opposing side, and the one who does the most remarkable work, is Chief Inspector Daniel Hegarty, a police veteran who, along with his friends, formed a group called the 62 and who, it seems, crossed some moral and legal lines in the past. He's a somewhat mysterious character, one the story plays with, because although he has a rather malevolent aura, there are small details that leave us puzzled. Is he racist? Is he part of an ultranationalist group? What is he hiding about the Errol case? The dynamic of the story lies in how these two police officers escalate their conflicts. While June seeks to uncover the truth—to find out if an innocent man is serving a 24-year prison sentence—Daniel seems determined to prevent anything from the past from coming to light, even if it means harming and destroying June. The writers manage to weave a compelling story, with new discoveries in each episode that complicate matters and generate more questions. This is a winning combination for creating an exceptional police procedural. Of course, it's not perfect, although it's addictive for those of us who enjoy a good police drama. The influence of many current productions is evident here. The protagonist is a woman, in this case, of African descent. The antagonist, the one with more darkness than light, is a straight white man suspected of belonging to racist political movements and other such nonsense. The political correctness cliché was inevitable, but the story is good, so this time I don't mind. It has a second season, which I haven't seen yet; I don't know when I'll have time. I don't know how the story will continue, perhaps with a new plot, a new case, because at the end of the first season, the case they're investigating is solved, and, of course, the shadows cast on a particular character are even greater. The second season will surely continue the conflict between them. I recommend it, especially if you like these kinds of stories. Let me know what you think in the comments. ---- > ¿A quién no le gusta un buen thriller policíaco? Entre las series británicas, siempre hay algunas que destacan, y ese fue el caso de Criminal Record. Llevaba tiempo queriendo verla; ya tiene dos temporadas, pero finalmente me animé a ver la primera, que tiene un comienzo excelente. Vi los tres primeros episodios seguidos, y luego tuve que buscar un hueco, siempre que podía, para verla completa. > Una llamada a los servicios de emergencia desencadena una serie de acontecimientos que profundizan en un caso del pasado y enfrentan a dos policías de distintas jurisdicciones. La detective June Lenker es muy inteligente y una de esas policías idealizadas típicas de las historias de ficción. Una mujer que presta atención a cada detalle y tiene un sentido de la justicia muy difícil de encontrar en la vida real. > En el bando contrario, y quien realiza el trabajo más destacable, está el inspector jefe Daniel Hegarty, un veterano de la policía que, junto con sus amigos, formó un grupo llamado los 62 y que, al parecer, cruzó algunos límites morales y legales en el pasado. Es un personaje algo misterioso, con el que la historia juega, porque aunque tiene un aura más bien malévola, hay pequeños detalles que nos desconciertan. ¿Es racista? ¿Forma parte de un grupo ultranacionalista? ¿Qué oculta sobre el caso Errol? > La dinámica de la historia radica en cómo estos dos policías intensifican sus enfrentamientos. Mientras June busca descubrir la verdad —averiguar si un hombre inocente está cumpliendo una condena de 24 años de prisión—, Daniel parece empeñado en impedir que salga a la luz cualquier cosa del pasado, incluso si eso significa dañar y destruir a June. Los guionistas logran tejer una buena historia, con nuevos descubrimientos en cada episodio que complican las cosas y generan más preguntas. Esta es una buena combinación para crear una historia policíaca excepcional. > Por supuesto, no es perfecta, aunque resulta adictiva para quienes disfrutamos de un buen drama policial. Aquí se nota la influencia de muchas producciones actuales. La protagonista es una mujer, en este caso, de ascendencia africana. El antagonista, el que tiene más oscuridad que luz, es un hombre blanco heterosexual sospechoso de pertenecer a movimientos políticos racistas y demás tonterías. El cliché de la corrección política no podía faltar, pero la historia es buena, así que esta vez no me importa. > Tiene una segunda temporada, que aún no he visto; no sé cuándo tendré tiempo. No sé cómo continuará la historia, quizás con una nueva trama, un nuevo caso, porque al final de la primera temporada, el caso que están investigando se resuelve y, por supuesto, las sombras que se proyectan sobre un personaje en particular son aún mayores. Seguramente la segunda temporada continuará el enfrentamiento entre ellos. > La recomiendo, sobre todo si te gustan este tipo de historias. Cuéntame qué te parece en los comentarios.

title.title: Adam Mickiewicz i Mapy Topik
title.body:
![AMzMNK1-768x1017.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/helcim/23w2mRgumh433jnPrGV7zSUa5ok6eaumuj33ioGGZDsifzmJrAGxU5yDYcQSGk4uuyo5R.jpg)

Portret Adama Mickiewicza, rep. fotograficzna dagerotypu, Muzeum Narodowe w Krakowie

Po kilkunastu latach, nawet nie jestem w stanie z pamięci powiedzieć ilu, trzeba by to sprawdzić, został zakończony publikacją online projekt jakich mało. Najpełniejsza z opublikowanych dotąd bibliografia Adama Mickiewicza. Zabierano się do niej wcześniej dwukrotnie i obie próby zakończyły się niepowodzeniem. Trudno się dziwić. Liczba publikacji Adama Mickiewicza i publikacji o Adamie Mickiewiczu  i jego utworach jest ogromna. Kiedy zaczynałem pracę nad [Cyfrowym Muzeum Narodowym w Warszawie](https://cyfrowe.mnw.art.pl/pl/strona-glowna) nie przypuszczałem, że moje doświadczenia „cyfrowego humanisty” przydadzą się polonistom. Każdy, kto spędził przynajmniej jeden semestr na jakiejkolwiek uczelni wyższej musiał zetknąć się z zasadami tworzenia przypisów i bibliografii, bo od tego zaczyna się naukę chyba w każdej specjalności. Nie jest to żadna filozofia, wystarczy trzymać się konsekwentnie konkretnego stylu bibliografii, co, zwłaszcza początkującym może trochę kłopotów sprawiać, ale raczej zwykle daje się to szybko opanować. Teraz, w epoce wszechobecnych narzędzi ułatwiających tworzenie bibliografii jest to łatwiejsze niż kiedykolwiek. Przy ich pomocy można z łatwością stworzyć bibliografię do artykułu lub ksiażki, ale co zrobić gdy cała bibliografia ma być książką o złożonej strukturze? Bez \

oprogramowania nie da się tego zrobić. Kiedy zaczynano pierwszą część projektu bibliografii Adama Mickiewicza – opracowanie jego *Bibliografii podmiotowej*, to znaczy bibliografii wszystkich wydań we wszystjkich językach, okazało się że stworzenie odpowiedniego programu było zadaniem co najmniej nietrywialnym. W każdym razie pierwsza próba się nie powiodła i uczestnicy projektu wrócili do tworzenia papierowych fiszek. Dołączyłem do projektu już po jego rozpoczęciu, mając za sobą utworzenie pierwszej bazy danych opartej na modelu Map Topik dla projektu [Poezja na marginesie cywilizacji](https://pnamc.ehum.psnc.pl/). Mapy Topik ujawniły w nim swoją ogromną przydatność dla tworzenia humanistycznych baz danych. Łatwość definiowania typów danych i relacji pomiędzy nimi oraz gwarancja stuprocentowej spójności sprawiały, że wprowadzanie dużych ilości danych i łączenie ich relacjami okazało się  łatwe jak bułka z masłem. Problemy jakie się pojawiały wynikały z niedostatecznej znajomości modelu danych. To może być pułapką w tego rodzaju projektach. \nNa szczęście udało się dobrnąć do końca. Zostały wydane dwa tomy w serii Nowego Korbuta z bibliografią podmiotową i przedmiotową Adama Mickiewicza, a ich zawartość jest teraz dostępna online na stronie [mickiewicz-nk.ehum.psnc.pl](https://mickiewicz-nk.ehum.psnc.pl/).\n

title.body:
![Taxi in Chandigarh (6).png](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/3f99e00df0058cf6d2056bb6703684faf4cbc130678ff76af8a853c7399bd7f7)



Transportation has become one of the most important parts of daily life in modern cities. Whether people are traveling for work, education, tourism, business meetings, airport transfers, or family events, reliable transportation directly affects convenience, productivity, and overall travel experience. As urban lifestyles become more fast-paced, travelers increasingly prefer transportation options that provide comfort, flexibility, and safety.

Chandigarh, known for its organized infrastructure, educational institutions, and growing business environment, has witnessed a major rise in demand for dependable travel services. Residents, tourists, students, and professionals now rely heavily on professional taxi services for both local commuting and intercity travel. The growing popularity of [Taxi in Chandigarh](https://www.chandigarhcabexpress.com/taxi-service-in-chandigarh/) reflects the changing expectations of modern travelers who prioritize convenience and efficient mobility.

Today’s taxi services are designed to provide far more than basic transportation. Customers now expect professional drivers, clean vehicles, transparent pricing, digital booking systems, and smooth travel experiences.

## Why Professional Taxi Services Matter Today

Public transportation plays an important role in city mobility, but it may not always meet the comfort and scheduling needs of every traveler. Professional taxi services provide personalized travel solutions that allow passengers to travel according to their own convenience.

People choose taxis because they offer:

*   Door-to-door pickup and drop

*   Flexible travel schedules

*   Comfortable seating and privacy

*   Better safety for families and solo travelers

*   Faster and more direct travel

*   Convenient luggage handling

For example, professionals traveling for meetings often prefer taxis to avoid delays and parking problems, while tourists use taxis for easy navigation and stress-free sightseeing.

The increasing demand for Taxi in Chandigarh shows how travelers are moving toward more flexible and customer-focused transportation options.

## Growth of Intercity Taxi Travel

Road travel between cities has become increasingly popular due to improved highways and rising demand for comfortable private transportation. Many travelers now prefer taxis for intercity journeys instead of buses or trains because of convenience and travel flexibility.

A highly preferred travel route is the [Delhi to Chandigarh taxi ride taxi](https://www.chandigarhcabexpress.com/delhi-to-chandigarh-taxi/), often used by tourists, business travelers, students, and families. Travelers choose private taxis for this route because they allow direct travel without unnecessary stops or transfers.

Intercity taxi services provide several advantages:

*   Flexible departure timing

*   Personalized travel experience

*   Comfortable highway journeys

*   Better travel privacy

*   Freedom to stop during travel

Long-distance taxi travel has become especially useful for airport transfers, family functions, corporate travel, and tourism purposes.

## Important Features of a Reliable Taxi Service

Not every transportation provider offers the same level of professionalism and reliability. Quality taxi services focus on several factors that improve customer satisfaction and travel safety.

### Professional Drivers

Experienced drivers with local and highway route knowledge improve both efficiency and passenger confidence.

### Clean and Well-Maintained Vehicles

Vehicle cleanliness and maintenance directly affect travel comfort, especially during longer journeys.

### Transparent Pricing

Clear pricing structures without hidden charges help build customer trust.

### Timely Service

Punctual pickups and drop-offs are essential for airport transfers and scheduled meetings.

### Responsive Customer Support

Reliable communication improves booking coordination and customer satisfaction.

Professional providers offering Taxi in Chandigarh often focus strongly on maintaining these service standards to ensure smooth travel experiences.

## Advantages of Choosing Private Taxi Services

Private taxis provide several practical benefits compared to crowded public transportation systems.

### Better Comfort and Privacy

Passengers can travel peacefully without overcrowding or unnecessary interruptions.

### Flexible Scheduling

Taxi services allow travelers to plan journeys according to their personal convenience.

### Improved Safety

Verified drivers and monitored services help create safer travel environments.

### Convenient Family Travel

Families with children or elderly passengers often find taxis more comfortable and manageable.

### Reduced Travel Stress

Direct transportation helps avoid the hassle of changing multiple transport modes.

These advantages make private taxi services highly suitable for daily commuting, tourism, corporate travel, and long-distance road journeys.

## Modern Trends Shaping the Taxi Industry

Technology and customer expectations continue transforming the transportation industry rapidly.

### Online Booking Platforms

Mobile applications and websites now make taxi booking faster and more convenient.

### GPS Navigation and Tracking

Real-time tracking improves route efficiency and passenger safety.

### Digital Payment Methods

Cashless payment systems simplify transactions for customers.

### Eco-Friendly Transportation

Many taxi providers are gradually introducing fuel-efficient and electric vehicles.

### Customized Travel Packages

Companies increasingly offer specialized packages for tourism, airport transfers, weddings, and corporate travel.

Taxi companies adapting to these changes often provide more reliable and customer-focused transportation experiences.

## Practical Tips for Booking Reliable Taxi Services

Travelers often focus only on pricing without considering service quality and safety standards. Careful planning can greatly improve the travel experience.

### Confirm Booking Information

Always verify driver details, vehicle information, and pickup schedules before travel.

### Read Service Reviews

Customer reviews provide valuable insights into punctuality, cleanliness, and professionalism.

### Understand Fare Policies

Clarifying tolls, waiting charges, and additional fees helps avoid confusion later.

### Plan Ahead for Busy Travel Seasons

Advance bookings improve vehicle availability during holidays and weekends.

### Prioritize Safety and Professionalism

Reliable service quality often matters more than choosing the cheapest option.

These simple steps help travelers enjoy smoother and safer transportation experiences.

## Role of Taxi Services in Tourism and Business Travel

Tourism and business activities depend heavily on efficient transportation systems. Visitors unfamiliar with local areas often rely on taxis for convenience and navigation support.

### Tourism Benefits

Tourists can comfortably explore attractions without worrying about parking or directions.

### Corporate Travel Support

Business professionals require punctual transportation for meetings, airport transfers, and conferences.

### Event Transportation

Taxis are commonly used during weddings, social gatherings, and family events.

### Educational Travel

Students traveling between cities often prefer private taxis for safer and more flexible journeys.

As Chandigarh continues growing as a business and educational destination, reliable taxi services play an important role in supporting mobility and convenience.

## Why Customer Experience Defines Taxi Service Quality

Transportation today is not only about reaching a destination. Customer experience strongly influences how travelers evaluate transportation providers.

Professional taxi companies focus on:

*   Driver behavior

*   Vehicle hygiene

*   Passenger comfort

*   Route efficiency

*   Travel safety

*   Communication quality

Positive travel experiences often encourage repeat bookings and long-term customer trust.

## Future of Taxi Services in Urban India

Urban transportation will continue evolving through smarter technology and sustainability-focused innovations. Taxi services are expected to become even more efficient through advanced booking systems, AI-powered route optimization, and eco-friendly vehicle adoption.

Future developments may include:

*   Electric taxi fleets

*   Smart traffic integration

*   Subscription-based transportation services

*   Improved passenger safety systems

*   Enhanced intercity travel networks

As urban mobility needs continue growing, taxi services will remain a vital part of convenient and reliable transportation.

## Conclusion

Modern travelers expect transportation services that combine comfort, punctuality, safety, and flexibility. Professional taxi services have become an essential part of both city and intercity travel by offering customer-focused transportation solutions for residents, tourists, students, and business professionals.

Choosing reliable taxi services can significantly improve travel experiences while reducing stress, delays, and transportation challenges. From airport pickups and daily city rides to long-distance highway travel, professional transportation providers continue helping travelers move more comfortably and efficiently.

As technology and customer expectations continue advancing, the future of taxi services will increasingly focus on smarter operations, better convenience, and improved travel experiences for modern commuters.

## FAQs

### Why do travelers prefer private taxi services?

Private taxi services provide comfort, flexible schedules, safer travel, and convenient door-to-door transportation.

### Are taxis suitable for long-distance travel?

Yes, many travelers prefer taxis for intercity journeys because they offer privacy, comfort, and flexible travel schedules.

### What should customers check before booking a taxi?

Customers should verify driver details, pricing, vehicle condition, and service reviews before confirming bookings.

### Why are professional drivers important in taxi services?

Experienced drivers improve safety, route efficiency, and overall passenger comfort.

### How is technology improving taxi services?

Technology improves booking convenience, GPS tracking, payment systems, customer communication, and route management.

title.title: Reviewing My Last 25 Days of Splinterlands Battles: Why Kicking Roc Became My Favorite Card
title.body:
![BEST ACTION.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23w2mKu4J8t9JFkBSXRfUYR2MJRFMHp73RKDEzc1pRb4xL9WoYngJWJV5fa2fJHhpxYm7.png)

After playing one month battles in Splinterlands I thought it would be a good idea to look back at my recent performance and see how things have been going. By checking my match history I can compare my wins and losses and see how many battles ended in a draw  and figure out which parts of my gameplay need the most improvement and what areas I must focus to improve in the battle...



Looking at my battle history from the last 25 days the results have not been as good as I expected. I managed to win 10 battles and lost 14 and had 1 draw.. So far my losses are higher than my wins which shows that there is still plenty of room for improvement and better decision making in future battles.

From my analysis I found that most of my losses happened in low mana battles. The main reason is that I do not have enough strong monster cards for low mana battles to make the best selections and positioning. 

Often I select high mana monster cards even in low mana battles which results in a weak team combination and eventually leads to a loss.
![Screenshot 2026-05-30 104401.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23t7931faN1Lo5R1sBp3VYZhud9aWf1NvwXVRRYKtkVY87jkY4fqmTecwSXLFJ5sHc6ik.png)

On the other hand I often win high mana battles because I can fill all the slots with monster cards. This gives me the opportunity to choose better monsters after understanding the strategy and ruleset and by improving their positioning I am able to win more battles.

A few days ago I played what was probably my most exciting and impressive battle of the month. It was a 60 mana cap battle and included two special rulesets.

The first ruleset was **Weak Magic** which gives all units Void Armor. This means armor must be damaged first before health can be affected. The second special ruleset allowed players to summon one Wild unit.

Because of these rulesets I selected my best armored monsters. I kept in mind that armor would absorb damage first no matter how many magic attackers the enemy team had. 

Therefore I focused heavily on armored units. At the same time I included more melee attackers because in battles with such modifiers. The stronger your attack power is the better your chances of winning.

Keeping all these factors in mind helped me secure a great victory in that battle.
![Screenshot 2026-05-30 104324.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/Eo1vw7DPh9XBw66rnnCjHe8pDWE39Bs11oPgWrn99CvtmJGTCAz8XzyY31HRjQQ7U65.png)

Among all the battles I played during this period the monster I liked the most and became my favorite was Kicking Roc. It belongs to the Life element. Its stats and abilities are excellent.

It is a magic attacking monster that deals 3 damage to the enemy each round. Since it is a ranged style backline unit it is best placed in the back position so you can take full advantage of its abilities. 

It also has 5 health which helps it survive longer in battles and a speed of 2 which supports its overall effectiveness.

This is an 8 mana card that can be used easily in medium to high mana battles.

![Screenshot 2026-05-30 104439.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23vhPzmLSpRznh9J1P1CGGXPnf88FW7WKdPFJFUgtJkFhMjWn8L2dMg8QM8swHJzLMEvp.png)

If we talk about its market price it is available at a very low cost. At level 1 you can get this card for only about 1 to 4 cents making it easy to add to your deck. Later when you have more funds available you can upgrade it as well.

What do you think about this monster card? Do you have it in your deck? Will be glad to see your answers in the comment seciton.

links.title: The world of rules. (Week 310)
links.body:
> --- >Extremes are always bad; they lead to excess on the part of someone, be it one person or many, and at the same time, it is difficult to find the middle ground. --- ![20260529_204510.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23ywiQetEyBJBaaWEytvvmvPCgj2koEuN2HKgqEveBmZDiKTCjt5mgTjzJtLPYqn7xSUk.jpg) --- I often think about this and come to the conclusion that human nature is complicated. For example, freedom is necessary, but if no limits are set, chaos can reign in many forms. There is a huge difference between my grandparents’ time and the present day, a vast difference. Life used to be very strict, or at least that is how my family experienced it: clearly defined boundaries, not only in terms of morality and good manners but also in terms of norms and rules, which did not even need to be written down; they were often taken for granted. Respect for them was paramount. Order prevailed more, although I think many took it to extremes. Today, it seems there is neither one nor the other; boundaries are not defined, and many do not even care if they harm others. Consequently, chaos reigns in many respects, and it is hard to see where society as a whole is heading. It is as if the motto ‘every man for himself’ were in force. --- ![20260515_183001.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243fdsD2FxKYxBfLUdK1MCKU3zGituyRaxwKuZ6fmCoKtmShzyPCzrsz6NdWggiaZx8As.jpg) --- For many reasons, going to extremes is not good; as Aristotle said, it is necessary to find the golden mean between the two extremes. It seems that this is not easy. If I consider that norms are more general and flexible, shaped or established by morality and traditions, rules are something more firmly established by governments; the danger lies in the fact that, throughout history, governments have shown that the rules they establish often harm citizens in one way or another, to the benefit of those in power. Are norms necessary? Yes, for respectful coexistence, where every human being takes others into account, norms that are accepted by all and that foster coexistence in harmony, peace, respect and kindness. But I believe that even that has been lost today, and it is clearly visible on the streets. --- ![20260515_183437.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/242D7nAbAPnrGHbdtb6J88pc9yUhaSAA6fKwWjo4uKye1VgxX2tahV6UDiPb9wa4446jq.jpg) --- But when it comes to rules, the matter changes, because depending on who holds power, the rules can be one way or another; they can be abusive, enforced authoritatively to the point of dictatorship, detrimental to human beings, forcing them to do things that violate their freedom when they have done nothing wrong according to the norms of social coexistence. And it seems that when someone comes to power, it acts as something that takes hold of the individual, transforms them and turns them against the rest of society, prioritising personal interests and ensuring that nothing else matters. Perhaps power transforms the people in government, or perhaps they were always like that and having power simply gives them the ability to do to others what they previously could not. Rules, depending on who dictates them, can be dangerous. --- ![20260515_184004.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23ywiwrNyuWmvsjqBTGs1jcybEG1UnJT7gT48aEB8y7TbLrHw76T6t33hZ6HwM88hmfVt.jpg) --- They can take away the freedom to express oneself, even respectfully, to move about freely, to have control over one’s own body, and even to make decisions that affect one’s own life. This has been done many times, under the pretext that the government is looking after people. Is it looking after people, or is it subjugating them? It is such a controversial issue, where many may hold differing views. Perhaps it is a utopian ideal, but if societies were to adhere to standards, not rules, but standards, perhaps there would be no need for those governments that can turn against the people. Ever since man has been man, there have always been leaders, but as extremes are never good, the existence of such a leader can steer society in opposite directions. For all these reasons, I would prefer a world without rules or governments, but one that always adheres to standards. It is not a simple matter, as in certain áreas, such as work, sport and others, specific rules are necessary; otherwise, everyone would do as they pleased. It is a subject as complicated as human nature itself. I think what I’d like is just that… a utopia, a world where everyone acted correctly, with values and principles towards themselves and others. But practice shows otherwise, unfortunately. --- ![20260515_191834.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23y8gmX26pTx6uJCkHGjanqBm8FxDJ1wwXg48A5rU5VEa6Z1gesywW8SW85LH9wN3PhsL.jpg) --- |||| |-|-|-| |||| |||| I thought I’d have to turn to Hitler to answer this question, but he wasn’t the right person to ask, as he didn’t value life, an ageold principle. I preferred to talk about what my inner self would like. Thank you @galenkp for these [weekend topics](https://peakd.com/hive-168869/@galenkp/weekend-engagement-topics-week-310), which give us the chance to reflect and interact by exchanging views. Thank you very much to everyone for reading today; I wish you all a very good weekend. See you soon. Amonet. |||| |-|-|-| |||| ||||
All the photographs are mine. Used translator [Deepl.com](https://www.deepl.com/translator) free version.

links.body:
![COVER.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rsphotos/23tvCoYcU27dYfAr3Jaw9jDq7SQh4jgdeZoUzxdyri4jJBn6zUE6LyHEugrgmS981JTPy.jpg)

These are the final photos and the last post I’ll be sharing about the city of Split. I’ve been thinking for a while about how best to present them. They mainly feature the architecture of various buildings that caught my eye while exploring the city. Since it’s all about architecture, both color and black-and-white versions will work well.


> <sub>**[ PL ]**</sub>
> To już ostatnie zdjęcia i ostatni post jaki będzie dotyczył miasta Split. Przez jakiś czas zastanawiałem się w jaki sposób je przedstawić. Jest to przede wszystkim architektura różnych budynków, które zwróciły moją uwagę podczas zwiedzania miasta. Skoro architektura to wersja kolorowa oraz B&W będzie odpowiednia.


![RSphotos-24-06-07-RSP_7304.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rsphotos/23xedWu98r3EviCqhkZYLZKoN1VPZpt8o35GkF43yrsnzEKKQHHjqsN2DFa96VR1jW7LR.jpg)

The first building is located on the southern side of Republic Square. I posted photos of this square in [this post](https://peakd.com/hive-194913/@rsphotos/photo-trip-croatia-republic-square-in-split).

> Pierwszy budynek znajduje się przy południowej części Placu Republiki. Zdjęcia z tego placu pokazałem w [tym poście](https://peakd.com/hive-194913/@rsphotos/photo-trip-croatia-republic-square-in-split).

![RSphotos-24-06-07-RSP_7306.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rsphotos/23ynJ8iya8KdmJoDf45J4BSiGZxW6Wzb254rF8vENywLHh1QLhhsQaxzgwSmd1iAkVCNd.jpg)

A little further south is the 13th-century Church and Monastery of St. Francis, though a white car in the foreground partially distracts the eye. In the background, however, you can see a palm tree and the Adriatic Sea.

> Kawałek dalej na południe znajduje się Kościół i klasztor św. Franciszka z XIII wieku, chociaż na pierwszym planie częściowo odwraca uwagę białe auto. Natomiast w tle widać palmę i Morze Adriatyckie.

![RSphotos-24-06-07-RSP_7311.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rsphotos/23zGRy156F8Tx91qa5JavZMHBFPaFHcpyFgFbAvAtMFrdt8tA89A14X1NeReXcUbvfwyp.jpg)

This time, we’re heading to a spot about 200 meters north of Republic Square. The photo shows the Church of Our Lady of Health.

> Tym razem przenosimy się w miejsce oddalone o jakieś 200 metrów na północ od Placu Republiki. Na zdjęciu widzimy Kościół Matki Bożej Zdrowia.

![RSphotos-24-06-07-RSP_7314.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rsphotos/23xyQd4gLUMBDktRH8J5UU8soQnMzWTK6wj9LLpu6wGJ5NdSe3XdKzTmkjhY3ndVvuzHc.jpg)

Next to the church is the Croatian National Theater in Split. The building was constructed in 1893; it was destroyed by fire in 1970 and reopened in 1980 after being rebuilt. In front of the building stands the Gajo Bulat Monument.

> Obok kościoła znajduje się Chorwacki Teatr Narodowy w Splicie. Budynek powstał w 1893 roku, w 1970 roku zniszczył go pożar, w 1980 roku po odbudowie został ponownie otwarty. Przed budynkiem stoi Pomnik Gajo Bulata.

![RSphotos-24-06-07-RSP_7318.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rsphotos/23xKnAtHqkVwh3jPjNoHa4JJxdLiuXNnTA5ezFZK55m9KsTkVkyPQfuviaRxP7vpjhuQs.jpg)

In general, the center of Split features a variety of buildings from different eras, ranging from Roman times to the present day.

> Ogólnie w centrum Splitu znajdziemy różne budynki z różnych epok, od czasów rzymskich po obecne.

---

Below are B&W versions of the photos above.

> Poniżej wersje B&W powyższych ujęć.

![RSphotos-24-06-07-RSP_7304X.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rsphotos/23wC5ACXS4DwZDVMV5CkE3xD6tpHKgXMb8j4JDF6PRrUHECFCjgDEpVHePY4MbexVXPAr.jpg)

![RSphotos-24-06-07-RSP_7306X.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rsphotos/23wWtoZE3odQe7ysUbrzY9usN1DbE64QS2KsQ1xuBaafixNFkuLE1biWgs2W4yA6iUVUp.jpg)

![RSphotos-24-06-07-RSP_7311X.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rsphotos/23wgB1PW7HnKVqW2jyiRtpzGBaYFyq6MQ3PvqUtiuNbYLpQxcQGptRasf7iAaDzFmXY2o.jpg)

links.body:
I don’t know who first said it, but they say it takes about 30 days or less to form a habit, and that includes physical habits! As for the pain, it usually eases off within a week as your body gets used to it; I find this happens when I start doing intense walks, but warming up and stretching at the end are essential when exercising.

Lots of people are passionate about exercise, cycling and the gym, and the important thing is that whatever you do makes you happy and is good for your life, so keep going, it’s not an addiction, it’s a discovery of something that fills the soul and does the body good. Big hug!🤗

>No sé quien será el sabio, pero un hábito se construye en unos 30 días o menos y los hábitos físicos están incluidos! Con respecto al dolor en una semana eso disminuye porque el cuerpo se va acostumbrando, me pasa cuando comienzo con las caminatas intensas, pero el calentamiento y estiramiento final son esenciales en el ejercicio.

>Mucha gente es apasionada del ejercicio, bicicleta, gimnasios y lo importante es que lo que uno haga lo haga feliz y sea bueno para la vida, así que sigue adelante, no es una adicción es un descubrimiento que algo que llena el alma y hac bien al cuerpo. Abrazo grande!🤗

body.title: Commencement of the Day’s Routine || A Typical Village Setting
body.body:
![IMG_20260530_083225_106.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pinkbeee/23yTbD27bvmqSDMjmHZnZnvtmBT9K7FujiQ8vFzghXdwoPRCFUbm4edPrZ6eQ2QSwowQc.jpg)


The day breaks with sounding cock-crows from different locations. The chirping birds, the bleating goats and the growling pig.

The cry of a new born baby is heard in the neighborhood, the clinging of plates from the early wakers and the sound of sweeping becomes an alarm.

She gets up from her comfy wooden bed and steps outside to receive fresh air. She is bitten by sandflies and morning mosquitoes.

Notwithstanding all these, she picks up her broom by the balcony and begins to sweep her surroundings filled with fallen dried leaves from the tree and other forms of dirt.

After sweeping, she embarks on fetching some water from the nearest community borehole. She fetches this water into a big drum in her house and she ensures that she fills this drum with water. 


![IMG_20260529_151718_985.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pinkbeee/23vsLSuv6WQjPmHGNmgndJpV3YwzrKRsd2oJyqfa7CJcstu1iNzryimsCeXP6GyZrrN6L.jpg)


She fetches the water by filling her empty bucket which she takes to the borehole, lifts it up and places it on her head and heads back home.

The community borehole is free for everyone and that is where everyone gets their clean water from apart from water from the rain.

The road to the stream has become very far away for most people as bush tracks have been abandoned for new major roads built by the rulers. Making many people to resort to fetching water from the borehole. The streams are only visited once in a while.

After she finished filling her drum with water, she embarked on feeding her father's animals with their morning food.

She went over to the rabbits and fed them with their leaves. She also went over to the pig house and also fed them with their food. She fed the cat with pawpaw also and all the animals were happy.


![IMG_20260529_085241_998.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pinkbeee/23wWyPbreNjQmEy5HjQHxFjaJ9M8UEajdr8A7ef7Lim6BkW2sAqwCjg88QJsJGQrV6PCz.jpg)


After feeding the animals, she went over to select beans. She wanted to cook porridge beans for breakfast.


Leaves for the rabbits were remaining small. Later in the day she promised herself that she will go into the bush and fetch leaves for the rabbits to eat.

Market women were already on their way to the market, farmers began to flood the road with their hoes as they were on their way to the farm, as well as students who were going to school. 

What was your day's routine like?


![20260522_200556.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pinkbeee/23uQrdsjhRwt8Eq4afqJnL3JLPfbuR8q7WpNuG3LU8oMYwkUCToAh7dA4DwoAWdkjA9pC.jpg)

body.title: A PICTURE IS WORTH A THOUSAND WORDS _THE LAST DOSEN SHE WILL EVER MAKE.
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWXE658ZZ8YSNdwp4sdvGcWVXGf1y9788JnuNokGAjk2y/1780129769934.jpg)



     What I See
Flour dust hangs in the air like quiet snow. A woman leans over a round cake, her hands steady as she places tiny green leaves with a spatula. Pink roses already bloom on the others behind her. The kitchen is calm, but her eyes don’t look calm. They look like goodbye.

   What I Feel  
This feels like grief in disguise. Each petal is careful. Each leaf is perfect. She’s not just decorating cake. She’s pouring love into something temporary, knowing it will be eaten and gone in minutes. That’s the heaviest kind of love - the kind that knows it’s the last time.

    The Story: \

She was diagnosed on Tuesday. By Friday, she was in her daughter’s kitchen.

“Teach me,” she whispered, touching the spatula to the frosting. “So when I’m gone, you’ll remember how I made them.”

Her daughter swallowed hard. “Mama, don’t talk like that.”

But the woman just smiled and placed another leaf. “We all leave, my love. But memories? Memories can be sweet. If we make them right.”

One by one, she decorated twelve cakes. Not for a party. For a goodbye she wouldn’t attend. 

“See this green?” she said, guiding her daughter’s hand. “Not too much pressure. Just enough to leave a mark. That’s how you love people too.”

The pink roses were for joy. The green leaves were for peace. The flour on the table was for the messiness of living.

When the last cake was finished, she licked frosting off her thumb and winked. “Now you have a thousand words to remember me by. One for every petal.”

She never saw them eaten. But every time her daughter bakes now, the kitchen fills with more than flour. It fills with her.

   Because a picture really is worth a thousand words. Sometimes, it’s worth a whole lifetime.



   How the prompt led me to this:
The prompt photo shows someone decorating cakes with flowers so carefully, so lovingly. But the focus and tenderness in her hands felt deeper than just baking. It felt like someone creating beauty they won’t be around to see. That’s how “Last Dozen” was born - a story about leaving love behind in edible form.

title.title: FRIDAY'S PHOTOS - (PHOTOGRAPHY SERIES)
title.body:
![Tcats.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/AKRBWWjYKQvwjWvBLAYHcAaxsGdVDBV4G6EAJmnjCCyj8vZyneJmwVTGw2QfYuK.jpg)

----

**I**t's Friday morning, and looking out from my front door, I immediately notice that the fog has settled in. To the southwest, a huge, whitish, ground-level object is slowly advancing, illuminated by the light of a sun that's just beginning to rise on the horizon. So I grab my camera and send a message to everyone at home, letting them know I've gone for a walk. I do it through a WhatsApp group chat since everyone's asleep. As I walk down the street, I continue to observe my thoughts, as I've often done these past few days, and I notice that my head is getting lighter, which brings a smile to my face... 😉

>**E**s viernes por la mañana y, mirando desde la puerta de mi casa hacia la calle, me percato de inmediato de que la niebla viene a visitarnos hoy,  pues hacia el suroeste una \

blanquecina y a ras del suelo, avanza lentamente iluminada por la luz de un sol que apenas recién despunta en el horizonte. Entonces tomo mi cámara, dejo un mensaje a todos en casa diciéndoles que he ido a deambular por las calles un rato; lo hago a través de un grupo de mensajería de WhatsApp pues todos duermen... Mientras voy por la calle continúo \

tal como lo he hecho frecuentemente estos últimos días, y me percato de que cada vez mi cabeza está más ligera, y eso es algo que me dibuja una sonrisa en el rostro... 😉

title.title: India's Clean Fuel Mandate: The E20 and E30 Roadmap Explained 🚗🌱
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmae1BdbRD4o27BYLqbQxyu2kFqor9qCFy8xax7oDy2NvK/1780128956955.png)

Hey Hive and Ecency community Hope you all are doing great

Today let's discuss an important topic jo direct ham sabki pocket or hamari rides se juda hai Agar aap India mien rahte hai or bike ya car drive karte hai  toh aapne petrol pumps par E20 likha zaroor dekha hoga  In this post ham simple words mai samjhenge ki ye  naya rule kya hai and how it will affect your vehicle Let's dive in 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmciiVSyLP6Qy6pohyaRXwwoL54rNucRgPVD2BXhQbb69L/1780128981289.png)


🔥 What is Ethanol Blendingb Yeh Kya Bala Hai?

Simple language mai bolu  toh government pure petrol ke andar Ethanol mix kar rahi hai. Ethanol mostly ganne (sugarcane) or kharab anaj se banta hai 


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTtDu9wqnyngt2G8h5aFH3KtBBAjJ4877K8FGV3rujkup/1780129023411.png)


• E20 Fuel: It means 80% Pure Petrol + 20% Ethanol Yeh India ka current standard hai or market mai mil raha hai 

• E30 Fuel: This is the future target  jaha petrol mai 30% Ethanol blend kiya jayega 


📈 Phased Roadmap: Agle Kuch Saalo Ka Game Plan

India har saal baahar ke desho se crude oil (kachha tel) khareedne mai billion of dollars kharch karta hai. To reduce this dependenceb government ne ek proper timeline set ki hai


• E20 (Current): 20% Ethanol blend  jo fully implement ho chuka hai 

• E22 to E27: Phase-wise blending ko har saal badhaya ja raha hai 

• E30 (Target 2030): By the year 2030 government ka target petrol mai poori tarah 30% ethanol mix karne ka hai 



🌿 What are the Benefits? Hamein Kya Fayda Hoga?

This green initiative is very important for two big reasons:

1.) Greener Future: This fuel reduces harmful greenhouse gas emissions Matlab pollution kam hoga or hawa saaf rahegi 

2.) Economic Growth: Local level par ethanol banne se desh ka paisa desh mai rahega. It saves billions in foreign exchange 


⚠️ The Risk Factor: Kya Aapki Gaadi Safe Hai?

Now comes the most important question Agar aap ki gaadi purani hai or is naye fuel ke liye compatible nhi  hai toh major issues ho sakte hai 



• Low Mileage: Ethanol has less energy density than pure petrol isliye aapko thoda kam mileage mil sakta hai 

• Corrosion & Rusting: Ethanol moisture (paani) ko absorb karta hai This can cause rust inside your fuel tank and engine parts 

• Pump Failure: Non-compatible vehicles mien fuel pump jaldi kharab ho sakta hai 


The Solution: All new vehicles nowadays come with a Re-calibrated Engine (ECU) and compatible fuel pumps. Unme stainless steel ya special coating wale tanks hote hai  jo damage nhi  hote 


💬 What are your thoughts  Aapka Kya Kehna Hai?
Which car or bike do you drive? Kya aapki gaadi E20 compatible hain Do you think India 2030 tak E30 target successfully achieve kar payega Share your opinions in the comments section below 



NOTE 

Hey guys just a quick heads-up! All the core content and research in this post were done by me However  to make sure this complex topic is easy for everyone to understand I used some AI assistance to help polish and articulate the language perfectly

Also please note that all the infographic images used here are fully AI-generatednand it took a lot of time and effort to prompt and design them accurately Hope you find this presentation helpful and easy to follow
