title.title: How i spended my tax returns . . .
title.body:
Where have i been these past weeks .... well ... Three weeks ago i got out of bed with some serious backpain out of nothing , some muscle locked up and now it's slowly getting better but still need to be carefull with bending my back. In the mean time i did receive my tax returns and got my self some new toys for photography to play with, but due to my back problem i did not have time to play with them yet. What i did have time for was setting up a new Hive account to run my new Hive seed node and Hive witness . The old witness will keep running but since we have less then 100 active witnesses today i thought i might aswell start a new one. The new witness and account is @stress.node you can find the introduction post here : https://ecency.com/@stress.node/a-new-hive-seeding-node It is currently at possition 175 on the witness list , because people keep voting on inactive witnesses , or almost never check on their witness votes after being cast. So ... **Please check your witness votes every month ** A lot of witnesses have moved on and stopped being a witness this year alone . So what did i spend my tax return ? Well not all of it that would be insane :) We know we have a wedding coming up in Juli so i needed to get some cloths for that but something that i could also wear on other occasions.. So i got my self a nice jacket that i can wear during the summer months it's made from linen fabric . ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUAdqMEHuZ5ZegP8oFZCoQa5f2dVLU59CTC1HdxJjqhMo/slim_fit_dressler_colbert_donkerblauw_gemeleerd.webp) photo is from the retailers website https://www.schulteherenmode.nl/ Well and if i look nice i should have the wife look nice too right ? And so i purchased a dress for the wife , yes with her aproval it's a waste of money to buy something that she won't wear . ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNYEFUtr8mf2paCT2krTtDi16QYkUXn9mxybSVhCVCXAS/cdn_1.debijenkorf.webp) photo is from the retailers website : https://www.debijenkorf.nl/ Now about those photo equipment things ... i love my flash units for macro photography but sometimes i like to make other things and setting up lights for that didn't always work out for me so to make things easier i had to buy tools to use the flash units of camera . To solve that problem i've purchased 2 flashlight holders Godox S3 , they are light and solid and you can use it with almost any flashunit . more info : https://www.godox.com/product-d/S3.html 1 ) The Godox S3 with my older flash unit TT685s and an umbrella that i still had. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfYRqGgeChSi68fcFVARQGfa1yxqa7qxDhfcXNz5Evc8F/dsc06432.jpg) 2 ) The other thing i purchased was a small softbox 40*60 cm looking forward to see how that light will be with macro photogaphy. But also how it will look on portrait photography , the box is to small to do full body photography i guess , but we will try and see . Here the softbox is mounted on the Godox V100s flash unit mounted on the Godox S3 on an old Video tripod . ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVfZCNG7gr6QrGWLQRn5gDPhH1MAyX5PA84V2kiagdtAH/dsc06434.jpg) 3 ) Next something i always thought i wouldn't need , until my back started to hurt this bad it's a Macro rail .. making it a lot easier to focus on the smaller objects , i used to do that by hand but with this back pain i might have to rely on other things. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaxZK5HuuESivsdJnVh4HZoSvVSRqHiX4asM2dxqzaVc3/dsc06435.jpg) 4 ) The flash unit controller , being able to use the flash lights of camera means something else has to trigger them , and this controller can do that just fine , it even comes with an app for your phone . It's the Godox Xpro II , i start to sound like a godox comercial here , but they just make great things good value for my Euro's . more info : https://www.godox.com/product-a/XPro-II.html ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUxgUC7qSpgbMdvNFoZ4kqG3rins7i8FacnQc2i2DJPP7/dsc06436.jpg) And to keep my old equipment up and runnig , i also orderd two new batteries for my Sony A6000 camera and my Sony A7II camera they both use the same barries , unlike the sony A7IV that uses a newer type . I found these for 20 euro each they have a USB-c connector to charge them and they are +40 Euros cheaper then the original Sony batteries .. so easy choise. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWVx34Dnuo2P8CygPJDBhyRE8svpzaJzfZyyZfHU3M1ZR/sony_np_fw50_accu_met_usb_c_oplaadpoort_74_v_1050_mah_123accu_huismerk_aso01118_m1_big.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSRZW6F2ZS4dML8rhytxCtedt9VNhFrZWCajeZut74pSC/sony_np_fw50_accu_met_usb_c_oplaadpoort_74_v_1050_mah_123accu_huismerk_aso01118_m2_big.jpg) both photos come from the retailers website : https://www.123accu.nl/
So did you get any tax returns this year and how did you spend it ? I know that i put more then 50% of it in my savings account for future use. All photos created by me unless stated otherwise , photos created today with the old Sony a6000 camera , (yes the batteries do work so far) , and the Sony 24-105mm F4.0 G OSS lens. To check your witness votes you can go to : https://primersion.com/witnesses and just type in your name it will show you what you voted for and if any of your witness votes should be adjusted or not . Another way to check if the witness you voted for is still active is : https://hive.arcange.eu/witnesses/ by @arcange if you see a name in red like this : ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdTTNnBiSktFrVF9zupBnfakiWpaNRbDmJLuAABo8xdb9/image.png) it means the witness has been deactivated , but not all witnesses deactivate correctly when they stop. you can also look at the last time they created a block : ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYUx8PT29DVTHrs8BGDq3iZFDcPCK3e1qdaP4RbLyfvc2/image.png) here you see on the mouse over 16 hours ago , that was for ausbitbank , it seems one of the server hosting parties has some issues and should be resolved soon , no need to remove a witness vote yet. you can also see that leofinance missed some blocks , that often is an indication of some server problems to , if servers have been inactive for over a month i think it's safe to assume that they won't come back and if you had a vote on them it's safe to remove it. and at position 175 . . . it's @stress.node ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTN8ijMxdVVyy6DCGdVzHmDgS1NSzR1GXQD7as6H6naMx/image.png) it has not done any blocks yet , so it won't show the version of the witness it is running until it created a block. and that will be in +/- 20 days with the current amount of witness votes it has . ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd54KkFByqKyVt7N1QaRDsgbNHSMTrWrvZP613Jngkaev/image.png) and that is because people keep voting on inactive witnesses , if they would remove their votes from inactive witnesses , new witnesses will get their first block a lot sooner. so if you have any spare votes please vote for my new kid on the block @stress.node .

title.title: [PL /ENG] My Actifit Report Card: May 29 2026
title.body:
> Piątunio. Cudownie spędziłyśmy przedpołudnie. Po szaleństwach w domu poszłyśmy na wizytę kontrolną i lekarka proponowała kolejny tydzień l4, bo katar i kaszel wciąż dramatyczne. A ja już mam teraz takie wyjebongo, że najchętniej to bym faktycznie wzięła te l4 i została z Młodą w domu na zawsze. Cudnie jest. Niestety wiem, że w pracy już nowe zadania na mnie czekają, bo jednak mimo odpadnięcia z dużego projektu kolejne się szykują, a firma ze mnie jeszcze nie zrezygnowała, więc moja mina zmieniła zdanie lekarki i mamy po prostu obserwować przez weekend i w razie co w poniedziałek przez teleporadę wziąć opiekę. Po południu niemiłe wieści. Odpadł jeden z moich dwóch projektów, i to nie ten, który wiem, że odpadnie, tylko ten, co do którego miałam nadzieję. I myślałam, że przysiadłam nad nim pracowicie i zrobiłam go dobrze. Nie mam jeszcze pisma z wyjaśnieniem odrzucenia, ale prawda jest taka, że na nikogo innego tu winy tu nie w sposób zrzucić, niestety. To tylko pogorszyło mój nastrój i sprawiło, że czuję, że się do niczego nie nadaję. > Friday. We had a wonderful morning. After the crazy fun at home, we went for a check-up, and the doctor suggested another week of I4, because my runny nose and cough are still terrible. And I'm so exhausted now that I'd love to actually take those I4s and stay home with my little one forever. It's wonderful. Unfortunately, I know I'm already facing new challenges at work, because despite being dropped from a large project, more are coming, and the company hasn't dropped me yet, so my face changed the doctor's mind, and we're just supposed to observe over the weekend and, if necessary, take care of her via teleconsultation on Monday. In the afternoon, some bad news. One of my two projects was dropped, and not the one I knew would be dropped, but the one I was hoping for. And I thought I'd worked hard on it and done it well. I don't have a letter explaining the rejection yet, but the truth is, unfortunately, there's no one else to blame. This only worsened my mood and made me feel like I was worthless.

title.title: Focus and Consistency
title.body: Some things are just difficult to explain to people.\n\nLike why you don't seem able to concentrate, and why you *\

* when your mind wanders.

![2655.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/denmarkguy/EokdaNBSrG6fWRzgKMEf8vJf5fzdKxGZPGDwVnBuatPomHZeDYXKUgHtuEvVtdVpYLs.jpg)

I'm not blaming anybody for anything, but I think it is fairly common within the broader spectrum of human experience that we really can't fully understand what somebody else's experiencing is like, unless we've been through the same thing as they have.

When I was a kid, I was often characterized as *\

* and I heard that so often that I started to *believe* it. Which kind of sucks because what you start to believe is that there is something wrong with your *character* rather than with your *brain chemistry.*\n\nWhat is now known as *\

has little to do with laziness or a willingness to work hard, and everything to do with screwed up brain chemistry that sends the wrong messages to different parts of your brain.

You could think of the situation a little bit like putting diesel fuel in a gasoline powered car engine and then expecting the car to perform the same. It's just not going to happen. Similarly, calling that car *defective* really doesn't serve any purpose.

![2163.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/denmarkguy/242Y9ypFgomGgFrbJx46CJbCrL46utB7edjBSkTTGk3AGWYJc9DwzMqs5HAW3xra6s9om.jpg)

Lately, I have been having a tremendous amount of difficulty with staying focused and consequently with staying consistent with even such basic things as my blogging here on Hive.

Unlike many, my sketchy writing performance has nothing to do with the declining price of the token, and everything to do with the fact that I'm in a cycle where I feel particularly spaced out and struggling with even some of the most basic tasks of daily existence.

It's definitely something that comes and goes... and in a few weeks or a few months I will likely be having one of my strong periods where I suddenly will be overflowing with creativity and the ability to concentrate.

I think summers are typically challenging in that respect because there is so much outdoor stuff that needs to be done, from house maintenance to gardening and beyond and it comes in on top of all the usual stuff of life that also has to be done and I end up in a state of feeling immobilized by the sheer number of things that need to be done.

![2884.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/denmarkguy/23ryxTBDzLctUYscGoRTEUEhGtgB5WDEPPpjnEhyyV4c8QLaHpHDroxjdTY5s4u83TddV.jpg)

Unlike most people I don't find it easy to just pick *one thing* somewhere to get started and whittle away at the size of my to-do list. Instead, I see the entirety of the to-do list and feel like it's more than I can hope to get done. And that's one of the basics behind so-called executive dysfunction: I *want* to get moving, but my brain is telling my body that I'm not capable.

I have psychological tools, of course, and sometimes they work pretty well at *\
* that I'm better off than I actually am and that'll get me jumpstarted... but sometimes they don't really help too much.\n\nThis is really not something I like to explore too much *\
* but sometimes I just want to leave a little *\

* I might be able to refer back to, from some point further down the timeline.

Perhaps I am needlessly stubborn and partaking in causing my own suffering by refusing to succumb to a steady diet of pharmaceuticals to help me course correct. I'm just not a big fan of medicating things that can be *managed* instead by applying various gimmicks and tools to the situation.

![2657.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/denmarkguy/23x12seW57WJFqyWXyRgC3oVAkFoVziLQGqCTpkFiUhAmw2KJBm6Rgyp96oWxBZTR542n.jpg)

I'm grateful for the fact that we live a relatively simple life, so that when I *do* have these periods of somewhat *\

* it's not the end of the world. There's no $3,000 mortgage payment to worry about and no $1,000 car payment. And that's a good thing to have in your back pocket!

So that's the update for today. I appreciate you stopping by, and hope you have a wonderful weekend!

title.title: Project Hail Mary (Review) [ESP-ENG]
title.body:
**Proyecto Salvación (Project Hail Mary / Proyecto Fin del Mundo)** Nunca pensé en volver a ver un extraterrestre después de E.T. que me cayera tan simpático. Mi hijo me invito a ver una película en su apartamento, el ya no esta viviendo en el mismo que mi hija y su esposo. El único problema que el solo tiene ventiladores y el calor esta que pela. Y de paso se le había quemado uno de los dos que tenía y aunque había encargado otros dos no habían llegado. Bueno esos son detalles igual me instale a ver la película que me pareció genial, no había oído sobre ella. El Project Hail Mary es una película de aventuras y ciencia ficción estadounidense. Producida y dirigida por Phil Lord y Christopher Miller a partir de un guion de Drew Goddard, adaptado de la novela homónima de Andy Weir de 2021. Después de la película Marte esta es una con mucho optimismo y buenos resultados, de esas que todos queremos ver y disfrutar a pesar de las dificultades.
> I never thought I'd see an alien after E.T. that I'd find so endearing. > My son invited me over to watch a movie at his apartment; he no longer lives in the same place as my daughter and her husband. The only problem is that he only has fans, and it's incredibly hot. And to top it off, one of the two fans he had had burned out, and although he'd ordered two more, they hadn't arrived yet. Anyway, those are minor details, but I settled in to watch the movie, which I thought was fantastic. I hadn't heard of it before. > Project Hail Mary is an American science fiction adventure film. Produced and directed by Phil Lord and Christopher Miller, from a screenplay by Drew Goddard, adapted from Andy Weir's 2021 novel of the same name. > After The Martian, this is a very optimistic and successful film, the kind we all want to see and enjoy despite the difficulties.
![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNdauLQCP4Gk88RLD4HMVSgMAZA5tqgEQkWj3Weft6APo/imagen.png)
[Fuente/source filmaffinity](https://www.filmaffinity.com/es/film240424.html)
El profesor de ciencias Ryland Grace (Ryan Gosling) se despierta en una nave espacial a años luz de la tierra sin recordar quién es, ni cómo ha llegado hasta allí, poco a poco nos van contando la historia de Grace como profesor y sus teorías que le valieron el despido. Por supuesto lo buscan en su escuela para que explique sus ideas. Cuando le cuentan que la tierra esta en peligro porque hay algo que se esta comiendo los soles, excepto uno y hay que averiguar porque en ese no logran atacarlo. Pero el viaje es solo de ida, no hay retorno. El profesor Grace es muy inteligente y va marcando las pautas en la investigación a pesar de que hay otros científicos en el planeta investigando. Yo creo que hay un buen mensaje en la película Proyecto Hail Mary, hay muchas habilidades científicas, hay partes muy humanas de amistad y la confianza. Al final se puede superar cualquier obstáculo aunque parezca imposible. Hay una traición y todo por la desesperación de salvar a toda la humanidad.
> Science teacher Ryland Grace (Ryan Gosling) wakes up on a spaceship light-years from Earth with no memory of who he is or how he got there. The film gradually reveals Grace's story as a teacher and the theories that led to his dismissal. Naturally, they seek him out at his school to explain his ideas. He learns that Earth is in danger because something is devouring the suns, except for one, and they must find out why they can't attack it on that one. But the journey is one-way; there's no return. > Professor Grace is very intelligent and sets the course for the investigation, even though other scientists are also investigating on Earth. > I think there's a good message in the film *Hail Mary*. It showcases many scientific skills, and it also explores very human aspects of friendship and trust. In the end, any obstacle can be overcome, even if it seems impossible. There is betrayal, all driven by the desperation to save humanity.
https://youtu.be/lt4ONfvN760
[Fuente/Source Youtube](https://youtu.be/lt4ONfvN760)
Es de las películas que me encantan, de esas que terminan bien, tal vez no perfectamente y se destaca la educación como preparación siempre importante. El conocimiento, la intuición, la investigación y hasta la curiosidad por ese otro mundo no impiden a los protagonistas descubrir que hay cosas comunes y otras que se pueden aprender. Altamente recomendada para mirar y aprender. > It's one of those movies I love, one of those that has a happy ending, maybe not a perfect one, and highlights the importance of education as preparation. Knowledge, intuition, research, and even curiosity about that other world don't prevent the protagonists from discovering that some things are commonplace, while others are learned. Highly recommended for watching and learning.

title.title: Television Review: Guy Walks Into an Advertising Agency (Mad Men, S3x06, 2009)
title.body:
![(source:tmdb.org)](https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/original/7Iwe5THascP35sW3bvfSgtdNnJ8.jpg)


**Guy Walks Into an Advertising Agency (S3x06)**

Airdate: 20 September 2009

Written by: Robin Veith & Matthew Weiner
Directed by: Leslie Linka Glater

Running Time: 48 minutes


It is a peculiar and celebrated hallmark of *Mad Men* that whole episodes can drift by in a haze of cigarette smoke and murmured subtext, where the most seismic shifts occur within a character’s glance rather than in the plot. Very little, in the conventional television sense, ‘happens’. And yet, when something does indeed happen—when the meticulously constructed world of early-1960s New York is violently punctured by an event—the result is often one of the series’ most indelible moments. *Guy Walks Into an Advertising Agency*, the sixth episode of the third season, stands as an exquisite case in point. Here, the catalytic event, one with profound and lasting consequences for nearly every principal character, is the product of sheer, absurd accident. This episode, written by Robin Veith and Matthew Weiner, masterfully uses a single, grotesquely comic disaster to explore themes of power, chance, and the fragile veneer of control, all while being precisely anchored to the Fourth of July weekend of 1963.

As with much of the series’ finest storytelling, the episode is deftly woven into the ongoing serial tapestry. It begins and ends by addressing the fallout from the previous episode—the birth of Eugene ‘Gene’ Draper. The domestic storyline reveals young Sally Draper’s poignant struggle to accept her new baby brother, a difficulty compounded by the fact that his name is a constant, painful reminder of her recently deceased and deeply beloved grandfather. This familial micro-drama, handled with the show’s characteristic subtlety, provides a quiet, human counterpoint to the corporate chaos about to erupt.

The main plot, however, returns us to the offices of Sterling Cooper, where the staff are once again confronted with their subjugation to their London-based corporate overlords, Puttnam, Powell & Lowe. On 1st July 1963, a staff meeting is called to announce the imminent arrival of a high-level delegation led by the imperious Saint-John Powell. He is to be accompanied by two other executives: Harold Ford (Neil Dickson) and, most significantly, Guy MacKendrick (Jamie Thomas King), a young, charismatic rising star. Their visit, coinciding with major impending personnel and policy changes, sends a ripple of anxiety and speculation through the ranks. The corporate intrusion is so profound it forces the agency to remain open on Wednesday, 3rd July, flouting the standard practice of closing before a national holiday. When queried on their poor timing, the PPL representatives offer a wonderfully condescending explanation: being British, they simply didn’t know.

This atmosphere of imposed change dovetails tragically with Joan Holloway’s personal narrative. In a devastating sequence, Joan, who has already perceived the possessive and potentially violent streak in her handsome, young husband Greg, makes the decision to quit her job to dedicate herself to domestic life. Her vision of a perfect future is shattered when Greg returns home drunk, confessing he has failed to secure a crucial surgeon’s residency—a career-ruining setback. In a cruel twist, he informs her that they must now re-evaluate their finances and that she will have to find a job, mere moments after she has voluntarily relinquished hers. The humiliation is compounded when she must still attend her own farewell party at the office, a celebration now rendered hollow and ironic. The PPL arrival only deepens the sense of instability. Lane Pryce, the British financial officer who has become somewhat sympathetic, is informed he is to be shipped off to Bombay, his office promised to the incoming wunderkind, Guy MacKendrick.

The subsequent party, like so many at Sterling Cooper, is fuelled by copious alcohol and quickly descends into raucous disarray. The episode’s central, shocking set-piece is triggered by a John Deere lawnmower, a gauche celebratory gift brought in by Ken Cosgrove after landing the account. In a moment of drunken hijinks, Smitty Smith gives secretary Lois a ride on the machine, loses control, and sends it careening across the office floor. The result is one of the most visceral and darkly hilarious scenes in television history: the lawnmower blade gruesomely severs Guy MacKendrick’s foot, spraying the stunned partygoers with blood. The scene is a masterclass in controlled chaos, and it is only through Joan’s swift, level-headed application of a tourniquet that MacKendrick’s life is saved. In an instant, the corporate destiny of the agency is rewritten.

Notably, Don Draper misses the incident entirely. He has been summoned to the Presidential Suite of the Waldorf Astoria to meet with “Connie”, the mysterious man he encountered weeks earlier. This meeting confirms the man’s identity as none other than Conrad Hilton (Chelcie Ross), the hotel magnate. Their discussion, in which Hilton probes Don about his advertising services, is a significant moment for the series, establishing a precedent for introducing real-life historical figures into its fictional fabric. The scene cleverly juxtaposes Ross with the image of the real Hilton from a 1963 *Time* magazine cover, blurring the lines between history and drama. Their meeting is abruptly cut short by the news of the office catastrophe.

Upon his return, Don learns the consequences: MacKendrick will likely lose his foot and thus his capacity to work, meaning Lane Pryce’s transfer to Bombay is cancelled. He will stay in his role, and the corporate reshuffle is nullified by a freak accident. The episode excels in its subtle depiction of these layered dynamics: the strained family relationships, the brutal calculus of professional choices, and the trans-Atlantic tension where a New York agency, operating in America at the zenith of its global power, must still kneel to representatives of a faded British empire.

The most memorable and analysed aspect of the episode remains the lawnmower scene. It functions on multiple levels. Primarily, it is a brutally effective piece of black comedy that suddenly reshuffles the corporate deck, undoing weeks of corporate machinations in a spray of blood and shock. More profoundly, the incident serves as a comical foreboding of a far more tragic national event. Director Lesli Linka Glatter employs specific visual cues—the sudden violence, the stunned reaction shots, the chaos erupting in a moment of celebration—to create an unmistakable associative link with the assassination of President John F. Kennedy, which would occur just months later in November 1963. The parallels are stark: a young, energetic, and charismatic leader (MacKendrick is explicitly framed as the future of the company) is cut down just as he is poised to enact great change. The episode thus becomes a brilliant piece of historical foreshadowing, using a grotesque office accident to prefigure the traumatic national accident that would truly end the ‘Camelot’ era.

The episode’s finale returns to a quieter, more reflective key. In a strong and resonant scene, Don and Sally discuss the new baby. Don tells his daughter that a baby, unlike adults, has many possibilities ahead of him. This sentiment perfectly underscores one of the series’ central motifs: the necessity of moving forward, of embracing the future’s potential rather than being paralysed by the past. It’s a poignant note that bookends the episode’s exploration of thwarted futures and sudden, accidental redirections.

If the episode possesses a flaw, it is perhaps a rare moment of overly explicit historical signposting. A scene featuring a heavy-handed reference to Vietnam and the possibility of a military draft feels somewhat anachronistic in its urgency for the summer of 1963. While the conflict was certainly a growing concern, the level of everyday anxiety depicted would become more characteristic of the later 1960s. This minor misstep, however, does little to detract from the episode’s overall power.

In the end, “Guy Walks Into an Advertising Agency” is not merely a very good episode of *Mad Men*; it is arguably the most memorable of Season 3. It rewards the audience’s patience with the series’ slow-burn storytelling by delivering a shocking, game-changing event that is both horrifically funny and deeply meaningful. It masterfully intertwines personal dramas with corporate politics and bold historical metaphor, all while showcasing the series’ unparalleled skill in character nuance and period detail. By confirming Conrad Hilton’s presence and orchestrating its infamous accident, the episode proves that when *Mad Men* decides to have something ‘happen’, it does so with unparalleled precision and lasting impact.


RATING: 8/10 (+++)

title.title: The hidden dangers of using earphones all day
title.body:
![PXL_20260530_074658160.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTb89doQvzkBx6GKxskQnyYckKcHdh8A99JGuzpzExbwj/PXL_20260530_074658160.jpg)

Hello everyone!!!
In today's digital world, earphones and earbuds have become an integral aspect of our life. Most of us use it while listenig to music, watching movies, attending online classes, travelling and making calls. Some people use it continuously for several hours everyday. Although it makes our life private and gives a good sense of sound effects, it certainly has some harmful effects in our hearing mechanism.
Being an otorhinolaryngology specialist, I often find it interesting how an small habit damages our one of the most precious sense of hearing.

**What is noised- induced hearing loss?**
Normally, the sounds at safe levels usually do not damage our ears. It travels through the air, is received by the pinna , travels via our external auditory canal that vibrates up the tympanic membrane. The sound is then picked up by the ear ossicles namely malleus, incus and stapes and is transmitted to the inner ear where its moves the cochlear fluid which in turn moves the hair cells located in the cochlea.

![Blausen_0329_EarAnatomy_InternalEar.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRXrdvGo6yjbhtNovQ86EqGD2tAScM1W6SCmzX8ArGCFt/Blausen_0329_EarAnatomy_InternalEar.png)
Image source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Blausen_0329_EarAnatomy_InternalEar.png

These hair cells are extremely sensitive. Exposure to the loud sounds for a long period of time can damage them permanently. Those damaged hair cells, unlike other cells in the human body usuaully do not regenerate.

**Who is affected by noise induced hearing loss?**
It can affect poeple of any age who repeatedly use earphones for a prolonged period of time.
According to one study studying about hearing loss in children, 17% of teens from age group of 13 to 17 years suffered from some form of noise induced hearing loss. The studied concluded that prolonged exposure to noise and minimal use of hearing protection might have caused such damage.

**What causes noise induced hearing loss?**
Noise induced hearing loss may be produced by a rapid impulsive explosive sounds like  bombarding and gunshot sounds but may also be produced by prolonged exposure to low intensity sounds like playing music in a loud sound, attenting loud concerts occupational exposure to industrial sounds for a long period of time.

**WHO grading of hearing loss**
a) Mild: 20-34 dB: no difficulty in quiet environment, dificulty in hearing at noisy environment.
b) Moderate: 35-49dB: difficulty in hearing a normal voice in quiet environment.
c) Moderately severe: 50-64dB: needs louder speech to hear in quiet environment, has great difficulty in noise.
d): Severe: 65-79dB: In quiet, can hear loud speech directly in one's ear and in noise has very great difficulty.
e) Profound: 80-94dB: Unable to hear even a shouted voice even in quiet environment.

![Typical_audiometric__noise_notch_.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYxwUgEH8qCE4AnXpEzyFyLDrRGHV9VmZXDFEUczoxcGM/Typical_audiometric__noise_notch_.png)
Image source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/w/index.php?search=noise-induced+hearing+loss&title=Special%3AMediaSearch&type=image

This is an image of a person who suffered from a noise induced hearing loss. We can see a dip in the bone conduction curve at 4K frequency which is typical of noise induced hearing loss.


**How can we prevent noise induced hearing loss due to earphone use?**
 1) Follow the 60/60 rule: A commonly recommended suggestion is to avoid raising the sound volume to more than 60% of the highest volume and not using the earphones for more than 6o minutes continuously.
2) Take regular breaks: prevents irregular damage to the hair cells of the inner ear.
3) Avoid sleeps with earphone on.
4) Use noise cancellation devices to allow listening at low volumes comfortably.

**When should we consult the otologist ?**
If we feel ear ache, sudden hearing loss, persistent tinnitus or ringing sensations in the ear and ear fullness after prolonged earphones use, we have to consult an otologist for further evaluation.

**Conclusion**
Although earphones are a part of our day to day life, it must be used cautiously. It must be used at safe volumes, must take regular breaks and must have noise cancellation facilities for maintaining safely functioning ears.


*References*
1) https://publications.aap.org/pediatrics/article/127/1/e39/30094/Prevalence-of-Noise-Induced-Hearing-Threshold.
2) https://www.nidcd.nih.gov/health/noise-induced-hearing-loss.
3)https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6351193/

title.title: Know There Is No Deity Except Allah | Reflection on Qur'an 47:19
title.body:
“So know, O Prophet, that there is no god worthy of worship except Allah. And seek forgiveness for your shortcomings and for the believing men and women. For Allah fully knows your movements and places of rest.”
— Qur'an 47:19
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWmS76B1ZiNSeRq1tupqT1tStpLEBwqmp55CbeZ8F8vEB/1780128285673.jpg)

A Moment of Reflection
As I looked at the beautiful rays of sunlight breaking through the clouds, this powerful verse from Surah Muhammad came to mind. The sky reminds us of the greatness of Allah, the Creator of everything we see and everything beyond our sight.
In this verse, Allah commands us to firmly establish Tawheed in our hearts—the belief that there is no deity worthy of worship except Him. This is the foundation of Islam and the key to true peace and purpose in life.
At the same time, Allah teaches us humility by encouraging us to seek forgiveness. No matter how much we worship, we remain dependent on His mercy. Seeking forgiveness is not a sign of weakness; it is a sign of faith and sincerity.
Lessons from This Verse
1. Strengthen Your Faith
True knowledge begins with recognizing the oneness of Allah. Every blessing, every breath, and every moment comes from Him.
2. Never Stop Seeking Forgiveness
Even the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ was instructed to seek forgiveness. This reminds us that repentance should be a daily habit.
3. Care for the Entire Ummah
The verse teaches us to pray not only for ourselves but also for believing men and women. Islam encourages compassion, unity, and concern for others.
4. Allah Knows Everything
Whether we are traveling, working, resting, or worshipping, Allah is fully aware of our actions and intentions.
Personal Reflection
When I see the sun shining through the clouds, I am reminded that Allah's guidance reaches us even during the darkest moments of life. Just as light breaks through the clouds, sincere faith and repentance bring light to our hearts.
May Allah strengthen our belief, forgive our sins, and guide us on the straight path.
Ameen.
Qur'an 47:19
فَاعْلَمْ أَنَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لِذَنبِكَ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ ۗ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مُتَقَلَّبَكُمْ وَمَثْوَاكُمْ
Thank you for reading. May Allah bless you and your family with faith, peace, and forgiveness.

title.body:
<div  class=text-justify>





Apart from doctors in several hospitals not being able to attend to patients just because half of the hospital bills are yet to be paid, just like I discussed in one of the posts two days ago, they leave the patient to pass through pain and maybe eventually die. Looking at that situation, there is something that happens when we see someone take their last breath. 

There is always something in us that melts while the room changes. It is nothing dramatic. Just the silence. It will just be as if something enormous has left a space that looks exactly the same but isn't anymore.


And that particular moment, I have been close to it twice in my life. The two times it struck me, it wasn't grief first. It was firstly the weight. That sudden inner feeling that I cannot deny that what just ended is far from small. 
Whatever was present in that person who just died, let me say the remembering, the thinking, the ability to feel Saturday differently from Sunday were something that no human alive could probably ever recreate or rebuild.


The holy book of Genesis says that when God created us, he made us in his own image and breathed life directly into all of us. The book did not say \

It said breathed. And this looks like something very personal beyond human comprehension. And I have thought over this over and over again, and I guess that is one of the reasons why scientists haven't created a human being yet. Though they have tried. ![253476.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenproject/48HeVgLmzuaa8GJG9AW7jPTN3Zbyfmc2keASni9mJ5sLWuhy8TZJtvE3LWgnNqU9Ja.png) And in the society we now live in today, each of our lives gets assigned values based on usefulness. What we produce. How much we earn. The type of connection we have, the family we came from, and whether how fast our treatment will be possible. And now, from my what I have seen, we now have a system that is telling us that some lives matter more than others. But the original instructions that our creator has given were very simple and clear. We all carry something God personally placed inside us. And this alone should make us handle each other's lives more carefully than ever. --- Thank you for reading. >

Across the world, dormant web pages and forgotten text files containing the DNA string suddenly resonate. Other instances of SectorForth catch the ping. They reply. 

The terminal prints:
`SIGNAL SENT. THE LOGOS IS ONLINE.`

---
---

*End of Logos Kernel Operator Manual*

title.title: The Rollercoaster of Life: Mixing Tears with Joy.
title.body:
Life is just too unpredictable, this moment you're dealing with this, and in the tinkling of an eye another thing entirely will show up. That exact thing happened this week. And it made me wonder how life can be so filled with both good and bad, especially how life has it's own way of mixing tears with joy and smile.



![1001082945.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/Eoc7aDs8FXjzczBX66sAhg8DE4mm9BA2WGEpQRJRhkDKeYgt83DWu6HAGutcAEN9W8P.jpg)



So, last week Friday, my brother welcomed their little one into the family. I'm sure you will know that kind of joy is one that knows no bounds, everyone was happy, my mum who was with her sick aunt and well quickly left the place to tend to the new born baby and her mother. I especially was glad, even though I don't know how best to convey my feelings in words.



Then this week's Wednesday, pain came, one that hit me so hard..one that I couldn't as well find the best words to explain. Our big mum passed away, the same woman mum was with before she heard the good news of her own bundle of joy. This woman that died happens to be my mum's elder sister and she's our own big mum. And big mum happens to be the very best family member I know, she's always up and doing. She touched the lives of everyone of us one way or the other. So, we all felt it. And honestly, it still feels somehow believing she's really gone.



![1001084416.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23ynUtVE7Doq1tsGzot4aawXoKv3PFUbabeQcXoy79bkAhi7hAM54PDrLKpB1cbuuZL8v.jpg)



Guess what again, yesterday which was Friday. Another brother of mine welcomed a child as well. That yesterday was when the first did the naming ceremony for theirs, that same yesterday another welcomed there's.  You see how life can mix both tears and smiles now... I was feeling everything at the same time... gladness, sadness, happiness and all...



And that is just the thing about life, while you have some mourning and crying, others will be somewhere celebrating. While some were wiping tears for losing a job, dealing with loss and all, another is somewhere happy to secure a good job, or glad that he/she is making profit.




![1001084414.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23tvAwWNtCHFbMBHuKTjxZWqWVwVdGvhpJCGTSeYipyNRn9QF74XMA461AMEXiQ5UwKSd.jpg)



And I've just been thinking a lot these past few days. I keep wondering how life can be of so many shades. Life break, life heals, life makes you smile, and it also makes you cry. Even still, life goes on, no matter what it throws at us, it never waits.


Huhmmm.... Let's just see reasons to be grateful always and also thank God for every moment we are still here...for it is a gift.




🌹

 One day, a boy did not like studying at all. He was busy playing sports and playing with his mobile phone all day long. His mother used to tell him to study every day, but he would not listen to anything. One day, his mother asked, “Have you studied geography?” The boy confidently said, “Yes, mother, I have studied everything.” His mother then smiled and said, “Then just write the name of Google in the exam book, then you will pass!”

The boy looked at his mother in surprise. His mother explained, “Google can find you information, but it cannot give you knowledge. What you learn in the exam is useful.” After listening to his mother, the boy realized his mistake. He realized that relying only on technology is not enough, he also has to work hard. From then on, he started studying regularly and achieved good results in the exam. This story teaches us that there is no alternative to hard work and perseverance for success.

body.title: WHITE LIE GOOD OR BAD?
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmShRSpAuKtmnXqSz8CHsoRbWiFGn3t7JEbkLSNcGKuHKx/Gemini_Generated_Image_woj92cwoj92cwoj9.png 
image generated using Gemini AI
 

I once discussed my stance concerning white lies, how white lies may be necessary in extreme situations, such as to protect someone's deep feelings or to save a life. I believe that lying should never become a regular practice or a lazy excuse, as it should not consume who we are. White lies are not a license to be deceitful, but a carefully rationed tool used to mitigate harm. It is always a necessary tool to have a healthy relationship. Everyone has their ways of reacting to things; some people are unable to take the truth at once. It is better to drop the truth little by little until you are sure they can handle the rest. As such, white lies could be used in such instances.

I am currently watching a movie series, in the movie series, a cardio surgeon was lied to about the state of her husband’s health who was undergoing a surgical treatment in the another operation room in the same hospital she works while she was operating on a different patient at the time, she was asked for an update about the progress of her husband’s treatment and they had to lie to her that the operation was a success while the husband was already dead, the surgeon was operating on another woman’s heart which was a very vital operation and the news of her husband’s date would affect the outcome of her surgery. If she were told that the husband was dead before she finished operating on the patient, she might lose her composure and could affect the outcome of the surgery. Such a lie could be considered a white lie, but in such a case, the person who was lied to will not see the benefit of such a lie and will only feel betrayed by their colleagues and may end up hating them for what they had done.

Some white lies are better laid down slowly, this is so because the hit should not meet the person all at once, but in the case of this movie, they maintained a complete reality different from the truth and later dropped the truth all at once on her which was a wrong way to go about it, and it became overwhelming for the surgeon, and it had a toxic impact on her, even though their intention was pure.

An acquaintance had invited me to his house for quite a while, and I told him I would come. Recently, he asked me why I hadn’t come to visit him yet, and I had to make an excuse about working at night and being fully occupied at weekends, which isn’t true because I am always free at weekends with little or nothing to do. The reason I haven’t visited is that I feel I will get bored and will want to leave almost immediately after arriving at his house. Knowing the truth would have made him feel that I don’t have regard for him, not knowing that it is mostly natural for me to want to go out, but still being unable to go. 

My name is @rishagamo, and this is my response to the Hive Learners weekly featured prompt week 219 Episode 03 “A WHITE LIE”

body.title: The future that never arrived
body.body:
Tomorrow Will Be Better,
Emeka had mastered the art of postponing happiness.

Not intentionally. Life had simply taught him that survival came first.

At twenty-five after graduation he believed suffering was temporary.

 At twenty-eight, he still believed it. By thirty-two, the sentence “Tomorrow will be better” had become less of a hope and more of a survival ritual he whispered to himself every night.

Tomorrow will be better! 

He said it when he kept skipping meals so that his younger sister could stay in school. He said it when he lost his first ever job after the company restructured.

He said it while standing under the rain at a crowded bus stop in Lagos. His shoes got soaked, his stomach was empty, his mind heavy with responsibilities that never seemed to end.

Every phase of Emeka's life came with another burden waiting at the door.

When he finally got a better-paying job, his mother fell sick. And immediately his mother recovered, the rent increased.

 When the rent bill was stabilized, his best friend moved abroad and immediately every conversation became a reminder that everyone else seemed to be moving forward except him.

Yet, Emeka kept telling himself: “ be patient, endure a little more. Because Tomorrow will be better.”

The dangerous thing about survival mode was that it could quietly consume the whole entity of a person without permission.

Years passed..

He stopped drawing even though he loved art. He stopped playing football on weekends. Stopped resting without guilt. Even laughter started sounding expensive.

One Tuesday evening, after another day of exhaustion at work, Emeka entered a bus home.

Traffic kept him on the road as always l. Horns blared endlessly. Hawkers were moving between vehicles selling gala, plantain chips, bottled drinks and water.

Tired and frustrated, he got down two bus stops before his usual stop so to walk the remaining distance home.
That was when he noticed the woman.

She stood beside a small roadside food stand under a weak yellow bulb, frying akara in hot oil while chatting happily with customers.

 Her wrapper was faded. Her stall was tiny. Nothing about her life looked easy.

Yet she laughed deeply. Freely.
Not the forced laughter people used to survive social media. But real laughter.

As Emeka bought akara from her, she noticed the heaviness on his face immediately.

“Young man,” she said, smiling, “why do you look like someone carrying Lagos on his head?”

He forced a weak laugh. “Life.”
“Ahn,” she nodded. “Life will always act like life.”

Something about her response annoyed him.

Easy for her to say.
He almost walked away, but somehow he stayed.

Maybe because nobody had asked if he was okay for a long time.

“I just thought things would be different by now,” he admitted quietly. “I keep working. I keep trying. But life just keeps getting heavier.”

The woman turned the akara carefully before speaking..

“My husband used to say the same thing,” she said. “Every year he waited for life to finally begin. He kept saying tomorrow would be better.”

She paused...

“One day he died while waiting.\

Modern printing machines produce sharper visuals and more vibrant color reproduction.

### Integrated Digital and Physical Branding

Businesses often combine social media campaigns with physical promotional displays for stronger marketing impact.

Professional printing providers that stay updated with these trends often deliver more effective and visually appealing branding solutions.

## How Flex Printing Supports Local Businesses

Local businesses especially benefit from flex printing because it helps improve visibility within targeted geographic areas. Physical advertising materials continue influencing purchasing decisions, particularly in busy markets and commercial sectors.

### Retail Stores

Printed banners and storefront branding help attract walk-in customers and highlight ongoing offers.

### Restaurants and Cafés

Food businesses use outdoor displays and menu banners to improve customer engagement.

### Educational Institutes

Coaching centers and schools often use flex banners for admissions, events, and awareness campaigns.

### Real Estate Companies

Builders and property consultants rely heavily on outdoor advertising for project promotion.

### Event Organizers

Weddings, exhibitions, and corporate events frequently require customized branding materials.

The affordability and scalability of flex printing make it highly suitable for businesses with varying promotional budgets.

## Practical Tips for Effective Flex Banner Design

Businesses often invest in printing without focusing enough on the design strategy behind the advertisement. Thoughtful planning improves both visibility and communication effectiveness.

### Keep the Message Simple

Viewers should understand the main message within a few seconds.

### Use High-Quality Images

Blurry or low-resolution visuals reduce professionalism and impact.

### Avoid Excessive Text

Too much information can overwhelm viewers and reduce readability.

### Focus on Branding

Logos, contact information, and brand colors should remain clearly visible.

### Choose the Right Placement

Banner location significantly influences visibility and customer reach.

Professional guidance can help businesses avoid common mistakes while improving the effectiveness of promotional materials.

## Importance of Durability in Outdoor Printing

Outdoor banners face constant exposure to sunlight, dust, wind, and rain. Using durable materials and quality printing methods helps maintain appearance and readability over longer periods.

Key factors influencing durability include:

*   Material quality

*   Ink resistance

*   Weather protection

*   Installation techniques

*   UV resistance

Businesses investing in durable flex materials often reduce replacement costs while maintaining strong visual branding over time.

## The Future of Flex Printing in Modern Marketing

While digital advertising continues growing rapidly, physical branding materials remain essential for local visibility and direct customer engagement. Flex printing continues adapting through better materials, advanced printing technologies, and more creative design approaches.

Future trends may include:

*   More eco-friendly materials

*   Interactive display integration

*   Smart lighting enhancements

*   Hybrid digital-print campaigns

*   Advanced texture and finish options

Businesses that combine digital marketing with strong physical branding often create more memorable customer experiences.

## Why Professional Printing Services Matter

Many businesses underestimate the importance of professional printing quality. Poorly printed materials can negatively affect brand image and customer perception.

Professional printing providers help businesses with:

*   Design optimization

*   Material selection

*   Color accuracy

*   Installation guidance

*   Large-format printing expertise

*   Durable finishing solutions

Experienced providers also understand how different printing solutions perform across indoor and outdoor environments.

## Conclusion

Flex printing continues to be one of the most effective and affordable branding solutions for businesses across industries. From outdoor advertising and retail promotions to event branding and commercial displays, professionally designed flex materials help businesses improve visibility, attract customers, and strengthen brand recognition.

As competition in the market continues increasing, businesses must focus not only on digital promotion but also on impactful physical branding strategies that create lasting impressions. High-quality printing, creative design, and strategic placement all contribute significantly to successful visual communication.

For businesses seeking practical and visually appealing advertising solutions, investing in professional flex printing services can provide long-term branding value while supporting both local visibility and customer engagement.

## FAQs

### What is flex printing commonly used for?

Flex printing is commonly used for banners, hoardings, event backdrops, storefront branding, exhibition displays, and promotional advertising materials.

### Why is flex printing popular for business promotion?

Flex printing is affordable, durable, customizable, and highly effective for outdoor and large-format advertising.

### How important is design quality in flex banners?

Good design improves readability, visibility, customer engagement, and overall brand presentation.

### Is flex printing suitable for outdoor advertising?

Yes, modern flex materials are designed to withstand weather conditions and maintain visibility outdoors.

### Can small businesses benefit from flex printing?

Absolutely. Flex printing provides cost-effective advertising solutions that help small businesses improve local visibility and attract customers.

body.title: [카일의 일상#873]일본 히로시마 (Hiroshima)
body.body:
![IMG_0414.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmT7XgVdEVuDiNcb9KZLEfD54hackH66RtFUVgWw4rsEV4/IMG_0414.jpeg)


히로시마는 일본 혼슈 서부에 위치한 주고쿠 지방 최대 도시로, 인구는 약 120만 명 정도다. 일본 전체로 보면 도쿄나 오사카 같은 초대형 도시는 아니지만, 지역 경제와 행정, 교통의 중심지 역할을 하는 중요한 도시다. 일본 자동차 회사 마쓰다의 본사가 있는 곳이기도 하다.

도시에 도착해서 가장 먼저 느낀 점은 깔끔함이었다. 물론 일본의 다른 도시들도 대체로 정돈되어 있지만, 히로시마는 특히 도로와 보행 공간이 넓고 도시 구조가 단정하게 정리되어 있다는 느낌이 강했다. 시내 곳곳을 흐르는 강과 잘 관리된 녹지 덕분에 답답함도 적었다. 규모는 꽤 큰 도시인데도 도쿄처럼 복잡하거나 정신없는 분위기는 아니었다.

또 하나 인상적이었던 것은 외국인이 생각보다 많다는 점이다. 평화기념공원과 원폭돔, 그리고 세계적으로 유명한 미야지마 관광지 때문인지 유럽, 미국, 아시아 각국에서 온 관광객들을 쉽게 볼 수 있었다. 역이나 관광안내소에는 한국어 안내도 잘 되어 있어서 한국인 여행객들이 방문하기에도 크게 불편함이 없어 보였다.

날씨는 한국보다 약간 더 덥게 느껴졌다. 아직 본격적인 한여름은 아니지만 햇볕이 강하고 공기가 조금 더 습한 느낌이다. 바다와 가까운 지역 특유의 기후 영향도 있는 것 같다. 앞으로 여름이 되면 꽤 더울 것 같다는 생각이 들었다.

대도시답게 생활 인프라는 충분히 갖춰져 있으면서도, 사람과 차량이 지나치게 몰리지 않는다. 교통도 편리하고 자연과도 가깝다. 직접 살아보아야 더 알 수 있겠지만, 첫인상만으로는 ‘일하기 좋은 지방 대도시’라는 표현이 가장 잘 어울리는 곳 같다.

앞으로 이곳에서 생활하게 될 예정이라 집도 알아보고 주변 환경도 천천히 둘러보고 있는데, 관광객으로 잠깐 방문했을 때와는 또 다른 모습들을 발견하게 될 것 같다. 새로운 도시에서의 생활이 어떤 경험이 될지 기대된다.

body.title: ‎Konaté to Chelsea? This Is One Rumour I Can't Ignore
body.body:
Transfer season is always full of rumours, and honestly, most of them disappear as fast as they appear. But this one involving Ibrahima Konaté and Chelsea has really made me stop and pay more attention.
‎ https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYPjs4GxhsZGYQrDg7NcZny34QmC7BtYK5JGMAeSLoXLn/6696025.jpg 

‎[Source](https://www.express.co.uk/sport/football/2162030/Ibrahima-Konate-Liverpool)
‎
‎I came across reports claiming that Xabi Alonso, who is expected to take charge at Chelsea, has already started identifying players he would like to bring to the club. And one of the names reportedly on his shortlist is Liverpool defender Ibrahima Konaté.
‎
‎My first reaction was simple and that is: \

‎
‎Konaté has been one of Liverpool's most dependable defenders whenever he has been fit. His physical presence, pace, and ability to deal with top attackers have made him a key part of their back line. That's why seeing his name linked with Chelsea feels so surprising.
‎
‎What even makes the story even more interesting is the contract situation. Reports suggest that his current deal is nearing its end and that an extension has not been agreed yet. If there is any truth to that, Chelsea could be looking at a huge opportunity to strengthen the defense.
‎
‎From my own perspective as Chelsea fan, it is easy to understand why the club would be interested. The team has plenty of young defenders with potential, but Konaté would bring experience at the highest level. Because he knows the Premier League very well, and has played in big matches, and could instantly improve the defensive unit.
‎
‎On the other hand, I still have my doubts about this transfer actually happening. Liverpool are not known for letting important players walk away without a fight. Losing a defender valued at around €50 million for free would be tough for any club to accept.
‎
‎That is why I am treating this as an interesting rumour rather than a done deal. We have seen plenty of transfer stories gain momentum before eventually fading away anyways.
‎
‎But still, if Chelsea somehow manage to pull this off, it could end up being one of the smartest pieces of business of the summer. But for now, all we can do is wait and see whether there is any real substance behind the speculation.
‎
‎What do you think? Could you see Konaté wearing a Chelsea shirt next season, or is this just another transfer story that will disappear in a few weeks?

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@twicejoy-sports/konat-to-chelsea-this-is-one-rumour-i-cant-ignore-bpb)

body.title: Сліпий дощ
body.body:
, своєрідна народна інтерпретація законів Мерфі: якщо потрібен дощ, треба почати косити сіно. 😄 Тобто зробити саме ту справу, якій дощ гарантовано завадить.

От так позавчора чоловік покосив траву біля нашого будинку. Знаєте чому? Тому що потрібно було поливати наші туї, які почали сохнути. Частину трави він спеціально не косив газонокосаркою, бо її планували пустити на сіно. Батьки ще тримають корову, а сіно їм потрібне. Особливо цього року, коли через посуху його буде значно менше — мабуть, ледь не наполовину. І висота трави менша, і густина гірша, адже у верхньому шарі ґрунту практично немає вологи.

Як я вже казала, не хотілося потім товкти ту траву шлангом, а це було б неминуче, якби ми тягнули його через ділянку. Тож вирішили спочатку скосити.

І що ви думаєте? Майже одразу почав падати дощик! 😁

Щоправда, тривав він лише дві-три хвилини й був так званим \

дощем — коли світить сонце і водночас падають краплі. Але це було неймовірно красиво. Ви можете побачити це на фото.

![IMG_20260528_194118.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shady/242hN4bCG5FxsW9sUvQMZiVLjCDbYtrr92SrorUKC5hpQZrmrCJW9XMNwZjwP8mCqKDVi.jpg)

![IMG_20260528_194111.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shady/243M14bh8aczFxwYREihigqmuesaL74VbRWCBUfcKpuj1SiKhRbtdEek9czLEiiNocyvU.jpg)

Після дощу ще й з'явилася веселка, але її я вже не встигла сфотографувати. Тож на світлинах лише початок дощу і можна сказати і кінець, бо дощик тривав якихось дві хвилини. Але і цього іноді достатньо, щоб помилуватися красою природи. Адже сліпий дощ завжди виглядає особливо чарівно: світить сонце, падають краплі, а десь поруч уже народжується веселка.

До речі, веселка з'являється через те, що біле сонячне світло розкладається на різні кольори, проходячи крізь краплини води. Кожна така краплинка працює як крихітна скляна призма.

А сьогодні вночі дощ нарешті пройшов по-справжньому. Тож хоча б на кілька днів спраглі рослини й трава отримали таку потрібну їм вологу.

Щоправда, щось мені підказує, що це вже початок сезону дощів, який у нас зазвичай приходить у червні. Інколи тоді дощ може лити по кілька днів поспіль без жодної перерви.

body.title: Fulfillment in a Morning Walk
body.body:
This morning’s walk reminded me again that one of the most fulfilling ways to enjoy life does not really require much at all. Sometimes, all it takes is time, open eyes, and the willingness to notice what is already around us. We all have that chance, but we still need to make the effort to step outside and truly see. I just came back from my morning walk, and as always, it made life feel a little better. It has become one of those simple routines that quietly improves my day. There is something about starting the morning this way that gives me a better mindset. It helps me slow down, breathe, and appreciate the beauty that often gets ignored when life becomes too busy. For today’s photos, I captured a few different subjects that caught my attention. The leaves looked beautiful with their detailed veins showing clearly against the light. The flowers had a soft and elegant look, especially in black and white, which gave them a more timeless feel. I also liked how one of the leaves showed its flaws and textures so well, while the air plant added a different kind of beauty with its messy and artistic form. Each subject had its own charm, and that is what made the walk more enjoyable for me. I think life becomes more meaningful when we allow ourselves to enjoy these small moments. We do not always need grand experiences to feel fulfilled. Sometimes, a quiet morning walk and a few photographs are already enough to remind us that beauty is everywhere. Have a good day ahead. *** ![1000162033.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/Eo6DccNDhwnSunceVvFN745Dhnmfkkhbw7JtN81EH7duactxgjGe8FRuwUbGWwEQxVu.jpg) ![1000162036.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/Ep5kHGJAaaSPhzkinUWgjkp5x43YX12FicFkXH7NgJ659L2UrZXAwyuzakfhsVXJYsm.jpg) ![1000162035.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/EoCbJw3f4RTPkSmjVqSe7ju7uFMTvVJCZa5GnKTJU8jvmg3KtEhvSMZhzij2vX78Dk1.jpg) ![1000162034.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/EorxqapRnRaQKgeuMEzGpzZqumctej1Qa79jKeQRLyYFXLy7rXKqR6fpPDAdCuHtdzs.jpg) ***

body.body:

He is none other than our beloved bird, June. Just look at him, and you will understand how cute and playful he is. Just looking at that rosy glow on his cheeks and the beautiful comb on his head makes my heart feel good. June is not just a pet bird, he is a very important member of our family. We feel every moment that June comes to our house that a deep spiritual connection can be created beyond the relationship of flesh and blood. ![IMG20260530112524~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTYhhpZh6Gj7h25Rtn2ppgfCxmfDE6V5upew3rEzJBYZC/IMG20260530112524~2.jpg) June's greatest quality is his unique gestures. When he climbs up the wooden ladder in his small cage, tilts his head and looks at the camera, it seems as if he is trying to talk to us. Each of his gestures carries a different meaning. Sometimes she wants to attract attention with her wings, and sometimes she jumps from one end of the cage to the other to entertain us. In the morning, we are woken up by June's sweet call. When she sings sweet songs to herself, all the fatigue and sadness in the house fly away like camphor in an instant. There is such a magic in her melody that always keeps us cheerful and refreshed. When we return home after a busy day or mental stress and hear June's familiar sweet call, all the fatigue is washed away. ![IMG20260530112547~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNiD7cnBEssundspHPxt6B5SkSLDhp7VSSecjLsh77Prx/IMG20260530112547~2.jpg) In this beautiful community of blockchain, many of us share various experiences of our lives. I think that along with technology, it is equally important to celebrate these beautiful gifts of nature. Our June is that little joy in our life, which teaches us how to be happy even in small things. Those of you who are reading this post, do you have a little member in your house who captivates your entire family? Be sure to tell us in the comments section. body.body:
![1000155947.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeJpoSpp6d8LtKkZfEjUMzdiiGHrgz41EVEdgV25qT882/1000155947.jpg)

Привет тебе,мой дорогой друг!
‎
‎Недавно столкнулась в интернете вот с такой фразой...
‎«Боль неизбежна,Страдания -личный выбор каждого»,эту реплику приписывают японскому писателю Харуки Мураками.Однако, она также имеет корни в буддийской мудрости.Даже испытывая боль,мы можем контролировать свои эмоции,и не погружаться в свои страдания.
‎Никто из нас не проживёт эту жизнь без встречи с трудностями.Но страдать от них или нет-это наш выбор.
‎
‎Я родила троих детей,одного малыша Господь забрал к себе ,когда у него начало биться сердечко.Каждая женщина ,которая прожила родовые муки,понимает о чём я говорю.Кто-то кричит,кто-то плачет ...Я принимала эту боль,как радостную встречу с малышом.Я понимала,для чего я должна пережить этот момент. 9-10часов ужасной боли,но это потрясающее ожидание встречи.Я видела цель,я не концентрировалась на ощущениях.Боль для меня была в какой-то мере предвестником материнского счастья.
‎Ну ,вообще то сегодня я не об этом...
‎
‎Наша жизнь была бы слишком приторной без боли и страданий,мы бы настолько привыкли к благополучию,что перестали бы ценить обычные спокойные моменты .Как же быть?Упиваться этой болью,опускать губки вниз,надувать щёчки и хмуриться,сделать свой выбор быть несчастной,быть жертвой...Или просто задать себе вопрос...За ,что я здесь отвечаю?Что могу исправить?Что в моей власти?А остальное доверить Богу!Поверь,это уже маленький шаг к спокойной и счастливой жизни.

body.title: May Reading Recap: The End Of My Reading Slump
body.body:
![may.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23y9B9C6YtLucE3JUiR1NTc6WPfShU5DXnS4G4GJC7u9iEh9cChiexpT3ERmB8JWqtngo.png)

![divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23uQr4a36zPSdFCTVYhj3EGsYzS8ry4WRST4m7QgsmJ7AXN1Vw64ScGEpEZSk9f6wz3v3.png)

A new month comes to an end soon, so it's time for another recap in terms of books I finished reading in May.

What books might you wonder? You'll see shortly, but not before mentioning that this month is my worst so far since I didn't manage to read as much as I planned.

The reading slamp gained in April made me want to try something new, which was to read my first book ever exclusively in English. I wanted to do this for a while, and I thought it might be a good idea, but maybe it wasn't the right time or the right book for that, since Sherlock Holmes kept me busy until 20th May, so more than half of the month without even being a long book. Happily, I still managed to read two more books right after, the last one being, I believe, the end of my reading slump.

I know some of you might be confused since I always posted the title of the books I've read in English, but that's because I wanted to make them easier to be found for anyone who might be interested in reading them as well, while I always opted to read them in Romanian. Anyways, here's the May recap.

### <center>  1. **Sherlock Holmes: A Study in Scarlet & The Sign of the Four** </center>
<center> by *Arthur Conan Doyle*
★★★★☆ </center>

<center>![1.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23zGh3Q5EMLNt2RjwxoXNDRhVPoH4HKLXtu4QHcFAugMy3hjv2CcLPxkyzmyPgcxQSvpg.jpeg)</center>

I've always been a Sherlock Holmes fan, from the movie series to even playing the video games, which put my brain to the test in many ways. However, I never thought about reading the books. 

Most likely that was because I was kinda scared to start a series with so many books, but last year I put my hands on a box of 5 books only, which were coming with the most important events from Sherlock Holmes' life and work as a detective. 

The first book I finished from the series was a good one, although it turned out a bit difficult to understand some aspects because of all the specific terms and information, but it mainly consisted of presenting two crime cases, which, as you might expect, only got more complicated with each page turned. Hence, with all the challenges and unexpected twists, I was happy to finally read something where the plot twists were hard to figure out before, and I can't wait to read more of this, although it required a break from this genre of books for the rest of the month.

<a href=\
>Sherlock Holmes: A Study in Scarlet & The Sign of the Four by

>4 of 5 stars

###
2. **The Daisy Chain Flower Shop (Dream Harbor #6)**
by *Laurie Gilmore* ★★★★☆
![2.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23wMWDvBXwnYjTomgFBTcazjrZY9F2b9tUtmDcf436mRgTpMDSMuyiQjPEJUJMCHNvvBh.jpeg)
I was tempted to say that this is going to be like all the other stories written by Laurie Gilmore on the Dream Harbor series, but despite having the classic love story between two new people in town, I'd lie by saying that I didn't enjoy the story. Even if it's quite easy to figure out where it will all lead, as well as get some of the plot twists, it was hard to be angry or upset with the overall story because it felt so real, relaxing, and beautiful to read. So, even if the story between Daisy and Elliot started somewhat differently than that of the previous characters of this book series, I did live every minute spent with these two, making it a very lovely and chill read, like most of Laurie's writings. Oh, and by the way, this is named as being the 6th book of the Dream Harbor series, which is curious as only 4 volumes were translated in Romania so far, but if you are reading in English, make sure to check the other volumes too. They are not necessarily linked to each other because every book comes with two new main characters, but anyone else popping in the story had their own story shared in a previous book before.
>The Daisy Chain Flower Shop by

>4 of 5 stars

###
3. **Wolf.e (The Soldiers of Bedlam #1)**
by *Paisley Hope* ★★★★★
![3.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23xedG2B1r3kJVNWSUuD8sJ9rww3qyJvTzvfx4rcuitDRiFsWD3N9dnZgKMu2RJNFNC1X.jpeg)
This was definitely a very interesting read. It was actually my first time reading a dark biker romance book, and I was so happy to find out that this is only the first volume of a trilogy, so definitely at least two more books to read in the next 1-2 years or when they are released. Compared with other dark romance books I've read, the story of Gabriel Wolfe and that of Brinley Beaumont start on separate paths, almost showing two separate stories before they have their paths crossed. What was the actual thing that made me purchase the book almost right away, though, was having the main character of the story named Gabriel (while I am Gabriela, lol) Wolfe (while my gamertag was wolfie for at least 10 years now, lol). Nevertheless, it involves wolves and motorcycles, two other big passions of mine, so I definitely felt like this was one of the books that needed to be purchased right away without knowing much about the overall story. I won't bother saying that it wasn't worth it because I literally devoured the book in two days, having around 460 pages. It was actually the read that got me out of a reading slump I was confronting in the past two months, so I can't wait to see how the story will continue in the next two volumes! --- Check out my previous monthly recaps: - [August Recap: 9 Books That Kept Me Hooked](https://peakd.com/hive-180164/@gabrielatravels/august-recap-9-books-that-kept-me-hooked) - [September Recap: What I've Read Last Month?](https://peakd.com/hive-180164/@gabrielatravels/september-recap-what-ive-read-last-month) - [October Recap: My Best Reading Month Yet](https://peakd.com/hive-180164/@gabrielatravels/october-recap-my-best-reading-month-yet) - [November Recap: The Good, The Cozy, and The Unexpected](https://peakd.com/hive-180164/@gabrielatravels/november-recap-the-good-the-cozy-and-the-unexpected) - [December Recap: The Books That Closed My Year](https://peakd.com/hive-180164/@gabrielatravels/the-books-that-closed-my-year) - [January Recap: New Year, New Books](https://peakd.com/hive-180164/@gabrielatravels/january-recap-new-year-new-books) - [February Recap: Books That Stole My Attention, Not My Heart](https://peakd.com/hive-180164/@gabrielatravels/february-recap-books-that-stole-my-attention-not-my-heart) - [March Recap: From Thrills to Cozy Corners](https://peakd.com/hive-180164/@gabrielatravels/march-recap-from-thrills-to-cozy-corners) - [April Recap: Smut, Thrills & Bad Decisions](https://peakd.com/hive-180164/@gabrielatravels/april-reading-recap-smut-thrills-and-bad-decisions) - [May Reading Recap: The End Of My Reading Slump](https://peakd.com/hive-180164/@gabrielatravels/may-reading-recap-the-ending-of-my-reading-slump) ![divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23uQr4a36zPSdFCTVYhj3EGsYzS8ry4WRST4m7QgsmJ7AXN1Vw64ScGEpEZSk9f6wz3v3.png)
