body.title: Strengthening Technology Careers Through Cybersecurity Knowledge and Skills
body.body:
![Cybersecurity Course in Chandigarh (6).png](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/5d640dd0369af506b3f6ab17d2fc7b82e76f498977e3c65ab306da116b499b45)



The digital world has transformed how businesses operate, communicate, and store information. Organizations now depend heavily on cloud systems, online platforms, digital transactions, and remote work environments to manage daily operations. While these technological advancements have improved efficiency and connectivity, they have also increased exposure to cyber threats, data breaches, and online attacks.

As cybercrime continues growing globally, businesses are investing heavily in security infrastructure and skilled professionals who can protect sensitive information and digital systems. This increasing demand has made cybersecurity one of the most valuable and future-focused career fields in the technology industry.

For students, IT professionals, and career changers looking to build strong long-term opportunities, enrolling in a [Cybersecurity Course in Chandigarh](https://www.cbitss.in/cybersecurity-course-in-chandigarh/) can provide the technical knowledge and practical experience needed to enter this rapidly expanding field.

Cybersecurity is no longer limited to large technology companies or government agencies. Today, healthcare providers, financial institutions, educational organizations, retail businesses, and even small startups require strong digital security measures to protect customer data and business operations.

## Why Cybersecurity Has Become Essential for Modern Businesses

Every organization that stores or processes digital information faces cybersecurity risks. Cybercriminals target businesses through phishing attacks, ransomware, malware, data theft, and network vulnerabilities. Even a small security breach can lead to financial losses, legal complications, and reputational damage.

Businesses invest in cybersecurity to:

*   Protect customer and business data

*   Prevent unauthorized system access

*   Reduce financial and operational risks

*   Ensure secure online transactions

*   Maintain customer trust

*   Comply with data protection regulations

For example, banks use advanced security systems to protect online transactions, while healthcare organizations secure patient records against unauthorized access. E-commerce platforms also depend on cybersecurity measures to safeguard payment information and user accounts.

These growing security concerns continue increasing the demand for trained cybersecurity professionals across industries.

## Core Skills Every Cybersecurity Professional Should Learn

Cybersecurity combines technical expertise, analytical thinking, and problem-solving abilities. Successful professionals often develop skills across multiple security domains.

### Network Security

Understanding firewalls, routers, protocols, and intrusion detection systems is essential for protecting business networks.

### Ethical Hacking

Ethical hackers identify vulnerabilities in systems before cybercriminals can exploit them.

### Risk Assessment

Security professionals evaluate potential threats and recommend preventive measures to reduce organizational risks.

### Security Monitoring

Monitoring systems for suspicious activities helps organizations respond quickly to potential threats.

### Cloud Security

As businesses move data to cloud platforms, securing cloud infrastructure has become increasingly important.

### Incident Response

Cybersecurity experts must understand how to respond effectively when security breaches or cyberattacks occur.

A practical Cybersecurity Course in Chandigarh often focuses on these real-world skills while providing hands-on experience through simulations and security projects.

## Importance of Practical Training in Cybersecurity

Cybersecurity is a highly practical field where real-world experience matters significantly. Employers often prefer candidates who can demonstrate problem-solving abilities and hands-on technical knowledge.

Practical learning helps students understand:

*   System vulnerabilities

*   Threat detection methods

*   Penetration testing techniques

*   Secure network configuration

*   Malware analysis

*   Incident response procedures

For example, practicing ethical hacking in controlled environments helps learners understand how attackers exploit system weaknesses. Similarly, working on network security labs improves familiarity with firewalls, encryption methods, and access controls.

Hands-on experience also helps learners develop confidence while preparing for real cybersecurity challenges in professional environments.

## Career Opportunities in the Cybersecurity Industry

Cybersecurity offers diverse career opportunities across industries and technology sectors.

### Security Analyst

Security analysts monitor systems, identify threats, and help organizations maintain secure digital environments.

### Ethical Hacker

Ethical hackers perform controlled testing to identify security vulnerabilities before attackers can exploit them.

### Network Security Engineer

These professionals design and manage secure network infrastructures for organizations.

### Incident Response Specialist

Incident response teams investigate and manage cybersecurity attacks and system breaches.

### Security Consultant

Consultants advise organizations on improving cybersecurity policies, systems, and risk management strategies.

As businesses increasingly expand online, professionals with complementary digital skills may also benefit from understanding areas such as a [Digital Marketing Course in Chandigarh](https://www.cbitss.in/digital-marketing-course-in-chandigarh/), especially when working with online platforms, website security, and customer data protection strategies.

## Industry Trends Shaping the Future of Cybersecurity

Cybersecurity continues evolving rapidly as technology advances and cyber threats become more sophisticated.

### Cloud Security Growth

Organizations increasingly rely on cloud services, creating strong demand for cloud security specialists.

### Artificial Intelligence in Security

AI-powered systems help detect suspicious activities and automate threat analysis more efficiently.

### Remote Work Security

Hybrid and remote work environments have increased the importance of secure access systems and endpoint protection.

### Data Privacy Regulations

Governments worldwide are strengthening data protection laws, increasing the need for compliance-focused security professionals.

### Zero Trust Security Models

Businesses now implement stricter identity verification and access management practices to improve security.

Professionals who stay updated with these trends often gain stronger career growth opportunities and industry recognition.

## Practical Tips for Beginners Entering Cybersecurity

Starting a cybersecurity career can feel challenging initially because of the technical knowledge involved. However, a structured learning approach can make the process more manageable.

### Understand Networking Fundamentals

Basic knowledge of networks, operating systems, and internet protocols creates a strong foundation for cybersecurity learning.

### Practice in Safe Environments

Using virtual labs and ethical hacking platforms helps beginners gain practical experience safely.

### Learn About Common Threats

Understanding phishing, malware, ransomware, and social engineering attacks improves security awareness.

### Develop Problem-Solving Skills

Cybersecurity often requires analytical thinking and the ability to respond quickly to technical issues.

### Stay Updated Continuously

Cyber threats evolve rapidly, making continuous learning essential for long-term success.

A structured Cybersecurity Course in Chandigarh can help learners follow a practical roadmap while gaining exposure to modern security tools and industry-relevant technologies.

## Why Cybersecurity Remains a Strong Long-Term Career Choice

The growing dependence on digital systems ensures that cybersecurity will remain a critical business priority for years to come. Unlike many industries affected by automation, cybersecurity still relies heavily on human expertise, strategic thinking, and technical analysis.

Organizations across sectors continue increasing investments in:

*   Network security systems

*   Cloud infrastructure protection

*   Threat monitoring tools

*   Secure payment technologies

*   Compliance and data privacy systems

This strong industry demand creates long-term opportunities for skilled cybersecurity professionals across global markets.

## Conclusion

Cybersecurity has become one of the most important technology domains in the modern digital economy. As businesses increasingly depend on online systems, cloud platforms, and digital communication, protecting sensitive information and network infrastructure has become a top organizational priority.

For students, IT professionals, and career changers looking to build future-ready careers, cybersecurity offers strong opportunities across industries and technology sectors. With practical training, continuous learning, and real-world technical exposure, aspiring professionals can develop valuable expertise in one of the fastest-growing fields in the technology industry.

Building strong cybersecurity skills not only creates career growth opportunities but also contributes to creating safer and more secure digital environments for businesses and individuals alike.

## FAQs

### What does a cybersecurity professional do?

Cybersecurity professionals protect systems, networks, and data from cyber threats, unauthorized access, and security breaches.

### Is cybersecurity a good long-term career?

Yes, cybersecurity remains one of the fastest-growing and most stable career fields due to increasing digital security requirements.

### Can beginners learn cybersecurity successfully?

Absolutely. Many beginners enter the cybersecurity field through structured learning, practical labs, and consistent skill development.

### Which industries hire cybersecurity professionals?

Banking, healthcare, retail, education, government, telecommunications, and technology industries all hire cybersecurity experts.

### Is practical experience important in cybersecurity?

Yes, hands-on practice is essential because cybersecurity involves real-world threat detection,system protection, and incident response tasks.

body.title: The beginning and end of the path that chooses us.
body.body:
The beginning and end of the path that chooses us. You must choose your path! - this phrase is heard by those wandering in the forest or the desert, heard by children in high school, heard by young men after graduating from university, heard by almost everyone at least once in their lives. Moreover, the beginning of the path is the same for everyone, whether a person or a sprouting bean. They will end up where the sunlight can illuminate them. But the end, the path itself, is different for everyone, and, for the most part, it is not the path we choose, but the path itself that chooses our next destination. A controversial statement, but arguments are pointless near a small rural cemetery where many people have found their final resting place; their path has ended there. And the road leading to this cemetery is paved with cobblestones, so uncomfortable to navigate that it's unlikely anyone would choose it, even with other options. This route is like a verdict, but while it's bad for some, it's good for others. Auto mechanics at the service station, who are always ready to replace your car's suspension, will definitely have nothing bad to say about this route. ![1lDSC01149.JPG](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmUyBV133p5LSMkqR7PUuWKM9U36b2pbzEFnM1ZEDTzpk9/1lDSC01149.JPG) How comfortable it must be to be pressed tightly against a tree branch, feeding on its sap, but the time comes for a new path, which chooses flight from the branch to the ground, and acorns fall into autumn puddles. For them, there are several options: ending up in a boar's stomach, or taking root and beginning the journey of a new oak tree, and they don't choose this path themselves. ![1p3t6yDSC00039.png](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmZndg4TA1LvqNZBzD58QHkCa1SUaHitkNTvdds7xzFfnE/1p3t6yDSC00039.png) People sometimes envy the path of others, simply because it's further proof that they couldn't have chosen the same path, successful and straightforward. Such a path didn't exist for them; apparently, at that moment, theirs had run out. And animals, who also have very different paths, are not familiar with envy, but they also do not choose their own path, and people think that, supposedly, they can choose a path, if not for themselves, then for their pets, but here, the path itself decides where they all turn. ![DSC04004.JPG](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmZ5t9DL9LqrvHQYepL3ppxQ94LwAKEriShcghSeUKJQpa/DSC04004.JPG) Zoom in on a photo for a closer view. *** Below you can see my containers with data that I collect in INLEO and always have quick access to them it is very convenient. body.title: Paranormal Hive Tribe Posting Guidelines: What Belongs in Our Community?
body.body:
Paranormal Hive is a Hive community and a Hive-Engine tribe for people who are interested in the strange, mysterious, unexplained, speculative, and supernatural. The goal of this tribe is to create a focused place for paranormal discussion, research, storytelling, theories, reviews, and original creative content.

Lately, some posts using the Paranormal Hive tribe tags have been unrelated to paranormal topics such as Actifit Reports. That content may be perfectly fine elsewhere on Hive but does not fit the purpose of this tribe.

To keep Paranormal Hive useful, interesting, and focused, here are some basic guidelines for what is acceptable. These guidelines are not exhaustive or prescriptive. When in doubt please use your best judgement and have at least a few sentances in the post justifying why the post is on topic for Paranormal Hive. 

<center>**Acceptable Topics**</center>

Posts in the Paranormal Hive tribe should be clearly connected to one or more of the following subjects:

 - Paranormal Phenomena
Ghosts, hauntings, poltergeists, apparitions, spirit communication, possession, shadow people, or other unexplained experiences.

 - Cryptids and Strange Creatures
Bigfoot, Mothman, lake monsters, chupacabras, dogmen, thunderbirds, black-eyed children, or other mysterious beings.

 - UFOs and UAPs
UFO sightings, alien encounters, abductions, government disclosure, ancient astronaut theories, alien technology, and related speculation.

 - Conspiracies and Hidden History
Secret societies, unexplained historical mysteries, cover-ups, strange archaeology, forbidden knowledge, suppressed technologies such as overunity devices, and mystery-based research.

 - Occult, Magic, and Folklore
Witchcraft, curses, rituals, legends, mythology, haunted objects, grimoires, demonology, and supernatural folklore.

 - Psychic and Metaphysical Topics
ESP, remote viewing, telepathy, precognition, near-death experiences, astral projection, dreams, synchronicity, and spiritual anomalies.

 - Paranormal Fiction and Creative Writing
Original horror stories, supernatural fiction, SCP-style stories, weird fiction, creepypasta, paranormal poetry, or fictional case files.

 - Reviews and Commentary
Reviews of paranormal books, documentaries, movies, YouTube channels, podcasts, games, websites, or TV shows.

 - Paranormal Technology and Experiments
EVP recording, ghost-hunting tools, spirit boxes, haunted location investigations, AI paranormal projects, speculative devices, and DIY paranormal tech.

<center>**Content That Does Not Fit**</center>

The following types of posts should generally not use the Paranormal Hive tribe tag unless they have a clear paranormal angle:

 - General Actifit reports
 - Daily personal journals
 - Food posts
 - Travel posts with no paranormal connection
 - Random photography
 - General crypto posts
 - Political posts
 - Memes with no paranormal theme
 - AI art with no supernatural, occult, cryptid, UFO, or mystery connection
 - Generic blog posts copied into many unrelated tribes

For example, an Actifit report about a regular walk does not belong in Paranormal Hive. However, an Actifit-style post about walking through a haunted cemetery, visiting a paranormal landmark, or investigating a local ghost story could fit if the paranormal topic is central to the post.

<center>**The Simple Rule**</center>

Before using the Paranormal Hive tribe tag, ask yourself:

*Would someone interested in ghosts, UFOs, cryptids, occult mysteries, supernatural fiction, or unexplained phenomena reasonably expect to find this post here?*

 - If the answer is yes, it probably fits.

 - If the answer is no, please use a different Hive community or tag that better matches your content.

Cross-posting Is fine, but please stay relevant.

Hive users often post to multiple communities using multiple tags. That is fine. However, the Paranormal Hive tags should not be used only to gain extra visibility or token rewards. The content itself should genuinely belong here.

<center>**Posts that are clearly off-topic may be muted, ignored, downvoted, or excluded from tribe promotion depending on the situation.**</center>

Good Examples of Paranormal Hive Posts

- A personal ghost experience
- A review of a Bigfoot documentary
- A theory about UFO disclosure
- A short horror story about a cursed mirror
- Photos from a haunted location with background information
- A post about EVP recording experiments
- A breakdown of an SCP-style anomaly
- A discussion of occult symbolism in a movie
- A local legend from your town
- AI art of cryptids, spirits, haunted houses, or cosmic horror with meaningful context


Paranormal Hive exists to help people find and share content about the mysterious, supernatural, speculative, and unexplained. Keeping the tribe focused helps everyone. It makes Paranormalhive.org more useful for readers, better for creators, and stronger as a niche community on Hive.

Please help us keep Paranormal Hive weird, mysterious, spooky, thoughtful, and on-topic. Thank you.

body.body: > Hello everyone. Today I am sharing a new set of photos that show quiet afternoons in the city of Bogota. In these images, you can see views of sunsets captured from local parks, residential streets lined with buildings, and sun rays cutting through the clouds. # These photographs document the busy yet occasionally calm lifestyle that characterizes this city. I focused on capturing different spots within the neighborhoods, choosing angles that show how the light transitions at the end of the day. The open areas of the parks offered a clean view of the sky without too many obstructions. # On the streets, the buildings frame the horizon directly. I wanted to show the contrast between the solid concrete blocks and the open space of the afternoon sky. The way the light passes through the clouds changes the appearance of the avenues for a brief period, creating a distinct visual environment. # I decided to share these images because they reflect the daily reality of the urban landscape. It is a common environment for anyone walking through these sectors, but taking the time to record it allows for a more detailed look at the surroundings. I hope you find these captures of the afternoon interesting. # Without anything more to add, I bid farewell. Stay tuned for future posts! Until next time!

body.title: Exposición Pictórica \
de Miguel Pedríquez en Puerto Ordaz - Conociendo al maestro[ENG/ESP]
body.body:
>Greetings to everyone in the Lifestyle community. Today I’m joining you here to share a new chapter in my life. On this occasion, I’d like to show you my visit to the solo art exhibition titled “Expresiones” by visual artist Miguel Pedríquez. The exhibition is located in the city of Puerto Ordaz, in the Altavista neighborhood, at the Sidor Art Gallery. The exhibition opened yesterday, May 29, 2026, to commemorate National Visual Artist Day (which was on May 10) and is celebrated on that day in honor of the birth of the “Painter of Light,” Armando Reverón. So it’s great news to be able to visit these spaces and find that someone (or several people) have thought about such an important date.

\n\n

>Anyone from Ciudad Guayana will have heard at some point about the master Miguel Pedríquez, as he is not only a visual artist but also a teacher and cultural promoter. Although he is originally from Anzoátegui, I believe he has felt deeply enchanted by Bolívar State, as his works are intimately linked to the geography of Ciudad Guayana. His work displays a material richness, where he uses various materials to create his compositions (the result of his own interpretations of what he observes), which come across as organic and deeply human. He tears, paints, adds impasto (thick layers of paint), uses quick brushstrokes, strong lines in various directions, and more. He likes to experiment and let the materials take center stage.

\n\n>

>Saludos a todos en la comunidad de Lifestyle, el día de hoy me uno por acá para compartir con ustedes un nuevo día en mi vida. En esta ocasión deseo mostrarles lo que fue mi visita a la Exposición Pictórica Individual, titulada “Expresiones”, del Artista Plástico, Miguel Pedríquez. La misma se encuentra ubicada en la ciudad de Puerto Ordaz, sector Altavista, en la Sala de Arte Sidor. La exposición se inauguró ayer 29 de mayo del 2026, con motivo de conmemorar el Día Nacional del Artista Plástico (que fue el 10 de mayo) y el cuál se celebra ese día por el nacimiento del “Pintor de la Luz”, Armando Reverón. Así que es una gran noticia poder visitar estos espacios y encontrar que alguien (o varios) han pensado en esa fecha tan importante.

\n\n>

>Para el que es de Ciudad Guayana, habrá escuchado en algún momento sobre el maestro Miguel Pedríquez, pues él además de ser un artista plástico, se dedica a la enseñanza y es promotor cultural. Aunque es oriundo de Anzoátegui, creo que se ha sentido firmemente encantado con el estado Bolívar pues sus obras están íntimamente ligadas a la geografía de Ciudad Guayana. Su trabajo muestra una carga materica, dónde hace uso de materiales varios para crear sus composiciones (producto de sus propias interpretaciones sobre lo que observa) y que resultan orgánicas y profundamente humanas. Rasga, pinta, añade impasto (capas gruesas de pintura), usa pinceladas rápidas, líneas fuertes con direcciones varias y más. Gusta de experimentar y dejar que los recursos sean protagonistas.

![IMG_4855.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EpvjtHN4Q3WdEM2CkHAuJX385L8DMwaEHrAx3zzyZwKdjaWhn5X8TXNkUJhfaswE3gt.jpeg) ![IMG_4880.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EpEJM6xouzb1aKfbCHGdXfojMsqZrpxwbM8H1xne3NxHfmU4b9dDfd5tPiVK9cxGsC3.jpeg) ![IMG_4831.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/23xyZf55Pg4zUKmE1aEJ7nBTEdinBwrGJYZEJrqDYzknUCp3ws6ukmhxfQeTe1K4iorBX.jpeg) ![IMG_4834.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EpT67CbEKJNMygQx1CnBoHAKTRkvius7pG6qLwG22Z1dgQJhL2rzPK24iVnRzE7CVzL.jpeg) ![IMG_4835.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EpLhtemeU8SL4hnv1YFnK16Ge7gLzbp9QiijnmwGfHDg6fKdk5HrsGKQ5qi5Y9v2S7a.jpeg) ![IMG_4837.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EppN9tT94m5AmYDcVBLmZ2qp8M5jbQG5saL2ufq9ik5iuKrprhiAcNH1icJn1swXePu.jpeg) ![IMG_4838.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EpT6ZLDHefDVQZYbfTkKPCa1ww3p5QzhskcrqSvr8z3H21reVLdy2MSM2ksvMB4TXP2.jpeg) ![IMG_4839.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/23yJNqqW5tCw2QHBPcLHcDfjzGW1Rkjwk3o7kUqpMZrEHiPECV2qwM2QWP5ES2HK4k45y.jpeg) ![IMG_4844.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/Eq5Fvc3agZEQasvhcPYk2Kx82axzCKo4dKHVatGqYwCGx6FaxNXM43wP4qa3geLffET.jpeg)

>There’s also a very spiritual aspect to it, with certain symbols that recur in some of the works, such as birds and the checkerboard floor. I’d like to know what it means to him, and I hope we can discuss it later. I also like one thing in particular: one of the pieces caught my attention because of its ochre tones and the way it plays with transparency and light, which reminded me of Armando Reverón (in his Sepia and White Period) and his seascapes of the Caribbean Sea. That classic style. And I say this with all due respect, because I believe that is something very difficult to execute, and the master achieved it. I think he must admire Reverón greatly—and of course, Soto, whom he portrays.

\n\n

>By the way, I also wanted to mention the actor Miguel Martínez, who was present and performing. I believe he is also someone unforgettable in the memory of Puerto Ordaz. Look for the film “El Salto de los Ángeles.” That day I had the opportunity to meet the master Miguel and was able to exchange a few words with him and, of course, take a photo to remember the moment. I thank Mr. José Collazo, who introduced me to the artist. And of course, I invite you all to attend the exhibition so you can get to know this great artist. Without further ado, thank you for stopping by.

\n\n>

>También tiene un aspecto muy espiritual, dónde se observan ciertos símbolos que se repiten en algunas obras, cómo las aves y el piso de ajedrez. Quisiera saber que significa para él y espero luego poder hablarlo. También me agrada una cosa y es que una de ellas me llamó la atención por sus tonos ocres y ese trabajo de transparencias y de la luz que me recordaron a Armando Reverón (en su Etapa Sepia y Blanca) con sus paisajes marinos del Mar Caribe. Esa estampa clásica. Y lo digo con todo respeto pues yo creo que eso es algo muy difícil de ejecutar y el maestro lo logró. Creo que debe admirar mucho a Reverón y cómo no, a Soto, a quién retrato.

\n\n>

>Por cierto, quería también mostrar al actor Miguel Martínez, quién estaba presente y ejecutaba una performance. Yo creo que él es también alguien inolvidable en la memoria de Puerto Ordaz. Busquen la película \

. Ese día tuve la oportunidad de conocer al maestro Miguel y pude compartir algunas palabras y cómo no, una fotografía para recordar el momento. Agradezco al señor José Collazo quién me presentó al artista. Y por supuesto, los invito a todos a asistir a la exposición para que puedan conocer a este gran artista. Sin más que decir, gracias por pasar por aquí.

![IMG_4845.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EpxsFiEYwZFXFoTj9jFRCHwMKK3MNLBz7wYysh5qvkmZnvv1uiPmYe2RDfkFPt2zjkw.jpeg) ![IMG_4846.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/23x1AzfcCNuKQxjZLyhpQfVwtupMXf7sDRpGCw8AQUfUUFZs8KtjjEq3rBQBXeNyTfR3F.jpeg) ![IMG_4847.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/Eos4F7deVzKTcVEtSPajriC33agYhNfLzkYHftG5JammBB7FV7fNTX5d8AisRcNM5do.jpeg) ![IMG_4849.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EpQxkkzaV1tDMepDcBJfAujha3UdPSHQVG4XSMGKewGAdHsKsurgFtU851TuXbHoDDF.jpeg) ![IMG_4848.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EpLhteCtHsahDLpdvFmCywQsANxLi19kig1TmgxQ7Eu1SQCHzg2vBpUPZ7vWjGDfkPa.jpeg) ![IMG_4850.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EoiXgtckoDkkfTi9Uw2H93jrTSVWu29KuzEAehEND6GueafaGPHy2Z5f52LF6F2eecy.jpeg) ![IMG_4852.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EpT6C7kSe6W2JJFfMTULTVwq27Myg5gi22Q1TGVi3mYTvEFuyQS7UdT5rKvRJ5KxigX.jpeg) ![IMG_4851.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EpCBLHNTSLiPa4Gutk264R3C7HgpfiA33EbeoQWPcYTqz2FkEac5ZFhk4ohZmwThXGc.jpeg) ![IMG_4856.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/23xL52RMYRVqQa8dgDHEpXivhaASputqc8UEwfMZWGq1C9SaCTm3EafN54YYBsozZAySZ.jpeg) ![IMG_4829.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/Ep5oc7QGM8cYT7M5mRXZ2AT486VfMi9TgdrShiU2RjbuZ44vtQjQo22NkZUA3hRV58m.jpeg) ![Thank You for stopping by_20251222_235935_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EqQRuBXhDFu9VJKoUi9KYBHi1fizexq9zibK9463CkCj7BCiSq9HsujVhAP8Vem6kgg.png)

body.title: 𝐇𝐎𝐃𝐋𝐎𝐑 || 𝐀𝐍 𝐔𝐍𝐃𝐄𝐑𝐑𝐀𝐓𝐄𝐃 𝐍𝐄𝐔𝐓𝐑𝐀𝐋 𝐅𝐈𝐆𝐇𝐓𝐄𝐑
body.body: />Hello Everyone! Hope you all are doing amazing and welcome to another #Splinterlands post. Today I wanted to do another card spotlight post, and this time I picked Hodlor. This is an Epic Neutral unit that can fit into many different team compositions, which already makes it pretty useful. Neutral cards are always interesting because they can be used alongside almost every element, and Hodlor is one of those cards that can quietly do a lot of work without getting much attention. At max level 6, Hodlor gains three abilities that work really well together. While it may not look like the flashiest card in the game, I think it has some solid utility and can be very annoying for opponents.

> Looking at the stats first, Hodlor comes with: * 3 Melee Damage * 2 Magic Damage * 4 Speed * 5 Health * 6 Mana Cost Those stats are pretty decent for a secondary attacker. The speed especially helps him survive longer because faster units naturally dodge more attacks. I personally like cards that can contribute damage while also bringing utility, and Hodlor definitely falls into that category. 𝐀𝐛𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐲 𝟏: 𝐑𝐞𝐚𝐜𝐡 ============================= **Reach**: Can use melee attacks from the second position.

> This is probably the ability that makes Hodlor playable in many lineups. Normally melee monsters need to stand in the first position to attack. Reach changes that by allowing Hodlor to attack from the second spot. This is very important because your main tank can absorb damage while Hodlor safely deals damage from behind. I often prefer putting strong Reach monsters behind durable tanks because it allows me to keep pressure on the enemy team from the very first round. 𝐀𝐛𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐲 𝟐: 𝐃𝐢𝐬𝐩𝐞𝐥 =============================== **Dispel**: Removes magic buffs after a successful attack.

> This ability can be surprisingly useful. Many players rely on buffs to make their monsters stronger. When Hodlor lands an attack, those magical enhancements can disappear instantly. Sometimes a single Dispel can completely change the battle. It may not always be the most noticeable ability, but when it activates against an important target, the impact can be huge. I think this is one of those abilities people underestimate untill it costs them a match. 𝐀𝐛𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐲 𝟑: 𝐏𝐡𝐚𝐬𝐞 ============================= **Phase**: Magic attacks have the same chance to miss as physical attacks.

></center>

Now this is where Hodlor becomes really interesting.

Normally magic attacks never miss. That's one of the reasons magic teams can be so strong.

But Phase changes that.

Because Hodlor has decent speed, he can sometimes dodge magic attacks completely. When this happens it feels amazing because many opponents expect guaranteed damage.

Against magic-heavy lineups, this ability can provide incredible value.

I've seen battles where a few lucky magic dodges completely changed the outcome.

𝐖𝐡𝐲 𝐈 𝐋𝐢𝐤𝐞 𝐓𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐂𝐚𝐫𝐝
====================================

What I like most about Hodlor is versatility.

He isn't just a damage dealer.

He attacks from the second position, removes buffs, and can even dodge magic attacks. That's a pretty nice package for a 6-mana card.

The combination of Reach and Phase is especially interesting because it allows Hodlor to stay relevant throughout the battle. Even after your tank falls, he can move forward and continue fighting.

𝐂𝐎𝐍𝐂𝐋𝐔𝐒𝐈𝐎𝐍
====================

Overall, I think Hodlor is a very solid Neutral card that deserves more attention.

The combination of Reach, Dispel, and Phase gives him utility against many different team compositions. He may not be the strongest damage dealer in #Splinterlands, but he brings enough value to earn a spot in plenty of lineups.

For me, the ability to pressure opponents from the second position while also disrupting buffs makes him a fun card to use.

Anyway thats it for today’s #splinterlands grind. More battles tomorrow and hopefully more crazy moments too. Please do give your reviews in the comments section below. I would really appreciate it :)

I'll be back with another one soon. So do follow me if you want to stay updated. Till then, Stay Happy and Stay Hydrated.

body.title: The bridge between an idea and its implementation.
body.body:
The bridge between an idea and its implementation. Once upon a time, long ago, sitting on a chair after school in the office of the design institute where my mother worked, I was examining the complex drawings she was sketching out by hand on a drawing board and asked her if this was the most difficult quarter of her life. She was drawing a plan for a bomb shelter, where all the concrete walls were studded with various rebars, and all this had to be taken into account and the loads calculated. She laughed and said that while she was making it difficult, it was much more difficult to calculate and draw a bridge, because there are so many torques involved. And indeed, a bridge is complex, indeed. For example, I decided to draw something and came up with some superficial idea, but all that separates a blank sheet of paper from the finished work is definitely a bridge. ![DSC00495.JPG](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmYMmuLGWwXPESAtP67BRTa8Pe6ym3WcPT2vPpvauwozT6/DSC00495.JPG) Often this bridge is shaky and he is a timid butterfly, ready to fly into any minute somewhere and not say when he is going to return. ![DSC04313.JPG](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmWfRAFyEbkSAnrzpAXTAqQp1CzDRqkt8M13jU7ACPvJbr/DSC04313.JPG) It's good when you can be careful and consistent, not to scare off the money and finish the work on building this bridge, but sometimes it happens that the result isn't a bridge, but a ramp, a pier, which still has a long way to go to reach the point of becoming a bridge. But there's still hope: one day, I'll be able to bridge both banks. ![1uDSC06038.JPG](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmeRYNw7Je3SzhF8nuwfos4EyqMu85HaxcWzeFVi91gA13/1uDSC06038.JPG) As in this case. ![DSC00517.JPG](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmNSgzHEUhogj1V6jEcF38Z37TbwH6KDWq43Pbv2aw4wfd/DSC00517.JPG) Zoom in on a photo for a closer view. *** Below you can see my containers with data that I collect in INLEO and always have quick access to them it is very convenient. body.title: The freshness of a rain-soaked rooftop garden and the flowers of the Puishak.
body.body:
> ![IMG20260124123527~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeT3LvdiN4qFKpxNwVuX59azQnamQRTj7XDXWhs9nDwJZ/IMG20260124123527~2.jpg) Many of us build rooftop gardens in search of a piece of peace amidst the hustle and bustle of city life. This small rooftop garden of mine is a wonderful refuge from my daily fatigue. The joy hidden in caring for the trees in the garden every morning and watching them grow is truly different. Recently, a Puishak tree in my rooftop garden has bloomed beautifully. Many people may not realize that Puishak flowers can be so spectacular. These flowers with small, soft petals have created a strange and magical atmosphere among the green leaves of the tree. ![IMG20260124123542~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcUZXmkMfzkSfDQJ2gcJEc8948GwcuNo7o8gYUCqi5s78/IMG20260124123542~2.jpg) This morning, a sudden downpour came and gave the entire garden a new look. When I went to the garden after the rain, I saw an unearthly sight. The rain water had collected on the young flowers and green leaves of the Puishak, forming beautiful water droplets. I could not help but be fascinated by this refreshing appearance. I took a few macro photos to capture these wonderful moments. Looking at the pictures, we can see how the raindrops on the buds of the Puishak are sparkling like pearls. The water droplets accumulated on the smooth surface of the leaves remind us of the perfect craftsmanship of nature. ![IMG20260124123551~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ9SLpPKofVt4zMvmqg5ZfRaNYJTEBGU7yHvuTnE3WJLD/IMG20260124123551~2.jpg) This calm and gentle form of nature refreshes our minds in an instant. In this brick-and-stone city, the combination of greenery and rain is as comfortable for the eyes as it is very peaceful for the mind. These small achievements of the rooftop garden are one of the greatest joys of life. The beauty of every leaf washed by the touch of rain and the newly blooming flowers is truly incomparable. Those who love trees will easily understand the depth of this feeling. This wonderful gift of nature teaches us how to find extraordinary beauty even in very ordinary things. This was my arrangement for today. I hope you liked the pictures I took and the nature observations. Wishing everyone good health, I bid you farewell here today. |

body.title: Turning Daily Intentions Into a Personal Birthday Reward
body.body:
<div  class=text-justify>

We're about to enter a new month, how time flies! It still feels like new year's day was last week but I know why it feels like that for me. I've been more intentional about my days since the year began, I've done a lot of the things I didn't even imagine I'd be able to do until I took the action.

In June, it will be a countdown to my birth month, July. And unlike in the other years of my life, I'm genuinely more excited about my upcoming birthday. You'd think at first that I'm excited because of gifts and promises anyone may have made to me but it's the opposite, it's my promise.

I plan to make a *\

* promise to myself that I'll fulfill on my birthday. But it wouldn't come for free, I have drawn out a plan for me to follow and the reward will come on my birthday if I finish strong, especially if it gets harder during the plan. I'm really excited about it. One of the things I've been doing a lot since this year is reflecting more about my life from better lens and I make sure to learn as much as I can to find even more better lens so my life doesn't go into default again, I want to keep learning to improve and become a better person everyday. ![InShot_20260530_070646784.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/merit.ahama/EoAYn3LjPwo4ZQygQVxRAjqSjPue7FgNXk4qkz1QYhqAdb3n34kaMYapNrnRmRQeaZP.jpg) So in that spirit, there are a few of my routines I'm hoping to change, make habits and grow in them. I drew out a plan for it and the reward for keeping to them will be given to me on my birthday coming up on July. I think this will give me a first of it's kind birthday, I'm still thinking of a reward. Knowing who I am and how I love to be rewarded, I'm already excited before I decide on one. I just need to keep my own part of the promise by following the plan as much as I can because at the end of it, I'll have even more rewards than the one I'm promising myself as my birthday gift. As for the plan drawn out, the most challenging one in it is, going out of my room every single day to find good photos or videos. It's more challenging because I've never had to do it intentionally before but I must get it done to be able do a few others on the plan, I'm a bit excited. Enjoying the process, is my goal. I know I really need to do that for me to finish strong and not only focus on the rewards that will come after. But the rewards are a motivation on the days when consistency gets boring and I'm tempted to not continue. So far, I'm excited for my becoming. **Image used is mine and edited using inshot.** Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@merit.ahama/turning-daily-intentions-into-a-personal-birthday-reward-5zj)

The three days of Eid were very wonderful and special. One of the most important things was that I had the opportunity to meet the great scholar Allama Liaqat Ali Murtazvi. Along with this I spent good time with friends and the days passed in a very pleasant gathering.

Time passed so quickly that I did not even realize when the third day of Eid came to an end... Once again we said goodbye to Eid with sad faces and emotional moments because Eid is a festival that comes only twice a year and then we have to wait for a long time for it to return back..

As I mentioned in my previous post during all three days of Eid we were visiting the homes of relatives and friends... We went to each others house to share eid gatherings. This is part of our tradition and culture that during Eid we visit relatives and friends, strengthen relationships and share gifts with each other..

---


![1000187271.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23zS9U61QSeztcwg9k5M2Tk5694NfTwHw6decwJbz56iNkMGAGBGEfwV1QL2kMKqNY7tf.jpg)

On the second day of Eid we visited the home of our respected elder Haji Daulat Hussain which is also the head of FIC institute. He also made excellent arrangements and welcomed us warmly. On the third day of Eid we visited Muhammad Hussain who is the manager in National Bank of Pakistan.

The best thing was that we met the great scholar Allama Liaqat Ali Murtazvi and benefited from his knowledge and discussion. I have tried to share different moments through pictures.

body.title: Mangoes are in abundance this year
body.body: # I got some special tools to experiment. ![Mango Fest 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sanjeevm/48PTcpGGZutBcM45WD79Rpvcqhn37XeqCfedtkuommzj5RUv99C6vhN3kiqTqPrSZT.jpg) After almost a decade, we have got a bumper crop of mangoes this year and Mom is very happy, because it's her favorite. And more ever, its fully organic as we use natural techniques to ripen them, putting them on sand. So they stay longer unlikely the ones from market which gets rotten within just few days. ![DSC06545.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sanjeevm/23tvZzgnwYYb2oRowrtiitAmZhwWomEPDT7xpVEgZfwnR5DJkXisTnFeJAfMspSuVg7Zv.JPG)|![DSC06542.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sanjeevm/23tSaymmc6wMkKgg6XYhdvXopo2hzbdUVehKNw83U6N9oeCz7XBtxTQ49GbGT9dvbURj9.JPG) -|- ![DSC06500.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sanjeevm/23wMWbAebBxGrv479UEvjoSjB4a2QFgWj66tTMFqSZ2QKpTyhWUdmyEz9vyHszzygJoqA.JPG)|![DSC06501.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sanjeevm/23wC3YmcMXf5ezaffM2eHx6seJLECZch6dHvj7ARSrPHEktQV1XB2fBdewzdMMvdnCRMt.JPG) I had to go multiple times to pluck them, as she is still recovering after the surgery and not able to do hard work. ![DSC06469.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sanjeevm/23zkhxYN1bK9mdDSw3XbirbGKzoM6rEcZgnpb7AmM6ZVFdLtriXWaJHgjmVxn9YGBZ64L.JPG) ![DSC06470.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sanjeevm/23yTccsvxb76btAtULozuvhST2dB9jBiqMYf1WaYfutwBt7icJvcDMjkimRCow4QNeRjS.JPG) These two plants are the major ones, though we have few more growing up in the backyards. Even though they are close to the roof, it still needs tools to pluck them, so this year I ordered a special tool from online. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sanjeevm/23tcNzkWS1p4bi7FPsYgx3BtW5dP8qRu8xodWJkWq9P9XEvG6iPrsQQXeZ3jpVy7QVHVH.png) The price has dropped now and you can see the product at the below link : https://www.amazon.in/Festel-Skytuch-Telescopic-Coconut-Plucker/dp/B08DVB54G7/ref=ast_sto_dp_puis ![20260513_132947.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sanjeevm/23vsUQAnho5xwEQs5tSD6a6rVJBqGeZELa7XBYWa8DYJwXZvMC6LhhqFQwE31CAjnZ3qy.jpg) ![20260513_175327.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sanjeevm/23tbw4Cc3TdWJJpksBoomQuSGN1ZhUtacbJomeCFstgo8JLKgcjG4tZPRyhdBiH8wt3pF.jpg) ![20260513_180951.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sanjeevm/23tbsLpx4shkccAHBx65N4ojf97C1Eyw6rZW6ttdrZGavDKC2yJp4SfeFjw95HVqtYMLB.jpg) It came with a 8-to-24 Foot Extendable Telescopic Pole and a Coconut Plucker along with the Mango Fruit Picker, but the quality did not meet my expectation. The Mango Fruit Picker is not sturdy as advertised and the pole is not very stable when fully expandable. Buying the same product with [6-to-18 Foot Extendable Pole](https://www.amazon.in/Skytuch-Extendable-Telescopic-Coconut-Plucker/dp/B08RRQCQGS/ref=ast_sto_dp_puis) would have been a better decision. Unfortunately the product did not have a return option and more ever we wanted it in time, so I had to use it. I extended it with three poles only, expanding to 18 ft, and it still needs a strong muscle to deal with. And I had to handle the Mango Fruit Picker very carefully, plucking only one mango at a time, else it felt like it will break easily. The pole is not available to buy separately, else I would have gone for that alone. ![DSC08580.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sanjeevm/23uQpeEAoPg97T2ydJHibEnfkhnTtGXWhiZ2r23VRZrR4MJHfGZLJvuEaEH8CMkx5GWsH.JPG) Last year I had ordered this one but did not use, and a friend took to use this year. It broke at few places, but he welded in a local shop, making it more stronger. This was a much useful than the other tool and I will have to make something like this next year, that would fit into the telescopic pole. The pole would certainly be useful, but not worth the price. ![20260515_165028.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sanjeevm/EoAaJwcbAzU9iKa5cvoGMWozExFRzBZNPSqmzVXNGvz9nJDCm6rKE5Xqj5ur9MBjemB.jpg) So as you can see, I used all the three different tools, the one created by Mom at home last year was still the best, she could not build a new one this year though. Using bamboos are better because of its light weight and we have them on our backward, so may be I will learn the skill as well to create the tool. Convenience comes at a price and these products available online was ordered only because of that, but when that too does not meet expectation, we will have to build it on our own. ![20260514_180206.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sanjeevm/EoyNaccTs1aC5PwmLzfhaD73ebQcauvMYP4SuA2pVvQhioPBQocyRZgAkRCL96Cd3UC.jpg) The ripen ones gets stored in the freezer and its a Mango Fest at house for couple of months. ![DSC06508.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sanjeevm/23vhuB7YYEoakTWLjZEkoZmoFnfRcivqEjUd2Q5N3G155RnNaZD6LBC4GyCGQ2JYTav4f.JPG) And there are plenty at the ground level, which can be plucked by hand and they are left to ripen at the end. Mangoes ripen by the heat and since they are getting the least amount of heat, they are expected to stay till next month. Occasional rain followed by heat ripens them faster, but they are anyways at a place where Mom or Dad can pluck by hand. ![DSC06535.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sanjeevm/23xAZpjwH1nK4VpfuZnY1Z1uyjhNi69u3pCUJcoQUQgEtaGdNDdrj5ciftddXziZfeb3L.JPG) ![DSC06537.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sanjeevm/23yJXeqHRbisSLxr9dNKaeqny5iWquJj6ab3piDV9thDwrwFMzDyhpUQNRhjhK9Z8kRkW.JPG) This variety is very sweet like sugar and my son loves this one, where as Mom likes the other one below, which is moderately sweet. ![DSC06479.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sanjeevm/23xVMbVq39p85bPoXg1WuqJAx18p4Xn8LLArYZaM2vT1RC2YYvuB89Mr3TjQ36kbNyqYC.JPG) Imagine how it would feel to pluck mangoes like this from the plant. ![DSC06476.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sanjeevm/EoiTqnDfbZfQ9CWLRk3Xjmj58SWpkfLdjQA8at9D63s4iVYyT9LweTyonZ7b3UZJAgL.JPG) And there was some other goodies at home as well, more to come on that.....that's the reward of taking care of parents. **This post will be part of my amazon review of the product, Hive genuinely is a perfect platform for transparent reviews.**

> https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sanjeevm/AJhUjytTMKidaQB3VDtoqp32up5HyvS3ixx7Y2EomYs9e8qdcHudLP33qrFGbbE.png

Find our community [here](https://peakd.com/c/hive-140635/created)!** ![Hive Garden Footer.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sanjeevm/EoCfdgSFyXTcwJdJnAgoebbcJiNBFqRY5hVfYpFGxURremPEvMkSU7WiDEycHDatr2G.jpg) ![hive.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sanjeevm/23t7Yf2ig7CziqatXGLDSFvEXbGWpLghnimWmyzQWE2BichH69ZtADrPf9j3fQTtbt3cw.png)

body.title: A strange hobby.
body.body:
A strange hobby. If you're passionate about something and occasionally find yourself in, or even touch upon, a circle of hobbits (not to be confused with hobbits), you've realized that hobbies can sometimes be very strange. Some people are into strange sports, some are fascinated by certain fields of science and technology, some play or sing musical instruments, some are immersed in the natural world, and some are passionate about collecting—and collecting shoehorns isn't the strangest way to declare your hobby. Personally, I can't say I'm not one of these types of hobbyists... although I haven't shown any interest in shoehorns, lol. But some of my hobbies are truly strange, and I even discovered this when I was looking at my collection and noticed that I was collecting... a hobby! Lol, so looking at my drawings, it turns out that I tend to draw things that I enjoy more or less, and that's my hobby? Right? So, mushroom picking has been my hobby since early childhood. And I've devoted quite a few drawings to this topic. It turns out that this hobby is even stranger, since it's a collection of random bits of my hobbies, and drawing is also a hobby, lol. It's like a Mobius strip. ![DSC00415.JPG](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQma9E7Ef6jnFm3ES6KdTPKXvLB16HpHkx2Sxer69Ei7o4y/DSC00415.JPG) As for fishing, I don't remember a single time I overslept. I'm ready to go day or night. If I don't have a worm, I'll fish with a bare hook, or maybe even with my bare hands. ![1uIMG20221221201609.png](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmV6PUEuB9fqrs7YHRs49m4Rrksy5eyLzXaiFgsYeL2eQ7/1uIMG20221221201609.png) Fishing is an amazing thing, and despite its importance to me, it hasn't deprived me of the ability to notice other things, important things. ![DSC00411.JPG](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmPdkcMPuVB73wLHBJ1RAjcmLA3N19nu7FyCKwodUwyiYK/DSC00411.JPG) And when the fish aren't biting, you can always take a nap, and I love to sleep, you could say it's another hobby of mine :) ![1uDSC09533.png](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmR7dTq59dqVNKqJoNJQvQcCcwihPaDmHa3WhwmBEU3jWy/1uDSC09533.png) So, drawing my hobbies is probably the strangest hobby for me. Zoom in on a photo for a closer view. *** Below you can see my containers with data that I collect in INLEO and always have quick access to them it is very convenient. [Material thoughts about beekeeping №1](https://inleo.io/threads/view/barski/re-leothreads-drl8tnsl) When I visited dense forests, I did not see ideal conditions for bees there, but many beekeepers harvest beekeeping products in such places. body.title: A Cat That Loves the Camera
body.body:
https://images.hive.blog/DQmZidhGvxYt34HR4nGrPRT5thKgcoAJ8tQbKR3rTMav9Cs/file_000000000b107243823289e21d232305.jpeg

I have been cat sitting for my friend for many years while she went on holiday. At first there were three cats I looked after. Each cat had their own way of doing things. They all had different personalities and routines.  Now I only look after one cat. He is the youngest one that was in the group.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmWhvBHoe1DrjurM6FxqdyySwAh9VgXXkZzvMw9CX7TxqA/file_000000004b8072439a043845a588715e.jpeg

https://images.hive.blog/DQmVwwhGQWFnTrNhCFPNS3rsXJTBczfa6QW1USggGs46kSf/20260529_090528.jpg

He likes to play with his cat toys.  I think this is his favoutite as it has cat nip in it.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmZvbXAkXoRQ9BM12bHAnUMnkTa6euaEfQdfumQa6LL3nH/20260527_150659.jpg

He is a very friendly cat. He likes attention and follows me around the garden when I am there. 

https://images.hive.blog/DQmVqL2AmbvV8b15atFPHLhrHcqKzTWAoG4SSCATfPdsiCy/20260527_151119.jpg

https://images.hive.blog/DQmTwKT8KB46BVeDHeTEd1bJVcGjMQY7q3Wy1gXSJN9EZhj/20260527_151211.jpg

One of his main things is that he loves posing for the camera. If I take out my phone, he often looks straight at it. Sometimes he sits in a way that looks like he is ready for a photoshoot. It makes it easy to take pictures of him.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmeJ7SPfB9C4Q4zzDkJz6Xbqi2j7p9mQQzXofaUq3YvXeF/20260529_150253.jpg

https://images.hive.blog/DQmeeXcjXU6KdNPAZCqzfee4PFdnex1oXFFnJrmvX68MqbD/20260529_162253.jpg

Looking after him is quite simple. I feed him, clean up, and spend a lot of time with him so he is not alone. However, during the day he also likes to sleep in the summerhouse, even though he has full access to the house. He goes there on his own and settles down for long naps. It seems to be his favourite quiet spot. I think he likes a bit of me time.  Or should I say miaow time?

body.title: Another House of Cats Story
body.body:
Since last year, the size of our fur family has been decreasing a lot. Since I have been pretty much absent from home, some of our cats wandered around the house and never return. Some were passing away due to an incurable illness.  

Now, what's left in our house is Twinky, Winky, Kopi, Cici, Cireng, and Micky. 

![DSCF1092.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeg3efSBKSwNmT2Q1VfEjs47c7AEJbgVgqhoDD7DjkGmN/DSCF1092.JPG)



Whenever I am home, they gather around me as if welcoming and wanted to play with me. Kopi here is the most playful and adorable than the others. 




![DSCF1047.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmckefE8HvoaJvapAnPgrynQiafn6wbjKVYSTnxMiu1dcb/DSCF1047.JPG)



We also recently have Cireng, milly's kitten who grow up to be fearless and playful.



![DSCF1070.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdMLjxSejfp8QKvKX59CwAupzu9pDeMneiBpd74qGs2iL/DSCF1070.JPG)

Sometimes, when I am away, I definitely miss them. I sometimes call my mom to ask about their condition or if I need to order more food for them. But I get the feeling that I will be here long enough to play around with them again.

body.title: Cristiano Ronaldo: From Madeira to Football Greatness
body.body:
Cristiano Ronaldo: The Legacy of a Football Icon

Few athletes have changed football as much as Cristiano Ronaldo. From his early days in Portugal to becoming one of the greatest footballers in history, Ronaldo's journey is a story of talent, discipline, and determination.

Born in Funchal, Madeira, Portugal, Ronaldo began his professional career with Sporting CP before attracting the attention of Manchester United. Under the guidance of Sir Alex Ferguson, he developed into one of the world's best players, winning multiple trophies and his first Ballon d'Or award.

His move to Real Madrid marked the beginning of an extraordinary era. Ronaldo became the club's all-time leading goalscorer, helping the team win numerous UEFA Champions League titles and domestic trophies. His incredible goal-scoring ability, athleticism, and leadership made him a global football superstar.

Ronaldo later enjoyed success with Juventus before returning to Manchester 
![1780077454039.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shimaya/23w2mFfonb1ipGWzibaCXfsbwrpcEiatifcTccGKQ96jGCuSaQCr15AThnKaaovYbhMdy.jpg)

![p0nmq1gl.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shimaya/23z7KpPnb71rsuxHGDwAAQ7yG1QDu8DMuWitd2KXxdRtT42okdEQyKAGZBMj7Zhk1FDCh.jpg)
United and eventually joining Al Nassr. Beyond club football, he has been a key figure for Portugal, leading his nation to victory at the UEFA European Championship and the UEFA Nations League.

What sets Ronaldo apart is not just his achievements but also his relentless work ethic. He has consistently maintained elite performance levels for over two decades, inspiring millions of fans and young footballers around the world.

Today, Cristiano Ronaldo's name is synonymous with greatness. His records, trophies, and influence on the game ensure that his legacy will be remembered for generations. Whether measured by goals, titles, or impact, Ronaldo remains one of football's greatest icons.

body.title: And here new story begins
body.body:
Hi, guys!

Today is my second-to-last day off, so I'm continuing to prepare for next week's work. I have a huge number of shoots planned, plus I need to film the unpacking of everything that arrived during my vacation, so there's a lot of filming to do. I've been really slow on my reading lately, so I need to fix that and get back into a regular reading routine. Basically, I need to reset and fix everything so that all my systems can function properly again.

I have a huge number of plans, but the main thing I'm working on right now is creating a system that allows my nervous system to function properly. I want to achieve a result where I'm not constantly stressed about not getting things done. So I'm trying to become more comfortable with the fact that I have unfinished business when the evening comes.

Also, I want to focus on improving the quality of my content, so I'll likely start filming more slowly and take longer to edit. This will probably last for a while. But sooner or later, I'll get used to it; everything should return to normal, and my shooting speed will increase.

So, starting Monday, I'm launching a test mode for this new approach, and I hope it works. In any case, I think I've done everything I can to make it work. Today, I'll be working on my bullet journal some more; I've almost finished the main sections, and I'll be able to start it in June.

Have a great day, everyone!

body.body:
> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX784CbYiaXwmLW94VTtVUn42DkY9Er6at66ecy6F7Xht/1780123017451.jpg) Bengalis and sweets are an inseparable and eternal chemistry. Any of our celebrations or simple gatherings would be incomplete without a piece of sweets at the end. The feeling of eating sweets is not limited to satisfying the taste of the tongue, but is associated with a strange mental satisfaction and pleasure. As we can see in the file, the soft, fluffy rasgollas arranged on a tray behind the glass showcase are an absolute attraction. Just looking at these balls of sweet potato soaked in sugar syrup makes your heart happy. The play of the senses begins when the steaming hot or cold dessert is presented to the shopkeeper on a plate. That first moment of gently cutting it with a spoon or putting it directly in your mouth is truly magical. As soon as you put the sweet, soft chickpea in your mouth, when the sweet juice inside melts and spreads all around, it feels as if all your fatigue and mental stress has momentarily vanished like camphor. This delicious taste of sweetness directly releases a kind of happy hormone in the brain, which instantly brings a bright smile to the face. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdwAF3C3wb33LEhPxn29UUo6sXxzEWVXZLzeM8Q42p8gV/1780123017609.jpg) Eating sweets is not just about savoring the taste, it is about biting into a piece of happiness. The soft texture of rasgolla, the coating of malai on chamcham, or the light aroma of sandesh, each sweet has its own story. This experience of eating sweets reminds us of our childhood. The familiar taste of chickpea pies from our grandmother's hands or the sweets our father bought after a good exam result still makes us nostalgic. Ultimately, no matter what your diet or calorie count, the heavenly feeling hidden in a bite of pure sweetness is unmatched by any other food. It is part of our culture, our passion. So, going to a sweet shop and reaching for those juicy balls is not just a way to fill your stomach but also a sweet attempt to give your mind a piece of absolute peace.

body.title: Finally Diamond 2 League before Season End
body.body:
Hello Splinterlands and Hive Fam!


I hope that life is treating you well wherever you are in this part of the world, and the weekend must be going great.


My Splinterlands Game account is - FinPulse9.

I have been trying hard to unlock the diamond two league from last few days, and I'm very happy to share that it is now finally done, which you can see on the snapshot below, where I can see the rating of 3240, which puts me into the Diamond Two League. I would need another 160 rating to move ahead into the diamond one, and since the current season will be ending in about one and half day approximately from now, it looks difficult to be honest. I know that how I have made it possible for the Diamond 2 league, and this was a tough journey. I will continue to play for today only, and after that, I will stop my battle because I don't think it makes sense to continue playing. Generally, there is more competition before the season ends, so I don't want to lose this league. 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/finpulse/23tkp8YZTX6w8iB38BSQSaTyFx7ANaXyN6bYCp81WAMiUyFVg4DyHBdiAQW3oYGySnDp9.png)



Winning a battle is a great motivation in the game. When I win this kind of battle, where I get a good reward, it's really cool, where you can see that I have got a rating of 40 along with more than three SPS and 665 Glimpse tokens. So altogether, it combines for a fantastic reward after winning a battle.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/finpulse/23t74Zk63yg9BKAKqFQwa5s23qYL61TZCFj1ZE4LKdGhDdzSx1yFvY58fSqS1w8cQorhr.png)

Here I'm also sharing the leaderboard progress, where you can see that my winning ratio is 51.2 percent, which is not bad, but the other player who is on top has got it more than 66%, and that's really huge. I have never crossed this barrier of 60% even since the time I have been playing the game, and I know even this 51% is a very high number for me. It requires a lot of effort and dedication, along with creative command in the game, and obviously, a fabulous card collection. Only then can one think about having this kind of winning ratio, but still, even after that, it is not going to be easy.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/finpulse/23swfwGBFddeu2tFgme9QfwyhJfriHUbCkCaGPivt1kLWxmbbBsUzTdYVHcDNozuoUudK.png)

as we are moving forward in the current season of the game where and it just one day away so I think it was a good season overall for me and at this point of time there is no need to change any strategy because whatever I'm playing is good enough so if I feel like I can enter in the diamond one then I will continue to play else I will stop it and continue to recharge my energy count. This energy count will be helping me once the season ends, so that I can start with the 50 energy count or similar. And this will help me play more battles at the beginning of the season, which can be a good idea, and that's what I'm planning to do in the next season without wasting any time. Thank you!

body.title: The Madman's Dream
body.body:
Monkey D. Luffy, the protagonist of the legendary One Piece anime, wants to become the “King of the Pirates”. Sounds so usual, right? Because, he is the protagonist, and it is the anime we are talking about. But here is the twist, one of the strongest truths about human civilization is this: conquering the world through absurdities. Whether it is an anime or real life, dreams require absurdity.  


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW5KRohg9Ue82MHdjWf8fZhoEL4GDn3myjzcwvowcWkRB/1780122983902.jpg)

(Taken by me) 

>**Absurdity**
 
Have you ever thought about an achievable goal? Of course, everyone has. How about an ultimate goal? Although, I prefer a continuity of life’s goal, but still, there must be one special thing you want to achieve. In order to call yourself - a successful person. What if that goal is beyond comprehension? The world will start calling you insane.

Let’s say I tell you that I want to become a doctor. You will be like, “okay, good luck”. Why? Because the goal is considered an achievable target in this contemporary world. Now, what if I say “I want to conquer the world”. To you, I may sound like a barbarian. Although just a century or two back, it was the normal thing (still is just the dynamics has changed with the capitalist system).  
 
>**What good is a goal without insanity?** 
 
I share a “great” dream of mine with you. In response, you say, it is a “good” goal. Then, it means that my dream, my goal, is not great enough to surpass the limits of current imagination. People understand it immediately because it does not challenge their mental architecture. It feels safe, logical and socially acceptable. However, historically, genuine transition was possible through ideas wearing the costume of madness.  

Before 1856, the world relied heavily on whale oil for lighting. One of the reasons behind naval battlefields. Then came the irrational ambition, of that time, of drilling into the earth for oil. People laughed at Edwin Drake. The idea sounded ridiculous because scarcity was the norm. Nobody imagined industrial pumps existing beneath the ground. Yet the “crazy” idea eventually became civilization itself. The fun part is that the world is still waging wars over each other for it. Geopolitics revolves around this drilling of oil.  

The same pattern appeared when Walt Disney imagined something more than an amusement park. To most people, entertainment was temporary distraction; a few rides, noise and few spectacles. Disney came up with an idea, emotional storytelling and escapism. Haters considered it a financial suicide. Yet today, theme parks are not simply places; they have become a part of our lives. 


Politics, too, follows this strange law of impossible visions. Consider Nelson Mandela, the legend who dreamt of Great world. People, other than the oppressed, must have considered his vision as a “dream of a madman”. 

All these yapping leads toward a strange paradox. On one hand, human beings are beyond imagination, with great projections. On the other, humans are psychologically conservative creatures. The conservative mind seeks familiarity because it feels safe. What we call realistic is, often, just a habit.  Most people do not reject abnormal ideas because they are evil or unintelligent. They do it, because human brain, instinctively, prefers to stay defensive. Or, in this modern world, a human is even afraid of sharing his wild dreams. Because people will laugh at him. 

>**If I cannot achieve greatness, then nobody can**.  

Adulthood is quiet tragedic. Many people stop dreaming big not because dreams are impossible, but because societal expectation exhausts them. The leg pulling has become a new habit. The person who follows the existing pathway is called practical; the person who does not is called delusional.  

>**Ending**

In the end, to remain a protagonist in this increasingly demonic world is, itself, becoming an act of rebellion. Modern society constantly leads people toward exhaustion. There is this endless comparison, selective morality, external validation, lust for hierarchy status and social media distraction. A man today is not tested merely by physical hardship, but by whether he can preserve his soul while living inside the so-called good systems. The strongest men are often those who quietly carry responsibility without applause; who continue building despite humiliation, and who refuse to surrender their inner world.  

Be delusional; be the change this world is afraid to see. As George Bernard Shaw quipped, “**The reasonable man adapts himself to the world; the unreasonable one persists in trying to adapt the world to himself. Therefore all progress depends on the unreasonable man**”. 
 
The future may begin as the joke, but the ending – slowly but surely - will become the new norm. Every era calls its visionaries unrealistic until their visions become infrastructure. 
 
“**And those who were seen dancing were thought to be insane by those who could not hear the music**”.  

...................... 

Peace 🕊

body.title: Welcome to my new addiction!
body.body:
> 🙌 (This is a cropped section of an image created by Copilot AI)
Mi nueva adicción...

Mi nueva adicción me está dando dolores y tirones en los muslos cuando me siento y luego intento ponerme de pie. Curiosamente, es solo ahí donde me duele. 😂 Ya sabes cómo es, ese ‘ayyyyyyy’ que se vuelve rutina. Espero que mejore al cabo de 100 días… sí, porque me lo dijo alguien sabio y yo le creo. Pero qué más da, 100 días se van volando, y como yo estoy viendo las cosas… desde que comencé con esta nueva adicción, en lugar de sentirme agotada, me siento como si no tuviera frenos, y las horas tampoco parecen tenerlos. De hecho, ayer llegué a casa y tuve que ponerme a baldear... venía con tanta fuerza que, al intentar arreglar un salidero de agua que detecté en el baño, le metí tal apretón a la rosca del latiguillo del lavamanos que terminé partiendo la tubería… ¡Dios santo! Las cosas se complican con Popeye en casa. Y eso que no he logrado comprar los vegetales… todo esto sucediendo sin espinacas. ¿Qué me recomiendan? 🤣 Al final tuve que llamar al plomero del barrio para que me echara una mano con ese asunto, porque yo lo iba a desarreglar sin remedio. La casa se convirtió en una laguna en menos de lo que canta un gallo. He tratado de hacer una lista de los ejercicios que me indicó el profesor en las dos primeras sesiones, que invariablemente comienzan con calentamiento. Esto es fijo… el calentamiento no puedo saltármelo porque de mi casa al gym hay solo 2 km, así que voy pedaleando relajadamente, sintiendo el fresquito de la mañana. No recuerdo los ejercicios en orden, pero sé que están buenos porque me siento diferente... y más encantadora. 🤣 No te voy a aburrir con cuestiones técnicas. Mantengamos esto simple y con un poco de fuerza bruta. He investigado 😁 y, según parece, las rutinas han estado orientadas a la explosividad 😜 en el tren inferior y la cadena posterior (cuádriceps, glúteos, femorales y zona lumbar)... creo que se nota el enfoque de entrenamiento pesado y de potencia, allí en el tren inferior, donde está lo que me hace exclamar constantemente ‘ayyyy’. En fin, que para el lunes voy a anotar todo porque me interesa tener esas rutinas bien descritas en una libreta. Ya sabes, para poder escribir poemas y cosas así.

My new addiction is giving me aches and strains in my thighs when I sit down and then try to stand up. Curiously, it only hurts there. 😂 You know how it is, that ‘ayyyyyyy’ that becomes routine. I hope it improves after 100 days… yes, because someone wise told me so and I believe them. But what does it matter, 100 days fly by, and the way I see things… since I started with this new addiction, instead of feeling exhausted I feel as if I have no brakes, and time seems to have none either. In fact, yesterday I got home and had to start mopping… I came back with so much strength that, when I tried to fix a water leak I spotted in the bathroom, I tightened the tap connector so hard I ended up breaking the pipe… dear Lord! Things get complicated when Popeye is at home. And I haven’t even managed to buy the vegetables… all this happening without spinach. What do you recommend? 🤣 In the end I had to call the neighbourhood plumber to give me a hand with that matter, because I was about to make it worse without remedy. The house turned into a lagoon in less than the blink of an eye. I’ve tried to make a list of the exercises my coach showed me in the first two sessions, which invariably begin with warm‑up. That’s a must… I can’t skip the warm‑up because the gym is only 2 km from my house, so I cycle there at a relaxed pace, enjoying the morning breeze. I don’t recall the exercises in order, but I know they’re good because I feel different… and more charming. 🤣 I’m not going to bore you with technicalities. Let’s keep this simple and with a touch of raw strength. I’ve done some research 😁 and it seems the routines have been aimed at explosiveness 😜 in the lower body and posterior chain (quads, glutes, hamstrings and lower back)… I think the focus on heavy, power‑oriented training is obvious, right there in the lower body, where it makes me constantly exclaim ‘ayyyy’. Anyway, on Monday I’ll start writing everything down because I want to have those routines properly described in a notebook. You know, for writing poems and such. ---
