body.title: Beef Stew with Carrots and Olives..! 🍲 🍜 || Today's Lunch
body.body:
>

Feliz de saludarlos queridos foodies, espero estén pasando un buen fin de semana en casa junto a su familia, en mi caso me dedique este día a cocinar algo bien nutritivo para mis hijos ofreciéndoles un delicioso almuerzo que prepare con una carne de lomito que compre ayer y decidí estofarla con zanahorias y aceitunas para servirla con pasta corta que tanto les gusta. Este estofado es un plato completo que puedes servir con diferentes guarniciones tanto a la hora del almuerzo como de la cena, a continuación les comparto los ingredientes y su preparación. ***Happy to greet you, dear foodies, I hope you are having a good weekend at home with your family. In my case, I dedicated this day to cooking something very nutritious for my children, offering them a delicious lunch that I prepared with a tenderloin that I bought yesterday and decided to stew it with carrots and olives to serve it with short pasta that they like so much. This stew is a complete dish that you can serve with different garnishes for both lunch and dinner. Below I share the ingredients and their preparation.*** ***

> # Ingredientes: * 500 gramos de Carne de res (corte de lomito) * 2 Ramas de Cebollín * 1 Rama de Ajo porro * 2 Zanahorias medianas * 4 Tomates rojos * 6 Ajíes dulces * 1 cucharada de Vinagre * 3 cucharadas de Aceite vegetal * Condimentos en polvo: Ajo, Pimienta, Comino, Adobo

> # Ingredients: * 500 grams of beef (loin cut) * 2 Branches of Chives * 1 Branch of Garlic * 2 medium carrots * 4 red tomatoes * 6 sweet chili peppers * 1 tablespoon of vinegar * 3 tablespoons of vegetable oil * Powdered seasonings: Garlic, Pepper, Cumin, Marinade

> *** # Paso 1: Lo primero que vamos hacer es adobar la carne con todos los condimentos y sal y se deja reposar en la nevera un par de horas antes de cocinar para que la carne vaya agarrando sabor. Luego llevamos al fuego un sartén grande con suficiente aceite vegetal y añadimos la carne la cual debe estar picada en trozos pequeños, movemos bien con una cuchara grande y dejamos cocinar a fuego moderado, mientras se coloca en una olla pequeña los tomates para sancocharlo, ya que este es el truco para que el guiso queden bien gustoso y espeso. > ***The first thing we are going to do is marinate the meat with all the seasonings and salt and let it rest in the refrigerator for a couple of hours before cooking so that the meat gains flavor. Then we heat a large frying pan with enough vegetable oil and add the meat, which must be chopped into small pieces, stir well with a large spoon and let it cook over moderate heat, while placing the tomatoes in a small pot to parboil it, since this is the trick to making the stew very tasty and thick.*** ***

> *** # Paso 2: A continuación lavamos muy bien los vegetales y hortalizas y mientras se cocina la carne, picamos el cebollín en ruedas y se lo agregamos a la carne; aparte se toman los ajíes dulces se pican en dos y se le retiran todas las semillas, ya que estas son un poco picantes y no queremos que el guiso quede picoso. Al estar listos los tomates se pelan y se llevan a la licuadora, junto a los ajíes y una rama de ajo porro picado, se le agrega una tasa de agua y se licua todo junto. Se agrega el contenido de la licuadora al sartén y se remueve muy bien para integrar todo, se le pone además 1 cucharada de Vinagre, sal al gusto, todos los condimentos y se deja a fuego bajo cocinando. ***

> *** > ***Step 2*** > ***Next we wash the vegetables very well and while the meat is cooking, we chop the chives into circles and add it to the meat; Separately, take the sweet peppers, chop them in two and remove all the seeds, since they are a little spicy and we don't want the stew to be spicy. When the tomatoes are ready, they are peeled and put in the blender, along with the chili peppers and a branch of chopped garlic, a cup of water is added and everything is blended together.*** > ***Add the contents of the blender to the pan and stir very well to integrate everything. Also add 1 tablespoon of vinegar, salt to taste, all the condiments and cook over low heat.*** ***

> *** # Paso 3: Ahora pasamos a lavar y a pelar las zanahorias, se cortan en ruedas y añadimos al sartén con la carne, finalmente colocamos las aceitunas para darle un toque diferente, a mí en lo particular me gusta mucho el sabor de las aceitunas, le agrego también un chorrito del vinagre de la aceituna y dejo que se haga la salsa a fuego lento. Mientras pongo a cocinar pasta corta para servir el estofado de carne como guarnición principal y sofrió algunas rebanadas de plátano maduro que son muy ricos por su dulzura. ***

> *** > # Step 3 > ***Now we move on to washing and peeling the carrots, cut them into rounds and add them to the pan with the meat, finally we add the olives to give it a different touch, I personally really like the flavor of the olives, I also add a splash of the olive vinegar and let the sauce cook over low heat. While I cook short pasta to serve the meat stew as the main garnish and sauté some slices of ripe banana that are very delicious due to their sweetness.*** ***

> *** ***Ya al cabo de 10 minutos tendremos todo listo para servir, les cuento que este estofado queda sumamente delicioso por el contraste de sabores de las zanahorias y las aceitunas; en mi caso les serví la pasta con el estofado de carne a mis hijos, y le agregue queso rallado para gratinar este plato que es un almuerzo muy nutritivo y practico de cocinar, por lo que les recomiendo que se lo preparen a su familia ya que estoy segura que les encantará, al igual que les gusto a mis seres queridos; y a ustedes amigos ¿cómo les gusta servir su estofado?, hasta una próxima oportunidad.*** ***

> *** > ***After 10 minutes we will have everything ready to serve. I tell you that this stew is extremely delicious due to the contrast of flavors of the carrots and the olives; In my case, I served the pasta with the meat stew to my children, and I added grated cheese to gratin this dish, which is a very nutritious and practical lunch to cook, so I recommend that you prepare it for your family since I am sure they will love it, just as my loved ones will love it; And you friends, how do you like to serve your stew? Until next time.*** ***

>

body.title: Dryomyza anilis fly
body.body: > This morning, I found something interesting again, perched on an old wall. It was a Dryomyza anilis fly, a beautifully colored species of fly from the Dryomyzidae family. Its body was light brown, accentuated by the jet black of its eyes. I found the fly perched there, seemingly lethargic, perhaps having just finished a fight or perhaps just completed a long journey. When I approached, it didn't appear afraid; it appeared relaxed, as if nothing had happened. I was delighted to find an insect that behaved like that.

> To the naked eye, the fly looked ordinary, perhaps even uninteresting. However, when it appeared on camera, especially when I zoomed in, its body appeared stunning, as if nature had painted it with soft, warm colors. Its small body was also covered in fine hairs, making its appearance even more captivating. The reflection of the sunlight made it even more alluring. The fine hairs resembled a coat, perhaps protecting it from the harsh environment it had explored.

body.body: Ще минулого року бачила в місцевих групах соцмереж оголошення від заготівельників: \

. Бажання заробити добавку до пенсії спонукає реагувати на подібні оголошення. Та, по-перше, тоді ми не знали, де шукати ту бузину, адже тільки перший рік тут жили. А по-друге, важко собі було уявити той пресловутий кілограм цвіту, за який дають 5 центів. Тому тема не була розвинута.
Але от знову з'явилися оголошення про прийом цвіту бузини, вже по 35 гривень за кілограм. Ставки ростуть, валюта міцніє!🤣 Та й декотрі зарослі бузини я вже знаю де знайти. Залишилось нерозкритим тільки одне питання: яка кількість цвіту відповідає кілограму ваги.
І от сьогодні, гуляючи з Джес, я спеціально пішла мимо кущів бузини. Щоб зірвати пару китиць цвіту і зважити. 
І нічого оптимістичного не побачила: на кілограм ваги мені треба зірвати у 20 разів більше. І тільки тоді я маю шанс на пресловуті ...8 центів? Чи я невірно рахую? Підкажіть, будь ласка.🙃

body.title: This Year Feels Like a Bean Year / 今年は豆の年！？
body.body:
The weather has been wonderfully sunny lately, and the temperatures have been perfect for cycling, so I've been visiting my garden quite often on my bike 😊

Among all the vegetables and flowers I planted for spring and summer, the beans are doing especially well. Broad beans, which I sow first every year in February and move outside after few weeks, have already started producing pods.

![0E9A056B-E42C-4C9B-B9BB-5A4D91A018DA\_1\_201\_a.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/EoEqx3KqWH5NTQQLmEZbYDcUjrbWK6jrMv3vVudvdqjmcWb4mckvPMMLXJZ4VzjYkRW.jpeg)

The various common beans I transplanted recently are also thriving. One of the varieties I'm particularly excited about this year is an heirloom bean called Magpie Bean. It got its name because its black-and-white pattern resembles the colors of a magpie. It's my first time growing it, and I can't wait to see how it develops. You can never have too many green beans, and since they freeze well, I've planted them in several places around the garden also to see which spot of the garden do they like.

![D00D6711-21E7-42A4-9BA9-3F05A2C33C8D\_1\_201\_a.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/EoGyM8cwfxh6vRKoep1gstzPwmTf1UkGsLx1vgWFwksMuBBQz69tFo2SF82Mhd2nm2u.jpeg)

Yesterday I also planted runner beans, which prefer even warmer conditions. I planted them around a tipi trellis and hope they will happily climb up it. While reading about them, I was surprised to learn that runner beans are actually related to common beans even both the flowers and the beans themselves look completely different.

![C59EE584-D508-4CA6-A8EF-066F5D249F18\_1\_105\_c.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/Eo8SH4VX3xGeBmL5pisvQv8oXKLEET7n21z5Nsf2v6aA1hmBcKNLNbWJndXHnqPanh8.jpeg)

Speaking of tipis, I built another, smaller one and planted lima beans around it. The seeds came from a bean collector in Spain. 

![B5C6475D-2397-4F3D-89C6-0E2EAAD5CFE5\_1\_201\_a.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/23uFRhVtHekqGxW7xSUY7RdwnBGvEqVbHrNK3HgEGSNe1szjmZ8vyEehq9aKiW8rt5Hrf.jpeg)

Both runner beans and lima beans have beautiful patterns, which are well liked in my bean jewelry workshop. In the photo below, the bean at the top left is an Andromeda Lima Bean, and the one to its right is a Scarlet Runner Bean.

![6165C5A1-3319-49C7-8E59-55BBD07B3780\_1\_105\_c.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/EoGyvypfzmPm8VuBy65LeBFV1nBigqdE4gVmyjQunnjTrwuo3E1zTPn288mks5TPfQL.jpeg)

Tomorrow I'm hosting a bean necklace workshop at a handmade market, so I'm fully in a bean mood now. Then I revisited a graphic of my favorite lima bean that I originally drew about three years ago and recolored it to match my current taste. The new version is also available on @nftshowroom.

![スクリーンショット 2026-05-30 7.36.52.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/23yxCbi22bChXJC12jvq4P4gGQbF1f24awkmh4znSNGs53eNg18LvVehYVSp6zyFu7LTs.png)

https://nftshowroom.com/gallery/akipponn_beautiful-beans_lima-2026

As I was working on it, I remembered thinking at the beginning of this year, \

It's funny how things sometimes turn out that way.

So I wish everyone a beautiful weekend & happy gardening!

---

このところ快晴が続いて、気温もサイクリングにばっちりということで足しげく庭に通っています。

あれこれ春夏の野菜や花を植えた中でも、豆がとても元気です。毎年一番に種をまいて外に出すそら豆はもう鞘をつけ始めています。

![0E9A056B-E42C-4C9B-B9BB-5A4D91A018DA_1_201_a.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/EoEqx3KqWH5NTQQLmEZbYDcUjrbWK6jrMv3vVudvdqjmcWb4mckvPMMLXJZ4VzjYkRW.jpeg)

先日移植した各種インゲン豆も元気にしています。中でもエアルームのMagpie Bean（カササギという鳥と色の組み合わせが似ていることからこの名前らしい）という白黒の豆は今年初めて育てていてとても楽しみにしている豆の一つです。インゲンはいくらあっても食べられるし、冷凍してもよいので、そここに植っています。

![D00D6711-21E7-42A4-9BA9-3F05A2C33C8D_1_201_a.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/EoGyM8cwfxh6vRKoep1gstzPwmTf1UkGsLx1vgWFwksMuBBQz69tFo2SF82Mhd2nm2u.jpeg)

インゲンよりもさらに暖かいのを好むランナービーンも昨日植えてきました。Tipiの周りを囲むように植えました。うまく登ってくれ流ことを願いつつ。調べていてびっくりしたのですが、このランナービーンってインゲンなんですね。たしかに和名はベニバナインゲン・・・見た目も豆の感じも全然違うのに。

![C59EE584-D508-4CA6-A8EF-066F5D249F18_1_105_c.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/Eo8SH4VX3xGeBmL5pisvQv8oXKLEET7n21z5Nsf2v6aA1hmBcKNLNbWJndXHnqPanh8.jpeg)

Tipiといえばもう一つ小ぶりのものを作って、スペインの豆コレクターの方から購入したリマ豆をまわりに植えました。

![B5C6475D-2397-4F3D-89C6-0E2EAAD5CFE5_1_201_a.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/23uFRhVtHekqGxW7xSUY7RdwnBGvEqVbHrNK3HgEGSNe1szjmZ8vyEehq9aKiW8rt5Hrf.jpeg)

ランナービーンもリマ豆も模様がとてもきれいなで、アクセサリーを作る時に人気です。下の写真の一番上の左側がアンドロメダ・リマというリマ豆、その右側がスカーレット・ランナービーンです。

![6165C5A1-3319-49C7-8E59-55BBD07B3780_1_105_c.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/EoGyvypfzmPm8VuBy65LeBFV1nBigqdE4gVmyjQunnjTrwuo3E1zTPn288mks5TPfQL.jpeg)

明日は豆ネックレスのワークショップということもあって、気分は豆ムードで、3年ほど前に描いて @nftshowroom でミントしたグラフィックを今の気分似合う色に直しました。新しいものもNFT Show Roomに置いてあります。


![スクリーンショット 2026-05-30 7.36.52.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/23yxCbi22bChXJC12jvq4P4gGQbF1f24awkmh4znSNGs53eNg18LvVehYVSp6zyFu7LTs.png)

https://nftshowroom.com/gallery/akipponn_beautiful-beans_lima-2026

実は今年の年初に「今年はなんだか豆な一年になる気がする」と思ったことを思い出し、なんともおもしろいですね。明日は豆のワークショップを楽しんできます！

body.body: > Hello, hello, another week here, participating silently. I like it because it's another way for me to vent and think carefully about the things I enjoy, which is why I always come back to answer questions from this community.

> Hello, hello, una semana más por aquí, participando de forma silenciosa. Me gusta porque es una forma más de desahogarme y de poder pensar concienzudamente en las cosas que me gustan, por eso siempre vuelvo para responder las preguntas de esta comunidad.
![IMG_4354.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdAWkYyMLJ4JRSVKbacrcsi66V6p4e773Gj17apMgmPYP/IMG_4354.jpeg)

> > What is your favorite safe heaven for relaxation and why? I think I'll be pretty general here; I love being in nature. So, that's my favorite place I could even call it paradise. Nature is everywhere in the world, so it's not a specific place. To relax, my goal isn't to seek intense emotions, but quite the opposite. I believe there's nothing better than connecting with those things that make you feel like yourself. In my case, that might include a peaceful walk, moments of silence, a simple meal outdoors, time to read or write, observing the landscape, and ending by watching the sunset. Not because these activities are extraordinary, but because they allow you to be present in the moment. Nature demands nothing. It doesn't ask for results, productivity, or explanations. It simply offers you space to be and exist. There, we can find clarity, peace, and a sense of freedom that's hard to achieve amidst the daily grind.

> >¿Cuál es tu paraíso seguro favorito para relajarte y por qué? Creo que seré bastante general aquí, me gusta estar con la naturaleza. Entonces, ese es mi lugar favorito qué podría decir paraíso, en todo el mundo hay naturaleza por eso no es un lugar concreto. Para relajarme mi objetivo no es buscar emociones intensas sino todo lo contrario. Considero que no hay nada mejor que poder conectar con esqs cosas que te hacen sentir tu misma, en mi caso, podría incluir una caminata tranquila, momentos de silencio, una comida sencilla al aire libre, tiempo para leer o escribir, observar el paisaje y terminar contemplando el atardecer. No porque esas actividades sean extraordinarias, sino porque permiten estar presentes en el momento. La naturaleza no exige nada. No pide resultados, productividad ni explicaciones. Simplemente te ofrece espacio para estar y ser. Allí podemos encontrqr claridad, paz y una sensación de libertad difícil de conseguir en medio de la rutina diaria.

![1000222347.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/EoiVDpAT5fDL6p4StP7tBhxV4nAgrfmpDrWd2MqXswKmUL8saAFtJRBd4Rt8t7JY9mq.jpg)

A beautiful morning and happy weekend to us all. I hope that the new day met us in good health and sound mind. We are up a bit earlier today and have hit the road in order to go continue the planting of the remaining parts of our lettuce of which the planting is yet to be completed. 


![1000222299.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23wqi8x4jrxvwTeSQMhQcusYWrC7p1tkhjywNtdcVgY6Qqspsv4hW5Zj6rP2iztc8zSG5.jpg)


We started the planting of these lettuce some few days back and there is still a significant part of the field to be covered as we ran out of seedlings the other day.
Although the labourers were able to complete the tillage of the land we which was the planned quotation portion for the planting of the veggies. 


![1000220453.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23xyQv5NkAebwf3Bx2mTZNaE9upa2soTK49pqSMYvpNNbjbCv2duroot8TCv4Y4yvoWxS.jpg)

Right after noticing some infection among the vegetables, this particular pesticide was purchase to stop the wild spread and pest attack on the veggies. The pesticides were mixed with sufficient amount of amount of water as prescribed on the label before which it was spread round the entire farm. 


![1000222296.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23yd1GkYgM87Zi2ucZutQaYbH9Dv78mf2nm368w7EmSF41DvYDVs2Hcn8BrB9rrzR1Qcf.jpg)

----

![1000222323.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/241tSxKH5TfRdA2fx53JobMpvdcD6x9jhYoduWtwXHyUyYLN1FqSVBFobU6pzSk88CiXE.jpg)


Starting from the fluted pumpkins that were infected down to the other vegetables here. The pesticides was applied to the entire vegetables. 
While at it, it is advisable to allow the veggies remain for at least 2weeks before one can approach them for eating. And if there is adequate rainfall within this timing it also cleanses the veggies and dilutes the pesticides more. Although these pesticide won't be harmful to healthz taking such cautuon is very necessary. 

![1000222290.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23uFTcpArkQ5xZsi4vXezK9fwKVB3gvcpFG1Va9QZMAkGtXMy3f6AbtvfqT5z8KgDFeCr.jpg)

----

![1000222329.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23wC5ciqwe6A3nwBS9ec2MtHFPGJNcyK5V3Uw9hfSe1KQeo5Y56dsPAE6LpMUJk5PDJyZ.jpg)

These are clusters of different vegetables and grasses mixed together. Vegetables and peppers have been planted together here, Spinach, jute mallow and peppers all together in thesame field. Only the fluted pumpkins that often have the privilege of being planted alone and even if they will be mixed with any crops it is often the tall growing cereals. Fluted pumpkins don't grow well if they are mixed in company of other veggies like you see these clusters of veggies in the picture.


![1000221780.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23xVHCstwsFK1Ry2r9hgaJFDxYh5AJwp7deYZQTcdZmFzrLnuzMFXvDyFLGe4TpusrcG9.jpg)
----

![1000222311.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23wzzeagyLhCRwVJJRGrHnwo86ygt8nnkCqcH8fGyj3f9zHPYa6N2o8LDSxgxEJo74xrx.jpg)

Even after carrying out weeding multiple times on this veggies farm, the grasses stull found a way to overwhelm the veggies. The land is a fertile ground and more reason for the fast growth of both plants and their counterparts. Even if the peppers and veggies are fully grown, weeding has to still be carried out so that the farm can be kept clean in order not to habour snakes or any dangerous animals whenever we enter the farm to harvest anything. Another round of weeding will have to hence be carried here one more time except if we decide to add some selective herbicides

body.title: Sugarcane Harvesting: A Flexible and Reliable Crop for Farmers
body.body:
![1000206617.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/AJoKuLdxzVFcmUtLbaXmC8cjVmDnPkH6Ng7JJEwAB6MeuHVExwZz5tjLznTEnV3.jpg)

Today, we harvested a small part of our sugarcane farm because we needed additional financing for our farming expenses. The sugarcane cutters started their work very early in the morning. Everyone worked hard to cut and prepare the sugarcane for delivery.


![1000206441.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23xALzrkMiudWzCBBBi8b8jAPh24vcwvXqtrNx3xfjxjsd5CEKHjmDNHwqRGUp9X56QCq.jpg)

Sugarcane farming is an important source of income for many farmers. It is a crop that requires patience because it takes a long time to grow. Sugarcane usually needs about 10 to 18 months before it is ready for harvest. The exact time depends on the weather, soil condition, and sugarcane variety.

![1000206439.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23w2ijy7nvUTsC75QkEJoK5r6FJ16RN7UVMjn2gDm6vfXDXHQwboRPgnGJx1dFLif9be9.jpg)


![1000206547.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23wMYm1vLuLSozqUcEwFPFF22pokfc6XGFfXQ413f8KoR271jdwzo6iAY4c281yHn2LGf.jpg)

The farming process starts with preparing the land. Farmers plow the field and make rows for planting. Healthy sugarcane stalks are then planted in the soil. After planting, the crop needs regular care. Farmers remove weeds, apply fertilizer, and monitor the field to help the sugarcane grow well. Good rainfall and proper field management are also important for a successful harvest.


![1000206431.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23tbtuuSkp6Av7xBHkf2PygUmBpj5YXvSWMxmLfZvKbvA3dSn2TB6f6C3o9YWntmQwWLu.jpg)

![1000206433.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23uQrHEbuWAhQSg9T1Ffj2sJx4xotDBsf9kjBacCnoDKGQecBxDN1z9JTqEwACeCYD8u6.jpg)

One thing I like about sugarcane farming is its flexibility. When the sugarcane is already mature, farmers can decide when to harvest it. If there is an urgent need for money, a small portion of the field can be harvested. The remaining sugarcane can stay in the field and be harvested later. This gives farmers more options in managing their finances.

![1000206428.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23tHAAbw4YiEfrbc3jzpFhjtuBcKYGAgAKc1tXjjGW3tbMZEJ1PqicZK5nM1vA86fPzJk.jpg)



Sugarcane farming is not easy. It requires hard work, time, and patience. Farmers face different challenges such as changing weather conditions, pests, and rising farming costs. Even with these challenges, many farmers continue growing sugarcane because it can provide a good income when the harvest is successful.



![1000206546.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23uQtsUnz6AFT1mXueazFf9bo9B6zxgwRu7K76gnwoNUR4gxxRpGUnuVCPfzappVorx6H.jpg)

![1000206549.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23y8wfPrD2FE828L1paTrSnjrByGDZXiLp7bCPadxeKS8Tj5mborGZkXY8q88bsP41pAV.jpg)

Today's harvest was only a small part of our farm, but it was still a productive day. Seeing the harvested sugarcane reminds us that our hard work is paying off. Every harvest, whether big or small, is important for our family and our farming journey.
We are thankful for this blessing and for the people who helped with the harvest. We hope for a good harvest from the remaining sugarcane in the coming months.


![1000206542.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23w2m8PgrAcpaMmq7J1xoft3aXmtq1CzhutmeCHhBxZHHpFMn5h1d8zFwFMrKZm4T3ssw.jpg)

Thank you for reading my story. This is my own picture, edited in Canva.

body.body:
I honestly do believe that kids have a phase where secrecy is normalized. Even when their actions may not be considered bad, they prefer to stay silent or share certain information with their siblings or peers alone. Thankfully, it usually doesn't last long for those who were raised in much love and honesty.

If I ever had kids, surely that depth of love and honesty would be the first thing I raise them with. I'll teach them how open communication works and the benefits of sharing confidential information with me. I'll encourage them to be comfortable with me as well by letting them on in my own decisions and secrets. That way, trust is built and they can always imitate what they see. 

We're no longer in the times where lack of communication and inability to express oneself in a close knit family should be glorified. Now more than ever, we must draw the young ones closer because the more they confide in us, the less grieviances they habour, and the easier it is for us to solve situations that involves their safety and general well being.

title.title: Sunset Magic on the Digul River: Finding Peace After a Long Day
title.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWyHFHGh8dU5o5LNVDk5TFFZgb1zxkmw6niFuVKkqunhh/1000711638.jpg 

Working in a remote area in South Papua means my days are often filled with intense routine and challenges. However, nature has a special way of rewarding me at the end of each day. Recently, I captured the breathtaking sunset over the Digul River, and it truly felt like the perfect remedy for a weary mind.
https://3speak.tv/shorts?v=yordan96/fiwiwrno
The sky turned into a canvas of fiery oranges, soft pinks, and deep purples, reflecting perfectly onto the calm waters of the river. Seeing the boats docked by the riverside as the sun dipped below the horizon brought a sense of profound serenity that is hard to find anywhere else.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmX7txjW8tnYyLzZzD4bmV4d3CP7DN1huzPU3ktH7h1EEQ/1000711599.jpg 
There is something about the Digul River at twilight that makes all the day's stress just fade away. The stillness of the water creates a mirror-like effect, magnifying the beauty of the clouds above.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWfTZXyv1oDHVfQKwG2CKMLeyCLxMFFMeZLoPjQgjXx7b/1000711632.jpg 

It’s not just about the view; it’s about the quiet moments that ground me. Even in the middle of a busy workday, taking five minutes to stop and look at the sky reminds me to be grateful for the life I live and the beauty that surrounds me in this remote corner of Indonesia.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmW98RUupiRmZUuJ46DTzm5GReZQRSLztzQBD4jpAbXx76/1000711636.jpg 
I hope this little piece of my evening in South Papua brings a bit of calm to your day, wherever you are. Nature really is the best therapy.
​📍 Location: Kali Digoel – Jair Asiki, South Papua

title.title: Crypto Cooking - One Tray Of Baked Eggs
title.body:
Cooking and cryptocurrency have more in common than people think. Both need the right ingredients, precise timing, and enough experimentation to avoid ending up completely cooked.

The market still knows how to scramble emotions faster than an overmixed omelets In the kitchen, chefs balance heat, texture, and flavour while trying not to burn the final result.

In crypto, we mix assets, chase yields, survive volatility, and hope our portfolios do not turn into bag holder breakfast specials. Today we feast with my trademark recipe! 

Some days your trades come out fluffy and perfectly folded like a French omelets. Other days the market flips you before you can flip the eggs.... but we keep going! 

Raided my fridge for leftovers today and decided to make my signature dish… the baked omelet! One of those “there’s nothing to eat” situations that somehow turns into a masterpiece! 

Will get better than farming points on L2s chains once you start throwing random ingredients together. Food waste is as bad humanity as are rug pulls in the crypto space! 

I opened the fridge, saw a few surviving vegetables, some mozzarella, a block of cheese, double cream, spinach, and spring onions staring back at me like a portfolio waiting for allocation.


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmW6co7ETMViBoS6fhJhJ9416s9fwm16h3TgYYa2b98vtk/image.png)


Only few minutes later the whole kitchen smelled like a full-blown bull market. The baked omelets is honestly undefeated because it works exactly like crypto HODL mode! 

You take what you have, combine the right ingredients, trust the process, and hope you don’t overcook everything at the last second. Too much heat? Burnt edges and instant regret.

Too little? A weak structure that falls apart the moment you touch it. Same thing happens onchain. Every ingredient has its role. Cheese is the liquidity holding the ecosystem together.

Mozzarella brings the stretch, just like long-term conviction during volatile markets. Double cream adds richness the same way yields make a portfolio feel alive again.

Spinach and spring onions are the risk management ... being healthy enough to convince yourself the whole thing is balanced. Crypto portfolios are basically giant omelets.

But why I baked a tray of eggs? Because I can! Layered the ingredients with style, making sure that there's even distribution... not like the TGE where the team keeps 80% of the supply! 


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeodyc62m4V1Q6WntgCQPbeMQxMcfNJyhLaf7osG3kUxN/image.png)


Some people throw everything into one pan and pray. Others carefully layer strategies, rebalance positions, compound yields, and try not to get wrecked by sudden market flips.

Timing matters in both worlds. Take the eggs out too early and it collapses... hold it too long and it dries out completely. Markets and eggs behave the same way.

Enter too early and you bleed patience.... exit too late and you become exit liquidity for someone else’s breakfast. What I like most about cooking is that it mirrors the same experimentation!

Sometimes the weird combinations end up working best and usually the leftovers become the strongest play. One random ingredient changes the whole outcome.

Whether it’s building positions or building dinner, there’s always some chaos involved, a bit of creativity, and the constant possibility that things either turn into perfection… or complete disaster.

That’s why I enjoy both worlds so much.  Thankfully today the omelet printed higher than most altcoins, and it took only 25 minutes to reach the golden perfection that I wanted


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRUzqtRfrGGLKo9UUCkB2rpXBe8gM1JdEVM5vNgZyckxd/image.png)


Whether it’s the kitchen or crypto charts... it’s all about reading the moment, trusting your instincts, and knowing when to let things ride.  Don't forget... game is game! 

No matter how you like your eggs... make sure you cook them well! Stir them, beat them or create some weird magic! Think of them as the memecoins of the food industry! 

Airdrops are basically the spices of crypto. Unexpected little ingredients that add extra flavour and excitement to the plate. Yields are the salt, pepper, and butter ... the fundamentals that make everything richer when used correctly.

Just like cooking, the secret is patience. Rush the pan and you burn the omelets. Rush the market and you usually get rekt. Stay farming, stay cooking, and never let the alpha go cold

>There are reports that the Donald Trump administration is pushing for a plan to give Iran massive economic compensation.
The New York Times reported on the 28th (local time) that the Trump administration delivered an unofficial request to the Gulf and Arab countries to fund Iran's reconstruction after the war.
According to reports, Gulf countries are discussing the creation of a large-scale investment fund worth $300 billion (about 449 trillion won) on the premise that Iran responds to the previous agreement.
While some point out that the funds are in the nature of war compensation that Iran has been demanding from the United States, the U.S. emphasizes that it is not direct support to Iran.

>The New York Times reported, \
This means that the U.S. will block political criticism and burden by providing bypass support, rather than injecting war compensation, which could be seen as \

into U.S. funds.
In addition, the U.S. is considering lifting some of the Iranian funds currently frozen in Qatar so that they can be used to purchase humanitarian goods such as pharmaceuticals and industrial raw materials.

>Iran Freeze Fund, Key Issues in the Previous Negotiations
The Strait of Hormuz, nuclear material disposal, and frozen funds are considered key issues in the face of a series of reports that the U.S. and Iran are close to reaching an end-of-war deal.
Iran is determined to open the Strait of Hormuz if the frozen funds are lifted first, while the United States maintains its stance to open the strait first and give up the frozen funds if it gives up nuclear material.
Currently, President Trump may be quite burdened by handing over frozen funds in his country to Iran, considering administrative procedures and political opposition in the United States.
Qatar, on the other hand, is a resource-rich country with financial leeway and has tied up Iran's frozen funds worth nearly 9 trillion won (9 billion U.S. dollars). Qatar is a bypass path through which the flow of funds can be controlled without the U.S. directly handing over cash to Iran.
Qatar is considered the only country that can serve as a financial buffer among the several arbitrators of the war between the United States and Iran.

>\

\nU.S. online media Axios reported in a recent report that the U.S. and Iran have agreed to an end-of-war memorandum of understanding (MOU), and only President Trump's final approval remains.\nAxios quoted officials from the U.S. government and arbitration agencies on the 28th, saying, \
\nA U.S. government official told the media, \

The 60-day memorandum of understanding reportedly included a promise by Iran not to pursue nuclear weapons. During the 60-day negotiation period, Iran's method of handling highly enriched uranium and the period of uranium enrichment were specified as the first issues to be discussed.
It also said that ships passing through the Strait of Hormuz will be operated without restrictions. It also included that there is no toll imposed by Iran, and that Iran must remove all mines from the strait within 30 days and return ship traffic to pre-war conditions.
However, in connection with the report, Iran's Tasnim news agency cited a source familiar with the negotiating team and refuted, \

Reporter Song Hyun-seo

It may just be hearsay, but it doesn’t seem entirely unfounded.
If the investment actually goes through, I believe there’s a good chance it will be profitable.
That could create a mutually beneficial situation for both sides.
Ultimately, the key may be to bring them out of isolation.

title.title: FANTASY TOURISM IN THE CITY OF PARADIS
title.body:
Since I haven't had time to drive around and visit real places lately, I decided to take a litlle virtual vacation last night and visit a city that doesn't exist outside the video game for which it was constructed.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmamVG4iwbz5DBVm7tKrCrHvi6RrJDoY9jpijrdhPrJs8q/screenshot_2244_.png)

Paradis is the largest city and the unofficial capital of The Living Lands. This place, called The Living Lands, is a rugged island, part of the world called Eora, in which the games Pillars of Eternity and Avowed are set.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbfqYGEx5qNfPxTp8kCdZ8vLjUFpCVLfJZi8mB16juh6n/screenshot_2262_.png)

The Living Lands is a wild frontier. Civilization is slowly expanding across the island, but the laws and infrastructure are very sparse and fragile in this part of Eora.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdeZkamPxY53cEdBMxcwqL2jfgcwf7XTNw82szrSr8Joq/screenshot_2243_.png)

The settlements across the island are small and far apart. Paradis, the only major city, isn't much bigger than other settlements of this mostly untamed land.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbvuDswsxQyyKwTSA3y6thZy4KAGisaDSguKnNWWP9UMm/screenshot_2260_.png)

Paradis is situated on the southern coast of the island, in the region known as Dawnshore, and is the first place in The Living Lands that a newcomer sees. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSTn9AXhwP2Z87eHpFFAbiX9DmqzTDUJrmUrKpzbk6iqK/screenshot_2581_.png)

Being a wild frontier, this place attracts adventurers and explorers in search of new, exciting stuff, but also people (which means various types of inteligent fantasy humanoids) who are searching for a better life or a fresh new start. Those who run from the law can also be sometimes found here, hiding in dark alleys of Paradis or somewhere in the dangerous wilderness.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPTi2boPNtpYmDYea4GwHWSJwiydj5S45PK7p7M5wgwNa/screenshot_2245_.png)

The loose law enforcement that can't cover much of the territory makes the island a mecca for smugglers, pirates, and some very shady trading organizations. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfHpinccpcRraA9fNoeECTaGwAYE8qABTvc1978qet6Lx/screenshot_2589_.png)

This screenshot shows the slum outside the thick stony walls of the city.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV1TN1VWBApnwsCEvNZxUB8t5c27pjigPjNtmM73m4dJq/screenshot_2592_.png)

Everything is made of wood in this place.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYrKoBwNUuURkZNrmKZJCK5FjFnjMGqL7DBWVZT1dqmyf/screenshot_2593_.png)

By everything, I mean wooden shacks and barracks upon barracks, that's all there is, and everything looks like it could collapse at any moment.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNVVEbg5beGdNSG3RunVj4mWSkU1djRcxxPbuQJXPUY6U/screenshot_2587_.png)

One of the cool things about this game is the way the light paints the environments, and the way everything changes as the day turns into the night, and vice versa. This screenshot shows the slum at night, while in the following one ...

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ8vFoUmQh5gxHUtukRB1Wn8kToUVwykj1dp5ZN1ij2cs/screenshot_2590_.png)

... you can see the same place early in the morning. I love the juicy, saturated colors in this game.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaFqRXfr8z63rPgJGd8WLgQ2m61gv3Wj4UsyQ5cjg5UTA/screenshot_2584_.png)

By the way, the name of the game is Avowed, if you haven't already guessed it. I post quite often about it lately.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSwtVomaXhsBygwJBK26qS2erxpcudKZJQQStMdhWWxdP/screenshot_2586_.png)

This screenshot shows a small, shady shop in the slum.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaKthB7WpW4VHyAen8UJKg4uobd8HEgZrUJswksMfArLK/screenshot_2583_.png)

It seems that quite a few of those who come to The Living Lands in search of a better life end up spending the rest of their lives here. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfX1n1gbyvJbBikw3AonHQkzm49GSgWo6JM4YiemUdwh7/screenshot_2249_.png)

Here you can see a cool, relatively small wagon on one of the squares inside the city walls. It looks like something a mobile vendor would use.

 ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmP3PLN3KX23jCdQ5stE5azedqtRvZabPbbxDGX32gbPQy/screenshot_2233_.png)

This screenshot shows the interior of a large, elegant villa.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTi3YJ51BCLmVYmbN8D9SVYUVUS4Phf3xmpekm7E12EGk/screenshot_2234_.png)

Here, the focus is on the inner courtyard of the same villa.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYZQPGDBJcpZS6K3Jfr8oFjpxK6cSLuptZZRjbfpvtZyf/screenshot_2247_.png)

All around the city, you can see large fabrics stretched from rooftop to rooftop or from a rooftop to the city wall. I can't tell you what their function is. Maybe they are here only to make a bit of shade. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf1orCLnt3BKiWQBCdueAQT8upytarDgskzhKK2tdpMhf/screenshot_2250_.png)

At some point, I decided to try out how resilient those fabrics are. That's how the hole in the fabric shown in this screenshot came to be.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmawK8LfSPB8LWFWfKyXbqtrGLpkZUDp78tcFwbWnQ1PmE/screenshot_2703_.png)

Here you can see another interior.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmapCxN3sZZeHc87H2ofrD1sFt4bJ7Rt88hxM9TtFjmfj6/screenshot_2704_.png)

This is the large, well-equipped kitchen of another villa.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSicfyoLzF8zdAgaVogj3LghWicRUP2LBSWiRqXmaeRLC/screenshot_2693_.png)

Here, you can take a look at a good chunk of the city at night.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdRiyYjYbJZDnCVJJJXGym53rsnDohcxfQiAKZP73mYFA/screenshot_2257_.png)

In this street life scene, someone is lecturing, preaching, or declaiming on a stage of sorts in front of a modest audience.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTj2gwFex3NmJoijsd57RZLLkywVfaLngx9AFWh1K4PRk/screenshot_2254_.png)

Here you can see a wagon and some buildings. Nothing special, just another urban scene.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVwC5n5KCLfqTNydzpbQQggc7kEEs9tN1uZrY9NXLx9sQ/screenshot_2258_.png)

I found these mysterious symbols in one of the small, dark alleys I usually avoid.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc4JeLfH5ZyVEjq6v9M2EqExPAUb8fcj2v77yskuMCvrX/screenshot_2436_.png)

The architecture in Paradis is fairly varied.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWyJzQh23HpNBhwvrbsucuzns9pD4ENdJbNSZixHXv1jj/screenshot_2580_.png)

It's a mix of styles from various regions of The Living Lands.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdfrd13rAfspdMdUYRWt4LebgSCcHko5qFHiGvNS8GeXg/screenshot_2707_.png)

The accommodation isn't expensive.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQma9XYWSPUAjvEJQNe5WJ5aneFAaeo4rh3sFviaGWFhxxa/screenshot_2694_.png)

Nighthlife isn't glamorous, but at least you can easily get robbed or killed, which can be exciting, and you can bring home great stories if you survive.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYZNJ5f2HqjTYKUY4kLhrnk6kf5UUfSRo3SffSo3jgR6d/screenshot_2264_.png)

The food isn't the best, but it has a certain local charm which isn't always easy to swallow. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXCZRZPA2R4GSXb6GqyziDeyJMLqk1KGm4k4BbUNHuzX7/screenshot_2271_.png)

This is the most renowned tavern in the city. The Grinning Balarok. That's the name. Balaroks are rare, ferocious, underground creatures that no one has ever seen.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNzoge1Ywu9r5sE9tiR8WrBkfDkbygN7Lqh7tEg9j79VF/screenshot_2274_.png)

This tavern is situated in the part of Paradis unofficially known as the Underbelly. Smugglers, pirates, and all kinds of cutthroats congregate there. The place is far from being safe, but the cuisine is surprisingly refined...and poisonous, if needed. For the right price, you can order a murder as easily as lunch or dinner there.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNNyuRVtYXtAHkJPbzHmttb9G7Aa83A7cWP9ukSTdQZ1c/screenshot_2273_.png)

Here you can see the dark, humid alley behind the tavern. Glowing mushrooms are one of the local attractions.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdvSTgjYEDGw3M5jDGEDrNp6xeJRYkVYYdtDcu2fzH7s8/screenshot_2275_.png)

This nighttime scene from the Underbelly shows, among other things, two people talking. The conversation is probably quite shady.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfJAW3QTdLLzibeTtap85fDRQ3s47XWw1bTYF13U5jks9/screenshot_2270_.png)

Here you can see the same area early in the morning.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeSUcsN7QqdEtRkuGSJPNTPgV6ShkNVSc3a6oSY9r4W5u/screenshot_2269_.png)

The underbelly definitely shares some stuff with the slum outside the walls of the fortified city.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZpu3PJr4dwgn3S2Y476MXbVmdZEvk4XSuBapBhXQHf4W/screenshot_2691_.png)

This is the home of a local fortuneteller, a scammer, of course. The place is a luxury villa - of course.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdS1WuyWcLQiucMSDQSXLReAa5jQnAuuVst6NXFGJu3du/screenshot_2640_.png)

Another expensive place, can't tell you who this one belongs to.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf9ks2zvUWdgGJZycXjLd1xHMoX8HSb7JqcuFBYQHYXTW/screenshot_2435_.png)

This is one of the larger squares of the city.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWXGnUPnxfK3UAJYqHrYf7nswMcgatDFUiFosVVYo7pNv/screenshot_2439_.png)

I'm a bit tired of writing right now. That's why I won't write anything under this picture. Oops - I just wrote something.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVBMKYQmihAraYVKdzpBCbxyrLywGb44zkZTcXtGSsPDS/screenshot_2255_.png)

Here you can see some lovely details of an inner courtyard of one of the large, stylish buildings on the main square.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTo48ouFgqVAM5PuohVGTQepcJGDZn69pZknyX9xMAkD9/screenshot_2263_.png)

In this screenshot, I'm standing on the rooftop of a building near the market. The market is the structure in the center of the picture. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUYbEEH3JKmhTiXsdZA7S2WsNqjGBuvjueXxWPGySevDz/screenshot_2690_.png)

Here you can see some decorative wagons, pots, and flowers near the market.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcqbRQ3wh2twmXgVvgPvSbEPb4in7WQeCQeBxsAjRswLW/screenshot_2692_.png)

This is yet another scene from the interior of a villa I introduced much earlier in the post.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf4awciFpgqztb7oqCTeBH9jnSnb8WHVZbZSXeZURpXEn/screenshot_2437_.png)

Nothing special here, just another corner of the city.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNeKD8o9y5amGNLYyQKHwCf4ZKpjZB2wanGiL2abZxkNx/screenshot_2438_.png)

The same here ...

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmessJzm2SNEc8Tcup5nHiGNLgADApcVFtc3U3RcsseoPx/screenshot_2251_.png)

... and here ...

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPdjVDFA4oe71i51jfNZpwqHrgnj9cuDkcQGaRktmnUjm/screenshot_2645_.png)

... here as well.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQnqAYejeCNw8BJqUWFvjf4BMKLxv5HokaN6m76CF7CJM/screenshot_2582_.png)

A lovely postcard from the slum.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZYK1xDiYAiz7PedhbnLoFs28xmFNdzJ9YkzS62vG85gS/screenshot_2232_.png)

This last screenshot shows the loading screen I had to watch for about 30 seconds upon entering the city.

title.title: [ENG/ESP] A busy Friday that ended on a high note with some great plans
title.body: > **Greetings. Today I’m going to enjoy a well-deserved rest—the kind you feel you’ve truly earned with every fiber of your being—and I sincerely hope you can treat yourselves to a moment of calm as well. I wish you a wonderful day, filled with little joys and those breaks that do us so much good. Among the things I want to do this weekend is find a gift for my husband, my life partner, whose birthday is coming up soon. I want that day to be special, for him to feel how much I value him and how grateful I am that we walk together through every day, every challenge, and every sunrise. That’s why I tried this Friday to leave no work undone and to avoid any unexpected events that might disrupt my plans. This past Friday took us back to the Unik hotel to carry out our work routine. Everything seemed to be going as usual, but just as we were arriving, we received a call from Sunsol Ecoland; they were having issues with one of the filters. It could have been left for the next day, but since I already had plans for my weekend, I told them that, once I finished my routine at the Unik, I would go check on the situation. Luckily, the weather was great—one of those clear days that lift your spirits and make any trip feel lighter. So, with the enthusiasm that always drives us, we carried out the tank chlorination and disinfection routine and checked the levels.**

> *Saludos. Hoy disfrutaré de un merecido descanso, uno de esos que se sienten ganados con el alma y el cuerpo, y espero sinceramente que ustedes también puedan regalarse un momento de calma. Les deseo un día maravilloso, lleno de pequeñas alegrías y de esas pausas que tanto bien hacen. Entre las cosas que quiero hacer este fin de semana está buscar un regalo para mi esposo, mi compañero de vida, que pronto estará cumpliendo años. Quiero que ese día sea especial, que sienta cuánto lo valoro y lo agradecida que estoy por caminar juntos en cada jornada, en cada reto y en cada amanecer. Por eso traté este viernes de no dejar ningún trabajo pendiente y de evitar cualquier imprevisto que pudiera alterar mis planes. Este viernes que recién culminó nos llevó nuevamente al hotel Unik para cumplir con nuestra rutina de trabajo. Todo parecía avanzar con normalidad, pero justo cuando estábamos llegando recibimos una llamada del Sunsol Ecoland; presentaban problemas con uno de los filtros. Podía dejarse para el día siguiente, pero como ya tenía planes para mi fin de semana, les comuniqué que, una vez terminada mi rutina en el Unik, iría a revisar la situación. Por suerte el clima estaba genial, de esos días claros que animan el espíritu y hacen más ligero cualquier recorrido. Así que, con el entusiasmo que siempre nos acompaña, realizamos la rutina de cloración y desinfección del tanque, verificamos los niveles.*
![photo_2026-05-30_00-54-08.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpnCrpys1AC2opMen8xKpEeERyE5ZFJo2nofLcUJ7QUaKUq7HZyJchNHZpjnrU8D92U.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-30_00-54-07.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eq5E2JpEkh2LUkit7N5E3ydNEYfzwuZR3e7kBxQeWCmpAZBhLX5L2mvPG3qJMzTvcdP.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-30_00-54-06.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EptbztYUktvzkFfgPYUpPsS3rPt7wqi2xDtBXQJoMYbYAQ4HuieLorHySXejEwNz7Er.jpg) ![z.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/23wC7rQcNMrVjP3f5oy9F85dRqofnqpxLQ4jTZzA4ms4bWrHix544181pU4Vd8uKDCnSq.jpg)

> **When we were done, we headed to the town of Gómez to address the issue with the filter. As we passed through Santa Ana, we saw that they were working on beautifying their streets. It’s something I deeply love about that area; they’re always doing something to improve their spaces, to keep the place’s identity alive. You can feel that dedication, you can breathe it in, and it brightens the journey.**

> *Al terminar, salimos rumbo al municipio Gómez para atender el problema del filtro. Al pasar por Santa Ana vimos que estaban trabajando en embellecer sus calles. Es algo que amo profundamente de esa zona; siempre están haciendo algo para mejorar sus espacios, para mantener viva la identidad del lugar. Esa dedicación se siente, se respira, y alegra el camino.*
![photo_2026-05-30_00-55-00.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Ep7ubWFyXHV6uzDuKMvwhxkmNDhDfdnAyfzZL8V7LhetUnBwP7Sre1oTrL761JYLJbS.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-30_00-54-55.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpNoM2czGPQRUZXAsANjBMek2Q29dzewLwQU9n56pGX8Rj3W7cSPm8Z6m5B2GJRKUAt.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-30_00-54-53.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqBcFqZH56aVjmY9ipcBVkcRuYepHmwomCqKzAcxY397F8Urzjk2eo4aztVdtFsL1pg.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-30_00-54-43.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EowEagYLXsPer8AZrWkRk8aAgqaN2mwQcgqSTH4n4H811ck7yx5N25HkDTz7V7d4wEp.jpg) ![a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpC9yKHQPf1wVeFY59ywkuU4mgta9qmJvjjs1ZMDRpm6zPTDWm4mZk1xwi1CbmNAfXA.jpg)

> **When we arrived at the hotel, the quality manager greeted us and took us to the area near the kitchen, where the affected filter was located. At first glance, everything looked fine, but one of the pipes wasn’t letting any water out, which confirmed that the filter was completely clogged. It was the result of a series of events that had been overlooked during the week—something quite common, considering that the water comes from the desalination plant and often carries solids that clog the filter media.**

> *Al llegar al hotel nos recibió el gerente de calidad y nos llevó al área cercana a la cocina, donde se encontraba el filtro afectado. A simple vista todo parecía perfecto, pero una de las tuberías no dejaba salir agua, lo que nos dio la certeza de que el filtro estaba completamente tapado. Era el resultado de una cadena de sucesos que habían pasado por alto durante la semana, algo muy normal considerando que el agua proviene de la desalinizadora y suele arrastrar sólidos que saturan la carga filtrante.*
![photo_2026-05-30_00-54-42.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpCBMN3pLNBD9arAtGEwBqawbJ3bm714dT2idTi6YjB6RWmKww1eVHa9rCMGrTyCcEY.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-30_00-54-42 (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eq5E4N3vNEVj22pLxXgRrYQd4yesCMPLxBXegVnPSsjy5xW1jRoa9wA9LEzacdXYwPh.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-30_00-54-11.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eq7LtUGXNfBoBxMFDpknBeb64PfNnDHZJeqmXKbpSJeRtzevNX57PUwU5Cwr9ZLSZi3.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-30_00-54-10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqWkiVTS8JH3FooK2aKSY7NVzW9KwgyNDu1FekNuCjW36j6qp1kmjxMmtgNmV8y5LzW.jpg)

> **The truth is that quite a bit of accumulated debris was removed, but with patience and experience, we were able to resolve the issue that had been worrying them since early in the morning. When the water started flowing again at the right pressure and with the desired quality, we left the hotel satisfied that we had done our job.**

> *La verdad es que se le extrajo bastante material acumulado, pero con paciencia y experiencia pudimos dar solución a la problemática que los tenía preocupados desde temprano. Cuando el agua volvió a salir con la presión adecuada y la calidad deseada, nos retiramos del hotel con la satisfacción de haber cumplido.*
![photo_2026-05-30_00-54-11 (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpviKQ5n6TR2RqjMBXef4gFGJSQkXoHg3pTtnZzJg27yScgKtG8GCSMSbyvMdTcF2Zt.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-30_00-54-09.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Ep5n9PAkWX3Kr4RvD5AV6HTwqCV92HdAs2QrcZn3PZ7Bfg4aQmPZ5nQPCwNnJZSDrwP.jpg)

> **We headed back home through Santa Ana and Tacarigua, two areas I always enjoy driving through. I love how picturesque the place is, and how the residents take such good care to keep everything painted, clean, and tidy. They take deep pride in their town, and that’s something that truly deserves to be appreciated.**

> *Tomamos el camino de regreso a casa atravesando Santa Ana y Tacarigua, dos zonas que siempre disfruto recorrer. Me encanta lo pintoresco del lugar, cómo sus habitantes se ocupan de mantener todo pintado, limpio y arreglado. Sienten un orgullo profundo por su municipio, y es algo que realmente merece ser valorado.*
![photo_2026-05-30_00-55-02.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eou8dGMDDu2shsr12wsUBodqmj2857vZTMkF3EMHCxSXxfqnHVV5GXXZv3NikbTwAwg.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-30_00-54-41.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqQPXnd8xXPpK3cu3Pyp7rbN3S6Ky6ZKCYnA9e4sAEVCojZZEXdeyzqUSfYSDheiBCN.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-30_00-54-32.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Ep1XKZYWhWJRJeqzDB83sCd9AanyGddpv6wrw51Qez5k3oaceZ5Y7kRBdQt2d6Nu2UG.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-30_00-54-31.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqL8o8gjhPSCwEhQwGBnonLxYE15vYjry1QWP1W4G8reUohdh45Jcvg8aU5J3EPQNEy.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-30_00-54-30.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eptb4KByJ2hWxWfW21foAkHxZKK8AyNhb3SVPji7Sf1WsnYrhRtoZTG9FDJpxwvN4hW.jpg) ![z (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpNotA4KbUdRpRmvNz3pTVVpnvhXhBr5X7V9nJ4qwxxyzm6j72zb26Qoq83L1kdXrP9.jpg) ![y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EokebocowxKtrAT58J1bs1XXoYRbWmn81PKRRioX2auT9ydfAAkQCxqqBiGgy2u32CK.jpg) ![a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqSWy4BWBzPdW3Wt3oA4asWJqkQJKU2xRCr5W6uFNdFEPV3rRyMZFD9s1DkxTcWQQDh.jpg)

> **Between beautiful walks and the sense of a job well done, we wrapped up a week that was a bit intense. Our coworker was sick, so my husband and I had to take on all the responsibilities. Even so, I’m grateful to have the health and strength to get every task done. And that’s how our work week ended. I’ll see you soon in another post, where I’ll share another little glimpse into our daily lives. See you soon. Bye.**

> *Entre caminos hermosos y la sensación del deber cumplido, cerramos una semana que fue un poco intensa. Nuestro compañero de trabajo estuvo enfermo y mi esposo y yo tuvimos que asumir todos los compromisos. Aun así, agradezco tener salud y fuerza para cumplir con cada tarea. Así concluyó nuestra semana de trabajo. Los veré pronto en otra de mis publicaciones, para contarles otro pedacito de nuestro día a día.   Hasta pronto. Chao.*
https://images.ecency.com/DQmX41osuLQUYYCyZK8X9Bw9HS64BTvn2S2qu3uWyowNJd4/la_laguna_tania5_copia.png

Just another lesson on the crypto-learning!

title.title: Practicando estructura de datos con C++
title.body:
Hoy estuve platicando nuevo con c++ y quería probar algo que suele utilizar mucho en javascript que normalmente lo llamaba mouse objetos pero es una estructura de datos que permite almacenar información a través de una clave y su valor.
Today I was talking to C++ again and wanted to try something that I usually use a lot in JavaScript, which I normally called mouse objects, but it's a data structure that allows you to store information through a key and its value.
![person.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmV4QGBS5Gd5XyyyS1MdPm5MofePTJHSimT3dLPotsVFu9/person.png) Programar con c++ se ve divertido porque todavía no he realizado cosas muy complejas por momentos solo es practicar algoritmos y algunos bucles probar ideas propias familiarizarme con el lenguaje y tratar de no olvidarme el punto y coma al final de cada expresión.
Programming with C++ seems fun because I haven't done very complex things yet; at times it's just practicing algorithms and some loops, trying out my own ideas, familiarizing myself with the language, and trying not to forget the semicolon at the end of each expression.
![person2.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQJet3cbiNG8ieQ1dFwYmNqwCnokYSZVPJ4PJvoe4JctA/person2.png) Este simple algoritmo que realice permite que a través de la terminal se ingrese el nombre y la edad y se vayan agregando dentro de un vector cada uno hasta la cantidad que se necesita porque luego se imprime por consola el nombre y el valor de cada ítem dentro del vector lo podré haber hecho de manera indefinida y más adelante imprimirlo pero no quería rebuscarme mucho por el momento quería familiarizarme más con practicarlo para asimilar cómo trabajar con el lenguaje de programación.
This simple algorithm I created allows you to enter a name and age through the terminal, and then add each item to a vector until the required amount is reached. The name and value of each item in the vector are then printed to the console. I could have done this indefinitely and printed it later, but I didn't want to overcomplicate things for now. I wanted to familiarize myself with it by practicing and learning how to work with the programming language.

title.body:
## Hello everyone!!! 
### I hope so you all are fine and happy 😃

I'm not saying here that i always speak truth, sometimes I've to hide something from someone and I've speak a lie and mostly a white lie just to protect the feeling of others. I know speaking truth Hits different but sometimes we've to speak a white lie. I usually speak a white lie sometimes to family and sometimes to students.

I give them proper handwriting homework, they do it too because some of them really want to improve it and at that time i mostly appreciate them that you guy's did a good work, although the work they done wasn't even good or better but i said to them you did well and at that time i know I'm speaking a pure white lie which maybe they understand too. But, i always took a benefit from this like when i appreciate them and said them you did well and they feel happy too that on next day they try their better to work more better to improve their writing as they also know that still they need an improvement. But if i shout on them then students will never do it in better way because it's just the matter of handwriting and you can do your paper too with normal handwriting. > But in the case of giving back assessment test and class test i never speak a white lie as i always speak them truth that you need more hardwork. ### A white lie to family!!! We often do celebration in the family but if someone isn't willing to celebrate her birthday or anniversary then we plan a surprise party for them and that time the person for which we arrange a party asked to us what's going on in the house and we're like nothing just a regular day. That person got some clues but i make them satisfied that nothing is happening just like you think and that's a sweet lie. At the moment when we reveal the party and obviously that person feel happy but she's like why you guy's hide it from me and at that time i always think that maybe we should tell her too but then at that time i also know that if i speak a truth to her than she cancelled the planned because she hasn't any trust in this but we just make it a memorable day. ### Final thought's!!! Believe me whenever i speak a white lie, i always think to tell them a pure truth but then there's something which doesn't allow me to do so. Actually sometimes to make someone's happy and to cheers the appreciate we could do that. > That's all for today and it's my entry in this week hive learner contest in #hl-exclusive for the topic #hl-w219e3. > Thank you for your time and support 🙏

title.title: True engagement on the Hive blockchain: comment, upvote and repeat it all
title.body:
I believe that true engagement on the Hive blockchain implies few ingredients when it comes to interacting with the content from our feeds or that we explore around: comment, upvote and repeat. The interactions between us should be meaningful in order to create relations and that doesn't just happen through upvotes (even if this is a great appreciation gesture), but also in leaving a comment or reply in case we find the content intriguing, information, something we resonate with or just something useful. And sometimes I like to achieve this routine and it leaves me with a warm and positive feeling that I simply also care about it and put the little effort it requires to do so.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/behiver/23yJQmEpmrJ7W7dMd7Z45XqS8ms3R9jp5MvpYRJKi51dkZG33seqQqXQG5knHNLykSE7o.png)

Nowadays I am using the [HivePulse](https://hivepulse.app) app to view my account operations and as I got a little bit of time on my hand I did a round of 7 interactions in the form of comment & upvote. It is not bad for finding good content that I like and engage with it. And probably I could do this more often by setting a routing out of it, but sometimes the lack of time is denying me to engage in this form. I think that anything helps, even if we do just one action or the other. This type of interactions is what helps the Hive blockchain to stay alive and incentivize people to stay around here or come back after some time. Making others feel good in this ecosystem is of upmost important as when that's achieved it might be a user for life (hope Hive will recover from where it is now and prove itself in time.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/behiver/23swbiP3op2wmMJdoekqqknVy3Zi4QtUK3YmWEs8sUKVFGCcjPcmtf9zdSxtboTtGo8fX.png)

### If only we could be consistent
Besides these engagement, one other thing that I find very important is to be consistent. We don't need to spend hours every single day in order to make a difference (we probably don't even have enough time anyhow), but being present from time to time and interacting genuinely with others can build strong connections organically. I observed that some of the people that constantly support and communicate with others are also the ones that create the most welcoming atmosphere around them. I do this for others and I feel that I get back same warm and genuine interactions and appreciation. Probably what I like the most about Hive are the people behind the screens with which I engage and the communities that are formed through these small but repeated interactions and common hobbies or interests.

### Motivation and inspiration can come from within
There are moments when a simple comment can brighten someone's day or motivate them to continue creating content. It happened to me and it can happen to others as well. Sometimes creators go through periods when inspiration is low or when engagement drops during bearish markets and receiving thoughtful feedback can make a big difference. This is why I believe that every meaningful interaction contributes to the health of the ecosystem and helps maintain the human touch of Hive and keep it alive and active. And sometimes we find treasures of information or things of interest that can bring us advantage before others.

I don't see the true engagement on Hive as something complicated, but rather as something that requires a bit of effort and engagement from all of us. Commenting, upvoting and making genuine interactions are simple actions that can strengthen the entire blockchain over time and us as communities. If more users would adopt this mindset, I think Hive could become not only a stronger platform, but also a more connected and supportive environment for everyone involved. And I feel that this creates great opportunities in the form of building projects while already having communities and people supporting us. And we should make the most of this!

Hello everyone..have a nice day to you all.. we live on an island called guimaras island... Guimaras used to be a part of iloilo, but on may 22 1992 if officially separated from iloilo and became a province with its own local government.. this is why the manggahan festival is celebrated in the month of may as it also mark that the province independence... The entire province cover five municipalities. Jordan,buenavista, san lorenzo, sibunag and nueva valencia.. even though guimaras is already separated from iloilo but most college students still study there.. even though there are already college here in guimaras almost everyone still chooses to study at the big universities in iloilo.. as for the mode of transportation, there are roro or (roll on roll off)for the vessels, while fiber boats are used for people..

We are week **465 of the BEER and fun challenge** and it is time for you to join the beery fun. ![](https://i.imgur.com/d7bSzo0.jpg) (C) by pixabay and modified by @detlev for #beersaturday Each week we call everyone worldwide to show us some of their favourite beer and their stories about that beer. --- # ![](https://images.hive.blog/100x0/https://i.imgur.com/2wCKc4z.png) The Weekly BeerSaturday Challenge ### The Challenge It's very simple: **share YOUR STORY about one of your favourite beer.** This is your chance to blog about **beer**, earn tokens, and why not use them to buy another beer for the next challenge. ### The Prizes **This week, we will give away 14 HIVE - 16 BEER - 5 ATX - 4 LEO - 500 Ecency POINTS** You may also get some upvotes from us and our sponsors on your posts and comments as a bonus! Here is how our tokens will be distributed: ||HIVE|BEER|LEO|POINTS|ATX| |:-----------------: |:-----: |-|-|-|-| |Prize 1|6 HIVE|7 BEER|2 LEO|250 POINTS|3 ATX| |Prize 2|5 HIVE|5 BEER|1 LEO|250 POINTS|1 ATX| |Prize 3|3 HIVE|3 BEER|1 LEO| |0,7 ATX| |Prize 4| |1 BEER| | |0,3 ATX| _Prizes are drawn at random and each participant can only win one prize per week._ ### The Rules **1**. Create a post about on the beer topic Your post must : * contain at least **3 pictures** related to **beer** (feel free to add more) * contain a **story about beer** with **200+ words** * use the Hashtag **#BeerSaturday** **2**. Add a **comment onto this post** with the **link of your new post**. ***Remarks:*** - You may post on any day of the week - You can publish more than one post - The challenge ends on Thursday midnight UTC - Winnter will be announced on Friday. It's all about **quality content** and boosting this #BeerSaturday Challenge. --- ### ![](https://images.hive.blog/80x0/https://i.imgur.com/Zw8hCGo.png) Mention and invite a friend Add the following line to your message, but replace @username with the name of one of your friends. > This is #BeerSaturday week and I would like to invite @username to write a post in any language about beer with at least 3 pictures. We know you can handle this job as well as **reblog** this weekly post ;-) ## ![](https://images.hive.blog/80x0/https://i.imgur.com/u7CqWo0.png) The BEER community Yes, we have a great beer community on Hive with around **2956 members**.
